explanations: 在直角三角形XYZ中tan Z=YX/XZ=cot Y。在直角三角形YXW中cot Y=YW/XW=652/489。因此tan Z=652/489=4/3。选A

question: A parabola in the xy-plane has a vertex of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>19</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. The equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mi>a</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi></math> represents this parabola, where a, b, and c are positive integer constants. What is greatest possible value of b ?
explanations: 顶点的x坐标为-b/(2(-a))=b/2a。因此b/2a=1，即b=2a。将点(1, 19)带入方程得到19=-a+b+c。将b=2a带入得到19=a+c。因为a，b，和c是正整数，所以a可能取到的最大值为18。即b可能取到的最大值为36.

question:
The following text is from the 1996 novel Desert Birds by Elena Ruiz.
A young girl is sitting in a room with her grandmother, Teresa, whose old rocking chair had previously been kept on the porch. The girl took comfort in the mere presence of the chair in the room. Comfort in its movement. It was faded by years in the sun and bent by occasional rain, and only in the last few months had Teresa decided to bring it inside with the family.
©1996 by Elena Ruiz.

As used in the text, what does the phrase “mere presence of the chair” most nearly refer to?
selections: A. The chair’s relative simplicity compared with the rest of the furniture
B. The simple fact of the chair’s existence
C. The chair’s lack of appeal to the rest of the family
D. The idea that the chair is unnoticeable
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文本来自埃琳娜·鲁伊斯1996年的小说《沙漠之鸟》。一个小女孩和她的祖母特蕾莎坐在一个房间里，祖母那把旧的摇椅之前一直放在门廊上。女孩从这把椅子仅仅存在于房间里就获得了安慰。从它的摇动中获得安慰。它因多年日晒而褪色，被偶尔的雨水淋弯，直到最近几个月特蕾莎才决定把它搬进屋里，和家人放在一起。
答案解析
“Mere presence of the chair” 指的是椅子仅仅存在这一事实本身，即不需要椅子做什么、不需要它好看或有用，只要它在房间里，女孩就能感到安慰。选项 B “The simple fact of the chair’s existence”（椅子存在的这个简单事实）最准确地表达了这一含义。

question:
The Cuban Revolution (1953–1959) was followed by a period of flourishing literary production, with writers such as Nicolás Guillén contributing to the_______ of poetry, fiction, essays, and more. Unfortunately, this flood of interesting writing has diverted scholarly attention from the equally fascinating work of nineteenth-century figures like Gertrudis Gómez de Avellaneda.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
古巴革命（1953–1959）之后，文学创作进入了一个繁荣时期，尼古拉斯·吉伦等作家为诗歌、小说、散文等作品的_______做出了贡献。不幸的是，这股有趣的写作洪流将学术界的注意力从十九世纪同样引人入胜的作品（如格特鲁迪斯·戈麦斯·德·阿韦利亚内达的作品）上转移开了。
答案解析
B.abundance（丰富、大量） 最符合逻辑。第一句描述革命后文学创作的“繁荣时期”（flourishing），需要填入一个表示“大量产出”的词。后文的“flood”（洪流）也呼应了这一含义。其他选项：A. overturning（推翻）、C. erasure（抹除）、D. underappreciation（未被充分欣赏）均与“繁荣时期的文学产出”这一语境不符。

question:
The following text is from Frances Burney’s 1784 satirical play The Busy Salon. Clara, Lady Venom, and Edward Fairman are discussing their mutual acquaintance Lord Arthur Sharp.
CLARA: [Lord Arthur] has done nothing—but his talk is a perpetual slander on all his acquaintances.
FAIRMAN: Aye, and the worst of it is there is no advantage in not knowing him, for he’ll abuse a stranger just as soon as his closest friend—and [his cousin] is as bad.
LADY VENOM: Nay, but we should make allowance. Lord Arthur is a wit and a poet.
CLARA: For my part—I admit, madam—wit loses its respect with me when I see it in company with malice. What say you, Mr. Fairman?
FAIRMAN: Certainly, madam, to smile at the jest that leaves a wound in another’s heart is to become a principal in the mischief.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It illustrates and expands on one character’s definition of a term that was discussed earlier in the text.
B. It appears to offer an explanation for the behavior of the character who is the topic of conversation in the text.
C. It contrasts the point of view of one character with that of another through the use of figurative language.
D. It presents a position that seems to support the stance of one character and undermine that of another.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
以下文本选自弗朗西斯·伯尼1784年的讽刺剧《忙碌沙龙》。克拉拉、维纳姆夫人和爱德华·费尔曼正在谈论他们共同的熟人阿瑟·夏普勋爵。
克拉拉说：“（阿瑟勋爵）什么也没做——但他的谈话是对所有熟人的永久诽谤。”
费尔曼说：“是的，最糟糕的是，不认识他也没有好处，因为他会像辱骂最亲密的朋友一样辱骂一个陌生人——而且（他的表兄）也一样坏。”
维纳姆夫人说：“不，我们应该体谅一下。阿瑟勋爵是个才子和诗人。”
克拉拉说：“就我而言——我承认，夫人——当我看到才智与恶意同行时，它在我心中就失去了敬意。你怎么看，费尔曼先生？”
费尔曼说：“当然，夫人，对一个在他人心中留下伤口的笑话微笑，就是在伤害中成为主犯。”
答案解析：
画线句是Venom女士为Lord Arthur的负面行为（不断诋毁他人）所做的辩解，她以“他是个才子和诗人”为由，主张大家应该对他多加包容。因此，这句话的功能是为对话中正在被讨论的这个角色的行为提供一种可能的解释，对应选项B。

question:
In the 1980s, Australian diners initially______major fast-food chains from the United States. However, marketing strategies such as free soft drinks and low prices gradually drew in customers looking for convenient meals. By the late 1990s, public opinion had changed as fast food shifted from a debated novelty to a familiar part of Australia’s dining culture.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
20世纪80年代，澳大利亚的食客最初______来自美国的主要快餐连锁店。然而，免费软饮料和低价等营销策略逐渐吸引了寻求便捷餐食的顾客。到90年代末，随着快餐从一种备受争议的新奇事物转变为澳大利亚餐饮文化中熟悉的一部分，公众舆论已经发生了改变。
答案解析
B. resisted（抵制） 最符合逻辑。第一句与第二句的“However”（然而）构成转折关系：最初是负面态度（抵制），后来因营销策略而逐渐被吸引。

question:
Solar physicists studying the Sun have identified an important________between magnetically active and relatively quiet regions. In active regions, bursts of ultraviolet light usually come before substantial decreases in magnetic energy, whereas in quiet regions, ultraviolet light intensity and magnetic energy remain continuously correlated without notable energy drops.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
分析太阳的天文学家发现了磁活跃区与宁静区之间的一个重要______。在活跃区，紫外光爆发通常先于磁能的显著下降；而在宁静区，紫外光强度与磁能之间存在持续的关联，没有显著的能量下降。
答案解析：
正确答案是 B。文本描述了活跃区与宁静区在行为模式上的明显不同（一个先爆发后下降，一个持续关联）。这种对比突出了两者之间的“差异”或“区别”。disparity（差异，不同）最准确地表达了这种对立关系。其他选项：trade-off（权衡，取舍）、interaction（相互作用）、analogy（类比，相似性）均不符合语境。

question:
First published in 1920, Edith Wharton’s The Age of Innocence takes place in New York in the 1870s. In one scene, Newland Archer goes to the opera. The narrator portrays Archer’s social circle as valuing the familiar more than the new:_____

Which quotation from The Age of Innocence most effectively supports the claim?
selections: A. “It surprised [Newland] that life should be going on in the old way when his own reactions to it had so completely changed.”

B. “Though there was already talk... of a new Opera House which should compete in costliness and splendour with those of the great European capitals, the world of fashion was still content to reassemble every winter in the shabby red and gold boxes of the sociable old Academy [of Music in New York].”
C. “Newland Archer, leaning against the wall at the back of the club box [where his seat was], turned his eyes from the stage and scanned the opposite side of the house.”
D. “But, in the first place, New York was a metropolis, and perfectly aware that in metropolises it was ‘not the thing’ to arrive early at the opera.”
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
伊迪丝·华顿的《纯真年代》于1920年首次出版，故事背景设定在19世纪70年代的纽约。在其中一幕场景中，纽兰·阿切尔去听歌剧。叙述者将阿切尔所处的社交圈描绘为重视熟悉事物胜于新鲜事物：______
答案解析：
正确答案是 B。该引文指出尽管有关于新建更华丽歌剧院的话题，时尚界仍然满足于每年冬天在破旧的旧音乐学院剧场中重聚，这直接体现了该社交圈“重视熟悉事物胜过新鲜事物”的特点。A表达的是纽兰内心变化与外部世界的反差，C描述的是纽兰在剧场的动作，D讨论的是纽约作为大都市在歌剧院到场的礼仪习惯，均未支持题干中的观点。

question:
Division of labor is a system in which the work of making a product is split among different people who each specialize in a particular task. Rather than having one person make the entire product, workers concentrate on just one stage of production. In a backpack factory, for example, some workers might cut the fabric, others sew the pieces together, and still others attach the zippers. Workers become more skilled at their individual tasks and save time because they do not have to switch between different kinds of work. This system has played an important role in increasing the amount of goods that can be produced in modern economies.

What is the main focus of the text?
selections: A. How factories prepare new employees for their work
B. The history of the zipper
C. How division of labor improves efficiency
D. The future of the backpack industry
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
劳动分工是一种将产品制造的工作分解给不同的人、每人专注于一项特定任务的系统。与其让一个人制造整个产品，不如让工人们专注于生产的某一个阶段。例如，在一个背包工厂中，一些工人可能负责裁剪布料，另一些负责将部件缝在一起，还有一些负责安装拉链。工人们在自己的单项任务上变得更加熟练，并且由于不必在不同工作之间切换而节省了时间。这一系统在提高现代经济中的商品产量方面发挥了重要作用。
答案解析：
正确答案是 C（劳动分工如何提高效率）。文本解释了劳动分工的定义（分解任务、工人专注于单一阶段），并说明了其带来的好处（熟练、节省时间、增加产量），因此核心关注点是“劳动分工如何提高效率”。

question:
The following text is adapted from Beatrix Potter’s 1913 story Winter at Pine Hollow.
The Mole has just been found by a companion after wandering in the forest. Snow is beginning to fall. The Mole looked at the wood that had seemed so frightening to him and saw it in a very different way. Holes, dips, puddles, traps, and other dangers to a traveler were quickly disappearing, and a bright blanket was spreading everywhere, looking too delicate for heavy feet to step on.

Which choice most accurately expresses the main idea of the text?
selections: A. The Mole prefers warm, dry weather to cold, snowy weather.
B. As the ground becomes covered in snow, the landscape no longer appears dangerous to the Mole.
C. After being found by his companion, the Mole feels embarrassed about getting lost.
D. The Mole is saddened that his time wandering in the forest has ended.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
以下文本改编自毕翠克丝·波特1913年的故事《松树谷的冬天》。
鼹鼠在森林里游荡后刚被一位同伴找到。此时雪开始飘落。鼹鼠看着那片曾经让他感到十分恐惧的树林，现在却以全然不同的眼光看待它。坑洞、洼地、水坑、陷阱以及其他对旅行者来说的危险正迅速消失，一张明亮的毯子正在各处铺展开来，看起来太过精致，不忍让沉重的脚步踏上去。
答案解析：
正确答案是 B（随着地面被雪覆盖，景色对鼹鼠来说不再显得危险）。文本指出鼹鼠曾觉得树林很可怕，但随着雪掩盖了各种危险（坑洞、陷阱等），他现在以不同的眼光看待它，即不再感到危险。

question:
Maya Elena Ruiz and colleagues conducted a study comparing musicians and nonmusicians in the volume, measured in decibels (dB), that they preferred when listening to various audio recordings, including solo piano pieces, symphonic works, and ocean sounds. The musicians, who reported far greater lifetime noise exposure than the nonmusicians, generally listened to the recordings at higher volumes than the nonmusicians did. The two groups had clinically similar hearing, however, suggesting that although a musician’s preferred volume for a favorite recording might be 84.8 dB and a nonmusician’s might be 65.9 dB, this difference____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. indicates that the musician is unlikely to listen to a nonfavorite recording at a higher volume than the nonmusician would.
B. shows that both the musician and the nonmusician have lower hearing ability than would be expected of clinically typical individuals with typical levels of lifetime noise exposure.
C. does not arise from the musician having a clinically significant reduction in hearing ability as a result of lifetime noise exposure.
D. cannot be explained as resulting from the musician’s relatively greater musical expertise.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
Maya Elena Ruiz及其同事进行了一项研究，比较音乐家和非音乐家在聆听各种录音（包括钢琴独奏、交响乐和海洋声音）时偏好的音量（以分贝为单位）。音乐家报告的终生噪音暴露量远高于非音乐家，听录音时普遍选择更高的音量。然而，两组的临床听力状况相似，这表明尽管音乐家偏好的音量可能是84.8分贝而非音乐家是65.9分贝，但这种差异______。
答案解析：
正确答案是C。文本指出两组临床听力相似，但音乐家噪音暴露量更高，说明音量偏好差异并非由听力能力显著下降导致。C直接表达这一逻辑：差异并非源于音乐家因终生噪音暴露而在临床上出现显著的听力下降。A引入“不喜欢的录音”，无依据；B与“临床听力相似”矛盾；D讨论“音乐专业水平”，文本未涉及。

question:
A group of public transit specialists in Portland is planning a new streetcar stop for the Burnside Corridor Streetcar line that will serve a neighborhood that currently has no stop. To determine where to place the stop, the group is relying on a survey from ten years ago that asked how far neighborhood residents would be willing to walk to reach a streetcar stop. The group also reviewed studies showing that people’s willingness to walk to public transit is affected by factors such as weather and the presence of well-enforced low speed limits for cars. A researcher has argued that the survey does not accurately reflect the views of people who live in this neighborhood today.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researcher’s claim?
selections: A. There has been a sharp increase in the last ten years in the number of cyclists using roads in the neighborhood that the streetcar stop will serve.
B. Residents of Portland are much less likely to use public transit on rainy days than on clear days.
C. The enforcement of posted speed limits in the neighborhood that the streetcar stop will serve has increased substantially in the last ten years.
D. Current riders of the Burnside Corridor Streetcar are satisfied with the number of stops along the line.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
波特兰的一群公共交通专家正计划为伯恩赛德走廊有轨电车线新增一个站点，服务于目前没有车站的社区。为确定站点位置，专家组依赖一项十年前关于居民愿意步行多远去车站的调查，还查阅了研究表明步行意愿受天气、低速限严格执法等因素影响。有研究者指出，该调查并不能准确反映如今该社区居民的看法。
答案解析：
正确答案是 C，因为研究表明低限速严格执法会提升步行意愿，而过去十年该社区限速执法力度大幅加强，改变了影响步行意愿的关键条件，说明十年前调查结果已不适用于现在，直接支持研究者的主张。A与步行意愿无直接关系；B关于雨天出行意愿与社区具体条件无关；D讨论的是现有乘客满意度，而非步行意愿。

question:
In 1903, Mary Anderson patented a device that cleared rain and snow from a car’s windshield, improving visibility for drivers. In 1886, Josephine Cochrane invented a machine that washed dishes more efficiently, easing a time-consuming household task. Although designed to solve different problems, both inventions have had lasting effects. Likewise, both inventors exemplified important traits that continue to drive innovation: creative thinking, strong problem-solving skills, and persistence.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It lists some specific impacts that two older inventions have had on modern life.
B. It lists qualities that Anderson and Cochrane shared and that many inventors rely on.
C. It lists characteristics that the text says are frequently mentioned in studies of modern inventors.
D. It lists the features of Anderson’s and Cochrane’s inventions that contributed most to their usefulness.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
1903年，玛丽·安德森为一款能清除汽车挡风玻璃上雨雪、提高驾驶员能见度的装置申请了专利。1886年，约瑟芬·科克伦发明了一台能更高效洗碗、减轻一项耗时家务的机器。虽然两种发明旨在解决不同的问题，但都产生了持久的影响。同样，两位发明家都体现了继续推动创新的重要特质：创造性思维、强大的解决问题的能力和毅力。
答案解析：
划线部分列出了两位发明家共有的、并且继续推动创新的三种特质。选项 B“列出了安德森和科克伦共有的、并且许多发明家所依赖的品质”准确描述了这一功能。选项 A（具体影响）和 D（对发明实用性贡献最大的特征）说的是发明本身而非发明家的特质；选项 C（现代发明家研究中经常提到的特征）原文未提及。

question:
Because biofuels usually produce less carbon than fossil fuels, they can help reduce emissions. In California, biofuel producers have two sources of revenue: biofuel sales and LCFS (low carbon fuel standard) credits bought from them by companies whose fuel does not meet the state’s emissions standards. Considering how these revenue streams affect one another, Aylin Karaca et al. studied three models for how a biofuel company might maximize profit: the industry-standard heuristic model, a lexicographic model, and a model proposed by the researchers. They concluded that although their model maximized profit, it might not be the best option for firms that need to minimize cash outflows.

Which choice best describes the data in the table that support the researchers’ conclusion?
selections: A. Both the total revenue and the total profit for the lexicographic model are higher than those for the heuristic model but lower than those for the proposed model.
B. Although the proposed model’s total profit and LCFS revenue are close in value, the lexicographic model’s total profit is much greater than its LCFS revenue.

C. Although the proposed model projects the greatest total profit, it also projects a higher total cost than the lexicographic model, which has the same total cost as the heuristic model but a higher total profit.
D. The proposed model has the highest total revenue, LCFS revenue, and total cost among the three models.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
由于生物燃料通常比化石燃料产生的碳更少，因此它们有助于减少排放。在加利福尼亚州，生物燃料生产商有两个收入来源：生物燃料销售和低碳燃料标准（LCFS）信用额度（由未达到该州排放标准的燃料生产公司向他们购买）。考虑到这些收入流之间的相互影响，Aylin Karaca等人研究了生物燃料公司最大化利润的三种模型：行业标准的启发式模型、字典序模型以及研究人员提出的模型。他们得出结论：尽管他们提出的模型利润最大，但对于那些需要最小化现金流的公司来说，它可能不是最佳选择。
答案解析：
正确答案是 C。研究人员结论是“提出的模型利润最大，但对需要最小化现金流的公司可能不是最佳”。选项C指出提出模型利润最高但成本也更高（30,933,469美元），而字典序模型利润较高（10,470,340美元）且成本与启发式模型相同（30,528,134美元），这支持了“提出模型不适合需要最小化现金流公司”的结论。A只比较利润和收入未涉及成本；B错误声称提出模型利润与LCFS收入接近（实际相差很大）；D只列出各项最高值，未关联到“最小化现金流”的需求。

question:
More than 700 languages are spoken in New York City in addition to English—someone might hear Bengali in Kensington or Tibetan in Woodside. Most speakers of Chinese languages live in the neighborhood of Flushing (in New York City’s borough of Queens), where the dominant Chinese language is Mandarin, and in Chinatown, in the borough of Manhattan, where the dominant Chinese languages are Cantonese and Fuzhounese. Mandarin is widely spoken in northern China, whereas Cantonese and Fuzhounese are widely spoken in southern China. It can therefore be inferred that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. people who emigrate from northern China tend to settle in Flushing, while people who emigrate from southern China tend to settle in Chinatown.
B. Chinese immigrants who moved to New York City long ago are more likely to speak several Chinese languages than are more recent Chinese immigrants.
C. overall, there are more Cantonese and Fuzhounese speakers among Chinese immigrants in New York than there are Mandarin speakers.
D. Chinese immigrants regularly move between Queens and Manhattan after emigrating rather than remaining in one borough.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
纽约市除了英语外还有超过700种语言——有人在肯辛顿可能听到孟加拉语，在伍德赛德听到藏语。大多数讲汉语的人居住在皇后区法拉盛（以普通话为主）和曼哈顿唐人街（以粤语和福州话为主）。普通话在中国北方广泛使用，而粤语和福州话在中国南方广泛使用。因此可以推断出______。
答案解析：
正确答案是A，因为它根据语言与地域的对应关系（法拉盛以北方普通话为主，唐人街以南方粤语/福州话为主）合理推断：来自北方的人倾向于定居法拉盛，来自南方的人倾向于定居唐人街。B、C、D均无文本依据。

question:
Common chickweed is a weed found across North America. Although gardeners and farmers often consider common chickweed a nuisance, weeds like it can offer certain advantages. For instance, they may help reduce soil erosion.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Removing weeds is an enjoyable chore.
B. Some weeds can be useful.
C. Certain gardening methods can lead to more weeds.
D. North America is home to many plant species.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
普通繁缕是北美各地常见的一种杂草。尽管园丁和农民常视其为麻烦，但像这样的杂草也能提供某些好处。例如，它们可能有助于减少水土流失。
答案解析：
正确答案是 B（有些杂草可能是有用的）。文本虽然开头提到杂草被视为麻烦，但通过“Although”转折后重点强调其好处（如减少水土流失），因此主旨是某些杂草也有用处。

question:
Sellers and advertisers often use prices ending in 9 (for example, $7.99) to make items seem like a better value. In many cases, shoppers respond as intended, viewing such prices as signs of a discount or special offer. However, studies have found that some consumers connect these prices with lower-quality goods and even see them as misleading—an attempt to make a $7.99 item seem like it costs $7 rather than $8, which is closer to the truth.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It describes a contrast between how sellers want prices ending in 9 to be understood and how consumers generally understand them.
B. It points out unexpected ways some consumers interpret prices ending in 9, suggesting that this pricing strategy may not be effective in every case.
C. It explains the negative reactions to prices ending in 9 that have caused some businesses to change their pricing methods.
D. It identifies how consumers usually react to prices ending in 9 while acknowledging that some consumers react differently.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
卖家与广告商经常使用以9结尾的价格（例如7.99美元）来让商品看起来更划算。在许多情况下，购物者会如其所愿地做出反应，将这些价格视为折扣或特惠的标志。然而，研究发现，一些消费者将这些价格与质量较低的商品联系起来，甚至认为它们具有误导性——这是一种试图让7.99美元的商品看起来像是7美元而不是更接近真实价格的8美元的做法。
答案解析
划线句子指出，一些消费者将“以9结尾的价格”与低质量、误导性联系起来，这与前文“许多消费者视其为折扣/特惠”形成转折。选项 B“指出了消费者对以9结尾的价格的一些意想不到的解读方式，表明这种定价策略并非在所有情况下都有效”最准确。

question:
Originally introduced in 2017 and later optimized for faster object detection,_______compared with conventional detection methods.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. high accuracy and lower computational power requirements are achieved by the RetinaNet algorithm
B. the RetinaNet algorithm achieves high accuracy while requiring less computational power
C. less computational power is required for the RetinaNet algorithm to achieve high accuracy
D. high accuracy while requiring less computational power is the RetinaNet algorithm’s achievement
explanations: 考察逻辑主语一致。句首分词短语“Originally introduced...optimized”的逻辑主语必须是RetinaNet算法，因此选项应直接以“the RetinaNet algorithm”开头。

question:
The outer edge of the Sun’s magnetic reach is called the heliopause. This invisible border, which ______created by the solar wind (charged particles from the Sun) colliding with interstellar space, has been crossed by only two spacecraft: Voyage 1 and Voyage 2.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 考察主谓一致。主语“border”为单数，描述客观事实应用一般现在时，且“which”引导的定语从句与被动语态“is created by”搭配正确。

question:
Many poetry anthologies include only a single poem from each poet, but Asha K. Raman’s Echoes of Contemporary Verse includes generous selections from each poet. _______ Raman includes multiple poems by Olivia Chen and Marcus Redbird. This allows readers to engage with a wide range of each poet’s work.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
许多诗歌选集每位诗人只收录一首诗，但阿莎·K·拉曼的《当代诗歌回响》每位诗人都有大量选录。______拉曼收录了奥利维亚·陈和马库斯·雷德伯德的多首诗作。这让读者能够广泛接触每位诗人的作品。
答案解析：
正确答案是C（For example）。前句说该选集每位诗人有大量选录，后句以两位诗人为例具体说明“收录多首诗作”，构成典型的举例关系。A“In addition”表递进，B“Next”表时间或顺序，D“However”表转折，均不符合逻辑。

question:
Policy ______ archiveal labor-market data is essential to evaluating the effects of different employment laws. These long-term records allow scholars to compare countries’ labor conditions before a law is introduced with conditions that emerge years after enactment.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 正确答案是B（analysts' access to countries'）。此处需要名词所有格：“analysts”为复数（多位分析师），所有格用“analysts'”；“countries”为复数（多个国家），“劳动力市场数据”属于这些国家，故用“countries'”。

question:
Although most animals seek the protection of nighttime migration, many poisonous amphibians—a group that includes the Colorado River toad and the strawberry poison dart frog—move safely during the day. _____ with the sun overhead, the amphibians’ vivid color patterns warn visually oriented daytime predators of the animals’ toxicity.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
尽管大多数动物选择在夜间迁徙以获得保护，但许多有毒的两栖动物——包括科罗拉多河蟾蜍和草莓箭毒蛙——在白天也能安全移动。______当太阳高照时，这些两栖动物鲜艳的色彩图案会警告以视觉为导向的白天捕食者它们具有毒性。
答案解析：
正确答案是B（At that time，在那时/此时）。前句提到这些两栖动物在白天移动，后句进一步解释当太阳高照时它们鲜艳的体色如何警告捕食者，“At that time”指代前句的“during the day”，逻辑连贯。

question:
At dawn, while the air is still cool, the desert iguana rests in sunny places to warm itself. ______as the day becomes hotter, the desert iguana moves into shaded areas and under stones to avoid getting too warm.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
黎明时分，空气还很凉爽，沙漠鬣蜥会待在阳光充足的地方取暖。______随着白天变热，沙漠鬣蜥会转移到阴凉处和石头下以避免过热。
答案解析：
正确答案是C（Later，稍后/后来）。文本描述了不同时间的行为变化：先是在清晨阳光下取暖，之后随着气温升高转移到阴凉处。“Later”表示时间上的先后顺序。

question:
The widespread adoption of point-based judging in combat sports reflects a preference, shaped largely by Western traditions, for competitions that can be measured numerically. _______in traditional Muay Thai, judges treat a match as an unfolding story in which the meaning of any single exchange depends on the larger course of the bout—the winner being determined not by a point total of separate actions but by an overall evaluation of the fighters’ performances.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
selections: A. Partly because of that preference,
B. As one more example of that system,
C. By contrast with that model,
D. Designed with much the same purpose,
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
基于打分判罚在搏击运动中的广泛采用，反映出一种主要由西方传统塑造的偏好，即倾向于可以用数字衡量的比赛。________在传统泰拳中，裁判将比赛视为一个逐步展开的故事，任何一次攻防的意义都取决于整场比赛的大局——胜负不是由单个动作的累计分数决定，而是通过对选手表现的整体评估来判断。
答案解析：
正确答案是C（By contrast with that model）。前句描述西方传统偏好的“数字衡量”模式，后句描述传统泰拳的“整体故事”模式，两者形成鲜明对比，C项“与该模式相比”最符合逻辑。A“部分由于那种偏好”、B“作为该系统的另一个例子”、D“以几乎相同的目的设计”均不能表达对比关系。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·The CITYGREEN project examined different kinds of urban natural areas in cities across Europe.
·Urban natural areas are spaces in cities that include natural features.
·Home gardens were one type of urban natural area included in the project.
·Home gardens are private gardens on residential properties throughout a city.
·They can help cities by increasing plant species diversity.

The student wants to provide a specific example of one kind of urban natural area.Which choice most effectively uses re levant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The CITYGREEN project examined different kinds of urban natural areas, which are spaces in cities that include natural features.
B. Urban natural areas can help cities by increasing plant species diversity.
C. One specific example of a kind of urban natural area is home gardens, which are private gardens on residential properties throughout a city.
D. Spaces in cities that include natural features are called urban natural areas.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
在研究某个主题时，一名学生做了如下笔记：
CITYGREEN项目考察了欧洲城市中不同类型的城市自然区域。
城市自然区域是城市中包含自然元素的空间。
家庭花园是该项目考察的一种城市自然区域。
家庭花园是遍布城市的住宅地块上的私人花园。
它们可以通过增加植物物种多样性来帮助城市。
答案解析：
正确答案是C，因为它直接指出“家庭花园是一种城市自然区域的具体例子”，并给出了定义（遍布城市的住宅地块上的私人花园），完全符合题目要求。

question:
The Benny Beaver stuffed toy______a skeptical public when it was introduced in 1911 as a potential rival to the popular teddy bear. In fact, one columnist wrote that the toy’s appearance was “likely to give a baby [a] nightmare.”

Which choice completes the text so that it follows the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 考察时态。时间状语“in 1911”明确表示过去发生的动作，应用一般过去时。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·A nonnative species that causes environmental or economic harm when introduced to an ecosystem is considered invasive.
·Leafy spurge is an invasive species of flowering plant that crowds out livestock forage and native plants.
·It was first introduced to the US accidentally through polluted seed.
·Water hyacinth is an invasive species of aquatic plant that blocks sunlight and reduces oxygen levels in bodies of water.
·It was first introduced to the US as an ornamental plant.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between leafy spurge and water hyacinth.Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Water hyacinth is an invasive species that blocks sunlight and reduces oxygen levels in bodies of water, causing environmental harm.
B. Leafy spurge was first introduced accidentally through contaminated seed, but it now crowds out livestock forage and native plants.
C. The harm to ecosystems caused by water hyacinth and leafy spurge has led both species to be considered invasive in the US.
D. Leafy sp urge is an invasive species of aquatic plant, and water hyacinth was first introduced accidentally through contaminated seed.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
在研究某个主题时，一名学生做了如下笔记：
·当一种非本地物种被引入生态系统后造成环境或经济损害时，该物种被视为入侵物种。
·乳浆大戟是一种入侵性开花植物，会排挤牲畜饲料和本地植物。
·它最初是通过受污染的种子意外引入美国的。
·水葫芦是一种入侵性水生植物，会阻挡阳光并降低水体中的氧气含量。
·它最初是作为观赏植物引入美国的。
答案解析：
正确答案是 C，因为它明确指出两种植物都因对生态系统造成危害而被视为入侵物种，这是两者的核心共同点。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·Nandi Khumalo was a South African singer.
·The song “Thula Bane” appears on her 1962 album Nandi Khumalo.
·Nandi Khumalo features a mix of traditional South African and popular European and American songs.
·Her 1972 album Remember Me features mostly renditions of popular songs from European and American artists of the time, such as “Here Comes the Sun.”
·“Here Comes the Sun” was originally made popular by the English rock band the Beatles.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between “Thula Bane” and “Here Comes the Sun.”Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Nandi Khumalo’s 1962 album Nandi Khumalo features a mix of traditional South African and popular European and American songs.
B. Originally made popular by the Beatles, the song “Here Comes the Sun” appears on Nandi Khumalo’s album Remember Me.
C. The songs “Thula Bane” and “Here Comes the Sun” can both be found on albums recorded by the South African singer Nandi Khumalo.
D. Nandi Khumalo recorded many songs over her lifetime, including “Thula Bane,” which appears on her 1962 album Nandi Khumalo.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
在研究某个主题时，一名学生做了如下笔记：
Nandi Khumalo是一位南非歌手。
歌曲“Thula Bane”收录于她1962年的专辑《Nandi Khumalo》中。
《Nandi Khumalo》融合了传统南非歌曲与流行的欧美歌曲。
她1972年的专辑《Remember Me》主要翻唱当时欧美艺术家的流行歌曲，如“Here Comes the Sun”。
“Here Comes the Sun”最初由英国摇滚乐队披头士推广流行。
答案解析：
正确答案是C，因为它明确指出两首歌都可以在同一歌手Nandi Khumalo的专辑中找到，这是两者的直接共同点。A只提到专辑《Nandi Khumalo》的风格，未提及“Here Comes the Sun”；B只提到“Here Comes the Sun”出现在专辑《Remember Me》中，未提及“Thula Bane”；D只提到“Thula Bane”，完全没有涉及“Here Comes the Sun”。

question:
Although calling the handfish (family Brachionichthyidae) a “walking fish” might suggest an animal that has fully transitioned to life on land, the handfish’s unusual locomotion is actually a specialized adaptation for moving along the _______ the handfish’s modified pectoral fins function much like legs, enabling this distinctive marine predator to “walk” across the ocean bottom in the temperate waters it inhabit.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 考察句子连接，第一句话是：分句“While calling...terrestrial life”结束后，主句“the frogfish's unique locomotion...movement along the seafloor”；第二句话：“the frogfish's modified pectoral fins function similarly to legs也是一个独立的句子。句子之间连接用冒号

question:
The following text is adapted from the 1898 poem “Odina” by Emily Pauline Johnson, a Kanien'kehá: ka(Mohawk) writer also known as Tekahionwake.
I am Odina, I am she, the wife
Of him whose name breathes bravery and life
And courage to the tribe who calls him chief.
I am Odina, his white star, and he
Is land, and lake, and sky—and soul to me.

As used in the text, what does the word “breathes” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
以下文本改编自艾米丽·波琳·约翰逊（Emily Pauline Johnson）1898年的诗歌《奥迪娜》。她是一位卡尼恩克哈卡（莫霍克）作家，也以泰卡希昂瓦克（Tekahionwake）之名闻名。
我是奥迪娜，我就是她，是他的妻子——他的名字向尊他为首领的人民传递着勇气、生命与力量。我是奥迪娜，他明亮的星辰，他的大地、河流与天空——对我而言，他也是我的灵魂。
答案解析：
正确答案是 C（Imparts，传递/赋予）。诗中描述他的名字向人民“breathes”勇气、生命与力量，意为传递或赋予这些品质，使人民受到鼓舞。A“放弃”、B“吸收”、D“投降”均不符合语境。

question:
Many models predict that as temperatures rise, North American tree populations will spread northward into habitats that are becoming newly suitable. However, forest surveys indicate that many species, such as the bur oak (Quercus macrocarpa) and the lodgepole pine (Pinus contorta), are showing migration lag—that is, they are not establishing northern populations as predicted. Research suggests that this lag is connected to reduced diversity of essential fungal partners at the northern edges of the trees’ ranges, making successful northward expansion difficult.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It summarizes recent research findings, identifies a gap in current understanding, and then suggests future research to address that gap.
B. It introduces a scientific model, presents several predictions made using data generated by the model, and then provides further support for one prediction over the others.
C. It presents a scientific prediction, describes evidence that contradicts that prediction, and then offers an explanation for the contradiction.
D. It describes an environmental problem, discusses several attempted solutions, and then proposes a new solution.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
许多模型预测，随着气温上升，北美树木种群将向北扩散到新近变得适宜的栖息地。然而，森林调查表明，许多物种（如大果栎和扭叶松）正表现出迁移滞后——即它们并未如预测般建立北部种群。研究表明，这种滞后与这些树木分布区北部边缘必需的真菌伙伴多样性减少有关，这使得向北成功扩张变得困难。
答案解析：
正确答案是 C。文本结构为：先提出科学预测（树木将向北扩散），接着给出与之矛盾的证据（调查显示许多物种并未如预测建立北部种群），最后对这一矛盾提供解释（与北部边缘真菌伙伴多样性减少有关）。

question:
Text 1
Studies adding to the evidence that people generally enjoy socializing have often focused on interactions within ongoing relationships (from siblings to coworkers), but psychologist Lina Mercado and colleagues have shown the value of making connections with strangers. Participants in their study who warmly greeted a campus bus driver reported greater positive affect than those who didn’t speak to the driver.
Text 2
Research on social ties often relies on a model that places an individual within three concentric circles. The innermost circle contains one’s strongest ties (e.g., a beloved friend), the next contains close but less central ties (e.g., a classmate on a club team), and the outermost contains weak ties (those more distant but still important enough to count as part of one’s social network).

Based on the texts, what would Mercado and colleagues (Text 1) most likely say about the discussion of the model in Text 2?
selections: A. It reflects an overemphasis on relationship duration in researchers’ assessments of the relative importance of different connections in a person’s social network.
B. It highlights that most research on social interaction overlooks a kind of connection that can positively affect individuals’ well-being.
C. It emphasizes distinctions among types of close relationships that aren’t adequately represented in social-ties research, since most studies classify relationships as either close or casual.
D. It accounts for researchers’ observations that people usually expect interactions with familiar individuals to be more positive than interactions with unfamiliar individuals.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
文本1
支持人们通常喜欢社交的证据往往关注持续关系中的互动（从兄弟姐妹到同事），但心理学家Lina Mercado及其同事展示了与陌生人建立联系的价值。他们研究中的参与者热情地向校车司机打招呼，比起那些不与司机交谈的参与者，报告了更积极的情绪。
文本2
关于社会关系的研究常采用一种模型，将个体置于三个同心圆中。最内圈包含最强的联系（如挚友），下一圈包含较亲密但次要的联系（如社团队友），最外圈包含弱联系（更疏远但仍重要的社交关系）。
答案解析：
正确答案是 B。文本1强调与陌生人（车司机）的积极互动被忽视却有价值，而文本2的三圈模型只包含从强到弱的已知联系，未纳入真正的陌生人互动。B指出该模型忽视了那种能积极影响个体幸福感的联系类型，最符合Mercado等人的观点。A“过度强调关系持续时间”文本未提及；C指出模型对亲密关系区分不足，但文本1的重点是陌生人而非亲密关系的细分；D关于“熟悉与不熟悉互动的预期差异”文本1未涉及。

question:
A distinctive habitat at the boundary between surface water and groundwater in river corridors, a river’s hyporheic zone (HZ) can extend well beyond its banks: for a major river like the Mississippi, the HZ may reach as far as 300 meters from the main channel. Because it is difficult to access directly, scientists use ______ to assess the HZ—for example, by tracking aquatic organisms found in soil past a river’s banks.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
河流廊道中地表水与地下水交界处有一种独特栖息地，称为河流的潜流区（HZ），其范围可远超河岸：以密西西比河这样的大河为例，HZ可能延伸至主河道300米以外。由于难以直接进入，科学家使用______来评估HZ——例如，通过追踪在河岸以外土壤中发现的水生生物。
答案解析：
正确答案是 B（proxies，替代指标/代理指标）。由于无法直接测量，科学家使用间接的替代指标（如河岸外土壤中的水生生物）来评估HZ。“Proxies”在科学研究中指代间接测量或估计目标变量的替代物。A“参数”、C“模拟”、D“辅助人员/辅助物”均不符合“间接替代”这一核心含义。

question:
The dinosaur exhibits at museums such as the Field Museum in Chicago (which has a mounted Parasaurolophus skeleton among its collections) are notable for the _____ of the research behind them—the museum staff consulted numerous sources to ensure the accuracy of the displays.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
芝加哥菲尔德博物馆等博物馆的恐龙展品（馆藏中包括一具副栉龙骨架）以其背后研究的______而著称——博物馆工作人员查阅了大量资料以确保展品的准确性。
答案解析：
正确答案是 B（rigor，严谨/严格）。破折号后的内容说明工作人员查阅了大量资料以确保准确性，这体现了研究的“严谨性”。A“新颖性”、C“模糊/晦涩”、D“浅薄”均与“查阅大量资料确保准确性”这一逻辑不符。

question:
For brands of bottled iced tea sold in Australia, the mean line length—the number of products sharing a brand name—is 10.2, while for brands of cookies, the mean line length is 24.1. Elena Markovic and colleagues examined 203 months of economic data to investigate whether line length mediates the effects of economic expansions and contractions on brand equity (the value, manifesting as a price premium, that a brand has in consumers’ minds due to its perceived quality and other associations). They noted that it becomes more difficult for consumers to evaluate brand quality as line length increases and that consumers show high risk aversion during economic downsturns. Markovic and colleagues would thus expect that______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. brand-related price premiums for bottled iced tea will likely show less variation across economic contractions and expansions than such premiums for cookies will.
B. brands of bottled iced tea are more likely to increase their line lengths during economic contractions than brands of cookies are.
C. brand-related price premiums for bottled iced tea are more likely to be maintained during economic contractions than are such premiums for cookies.
D. brands of bottled iced tea will likely have higher brand equity than brands of cookies will during economic contractions but not during economic expansions.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
对于在澳大利亚销售的瓶装冰茶品牌，平均产品线长度（共享同一品牌名的产品数量）为10.2，而对于饼干品牌，平均产品线长度为24.1。Elena Marković及其同事研究了203个月的经济数据，以探究产品线长度是否在经济扩张和收缩对品牌资产（品牌因感知质量和其他关联而在消费者心中形成的价值，表现为价格溢价）的影响中起到中介作用。他们指出，随着产品线长度增加，消费者评估品牌质量变得更加困难，且消费者在经济衰退期间表现出较高的风险厌恶。因此，Marković及其同事预计______。
答案解析：
正确答案是 C。文本指出产品线越长，消费者评估品牌质量越难；经济衰退时消费者风险厌恶更高。饼干产品线更长（24.1），冰茶更短（10.2），因此冰茶的消费者评估质量更容易，在经济衰退时更可能维持价格溢价。C正确表达了这一点。A与逻辑相反；B讨论产品线长度的变化趋势，文本未涉及；D引入“经济扩张”的复杂比较，且逻辑不明确。

question:
To investigate how trees influence the chemistry of rainwater, a student consulted data collected during several precipitation events at sites in a temperate forest in the upper Midwest of the United States. The student considered three kinds of rainwater samples: regular (falling directly into a container), throughfall (passing through the tree canopy), and stemflow (running down branches and trunks). Noting that regular samples had average concentrations of 0.90 mg/L of dissolved organic carbon (DOC) and 0.19 mg/L of total dissolved nitrogen (TDN) across events, the student concluded that contact with trees changes the chemical composition of rainwater before it reaches the ground.

Which choice best explains how well the data in the table support the student’s conclusion?
selections: A. The differences between the average concentrations of DOC and TDN in the stemflow and throughfall samples and those reported for regular samples vary greatly across precipitation events, which calls the conclusion into question.
B. The average concentrations of DOC and TDN in the stemflow samples are higher than those in the throughfall samples, supporting the conclusion for only one kind of tree contact.
C. The average concentrations of DOC and TDN are higher in both the stemflow and throughfall samples than in the regular samples, which strongly supports the conclusion.

D. The average DOC concentrations are higher in the stemflow and throughfall samples than in the regular samples, whereas the average TDN concentrations are slightly lower than in the regular samples, which weakly supports the conclusion.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
为研究树木如何影响雨水化学组成，一名学生查阅了美国中西部北部温带森林多个降水事件中采集的数据。学生考虑了三种雨样：普通雨水（直接落入容器）、穿透雨（通过树冠）和树干径流（沿树枝和树干流下）。注意到普通雨水在各事件中平均DOC浓度为0.90 mg/L、平均TDN浓度为0.19 mg/L，学生得出结论：雨水在到达地面之前与树木的接触改变了其化学成分。
答案解析：
正确答案是C。表格中所有穿透雨和树干径流样本的DOC和TDN浓度均高于普通雨水样本，直接支持“与树木接触改变雨水化学成分”的结论。A错误，数据差异虽大但都高于普通雨水，并不削弱结论；B错误，两种接触方式都支持结论，并非只有一种；D错误，TDN浓度在两种样本中都高于（而非低于）普通雨水。

question:
“Golden Hours” by Clara J. Whitmore, published in the Chicago Evening Post in 1878, exemplifies the phenomenon of “fugitive verse,” poems reprinted in newspapers and other nineteenth-century US periodicals without authorial oversight or even, in many cases, knowledge. Though poems that became fugitive verse were typical of newspaper poetry of their era in their reliance on such elements as simple rhyme schemes and everyday settings, the phenomenon of fugitive verse represents a significant departure from the dominant model of literary authorship in which a work is controlled by a single and publicly identified author. This practice, however, was accepted as routine, even by the poets affected; that it has come to seem anomalous is indicative of the fact that _____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the authors of nineteenth-century newspaper poetry placed less value on artistic control than did their contemporaries who wrote other types of literature.
B. the concept of authorship and the happiness associated with the author’s role are mediated by the contexts within which works are written and published.
C. the notion that authors should have control over the reprinting of their works was a contested issue in nineteenth-century literary culture.
D. the literary characteristics of works disseminated through commercial venues are influenced by the circumstances of publication as well as by authorial choices.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
Clara J. Whitmore的《黄金时光》1878年发表于《芝加哥晚报》，是“流散诗作”现象的典型代表——这些诗作在未经作者监督甚至不知情的情况下被美国19世纪期刊转载。尽管这类诗作在简单韵律、日常场景等元素上与当时报纸诗歌并无二致，但“流散诗作”现象本身却显著背离了“作品由单一公开作者掌控”的主流文学作者模式。然而，这种作法在当时（甚至包括受影响的诗人）都被视为常规；如今它之所以显得反常，说明______。
答案解析：
正确答案是 B。文本核心论点是“作者身份及与之相关的观念受创作和发表语境影响”。“流散诗作”在当时被视为常规，如今却反常，说明关于作者控制的观念随语境变化而变化，B准确表达了这一逻辑。A说报纸诗歌作者比其他文学类型作者更不重视艺术控制，过度推断且无依据；C说“作者应控制作品转载”在当时有争议，但文本强调当时接受“无控制”是常规而非争议；D讨论文学特征受发表环境和作者选择影响，但未解释“当时接受、现在反常”的观念转变。

question:
Orbicella faveolata, a Caribbean coral with a boulder-like shape, and Pocillopora eydouxi, a coral from the Indian Ocean with branching clusters, are both stony corals—the type that builds reefs. Increasing stony coral colonies worldwide is a key objective for ecologists, since land-based runoff and other pressures are causing growing harm to reefs. In the wild, crustose coralline algae (CCA) promote growth in the healthy reefs they inhabit by releasing lipids and other metabolites—chemical cues that trigger coral larvae settlement. Biotechnology researcher Lina Haddad and team have developed a tool to restore those cues in damaged reefs: a gel coating infused with metabolites derived from Indian Ocean CCA. In tests with Porites lutea, an Indian Ocean stony coral, settlement rates rose substantially.

Which finding, if true, would best support a claim that the new tool already has the capacity to support the scope of the ecologists’ objective?
selections: A. The lipids and other metabolites derived from Indian Ocean CCA seem to remain stable for long periods under a variety of water temperatures and environmental conditions.

B. Exposure to lipids and other metabolites released by CCA from Indian Ocean reefs improves settlement rates for larvae of Orbicella faveolata and a variety of other coral species in regions outside the Indian Ocean.

C. In Indian Ocean reefs, higher concentrations of lipids and other metabolites released by local CCA are linked to larger colonies of Pocillopora eydouxi and greater overall diversity of coral species.

D. When CCA are present and releasing lipids and other metabolites, larvae settlement rates improve nearly as much in damaged reefs with Porites lutea as they do in healthy reefs containing that coral.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
Orbicella faveolata（一种形似巨石的加勒比珊瑚）和Pocillopora eydouxi（一种来自印度洋、呈分支状团簇的珊瑚）都属于石珊瑚——即造礁珊瑚类型。由于陆地径流及其他压力对珊瑚礁造成的危害日益严重，增加全球范围内的石珊瑚种群数量是生态学家的一个关键目标。在野外，珊瑚藻（CCA）通过释放脂质和其他代谢物（即诱导珊瑚幼虫定居的化学信号）来促进其所在健康珊瑚礁的生长。生物技术研究员Lina Haddad及其团队开发了一种工具来恢复受损珊瑚礁中的这些信号：一种注入来自印度洋CCA代谢物的凝胶涂层。在Porites lutea（一种印度洋石珊瑚）的测试中，定居率显著上升。
答案解析：
正确答案是 B。生态学家的目标是“增加全球范围内的石珊瑚种群数量”，新工具使用印度洋CCA的代谢物，在印度洋珊瑚Porites lutea上测试成功。B表明该工具对加勒比珊瑚Orbicella faveolata及印度洋以外多种其他珊瑚的幼虫定居率同样有效，直接证明其具备支持“全球范围”目标的能力。A讨论代谢物的稳定性，但稳定性不等于有效性；C讨论天然CCA与珊瑚群落的关联，未涉及工具；D局限于Porites lutea，未说明能否扩展到全球多种珊瑚。

question:
The Qimmiq, an Arctic breed believed to date to before Europeans arrived in the Americas, descends from a precontact dog population. The Qimmiq carries a haplotype (a group of genetic variants inherited together from one parent) absent in European dogs but present in Northeast Asian dogs, supporting the idea that precontact breeds in the Americas descend from dogs that accompanied human migration from Asia during the last ice age. The Dixie dingo, a tan-coated breed native to the rural Gulf Coast of the United States, offers additional support: living individuals carry haplotype B217, part of a haplotype group unique to Northeast Asian dogs. Many other precontact breeds, such as Canada’s Tahltan bear dog, disappeared through interbreeding with dogs brought from Europe.

Which finding, if true, would most directly undermine the underlined claim?
selections: A. Haplotype B217 is present in dog remains recovered in Northeast Asia and dating to before the emergence of the Dixie dingo.
B. The Dixie dingo carries some genes that are also common in the remains of European dogs from before Europeans arrived in the Americas.
C. Several modern Northeast Asian breeds were imported to the Gulf Coast of the United States in the 1900s, and the Dixie dingo’s recent ancestry may include individuals from these breeds.
D. Haplotype B217 is present in precontact remains recovered from Arctic North America, where the Qimmiq originated, as well as in remains from other regions outside the Gulf Coast.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
Qimmig是一种北极犬种，据信在欧洲人到达美洲之前就已存在，源自前接触时期的犬群。Qimmig携带一种在欧洲犬中不存在但在东北亚犬中存在的单倍型，这支持了“美洲前接触时期的犬种源于末次冰河时期随人类从亚洲迁徙而来的犬类”的观点。Dixie dingo是一种美国墨西哥湾沿岸乡村地区的黄褐色犬种，提供了进一步支持：活体个体携带单倍型B217，这是东北亚犬特有单倍型群的一部分。许多其他前接触时期犬种（如加拿大的Tahltan熊犬）通过与欧洲带来的犬杂交而消失。
答案解析：
正确答案是 C。划线部分称Dixie dingo为“前接触时期犬种”提供支持，因为它携带东北亚犬特有的单倍型B217。C指出Dixie dingo最近的血统可能包含20世纪才从东北亚进口到美国墨西哥湾沿岸的犬种，意味着B217可能来自近代引进而非古老的亚洲迁徙，从而削弱了它对“前接触时期犬种亚洲起源”的支持力度。A和D实际上提供支持，B提到欧洲犬基因但不直接削弱。

question:
Early television criticism in the 1970s and 1980s drew heavily on film studies, though media scholar Jane Feuer observed that concepts borrowed from that discipline often fell short when applied to television’s distinctive features. Recognizing those limits, researchers turned to approaches that considered home viewing environments, built-in commercials, and episodic storytelling, as well as to audience studies using ethnographic methods that highlighted viewer participation. By the 1990s, television studies had become a broadly established academic field, with scholars launching specialized journals.

Which choice best states the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It questions the extent to which the methodologies of film studies informed methodologies in the emerging field of television studies.
B. It implies that the development of television studies as a discipline was slowed by scholars’ early reluctance to accept that television and film have different characteristics.
C. It suggests that Feuer’s observations were the primary catalyst for the emergence of television studies as a formal academic field.
D. It introduces an expert opinion that establishes the impetus for a change in scholarly methods of studying television.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
20世纪70年代和80年代的早期电视分析深受电影研究的影响，但媒体学者霍勒斯·纽科姆指出，从该领域借用来的工具在应用于电视的独特特征时往往被证明是不足够的。认识到这一局限性后，研究人员转向了能够解释家庭观看环境、嵌入式广告和系列化叙事的方法，并将受众研究转向强调观众参与度的民族志方法。到了20世纪90年代，电视研究已成为一个广受认可的学术领域，学者们创办了专门的期刊。
答案解析：
正确答案是 C。划线部分引用了学者霍勒斯·纽科姆的观点，指出从电影研究借用的工具在应用于电视时存在不足。这一专家意见直接引出了后文中研究方法的转变（转向新方法、采用民族志方法等）。因此，它的作用是“引入了一个专家意见，为电视研究方法的变革确立了动力”。

question:
When trying to determine why an apartment’s circuit breaker has shut off, an electrician will usually ask tenants to _____ the devices that were in use when the electricity failed. This information is necessary so that the electrician can begin figuring out whether the continued outage is caused by a defective device or simply by too many devices running at the same time.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
在试图确定公寓断路器跳闸的原因时，电工通常会要求租户______断电时正在使用的设备。这些信息是必要的，以便电工能够开始判断持续停电是由设备故障引起，还是仅仅因为同时运行的设备太多。
答案解析：
正确答案是 B（itemize，逐项列出/详细列明）。电工需要知道断电时具体有哪些设备在使用，因此要求租户“逐项列出”这些设备。A“启动”、C“更换”、D“翻新”均不符合语境。

question:
In restaurant kitchen ventilation design and construction, engineers carefully balance incoming and outgoing airflow to______ negative pressure conditions. If the air pressure is lower in the kitchen than in nearby areas (that is, if there is negative pressure), fresh air will move from those areas into the kitchen, helping contain cooking odors and keep kitchen staff comfortable.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
在餐厅厨房通风设计和施工中，工程师谨慎平衡进出气流以______负压条件。如果厨房内的气压低于邻近区域（即存在负压），新鲜空气就会从那些区域流入厨房，有助于控制烹饪气味并保持厨房工作人员的舒适度。
答案解析：
正确答案是 B（create，创造/产生）。后文解释了负压的作用（让新鲜空气流入厨房以控制气味和保持舒适），说明工程师的目标是主动“制造”负压条件。A“估计”、C“防止”、D“忽略”均与后文逻辑矛盾。

question:
After showing that the power-conversion efficiency of newly developed perovskite solar cells is nearly the same as that of cells recycled several times, Meilin Zhou and colleagues calculated the levelized cost of electricity (LCOE)—the cost per unit of electricity generated, including both material-acquisition and operating expenses— for power plants using each type of cell. Assuming a 15-year cell lifetime, the LCOE for plants using new cells was 4.99 cents per kilowatt-hour, whereas the LCOE for plants using cells recycled three times was 4.05 cents per kilowatt-hour. Furthermore, when the assumed cell lifetime was reduced by two-thirds, the LCOE difference increased from 18.8% to 31.3%.

Based on the text, which choice, if true, best accounts for the observation presented in the underlined sentence?
selections: A. As the assumed cell lifetime decreases, plant operating costs increase, and thus the LCOE for plants using new cells diverges from that of plants using recycled cells.
B. Although recycling cells is less expensive than producing new ones, recycling still has costs, and thus shorter cell lifetimes lead to greater cumulative costs.
C. Obtaining materials for new cells is more expensive than recycling materials from old cells, and thus more frequent cell replacement results in a greater difference in total costs.
D. Cells can be recycled multiple times without a substantial drop in power-conversion efficiency, and thus recycling cells more frequently does not affect the LCOE for plants using recycled cells.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
在证明新研制的钙钛矿太阳能电池与新电池多次回收后的能量转换效率几乎相同之后，Meilin Zhou及其团队计算了使用每种电池的发电厂的平准化度电成本（LCOE，即每发电单位成本，包括材料采购和运营费用）。假设电池寿命为15年，使用新电池的电厂LCOE为每千瓦时4.99美分，而使用回收三次电池的电厂为4.05美分。此外，当假定电池寿命减少三分之二时，LCOE差异从18.8%增加到31.3%。
答案解析：
正确答案是 C。划线句子指出电池寿命缩短时LCOE差异增大。C说明新电池材料获取成本高于回收材料，因此更频繁地更换电池（寿命缩短意味着更频繁更换）会导致总成本差异更大，直接解释了这一现象。A提到“运营成本增加”，但LCOE差异增大主要源于材料成本差异而非运营成本；B强调回收仍有成本，但未解释为何差异会随寿命缩短而扩大；D强调回收不影响效率，但无法解释差异增大，反而可能削弱结论。

question:
Having found that object emojis generally have a negative effect when used in social media marketing, Anika Desai and team studied reactions to three versions of a bakery’s message about tea: one with a teacup emoji after the text (supplement), one with the emoji standing in for the word “tea” (substitute), and one with no emoji (control). Participants rated their openness to the content of the version of the message they saw, on a scale from 1 (not at all open) to 7 (very open). The team hypothesized that the general effect they’d previously observed would be reduced when an emoji replaces the word it represents.

Which choice best describes data from the graph that support the team’s hypothesis?
selections: A. The highest average rating for any of the three conditions was well below the maximum rating of 7.
B. The average rating for the control condition was higher than the average rating for the supplement condition.
C. The average rating for the substitute condition was higher than the average rating for the supplement condition.
D. The substitute condition and the control condition both received an average rating of about 4.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
研究发现物体表情符号在社交媒体营销中通常具有负面影响。Anika Desai团队研究了一家面包店三种茶信息版本的反应：文本后加茶杯表情符号（补充型）、用表情符号替代“茶”字（替代型）、无表情符号（对照组）。参与者对信息内容的接受度按1（完全不接受）到7（非常接受）评分。团队假设：当表情符号替代它所代表的词时，先前观察到的负面影响会减弱。
答案解析：
正确答案是 C。替代型平均评分（约4.1）高于补充型（约3.7），说明替代使用时负面影响减弱，直接支持假设。A只说明评分未达最高分，与假设无关；B显示对照高于补充，但假设核心是比较替代型与补充型；D说替代型与对照均约4，但对照实际约4.2，替代型约4.1，且未与补充型比较。

question:
The scientific team using the Prime Focus Spectrograph (PFS) to conduct a cosmological survey, which has produced one of the most detailed 3D maps of the cosmos to date, plans to observe roughly 45 million celestial objects. Mounted on a telescope in Chile,_____

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. this impressive instrument can measure 4,000 galaxies simultaneously, tracking how matter is distributed throughout the cosmos.
B. the distribution of matter throughout the cosmos is tracked by researchers using this impressive instrument that can measure 4,000 galaxies simultaneously.
C. 4,000 galaxies can be measured simultaneously by this impressive instrument, tracking how matter is distributed throughout the cosmos.
D. researchers track how matter is distributed throughout the cosmos with this impressive instrument that can measure 4,000 galaxies simultaneously.
explanations: 正确答案是 A。句首分词短语“Mounted on a telescope in Chile”的逻辑主语应是仪器本身（Prime Focus Spectrograph），因此选项应以“this impressive instrument”开头，符合语法和语义逻辑。

question:
The furnaces used in ancient China to produce glazed tiles reached heights of 150 feet and diameters of 24 feet. These massive structures were used to heat clay mixtures to temperatures of up to 230 degrees _____ such intense heat produced chemical effects that couldn’t occur with air-dried materials.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 考察句子连接，前后是两个句子，所以用分号隔开。

question:
Curator Elena Martínez organized the 2026 exhibition Hidden threads: Clara Wells’s Textile Archive at the Oregon Historical Museum in Portland with a twofold _____the achievements of Wells, an innovative early-20th-century textile historian, and highlighting the museum’s extensive fabric collection.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 正确答案是C（purpose: celebrating）。冒号用于引出对“双重目的”的具体解释，即两个并列的动作（celebrating...和highlighting...），结构清晰，符合标准英语用法。

question:
In recent years, the English poet Charlotte Smith (1749-1806), whose verse was widely read during her lifetime, has been rediscovered by contemporary audiences—a resurgence of interest that is largely due to literary scholars such as Elena Matthews, whose work ____ the richness of Smith’s poems and the poet’s historical importance to the Romantic literary movement encourages a broader rethinking of British Romanticism itself.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 考察非谓语，句子结构分析：“whose work”引导一个定语从句修饰“Elena Matthews”，在定语从句中，“work”是主语，谓语动词是“encourages”，因此“highlights”不能作为谓语，而应使用现在分词“highlighting”作定语修饰“work”，相当于“work that highlights”。

question:
According to period records, courtly entertainment—including cards, dice, and other games enjoyed in palaces and wealthy households—_____ primarily centered on strategic play that reflected social hierarchies. Trick-taking card games, with their ranked suits and formal rules, were especially fashionable during this era.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 考察主谓一致，正确答案是 C（was）。主语“courtly entertainment”为单数不可数名词，破折号之间的插入语不影响主谓一致，且描述历史事实应用一般过去时。

question:
While researching a topic, a student took the following notes:
·Late 1800s to early 1900s: Japanese manga (comics) typically used an orderly vertical format with four panels on each page.
·Late 1800s to late 1980s: Strongly influenced by manga, Taiwanese manhua (comics) also tended to use a structured layout.
·After 1945: Manga artists began experimenting with panels of different sizes to heighten visual tension (for example, by creating visual sight lines between a character in one panel and an object in the next).
·1947 to late 1980s: Taiwanese manhua artists adopted additional manga traits, such as genre features and greater narrative complexity.

The student wants to describe how Taiwanese manhua relates to manga from the late 1800s through the late 1980s.Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. From the late 1800s to the late 1980s, Taiwanese manhua increasingly broke away from manga by developing more innovative layouts.
B. Even though Taiwanese manhua did not always follow every development in manga during this period, it remained heavily influenced by manga.
C. From the time manga’s layout first started changing in the late 1800s until manga adopted dynamic panel sizing in the late 1980s, Taiwanese manhua kept a structured layout.
D. Although Taiwanese manhua artists initially rejected manga’s growing genre range and narrative complexity, they adopted those features in the early 1900s.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了如下笔记：
19世纪末至20世纪初：日本漫画通常采用规整的纵向格式，每页四个画格。
19世纪末至20世纪80年代末：受漫画强烈影响的台湾漫画也倾向于使用结构化布局。
1945年后：漫画艺术家开始尝试不同尺寸的画格以增强视觉张力（例如，在一个画格中的人物与下一个画格的物体之间建立视觉视线）。
1947年至20世纪80年代末：台湾漫画家吸收了漫画的其他特征，如类型元素和更强的叙事复杂性。
解析：
正确答案是B。笔记显示台湾漫画最初在布局上受漫画影响（使用结构化布局），后来虽然漫画发展了动态画格尺寸，但笔记并未记载台湾漫画采用这一特征，而记载了其采用其他特征（类型元素和叙事复杂性）。B准确概括了“并非每个发展都跟随，但仍深受影响”这一关系。A说台湾漫画“越来越脱离”与笔记不符；C忽略台湾漫画后期采用其他特征的事实；D说台湾漫画家“最初拒绝”类型和叙事复杂性，笔记未提及。

question:
A 1932 report by celebrated US track coach Lawson Robertson______ that the limits of human physiology ruled out a mile time under 4:01.6 was disproved by Roger Bannister’s sub-four minute mile in 1954—not to mention the fact that more than 2,000 runners have since matched Bannister’s feat.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 考察非谓语动词，句子主语是report, 谓语是was diproved; by引导的介词短语后面有一个现在分词短语修饰Lawson Robertson，相当于定语从句who had asserted that...

question:
Mark diSuvero’s steel sculpture Schubert Sonata is displayed at Millennium Park, an outdoor art space in Chicago. _____ it is exposed to rain, snow, heat, and humidity. Di Suvero’s sculpture is particularly well suited to withstand these conditions, though, because it is made of weathering steel.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
Mark di Suvero的钢雕《舒伯特奏鸣曲》展出于芝加哥的户外艺术空间千禧公园。______它会暴露于雨、雪、高温和湿气中。不过，di Suvero的雕塑特别适合承受这些条件，因为它由耐候钢制成。
答案解析：
正确答案是 B（There，在那里）。前句提到雕塑位于千禧公园，后句说明“在那里”它会暴露于各种天气条件下，“There”指代前句的“Millennium Park”，地理位置承接最自然。

question:
When ordering the branches of the Stikine River system, cartographers tend to begin with the riverway’s lowest point, the Stikine River. _____ hydrologists begin at the top of the river system, with the Tuya River and other tributaries fed by the riverway’s source, Tuya Lake.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
在排列斯蒂金河系的水系分支时，制图师倾向于从河道的最低点——斯蒂金河本身开始。______水文学家则从河系的顶部开始，从图亚湖（河道的源头）所补给的图亚河及其他支流入手。
答案解析：
正确答案是B（By contrast，相比之下）。制图师从“最低点”开始，而水文学家从“顶部/源头”开始，两者方法形成鲜明对比，因此“By contrast”最符合逻辑。

question:
Fragments of ceramic griddles have been uncovered across southeastern Anatolia, dating to the Chalcolithic Period. Molina et al. wanted to determine whether the use-wear patterns on the griddle fragments were consistent with the cooking of oil-rich flatbreads. _______ they cooked such flatbreads in reconstructed griddles and compared the use-wear patterns on the reconstructed tools with those on the fragments.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
在东南安纳托利亚地区发现了可追溯至铜石并用时代的陶瓷烤盘碎片。Molina等人希望确定这些烤盘碎片的磨损痕迹是否与烹饪富含油脂的扁面包一致。______他们用复原的烤盘烹饪了这种扁面包，并将复原工具上的磨损痕迹与碎片上的痕迹进行比较。
答案解析：
正确答案是B（To that end，为此）。前句说明研究目标是判断磨损痕迹是否与烹饪扁面包一致，后句描述为实现该目标所采取的具体方法（用复原烤盘烹饪并比较痕迹），因此“To that end”表示“为了这个目的”，逻辑连贯。A“Nevertheless”表转折，C“In other words”表换种说法，D“In addition”表递进，均不符合。

question:
Even though it is about 1,400 light-years from Earth, the star Mintaka is still one of the brightest stars visible in the night sky, ranking 31st. While not as bright as Mintaka, the star Merak also ranks among the 50 brightest stars, coming in 39th. _____ Merak’s brightness is probably explained by its relative closeness to Earth: Merak is only about 80 light-years away.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
尽管参宿三距离地球约1400光年，它仍是夜空中最亮的恒星之一，排名第31位。虽然不及参宿三明亮，北斗三也跻身50颗最亮恒星之列，位列第39。______北斗三的亮度可能由其相对接近地球来解释：北斗三距离仅约80光年。
答案解析：
前面讲不如Mintaka亮但是也是前50名，后面指出亮的具体原因其实是因为离地球近，indeed引出新信息，用于强调和对比。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·A 2023 investigation examined the facial expressions of wolves and domestic dogs.
·In the investigation, facial expressions were coded using 46 distinct facial actions.
·The “ears rotator” facial action is seen in wolves.
·Dog breeds with upright (wolf-like) ears can produce the “ears rotator” facial action.
·Dog breeds with drooped or partly drooped (non-wolf-like) ears cannot produce the “ears rotator” facial action.

The student wants to contrast dog breeds with wolf-like ears and dog breeds with non wolf-like ears.Which choice most effectively uses re levant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In a 2023 investigation, dog breeds with non-wolf-like ears were able to produce the same facial movements that wolves could.
B. Non-wolf-like ears are drooped or partly drooped, but wolf-like ears are different: they are upright and can produce the “ears rotator” facial action.
C. Like wolves, dog breeds with upright ears can produce the “ears rotator” facial action, while those with drooped or partly drooped ears cannot.
D. One difference between dog breeds with wolf-like ears and dog breeds without them is that wolf-like breeds cannot produce the “ears rotator” facial action.
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
在研究某个主题时，一名学生做了如下笔记：
2023年的一项调查分析了狼和家犬的面部表情。
调查中，面部表情使用46种不同的面部动作进行编码。
“耳部旋转”这一面部动作在狼身上可见。
具有直立（狼样）耳朵的犬种能够做出“耳部旋转”动作。
具有下垂或部分下垂（非狼样）耳朵的犬种不能做出“耳部旋转”动作。
答案解析：
正确答案是C。该选项明确指出：像狼一样，具有直立耳朵的犬种能做“耳部旋转”动作，而具有下垂或部分下垂耳朵的犬种不能，直接对比了两类犬种在“耳部旋转”动作上的差异。A错误地说非狼样耳朵犬种能做狼能做的动作；B只描述耳朵外形差异，未对比“耳部旋转”动作；D说反了事实，狼样犬种实际上能做该动作。

question: The table summarizes members of a local organization by age and whether they live north or south of Center St．If a member of the organization is selected at random，what is the probability that the selected member is at least 45 years old？
explanations: 题目指出是从整个组织中随机选取，因此总样本量是135人，题目要求的条件是这名成员“至少45岁”满足条件的人数是110人。因此概率为110/135。选D。

explanations: 题目已知宽 y = 9。将它代入给定的周长公式 58 = 2x + 2y 中： 58 = 2x + 2(9) ，解出x = 20

question: If<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn> 2</mn><msqrt><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></math>, what is the value of<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn> 30</mn><mi>x ?</mi></math>

question: The estimated fuel cost <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>C</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, in dollars, to drive a vehicle 100 kilometers is given by the function <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>C</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>0.0019</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mn>0.248</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>12.62</mn></math>, where x is the average speed, in kilometers per hour, of the vehicle. If the function C is graphed in the xy-plane, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>C</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, what is the best interpretation of the point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>60</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>4.58</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> on the graph?
selections: A. The estimated fuel cost to drive the vehicle at an average speed of 4,58 kilometers per hour increases by $60 each hour.
B. The estimated fuel cost to drive the vehicle at an average speed of 60 kilometers per hour increases by $4.58 each hour.
C. The estimated fuel cost to drive the vehicle 100 kilometers at an average speed of 4.58 kilometers per hour is $60.
D. The estimated fuel cost to drive the vehicle 100 kilometers at an average speed of 60 kilometers per hour is $4.58.
explanations: 由点(60, 4.58)得到x=60, C(x)=4.58。x表示平均速度，所以平均速度为60千米每小时。C(x)表示燃油费用，所以燃油费用为4.58美元。选D

question: The exponential function g is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mi>x</mi> </msup></math>, where a and b are positive constants. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>m</mi></math> and the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> is 62% more than the value of m, where c and m are constants, what is the value of b ?
explanations: 因为g(c+1)比m多62%，所以g(c+1)=(1+62%)m=1.62m。因为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mi>x</mi> </msup></math>所以 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mi>c</mi> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi> </mrow></math>且 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi>c</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>1</mn> </mrow> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mi>c</mi> </msup> <mo>⋅</mo> <mi>b</mi></math>。因此g(c+1)=mb。结合g(c+1)=1.62m，得到b=1.62。选C

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
The function f is defined by the given equation, where a and b are integer constants. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>39</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></math>, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>42</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo><</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo></math>, and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>45</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></math> , what is one possible value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi></math> ?
explanations:
函数f(x)的图像是一个开口向上的抛物线，且抛物线与x轴的两个交点为x=a和x=b。
因为f(39)>0(在x轴上方)且f(42)<0(在x轴下方)，所以函数在x=39和x=42之间一定穿过了x轴，这意味着其中一个根一定在x=39和x=42之间.同理因为f(42)<0且f(45)>0，所以函数在x=42和x=45之间有一个根。
假设a是较小的根，那么39<a<42且42<b<45。因为a和b是整数，所以a=40或41，b=43或44。因此a+b=83,84, 或85.

question: Two types of fish will be added to a pond: bluegill and largemouth bass. Based on ecological guidelines, the number of bluegill added to the pond will be 10 times the number of largemouth bass added to the pond. If a total of 1,870 fish will be added to the pond, how many of these will be largemouth bass?

explanations:
从图中取两个点(0, 7)和(5, 0)，则斜率为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow><mn>5</mn></mfrac></math>。设直线ℓ的斜率为m
,因为两条直线互相垂直，则 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>m</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>7</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></math>，解出m=5/7。因为直线ℓ经过点(0,4)，所以方程为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>5</mn><mn>7</mn></mfrac><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>，化简得-5x+7y=28。选A

question: The table shows three values of x and their corresponding values of y where n is a constant, for the linear relationship between x and y. What is the slope of the line that represents this relationship in the xy-plane?
explanations: 任取表中的两个点，比如(-5, n+53) 和(0, n)。斜率为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><msub><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><mrow><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>53</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>−</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>53</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac></math>选A

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>31</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
Which of the following are solutions to the given equation, where a is a constant and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo>></mo><mn>32</mn></math> ?
I. a
II. 31
III. 32
explanations: 如果 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>≠</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，将等式两边同时除以x-a得到1=x-31，解出x=32。如果x-a=0，即x=a，方程变为0=0，恒成立。因此x=32或a。选B

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>6</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mi>x</mi></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow></math>
The function f is defined by the given equation. For all values of x, the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> is greater than k, where k is a constant. What is the greatest possible value of k ?
explanations: 因为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo>/</mo></mrow><mn>6</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>x</mi></msup></math>的底数为正数，所以 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo>/</mo></mrow><mn>6</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>x</mi></msup><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></math>。因此 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo>/</mo></mrow><mn>6</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>x</mi></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo>></mo><mn>7</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>56</mn></math>。选C

question: The table gives three values of x and their corresponding values of y, where k is a positive constant. There is a linear relationship between x and y. Which equation represents this relationship?
explanations: 任取两个点(-5, 91+4k)和(5, 91)，斜率为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mn>91</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>91</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></mrow><mn>5</mn></mfrac></math>。因此直线方程为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>91</mn><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></mrow><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>。化简得2kx+5y=455+10k。选D

question: The height of a right circular cylinder is 21 inches, and the circumference of its base is 210 inches. Which expression represents the total surface area, in square inches, of the cylinder?
selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>21</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>210</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>+</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>π</mi> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mfrac> <mn>105</mn> <mi>π</mi> </mfrac> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>

B. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>21</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>210</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>+</mo> <mi>π</mi> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mfrac> <mn>105</mn> <mi>π</mi> </mfrac> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>

C. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>π</mi> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mfrac> <mn>105</mn> <mi>π</mi> </mfrac> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>21</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>

D. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>21</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>210</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
explanations: 设半径为r。底边周长为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>2</mn> <mi>π</mi> <mi>r</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>210</mn></math>，解出 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>r</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>105</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">Π</mi> </mfrac></math>。底面和顶面的面积和为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>2</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">Π</mi> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mfrac> <mn>105</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">Π</mi> </mfrac> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>。侧面面积为(21)(210)。所以总表面积为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mtext> (21) </mtext> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>210</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>+</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">Π</mi> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mfrac> <mn>105</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">Π</mi> </mfrac> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>，选A

question: To install flooring, a contractor charges $8.75 per square foot plus $100 for labor. If a kitchen floor is a square with the side length of 13 feet, what is the total, in dollars, that the contractor charges to install flooring in this kitchen?
explanations: 厨房地板的面积为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mn>13</mn> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>169</mn></math>平方英尺，所以费用为8.75(169)+100=1578.75，选D

question: How many solutions does the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>13</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>13</mn> <mi>x</mi></math> have?
explanations: 因为等式两边相同，所以等式对所有x都成立，因此有无穷多个解，选D

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnspacing="1em" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="3pt"><mtr><mtd><mn>20</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.6</mn><mi>r</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>0.8</mn><mi>s</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>160</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mn>70</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.8</mn><mi>r</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>0.6</mn><mi>s</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>420</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>
The solution to the given system of equations is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>s</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>r</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>s</mi></math> ?
explanations: 将等式一两边同时除以20得到0.6r-0.8s=-58，等式两边同时乘以0.6得到0.36r-0.48s=-34.8。将等式二两边同时除以70得到0.8r+0.6s=106，等式两边同时乘以0.8得到0.64r+0.48s=84.8。将两个化简后的等式相加得到r=50。将r=50带入0.64r+0.48s=84.8解出s=110。所以r+s=160

question: The line models the possible combinations of the number of boxes of cups, x, and the number of boxes of mugs, y, a company can purchase for a total price of $640. What is the price, in dollars, per box of cups?
explanations: 函数图像经过点(20, 0)，表示0盒马克杯，20盒纸杯。因此如果640美元全用来买纸杯，可以买20盒。所以没盒纸杯的价钱是640/20=32美元，选C

question: The function f is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6</mn></math>. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>a</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>+</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mi>a</mi></math>, what is the value of a ?
explanations: f(a)=4a-6。所以4a-6+1=3a，解出a=5。选B

question: When several resistors are connected in series in a circuit, the total resistance of the circuit is the sum of the resistances of these resistors. A certain circuit consists of 8 resistors connected in series, where the resistance of each resistor is positive. The total resistance of 3 resistors in this circuit is 70 ohms. Each of the other 5 resistors in this circuit has a resistance of at most 40 ohms. The total resistance of this circuit is x ohms. Which inequality best represents this situation?
explanations: 因为其中3个电阻的总电阻是70欧姆，另外5个电阻每个最大是40欧姆，所以总电阻最大是70+5(40)=270欧姆，即<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>270</mn></math>。因为每个电阻的阻值都是正的，所以70+5(0)<x。综上70<x≤270。选C

question: In the xy-plane, the graph of the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>36</mn></math> is a circle. The point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>12</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, where c is a constant, lies on this circle. What is the value of c ?
explanations: 带入点(12, c)得到 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>12</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>36</mn></math>，解出c=7
