explanations:
交叉相乘得到1(-x-1.25)=(x-1)(x-7)。左边展开得到：-x-1.25。
右边展开得到 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn></math>。将两边写在一起得到 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1.25</mn><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn></math>。移项转化为标准的一元二次方程得到 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>8.25</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>。因此 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>±</mo><msqrt><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi></msqrt></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>a</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>±</mo><msqrt><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>8.25</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></msqrt></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>7</mn><mo>±</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>5.5</mn><mtext>或</mtext><mn>1.5</mn></math>

question: A chemist combines water and isopropanol to make a mixture with a volume of 31 milliliters ( mL ). The volume of isopropanol in the mixture is 10 mL. What is the volume of water, in mL , in the mixture? (Assume that the volume of the mixture is the sum of the volumes of water and isopropano before they were mixed.)
explanations: 混合物的总体积为31毫升，异丙醇的体积为10毫升，所以水的体积为31-10=21毫升

question: The estimated fuel cost <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>C</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, in dollars, to drive a vehicle 100 kilometers is given by the function <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>C</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>0.0019</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mn>0.248</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>12.62</mn></math>, where x is the average speed, in kilometers per hour, of the vehicle. If the function C is graphed in the xy-plane, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>C</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, what is the best interpretation of the point (60, 4.58) on the graph?
selections: A. The estimated fuel cost to drive the vehicle at an average speed of 4.58 kilometers per hour increases by $60 each hour.
B. The estimated fuel cost to drive the vehicle at an average speed of 60 kilometers per hour increases by $4.58 each hour.
C. The estimated fuel cost to drive the vehicle 100 kilometers at an average speed of 4.58 kilometers per hour is $60.
D. The estimated fuel cost to drive the vehicle 100 kilometers at an average speed of 60 kilometers per hour is $4.58.
explanations: x表示速度，C(x)表示燃油费用，(60, 4.58)表示当速度为60千米每小时是，燃油费用为4.58。选D

question:
The scatterplot shows the relationship between two variables, x and y.
Which of the following equations is the most appropriate linear model for the data shown?
explanations: 从图中可以看出，随着横坐标x值的增加，纵坐标y的值也在增加，所以数据呈正相关，斜率为正数，排除A和B选项。在横坐标x=10附近，对应的数据点y值大约在10左右。在横坐标x=12附近，对应的数据点y值大约在12左右。如果是选项C y=x, 直线会穿过(10, 10), (12, 12)这些点。观察图形，这条线完美地从数据点的正中间穿过，非常贴合。如果是选项D y=2x，这意味着当x=6时，y是12，但在图中x-6附近没有这么高的点。所以不符合图中的数据分布。选C

question: A pet service that takes care of both cats and dogs can care for at most 31 animals. Which inequality represents this situation, where c is the number of cats and d is the number of dogs?
explanations: 机构照顾的动物总数是c+d，由最多31只得到c+d小于等于31。选A

question: The table summarizes members of a local organization by age and whether they live north or south of Center St. If a member of the organization is selected at random, what is the probability that the selected member is at least 45 years old?
explanations:
确定总样本数（分母）： 题目明确指出是从“该组织”中随机抽取，因此总人数需要看表格右下角的总计，即 135 人。
确定目标事件数（分子）： 条件是抽中“至少45岁”的成员。总数为 102 人 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtext>概率</mtext><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mtext>符合条件人数</mtext><mtext>总人数</mtext></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>102</mn><mn>135</mn></mfrac></math> ，选D

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>12</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>
How many distinct real solutions does the given equation have?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo>=</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>12</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></math> 。所以由两个实数解。选B

question: Line c is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>9</mn></math>. Line d is parallel to line c in the xy-plane. What is the slope of line d ?
explanations: 平行的直线有相同的斜率，直线c的斜率是2，所以直线d的斜率是2，选A

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>131</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mi>x</mi></math>
The function p shown gives the number of blank sheets of paper, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> , remaining in a printer x days after the printer had been loaded with paper. Which statement is the best interpretation of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>110</mn></math> ?
selections: A. There were 3 blank sheets of paper remaining in the printer 110 days after the printer had been loaded with paper.
B. The number of blank sheets of paper remaining in the printer decreased by a total of 3 sheets after 110 days.
C. There were 110 blank sheets of paper remaining in the printer 3 days after the printer had been loaded with paper.
D. The number of blank sheets of paper remaining in the printer decreased by a total of 110 sheets after 3 days.
explanations: x表示天数，p(x)表示剩余纸的张数，所以p(3)=110表示3天后剩余纸的张数为110。选C

question: The measure of angle Z is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>240</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo>∘</mo></mrow></msup></math>. What is the measure, in radians, of angle Z ?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtext>孤度</mtext><mo>=</mo><mtext>角度</mtext><mo>×</mo><mfrac><mi mathvariant="normal">Π</mi><mn>180</mn></mfrac></math> 。所以弧度为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>240</mn><mo>×</mo><mfrac><mi mathvariant="normal">Π</mi><mn>180</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>4</mn><mn>3</mn></mfrac><mi mathvariant="normal">Π</mi></math>。选B

question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>5</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>6</mn></math>, what is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>5</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>9</mn></math> ?
The ratio of the side length of square A to the side length of square B is 4 to 20 . Square A has a side length of 26 inches. What is the side length, in inches, of square B ?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mtext> 正方形 </mtext> <mi>A</mi> <mtext> 的边长 </mtext> </mrow> <mrow> <mtext> 正方形 </mtext> <mi>B</mi> <mtext> 的边长 </mtext> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>4</mn> <mn>20</mn> </mfrac></math> , 正方形A的边长为26，所以 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>26</mn> <mrow> <mtext> 正方形 </mtext> <mi>B</mi> <mtext> 的边长 </mtext> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>4</mn> <mn>20</mn> </mfrac></math> , 解出正方形B的边长为130

question: The length of a rectangle’s diagonal is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msqrt> <mn>34</mn> </msqrt></math>, and the length of one of the rectangle’s sides is 5 . What is the perimeter of the rectangle?
explanations: 设另一条边的长度为x，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <msup> <mn>5</mn> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <msqrt> <mn>34</mn> </msqrt> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math> 。解出x=3或-3。因为边长为正数，所以是3。周长为2(5+3)=16。选B

question: In a certain colony, one of the bees is a queen bee. Of the bees in this colony that are not the queen bee, 85% are worker bees, and the remaining bees are drones. If there are 11,109 drones in this colony, what is the total number of worker bees in this colony?
explanations: 设蜂群中除蜂王外的蜜蜂总数为x。则工蜂占85%，雄峰占15%，已知雄峰有11,109只，所以0.15x=11109，解得x=74060。工蜂数量为0.85×74060=62951。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
The function f is defined by the given equation, where a and b are integer constants. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>11</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></math> , <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>14</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo><</mo><mn>0</mn></math> , and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>17</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></math>, what is one possible value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi></math> ?
explanations:
函数 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mi>a</mi><mi>b</mi></math> 的图像是一个开口向上的抛物线，且与x轴的交点为x=a和x=b。
因为f(11)>0（在x轴上方）且f(14)<0（在x轴下方），所以函数在x=11和x=14之间一定穿过了x轴。因此其中一个根在11和14之间。同样因为f(14)<0且f(17)>0，另一个根一定在14和17之间。
设a为较小的根，b是较大的根。所以11<a<14，14<b<17。因为a和b是整数，所以a是12或13，b是15或16。a+b是12+15=27，12+16=28，13+15=28，或13+16=29。
因此可能的a+b的值为27， 28， 或29.

question: The exponential function g is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mi>x</mi> </msup></math>, where a and b are positive constants. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>m</mi></math> and the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> is 82% more than the value of m, where c and m are constants, what is the value of b ?
explanations: g(c+1)的值比m多82%，所以g(c+1)=m(1+0.82)=1.82m。因为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mi>x</mi> </msup></math>。所以 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mi>c</mi> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi> </mrow></math>， <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi>c</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>1</mn> </mrow> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mi>c</mi> </msup> <mo>⋅</mo> <mi>b</mi></math> 。因为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mi>c</mi> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mi>m</mi></math>，所以g(c+1)=mb。结合第一步中得到的g(c+1)=1.82m，得到mb=1.82m。解出b=1.82。选C

question: The table shows three values of x and their corresponding values of y, where n is a constant, for the linear relationship between x and y. What is the slope of the line that represents this relationship in the xy-plane?
explanations: 取两个点(-5, n+64),(0, n) <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtext>斜率</mtext><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><msub><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow><mrow><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>64</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>n</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>64</mn><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow></mfrac></math>。选A

question: A machine makes 2 -inch, 7 -inch, and 11 -inch parts. During a certain day, the number of 2 -inch parts that the machine makes is 5 times the number n of 7 -inch parts, and the number of 11 -inch parts is 4. During this day, the machine makes 100 parts total. Which equation represents this situation?
selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mi>n</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>+</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mi>n</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>11</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>100</mn></math>
explanations: 设 7 英寸零件数量为 n，则2英寸零件数量为5n，11英寸零件数量为4.根据总零件数为100，得方程5n+n+4=100，即6n+4=100。故正确选项为D。

question: During a trip, a car traveled a total of 510 miles on city roads and highways and used a total of 17 gallons of gas. The car traveled an average of 29 miles per gallon of gas on city roads and 35 miles per gallon of gas on highways. Which system of equations represents this situation, where c is the number of miles the car traveled on city roads and h is the number of miles the car traveled on highways?
explanations: 在城市道路上：汽车行驶29英里每加仑，汽车行驶c英里，所以消耗c/29加仑汽油。在高速上：汽车行驶35英里每加仑，汽车行驶h英里，所以消耗h/35加仑汽油。因为汽车一共行驶510英里，所以c+h=510。一共消耗17加仑汽油，所以(c/29)+(h/35)=17。选C

question: In the relationship between x and y, each increase of 1 in the value of x decreases the value of y by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>7</mn> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac></math>. When <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn></math> , <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>5</mn></math> . Which equation represents this relationship?
explanations: x增加1，y减少7/2，所以斜率为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </mrow> <mn>1</mn> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mn>7</mn> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac></math>。设函数为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mn>7</mn> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>b</mi></math>。带入x=-2和y=5，解出b=-2。所以 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mn>7</mn> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn></math>。选A

question: What is an equation of the graph shown, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> ?
explanations: 抛物线与x轴交于x=-1和x=4。所以二次函数的解为x=-1和x=4。因此f(x)=(x-(-1))(x-4)。化简后得到C

question: The function f is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>+</mo> <mn>2</mn></math>. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>a</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>7</mn></math>, what is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>a</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>3</mn></math> ?

An online store is offering two different discounts on its sweaters: a bulk discount for large orders and a coupon discount. For orders of n sweaters, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>10</mn> <mo><</mo> <mi>n</mi> <mo><</mo> <mn>50</mn></math>, a bulk discount of n% off the original price of $44 is applied to the price of each sweater. If a coupon is applied to the order, a discount of an additional $3 is applied to the price of each sweater, after the bulk discount is applied. For a certain order with both the bulk discount and the coupon discount applied, the total price after the discounts for the sweaters purchased was $834. How many sweaters were purchased in this order?
explanations: 单件毛衣的价钱是44，打完批量折扣之后的单价为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>44</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mi>n</mi> <mn>100</mn> </mfrac> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow></math>，使用优惠券后的单价为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>44</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mi>n</mi> <mn>100</mn> </mfrac> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mo>−</mo> <mn>3</mn></math>。总价为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>n</mi> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mn>44</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mi>n</mi> <mn>100</mn> </mfrac> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mo>−</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mo>=</mo> <mn>834</mn></math>。化简得到n(44-0.44n-3)=834,进一步化简得到n(41-0.44n)=834。带入选项得到C满足条件

question: An entomologist is studying the growth rate of various insect species in a controlled environment. For one particular species being studied in the controlled environment, an exponential model predicts that a population with an initial measurement of 8 organisms will increase by 160% every 24 days. Which equation represents this model, where y is the predicted number of organisms in the population x days since the initial measurement?
explanations:
指数函数的一般形式为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mi>t</mi> </msup></math>。这里的初始数量a=8。所以方程开头应该是8。四个选项都符合条件
增加160%意味着 新的数量=原数量(1+160%)。因此增长乘数为1+160%=2.6。所以指数的底必须是2.6，排除A和C
这种增长是每24天发生一次，如果已经过去了x天，那么一共经历了x/24个完整的24天周期，所以指数部分应该是x/24.选D

question: In the xy-plane, the graph of the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>10</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>4</mn></math> is a circle. The point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> , where c is a constant, lies on this circle. What is the value of c ?
explanations: 将点(4, c)带入圆方程得到：<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>10</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>4</mn></math>。解出c=10.

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnspacing="1em" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="3pt"><mtr><mtd><mi>y</mi><mo>></mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mi>y</mi><mo><</mo><mn>9</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>
In the given system of inequalities, k is a positive constant. Which of the following represents the x-coordinates of all the points <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> that satisfy this system in the xy plane?
explanations: 联立两个不等式得到2x+k<y<9-x。因此2x+k<9-x。两边同时加x得到3x+k<9。等式两边同时减去k得到3x<9-k。因此x<(9-k)/3。选D

question: The line models the possible combinations of the number of boxes of cups, x, and the number of boxes of mugs, y, a company can purchase for a total price of $880. What is the price, in dollars, per box of cups?
explanations: 直线与x轴的交点为x=20。所以当把钱全用来买纸杯，一个马克杯都不买的时候，880美元预算可以买20盒纸杯。因此每盒纸杯的价钱为880/20=44。选C

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>v</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mi>w</mi><mrow><mn>119</mn><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>
The given equation relates the distinct numbers v, w, and x. Which equation correctly expresses w in terms of v and x ?
explanations: 等式两边同时乘以119x得到119xv=-w。因此w=-119xv。选A。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>b</mi><mn>3</mn></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mn>16</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi></math>
In the given equation, b is a constant. The equation has infinitely many solutions. What is the value of b ?
explanations: 当一个方程有无数个解时，等式两边化简后必须完全相同。这样无论x取什么值，等式都永远成立。分配等式左边的括号外的3得到：3x+b-48=3x。想要等式两边完全相同，必须有b-48=0，即b=48

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnspacing="1em" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="3pt"><mtr><mtd><mn>40</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.6</mn><mi>r</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>0.8</mn><mi>s</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>320</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mn>70</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.8</mn><mi>r</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>0.6</mn><mi>s</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>420</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>
The solution to the given system of equations is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>s</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>r</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>s</mi></math> ?
explanations:
化简第一个方程：等式两边同时除以40得到：0.6r-0.8s=-108。等式两边同时乘以10得到：6r-8s=-1080
化简第二个方程：等式两边同时除以70得到：0.8r+0.6s=106。等式两边同时乘以10得到：8r+6s=1060
将第一个方程乘以6，第二个方程乘以8，相加得：(36r-48s)+(64r-48s)=-6480+8480。因此100r=2000，解出r=20。将r=20带入第二个方程得到s=150。因此r+s=170

question:
The scatterplot shows data set A.
Data set B is created by multiplying the y-value of each data point from data set A by 30 . Which of the following equations is the most appropriate model for data set B ?
explanations: 由图得到，指数函数的渐近线为y=0。所以数据A的模型为y=ab^x。数据B的模型为y=30ab^x。排除C和D选项。对于数据A，从图中可以看出，x=0是，y大约是5。因此对于数据B，当x=0时，y大约是150，选B

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnalign="right left" columnspacing="0em" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="3pt"><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd style="text-align: center;"><mn>12</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>11</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>c</mi></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd style="text-align: center;"><mn>11</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>12</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>c</mi></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>
In the given system of equations, c is a positive constant. Which of the following could be the point where the graphs of the equations in this system intersect in the xy-plane?
explanations: 因为两个方程的右边相同，所以左边也相同，得到12x+11y=11x-12y。化简得x= -23y。只有选项D满足要求。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>9</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>8</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mi>x</mi></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow></math>
The function f is defined by the given equation. For all values of x, the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> is greater than k, where k is a constant. What is the greatest possible value of k ?
explanations: 因为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>8</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mi>x</mi></msup><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></math>，所以 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>8</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mi>x</mi></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>></mo><mn>7</mn></math>，不等式两边同时乘以9得到f(x)>63。因此k的最大值为63。选C

question:
Note: Figure not drawn to scale.
In the figure, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>L</mi><mi>Q</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math> intersects <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>M</mi><mi>P</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math> at point R, and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>L</mi><mi>M</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math> is parallel to <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>P</mi><mi>Q</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math>. The lengths of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>M</mi><mi>R</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math>, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>L</mi><mi>R</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math>, and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>R</mi><mi>P</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math> are 9,10 , and 13 , respectively. What is the length of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>L</mi><mi>Q</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math> ?
explanations: 因为LM平行于PQ，所以角L等于角Q，角M等于角P，所以三角形LMR和三角形QPR相似。因此LR/QR=MR/PR。带入LR=10，MR=9，和PR=13，得到10/QR=9/13，解出QR=130/9。因此LQ=LR+QR=10+(130/9)=220/9。选D

question: A right square pyramid has a surface area of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>16</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mn>8</mn> <msqrt> <mn>293</mn> </msqrt></math> square inches, which includes a base area of 16 square inches. What is the height, in inches, of this pyramid?
explanations:
正四棱锥的底面是一个正方形。因为底面积为16，所以底面边长为4.
总表面积=侧面积+底面积，所以侧面积为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>16</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mn>8</mn> <msqrt> <mn>293</mn> </msqrt> <mo>−</mo> <mn>16</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>8</mn> <msqrt> <mn>293</mn> </msqrt></math>。因为正四棱锥的侧面是4个全等的等腰三角形，这些三角形的底边长为4，设三角形的高为x，则三角形的面积为1/2*4*x=2x。因此 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>4</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>8</mn> <msqrt> <mn>293</mn> </msqrt></math>。因此斜高 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>=</mo> <msqrt> <mn>293</mn> </msqrt></math>在正四棱锥的内部，四棱锥的高(h)，底面边长的一半(2)，和斜高 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msqrt> <mn>293</mn> </msqrt></math> 构成了一个直角三角形。因此 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>h</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <msup> <mn>2</mn> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <msqrt> <mn>293</mn> </msqrt> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>，解出h=17

question: The data value 16 was recorded in error and is removed from data set A to create data set B , which consists of the remaining 40 data values. Which statement best compares the median of data set A and the median of data set B ?
selections: A. The median of data set B is less than the median of data set A .
B. The median of data set B is equal to the median of data set A .
C. The median of data set B is greater than the median of data set A .
D. There is not enough information to compare the medians of the two data sets.
explanations:
对于数据集A，中位数的位置在41/2=20.5，即第20，21个数。因为数值0有1个（排第1），数值1有7个（排到8）， 数值2有8个（排到16），数值3有9个（排到25），所以第20，21个数为3
对于数据集B，中位数的位置在40/2=20，即第20个数。因为删掉的是最大的数。所以第20个数不变，还是3.
因此两个数据集的中位数相同，选B

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>51</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>51</mn><mi>b</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>a</mi><mi>b</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>
In the given equation, a and b are positive constants. The product of the solutions to the given equation is kab, where k is a constant. What is the value of k ?
explanations: 给定一元二次方程Ax^2+Bx+C=0，两根之积为C/A。因此ab/51=kab，两边同时除以ab得到k=1/51，选D

question: Which of the following expressions has a factor of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>b</mi></math>, where b is a positive integer constant?
explanations:
四个选项的二次项都是3x^2，因为一个因式为x+2b, 设另一个因式为3x+k。将两个因式相乘展开得到(x+2b)(3x+k)=3x^2+(k+6b)x+2bk。因为四个选项的常数项都是18b，所以2bk=18b，解出k=9。
因此x项的系数k+6b=9+6b。选项A：9+6b=9，解出b=0，不是正整数。选项B：9+6b=30，解出b=3.5，不是整数。选项C：9+6b=42，解出b=5.5，不是整数。选项D：9+6b=51，解出b=7。选D

question: In triangle XYZ, the measure of angle X is<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn> 90</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo>∘</mo></mrow></msup></math>. Point W lies on segment YZ, and segment WX is perpendicular to segment YZ. The length of segment WY is 588 , and the length of segment WX is 441 . What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>tan</mi><mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo><mi>Z</mi></math> ?
explanations: 在直角三角形XYZ中，WX为斜边YZ上的高。由射影定理WX² = WY × WZ，代入WX=441、WY=588得441² = 588 × WZ，解得WZ = 330.75。在直角三角形XWZ中，tan Z = WX / WZ = 441 / 330.75 = 4/3，故选D。

question: The mass of object A is 492% of the mass of object B , and the mass of object A is 0.820% of the mass of object C . If the mass of object C is p% of the mass of object B , what is the value of p ?
explanations: 设物体A，B。C的体积分别为a，b，和c。得到a=4.92b, a=0.0082c。因此 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>0.0082</mn> <mi>c</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mn>4.92</mn> <mi>b</mi> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mi>a</mi> <mi>a</mi> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mn>1</mn></math>解出c/b=600=60000%。因此p=60000。

question: A parabola in the xy-plane has a vertex of (1, 19). The equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mi>b</mi> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>c</mi></math> represents this parabola, where a,b, and c are positive integer constants. What is the greatest possible value of b ?
explanations: 由顶点坐标公式得顶点横坐标 1 = b/(2a)，即 b = 2a。代入纵坐标 19 = -a + b + c，得 19 = -a + 2a + c = a + c，故 c = 19 - a。要求 a、b、c 均为正整数，则 a 可取 1 到 18，b = 2a 最大为 36。因此 b 的最大可能值为 36。

question: The length of a rectangle's diagonal is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msqrt> <mn>65</mn> </msqrt></math> , and the length of one of the rectangle's sides is 4. What is the perimeter of the rectangle?
explanations: 设长方形另一条边的长度为x，由勾股定理，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <msup> <mn>4</mn> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <msqrt> <mn>65</mn> </msqrt> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>，解出x=7。所以长方形周长为2(7+4)=22，选B

question: A study established that in a certain park, there are at least 141 squirrels, consisting of red squirrels and gray squirrels. The study also established that there are at least 4 times as many gray squirrels as red squirrels in this park. Which of the following systems of inequalities best represents this situation, where g is the number of gray squirrels in this park and r is the number of red squirrels in this park?
explanations: 因为灰松鼠至少是红松鼠的4倍，所以g≥4r。松鼠总数至少是141，所以g+r≥141。选C

question: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle XYZ such that A, B, and C correspond to X, Y, and Z, respectively. The length of each side of triangle ABC is n times the length of its corresponding side in triangle XYZ, where n is an integer greater than 1 . The measure of angle C is 52 degrees, and YZ=71. Which of the following must be true?
selections: C. The measure of angle Z is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>52</mn><mi>n</mi></mfrac></math> degrees.
D. The measure of angle Z is 52n degrees.
explanations: 相似的三角形对应的角相等，因为角C对应角Z，所以角Z为52度。边YZ对应于边BC，且BC的长度是n乘以YZ的长度，所以BC=71n。选B

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>20</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>32</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>
What is the positive solution to the given equation?
explanations: 分解因式得(3x+4)(x-8)=0。因此x=-4/3或8，正数解为8

question: A right square prism has a height of 16 units. The volume of the prism is 144 cubic units. What is the length, in units, of an edge of the base?
explanations: 棱柱的体积为底面积乘以高，所以底面积*16=144，解出底面积为9.因为地面为正方形，所以底面边长为3，选A

question: In the relationship between variables x and y, each increase of 1 in the value of x decreases the value of y by 3 . When x=0 , y=2. Which equation represents this relationship?
explanations: 因为x每增加1，y减少3，所以斜率为−3/1=−3。因为当x=0时，y=2,所以y-2=-3(x-0)，化简得y=-3x+2。选C

question:

explanations: 设 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>u</mi><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>22</mn></msqrt></math>，则 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>u</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>u</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math>。即 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>u</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>u</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，分解因式得u(u-1)=0，因此u=0或u=1，即 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>22</mn></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> 或 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>22</mn></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math>。因此x-22=0或x-22=1，解出x=22或23。解的和为45。选D

question: A rectangle has a length that is 60 times its width. The function <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>60</mn> <mi>w</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>w</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> represents this situation, where y is the area, in square feet, of the rectangle and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>></mo> <mn>0</mn></math>. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 60w in this context?
selections: A. The length of the rectangle, in feet
B. The area of the rectangle, in square feet
C. The difference between the length and the width of the rectangle, in feet
D. The width of the rectangle, in feet
explanations: 长方形的长是宽的60倍，所以长=60*宽。60w表示长方形的长。选A

question:

The given equation relates the resistances,<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi> R</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math>, in ohms, of two resistors arranged in parallel in a circuit with a total resistance of 41 ohms, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>R</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> are positive. Which equation correctly expresses <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>R</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></math>  in terms of  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math>?
explanations: 等式两边同时减去 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msub><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mfrac></math> 得到 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msub><mi>R</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>41</mn></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msub><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><msub><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><mn>41</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>41</mn><msub><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></mfrac></math>。将等式两边取倒数得到 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>R</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>41</mn><msub><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow><mrow><msub><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><mn>41</mn></mrow></mfrac></math>。选D

question: In triangle EFG, EF=8 and EG=10. Which of the following could NOT be the length of  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>F</mi> <mi>G</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="true">―</mo> </mover></math>?

question: The function f is a quadratic function. In the xy-plane, the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> has a vertex at (1, 9) and passes through the points (2, 30) and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>93</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>?
explanations: 因为顶点为(1, 9)，可设函数方程为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn></math>。带入点(2, 30)得到 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>30</mn><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn></math>，解出a=21。因此函数为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>21</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn></math>。计算f(-2)=198，和f(0)=30。因此f(-2)-f(0)=168，选C

question: At each of four wildlife preserves, an ornithologist found a sample of 48 nests and recorded the number of eggs in each nest. The following frequency tables represent the data set recorded at each wildlife preserve. Which frequency table represents the data set with the greatest mean?

question: Right rectangular prism X is similar to right rectangular prism Y . The surface area of right rectangular prism X is 58 square centimeters <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi data-mjx-auto-op="false">cm</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow></math>, and the surface area of right rectangular prism Y is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>2</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>088</mn> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mtext> </mtext> <mi data-mjx-auto-op="false">cm</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>. The volume of right rectangular prism Y is 2,160 cubic centimeters <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi data-mjx-auto-op="false">cm</mi> </mrow> <mn>3</mn> </msup> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow></math>. What is the sum of the volumes, in <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi data-mjx-auto-op="false">cm</mi> </mrow> <mn>3</mn> </msup></math>, of right rectangular prism X and right rectangular prism Y ?
explanations: 设X的长宽高分别为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>ℓ</mi></math>, w，和h。因为X和Y相似，则存在一个数k使得Y的长宽高分别为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>k</mi> <mi>ℓ</mi></math>, kw，和kh。X的表面积为58，所以 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>ℓ</mi> <mi>w</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>ℓ</mi> <mi>h</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>w</mi> <mi>h</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>58</mn></math>。Y的表面积为2088，所以 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>2</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <msup> <mi>k</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mi>ℓ</mi> <mi>w</mi> <mo>+</mo> <msup> <mi>k</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mi>ℓ</mi> <mi>h</mi> <mo>+</mo> <msup> <mi>k</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mi>w</mi> <mi>h</mi> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mo>=</mo> <mn>2088</mn></math>。解出 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>k</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>36</mn></math>。因为长度都是正数，所以解出k=6。Y的体积为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>k</mi> <mi>ℓ</mi> <mo>⋅</mo> <mi>k</mi> <mi>w</mi> <mo>⋅</mo> <mi>k</mi> <mi>h</mi> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mi>k</mi> <mn>3</mn> </msup> <mi>ℓ</mi> <mi>w</mi> <mi>h</mi></math>。因此 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mn>6</mn> <mn>3</mn> </msup> <mi>ℓ</mi> <mi>w</mi> <mi>h</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>2160</mn></math>，解出X的体积ℓwh为10。因此体积和为10+2160=2170.

question:
