Installing a new high-speed rail (HSR) hub in an area has the potential to boost residential development nearby, though the amount and type of development vary considerably by location. This potential is greatest when HSR hubs are established in areas far away from city centers, as these locations tend to have more available land for redevelopment into residential areas.

Which statement is best supported by information from the text and table?
selections: A. The area around Lille Europe has greater potential for residential development than the area around Reqg'o Emilia AV Mediopadana does.
B. The area around Lille Europe has greater potential for residential development than the area around København H does.
C. The area around Københav n H has greater potential for residential development than the area around Reggio Emilia AV Mediopadana does.
D. The area around Københav n H has greater potential for residential development than the area around Stuttgart Hbf does.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：

question:
In an analysis of medieval urbanization in York, Bautzen, and other European settlements, researchers drew on modern urban scaling theory, which posits that population density in core urban areas increases as a city grows larger. Hypothesizing that this typical relationship would have differed in medieval settlements because of the constraining influence of strong hierarchical social structures (which are much less pronounced in modern cities) on social networking and economic integration—drivers of urban agglomeration—the team created a model that accounted for the presence of restrictive institutions. They found that the typically expected density-size relationship held for each of the 173 medieval settlements whose growth they analyzed, suggesting that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the social and economic dynamics that affect urban agglomeration were likely much different in medieval settlements than in modern cities, despite the similarity across time in population density patterns.

B. although there tends to be a positive relationship between population size and development of core urban areas for both medi eval settlements and modern cities, social institutions likely limited the rate at which population density increased in medieval settlements.

C. despite a change in the role of social structures over time, there is likely a notable consistency between medieval settlements and modern cities in underlying elements of the social and economic interactions among individuals that shape the development of core urban areas.

D. the constraining influence of hierarchical medieval institutions likely had a significant effect on individuals in some social groupings but little to no effect on members of other social groupings.
explanations:
题目翻译：
在对约克、包岑等欧洲中世纪聚落城市化的分析中，研究人员借鉴了现代城市规模理论（该理论认为城市核心区人口密度随城市规模扩大而增加）。研究团队假设这一典型关系在中世纪聚落中会有所不同，原因是强大的等级社会结构（在现代城市中远不明显）会限制社会网络与经济整合（城市集聚的驱动因素）。为此他们建立了一个考虑限制性制度存在的模型。他们发现，在所分析的173个中世纪聚落中，典型的密度-规模关系仍然成立，这表明________
答案解析：
研究发现，尽管假设等级制度会削弱驱动城市集聚的社会经济互动，但中世纪聚落仍呈现出与现代城市一致的密度-规模关系。这表明核心社会与经济互动的底层要素在不同时期具有一致性，其塑造城市发展的力量超越了表层制度差异。C项准确地抓住了这一“深层一致性”的逻辑。A项强调“差异”与发现相反；B项强调“限制了增速”与“关系依然成立”矛盾；D项的“对不同群体影响不同”在文本中无依据。

question:
The Rajahnate of Butuan, a sea power based on Mindanao island in the Philippines that reached the height of its influence around 1100 CE, is classified as a thalassocracy. Thalassocracies are generally considered distinct from tellurocracies, or land-based powers. _______the British Empire (1600s-1900s CE) notably extended its hegemony across both land and sea.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目翻译：
武端王国（Rajahnate of Butuan）是一个以菲律宾棉兰老岛为基础的海上强权，在公元1100年左右达到影响力顶峰，被归类为海权国家（thalassocracy）。海权国家通常被认为不同于陆权国家（tellurocracies）。_______大英帝国（公元1600-1900年代）显著地将其霸权同时扩展到陆地和海洋。
中文解析：
上下文逻辑为：前两句定义并区分了“海权国家”和“陆权国家”两种概念。空格后举例的“大英帝国同时掌控陆海霸权”，其特点不符合前文设定的严格区分，反而使两者的界限变得模糊。因此，"Blurring this line"（模糊了这一界限）最符合此处的转折与例证逻辑。其他选项"Exemplifying this distinction"（例证这一区别）、"Underscoring this difference"（强调这一不同）、"Supporting this claim"（支持这一说法）均与例句的实际作用相悖。

question:
Reena Esmail’s classical composition “Summitless Mountains” incorporates a raag, a melodic framework used in Hindustani classical music, called Raag Chandrakauns. Often, interplay between the raag’s designated vadi and samvadi (the first-and second-most important notes, respectively) and its prescribed melodic sequences______an unsettled mood.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主语为单数名词短语“interplay between... and...”，因此谓语动词需使用第三人称单数形式“evokes”。

question:
As anthropologist Cristina Grasseni explains, many artisanal cheeses in Italy, such as Castelmagno from Piedmont and Quartirolo Lombardo from Lombardy, are highly valued for their regional authenticity;______they are prized for being made using local ingredients and methods typical of their respective geographic regions.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
正如人类学家Cristina Grasseni所解释的那样，意大利的许多手工奶酪（如皮埃蒙特的Castelmagno和伦巴第的Quartirolo Lombardo）因其地域真实性而备受推崇；______它们因其使用当地原料及各自地理区域的典型方法制作而受到珍视。
中文解析：
空格前后两句为解释说明关系。后句（使用本地原料和方法）具体解释了前句所说的“地域真实性”的内涵。"that is,"（即，也就是说）引入解释或重述。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Birthday Party is a 1957 black-and-white linocut print by Black American artist Margaret Burroughs.
●It depicts a tranquil, everyday scene (a group of children celebrating).
●Amanzi Amthatha (“The cold water takes him”) is a 2001 black-and-white linocut print by South African artist Nomathemba Tana.
●It features a scene with an explicitly political point of view (a Xhosa warrior fighting British colonial rule).
●Relief printing is a technique in which an image is carved onto a printing block, covered in ink or paint, and stamped

The student wants to contrast the subject matter of the two prints. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The print by Tana is a black-and-write linocut; by contrast, Burroughs’s is a relief print.
B. Burroughs made Birthday Party in 1957, while Tana made Amanzi Amthatha (“The cold water takes him”) later, in 2001.
C. Tana’s print expresses an explicitly political point of view, while Burroughs’s depicts a tranquil, everyday scene.
D. The scenes depicted in both works were first carved onto a printing block, then stamped onto paper; however, one work is a linocut, while the other is a relief print.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
●一位学生在研究某个主题时记录了以下笔记：
●《生日派对》是美国黑人艺术家玛格丽特·伯勒斯于1957年创作的一幅黑白亚麻油毡版画。
●它描绘了一个宁静的日常场景（一群孩子在庆祝）。
●《Amanzi Amthatha》（“冷水带走了他”）是南非艺术家诺玛坦巴·塔纳于2001年创作的一幅黑白亚麻油毡版画。
●它具有明确政治观点的场景（一位科萨武士与英国殖民统治抗争）。
●浮雕印刷是一种将图像刻在印刷版上、涂上油墨或颜料、然后进行压印的技术。
答案解析：
题干明确要求“对比主题内容”。笔记中对两幅画的描述核心差异在于：Burroughs的画是“宁静的日常场景”，而Tana的画是“具有明确政治观点”。选项C直接、准确地对比了这一主题差异。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Researchers Gwangsu Kim et al. sought to explore the relationship between the brain’s ability to process natural sounds and its ability to process music.
●They used an artificial deep neural network (DNN) that models how the brain processes auditory information. The DNN had been trained to detect natural sounds (excluding music).
●Finding: The DNN spontaneously developed neurons that responded to music but not to other auditory stimuli.
●Conclusion: The brain’s ability to process music may arise as a by-product of natural sound processing.

The student wants to present the aim of the study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Using an artificial deep neural network the researchers sought to explore the relationship between the brain’s ability to process natural sounds and its ability to process music.
B. The researchers used an artificial deep neural network, which spontaneously developed neurons that responded to music but not to other auditory stimuli.
C. By training an artificial deep neural network, the researchers aimed to establish that the brain’s ability to process natural sounds arises as a by-product of processing music.
D. In their study, the researchers evaluated whether an artificial deep neural network trained only on natural sounds would develop neurons that respond to music.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一位学生在研究某个主题时记录了以下笔记：
1.研究人员Gwangsu Kim等人试图探索大脑处理自然声音的能力与处理音乐的能力之间的关系。
2.他们使用了一个模拟大脑处理听觉信息方式的人工深度神经网络（DNN）。该DNN曾被训练用于检测自然声音（不包括音乐）。
3.发现：DNN自发地产生了对音乐有反应但不对其他听觉刺激有反应的神经元。
4.结论：大脑处理音乐的能力可能是自然声音处理的副产品。
中文解析：
研究的目的在笔记第一点中明确表述为“探索大脑处理自然声音与处理音乐能力之间的关系”。选项A直接、完整地复现了这一目的陈述。选项B描述的是发现，而非目的；选项C的因果方向与笔记结论（音乐能力是自然声音处理的副产品）相反；选项D（按完整版）描述的是研究方法或检验的问题，而非研究的整体目的。

question:
The moon Valetudo orbits Jupiter in the same direction that the planet rotates. _______ Valetudo’s orbit is described as prograde. Mneme, another of Jupiter’s moons, orbits in the opposite direction, so its orbit is described with the opposite term: retrograde.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
木卫六十二（Valetudo）绕木星公转的方向与木星自转方向相同。_______其轨道被描述为顺行。木卫四十（Mneme）作为木星的另一颗卫星，公转方向相反，因此其轨道用相反的术语描述：逆行。
中文解析：
空格前陈述了事实（公转方向与行星自转相同），空格后是据此得出的定义或结论（轨道被称为prograde）。这是一种因果关系，需选用表示“因此”的过渡词。

question:
According to climate envelope models, individual organisms that inhabit the coolest areas of their species’ geographic distribution are expected to benefit from a warming climate, while individuals in the warmest areas will struggle. A 2024 University of Arizona study, ______found that warmer-than-average temperatures resulted in a decrease in growth across all areas of the common piñon tree’s distribution range.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目翻译：
根据气候生态位模型，生活在物种地理分布中最冷区域的个体预计会受益于气候变暖，而生活在最暖区域的个体则会艰难生存。一项2024年亚利桑那大学的研究，______发现高于平均温度导致了普通矮松分布范围内所有区域的生长量下降。
答案解析：
前后句为转折关系。前句是模型的普遍预测（冷暖区反应不同），后句是研究的实际发现（所有区域都受负面影响），两者在结论上存在矛盾。"though"（然而）能准确引入这一意外或相反的发现。

question:
For several centuries after the birth of opera in sixteenth-century Florence, Italian remained the default language in which most opera scores were written._______ opera singers today, such as the soprano Amira Selim, encounter a wide range of Italian terms—from affettuoso (with feeling) to accelerando (at an accelerating tempo)—when following many eighteenth-century opera scores.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目翻译：
自16世纪歌剧诞生于佛罗伦萨后的数百年间，意大利语一直是大多数歌剧乐谱的默认书写语言。_______今天的歌剧演唱者，如女高音Amira Selim，在研习许多18世纪的歌剧乐谱时，仍会遇到大量的意大利语术语——从affettuoso（富有感情地）到accelerando（渐快地）。
中文解析：
空格前是历史背景（意大利语曾是歌剧默认语言），空格后是延续至今的结果（现代歌手仍需接触这些意大利术语）。这是一种因果延续关系

question: A polygon with 22 sides has a perimeter of 131 inches. The length of one side is 5 inches. The other 21 sides have equal lengths. What is the length, in inches, of one of the 21 sides with equal lengths?
explanations: 考查多边形的周长等于所有边长的和，其中一条边长是5，那剩余21条边的长度之和就是周长131减去5，即126；剩下所有的边长一致，所以每条边的长度就是126/21=6，故答案为6。

question: On a certain day in June, the lowest recorded wind speed in a town was 5 miles per hour (mph) and the highest recorded wind speed was 14 mph. Which inequality is true for all values of w, where w represents any wind speed, in mph, recorded in the town on this day?
explanations: 最低风速5，最高风速14，那风速的范围就是D选项。

question: The function f is defined by the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6</mn></math>. question: The ratio 72 to m is equivalent to the ratio 4 to 24. What is the value of m?
explanations: 根据题意可得 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>72</mn> <mi>m</mi> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>4</mn> <mn>24</mn> </mfrac></math> ，计算可得m=432，故选D。

question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>3</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>42</mn></math>, what is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>1</mn> <mn>6</mn> </mfrac> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>1</mn> <mn>6</mn> </mfrac> <mstyle scriptlevel="0"> <mspace width="1em"></mspace> </mstyle> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>1</mn> <mn>6</mn> </mfrac> <mo>∗</mo> <mn>42</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>7</mn></math>，故选B。

question: A real estate company offers a series of three webinars. 3,125 people attended the first webinar. 56% of the people who attended the first webinar attended the second webinar, and 26% of the people who attended the first and second webinars attended the third webinar. How many people attended all three webinars?
explanations: 参加第一次会议的有3125人，参加第二次会议的有3125*56%=1750人，参加第三次会议的有1750*26=455人，这455人三次会议都参加了，故答案为455。

question: The table shows four values of x and their corresponding values of y. There is a linear relationship between x and y. Which of the following equations represents this relationship?
explanations: 将表格中的数字代入检验可得正确答案为A。

question: The expression <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>15</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow></math> is equivalent to <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>3</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mi>b</mi> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mi>x</mi></math>, where a, b, and c are constants. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>a</mi> <mi>b</mi> <mi>c</mi></math>?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>15</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow></math> 计算出来只有3次项和一次项，没有二次项，所以b=0，故abc=0，即答案为0。

question:
For a rational function f, the table shows three values of x and their corresponding values of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>.
Which of the following could be the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>?
explanations: 对比图表中的x等于-4,0,8的时候对应的y值是否与表格中一致，答案为D。

question: To purchase a used car at a total price of 13,000 dollars, a onetime down payment is required, and then fixed monthly payments are made for the remaining amount owed for the car. The equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>13</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>000</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>600</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mn>260</mn> <mi>t</mi></math> represents this situation, where t is the number of fixed monthly payments that are made. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 260 in this context?
selections: A. The amount, in dollars, of the down payment
B. The amount, in dollars, of each fixed monthly payment
C. The total amount, in dollars, paid for the car after t fixed monthly payments
D. The total number of fixed monthly payments
explanations: 考查线性函数的解释，13000=2600+260t，其中13000是总价，那固定的数字2600就是首付，t表示还贷款的月数，那260就是每月需偿还的金额，故选B。

question: What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>tan</mi><mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo><mi>X</mi></math> in the triangle shown?
explanations: tan是对边比临边，也就是tanX =168/126=4/3，故选D。

question: In the xy-plane, an equation of circle R is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>8</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>19</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>100</mn></math>. Circle S is obtained by shifting circle R to the right 3 units. An equation defining circle S is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>h</mi> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>k</mi> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>100</mn></math>, where h and k are constants. What is the value of h?
explanations: 圆R的圆心为（-8，-19），向右平移3个单位，那就变成了（-5，-19），所以圆S的方程就是 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>5</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>19</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>100</mn></math>，也就是h=5，故答案为5。

question: On January 1, there were 237 views of a video posted on a social media site. selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>237</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0.70</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mfrac> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> </mrow> </msup></math>

B. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>237</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0.70</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> </mrow> </msup></math>

C. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>237</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1.70</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mfrac> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> </mrow> </msup></math>

D. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>237</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1.70</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> </mrow> </msup></math>
