The function h is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>h</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn></math>. What is the minimum value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>h</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>h</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>16</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>22</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>16</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>31</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>31</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">[</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">]</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>31</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>16</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>31</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>15</mn></math> ，故该函数的最小值为15，所以选B。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnspacing="1em" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="3pt"><mtr><mtd><mn>7</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>189</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mn>7</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>9</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>819</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>
The solution to the given system of equations is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>y</mi></math>?
explanations: 将上下两个式子相加可得14（5x）=-630，故5x=-45；用上面的式子减去下面的式子可得18（8y）=1008，故8y=56；所以5x+8y=-45+56=11，故选C

question:
Note: Figure not drawn to scale.
Triangle TUV is dilated by a scale factor of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></math> to obtain triangle <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>T</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi data-mjx-alternate="1">′</mi></mrow></msup><msup><mi>U</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi data-mjx-alternate="1">′</mi></mrow></msup><msup><mi>V</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi data-mjx-alternate="1">′</mi></mrow></msup></math> (not shown), where T corresponds to <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>T</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi data-mjx-alternate="1">′</mi></mrow></msup></math> and U corresponds to <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>U</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi data-mjx-alternate="1">′</mi></mrow></msup></math>. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>V</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi data-mjx-alternate="1">′</mi></mrow></msup></math>?
explanations: 三角形TUV扩大1/2倍得到T’U’V’，那两个三角形就是相似三角形，相似三角形对应的角大小相等，所以∠V’=∠V=26°，故选A。

question: The line segment shown in the xy-plane represents side JK of isosceles triangle JKL, where side JL is congruent to side KL. The perimeter of this triangle is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>13</mn><msqrt><mn>17</mn></msqrt></math> units. What is the length, in units, of side JL of this triangle?
explanations: 图形中的线段表示JK，那JK的长度是 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><msqrt><mn>17</mn></msqrt></math>；JL和KL全等，那就是JL和KL是相等的两个腰；三角形周长是 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>13</mn><msqrt><mn>17</mn></msqrt></math>，那JL的长度就是 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>13</mn><msqrt><mn>17</mn></msqrt><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><msqrt><mn>17</mn></msqrt><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo>/</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><msqrt><mn>17</mn></msqrt></math>，故选C。

question: For the polynomial function when <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> is divided by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn></math>, the remainder is 9. Which of the following must be true about the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> in the xy-plane?
selections: A. It passes through the point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>.

B. It passes through the point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
C. It passes through the point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>8</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
D. It passes through the point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>8</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
explanations: 根据题意f(x)=（x-8）（）（）（）...+9，所以当x=8时，f(x)=9，即该函数通过（8,9）这个点，故选D。

question:
In triangle JKL, the measures of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi> <mi>K</mi></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi> <mi>L</mi></math> are each 51. What is the measure of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi> <mi>J</mi></math>, in degrees?
(Disregard the degree symbol when entering your answer.)
explanations: 考查三角形的内角和是180度，180-51*2=78，故答案为78。

question: The table shows three values of x and their corresponding values of y for the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>x</mi></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn></math>. In the table, a is a constant. What is the value of a?
explanations: 将x=3代入 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>x</mi></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn></math> 计算可得 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>64</mn></math>，故选B。

question: A researcher is designing a study to investigate the average number of hours students at a high school spend reading per day. The researcher will report an estimated average number of hours students at the high school spend reading per day with an associated margin of error. The researcher is considering using a random sample of either 90 or 180 students from the high school. Which of the following would be the most likely effect of using the larger random sample compared to the smaller random sample?
selections: A. The reported margin of error would be lower
B. The reported margin of error would be higher
C. The reported average number of hours would be lower.
D. The reported average number of hours would be higher.
explanations: 考查margin of error，样本数量越大，margin of error越小，故选A。

question: The figure shows the xy-plane with the quadrants labeled. The graph of a linear function h (not shown), where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>h</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, is a line completely contained in only quadrants I and II of the xy-plane. Which of the following could define the function h?
explanations: 直线的图像只在第一二象限，那只能是跟x轴平行，故选C。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>
What is the greatest solution to the given equation?
explanations: 考查一元二次方程 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> 的求根公式 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>±</mo><msqrt><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi></msqrt></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>a</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>，将该题的方程中对应的数字代入求根公式计算可得AB为方程的解，较大的为B，故选B。

question:
The scatterplot shows the relationship between two variables, x and y.
Which of the following equations is the most appropriate quadratic model for the data shown?
explanations: 考查二次函数的图像问题，抛物线开口向下，所以二次项系数应该为负数，故答案应该是A或者B；根据图像，（49,35）差不多是该函数的顶点值，根据该顶点值确定答案为A。

question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>16</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mfrac> <mn>1</mn> <mn>4</mn> </mfrac> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>3</mn> <mn>4</mn> </mfrac> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. what is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>7</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6</mn></math>?
explanations: 整理方程可得 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>16</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>1</mn> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>，故7x-6=32，所以答案为32。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>H</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2.419</mn><mi>L</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>22.83</mn></math>
A group of biology students conducted an experiment to study the relationship between a person's femur length and the person's height. The given equation describes the relationship between the length L, in inches, of a student's femur and the student's estimated height H, in inches, for the students in the group. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 2.419 in this context?
selections: A. The increase in a student's estimated height, in inches, for each increase of 1 inch in the student's femur length
B. The increase in a student's femur length, in inches, for each increase of 1 inch in the student's estimated height
C. The increase in a student's femur length, in inches, for each increase of 22.83 inches in the student's estimated height
D. The estimated height, in inches, of a student whose femur has a length of L inches
explanations: 考查线性函数的解释，y=mx+b，其中斜率m表达的是x每增长1，y就会增长m，符合该说法的是A，故答案为A。

question: Which system of linear equations has no solution?
explanations: 考查两根直线的交点问题，A和C选项调整一下正负号发现是两个相同的式子，故有无穷多解；B选项两根直线的斜率不同，故有一个解；所以答案为D。

question: In the xy-plane, line h passes through the point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> and is perpendicular to the line represented by the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo>−</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>20</mn></math>. If line h also passes through the point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>18</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, what is the value of t?
explanations: 将-3x+y=20整理为标准式y=3x+20，故该直线的斜率为3；因为line h与该直线垂直，所以line h的斜率为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mn>1</mn> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac></math>；因为line h通过（0,0），所以line h的表达式为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mn>1</mn> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac> <mi>x</mi></math>；将x=18代入该式可得t=-6,故选B。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo><</mo><mn>15</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>13</mn></math>
For which of the following tables are all the values of x and their corresponding values of y solutions to the given inequality?

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>000</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1.003</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup></math>
The given function f models the balance of a bank account, in dollars, x years after it is opened. Which statement is the best interpretation of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1.003</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup></math> ?
selections: A. Every 6 months, the balance increases by about <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">$</mi><mn>3</mn></math>.
B. Every 2 years, the balance increases by about <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">$</mi><mn>3</mn></math>
C. At the end of every 6-month interval, the balance increases by about 0.3% of the balance at the beginning of the 6-month interval.
D. At the end of ever 2-year interval, the balance increases by about 0.3% of the balance at the beginning of the 2-year interval
explanations: 1.003表示1+0.3%，故排除AB；指数2x表示x/(1/2)，也就是1/2年为一个周期，1/2年表示6个月，故选C。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnspacing="1em" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="3pt"><mtr><mtd><mn>8</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>
The solution to the given system of equations is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi></math>?
explanations: 求解该方程组可得x=61/36,y=11/9，故x+y=35/12，所以答案是35/12。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0.10</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>0.20</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0.17</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
The equation gives a volume x, in gallons, of a 10% saltwater solution that could be mixed with a volume y, in gallons, of a 20% saltwater solution to produce a 17% saltwater solution. According to this equation, what volume, in gallons, of the 20% saltwater solution could be mixed with 75.0 gallons of the 10% saltwater solution to produce a 17% saltwater solution?
(Assume that the volume of the mixture is the sum of the volumes of the two solutions before they were mixed.)
explanations: 根据0.10x+0.20y=0.17(x+y)计算可得7x=3y；将x=75代入该式可得y=175，故答案为175。

question:
Which of the following is a factor of the expression <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>18</mn><mi>r</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>45</mn><mi>r</mi></math>, where r is a nonzero constant?
i. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn><mi>r</mi></math>
ii. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>r</mi></math>
explanations: 考查二次函数的因式分解，原式可因式分解为（2x+5）（x+9r），故I是原式的一个因式，II不是，所以选A。

question: Each of the following frequency tables represents a data set. Which of these frequency tables represents the data set with the smallest standard deviation?
explanations: 考查标准差的基本定义，一组数据越集中，即越多的数字靠近平均值，这组数据的标准差越小，故选D。

question: The quadratic function g models the depth, in meters, below the surface of the water of a Weddell seal t minutes after the seal entered the water during a dive. The function estimates that the seal reached its maximum depth of 382.2 meters 7 minutes after it entered the water and then reached the surface of the water 14 minutes after it entered the water. Based on the function, what was the estimated depth, to the nearest meter, of the seal 10 minutes after it entered the water?
explanations: 根据给出的最大值可列出该二次函数的顶点式 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>382.2</mn></math>，将（14,0）代入该函数求解可得a=- 7.8，故函数表达式为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7.8</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>382.2</mn></math>；将t=10代入计算可得答案为312。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnalign="right left" columnspacing="0em" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="3pt"><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>11</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>10</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>8</mn></msup></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>17</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>7</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>5</mn></msup></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>
The polynomial <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> is defined as the product of the given polynomials, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. What is the coefficient of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>15</mn></mrow></msup></math> in <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>∗</mo></msup><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mn>11</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>10</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>8</mn></msup><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>17</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>7</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>5</mn></msup><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><msup><mn>17</mn><mo>∗</mo></msup><mn>11</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>17</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mn>11</mn><mo>∗</mo></msup><mn>9</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>15</mn></mrow></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>∗</mo><mn>17</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>15</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>∗</mo><mn>9</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>13</mn></mrow></msup></math>，故<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>15</mn></mrow></msup></math>的系数为11*9-3*17=48，故选B。

question: The equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>5</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo stretchy="false">|</mo> </mrow> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo stretchy="false">|</mo> </mrow> <mo>=</mo> <mi>k</mi></math>, where k is a constant, has exactly one solution. Which of the following could be the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mi>k</mi> <mn>5</mn> </mfrac></math>?
explanations: 考查绝对值方程；当绝对值方程等于0时，方程只有一个解，即k=0，那k/5=0，故选C。

question: An isosceles right triangle has a perimeter of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>34</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mn>34</mn> <msqrt> <mn>2</mn> </msqrt></math> inches. What is the length, in inches, of one leg of this triangle?
explanations: 等腰直角三角形的周长是 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>34</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mn>34</mn> <msqrt> <mn>2</mn> </msqrt></math>，如果两个直角边之和是34，那一条直角边就是17，斜边就是 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>17</mn> <msqrt> <mn>2</mn> </msqrt></math>，此刻周长和题干中的不相同，此种情况不成立；那直角边之和只能是 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>34</mn> <msqrt> <mn>2</mn> </msqrt></math>，那一条直角边就是 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>17</mn> <msqrt> <mn>2</mn> </msqrt></math>，斜边就是34，周长符合题干，此情况成立；故选B。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>q</mi><mi>r</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>r</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>87</mn></math>
In the given equation, q is an integer constant. The given equation has no real solutions. What is the largest possible value of q?
explanations: 考查一元二次方程 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> 根的个数，当 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi><mo><</mo><mn>0</mn></math> 时，方程无解；将题目中的方程整理成标准的一元二次方程为 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">q</mi></mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>8</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi></mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>87</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，代入 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi><mo><</mo><mn>0</mn></math> 计算可得 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mn>87</mn></msqrt><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn><mo><</mo><mi>q</mi><mo><</mo><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mn>87</mn></msqrt><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn></math>，因为q是整数，所以q最大是26，故答案为26。

question: A scientist studied the effects of mixing two chemicals, chemical A and chemical B, by gradually adding more of each chemical to a mixture of the two chemicals. At the start of the study, the mass of chemical A in the mixture was equal to the mass of chemical B in the mixture. From the start of the study to the end of the study, the mass of chemical A in the mixture increased by 2,600% and the mass of chemical B in the mixture increased by 380%. At the end of the study, approximately how many times greater was the mass of chemical A in the mixture than the mass of chemical B in the mixture?
explanations: 设最初A和B的数量均为x，实验结束时A的数量为（1+2600%）x=27x，B的数量为（1+380%）x=4.8x；(27x)/(4.8x)=5.625，故选D。

question:
Though Vasily Grossman’s novel Stalingrad is not as beloved as his later work Everything Flows, some critics commend it despite its mangling by Soviet censors: Marcel Theroux in The Guardian called it “lucid and readable.” Several draft versions have been ______, and translators consulted those drafts when working on what they hoped would be a definite English edition.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管瓦西里·格罗斯曼的小说《斯大林格勒》不如他后来的作品《一切都是流动的》那样受人喜爱，但一些评论家仍称赞它——尽管它曾被苏联审查机构篡改：《卫报》的马塞尔·泰鲁称它“清晰易读”。这部小说的几份草稿版本被 ____，译者在努力完成他们希望成为权威英文版本时参考了这些草稿。
答案解析：
后半句提到译者在翻译时consulted those drafts（参考了这些草稿），说明草稿需要被保存下来才能被参考。因此，空格应填入表示“保存、保留”的词。选项 C preserved 最符合语境逻辑。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Number of City Residents Who Often Biked to Work in 2016
In the table, the city with the lowest number of residents who often biked to work in 2016 is _____

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
表格中，2016年经常骑自行车上班的居民人数最少的城市是 _____
答案解析：
对比表格数据：凤凰城（4,709）＜ 博尔德（5,314）＜ 麦迪逊（7,186）＜ 西雅图（14,801）。人数最少的是 凤凰城，对应选项 C。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Few stories in art history rival the gilded drama of James McNeill Whistler’ s Peacock Room. This sumptuous dining space became the setting of a spectacular falling-out between Whistler, who transformed the somber room into a golden aviary, and shipping magnate Frederick Leyland, who commissioned the work but refused to pay for what he _____ as a tasteless, gaudy design.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 空格前是“what he... as a tasteless... design”，缺少宾语从句的谓语动词，所以选B
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
It may seem that works of art are best experienced in person. However, in an online collection from the Museo de Arte de Lima in Lima, Peru, people can zoom in on a high-quality image of the drawing Drawing B... by Gilda Mantilla. A student argues that viewers usually can’t examine works of art in a museum as carefully as they can examine works in online collections.

Which statement, if true, would most directly support the underlined argument?
selections: A. Most museums have signs that provide basic information about the works of art on display.
B. Most museums don’ t allow visitors to get very close to the works of art on display.
C. Many museums have started adding images of works from their collections to their websites.
D. Museums don’ t always put works by different artists together in one room.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
人们可能认为艺术作品最好亲身体验。然而，在秘鲁利马的利马艺术博物馆的在线藏品中，人们可以放大吉尔达·曼蒂利亚的画作《绘图B……》的高清图像。一位学生认为，观众通常无法像在在线藏品中那样仔细地观察博物馆里的艺术品。
答案解析：
论点核心是：在博物馆里无法像在线查看那样仔细看艺术品。要直接支持这一点，需要说明博物馆存在某种限制，阻碍了近距离仔细观察。选项B“大多数博物馆不允许参观者太靠近展出的艺术品”直接解释了为何在博物馆无法仔细看，因此最有力地支持了论点。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
One example of public art (art that’s readily accessible to the general public) ____ the work Singing Ringing Tree. This sculpture is installed on public land in Burnley, England.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子主语是“One example”，为单数第三人称，因此谓语动词应使用单数形式 is。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
River Lengths
Researcher Shaochuang Liu and team presented updated measurements of the lengths of several rivers.

According to the table, which river is the longest?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
研究者刘绍川及其团队公布了几条河流的最新长度测量数据。
答案解析：
表格中三条河流的长度数据为：长江（6,236 km）> 鄂毕河（5,525 km）> 刚果河（5,118 km）。因此最长的河流是长江，对应选项 D（虽有拼写错误，但可识别为 Yangtze River）。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
In a recent study, Antonia Olivia Dolan and colleagues investigated the relationship between people’ s music preferences and their preferred listening volume. Participants listened to recordings — Led Zeppelin’ s “Whole Lotta Love,” Ludwig van Beethoven’ s Symphony No.5 in C Minor, and others — at their preferred volume and indicated their most and least favorite among the recordings. The researchers found that participants listened to recordings they liked most at a higher volume than recordings they liked least. And given that the frequencies in all the recordings were within the audible range of these participants (all of whom had clinically typical hearing), it is therefore likely that for a given participant, the _____.

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. relationship between the preferred volume of a recording and the participant’s attitude toward that recording cannot be attributed to its genre.
B. fact that the preferred volume offered by recording cannot be attributed to the participant wanting to hear the favorite recording at a higher volume than the least favorite recording.
C. difference between the preferred volumes of the favorite and least favorite recordings cannot be attributed to one recording being inherently harder to hear than the other.
D. identification of one recording as the favorite and another recording as the least favorite cannot be attributed to the participant having prior familiarity with either recording
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在一项最新研究中，安东尼娅·奥利维亚·多兰及其同事探究了人们的音乐偏好与他们偏好的听音音量之间的关系。参与者在以自己偏好的音量听了几段录音（齐柏林飞艇的《Whole Lotta Love》、路德维希·范·贝多芬的《C小调第五交响曲》等）后，指出其中最喜爱和最不喜爱的录音。研究者发现，参与者听最喜爱的录音时音量高于最不喜爱的录音。鉴于所有录音的频率都在参与者（所有参与者听力均临床正常）的可听范围内，因此很可能对于任一参与者来说，_____。
答案解析：
研究结论是：人们听更喜欢的音乐时会把音量调得更高。由于所有录音都在可听范围内，可以排除“某段录音本身更难听清”这一干扰因素。因此，最合理的推断是：喜不喜欢音乐与音量的关系，不是因为某个录音更难听，而是因为喜好。选项C“最喜欢和最不喜欢录音的偏好音量差异，不能归因于其中一个录音本质上比另一个更难听清”最符合逻辑。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Animals use many objects as tools to achieve goals more easily. Such goals include grooming, finding food, and protecting themselves. For a long time, people thought tool use was unique to primates. Elephants and other animals, though, have busted the myth that tool use requires hands. Inventively, elephants use branches to scratch themselves. Woodpecker finches also get creative. They use cactus spines to pry insects from hiding places.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Unlike primates, elephants are exceptionally skillful at using different tools.
B. Contrary to long-held beliefs, primates aren’t the only animals to use tools.
C. There are many myths about tools use that researchers are starting to challenge.
D. Animals find it difficult to use objects as tools.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
动物会用许多物体作为工具，以便更容易实现目标。这些目标包括梳理毛发、寻找食物和自我保护。长期以来，人们认为使用工具是灵长类动物的独有本领。然而，大象和其他动物打破了“使用工具需要用手”的迷思。大象创造性地使用树枝来搔痒自己。啄木鸟雀也很有创意，它们用仙人掌刺将昆虫从藏身处撬出来。
答案解析：
文章以“动物使用工具”为背景，先指出“过去人们认为工具使用是灵长类动物独有的”，然后通过大象和啄木鸟雀的例子反驳了这一观点。因此，文章的核心是说明除灵长类外，其他动物也会使用工具。选项B“与长期持有的观念相反，灵长类并非唯一使用工具的动物”准确概括了主旨。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
The following text is adapted from Jhumpa Lahiri’s 2003 novel The Namesake. Gogol is an elementary school student in Massachusetts.
In art class, his favorite hour of the week, he carves his name with paper clips into the bottoms of clay cups and bowls. He pastes uncooked pasta to cardboard, and leaves his signature in fat brush strokes below paintings.

As used in the text, what does the word “leaves” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字改编自朱帕·拉希里2003年的小说《同名人》。戈戈尔是马萨诸塞州的一名小学生。
在艺术课上（他每周最喜欢的时刻），他用回形针在黏土杯碗的底部刻下自己的名字。他将未煮熟的意大利面粘贴到纸板上，并在画作下方用粗犷的笔触“留下”自己的签名。
答案解析：
文中“leaves”与“signature”（签名）搭配，在艺术创作语境下引申为“写下”或“留下”签名的意思。选项D “Writes”（书写）最贴合此处的动作含义。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Several scholars of children’s literature recently _____ to discuss the work of Jerry Pinkney, illustrator of such lauded books as The Talking Eggs: A Folktale from the American South. Once together, they talked about his style, influences, and themes.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
几位儿童文学学者最近 _____，以讨论杰里·平克尼（曾为《说话的蛋：美国南方民间故事》等备受赞誉的书籍绘制插图）的作品。他们聚在一起后，探讨了他的风格、影响与主题。
答案解析：
空格后的“Once together”（一旦聚在一起）明确提示学者们是“聚集/召开会议”进行讨论。选项中只有 C convened（召集，集合）能准确表达“为讨论而聚集”的意思，且与上下文逻辑紧密衔接。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
The following text is from Thomas Hardy’s 1874 novel Far from the Madding Crowd.
Bathsheba and Liddy are traveling down a road when Liddy points out a neighbor whom Bathsheba hasn’t met yet.
Liddy looked. “That! That’s Farmer Boldwood—of course ‘tis — the man you couldn't see the other day when he called.” “Oh, Farmer Boldwood” murmured Bathsheba, and looked at him as he outstripped them. The farmer had never turned his head once, but with eyes fixed on the most advanced point along the road, passed as unconsciously and abstractly as if Bathsheba and her charms were thin air.

As used in the text, what does the phrase  “most advanced” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本选自托马斯·哈代1874年的小说《远离尘嚣》。芭丝谢芭和莉蒂正沿路行走时，莉蒂指出了一个芭丝谢芭尚未见过的邻居。
莉蒂看了看。“那是农夫波德伍德——当然是他——就是那天他来拜访时你没见到的那个人。”“哦，农夫波德伍德，”芭丝谢芭低声说，并看着他超过了她们。农夫一次也没有回头，而是双眼“紧盯着路上最 ______ 的一点”，毫无知觉、心不在焉地走过，仿佛芭丝谢芭和她的魅力稀薄如空气。
答案解析：
文中描述农夫目光锁定在“路上最 ______ 的一点”，结合“他超过了她们”以及“双眼固定在路上某一点”的语境，应理解为“视野前方最远处”。选项 D Farthest（最远的）最符合这一空间描述。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Research such as the 2010 study of arthropods by Alvin Aaden Yim-Hol Chan and colleagues has shown that noise from human activity, like traffic on a busy highway, has various significant effects on animals, and many governments require studies of the potential noise effects on wildlife before approving highway construction projects. For one of these projects, a group of researchers suggested that, although there are both arthropods and birds in the area, taking actions to reduce the effects of noise on the arthropods will probably protect both types of animals because noise tends to affect arthropods more strongly than birds. Another group of researchers indicated that, although the effects are usually greater on arthropods, addressing only those effects won't reduce the potential harm to the birds in the area because______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the species of birds in the area experience different negative effects from noise than the species or arthropods in the area do.
B. the actions to reduce effects on the arthropods are significantly more robust than is needed to lessen the effects on the birds in the area.
C. the effects of noise on birds have been more thoroughly studied than the effects on arthropods have.
D. the types of actions that are usually taken to lessen the effects of noise on birds can sometimes harm arthropods.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Alvin Aaden Yim-Hol Chan 及其同事在2010年关于节肢动物的研究等表明，人类活动（如繁忙公路的交通）产生的噪音会对动物产生多种显著影响，因此许多政府在批准公路建设项目前，要求研究噪音对野生动物的潜在影响。针对其中一个项目，一组研究人员提出，尽管该区域同时存在节肢动物和鸟类，但采取措施减少噪音对节肢动物的影响很可能同时保护这两类动物，因为噪音对节肢动物的影响通常比对鸟类更强。另一组研究人员则指出，虽然噪音对节肢动物的影响通常更大，但仅仅针对这些影响采取措施并不会减少对该区域鸟类的潜在危害，因为______
答案解析：
第二组研究者认为，仅解决噪音对节肢动物的影响并不能减少对鸟类的危害。这是因为鸟类和节肢动物对噪音的负面反应类型不同（例如敏感频率、行为干扰模式等差异），因此针对节肢动物有效的降噪措施未必能覆盖鸟类所受的影响。选项A准确指出了这一关键区别，而其他选项均未直接解释“为何单保护节肢动物仍无法保护鸟类”这一逻辑。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
How does the friction between different surfaces and a rolling object affect the speed of the object? One way to explore this question is to use the scientific method. This method involves forming a hypothesis, conducting an experiment, collecting data, and drawing a conclusion. Using the scientific method helps us understand how things work and helps us answer questions, such as the one about friction and a rolling object.

Which choice best describes the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To criticize an experiment scientists conducted about friction and a rolling object
B. To explain one way to answer the question about friction and a rolling object
C. To summarize two sides of a scientific debate
D. To describe the career of a famous scientist
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
不同表面与滚动物体之间的摩擦力如何影响物体的速度？探索这个问题的一种方法是使用科学方法。该方法包括提出假设、进行实验、收集数据并得出结论。使用科学方法能帮助我们理解事物运作的原理，并帮助我们回答诸如上述关于摩擦力和滚动物体的问题。
答案解析：
文本围绕“如何探索摩擦力对滚动物体速度的影响”这一问题展开，核心是介绍“科学方法”作为解答该问题的一种途径。选项 B “解释回答关于摩擦力和滚动物体问题的一种方法”准确概括了文本主旨。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Text 1
Economist Thomas Piketty’ s book Capital in the Twenty-First Century has a more rigorous structure than its sequel, Capital and Ideology. While the first book’ s chapters all contribute to bolstering a clear, coherent argument about income inequality, the second book’ s digressions on subjects such as the various constitutions of France do not just make the book tedious but also muddy its reasoning.
Text 2
Capital and Ideology has different aims than Piketty’s earlier books. It should be judged not just in the context of Piketty' s previous work but placed next to books like William T. Vollmann’ s Rising Up and Rising Down, in which the stated theme of justifications for violent acts is mainly an excuse for a polymath to map his own mind. Even when sections do not explicitly support the central thesis, they link to each other in intriguing ways. None of them should be considered extraneous.

Based on the texts, which choice best describes a difference in how the authors of Text 1 and Text 2 view Capital and Ideology?
selections: A. The author of Text 1 finds the claim that Capital and Ideology resembles the work of Robert Burton to be dubious, while the author of Text 2 believes there is sufficient evidence to substantiate the claim.

B. The author of Text 1 thinks that Capital and Ideology does not entirely succeed in its attempt to make a single coherent argument, while the author of Text 2 contends that making such an argument is not the book's ambition.

C. The author of Text 1 thinks that the structure of Capital and Ideology makes it a less well-written book than Capital in the Twenty-First Century, while the author of Text 2 thinks that the structure of Capital and Ideology is why it is superior to Capital in the Twenty-First Century.

D. The author of Text 1 thinks that Piketty’ s expertise as an economist does not qualify him to discuss the various constitutions of France in Capital and Ideology, while the author of Text 2 holds that academics such as Piketty should feel comfortable discussing subjects outside their fields of study.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
文本1：
经济学家托马斯·皮凯蒂的著作《二十一世纪资本论》结构比其续作《资本与意识形态》更严谨。前者的所有章节都致力于巩固一个关于收入不平等问题的清晰、连贯的论点，而后者的离题内容（例如对法国各种宪法的讨论）不仅使该书显得冗长乏味，还使其推理变得模糊不清。
文本2：
《资本与意识形态》的目标与皮凯蒂的早期著作不同。评价它不应仅依据皮凯蒂之前的作品，而应将其与威廉·T·沃尔曼的《起与落》这类书籍并列。在后一本书中，关于暴力行为正当性的主题，实际上只是一位博学者用以描摹自己思想的借口。即使某些章节没有明确支持中心论点，它们也以有趣的方式相互关联，没有一部分应被视为多余。
答案解析：
文本1批评《资本与意识形态》结构松散、论证模糊，暗示其未能成功构建统一连贯的论点。文本2则认为该书的目标本就是进行博学式的思想漫游，不必追求严密论证。因此核心分歧在于：文本1认为该书在构建单一论点方面不成功，而文本2则主张这根本就不是该书的目标。故应选择 B。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
When searching for clues about how Neolithic peoples lived, British archaeologist Lisa-Marie Shillito starts by examining ____ trash. Buried trash deposits (known as middens) are a rich source of information for archaeologists like Shillito.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句中“Neolithic peoples”是复数名词，指新石器时代的人们，其正确的复数所有格代词是 their。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Many places in the United States share a name with a foreign city or country. When founding the town of Edinburgh, Indiana, residents decided to name_____after the Scottish city of Edinburgh.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 指代前文提到的“the town of Edinburgh, Indiana”（印第安纳州的埃迪森堡镇），这是一个单数名词（城镇），因此应使用单数代词 it 来指代。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Many ranching terms come from Spanish. For example, the word “rodeo” (a roundup) comes from the Spanish word rodear, and “cinch” (a belt)_____ from cincho. This is because the first Anglo, African, and Native American cattle ranchers in the southwestern US learned the trade from Spanish-speaking Mexican vaqueros, or cowboys.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 本句讲述的是词汇来源的客观事实，应使用一般现在时。主语为单数名词谓语动词需用第三人称单数形式 comes，与前半句的时态和结构保持一致。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·The Vistula River is in Europe.
·It is the eighth longest river in Europe.
·It crosses the countries Belarus and Poland.
·It ranks No.133 among the longest rivers in the world.
·It is 1,213 kilometers long.

The student wants to specify how many kilometers long the Vistula River is. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Vistula River crosses both Belarus and Poland in Europe.
B. The Vistula River in Europe is 1,213 kilometers long.
C. Among the longest rivers in the world, the Vistula River ranks No. 133.
D. The eighth longest river in Europe, the Vistula River crosses s both Belarus and Poland.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一名学生在研究某个主题时记录了以下笔记：
·维斯瓦河位于欧洲。
·它是欧洲第八长的河流。
·它流经白俄罗斯和波兰。
·它在世界最长河流中排名第133位。
·它全长1,213公里。
答案解析：
题目要求明确说明河流的长度。选项B直接给出了“维斯瓦河全长1,213公里”，并补充了“在欧洲”这一地理位置，完全符合目标。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Unlike the sprawling, permanent mural installations of Aurora Reyes Flores and other contemporaries of the Muralismo Mexicano movement, the easily reproducible block print posters that Alberto Beltrán and Jean Charlot created as part of the printmaking collective Taller de Gráfica Popular (TGP) were highly portable. _____ the prints were a boon to the TGP’ s goal of spreading their artwork throughout Mexico and the world beyond.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
与奥罗拉·雷耶斯·弗洛雷斯等墨西哥壁画运动同时代艺术家所创作的大规模永久性壁画装置不同，阿尔贝托·贝尔特兰和让·夏洛作为版画团体“大众图像工作室”（TGP）成员创作的可大量复制的木版画海报具有高度便携性。_____ 这些版画对TGP将其艺术作品传播至墨西哥乃至世界各地的目标而言是一大助力。
答案解析：
前一句说木版画海报“高度便携”，后一句说它们“对传播目标是一大助力”。两句之间是因果关系：因为便携，所以有助于传播。因此，需要一个表示“因此、这样一来”的逻辑连接词。选项 D As such.（因此，这样）最符合此处的因果逻辑。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·Chapantongo is a municipality in the state of Hidalgo, Mexico.
·It had a population of 12,967 in 2020.
·Chapulhuacán is a municipality in Hidalgo.
·It had a population of 22,903 in 2020.
·Municipalities are governmental regions responsible for providing many public services to their residents.
·Hidalgo is divided into 84 municipalities.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between Chapantongo and Chapulhuacán. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Chapantongo is one of 84 governmental regions, known as municipalities, in Hidalgo, Mexico.
B. As of 2020, Chapantongo was not as populous as Chapulhuacán.
C. As a municipality of Hidalgo, Chapulhuacán is responsible for providing many public services.
D. Both Chapantongo and Chapulhuacán are municipalities in Hidalgo, Mexico.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一名学生在研究某个主题时记录了以下笔记：
·查潘通戈是墨西哥伊达尔戈州的一个市镇。
·它在2020年人口为12,967人。
·查普尔瓦坎是伊达尔戈州的一个市镇。
·它在2020年人口为22,903人。
·市镇是负责为居民提供许多公共服务的行政区划。
·伊达尔戈州分为84个市镇。
答案解析：
题目要求强调两个地点之间的“相似之处”。笔记中明确指出二者都是“伊达尔戈州的市镇”。选项D直接点明“查潘通戈和查普尔瓦坎都是墨西哥伊达尔戈州的市镇”，准确抓住了这一核心共同点。其他选项只分别说明单方面信息或对比差异，未突出“共同点”。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
Thousands of years ago, the Olmec civilization’ s reign over parts of eastern Mexico ended. _____ the Olmecs’ massive stone statues of human heads remain. Two of these statues, known as Monument 4 and Monument 3, weigh over 5 tons!

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
数千年前，奥尔梅克文明对墨西哥东部部分地区的统治结束了。_____ 奥尔梅克人的巨大石制人头雕像仍然留存。其中两座被称为纪念碑4号和3号的雕像，重量超过5吨！
答案解析：
第一句说奥尔梅克文明的统治“结束了”，第二句说其石像“仍然留存”。两句之间是转折关系，强调尽管文明已逝，但遗迹仍在。因此，需要一个表示“尽管如此、然而”的转折连接词。选项 A Still, 最符合逻辑。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·Sodium is a chemical element.
·When the electrons of a chemical element change energy states, certain wavelengths of light are released.
·This unique collection of wavelengths is known as the emission spectrum of the element.
·Sodium’ s emission spectrum includes the 589.5 nanometer (nm) wavelength of light.
·Wavelengths of 570–590nm make up the yellow portion of the visible spectrum.

The student wants to indicate one of the wavelengths of light in sodium’ s emission spectrum. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Sodium’ s emission spectrum consists of a unique collection of wavelengths.
B. When sodium’ s electrons change energy states, certain wavelengths of light are released.
C. One of the wavelengths in sodium’ s emission spectrum is the 589.5 nm wavelength.
D. If a chemical element releases a wavelength of light between 570-590 nm, that wavelength would be part of the yellow portion of the visible spectrum.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一名学生在研究某个主题时记录了以下笔记：
·钠是一种化学元素。
·当化学元素的电子改变能量状态时，会释放特定波长的光。
·这种独特的波长组合称为该元素的发射光谱。
·钠的发射光谱包含波长为 589.5 纳米（nm）的光。
·570–590 nm 的波长构成可见光谱的黄色部分。
答案解析：
题目要求“指出钠发射光谱中的一个波长”。笔记中明确提到“钠的发射光谱包含 589.5 nm 的波长”。选项C直接陈述“钠发射光谱中的一个波长是 589.5 nm”，并使用了笔记中的具体数据，最精准地实现了目标。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·Ukiyo-e woodblock prints were a popular artistic form in Japan from the 1600s through the 1800s.
·Ukiyo-e prints were produced by teams of artisans that included artists, wood-carvers, printers, and publishers.
·Sōsaku-hanga was a popular Japanese printmaking movement that emerged in the early 1900s.
·Sōsaku-hanga prioritized individual artistic expression.
·An artist working in this style typically handled all aspects of print creation, from drawing to wood carving to printing.

The student wants to contrast ukiyo-e and Sōsaku-hanga production methods. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In contrast to ukiyo-e prints, Sōsaku-hanga prints were produced using methods such as drawing and wood carving.
B. Ukiyo-e prints were popular in Japan from the 1600s through the 1800s, while sōsaku-hanga prints emerged later, in the early 1900s.
C. One notable distinction between ukiyo-e and Sōsaku-hanga prints is sōsaku-hanga's emphasis on individual artistic expression.
D. Teams of artisans produced ukiyo-e prints, whereas individual artists typically handled all aspects of Sōsaku-hanga printmaking themselves.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一名学生在研究某个主题时记录了以下笔记：
·浮世绘木版画是17世纪至19世纪日本流行的艺术形式。
·浮世绘版画是由艺术家、木雕师、印刷师和出版商组成的工匠团队制作的。
·创作版画是20世纪初兴起的一场日本流行版画运动。
·创作版画强调个人艺术表达。
·这种风格的艺术家通常亲自处理版画创作的所有环节，从绘画、木雕到印刷。
答案解析：
题目要求“对比生产方法”。笔记明确指出：浮世绘由“团队”制作，而创作版画由“个体艺术家”独立完成所有环节。选项D“团队工匠制作浮世绘，而个体艺术家通常自行处理创作版画的所有方面”直接对比了二者的制作方式，最契合要求。
exam_name: 2025年12月亚太阅读语法第1套M2-Easy（去重版）

question:
In eastern Mexico, Monument 89 and Monument 4 are the names given to two massive human head statues that were left behind by the ancient Olmec civilization. Both statues are made of stone and are extremely heavy. _____ they each weigh more than 5 tons!

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在墨西哥东部，Monument 89 和 Monument 4 是古代奥尔梅克文明留下的两个巨大人头雕像的名称。这两个雕像都是用石头制成的，而且非常重。_____ 它们每个都重达5吨以上！
中文解析：
选项D "In fact,"（事实上）是最逻辑的过渡，因为它用于进一步强调或证实前一句的陈述（雕像"非常重"），通过提供具体重量（5吨以上）来强化事实。

question:
In a theater-in-the-round, the stage is surrounded on all sides by the audience. This means that the play must remain visible from all angles. _____ plays performed in-the-round often use minimal sets and scenery, so the view of the actors is not blocked.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在圆形剧场中，舞台被观众四面环绕。这意味着戏剧必须从所有角度都可见。_____ 在圆形剧场中演出的戏剧经常使用极简的布景和道具，这样演员的视线就不会被阻挡。
中文解析：
选项D "For this reason,"（因此）是最逻辑的过渡，因为它表示因果关系：前两句说明圆形剧场要求戏剧从所有角度可见，这直接导致了使用极简布景的结果，以确保视线不受阻挡。

question:
Bing Xie and her team have discovered that plains zebras make at least four types of vocalizations: “snorts,” “soft snorts,” “squeals,” and “quagga quagga” calls. The researchers used machine-learning algorithms to_____ recorded vocalizations according to type, finding that snorts vary across individual zebras, while squeals are more uniform across zebra populations.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Bing Xie和她的团队发现平原斑马至少能发出四种类型的叫声：“喷鼻声”、“轻柔喷鼻声”、“尖叫声”和“quagga quagga”叫声。研究人员使用机器学习算法根据类型对记录的叫声进行______，发现喷鼻声因斑马个体而异，而尖叫声在不同斑马种群中更为一致。
中文解析：
文中提到研究人员要区分四种叫声类型，并使用机器学习算法进行分析，因此最合理且精确的动词是“分类”（categorize）。其他选项如collapse（合并）、extend（扩展）、suppress（抑制）均不符合“按类型区分声音”的语境和逻辑。

question:
The dinosaur displays at museums such as the Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County in Los Angeles (which has a mounted Allosaurus fragilis skeleton among its Holdings) are notable for the______ of the research behind them—the museum staff consulted numerous sources to ensure the accuracy of the displays.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
诸如洛杉矶县自然历史博物馆（其馆藏中包含一具安装好的脆弱异特龙骨架）等机构的恐龙展览，因其背后研究的______而引人注目——博物馆工作人员参考了大量资料以确保展览的准确性。
中文解析：
文中提到工作人员“参考了大量资料以确保准确性”，这直接体现了研究过程的细致、严谨和高标准。rigor 意为“严谨、严格”，最符合语境。其他选项：A. shallowness（浅薄）与文意相反。B. novelty（新颖性）未在文中体现。C. obscurity（模糊性）与“确保准确性”矛盾。

question:
Ian Gilligan et al. claim that during the Ice Age, humans at Stajnia Cave in Europe made fitted clothing by boring holes in pieces of hide and fur with a sharpened bone tool called an awl and then threading cord through the holes to bind the pieces together. Eventually, as evidenced by artifacts at Shuidonggou 2 in East Asia, someone perforated the end of a bone awl to make an eye (hole) to hold the cord, thereby creating a sewing needle with which both steps could be performed in a single motion. This sped up the process of making clothing and, by freeing them from the need to push cord through holes manually, allowed artisans to make smaller holes and thus finer seams.

Based on the text, what can be concluded about clothing made during the Ice Age?
selections: A. Clothing made with awls at sites like Stajnia Cave could likely be made more quickly than clothing made with needles at sites like Shuidonggou 2.
B. Clothing made at sites like Stajnia Cave was likely made with needles, while clothing made at sites like Shuidonggou 2 was likely made with awls.
C. Clothing made with awls at sites like Stajnia Cave likely had coarser seams than clothing made with needles at sites like Shuidonggou 2 did.
D. Clothing made with awls at sites like Stajnia Cave likely had finer seams than clothing made with needles at sites like Shuidonggou 2 did.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Ian Gilligan等人声称，在冰河时期，欧洲斯塔尼亚洞穴的人类使用一种名为“锥子”的尖锐骨制工具，在兽皮和毛皮上钻孔，然后用绳索穿过孔洞将碎片绑在一起，制作出合身的衣物。后来，根据东亚水洞沟2号遗址的文物证据，有人在骨锥末端穿孔制成“针眼”以固定绳索，从而发明了缝衣针，使得两个步骤可以一次完成。这加快了制衣过程，并且由于无需手动穿线，工匠可以制作更小的孔，从而得到更精细的缝线。
中文解析：
文本明确指出，使用针（水洞沟2号）可以制作更小的孔和更精细的缝线，而使用锥子（斯塔尼亚洞穴）则需要手动穿线，无法实现同样精细的缝制效果。因此，使用锥子制作的衣物缝线相对更粗糙。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● The Galápagos penguin is a species of bird found in the Galápagos Islands.
● It has an average weight of 2,500 grams.
● The large ground finch is a species of bird found in the Galápagos Islands.
● It has an average weight of 35 grams.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two bird species. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The large ground finch and the Galápagos penguin are both bird species.
B. The large ground finch and the Galápagos penguin can be found in the Galápagos Islands.
C. On average, the Galápagos penguin weighs 2,500 grams, while the large ground finch weighs only 35 grams.
D. The Galápagos penguin is a bird with an average weight of 2,500 grams.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记：
●加拉帕戈斯企鹅是一种在加拉帕戈斯群岛发现的鸟类。
●它的平均重量为2500克。
●大嘴地雀是一种在加拉帕戈斯群岛发现的鸟类。
●它的平均重量为35克。
中文解析：
选项C直接比较了两种鸟类的重量（企鹅2500克 vs. 地雀35克），突出了重量上的巨大差异，从而最有效地实现了强调差异的目标。因此，正确答案应为C

question:
All stainless steel contains varying amounts of iron, carbon, and corrosion-inhibiting chromium. However, ferritic stainless steel, often used for induction cookers, contains a higher percentage of chromium (at least 10.5%) than does austenitic stainless steel and a higher concentration of iron, which is responsible for its magnetic properties. Unlike ferritic stainless steel, austenitic stainless steel has a face-centered cubic crystalline structure resulting from the addition of nickel to the alloy. Austenitic stainless steel has two subtypes: the 200 series, often used for home water tanks, and the 300 series, which has more nickel than the 200 series and is often used for pharmaceutical equipment or compensate. Thus, stainless steel used to manufacture __________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. pharmaceutical equipment will have a concentration of chromium lower than 10.5%, while stainless steel used to manufacture home water tanks will not.
B. home water tanks will have a lower percentage of chromium in its composition than stainless steel used for induction cookers will.
C. compensate with similar magnetic properties to stainless steel used to manufacture induction cookers.
D. induction cookers will have a face-centered cubic crystalline structure.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
所有不锈钢都含有不同量的铁、碳和抗腐蚀的铬。然而，常用于感应炊具的铁素体不锈钢比奥氏体不锈钢含有更高比例的铬（至少10.5%）和更高浓度的铁，这使其具有磁性。与铁素体不锈钢不同，奥氏体不锈钢因添加镍而具有面心立方晶体结构。奥氏体不锈钢有两个子类型：200系列（常用于家用热水箱）和300系列（镍含量更高，常用于制药设备或补偿）。因此，用于制造_____空白的不锈钢
中文解析：
选项B（家用热水箱的不锈钢铬含量将低于用于感应炊具的不锈钢）最符合文本逻辑，因为文本明确指出铁素体不锈钢（用于感应炊具）的铬含量高于奥氏体不锈钢，而家用热水箱使用的是奥氏体不锈钢的200系列，因此其铬含量自然较低。其他选项与文本信息矛盾或缺乏支持。

question:
During a 2022 expedition led by research zoologist Andrea Quattrini, scientists discovered a new species of black coral off the coast of Puerto Rico. Like other black corals, the newly discovered species, which they named Aphanipathes puertoricoensis, has coiled branching structures that ____ it survive in the deep sea.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 因为关系代词that指代复数名词coiled branching structures，所以动词必须使用复数形式help以保持主谓一致。

question:
• Calida Garcia Rawles is an African American painter.
• She is known for her large-scale, hyperrealistic paintings depicting African American figures in water.
• The painting When It calls (16×12 in) depicts a bearded man with his arms outstretched floating in the bottom left corner of the canvas.
• Lost in the Shuffle (36×24 in) depicts two young men with their arms outstretched floating in the bottom left and upper right corners of the canvas.
• She paints the water with vivid blue colors, including black blue and mint blue.
• The mood in the paintings is calm.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize a difference between the two paintings?
selections: A. Although the number of figures may differ, constant among Rawles’s hyperrealistic works is the calm mood that the paintings evoke.
B. While some of Rawles’s works, such as When It Calls, feature one figure in the composition, Lost in the Shuffle features two figures floating in the vivid blue water.
C. Among the many stunning works of Calida Garcia Rawles is Lost in the Shuffle, a calm 36-by-24-inch painting depicting two young men floating with their arms outstretched in the vivid blue water.
D. Calida Garcia Rawles captures the water in paintings such as When It Calls and Lost in the Shuffle in vivid hues of black blue and mint blue.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
•Calida Garcia Rawles 是一位非洲裔美国画家。
•她以大型、超写实的绘画而闻名，描绘了水中的非洲裔美国人物。
•画作《When It Calls》（16×12 英寸）描绘了一个有胡子的男人，双臂伸展，漂浮在画布的左下角。
•《Lost in the Shuffle》（36×24 英寸）描绘了两个年轻男人，双臂伸展，漂浮在画布的左下角和右上角。
•她用鲜艳的蓝色画水，包括黑蓝色和薄荷蓝。
•画中的氛围是平静的。
中文解析：
选项B最有效地强调了两幅画的差异，因为它直接对比了《When It Calls》中只有一个 figure（人物）而《Lost in the Shuffle》中有两个 figures。

question:
The following text is from Robert Lowel’s 1964 poem “For the Union Dead.” The South Boston Aquarium closed permanently in 1954.
The old South Boston Aquarium stands
in a Sahara of snow now. Its broken windows are boarded.
The bronze weathervane cod has lost half its scales.
The airy tanks are dry.
©2003 by Robert Lowell

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To contrast the effects of different kinds of weather on a building
B. To argue that a building should be rehabilitated
C. To describe details of the deteriorated state of a building
D. To explain why a once-popular building was abandoned
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本摘自罗伯特·洛威尔1964年的诗《为联邦死者》：
南波士顿水族馆于1954年永久关闭。
古老的南波士顿水族馆如今矗立在一片雪的撒哈拉中，它破碎的窗户被木板封住。
青铜风向标鳕鱼掉了半片鳞片。
通风的水箱都干了。
中文解析：
选项C正确，因为文本主要通过对窗户被封、风向标损坏和水箱干涸等细节的描绘，生动地展现了水族馆的破败状态，而没有涉及天气对比、修复论证或废弃原因的解释。

question:
To British musician Jacob Collier, substituting the Imaj7 chord for the ib6 chord—its opposite in pitch and tone—adds expression to improvisation without creating dissonance. This conceptualization of harmonic opposites did not originate with _____ 1985, the idea was first articulated in Swiss musicologist Ernst Levy’s posthumously published book A Theory of Harmony.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 题目文本有三个句子，空处连接了后两个句子This conceptualization of....Collier和the idea was first articulated...A Theory of Harmony,所以排除了AD（两个句子之间不能用逗号连接），第一个句子和第二个句子是转折关系，所以however放在第二个句子内。

question:
The Tiwi geothermal power plant in the Philippines provides a reliable source of renewable energy, yet geothermal plants supply only around 10.1% of the Philippines' electricity. Indeed, the necessary combination of naturally occurring geological and hydrological features—accessible underground reservoirs, sufficiently high underground temperatures, and fractured rocks— ______ relatively rare, effectively limiting the Philippines’ development of new geothermal energy infrastructure.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 因为句子主语"the necessary combination"是单数名词，所以谓语动词必须使用单数形式"has proved"以保持主谓一致。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Bert terHart is a Canadian sailor.
● Seaburban is a sailboat.
● terHart sailed Seaburban on a nonstop, 266-day journey around the world.
● Jesse Martin is an Australian sailor.
● Lionheart is a sailboat.
● Martin sailed Lionheart on a nonstop, 328-day journey around the world.

The student wants to compare the durations of the two sailors’ journeys. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Both Martin and terHart embarked on sailing journeys around the world.
B. Martin’s journey took place aboard Lionheart, while terHart sailed on Seaburban.
C. Canadian sailor Bert terHart sailed Seaburban around the world in 266 days.
D. Martin’s 328-day journey around the world took longer than terHart’s 266-day journey.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记：
● Bert terHart 是一名加拿大水手。
● Seaburban 是一艘帆船。
● terHart 驾驶 Seaburban 进行了为期266天的不间断环球航行。
● Jesse Martin 是一名澳大利亚水手。
● Lionheart 是一艘帆船。
● Martin 驾驶 Lionheart 进行了为期328天的不间断环球航行。
中文解析：
选项D最有效地比较了航行持续时间，因为它直接对比了Martin的328天航行和terHart的266天航行。

question:
Blue holes, such as Nancy’s Blue Hole in the Abaco Islands, are large marine sinkholes. They are typically located in areas where the ocean bedrock is made of soluble material (e. g., marble) because rock erosion is crucial to their formation. Because of the preserved fossils they contain, blue holes attract numerous divers and scientists. Currently, the Taa m Ja’ Blue Hole in Chetumal Bay, Mexico, is the deepest blue hole on record, measured by Joan A. Sánchez-Sánchez and colleagues to be at least 420 meters below sea level.

According to the text, what draws divers and scientists to blue holes such as Nancy’s Blue Hole and the Taam Ja’ Blue Hole?
selections: A. A commitment to protecting the marble and other soluble materials in the blue holes
B. An interest in comparing the depths of Nancy’s Blue Hole and the Taam Ja' Blue Hole to the depths of other blue holes
C. A hope to observe fossils that are located in the blue holes
D. A desire to witness the erosion of the rocks in the blue holes
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
蓝洞，如阿巴科群岛的南希蓝洞，是大型海洋沉洞。它们通常位于海洋基岩由可溶性材料（如大理石）组成的区域，因为岩石侵蚀对其形成至关重要。由于蓝洞中含有保存完好的化石，它们吸引了众多潜水员和科学家。目前，墨西哥切图马尔湾的塔姆贾蓝洞是记录中最深的蓝洞，由琼·A·桑切斯-桑切斯及其同事测量，至少低于海平面420米。
中文解析：
选项C正确，因为文本明确指出蓝洞吸引潜水员和科学家的原因是“由于它们包含保存完好的化石”（Because of the preserved fossils they contain）。

question:
While some biologists cite the general lineage species concept (Queiroz 1998), others adhere to the biological species concept (Coyne and Orr 2004), with at least fourteen other concepts used across the field. Such lack of consensus, however, isn’t necessarily cause for alarm. Scholars supporting a pluralist approach—in place of a single, monistic concept—to defining a species_____ that a diversity of species concepts fits their equally diverse applications throughout the discipline.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 选项C "argue" 正确，因为主语"Scholars"是复数名词，需要复数形式的谓语动词"argue"以保持主谓一致。

question:
Brigadier General Virgilio Cordero was a soldier in the United States 65th infantry Regiment, a Puerto Rico-based regiment of the US Army. In 2016, the United States Congress honored Cordero and the other servicepeople of the 65th infantry Regiment with one of its highest_____Congressional Gold Medal.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 冒号用于引入具体例子或解释，这里"the Congressional Gold Medal"是"highest honors"的具体体现，使句子结构清晰合理。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● In the Electoral College system that determines the outcome of US presidential elections, the winner of Connecticut’s popular vote receives all 7 of Connecticut’s electoral votes.
● A 2001 article written by law professors Akhil and Vikram Amar proposed that states could instead agree to award their electoral votes to the winner of the national popular vote.
● The Amars’ idea is the basis of the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact (NPVIC).
● If states holding a majority of electoral college votes (270) adopt the NPVIC, the compact will take effect and adopters will award their electoral votes accordingly.
● Connecticut adopted the NPVlC in 2018.

The student wants to explain the significance of Connecticut’s NPVIC adoption. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. According to the idea proposed by the Amars, the winner of Connecticut’s popular vote will receive all of the state’s electoral votes if the NPVIC takes effect.
B. An agreement among US states to award their electoral votes to the presidential candidate who wins the national popular vote was adopted by Connecticut in 2018.
C. If the NPVIC takes effect, adopter Connecticut will award all 7 of its electoral votes to the winner of the national, rather than the state’s, popular vote.

D. Because it has adopted the NPVIC, Connecticut will award its electoral votes to the winner of the state’s popular vote — once states holding a majority of electoral college votes (270) do the same.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记：
● 在决定美国总统选举结果的选举人团制度中，康涅狄格州普选胜者获得该州全部7张选举人票。
● 2001年，法学教授Akhil和Vikram Amar撰写的一篇文章提出，各州可以同意将选举人票授予全国普选胜者。
● Amar兄弟的想法是《全国普选州际契约》（NPVIC）的基础。
● 如果拥有选举人团多数票（270张）的州采用NPVIC，该契约将生效，采用州将据此授予选举人票。
● 康涅狄格州于2018年采用了NPVIC。
中文解析：
选项C最有效地解释了康涅狄格州采用NPVIC的意义，因为它明确指出，如果NPVIC生效，康涅狄格州将把全部7张选举人票授予全国普选胜者，而不是州普选胜者，这直接体现了从当前制度到新制度的转变。其他选项存在错误：A错误地声称州普选胜者将获得选举人票（实际应为全国胜者）；B仅描述 adoption 事实，未说明意义；D错误地表示选举人票仍将授予州普选胜者（与NPVIC目的不符）。

question: Line k is shown in the xy-plane. Line j (not shown) is perpendicular to line k and passes through the point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>15</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>29</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. Which equation defines line j?
explanations: 在图像中选取line k上的两个点的坐标（0,3）（4,0），根据两个点的坐标计算可得斜率为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>4</mn></mfrac></math>；垂直的两条直线的斜率相乘得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></math>，所以与line k垂直的line j 的斜率是<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo>/</mo></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>4</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>4</mn><mn>3</mn></mfrac></math>，故答案为C或者D；代入<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>15</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>29</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>检验可得答案为C。

question: The length of a side of square X is 8 centimeters. The area of rectangle Y is 28 square centimeters. What is the total area, in square centimeters, of square X and rectangle Y?
explanations: 正方形的面积是8*8=64，长方形的面积是28，两个图形的面积之和就是64+28=92，故选C。

question: One of the factors of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>6</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>4</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>29</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>28</mn></math> is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mi>b</mi></math>,where a and b are positive constants. Which of the following is a possible value of ab?
explanations: 考查因式分解，原式可以因式分解为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mn>3</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow></math>，所以ab=2*7=14或ab=3*4=12，故选D。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>153</mn></math>

question:
