question:
The scatterplot shows the relationship between x and y. A line of best fit is also shown.
Which of the following is closest to the slope of the line of best fit shown?
explanations: 在直线上选取两个点的坐标（0,0）（5,3），计算可得直线的斜率为0.6，选项中与0.6最接近的是0.54，故选C。

question:
Circle A: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>9</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>p</mi><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>24</mn></math>
Circle B: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>p</mi><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>24</mn></math>
In the given equations, p is a positive constant. Which statement correctly compares the graphs of circles A and B in the xy-plane?
selections: A. Circle B is the reflection of circle A across the x-axis.
B. Circle B is the reflection of circle A across the y-axis.
C. Circle B is the translation of circle A 18 units to the right.
D. Circle B is the translation of circle A 18 units up.
explanations: 圆心为（a,b），圆的半径为r，那圆的方程就是<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>a</mi><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math>，据此可知圆A的圆心是<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>9</mn><mo>,</mo><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>，圆B的圆心是<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>9</mn><mo>,</mo><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>。这两个圆心是关于y轴对称的，故选B。

question: During a trip, Bill drove his car for 14.0 miles and then began driving at a constant speed of 70.0 miles per hour. After 2 hours of driving at this speed, what is the total distance, in miles, Bill has traveled during this trip?

James purchased a certain baseball card on January 1. The function <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>75</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1.04</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mi>x</mi> </msup></math>, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>0</mn> <mo>≤</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>≤</mo> <mn>10</mn></math> gives the predicted value, in dollars, of the baseball card x years after James purchased it. What is the best interpretation of the statement “<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>6</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> is approximately equal to 95” in this context?
selections: A. 6 years after James purchased the baseball card, its predicted value is approximately 95 dollars.
B. When the baseball card’s predicted value is approximately 95 dollars, it is 6% greater than the predicted value, in dollars, on January 1 of the previous year.
C. When the baseball card’s predicted value is approximately 95 dollars, it is 6 times the predicted value, in dollars, on January 1 of the previous year.
D. From the day James purchased the baseball card to 6 years after James purchased the card, its predicted value increased by a total of approximately 95 dollars.
explanations: 考查指数函数的解释，x表示多少年，f(x)表示卡片的价值，所以f(6)=95,表示6年以后卡片价值为95美元，符合该描述的是A选项，故选A。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>14</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>12</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>17</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>
What is a positive solution to the given equation?
explanations: 根据方程可以知道方程的解为14,12，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn></math>，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>17</mn></math>，题目要的是正数解，所以答案是12或者14。

question: A jar has 310 marbles, and 20% of these marbles are blue. How many marbles in the jar are blue?

If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>4</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>10</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>6</mn></math>, what is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>4</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>10</mn></math>?

For a project, Kayla recorded the heights of 21 people in her neighborhood. The histogram summarizes the heights, in inches (in), of these 21 people in Kayla’s neighborhood. The first bar represents people with a height of at least 51 in but less than 53 in. The second bar represents people with a height of at least 53 in but less than 55 in, and so on.
How many of these 21 people in Kayla’s neighborhood had a height of at least 51 in but less than 55 in?
explanations: 等于51，小于55表示前两个柱子，对应的数量是3+5=8，故答案为8。

question: The measures of the interior angles of triangle ABC are 4l°, 82°, and x°. What is the value of x?
explanations: 考查三角形的内角和是180°，41+82+x=180，计算可得x=57，故选D。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn></math>
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>9</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>15</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>24</mn></math>
How many solutions does the given system of equations have?
explanations: 考查两根直线的交点问题，因为第二个式子的所有系数都是第一个式子的系数乘3所得，所以两根直线实际是一根直线，那就有无穷多个交点，故选D。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn></math>
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn></math>
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>h</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></math>
The functions f, g, and h are defined as shown. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>⋅</mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mi>h</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></math>, where a, b, and c are constants, what is the value of b?
explanations: 将f(x)、g(x)、h(x)的表达式代入f(x)*g(x)-h(x)计算可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>15</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>23</mn></math>，故b为15，所以答案是C。

question: For two acute angles X and Y, the measure of angle Y is 28° and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>sin</mi> <mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo> <mi>X</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mi>cos</mi> <mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo> <mi>Y</mi> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mn>1</mn></math>. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle X?
explanations: 因为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>sin</mi> <mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo> <mi>X</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mi>cos</mi> <mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo> <mi>Y</mi> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mn>1</mn></math>，所以sinX=cosY，所以两个锐角X和 Y的关系是X+Y=90°，把Y=28°代入计算可得X=62°，故选D。

question: A survey was conducted in Arlington to estimate the percent of adult residents who support the addition of a gas station at a popular intersection in their town. Based on the survey, it is estimated that 51% of all adult residents of Arlington support the addition of a gas station at a popular intersection in their town, with an associated margin of error of 7%. Which of the following is the most appropriate conclusion about all adult residents of Arlington?
selections: A. The addition of a gas station at a popular intersection in the town is supported by more than 58% of all adult residents of Arlington.
B. Plausible values for the percent of all adult residents of Arlington who support the addition of a gas station at a popular intersection in their town are between 44% and 58%.
C. Plausible values for the percent of all adult residents of Arlington who support the addition of a gas station at a popular intersection in their town are either less than 44% or more than 58%.
D. The addition of a gas station at a popular intersection in the town is supported by exactly 44% of all adult residents of Arlington.
explanations: 考察的margin of error，最合适的比例应该是样本比例加减margin of error，即51%加减7%，也就是44%到57%，故选B。

question: The function g is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>18</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, where t is a constant. In the xy-plane, the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> passes through the point (22,0). What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>?
explanations: 如果g(x)=（x+18）（t-x）=0，那么x=-18或者x=t，因为该函数通过（22,0）这个点，所以t=22，故g(x)=（x+18）（22-x），将x=0代入该函数计算可得结果为396。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>h</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>16</mn><msup><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi></math>
The function h estimates an object’s height, in feet, above the ground t seconds after the object is dropped, where b is a constant. The function estimates that the object is 6.76 feet above the ground when it is dropped at <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>. How many seconds after being dropped does the function estimate the object will hit the ground?
explanations: t=0时，h(t)=0+b=6.76，故<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>h</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>16</mn><msup><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>6.76</mn></math>；撞击地面即为h(t)=0，代入函数求解可得t=0.65，故答案为0.65。

question: The equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>54</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>y</mi></math> gives the perimeter of a rectangular garden that has length x, in feet, and width y, in feet. The width of the garden is 12 feet. What is the length, in feet, of the garden?
explanations: 把y=12代入54=2x+2y求解可得x=15，故答案是15.

question: A beekeeper’s initial observation of the population of a certain bee colony was 1,900 bees. The beekeeper set a goal to increase the population to 3,025 bees. The beekeeper uses a model that predicts the population of this bee colony begins at 1,900 and increases by 90 bees per week in the first two weeks after the initial observation, and then increases by 135 bees per week until the beekeeper’s goal is reached. According to this model, at the end of week w after the initial observation, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>w</mi><mo>></mo><mn>2</mn></math>,which of the following functions gives the predicted number of bees still needed to reach the beekeeper’s goal?
explanations: 需要找的是w>2，即2周以后的表达式，故前两周的增长已经完成，那2周以后还需要增长的数量是3025-1900-90*2=945。后续每周增长135，那就是y=945-135*（w-2）=1215-135w，故选D。

question: The graph of the function f, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, gives the total cost y, in dollars, for a certain video game system and a x games. What is the best interpretation of the slope of the graph in this context?
selections: B. The video game system costs $24.
C. The video game system costs $150.
explanations: 直线的斜率计算可得为24，符合要求的是BD，根据x轴、y轴表达的含义可知答案为D。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>≥</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn></math>
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>≤</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>9</mn></math>
Which point (x,y) is a solution to the given system of inequalities in the xy-plane?
explanations: 考查线性不等式，把选项代入两个式子检验可得答案为A。

question: A machine makes 9-inch, 4-inch, and 7-inch parts. During a certain day, the number of 9-inch parts that the machine makes is 3 times the number n of 4-inch parts, and the number of 7-inch parts is 12. During this day, the machine makes 100 parts total. Which equation represents this situation?
selections: C. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mi>n</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>+</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mi>n</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>12</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>100</mn></math>
explanations: 4-inch的数量为n，9-inch的数量为3n，7-inch的数量为12，总数量为100，即n+3n+12 =100，故选B。

question: At different times on a certain day, a manager at a theme park recorded the number of visitors. An exponential model gives the estimated number of visitors, V, at the theme park t hours after the theme park opened, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>t</mi> <mo>≤</mo> <mn>3</mn></math>. Based on the model, 70 visitors were estimated to be at the theme park when it opened, and every 30 minutes the estimated number of visitors increased by 140% of the estimated number of visitors 30 minutes earlier. Which of the following equations best represents this model?
explanations: 每次比之前增长140%，所以底数是1+140%=2.4，所以答案是B或者C。如果是每小时增长140%的话，那表达式应该是N=70（2.40）t，但是现在是每30分钟增长140%，相对于每小时增长140%来说，增长的速度变快了，符合加快的是B，故选B。

question: The quadratic equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>6</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>16</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi></math>, where a is a constant, has exactly one real solution. What is the value of a?
explanations: 平方项大于等于0，当大于0时，方程有2个解，当等于0时，方程只有一个解，所以a=0，故答案为0。

question: A car dealership has only sedans, SUVs, and minivans for sale. On Monday, 30% of the vehicles for sale were sedans and 50% were SUVs. If there were 18 sedans for sale at the dealership on Monday, how many minivans were for sale?
explanations: 考查比例，sedan:SUV:minivan =30% ：50%：（1-30%-50%）=3:5:2，sedan的数量为18，那minivan的数量就18/3*2=12，故答案为12。

question:
In triangle RST, the measure of angle R is 49°, the measure of angle S is x°, and the measure of angle T is (7x−5)∘. Point L lies on RS―, point K lies on 
ST―, and LK― is parallel to RT―. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle SKL? (Disregard the degree symbol when entering your answer.)
explanations: 三角形的内角和是180°，所以49+x+(7x-5)=180，计算可得x=17，那7x-5=114。因为LK平行于RT，所以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi data-mjx-auto-op="false">SKL</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>114</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo>∘</mo></mrow></msup></math>。故答案为114。

question: How many solutions does the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>3</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>12</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>+</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>12</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> have?
explanations: 考查两条直线的交点问题，等号左右的式子整理可得12x+36=12x+36,等号左右两边的式子是完全相同的，所以有无穷多个交点，即无穷多个解，故选A。

question:
The functions f and g are defined by the given equations, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math>≥<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn></math>, a and b are integer constants, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo><</mo><mi>b</mi></math>, and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo>></mo><mn>1</mn></math>. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> are graphed in the xy-plane, which of the following equations displays, as a constant or coefficient, the minimum value of the function it defines, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>0</mn></math>？
I. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.48</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup></math>
II. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1.52</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi></math>
explanations:
等式I中，由于 0.48 < 1，且指数 -bx ≤ 0，该函数等价于 f(x) = a * (1/0.48)^{bx}。因为 (1/0.48) > 1 且 b > 0，所以函数在 x ≥ 0 区间内是单调递增的，最小的y值就是方程式起始的数字（x=0的时候），带入x=0，y=a。我们看到a以coefficient的形式出现，所以第一个式子是对的。
等式II中，底数为1.52，所以函数在 x ≥ 0 区间内是一个增函数，带入x=0，我们得到y=a（1.52)^2 + b ，它没有以单独的常数或系数的形式直接写在方程里。方程中可见的常数是 b，系数是 a，但它们单独都不等于最小值，不符合题目要求。
所以只有I是合适的，故选D。

question: A circle in the xy-plane has its center at (35) and has a radius of length 7. Which equation represents this circle?
selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>3</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>5</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>49</mn></math>

B. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>3</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>5</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>49</mn></math>

C. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>3</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>5</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>7</mn></math>

D. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>3</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>5</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>7</mn></math>
explanations: 圆心为（a,b），圆的半径为r，那圆的方程就是<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mi>b</mi> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mi>r</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>，故答案为B。

question:
The table gives the areas and perimeters of two similar rectangles, where n is a constant.
Area (square inches)Perimeter (inches)Rectangle A540180Rectangle B2,160nWhat is the value of n?
explanations: 如果两个相似图形的边长之比为1：a，那周长之比为1:a，面积之比为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>:</mo><msup><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math>。代入题目中的数字可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>2160</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo>/</mo></mrow><mn>540</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></math>，故a=2；故n=180*2=360，所以答案为A。

question: Line t in the xy-plane has a slope of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>1</mn> <mn>5</mn> </mfrac></math> and passes through the point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>15</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. Which equation defines line t?
explanations: 直线的斜率为1/5，所以答案为B或D，代入（15，-9）检验可知答案为D。

question: The function h is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>h</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>10</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> </mrow> <mrow> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mn>9</mn> <msup> <mi>k</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>5</mn> <mi>x</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mi>k</mi> </mrow> </mfrac></math>, Where k is a positive constant. What is the value of h <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>27</mn> <mi>k</mi> </mrow> <mn>8</mn> </mfrac> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow></math>?
explanations: 整理h(x)的式子可以得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">h</mi> </mrow> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi> </mrow> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>5</mn> <mi>x</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mi>k</mi> </mrow> </mfrac></math>，代入<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi> </mrow> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>21</mn> <mi>k</mi> </mrow> <mn>8</mn> </mfrac></math>可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo>−</mo> <mn>35</mn></math>，故选D。

question: The graph of the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></math> is shown, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?
explanations: 根据图像，当x=0时，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn></math>，即<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>4</mn><mn>0</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn></math>，求解可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn></math>，故选B。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>3</mn></mfrac><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></math>
In the given equation, k is a constant. A solution to the equation is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>21</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn><msqrt><mn>69</mn></msqrt></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac></math>.What is the value of k?
explanations: 考查一元二次方程<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>的求根公式<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>χ</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>±</mo><msqrt><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi></msqrt></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>a</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>，将该题的方程整理成标准式为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>3</mn></mfrac><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，将对应的数字代入求根公式计算可得方程的解为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>21</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn><msqrt><mn>49</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>∗</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>3</mn></mfrac><mo>∗</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></msqrt></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac></math> 或者<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>21</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn><msqrt><mn>49</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>∗</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>3</mn></mfrac><mo>∗</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></msqrt></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac></math>  ,所以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>49</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>∗</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>3</mn></mfrac><mo>∗</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>69</mn></math>，计算可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>11</mn></math>，故选A

question:

question: In the figure, AD― and BC― intersect at point D. The measure of ∠ABD is ω∘, the measure of ∠CAD is z∘, and AD=l86. If cos⁡ω∘=941, what is the value of tan z∘?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">w</mi></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi data-mjx-auto-op="false">BAD</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>90</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo>∘</mo></mrow></msup></math>，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">z</mi></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi data-mjx-auto-op="false">BAD</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>90</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo>∘</mo></mrow></msup></math>，所以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi><mi>W</mi><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi><mi>Z</mi></math>,那么cosZ=cosw=9/41，即AD/AC=9/41， 将AD=186代入计算可得AC=7626/9； 根据直角三角形三条边的关系计算可得CD=7440/9，所以tanz=CD/AD=40/9，故答案为40/9。

question:
Which of the following expressions is (are) a factor of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>3</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>10</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>48</mn></math>?
I. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6</mn></math>

question: Zuri has a goal to run at least 12 miles per week while training for a race. This week, she has run 8 miles. If x represents the additional number of miles Zuri needs to run this week to meet her goal, which inequality represents this situation?
explanations: additional表示加，at least表示大于等于，故选A。

question: An area of 55.00 square nautical miles is equivalent to k square kilometers. To the nearest tenth, what is the value of k?(1 nautical mile = 1.852 kilometers)
explanations: 考查单位换算，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi> </mrow> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mtext> </mtext> <mi data-mjx-auto-op="false">km</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>55</mn> <mtext> nautical mile </mtext> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"></mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mn>55</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>⋆</mo> </mrow> </msup> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1.852</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mtext> </mtext> <mi data-mjx-auto-op="false">km</mi> </mrow> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>，计算可得答案为188.6。

question: In the xy-plane, the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>6</mn> <mi>x</mi></math> intersects the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mn>55</mn></math> at two points. What is the sum of the x-coordinates of the two points of intersection?
explanations: 考查韦达定理。将表达式联立为方程组，消掉y可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>6</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mn>55</mn></math>，整理成标准一元二次方程为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>55</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>0</mn></math>，根据韦达定理<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msub> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi> </mrow> <mn>1</mn> </msub> <mo>+</mo> <msub> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msub> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mi>b</mi> <mi>a</mi> </mfrac></math> 可得该方程的两根之和为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6</mn> </mrow> <mn>1</mn> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mn>6</mn></math>。故选D。

question: In 2012, Chloe earned 17% more than in 2011, and in 2013 Chloe earned 3% more than in 2012. If Chloe earned y times as much in 2011 as in 2013, which of the following is closest to the value of y?
explanations: 设2011年对应的数额为x，那2012年就是（1+17%）x=1.17x，2013年就是（1+3%）*1.17x=1.2051x。题目问的是2011年是2013年的多少倍，那就是x/(1.2051x)，计算可得答案为C。

question:
In a section of a 1976 essay discussing cinema of the United States, James Baldwin observed that Lady Sings the Blues (1972), a biographical film about jazz singer Billie Holiday, can be said to reflect Holiday’s life and the experiences of Black Americans only “by courtesy.” According to Baldwin, the failure of this film to authentically represent its subject matter is indicative of a larger trend in films of the era: rather than leveraging the medium’s potential to confront difficult truths, filmmakers and studios often resorted to platitudes about contemporary US society.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It expresses Baldwin’s initial reaction to a US film that the text suggests he would later reconsider.
B. It illustrates a view of Baldwin’s that the text explains departed substantially from the consensus view held by US film critics.
C. It characterizes the nature of the disconnect Baldwin identified between reality and how it was represented in US cinema.
D. It conveys Baldwin's rejection of contemporary US cinema in favor of earlier films that are more authentic representations of society.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在1976年一篇讨论美国电影的文章中，詹姆斯·鲍德温观察到，《Lady Sings the Blues》（1972年），一部关于爵士歌手比莉·哈乐黛的传记电影，可以说只是“出于礼貌”地反映了哈乐黛的生活和美国黑人的经历。根据鲍德温，这部电影未能真实地表现其主题内容，表明了那个时代电影的一个更大趋势：电影制作人和制片厂没有利用媒体的潜力来面对困难的真相，而是经常诉诸关于当代美国社会的陈词滥调。
中文解析：
划线部分“by courtesy”在文本中用于描述电影对现实的反映只是表面和敷衍的，这直接体现了鲍德温所识别的现实与电影表现之间的脱节性质。文本随后将这种脱节扩展为更广泛的趋势，因此C选项准确捕捉了这一功能。其他选项（如A提到后续重新考虑、B涉及共识观点或D比较早期电影）均未在文本中得到支持。

The Girl Scouts of America is an organization famous for its annual sales of several varieties of cookies, including S’ Mores. A student is writing an essay on the history of the organization. The student claims that from 1992 to 1995 the organization’s popularity regularly peaked among participants in a certain age range before declining among older participants as Girl Scout activities began to compete with other interests.

Which choice best describes data from the table that support the student’s claim?
selections: A. Only once between 1992 and 1995 did the number of Ambassadors in the Girl Scouts exceed the number of Brownsies.
B. There were 1,319,000 Browns in the Girl Scouts in 1992 but 1,142,000 in 1995.
C. Throughout the years from 1992 to 1995, the number of Daisies in the Girl Scouts exceeded the number of Ambassadors.
D. For each year from 1992 to 1995, there were fewer Seniors in the Girl Scouts than there were Browns.
explanations:

美国女童子军是一个以其每年销售多种饼干（包括S’mores）而闻名的组织。一名学生正在撰写一篇关于该组织历史的文章。该学生声称，从1992年到1995年，该组织的受欢迎度在某个年龄段的参与者中定期达到顶峰，然后随着女童子军活动开始与其他兴趣竞争，在年长参与者中下降。

question:
The following text is adapted from Alice Dunbar Nelson’s 1899 short story “The Fisherman of Pass Christian.” Pass Christian is a city in the US state of Mississippi.
The swift breezes on the beach at Pass Christian meet and conflict as though each strove for the mastery of the air. The land-breeze blows down through the pines, resinous, fragrant, cold, bringing breath-like memories of dim, dark woods shaded by myriad pine-needles. The breeze from the Gulf is warm and soft and languorous, blowing up from the south with its suggestion of tropical warmth.

As used in the text, what does the word “mastery” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Pass Christian海滩上的迅疾微风相遇并冲突，仿佛每一阵风都在争夺空气的掌控权。陆风从松树林中吹下，带着树脂的芳香、清凉，带来似呼吸般的记忆，那是由无数松针遮蔽的昏暗、幽暗的树林。来自墨西哥湾的风温暖、柔软、令人倦怠，从南方吹来，带着热带温暖的暗示。
中文解析：
在文本中，“mastery”一词用于描述微风在冲突中争夺对空气的控制权，这与“支配”（domination）的意思最为接近，因为它强调了竞争中的主导地位。其他选项如“熟悉”（familiarity）或“技巧”（skillfulness）无法体现这种竞争关系，而“理解”（comprehension）则与上下文无关。

question:
The Underdogs is a 1915 novel by Mariano Azuela, originally written in Spanish. In the novel, Azuela depicts the character Camilla as experiencing a change in how she perceives her immediate surroundings:________

Which quotation from a translation of The Underdogs most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. A. “Camilla’s tongue clove to her mouth, heavy and damp as a rag; she could not utter a word.”

B. A. “All nature was as she had found it before, evening upon evening; but in the stones and the dry weeds, amid the fragrance of the air and the light whir of falling leaves, Camilla sensed a new strangeness, a vast desolation in everything about her.”
C. A. “A dead leaf shook slowly loose from the crest of a tree swinging slowly on the wind, fell like a small dead butterfly at her feet. [Camilla] bent down and took it in her fingers.”

D. A. “[Camilla] closed her eyes fast to hold back the tears that welled up in them. Then, with the back of her hand, she wiped her wet cheeks, and just as she had done three days ago, fled with all the swiftness of a young deer.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《Underdogs》是Mariano Azuela于1915年创作的小说，原版为西班牙语。在小说中，Azuela描绘了角色Camilla经历了她对周围环境感知的变化：________
中文解析：
选项B的引文直接描述了Camilla对环境感知的变化——她虽然看到熟悉的自然景象，但却感受到“一种新的陌生感”和“巨大荒凉”，这恰好体现了文本中声称的“感知变化”。

question:
Notes from a Liar and Her Dog was Gennifer Choldenko’s debut novel. It was published in 2001. A debut novel is the first book that an author has published. Debut novels are especially interesting to literary critics (people whose job it is to evaluate books) and readers because these books offer a look at new voices in the literary world.

According to the text, what is someone who professionally evaluates books called?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《Notes from a Liar and Her Dog》是Gennifer Choldenko的处女作小说，于2001年出版。处女作小说是作者出版的第一本书。文学评论家（以评价书籍为职业的人）和读者对处女作特别感兴趣，因为这些书展现了文学界的新声音。
中文解析：
文本中明确将“literary critics”定义为“以评价书籍为职业的人”（people whose job it is to evaluate books），这与题目所问的“专业评价书籍的人”完全对应，因此正确答案是D。

question:
In the search for new impact craters on Mars, the roles of seismic monitoring and orbital imaging as data sources are______: when vibrations detected with seismic monitoring indicate roughly where an impact has occurred, researchers can use orbital images of that relatively limited area of the rocky surface to precisely locate a new crater.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在寻找火星上新撞击坑的过程中，地震监测和轨道成像作为数据源的作用是______：当通过地震监测检测到的振动大致指示出撞击发生的位置时，研究人员可以使用该相对有限区域的岩石表面轨道图像来精确定位新撞击坑。
中文解析：
空白处需要描述地震监测和轨道成像两种数据源之间的关系，文本中显示它们协同工作——地震监测提供大致位置，轨道成像用于精确定位，这体现了它们的互补性（complementary），因此选D最符合上下文。其他选项如“exhaustive”（详尽的）或“redundant”（冗余的）无法准确表达这种协作关系，而“interchangeable”（可互换的）则与两种方法的不同功能不符。

question:
Founded in 1904, the Hispanic Society of America showcases the arts and cultures of Spanish-speaking and Portuguese-speaking regions around the world, including Latin America. It is located in New York City and has more than 18,000 objects in its museum collection. Since 2000, a number of other institutions devoted to Latino cultures have opened in the United States. A notable example is the National Hispanic Cultural Center in Albuquerque. It focuses on the literature, art, and cultures of Latin America as well as of Latino communities in the United States.

Which statement about the Hispanic Society of America is best supported by the text?
selections: A. It is no longer located in New York City.
C. It is visited by more people than any other Latino cultural institution in the US.
D. Its collection includes over 18,000 objects.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
成立于1904年，西班牙裔美国协会展示了世界各地西班牙语和葡萄牙语地区的艺术和文化，包括拉丁美洲。它位于纽约市，其博物馆收藏品超过18,000件。自2000年以来，美国其他一些致力于拉丁文化的机构已经开放。一个显著的例子是阿尔伯克基的国家西班牙裔文化中心。它专注于拉丁美洲以及美国拉丁裔社区的文学、艺术和文化。
中文解析：
文本明确陈述“其博物馆收藏品超过18,000件”，这直接支持选项D。其他选项均与文本内容不符：A错误，因为文本指出它位于纽约市；B错误，因为文本说明它成立于1904年；C错误，因为文本未提及访问人数或受欢迎程度的比较。

question:
Researchers have long debated the origins of silver used in European coins from the 600s through the early 800s CE. Geochemical analysis by Kershaw et al. of 49 coins dating to 660-820 CE provides concrete evidence that reconciles two competing theories: early coins were made from Byzantine silver, and later coins used Frankish silver, findings that provide firm details in a previously _____area of study.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
研究人员长期争论公元600年代至800年代早期欧洲硬币中银的起源。Kershaw等人对49枚可追溯到公元660-820年的硬币进行的地球化学分析提供了具体证据，调和了两种竞争理论：早期硬币使用拜占庭银，后期硬币使用法兰克银，这些发现为先前_____的研究领域提供了坚实的细节。
中文解析：
空白处需要描述研究领域在获得具体证据之前的状态，由于长期存在争论且缺乏实证，该领域原本是基于推测的（speculative），因此选B最符合上下文。其他选项如“esoteric”（深奥的）或“authoritative”（权威的）无法准确表达这种不确定性，而“solitary”（孤独的）则与内容无关。

question:
The Umpila language of Australia has 21 vowel and consonant sounds. In contrast, the Taa language of southern Africa has over 100. Why would languages differ in this way? One researcher has claimed that when modern humans arose in Africa, they spoke a single language, but as humans gradually spread throughout Africa and then around the globe, that language developed into new languages. Those developed into still more languages as small bands of humans spread even farther, with each new language retaining fewer sounds from humanity’s original language.

Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the researcher’s claim?
selections: A. Languages that emerged in Central America tend to have fewer sounds than languages that emerged in Western Europe do, and Central America is farther away from Africa than Western Europe is.
B. Languages that emerged in Europe and Western Asia tend to have more sounds than languages that emerged in Africa do.
C. The number of sounds is fairly consistent across the various languages that emerged in the last parts of Africa to be settled by humans.
D. A wider range of sounds is found across the languages of Africa as a whole than across the languages of South America as a whole.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
澳大利亚的Umpila语言有21个元音和辅音声音。相比之下，南部非洲的Taa语言有超过100个声音。为什么语言会以这种方式不同？一位研究人员声称，当现代人类在非洲出现时，他们说一种单一语言，但随着人类逐渐扩散到整个非洲然后全球，那种语言发展成新语言。随着小群人类扩散得更远，这些语言又发展成更多语言，每种新语言保留的人类原始语言的声音越来越少。
中文解析：
研究人员的声称基于语言随人类扩散而离非洲越远保留的声音越少，因此非洲以外的语言声音数量应少于非洲。选项B指出欧洲和西亚的语言声音比非洲还多，这直接挑战了声音数量随距离减少的观点，从而削弱了声称。

question:
The following text is adapted from Daniel Defoe’s 1704 nonfiction book The Storm.
If I judge right, ’tis the duty of an historian to set everything in its own light, and to convey matter of fact upon its legitimate authority, and no other: I mean thus, (for I would be as explicit as I can) that where a story is vouched to him with sufficient authority, he ought to give the world the special testimony of its proper voucher, or else he is not just to the story: and where it comes without such sufficient authority, he ought to say so; otherwise he is not just to himself.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Historians rarely have access to all the information relevant to a particular event, so no single work of history should be taken as definite.
B. The only figures that a historian should quote are those who are widely viewed as credible.
C. Historians should clearly indicate the extent to which each of their sources is trustworthy.
D. Because historians cannot tell whose memories they should trust, they should avoid relying one eyewitness accounts of events.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本改编自丹尼尔·笛福1704年的非虚构作品《风暴》。
如果我判断正确，历史学家的职责是让一切以其本来面目呈现，并只依据其合法权威来陈述事实：我的意思是（我会尽可能明确说明），当一个故事有充分权威依据时，他应当向世人提供其特定凭证；否则他对这个故事就不公正：而当故事缺乏充分权威依据时，他也应当说明；否则他对自己就不公正。
中文解析：
原文核心是强调历史学家必须明确标注信息来源的权威性——有权威依据就提供凭证，缺乏权威依据就如实说明，这与C选项“清楚说明每个来源的可信程度”完全对应。

question:
Microplastics are a common pollutant in large masses of water like rivers. High concentrations and_______among particles—variations in size, shape, and materia—make it onerous to comprehensively classify the microplastics in a water sample, so Alvarez-Zeferino et al. are exploring a device to help quickly and accurately identify certain characteristics.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
微塑料是河流等大型水体中的常见污染物。高浓度和颗粒之间的_______——大小、形状和材料的变异——使得全面分类水样中的微塑料变得繁琐，因此Alvarez-Zeferino等人正在探索一种设备，以帮助快速准确地识别某些特征。
中文解析：
空白处需要描述颗粒之间的特性，这些特性包括大小、形状和材料的变异（variations），这些变异正是不一致性（inconsistencies）的体现，因此选D最符合上下文，因为它直接与“variations”同义，并强调了分类困难的原因。其他选项如“incompatibilities”（不兼容）或“disruptions”（中断）无法准确表达这种变异带来的不一致性。

question:
Understanding juvenile sea turtles’ migratory patterns is crucial for conservation efforts. While adult sea turtles are well studied, little is known about juveniles during their oceanic stage, when they spend most of their time in the open ocean. To learn about this stage, researchers tagged and released six juvenile green sea turtles (Chelonia mydas) into the eastern Caribbean Sea. Their findings revealed that the majority of the turtles passively drifted with ocean currents throughout the region. However, two individuals swam against the currents, possibly in search of foraging grounds off the coast of South America.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To summarize research on an understudied stage of sea turtle development
B. To suggest reasons why some juvenile sea turtles swim against the ocean currents
C. To compare the behavior of adult and juvenile sea turtles during migration
D. To describe successful conservation efforts for sea turtles
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
了解幼年海龟的迁徙模式对于保护工作至关重要。虽然成年海龟已被充分研究，但人们对幼年海龟在海洋阶段的情况知之甚少，此时它们大部分时间在开阔海洋中度过。为了了解这一阶段，研究人员标记并释放了六只幼年绿海龟（Chelonia mydas）到东加勒比海。他们的发现显示，大多数海龟被动地随洋流在该区域漂流。然而，有两只个体逆流游动，可能是在寻找南美洲海岸附近的觅食地。
中文解析：
文本的主要目的是总结对幼年海龟海洋阶段（一个未被充分研究的发育阶段）的研究发现，包括研究方法和结果（如被动漂流和逆流行为）。选项A准确捕捉了这一核心，而其他选项（如B只关注部分行为原因、C缺乏详细比较、D未描述具体保护努力）均未能全面反映文本的整体内容。

question:
Antonia Olivia Dolan and colleagues had musicians and nonmusicians with clinically average hearing listen to recordings of nature sounds and music in popular genres like pop and classic rock and adjust the volume to optimize their listening enjoyment. The researchers found that for a given recording that a musician and nonmusician identified as their favorite among those included in the study, optimal volume tended to be higher for the musician than for the nonmusician. Thus, if a musician and nonmusician both identified Beyoncé’s “Crazy in Love” as their favorite recording and the musician preferred to listen to it at a volume of 84.8 decibels, the nonmusician would be expected to _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. find listening to “Crazy in Love” at 84.8 decibels less enjoyable than listening to it at a lower volume.
B. prefer listening to other music at 84.8 decibels over listening to “Crazy in Love” at that volume.
C. enjoy listening to the nature sounds at 84.8 decibels more than listening to “Crazy in Love” at 84.8 decibels.
D. not find it enjoyable to listen to any recordings at a volume as low as 84.8 decibels.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Antonia Olivia Dolan和同事让具有临床平均听力的音乐家和非音乐家听自然声音和流行音乐（如流行乐和经典摇滚）的录音，并调整音量以优化听音享受。研究人员发现，对于同一首录音（音乐家和非音乐家都认为这是他们研究中最喜欢的），音乐家的优化音量倾向于比非音乐家更高。因此，如果音乐家和非音乐家都认为Beyoncé的“Crazy in Love”是他们最喜欢的录音，并且音乐家喜欢在84.8分贝的音量下听它，那么非音乐家会预期_______
中文解析：
研究结果表明音乐家偏好更高音量，而非音乐家偏好更低音量。因此，对于同一首录音，非音乐家会觉得84.8分贝的音量过高，从而享受度低于更低的音量。选项A直接体现了这一逻辑。

question:
Outi Tervo and team studied the effect of human-caused noise on narwhals (Monodon monoceros), arctic marine mammals that are sensitive to acoustic changes in their environment. Hypothesizing that elevated sound levels affect foraging among narwhals, Tervo’s team compared narwhal diving behaviors in natural sound conditions with those behaviors in two human-caused sound exposure conditions—ship sounds and ship sounds coupled with sonic pulses. Both exposure conditions resulted in significant decreases in the number and target depth of deep dives (associated with foraging) relative to natural conditions. However, differences between diving behaviors in the two exposure types were negligible, a finding that could be attributed to the fact that_______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. sonic pulses can be heard at significantly greater ocean depths than ship sounds can.
B. the narwhals weren’t as sensitive to human-caused sounds as the researchers had predicted.
C. ship sounds contribute so much to the overall sound level that the addition of sonic pulses has little effect on the narwhals’ auditory environment.
D. narwhals forage at shallower depths in the presence of ship sounds alone than in the presence of ship sounds coupled with sonic pulses.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Outi Tervo团队研究了人为噪音对独角鲸（Monodon monoceros）的影响，独角鲸是一种对环境中声学变化敏感的北极海洋哺乳动物。Tervo团队假设升高的声音水平会影响独角鲸的觅食，因此比较了自然声音条件下与两种人为声音暴露条件下（船舶声音和船舶声音加上声脉冲）的独角鲸潜水行为。两种暴露条件都导致深潜（与觅食相关）的数量和目标深度相对于自然条件显著减少。然而，两种暴露类型之间的潜水行为差异可以忽略不计，这一发现可能归因于_______
中文解析：
文本指出两种暴露条件（船舶声音和船舶声音加声脉冲）对潜水行为的影响没有显著差异，选项C直接解释了这一现象：船舶声音本身对整体声音水平的贡献已经很大，以至于添加声脉冲几乎不改变独角鲸的听觉环境，因此行为差异可以忽略。

question:
The atomic structure of an element ______the element’s place on the periodic table.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主语"The atomic structure"是单数，所以动词需用第三人称单数形式"determines"。

question:
While some researchers have identified the planet Kepler-1552b as potentially habitable, it’s unlikely that humanity will be able to take advantage of its favorable conditions anytime soon—it’s 2,507 light years away._______ humanity must first focus on making planets within our solar system more habitable.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
虽然一些研究人员已经确定行星Kepler-1552b可能适宜居住，但人类不太可能很快利用其有利条件——它距离我们2,507光年。_______ 人类必须首先专注于使太阳系内的行星更适宜居住。
中文解析：
选项C“Instead”（相反地）最符合逻辑过渡，因为前一句强调人类无法利用遥远的Kepler-1552b，后一句则提出一个替代方向（专注于太阳系内的行星），体现了转折关系。

question:
In a chemical equation, the value known as molar mass is useful for converting between the mass of the reactants and the mass of the product. The liquid _______have molar masses of 186.06 and 156.31 g/ mol, respectively.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 限定修饰，所以compounds和化学成分不用符号隔开，同时，它们作为主语和谓语have也不用逗号隔开

question:
Growing as large as three meters in diameter, the leaves of the giant Amazonian waterlily feature a complex network of radiating veins that provide structural _______ in thickness from the center to the edges, these veins allow the leaves to maintain their large size and buoyancy with minimal material, optimizing light capture and photosynthesis.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 选项C使用句号将原句分为两个完整的句子：第一个句子以“that provide structural support.”结束；第二个句子以“Decreasing”开头，作为分词短语修饰“these veins”。

question:
Recordings of electrical activity in the brain,_______increased activity in brain areas associated with suppressing motor functions.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. electrograms show that while responding to hypothetical match scenarios, the most highly skilled soccer players have
B. responses to hypothetical match scenarios show that the most highly skilled soccer players have electrograms with
C. the most highly skilled soccer players responding to hypothetical match scenarios have electrograms that show
D. hypothetical match scenario responses show that the most highly skilled soccer players captured in electrograms have
explanations: “Recordings of electrical activity in the brain”只能跟electrograms构成逻辑主语一致关系，所以选A。

question:
Artists’ palettes—the surfaces on which painters arrange and mix their paints—can provide valuable insights into the painters’ creative processes. In her 2024 book The Artist’s palette, Alexandra Loske analyzes the palettes of 50 different painters across 500 years._____ Loske reveals clues about the techniques and practices of such artists as Kerry James Marshall, Artemisia Gentileschi, and Vincent van Gogh.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
艺术家调色板——画家安排和混合颜料的表面——可以提供对画家创作过程的宝贵见解。在Alexandra Loske的2024年书《The Artist's Palette》中，她分析了50位不同画家跨越500年的调色板。_____ Loske揭示了关于Kerry James Marshall、Artemisia Gentileschi和Vincent van Gogh等艺术家的技巧和实践的线索。
中文解析：
选项D“In doing so”（通过这样做）它直接连接前一句“分析调色板”的行动与后一句“揭示线索”的结果，体现了顺承关系。

question:
On January 11, 1996, the space shuttle Endeavour blasted off into space, commencing Mission_______eight days and twenty-two hours, the mission ended when the shuttle landed at Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 选项A使用句号将原句分为两个完整的句子：第一个句子以“commencing Mission STS-72.”结束，第二个句子以“Lasting”开头，作为分词短语修饰“the mission”.

question:
As lestyn Barr and his team of researchers discovered when establishing the glacial timeline of Antarctica, the Transartctic Mountains—a 3,500-km mountain range spanning the continent—are home to glaciers of at least 60 million years in age._____ the researchers concluded, Antarctica had glaciers long before the formation of its continent-wide ice sheet 34 million years ago.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
正如Lestyn Barr和他的研究团队在建立南极洲冰川时间线时所发现的，横贯南极山脉——一条横跨大陆的3500公里长的山脉——拥有至少6000万年历史的冰川。_____研究人员得出结论，南极洲在3400万年前形成全大陆冰盖之前很久就有了冰川。
中文解析：
选项B“Thus”（因此）最符合逻辑过渡，因为第一句提供了冰川年龄的证据（至少6000万年），第二句是基于这一证据得出的结论（冰川在冰盖形成之前就存在），体现了因果关系。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·Lighthouses send out crucial light signals to help ships and other watercraft navigate at night.
·Before automation, lighthouses were run by lighthouse keepers.
·Fannie May Salter was the lighthouse keeper at Turkey Point Light in Maryland.
·She held this position for twenty-two years (1925-1947).
·Ida Lewis was the lighthouse keeper at Lime Rock Light in Rhode Island.
·She held this position for fifty-four years (1857-1911).

The student wants to compare the length of time Fannie May Salter and Ida Lewis worked as lighthouse keepers. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Fannie May Salter and Ida Lewis were both lighthouse keepers at a time when such a person was needed to operate a lighthouse.
B. From 1925 to 1947, the nighttime waters of Maryland were more navigable thanks to lighthouse keepers Fannie May Salter and Ida Lewis.
C. Before automation, lighthouse keepers like Fannie May Salter, who served for twenty-two years, and Ida Lewis were crucial to ensuring safe navigation for watercraft.
D. Fannie May Salter worked as a lighthouse keeper for twenty-two years, but Ida Lewis did so for even longer: fifty-four years.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记：
●灯塔发出关键的光信号，帮助船只和其他水上交通工具在夜间航行。
●在自动化之前，灯塔由灯塔看守人运营。
●Fannie May Salter 是马里兰州土耳其点灯塔的看守人。
●她担任这一职位二十二年（1925-1947）。
●Ida Lewis 是罗德岛莱姆岩灯塔的看守人。
●她担任这一职位五十四年（1857-1911）。
中文解析：
选项D直接比较了两人的工作时间长度，明确指出Salter工作了22年，而Lewis工作了更长的54年。

question:
Brain imaging research led by neuroscientist Dwaynica Greaves found that actors showed suppressed responses in the left anterior prefrontal cortex (the portion of the brain associated with self-awareness) when their names were called during performances; _____ the actors’ responses were normal in nonacting contexts. These findings suggest that when embodying characters, performers may temporarily set aside their personal identities.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
由神经科学家Dwaynica Greaves领导的脑成像研究发现，演员在表演期间被叫到名字时，左前额叶皮层（与自我意识相关的大脑部分）的反应被抑制；_____在非表演情境中，演员的反应是正常的。这些发现表明，在体现角色时，表演者可能暂时放下了个人身份。
中文解析：
文本中分号前后的内容形成了直接对比：表演期间大脑反应被抑制与非表演情境下反应正常。所以选D“conversely”（相反地），强调了两种情境下的相反结果。

question:
As an archaeologist, Dr. Rubén G._____ studies historical locations all across the US Southwest and Mesoamerica, a region that includes ancient Maya sites like Ek’ Balam in Mexico.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: “Dr. Rubén G. Mendoza”是主语的一部分，后面直接跟谓语动词“studies”，中间不需要任何标点符号。

question:
Museo Casa Canales, a history museum in Jayuya, Puerto Rico, is one of more than eighty museums in the US territory. These museums present a wide range of information about Puerto Rico, showcasing everything from the territory’s history to _____ architecture to its coffee.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 这个句子描述的是波多黎各（Puerto Rico）作为一个单数实体的特征，因此需要使用单数所有格代词“its”来指代其建筑和咖啡。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·An isthmus is a strip of land that connects two larger pieces of land across an expanse of water.
·It is also known as a land bridge.
·The Isthmus of lerapetra connects the Siteia municipality to the rest of the island of Crete.
·The Isthmus of lerapetra is located in the Mediterranean Sea.

The student wants to indicate the location of the Isthmus of lerapetra. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. An isthmus, or land bridge, like the Isthmus of lerapetra, connects two larger pieces of land.
B. An isthmus, also known as a land bridge, is a strip of land that connects two larger pieces of land across an expanse of water.
C. One example of an isthmus is the Isthmus of lerapetra.
D. The Isthmus of lerapetra is located in the Mediterranean Sea, where it connects the Siteia municipality to the rest of the island of Crete.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记：
●地峡是一块连接两个较大陆地的狭长土地，跨越一片水域。
●它也被称为陆桥。
●耶拉佩特拉地峡连接了锡提亚自治区和克里特岛的其余部分。
●耶拉佩特拉地峡位于地中海。
中文解析：
选项D直接结合了笔记中关于位置的信息（位于地中海）和连接功能（连接锡提亚自治区和克里特岛），明确指出了地峡的地理位置。

question:
Exposed to harsh environmental conditions for centuries, lighthouses such as La Jument lighthouse off the coast of Brittany, France, exemplify the______between marine structures and ocean forces: the continuous impact of breaking waves necessitates periodic reinforces to or redesigns of the structures that in turn may alter local wave patterns.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
几个世纪以来暴露在恶劣的环境条件下，法国布列塔尼海岸附近的La Jument灯塔等建筑体现了海洋结构与海洋力量之间的______：持续破碎波浪的冲击需要对这些结构进行周期性加固或重新设计，而这反过来又可能改变当地的波浪模式。
中文解析：
空白处需要描述海洋结构与海洋力量之间相互影响、相互作用的关系。后文详细说明了两者如何相互影响（波浪冲击结构，结构改变又影响波浪模式），这正是一种动态的“相互作用”（interplay）。其他选项如“tension”（紧张）、“incongruity”（不协调）或“continuum”（连续体）均无法完整体现这种相互影响的动态过程。

question:
Establishing protected areas (PAs), such as the Mamanuca Islands in Fiji, is a common conservation strategy, but because PAs restrict some kinds of economic activity, it’s widely thought that they hinder economic development. This perception is driven in part by the fact that economic assessments often don’t capture the indirect effects of tourism linked to PAs. But Hasita Bhammar et al. found that tourism associated with the Mamanuca Islands boosts local demand for goods and services in other economic sectors, resulting in, for instance, increased income from retail in nearby areas.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It explains how PAs typically affect economic development in the regions where they are established, summarizes the findings of several economic studies that support this explanation, and then concedes that a particular PA is an exception to the general trend.

B. It introduces a widely held belief about the effect PAs have on the economy, proposes a reason for that belie’s prevalence, and then details a study whose findings seemingly conflict with that belief.

C. It makes a generalization about the difficulty of using PAs to reconcile economic and conservation priorities, demonstrates why most PAs fall short of achieving that goal, and then holds up a particular PA as an example of how that goal can be achieved.

D. It states a hypothesis that accounts for why PAs generally negatively impact local economies, outlines how a research team's findings support that hypothesis, and then suggests how a novel methodology led a separate team of researchers to a different conclusion.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
建立保护区（PAs），例如斐济的马马努卡群岛，是一种常见的保护策略，但由于保护区限制了一些经济活动，人们普遍认为它们阻碍了经济发展。这种看法部分源于经济评估通常未能捕捉到与保护区相关的旅游业的间接影响。但是，Hasita Bhammar等人发现，与马马努卡群岛相关的旅游业促进了其他经济部门对商品和服务的本地需求，例如，增加了附近地区的零售收入。
中文解析：
这道题选B是因为文本首先引入了关于保护区阻碍经济发展的普遍信念，然后解释了这种信念存在的原因（经济评估未考虑间接影响），最后详细描述了Hasita Bhammar等人的研究，其发现（旅游业带来积极经济影响）与这一普遍信念相冲突。B选项准确概括了这一结构。

question:
Ranking of Environmental andSociocultural Benefits of Urban Agriculture (scale of 1 to 25; 1= highest)

improvement of social cohesion
17

Esther Sanyé-Mengual, Kathrin Specht, and their team surveyed three groups of people in Bologna, Italy—leaders of urban agriculture projects, stakeholders in urban agriculture (e.g., food researchers and urban farming associations), and the general public—to compare their views about the extent to which urban agriculture contributes to 25 social or ecological services that the team identified. The researchers used these ratings to rank the services for each group, with a ranking of 1 indicating that a group perceives that urban agriculture benefits that service the most. Using only the rankings shown in the table, a city planner in Bologna who is promoting a new urban agriculture project concludes that advertisements aimed at project leaders should emphasize the project’s benefit to the enhancement of pollination.

Which choice best describes data in the table that support the city planner’s conclusion?
selections: A. The conservation of genetic variability was ranked lower for project leaders than it was for the general public.
B. The enhancement of pollination was ranked higher for project leaders than it was for stakeholders.
C. The enhancement of pollination was ranked higher for project leaders than were the other four services.
D. The improvement of social cohesion was ranked higher for project leaders than was the enhancement of pollination.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
埃斯特·桑耶-门古阿尔、凯瑟琳·施佩希特和他们的团队在意大利博洛尼亚调查了三组人——城市农业项目负责人、城市农业利益相关者（如食品研究者和城市农业协会）以及普通公众——以比较他们对城市农业在25项社会或生态服务中贡献程度的看法。研究人员使用这些评分对每组的服务进行排名，排名1表示该组认为城市农业对该服务的益处最大。仅使用表格中显示的排名，一位在博洛尼亚推广新城市农业项目的城市规划者得出结论，针对项目负责人的广告应强调项目对授粉增强的益处。
中文解析：
选项C指出“授粉增强在项目负责人中的排名比其他四个服务都高”，这直接支持了城市规划者的结论。因为项目负责人将授粉增强排名为1，高于其他所有服务（排名分别为17、13、5、8）。

question:
Optimal foraging theory (OFT) holds that animals’ foraging behaviors reflect cost-benefit trade-offs that vary by species and with dynamic ecological circumstances. One such circumstance is lunar intensity, which W.J. Cresswell and Stephen Harris found to be negatively associated with foraging by European badgers but Eduardo Fernández-Duque and colleagues found to be positively associated with foraging by Azara’s night monkeys. This discrepancy is explicable in terms of OFT: the monkeys’ greater reliance on vision means that higher lunar intensity benefits them more than it benefits the badgers.

Information in the text best supports which statement about Azara’s night monkeys?
selections: A. If the monkeys’ foraging behavior under increased lunar intensity actually reflects a cost-benefit trade-off, their behavior should be more similar to that of European badgers than it is.

B. If the advantages that the monkeys gain from increased lunar intensity explain the change in their foraging behavior, those advantages are likely shared by some other species that are not heavily reliant on vision.
C. If increased lunar intensity imposed the same costs on the monkeys that it imposes on European badgers, there would be no association between lunar intensity and the monkeys’ foraging.
D. If increased lunar intensity creates any disadvantages for the monkeys, those disadvantages are more than compensated for by the advantages that the monkeys gain.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
最优觅食理论（OFT）认为，动物的觅食行为反映了成本效益的权衡，这种权衡因物种和动态生态条件而异。其中一个条件是月光强度，W.J. Cresswell 和 Stephen Harris 发现月光强度与欧洲獾的觅食负相关，而 Eduardo Fernández-Duque 和同事们发现月光强度与 Azara 夜猴的觅食正相关。这种差异可以用 OFT 解释：夜猴更依赖视觉，这意味着较高的月光强度对它们的益处大于对獾的益处。
中文解析：
文本指出，月光强度与夜猴的觅食行为正相关，且根据OFT，这种行为反映了成本效益权衡。尽管月光强度可能带来某些不利因素（如增加被捕食风险），但夜猴因依赖视觉而从月光中获得的优势（如更容易寻找食物）足以抵消这些不利，从而导致净收益。选项D准确地捕捉了这一权衡关系。

question:
Typically, synthetic leather is petroleum based, but materials scientists searching for an ecologically sustainable alternative have used various bacteria that secrete linear chains of glucose, forming a dense mesh of cellulose called a pellicle, which is leatherlike except in color. The standard process for dyeing leather generates substantial wastewater and other undesirable byproducts, so adopting such a regimen would run counter to the ecological promise of the pellicle approach. To address this, Kenneth T. Walker and colleagues worked to modify Komagataebacter rhaeticus bacteria to produce a pellicle with embedded pigmentation cells, thereby allowing the pellicle to  “dye” itself from the inside.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. To illustrate how the researchers adapted the pellicle approach to overcome a potential impediment to their main goal as presented in the text
B. To concede that the researcher’s main goal as described in the text will be challenging to achieve due to the standard coloring approach being impractical for use on a pellicle
C. To indicate the characteristic of conventional synthetic leathers that makes those leathers poorly suited to achieve the researcher’ main goal as presented in the text
D. To describe a consideration that led the researchers to employ an alternative approach to coloring a pellicle that allowed them to achieve their main goal as presented in the text
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
通常，合成皮革是基于石油的，但寻找生态可持续替代品的材料科学家们使用了各种能分泌线性葡萄糖链的细菌，形成一种称为薄膜的致密纤维素网状结构，这种结构除了颜色之外都类似于皮革。给皮革染色的标准过程会产生大量的废水和其他不良副产品，因此采用这种（标准染色）方案将与薄膜方法的生态前景背道而驰。为了解决这个问题，Kenneth T. Walker 和他的同事们努力改造了红茶菌，使其能产生带有嵌入色素细胞的薄膜，从而使薄膜能够从内部进行"自我染色"。
中文解析：
划线部分的功能是指出传统染色方法存在的环境问题（即一个需要考虑的因素），正是这个考虑因素促使研究人员去寻找并最终采用了一种全新的、让薄膜从内部自我染色的替代方法。选项D准确地描述了这个因果关系。

question:
Enacted in 1991, Latvia’s 4,917-word constitution, in contrast to Chile’s, which was enacted in 1980 and contains a far greater number (25,821) of words, ______ as the 4th shortest in the world. Such data are studied by constitutional scholars like Dominic J. Nardi, who can use them to draw broader conclusions.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主语是“Latvia’s 4,917-word constitution”，这是一个单数名词短语，因此动词需要采用单数形式。

question:
Richard II is a play from the 1590s by William Shakespeare. Although King Richard has been vanquished by his cousin Henry Bolingbroke, heintimates that he is not entirely ready to show subservience to his cousin, saying,________

Which quotation from Richard II most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. A. “Am I both priest and clerk? Well then, amen./ God save the King! although I be not he; / And yet, amen, if heaven do think him me.”

B. A. “I have no name, no title,—/ No, not that name was given me at the font,—/ But ‘tis usurp’d:— Alack the heavy day, / That I have worn so many winters out, / And know not now what name to call myself!”
C. A. “Still my griefs are mine. / You may my glories and my state depose, / But not my griefs; still am I king of those.”
D. A. “Alack, why am I sent for to a king, / Before I have shook off the regal thoughts / Wherewith I reign’d? I hardly yet have learn’d / To insinuate, flatter, bow, and bend my knee.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《理查二世》是威廉·莎士比亚在16世纪90年代创作的一部戏剧。尽管理查国王已被其堂兄亨利·博林布鲁克击败，但他暗示自己并未完全准备好向堂兄表示臣服，说道：________
中文解析：
D选项最直接体现了理查二世在被迫面对新王时，内心尚未准备好接受臣属地位的心理。他坦言自己仍沉浸在君王的思维中，尚未学会如何奉承、屈膝，这生动地展现了他虽被废黜却不愿屈从的姿态。而其他选项更多聚焦于身份失落或内心痛苦，并未如此明确地表达出对"学习臣服"的抗拒。

question:
Duckweed is a small freshwater plant that is often exposed to zinc pollution. Sofia Vámos and colleagues collected samples of four duckweed ecotypes (genetically and geographically distinct populations within a species), along with water from each ecosystem’s habitat. Hypothesizing that each ecosystem is adapted to its local conditions in ways that bolster its growth and resistance to pollutants, the researchers grew each ecosystem in all four water samples and with three levels of zinc (none, low, high).(The researchers did not replicate local differences in light or temperature.) They found that the ecotypes grew equally well in all four water samples and that adding zinc consistently enhanced growth, regardless of concentration, suggesting that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. there may not be significant differences in the water that each ecosystem inhabit, but there are significant differences in each ecosystem’s resistance to zinc pollution.
B. if each ecosystem is indeed locally adapted as the researchers hypothesized, those adaptations are to other environmental conditions than the water each ecosystem inhabit.
C. while the ecotypes are genetically and geographically distinct, those differences do not represent adaptations to local environmental conditions.

D. although the researchers’ hypothesis does not appear to be supported, this may be because the levels of zinc exposure the plants in the experiment received did not match their exposure in their natural environments.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
浮萍是一种小型淡水植物，经常暴露于锌污染中。Sofia Vámos和同事们收集了四种浮萍生态型（物种内遗传和地理上 distinct 的种群）的样本，以及每个生态系统栖息地的水。研究人员假设每种生态型都适应了当地条件，从而增强其生长和对污染物的抵抗力，他们让每种生态型在全部四种水样中生长，并添加三种水平的锌（无、低、高）。（研究人员没有复制当地的光照或温度差异。）他们发现所有生态型在四种水样中生长得同样好，而且添加锌始终增强了生长，无论浓度如何，这表明______
中文解析：
实验结果显示所有生态型在不同水样中生长无差异，且锌反而促进生长，这与假设中生态型对本地水样适应的预期不符。因此，如果生态型确实存在本地适应，这些适应更可能针对其他环境因素（如光照或温度），而非水样本身。选项B直接基于水样无影响的发现，逻辑上推导出适应可能针对其他条件，与实验设计中对光照和温度未复制的说明一致。

question:
Text 1
Mooseberry (Viburnum edule) plants are native to Alaska, where harsh conditions have historically impeded potential invasive species. As the boreal climate has warmed in recent decades, however, common knotgrass (Polygonum aviculare) plants have established themselves in Alaska. Previous research conducted in non-boreal ecosystems has documented warming-induced increases in summer temperatures benefiting invasive species more than native species.
Text 2
At a site near Fairbanks, Alaska, Christa Mulder and Katie Spellman tracked V. edule and P. aviculare, along with other native and invasive species, over several years. They observed that although average summer temperatures were substantially higher in some years of the study than in others, neither V. edule nor P. aviculare showed any significant variation in summer growth patterns from year to year.

Which choice best describes the relationship between the two texts?
selections: A. Text 2 explains a study that suggests an alternative explanation for the trend observed in the research discussed in Text 1.
B. Text 2 describes a methodology that helps researchers avoid a problem encountered in the studies discussed in Text 1.
C. Text 2 presents a finding that casts doubt on the generalizability of the research discussed in Text 1.
D. Text 2 discusses an observation that challenges the validity of the findings described in Text 1.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
文本1：
莫斯莓（Viburnum edule）植物原产于阿拉斯加，那里恶劣的条件历来阻碍了潜在的入侵物种。然而，随着近几十年来北方气候变暖，常见萹蓄（Polygonum aviculare）植物已在阿拉斯加扎根。先前在非北方生态系统中进行的研究记录显示，变暖导致的夏季温度升高对入侵物种的益处大于本地物种。
文本2：
在阿拉斯加费尔班克斯附近的一个地点，Christa Mulder 和 Katie Spellman 多年来跟踪了 V. edule 和 P. aviculare 以及其他本地和入侵物种。他们观察到，尽管研究中的某些年份夏季平均温度明显高于其他年份，但 V. edule 和 P. aviculare 在夏季生长模式上都没有显示出显著的年度变化。
中文解析：
文本2的发现（在北方生态系统中，温度变化并未导致本地和入侵物种生长模式显著变化）对文本1中引用的非北方生态系统研究的普遍性提出了质疑，因为文本1的研究可能不适用于北方生态系统。选项C准确描述了这种关系，即文本2的发现让人怀疑文本1研究的结论是否具有广泛适用性。

question:
______the mythological and heroic subject matter often found in works by Horace Vernet and other establishment figures, Honoré Daumier’s painting The Third-Class Carriage instead focuses on something decidedly mundane: working-class travelers in a third-class railway car.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
______ 霍勒斯·韦尔内及其他权威人士作品中常见的的神话与英雄题材，奥诺雷·杜米埃的画作《三等车厢》反而专注于 decidedly mundane（极其平凡）的主题：三等火车车厢中的工人阶级旅客。
中文解析：
选 A. Eschewing。因为句子前后是对比关系——Daumier 不画神话英雄题材，而是画普通工人题材，所以空格需要一个表示“避开、不用”的词，与“instead focuses on something decidedly mundane”形成逻辑对应。A. Eschewing 避开；B. Expounding 阐述；C. Caricaturing 讽刺；D. Appraising 评价

question:
In their study of caterpillars in fragmented forests (formerly contiguous forests that have been broken into isolated patches by roads or other interruptions), James Mickley et al. stress that although fragmentation inevitably________alterations to local ecological processes, the changes will likely have a greater impact on Catocalailia, a specialist feeding on a limited number of plant species, than on a species like Achatia distincta that feeds on several.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在他们对碎片化森林（以前是连续森林，被道路或其他中断分割成孤立斑块）中毛虫的研究中，James Mickley 等人强调，尽管碎片化不可避免地________当地生态过程的改变，但这些变化可能对 Catocala ilia（一种只以有限植物物种为食的专化种）的影响大于对像 Achatia distincta（以多种植物为食）这样的物种的影响。
中文解析：
这道题选A（engenders）是因为“engenders”意为“引起”或“导致”，最符合逻辑和上下文：碎片化会不可避免地引发当地生态过程的改变，从而对不同毛虫物种产生不同程度的影响。其他选项如B（attenuates，减弱）、C（preempts，抢先）和D（subsumes，包含）都不符合语境，因为碎片化是改变的原因而非减弱或抢先改变。

question:
Though copies of The Adventures of Indiana Jones in Wenceslas Square in Prague on January 16, 1989—an underground computer game that was created anonymous in 1989 as an act of political protest against the authoritarian regime of what was then Czechoslovakia—were originally distributed ______, the game is now readily available online for anyone to play.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:

The Adventures of Indiana Jones in Wenceslas Square in Prague on January 16, 1989是一个地下的电脑游戏，创作于1989年，其目的之一是为了抗议当时的专权Czechoslovakia，虽然它的不同版本原来是_____发行的，但是这个游戏现在任何网友都可以玩耍。
中文解析：
though是解题信号，后面说游戏现在readily available，所以前面应该是说秘密分发的。对应C选项surreptitiously —— 偷偷地；秘密地。A. dispassionately —— 冷静地；客观地；B. disingenuously —— 不真诚地；虚伪地；D. succinctly —— 简洁地；简明地
