What is one of the solutions to the given equation?
explanations: 考查一元二次方程<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>的求根公式<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>±</mo><msqrt><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi></msqrt></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>a</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>，将该题的方程整理成标准式为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>29</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，把对应的数字代入求根公式计算可得B为正确答案。

question: In the xy-plane, the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi></math> intersects the graph of  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>35</mn></math>  at two points. What is the sum of the x-coordinates of the two points of intersection?
explanations: 考查韦达定理。两个图像相交，可以把图像表达式联立为方程组，消掉y可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>35</mn><mo>,</mo></math>，整理成标准一元二次方程为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>35</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，根据韦达定理<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi></mrow><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><msub><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mi>b</mi><mi>a</mi></mfrac></math>可得该方程的两根之和为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mn>1</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></math>。故选C

question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>5</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>32</mn></math>, what is the value of  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>50</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>20</mn></math>？

Note: Figure not drawn to scale.
The area of triangle ABC is 150 square centimeters. What is the height h, in centimeters, of this triangle?
explanations: 考查三角形的面积，（1/2）*10*h=150，计算可得h=30，故选C。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>165</mn></math>
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>185</mn></math>
The solution to the given system of equations is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>.What is the value of y?
explanations: 考查二元一次方程组的求解，用下面的式子减去上面的式子可得y=20，故答案为20

question: An exponential model for the number of squirrels in a certain area estimates that there were 200 squirrels in the area in the year 2003, and that at the end of each 4-year period for the next 20 years, the number of squirrels in the area was <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>120</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> more than the number at the end of the previous 4-year period. Which of the following equations represents this model, where N is the estimated number of squirrels in this area t years after 2003, and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>≤</mo><mi>t</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>20</mn></math>？
explanations: 每次比之前增长120%，所以底数是1+120%=2.2，所以答案是A或者D。如果是每年增长120%的话，那表达式应该是<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>200</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2.20</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi></mrow></mrow></msup></math>，但是现在是每四年增长120%，相对于每年增长120%来说，增长的速度减慢了，符合减慢的是D，故选D。

question: The width of a rectangle is 16 inches less than 2 times its length, in inches. The area of the rectangle is 130 square inches. What is the width, in inches, of the rectangle?
explanations: 设长方形的长为x，那宽就是2x-16，面积就是x(2x-16)=130，求解该方程可得x=13，那宽度就是2x-16=2*13-16=10，故选B。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>30</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><mn>6</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn></math>
What is the sum of the solutions to the given equation?
explanations: 考查绝对值，整理方程可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>30</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>27</mn></math>，约分得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>10</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>9</mn></math>，即x-10=9或者x-10=-9，求解可得两个解分别是19和1，两根之和就是19+1=20。

question: Circle A in the xy-plane has the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>8</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>25</mn></math>. Circle B has the same center as circle A. The radius of circle B is two times the radius of circle A. The equation defining circle B in the xy-plane is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>8</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mi>k</mi></math>, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?
explanations: 圆心为（a,b），圆的半径为r，那圆的方程就是<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mi>b</mi> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mi>r</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>，据此可知圆A的半径为5，圆B的半径就是<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>5</mn> <mo>∗</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>10</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi> </mrow> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mn>10</mn> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>100</mn></math>，故答案为100。

question: A machine makes 8-inch, 9-inch, and 3-inch parts. During a certain day, the number of 8-inch parts that the machine makes is 5 times the number n of 9-inch parts, and the number of 3-inch parts is 4. During this day, the machine makes 100 parts total. Which equation represents this situation?
selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>8</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mi>n</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>+</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mi>n</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>100</mn></math>
explanations: 9-inch的数量为n，8-inch的数量为5n，3-inch的数量为4，总数量为100，即n+5n+4=100，故选D。

question: The graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> is shown in the xy-plane. For what value of x does <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>？
explanations: f(x)=0表示与x轴的交点，图像中曲线与x轴的交点为x=4，故选D。

question: Line h is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>1</mn> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mfrac> <mn>1</mn> <mn>5</mn> </mfrac> <mi>y</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>40</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>0</mn></math>. Line j is perpendicular to line h in the xy-plane. What is the slope of line j?
explanations: 将line h的表达式整理成直线的标准式为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mn>5</mn> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>200</mn></math>。垂直的两条直线的斜率相乘得-1，所以与line h垂直的line j 的斜率是<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo>−</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mn>5</mn> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mo>=</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <mn>5</mn></math>，故选D。

question: The graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>9</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>16</mn></math> in the xy-plane is a line. What is the slope of the line?
explanations: 将直线表达式整理成标准式为y=-9x+16，直线斜率为-9，故答案为-9。

question: In the figure shown, line k intersects lines r and s. If  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>w</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>141</mn></math>, which additional piece of information is sufficient to prove that lines r and s are parallel?
explanations: 考查平行线中同位角相等，故选B。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>185</mn></math>
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>
A solution to the given system of equations is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>，where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo><</mo><mn>0</mn></math> . What is the value of y?
explanations: 根据第二个式子可得y=8x，代入第一个式子可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>65</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>3185</mn></math>，又因为x小于0，所以求解可得x=-7，那y=8x=-56，故选B。

question: The function f is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>11</mn> </mrow> <mn>5</mn> </mfrac></math>, and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>a</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>15</mn></math>, where a is a constant. What is the value of a?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>a</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>a</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>11</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <mn>5</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>15</mn></math>，求解可得a=-86，故选A

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>
Which of the following is a solution to the given equation?
explanations: 让每个括号内的式子等于0可得方程的两个解为-6/5和8/5，故选B。

question: The function g is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>13</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> , where t is a constant. In the xy-plane, the graph of  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>  passes through the point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>24</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. What is the value of g(0)?
explanations: 如果<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>13</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>0</mn></math>，那么x=-13或者x=t，因为该函数通过（24,0）这个点，所以t=24，故<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>13</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>24</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>，将x=0代入该函数计算可得结果为312。

question: A line passes through the points <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo stretchy="false">) </mo></math>and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>18</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>28</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> in the xy-plane. What is the slope of the line?
explanations: 考查通过两根直线的斜率<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>y</mi><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>28</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>18</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo>/</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></math>或者1.5，故答案为3/2或者1.5。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>r</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>13</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>s</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>n</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>n</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn></math>
For the given functions r and s, n is a constant. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>r</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>⋅</mo><mi>s</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>13</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>16</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow></math>, what is the value of n?
explanations: 将r(x)与s(x)的表达式代入r(x)*s(x)计算可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>13</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>n</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>n</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>n</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>n</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>16</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>13</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>16</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow></math>，故n=2。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>28</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mi>x</mi></math>
In the given equation, a is a constant. The equation has exactly one solution. Which of the following CANNOT be the value of a?
explanations: 考查两条直线的交点问题，当两条直线的slope不同时，两条直线只有1个交点。将等号左右两边的式子整理成直线的标准式可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mi>a</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>28</mn></math>，斜率不同的话就是-a不等于-7，即a不等于7，故选C。

question: The equation<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi> y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>4.9</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>8.9</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>12</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>400</mn></math> gives the estimated height above ground, y, in meters, of a plane, where x is the number of seconds since it started a parabolic maneuver. If this equation is graphed in the xy-plane, which of the following is the best interpretation of the vertex of the graph?
selections: A. The plane reached an estimated maximum height of 12,400 meters 4.9 seconds after it started the parabolic maneuver.
B. The plane reached an estimated maximum height of 12,400 meters 8.9 seconds after it started the parabolic maneuver.
C. The plane reached an estimated maximum height of 4.9 meters 12,400 seconds after it started the parabolic maneuver.
D. The plane reached an estimated maximum height of 8.9 meters 12,400 seconds after it started the parabolic maneuver.
explanations: 考查二次函数顶点的解释，该函数的顶点是（8.9，12400），即8.9秒时的高速是12400米。符合该描述的是B，故选B。

question:
Note: Figure not drawn to scale.
In triangle QRS shown, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Q</mi><mi>R</mi><mo><</mo><mi>R</mi><mi>S</mi></math>.Which expression represents the length of  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>Q</mi><mi>S</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math>?
explanations: 根据选项中用到的<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">Q</mi></mrow></math>，待求的QS，还有已知的边长23可知<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>sin</mi><mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">Q</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>23</mn><mrow><mi>Q</mi><mi>S</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>，求解可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi data-mjx-auto-op="false">QS</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>23</mn><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo><mi>Q</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>，故选D。

question: The length of a rectangle’s diagonal is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msqrt> <mn>106</mn> </msqrt></math> , and the length of one of the rectangle’s sides is 9. What is the perimeter of the rectangle?
explanations: 长方形的对角线（我们可以记作c）与长方形相邻的两条边（我们可以记作a和b）形成了直角三角形，所以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>a</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mi>c</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>，代入数字可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <msup> <mn>9</mn> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <msqrt> <mn>106</mn> </msqrt> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>,</mo></math>，求解可得a=5。那周长就是2*（9+5）=28，故选C。

question: The function f is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>55</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0.19</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mi>x</mi> </msup></math>. For any positive integer n, the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>n</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>p</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> less than the value of  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>n</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> . What is the value of p?
explanations: 根据题意可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>n</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>n</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>∗</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mi>p</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>，代入函数表达式可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>56</mn> <mo>∗</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0.19</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi> </mrow> </mrow> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>56</mn> <mo>∗</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0.19</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi> </mrow> <mo>−</mo> <mn>1</mn> </mrow> </msup> <mo>∗</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi> </mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>，求解可得p=81，故答案为D。

question: The graph of the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>5</mn><mi>x</mi></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>k</mi></math> is shown, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?
explanations: 根据图像，当x=0时，y=-7，即<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>5</mn><mn>0</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn></math>，求解可得k=-8，故选A。

question: A beekeeper’s initial observation of the population of a certain bee colony was 1,800 bees. The beekeeper set a goal to increase the population to 3,300 bees. The beekeeper uses a model that predicts the population of this bee colony begins at 1,800 and increases by 120 bees per week in the first two weeks after the initial observation, and then increases by 180 bees per week until the beekeeper’s goal is reached. According to this model, at the end of week w after the initial observation, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>w</mi> <mo>></mo> <mn>2</mn></math>, which of the following functions gives the predicted number of bees still needed to reach the beekeeper’s goal?
explanations: 需要找的是w>2，即2周以后的表达式，故前两周的增长已经完成，那2周以后还需要增长的数量是3300-1800-120*2=1260。后续每周增长180，那就是y=1260-180*（w-2）=1620-180w，故选C。

question: In 2005, Aster earned <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>12</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> more than in 2004, and in 2006 Aster earned  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>6</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> more than in 2005. If Aster earned y times as much in 2004 as in 2006, which of the following is closest to the value of y?
explanations: 设2004年对应的数额为x，那2005年就是<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>12</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1.12</mn><mi>x</mi></math>，2006年就是<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>∗</mo><mn>1.12</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1.1872</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></math>。题目问的是2004年是2006年的多少倍，那就是x/(1.1872x)，计算可得答案为C。

question: The triangle inequality theorem states that the sum of any two sides of a triangle must be greater than the length of the third side. If a triangle has side lengths of 10 and 11, which inequality represents the possible lengths, x, of the third side of the triangle?
explanations: 考查三角形的三条边的边长的关系：两边之和大于第三边，两边之差小于第三边，故选C。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>x</mi><mn>7</mn></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>y</mi><mn>9</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>41</mn><mn>63</mn></mfrac></math>
An engineer connects resistors in series, where the resistors in the series have a total resistance of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>41</mn><mn>63</mn></mfrac></math> ohms. In this series, there are x resistors of type A, which each have a resistance of a ohms, and y resistors of type B, which each have a resistance of b ohms. The given equation represents this situation. According to this equation, what is the positive difference between the value of a and the value of b?
explanations: x表示A电阻的个数，那每个A电阻的大小为1/7，同理每个B电阻的大小为1/9，两种电阻的的大小之差为1/7 - 1/9 =2/63，故选D。

question: An area of 58.00 square nautical miles is equivalent to k square kilometers. To the nearest tenth, what is the value of k? <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1 </mn><mtext>nautical mile</mtext><mo>=</mo><mn>1.852</mn><mtext> kilometers</mtext><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
explanations: 考查单位换算，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi></mrow><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mtext></mtext><mi data-mjx-auto-op="false">km</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>58</mn><mtext>nautical mile</mtext><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>58</mn><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1.852</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mtext></mtext><mi data-mjx-auto-op="false">km</mi></mrow><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></math>，计算可得答案为198.9。

question: A line in the xy-plane passes through the points <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>,</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>8</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>,</mo></math> and  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mo>,</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. What is the value of c?
explanations: 设直线的表达式为y=mx+b，把<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>8</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>代入直线表达式求解可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>m</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <mn>9</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mstyle scriptlevel="0"> <mspace width="1em"></mspace> </mstyle> <mi>b</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>8</mn></math>，即直线的表达式为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>8</mn></math>。把（c,0）代入该表达式计算可得c=72/7，故答案为72/7。

question:
Postcranial skeletal pneumaticity (PSP) refers to the presence of extensions of an animal’s lungs and air sacs inside its bones. These extensions are known as pneumatic diverticula. Vascularity and other identifying characteristics of pneumatic diverticula tend not to fossilize, so paleontologists have relied on studies of living bird species to document these qualities, augmenting their findings from fossil analysis to glean additional insights into the respiratory systems of extinct genera such as Tyrannosaurus, Euhelopus, and other Cretaceous theropods and sauropods that may have also exhibited PSP.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It presents information about the fossilization of pneumatic diverticula that has led paleontologists to question the applicable of studies of certain living species.
B. It accounts for disagreements among paleontologists about how the respiratory systems of certain extinct genera functioned.
C. It highlights an issue with fossils that previously led paleontologists to misidentify certain characteristics of pneumatic diverticula.
D. It indicates why paleontologists have used another approach in addition to fossil analysis to learn about certain aspects of pneumatic diverticula.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
骨骼后气腔性（PSP）是指动物肺部及气囊延伸至骨骼内部的现象。这些延伸部分被称为气憩室。气憩室的血管分布及其他识别特征通常难以形成化石，因此古生物学家依靠对现存鸟类的研究来记录这些特性，用这些研究发现来补充他们的化石分析结果，从而进一步了解霸王龙、盘足龙等可能也具有PSP特征的白垩纪兽脚类恐龙与蜥脚类恐龙的呼吸系统。
中文解析：
划线部分前的句子说明气憩室的血管等特征难以形成化石，因此古生物学家需要“依靠对现存鸟类的研究”。划线部分“用这些研究发现来补充化石分析结果”直接解释了古生物学家为何要采用双重研究方法——既分析化石，又借助现生鸟类研究来弥补化石信息的不足。选项D准确概括了这一补充说明的作用。

question:
A study by Augusta D. Gaspar and Joana Carneiro Pinto found that a bank’s corporate social responsibility (CSR) efforts, including environmental and social campaigns, improve its corporate image. When CSR was mentioned in bank marketing strategies, favorability scores assigned by study participants tended to______ the scores assigned by participants when CSR wasn’t mentioned.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一项由Augusta D. Gaspar和Joana Carneiro进行的研究发现，银行的企业社会责任（CSR）举措，包括环境和社会宣传活动，会提升其企业形象。当银行营销策略中提到CSR时，研究参与者给出的好感度评分倾向于______未提及CSR时参与者给出的评分。
中文解析：
根据原文逻辑，企业社会责任（CSR）举措会改善企业形象，因此当营销策略中提到CSR时，参与者给出的好感度评分应高于未提及时的评分。选项D“超过”最符合语境，能准确体现评分的正向差异。

question:
Science fiction has long served as a ______ real-world technological advancements. Indeed, from Jules Verne’s 1865 novel From the Earth to the Moon inspiring developments in aerospace engineering to the television show Star Trek sparking the design of the ancestor of today’s smartphones, these narratives have spurred many actual innovations.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
科幻小说长期以来一直是现实世界技术进步的______。事实上，从儒勒·凡尔纳1865年小说《从地球到月球》启发航空航天工程的发展，到电视剧《星际迷航》催生了现代智能手机前身的设计，这些叙事推动了许多实际创新。
中文解析：
原文通过“凡尔纳小说启发航天工程”和“《星际迷航》催生智能手机设计”两个具体例证，说明科幻小说对现实技术创新具有推动和激发作用。选项B“催化剂”能准确体现这种“引发、促进”的关系，与后文“推动许多实际创新”形成逻辑呼应。其他选项均与文意相悖。

question:
Antonia Olivia Dolan and colleagues had musicians and nonmusicians with clinically average hearing listen to recordings of nature sounds and music in popular genres like acoustic folk and funk and adjust the volume to optimize their listening enjoyment. The researchers found that for a given recording that a musician and nonmusician identified as their favorite among those included in the study, optimal volume tended to be higher for the musician than for the nonmusician. Thus, if a musician and nonmusician both identified Jose Gonzalez’s “Heartbeats” as their favorite recording and the musician preferred to listen to it at a volume of 82.2 decibels, the nonmusician would be expected to _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. find listening to “Heartbeats” at 82.2 decibels less enjoyable than listening to it at a lower volume.
B. prefer listening to other music at 82.2 decibels over listening to “Heartbeats” at that volume.
C. enjoy listening to the nature sounds at 82.2 decibels more than listening to “Heartbeats” at 82.2 decibels.
D. not find it enjoyable to listen to any recordings at a volume as low as 82.2 decibels.
explanations:
题目文本解析：
Antonia Olivia Dolan与同事让听力正常的音乐家和非音乐家聆听自然声音及流行音乐（如民谣、放克）的录音，并调节音量以获得最佳聆听享受。研究人员发现，对于某一首被音乐家和非音乐家共同选为研究中最喜爱的录音，音乐家选择的理想音量往往高于非音乐家。因此，如果一位音乐家和一位非音乐家都认为何塞·贡萨雷斯的《Heartbeats》是他们最喜爱的录音，且音乐家偏好以82.2分贝的音量聆听，那么可以推测非音乐家会_______
中文解析：
研究结论明确指出：对于同一首最喜爱的录音，音乐家偏好的最佳音量高于非音乐家。因此当音乐家选择82.2分贝时，非音乐家的理想音量应低于此值，故他们听82.2分贝版本时的享受程度会低于更低的音量。选项A准确体现了这一音量偏好差异带来的体验差异，其他选项均引入了无关比较（如其他音乐、自然声音或绝对音量阈值），脱离了研究核心结论。

question:
Seesaw Girl was Linda Sue Park’s debut novel. It was published in 1999. A debut novel is the first book that an author has published. Debut novels are especially interesting to literary critics (people whose job it is to evaluate books) and readers because these books offer a look at new voices in the literary world.

According to the text, what is someone who professionally evaluates books called?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《跷跷板女孩》是琳达·苏·帕克的处女作，于1999年出版。处女作是指作家出版的第一本书。文学评论家（以评价书籍为职业的人）和读者对处女作特别感兴趣，因为这些作品展现了文学界的新声音。
中文解析：
文本中明确提到“文学评论家（以评价书籍为职业的人）”，括号内的解释直接对应题干所问的“专业评价书籍的职业人士”。因此选项B是原文信息的直接复现，其他选项均未在文中被定义为从事书籍评价工作的人。

question:
Outi Tervo and team studied the effect of human-caused noise on narwhals (Monodon monoceros), arctic marine mammals that are sensitive to acoustic changes in their environment. Hypothesizing that elevated sound levels affect foraging among narwhals, Tervo’s team compared narwhal diving behaviors in natural sound conditions with those behaviors in two human-caused sound exposure conditions— ship sounds and ship sounds coupled with sonic pulses. Both exposure conditions resulted in significant decreases in the number and target depth of deep dives (associated with foraging) relative to natural conditions. However, differences between diving behaviors in the two exposure types were negligible, a finding that could be attributed to the fact that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. narwhals forage at shallower depths in the presence of ship sounds alone than in the presence of ship sounds coupled with sonic pulses.
B. sonic pulses can be heard at significantly greater ocean depths than ship sounds can.
C. the narwhals weren’t as sensitive to human-caused sounds as the researchers had predicted.
D. ship sounds contribute so much to the overall sound level that the addition of sonic pulses has little effect on the narwhals’ auditory environment.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Outi Tervo团队研究了人为噪音对一角鲸（一种对环境中声音变化敏感的北极海洋哺乳动物）的影响。Tervo团队假设升高的声音水平会影响一角鲸的觅食，他们将自然声音条件下与两种人为声音暴露条件下（船舶声，以及船舶声加声脉冲）的一角鲸潜水行为进行了比较。两种暴露条件都导致深潜（与觅食相关）的次数和目标深度显著减少。然而，两种暴露类型之间的潜水行为差异可忽略不计，这一发现可归因于______
中文解析：
文本指出两种暴露条件（船舶声、船舶声+声脉冲）对一角鲸行为的影响差异很小。要解释这一现象，需说明为何加入声脉冲未带来显著额外影响。选项D指出船舶声本身已主导了听觉环境，声脉冲的加入未能明显改变整体噪音水平，这直接解释了行为反应为何无显著差异。其他选项或与文中“差异可忽略”矛盾（A），或未直接关联两种暴露条件的比较（B、C）。

question:
The Rarámuri language of northern Mexico has 20 vowel and consonant sounds. In contrast, the Taa language of southern Africa has over 100. Why would languages differ in this way? One researcher has claimed that when modern humans arose in Africa, they spoke a single language, but as humans gradually spread throughout Africa and then around the globe, that language developed into new languages. Those developed into still more languages as small bands of humans spread even farther, with each new language retaining fewer sounds from humanity’s original language.

Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the researcher’s claim?
selections: A. A wider range of sounds is found across the languages of Africa as a whole than across the languages of South America as a whole.
B. Languages that emerged in Europe and Western Asia tend to have more sounds than languages that emerged in Africa do.
C. Languages that emerged in Central America tend to have fewer sounds than languages that emerged in Western Europe do, and Central America is farther away from Africa than Western Europe is.
D. The number of sounds is fairly consistent across the various languages that emerged in the last parts of Africa to be settled by humans.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
墨西哥北部的Rarámuri语有20个元音和辅音，而非洲南部的Taa语则有超过100个。为何语言会如此不同？一位研究者声称，现代人类起源于非洲时使用单一语言，但随着人类逐渐遍布非洲乃至全球，该语言演变成新语言。当小规模人群迁徙得更远时，这些语言又衍生出更多语言，且每种新语言保留的人类原始语言音素越来越少。
中文解析：
研究者的核心主张是：人类迁徙距离非洲起源地越远，所形成的新语言保留的原始音素就越少（即音素数量递减）。选项B指出，欧洲和西亚的语言（距离非洲较远）比非洲本土语言（距离起源地更近）拥有更多音素，这与“越远音素越少”的预测直接矛盾，因此能最直接削弱研究者主张。选项C“中美洲语言比西欧音素更少”符合“越远越少”的预期，反而支持了主张；选项A和D均未直接挑战“迁徙距离与音素数量负相关”的核心逻辑。

question:
Moving beyond a simple “present or absent” designation, researchers created a new classification system that allows for a nuanced understanding of bioluminescence in marine organisms that was unavailable under binary classification systems. The new six-point scale considers varying levels of supporting evidence used to identify bioluminescent species. For example, the firefly squid scores 1 because of inconsistent reports, the emperor squid scores 4 because of its anatomical similarity to known luminous relatives, and the shaggy anglerfish scores 6 because of substantiated direct observations.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It emphasizes the thoroughness of the research conducted.
B. It explains how the new classification system was derived from the previous binary system.
C. It justifies the need for a new classification system for marine species.
D. It explains the basis for the new system’s scoring criteria.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
研究人员超越简单的“存在或不存在”分类法，创建了一个新的分类系统，使人们能够细致理解海洋生物的生物发光现象，这是二元分类系统无法实现的。新的六级量表考虑了用于识别发光物种的不同等级的支持证据。例如，萤火虫鱿鱼因报告不一致而得1分，皇帝鱿鱼因与已知发光物种在解剖结构上相似而得4分，毛颌角鮟鱇因有经证实的直接观察记录而得6分。
中文解析：
划线句子作为具体实例，直接展示了新评分系统如何根据不同类型的证据（如不一致的报告、解剖相似性、直接观察）为不同物种分配具体分数。这正好解释了前一句所提到的“新系统考虑了不同等级的支持证据”，因此其功能是阐明新系统评分标准的运作依据。

question:
Any effort to raise the toll that drivers must pay to use the Lewis and Clark Bridge, which spans the Ohio River to connect Indiana and Kentucky, should explain why a higher toll is necessary; no amount of justification, however, is likely to persuade some drivers who believe the current toll is _______.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
任何试图提高司机使用刘易斯克拉克桥（横跨俄亥俄河，连接印第安纳州与肯塔基州）通行费的努力，都应解释为何需要提高费用；然而，再多的理由也不太可能说服部分司机——他们认为当前的通行费已是_______。
中文解析：
原文指出，即使解释涨价的必要性，部分司机仍不会被说服，暗示他们认为现有费用已经太高，因此再涨价更无法接受。选项A“过高的”准确体现司机对当前收费的负面评价，与“难以被说服”形成因果逻辑。其他选项均无法解释司机抗拒涨价的根本原因。

question:
Adult glass eels can be found off the coast of Maine, but the eels begin their lives in the Sargasso Sea, a diverse area in the North Atlantic Ocean where they are born and later return to breed. Though biologists believe they have identified the general area in the Sargasso Sea that is crucial to the endangered eels’ survival, little is yet known about how the animals spawn there. Scientists believe that solving the mystery will lead to better conservation of glass eels and their habitat, helping in turn to sustain several other species that rely on them as a food source.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It suggests that scientists are more concerned about other species than about glass eels’ habitat.
B. It indicates that the benefit of understanding glass eels’ spawning behavior extends beyond the eels.
C. It discusses a role that glass eels and other species serve in supporting the ecosystem of the Sargasso Sea.
D. It presents a finding from a study that identifies the circumstances required to ensure the survival of glass eels.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
成年玻璃鳗可在缅因州海岸附近找到，但它们始于马尾藻海——一个位于北大西洋的多样化区域，它们在此出生并会返回繁殖。尽管生物学家认为已确定了马尾藻海中对该濒危鳗鱼生存至关重要的区域，但人们对它们如何在那里产卵仍知之甚少。科学家相信，解开这一谜团将有助于更好地保护玻璃鳗及其栖息地，进而帮助维持其他几种以它们为食的物种。
中文解析：
划线部分“进而帮助维持其他几种以它们为食的物种”说明了保护玻璃鳗的连锁生态效益——不仅直接有利于玻璃鳗，还会通过食物链间接维持其他依赖它们的物种。这与选项B中“益处不仅限于鳗鱼本身”的含义完全一致。其他选项或扭曲文意（A），或过度延伸（C），或与划线部分内容不符（D）。

question:
The Underdogs is a 1915 novel by Mariano Azuela, originally written in Spanish. In the novel, Azuela depicts the character Camilla as experiencing a change in how she perceives her immediate surroundings:________

Which quotation from a translation of The Underdogs most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “Camilla stared up at the blue sky so [Luis] should not read the expression in her eyes.”
B. “Camilla, standing on the beach of washed, round stones, caught a reflection of herself in the waters.”

C. “All nature was as she had found it before, evening upon evening; but in the stones and the dry weeds, amid the fragrance of the air and the light whir of falling leaves, Camilla sensed a new strangeness, a vast desolation in everything about her.”

D. “[Camilla] closed her eyes fast to hold back the tears that welled up in them. Then, with the back of her hand, she wiped her wet cheeks, and just as she had done three days ago, fled with all the swiftness of a young deer.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《Underdogs》是马里亚诺·阿苏埃拉于1915年创作的西班牙语小说。在小说中，阿苏埃拉描绘了角色卡米拉对她周围环境的感知发生了变化：________
中文解析：
题目要求体现“对周围环境感知的变化”。C选项通过对比“自然景物依旧”与“感受到新的陌生感与荒凉”，直接展现了人物主观感知的转变——环境未变。

question:
Peter Pan is a 1911 novel by J.M. Barrie. In the fantasy novel, Peter is a young boy who can fly. He brings Wendy, John, and Michael to Neverland, the mythical island where he lives. The narrator suggests that activity on the island stops when Peter is away and starts again when he is about to return:_________

Which quotation from Peter Pan best supports the claim?
selections: A. “The rock was very small now.”
B. “Wendy and John and Michael stood on tip-toe in the air to get their first sight of the island.”
C. “Peter was alone on the lagoon.”
D. “Feeling that Peter was on his way back, the Neverland had again woke into life.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《彼得·潘》是J.M.巴里于1911年创作的奇幻小说。主人公彼得是个会飞的小男孩，他将温蒂、约翰和迈克尔带到了自己居住的神秘岛屿——永无乡。叙述者暗示，岛上的一切活动在彼得离开时会停止，而当他即将归来时又会重新开始：________
中文解析：
题目核心是“岛上活动随彼得离开而停止，随其归来而重启”。D选项直接描述“永无乡因感知彼得归来而苏醒”，与文中“当他即将归来时又重新开始”形成完美对应。

question:
The following text is adapted from Alice Dunbar Nelson’s 1899 short story “The Fisherman of Pass Christian.” Pass Christian is a city in the US state of Mississippi.
The swift breezes on the beach at Pass Christian meet and conflict as though each strove for the mastery of the air. The land-breeze blows down through the pines, resinous, fragrant, cold, bringing breath-like memories of dim, dark woods shaded by myriad pine-needles. The breeze from the Gulf is warm and soft and languorous, blowing up from the south with its suggestion of tropical warmth.

As used in the text, what does the word “mastery” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本改编自爱丽丝·邓巴·尼尔森1899年的短篇小说《帕斯克里斯蒂安镇的渔夫》。帕斯克里斯蒂安是美国密西西比州的一座城市。
帕斯克里斯蒂安海滩上的疾风相互碰撞冲突，仿佛每阵风都在争夺空气的掌控权。来自松林的陆风带着树脂的芬芳与凉意，吹来被无数松针遮蔽的幽暗树林如呼吸般的记忆；而来自墨西哥湾的海风温暖柔和、令人慵懒，从南方吹来，带着热带的温润气息。
中文解析：
“mastery”在文中描述海风与陆风“相互冲突，争夺对空气的掌控权”，此处强调对空气的控制与主导地位。选项B“支配”最贴合语境，体现双方争夺主导权的动态关系。其他选项“熟悉”“理解”“娴熟”均与自然力量的竞争场景不符。

question:
Researchers have long debated the origins of silver used in European coins from the 600s through the early 800s CE. Geochemical analysis by Kershaw et al. of 49 coins dating to 660-820 CE provides concrete evidence that reconciles two competing theories: early coins were made from Byzantine silver, and later coins used Frankish silver, findings that provide firm details in a previously _______ area of study.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
研究人员长期争论公元7世纪至9世纪初欧洲银币所用白银的来源。Kershaw等人对49枚可追溯至公元660-820年银币的地球化学分析提供了确凿证据，调和了两种相互竞争的理论：早期银币使用拜占庭白银，后期则使用法兰克白银。这些发现为一个此前_______的研究领域提供了确切细节。
中文解析：
原文指出，关于早期欧洲银币来源长期存在争议，而新研究提供了“确凿证据”与“确切细节”。这暗示该领域先前缺乏实证，主要依赖推测。选项D“推测性的”与后文“提供确切细节”形成逻辑对应，最符合语境。

question:
Elvis Presley’s iconic jumpsuit Red Pinwheel featured rhinestones arranged in pinwheel patterns. Historians note that adornments such as these added between twenty-five and fifty pounds to each of Elvis’s stage outfits.______ the fabric used to make the outfits was light and flexible, enabling freedom of motion.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
埃尔维斯·普雷斯利标志性的连体衣“红色纸风车”饰有按纸风车图案排列的莱茵石。历史学家指出，这类装饰使埃尔维斯的每套舞台服装增重25至50磅。______ 制作服装所用的面料却轻质柔韧，确保了动作的自由度。
中文解析：
前句强调装饰使服装重量大增，后句指出面料轻质柔韧——两者形成明显对比关系。选项A“另一方面”专门用于引出对立或对比信息。

question:
·Thomas Edison is regarded as one of the most important inventors in US history.
·Having received little formal schooling, Edison relied on specialist employees at his various laboratories and offices to complete the technical work for many of his inventions.
·William Joseph Hammer was a laboratory assistant who worked at the Menlo Park laboratory.
·He is best known for curating the most comprehensive collection of historic light bulbs anywhere in the world.
·William Symes Andrews was an electrical engineer who worked at the Edison Electric Light Company.
·He is best known for establishing more than thirty power plants across New York and Pennsylvania.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize Edison’s reliance on Hammer?
selections: A. William Joseph Hammer, a laboratory assistant, worked at the Menlo Park laboratory.
B. William Joseph Hammer, a laboratory assistant, was known for his valuable contribution to the field of technology.

C. Most of Thomas Edison’s employees had successful careers independent of working for him; for example, William Joseph Hammer, who worked at the Menlo Park laboratory, was an accomplished laboratory assistant.
D. Having received little formal education, Thomas Edison depended on specialized employees, including laboratory assistant William Joseph Hammer, for many of his inventions.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
·托马斯·爱迪生被视为美国历史上最重要的发明家之一。
·由于几乎没有接受正规学校教育，爱迪生依靠其各个实验室和办公室的专业员工来完成许多发明的技术工作。
·威廉·约瑟夫·哈默是在门洛帕克实验室工作的一名实验室助理。
·他因策划了世界上最具历史意义的灯泡收藏而闻名。
·威廉·赛姆斯·安德鲁斯是在爱迪生电灯公司工作的一名电气工程师。
·他因在纽约和宾夕法尼亚建立了三十多家发电厂而闻名。
中文解析：
题目要求“强调爱迪生对哈默的依赖”，D选项直接整合了爱迪生缺乏正规教育、依赖专业员工的核心信息，并明确将哈默作为被依赖的实例，完全符合要求。

question:
Growing as large as three meters in diameter, the leaves of the giant Amazonian waterlily feature a complex network of radiating veins that provide structural ______ in thickness from the center to the edges, these veins allow the leaves to maintain their large size and buoyancy with minimal material, optimizing light capture and photosynthesis.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: the leaves of the....structural support是第一个句子；these veins allow....photosynthesis是第二个句子，两个句子之间用句号连接，对应A

question:
Though largely eclipsed by her success as a novelist, Jessie Redmon Fauset’s contributions as literary editor of The Crisis, a New York City-based periodical whose influence was arguably at its peak during her Harlem Renaissance-era tenure,_____ in recent scholarship that explores Fauset’s instrumental role in shaping the magazine’s aesthetic and debuting the work of Langston Hughes and other emerging Black writers.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子主语是contributions（复数），因此谓语动词需用复数形式have been revisited。

question:
______ a US state when it ratified the US Constitution on December 12, 1787, was thereby empowered, via its representatives to the US Congress, to vote on whether to admit Louisiana as a state on April 30, 1812.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子主语Pennsylvania、谓语was thereby empowered。选项DPennsylvania, having officially become...使用having officially become构成完整分词短语作插入状语。

question:
Giant dust plumes from the Sahara Desert that blow across the Atlantic Ocean can have complex and opposing effects on tropical cyclones. On one hand, the dust can enhance the formation of ice clouds in the cyclone’s core, increasing precipitation.______ the dust can lower sea surface temperatures around the cyclone’s core, weakening the storm.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
从撒哈拉沙漠吹过大西洋的巨型沙尘羽流对热带气旋可能产生复杂且对立的影响。一方面，沙尘能增强气旋核心区冰云的形成，增加降水。______ 沙尘会降低气旋核心区周围的海面温度，从而减弱风暴。
中文解析：
On one hand和on the other hand形成一对儿对比。

question:
A 2024 study cataloged all the trees in Amsterdam to evaluate the biodiversity of the city’s urban forest. The researchers, finding that administrative unit GK13 had a 0.62 ratio of native to non-native trees,______ efforts to improve the biodiversity of the trees in that unit and other areas with a similarly moderate ratio.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 选项A“recommended”作为谓语动词，与主语“researchers”构成完整主谓结构。

question:
As lestyn Barr and his team of researchers discovered when establishing the glacial timeline of Antarctica, the Transantarctic Mountains—a 3,500-km mountain range spanning the continent—are home to glaciers of at least 60 million years in age._____ the researchers concluded, Antarctica had glaciers long before the formation of its continent-wide ice sheet 34 million years ago.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
正如Lestyn Barr及其研究团队在确定南极洲冰川时间线时所发现的，横贯南极山脉（横跨大陆的3500公里山脉）拥有年龄至少为6000万年的冰川。_____ 研究人员得出结论，南极洲在3400万年前形成覆盖整个大陆的冰盖之前很久就已经有冰川存在。
中文解析：
前句提出“发现至少6000万年的冰川”这一具体证据，后句是研究人员基于该证据得出的结论“冰盖形成前早已有冰川”，二者构成证据与结论的因果关系。

question:
Resins play several important roles in maintaining the health of conifers and many other kinds of trees.______ resins quickly seal wounds, which helps prevent harmful insects and fungi from entering trees. These sticky substances also help trees retain water that is needed for them to survive.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
树脂在维持针叶树及许多其他树木健康方面扮演着几个重要角色。______ 树脂能快速密封伤口，这有助于防止有害昆虫和真菌侵入树木。这些黏性物质还能帮助树木保持生存所需的水分。
中文解析：
首句总述树脂有“多个重要作用”，后文分别具体说明“密封伤口”和“保持水分”这两个作用，属于从概括到具体的举例关系。

question:
Many works of the Greek mathematician Euclid (3rd century BCE) are _____ his Elements, a treatise of mathematical knowledge, is an extant work: it can still be read.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 两个句子之间用句号或者逗号+and连接，但是conversely放在句首，需要用逗号跟前面的句子隔开。

question:
In a 1998 study by Smith et al., the researchers used microhistological fecal analysis to determine the ratio of three plant subtypes (graminoids, forbs, and browse) within the diets of North American ungulates. The researchers did not perform this analysis on all such ungulates,_____ they focused exclusively on pronghorns and wild horses in New Mexico.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在Smith等人1998年的研究中，研究人员采用显微粪便分析法测定北美有蹄类动物饮食中三种植物亚型（禾草类、非禾本草本植物及嫩枝叶）的比例。_____研究人员并未对所有此类有蹄类动物进行分析。他们仅聚焦于新墨西哥州的叉角羚和野马。
中文解析：
前面说研究了三种，后面说没有研究所有的类型，两者之间构成转折，对应D.

question:
Though its onboard laboratory allowed it to analyze rock samples on-site, the 2011 Mars Curiosity rover was unable to preserve samples for future analysis._____ when creating the 2020 Mars Perseverance rover, robotics technologist Yumi Iwashita and other members of NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory sought to implement a mechanism that could do exactly that.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管2011年的“好奇号”火星车配备车载实验室可现场分析岩石样本，但它无法保存样本供未来研究。_____ 在研制2020年“毅力号”火星车时，机器人技术专家Yumi Iwashita及NASA喷气推进实验室的团队成员试图实现一种能精确完成此功能的机制。
中文解析：
前句指出“好奇号”存在无法保存样本的缺陷，后句说明研制“毅力号”时试图解决该问题——两者构成明确的因果关系。选项C“因此”能准确体现“基于前驱任务的不足，后续任务进行改进”的逻辑关系。其他选项中，“具体来说”表示具体化，“此前”表示时间倒叙，“类似地”表示类比，均不符合此处的因果推进关系。

question:
Louisa May Alcott contributed A Modern Mephistoheles to the No Name Series, a collection of novels published anonymous between 1876 and 1887. The series challenged readers to guess authors’ identities, reflecting the era’s fascination for literary mystery. This _______approach to publishing allowed Alcott to experiment beyond her established style.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
路易莎·梅·奥尔科特向“无名丛书”投稿了《现代的梅菲斯托菲勒斯》，该丛书是1876至1887年间匿名出版的小说合集。该系列要求读者猜测作者身份，反映了当时对文学神秘性的热衷。这种_______的出版方式使奥尔科特得以超越其固有风格进行创作实验。
中文解析：
原文指出该丛书“匿名出版”并让“读者猜测作者身份”，强调其隐匿作者信息的特点。选项B“秘密的”能准确对应这种匿名出版的隐蔽性质，与“fascination for literary mystery”形成逻辑呼应。其他选项均与匿名机制相悖：A“初步的”强调初始阶段,C“明确的”指向公开透明，D“无法解释的”则偏离文意。

question:
Though copies of The Adventures of Indiana Jones in Wenceslas Square in Prague on January 16,1989 — an underground computer game that was created anonymous in 1989 as an act of political protest against the authoritarian regime of what was then Czechoslovakia — were originally distributed _______, the game is now readily available online for anyone to play.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管《瓦茨拉夫广场的印第安纳·琼斯历险记》——一款1985年匿名创作、旨在抗议当时捷克斯洛伐克专制政权的地下电脑游戏——的副本最初以_______方式传播，但如今该游戏已能在网上随意获取供人游玩。
中文解析：
原文指出该游戏是“匿名创作的地下电脑游戏”且用于“政治抗议”，在专制政权背景下，其传播必然需要隐蔽性。选项A“秘密地”精准对应这种为避免当局发现而采取的隐匿传播方式，与“地下”“匿名”“政治抗议”等关键词形成逻辑闭环。其他选项均不符合语境：B强调虚伪动机，C指表达简练，D指态度客观。

question:
Magical realism, a style that weaves fantasy into realistic narratives, coalesced in Latin America in the 1960s. It is associated with Gabriel García Márquez, whose One Hundred Years of Solitude is a key text. The style was embraced by Mexican American writers, such as Ana Castillo, whose So Far from God draws on Mexican folktales as a source of fantasy. Yet The Mixquiahula Letters, also by Castillo, features no fantastic plot events. And despite his popular reputation, García Márquez himself wrote several works of strict realism, including Chronicle of a Death Foretold.

Which choice best states the function of the underlined sentence?
selections: A. To identify an recognized point of similarity between Chronicle of a Death Foretold and So Far from God
B. To suggest that Mexican American authors who were influenced by García Márquez may have, in turn, influenced him
C. To refute the possible impression that García Márquez conformed to magical realism in all of his works
D. To challenge the common assumption that One Hundred Years of Solitude is superior to realist works by García Márquez
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
魔幻现实主义是一种将奇幻融入现实叙事的风格，于20世纪60年代在拉丁美洲形成。该风格与加夫列尔·加西亚·马尔克斯相关，其《百年孤独》是代表作。墨西哥裔美国作家也接纳此风格，如安娜·卡斯蒂略的《远离上帝》借鉴墨西哥民间传说作为奇幻来源。然而卡斯蒂略的另一作品《米克斯基亚乌拉书信》并无奇幻情节。尽管加西亚·马尔克斯广为人知，但他本人也创作了多部严格现实主义作品，包括《一桩事先张扬的凶杀案》。
中文解析：
划线句子通过“尽管…但…”的转折结构，明确指出马尔克斯虽以魔幻现实主义闻名，但其部分作品（如《一桩事先张扬的凶杀案》）属于严格现实主义。这直接纠正了读者可能因其代表作《百年孤独》而产生的“他所有作品都是魔幻现实主义”的片面认知，与选项C的“反驳可能存在的印象”完全对应。

question:
Yuen Yuen Ang et al. argue that merely tallying the number of patents filed per year _______the degree of innovation occurring: truly novel patents—those, like a 2011 patent for an automated navigation system for planes, that combine previously unaffiliated technological domains—are vastly outnumbered by nonnovel patents (e.g., a 2008 patent for a method of making soup).

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Yuen Yuen Ang等人认为，仅统计每年提交的专利数量_______实际发生的创新程度：真正新颖的专利（如2011年将此前无关技术领域结合的飞机自动导航系统专利）数量远少于非新颖专利（如2008年的一种制汤方法专利）。
中文解析：
原文通过对比“真正新颖专利数量远少于非新颖专利”，说明仅统计专利总数会扭曲或掩盖真实的创新水平。选项A“歪曲/掩盖”准确体现这种“表面数据与实质情况不符”的悖反关系。其他选项均不符合逻辑：B“预示”，C“阻碍”，D“诽谤”。

question:
In Puerto Rico, it’s not unusual for a city or town to be known by a nickname that corresponds to one of its notable features, like landscape, climate, famous residents, or chief export. For example, the Puerto Rican municipality of Manatí is well known for its history as a cultural center in the early 20th______this distinction has earned it the fitting nickname of “the Athens of Puerto Rico.”

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 空前后有两个独立的句子，用分号连接。

A Pew Research Center survey conducted in January 2024 found that three out of ten US adults make at least one New Year’s resolution (a promise for the year ahead), while half of those who make a resolution make more than one. The survey asked participants what kinds of resolutions they made and separated them into several categories. The table presents percentages of people who make particular kinds of New Year’s resolutions among those who choose to make them, indexed by age bracket.

Which choice best presents a conclusion about the habits of New Year’s resolution makers that is best supported by information in the text and the table?
selections: A. The majority of US adults who make resolutions related to health and exercise also make resolutions in multiple additional categories.

B. Resolution makers between the ages of 50 and 64 are more likely to make resolutions related to personal relationships and less likely to make resolutions related to finances than resolution makers between the ages of 30 and 49 are.
C. Among all US adults, people become less likely to make New Year’s resolutions as they age, regardless of the type of resolution.
D. Resolution makers between the ages of 18 and 29 are more likely to make resolutions about health and exercise than resolution makers between the ages of 30 and 49 are.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
皮尤研究中心在2024年1月的一项调查发现，十分之三的美国成年人会制定至少一项新年决心（对来年的承诺），而制定决心的人中有一半会制定多项。调查询问参与者制定了哪些类型的决心，并将其分为几类。表格按年龄段列出了选择制定新年决心的人群中制定特定类型决心的人所占百分比。
中文解析：
表格数据清晰显示：50-64岁组在“人际关系”决心上的比例为58%，高于30-49岁组的53%；而在“财务”决心上的比例为56%，低于30-49岁组的63%。选项B准确描述了这一对比关系。

question:
Duckweed is a small freshwater plant that is often exposed to zinc pollution. Sofia Vámos and colleagues collected samples of four duckweed ecotypes (genetically and geographically distinct populations within a species), along with water from each ecosystem’s habitat. Hypothesizing that each ecosystem is adapted to its local conditions in ways that bolster its growth and resistance to pollutants, the researchers grew each ecosystem in all four water samples and with three levels of zinc (none, low, high). (The researchers did not replicate local differences in light or temperature.) They found that the ecotypes grew equally well in all four water samples and that adding zinc consistently enhanced growth, regardless of concentration, suggesting that ________.

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. if each ecosystem is indeed locally adapted as the researchers hypothesized, those adaptations are to other environmental conditions than the water each ecosystem inhabit.
B. while the ecotypes are genetically and geographically distinct, those differences do not represent adaptations to local environmental conditions.
C. there may not be significant differences in the water that each ecosystem inhabit, but there are significant differences in each ecotype’s resistance to zinc pollution.

D. although the researchers’ hypothesis does not appear to be supported, this may be because the levels of zinc exposure the plants in the experiment received did not match their exposure in their natural environments.
explanations:
题目文本翻译:
浮萍是一种常暴露于锌污染的小型淡水植物。Sofia Vámos及同事采集了四种浮莲生态型（物种内遗传和地理上独特的种群）及其各自栖息地的水样。研究人员假设每种生态型已适应其当地环境，从而促进生长并增强对污染物的抵抗力。他们在所有四种水样中培养每种生态型，并设置三种锌浓度（无、低、高）。（实验未复现光照或温度的局部差异。）结果发现，所有生态型在四种水样中生长同样良好，且添加锌始终促进生长（与浓度无关），这表明________。
中文解析：
实验发现：所有生态型在不同来源水样中生长无差异 → 说明它们未对特定水源产生适应；锌污染均促进生长（与浓度无关）→ 说明它们也未对锌污染产生差异化适应。
但实验未控制光照、温度等其它环境因素，因此局部适应可能体现在这些未测试的方面。选项A准确指出“适应可能针对水以外的其他环境条件”，既承认假设的可能性，又符合实验局限性。其他选项或直接否定适应（B），或与“锌均促进生长”的结果矛盾（C），或引入无关的锌暴露水平差异（D）。

question:
Optimal foraging theory (OFT) holds that animals’ foraging behaviors reflect cost-benefit trade-offs that vary by species and with dynamic ecological circumstances. One such circumstance is lunar intensity, which Mary V. Price and colleagues found to be negatively associated with foraging by white-throated woodrats but Simon Kenneth Bearder and colleagues found to be positively associated with foraging by Mohol bushbabies. This discrepancy is explicable in terms of OFT: the bushbabies’ greater reliance on vision means that higher lunar intensity benefits them more than it benefits the woodrats.

Information in the text best supports which statement about Mohol bushbabies?
selections: A. If increased lunar intensity imposed the same costs on the bushbabies that it imposes on white-throated woodrats, there would be no association between lunar intensity and the bushbabies' foraging.

B. If the advantages that the bushbabies gain from increased lunar intensity explain the change in their foraging behavior, those advantages are likely shared by some other species that are not heavily reliant on vision.
C. If increased lunar intensity creates any disadvantages for the bushbabies, those disadvantages are more than compensated for by the advantages that the bushbabies gain.

D. If the bushbabies’ foraging behavior under increased lunar intensity actually reflects a cost-benefit trade-off, their behavior should be more similar to that of white-throated woodrats than it is.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
最佳觅食理论（OFT）认为，动物的觅食行为反映了因物种和动态生态情境而异的成本—收益权衡。月相亮度即为此类情境之一，Mary V. Price等人发现它与白喉林鼠的觅食呈负相关，而Simon Kenneth Bearder等人则发现它与莫霍尔丛猴的觅食呈正相关。这一差异可用OFT解释：丛猴对视觉的依赖性更强，意味着更高的月相亮度对其益处大于对林鼠的益处。
中文解析：
文本指出，月相亮度与丛猴觅食呈正相关，并用OFT解释为丛猴因更依赖视觉而净收益更高。根据OFT的“成本—收益权衡”原则，只有当收益大于成本时，行为才会持续。因此，若月相亮度带来任何劣势，这些劣势必然被视觉优势所超额补偿，选项C准确体现了这一逻辑。其他选项均与文本信息矛盾或缺乏依据。

question:
Scholars cite One Hundred Years of Solitude, the 1967 novel by Colombian author Gabriel García Márquez, as a foundational text of magical realism, the Latin American style of fiction in which antirealistic plot devices—often borrowed from the spiritual and narrative traditions of Indigenous and colonial societies in the Americas—are deployed in an otherwise realistic mode of representation typical of the modern novel. This style has exerted a decisive influence on authors in the United States, including Toni Morrison, whose 1987 novel Beloved resembles classic magical realist novels in its juxtaposition of literary realism with long-established cultural traditions— namely, those of the Black American community.

Which quotation from a literary scholar would most directly support the claim in the underlined portion of the text?
selections: A. “Much of the interest of Beloved derives from the productive tension between its competing influences—namely, Black American cultural traditions and the magical realism of Latin America.”

B. “The cultural traditions of the Black American community, which figure so prominently in the magical realist tradition of Latin America, permit realistic as well as antirealistic scenarios—much as Beloved does.”
C. “Even though Beloved alternates between realistic and antirealistic modes of representation, the influence of Black American cultural traditions remains constant throughout the novel.”

D. “Although much of Beloved conforms to the conventions of realistic fiction, Toni Morrison also incorporates elements drawn from Black American cultural traditions that transcend and expose the limitations of realism.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
学者们将哥伦比亚作家加夫列尔·加西亚·马尔克斯1967年的小说《百年孤独》视为魔幻现实主义的奠基之作。魔幻现实主义是一种拉丁美洲小说风格，其特点是将反现实的情节手法——常借鉴自美洲原住民与殖民时期社会的精神及叙事传统——融入现代小说典型的现实主义表现模式中。这种风格对美国作家产生了决定性影响，包括托妮·莫里森，其1987年小说《宠儿》在将文学现实主义与悠久的传统文化——即美国黑人社区的传统文化——并置方面，与经典魔幻现实主义小说相似。
中文解析：
划线部分的观点是：《宠儿》与经典魔幻现实主义小说相似，因为它将文学现实主义与黑人传统文化并置，而黑人传统文化中包含了超越现实主义的元素。
D 选项直接指出《宠儿》大部分符合现实主义小说的惯例，但莫里森也加入了源自黑人文化传统的元素，这些元素超越了现实主义的限制。这与划线部分关于“现实主义与传统文化并置”的说法完全一致，因此能直接支持原观点。

question:
Linguist John McWhorter asserts that translation apps for smartphones and computers are—despite generally failing to convey many nuances—increasingly obviating the need to learn new languages. Advances in language processing technology have greatly boosted the utility of these apps for perfunctory tasks, like inquiring about an item on a menu, and passing interactions; be that as it may, richer communication (e.g., in business dealings or meaningful personal exchanges) often hinges on conversational patterns and gradations of meaning.

What does the text most directly suggest about translation apps?
selections: A. They have improved remarkably over time but remain insufficient to support the complexity called for in certain interactions.
B. They are coming to be embraced by international tourists but are viewed with skepticism by many business professionals.
C. They are becoming simpler to use but are inconsistent in how comprehensively they cover different languages.
D. They have gained impressive capabilities but continue to be widely viewed as inadequate for most practical purposes.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
语言学家约翰·麦沃特断言，尽管智能手机和计算机的翻译应用通常无法传达许多细微差别，但它们正逐渐使学习新语言变得不再必要。语言处理技术的进步极大提升了这些应用在处理敷衍性任务（如询问菜单上的菜品）和短暂互动中的实用性；尽管如此，更丰富的交流（例如在商业交易或有意义的个人交往中）往往依赖于对话模式和意义的细微层次。
中文解析：
文本明确指出翻译应用因技术发展在“敷衍性任务”中实用性提升，但强调“更丰富的交流”仍依赖“对话模式和意义层次”等复杂因素，暗示其尚无法满足深层沟通需求。对应A。

question:
Working on an unimaginably small scale of billionths of a meter, nanoengineers have found ways to leverage palladium____to facilitate energy generation in fuel cells.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 此处需要表示“纳米颗粒的特性”，且“纳米颗粒”为复数名词（nanoparticles），其所有格形式应为复数名词所有格 nanoparticles’，后接复数名词properties。选项D 。

question:
As juveniles, all white-necked jacobin hummingbirds display vividly blue head plumage; when they enter adulthood, males retain these blue feathers and most females molt to a drab green hue. However, 28% of adult female jacobins remain identical in coloration to juveniles and adult males. Based on field observations in Panama, a team of researchers reports that while adult males show a clear preference in mate selection for adult females with drab green feathers, they also engage in more antagonistic behavior toward those adult females than toward blue-feathered adult females when competing for resources. Therefore, the team hypothesizes that_______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the percentage of blue-feathered females will increase until fewer than half of adult female jacobins are green-feathered.
B. the occurrence of blue head plumage in adult female jacobins is driven by one or more factors not associated with mate attraction.
C. coloration prevents green-feathered adult female jacobins from distinguishing between adult males and blue-feathered adult females.
D. adult male jacobins do not act antagonistically toward juvenile jacobins with blue head plumage when competing for resources.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
白颈雅各蜂鸟在幼鸟阶段头部羽毛均为鲜亮的蓝色；成年后，雄性保留蓝色羽毛，而大多数雌性换羽为暗淡的绿色。然而，28%的成年雌性仍保持与幼鸟及成年雄性相同的蓝色。基于在巴拿马的野外观察，一研究团队报告称：成年雄性在择偶时明显偏好绿色羽毛的成年雌性，但在争夺资源时，它们对绿色雌性的攻击行为却多于对蓝色雌性。因此，研究团队假设______
中文解析：
研究显示：蓝色雌性在择偶中不占优势（雄性更偏好绿色雌性），但在资源竞争中被攻击较少。若蓝色羽毛仅为吸引配偶，则其应被自然选择淘汰；但蓝色性状得以维持，说明其可能在其他方面（如减少竞争攻击、提高生存率）存在优势。选项B指出蓝色羽毛由“与吸引配偶无关的因素”驱动，与观察数据逻辑一致。其他选项或缺乏依据（A、C），或偏离核心逻辑（D）。
