question:
Saeed M. Z. A. Tarabich conducted a study of consumer attitudes toward Jordanian food and beverage companies and found that for consumers who value environmental conservation, their likelihood of purchasing a product decreased when their perception of the product’s risk of causing environmental harm increased. Subsequently, other researchers conducted a study of various demographic groups in China, investigating participants’ intentions to purchase a new piece of furniture, and found that, on average, college students had the lowest perception among all the demographic groups in the study of the environmental risks of the piece of furniture. Assuming that the results of Tarabieh’s study are broadly applicable, this finding suggests that _____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the new piece of furniture is less appealing to college students than other similar products on the market are.
B. college students might be more likely than participants in the other demographic groups to purchase the piece of furniture.
C. college students likely prioritize other factors over a product’s environmental sustainability when making purchasing decisions.
D. there is not a meaningful difference in the average likelihood of purchasing environmentally friendly products among the demographic groups included in the study.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Saeed M. Z. A. Tarabieh 研究消费者对约旦食品饮料公司的态度，发现重视环保的消费者若认为产品对环境有害的风险较高，购买可能性会降低。后来其他研究者在中国调查不同人群购买新家具的意愿，发现大学生群体对家具环境风险的感知在所有人群中最低。假设 Tarabieh 的研究结论普遍适用，这一发现表明 _____
中文解析：
根据 Tarabieh 的研究：环境风险感知高 → 购买可能性低那么，大学生环境风险感知最低 → 购买可能性应相对较高。因此，大学生比其他人群更可能购买该家具。

question:
In 1990, oil prices rose 90% between August and October, creating what economists term an oil shock. Although oil shocks have occurred multiple times since 1945, a broadly applicable description of how oil shocks affect economies at the national level has proved elusive, a problem typically attributed to the fact that oil shocks’ effects are substantially conditioned on country-specific characteristics (oil import-export ratios, most importantly). Recently, however, Gbadebo Oladosu et al. showed that economists’ estimates of national economies’ responsiveness to oil shocks are highly heterogeneous even within a given country and time frame—ranging by more than a factor of five in the case of Australia during a recent oil shock, for instance—suggesting that _____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. differences in oil import-export ratios from one country to another may account for more of the differences in the effects of oil shocks on those countries’ economies than economists previously believed.
B. methodological discrepancies in studies of oilshocks may have contributed to economists’ inability to provide a generalized model of oilshocks’ effects on national economies.
C. economists’ conventional measures of national economic activity may be insufficiently sensitive to the effects of oil shocks.
D. controlling for variations in countries’ oil import-export ratios may have obscured inconsistencies in economists’ findings about the effects of oil shocks at national levels.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
1990年，石油价格在8月至10月间上涨了90%，形成经济学家所称的“石油危机”。尽管自1945年以来多次发生石油危机，但一直难以得出石油危机如何影响国家层面经济的广泛适用描述，这一问题通常归因于石油危机的影响在很大程度上取决于各国的具体特征（尤其是石油进出口比率）。然而，Gbadebo Oladosu 等人最近指出，即使在同一个国家和时间段内，经济学家对国家经济对石油危机反应程度的估计也差异巨大（例如最近一次石油危机中澳大利亚的估计值相差五倍以上），这表明 _____
中文解析：
原文逻辑是：过去把难以建立通用模型归因于国家间特征差异（如进出口比率不同）。但 Oladosu 等人发现在同一个国家、同一时期，不同研究的估计结果差异仍然很大。这说明问题可能不在于国家间差异，而在于研究方法本身的不一致导致结果无法统一。因此，最合理的补全是：方法上的差异导致了无法建立通用模型

question:
The following text is from Edward Gibbon’s 1796 Memoirs of My Life and Writings. Gibbon reflects on publishing a volume of his series The History of the Decline and Fall of the Roman Empire.
I am at a loss how to describe the success of the work, without betraying the vanity of the writer. The first impression was exhausted in a few days; a second and third edition were scarcely adequate to the demand.

As used in the text, what does the word “betraying” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字选自爱德华·吉本1796年的《我的生平与著作回忆录》。吉本在文中谈及他出版《罗马帝国衰亡史》系列中某一卷的经历："我不知该如何描述这部著作的成功，而不_______作者的虚荣。初版数日内售罄，第二版与第三版仍几乎供不应求。"
中文解析：
正确答案是 B 暴露 (Exposing)。原文语境中，吉本希望描述作品的成功，但又不想因此"显露/暴露"(betray)出作者的虚荣心。"betray"在此取"无意中显露"的引申义，与"暴露"含义高度契合，其他选项均不符合文意。

question:
Players of online games are largely aware that the games collect their data, and they’re often willing to trade some privacy for a fun experience. But the games are often quite _______ about what data they collect and why. Because of this, data-privacy advocates are seeking to expand online players’ knowledge of data collection practices and improve their ability to navigate privacy-setting features in games.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在线游戏玩家大多意识到游戏会收集他们的数据，并且常常愿意用部分隐私换取有趣的体验。但游戏对于收集哪些数据及为何收集往往相当_______。正因如此，数据隐私倡导者正致力于提升在线玩家对数据收集行为的认知，并增强他们使用游戏中隐私设置功能的能力。
中文解析：
正确答案是 C opaque。原文指出游戏在数据收集方面缺乏透明度，导致玩家不清楚具体操作（与后文“提升认知”形成因果关联）。“opaque”准确描述了这种信息不透明的状态，而其他选项均无法体现“信息不明确”这一核心含义。

question:
Described in treatises mainly published between 1768 and 1950 (such as W. D. Dunton’s Dunton’s Musical Shorthand), musical stenography used quickly written squiggles and dots in an attempt to preserve, in printand in real time, the _______features of live performances — those that result from impromptu deviations of performers when fidelity to an established musical score is not mandated.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
音乐速记法主要见于1768至1950年间出版的论著（如W. D. Dunton的《丹顿音乐速记法》），它通过快速书写的曲线与圆点，试图以印刷形式和实时方式留存现场演出的_______特征——即当演出者无需严格遵循既定乐谱时，因即兴发挥而产生的特质。
中文解析：
正确答案是 B extemporaneous。破折号后的解释明确强调这些特征源自演出者的“即兴偏离”（impromptu deviations），与“extemporaneous”（即兴的）形成直接对应关系。其他选项均无法体现“非预设的即时创作”这一核心含义。

question:
Harold Newton’s Yellow Day, a wetland landscape with palm trees and lush greenery set against the pastel yellows and pinks of the sky and water, is typical of paintings by the Florida Highwaymen, loosely affiliated landscape artists mainly active in Fort Pierce, Florida, during the 1950s and ’60s. Some art historians suggest that Highwaymen paintings played a role in shaping popular perceptions of the state that persist today: the natural iconography that Newton and colleagues constantly revisited—lush tropical forests, vivid sunsets—is now seen as classically Floridian.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To explain that a particular painting by Harold Newton has had greater influence on the broader culture of the state of Florida than is generally acknowledged
B. To contrast the public’s reaction during the 1950s and ’60s to a particular painting by Harold Newton with more recent reactions to it
C. To describe the historical circumstances in which paintings by the Florida Highwaymen experienced a resurgence in popularity
D. To present the argument that paintings by the Florida Highwaymen likely helped to create a particular widespread impression of Florida
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
哈罗德·牛顿的《黄色日子》描绘了一幅湿地景观——棕榈树与葱郁绿意映衬着天空与水面的淡黄与粉红，这幅作品是"佛罗里达公路画家"（一组松散关联的风景画家，主要于20世纪50-60年代在佛罗里达皮尔斯堡活动）的典型画作。一些艺术史学家指出，公路画家的作品对塑造当今人们对佛罗里达的普遍认知起到了作用：牛顿及其同行不断描绘的自然意象——茂密的热带森林、绚丽的日落——如今已被视为经典的佛罗里达风貌。
中文解析：
正确答案是 D。文本核心在于指出艺术史学家认为公路画家（以牛顿为例）通过反复描绘特定自然意象，"塑造了延续至今的佛罗里达普遍认知"。D选项准确概括了这一论点，而其他选项均偏离了文本主旨（A强调单幅画被低估、B涉及公众反应对比、C讨论作品重新流行，文中均未体现）。

question:
Callie W. Babbitt, Hema Madaka, and colleagues assembled a database of materials used in consumer electronics by studying products in the lab and by gathering data from similar product studies. The team gave each of these studies a rating for level of detail (with a higher rating for reported data with more detail) and for level of traceability (with a higher rating for clearer descriptions of procedures). Based on these ratings, a second research team concluded that a study by Paul Teehan and Milind Kandlikar provided more specificity in its data than a study by Oguchi Masahiro and colleagues did.

Which finding, if true, would most directly challenge the second research team’s conclusion?
selections: A. The study by Oguchi and colleagues had a low detail rating and a low traceability rating.
B. The study by Teehan and Kandlikar had a lower traceability rating than the study by Oguchi and colleagues did.
C. The study by Teehan and Kandlikar had a high detail rating and a high traceability rating.
D. The study by Teehan and Kandlikar had a lower detail rating than the study by Oguchi and colleagues did.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Callie W. Babbitt、Hema Madaka 及同事通过实验室研究产品并收集同类产品研究的数据，建立了一个消费电子材料数据库。团队对每项研究的详细程度（数据越详细，评分越高）和可追溯性（流程描述越清晰，评分越高）进行了评级。基于这些评级，第二个研究团队得出结论：Teehan 和 Kandlikar 的研究比 Oguchi 等人的研究在数据上提供了更明确的细节。
中文解析：
第二个团队的结论是“Teehan 和 Kandlikar 的研究比 Oguchi 等人的研究数据更具体”，这意味着前者的细节评分应更高。如果 Teehan 和 Kandlikar 的研究细节评分实际上低于 Oguchi 的研究，就直接与结论矛盾，因此最能挑战该结论。

question:
The metal featured in both the structure of the Shimogamo Machiya Villa by Takuma Ohira and the hardware in the One-Room Residence of 5 Layers by Matsuyama Architect and Associates is representative of a trend in contemporary Japanese interior design to juxtapose sleek, modern accents with traditional organic materials such as cypress. The prominent featuring of metal stems from the post-World War II emphasis on technological progress, while more traditional natural materials help preserve longstanding architectural and aesthetic approaches.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. The text names projects that are noteworthy for their inclusion of certain materials and then explains past important uses of the materials.
B. The text introduces the salient characteristics of two buildings and then details the historical events that occasioned the buildings’ designs.
C. The text cites examples of a design trend and then briefly establishes the principles underlying the trend.
D. The text distinguishes between two aesthetic approaches to architecture and then submits that one approach has had more of a long-term impact than the other has had.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
由大平拓马设计的Shimogamo Machiya别墅，以及松山建筑师事务所设计的5层单间住宅中使用的金属构件，共同体现了当代日本室内设计的一种趋势——将线条流畅的现代金属元素与传统有机材料（如柏木）并置。金属的突出运用源于二战后对技术进步的重视，而更传统的天然材料则有助于延续悠久的建筑与美学传统。
中文解析：
正确答案是 C。文本首先通过两个具体案例指出当代日本设计中"金属与传统材料并置"的趋势，接着阐明这种趋势背后的设计理念（金属代表技术进步，天然材料延续传统），完全符合"举例说明趋势→阐释背后原理"的结构。其他选项均与文本实际内容不符。

question:
Based on findings from fossil sites, paleobotanists had developed the so-called partition hypothesis, which holds that there were two distinctly different kinds of biomes during the Devonian period (circ a 360 to 420 million years ago). One was a tropical deltaic forest biome home to plants such as the femaine Eospermatopteris, and the other was an arid floodplain forest biome home to plants such as the coniferlike Archaeopteris. Recently, however, evolutionary ecologist Khudadad Khudadad examined the remnants of a Devonian forest in what is now Cairo, New York, and concluded that evidence from the Cairo site is inconsistent with the partition hypothesis.

Which finding about the Cairo site, if true, would most directly support Khudadad’s conclusion?
selections: A. The site appears to have been a tropical deltaic forest early in the Devonian period but transitioned to an arid floodplain forest after the end of the Devonian period.
B. Fossil evidence from the site suggests that several forest plant species other than Eospermatopteris and Archaeopteris lived there during the Devonian period.
C. Although the site appears to have been a tropical deltaic forest during the Devonian period, fossil evidence suggests that Eospermatopteris was present at that time.

D. The site appears to have been an arid floodplain forest during the Devonian period
and contains fossil evidence of contemporaneous Eospermatopteris and Archaeopteris.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
根据化石遗址的发现，古植物学家曾提出所谓的“分隔假说”，认为泥盆纪（约3.6亿至4.2亿年前）存在两种明显不同的生物群系：一种是热带三角洲森林生物群系，以蕨类植物 Eospermatopteris 等为特征；另一种是干旱洪泛区森林生物群系，以类似针叶树的 Archaeopteris 等为特征。然而，生态学家 Khudadad 研究了纽约开罗地区一处泥盆纪森林的遗迹后，认为该遗址的证据与分隔假说不一致。
中文解析：
分隔假说认为两种植物分别生长在不同类型的生物群系中。要反驳它，就需要找到它们共存的证据。
选项 D 表明该遗址在泥盆纪是干旱洪泛区森林（本应只有 Archaeopteris），却同时存在 Eospermatopteris 的化石，这直接证明两种植物可共存于同一环境，与分隔假说矛盾，因此最能支持 Khudadad 的结论。

question:
Microbiologist Radamés Cordero and team investigated surface temperatures of a variety of fungi, including Amanita brunnescens and a species from the genus Hortiboletus, in a study _______a previous observation: Cordero had taken thermal images of various wildmushrooms while hiking and found that the mushroomsall appeared to be colder than the surrounding environment, raising questions about thermoregulation in fungi.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
微生物学家Radamés Cordero及其团队研究了一系列真菌的表面温度，包括棕鹅膏（Amanita brunnescens）和 Hortiboletus 属的一个物种，这项研究 _______ 先前的观察：Cordero 在徒步时拍摄了多种野生蘑菇的热成像图，发现所有蘑菇似乎都比周围环境更冷，这引发了关于真菌体温调节的疑问。
中文解析：
正确答案是 A prompted by。研究是基于Cordero早先的观察（蘑菇比环境更冷）而展开的，因此这项研究是由该观察“引发”的。其他选项不符合逻辑，因为研究并非“被排除”“在…中发布”或仅仅“在…中承认”该观察。

question:
The following text is from Nathaniel Hawthorne’s 1830 short story “Sir William Phips.”
The knowledge, communicated by the historian and biographer, is analogous to that which we acquire of a country by the map,—minute, perhaps, and accurate, and available for all necessary purposes, but cold and naked, and wholly destitute of the mimic charm produced by landscape painting. These defects are partly remediable, and even without an absolute violation of literal truth, although by methods rightfully interdicted to professors of biographical exactness.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Historians should not worry if their readers believe they are embellishing the truth.
B. Historians’ fidelity to the truth often results in work that is less engaging than it could be.
C. Historians do not agree among themselves about the best methods of recording history.
D. Maps are more practical to own than paintings.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本选自纳撒尼尔·霍桑1830年的短篇小说《威廉·菲普斯爵士》。
历史学家和传记作家所传达的知识，类似于我们通过地图对一个国家的了解——或许细致、准确且能满足一切必要用途，但却冰冷而直白，完全缺乏风景画所营造的拟真魅力。这些缺陷在一定程度上是可以弥补的，甚至无需全然违背事实真相，尽管所采用的方法确实被恪守传记精确性的学者所禁止。
中文解析：
正确答案是 B。文本通过“地图”与“风景画”的比喻，指出历史记载虽精确却枯燥（“冰冷而直白”），暗示对事实的严格遵循牺牲了作品的感染力。B选项准确概括了“忠于史实导致作品缺乏吸引力”这一核心观点，其他选项均偏离文本主旨（A强调修饰事实的合理性，C讨论方法论分歧，D比较地图与绘画的实用性，均非原文重点）

question:
Text 1
For decades, ornithologists assumed that if they saw a singing house wren—a bird species found in temperate North America—they must be observing a male trying to attract a mate or claim territory. As Peter J. B. Slater and Nigel I. Mann have emphasized, however, a similar assumption can’t be made about birds in the tropics, where females sing as often as males do. Slater and Mann call for more research on this discrepancy between tropical and temperate female birdsong.
Text 2
Recent evidence shows that a female house wren is as capable of song as a male is. In fact, female birdsong is more common among temperate species than currently assumed, claim Evangeline Rose and colleagues. These female songbirds sing less frequently than males do, and in duller tones, making it “easy for researchers to miss the quiet and hidden females and focus on the loud and colorful males,” says Rose.

Based on the texts, how would Rose and colleagues (Text 2) most likely respond to the assertion by Slater and Mann (Text 1) about the different prevalence of female birdsong in temperate and tropical areas?
selections: A. They would raise the possibility that the difference in prevalence may be due to differences in the timing of the mating season among temperate and tropical bird species.
B. They would concede that the geographic difference in prevalence is real but argue that the frequency with which male tropical birds sing has been overstated by previous researchers.
C. They would argue that the apparent difference in prevalence may partly reflect a difference in the ease with which female birdsong and male birdsong can be detected.
D. They would caution that the seeming difference in prevalence may be an artifact of researchers’ tendency to study birdsong among temperate species more frequently than among tropical species.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
文本1
几十年来，鸟类学家一直认为，如果看到一只正在鸣唱的莺鹪鹩（一种分布于北温带的鸟类），他们观察到的必然是一只试图求偶或宣示领地的雄鸟。然而，正如Peter J. B. Slater和Nigel I. Mann所强调的，对于热带鸟类不能做出类似假设——在热带，雌鸟和雄鸟的鸣唱频率相同。Slater与Mann呼吁针对热带与温带雌鸟鸣唱率的差异展开更多研究。
文本2
最新证据表明，雌性莺鹪鹩与雄性一样具备鸣唱能力。Evangeline Rose与同事指出，实际上温带鸟类的雌鸟鸣唱现象比当前认知的更普遍。这些雌性鸣禽的鸣唱频率低于雄鸟，且音调更为单调，Rose表示“这容易使研究者忽略安静隐蔽的雌鸟，而将注意力集中在喧闹鲜艳的雄鸟身上”。
中文解析：
正确答案是 C。文本2明确指出雌鸟鸣唱因频率低、色调单调而“容易被研究者忽略”，暗示温带地区雌鸟鸣唱的实际普遍性可能被低估——这与Slater和曼指出的温带与热带差异可能并非真实存在，而是源于观测偏差。C选项准确抓住了“侦测难度导致表面差异”这一核心反驳逻辑。

question:
Carolina chickadees are cavity nesting birds that initiate nest building at the same time of year as golden paper wasps, a species that also nests in enclosed spaces. Researchers observed that both species will settle in nesting boxes, but birds and wasps are not often observed co-occupying boxes, leading to the hypothesis that the two species compete for nesting sites. To test this hypothesis, the researchers installed nesting boxes throughout a nature preserve in the US state of North Carolina, manipulated some of the boxes to exclude birds, and then monitored the boxes for two years. Not only was the hypothesis validated, there was also a clear indication of competitive advantage for birds.

Which finding from the study, if true, would most directly support the text's characterization of the study's results?
selections: A. Although only 15 instances of co-occupation of unmanipulated boxes by wasps and birds were observed over the course of the study, in a majority of those instances, wasps were already occupying the boxes when birds initiated nesting in them.

B. Wasps initiated nesting in manipulated boxes much more often than in unmanipulated boxes, and 80% of initial co-occupations of unmanipulated boxes resulted in abandonment by wasps but not by birds.

C. Even though overall usage of the nesting boxes by wasps and birds was high throughout the study, 24% of the manipulated boxes remained vacant each spring, while less than 4% of the unmanipulated nesting boxes remained vacant.
D. Nest initiation by either birds or wasps but not both was observed in more than 90% of the unmanipulated boxes, but nest initiation by wasps was observed in less than 50% of the manipulated boxes.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：：
卡罗山雀与金纸黄蜂都是在封闭空间筑巢的物种，且筑巢时间相同。研究者发现它们很少共占同一个巢箱，因此提出假说：两者存在巢位竞争。为验证假说，研究者在北卡罗来纳州自然保护区内设置巢箱，部分巢箱经改造以阻止鸟类进入，并监测两年。结果不仅验证了假说，还表明鸟类具有明显的竞争优势。
中文解析：
要支持“存在竞争”且“鸟类占优势”，需同时满足两个条件：1）阻止鸟类进入后，黄蜂使用巢箱更多 → 说明原本鸟类限制了黄蜂；2）在共占情况下，黄蜂更常放弃而鸟类留下 → 说明竞争中鸟类胜出。选项 B 同时包含这两方面证据，因此最能直接支持结论。

question:
The advent of online streaming has led many music listeners to drift away from ownership of music (through downloads or through physical media such as compact discs) and toward the streaming services Bandcamp and Tidal, among others. Datta et al. studied the impact of this change on the variety of music that listeners consume. The researchers reasoned that the ownership model of music assigns a cost per song to acquiring a variety of music, while streaming services typically charge a flat fee for access to an entire music catalog, making variety free, which suggests that____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. listeners who use streaming services would be more likely to give physical copies of music as gifts to others than to purchase physical copies for themselves.
B. listeners who prefer to purchase compact discs rather than use a service such as Bandcamp or Tidal would tend to listen to older music.
C. the music choices of listeners who use streaming services would likely be more varied than those of listeners who do not use streaming services.
D. music publishers who choose to forgo releasing music on physical media are likely to see no change in revenue.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在线流媒体的兴起使得许多音乐听众逐渐从拥有音乐（通过下载或CD等实体媒介）转向使用Bandcamp和Tidal等流媒体服务。Datta等人研究了这一变化对听众音乐消费多样性的影响。研究者的推论是：音乐所有权模式为获取多样音乐设定了每首歌曲的成本，而流媒体服务通常对访问整个音乐库收取固定费用，这使得多样性无需额外成本，这表明______
中文解析：
正确答案是 C。文本核心逻辑为：所有权模式中“每首歌曲需单独付费”会限制多样性消费，而流媒体“固定费用畅听全库”使探索多样性音乐无需额外成本。根据经济学原理，价格障碍消除将直接促进消费多样性，因此C选项“流媒体用户可能拥有更广泛的音乐选择”是唯一符合前文推论的合理结论。

question:
Social media platforms have made the collection of qualitative human behavioral data easier than ever. To collect such data by means of social media does raise a serious ethical _________ terms of service stipulate that platforms can analyze users’ accounts and posts, according to sociologist Jose van Dijck, users are not informed when their data are included in behavioral studies.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 分析主语和谓语，第一个主语和谓语：to collect such data是主语，does raise是谓语；第二个主语和谓语：terms of service stipulate是主语，stipulate是谓语；第三个主语和谓语：users是主语，are是谓语。根据选项可以看出来，需要判断though是作为连词还是副词使用。根据以上分析，我们可以看出，后面两个句子首先需要一个连词，那么就是though，排除AD。那么第一个句子和后面的主从句不能用逗号隔开，那么就需要冒号，对应B.

question:
In a letter dated January 14th, 1780, congressman John Witherspoon attempts to persuade General George Washington that the Continental Army’s difficulty in procuring supplies, often attributed to disloyalty among civilian farmers and merchants,__________ due to concerns suppliers have about receiving compensation in the form of rapidly depreciating Continental currency.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 考察从句中的主谓一致，从句的主语是difficulty，谓语应该用三单形式，所以选D

question:
Brothers Orville and Wilbur Wright famously received a patent for their flying machine on May 22, 1906. Louisiana native Charles F. Page, who was born into slavery and self-educated, created a gas-powered flying ship in 1903 that was officially patented on April 10,______ only model had been suspiciously destroyed en route to a planned demonstration at the 1904 World’s Fair, and, discouraged, he never built a replacement.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. 1906 — roughly six weeks earlier. Page’s
B. 1906. Roughly six weeks earlier, Page’s
C. 1906 roughly six weeks earlier, Page’s
D. 1906 — roughly six weeks earlier — Page’s
explanations: 第一个句子的主语是Brothers Orville and Wilbur Wright，谓语是received；第二个句子的主语是Louisiana native Charles F. Page，谓语是created；第三个句子的主语是Page’s only model，谓语是had been destroyed；第四个句子是he never built a replacement. 首先，考察的是第三句话和第四句话连接，那么排除CD。接下来看下roughly six weeks earlier修饰谁，根据第一句话时间状语可以看到1906年5月22号和第二句话时间状语可以看到1906年4月10号，正好4月10好是5月22号的5周前，所以roughly six weeks earlier修饰的是第一二句话，所以放在第二句话内，对应A.

question:
Alberto Gabriele, author of Reading Popular Culture in Victorian Print, tracks the transnational dissemination of works by author Mary Elizabeth Braddon via the magazine ______ from 1866 to 1899 and distributed throughout the Australian cities of Melbourne, Adelaide, and Hobart; the continental European cities of Brussels, Paris, and Turin; and cities in Turkey, India, and Jamaica, this magazine helped make Braddon’s serialized novels globally available.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 第一个句子的主语是Alberto Gabriele，谓语是tracks；第二个句子的主语是this magazine，谓语是helped，两个句子之间只能用分号或者句号，两个句子之间是顺承关系，而非并列关系，所以选D.

question:
Helical ____ widely understood to confer stability and efficiency in the locomotion of a variety of microscopic organisms—including bacteria, eukaryotic algae, and ciliates—bestows similar advantages, albeit via different propulsive modes, to larger oceanic macroplanktons, such as salps.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: Helical swimming是主语，bestows是谓语，中间都是插入语，所以选D

question:
The neurotechnology company MindMaze is working on an exciting new technology: game-based digital therapies that improve neuroplasticity to help with cognitive rehabilitation. MindMaze’s technology, alongside other such neuromodulation technologies that function by stimulating nervous system structures,_______ the way for future advancements in neurotechnology.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 考察主谓一致，从句的主语是technology，谓语应该用三单形式，所以选B

question:
At Storm King Art Center, an outdoor sculpture park in New York, Herbert Ferber’s Konkapot Ⅱ is exposed to rain, snow, heat, and humidity. ________ it remains in good condition due to its material: Ferber’s sculpture is made of corrosion-resistant steel.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在纽约户外雕塑公园Storm King艺术中心，赫伯特·费伯的雕塑《康卡波特二世》长期暴露于雨雪、高温与潮湿中。________ 由于其所用材质，作品依然保持良好状态：费伯的雕塑由耐腐蚀钢材制成。
中文解析：
正确答案是 C。原文前句强调雕塑暴露于恶劣环境，后句指出它因特殊材质仍保持完好，前后存在语义转折关系。"不过"能准确表达这种"尽管环境恶劣，但结果意外良好"的转折逻辑，其他选项均不符合语境（A表因果、B表对立、D表并列）。

question:
In contrast to first-past-the-post electoral processes, the proportional representation system by which Paraguay’s Chamber of Senators is elected begins with citizens casting their votes not for specific candidates but for political parties. _______once the votes have been tabulated, each party is awarded a number of seats proportional to the number of votes it received.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
与"简单多数决"选举制度不同，巴拉圭参议院选举所采用的比例代表制始于公民不为具体候选人、而是为政党投票。_______在选票统计完成后，各政党将按其得票比例获得相应席位。
中文解析：
正确答案是 D。原文描述的是一个连续选举流程：先说明投票方式（投给政党），后说明计票结果（按比例分配席位）。两句话之间是时间顺序关系，而非对比（A）、解释（B）或转折（C），因此"随后"最能体现程序步骤的连贯性。

question:
Photogrammetry and boolean modeling approaches to three-dimensional digital modeling for video games yield graphics that accurately represent the relative sizes and proportions of real-world objects, but since these graphics are rendered from perfect geometric shapes, they tend to lack organic realism.________ these 3D elements may display unnaturally precise angles and curves as compared to their real- world counterparts.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
电子游戏三维数字建模中的摄影测量法与布尔建模方法，能生成准确反映现实物体相对大小与比例的图形，但由于这些图形是从完美几何形状渲染而成，往往缺乏有机真实感。________与现实世界对应物相比，这些3D元素可能呈现出不自然的精确角度与曲线。
中文解析：
正确答案是 B。前后句之间是明确的因果关系：前句指出建模方法因使用“完美几何形状”而导致“缺乏有机真实感”，后句具体说明其表现（角度曲线不自然），二者构成“原因→具体结果”的逻辑链条。“因此”能准确体现这种推论关系，其他选项均不符合（A用于总结、C表转折、D表并列）。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Raymond is the nickname of a Triceratops fossil specimen housed at the National Museum of Nature and Science.
●The National Museum of Nature and Science is located in Tokyo, Japan.
●Raymond lived in the Late Cretaceous period.
●Dio is the nickname of a Triceratops fossil specimen housed at the Royal Ontario Museum.
●The Royal Ontario Museum is located in Ontario, Canada.
●Dio lived in the Late Cretaceous period.

The student wants to contrast the locations of the two specimens. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Raymond is housed at the National Museum of Nature and Science in Tokyo, Japan, while Dio is housed at the Royal Ontario Museum in Ontario, Canada.
B. Like Raymond, Dio is a Triceratops fossil specimen that lived in the Late Cretaceous period.
C. The Royal Ontario Museum in Ontario, Canada, houses Dio, a Triceratops fossil specimen
D. The Triceratops fossil specimen Raymond is not the only such specimen currently housed in a museum or institute.
explanations:
题目文本翻译:
一名学生在研究某个课题时记录了以下信息：
●“雷蒙德”是存放于日本国立自然科学博物馆的一具三角龙化石标本的昵称。
●日本国立自然科学博物馆位于日本东京。
●雷蒙德生活在白垩纪晚期。
●“迪奥”是存放于安大略皇家博物馆的一具三角龙化石标本的昵称。
●安大略皇家博物馆位于加拿大安大略省。
●迪奥生活在白垩纪晚期。
中文解析：
正确答案是 A。题目明确要求“对比两具标本的存放地点”，A选项通过并列结构直接清晰地并列呈现了两者的博物馆名称与所在地点，完全符合对比要求。其他选项均未实现有效对比：B强调共同时期而非地点差异，C仅提及单一样本信息，D表述模糊未体现具体地点对比。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Manchu is a synthetic language in the Tungusic language family.
●In synthetic languages, nouns can take several different forms (or cases) depending on their function within a sentence.
●Combining the suffix-de with the Manchu noun boo (house) forms the locative-case noun boode (in the house).
●Synthetic languages have extensive case systems. In analytic languages, cases are not typically used to indicate noun function.
●Noun function is instead indicated through word order and auxiliary words (such as prepositions and adjectives).

The student wants to explain why Manchu is classified as a synthetic language. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Manchu is classified as a synthetic language, meaning that the Tungusic language utilizes nouns to fulfill various functions within asentence.
B. Manchu is a synthetic language rather than an analytic language, where nouns rely on word order and auxiliary words to indicate their function.
C. Manchu has a robust case system in which nouns take different forms depending on their function, making it a synthetic language.
D. In contrast to an analytic language, a synthetic language like Manchu indicates a noun’s function within a sentence.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一名学生在研究某个课题时记录了以下信息：
●满语是通古斯语系中的一种综合语。
●在综合语中，名词根据其在句中的功能可采取多种不同形式（即格）。
●在满语中，将后缀-de 与名词 boo（房屋）结合可形成方位格名词 boode（在房屋里）。
●综合语具有丰富的格系统。在分析语中，通常不使用格来表示名词功能。
●分析语中名词功能通过词序和辅助词（如介词、形容词）来表示。
中文解析：
正确答案是 C。题目要求解释“满语为何被归类为综合语”，即需说明其符合综合语的定义特征。C选项直接关联“名词依功能取不同形式（即格变化）”这一综合语核心特征，并援引满语自身“后缀构成方位格”的实例，精准对应笔记中“综合语有丰富格系统”的定义，完整达成解释目标。其他选项或定义模糊（A、D），或仅通过对比分析语间接说明（B），均未直接结合满语自身特征进行有效解释。

question:
Some animals can wiggle their ears to find prey. Many people think that most humans can’t wiggle their ears, maybe because we don’t need to do it for survival. But in a 2020 study, Daniel Strauss and team found that study participants made small ear movements without realizing it while listening to podcasts. This finding could suggest that humans might have some _______ to wiggle their ears.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
有些动物能通过摆动耳朵来寻找猎物。许多人认为大多数人类不会动耳朵，或许是因为我们不再需要借此求生。但在2020年的一项研究中，丹尼尔·斯特劳斯团队发现，参与者在听播客时会无意识地轻微移动耳朵。这一发现可能表明人类具有摆动耳朵的某种_______。
中文解析：
研究结果表明人类在无意识状态下仍能做出耳部动作，这体现了生理上的潜在“能力”。选项B“能力”既能准确描述这种生理特性，又符合科学研究发现的逻辑语境。其他选项均无法与“无意识耳部运动”这一科学观察形成合理关联。

question:
A team of public transportation experts in Oceanside, California, is creating a new light rail stop for the SPRINTER system that will service a neighborhood in which a stop does not currently exist. To decide where to place the stop, the team is using a survey from ten years ago that asked how far neighborhood residents would be willing to walk to a light rail stop. The team also looked at studies showing that people’s willingness to walk to public transit is influenced by factors like weather and the presence of well-enforced low speed limits for cars. A researcher has argued that the survey does not accurately reflect the feelings of today’s residents of this neighborhood.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researcher’s claim?
selections: A. There has been a sharp increase in the last ten years in cyclists who use the roads in the neighborhood that the light rail stop will service.
B. Current users of the SPRINTER are satisfied with the number of stops along the line.
C. Residents of Oceanside, California, are much less likely to use public transit on rainy days than on clear days.
D. The enforcement of posted speed limits in the neighborhood that the light rail stop will service has increased substantially in the last ten years.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
加利福尼亚州奥申赛德的一个公共交通专家团队正在为SPRINTER系统创建一个新的轻轨站点，该站点将服务于一个目前没有站点的社区。为了决定站点位置，该团队使用了一份十年前的调查，该调查询问了社区居民愿意步行多远到达轻轨站。团队还参考了研究，表明人们步行使用公交的意愿受天气、以及是否有得到良好执行的汽车低速限速等因素影响。一位研究人员认为，该调查不能准确反映当前社区居民的感受。
中文解析：
研究人员的核心论点是“十年前的数据无法反映现状”。选项D指出“该社区限速执法力度在过去十年大幅加强”，这直接改变了影响居民步行意愿的关键因素（良好低速限速环境），从而有力支持了“旧调查已过时”的论断。其他选项均未建立“社区现状与十年前发生显著变化”的直接关联。

question:
The following text is adapted from Jhumpa Lahiri’s 2003 novel The Namesake. Ashima and her husband, Ashoke, are traveling from the United States to India. Ashoke puts his hand over hers as the plane begins to gather speed. And then Boston tilts away and they ascend effortlessly over a blackened Atlantic.
©2003 by Jhumpa Lahiri

As used in the text, what does the word “gather” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下段落改编自裘帕·拉希莉2003年的小说《同名人》。艾西玛与丈夫艾修克正从美国返回印度。当飞机开始加速时，艾修克将手覆在她的手上。随后波士顿逐渐倾斜远去，他们轻盈地攀升至漆黑的大西洋上空。
©2003 by Jhumpa Lahiri
中文解析：
原文描述飞机起飞时“开始加速”的场景，“gather”在此语境中特指“逐渐积累速度”。选项C“获得”能准确体现“速度提升”的动态过程，而其他选项均与飞机起飞时的物理动作无关。通过上下文“飞机加速后攀升”可进一步确认该词义。

question:
A few years ago, a study found that participants who rowed on a rowing machine while listening to Little Richard’s “Long Tall Sally” — which, at 189 beats per minute, or bpm, is a high-tempo song — exhibited a faster pace and higher heart rate than did participants who listened to Vanessa Williams’s “Colors of the Wind” (83 bpm). In a recent effort to replicate this study’s findings, researchers played the same songs while two groups of participants similar to those from the earlier study climbed steps for 30 minutes. Average paces and heart rates were similar across the two groups in the new study, leading the researchers to suggest that_______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. participants’ prior experience with rowing and stair climbing may have improved their performance in each study.
B. the effects of high-tempo music seen in the earlier study may be specific to rowing.
C. participants’ familiarity with the songs may have affected performance in both studies.
D. some aspect of stair climbing may magnify the effect of high-tempo music on participants’ pace.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
数年前，一项研究发现：在划船机上边听Little Richard的《Long Tall Sally》（189 bpm快节奏歌曲）边运动的参与者，比听Vanessa Williams《Colors of the Wind》（83 bpm）的参与者表现出更快的节奏和更高的心率。在近期复制该研究结果的实验中，研究人员让两组与早期研究类似的参与者在爬楼梯30分钟时听相同的歌曲。新研究中两组的平均步速和心率相近，因此研究人员推测：________
中文解析：
新研究在爬楼梯情境中未能复现快节奏音乐对运动表现的提升效果，说明原始研究发现的效应可能依赖于特定运动类型（划船）。选项B指出“早前研究中快节奏音乐的效果可能仅适用于划船”，这与新旧实验情境差异（划船vs爬楼梯）导致的相反结果形成逻辑闭环，最合理地解释了研究者的推论方向。

question:
At a conference for aspiring children’s book illustrators, Wil Clay, illustrator of such lauded works as Little Eight John, was the subject of a presentation that was intended specifically to foster __________ the techniques of successful illustrators so that attendees could use that understanding to improve their own work.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在一场面向儿童书籍插画师新秀的会议上，以《小八约翰》等作品闻名的插画师威尔·克莱成为专题演讲的主题。该演讲旨在专门培养对成功插画师技巧的__________，以便与会者能运用这种理解来提升自身创作。
中文解析：
原文明确指出演讲目的是让与会者“理解并提升自身创作”，这需要深入理解成功插画师的技巧。选项B“洞察”精准体现了“通过分析获得深刻认知”的过程，且与“运用理解”形成逻辑闭环。其他选项均与“学习借鉴”的积极目的相矛盾。

question:
The Wonderful Wizard of Oz is a 1900 novel by L. Frank Baum. In the novel, the narrator describes Dorothy’s dog, Toto, as causing Dorothy to feel cheerful:________

Which quotation from The Wonderful Wizard of Oz most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “Uncle Henry was milking the cows in the barnyard, and Toto had jumped out of [Dorothy’s] arms and was running toward the barn, barking furiously.”
B. “Dorothy stood in the door with Toto in her arms, and looked at the sky too.”
C. “Toto was not gray; he was a little black dog, with long silky hair and small black eyes that twinkled merrily on either side of his funny, wee nose.”
D. “It was Toto that made Dorothy laugh, and saved her from growing as gray as her other surroundings.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《绿野仙踪》是L.弗兰克·鲍姆于1900年创作的小说。在小说中，叙述者描述女主角 Dorothy 的小狗托托让她感到快乐：________
下列哪段《绿野仙踪》的引文最能有效证明这一说法？
中文解析：
选项D直接描述“正是托托让Dorothy发笑，使她免于变得像周围环境一样灰暗”，这明确体现了托托给Dorothy带来快乐情绪的作用。其他选项仅描述托托的动作或外貌，并未直接展现其对Dorothy情绪的积极影响。该选项与题干中“让Dorothy感到快乐”的表述形成直接印证。

question:
Often, the Nobel Prize in Chemistry is given to a single person, such as Robert Burns Woodward in 1965. But scientific breakthroughs are rarely the work of lone geniuses. Instead, success in fields like chemistry has often been achieved through __________other experts, as was the case for Ben Feringa, who was among those awarded for “the design and synthesis of molecular machines.”

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
诺贝尔化学奖通常只授予单人，例如1965年的罗伯特·伯恩斯·伍德沃德。但科学突破很少是孤独天才的成果。相反，在化学等领域，成功往往是通过__________其他专家实现的，正如本·费林加的经历——他因“分子机器的设计与合成”与其他学者共同获奖。
中文解析：
原文通过费林加“共同获奖”的案例强调科学成果多源于团队协作，且前文明确否定“孤独天才”模式。选项B“合作”既能对应“与其他专家”的互动关系，又符合“突破需集体智慧”的核心逻辑，而竞争、隔绝或遵从均与语境相悖。

question:
In rainforests in Costa Rica, there are large bully trees. Dead leaves and other falling things collect in the trees’ branches and break down into mats of soil. This is called canopy soil because it forms in a tree’s branches (its canopy). Scientist Jessica Murray’s 2023 study of canopy soil found that it helps preserve a healthy water cycle (how water moves through the environment) in forests.

According to the text, Murray’s study is from what year?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在哥斯达黎加的热带雨林中，生长着高大的霸凌树。枯叶和其他坠落物会堆积在树枝上，并分解成土壤层。这被称为冠层土壤，因为它形成于树木的枝干（即树冠）中。科学家杰西卡·默里2023年对冠层土壤的研究发现，它有助于维持森林中健康的水循环（即水在环境中的流动方式）。
中文解析：
文本中明确写道“Scientist Jessica Murray’s 2023 study of canopy soil...”，直接指出研究年份为2023年。此题属于细节定位题，无需推理即可从原文找到对应信息。其他选项的年份在文中均未出现。

question:
Wenheng Zhang and colleagues have explored how convergent evolution — a phenomenon that occurs when the same trait evolves independently in two reproductively separate lineages — can result from a genetic mechanism shared by both lineages. Meanwhile, Michael D. Shapiro and colleagues have investigated how convergence occurs through different genetic mechanisms, but the relative prevalence of convergence through shared and different genetic processes is still poorly understood. This motivated biologists Delbert A. Green II and Cassandra G. Extavour to evaluate both types of convergence in a single study for their 2012 paper.

Which choice best states the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It clarifies a concept that the author implies was unclear in the studies mentioned in the text.
B. It provides examples of how a phenomenon was studied by scientists in the field before Green and Extavour’s study.
C. It introduces a method of scientific analysis that is discussed in greater detail later in the text.
D. It gives a basic description of a phenomenon that is central to the discussion that follows.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
张文科和同事们探索了趋同进化——当同一特征在两个生殖隔离的谱系中独立演化时出现的现象——如何可能由两个谱系共享的遗传机制导致。与此同时，迈克尔·D·夏皮罗和同事们研究了趋同如何通过不同的遗传机制发生，但通过共享和不同遗传过程实现趋同的相对普遍性，人们仍然知之甚少。这促使生物学家德尔伯特·A·格林二世和卡桑德拉·G·埃克斯塔沃尔在他们2012年的论文中，于一项单一研究内对这两种趋同类型进行了评估。
中文解析：
划线部分是对“趋同进化”这一核心概念的定义说明。该定义位于文章开头，旨在为后续讨论张文科、夏皮罗以及格林等人的研究奠定基础，确保读者理解这一关键术语。其功能并非提供例子、引入分析方法或澄清模糊概念，而是直接描述后续讨论所围绕的核心现象。

question:
The 2005 production of Souvenir was the first Broadway show for which Tracy Christensen was credited as a costume designer. Christensen was among the Broadway costume designers interviewed by Sara Jablon-Roberts and Eulanda A. Sanders for their study of historical accuracy in costume design for shows with a historical setting. They found that even designers who value historical accuracy will often include contemporary design elements that don’t fit with the historical period. In a research paper about theatrical costume design, a student argues that costume designers for modern productions of plays such as Shakespeare’s A Midsummer Night’s Dream (set in ancient Greece) sometimes include such elements unintentionally.

Which quotation from an interview with a costume designer would most effectively support the student’s claim?
selections: A. “ I tend to pay careful attention to the accessories, like gloves, hats, and jewelry, in my work.”
B. “Costumes must always reflect the appropriate historical period.”
C. “Total historical accuracy in costume design isn’t achievable because our habits and tastes as designers will always be influenced by modern styles.”
D. “A truly historically accurate costume will sometimes make the character look comically strange to a modern audience.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
2005年上演的《纪念品》是特雷西·克里斯滕森首次在百老汇被列为服装设计师的作品。克里斯滕森是萨拉·贾布隆-罗伯茨和尤兰达·A·桑德斯为研究历史题材戏剧服装设计的历史准确性而采访的百老汇服装设计师之一。他们发现，即使是重视历史准确性的设计师，也常常会加入一些与历史时期不符的当代设计元素。在一篇关于戏剧服装设计的研究论文中，一名学生提出，对于现代制作的戏剧（例如设定在古希腊的莎士比亚戏剧《仲夏夜之梦》），服装设计师有时会无意中加入此类元素。
中文解析：
该学生的论点是“设计师有时会无意中加入不符合历史背景的现代元素”。选项C中设计师承认“我们的习惯和品味总会受到现代风格影响”，这直接证明了无意识引入现代元素的可能性，与“无意中”这一关键点高度契合。其他选项或强调主观努力（B）、或关注客观效果（D）、或未涉及无意性（A），均无法有效支持该主张。

question:
Like all species of baleen whales, the sei whale feeds on tiny creatures known as krill by filtering water through bristlelike keratin structures called baleen plates. In this way, baleen whales can eat up to 30 percent of their total mass per day. And while no one would call the sei whale small — it can have a mass as high as 25,000 kg — it is one of the smaller baleen whales and is much smaller than the bowhead whale, which can weigh a whopping 66,000 kg and consume as much as 19,800 kg of krill per day.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It downplays the significance of the size difference between the sei whale and the bowhead whale.
B. It emphasizes the quantity of krill needed to support both the sei whale and the bowhead whale.
C. It draws a distinction between the overall size of the sei whale and the relatively small quantity of krill it can consume per day.
D. It illustrates the size of the sei whale and establishes a point of contrast with the size of the bowhead whale.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
与所有须鲸类物种一样，塞鲸通过被称为鲸须板的鬃毛状角蛋白结构过滤海水，以捕食名为磷虾的微小生物。通过这种方式，须鲸每天可进食多达自身总重30%的食物。尽管无人会称塞鲸体型小——其质量可达25,000公斤——但它属于体型较小的须鲸之一，且远小于弓头鲸；后者重量可达惊人的66,000公斤，每天最多能消耗19,800公斤磷虾。
中文解析：
划线句子通过“虽无人称其小…但属较小须鲸”的转折结构，先确立塞鲸的客观体型，再引出与弓头鲸的对比关系。该描述既客观呈现塞鲸的体型参数，又通过“远小于”明确构建与更大物种的参照系，为下文具体数据对比奠定逻辑基础。选项D准确捕捉到“确立特征+构建对比”的双重功能。

question:
Male orangutans typically disperse from the territory in which they were born when they reach maturity, whereas females typically do not. Beatrice Ehmann and her colleagues hypothesized that this difference in life trajectory should be reflected in the diets of immature orangutans: males should share fewer of their mothers’ dietary preferences than females do since those preferences tend to be particular to the food resources available in the local area and may be of relatively low utility beyond it. The researchers calculated the percent of mother orangutans’ diets shared with their offspring’s diets and the percent of immature oranautans’ diets not shared with their monthers’ diets.

Which choice best describes data from the graph that support Ehmann and colleagues’ hypothesis?
selections: A. The majority of the diet of the mother of individual 6 was shared with the diet of individual 6, whereas significantly less than half the diet of the mother of individual 11 was shared with the diet of individual 11.

B. The percent of individual 6’s mother’s diet that was shared with individual 6’s diet ranged from approximately 51% to approximately 72%, whereas the percent of individual 11’s mother’s diet that was shared with individual 11’s diet ranged from approximately 14% to approximately 18%.

C. Neither individual 11 nor individual 6 had a diet that consisted mostly of food not shared with the individual’s mother’s diet, whereas more than half of both individuals’ mothers’ diets were shared with their offspring’s diets.

D. The percent of the mother’s diet shared with its offspring’s diet was smaller for individual 11 than for individual 6, and the percent of the individual’s diet not shared with its mother’s diet was greater for individual 11 than for individual 6.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
雄性猩猩成熟后通常会离开出生地，而雌性通常不会。比阿特丽斯·埃曼及其同事提出假设：这种生命轨迹的差异应反映在未成年猩猩的饮食上——由于母亲的饮食偏好通常与当地食物资源相关，在异地效用较低，因此雄性幼崽与母亲共享的饮食偏好应少于雌性。研究人员计算了母亲饮食与幼崽饮食的重合比例，以及幼崽饮食中与母亲不重合的比例。
中文解析：
假设的核心是雄性幼崽（如11号）与母亲饮食重合度应低于雌性（如6号），且独立饮食比例更高。选项D直接对比了两组数据：11号与母亲饮食重合比例更低，而其独立饮食比例更高，这完全符合“雄性为扩散做准备而减少对本地特定食物依赖”的预期。其他选项仅描述单一维度或局部数据，未能同时验证重合度与独立度的双向差异。

question:
The advent of online streaming has led many music listeners to drift away from ownership of music (through downloads or through physical media such as compact discs) and toward the streaming services Bandcamp and Tidal, among others. Datta et al. studied the impact of this change on the variety of music that listeners consume, The researchers reasoned that the ownership model of music assigns a cost per song to acquiring a variety of music, while streaming services typically charge a flat fee for access to an entire music catalog, making variety free, which suggests that____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. listeners who use streaming services would be more likely to give physical copies of music as gifts to others than to purchase physical copies for themselves.
B. listeners who prefer to purchase compact discs rather than use a service such as Bandcamp or Tidal would tend to listen to older music.
C. the music choices of listeners who use streaming services would likely be more varied than those of listeners who do not use streaming services.
D. music publishers who choose to forgo releasing music on physical media are likely to see no change in revenue.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在线流媒体的出现使许多音乐听众逐渐从拥有音乐（通过下载或CD等实体媒介）转向使用Bandcamp和Tidal等流媒体服务。Datta等人研究了这一变化对听众音乐消费多样性的影响。研究人员的推论是：音乐所有权模式使得获取多样音乐需按单曲付费，而流媒体服务通常以统一费用提供整个音乐库，使多样性获取变得免费，这表明________
中文解析：
文本核心逻辑为“流媒体统一收费模式降低了探索多样音乐的成本”。根据经济学原理，价格壁垒消除将直接促进消费多样性，故可合理推断流媒体用户会比非流媒体用户接触更广泛的音乐类型。选项C准确承接了“成本下降→多样性增加”的因果链，其他选项均未涉及音乐多样性这一核心比较维度。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
•Catharsis, Conversion, Traumata is a 1986 sculpture by American artist Joseph Kosuth.
•It is crafted from blue neon lighting that spells out the title phrase (“catharsis, conversion, traumata”).
•Harvest Moon is a 2013 sculpture by British/ Pakistani artist Shezad Dawood.
•It is crafted from yellow neon lighting that forms an abstract moon shape.

The student wants to describe Kosuth’s sculpture. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Joseph Kosuth and Shezad Dawood are artists who have used neon in their sculptures.
B. Joseph Kosuth created his sculpture in 1986, and Shezad Dawood’s was made in 2013.
C. Joseph Kosuth’s sculpture Catharsis, Conversion, Traumata is crafted from blue neon that spells outthe title phrase (“catharsis, conversion, traumata”).
D. Harvest Moon is a neon sculpture by Shezad Dawood, and it contains an an abstract moon shape in yellow neon lighting.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一位学生在研究某个主题时记录了以下信息：
- 《Catharsis, Conversion, Traumata》是美国艺术家约瑟夫·科苏斯于1986年创作的雕塑。
- 它由蓝色霓虹灯制成，拼写出标题短语（“catharsis, conversion, traumata”）。
- 《Harvest Moon》是英国/巴基斯坦艺术家谢扎德·达伍德于2013年创作的雕塑。
- 它由黄色霓虹灯制成，形成一个抽象的月亮形状。
该学生想要描述科苏斯的雕塑。下列哪个选项最有效地运用了笔记中的相关信息来实现这一目标？
中文解析：
题目明确要求描述科苏斯的雕塑，选项C完整提取了该作品的创作年份、材质、形式及标题内容，全部信息均来自笔记前两条。其他选项均存在偏差：A和B混杂了两位艺术家的无关信息，D则完全在描述另一位艺术家的作品，均未聚焦于科苏斯的雕塑本身。

question:
Many puppeteers specialize in a specific type of puppetry. Indian puppeteer Dadi Pudumjee,________ is a specialist in marionette puppetry, while Tamao Yoshida, a Japanese puppeteer, is a bunraku puppetry specialist.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:

许多木偶师专攻特定类型的木偶戏。印度木偶师达迪·普杜姆吉，________是提线木偶戏专家，而日本木偶师吉田玉男则是文乐木偶戏专家。
中文解析：

question:
Ecologists, such as Petra H. Lenz, use trophic pyramids to illustrate the food chain within a given ecosystem. At a typical pyramid’s base are primary producers, like phytoplankton, followed by herbivores at the second trophic level, then omnivores and carnivores at the third. ________ at the fourth, highest trophic level are apex predators, like polar bears, that feed on the animals below.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
生态学家（如Petra H. Lenz）使用营养金字塔来展示特定生态系统中的食物链。金字塔底层通常是初级生产者（如浮游植物），第二层是食草动物，第三层是杂食动物和食肉动物。________在第四层（最高营养级）是顶级捕食者（如北极熊），它们以较低层动物为食。
中文解析：
原文按营养级从低到高依次描述金字塔结构，第四层是序列的最终环节。选项C“Finally”准确体现叙述顺序的终结，起到自然收束逻辑序列的作用。其他选项均不符合层级递进的语境：“For example”用于举例，“In fact”表示强调，“Besides”表示补充信息。

question:
•The Malawi Congress of Trade Unions (MCTU) is a national union federation for the African nation of Malawi.
•It helps improve conditions for workers in that nation.
•ITUC-Africa is a regional union federation that represents national union federations across Africa.
•It represents the MCTU.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to explain the relationship between ITUC-Africa and the MCTU?
selections: A. National union federations, such as the MCTU, work to improve conditions for workers in their member nations.
B. ITUC-Africa represents many national union federations, including the MCTU.
C. ITUC-Africa is a regional union federation.
D. The MCTU is a national union federation.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
- 马拉维工会大会（MCTU）是非洲国家马拉维的全国性工会联合会。
- 它致力于改善该国工人的工作条件。
- 非洲工会联合会（ITUC-Africa）是一个区域性工会联合会，代表整个非洲的各国全国性工会联合会。
- 它代表MCTU。
中文解析：
题目要求明确解释两个组织间的直接关系。选项B整合了“ITUC-Africa代表各国全国性工会联合会”和“它代表MCTU”这两个关键信息，清晰说明了从属关系。其他选项仅描述单个组织的属性或职能，未直接阐明两者之间的代表与被代表关系。

question:
•India Arie is an African American singer and songwriter.
•The media outlet All Music has described her music as having “glistening acoustic guitar, churchy organ, and smooth, supple beats.”
•Her first studio album, Acoustic Soul, was released in 2001.
•It features the song “Always in My Head.”
•David Spak played percussion on the album.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to specify David Spak’s contribution to India Arie’s music?
selections: A. David Spak played percussion on India Arie’s 2001 album Acoustic Soul.
B. Acoustic Soul, India Arie’s first studio album, features David Spak.
C. Featuring the song “Always in My Head,” Acoustic Soul is India Arie’s first studio album.
D. India Arie is an African American singer and songwriter whose music has been described as having “glistening acoustic guitar, churchy organ, and smooth, supple beats.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
- 印度·艾瑞是一位非裔美国歌手兼词曲创作人。
- 媒体机构All Music将她的音乐描述为“有闪亮的原声吉他、教堂风琴和平滑柔和的节拍”。
- 她的首张录音室专辑《Acoustic Soul》于2001年发行。
- 专辑中包含歌曲《Always in My Head》。
- 大卫·斯帕克在该专辑中负责打击乐演奏。
中文解析：
题目要求明确说明大卫·斯帕克的具体贡献。选项A直接点明其“在指定专辑中演奏打击乐”的角色及作品信息，精准对应笔记内容。其他选项均未完整表述“人物-作品-具体贡献”的要素：B未说明参与形式，C未提及大卫·斯帕克，D则完全未涉及相关人物。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
•Pedestrian malls are outdoor streets in a city or town where vehicle traffic is prohibited.
•Many pedestrian malls were built in the 19th and 20th centuries in Europe and Asia.
•Qianmen Dajie is a famous pedestrian mall in Beijing. It has existed since the Ming dynasty (1368-1644 CE).
•Rue Mouffetard is a famous pedestrian mall in Paris. It has existed since the mid-Roman Empire (117-235 CE).

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the ages of the malls. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Qianmen Dajie and Rue Mouffetard are pedestrian malls, outdoor streets closed to vehicle traffic.
B. Both Qianmen Dajie and Rue Mouffetard are famous pedestrian malls, the former in Beijing and the latter in Paris.
C. The Qianmen Dajie pedestrian mall has roots as far back as the Ming dynasty; likewise, Rue Mouffetard has existed for centuries.
D. Qianmen Dajie and Rue Mouffetard are examples of pedestrian malls, which proliferated in Europe in the 19th and 20th centuries.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
- 步行街是城镇中禁止机动车通行的户外街道。
- 许多步行街建于19至20世纪的欧洲和亚洲。
- 前门大街是北京著名步行街，其历史可追溯至明朝（1368–1644年）。
- 穆夫塔街是巴黎著名步行街，其历史可追溯至罗马帝国中期（117–235年）。
中文解析：
题目要求强调两条步行街在“历史久远”方面的相似性。选项C通过“has roots as far back as...; likewise...”的并列结构，明确对比了两者均拥有数百年历史的共同特征，直接实现了强调“年代相似性”的目标。其他选项中：A、B仅陈述基本属性或地理位置，D则错误地将两条古街归类为19-20世纪建设的案例，均未突出“古老”这一核心相似点。

question:
For certain air temperatures, the table gives wind chill temperatures for two different wind speeds.
According to the table, what is the wind chill temperature, in degrees Fahrenheit <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo>∘</mo></mrow></msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></mrow><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow></math> , when the air temperature is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>27</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo>∘</mo></mrow></msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></mrow></math> and the wind speed is 20 miles per hour(mph)? (Disregard the degree symbol when entering your answer.)

Trapezoid <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi><mi>D</mi><mi>E</mi><mi>F</mi></math> is similar to trapezoid <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>J</mi><mi>K</mi><mi>L</mi><mi>M</mi></math>, such that <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>D</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>E</mi><mtext>, and</mtext><mi>F</mi></math> correspond to <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>J</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>K</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>L</mi><mo>,</mo><mtext>and</mtext><mi>M</mi></math>, respectively. The length of each side of trapezoid <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>J</mi><mi>K</mi><mi>L</mi><mi>M</mi></math> is 4 times the length of its corresponding side in trapezoid <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi><mi>D</mi><mi>E</mi><mi>F</mi></math>. The measure of angle <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C </mi><mtext>is</mtext><msup><mn> 42</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo>∘</mo></mrow></msup></math>. question: In the ancient Roman measurement system, a leuga was a unit of length that was equal to 7,500 pedes. In this measurement system, how many pedes were equivalent to 3.8 leugas?
explanations: 1 leuga= 7500 pedes，那3.8 leuga= 3.8*7500 pedes=28500 pedes。

question: For the linear function <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi></math>, the table shows three values of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> and their corresponding values of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. Function <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi></math> is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>r</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>s</mi></math>, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>r</mi></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>s</mi></math> are constants. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>r</mi><mi>s</mi></math>?

question: A computer program models the total mass of the population of a certain type of algae after the algae was placed in an environment where it has no natural predators. According to the model, the estimated total mass of this population of algae at the end of every 6 －hour period is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>129</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> greater than the estimated total mass of this population of algae at the end of the previous 6 －hour period, and the estimated total mass of this population of algae is 613.90 grams after 18 hours. Which equation best represents this model, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>A</mi></math> is the estimated total mass, in grams, of the population of algae after <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi></math> hours, and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo><</mo> <mn>50</mn></math>?
explanations: 考查的指数函数。首先增长比例是129%，那我们的base应该是1+129%=2.29。如果设initial value是m，那对应的表达式就是 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>A</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>m</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2.29</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <mn>6</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> </mrow> </msup></math>，即答案应该是B或者C。现在已知A（18）=613，将该数据代入B或者C检验即可得到答案是C。

question: One gallon of paint will cover 70 square feet of a surface. A room has a total wall area of w square feet. Which equation represents the total amount of paint P, in gallons, needed to paint the walls of the room twice？
explanations: 1 gallon对应70 feet2，P gallon对应2w feet2，可以得到等式1/70=P/(2w)，计算可得D为答案。

question: Hannah and Wyatt are saving money to purchase a car. Hannah saves <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>1</mn> <mn>5</mn> </mfrac></math> of her salary each month, and Wyatt saves <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>2</mn> <mn>7</mn> </mfrac></math> of his salary each month. Together, they save a total of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi mathvariant="normal">$</mi> <mn>3</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>270</mn></math> from their monthly salaries each month. If h and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>w</mi></math> represent Hannah’s and Wyatt’s monthly salaries, in dollars, respectively, which equation shows the relationship between <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>h</mi></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>w</mi></math>?
explanations: 根据题意可得（1/5）h+（2/7）w=3270，等号左右两边乘以分母的最小公倍数35可得D为正确答案。

question: The table shows the volume of two similar solids, right circular cylinder A and right circular cylinder B. The radius of right circular cylinder A is 7 units. The surface area of right circular cylinder A is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>k</mi><mi>π</mi></math> square units, and the surface area of right circular cylinder B is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>n</mi><mi>π</mi></math> square units, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>k</mi></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>n</mi></math> are constants. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>k</mi></math>? (The surface area of a right circular cylinder with radius <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>r</mi></math> and height <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>h</mi></math> is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>h</mi></math>.)
explanations:
如果两个相似图形的边长之比为1:a，那周长之比为1:a，面积之比为1：<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math>，体积之比为1： <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>a</mi><mn>3</mn></msup></math>。题目中A与B的体积之比为392:10584=1:27，故a=3。
A的体积为392π，半径为7，根据V=π* <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> *h可得h=8。代入2π* <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> +2πrh可得A的表面积为210π。故k=210。
根据面积之比为1： <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math>可得B的表面积为210π*9=1890π。故n=1890。
n-k=1680。故答案为1680。

If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>z</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>87</mn><mtext> and </mtext><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>z</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>15</mn></math>, what is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>z</mi></math>?

In triangle RST, angle T is a right angle, point L lies on <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>R</mi><mi>S</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math>, point K lies on <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>S</mi><mi>T</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math>, and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>L</mi><mi>K</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math> is parallel to <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>R</mi><mi>T</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math>. If the length of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>R</mi><mi>T</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math> is 63 units, the length of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>L</mi><mi>K</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math> is 21 units, and the area of triangle RST is 252 square units, what is the length of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>K</mi><mi>T</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">―</mo></mover></math>, in units?
explanations:
根据三角形的面积公式可得252=（1/2）*63*ST，故ST=8。
因为LK平行于RT，所以三角形LSK相似于三角形RST。相似三角形对应的边成比例，所以LK/RT=SK/ST，即21/63=SK/8，计算可得SK=8/3。
KT=ST-SK=8-8/3=16/3。故答案为16/3。

question: A researcher investigated two species of mites: a predator and its prey. At the start of a week, there was an equal number of the two species. At the end of the week, the number of prey had increased by 1,900% of the number of prey at the start of the week, and the number of predators had increased by 150% of the number of predators at the start of the week. The number of prey at the end of the week was <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>p</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> greater than the number of predators at the end of the week. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>p</mi></math>?
explanations:
设最初prey和predator的数量均为m，那这周结束时，prey的数量为m（1+1900%）=20m，predator的数量为m（1+150%）=2.5m。
根据prey=predator（1+p%）可得20m=2.5m（1+p%），计算可得p=700，故答案为700。

question: A quadratic function C models the coefficient of lift of a flying disc, where x is the angle of incidence, in degrees, and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>30</mn> <mo>≤</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>≤</mo> <mn>45</mn></math>. question: The expression <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mroot> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi> </mrow> <mn>5</mn> </msup> <mn>7</mn> </mroot> <msqrt> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi> </mrow> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi> </mrow> <mo>+</mo> <mn>3</mn> </mrow> </msup> </msqrt> </mfrac></math>, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>t</mi></math> is a constant, is equivalent to <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mroot> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mn>7</mn> </mroot></math> for all positive values of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>p</mi></math>. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>t</mi></math>?
explanations:
考查指数函数的性质。<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mroot> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi> </mrow> <mn>5</mn> </msup> <mn>7</mn> </mroot> <msqrt> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi> </mrow> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi> </mrow> <mo>+</mo> <mn>3</mn> </mrow> </msup> </msqrt> </mfrac></math>可整理为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>p</mi> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <mn>7</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> </mrow> </msup></math>， <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mroot> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mn>7</mn> </mroot></math>可整理为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi> </mrow> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <mn>7</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> </mrow> </msup></math>。
因为这两个式子相等，所以5/7-(t+3)/2=2/7，求解可得A。

question: All the sidewalk paving stones in a neighborhood are rectangular. The length of each of these paving stones is 41 centimeters greater than the width. Which equation gives the area A, in square centimeters, of a sidewalk paving stone in terms of the width w, in centimeters, of that paving stone?
selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi> </mrow> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">w</mi> </mrow> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mfrac> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">w</mi> </mrow> <mn>41</mn> </mfrac> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow></math>

B. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi> </mrow> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">w</mi> </mrow> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>41</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">w</mi> </mrow> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>

C. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>A</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>w</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>w</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>41</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>

D. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi> </mrow> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">w</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>
explanations: 长方形的面积=长*宽=（w+41）（w），故选C。

question: Rectangles S and R are similar. The ratio of each side length of rectangle S to the corresponding side length of rectangle R is 25 to 49. The ratio of the area of rectangle S to the area of rectangle R is 625 to r. What is the value of r?
explanations: 考查的相似图形。相似图形的边长之比是25/49，面积之比就是<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mn>25</mn> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <msup> <mn>49</mn> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>，也就是625/2401。故r=2401。

question: What is the x-intercept of the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>4</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>24</mn></math> in the xy-plane?
explanations: x-intercept 对应y=0，把y=0代入函数式，可得x=6。故选A。

question:

question: A rectangle has a perimeter of 36 inches. If the sum of the lengths of three sides of the rectangle is 21 inches, what is the length, in inches, of the fourth side?
explanations: 周长减去三边之和等于第四条边的长度，即36-21=15。故选C。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>15</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>175</mn></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><msqrt><mn>11</mn></msqrt></math>
What are all possible solutions to the given equation?
explanations:
等号左右两边平方，整理可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>35</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，因式分解得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，因此可得x=-5或者x=7/2。
因为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>15</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>175</mn></msqrt></math>大于等于0，所以大于等于0，故而x应该大于等于0。
所以符合条件的解只有一个x=7/2，故选B。

question: A certain investment account offers a special interest rate for the first 4 months the account is open followed by a lower interest rate for the remainder of the time the account is open. Bennett opened one of these accounts with an original account balance of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi mathvariant="normal">$</mi> <mn>900</mn></math> and did not make any other deposits or withdrawals. 4 months after Bennett opened the account, the balance had increased by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>0.6</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> of the original balance. 6 months after Bennett opened the account, the balance had increased by an additional <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>0.3</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> of the balance at the end of the first 4 months. Every 2 months after the first 6 months, the balance had increased by an additional <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>0.3</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> of the balance 2 months before. Which of the following equations could represent the account balance <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>B</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, in dollars, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi></math> months after the account was opened, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>≥</mo> <mn>4</mn></math>?
selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>B</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>905.40</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1.003</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mfrac> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mn>4</mn> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> </mrow> </msup></math>

B. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>B</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>905.40</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1.003</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> </mrow> </msup></math>

C. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>B</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>905.40</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1.003</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>4</mn> </mrow> </msup></math>

D. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>B</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>905.40</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1.003</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mfrac> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> <mo>−</mo> <mn>4</mn> </mrow> </msup></math>
explanations:
最初存入900美元,4个月后增长了0.6%，那金额是905.4美元。
后续每两个月增长0.3%，那每两个月就是上一次金额的1+0.3%=1.003倍。
前4个月的增长计算过了，还剩（x-4）个月，每两个月增长0.3%，那指数应该是（x-4）/2。
综上A是正确选项。

question: At the beginning of an experiment, the temperature of a liquid is 23 degrees Celsius (℃). During the first 4.0 minutes of the experiment, the temperature of the liquid increases at an average rate of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mn>7.5</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>∘</mo> </mrow> </msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi> </mrow></math> per minute. Then, the temperature of the liquid increases at a constant rate of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mn>2.6</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>∘</mo> </mrow> </msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi> </mrow></math> per minute. If the temperature of the liquid reaches 61℃ <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi></math> minutes after the beginning of the experiment, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>></mo> <mn>4.0</mn></math>, which equation represents this situation?
explanations: 最初温度23度，4分钟后温度是23+7.5*4=53度。在剩余的（x-4）分钟之间内，每分钟增长2.6度，故选D。

question: Quadrilateral MNOP is similar to quadrilateral QRST such that M, N, O, and P correspond to Q, R, S, and T, respectively.
