question: A certain investment account offers a special interest rate for the first 4 months the account is open followed by a lower interest rate for the remainder of the time the account is open. Bennett opened one of these accounts with an original account balance of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">$</mi><mn>900</mn></math> and did not make any other deposits or withdrawals. 4 months after Bennett opened the account, the balance had increased by  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0.6</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> of the original balance. 6 months after Bennett opened the account, the balance had increased by an additional  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0.1</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math>  of the balance at the end of the first 4 months. Every 2 months after the first 6 months, the balance had increased by an additional  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0.1</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> of the balance 2 months before. Which of the following equations could represent the account balance  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>B</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>in dollars,  x months after the account was opened, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>4</mn></math>？
explanations:
最初存入900美元,4个月后增长了 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0.6</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math>，那金额是905.4美元。
后续每两个月增长<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0.1</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math>，那每两个月就是上一次金额的<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>0.1</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1.001</mn><mtext>倍。</mtext></math>前4个月的增长计算过了，还剩（x-4）个月，每两个月增长0.1%，那指数应该是（x-4）/2。
综上B是正确选项。
exam_name: 2025年9月第5套数学去重版（M1全+M2部分题）

question:
The following text is from Louise Erdrich’s 1986 novel The Beet Queen.Celestine takes her infant daughter with her to the butcher shop where she makes sausages.
Sometimes Celestine turned around and met the direct gaze of her daughter, a look so penetrating that Celestine’s breath caught. She dropped the spice, the string, the knife she was using, and took the girl up in her arms, ready for her to speak as if a spell had suddenly lifted.
When the baby flexed her entire body and struggled to free herself, Celestine put her down. No matter how thorough Celestine’s exhaustion, no matter how little sleep she’d had, there was a nerve of excitement running through each hour.
©1986 by Louise Erdrich

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To show that Celestine enjoys imagining her daughter’s future life
B. To explain how Celestine’s coworkers bond with her daughter
C. To portray Celestine’s excitement about her daughter
D. To imply that Celestine is dissatisfied with her job
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
选自路易丝·厄德里克1986年小说《甜菜女王》：
塞莱斯汀带着她襁褓中的女儿去她工作的香肠肉铺。有时塞莱斯汀转过身，会迎上女儿直视的目光，那眼神如此锐利，让她不禁屏住呼吸。她扔下香料、绳子和手中的刀，把女孩抱进怀里，期待她开口说话，仿佛某种魔咒突然被解除。当婴儿全身扭动挣扎着要自由时，塞莱斯汀便放下她。无论塞莱斯汀多么精疲力尽，无论她睡眠多么不足，每一刻都有一丝兴奋的情绪贯穿其中。
©1986 by Louise Erdrich
中文解析：
文本通过细节（如“屏住呼吸”“扔下工具抱起女儿”“期待她说话”“每一刻都有兴奋情绪”）集中描写塞莱斯汀对女儿强烈的情感反应和期待，而非想象未来（A）、同事互动（B）或工作不满（D）。关键词“a nerve of excitement running through each hour”直接指向C选项的核心。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
Cacao was domesticated in South America. Its physical structure is no longer identical to the structure of the wild plant it is descended from. Maize (corn) also ______its wild ancestor. That ancestor plant had a few small kernels. Indigenous people in Mexico carefully bred the crop until it had numerous fleshy kernels.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
可可树在南美洲被驯化。其物理结构不再与其野生祖先植物的结构完全相同。玉米（maize）也______其野生祖先。该祖先植物只有少量小型谷粒。墨西哥的土著人民精心培育这种作物，直到它长出大量饱满的谷粒。
中文解析：
文本通过可可树的例子说明驯化作物与野生祖先存在差异（物理结构不再完全相同），接着用玉米类比这一现象。后文进一步解释玉米野生祖先仅有少量小谷粒，但经过人工培育后变得果实饱满，强调玉米与祖先的“不同”。因此空格需填入表示“与...不同”的词组。对应A.
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
In 1940, John H. Sengstacke founded the National Newspaper Publishers Association to support Black-owned papers. Sengstacke’s accomplishment is just one example of the rich history of Black journalism in the United States. That history is preserved by the National Association of Black Journalists, which was founded in Washington, DC, in 1975 to support Black media professionals and honor people like Sengstacke.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It introduces the history of an organization honoring Black journalists, then suggests how that organization might recruit more members.
B. It summarizes a theory about journalism, then explains how a journalistic practice has changed over time.
C. It describes the career of a well-known figure in Black journalism, then compares that career to one of a figure who is lesser known.
D. It mentions a specific achievement in Black journalistic history, then describes an organization dedicated to upholding that history.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
1940年，约翰·H·森斯塔克创立了全国报纸出版商协会，以支持黑人拥有的报纸。森斯塔克的成就只是美国黑人新闻业丰富历史的其中一个例子。这段历史由全国黑人记者协会保存，该协会于1975年在华盛顿特区成立，旨在支持黑人媒体专业人士，并表彰像森斯塔克这样的人。
中文解析：
文本首先以森斯塔克创立全国报纸出版商协会的具体成就为例，引出黑人新闻业的丰富历史（第一句和第二句），接着转向全国黑人记者协会的成立及其使命（保存历史、支持专业人士、表彰先驱），整体结构为“从具体案例过渡到维护历史的组织”。D选项准确对应“先提成就（森斯塔克），后介绍组织（全国黑人记者协会）及其维护历史的使命”。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
Vehicle transmissions and many other widely used mechanical systems have moving parts that rub or slide against one another, creating friction. This friction increases energy consumption and causes wear, which decreases the stability and life span of the system. Using carbon nanotubes and oil, Jun Qu and colleagues at a US Department of Energy lab have created a coating for moving parts that reduces friction to the point where it is almost nonexistent. The new coating is suitable for common applications, unlike other approaches that require special conditions.

What does the text most strongly suggest about the coating created by Qu and colleagues?
selections: A. It is unlikely to reduce wear in mechanical systems that have multiple moving parts.
B. It is unlikely to be widely used because it can be applied only under special conditions.
C. It can likely be used to reduce energy consumption and wear in vehicle transmissions and other common mechanical systems.
D. It can likely improve the energy consumption of certain mechanical systems but not of vehicle transmissions.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
车辆变速箱和许多其他广泛使用的机械系统具有相互摩擦或滑动的运动部件，从而产生摩擦力。这种摩擦会增加能量消耗并导致磨损，从而降低系统的稳定性和使用寿命。美国能源部实验室的Jun Qu及其同事利用碳纳米管和油，为运动部件创建了一种涂层，可将摩擦减少到几乎不存在的程度。与其他需要特殊条件的方法不同，这种新涂层适用于常见应用。
中文解析：
文本明确提到：摩擦会增加能量消耗和磨损（普遍问题）；Qu团队创建的涂层能几乎消除摩擦（直接解决该问题）；该涂层“适用于常见应用”（common applications），且“与其他需要特殊条件的方法不同”（unlike other approaches that require special conditions），暗示其具有普适性和实用性。所以对应C
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
Probabilistic models generate predictions based on outcomes of analogous past events, but even as these models project likely outcomes, they implicitly acknowledge that lower-frequency events may occur instead. Because they accommodate multiple potential outcomes, such models may seem incompatible with causal determinism—the view that particular outcomes are inevitable given certain preconditions. But complete foreknowledge of relevant conditions is generally unavailable, suggesting that a state of uncertainty ultimately prevails in which outcomes can be predicted but not definitively foretold.

What does the text most strongly imply about the relationship between probabilistic models and causal determinism?
selections: A. The predictive use of probabilistic models can be reconciled with acceptance of causal determinism because causal determinism does not necessarily entail the existence of absolute certainty.
B. The predictive use of probabilistic models represents a rejection of causal determinism because such models associate a single event with multiple potential outcomes.
C. Probabilistic models reflect the influence of causal determinism because their predictions of future outcomes are informed by concrete information about past events.
D. Probabilistic models can be understood as compatible with causal determinism only when their predictions of future events overwhelmingly favor one potential outcome.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
概率模型基于类似过去事件的结果生成预测，但即使这些模型预测了可能的结果，它们也隐式承认低频事件可能发生。由于它们容纳了多种潜在结果，这类模型似乎与因果决定论不相容——即认为在特定前提条件下，特定结果是不可避免的观点。但对相关条件的完全预知通常无法获得，这表明不确定性状态最终占主导地位，在这种状态下，结果可以被预测但不能被明确预知。
中文解析：
文本关键逻辑：Probabilistic models承认多种潜在结果（包括低频事件），这似乎与因果决定论（认为结果必然发生）矛盾。但文本指出“对相关条件的完全预知通常无法获得”（complete foreknowledge...unavailable），因此不确定性普遍存在（uncertainty ultimately prevails），结果可预测但无法绝对预知。这暗示：即使因果决定论在理论上成立（结果必然由前提条件决定），人类无法完全掌握所有条件，因此概率模型（容纳多重结果）在实际应用中与这种认知局限一致，而非直接否定决定论本身。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
Chengdu, China, was named a City of Gastronomy by UNESCO in 2010, a title that _____ that Chengdu has a unique and vibrant food culture worthy of celebration.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
中国成都于2010年被联合国教科文组织评为“美食之都”，这一称号______成都拥有独特而充满活力的美食文化，值得庆祝。
中文解析：
文本中“美食之都”的称号是对成都美食文化的官方认可，空格需填入一个能体现“称号代表或象征某种含义”的动词。对应D) denotes（表示/象征）准确表达“称号指向特定内涵”的逻辑，且与“worthy of celebration”呼应。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

Elisabeth Pötzelsberger and colleagues gathered data on 23 non-native tree species grown in Europe. They analyzed reports from Austria, Poland, and Hungary about the number of these species grown in those countries as well as the numbers of insect and fungus species that damage those trees. The researchers concluded that Austria had a greater number of damaging fungus species than either of the other countries did.

Which choice best describes data from the table that support Pötzelsberger and colleagues' conclusion?
selections: A. Austria reported 51 damaging fungus species, which is more than either Poland or Hungary reported.
B. Poland and Hungary reported 10 and 1 damaging fungus species, respectively, which is far fewer than Austria reported.
C. Austria reported 51 damaging fungus species, whereas Poland reported 105 damaging insect species.
D. Hungary reported 18 damaging fungus species but only 13 damaging insect species.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Elisabeth Pötzelsberger 及其同事收集了关于欧洲种植的23种非本地树种的数据。他们分析了来自奥地利、波兰和匈牙利的报告，这些报告涉及这些国家种植的这些树种的数量以及损害这些树种的昆虫和真菌物种的数量。研究人员得出结论，奥地利的有害真菌物种数量比其他两个国家都多。

只有选项A正确比较了奥地利的真菌数量（51）与波兰（25）和匈牙利（18），并明确支持结论。

question:
Optimal foraging theory (OFT) holds that animals’ foraging behaviors reflect cost-benefit trade-offs that vary by species and with dynamic ecological circumstances. One such circumstance is lunar intensity, which Burt Kotler and colleagues found to be negatively associated with foraging by greater Egyptian gerbils but Eduardo Fernández-Duque and colleagues found to be positively associated with foraging by Azara’s night monkeys. This discrepancy is explicable in terms of OFT: the monkeys’ greater reliance on vision means that higher lunar intensity benefits them more than it benefits the gerbils.

Information in the text best supports which statement about OFT?
selections: A. It may be weakened by the finding that the costs and benefits associated with a particular ecological circumstance vary by species.
B. It can explain why some species act in accordance with cost-benefit trade-offs and others do not.
C. It can account for observations of different species responding differently to similar ecological circumstances.
D. It tends to allow for a better understanding of the benefits of ecological circumstances than the costs of those circumstances.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
最优觅食理论（OFT）认为，动物的觅食行为反映了因物种和动态生态环境而异的成本-效益权衡。其中一个环境因素是月光强度：Burt Kotler及其同事发现，月光强度与埃及大沙鼠的觅食行为呈负相关，而Eduardo Fernández-Duque及其同事发现，月光强度与阿萨拉夜猴的觅食行为呈正相关。这种差异可以用OFT解释：夜猴更依赖视觉，这意味着较高的月光强度对它们的益处大于对沙鼠的益处。
中文解析：
文本核心：OFT的核心观点是动物觅食行为基于成本-效益权衡，且权衡因物种和环境而异。给出具体例子：月光强度对沙鼠（负相关）和夜猴（正相关）的影响不同。直接用OFT解释这种差异：夜猴更依赖视觉（月光强时效益高、成本低），而沙鼠可能因月光强时捕食风险高（成本高）而减少活动。对应C
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
Farmhouse interior, painted in the realist style by Jan Hendrik Weissenbruch, depicts a peasant woman knitting at a table while a cat sits underneath. The realists’ emphasis on accurately portraying the experiences of average working people was largely a rejection of the romantic style evident in many paintings by Pierre-Auguste Cot, which instead______their subjects’ positive traits, altering subjects to appear more beautiful or heroic than they actually were.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
由扬·亨德里克·维森布鲁赫以现实主义风格绘制的农舍内部画面，描绘了一位农妇坐在桌边编织，一只猫趴在桌下的场景。现实主义者强调准确描绘普通劳动人民的体验，这在很大程度上是对皮埃尔-奥古斯特·科特许多画作中明显的浪漫主义风格的摒弃。浪漫主义风格反而______其对象的积极特质，通过改变对象使其看起来比实际更美丽或英勇。
中文解析：
根据文本逻辑，现实主义反对浪漫主义风格的处理方式。浪漫主义的特点是通过美化或英雄化来改变真实面貌，因此空格处应填入表示“夸大、强化”积极特质的词，于是选C。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
The hwamei and other fruit-eating bird species introduced to the Hawaiian island of Oahu in the last 150 years have recently been found to spread seeds from the fruits of forest plants native to Oahu that are at risk of extinction, such as the kolea lau nui tree. Many of these vulnerable plant species rely on the activity of fruit-eating birds to help spread the plants’ seeds in the wild. All fruit-eating bird species native to Oahu have gone extinct, suggesting that _____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. hwameis and other non-native birds play an important role that used to be filled by birds that were native to Oahu.
B. non-native birds, such as the hwamei, will also be at risk of extinction if they lose access to kolea lau nui trees.
C. populations of hwameis and other non-native birds will probably soon experience rapid growth.
D. non-native birds, such as the hwamei, now spread more seeds from the kolea lau nui tree than birds native to Oahu did in the past.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在过去150年中引入夏威夷欧胡岛的画眉（hwamei）及其他食果鸟类最近被发现能够传播欧胡岛本土濒危森林植物（如kolea lau nui树）果实的种子。这些易危植物许多依赖食果鸟类的活动来帮助在野外传播种子。而欧胡岛所有本土食果鸟类均已灭绝，这表明_______
中文解析：
文本指出本土食果鸟类已灭绝，但引入的非鸟类（如画眉）正在传播濒危植物的种子，说明它们正在填补本土鸟类原有的生态角色。选项A直接指出非鸟类扮演了曾经由本土鸟类承担的重要角色，与文本逻辑一致。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
Life Among the Paiutes is an 1882 autobiographical narrative by Sarah Winnemucca Hopkins. In the work, Winnemucca explicitly indicates when and how she is shifting the focus of the narrative, as when she writes, _______

Which quotation from Life Among the Paiutes most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “Nothing happened during the day, and after a while mother told us not to say a word about why we left, for grandpa might get mad with us.”
B. “My dear readers, such is the respect my people have for their chiefs.”
C. “But how can I describe the scene that followed? Some of you, dear readers, can imagine.”
D. “I will now stop writing about myself and family and tribe customs, and tell about the wars, and the causes of the wars. I will jump over about six years.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《派尤特人的生活》是莎拉·温尼穆卡·霍普金斯于1882年创作的自传体叙事作品。在该作品中，温尼穆卡明确指出了她何时以及如何转换叙事焦点，例如她写道：__________
中文解析：
D选项直接展示了作者主动控制叙事结构的行为，明确告知读者焦点从个人/部落内容转向战争主题，并跳过六年时间。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
The collectibles market is one of the most difficult segments of the consumer economy to_____ . Few economists would have predicted, for example, that the prices of vintage Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles action figures would soar in the 2010s, but soar they did.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
收藏品市场是消费经济中最难以______的领域之一。例如，几乎没有经济学家会预测到，复古版《忍者神龟》动作玩偶的价格在2010年代会飙升，但它们确实飙升了。
中文解析：
文本通过具体例子（经济学家未能预测《忍者神龟》玩偶价格飙升）说明收藏品市场的价格变化难以预料，因此空格处应填入表示“预测”的词。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
High-speed rail (HSR) systems have trains that move at much higher speeds than traditional trains. HSR is expanding in Norway, Japan, and many other countries around the world. The United States, however, has been slow to build HSR systems. Researchers surveyed United States residents about their attitudes toward HSR. The researchers claim that this survey reveals that there is strong support for building more HSR lines in the United States.

Which quotation from a survey respondent would best illustrate the underlined claim?
selections: A. “I prefer riding buses instead of taking trains because buses travel to more locations.”
B. “I have traveled on high-speed rail lines in Norway but not in Japan.”
C. “I think high-speed rail is wonderful. The United States needs to build more high-speed rail lines.”
D. “I believe that the United States has enough high-speed rail lines. It should invest in airports instead.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
高速铁路（HSR）系统拥有比传统列车运行速度更快的列车。高速铁路正在挪威、日本和世界许多其他国家扩展。然而，美国在建设高速铁路系统方面一直进展缓慢。研究人员就美国居民对高速铁路的态度进行了调查。研究人员声称，这项调查揭示了美国民众对建设更多高速铁路线路有强烈支持。
中文解析：

question:
Though Vasily Grossman’s novel Stalingrad is considered inferior to his later work Everything Flows, some critics praise it despite an arduous writing process required to satisfy Soviet censors (Jordan Penney in PopMatters called Stalingrad “powerful”). Of the novel’s eleven drafts, the second is inexplicably missing, the sixth closely news to Soviet orthodoxy, and published versions most resemble the fifth. The English edition’s translators culled material from unpublished drafts and published Russian versions to create a comprehensive edition.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It notes a novel’s critical reception, addresses the complicated history of the novel’s development, and suggests how that history informed the work of the novel’s English translators.

B. It describes a novel whose critical reputation has declined over time, explains the cause of that decline, and reports the effort of translators to rehabilitation a work they believe has been unjustly ignored.

C. It mentions a novel whose quality critics do not agree on, discusses obstacles that make it difficult to determine what the best version of that novel might be, and offers a reason why some critics find a translation of the novel to be superior to the original.

D. It refers to a novel that has several different published and published versions, identifies characteristics that have led critics to prefer one version to others, and tells how published justifications their choice to bring one particular version of the novel into another language.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管瓦西里·格罗斯曼的小说《斯大林格勒》被认为不如他后来的作品《一切都在流动》，但一些评论家仍称赞它——尽管为满足苏联审查官的要求，其创作过程十分艰辛（乔丹·彭尼在PopMatters上称《斯大林格勒》“震撼人心”）。该小说共有十一份草稿，第二稿莫名缺失，第六稿紧密贴合苏联正统思想，而出版的版本最接近第五稿。英文版的译者从未发表的草稿和已出版的俄语版本中筛选材料，制作了一个综合版本。
中文解析：
文本结构清晰分为三部分：1）评论界反响：指出小说虽被认为不如后期作品，但仍有评论家称赞（如乔丹·彭尼的评价）；2）创作复杂历史：提到十一份草稿的坎坷（第二稿缺失、第六稿贴合审查、出版版基于第五稿）；3）译者工作依据：英文译者综合未发表草稿和已出版版本制作全面版本，直接呼应“复杂历史如何影响译者”。A准确对应这三层结构

Studies have found that when looking at other people’s eyes, humans tend to perceive dilated pupils positively and constricted pupils negatively. Noting that a dark iris—the colored portion surrounding the pupil—is hard to distinguish from the black of the pupil (and thereby affects the pupil’s apparent size) and that many domestic dogs have dark irises, Akitsugu Konno et al. showed close-up images of dogs’ faces to human participants and asked them to rate the dogs’ traits and their own attitudes toward the dogs. Their findings suggest that ______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
selections: A. differences in dogs’ pupil size may elicit a stronger response in humans than differences in people’s pupil size do, as participants’ responses to the images when dogs’ pupils were actually large were indistinguishable from participants’ responses when dogs’ pupils only appeared to be large due to iris color.

B. iris color in domestic dogs may be an adaptation to elicit positive responses from humans, as participants responded more negatively to images of dogs whose iris colors can make pupils appear large than they did to images of dogs without such iris colors.

C. humans’ responses to pupil size in other people may extend to dogs, as participants responded more positively to images of dogs whose iris colors were likely to make their pupils appear large than they did to images of dogs whose iris colors were unlikely to have that effect.

D. humans may not be as sensitive to pupil size in dogs as they are to pupil size in other people, as participants’ responses to the images show no relationship to differences in the shade of dogs’ irises that could affect how large the dogs’ pupils appear to be.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
研究发现，当观察他人的眼睛时，人类倾向于将扩大的瞳孔视为积极信号，而将收缩的瞳孔视为消极信号。注意到深色虹膜（围绕瞳孔的有色部分）很难与瞳孔的黑色区分（从而影响瞳孔的表观大小），且许多家养犬拥有深色虹膜，Akitsugu Konno等人向人类参与者展示了狗脸的特写图像，并要求他们评估狗的特征以及自己对狗的态度。他们的研究表明______
中文解析：
表格数据显示，深色虹膜的狗（ID 11和3）在“友好”评分（分别为3.18和3.88）和“愿意饲养”（1.85和2.35）、“愿意互动”（2.05和2.65）方面均高于浅色虹膜的狗（ID 20和14：友好评分2.08和2.11，愿意饲养1.5和1.55，愿意互动1.75和1.85）。深色虹膜会使瞳孔看起来更大，而人类通常对较大的瞳孔（扩张的瞳孔）有积极反应。因此，参与者对深色虹膜（瞳孔显得更大）的狗反应更积极。根据原文第一句话的铺垫，可以看出人类对他人瞳孔大小的积极反应也延伸到狗身上，参与者对深色虹膜（使瞳孔显得大）的狗反应更积极。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes.
●During the Industrial Revolution (from the mid-1700s to the mid-1800s), the number of people living in urban areas of the UK grew substantially (30%).
●Urbanization occurred as large segments of the country’s rural population relocated to cities to support the burgeoning manufacturing industry.
●The industrial city of Manchester, England, experienced the most population growth (2,000%).
●A comparison of a 1746 map of Manchester with maps of the city from the late 1800s reflects the city’s expansion.
●According to historian Donna Sherman, these maps present “a powerful visual representation of the transformation of Manchester’s landscape.”

The student wants to connect the quotation from Sherman to the increase in the UK’s urban population during the Industrial Revolution. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Sherman claims that maps of Industrial Revolution-era Manchester, England, present “a powerful visual representation of the transformation of Manchester’s landscape” during a time period in which the UK experienced a substantial (2,000%) increase in population.
B. Rural populations relocating to cities like Manchester created a phenomenon that Sherman describes as “a powerful visual representation” of how the UK transformed during the Industrial Revolution.
C. Sherman claims that period maps of the UK present “a powerful visual representation” of how the country’s rural landscape was transformed by population shifts during the Industrial Revolution.

D. The sizeable growth in the UK’s urban population during the Industrial Revolution is reflected in before-and-after maps that present, in Sherman’s view,“a powerful visual representation” of how the increase transformed Manchester.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记：
●工业革命期间（18世纪中期至19世纪中期），英国城市地区人口大幅增长（30%）。
●城市化发生的原因是大量农村人口迁往城市，以支持蓬勃发展的制造业。
●工业城市曼彻斯特经历了最大的人口增长（2000%）。
●将1746年的曼彻斯特地图与19世纪末的地图进行比较，反映了城市的扩张。
●历史学家Donna Sherman认为，这些地图呈现了“曼彻斯特景观变革的强有力视觉表现”。
中文解析：
选项D正确地将英国城市人口整体增长（30%）与曼彻斯特的极端增长（2000%）联系起来，并通过地图对比（1746年与19世纪末）直观展示了这一变化，同时准确引用了Sherman关于地图视觉表现的观点。其他选项存在事实错误（如A混淆了全国与曼彻斯特的增长数据）或偏离核心证据（如B未提及地图，C错误聚焦农村景观）。

question:
Text1
In separate studies, Guihua Wang and colleagues and Xinhua He and colleagues examined whether plants transfer nutrients to one another using a common mycorrhizal network (CMN)—a lattice of fungal strands in the soil. Wang and colleagues excluded all pathways other than the CMN by using barriers to keep the plants’ root systems separate while allowing mycorrhizal strands through — an essential step He and colleagues’ study did not take.
Text2
Wang and colleagues took the necessary precaution of separating the plants’ root systems (thereby excluding root-to-root transmission). However, any barrier used must allow the thread-like hyphae of a CMN to pass through, and this permeability would also allow liquids through. Thus, the researchers’ experimental design cannot ensure that any nutrient transfer observed can be attributed to a CMN and not to some other pathway.

Based on the texts, the author of Text 1 and the author of Text 2 would most likely agree with which statement?
selections: A. He and colleagues’ study did not find convincing evidence of nutrient transfer between individual plants.
B. Excluding root-to-root transfer of nutrients between plants is sufficient to evaluate whether any observed nutrient transfer involved a CMN.
C. It is impossible to determine whether a CMN is the mechanism for any observed nutrient transfer unless root-to-root transfer is precluded.
D. A barrier that is impervious to both roots and fungal strands is necessary to examine nutrient transfer via a CMN.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
文本1：
在各自的研究中，王桂华（Guihua Wang）及其同事与何新华（Xinhua He）及其同事均检验了植物是否通过共同菌根网络（CMN）——土壤中的真菌菌丝网格——传递养分。王及其同事通过使用屏障将植物的根系分隔开（同时允许菌根菌丝通过），排除了CMN以外的所有路径，而何及其同事的研究未采取这一关键步骤。
文本2：
王及其同事采取了必要的预防措施来分隔植物的根系（从而排除了根与根之间的直接传递）。然而，任何使用的屏障必须允许CMN的线状菌丝通过，而这种渗透性也会允许液体通过。因此，研究者的实验设计无法确保观察到的养分传递是归因于CMN，而不是其他路径。
中文解析：
文本1强调王的研究排除了根与根传递（通过屏障分隔根系），而何的研究未做到这一点；文本2虽指出王的屏障设计有缺陷（可能允许液体等其他路径），但同样默认“排除根与根传递”是必要前提（否则更无法区分CMN的作用）。因此，两文本作者都会同意：必须先排除根与根传递，才能进一步讨论CMN的作用（C选项）。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
Lady Grant and colleagues _____ pots of sterilized soil with slurries of live microbes collected from soil in five sites across Colorado, including areas of sagebrush and ponderosa pine forest. Grant and team then grew mustard plants in the pots to see if the different microbial slurries affected levels of spicy glucosinolates like indole in the plants’ seeds.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Grant女士和同事们______装有灭菌土壤的花盆，这些土壤中加入了从科罗拉多州五个地点（包括山艾树和黄松林区域）采集的活微生物浆液。Grant团队随后在盆中种植芥菜植物，以观察不同微生物浆液是否会影响植物种子中辛辣硫代葡萄糖酸盐（如吲哚）的水平。
中文解析：
实验需要将微生物浆液引入灭菌土壤中，以研究其对植物的影响。选项B "populated"（填入、注入）最精确，表示将微生物群引入土壤的过程，符合科学实验语境。

question:
Male orangutans typically disperse from the territory in which they were born when they reach maturity, whereas females typically do not. Beatrice Ehmann and her colleagues hypothesized that this difference in life trajectory should be reflected in the diets of immature orangutans: males should share fewer of their mothers’ dietary preferences than females do since those preferences tend to be particular to the food resources available in the local area and may be of relatively low utility beyond it. The researchers calculated the percent of mother orangutans’ diets shared with their offspring’s diets and the percent of immature orangutans’ diets not shared with their mothers’ diets.

Which choice best describes data from the graph that support Ehmann and colleagues’ hypothesis?
selections: A. The majority of the diet of the mother of individual 5 was shared with the diet of individual 5, whereas significantly less than half the diet of the mother of individual 17 was shared with the diet of individual 17.

B. The percent of the mother’s diet shared with its offspring’s diet was smaller for individual 17 than for individual 5, and the percent of the individual’s diet not shared with its mother’s diet was greater for individual 17 than for individual 5.

C. Neither individual 17 nor individual 5 had a diet that consisted mostly of food not shared with the individual’s mother’s diet, whereas more than half of both individuals’ mothers; diets were shared with their offspring’s diets.

D. The percent of individual 5’s mother’s diet that was shared with individual 5’s diet ranged from approximately 59% to approximately 65%, whereas the percent of individual 17’s mother’s diet that was shared with individual 17’s diet ranged from approximately 8% to approximately 19%.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
雄性猩猩在成年后通常会离开其出生地，而雌性通常不会。比阿特丽斯·埃曼和她的同事们假设，这种生命轨迹的差异应该反映在未成年猩猩的饮食中：由于母亲的饮食偏好往往特定于当地可获取的食物资源，并且超出该地区后实用性可能较低，因此雄性猩猩与母亲共享的饮食偏好应少于雌性。研究人员计算了母亲饮食中与后代饮食共享的百分比，以及未成年猩猩饮食中未与母亲饮食共享的百分比。
中文解析：
选项B直接、准确地对比了两个关键数据：个体17（雄性的）“母亲共享饮食百分比”（MD柱）远低于个体5（雌性），而个体17的“自身非共享饮食百分比”（ID柱）远高于个体5，这完全符合假设的预期。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
Mauricio Drelichman and Hans-Joachim Voth’s research into the debt defaults of Philip II (who ruled an empire including Spain and Northern Catalonia from 1556 to 1598) relates to other work on European early modern state finance, including John Brewer’s research on taxation and warfare. But Drelichman and Voth’s unique contribution to the field is their reconstruction of the earliest extant set of annual fiscal records for any sovereign state, demonstrating in turn that Philip’s defaults were caused by short-term cash shortages, not long-term unsustainable debts.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Analysis of the earliest available records of a sovereign state’s finances can be found not in the work of Brewer but in that of Drelichman and Voth.
B. The research by Drelichman and Voth suggests that the logistics of ruling both Spain and Northern Catalonia led to short-term problems with cash that forced Philip II to default on his debts.
C. Drelichman and Voth advanced the field of research on European early modern state finance by assembling a novel collection of evidence that gave them insight into Philip II’s debt defaults.
D. Drelichman and Voth’s research on Philip II's debt defaults builds on earlier work by Brewer, adding nuance to the earlier work's findings.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
毛里西奥·德雷希曼（Mauricio Drelichman）和汉斯-约阿希姆·沃斯（Hans-Joachim Voth）对腓力二世（1556-1598年统治包括西班牙和北加泰罗尼亚的帝国）债务违约的研究，与约翰·布鲁尔（John Brewer）关于税收和战争的研究等其他欧洲近代早期国家财政工作相关。但德雷希曼和沃斯对该领域的独特贡献是重建了现存最早的主权国家年度财政记录，并由此证明腓力二世的违约是由短期现金短缺而非长期不可持续的债务所致。
中文解析：
文本核心强调德雷希曼和沃斯的“独特贡献”（unique contribution）是重建了最早年度财政记录（即新颖证据），并由此得出新结论（短期现金短缺导致违约），这直接对应C选项“整合新颖证据推动研究领域”。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
The metal featured in both the structure of the ARK by APOLLO architects Associates and the hardware in the House in Goido by Fujiwara Muro architects is representative of a trend in contemporary Japanese interior design to juxtapose sleek, modern accents with traditional organic materials such as cypress. The prominent featuring of metal stems from the post-World War II emphasis on technological progress, while more traditional natural materials help preserve longstanding architectural and aesthetic approaches.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. The text distinguishes between two aesthetic approaches to architecture and then submits that one approach has had more of a long-term impact than the other has had.
B. The text names projects that are noteworthy for their inclusion of certain materials and then explains past important uses of the materials.
C. The text cites examples of a design trend and then briefly establishes the principles underlying the trend.
D. The text introduces the salient characteristics of two buildings and then details the historical events that occasioned the buildings’ designs.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
APOLLO建筑事务所设计的ARK结构和Fujiwara Muro建筑事务所设计的House in Goido中均采用的金属，代表了当代日本室内设计的一种趋势：将光滑的现代元素与传统有机材料（如柏木）并置。金属的突出运用源于二战后对技术进步的重视，而更传统的天然材料则有助于保留悠久的建筑与美学方法。
中文解析：
文本首先通过两个具体建筑案例（ARK和House in Goido）指出金属与传统材料并置的设计趋势，随后直接解释该趋势的成因（二战后的技术进步导向与传统材料的保留需求），这完全对应C选项“引用趋势示例+阐述背后原理”。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
The bird species Tachyphonus surinamus (the fulvous-crested tanager) practices a foraging strategy known as sallying (catching insects in flight and returning to a perch to eat them), enabling it to scan for prey and predators simultaneously. Conversely, Percnostola rufifrons (the black-headed antbird), with which T. surinamus shares territory in French Guiana, practices foliage gleaning (picking insects off leaves), substantially limiting the bird’s field of vision while foraging. Biologist Ari Martínez and colleagues hypothesized that the greater vulnerability inherent in the latter strategy is reflected in greater sensitivity to predator warning signals from neighboring species.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support Martínez and colleagues’ hypothesis?
selections: A. When Martínez and colleagues played T. surinamus alarm calls, only T. surinamus displayed predator-avoidance behavior, whereas both T. surinamus and P. rufifrons displayed such behavior when P. rufifrons alarm calls were played.

B. When Martínez and colleagues played control sounds of random noise, only P. rufifrons displayed predator avoidance behavior, whereas both P. rufifrons and T. surinamus displayed such behavior when alarm calls from another local bird species were played.

C. When Martínez and colleagues played alarm calls from a species that does not share territory with T. surinamus and P. rufffrons, T. surinamus displayed predator-avoidance behavior, whereas P. rufifrons did not display any behavioral change.
D. When Martínez and colleagues played alarm calls from another local bird species, P. rufifrons displayed predator-avoidance behavior, whereas T. surinamus did not display any behavioral change.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
鸟类物种 Tachyphonus surinamus（黄冠唐纳雀）采用一种称为“飞捕”的觅食策略（飞行中捕捉昆虫并返回栖木进食），使其能同时观察猎物和捕食者。相反，与之在法属圭亚那共享领地的 Percnostola rufifrons（黑头蚁鸟）采用“叶片拾取”策略（从叶片上啄食昆虫），这在觅食时极大限制了其视野。生物学家 Ari Martínez 与同事假设，后一种策略固有的更高脆弱性，会体现在对邻近物种发出的捕食者警告信号具有更高的敏感性。
中文解析：
选项D显示，当播放其他本地鸟类的警报声时，P. rufifrons 表现出躲避行为，而 T. surinamus 没有反应。这直接表明 P. rufifrons 对异种警报声更敏感，支持了其因脆弱性高而更依赖外界警告的假设。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
The _____ of leaf-vein architectures—the branching venation of Ginkgo biloba, the hierarchical netlike venation of Clematis reticulata, and others—likely resulted from competing selective pressures to maximize fluid transport, photosynthesis, and robustness against herbivory. The associated trade-offs may account for the range of adaptations in different lineages.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
叶脉结构的_____——如银杏的分枝状脉序、网脉铁线莲的层级网状脉序等——可能源于最大化流体传输、光合作用及抗食草性稳健性的竞争性选择压力。相关的权衡可能解释了不同谱系中的一系列适应性变化。
中文解析：
选A（多样性）。原文列举了银杏（分枝状）和网脉铁线莲（网状）等截然不同的叶脉结构（即“多样性”），并指出这种差异是竞争性选择压力导致的结果。其他选项意思：B---顽固性；C---纠缠性；D---过失性。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
Canada, which, according to international indices, has relatively strong democratic institutions and low intranational income inequality, experienced an inflation rate of 2.26% in 2018, whereas Oman, which shows the opposite pattern on such indices, had an inflation rate of only 0.88% that year. Such a comparison may seem consistent with the theoretical critique that by diluting control over the economy, democratic institutions inhibit states’ ability to counteract inflationary pressures, but when Raj Desai et al. examined democratic strength, intranational inequality, and inflation in more than 100 countries, they found that democratic strength, if associated with low inequality, restrains inflationary pressures, which would suggest that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. international indices may have underestimated the strength of Canada’s democratic institutions relative to Oman’s.
B. inflation in Canada in 2018 would have been higher if Canada’s government had less control over the economy.
C. factors other than Canada’s political structure contributed to the country’s inflation rate exceeding that of Oman in 2018.

D. the 2018 difference between Canada’s inflation rate and Oman’s inflation rate is primarily but not exclusively attributable to the different levels of intranational income inequality in the two countries
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
国际指数显示，加拿大民主制度相对健全、国内收入不平等程度较低，但2018年通胀率为2.26%；而阿曼在这些指标上呈现相反特征，同年通胀率却仅为0.88%。这一对比似乎符合理论批评的观点，即民主制度会稀释政府对经济的控制力，从而抑制国家应对通胀压力的能力。然而，当Raj Desai等人研究100多个国家的民主强度、国内不平等和通胀关系后，发现若民主强度与低不平等相结合，反而会抑制通胀压力。这表明______
中文解析：
研究结论指出“民主强度+低不平等”会抑制通胀，但加拿大的案例（符合该条件）却出现比阿曼更高的通胀率，这与研究结论表面矛盾。选项C指出“加拿大2018年通胀率高于阿曼是政治结构以外的因素导致的”，这既承认了表面矛盾，又为研究结论的合理性提供了解释空间，逻辑上衔接了转折关系。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
As a work of scholarship, Advancing U.S. Latino Entrepreneurship (2020) is notable for its _____. Featuring contributions from Zulema Valdez, Bea Stotzer, and others, it explores contemporary issues while also providing context dating all the way back to the sixteenth century on Latino populations and their experiences with business and commerce.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
作为一部学术著作，《推进美国拉丁裔创业精神》（2020年）因其______而引人注目。本书收录了祖莱玛·瓦尔德斯、比娅·斯托泽等人的贡献，不仅探讨了当代问题，还提供了可追溯至16世纪的关于拉丁裔人口及其商业和贸易经历的背景。
中文解析：
原文提到该书既研究当代问题，又提供从16世纪至今的历史背景（"dating all the way back to the sixteenth century"），这直接体现了其时间跨度和内容覆盖的广度（即范围之广）

While observing birds for a biology class, a group of students noticed a lesser sand plover (Charadrius mongolus), a bird of the order Charadriformes (shorebirds), slowly move away, make loud noises, and feign an injured wing as the group approached the bird’s ground nest. Researching this behavior, the students learned that this phenomenon is commonly referred to as “broken-wing display” and is meant to lure predators away from the nesting site and toward a seemingly vulnerable adult bird. Upon learning of other birds that also exhibit the behavior they had observed, the students hypothesized that the phenomenon is exclusive to shorebirds.

Which choice best describes data from the table that weaken the students’ claim?
selections: A. The common sandpiper, in the order Charadriformes, is known to perform broken-wing display, and the West Peruvian dove, in the order Columbiformes, is not.
B. Neither the West Peruvian dove nor the purple sandpiper is known to perform broken-wing display.
C. Unlike the common sandpiper, the purple sandpiper is not known to perform broken-wing display, even though both are in the order Charadriformes.
D. Both the sooty grouse and the pine warbler are known to perform broken-wing display.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
学生们在接近一只蒙古沙鸻（属于鸻形目，即岸禽）的地面巢穴时，观察到该鸟慢慢走开、发出大声鸣叫并假装翅膀受伤。他们研究发现，这种行为被称为“断翅表演”，旨在将捕食者从巢穴引开，导向看似脆弱的成鸟。得知还有其他鸟类也表现出这种行为后，学生们假设该现象是岸禽（鸻形目）所独有的。
中文解析：
学生的假设是“断翅表演现象是岸禽（鸻形目）所独有的”。选项D指出，乌灰榛鸡（属于鸡形目）和松林莺（属于雀形目）这两种非鸻形目的鸟类也已知会进行断翅表演。这直接提供了反例，表明该行为并不仅限于鸻形目，从而削弱了“独有性”的假设。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
The subscription economy has rapidly expanded to include a wide range of products—from books to cloud storage—in part because consumers appreciate the convenience of automatic payments. But as a study by Ben Klopack and team shows, consumers are typically inattentive to automatic payments and remain subscribed to services long after their value has worn off. The study also found that subscribers were much more likely to discontinue a service when they had to make an active renewal decision (for example, when they need to update payment information to remain subscribed) than at other times. The researchers therefore concluded that a regulation requiring all subscribers to complete payments manually would likely_____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. deter attentive consumers from subscribing in the first place but would have little effect on whether inattentive consumers decide to subscribe.
B. decrease subscribers’ valuation of the subscription services at a faster rate than if no such regulation were implemented.
C. enable dissatisfied subscribers to save more money than they would without such a regulation in place but at the expense of a feature that may have induced them to subscribe initially.
D. result in reduced average subscription durations, but the overall experience of the longest-subscribing consumers would improve.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
订阅经济已迅速扩展到涵盖从书籍到云存储的各种产品，部分原因是消费者欣赏自动支付的便利性。但 Ben Klopack 团队的研究表明，消费者通常不会留意自动支付，甚至在服务失去价值后仍长期订阅。研究还发现，当订阅者必须主动做出续订决定时（例如需要更新支付信息才能保持订阅），他们取消服务的可能性远高于其他时候。因此研究人员得出结论，一项要求所有订阅者手动完成支付的规定可能会______
中文解析：
研究核心逻辑是：自动支付导致消费者因疏忽而持续订阅不需要的服务，而主动决策点（如手动支付）能显著提高取消率。选项C准确对应此逻辑：手动支付规定会让不满意的订阅者更易取消（从而省钱），但代价是失去了“自动支付”这一最初吸引他们订阅的便利功能。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
Nature reserves and other types of protected areas (PAs) are established to promote conservation, but because they restrict certain economic activities, it is widely believed that they hinder local economic development. However, a study by Hasita Bhammar and team investigating five PAs, including Lower Zambezi National Park (a terrestrial PA in Zambia) and Abrolhos Marine Park (a marine PA in Brazil), estimated the impact of tourism on these regions and concluded that tourism likely results in increased household incomes in local communities. But whereas terrestrial PAs were in remote places with few alternative amenities to attract tourists, marine PAs were close to additional amenities not part of the PA. Thus, the researchers conceded that although _____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the establishment of both PAs likely benefited their respective local economies, such gains likely derived mainly from the tourism industry in Lower Zambezi and from industries unrelated to tourism in Abrolhos.
B. tourism at Abrolhos and surrounding regions likely fluctuated erratically in the period shortly after the PA was created, tourism at Lower Zambezi remained largely stable.

C. economic activity in the tourism sector in communities around Lower Zambezi can likely be attributed to interest in it as a protected area, economic activity in tourism around Abrolhos may be unrelated to the PA.
D. household income increased in the areas surrounding both PAs, it likely grew at a much faster rate for households near Abrolhos than for households near Lower Zambezi.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
自然保护区和其他类型的保护区旨在促进生态保护，但由于限制了某些经济活动，人们普遍认为它们会阻碍当地的经济发展。然而，Hasita Bhammar 团队对包括赞比亚的陆地保护区下赞比西国家公园和巴西的海洋保护区阿布罗柳斯海洋公园在内的五个保护区进行研究，评估了旅游业对这些地区的影响，结论是旅游业可能提高了当地社区的家庭收入。但陆地保护区位于偏远地区，缺乏其他吸引游客的便利设施，而海洋保护区则靠近保护区以外的附加设施。因此，研究人员承认，尽管 ______
中文解析：
前文指出关键差异：陆地保护区（下赞比西）本身是主要旅游吸引力，而海洋保护区（阿布罗柳斯）附近有其他非保护区的便利设施。选项C直接基于此差异进行推论：下赞比西的旅游经济活动可归因于其作为保护区的吸引力，而阿布罗柳斯的旅游经济活动可能与保护区本身无关。这完美衔接了研究人员承认的转折逻辑，解释了为何同样有旅游收入，但成因不同。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
The following text is adapted from John Matheus’s 1926 short story, “Mr. Bradford Teaches Sunday School.” Mr. Bradford is driving through the countryside in Florida.
The moss in the towering water oaks had become enlivened with a verdant sheen of silver and hung like festoons of carnival or like funeral decorations for the mourning of the dead. The pine green was resplendent. The bald cypress spread themselves along the water courses while the willows wept as they always did. Mr. Bradford was conscious of this gorgeous display of nature.

As used in the text, what does the word “display” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本改编自约翰·马修斯（John Matheus）1926年的短篇小说《布拉德福德先生教主日学》。布拉德福德先生正驾车穿过佛罗里达州的乡村。
高耸的水橡树上的苔藓因银绿色的光泽而生机勃勃，像狂欢节的彩带，又像哀悼死者的葬礼装饰。松树的绿色绚烂夺目。秃柏树沿水道蔓延，柳树如常垂泣。布拉德福德先生注意到了自然的这一华丽______。
中文解析：
上下文描绘了自然景色的绚丽画面（苔藓的银绿光泽、松树的绚烂、柏树与柳树的姿态），强调这是一种视觉上的壮观景象。选项A "spectacle"（奇观、景象）最贴合这种对自然华丽景象的展示，其他选项均不符：B "pretentiousness"（矫饰）含负面意义；C "resemblance"（相似性）无关；D "deception"（欺骗）与文意矛盾。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

This hypothesis, based on comparative analyses of owl drawings made by modern children, is supported by the objects predominantly being crafted from slate—a material that, because of its _____ be easily carved by small hands using rudimentary tools.

question:
William Duer employed the pseudonym “Philo-Publius”—a reference to an ancient Roman statesman — in political essays he wrote in 1787, a choice that accomplished far more than simply concealing his authorship._____ it wasn’t an arbitrary pen name but rather a complex rhetorical strategy through which Duer aligned his federalist views with the venerated republicans ideals of the ancient world, thereby bolstering the authority of his writing.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
威廉·杜尔在1787年所写的政治散文中使用了笔名"Philo-Publius"（暗指一位古罗马政治家），这一选择远不止是为了隐藏作者身份。_____ 这并非随意取的笔名，而是一种复杂的修辞策略——杜尔通过该策略将自身的联邦主义观点与古代受尊崇的共和理想相结合，从而增强其著作的权威性。
中文解析：
应选B) Indeed（确实）。因为后句"这并非随意取名..."是对前句"远不止隐藏身份"的进一步强调和具体说明，存在递进确认的逻辑关系。"Indeed"能准确体现这种顺承强化语气，而其他选项均表示转折或补充，与语境不符。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
Although the Eskimo-Aleut language of Inuktun has only about 1,200 living speakers, most in Greenland, the New York City-based Endangered Language Alliance has identified a group of Inuktun speakers in the city’s borough of Manhattan._____ in the borough’s Upper West side neighborhood, these speakers are both helping to ensure Inuktun’s survival and contributing to the city’s unmatched linguistic diversity.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管因图顿语（Inuktun）这种爱斯基摩-阿留申语言只有约1200名现存使用者（大部分在格陵兰岛），但纽约市的濒危语言联盟在该市曼哈顿区发现了一群使用因图顿语的人。_____ 在该区的上西城社区，这些使用者既帮助确保因图顿语的生存，又为这座城市无与伦比的语言多样性做出贡献。
中文解析：
前句提到“在曼哈顿区发现一群使用者”，后句具体说明“在该区的上西城社区”（in the borough’s Upper West side neighborhood），“There”直接指代前文提到的曼哈顿区，形成空间逻辑衔接（“在那里”），过渡自然。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
Every US state has an associated state soil, which is typically selected by a group of experts, then passed through the state legislature to receive its official designation. For example, Wisconsin’s Antigo soil was formally designated in 1983, and Vermont’s Tunbridge soil in 1985. _____ years pass between a soil’s selection and official designation, as the legislative process can be notorious slow.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
每个美国州都有其对应的州土壤，通常由一组专家选定，然后通过州立法机构获得正式命名。例如，威斯康星州的安蒂戈土壤于1983年正式命名，佛蒙特州的滕布里奇土壤于1985年正式命名。_____ 从土壤被选中的正式命名之间可能经过多年，因为立法过程可能非常缓慢。
中文解析：
前文通过两个具体例子（威斯康星和佛蒙特）说明土壤命名需要时间（1983和1985年命名，但未说明选中时间），后文总结“从选中的正式命名可能经过多年”。A选项“In many cases”（在许多情况下）泛化前文例子，暗示这种延迟是普遍现象（而不仅仅是两个特例），与“as the legislative process can be notoriously slow”（立法过程缓慢）形成合理推论。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Artistic works made readily accessible to the general public are categorized as public art.
●Artist Zenos Frudakis’s twenty-foot-long bronze sculpture Freedom Sculpture is on display along a public sidewalk in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
●This work of public art depicts a group of people emerging from the side of a building.
●Artist David McCracken’s thirty-one-foot-long aluminum sculpture Diminish and Ascend is on display in a public botanical garden in Christchurch, New Zealand.
●This work of public art depicts a staircase that appears to ascend into the clouds.

The student wants to contrast the two sculptures. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In contrast to Frudakis’s Freedom Sculpture, McCracken’s Diminish and Ascend is displayed in a public place.
B. Frudakis’s Freedom Sculpture, unlike McCracken’s Diminish and Ascend, depicts human subjects.
C. Freedom Sculpture by Frudakis and Diminish and Ascend by McCracken are two examples of public art.
D. McCracken’s sculpture Diminish and Ascend, which depicts a staircase that appears to ascend into the clouds, is on display in Christchurch, New Zealand.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究某个主题时，一位学生记录了以下笔记：
●向公众开放的艺术作品被归类为公共艺术。
●艺术家泽诺斯·弗鲁达基斯长达20英尺的青铜雕塑《自由雕塑》陈列在宾夕法尼亚州费城的一条公共人行道旁。
●这件公共艺术作品描绘了一群人从建筑物侧面走出来的场景。
艺术家大卫·麦克拉肯长达31英尺的铝制雕塑《消逝与上升》陈列在新西兰克赖斯特彻奇的一个公共植物园里。
●这件公共艺术作品描绘了一段似乎升入云端的阶梯。
中文解析：
题目要求"对比两件雕塑"，需要找出它们内容上的核心差异。选项B准确抓住了笔记中关于雕塑描绘对象的关键区别：《自由雕塑》描绘的是"一群人"（human subjects），而《消逝与上升》描绘的是"一段阶梯"，形成了直接有效的对比。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●A U-shaped curve in a river channel is called a meander.
●A meander forms when water erodes sediment from one side of the riverbank and redeposits that sediment on the opposite side.
●Meanders will gradually change shape and migrate downstream over time.
●A river with high sinuosity has many meanders, and a river with low sinuosity has few.
●The Huallaga River in Peru has high sinuosity.

The student wants to describe how meanders are formed. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Over time, many meanders have formed in the Huallaga River, a river in Peru with high sinuosity.
B. The U-shaped curves, or meanders, that form in a river will gradually change shape and migrate downstream.
C. A high-sinuosity river, the Huallaga River has many meanders that will change shape and shift downstream over time.
D. Over time, water erodes sediment from one side of a riverbank and redeposits it on the other, resulting in a U-shaped curve, or meander, in the river channel.
explanations:
在研究某个主题时，一位学生记录了以下笔记：
●河流河道中的U形曲线称为河曲。
●当水流侵蚀河岸一侧的沉积物并将其重新沉积到对岸时，就形成了河曲。
●随着时间的推移，河曲会逐渐改变形状并向下游迁移。
●曲折度高的河流有许多河曲，曲折度低的河流则很少。
●秘鲁的瓦利亚加河曲折度很高。
中文解析：
只有选项D准确复现了笔记中关于形成机制的关键信息："水流侵蚀一侧沉积物并重新沉积到对岸，导致河道形成U形曲线（河曲）"。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Gabriel de Vallseca was a fifteenth-century Majorcan cartographer of portolan charts.
●Domenico Pizigano was a fifteenth-century Venetian cartographer of portolan charts.
●Portolan charts were early nautical charts that mapped the waterways of the Mediterranean and Black Seas.
●Portolan charts in the Venetian tradition tended to be sparse in illustrations.
●Those in the Majorcan tradition tended to be richly illustrated.
●In Majorcan charts, the Atlas Mountains are depicted as a palm tree, and the Tagus River is depicted as a shepherd’s crook.

The student wants to make a distinction between the two portolan traditions. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Unlike Venetian portolan charts, which could include illustrations of palm trees and shepherds’ crooks, Majorcan charts were sparse in illustration.
B. Being in the Majorcan tradition, the portolan charts of Gabriel de Vallseca differed from those of the Venetian cartographer Domenico Pizigano.
C. While portolan charts in the Majorcan tradition tended to be richly illustrated, those in the Venetian tradition mapped the waterways of the Mediterranean and Black Seas.
D. Majorcan portolan charts, unlike their sparser Venetian counterparts, tended to be richly illustrated.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究某个主题时，一位学生记录了以下笔记：
●加布里埃尔·德·瓦尔斯卡是15世纪马略卡派的波特兰类型海图制图师。
●多梅尼科·皮齐加诺是15世纪威尼斯派的波特兰类型海图制图师。
●波特兰海图是早期航海图，绘制了地中海和黑海的水道。
●威尼斯传统的波特兰海图插图往往很稀疏。
●马略卡传统的波特兰海图则往往插图丰富。
●在马略卡海图中，阿特拉斯山脉被描绘成棕榈树，塔霍河被描绘成牧羊人的拐杖。
中文解析：
题目要求"区分两种传统"，核心区别在于插图的丰富程度。选项D直接、准确地对比了"插图丰富的马略卡传统"与"插图稀疏的威尼斯传统"，完全基于笔记中的关键区别信息。选项A的对比关系（插图内容）与事实相反；选项B未提及具体区别；选项C的后半句（绘制水道）是两种传统的共同点，而非区别。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question:
Located on the Emscher River in Germany, the city of Dortmund was a member of a powerful mercantile alliance that dominated northern European trade between the 13th and 17th _____ a loose confederation of cities from eleven modern-day countries, it has been described as a precursor to today’s European Union.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations:
首先，识别两个独立的句子，句子1：the city of Dortmund was a member of a powerful mercantile alliance.....句子2：it has been described as a precursor to today’s European Union.根据两个句子之间不能用逗号连接排除D。
其次，the Hanseatic League属于句末同位语，解释前面的a powerful mercantile alliance，所以应该用冒号，破折号，只能选A或者B
最后，a loose confederation...European Union不属于对于a powerful mercantile alliance的继续解释，所以A选项中League后面的逗号就不能成立。
exam_name: 2025年9月第4套阅读语法（北美B-F去重合并版）

question: A freight elevator can hold a maximum weight of 5,450 pounds during one trip. A 190-pound person needs to deliver several boxes using the freight elevator. question: In the xy-plane, the graph of the linear function h contains the points <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>  and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>10</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>.Which equation defines  h，where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>h</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>？
explanations: 使用方程<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi> </mrow> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <msub> <mi>x</mi> <mn>1</mn> </msub> <mo>−</mo> <msub> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msub> </mrow> <mrow> <msub> <mi>y</mi> <mn>1</mn> </msub> <mo>−</mo> <msub> <mi>y</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msub> </mrow> </mfrac></math>，然后代入（0，0）和（1，10） 和 最后计算出m=10。答案是A。

question:

A line of best fit is also shown.
Which of the following is the best interpretation of the slope of the line of best fit?

B. C. The predicted temperature increases at a constant rate of approximately <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>40</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo>∘</mo></mrow></msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></mrow></math> per hour over the 10hour period

question: The width of a rectangle is 9 centimeters. The length of the rectangle is 50 centimeters longer than the width. What is the area, in square centimeters, of this rectangle?
explanations: 宽9cm，长比宽长50cm，所以长是59cm。答案是B。

question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>3</mn></math>，what is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>？
explanations: 将x+1看作一个整体（假设为a），a=3，那么2a=6。答案是6。

question:

question:

explanations: 先化简第一个公式得出<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>21</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi></math>，再代入第二个公式计算出x后再计算y。最后发现x和y都只有一个解。答案是D。

question: A bank account was opened with an initial deposit. Over the next several months, regular deposits were made into this account, and there were no withdrawals made during this time. The graph of the function f shown, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>，estimates the account balance, in dollars, in this bank account x months since the initial deposit. To the nearest whole dollar, what is the amount of the initial deposit estimated by the graph?
explanations: x轴是账户余额，y轴是月份。当x为0的时候y在30的位置。答案是30。

question:

question: The length of a rectangle is 35 centimeters greater than its width. Which equation gives the area A, in square centimeters, of the rectangle in terms of the width w, in centimeters, of the rectangle?
selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>A</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>w</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>w</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>35</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>

B. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>A</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>w</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>35</mn> <mi>w</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>

C. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>A</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>w</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mfrac> <mi>w</mi> <mn>35</mn> </mfrac> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow></math>

D. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>A</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>w</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>w</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>35</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mtext> Area </mtext> <mo>=</mo> <mtext> length </mtext> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>w</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>35</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>∗</mo> <mtext> wide </mtext> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>w</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>。答案是A。

question: The measure of angle K is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mi>π</mi> <mrow> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>12</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> </mrow> </mfrac></math> radians. The measure of angle L is 12 times the measure of angle K. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle L?
explanations: L是K的12倍。所以半径是<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mi>π</mi> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac></math>，将其换算成角度（乘以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>180</mn> <mi>π</mi> </mfrac></math>)，答案是D。

question: The function w is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>w</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>r</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>1</mn> <mrow> <mi>r</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>r</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>5</mn> </mrow> <mrow> <mo>−</mo> <mi>r</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>4.25</mn> </mrow> </mfrac></math>.What is the greatest possible value of r  such that <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>w</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>r</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>0</mn></math>？
explanations: 因为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>w</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>r</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>0</mn></math>，所以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>1</mn> <mrow> <mi>r</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>r</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>5</mn> </mrow> <mrow> <mo>−</mo> <mi>r</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>4.25</mn> </mrow> </mfrac></math>。交叉相乘得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mn>12</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi> </mrow> <mo>+</mo> <mn>35.75</mn></math>，解这个方程。答案是6.5 。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>42</mn><mi>p</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>84</mn></math>

question: What is the y-intercept of the graph of  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mn>6</mn> <mi>x</mi> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>12</mn></math> in the xy-plane?
explanations: 要找出y-intercept只需要令x为0，最后算出y。答案是D。

question: The density of a certain type of marble stone is 2.6000 grams per cubic centimeter. If a sample of this type of stone is in the shape of a sphere with a diameter of 31.000 centimeters, what is the mass of this sample, in grams, to the nearest whole number? (Use 3.14159 for <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>π</mi><mo>.</mo></math>）
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>v</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>4</mn><mn>3</mn></mfrac><mi>π</mi><mi>r</mi><mn>3</mn></math>，带入数值的出v=15598。再乘以质量2.6得出答案。答案是40556 。

question: Stefan purchased 500 feet of fencing. He used <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>80</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> of this fencing to surround a vegetable garden. How many feet of fencing did Stefan use to surround the vegetable garden?

explanations: 将d=36代入公式。得出c=0 。答案是0 。

question:

question: On January 1, 2000, the population of a town was 26,255 and on January 1, 2010, the population was 26,956. The equation  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>26</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>255</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>26</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>956</mn></math> describes this situation. Which of the following is the best interpretation of x in this context?
selections: A. The total increase in population between 2000 and 2010
B. The average increase per year of the population between 2000 and 2010
C. The percentage by which the population of the town increased each year between 2000 and 2010
D. The projected population of the town 10 years after 2010
explanations: 这里 2625526 是 2000 年人口。 经过 10 年人口变为 26,956。 10x 表示 10 年内总增长量。 所以 x 表示每年平均增长的人口数。

question: An equation of the line in the xy-plane that contains the points <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>  is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>A</mi> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>B</mi> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>9</mn></math>，where A and B are constants. question: A researcher observes a sample of a nuclide. An exponential model estimates that the mass, in grams, of the sample decreases by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>27</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> every 14.07 minutes. Which of the following equations could represent this model, where M is the estimated mass, in grams, of the sample t minutes after the researcher began observing the sample?

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>11</mn></mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>x</mi></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow></math>
The function g is defined by the given equation. question:
The following text is adapted from Willa Cather’s 1912 novel Alexander’s Bridge.
For the next few days Alexander was very busy. He took a desk in the office of a [Scottish] engineering firm on Henrietta Street, and was at work almost constantly. He avoided the clubs and usually dined alone at his hotel.

As used in the text, what does the word “constantly” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在接下来的几天里，亚历山大忙得不可开交。他在亨利埃塔街一家苏格兰工程公司的办公室里摆了张办公桌，几乎片刻不停地投入工作。他避开俱乐部，通常独自在酒店用餐。
中文解析：
在原文中，Bartley Alexander 几乎都在工作，这表明他花费了连续不断的时间在工作上，没有长时间中断。因此，“constantly”在这里最接近“持续地”的意思，continuously符合要求。

question:
Tokyo has high pedestrian traffic, but other cities cannot increase their pedestrian traffic simply by replicating a single feature of Tokyo — e.g., its high population density — that is associated with walkability. As urbanist Mariela Alfonzo argues, many factors influence people’s decision-making about whether to walk: some studies have shown the importance of personal preference, others have shown the importance of perceived safety, and so on, and it is clear that none of these factors in isolation fully explains pedestrian habits in a given city.

Based on the text, the author would most likely agree with which statement about Tokyo’s “high population density”?
selections: A. It may increase walkability in Tokyo but is known to reduce walkability in other cities.
B. It should be understood as just one of several factors that influence pedestrian activity in Tokyo.
C. It affects walking decisions in Tokyo less than personal preference and perceived safety do.
D. It is better understood as an effect of the high level of pedestrian traffic in Tokyo than as a cause of that pedestrian traffic.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
东京拥有很高的步行交通量，但其他城市不能仅仅通过复制东京与步行性相关的单一特征（例如其高人口密度）来增加自身的步行交通量。正如城市学家马里ela·阿尔丰佐（Mariela Alfonzo）所论证的，许多因素会影响人们是否选择步行的决策：一些研究显示了个人偏好的重要性，另一些研究显示了感知安全的重要性，等等。显然，这些因素中没有任何一个能单独完全解释某个城市的步行习惯。
中文解析：
题目要求根据文本推断作者对东京高人口密度的看法。文中强调步行性受多因素共同影响，且单一因素无法完全解释步行习惯。

explanations:
题目文本翻译：
据说西莫维特在9世纪统治了后来成为波兰的地区。与贝斯普里姆或波兰早期历史上其他有充分证据的人物不同，西莫维特的存在一直存在争议，因为我们对他的了解_____那些在事件发生数百年后才被记录下来的、有些可疑的口头传统。
中文解析：
文本指出关于Siemowit的知识源自"有争议的口头传统"，这些传统在事件发生数百年后才被记录。"derived from"最精确地表达了"知识来源"这一逻辑关系，强调信息获取的途径。

question:
High-speed rail systems, in which trains can move at great speeds, are expanding in many countries because high-speed rail can reduce the number of automobiles on the road and ultimately conserve energy. In Morocco, for instance, 186 kilometers of high-speed rail lines are in operation as of 2023, and 1,287 kilometers are under construction.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. The text notes a general trend and then cites an example of that trend.
B. The text summarizes an argument and then offers a challenge to that argument.
C. The text questions a course of action and then sugAgests alternatives to that action.
D. The text rejects a long-held belief and then proposes a different interpretation.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
高速铁路系统（列车可在其中高速运行）正在许多国家扩展，因为高铁可以减少道路上的汽车数量并最终节约能源。例如，在摩洛哥，截至2023年已有186公里高铁线路投入运营，另有1,287公里正在建设中。
中文解析：
题目要求选出最能概括原文结构的选项。原文先说明高铁发展的普遍现象及原因，再以摩洛哥的具体数据为例，因此A选项最符合。

question:
Women like Minnie McNeal Kenny made important early contributions to the history of US cryptology, a field concerned with secure data communication and storage. Kenny worked for the National Security Agency (NSA) and received the NSA’s two highest awards. She also held istrative positions at the National Cryptologic School. In this way, Kenny and others like her helped make it possible for more women — such as Anna Lysyanskaya, who currently works in and teaches digital cryptography — to enter the field of cryptology

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Women such as Minnie McNeal Kenny and Anna Lysyanskaya have contributed to the field of cryptology.
B. Cryptology is a field that focuses primarily on securely managing data.
C. Minnie McNeal Kenny and Anna Lysyanskaya worked together on an important project in the field of cryptology.
D. Cryptology should be taught more often in schools to encourage more women to enter the field.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
像明妮·麦克尼尔·肯尼（Minnie McNeal Kenny）这样的女性为美国密码学的早期发展做出了重要贡献。密码学是一个涉及安全数据通信和存储的领域。肯尼曾就职于美国国家安全局（NSA），并获得了该局的两项最高荣誉。她还在国家密码学校担任行政职务。通过这种方式，肯尼和其他像她一样的女性帮助更多女性——例如目前从事并教授数字密码学的安娜·利西亚斯卡娅（Anna Lysyanskaya）——得以进入密码学领域。
中文解析：
题目要求选出最能概括全文核心内容的选项。全文通过肯尼和利西亚斯卡娅的例子，强调女性对密码学领域的贡献，因此A选项最准确。

question:
A microgenre is a specialized genre consisting of a comparatively small number of stylistically similar artists. The microgenre of electronic music known as hyperpop emerged in the 2010s, with American musician Laura Les as an early exponent. Her combination of dense synthesizer arrangements and metallic percussion with vocals electronically shifted in pitch above her natural range exemplifies the hyperpop sound. More recently, British recording artist Charli XCX has contributed to that sound by incorporating pop melodies into it.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence?
selections: A. It asserts that the hyperpop sound hasn’t changed, even though new artists have adopted it.
B. It criticizes a later hyperpop artist for being too similar to an earlier hyperpop artist.
C. It praises a particular hyperpop artist for consistently evolving through the years.
D. It identifies an artist who has contributed a new stylistic element to the hyperpop sound.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
微流派（microgenre）是一种专门化的流派，由数量相对较少但风格相似的艺术家组成。电子音乐的微流派“超流行乐”（hyperpop）兴起于2010年代，美国音乐人劳拉·莱斯（Laura Les）是其早期代表。她将密集的合成器编曲、金属质感的打击乐与人声音高电子化提升至自然音域之上的演唱相结合，完美诠释了超流行乐的风格。最近，英国录音艺术家查莉·XCX（Charli XCX）通过将流行旋律融入这种风格，为其注入了新元素。
中文解析：
题目要求分析划线句子（关于Charli XCX的句子）在文中的作用。该句说明Charli XCX通过加入流行旋律为超流行乐增添了新元素，因此D选项正确。

question:
Studies have demonstrated that positive feedback enhances real-world exercise performance and exercisers’ psychological experience of physical activity. Nicole Trewick and team tested their prediction that positive feedback would produce analogous results among participants cycling on a stationary bike in a virtual reality environment. After monitoring participants’ pedaling rate and heart rate to determine the effects on their physical endurance (e. g., their ability to sustain a certain target pedaling and heart rate) of feedback (positive, negative, or neutral) delivered at regular intervals, the researchers used participants’ questionnaire responses to assess their psychological experience of the task.

Assuming participants had similar baseline fitness levels, which finding from the study, if true, would most strongly suggest that positive feedback had the predicted psychological effect but not the predicted physical effect?
selections: A. Compared with participants who received negative or neutral feedback, participants who received positive feedback reported greater enjoyment of the activity on average but maintained their heart and pedaling rates for approximately similar durations.

B. Compared with participants who received positive or neutral feedback, participants who received negative feedback reported lower enjoyment of the activity on average but maintained their heart and pedaling rates for longer durations.

C. Compared with participants who received negative feedback, participants who received neutral feedback reported similar levels of enjoyment of the activity on average but maintained their heart and pedaling rates for shorter durations than participants who received positive feedback.

D. Compared with participants who received positive feedback, participants who received neutral feedback reported lower enjoyment of the activity on average but maintained their heart and pedaling rates for longer durations than participants who received negative feedback.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
研究表明，积极反馈能提升现实运动中的运动表现和锻炼者对身体活动的心理体验。Nicole Trewick团队测试了以下预测：在虚拟现实环境中骑固定自行车的参与者，积极反馈也会产生类似效果。研究通过监测参与者的蹬踏频率和心率，评估定期提供的反馈（积极、消极或中性）对其身体耐力（如维持特定目标蹬踏频率和心率的能力）的影响，并通过问卷回答评估参与者对任务的 psychological experience（心理体验）。
中文解析：
题目要求找出能证明“积极反馈有心理效果（愉悦度提升）但无身体效果（耐力未提升）”的选项。需同时满足心理体验改善（如愉悦度更高）与身体耐力无差异（如维持心率/蹬踏时间相似）。选项A直接表明积极反馈组心理体验更优（愉悦度更高），但身体耐力指标（维持心率和蹬踏时间）与其他组无差异，完美符合“有心理效果无身体效果”的要求。

question:
Meredith E. Protas and colleagues have explored how convergent evolution — a phenomenon that occurs when the same trait evolves independently in two reproductive separate lineages — can result from a genetic mechanism shared by both lineages. Meanwhile, Cynthia C. Steiner and colleagues have investigated how convergence occurs through different genetic mechanisms, but the relative prevalence of convergence through shared and different genetic processes is still poorly understood. This motivated biologists Delbert A. Green II and Cassandra G. Extavour to evaluate both types of convergence in a single study for their 2012 paper.

According to the text, what did Protas and colleagues focus on in their study?
selections: A. Convergent traits arising from different genetic mechanisms
B. Convergent traits arising from a shared genetic mechanism
C. The convergence of traits in lineages that are not reproductive separate
D. The relative prevalence of convergent traits emerging through shared and different genetic mechanisms
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
梅雷迪思·E·普罗塔斯（Meredith E. Protas）及其同事研究了趋同进化（当相同特征在两个生殖隔离的谱系中独立进化时发生的现象）如何由两个谱系共享的遗传机制所导致。而辛西娅·C·斯坦纳（Cynthia C. Steiner）及其团队则研究了趋同现象如何通过不同的遗传机制发生，但通过共享机制和不同机制实现趋同的相对普遍性仍知之甚少。这促使生物学家德尔伯特·A·格林二世（Delbert A. Green II）和卡桑德拉·G·埃克斯塔沃尔（Cassandra G. Extavour）在2012年的论文中对这两种趋同类型进行了统一评估
中文解析：
题目要求根据文本明确普罗塔斯团队的研究焦点。原文首句直接说明其研究重点是趋同进化如何由共享遗传机制导致，因此B选项正确。

question:
Nautilids are marine mollusks that begin growing their shells before emerging from their eggs and continue to add shell segments throughout their lifetimes. The walls between their shells’ chambers are called septa, and the concentration of the isotope oxygen-18 they contain exactly reflects the isotope’s concentration in the water at the depth at which the septa formed. Paleontologist Amane Tajika and colleagues examined each of the septa in two nautilid shells; finding that sample F13 had a higher concentration of the isotope than sample M03 did, the researchers concluded that F13 must have formed at a significantly lower temperature than M03 did.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers’ conclusion?
selections: A. As the concentration of oxygen-18 in water decreases, water temperature decreases and nautilid shell growth slows.
B. As water depth increases, both the concentration of oxygen-18 and the water temperature decrease.
C. As water depth increases, the concentration of oxygen-18 increases and water temperature decreases.
D. As water temperature increases, nautilids are able to concentrate more oxygen-18 into their shells.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
鹦鹉螺类（nautilids）是海洋软体动物，它们在破卵前就开始生长外壳，并终身持续增加壳段。其壳内腔室之间的壁称为隔板（septa），隔板中氧-18同位素的浓度恰好反映了隔板形成时所在水深中该同位素的浓度。古生物学家Amane Tajika及其同事检查了两个鹦鹉螺壳中的每一个隔板；发现样本F13的同位素浓度高于样本M03，研究人员得出结论：F13形成时的温度明显低于M03。
中文解析：
题目要求找出研究结论依赖于“氧-18浓度越高，形成温度越低”的逻辑。选项C明确说明水深增加时氧-18浓度升高且水温降低，直接建立了同位素浓度与水温的负相关关系，支持了F13浓度更高则温度更低的推断。

question:
Examples of Hoards found in Ireland and Northern Ireland
Hoard name
Date of contents
Year of discovery
Description
Broighter Hoard

1896

Deposits of valuable objects, or hoards, have been unearthed in many different parts of Ireland and Northern Ireland. Some of these hoards were discovered before 2000; for example, ______

selections: A. the Balline Hoard and the Dooyork Hoard were both discovered in the 2000s.
B. the Broighter Hoard was one of several hoards discovered in the 1800s.
C. the Dooyork Hoard was discovered in 1940, and the Balline Hoard was discovered in 2001.
D. the Broighter Hoard was discovered in 1896, and the Balline Hoard was discovered in 1940.
explanations:

在爱尔兰及北爱尔兰许多地区都出土过贵重物品的沉积物（即窖藏）。其中部分窖藏发现于2000年之前，例如
中文解析：
