On June 10,1963, Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan received a ticker-tape parade in New York City in recognition of his status as president of India. Of the 206 ticker-tape parades held between 1886 and 2022, a number were for international leaders. ______ Radhakrishnan’s parade was one of 73 honoring foreign heads of state.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
1963年6月10日，萨瓦帕利·拉达克里希南在纽约市举行了彩带游行，以表彰其作为印度总统的地位。在1886年至2022年间举行的206场彩带游行中，有一部分是为国际领导人举办的。______拉达克里希南的游行是73场为外国元首举办的游行之一。
中文解析：
前句提到“一部分游行是为国际领导人举办”，后句用具体数字“73场为外国元首”对“一部分”进行具体说明。A项“Specifically”（具体而言）准确引出细节例证，符合“概括→具体化”的逻辑递进关系。

question:
Following her debut album release in 2002, Mexican singer-songwriter Natalia Lafourcade quickly shot to fame. By 2023, she ______ one of the most celebrated musicians in Latin America, having released twelve albums and won seventeen Latin Grammy awards—more than any other female artist in history.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: “By 2023”（到2023年为止），描述的是在此时间点之前已完成的状况。B项“had become”是过去完成时，准确表达了“在2023年之前已成为”这一先于过去时间点完成的动作。

question:
A number of recording artists ______ Indigenous music with other musical styles. For example, Wolastoq musician Jeremy Dutcher incorporated traditional Wolastoq songs into experimental pop on his album Wolastoqiyik Lintuwakonawa, and Tuscarora/Taíno singer-songwriter Pura Fé combined Indigenous rhythms and vocals with R&B on her album Sacred Seed.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
许多录音艺术家将 Indigenous 音乐与其他音乐风格 ______。例如，Wolastoq 音乐家 Jeremy Dutcher 在他的专辑《Wolastoqiyik Lintuwakonawa》中将传统的 Wolastoq 歌曲融入实验性流行乐中，而 Tuscarora/Taíno 唱作歌手 Pura Fé 在她的专辑《Sacred Seed》中将 Indigenous 的节奏、人声与 R&B 相结合。
中文解析：
文中通过两个具体例子说明艺术家如何将 Indigenous 音乐元素与其他风格融合，强调创造性结合而非单纯分析或获取。A 项 "fuse"（融合）精准对应后文 "incorporated...into" 与 "combined...with" 的语境逻辑，而其他选项无法体现这种有机混合的关系。

question:
Most people are familiar with the song “Happy Birthday” because_______Few, however, may know the song’s origin. The tune began as “Good Morning to All,” a song written by sisters Mildred and Patty Hill in the early 1890s.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. it is the most frequently sung song in the English language?
B. it is the most frequently sung song in the English language.
C. is it the most frequently sung song in the English language.
D. is it the most frequently sung song in the English language?
explanations: 空格前是连词“because”，其后应接一个陈述句作为原因状语从句，且该从句本身不是疑问句，因此应使用正常语序（主语+谓语）且句末用句号。

question:
Commedia dell’arte was a type of theater that emerged in Italy in the 1500s. It became popular throughout Western Europe. In commedia dell’arte, actors didn’t have a script. Instead, they created their dialogue and actions onstage in the moment. Actors in these plays also usually wore stylized masks. In a research paper, a student argues that doing so affected how the actors portrayed their characters.

Which quotation from a historian would most directly support the student’s argument?
selections: A. “Since their faces were hidden by masks, actors in commedia dell’arte used hand gestures and other movements of their bodies to display emotions.”
B. “The use of masks in commedia dell’arte can be traced directly to the theater of ancient Rome.”
C. “After almost vanishing in the 1800s, commedia dell’arte once again became popular in Italy and Great Britain for a brief period in the 1960s and 1970s.”
D. “Masks are also worn in the traditional theater of China, India, and Maya communities in Mexico and Central America.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
即兴喜剧（Commedia dell’arte）是16世纪在意大利出现的一种戏剧形式，后来在整个西欧流行。在即兴喜剧中，演员没有剧本，而是在舞台上即兴创作台词和动作。这些剧目的演员通常还佩戴风格化的面具。一名学生在研究论文中提出，这样做影响了演员对角色的塑造。
中文解析：
学生的论点是“佩戴面具影响了演员塑造角色的方式”。A项引述明确指出“由于面具遮住了脸，演员使用手势和其他身体动作来展示情绪”，这直接证明了面具如何改变了演员的表演方式，从而支持了学生的论点。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●The exoplanet GJ 357 b (31 light-years from Earth) doesn’t emit enough light to be observed by Earth-or space-based telescopes.
●Astronomers were able to detect the exoplanet indirectly by the transit method of planetary detection.
●In this method, astronomers analyzed the periodic dimming of the light emitted by a distant star.
●They determined that this dimming was caused by the orbit of an unseen exoplanet (GJ 357 b) passing between the star and the observation point.
●As of February 2024, the transit method had been used to detect 4,153 exoplanets.

The student wants to explain an advantage of the transit method. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The transit method of planetary detection was used to detect GJ 357 b, an exoplanet located 31 light-years from Earth.

B. In the transit method, astronomers observe the light emitted by a distant star for signs of dimming, which is caused by the orbit of an unseen exoplanet passing between the star and the observation point.

C. Used to detect exoplanets by the periodic dimming they cause in the light of the stars they orbit, the transit method allows for the discovery of distant exoplanets not bright enough to be observed directly.
D. As of February 2024, the transit method of planetary detection had been used to discover 4,153 exoplanets, including GJ 357 b.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一名学生在研究课题时记录了以下笔记：
●系外行星 GJ 357 b（距离地球 31 光年）本身发射的光线不足，无法被地基或天基望远镜直接观测到。
天文学家能够通过行星探测的“凌星法”间接探测到该行星。
●该方法中，天文学家分析遥远恒星发出的光线发生的周期性变暗。
●他们确定这种变暗是由一颗看不见的系外行星（GJ 357 b）在恒星和观测点之间运行轨道所致。
●截至 2024 年 2 月，凌星法已用于探测到 4,153 颗系外行星。
●该学生想解释凌星法的一个优势。
中文解析：
题目要求解释凌星法的“优势”。笔记核心在于：凌星法通过分析恒星光线周期性变暗，能间接探测到本身太暗而无法直接观测的系外行星（如GJ 357 b）。对应C

question:
Sunita Williams, a US astronaut, has gone on seven spacewalks. During ______ spacewalks, Williams performed important tasks outside the spacecraft, such as installing new equipment.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: these指代前面seven spacewalks

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●In music theory, the term “key” refers to the set of musical notes that forms the foundation of a piece of music.
●In On the Sensations of Tone (1863), German physicist Hermann von Helmholtz describes the moods of various musical keys.
●He describes the key of D flat major as expressing “fullness of tone.”
●He describes the key of C major as “expressive of innocence.”
●“Waterfalls” (1995) by TLC is a song written in D flat major.
●“Imagine” (1971) by John Lennon is a song written in C major.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between “Waterfalls” and “Imagine.” Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. “Waterfalls” is written in the key of D flat major, while “Imagine” is written in C major.
B. Helmholtz describes the mood of D flat major as expressing “fullness of tone” and the mood of C major as “expressive of innocence.”
C. D flat major is the key in which “Waterfalls” by TLC was written, and its mood has been described as expressing “fullness of tone.”
D. In On the Sensations of Tone, Helmholtz describes the mood of various keys, including D flat major, which he describes as expressing “fullness of tone.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一名学生在研究课题时记录了以下笔记：
●在音乐理论中，“调”指构成一首乐曲基础的一组音符。
●德国物理学家赫尔曼·冯·亥姆霍兹在《论音感》（1863年）中描述了不同音乐调性的情绪。
●他将降D大调描述为表达“音调的饱满感”。
●他将C大调描述为“表现天真无邪”。
●TLC乐队的《瀑布》（1995年）是一首以降D大调创作的歌曲。
●约翰·列侬的《想象》（1971年）是一首以C大调创作的歌曲。
题目解析:
题目核心要求是强调两首歌的“差异”。A项直接对比了两首歌的调性（《瀑布》为降D大调，《想象》为C大调）。

question:
Although oil shocks — such as the 145% rise in oil prices between February 2007 and June 2008— can strongly affect individual consumers, Gbadebo Oladosu and colleagues have shown that at the level of national economies, their effects are often quite ______ . The effect of recent oil shocks on the gross domestic product of India, for example, was only slightly greater than zero.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管石油冲击——例如2007年2月至2008年6月间油价上涨145%——可能强烈影响个体消费者，但Gbadebo Oladosu和同事的研究表明，在国家经济层面，其影响往往十分______。例如近期石油冲击对印度国内生产总值（GDP）的影响仅略大于零。
中文解析：
文中通过数据举例（对印度GDP影响微乎其微）强调石油冲击对国家经济的影响远小于对个人的影响，因此需要填入表示“不显著”或“较弱”的词。“subdued”在此语境中意为“缓和的”、“不强烈的”，最符合逻辑，而其他选项（持久、有益、多变）均与后文证据矛盾。

question:
Text 1
In a seminal 1979 study, Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky presented students and college faculty from Israel, Sweden, and the United States with hypothetical questions involving financial decisions. Finding that participants’ responses indicated that losses have a greater psychological impact than equivalent gains do, the researchers formulated the concept of loss aversion, which has since informed research in fields ranging from behavioral economics to law.
Text 2
Fieke Harinc k et al. conducted an experiment in which Dutch study participants were exposed to financial choices that involved potential losses of either relatively minor sums of money, such as 2 euros (low-stakes contexts), or more substantial sums, such as 50 euros (high-stakes contexts). The researchers concluded that only the latter contexts were associated with loss aversion.

Based on the texts, how would Harinc k et al.(Text 2) most likely respond to Kahneman and Tversky's finding(Text 1)?
selections: A. By observing that researchers' ability to assess feelings about financial decisions is contingent on gathering adequate data about gains and losses
B. By contending that the attitude toward financial losses that Kahneman and Tversky observed is contingent on the magnitude of outcomes
C. By disputing Kahneman and Tversky's claim that a tendency to place excessive emphasis on financial losses accounts for the loss aversion observed in fields such as behavioral economics and law
D. By agreeing that experimental results support the idea that some people tend to be more cognizant of financial losses than of gains
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一些研究者认为，居住在南太平洋大岛（Grande Terre）上的物种属于其所在演化支（clades），这些演化支在该岛屿约8000万年前从远古超大陆冈瓦纳（Gondwana）的残余部分分裂之前就已存在。然而，Yohan Pillon等人进行的一项研究发现，大岛上Geissois树木演化支的冠群年龄（该演化支中所有现存和灭绝物种的最晚共同祖先的年龄）为730万年；Pillon等人进一步发现，整个南太平洋地区Geissois树木演化支的冠群年龄也大约为730万年。
中文解析：
文本2的实验表明，损失厌恶仅在高风险情境（大额损失）中出现，而低风险情境（小额损失）中未观察到这一现象，这说明损失厌恶并非绝对，而是受损失金额大小的影响。Harinck等人通过区分金额规模，对Kahneman和Tversky的普遍性结论提出了细化补充，而非完全否定（C）或简单同意（D），也未强调数据充足性（A）。

question:
Some researchers posit that the species inhabiting the South Pacific island of Grande Terre belong to clades that predate the island’s split from remnants of the former supercontinent Gondwana around 80 million years ago. A study conducted by Yohan Pillon et al. found, however, that the crown age (the age of the most recent common ancestor of all living and extinct species in the clade) of the clade of Geissois trees on Grande Terre is 7.3 million years; Pillon et al. further found that the crown age of the clade of Geissois trees in the South Pacific generally is also approximately 7.3 million years.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It presents a possibility that some researchers have raised, then describes a study that clarifies their reasons for doing so.
B. It describes an idea that some researchers have put forward, then presents study results that are incompatible with that idea.
C. It identifies a discrepancy between a hypothesis some researchers have proposed and related research findings, then explains that discrepancy.
D. It explains a view some researchers have advanced, then discusses study results that led them to reconsider that view.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一些研究者认为，居住在南太平洋大岛（Grande Terre）上的物种属于其所在演化支（clades），这些演化支在该岛屿约8000万年前从远古超大陆冈瓦纳（Gondwana）的残余部分分裂之前就已存在。然而，Yohan Pillon等人进行的一项研究发现，大岛上Geissois树木演化支的冠群年龄（该演化支中所有现存和灭绝物种的最晚共同祖先的年龄）为730万年；Pillon等人进一步发现，整个南太平洋地区Geissois树木演化支的冠群年龄也大约为730万年。
中文解析：
文本首先介绍了一些研究者的假设（物种演化支早于岛屿分裂），但通过Pillon等人的研究数据（冠群年龄仅730万年），直接反驳了这一观点（因为730万年远晚于8000万年前的岛屿分裂）。研究结果（年轻冠群年龄）与初始假设（古老起源）明显矛盾，因此结构是“提出观点→展示不兼容的证据”，而非解释原因（A）、解释差异（C）或描述研究者自我修正（D）。

question:
The following text is adapted from Susan Glaspell’s 1917 play The People. Oscar, a writer at a newspaper called The People, is writing at a table when a woman enters the office to speak to the editor.
THE WOMAN: This is the office of The People?
OSCAR: Um-hum.
THE WOMAN: (Excitedly.) I came to see the author of those wonderful words.
OSCAR: (Rising.) Which wonderful words?
THE WOMAN: About moving toward the beautiful distances.
OSCAR: (Loses interest and returns to his writing.): Oh. Those are Mr. Wills’ wonderful words.
THE WOMAN: Could I see him?
OSCAR: He isn’t here yet. He’s just back from California. Won’t be at the office till a little later.

Which choice best states the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. To suggest that Oscar is annoyed that the woman’s visit has interrupted his work
B. To indicate that Oscar had been expecting the woman to come to the office
C. To show Oscar’s brief hope that the woman is fond of his writing
D. To depict Oscar as a polite and professional representative of the newspaper
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本改编自苏珊·格拉斯佩尔（Susan Glaspell）1917年的戏剧《人民》。奥斯卡（Oscar）是一家名为《人民》的报社作家，他正在桌边写作时，一位女性走进办公室要找编辑。
女人：这里是《人民》的办公室吗？
奥斯卡：嗯哼。
女人：（激动地。）我来见那些精彩文字的作者。
奥斯卡：（起身。）哪些精彩文字？
女人：关于“走向美丽远方”的那些。
奥斯卡：（失去兴趣，回到写作中）：哦。那些是威尔斯先生（Mr. Wills）的精彩文字。
女人：我能见他吗？
奥斯卡：他还没来。他刚从加州回来。要稍晚才会到办公室。
中文解析：
当女性提到“精彩文字”时，奥斯卡立刻起身回应，表现出兴趣和期待；但一旦发现她找的是别人（威尔斯），他立刻失去兴趣并恢复工作。这一动作变化生动体现了他短暂的希望和随后的失望，其他选项（恼火、期待她来访、专业代表）均无法准确解释这一情绪转变。

question:
The recovery program led by Marisel Lopez-Flores has dramatically increased the population size of the endangered Amazona vittata, the endemic parrot of Puerto Rico. Given that A. vittata corresponds in physiology, behavior, and ecology to endangered Amazona species elsewhere in the Caribbean, the conservation approach developed by Lopez-Flores may be______ across the genus.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
由Marisel Lopez-Flores领导的恢复计划显著增加了波多黎罗特有濒危鹦鹉Amazona vittata的种群规模。鉴于A. vittata在生理、行为和生态上与加勒比海其他地区的濒危亚马逊鹦鹉物种相对应，由Lopez-Flores开发保护方法可能在该属（genus）范围内是______。
中文解析：
因为文中指出，这种鹦鹉的生理、行为和生态与其他濒危亚马逊鹦鹉物种相似，因此Lopez-Flores成功的保护方法很可能也适用于同属的其他物种，即该方法具有“可复制性”。其他选项（可赎回、可观察、可理解）均与语境中“推广适用”的逻辑不符。

question:
Vertical gene transfer involves the transmission of genetic material from a parent to offspring; horizontal gene transfer, on the other hand, involves the exchange of genetic material between organisms not in a parent-offspring relationship. While horizontal gene transfer is common among prokaryotes—single-celled organisms, such as the bacteria Brevundimonas diminut a and Lactobacillus curvatus — it has rarely been observed among eukaryotes (multicellular organisms). However, new studies suggest that horizontal gene transfer is more common in eukaryotes than originally thought.

Which choice best states the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It argues that two biological phenomena are more similar than they may initially appear to be.
B. It proposes a direction for future research into a biological phenomenon.
C. It explains why a common perception of a biological process is flawed.
D. It explains a biological process by contrasting it with a somewhat similar process.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
垂直基因转移涉及遗传物质从亲代传给子代；而水平基因转移则涉及无亲缘关系的生物体之间的遗传物质交换。虽然水平基因转移在原核生物（单细胞生物，如细菌Brevundimonas diminuta和Lactobacillus curvatus）中很常见，但在真核生物（多细胞生物）中很少被观察到。然而，新的研究表明，水平基因转移在真核生物中比最初认为的更常见。
中文解析：
划线句子通过对比“垂直基因转移”（亲代与子代）和“水平基因转移”（非亲缘关系生物）的定义，清晰解释了“水平基因转移”这一核心概念。所以选D

question:
Lin-Tai Ho and colleagues counted fish in a tide pool in Taiwan at several times during the year and found that some species had a significantly higher maximum population count than others. For example, the highest count for the dusky frillgoby was 38 individuals in January of 2001, whereas the highest count for the Bengal sergeant was _______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the example?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
林泰何（Lin-Tai Ho）与同事在一年中的多个时间点统计了台湾一个潮池中的鱼类数量，发现某些物种的最大种群数量显著高于其他物种。例如，昏蝾虾虎鱼（dusky frillgoby）的最高数量是2001年1月的38条，而孟加拉 sergeant（Bengal sergeant）的最高数量是_______。
中文解析：
找到the Bengal sergeant对应的最高点，就是2001年10月份3个。

question:
Lin-Manuel Miranda’s 2015 hip-hop musical Hamilton depicts historical political figure Alexander Hamilton as a self-made man who, through sheer determination, transcends his humble origins to become a key participant in the founding of the United States. This depiction of Hamilton establishes him as a compelling and well-defined protagonist but obscures other facets of the historical person’s views, namely his elitism and mistrust of the democratic politics of some of his contemporaries. In effect, the musical’s portrayal of Hamilton fails to convey the ideological complexity that a more nuanced portrayal might have suggested.

The text most strongly suggests that particular aspects of Hamilton’s political beliefs may have been omitted from the musical in part to achieve which effect?
selections: A. To create an unambiguous thematic presentation of Hamilton’s life
B. To suggest why certain contributions by Hamilton to US history have been overlooked
C. To challenge the prevailing historical consensus about Hamilton
D. To encourage modern audiences to emulate Hamilton’s politics
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
林-曼努埃尔·米兰达（Lin-Manuel Miranda）2015年的嘻哈音乐剧《汉密尔顿》（Hamilton）将历史政治人物亚历山大·汉密尔顿描绘成一个白手起家的人，他凭借纯粹的决心，摆脱卑微的出身，成为美国建国的关键参与者。这种对汉密尔顿的刻画将他塑造成一个引人注目且形象鲜明的主角，但掩盖了这位历史人物观点的其他方面，即他的精英主义和对某些同代人民主政治的不信任。实际上，音乐剧对汉密尔顿的刻画未能传达出更 nuanced（细致入微）的刻画可能展现的意识形态复杂性。
中文解析：
文本指出音乐剧将汉密尔顿塑造成“形象鲜明的主角”，但省略了他的精英主义和对民主的不信任等复杂面，这种简化是为了突出“a self-made man”“sheer determination”等单一主题，强化主角的正面形象。

question:
Prices of Nuts Sold by Growers in the United States, 2016/17 to 2019/20 Seasons
The US Department of Agriculture’s Fruit and Tree Nuts Outlook is a document that covers a variety of subjects, from the increasing availability of fresh fruit to the forecast for yields of apple crops. A student studying agricultural economics is consulting a graph in the document that shows the prices for which several types of nuts have been sold by growers in the United States over four growing seasons from 2016 to 2020. The student wishes to determine in which season walnuts reached their lowest price. Consulting the graph, the student finds that this season was the ______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
美国农业部的《水果与坚果展望》是一份涵盖多个主题的文件，从新鲜水果供应量的增加到苹果作物产量的预测。一名学习农业经济学的学生正在查阅该文件中的一张图表，该图表显示了2016年至2020年四个生长季节中美国种植者销售的几种坚果的价格。该学生希望确定核桃在哪个季节达到最低价格。通过查阅图表，该学生发现这个季节是______。
中文解析：
若图表显示核桃价格在2018/19季节最低，选B。

question:
LaRose is a 2016 novel by Ojibwe writer Louise Erdrich. It explores how historical events affect families on a reservation in rural North Dakota. LaRose is typical of Erdrich’s work. Her writing usually focuses on portrayals of everyday life in Ojibwe communities. Yet some of her novels have fantastical plots and take place outside Ojibwe communities. For example, her 2017 novel Future Home of the Living God is essentially science fiction, and the otherworldly events in its plot are set in urban Minneapolis.

According to the text, what is one way that Future Home of the Living God differs from most of Erdrich’s work?
selections: A. It contains very little dialogue.
B. Its main characters are Ojibwe.
C. It has been adapted into a movie.
D. It isn’t set in a rural Ojibwe community.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《LaRose》是奥吉布瓦族作家路易丝·厄德里克（Louise Erdrich）于2016年创作的小说。它探讨了历史事件如何影响北达科他州保留地上家庭的故事。《LaRose》是厄德里克作品的典型代表，她的写作通常聚焦于描绘奥吉布瓦社区的日常生活。然而，她的一些小说具有奇幻情节且发生在奥吉布瓦社区之外。例如，她2017年的小说《未来之家的活上帝》本质上是科幻题材，其情节中的超现实事件设定在明尼阿波利斯城市中。
中文解析：
文本明确提到厄德里克的作品“通常聚焦奥吉布瓦社区的日常生活”，但《未来之家的活上帝》却以“城市明尼阿波利斯”为背景，take place outside Ojibwe communities。

question:
The following text is from Ralph Waldo Emerson’s 1841 essay “The Method of Nature.”
The scholars are the priests of that thought which establishes the foundations of the earth. No matter what is their special work or profession, they stand for the spiritual interest of the world, and it is a common calamity if they neglect their post in a country where the material interest is so predominant as it is in America.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. The habit of intellectuals of privileging ideas over material things invariably leads to tragedy.
B. Scholars have played an important role in society for a much longer time than have those people who are mainly concerned with financial gain.
C. In a country whose citizens are largely preoccupied with tangible gains, it is crucial that some people work to foster and preserve ideas.
D. Those Americans who have some military experience will be the ones most likely to have a thorough understanding of the world.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本节选自拉尔夫·沃尔多·爱默生（Ralph Waldo Emerson）1841年的散文《自然的方法》。
学者是那种为地球奠定基础的思想的祭司。无论他们的具体工作或职业是什么，他们代表着世界的精神利益；在一个像美国这样物质利益如此占主导地位的国家，如果他们忽视了自己的岗位，将是一种共同的灾难。
中文解析：
文本强调学者代表“精神利益”，并警告在物质利益主导的美国，若学者忽视职责将导致“共同灾难”，直接呼应C选项的核心：物质至上环境中精神守护者的必要性。

question:
Declining fishing technology costs and overexploitation of near-shore fishing grounds have made isolated oceanic reefs, which often lack regulatory protections, increasingly attractive to commercial and sport fishers. A team led by Octavio Aburto-Oropeza surveyed the biomass density and species composition of two isolated reefs: Alacranes, a protected (fishing prohibited) reef 135 kilometers from the Yucatan Peninsula, and Bajos del Norte, an unprotected reef 25 kilometers further out to sea. Species at the highest level of the trophic pyramid constituted 34% of the biomass at Alacranes and 10% of the biomass at Bajos del Norte. Aburto-Oropeza and colleagues attribute this difference to the two reefs’ difference in regulatory status.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support Aburto-Oropeza and colleagues’ explanation?
selections: A. Total biomass at Alacranes is much greater than total biomass at Bajos del Norte, though the reefs’ biomass densities are similar.
B. It is somewhat more expensive for commercial and sport fishers to reach Bajos del Norte than it is to reach Alacranes.
C. Some of the species that compose the highest trophic level at Bajos del Norte are not found at Alacranes.
D. Commercial and sport fishers tend to disproportionately remove species at the highest trophic level.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
捕鱼技术成本的下降和近岸渔场的过度开发，使得缺乏监管保护的孤立海洋礁石对商业和休闲渔民的吸引力日益增加。由Octavio Aburto-Oropeza领导的团队调查了两个孤立礁石的生物量密度和物种组成：Alacranes（受保护礁石，禁止捕鱼，距尤卡坦半岛135公里）和Bajos del Norte（未受保护礁石，向海再延伸25公里）。营养金字塔最高层的物种在Alacranes的生物量中占比34%，而在Bajos del Norte的生物量中仅占10%。Aburto-Oropeza及其同事将这一差异归因于两个礁石监管状态的不同。
中文解析：
研究团队将两个礁石营养级顶层物种生物量占比的差异（34% vs 10%）归因于监管状态（保护与否），选项D指出商业和运动渔民倾向于不成比例地捕捞食物链顶层的物种，它证明了渔民的行为（因）恰好就是导致Bajos del Norte（未受保护）礁石顶级捕食者比例低（果）的直接原因，直接支持“监管缺失导致差异”的解释。

question:
Researchers Eugeni Vidal-Tortosa and Robin Lovelace looked at the relationship between street lighting in a city and people’s willingness to ride a bicycle. Their results suggest that poor street lighting can deter new or inexperienced cyclists from riding in a city but has little effect on experienced cyclists. Therefore, increasing the number of streetlights in a city could potentially ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. decrease the number of new or inexperienced cyclists riding in the city.
B. increase the number of experienced cyclists riding in the city.
C. increase the number of new or inexperienced cyclists riding in the city.
D. decrease the number of experienced cyclists riding in the city.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
研究人员Eugeni Vidal-Tortosa和Robin Lovelace研究了一个城市的街道照明与人们骑自行车意愿之间的关系。他们的结果表明，昏暗的街道照明会阻碍新手或经验不足的骑行者在该城市骑车，但对经验丰富的骑行者影响甚微。因此，增加城市路灯的数量可能会______。
中文解析：
研究明确指出“昏暗照明会阻碍新手骑行”，因此增加照明可以直接消除这一障碍，鼓励更多新手参与。

question:
Steiger Butte Drum, a family ensemble from the Klamath Tribes of the Pacific Northwest, collaborated with composer Michael Gordon to create Natural History, a work featuring traditional drumming and vocals alongside an orchestra and chorus. Steiger Butte Drum’s participation is _____ to the piece: members not only contributed to its composition but also must be included in all performances.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
来自太平洋西北部克拉马斯部落的家庭合奏团体Steiger Butte Drum，与作曲家Michael Gordon合作创作了《自然历史》（Natural History）——一部融合传统鼓乐、人声与管弦乐及合唱的作品。Steiger Butte Drum的参与对这部作品是______：成员们不仅参与了作曲，而且必须参与所有演出。
中文解析：
后文用冒号具体说明：该团体不仅参与创作，还必须出席所有演出，这证明他们的参与是“核心的、必不可少的”。“integral”完美呼应了这一绝对必要性，而其他选项（类似、次要、随后）均与语境中强调的关键作用相矛盾。

question:
Research into whether floating mats of macroalgae affect the prevalence of microphytobenthos (MPB)—benthic, or bottom-dwelling, microalgae—has produced varying results: Amber Hardison and colleagues determined that macroalgae do not impact MPB, whereas Kristina Sundbăck and colleagues observed that benthic chlorophyll concentrations (a common measure of MPB biomass) decreased in the presence of macroalgae. Hypothesizing that macroalgal mats have a negative effect on MPB biomass, Alice F. Besterman and Michael L. Pace surveyed mudflats in Curlew Bay and other coastal sites in Virginia. Because Besterman and Pace did not find a significant correlation between benthic chlorophyll concentrations and the abundance of macroalgal mats, it can be concluded that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. rather than inhibiting chlorophyll production in MPB, as they had hypothesized, macroalgal mats may positively affect chlorophyll production.
B. their hypothesis about the relationship between macroalgae and MPB was not supported and their finding was instead consistent with that of Hardison and colleagues.
C. differences between their study design and that of Sundbäck and colleagues likely explain the discrepancy in the two studies’ findings about the responses of MPB to macroalgal mats.
D. although this finding was consistent with that of Sundbäck and colleagues, trends in MPB biomass are likely not a result of stresses caused by macroalgae.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
关于大型藻类（macroalgae）的漂浮垫是否影响底栖微藻（MPB）——即底栖或底部栖息的微藻——的普遍性研究得出了不同的结果：Amber Hardison和同事认为大型藻类不会影响MPB，而Kristina Sundbäck和同事则观察到，在大型藻类存在时，底栖叶绿素浓度（衡量MPB生物量的常用指标）会下降。Alice F. Besterman和Michael L. Pace假设大型藻类垫对MPB生物量有负面影响，并对Curlew湾和弗吉尼亚州其他沿海地点的泥滩进行了调查。由于Besterman和Pace未发现底栖叶绿素浓度与大型藻类垫丰度之间存在显著相关性，因此可以得出结论：______
中文解析：
Besterman和Pace的假设（大型藻类对MPB有负面影响）未被自己的数据支持（无显著相关性），这与Hardison的“无影响”结论一致，而与Sundbäck的“负面影响”结论相反。

question:
Many ranching terms come from Spanish. For example, the word “stockade” (a fence) ______ from the Spanish word estacada, and “cinch” (a belt) derives from cincho. This is because the first Anglo, African, and Native American cattle ranchers in the southwestern US learned the trade from Spanish-speaking Mexican vaqueros, or cowboys.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: word做主语，谓语用三单

question:
The epic poem The Poem of the Cid dates back to the 12th century. Originally ______ in Old Spanish, it has since been translated into other languages.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 过去分词短语written in old spanish放在句首，修饰it。

question:
In his 2023 collection The Diaspora Sonnets, Filipino American poet Oliver de la Paz leverages the sonnet form’s “diamond-like quality of precision,” as he describes it. The poems often adhere scrupulously to the form’s centuries-old conventions, such as its characteristic fourteen-line length. In the twelve-line poem “Diaspora Sonnet at the Feeders Before the Freeze,”______ de la Paz playfully subverts connect conventions, the poem’s truncated length conveying a sense of abruptness.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在他的2023年诗集《离散十四行诗》（The Diaspora Sonnets）中，菲律宾裔美国诗人Oliver de la Paz利用了他所描述的十四行诗形式“如钻石般精确的特质”。这些诗通常严格遵守该形式数百年来的惯例，例如其标志性的十四行长度。在十二行诗《霜冻前喂食处的离散十四行诗》中，______ de la Paz戏谑地颠覆了这些惯例，该诗被截断的长度传达出一种突兀感。
中文解析：
前文强调诗集“通常严格遵守”十四行诗的惯例（如十四行长度），但后文指出这首十二行诗“颠覆了惯例”，前后内容形成鲜明对比。

question:
Though it was designated as mission ______ mission was actually the forty-second flight under NASA’s Space Shuttle Program.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: Though+从句+逗号+主句

question:
A voluntary workforce established to make improvements to public lands, parks, and forests across the US, the Civilian Conservation Corps (CCC) — though widely popular — was not without its critics. For Aldo Leopold, the CCC was implicated in what ______ “Idle CCC camps,” he wrote, “presented a widespread temptation to build new and often needless roads.”

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. did he view as unnecessary development?
B. he viewed as unnecessary development?
C. he viewed as unnecessary development.
D. did he view as unnecessary development.
explanations: In what后面的宾语从句用正常语序，句末用句号结尾

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·An isthmus is a strip of land that connects two larger pieces of land across an expanse of water.
·It is also known as a land bridge.
·The Isthmus of Catalina Island is located in the United States.
·It connects the northwestern part of Santa Catalina Island to the main part of the island.

The student wants to provide a specific example of an isthmus. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. One example of an isthmus is the Isthmus of Catalina Island in the United States.
B. An isthmus, also known as a land bridge, is a strip of land that connects two larger pieces of land across an expanse of water.
C. In the United States, the northwestern part of Santa Catalina Island is connected to the main part of the island.
D. There is a land bridge in the United States.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
· 地峡（isthmus）是一块连接两片较大陆地的狭长土地，中间跨越水域。
· 它也被称为陆桥（land bridge）。
· 卡特琳娜岛地峡（Isthmus of Catalina Island）位于美国。
· 它连接了圣卡特琳娜岛（Santa Catalina Island）的西北部分和主岛部分。
中文解析：
A直接明确地将“卡特琳娜岛地峡”作为地峡的具体实例，并提及其地理位置（美国），完全符合“提供具体例子”的要求，且信息简洁准确。

question:
Trade with neighboring civilizations contributed to the success of the Sasanian Empire, which reigned in Mesopotamia from around 224 CE to 651 CE. By supplying silk, textiles, and leather to societies that lacked these valuable _____ Sasanian Empire grew not only in wealth but also in power and influence.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: by supplying....放在句首作状语，跟后面的句子用逗号隔开，所以选A

question:
·A wind farm uses turbines to convert wind into electrical power.
·Offshore wind farms tend to produce more electricity than farms on land (onshore).
·Offshore wind farms tend to be more expensive to build and maintain than onshore ones.
·Lake Bonney Wind Farm is an onshore wind farm in Millicent, Australia.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to explain the advantages of onshore wind farms over offshore ones?
selections: A. Like other wind farms, Lake Bonney Wind Farm in Millicent, Australia, uses turbines to turn wind power into electricity.
B. Whether onshore or offshore, wind farms harness the power of wind to generate electricity.
C. Millicent, Australia, is home to Lake Bonney Wind Farm.
D. Though they don’t produce as much electricity as offshore wind farms, onshore farms are usually cheaper to build and maintain.
explanations:
中文解析：
题目文本翻译：
· 风电场利用涡轮机将风能转化为电能。
· 海上风电场往往比陆地（陆上）风电场发电量更多。
· 海上风电场的建设和维护成本往往比陆上风电场更高。
· 邦尼湖风电场（Lake Bonney Wind Farm）是位于澳大利亚米利森特（Millicent）的一个陆上风电场。
中文解析：
D选项直接整合了原文的关键对比信息：海上风电场发电量更多（第二句），但陆上风电场成本更低（第三句），从而清晰说明了陆上风电场的经济性优势。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·Wilkie Collins's mystery novel The Woman in White first appeared in a London literary magazine.
· The novel was published in forty weekly installments between November 1859 and August 1860.
·Every installment ended with a moment of unresolved suspense.
·The Woman in White became extremely popular as readers eagerly anticipated the next week’s entry.
·The magazine’s sales increased to a record-breaking 100,000 copies per issue.

The student wants to emphasize how popular The Woman in White became when it was first published. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Woman in White, a mystery novel, first appeared in a London literary magazine.
B. The Woman in White became so popular that sales of the magazine it appeared in increased to a record-breaking 100,000 copies per issue.
C. Collins’s novel The Woman in White was published in forty weekly installments between November 1859 and August 1860.
D. Every installment of The Woman in White ended with a moment of unresolved suspense, which led readers to eagerly anticipate the next week’s entry.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
· 在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
· 威尔基·柯林斯（Wilkie Collins）的悬疑小说《白衣女人》（The Woman in White）最初发表在一本伦敦文学杂志上。
· 该小说于1859年11月至1860年8月期间以每周连载的形式出版了40期。
· 每一期都以未解决的悬念结尾。
· 《白衣女人》变得极其受欢迎，读者热切期待每周的新内容。
· 杂志的销量增加到每期破纪录的10万份。
中文解析：
B选项直接使用了笔记中“极其受欢迎”和“销量破纪录”的具体数据（10万份），以量化结果强有力地证明了小说的流行程度，最符合“强调受欢迎”的目标。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·The Mohs scale of mineral hardness is a ten-point scale that orders minerals by hardness based on their ability to scratch other minerals.
·Minerals with larger numbers are harder than minerals with smaller numbers and can leave visible scratches on them.
·Minerals with smaller numbers are softer than minerals with larger numbers and cannot leave visible scratches on them.
·The mineral apatite has a Mohs scale number of 5.
·The mineral quartz has a Mohs scale number of 7.
·The mineral diamond has a Mohs scale number of 10.

The student wants to emphasize quartz’s Mohs scale number. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Quartz, apatite, and diamond can be ordered by their ability to leave visible scratches on other minerals.
B. Diamond, which has a Mohs scale number of 10, can scratch both apatite and quartz.
C. Quartz has a Mohs scale number of 7, which means that it is harder than apatite (5) but softer than diamond (10).
D. In the Mohs scale of mineral hardness, diamond(10) is ranked higher than apatite (5).
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
· 莫氏矿物硬度表（Mohs scale of mineral hardness）是一个十分度的标准，根据矿物划伤其他矿物的能力按硬度排序。
· 数字较大的矿物比数字较小的矿物更硬，能在其上留下可见划痕。
· 数字较小的矿物比数字较大的矿物更软，无法在其上留下可见划痕。
· 矿物磷灰石（apatite）的莫氏硬度值为5。
· 矿物石英（quartz）的莫氏硬度值为7。
· 矿物钻石（diamond）的莫氏硬度值为10。
中文解析：
C选项直接明确给出了石英的硬度值（7），并通过与磷灰石（5）和钻石（10）的对比，突出了其硬度等级的位置，完美实现了“强调石英硬度值”的目标。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·The dinosaur ant is an insect species.
·It was believed to be extinct until a living dinosaur ant was identified in Australia in 1977.
·Mount Diablo buckwheat is a plant species.
·It was believed to be extinct until a living Mount Diablo buckwheat was identified in the United States in 2005.
·They are considered Lazarus species.
·“Lazarus species” is a term for living species of organisms that were once believed to be extinct.

The student wants to specify when the dinosaur ant was identified. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. An example of a Lazarus species was found in 2005.
B. A living dinosaur ant, once believed to be extinct, was identified in 1977.
C. Previously believed to be extinct, a living dinosaur ant was identified in Australia.
D. Identified in the United States, a living Mount Diablo buckwheat was found in 2005.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
· 恐龙蚁（dinosaur ant）是一种昆虫物种。
· 它曾被认为已灭绝，直到1977年在澳大利亚发现了一只存活的恐龙蚁。
· 迪亚布罗山荞麦（Mount Diablo buckwheat）是一种植物物种。
· 它曾被认为已灭绝，直到2005年在美国发现了一株存活的迪亚布罗山荞麦。
· 它们被认为是“拉撒路物种”（Lazarus species）。
· “拉撒路物种”一词指的是那些曾被认为已灭绝、但后来又被发现存活的生物物种。
中文解析：
B选项直接提取了笔记中关于恐龙蚁的核心信息：其“曾被认为灭绝”的背景以及“1977年被发现”的具体时间点，完全符合“明确说明发现时间”的要求。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·Stop motion animation (SMA) is a filmmaking technique that involves manipulating characters (puppets, clay figures, etc.) by hand in minute increments.
·Each change in position is meticulously captured in a series of images that, when played back, give the illusion of motion.
·Producer Travis Knight: “It’s a process that dates back to the dawn of cinema, with a charm and a warmth and a beauty that other forms of animation... do not have. And because you effectively get one opportunity to get it right, every shot is a high-wire act.”
·Knight: SMA is “raw and it’s imperfect. It’s also undeniably human.”

The student wants to emphasize the aesthetic qualities of SMA by quoting Knight. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. As Knight says, “you effectively get one opportunity to get it right” when meticulously capturing the series of images that, when played back, give it the illusion of motion.
B. With its puppets and clay figures, stop motion animation, Knight says, “dates back to the dawn of cinema.”
C. The handmade, “imperfect” look of stop motion animation, says Knight, lends this “undeniably human” technique a “charm and a warmth and a beauty.”
D. Stop motion animation is imperfect, making every shot “a high-wire act,” Knight says.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
· 定格动画（Stop motion animation，SMA）是一种电影制作技术，涉及手动微调角色（木偶、黏土人物等）的位置。
· 每次位置变化都被精心捕捉到一系列图像中，播放时会产生运动错觉。
· 制片人特拉维斯·奈特（Travis Knight）说：“这是一种可追溯到电影诞生之初的工艺，具有其他动画形式所没有的魅力、温暖和美感。因为你实际上只有一次机会把它做好，所以每个镜头都像走钢丝一样。”
· 奈特：定格动画“原始而不完美，但也无可否认地具有人性化。”
中文解析：
C选项直接整合了奈特对定格动画美学品质的核心描述：“魅力、温暖、美感”（charm, warmth, beauty）、“不完美”（imperfect）和“人性化”（human），完全聚焦于“美学品质”的强调目标。

question:
Lady Grant and colleagues _______ pots of sterilized soil with slurries of live microbes collected from soil in five sites across Colorado, including areas of sagebrush and ponderosa pine forest. Grant and team then grew mustard plants in the pots to see if the different microbial slurries affected levels of spicy glucosinolates like butenyl in the plants’ seeds.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
格兰特女士（Lady Grant）和同事_______了装有灭菌土壤的花盆，方法是向其中添加从科罗拉多州五个地点（包括山艾树和黄松林区域）采集的活微生物浆液。随后，格兰特团队在盆中种植芥菜植物，以观察不同的微生物浆液是否会影响植物种子中辛辣硫代葡萄糖酸盐（如丁烯基）的水平。
中文解析：
语境中，研究人员需要将活微生物引入灭菌土壤中以进行实验，因此需填入表示“添加”或“接种”的动词。“populated”在此意为“使（土壤）充满微生物”，最符合逻辑（如“populated the pots with microbes”）；其他选项“排除”“估计”“消毒”均与实验操作（添加微生物浆液）矛盾。

question:
Blandine Courel and her colleagues analyzed pottery fragments from thirty-five sites across the Volga and Don river basins to determine whether the ways in which hunter gatherer societies used pottery in these regions around 6,500-8,000 years ago were influenced primarily by local food availability or primarily by cultural factors. Analysis of organic residues on the pottery fragments showed different prevailing uses for pottery in these locations — cooking and storing terrestrial animal protein at Volga sites and cooking and storing aquatic animal protein at Don sites — which Courel and colleagues attribute to cultural differences.

Assuming that the Volga and Don basins supported similarly sized hunter-gatherer populations 6,500-8,000 years ago, which finding, if true, would most directly support Courel and colleagues' explanation?
selections: A. Across the Volga and Don basins, people had broadly similar access to the same terrestrial and aquatic animal resources.
B. In both the Volga and Don basins, most of the sites from which pottery has been recovered appear to have been seasonal fishing and hunting encampments rather than year-round settlements.
C. There were many more bodies of water in a comparably sized area in the Don basin than in the Volga basin.
D. The people of the Volga basin acquired the techniques used to create pottery for cooking and storing food from the people of the Don basin.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
布兰丁·库雷尔（Blandine Courel）和她的同事分析了来自伏尔加河和顿河流域35个地点的陶器碎片，以确定在约6500-8000年前，这些地区的狩猎采集社会使用陶器的方式主要是受当地食物供应影响，还是主要受文化因素影响。对陶器碎片上有机残留物的分析显示，这些地点的陶器主要用途不同——伏尔加河流域遗址用于烹饪和储存陆地动物蛋白，而顿河流域遗址用于烹饪和储存水生动物蛋白——库雷尔及其同事将此归因于文化差异。
中文解析：
研究将陶器用途差异归因于“文化差异”而非“食物可用性”，若两地区资源相似（A选项），则排除了环境限制导致用途不同的可能性，直接强化了文化解释的合理性。

question:
In their study of the steering muscles regulating sclerites (minute hardened structures) in the Drosophila (fruit fly) wing hinge, Johan M. Melis et al. used machine learning to devise a convolutional neural network (CNN) model capable of predicting the pattern of wing motion produced by the maximum activity of the muscles. The CNN model’s output aligned with results of prior studies by other researchers measuring muscle activity patterns directly—one of several indications, said Melis et al., that the model accurately represents important biomechanical processes underlying wing motion.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To present evidence from Melis et al.’s study in support of the efficacy of their CNN model
B. To provide an overview of how Melis et al. honed the accuracy of their CNN model
C. To compare results obtained by Melis et al. using their CNN model to prior results obtained from other researcher’ models
D. To account for Melis et al.’s reliance in their study on a CNN model in lieu of direct measurement
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在关于果蝇（Drosophila）翼铰链中调节骨片（微小硬化结构）的转向肌肉的研究中，Johan M. Melis等人使用机器学习设计了一个卷积神经网络（CNN）模型，该模型能够预测肌肉最大活动产生的翼运动模式。CNN模型的输出与其他研究者直接测量肌肉活动模式的先前研究结果一致——Melis等人称，这是该模型准确表征翼运动背后重要生物力学过程的若干迹象之一。
中文解析：
文本核心是展示CNN模型的可靠性：通过“输出与先前研究结果一致”这一证据，直接证明模型能准确模拟翼运动机制（“重要生物力学过程”）。

question:
Northeastern North Carolina’s Camden County is among the most rural counties in the United States: the US Census Bureau classified it as 99.5% rural in 2010. Researchers often struggle to recruit residents of counties like Camden for inclusion in studies. Melissa Valerio and colleagues tested whether an approach called snowball sampling improves recruitment. Working in two rural counties, they recruited a few people (known as “seeds”) with the characteristics desired for a proposed study and asked them to recruit additional participants from their social networks. Though the seeds were given minimal guidance, many more people they recruited had the desired characteristics for the study than would be expected by chance alone, most likely because ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. most seeds’ social networks include some people who do not know one another and who share few characteristics.
B. the seeds’ social networks include a high proportion of people who share characteristics with the seeds.
C. the seeds’ social networks tend to be somewhat smaller than the networks of people who do not live in rural areas.
D. the characteristics that made the seeds desirable for inclusion in the proposed study may be unknown to some members of the seeds' social networks.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
北卡罗来纳州东北部的卡姆登县（Camden County）是美国最乡村化的县之一：美国人口普查局2010年将其分类为99.5%的乡村地区。研究人员通常难以招募像卡姆登这样的县居民参与研究。梅丽莎·瓦莱里奥（Melissa Valerio）和同事测试了一种名为“滚雪球抽样”（snowball sampling）的方法是否能改善招募效果。他们在两个乡村县开展工作，招募了少数符合研究所需特征的人（称为“种子”），并请他们从自己的社交网络中招募更多参与者。尽管种子仅获得极少指导，但他们招募到的人中符合研究所需特征的数量远高于随机预期，这很可能是因为______
中文解析：
“滚雪球抽样”的核心逻辑是：社交网络具有同质性（相似的人相互关联），因此种子会自然接触到更多类似特征的人（如相同 rural 环境、生活方式等），从而高效招募到目标群体。

question:
The following text is from Julia Alvarez's 2000 novel In the Name of Salomé. The narrator and her sister, daughters of a famous poet, are being tutored by Alejandro Román.
Our tutor, Alejandro Román, brought his younger brother, Miguel, to class one day. By now I was eighteen and had learned everything Alejandro had to teach me, so I was glad for a new face. Miguel was an aspiring poet, and he had heard from his brother that the Ureña girls were none other than the daughters of Nicolás Ureña, and they were smart as clockwork. Miguel was hoping not only to meet us but to make the acquaintance of the poet himself at Mamá’s house.
©2000 by Julia Alvarez

Based on the text, why does Miguel accompany his brother to the sisters’ house one day?
selections: A. Miguel has learned all he can from his brother and hopes that the sisters will be able to give him additional guidance.
B. Miguel has not received formal instruction in poetry and wants to ask the sisters' famous father to be his mentor.
C. Miguel aspires to present his poems to the sisters and ask for their opinion on his writing.
D. Miguel anticipates having the opportunity to be introduced to both the sisters and their father.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本节选自朱莉娅·阿尔瓦雷斯（Julia Alvarez）2000年的小说《以萨洛梅之名》（In the Name of Salomé）。叙述者和她的姐姐是一位著名诗人的女儿，由亚历杭德罗·罗曼（Alejandro Román）担任家庭教师。
我们的家庭教师亚历杭德罗·罗曼有一天带了他的弟弟米格尔（Miguel）来上课。那时我已经十八岁，学会了亚历杭德罗能教给我的一切，所以很高兴能看到新面孔。米格尔是一位有抱负的诗人，他从哥哥那里听说乌雷尼亚姐妹（Ureña girls）正是尼古拉斯·乌雷尼亚（Nicolás Ureña）的女儿，而且她们聪明得像钟表一样精准。米格尔不仅希望见到我们，还期待在妈妈家里结识诗人本人。
中文解析：
文本明确提到米格尔“不仅希望见到我们（姐妹），还期待在妈妈家里结识诗人本人（父亲）”，直接对应D选项的双重目的。

question:
In classical Greek and Roman mythology, female characters are typically cast as either villains lacking in psychological depth or passive victims who are marginal to these stories, which usually focus on the exploits of male characters. Recently, a subgenre has emerged in which writers reimagine these stories from the perspectives of their female characters, giving them agency and complex motivations. Purists argue that such efforts represent a distinctively modern tendency to impose our own values on past civilizations, obscuring those civilizations’ beliefs. Defenders of the subgenre counter that reimaginings of the myths for new cultural contexts are almost as old as the myths themselves, suggesting that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. bringing female perspectives to the forefront is not indicative of a novel attitude regarding fidelity to Greek and Roman myths’ ideologies.
B. purists are overlooking a long tradition of adapting Greek and Roman myths to focus on female characters.
C. the complex motivations given to female characters in modern retellings of Greek and Roman myths reflect a recent shift toward psychological depth in fictional representation.
D. modern writers’ foregrounding of female characters is chiefly motivated by a desire to counterbalance the primacy of male perspectives among earlier adaptations of Greek and Roman myths.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在古典希腊和罗马神话中，女性角色通常被塑造成缺乏心理深度的反派或边缘化的被动受害者，这些故事通常聚焦于男性角色的英勇事迹。最近，出现了一种子类型文学，作家们从女性角色的视角重新构思这些故事，赋予她们主动性和复杂的动机。纯粹主义者认为，这种努力代表了一种独特的现代倾向，即将我们自己的价值观强加于过去文明，从而模糊了那些文明的信仰。该子类型的捍卫者则反驳说，为新文化背景重新诠释神话的做法几乎与神话本身一样古老，这表明______
中文解析：
A选项这里的“ideologies”完美地概括了原文中“those civilizations’ beliefs”（那些文明的信仰）。捍卫者想要证明的是，这种改编并非不忠于神话的“ideologies”，因为改编本身就是一个古老的传统。B选项说从女性角度改编是一个很久以来的传统，表述不精准，因为原文说的是“重新诠释神话的做法几乎与神话本身一样古老”，这里reimaginings of the myths是泛指，不是特指从女性视角改编。

question:
While US public charities, like Commonfund, must file Form 990 yearly with the IRS, private foundations, such as the David and Lucile Packard Foundation, must file a different form, 990-PF. In addition, foundations that engage in certain prohibited activities must also file Form 4720 and pay a penalty tax on the money involved. Private foundations are prohibited from holding excess interests in a business enterprise, “self-dealing” (conducting activities that benefit foundation insiders), making taxable expenditures such as outlays for lobbying, and failing to cross a required threshold in making charitable distributions from income. Out of the organizations that filed Form 990-PF in the years 2003-2005,_______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the assertion?
selections: A. a smaller percentage of those that also filed Form 4720 did so because they engaged in self-dealing than the percentage of those that filed Form 4720 because they did not meet the minimum charitable distribution requirement.

B. those that also filed Form 4720 paid a larger penalty for failing to meet a minimum charitable distribution requirement than those organizations that filed Form 990 but also filed Form 4720 for the same reason.

C. those that were also required to file Form 4720 because they had excess holdings in a business enterprise paid, on average, a larger penalty than those organizations that filed Form 4720 because they made taxable expenditures.
D. those that also filed Form 4720 collectively paid larger penalties for failing to meet the minimum charitable distribution requirement than for other reasons.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
美国公共慈善机构（如Commonfund）必须每年向美国国税局（IRS）提交990表格，而私人基金会（如大卫与露西尔·帕卡德基金会）必须提交另一种表格990-PF。此外，从事某些禁止活动的基金会还必须提交4720表格，并就所涉资金缴纳罚款税。私人基金会禁止过度持有企业权益、“自我交易”（进行使基金会内部人员受益的活动）、进行游说等应税支出，以及未达到慈善收入分配的最低要求。在2003-2005年提交990-PF表格的组织中，______
中文解析：
图表显示，“未分配收入”（undistributed income，即未达到慈善分配要求）的罚款比例连续三年（2003-2005）显著高于其他原因（均占50%以上，其他原因均低于20%）。因此，正确选项应指出“未达到慈善分配要求”是罚款最主要的原因（D选项），其他选项（如比较罚款金额大小、或错误关联原因）均与图表数据趋势不符。

question:
The following text is from Jerome K. Jerome’s 1889 novel Three Men in a Boat (To Say Nothing of the Dog). The narrator and two friends are taking a boat down the River Thames in England.
In a boat, I have always noticed that it is the fixed idea of each member of the crew that he is doing everything. Harris’s notion was, that it was he alone who had been working, and that both George and I had been imposing upon him. George, on the other hand, ridiculed the idea of Harris’s having done anything more than eat and sleep, and had a cast-iron opinion that it was he — George himself — who had done all the labour worth speaking of.

Which choice best describes the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To give an overview of a particular situation that the narrator finds puzzling
B. To discuss how the narrator and his friends each contributed to resolving a conflict
C. To convey the narrator’s confidence that he understands the role expected of him in a group
D. To present the narrator’s generalization along with supporting examples from a specific situation
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本节选自杰罗姆·K·杰罗姆（Jerome K. Jerome）1889年的小说《三人同舟》（Three Men in a Boat，又名《三怪客泛舟记》）。叙述者和两位朋友正乘船沿英国泰晤士河而下。
在船上，我总注意到每个船员都有一个固执的想法：自己包揽了所有事情。哈里斯（Harris）认为，只有他一个人在干活，而我和乔治（George）都在占他便宜。另一方面，乔治则嘲笑哈里斯除了吃喝睡觉啥也没干，并坚信自己——乔治本人——才完成了所有值得一提的活儿。
中文解析：
文本开头是叙述者的总体观察（“每个船员都认为自己包揽一切”），随后用哈里斯和乔治的具体矛盾言行作为例证，完美符合“观点+例证”的结构。

question:
Paleontologists think that Buitreraptor, Saltasaurus, and other long-extinct theropods and sauropods may have breathed using air sacs connected to tubelike extensions inside the animals’ bones. Such structures are found in modern birds, which is why some paleontologists treat the respiratory systems of birds as _______ those of Buitreraptor, Saltasaurus, and other theropods and sauropods.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
古生物学家认为，Buitreraptor（鹫盗龙）、Saltasaurus（萨尔塔龙）及其他早已灭绝的兽脚类恐龙和蜥脚类恐龙，可能通过连接骨骼内部管状延伸的气囊呼吸。现代鸟类也存在类似结构，因此一些古生物学家将鸟类的呼吸系统视为Buitreraptor、Saltasaurus及其他兽脚类和蜥脚类恐龙呼吸系统的_______。
中文解析：
文本指出现代鸟类与恐龙有相似呼吸结构，因此古生物学家用鸟类系统替代（proxy）恐龙系统进行研究，即将其作为间接参考模型。“proxies for”精准表达了“替代物”的科学类比关系，其他选项（预示、代表、从属）均无法体现这种“基于相似性的间接研究”逻辑。

question:
Some social scientists argue that while a belief in the importance of individual autonomy is key to democracy, the public’s understanding of economics is also central to its subsequent comprehension of a state’s politics, and if an electorate is to function, economic issues cannot remain the domain only of experts. Economics is too ______ to leave to economists alone.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一些社会科学家认为，尽管对个人自主权重要性的信念是民主的关键，但公众对经济学的理解也对其后续理解国家政治至关重要，并且如果选民要发挥作用，经济问题就不能仅仅是专家的领域。经济学太______，不能只留给经济学家。
中文解析：
前文强调经济问题“不能只是专家的领域”，且公众理解经济学对“理解国家政治”和“选民发挥作用”至关重要，因此经济学太重要（critical），必须由大众参与。其他选项（复杂、可敬、易理解）均无法直接呼应“民主参与”的核心逻辑，且“易理解”（accessible）甚至与“不能只留给专家”的语义矛盾。

question:
To boost the performance of oil-absorbing resins, which are used to remove oil and other organic compounds from wastewater, one team of materials researchers created a resin with a novel —albeit very expensive — monomer (a molecule that can chemically bond with analogous molecules to form polymers) synthesized from β-cyclodextrin. Other researchers have produced resins consisting of various much cheaper, commercially available methacrylate monomers, including one derived from benzyl methacrylate (BZMA). Testing all these resins’ capacity to absorb toluene and trichloromethane, two organic compounds, a scientist concluded that when practical considerations were taken into account, the BZMA-derived resin showed the greatest potential for use in wastewater cleanup.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the scientist’s conclusion?
selections: A. For both toluene and trichloromethane, the BZMA-derived resin exhibited only modestly lower absorption capacity than the resin synthesized from β-cyclodextrin but higher absorption capacity than other resins consisting of commercially available methacrylate monomers.

B. Relative to the resin synthesized fromβ-cyclodextrin and to other resins consisting of commercially available methacrylate monomers, the BZMA-derived resin exhibited superior absorption capacity for toluene but not for trichloromethane.

C. For both toluene and trichloromethane, the BZMA-derived resin exhibited similar absorption capacity as other resins consisting of commercially available methacrylate monomers and a slightly higher absorption capacity than the resin synthesized from β-cyclodextrin.

D. Whereas the resin synthesized fromβ-cyclodextrin exhibited the highest absorption capacity for toluene, the BZMA-derived resin and other resins consisting of commercially available methacrylate monomers exhibited the highest absorption capacity for trichloromethane.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
为了提高吸油树脂（用于去除废水中的油和其他有机化合物）的性能，一个材料研究团队创建了一种新型树脂，其单体（一种能与其他类似分子化学键合形成聚合物的分子）由β-环糊精合成，但成本非常高昂。其他研究人员生产了由各种更便宜、市售的甲基丙烯酸酯单体组成的树脂，包括一种源自甲基丙烯酸苄酯（BZMA）的单体。通过测试所有这些树脂对甲苯和三氯甲烷（两种有机化合物）的吸收能力，一位科学家得出结论：当考虑实际因素时，BZMA衍生树脂在废水净化中显示出最大的应用潜力。
中文解析：
科学家的结论强调“考虑实际因素”（即成本与性能平衡），A选项显示BZMA树脂性能接近昂贵树脂（β-环糊精）且优于其他廉价树脂，直接支持其“最大潜力”的结论（低成本、高性价比）。

question:
The collectibles market is one of the most difficult segments of the consumer economy to ______. Few economists would have predicted, for example, that the prices of collectible stuffed toys called Beanie Babies would soar in the late 1990s, but soar they did.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
收藏品市场是消费经济中最难以______的领域之一。例如，几乎没有经济学家会预测到，一种名为“豆豆娃”（Beanie Babies）的收藏毛绒玩具的价格在1990年代末会飙升，但它们的价格确实飙升了。
中文解析：
后文举例说明经济学家无法预测“豆豆娃”价格飙升（但事实却发生），直接支持“难以预测”这一核心逻辑。

question:
Derived from research conducted with factory workers from 1924 to 1933, the Hawthorne effect suggests that participants’ awareness that they are being studied alters their behavior and influences study outcomes. Since then, several researchers have claimed to invalidate this phenomenon, positing that the Hawthorne effect cannot be ______ because attempts to detect it invariably involve faulty research methods.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
基于1924年至1933年对工厂工人进行的研究，霍桑效应（Hawthorne effect）表明，参与者意识到自己被研究时会改变行为，从而影响研究结果。此后，一些研究者声称这一现象无效，并认为霍桑效应无法______，因为试图检测它的研究总是存在方法缺陷。
中文解析：
后文指出，由于检测霍桑效应的研究“总是存在方法缺陷”（faulty research methods），因此无法可靠地验证这一现象的真实性。“substantiated”（被证实）最符合“通过证据证明”的语义，其他选项（被假设、被纠正、被灌输）均与“研究方法缺陷导致无法验证”的逻辑无关。

question:
Motivated to sell as many paintings as possible, Alfred Hair; an influential figure among the landscape artists known as the Florida Highwaymen, pioneered “fast painting,” which in part involved swift applications of paint. That many of Hair’s acolytes, including Rodney Demps, imitated the technique accounts in part for the impressionistic qualities that are now synonymous with the group’s shared aesthetic. But not all Highwaymen fully embraced this approach; for instance, though Roy McLendon was also prolific, his paintings were executed with greater attention to detail.

What does the text most strongly suggest about paintings by Demps?
selections: A. Demps’s reliance on the technique of fast painting likely accounts for his works being more aesthetically interesting than works by McLendon are.
B. Although it is evident that Demps adopted some of Hair’s preferred techniques, Demps’s works are less derivative of works by Hair than is typically acknowledged.
C. The lack of precision with which they were executed suggests that they are inferior to works by either Hair or McLendon.
D. Because of the manner in which they were created, they likely have visual qualities that are regarded as more typical of Florida Highwaymen paintings than the qualities in works by McLendon are.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
出于尽可能多卖画作的动机，阿尔弗雷德·海尔（Alfred Hair）——被称为“佛罗里达公路画家”（Florida Highwaymen）的风景画艺术家中的一位有影响力的人物——开创了“快速绘画法”，这种方法部分涉及快速上色。海尔的许多追随者（包括罗德尼·登普斯 Rodney Demps）模仿了这一技术，这在一定程度上解释了如今与该群体共同美学同义的印象派特质。但并非所有公路画家都完全接受这种方法；例如，尽管罗伊·麦克伦登（Roy McLendon）同样多产，但他的画作更注重细节。
中文解析：
文本明确指出登普斯模仿海尔的“快速绘画法”，且这种技术造就了“与该群体共同美学同义的印象派特质”；而麦克伦登虽多产但更注重细节（偏离群体典型风格），因此登普斯的作品更代表公路画家的普遍美学。

question:
Advancements like the emergence of wheel-fashioned ceramics in the eastern Mediterranean circa 4500 BCE are overemphasized in innovation studies, contributing to the idea that technological change always brings greater complexity. Research by Nathaniel Erb-Satullo reveals an important exception: gold metallurgy flourished in the Caucasus in the Bronze Age, but a steep drop during that time (circa 1500 BCE) in objects featuring gold granulation (in which tiny gold spheres are applied to a gold surface to create textured designs) and other sophisticated goldsmithing techniques suggests that simpler processes supplanted advanced methods.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It summarizes the findings of several studies into the origins of a particular invention and then presents additional evidence from a more recent study that contradicts those findings.

B. It details the near-consensus among researchers in a particular field of study regarding how technology evolves and then indicates the controversial nature of a study challenging that broadly accepted view.

C. It explains that a particular interpretation of technological development has been perpetuated in an academic field and then provides a counterexample demonstrating that the interpretation isn't always accurate.

D. It advances a claim made by researchers in one academic field about the nature of technological change and then critiques a contrasting claim presented by a researcher from a related academic field.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
创新研究过度强调了诸如公元前4500年左右东地中海地区轮制陶瓷出现之类的进步，这助长了“技术变革总是带来更高复杂性”的观点。纳撒尼尔·厄布-萨图洛（Nathaniel Erb-Satullo）的研究揭示了一个重要的例外：高加索地区的金冶金在青铜时代蓬勃发展，但该时期（约公元前1500年）采用金粒化（将微小金球附着于金表面以创造纹理设计）及其他复杂金匠技术的器物数量急剧下降，表明更简单的工艺取代了先进方法。
中文解析：
文本首先指出创新研究普遍存在“技术变革总带来复杂性”的片面观点（第一句），接着通过Erb-Satullo的研究案例（高加索地区金匠技术简化）作为反例，直接挑战了这一观点的绝对性。

question:
The world's many geothermal power plants leverage an array of _____ the Sarulla plant uses a flash steam system that transforms high-temperature geothermal fluid into steam; in Iceland, the Reykjanes plant's dry steam system pumps superheated steam from a reservoir; and in the US, the McGinness Hills plant's binary cycle system uses lower temperature geothermal fluid in conjunction with a secondary fluid.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 后面属于对于an array of technologies的解释说明，in Indonesia和 in Iceland 以及in the US构成了三着的平行并列。

question:
Architect Victor Gruen, the designer of Illinois’s Lakehurst shopping mall, conceived of the mall as an indoor version of the European town square, a communal space that encouraged visitors to stroll and linger. ______ he designed Lakehurst Mall with long, pedestrian-friendly promenades and ample seating areas clustered around fountains and greenery.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
建筑师维克多·格鲁恩（Victor Gruen）是伊利诺伊州莱克赫斯特购物中心的设计师，他将购物中心构想成欧洲城镇广场的室内版本，一个鼓励游客漫步和逗留的公共空间。______他将莱克赫斯特购物中心设计成拥有长长的、便于步行的长廊和充足的座位区，并围绕喷泉和绿植布局。
中文解析：
前文描述格鲁恩的设计理念（将购物中心视为公共空间），后文具体说明他如何通过设计（长廊、座位区等）实现这一理念，前后是明确的“理念→执行”的因果关系。“Accordingly”自然引出基于前因的结果。

question:
A single specimen of T. iota, collected at a depth of 1,684 fathoms (3,080 meters) in the South Pacific, and a single specimen of P. obliquiloculata, collected at a depth of 260 fathoms(475 meters) in the South Atlantic, have been preserved as exemplars of their respective _______ former in a repository at Washington, DC’s Museum of Natural History and the latter in a repository at London’s Natural History Museum.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: species后面的the former和the latter是对species的解释说明，所以选A，属于句末同位语。

question:
In their attempt to create a quantum random number generator, K. Muhammed Shafi et al. used a continuous-wave diode laser to fire photons at a periodically-poled potassium titanyl phosphate(PPKTP) nonlinear crystal. A plano-convex lens ______ the laser on the center of the 10-millimeter-long crystal ensured a spot size (a measure of the beam’s diameter) of 85 micrometers.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: A plano-convex lens是句子主语，ensured是谓语动词，focus在这里需要用非谓语形式

question:
In Annie Dillard’s Pilgrim at Tinker Creek—where, early on, the author marvels at a single goldfish’s delicate fins but later winces when imagining a horde of goldfish laying and eating their own eggs—Dillard struggles to reconcile the complicated juxtapositions of the natural world.______ nature’s mesmerizing intricacy and pitiless harshness prove inextricably linked for Dillard, like “two branches of the same creek.”

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在安妮·迪拉德（Annie Dillard）的《汀克溪的朝圣者》（Pilgrim at Tinker Creek）中，作者起初惊叹于一条金鱼精致的鳍，但后来想到一群金鱼产卵并吞食自己的卵时又感到不适——迪拉德努力调和自然界中复杂的矛盾并存。______对迪拉德而言，自然令人着迷的精细与无情的严酷证明是不可分割地联系在一起的，就像“同一条溪流的两条分支”。
中文解析：
前文描述迪拉德对自然矛盾的观察与挣扎，后文总结她得出的核心结论（精细与严酷不可分割），体现从过程到结果的逻辑推进。“Ultimately”自然引出最终领悟，其他选项“To that end”（为此）、“Moreover”（此外）或“Hence”（因此）均无法准确体现这种从探索到结论的终结性关系。

question:
For her installation The Last Cruze, photographer LaToya Ruby Frazier traveled to Lordstown, Ohio, where she documented the lives of workers at the local automobile plant. In the installation, text culled from a series of in-depth interviews with employees and their families ______ sixty-seven gelatin silver prints, highlighting the collaborative, documentary nature of Frazier’s work.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主谓一致，text是这个句子的主语，punctuate应该用三单形式。

question:
When a given term — “self-fulfilling prophecies” and “role models” are two well-known examples—is generally accepted and frequently used,______ susceptible to obliteration by incorporation (OBI). In cases of OBI, widely used terms are rarely, if at all, attributed to the individuals who coined them.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: it指代a given term

question:
·Silent films can be valuable historical documents of their time.
·Ninety percent of silent films made before 1930 are now lost.
·A film is considered lost when no remaining copies are known to exist.
·Director Paul Fejos’s 1928 silent film The Last Moment is lost.
·Director Oscar Micheaux’s 1920 silent film Within Our Gates is archived at the UCLA Film & Television Archive in Los Angeles, California.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize a difference between the two movies?
selections: A. While Paul Fejos’s The Last Moment is considered lost to history, Oscar Micheaux’s film Within Our Gates is archived at the UCLA Film& Television Archive in Los Angeles, California.
B. Paul Fejos’s The Last Moment (1928) and Oscar Micheaux’s Within Our Gates (1920) are just two examples of silent films from the 1920s.
C. Oscar Micheaux’s film Within Our Gates can be found at the UCLA Film & Television Archive in Los Angeles, California.
D. Paul Fejos’s 1928 film The Last Moment is among the many lost films of the era.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
· 无声电影可以是其所在时代的珍贵历史文献。
· 1930年之前制作的无声电影有90%现已遗失。
· 当已知没有现存拷贝时，一部电影被视为遗失。
· 导演保罗·费乔斯（Paul Fejos）1928年的无声电影《最后时刻》（The Last Moment）已遗失。
· 导演奥斯卡·米肖（Oscar Micheaux）1920年的无声电影《我们的大门内》（Within Our Gates）存档于加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的UCLA电影与电视档案馆。
中文解析：
A选项直接对比了两部电影的核心差异：一部“已遗失”（lost），另一部“被存档”（archived），并通过“While”引导的转折结构突出这种对立关系，完美实现了“强调差异”的目标。

question:
Long thought to be sessile (immobile), adult Chelonibia testudinaria, barnacles that adhere to sea turtle shells, have been observed to shift slightly in position over time — a phenomenon that has been attributed to the barnacles’ passive displacement by water currents. ______a research team found that adult C. testudinariamoved toward the heads of their sea turtle hosts and thus against the prevailing water flow, behavior consistent with self-initiated locomotion.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
长期以来，成年龟藤壶（Chelonibia testudinaria）——一种附着在海龟壳上的藤壶——被认为固着不动（无法移动），但据观察，它们会随时间推移轻微移动位置。这一现象一直被归因于藤壶被水流被动位移。______一个研究团队发现，成年龟藤壶会向海龟宿主的头部移动，从而逆着主流流向运动，这种行为与自主移动一致。
中文解析：
前文将藤壶移动归因于“被动位移”（水流导致），但后文研究显示藤壶会“逆流自主移动”，直接反驳了前文的传统解释。“Undermining this explanation”精准体现了后文研究对前文观点的否定。

question:
In pre-Columbian Mesoamerica, obsidian was used as a commodity currency. By using specific goods like obsidian as common units of exchange, commodity currency economies streamline trade, which is why they often replaced barter economies. Barter economies eschew ______ that requires what economist W. S. Jevons deems a “double coincidence of wants”—in other words, each trading party must want precisely what the other has.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. currency, in favor of a direct trade system
B. currency in favor of a direct trade system
C. currency, in favor of a direct trade system,
D. currency—in favor of a direct trade system
explanations: 定语从句＂that requires...＂修饰的是整个＂currency in favor of a direct trade system＂（摒弃货币而选择直接交易系统这一行为），而不是仅仅修饰＂currency＂。因此，＂in favor of a direct trade system＂不能作为插入语隔离，否则定语从句＂that requires...＂会只修饰＂currency＂（货币），导致语义错误（货币本身不需要“双重需求巧合”）。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Founded in 2011, Thync is a neurotechnology company that develops neuromodulation technologies.
• Neuromodulation technologies use neural interfaces to stimulate nervous system structures and influence neural activity.
• Founded in 2009, Brain Gate is a neurotechnology company that develops neuroprostheses.
• Neuroprostheses act as replacement brain functions to restore the user’s lost sensory, motor, or neural functions.
•Founded in 2015, Neurable is a neurotechnology company that develops brain computer interfaces (BCIs).
• BCIs interpret and execute brain signals to allow users to control external software or hardware with their thoughts.

The student wants to contrast the type of neurotechnology Thync develops with the type of neurotechnology BrainGate develops. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Founded in 2011, Thync develops technology for stimulating nervous system structures, which, unlike BrainGate and Neurable, is categorized as a neuroprosthestic.
B. Unlike BrainGate, which develops neurotechnology, Thync develops neuromodulation technologies.
C. Neuromodulation technologies influence neural activity, but they don’t restore sensory, motor, or neural functions as neuroprostheses do.

D. Neuromodulation technologies use neural interfaces to stimulate nervoussystem structures and influence neural activity, whereas neuroprostheses allow users to control external software or hardware with their thoughts.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
· 在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
· Thync公司成立于2011年，是一家开发神经调节技术（neuromodulation technologies）的神经科技公司。
· 神经调节技术使用神经接口刺激神经系统结构并影响神经活动。
· BrainGate公司成立于2009年，是一家开发神经假体（neuroprostheses）的神经科技公司。
· 神经假体充当替代大脑功能，以恢复用户丧失的感觉、运动或神经功能。
· Neurable公司成立于2015年，是一家开发脑机接口（BCIs）的神经科技公司。
· 脑机接口解读并执行大脑信号，使用户能够通过思维控制外部软件或硬件。
中文解析：
C选项直接对比了两种技术的核心功能：Thync的神经调节技术“影响”神经活动（非治疗性），而BrainGate的神经假体“恢复”功能（治疗性），精准体现了本质差异。注意：D混淆了神经假体与脑机接口的功能（笔记中“恢复功能”属于神经假体，“思维控制”属于脑机接口）。

question:
In a given rock formation, Viséan rock from 346.7 million years ago might directly abut Selandian rock from 61.6 million years ago, with millions of years of material missing in between. ______ time did not stand still during these intervening years; the unaccounted-for sedimentary material was likely removed from the stratigraphic record via erosion and weathering.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在一个给定的岩层中，3.467亿年前的维宪期（Viséan）岩石可能直接毗邻6160万年前的塞兰特期（Selandian）岩石，中间缺失了数百万年的物质。______在此期间时间并未静止；未被记录的沉积物质很可能通过侵蚀和风化作用从地层记录中移除了。
中文解析：
后文“时间并未静止”是对前文“缺失数百万年物质”的必然性强调（否则时间就静止了），是一种常识性补充，所以选of course。

question: The number of muskrat in a 115-acre area is estimated to be 2,070. What is the estimated population density, in muskrat per acre, of this area?
explanations: 考查的平均值计算，用总数量除以总面积即可。2070/115=18，故选A。

question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>7</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>22</mn></math>, what is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>?
explanations: 考查的基础运算，整体代入会更加简单。7x+5=22，那么2（7x+5）=2*22=44，故选C。

question: There are a total of 3,500 milligrams of phosphorus in a sample of soil. Each kilogram of this sample contains 700 milligrams of phosphorus. Which equation represents this situation, where x is the mass, in kilograms, of the sample of soil?
explanations: 考查的ratio比例关系。1千克样本包含700毫克磷元素，x千克样本包含3500毫克磷元素，对应的比例关系应该是1/x=700/3500，十字交叉相乘，得到700x=3500，故选D。

question: A savings account is opened with an initial deposit of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi mathvariant="normal">$</mi> <mn>9</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>000</mn></math>. The amount of money in the account t years after the initial deposit is given by the function <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>000</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1.02</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mn>2</mn> <mi>t</mi> </mrow> </msup></math>. Which of the following is the best interpretation of the statement <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo data-mjx-pseudoscript="true">"</mo> </mrow> <mtext> </mtext> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> is approximately equal to <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mtext> 12,854.22" </mtext></math> in this context?
selections: A. Every 9 years, the amount of money, in dollars, in the account increases by 12,854.22.
B. 9 years after the initial deposit, the amount of money, in dollars, in the account is 12,854.22.
C. 9 years after the initial deposit, the amount of money, in dollars, in the account has increased by 12,854.22.
D. Every 9 years, the amount of money, in dollars, in the account decreases by 12,854.22.
explanations: 考查的指数函数的解释。f(9)=12854.22，表示t=9的时候，函数值是12854.22。其中t表示钱存入了账户多少年，函数值表示账户的金额，故f(9)=12854.22表示钱存入账户9年，账户金额是12854.22美元。符合该描述的是B选项，故选B。

question: The graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo>−</mo> <mn>11</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>2.2</mn> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>605</mn></math> in the xy-plane has intercepts at <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>a</mi> <mo>,</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mi>b</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. What is the value of ab?
Triangles ABC and DEF are congruent, where A corresponds to D, and B and E are right angles. The measure of angle A is 63°. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle F?
explanations: 考查的全等三角形：两个全等的三角形，对应的角大小相等，对应的边长度相等。角B是直角，那角A+角C就是90度；已知角A是63度，那么角C就是90-63=27度。三角形ABC和三角形DEF全等，角F和角C是对应的角，那角F等于角C，也就是27度。

question: An arborist studying forestland in Illinois estimates that there are at least 40 and no more than 70 hickory trees per acre in a certain forest. Which of the following best represents the arborist's estimate of the number of hickory trees, x, that are in a 7 -acre section of this forest?
explanations: 考查不等式。At least表示大于等于，no more than表示小于等于，根据题目，1 acre土地包含的数的数量是大于等于40，小于等于70，那么7 acre土地中树的数量就是大于等于（40*7=280），小于等于（70*7=490），故选B。

question: A length of 550 meters is equal to how many decimeters? (1 meter = 10 decimeters)
explanations: 考查的单位换算，1 meter=10 decimeters, 那么550 meters= 50 * 10 decimeters= 5500 decimeters。

question: A jar has 170 buttons, and 20% of these buttons are green. How many buttons in the jar are green?
explanations: 考查的百分比。总数量乘以百分比等于对应的数量，即：170*20%=34。

question:
Note: Figure not drawn to scale.
The triangle shown has one side with a length of x inches and two sides each with a length of y inches. The perimeter of the triangle is 63 inches. Which equation represents this situation?
explanations: 考查的三角形的周长等于三条边的和，即：x+2y=63，故选B。

question:

The solution to the given system of equations is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. What is the value of y?
explanations: 考查二元一次方程组的求解。利用消元法消掉x求解y即可。x+21y=38---> 4x+84y=152，将该式与4x+3y=17相减，得到81y=135，故y=5/3或1.666或1.667

question: For the polynomial function p, the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> in the xy-plane crosses through the points <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>,</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>12</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>,</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>14</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>?
explanations: 考查多项式函数。因为y=p(x)通过（0,12）这个点，所以p（0）=12。

question: In the linear function <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi></math>, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>9</mn></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>9</mn></math>. Which equation defines <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi></math>?
explanations: 考查线性函数，把给出的函数值代入选项，选出两组数值都符合的即可。F(0)=9,F(7)=9，这两组数据代入都成立的是A选项，故选A。

question: The function f is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>1</mn> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>11</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>?
explanations: 考查的基础运算，把x=3代入函数表达式即可。f(3)=(1/2)*(3+11)=7，故选C。

question:
