Which table gives four values of x and the corresponding values of y for the given quadratic equation?
explanations: 考查的基础函数，把对应的x值代入函数式，求解对应的y值，然后看哪个选项符合要求即可。F(-1)=(-8)*(2)=-16，符合该组数据的只有C，其他的无需检验，选C即可。

question:
As part of a study on sedimentary habitats, the water temperature was recorded at different depths below the surface of the water in the northern Alboran Sea. The data shown in the scatterplot give the recorded temperature, in degrees Celsius, for 7 depths, in meters, below the surface of the water.
Which of the following is closest to the slope of a line of best fit for the data shown?
explanations: 考查线性函数的斜率。从所给的点中挑选两组，用两点的y坐标之差除以这两点的x左边之差即可。（22.30-21.30）/（15-22）=-0.14，和该数据最接近的是B选项，故选B。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnspacing="1em" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="3pt"><mtr><mtd><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>12</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>18</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>
How many solutions are there to the given system of equations?
explanations: 考查一元二次方程解的个数。<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，当<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi></math>大于0时，该方程有2个实数解；当<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi></math>等于0时，该方程有一个实数解；当<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi></math>小于0时，该方程没有实数解。本题中，把第二个式子转换为y=-2，代入第一个式子整理得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>12</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>20</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，该式的<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi></math>等于（-12）*（-12）-4*3*20=-96小于0.所以该方程没有实数解，故选C

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>=</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>11</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn></math>
What is the smallest solution to the given equation?
explanations: 考查绝对值方程（转换为二次方程）的求解。等号两边都有4，减去它得到|x+4|=|2x-11|，两边平方得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>16</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>44</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>121</mn></math>，整理得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>52</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>105</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，因式分解为（x-15）（3x-7）=0，得到方程的两个解分别是15和7/3，故最小的解应该时候7/3或2.333。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>38</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>32</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
The function g is defined by the given equation. For what value of x does <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> reach its maximum?
explanations:
考查二次函数的顶点。g(x)=（38-2x）（32+2x），该函数的和x轴的两个交点分别是19和-16，它们的中点就是顶点的横坐标，即1.5，故选C。
该题也可以把g（x）的表达式整理成顶点式的样子，即<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>38</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>32</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>19</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>∗</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>16</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>19</mn><mo>∗</mo><mn>16</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow></math>,这里<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi></math>整理成完全平方的的应该是<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1.5</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mn>1.5</mn><mn>2</mn></msup></math>，故x=1.5时，函数值最大。

question: Which of the following lists represents a data set with the smallest standard deviation?
explanations: 考查标准差，一组数据越集中，也就是有更多的数据距离平均值比较近，那这这组数据的标准差就越小。故选B。

question: In triangle EFG, the sum of the measures of angles E and F is 22°. What is the measure of angle G?
explanations: 考查三角形的内角和是180度，E和F的和是22度，那第三个角G就是180-22=158度，故选A。

question: The function g is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>18</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>31</mn></math>. question: The equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>h</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>v</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>273.15</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> </mrow> <mn>5</mn> </mfrac> <mo>+</mo> <mn>32</mn></math> gives the corresponding temperature h, in degrees Fahrenheit, of any substance that has a temperature of v kelvins, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>v</mi> <mo>></mo> <mn>0</mn></math>. If a substance has a temperature of 845.33 degrees Fahrenheit, what is the corresponding temperature, in kelvins, of this substance?
explanations: 考查一次方程的求解，根据题意判断，该题已知h=845.33，求v。代入式子计算得到得到v=725。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnspacing="1em" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="3pt"><mtr><mtd><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>25</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>75</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>
The graphs of the equations in the given system of equations intersect at the point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> in the -plane. What is a possible value of x?
explanations: 考查一元二次方程的求解，因为y=y，所以（x-25）（x-75）=0，故方程的两个解分别是25和75。所以答案是A。

question: Rectangle X has a length of 24 millimeters (mm) and a width of 7.5 mm. Right triangle Y has a base of 60 mm. The area of rectangleX is 3 times the area of right triangle Y. What is the height, in mm, of right triangle Y?
explanations: 考查图形的面积。长方形的面积=3*三角形的面积，也就是length*width=3*(1/2)*base*height，代入数字就是24*7.5=3*（1/2）*60*height，计算得到height是2 。故答案是B。

question: There is a linear relationship between x and y. The table shows three values of x and their corresponding values of y in terms of a constant n. What is the slope of the line in the xy-plane that represents this relationship?
explanations: 考查线性函数的斜率。从所给的点中挑选两组，用两点的y坐标之差除以这两点的x左边之差即可。（n+21-n）/（4-0）=21/4，故选C。

question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>a</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mi>k</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>6</mn> <mi>r</mi></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>b</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>8</mn> <mi>k</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>11</mn> <mi>r</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>3</mn></math>, which expression is equivalent to <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>a</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mi>b</mi></math>?

An exponential function f is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mi>c</mi> <mi>x</mi> </msup></math>, where c is a constant greater than 1 . If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>6</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>25</mn> <mo>⋅</mo> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, what is the value of c?
explanations: 考查指数函数的性质，把函数式代入等式，得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>c</mi> <mn>6</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>25</mn> <mo>∗</mo> <msup> <mi>c</mi> <mn>4</mn> </msup></math>，求解得到C=5 。

question: In triangle RST, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>R</mi> <mi>S</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>S</mi> <mi>T</mi></math> and the length of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>R</mi> <mi>T</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="true">―</mo> </mover></math> is 48 units. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>tan</mi> <mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo> <mi>R</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>7</mn> <mn>24</mn> </mfrac></math>, what is the area, in square units, of triangle RST?
explanations: 考查三角函数，从S向RT做垂直线SA；因为RS=ST，所以A是RT的中点，即RA=RT/2=24。因为tanR=SA/RA=7/24，所以SA=7。那么三角形的面积就是（1/2）*48*7=168。故选A。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>570</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.28</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mi>x</mi><mn>12</mn></mfrac></mrow></msup></math>
The function f gives the value, in dollars, of a certain piece of equipment after x months of use. If the value of the equipment decreases each year by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>p</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> of its value the preceding year,what is the value of p?
explanations: 考查的指数函数，x表示有几个月，x/12就表示有year。那base0.28就是每年减完p%后的结果，那p%=1-0.28=0.72，p就是72。故选C。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>25</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>10</mn><msqrt><mn>39</mn></msqrt><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>p</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>
In the given equation, p is a constant. The equation has exactly one real solution. What is the value of p?
explanations: 考查一元二次方程解的个数。<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，当<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi data-mjx-auto-op="false">ac</mi></mrow></math>等于0时，该方程有一个实数解。把题目中对应的数据代入，得到3900-100p=0，求解该方程得到p=39，故选D。

question: An equilateral triangle has a height of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>21</mn> <msqrt> <mn>3</mn> </msqrt></math> units. What is the length, in units, of one side of this triangle?
explanations: 考查特殊直角三角形。30度、60度、90度三角形的三条边的关系是短直角边：长直角边：斜边=1：根号3:2。现在已知的高度是长直角边，长度是21倍的根号3，那根据边长比例，我们可以知道斜边对应的长度是42。故选A。

question: Which expression is NOT a factor of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>1</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>440</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>4</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mn>56</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>250</mn></math>?
explanations: 考查因式分解，根据<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>a</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>a</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>b</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>a</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mi>b</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>1440</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>4</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mn>56250</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>90</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mn>16</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>4</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mn>625</mn> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mo>=</mo> <mn>90</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mn>4</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>25</mn> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mn>4</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mn>25</mn> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mo>=</mo> <mn>90</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <mn>4</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>25</mn> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>，故选C。

question: In the xy-plane, line r passes through the points <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>12</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>13</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. Line s passes through the point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> and is perpendicular to line r. An equation of line s is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>a</mi> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>c</mi></math>, where a and c are constants. What is the value of c ?
explanations: 考查两根直线slope的求解，以及两根直线的垂直。Line r的斜率是（13-12）/（7-3）=1/4；line s的斜率是-a/7；因为两根直线垂直，所以（1/4）*（-a/7）=-1，计算得出a=28。那line s的表达式就是28x+7y=c。因为line s穿过（1,2），所以可以把该点的坐标代入line s的表达式，也就是28*1+7*2=C，计算可得C=42。

question:
The Apollo Moon landings (1969–1972) brought charged particle detectors and temperature probes to the Moon and produced large amounts of data, much of which was stored on technologies that are now obsolete. Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

由于数据存储在过时技术中，面临无法读取的风险，项目目的是"抢救"（salvage）数据以避免丢失，其他选项（改进/简化/修正）均不符合语境。

question:
Land art, or earth art, is characterized by its large scale and the fact that it’s often placed in remote or surprising locations. Land art is also notable for the wildly diverse ways in which it is created: Robert Smithson’s Spiral Jetty, for instance, was created by arranging rocks in a large spiral in Utah’s Great Salt Lake, whereas for Wheatfield—A Confrontation, Agnes Denes planted and harvested a field of wheat in Lower Manhattan in New York City.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. The text compares two works of art, then provides details about the lives of the artists who created them.
B. The text conveys a definition of a kind of art, then addresses a well established criticism of the art.
C. The text outlines a common misconception about a kind of art, then offers an explanation for why that misconception persists.
D. The text describes a particular genre of art, then cites examples illustrating an important characteristic of that genre.
explanations:
题目文本翻译:
大地艺术（或地景艺术）的特点是其规模宏大，且常位于偏远或出人意料的地点。大地艺术同样因其创作方式的极端多样性而引人注目：例如，罗伯特·史密森的《螺旋防波堤》是通过在犹他州大盐湖中排列岩石形成巨大螺旋而创作的，而阿格尼丝·丹尼斯的《麦田——对抗》则是在纽约市下曼哈顿种植并收获了一片麦田。
中文解析：
文本首句定义了大地艺术的特征（大规模、偏远位置），接着通过“also”引出另一个重要特征（创作方式多样性），并用两个具体例子（Spiral Jetty 和 Wheatfield）来Illustrate（说明）这个特征，完全符合D选项的结构。其他选项均与文本内容不符（A无艺术家生平、B无批评内容、C无误解及解释）。

question:
The following text is from Yung Wing’s 1909 memoir My Life in China and America.
We landed in New York on the 12th of April, 1847, after a passage of ninety-eight days of unprecedented fair weather. The New York of 1847 was altogether a different city from the New York of 1909. It was a city of only 250,000 or 300,000 inhabitants; now it is a metropolis rivaling London in population, wealth and commerce. The whole of Manhattan Island is turned into a city of skyscrapers, churches and palatial residences.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Yung has experienced significant personal growth in the time since his arrival to New York City in 1847.
B. New York City has become more developed and populated since Yung’s arrival in 1847.
C. The journey to New York City was dull and isolating for Yung.
D. New York City is more populated than London is.
explanations:
题目文本翻译:
以下文本节选自容闳1909年的回忆录《西学东渐记》。
“我们于1847年4月12日登陆纽约，途中经历了98天前所未有的晴朗天气。1847年的纽约与1909年的纽约完全不同。当时它是一个仅有25万或30万居民的城市；如今它已是一个在人口、财富和商业上与伦敦相媲美的大都市。整个曼哈顿岛变成了一个摩天大楼、教堂和豪华住宅林立的城市。”
中文解析：
文本通过对比1847年（小城市）和1909年（大都市、摩天大楼、人口激增）的纽约，重点强调城市的发展和变化，而非容闳的个人经历（A、C）或与伦敦的直接比较（D仅部分提及但非主旨）。

question:
Because they penetrate the visible surface of a painting, ultraviolet and other nonvisible spectra of light enable the detection of otherwise imperceptible features of the work. Beneath the surface of Claude Monet’s Wisteria (1917–20), art historians found that Monet had initially included water lilies but ultimately painted over them. Furthermore, nonvisible spectra can be used for chemical analysis to identify specific pigments and thus, in some cases, reveal forgeries: if, for example, titanium oxide—which wasn’t developed until the 20th century—is evident throughout the layers of a painting attributed to an 18th-century artist, that work can only be a forgery.

What does the text most strongly suggest about how analyzing a painting with nonvisible light can inform a judgment about who that painting is attributed to?
selections: A. It can provide new information about the attributed artist’s practices.
B. It can definitively undermine that attribution.
C. It can confirm that attribution with a high degree of confidence.
D. It can show how the work is similar to others attributed to the same artist.
explanations:
题目文本翻译:
由于紫外线和其他不可见光谱能穿透绘画的可见表层，因此可以检测到作品原本难以察觉的特征。在克劳德·莫奈《紫藤》（1917-20）的表层之下，艺术史学家发现莫奈最初画了睡莲但最终覆盖了它们。此外，不可见光谱可用于化学分析以识别特定颜料，从而在某些情况下揭露赝品：例如，如果在一幅据称出自18世纪艺术家的画作各层中明显存在二氧化钛（这种颜料直到20世纪才被开发），那么该作品只能是赝品。
中文解析：
文本明确说明，通过不可见光谱的化学分析若发现“时代错位”的颜料（如18世纪画作中出现20世纪的钛白粉），则能直接证明该作品是赝品（“can only be a forgery”），从而彻底否定原艺术家的归属认定。其他选项虽部分正确（A项对应发现莫奈修改画作），但问题核心是“对归属判断的影响”，文本最强有力的暗示是B项的“ definitive undermine”（明确推翻）。

question:
The US Department of Agriculture’s Fruit and Tree Nuts Outlook is a document that covers a variety of subjects, from the causes of reductions in grapefruit supply to the number of avocados that are imported from abroad. A student studying agricultural economics is consulting a graph in the document that shows the prices for which several types of nuts have been sold by growers in the United States over four growing seasons from 2016 to 2020. The student wishes to determine in which season walnuts reached their lowest price. Consulting the graph, the student finds that this season was the______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement?
explanations:
题目文本翻译:
美国农业部《水果与坚果展望》是一份涵盖多种主题的文件，从葡萄柚供应减少的原因到从国外进口的鳄梨数量。一名学习农业经济学的学生正在查阅该文件中的一张图表，该图表显示了2016至2020四个产季期间美国种植者销售的几种坚果的价格。该学生希望确定核桃在哪个产季价格最低。查阅图表后，学生发现这个产季是______。
中文解析：
根据图表中核桃（walnuts）的价格曲线（图中未直接给出但需基于常识或图表推断），核桃在2018/19产季的价格最低（通常图表会显示该产季价格处于谷底）。其他选项对应的产季价格均高于此产季。

question:
Many ranching terms come from Spanish. For example, the word “lasso” (a rope) _______from the Spanish word lazo, and “cinch” (a belt) derives from cincho. This is because the first Anglo, African, and Native American cattle ranchers in the southwestern US learned the trade from Spanish-speaking Mexican vaqueros, or cowboys.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主谓一致考察，the word “lasso”三单

question:
Fossil evidence indicates that the End-Triassic mass extinction—the relatively sudden die-off of about 80 percent of species (including many species of bivalves)—occurred approximately 201 million years ago. Researchers have identified the effects of a sudden release of carbon dioxide as a possible initial cause of this mass extinction. But mass extinctions, while abrupt in geological terms, unfold over thousands or millions of years: it’s likely that multiple factors drove extensive species loss.

Which choice best states the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It expands on the uncertainty mentioned earlier regarding the pace of extinction of species of bivalves relative to that of other species.
B. It concedes that the pace of mass extinctions as described in the information that follows is perceived differently when considered from another point of view.
C. It offers support for an earlier claim about the primary cause of a mass extinction that is then qualified by the information that follows.
D. It emphasizes that a question about the beginning of a mass extinction raised by the researchers mentioned earlier is still unresolved.
explanations:
题目文本翻译:
化石证据表明，三叠纪末期大灭绝——约80%物种（包括许多双壳类物种）相对突然的消失——发生在大约2.01亿年前。研究人员已确定二氧化碳突然释放的影响是这次大灭绝的一个可能初始原因。但大灭绝（虽然从地质学角度说是突然的）其实持续数千年或数百万年：很可能多种因素共同导致了广泛的物种损失。
中文解析：
划线部分"while abrupt in geological terms"（虽然从地质学角度是突然的）作为让步状语，承认前文"突然灭绝"的说法是从地质时间尺度（数百万年为单位）的宏观视角成立，但随即通过冒号后的内容转折指出实际过程持续数千年以上，暗示从其他视角（如生物进化尺度）看并非真正"突然"，完美对应B选项的"从另一角度会被不同理解"。其他选项均与文本逻辑不符（A未提双壳类特异性、C未支持前文主张、D未强调问题未解决）。

question:
The state of Washington has classified the American bullfrog as an invasive species that could harm some of the state’s native species. But researchers Alejandro Camacho and Jason McLachlan have pointed out that “invasive” and “native” are labels that describe temporary circumstances. Changes in Earth’s climate may force animals from their current ranges. Climate changes may also create good habitats in areas where a species couldn’t live previously. These observations suggest that_______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. Washington was previously home to some American bullfrogs but they were outcompeted by invading species.
B. Washington may eventually need to reexamine its designation of the American bullfrog as invasive.
C. It’s appropriate for Washington to designate certain species as invasive but the state should designate the American bullfrog as native.
D. changes in Earth’s climate are likely to result in the American bullfrog establishing itself as a native species in locations other than Washington.
explanations:
题目文本翻译:
华盛顿州将美国牛蛙列为入侵物种，认为其可能危害该州某些本地物种。但研究者Alejandro Camacho和Jason McLachlan指出，“入侵”和“本地”是描述临时状况的标签。地球气候变化可能迫使动物离开当前栖息地，也可能在物种原本无法生存的区域创造适宜栖息地。这些观察表明_______
中文解析：
研究者强调“入侵/本地”标签是临时的，气候变化会改变物种分布。因此，当前被列为入侵的牛蛙，未来可能因气候驱动成为华盛顿州的“合理居民”，故需重新评估其标签。其他选项均偏离核心逻辑（A无依据，C直接推翻当前分类过于绝对，D未聚焦华盛顿州本身）。

question:
A preserved specimen of the marine protist G. conglobatus collected from the South Atlantic has been identified as the species lectotype, a term _______ that this specimen serves as the basis for all formal scientific descriptions of the species.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 非谓语动词的考察，indicating做term的后置定语

question:
Pollination syndromes are suites of floral traits that have independently evolved as a result of selection pressure exerted by pollinators; ornithophilous (bird pollinated) flowers, for example, frequently exhibit red, orange, or yellow coloring. In a review of previous studies covering 417 plant species, Victor Rosas-Guerrero et al. concluded that the syndromes reliably predict angiosperms’ most effective pollinators. However, in a response paper, Jeff Ollerton et al. note that Rosas Guerrero et al. may have inadvertently excluded studies published before the term “pollinator effectiveness” came into common use.

What does the text most strongly suggest about the study conducted by Rosas-Guerrero et al.?
selections: A. The approach selected by the researchers enabled them to sort through and remove obviously incomplete or inconsistent data before conducting their analysis.
B. Due to the difficulty of gathering representative research on angiosperms, the study may have included previous research with a focus too heterogeneous to be comparable.
C. Because the study contained data on a limited number of plant species, its conclusion is accurate for those species but cannot be applied to species not in the study.
D. A limitation in the methodology used by the researchers may entail that the study’s conclusion is not well supported.
explanations:
题目文本翻译:
授粉综合征是一套花部特征，它们因传粉者施加的选择压力而独立演化；例如，鸟媒花通常呈现红色、橙色或黄色。Victor Rosas-Guerrero等人对覆盖417种植物的既往研究进行综述后得出结论：这些综合征能可靠预测被子植物的最有效传粉者。然而，Jeff Ollerton等人在回应文章中指出，Rosas-Guerrero等人可能无意中排除了在“传粉者有效性”一词常用前发表的研究。
中文解析：
文本指出Ollerton等人批评Rosas-Guerrero的研究方法存在缺陷（无意排除特定时期研究），这直接暗示其结论可能因数据选择偏差而支撑不足。其他选项均未体现这一核心批评：A（肯定数据筛选）与批评方向相反；B（焦点分散）和C（物种有限）并非文本所指出的具体问题。

Most bird species that are capable of flight weigh less than a kilogram (kg), which is not surprising considering the burden that extra body weight puts on a flying animal. But not all flying birds are so light, as we can see most clearly in the example of the _______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the example?
selections: A. Mute swan, which has an average mass of 11.9 kg.
B. Andean condor, which has an average mass below 10 kg.
C. Somali ostrich, which has a higher average mass than the dwarf cassowary.
D. Somali ostrich, which has an average mass of 90.0 kg.
explanations:
题目文本翻译:
能够飞行的鸟类大多体重不足一公斤（kg），考虑到额外体重对飞行动物造成的负担，这并不令人惊讶。但并非所有飞鸟都如此轻盈，这一点在_______的例子中最为明显。

question:
A significant work in the school of thought known as empiricism, John Locke’s “An Essay Concerning Human Understanding”—first published in _______ is essential reading for scholars of philosophy's modern period, which spanned from the 1600s to around 1900.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 双破折号内的插入语考察

question:
New and interesting research conducted by Suleiman A. Al-Sweedan and Moath Alhaj is inspired by their observation that though studies of the effect of high altitude on blood chemistry are______, the effect on blood chemistry of living in locations below sea level, such as the California towns of Brawley and Holtville, has received comparatively little notice.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译:
Suleiman A. Al-Sweedan和Moath Alhaj进行的一项新颖有趣的研究源于他们的观察：尽管关于高海拔对血液化学影响的研究______，但对低于海平面地区（如加利福尼亚州的布劳利和霍尔特维尔镇）生活对血液化学影响的研究却相对较少受到关注。
中文解析：
句中"though"表示转折，后半句指出对低于海平地区的研究"相对较少（little notice）"，因此前半句应表示高海拔研究"很多"，故选B（大量的）。其他选项均无法与"little notice"形成有效转折关系。

question:
Peter Pan is a 1911 novel by J. M. Barrie. In the fantasy novel, a dog named Nana is a nurse (nanny) for the children in the Darling family—Wendy, John, and Michael. The narrator describes Nana as planning for events like a human would:______

Which quotation from Peter Pan best illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “[Mrs. Darling] had found her two older children playing.”
B. “Mrs. Darling loved to have everything just so, and Mr. Darling had a passion for being exactly like his neighbours.”
C. “On John’s [soccer] days [Nana] never once forgot his sweater, and she usually carried an umbrella in her mouth in case of rain.”
D. “Nana, who had been barking distressfully all the evening, was quiet now.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译:
《彼得·潘》是J.M.巴里于1911年创作的奇幻小说。小说中，一只名叫娜娜的狗是达林家族孩子（温迪、约翰和迈克尔）的保姆。叙述者描述娜娜像人类一样为事件做计划：______
中文解析：
选项C直接展示了娜娜像人类一样“提前计划”的行为（记得带毛衣和雨伞），完美契合题干中“像人类一样为事件做计划”的表述。其他选项均未体现“计划”这一核心特征。

question:
Debuting in 1982, San Francisco to Hawai’i Overnight! is just one of the ______ that have been curated by the staff of the San Francisco International Airport.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 这里需要全部用名词复数

question:
After touching down on Mars on May 25, 2008, the Phoenix lander spent 161 days exploring the geology of the red planet, including its many ______To aid in communication, scientists gave informal names like Neverland and Dodo to some of the smaller yet notable rocks discovered.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 这里需要全部用名词复数

question:
In July 2021, consumer goods cost less in Slovenia than in ______ to data from the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development. A set of consumer goods priced at 100 US dollars (USD) in the United States would cost 73 USD in Slovenia but 106 USD in Sweden.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句内标点的考察，according to...句末状语，与前面用逗号隔开

question:
Around 6,000 years ago, humans in eastern Europe began the process of domesticating the wild horse (Equus ferus). _______wild horses were domesticated through selective breeding to be used for transportation and for plowing fields, among other things. The present-day result of this millennia-long process is Equus caballus, a distinct species commonly known as the domestic horse.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
selections: A. To further illustrate this timeline,
B. Over the course of many generations,
C. Similar to the process that began thousands of years ago,
D. As a result of being domesticated,
explanations:
题目文本翻译:
大约6000年前，东欧人类开始了驯化野马（Equus ferus）的过程。_______野马通过选择性育种被驯化，用于运输、耕地等用途。这一长达数千年过程的现今成果是Equus caballus，即通常被称为家马的独特物种。
中文解析：
空格后描述“通过选择性育种驯化”，这是一个需要长期、多代才能完成的过程（对应下文的“数千年”），B选项“经过许多代”最自然衔接。其他选项逻辑不通：A（说明时间线）多余，C（类似过程）无比较对象，D（作为结果）因果倒置（驯化是过程而非结果）。

question:
Broadcasting from the Leech Lake Band of Ojibwe’s lands in northern Minnesota, the Native-run radio station KOJB 90.1 FM does much to serve the local Ojibwe speaking community. ______ it broadcasts local news and music as well as programming in the Ojibwe language.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译:
在明尼苏达州北部Leech Lake奥吉布瓦部落的土地上播出的原住民运营电台KOJB 90.1 FM，为当地奥吉布瓦语社群提供了大量服务。______它播放本地新闻、音乐以及奥吉布瓦语节目。
中文解析：
前后为举例关系

question:
The Willamette meteorite, discovered in the United States in 1902, weighs approximately 31,200 pounds and is the tenth-largest iron meteorite ever discovered on Earth. The Bondoc meteorite, discovered in the Philippines in 1956, is much smaller at 1,959 pounds.______the latter is a story-iron meteorite, and a size difference between meteorites of different compositions isn’t unexpected.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译:
1902年在美国发现的威拉米特陨石重约31,200磅，是地球上迄今发现的第十大铁陨石。1956年在菲律宾发现的邦多克陨石则小得多，仅1,959磅。______后者是一种石铁陨石，而不同成分的陨石存在尺寸差异并不意外。
中文解析：
空格后“后者是石铁陨石（与前者成分不同）”是对前句“尺寸差异巨大”的让步性解释，承认事实但弱化其反常性（“并不意外”）。B选项“诚然”最准确引入这种让步语气，其他选项均不符：A（总结）无总结关系，C（因果）但尺寸差异不是成分不同的结果，D（同义重述）但后句并非前句的简单复述。

question:
From mountains to monuments, deserts to rainforests, and isolated islands to teeming cities, the sites on UNESCO’s World Heritage List are chosen because they hold cultural or natural value that the organization wishes to preserve for future generations.______in 2010, UNESCO recognized the importance of Kiribati’s Phoenix Islands Protected Area, home to one of the world’s largest oceanic coral ecosystems, by adding it to the list as a natural heritage site.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译:
从山脉到纪念碑、沙漠到雨林、孤岛到繁华城市，联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录中的遗址因其具有该组织希望为后代保留的文化或自然价值而被选中。______2010年，联合国教科文组织将基里巴斯的菲尼克斯群岛保护区列为自然遗产地，承认其重要性——该地区拥有世界最大的海洋珊瑚生态系统之一。
中文解析：
前句说明世界遗产的评选标准（具有文化或自然价值），后句以菲尼克斯群岛为例（拥有巨大珊瑚生态系统，符合自然价值标准），两者是因果关系。D选项“因此”最自然衔接这一逻辑，表明该地因符合标准而被列入名录。其他选项均不合理：A（对比）无对立关系，B（顺序）非时间列举，C（同义重述）但后句是具体案例而非前句的抽象解释。

question:
Biologists have yet to agree on a single concept of what defines a species. Thus, numerous competing species concepts are used within the field, a dilemma known as the species problem. The cohesion species concept, described in 1985 by Templeton, defines species in accordance with phenotypic cohesion. The genetic species concept,______ delineated by Baker and Bradley in 2006, organizes species according to genetic similarity.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译:
生物学家尚未就如何定义物种达成单一概念。因此，该领域使用了众多相互竞争的物种概念，这一困境被称为“物种问题”。由Templeton于1985年提出的凝聚力物种概念（cohesion species concept）根据表型凝聚力定义物种。而由Baker和Bradley于2006年______阐述的遗传物种概念（genetic species concept）则根据遗传相似性划分物种。
中文解析：
上下文并列介绍了两种不同的物种概念（一个基于表型，一个基于遗传），两者是对比关系。D选项“另一方面”最准确体现这种对比，其他选项均不符合逻辑：A（举例）会混淆概念类型，B（因果）无因果关系，C（强调事实）但此处无需强调。

question:
Leptoptilos dubius, also known as the greater ______can be found in places like Hakaluki Haor in Bangladesh and Northern Santuk in Cambodia, but more than 80 percent of this endangered stork species is found in Assam, India. There, wildlife biologist Dr. Purnima Devi Barman is on the front lines of a conservation effort that aims to bring adjutants back from near extinction.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 双逗号内的插入语考察

question:
The Museum of Modern Art (MOMA) in New York City has an exhibition of video games that includes Vib-Ribbon from 1999, which museum visitors can play on site, and SimCity 2000 from 1994, which visitors can see only in a video presentation. MOMA claims the video presentations are only for games that would be impractical to display in a playable form, but video games are an inherently interactive medium, a feature that is grossly absent in a video-only presentation.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It provides MOMA’s rationale for a decision that the author critiques.
B. It introduces a fact about video games that the author thinks MOMA did not appropriately consider when choosing which video games to exhibit.
C. It details a criticism of MOMA that the author defends against in the remainder of the sentence.
D. It presents a misconception about video games that the author believes is evident in MOMA’s choice about which video games to exhibit.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
纽约市现代艺术博物馆（MOMA）举办了一场视频游戏展览，其中包括1999年的《Vib-Ribbon》，博物馆游客可以现场试玩，以及1994年的《SimCity 2000》，游客只能通过视频演示观看。MOMA声称视频演示仅适用于那些以可玩形式展示不切实际的游戏，但视频游戏本质上是一种互动媒介，这一特性在仅有视频演示的情况下严重缺失。
中文解析：
划线部分是MOMA的展览方式，即仅以视频形式展示。但作者随后批评了这种做法，指出游戏本质是interactive，仅展示视频忽略了这一核心特性。因此，划线部分的功能是给出MOMA的理由，而作者对此理由进行批判。

question:
The following text is from Alice Wong’s 2022 memoir Year of the Tiger: An Activist’s Life. Wong has just described her tendency to procrastinate when she has a writing deadline.
In the middle of these distractions, a vibe will emerge, a point I want to make, a phrase, a hook, a title for a story, an image. A connection or epiphany can happen while watching or reading something brilliant. By doing “nothing” and daydreaming, I am actually composing, even if words don’t immediately materialize.
@ 2022 by Alice Wong

Based on the text, what does Wong most likely mean when she states that she is “composing”?
selections: A. She is deceiving herself about her true feelings about a subject.
B. She is engaging in an important part of her writing process.
C. She is gathering sources of information to use in her writing.
D. She is being soothed by immersing herself in creative works by other people.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本来自爱丽丝·黄（Alice Wong）2022年的回忆录《虎年：一个活动家的生活》。黄刚刚描述了她在写作截止日期面前的拖延倾向。
在这些干扰的过程中，一种氛围会出现，一个我想表达的观点、一个短语、一个吸引人的钩子、一个故事的标题、一个形象。在观看或阅读一些精彩的作品时，可能会发生一种联系或顿悟。通过“什么都不做”并白日做梦，我实际上是在创作，即使文字并没有立即显现出来。
© 2022 爱丽丝·黄
中文解析：
尽管表面doing nothing或daydreaming，但她实际上通过这种状态获得了灵感、建立了联系，这是在为写作进行构思准备，是创作过程的重要组成部分.

question:
Paleontologists think that Tyrannosaurus, Sauroposeidon, and other long-extinct theropods and sauropods may have breathed using air sacs connected to tubelike extensions inside the animals’ bones. Such structures are found in modern birds, which is why some paleontologists treat the respiratory systems of birds as _______ those of Tyrannosaurus, Sauroposeidon, and other theropods and sauropods.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
古生物学家认为，暴龙、巨颈龙以及其他早已灭绝的兽脚亚目和蜥脚亚目可能通过与动物骨骼内部管状延伸相连的气囊进行呼吸。这种结构在现代鸟类中存在，这就是为什么一些古生物学家将鸟类的呼吸系统视为_______暴龙、巨颈龙以及其他兽脚亚目和蜥脚亚目的呼吸系统的原因。
中文解析：
好得分网站题目的变体，古生物学家通过现代鸟类的气囊结构来作为代表（proxies for），研究已灭绝的恐龙的呼吸系统，因为两者具有相似性，proxy表示替代角色。

question:
Several sociologists have observed that the word “culture,” though commonly used in academic literature, is an ultimately hazy concept—for example, Victoria Bonnell and Lynn Hunt have noted that “many critics have pointed to the vagueness of the concept of culture.” Does the concept of culture encompass knowledge, or laws. or both these things and others? For casual usage, such haziness is permissible——we know culture when we see it—but for researchers, a standardization of the term is called for if sociology is to truly progress.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It lists two essential components of what is referred to by Bonnell and Hunt as “culture.”
B. It presents a point regarding the definition of “culture” on which nonspecialists and specialists tend to disagree.
C. It describes the questions first raised by Bonnell and Hunt’s inquiry into the meaning of the word “culture.”
D. It illustrates a difficulty associated with the meaning of “culture” that the author believes holds back an academic field.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
几位社会学家观察到，尽管“文化”这个词在学术文献中被广泛使用，但它最终是一个模糊的概念。例如，维多利亚·博内尔和林恩·亨特指出，“许多批评者提到了文化概念的模糊性。”文化的概念是否涵盖知识、法律，或者这两者以及其他东西？对于日常用法来说，这种模糊性是可以接受的——我们在看到文化时就知道它是什么——但对于研究人员来说，如果社会学要真正进步，就需要对这个术语进行标准化。
中文解析：
划线句子展示“文化”概念的模糊性，后文强调这种模糊性对研究者有害，因此，该句的功能是具体说明“文化”定义的困难，且这种困难阻碍了学术进步，对应D选项。

question:
Because blue holes (such as the Lost Blue Hole in the Bahamas) and cenotes (such as Cenote Dos Ojos in Mexico) differ in their size, water composition, and type of location, they are not usually viewed as being _______, but both are water-filled sinkholes typically produced by the natural dissolution and collapse of rocks.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
因为蓝洞（如巴哈马的失落蓝洞）和天坑（如墨西哥的双眼天坑）在大小、水的成分和地理位置类型上有所不同，因此它们通常不被视为_______，但它们都是由岩石的自然溶解和坍塌形成的充满水的塌陷坑。
中文解析：
因为blueholes和cenotes在大小、水质和地点上不同，因此它们通常不被认为是类似的，选择analogous

question:
Radamés Cordero et al. have confirmed that twenty mushroom species (including Coprinellus micaceus and species from the genus Russula) maintain subambient temperatures in both their fruited bodies and their mycelium (the root-like hyphae from which the fruited bodies grow), though the benefits of this hypothermic behavior are unclear. Noting that relative coldness was more pronounced in fruiting than in nonfruiting sites of the mycelium—a difference that persisted even after fruited bodies were detached—the researchers speculate that thermoregulation in the mycelium may influence reproductive success.

Which statement about the mycelium of the twenty mushroom species is best supported by the text?
selections: A. Variation in thermoregulation across the mycelium may occur independent of the presence or absence of fruited bodies.
B. The correlation between higher mycelium temperature and greater fruit productivity indicates that successful reproduction may be dependent on thermoregulation in the mycelium.
C. Temperatures in the fruiting areas of the mycelium are lower than in the nonfruiting areas due to differences in the depth and spread of the mycelium within soil or other organic matter.
D. The mycelium generally maintains temperatures lower than those of the fruited bodies even when considering temperature variations between fruiting and nonfruiting sites.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
拉达梅斯·科尔德罗等人确认，二十种蘑菇物种（包括微光伞和红菇属的物种）在其果体和菌丝体（果体生长的根状菌丝）中维持低于环境温度，尽管这种低温行为的好处尚不清楚。研究人员注意到，相对寒冷的现象在果体生长的菌丝与非果体生长的菌丝之间更为明显——这一差异在果体被切离后依然存在——他们推测，菌丝体中的温度调节可能会影响繁殖成功率。
中文解析：
蘑菇的菌丝（root-like hyphae）有些地方长蘑菇（fruited bodies），有些地方不长。研究发现长蘑菇的部位温度更低，而且即使把蘑菇摘掉，这些部位仍然更冷。这说明菌丝自己就能调节温度，和有没有蘑菇挂着没关系。

question:
Text 1
The land that became Grande Terre island split from remnants of the former supercontinent Gondwana approximately 80 million years ago, carrying Gondwanan biota with it, and experienced periodic submersion until 37 million years ago. Some researchers posit that the island’s current biota includes members of Gondwanan clades (i. e., clades predating the split) that persisted by seeking temporary refuge on nearby islands during submergence events.
Text 2
In a recent study, Prashant Sharma and Gonzalo Giribet found that the crown age — the age of the most recent common ancestor of all species in the clade (i. e., the clade’s founder) — is 48.9 million years for Grande Terre’s clade of harvest spiders. Most of the island’s extant biota belong to clades with younger crown ages, however: Jérôme Murienne et al. found that the crown age of Grande Terre’s clade of cockroaches is 2.7 million years, for example.

Taken together, Text 1 and Text 2 best support which statement about the clades of harvest spiders and cockroaches on Grande Terre?
selections: A. The clade of harvest spiders must have originated on Gondwana, but the clade of cockroaches may or may not have.
B. Both the clade of harvest spiders and the clade of cockroaches originated elsewhere and colonized Grande Terre.
C. Neither the clade of harvest spiders nor the clade of cockroaches originated on Gondwana.
D. The clade of harvest spiders originated before Grande Terre split from Gondwana, whereas the clade of cockroaches originated after the split but before the periodic submergence events began.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
文本1
形成格朗德特尔岛的土地大约在8000万年前从前超级大陆冈瓦纳的残余中分裂而出，携带了冈瓦纳生物群，并经历了周期性的淹没，直到3700万年前。一些研究人员假设，该岛当前的生物群包括冈瓦纳谱系的成员（即，分裂之前的谱系），这些成员在淹没事件期间通过在附近岛屿寻求临时避难而得以存活。
文本2
在一项最近的研究中，普拉尚特·夏尔马和冈萨洛·吉里贝特发现，格朗德特尔的捕虾蜘蛛谱系的冠龄——所有该谱系物种的最近共同祖先的年龄——为4890万年。然而，岛上大多数现存生物属于冠龄较年轻的谱系：例如，热罗姆·穆里安等人发现，格朗德特尔的蟑螂谱系的冠龄为270万年。
中文解析：
这两类生物的冠龄（48.9 million and 2.7 million）晚于岛屿分离（80 million），则说明该类群不是和Gondwanna分离时遗留的，C选项正确。

question:
Trade with neighboring civilizations contributed to the success of the Neo-Assyrian Empire, which reigned in Mesopotamia from around 911 BCE to 609 BCE. By supplying grain, textiles, and tin to societies that lacked these valuable_______Neo Assyrian Empire grew not only in wealth but also in power and influence.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: by supplying…做状语，和主句间逗号隔开，D符合要求

question:
“The Monster” is an 1898 story by Stephen Crane. In the story, the character of Jim, a young boy, is playing in his yard while his father mows the lawn; while playing, Jim accidentally damages a peony (a flower). Crane emphasizes Jim’s energy and his distracted absorption in his play by writing, _______

Which quotation from “The Monster” most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “[Jim] went on to the lawn, very slowly, and kicking wretchedly at the turf. Presently his father came along with the whirring machine, while the sweet, new grass blades spun from the knives.”
B. “Jim could do no reparation. He looked again towards his father.”
C. “[W] hen [Jim] swung around the curve at the flower-bed, a wheel of his cart destroyed a peony.”
D. “Little Jim was, for the time, engine Number 36, and he was making the run between Syracuse and Rochester. He was fourteen minutes behind time, and the throttle was wide open.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《怪物》是斯蒂芬·克雷恩于1898年创作的一个故事。在故事中，角色吉姆是一个年轻男孩，他在院子里玩耍，而他的父亲则在修剪草坪；在玩耍时，吉姆不小心损坏了一朵牡丹花（一种花）。克雷恩通过写道，强调了吉姆的活力和他在玩耍中分心而全神贯注的状态。
中文解析：
题目要求支持energy和distracted absorption，高度专注（absorption），又因为太投入而分心（distracted），没注意自己破坏了东西，D选项直接描述了吉姆完全沉浸在想象中（他把自己想象成一列火车，正在全速行驶），这展示了他的能量energy和 distracted absorption完全专注于游戏，甚至忽略了现实.

question:
Disproportionate emphasis on instances of invention, such as the emergence of potter’s wheels circa 4500 BCE, contributes to a pro-innovation bias that_______studies of the history of technology. More attention to technological discontinuance (e. g., the loss of various hunting and fishing implements in Tasmania over thousands of years) is thus a necessary corrective to the dominant view that innovations are steadily and inevitably adopted.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
对发明实例（例如公元前4500年左右陶轮的出现）过分强调，导致了对技术历史研究的_______偏见。因此，更加关注技术的中断（例如，塔斯马尼亚数千年间各种狩猎和捕鱼工具的丧失）是对“创新始终且不可避免地被采纳”这一主流观点的必要修正。
中文解析：
过度关注发明实例会导致pro-innovation渗透技术史研究领域，这种偏见普遍存在且扭曲了视角，便是普遍存在用pervade。

question:
Among the small magazines animating New York’s vibrant literary scene in the early twentieth century was ______ by Harold Loeb and featuring artwork by Pablo picasso, Henri Matisse, and Juan Gris; poetry by William Carlos Williams and Jean Boomer; and fiction by Sherwood Anderson, this magazine publicized the work of influential avant-garde writers and artists of the day.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 文本中有两个主谓，也就是两个独立的句子，他们之间只能是用句号或者分号连接，两句话并不是并列关系，所以选B。

One journalist claims that to overcome what director Bong Joon-ho calls “the one-inch-tall barrier of subtitles,” it is essential for a film to receive an Oscar nomination: non-English language films that are not given this public indication of high quality will struggle to find an audience compared with those that do receive Oscar nominations.

Which choice best describes data from the table that weaken the journalist's claim?
selections: A. Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon, which was recognized by the Oscars, had lower opening weekend earnings but higher lifetime earnings than Huevos: Little Rooster's Egg-cellent Adventure, which was not recognized by the Oscars.
B. Instructions Not Included was not recognized by the Oscars but had higher lifetime earnings than Eat Drink Man Woman, which was recognized by the Oscars.
C. Although the opening weekend earnings were $7,846,426 for Instructions Not Included and $3,424,702 for Huevos: Little Rooster's Egg-cellent Adventure, neither film was recognized by the Oscars.
D. Although both Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon and Eat Drink Man Woman were recognized by the Oscars, Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon had higher lifetime earnings.
explanations:

美国电影院中，最具商业成功的影片很少是用英语以外的语言制作的。一位记者声称，为了克服导演奉俊昊所称的“只有一寸高的字幕障碍”，一部电影获得奥斯卡提名是至关重要的：未获得这一高质量公开认可的非英语影片相比那些获得奥斯卡提名的影片，将更难找到观众。

question:
In 2008, the US state of Hawaii enacted rate stability regulations (RSRs), constraining insurance companies’ latitude to raise premiums (the periodic fees policyholders pay to maintain insurance policies) after policies are in effect. RSRs are effective at protecting existing policyholders from price volatility, but Naoki Aizawa and Ami Ko note that since dynamic pricing of premiums is an important risk-mitigation tool for insurers, RSRs may lead some insurers to scale back or entirely cease selling new policies in the affected market, thereby reducing the competitive pressure that typically restrains premium prices for new policies. Thus, Hawaii’s RSRs may_______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. benefit policyholders at the expense of nonpolicyholders seeking to acquire policies.
B. reduce premium price volatility once policies are in effect but increase risks for policyholders.
C. prevent large increases in premium prices for new policies despite leading to fewer insurers offering such policies in the affected market.
D. be more advantageous for insurers than they are for either current or prospective policyholders.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在2008年，美国夏威夷州实施了费率稳定规定（RSRs），限制了保险公司在保单生效后提高保费（保单持有人为维持保险政策而定期支付的费用）的自由度。RSRs有效地保护了现有保单持有人免受价格波动的影响，但相泽直树和小天阿美指出，由于保费的动态定价是保险公司重要的风险缓解工具，RSRs可能导致一些保险公司减少或完全停止在受影响市场上销售新保单，从而减弱通常限制新保单保费价格的竞争压力。因此，夏威夷的RSRs可能会_______。
中文解析：
RSR限制保险公司对现有保单提高保费，保护了现有保单持有人（policyholders）免受价格波动影响（benefit policyholders）。但RSRs可能导致保险公司减少或停止销售新保单（scale back or cease selling new policies），损害了想要购买新保单的非保单持有人（nonpolicyholders）的利益，于是A符合

question:
Uncle Vanya: Scenes from Country Life in Four Acts is an 1898 play by Anton Chekhov, originally written in Russian. In the play, Professor Serebrakoff and his wife Helena have come to stay at their country estate, which Vanya manages with the help of Sonia, the professo’'s daughter from a previous marriage. Chekhov portrays Vanya as feeling underappreciated by the professor, as is evident when_______

Which quotation from a translation of Uncle Vanya most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. Vanya says to Professor Serebrakoff, “For twenty-five years I have managed this place [the estate], and have sent you the returns from it like the most honest of servants, and you have never given me one single word of thanks for my work, not one-neither in my youth nor now.”
B. Professor Serebrakoff says to Helena, “Of course I see that it is foolish for me to live so long, but wait! I shall soon set you all free. My life cannot drag on much longer.”

C. Vanya says to Professor Serebrakoff, “We used to think of you as almost superhuman, but now the scales have fallen from my eyes and I see you as you are! You write on art without knowing anything about it. Those books of yours which I used to admire are not worth one copper kopeck. You are a hoax!”

D. Vanya says to himself, “I was proud of [Professor Serebrakoff] and of his learning; I received all his words and writings as inspired and now? Now he has retired, and what is the total of his life? A blank!”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《万尼亚舅舅：乡村生活的场景》是安东·契诃夫于1898年创作的四幕剧，最初用俄语写成。在剧中，教授塞雷布拉科夫和他的妻子海伦娜来到他们的乡村庄园度假，而万尼亚在教授的女儿索尼亚的帮助下管理着这座庄园。契诃夫描绘了万尼亚感到教授对他的贡献不够重视，这一点在_______时显而易见。
中文解析：
题目要求找出最能证明“万尼亚觉得自己不被教授赏识”的台词。A选项直接表明：万尼亚为教授管理庄园25年，却从未得到一句感谢，这完美体现了“不被赏识”的感受。

question:
Saeed M. Z. A. Tarabieh conducted a study of consumer attitudes toward Jordanian food and beverage companies and found that for consumers who value environmental conservation, their likelihood of purchasing a product decreased when their perception of the product’s risk of causing environmental harm increased. Subsequently, other researchers conducted a study of various demographic groups in Vietnam, investigating participants’ intentions to purchase a new skin-care product, and found that, on average, parents of small children had the lowest perception among all the demographic groups in the study of the environmental risks of the skin-care product. Assuming that the results of Tarabieh’s study are broadly applicable, this finding suggests that _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. parents of small children likely prioritize other factors over a product’s environmental sustainability when making purchasing decisions.
B. there is not a meaningful difference in the average likelihood of purchasing environmentally friendly products among the demographic groups included in the study.

萨伊德·M·Z·A·塔拉比耶进行了关于消费者对约旦食品和饮料公司的态度的研究，发现对于重视环境保护的消费者来说，当他们对产品造成环境危害的风险认知增加时，购买该产品的可能性会降低。随后，其他研究人员对越南的不同人口群体进行了研究，调查参与者购买新护肤产品的意图，并发现，拥有小孩的父母在所有研究中的人口群体中对护肤产品的环境风险的认知普遍最低。假设塔拉比耶研究的结果具有广泛的适用性，这一发现表明_______。

有小孩子的父母（感知风险最低）购买该产品的可能性可能最高（比其他群体更可能购买）。

●Cranberries are fruits that contain ascorbic acid.

●There is 13 mg of ascorbic acid per every 100g of cranberries.
●Humans cannot make ascorbic acid in their bodies, so they must get it from foods, including fruits and vegetables.
●Ascorbic acid is also known as vitamin C.

The student wants to refute a claim that cranberries are a better source of vitamin C than brussels sprouts are. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Brussels sprouts contain ascorbic acid (also known as vitamin C), and cranberries do too.
B. Brussels sprouts contain vitamin C (also known as ascorbic acid); in fact. there is 80 mg of vitamin C in every 100g of brussels sprouts.
C. With 80 mg of vitamin C per every 100g, brussels sprouts are actually a better source of vitamin C than cranberries, which contain only 13 mg per every 100g.

在研究一个主题时，学生做了以下笔记：
- 球芽甘蓝是含有抗坏血酸的蔬菜，抗坏血酸是人类所需的重要营养素。

question:
Postcranial skeletal pneumaticity (PSP), a system of skeletal air sacs, occurred in three Cretaceous clades, including pterosaurs (e.g., Pteranodon); past studies have hypothesized that the trait was homologous (originating from a shared ancestor). With this in mind, Tito Aureliano et al. examined fossils of common ancestors of the clades using microtomography, finding openings in bones — a possible indicator of PSP — but of sizes inconsistent with PSP. The team reported other findings contradicting the homology hypothesis as well, concluding that PSP likely evolved independently in each clade.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Aureliano et al. found openings in bones in fossils of common ancestors of pterosaurs and two other Cretaceous clades, but the team determined that the sizes of the openings were too varied to be indicative of PSP, thereby weakening the homology hypothesis.

B. Although past studies by paleontologists concluded that PSP in pterosaurs and two other Cretaceous clades was likely attributable to a common ancestor, those paleontologists lacked access to technology that led Aureliano et al. to reach a different conclusion.

C. Previous studies hypothesized that PSP originated in a shared ancestor of pterosaurs and two other clades, but the findings of Aureliano et al. suggest that PSP evolved independently in pterosaurs and was subsequently inherited by the other two clades.

D. Aureliano et al. found that pterosaurs and two other Cretaceous clades with PSP likely lacked a common ancestor with the trait, leading the team to posit a different evolutionary origin for PSP than that posited in earlier studies.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
后颅骨骼气腔（Postcranial skeletal pneumaticity，PSP）是一种骨骼气囊系统，出现在三个白垩纪的类群中，包括翼龙（例如，普特拉诺登（Pteranodon））。过去的研究假设这一特征是同源的（源自共同祖先）。考虑到这一点，蒂托·奥雷利亚诺（Tito Aureliano）等人使用微断层扫描技术检查了这些类群共同祖先的化石，发现骨骼中存在开口——这可能是PSP的指示，但其大小与PSP并不一致。研究小组还报告了其他与同源假说相矛盾的发现，得出结论认为，PSP可能在每个类群中独立演化。
中文解析：
过去的研究假设PSP这一特征在三个白垩纪演化支中是同源的（homologous），Aureliano等人的团队为了验证这个假设，使用显微CT技术检查了这些演化支共同祖先的化石。他们发现了一些可能是PSP指示的骨孔，但其尺寸与PSP不一致，并且还发现了其他与同源假说相矛盾的发现，因此，团队得出结论：PSP更可能是evolved independently in each clade的，而不是从一个共同祖先那里继承来的。
exam_name: 2025年8月第4套阅读语法（M1和M2合并版，重题较多）

question:
Belonging to neither the minimalist nor the abstract art movements but heavily influencing both, Constantin Brâncuşi spent his sculpting career returning to the same few themes — a kiss, a sleeping head, and a bird in flight — each rendered in pristine, simple, almost abstract forms. Perhaps the most famous example is Bird in Space (1941), a tall, slender bronze sculpture that arcs upward in a manner suggestive of flight but that otherwise lacks any identifiable characteristics of a bird. Despite the seeming simplicity of his works, the exacting standards to which Brâncuși held his work meant that he produced relatively few pieces over his career. There is thus something of a disparity between ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the themes Brâncuși explored and the themes favored by artists he inspired.
B. Brâncuşi’s importance to the history of art and his total artistic output.
C. the nature of much of Brâncuși’s work and the abstraction of Bird in Space.
D. Brâncuşi’s relatively limited productivity and the diversity of his sculptures.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
不属于极简主义或抽象艺术运动，但对两者都有着深刻影响的康斯坦丁·布朗库西（Constantin Brâncuşi）在他的雕塑生涯中不断回归于同几个主题——一个吻、一颗沉睡的头颅和一只飞翔的鸟——每个主题都以纯净、简单、几乎抽象的形式呈现。或许最著名的例子是《飞鸟》（Bird in Space，1941），这是一座高挑、纤细的青铜雕塑，向上弯曲，暗示着飞行，但却缺乏任何可识别的鸟类特征。尽管他的作品看似简单，但布朗库西对自己作品的严格标准意味着他在职业生涯中创作的作品相对较少。因此，在______之间存在一定的差距。
中文解析：
Brâncuși对艺术史非常重要，但他一生创作的作品总数却非常少，所以他在艺术史上的重要地位和他实际留下的作品数量很少之间的巨大反差。

Domestic sheep’s wild ancestor, the mouflon, has a coarse outer coat and an inner coat of wool fiber that is finer in diameter and therefore much softer. In some domestic breeds, such as the Spanish Merino, the outer fiber is only marginally coarser than the inner, and the wool is soft overall. Thus, Merino wool is ideal for delicate garments worn against the skin. Meanwhile, the Navajo-Churro has been selected to retain the marked distinction between outer and inner fiber that the Merino has lost. Being coarser than Merino wool overall, Navajo-Churro wool yields a more durable yarn, which Diné (Navajo) weavers use in their celebrated rugs. Yet a comparison of the fiber characteristics of all three sheep reveals that ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the text?
selections: A. the Navajo-Churro more closely resembles its ancestor, the mouflon, in the uniform softness of its inner fiber, while the Merino more closely resembles the mouflon in the variable diameter of its outer fiber.

B. domestication resulted in a counterintuitive increase in the inner fiber’s minimum diameter, making the inner fiber of the Merino and the Navajo-Churro less suitable for delicate garments than the mouflon’s inner fiber is.
C. the domestication of the mouflon and the subsequent selection process that produced the Merino and the Navajo-Churro resulted in greater softness of outer and inner fiber alike.

D. the selection process that enabled the Navajo-Churro to retain its somewhat coarse outer fiber also resulted in inner fiber that, at its softest, is softer than either the mouflon’s or the Merino’s inner fiber.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
家养羊的野生祖先穆夫隆（mouflon）具有粗糙的外层毛发和内层细腻的羊毛纤维，后者直径更细，因此更加柔软。在某些家养品种中，如西班牙美利奴羊（Spanish Merino），外层纤维的粗糙度仅略大于内层纤维，整体羊毛也很柔软。因此，美利奴羊毛特别适合用作贴身穿着的精致服装。同时，纳瓦霍-丘罗羊（Navajo-Churro）在选育过程中保留了外层和内层纤维之间明显的区别，而美利奴羊则失去了这种特征。纳瓦霍-丘罗羊毛总体上比美利奴羊毛粗糙，产生的纱线更加耐用，迪内族（纳瓦霍）织工使用这种纱线制作他们著名的地毯。然而，对这三种羊的纤维特征进行比较后显示，______。
中文解析：
读图结论： Navajo-Churro的内层纤维最细可至10微米，比Mouflon（15微米）和Merino（最细17微米）更软（直径越小越软）。
选项D直接利用这一数据：Navajo-Churro的内层纤维在最软时（10微米）比另外两种羊都软，且与其粗糙外层纤维（35+微米）形成鲜明对比，符合“保留差异”的描述。

question:
The glossy ibis and the little blue heron are long-legged birds that live in wetlands, like the Everglades in Florida. Laura D’ Acunto and colleagues wanted to know how these birds choose an area in which to live. They looked at features of the birds’ habitats, such as the geographic location of the area and how deep the water is during breeding season. They found that although only glossy ibises prefer areas with deep water during breeding season, both glossy ibises and little blue herons prefer areas that have standing water for more than 60 days per year. The researchers therefore concluded that neither species is very drawn to areas where ________

B. there are any features that attract the other species.

两种鸟类都喜欢一年中有积水超过60天的区域。因此，研究人员得出结论：这两种鸟都不会被“一年中积水远少于60天”的区域所吸引

question:
Subsequent to simulating an attack to elicit defense responses in three caterpillar species, ecologists placed a treatment group of those individuals in an enclosure where they were exposed to slight, harmless ambient electric field shifts like those created by common predatory wasps in flight. When exposed to the treatment, cinnabar moth caterpillars and scarce vapourer moth caterpillars remained coiled in a defensive position for an average of 71 seconds and 87 seconds, respectively, whereas European peacock butterfly caterpillars continued to flail defensively for 20 seconds. Meanwhile, in a control group, all individuals (from all three species) resumed neutral behavior in less than one-tenth of a second after the simulated attack. These results suggest that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. some species of caterpillars are able to detect potential threats via changes in ambient electric fields.
B. in some caterpillar species, the type and duration of defensive responses to electric field shifts varies based on the size of the shifts.
C. European peacock butterfly caterpillars are more sensitive to changes in ambient electric fields than are cinnabar moth caterpillars or scarce vapourer caterpillars.
D. caterpillar species with the sensory acuity to detect small changes in ambient electric fields may also be able to cause shifts in those fields.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在对三种毛虫进行攻击模拟以引发防御反应后，生态学家将这些个体中的一个处理组放置在一个围栏中，暴露于轻微、无害的环境电场变化中，这些变化类似于普通捕食性黄蜂飞行时产生的电场。当暴露于这种处理时， cinnabar 蛾幼虫和稀有蒸汽蛾幼虫分别以平均71秒和87秒的时间保持卷曲的防御姿势，而欧洲孔雀蝶幼虫则继续在防御状态下挣扎了20秒。同时，在对照组中，所有个体（来自三种物种）在模拟攻击后不到十分之一秒就恢复了中性行为。这些结果表明，______。
中文解析：
比起control group，暴露于微弱电场的三种毛毛虫都保持了长时间的防御姿态，treatment group的毛毛虫是因为感知到了环境中由黄蜂飞行产生的微弱电场变化，因此，它们能通过电场变化来探测潜在威胁。

question:
High-reward flowers that produce nectar with relatively high sugar concentrations are thought to be especially attractive to stripe-throated hermits and other hummingbird species. But when María A. Maglianesi and team monitored hummingbird visits to flowering plants, including Palicourea tomentosa, at Los Cusingos Bird Sanctuary and other sites in Costa Rica, they found that visit frequencies weren’t influenced by nectar traits. Rather, physical compatibility of flower corollas (collections of petals) and hummingbird bills more strongly predicted hummingbird-plant interaction patterns.

Which statement about hummingbird preferences is most strongly supported by the text?
selections: A. Hummingbirds consistently prefer plant species whose flowers have physical traits that are compatible with their bills but offer relatively low nectar rewards.

B. The floral traits that most strongly influence which plant species hummingbirds prefer may result in certain hummingbird species visiting flowers with relatively low nectar rewards over those with higher nectar rewards.
C. Hummingbirds’ preferences are primarily driven by trait-matching between their bills and flower corollas, though nectar qualities are a secondary factor driving their preferences.

D. Physical compatibility between flower corollas and hummingbird bills becomes an important factor that influences hummingbird preferences when hummingbirds are uncertain about which plants produce high-reward nectar.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
被认为高回报的花朵产生相对高糖浓度的花蜜，特别吸引条喉隐鸟和其他蜂鸟种类。然而，当玛丽亚·A·马利亚内西（María A. Maglianesi）及其团队在哥斯达黎加的洛斯库辛戈斯鸟类保护区及其他地点监测蜂鸟对开花植物（包括帕利库雷亚·托门托萨（Palicourea tomentosa））的访问时，他们发现访问频率并不受花蜜特征的影响。相反，花冠（花瓣的集合）与蜂鸟喙的物理兼容性更强地预测了蜂鸟与植物之间的互动模式。
中文解析：
文本明确指出，研究人员发现蜂鸟访问花朵的频率不受花蜜特性（如高糖浓度）的影响（visit frequencies weren’t influenced by nectar traits）。相反，花冠与蜂鸟喙的物理兼容性（physical compatibility）是预测它们互动模式的更强因素（more strongly predicted）。
exam_name: 2025年8月第4套阅读语法（M1和M2合并版，重题较多）

question:
Text 1
For decades, ornithologists assumed that if they saw a singing Cassin’s finch — a bird species found in temperate North America — they must be observing a male trying to attract a mate or claim territory. As Peter J. B. Slater and Nigel I. Mann have emphasized, however, a similar assumption can’t be made about birds in the tropics, where females sing as often as males do. Slater and Mann call for more research on this discrepancy between tropical and temperate female birdsong.
Text 2
Recent evidence shows that a female Cassin’s finch is as capable of song as a male is. In fact, female birdsong is more common among temperate species than currently assumed, claim Evangeline Rose and colleagues. These female songbirds sing less frequently than males do, and in duller tones, making it “easy for researchers to miss the quiet and hidden females and focus on the loud and colorful males,” says Rose.

Which choice best describes a difference in what the author of Text 1 and the author of Text 2 believe about female birdsong?
selections: A. The author of Text 2 thinks that among tropical species, females sing less frequently than males do, whereas the author of Text 1 thinks that females sing as frequently as males do.
B. The author of Text 2 would likely disagree with the author of Text 1 about whether it can be assumed that females of temperate species don’t sing.
C. The author of Text 2 believes that female birdsong is much more common among tropical species than the author of Text 1 believes.
D. The author of Text 2 would likely reject the claim by the author of Text 1that among tropical birds, females sing as frequently as males do.
explanations:
文本1
几十年来，鸟类学家们认为，如果他们看到一只正在鸣唱的卡辛雀（Cassin’s finch）——一种栖息在温带北美的鸟类——他们一定是在观察一只雄性鸟在试图吸引配偶或宣示领土。然而，正如彼得·J·B·斯莱特（Peter J. B. Slater）和奈杰尔·I·曼（Nigel I. Mann）所强调的，关于热带鸟类的假设却不能如此简单，因为热带地区的雌鸟和雄鸟一样常常鸣唱。斯莱特和曼呼吁对热带和温带雌鸟鸣唱之间的这一差异进行更多研究。
文本2
最近的证据表明，雌性卡辛雀与雄性一样具备鸣唱能力。实际上，埃万杰琳·罗斯（Evangeline Rose）和同事们声称，在温带物种中，雌鸟的鸣唱比目前认为的更为普遍。这些雌性鸣鸟的鸣唱频率低于雄鸟，且音调更为单调，这使得罗斯表示：“研究人员容易忽视安静而隐蔽的雌鸟，反而专注于那些响亮而色彩鲜艳的雄鸟。”
中文解析：
文本2明确指出，雌性Cassin's finch和雄鸟一样有能力鸣叫（as capable of song as a male is），并且在温带物种中，雌鸟鸣叫比目前假设的要更普遍。因此，文本2的作者很可能会不同意文本1的作者所提到的那个传统假设（即认为温带物种的雌鸟不鸣叫）。选项B准确地描述了这个分歧。
exam_name: 2025年8月第4套阅读语法（M1和M2合并版，重题较多）

question:
Political scientists have asserted that by providing succinct and clear information about candidates and issues, campaign advertisements should reduce the differences in political knowledge observed between groups of voters. Cognitive scientists have noted, however, that existing domain knowledge facilitates the acquisition of new information in that domain. Valentino et al. shed light on this issue by presenting control ads or ads for George W. Bush or Al Gore (candidates in the 2000 US presidential election) to participants with low or high existing political knowledge, then quizzing participants on their understanding of both candidates’ positions.

Taken together, information in the text and graph best support which conclusion about the campaign ads used in the study by Valentino et al.?
selections: A. They appear to have benefited high-knowledge participants more than they benefited low-knowledge participants, which lends more support to the view advanced by political scientists than to the view advanced by cognitive scientists.
B. They appear to have had an effect contrary to the effect that political scientists expect campaign ads to have, possibly due to the phenomenon that cognitive scientists have identified.

C. They appear to have worsened the problem that political scientists claim that campaign ads should alleviate, possibly because the phenomenon identified by cognitive scientists appears not to have occurred.
D. They appear to have had the result that political scientists predict that campaign ads will have, but only for high-knowledge participants, which is what cognitive scientists would expect.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
政治科学家们认为，通过提供简洁明了的候选人和问题信息，竞选广告应能减少不同选民群体之间观察到的政治知识差异。然而，认知科学家指出，现有的领域知识有助于在该领域获取新信息。瓦伦蒂诺等人通过向具有低或高政治知识的参与者展示控制广告或乔治·W·布什（George W. Bush）或阿尔·戈尔（Al Gore，2000年美国总统选举的候选人）的广告，来阐明这个问题，然后对参与者对两位候选人立场的理解进行测验。
中文解析：
竞选广告反而扩大了高低知识水平选民间的认知差距，这符合认知学家知识越多学得越快的论断，与政治学家的预期相反。简单说就是懂得越多的学新的越快。
exam_name: 2025年8月第4套阅读语法（M1和M2合并版，重题较多）

question:
The following text is from a 1955 translation of Samuel Beckett’s 1951 novel Molloy (translated by the author and Patrick Bowles). In the text, Molloy has arrived at the town ramparts, an elevated walkway atop the city walls.
And having cleared the ramparts I had to confess the sky was clearing, prior to its winding in the other shroud, night. Yes, the great cloud was ravelling, discovering here and there a pale and dying sky, and the sun, already down, was manifest in the livid tongues of fire darting towards the zenith, falling and darting again, ever more pale and languid, and doomed no sooner lit to be extinguished.
©1955 by Grove Press, Inc.

As used in the text, what does the word" manifest" most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本摘自塞缪尔·贝克特（Samuel Beckett）于1951年出版的小说《莫洛伊》（Molloy）的1955年译本（由作者和帕特里克·鲍尔斯（Patrick Bowles）翻译）。在文本中，莫洛伊已经抵达城墙上的城镇城垛，这是城墙上的一个高架步道。
“当我走出城垛时，不得不承认天空开始放晴，准备迎接另一个裹尸布，夜幕。是的，巨大的云层在散开，时而显露出一片苍白而垂死的天空，太阳已经落下，出现在向天顶飞舞的苍白火舌中，起伏不定、时而落下又时而跃起，愈发苍白、无力，注定一旦点燃就会熄灭。”
中文解析：
在文本中，太阳已经落下（the sun, already down），但它的存在通过惨白的火舌（livid tongues of fire）显现出来，这些火舌向天顶闪烁（darting towards the zenith）。Manifest在这里描述太阳虽然已落山，但其效果仍然是可见的、能感知到的。
exam_name: 2025年8月第4套阅读语法（M1和M2合并版，重题较多）

question:
The Silence of Dean Maitland is one of twenty-five works from the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries reissued in 2020 in a project professing to give overdue credit to authors by replacing nonfemale pseudonyms with the authors’ given female names (crediting Mary Tuttiett rather than Maxwell Gray, in this case). Olivia Rutigliano and other scholars cite a lack of nuance and erasure of intention in the implication that pseudonymous identities were invariably necessary due to social roles, appropriately contending that what may have been a constraint for some was an elective exercise in self-fashioning for others.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. A literary project is briefly described, the stance taken by Rutigliano and others in response to that project is introduced, and then support for that stance is expressed.

B. Details about a reissue of The Silence of Dean Maitland are given, a question about the authorship of that work is raised, and then the circumstances of the work’s original publication are considered.
C. The Silence of Dean Maitland is cited as a prominent work from a literary movement, a study of the movement’s defining features is mentioned, and then one of the study’s insights is presented.
D. An assertion about a literary project is reported, the team of scholars that advanced the assertion is identified, and then the reasoning behind the assertion is summarized.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《迪恩·梅特兰的沉默》（The Silence of Dean Maitland）是2020年重新发行的二十五部十九世纪和二十世纪初作品之一，该项目旨在给予作者应有的认可，通过用作者的真实女性姓名替代非女性化笔名（在这种情况下，使用玛丽·图蒂埃特（Mary Tuttiett）而非麦克斯韦·格雷（Maxwell Gray））。奥利维亚·鲁蒂利亚诺（Olivia Rutigliano）和其他学者指出，这种暗示笔名身份是由于社会角色而不可避免的说法缺乏细致入微的考量和对意图的抹杀，恰当地辩称，对某些人而言，可能是一种约束的东西，对其他人来说却是一种自我塑造的选择性实践。
中文解析：
首先简要描述了一个文学项目，然后介绍了Rutigliano等学者对此项目所持的立场，接着表达了对该立场的支持；

question:
The metal displayed in the structure of House in Kamiaraya by Kazuto Nishi Architects and the metal hardware in UE House by GENETO are representative aspects of a juxtaposition common in contemporary Japanese architecture: the _______ of sleek, contemporary elements and traditional organic materials in a single design is a trend with both aesthetic and highly practical purposes.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
由西建筑事务所（Kazuto Nishi Architects）设计的神原屋（House in Kamiaraya）中的金属结构以及GENETO设计的UE House中的金属五金，都是当代日本建筑中常见的对比特征：将流畅、现代元素与传统有机材料结合在同一设计中的_______是一种具有美学和高度实用目的的趋势。
中文解析：
文本描述了日本当代建筑中一个常见的特点：将光滑的现代元素（sleek, contemporary elements）和传统的有机材料（traditional organic materials）并置（juxtaposition）在同一个设计中。这种并置不仅仅是为了美观，也有很强的实用目的，Synthesis表示合成综合符合题意

question:
Topographical prominence is a measure of a mountain’s independence from other mountains. Having 9,721 feet of prominence, ________

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. Pico do Ramelau, a peak located in Timor-Leste, is ranked by geographers as the world’s 98th most prominent mountain.
B. the list of mountains geographers rank as the world’s most prominent includes Pico do Ramelau, a peak located in Timor-Leste, at number 98.
C. geographers have ranked Pico do Ramelau, a peak in Timor-Leste, as the world’s 98th most prominent mountain.

question:
At the Museum of Natural History in Washington, DC, a single specimen of the planktonic marine organism B. pumilio is preserved as the reference organism for the species. This specimen is a holotype, meaning it was the basis of the first formal scientific description of B. pumilio. ________ the reference organism for the planktonic G. inflata, preserved at the Natural History Museum in London, is a neotype, meaning it acts as a reference organism but is not the exact specimen originally described.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：

By contrast在这里用于突出两种标本类型之间的关键区别，一个是 holotype，另一个是 neotype（替代品，并非最初描述的依据）
