因为不能确定动物数量具体情况，于是也能确定保护策略是否真的有效

question:
The following text is from Louise Erdrich’s 1986 novel The Beet Queen. The narrator discusses her relationship with her young niece, Dot. Celestine, the narrator’s sister-in-law, is Dot’s mother.
Dot and I had a mental connection, I was sure of it. I understood things about the baby that her mother could not accept.
For instance, she was never meant to be a baby.
Dot was as impatient with babyhood as I. She tried at once to grow out of it. Celestine never saw that, because she, and only she, took pleasure in Dot’s helpless softness. Only Celestine was saddened by her daughter’s fierce progress. Day by day, Dot grew stronger. In her shopping-cart stroller she exercised to exhaustion, bouncing for hours to develop her leg muscles.
©1986 by Louise Erdrich

Which choice best describes the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To present the narrator’s belief that she understands Dot better than Celestine does
B. To speculate that when Dot is older, her personality will be like Celestine’s
C. To discuss what the narrator and Celestine do to amuse Dot
D. To compare the narrator’s physical appearance to the physical appearance of Celestine
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本来自路易丝·厄德里克1986年的小说《甜菜女王》。叙述者讨论了与她年轻的侄女Dot的关系。叙述者的嫂子Celestine是Dot的母亲。
我确信我和Dot之间有一种心灵上的联系。我理解关于这个婴儿的一些事情，而她的母亲却无法接受。例如，她从来不应该是个婴儿。Dot对婴儿期的耐心与我一样少。她立刻试图摆脱这个阶段。Celestine从未看到这一点，因为只有她自己享受Dot那种无助的柔软。只有Celestine对女儿的迅速成长感到伤心。一天又一天，Dot变得越来越强壮。在她的购物车推车里，她不断锻炼，跳跃数小时以锻炼她的腿部肌肉。
中文解析：
从文本开始I understood the things …全文都在表述自己更加了解Dot，比起Dot的妈妈

question:
Carcinization, or the evolution of a crablike body form, has taken place in crustaceans many times over the last 250 million years. Decarcinization has occurred several times as well, even though it involves the loss of traits such as sideways walking that seem to have helped carcinized groups persist in a variety of ecosystems. In a 2021 paper, Joanna Wolfe and team note that many decarcinized groups are extinct and have very few living relatives— signs that decarcinization might be an “evolutionary dead-end.” But the team also discusses frog crabs, a living decarcinized group with traits suited to dwelling in sediment; fossils show that the group had decarcinized members as far back as the Early Cretaceous. This example suggests that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the evolutionary benefits of a crablike body form are less certain than many studies of carcinization had previously implied.
B. despite having many living relatives, some decarcinized groups did not benefit from decarcinization.
C. sideways walking may have been less important to the survival of frog crabs than a protected abdomen and other traits associated with carcinization.
D. a crablike body form may not be optimal in all cases, with ecological conditions sometimes favoring the persistence of decarcinization.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
“癌变化”或螃蟹状体型的演化在过去的2.5亿年中在甲壳类动物中发生过多次。“去癌变化”也发生过几次，尽管它涉及失去一些特征，比如侧行，这些特征似乎帮助了癌变类群在多种生态系统中存活。Joanna Wolfe及其团队在2021年的一篇论文中指出，许多去癌变类群已经灭绝，并且几乎没有活着的亲属——这表明去癌变化可能是一个“进化的死胡同”。但该团队也讨论了蛙蟹，这是一种现存的去癌变类群，具有适合栖息在沉积物中的特征；化石显示，该类群早在早白垩世就已经出现了去癌变的成员。这个例子表明，________。
中文解析：
根据文本decarinization确实会失去很多特征，也就是并非最优进化，但是最后的发现证明有白垩纪到现在存活，说明decarinization也产生进化的有利之处，对应了D选项

question:
Women like Dorothy T. Blum made important early contributions to the history of US cryptology, a field concerned with secure data communication and storage. Blum provided cryptological services for the US Army in the 1940s and then joined the National Security Agency (NSA). She was a pioneer in transitioning the NSA to using computers for cryptoanalysis. In this way, Blum and others like her helped make it possible for more women— such as Maureen Baginski, who currently works in intelligence and supports the FBI— to enter the field of cryptology.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Cryptology is a field that focuses primarily on securely managing data.
B. Women such as Dorothy T. Blum and Maureen Baginski have contributed to the field of cryptology.
C. Dorothy T. Blum and Maureen Baginski worked together on an important project in the field of cryptology.
D. Cryptology should be taught more often in schools to encourage more women to enter the field.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
像多萝西·T·布鲁姆这样的女性对美国密码学的历史做出了重要的早期贡献，密码学是一个涉及安全数据通信和存储的领域。布鲁姆在1940年代为美国陆军提供密码服务，随后加入了国家安全局（NSA）。她是推动NSA转向使用计算机进行密码分析的先驱。通过这种方式，布鲁姆和她这样的其他人帮助更多女性进入密码学领域，例如目前在情报领域工作并支持联邦调查局的莫琳·巴金斯基。
中文解析：
文本主要描述了一些女性对于cryptology的贡献，B选项概括了主旨

question:
Adelaide is one of many cities that have installed pontoons or other hardening structures to protect their shorelines against coastal hazards. To assess how birds respond to shoreline hardening and other landscape alterations, Diann Prosser et al. used a tool known as the Index of Waterbird Community Integrity to survey bird communities consisting of sixty-four species, including the tundra swan and the great blue heron, in the Chesapeake Bay on the US East Coast. The researchers concluded that shoreline hardening more negatively affects birds than does land development for uses such as housing.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It introduces a certain technique, mentions the hypothesis of a study into an ecological consequence of that technique, and presents evidence in support of that study’s hypothesis.
B. It provides an example of a location that has adopted a particular approach, explains the methodology of a study into an ecological effect of that approach, and describes a finding of that study.

C. It makes a claim about the use of a specific strategy, describes field observations of a consequence of that strategy in a particular ecosystem, and makes a supposition based on those observations.

D. It presents a solution to a commonly occurring problem, summarizes the procedures used by a group of researchers studying the environmental impact of that solution, and notes the significance of the researchers’ findings.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
阿德莱德是众多安装浮桥或其他硬结构以保护海岸线免受沿海灾害影响的城市之一。为了评估鸟类对海岸线硬化以及其他景观变化的反应，Diann Prosser等人使用了一种名为“水鸟群落完整性指数”的工具，调查了包括苔原天鹅和蓝鹭在内的64种鸟类群落，这些鸟类生活在美国东海岸的切萨皮克湾。研究人员得出结论，相较于土地开发（如用于住房建设），海岸线硬化对鸟类的负面影响更大。
中文解析：
按照好得分老师说的structure顺序概括，文本先描述了一个地点Adelaide用了pontoons和其它的加固海岸结构，然后具体买描述了Diann他们的研究，最后是发现（finding）这些加固结构对于birds的消极影响。B满足要求

question:
Over the course of the 1900s, more and more Native Hawaiians spoke English instead of the Hawaiian language. To preserve their language, Native Hawaiian teachers founded the ‘Aha Pūnana Leo preschool in 1984. They spoke Hawaiian while teaching, and their Native Hawaiian students were soon able to understand and speak it themselves. The school was a huge success. Eventually it opened locations around Hawai’i and started teaching Hawaiian to elementary and high school students too. Thanks to ‘Aha Pūnana Leo, the number of young people who speak the language has increased.

Which statement, if true, would most directly support the underlined claim?
selections: A. Besides Native Hawaiians, tens of thousands of people from other Pacific Islander communities live in Hawai’i today, including over 37,000 Samoans.
B. Fewer than fifty children could speak Hawaiian when ‘Aha Pūnana Leo was founded, but now more than 2,000 students at ‘Aha Pūnana Leo speak it.
C. Hawaiian is very similar to other languages that are spoken on the Polynesian Islands of the Pacific Ocean, including Tahitian, Samoan, and Mãori.
D. Roughly 680,000 Native Hawaiian people lived in the United States in 2020, and a little less than half of them lived in Hawai’i.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在20世纪，越来越多的夏威夷原住民开始说英语，而不是夏威夷语。为了保护他们的语言，夏威夷原住民教师于1984年创办了‘Aha Pūnana Leo学前班。他们在教学时使用夏威夷语，原住民学生很快就能理解并自己说这门语言。该校取得了巨大的成功，后来在夏威夷各地开设了分校，并开始教授小学和中学生夏威夷语。多亏了‘Aha Pūnana Leo，会说这门语言的年轻人数量有所增加。
中文解析：
画线句说因为Aha Punana Leo，说夏威夷语的年轻人多了，B选项用具体数据说明了人口的增加，满足要求

question:
The dates that archaeologists assign to most of the colossal sculptures of human heads produced by the Olmec civilization of Mesoamerica are necessarily ________. The majority of the sculptures have been moved from their original context, making precise dating impossible.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
考古学家给美索美洲奥尔梅克文明所制作的大多数巨大人头雕塑所赋予的日期必然是______。大多数雕塑已经被移离其原始环境，这使得精确的年代测定变得不可能。
中文解析：
根据最后说precise dating impossible,于是前面选择approximate，表示日期只能是大约接近的

question:
Traditionally, certain features of mosque architecture are nearly ________, such as the mihrab (or niche), which almost all mosques include. But mosques can also be built to reflect a multitude of different architectural styles, as in the case of the Great Mosque of Central Java, which includes elements from the Javanese and Greek revival styles.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
传统上，清真寺建筑的某些特征几乎是________，例如几乎所有清真寺都包含的米哈拉布（或壁龛）。但清真寺也可以建造得反映多种不同的建筑风格，比如中爪哇大清真寺，它结合了爪哇风格和希腊复兴风格的元素。
中文解析：
根据后面such as例子中讲这些features所有的mosque中都会包含，于是选择universal表示普遍的

question:
Scientists discovered a 390-million-year-old fossilized forest of Calamophyton trees in modern-day England. The scientists believe the emergence of these Calamophyton forests changed the land significantly. For example, the tree roots would have greatly reduced soil erosion, and the accumulated twigs the trees shed likely created new habitats for animal life.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It suggests that there are likely fossilized Calamophyton forests from before 390 million years ago.
B. It provides two competing views of when the Calamophyton forest likely merged.
C. It illustrates how Calamophyton forests likely changed conditions on the land.
D. It indicates how fast the Calamophyton forest spread.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
科学家在现代英格兰发现了一个距今3.9亿年的化石化Calamophyton树木森林。科学家们认为，这些Calamophyton森林的出现显著改变了土地。例如，树根会大大减少土壤侵蚀，而树木脱落的积累树枝可能为动物生活创造了新的栖息地。
中文解析：
画线句是具体的例子具体解释（illustrate）前文change the land部分，C描述合理

question:
________ traditional descriptions of pollination syndromes (suites of floral traits, such as nectar composition and symmetry, hypothesized to have independently evolved as a result of selection pressure exerted by pollinators) and recent empirical observations of floral-trait combinations have led some ecologists to express reservations about the utility of those descriptions.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
传统的授粉综合征描述（即花朵特征的组合，如花蜜成分和对称性，假设是由于授粉者施加的选择压力而独立进化的）以及最近的实证观察结果使一些生态学家对这些描述的实用性表示怀疑。
中文解析：
根据文本traditional description and recent observation有出入，生物学家才是expressive reservations about…表示持保留意见

question:
As an object-oriented computer programming language, Perl is used by coders like Black Girls Code founder Kimberly Bryant to create computer programs by manipulating “objects” (that is, specifically defined variables or combinations of variables) into interacting with each other. Conversely, languages like Scheme, used in software development, ________ object oriented.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: languages作主语，是复数，对应的系动词需要are

question:
Creating personas — brief profiles of imaginary characters that represent key segments of a customer base — can help user experience (UX) designers think like and empathize with those using their products. Fictional yet realistic, ________

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. these personas include specific details (demographics, browsing habits, etc.) that UX designers draw from actual users.
B. specific details that UX designers draw from actual users (demographics, browsing habits, etc.) are included in these personas.
C. UX designers include specific details (demographics, browsing habits, etc.) drawn from actual users in these personas.
D. actual users are the source of the specific details (demographics, browsing habits, etc.) that UX designers include in these personas.
explanations: fictional yet realistic的主语就是these personas，A符合要求

question:
Although the term “balloonomania” — referring to the hot-air balloon fad in England and France in the late 1700s— might suggest that the public as a whole was captivated by the technology, it was not universally ________ whereas many flocked to balloon launches and purchased balloon-themed items ranging from dinnerware to accessories, others dismissed the hot-air balloon as an impractical and dangerous extravagance.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 前后链接完整的句子，且是解释关系用冒号连接

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
· India Arie is an African American singer and songwriter.
· The media outlet BBC Music has described her music as a “blend of hip hop, soul and folk [that is] as subtle as it [is] inspired.”
· Her acclaimed albums feature many talented musicians.
· Judeth Insel played viola on her first studio album, Acoustic Soul (2001).• Ricky Quiñones played guitar on her second studio album, Voyage to India (2002).

The student wants to emphasize a difference between Judeth Insel and Ricky Quiñones. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Judeth Insel played on India Arie’s first studio album, Acoustic Soul, which was released one year before her album Voyage to India.
B. Both musicians have played on India Arie albums, but Judeth Insel played viola, whereas Ricky Quiñones played guitar.
C. Acoustic Soul and Voyage to India, released in 2001 and 2002, respectively, are albums by singer and songwriter India Arie.
D. Judeth Insel and Ricky Quiñones have both lent their musical talents to albums by India Arie.
explanations:
在研究一个主题时，一位学生做了以下笔记：
· 印度阿里（India Arie）是一位非裔美国歌手和词曲创作人。
· 媒体机构BBC音乐将她的音乐形容为“嘻哈、灵魂和民谣的融合，既微妙又富有灵感”。
· 她备受赞誉的专辑中有许多才华横溢的音乐家参与。
· 朱迪思·因塞尔（Judeth Insel）在她的第一张录音室专辑《声乐灵魂》（Acoustic Soul，2001）中演奏了中提琴。
· 瑞奇·奎尼昂斯（Ricky Quiñones）在她的第二张录音室专辑《印度之旅》（Voyage to India，2002）中演奏了吉他。
中文解析：
题目要求两个人的不同指出，B选项指出了俩人的乐器不同

question:
In February 1864, James Johnson joined the US Army. He went on to serve in the 18th New York Cavalry during the US Civil War and, ________ earned a place in US history as one of the war’s few Chinese-born American soldiers.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在1864年2月，詹姆斯·约翰逊加入了美国陆军。他在美国内战期间服役于第18纽约骑兵团，并且，______获得了美国历史上作为为数不多的华裔美国士兵之一的地位。
中文解析：
前面描述James继续在civil war期间服役，后面是获得历史地位，前后为因果关系，前因后果，于是选in doing so，表示这样做 （之后的结果）

question:
In premodern Europe, one could sail from the east coast of England to the Netherlands or France faster than one could travel by land to England’s capital, London. In that era, historian Michael Pye argues in his 2015 book The Edge of the World: A Cultural History of the North Sea and the Transformation of Europe, the North Sea did more to link the various peoples, cultures, and economies on ________ shores than to divide them.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: its代指前面的north sea‘s

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·A supercontinent is a single landmass made up of most or all of Earth’s continents.
· Over time, continents merge together to form supercontinents, which then break apart.
· This process is believed to take hundreds of millions of years and is known as the supercontinent cycle.
· Vaalbara was a supercontinent that formed about 3.6 billion years ago.
· Euramerica was a supercontinent that formed about 300 million years ago.

The student wants to emphasize the order in which the supercontinents were formed. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Vaalbara and Euramerica were both supercontinents, single landmasses made up of most or all of Earth’s continents.
B. The supercontinent Euramerica formed long after the supercontinent Vaalbara.
C. Forming and breaking apart over hundreds of millions of years, supercontinents are made up of most or all of Earth’s continents.
D. Vaalbara formed about 3.6 billion years ago but eventually broke apart.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记：
· 超大陆是由地球大部分或全部大陆组成的单一陆块。
· 随着时间的推移，大陆会合并形成超大陆，然后又分裂开来。
· 这一过程被认为需要数亿年的时间，称为超大陆周期。
· 瓦尔巴拉是一个大约在36亿年前形成的超大陆。
· 欧亚美洲是一个大约在3亿年前形成的超大陆。
中文解析：
题目要求supercontinents的形成顺序，B根据最后两条ntoes描述了两个supercontinents的前后顺序

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
· Grimanesa Amoros is a Peruvian American artist well known for her LED light sculptures.
· Uros Island (2011) is from her Uros series of works.
· It is made of smooth multicolored LED domes.
• Golden Connection (2013) is from her Huanchaco series of works.
· It is made of entangled blue and white LED tubes.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between Uros Island and Golden Connection. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Grimanesa Amoros often employs LED lights in her work, but the smooth LED domes of Uros Island stand in contrast to the tangled LED tubes of Golden Connection.
B. Uros Island and Golden Connection are two LED light sculptures by well-known artist Grimanesa Amoros.
C. In 2011, Grimanesa Amoros debuted Uros Island, a part of her Uros series.
D. Many of Grimanesa Amoros’s sculptures, like Uros Island and Golden Connection, incorporate LED lights in the form of domes or tubes.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一位学生记录了以下笔记：
· 格里曼莎·阿莫罗斯是一位著名的秘鲁裔美国艺术家，以她的LED灯光雕塑而闻名。
· 《乌罗斯岛》（2011）是她乌罗斯系列作品中的一件。
· 它由光滑的多彩LED圆顶构成。
· 《金色连接》（2013）是她胡安查科系列作品中的一件。
· 它由缠绕的蓝色和白色LED管道构成。
中文解析：
题目要求描述两部LED作品的不同，A指出了不同，比如LED domes and LED tubes

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
· Refrigerants are chemical compounds used in cooling technologies, such as air conditioners.
· Air conditioners can use refrigerants to absorb heat and release cold air.
· The refrigerant dichloromethane is a hydrochlorocarbon (HCC).
· HCCs are composed of the elements hydrogen, chlorine, and carbon.
· The refrigerant tetradecafluorohexane is a perfluorocarbon (PFC).
· PFCs are composed of fluorine and carbon.

The student wants to contrast dichloromethane and tetradecafluorohexane. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Dichloromethane, a hydrochlorocarbon, is composed of hydrogen, chlorine, and carbon; tetradecafluorohexane, a perfluorocarbon, is composed of fluorine and carbon.
B. Dichloromethane and tetradecafluorohexane are chemical compounds used in cooling technologies; the compounds are known as refrigerants.
C. The hydrochlorocarbon dichloromethane and the perfluorocarbon tetradecafluorohexane are both refrigerants that can be used in cooling technologies like air conditioners.
D. Tetradecafluorohexane, a refrigerant, can be used in cooling technologies to absorb heat and release cold air.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记：
· 制冷剂是用于冷却技术的化学化合物，例如空调。
· 空调可以使用制冷剂来吸收热量并释放冷空气。
· 制冷剂二氯甲烷是一种氢氯碳化合物（HCC）。
· HCC由氢、氯和碳元素组成。
· 制冷剂四氟十四烷是一种全氟化合物（PFC）。
· PFC由氟和碳组成。
中文解析：
题目要求contrast对比两个事物，A指出了其成分的不一样，满足要求

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
· The A. M. Turing Award is a prestigious award given by the Association for Computing Machinery (ACM).
· The ACM gives the award for “major contributions of lasting importance to computing.”
· It is named after groundbreaking British mathematician Alan Turing.
· Raj Reddy won the award in 1994 for pioneering the development of large-scale artificial intelligence systems.

The student wants to explain whom the award is named for. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In 1994, Raj Reddy won the A. M. Turing Award for pioneering the development of large-scale artificial intelligence systems.
B. The A. M. Turing Award is given for “major contributions of lasting importance to computing.”
C. The A. M. Turing Award is named for groundbreaking British mathematician Alan Turing.
D. It was in 1994 that Raj Reddy won the A. M. Turing Award.
explanations:
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
· A. M. 图灵奖是由计算机协会（ACM）颁发的一个著名奖项。
· ACM颁发该奖项是为了表彰“对计算机领域具有重大且持久影响的贡献”。
· 奖项以开创性的英国数学家艾伦·图灵的名字命名。
· 拉杰·雷迪在1994年因开创大规模人工智能系统的发展而获奖。
中文解析：
题目要求explain whom the award is named for, 于是C满足要求，明确说出了数学家Alan Turing

question:
In what is now southern Florida, the Calusa people (circa 1000-1600 CE) supported their relatively large population’s dietary needs with hydrological engineering rather than terrestrial farming methods. They constructed watercourts (gated coastal enclosures) out of shells and sediments to trap a variety of fish as waters rose and fell with tides and seasonal sea-level shifts; watercourt pools then held the fish for later consumption. Archaeologist Theresa Schober has posited an additional purpose of these enclosures, suggesting that they were intended to foster conch. She ties this hypothesis to the high value the sea snails would have had for the Calusa, both nutritionally and as a building material (conch shells are highly durable).

Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken Schober’s hypothesis?
selections: A. Samples of animal remains collected at Calusa sites reflect a greater diversity of marine species, particularly among sea snails, within the perimeter of watercourts than in locations known to have been devoted to the preparation and consumption of food.

B. Historical population-size estimates suggest that the sea snails and fish most common in the Calusa diet were plentiful in open coastal waters when the watercourts were constructed but decreased in abundance in the years immediately after construction.

C. Radar surveys of Calusa sites reveal watercourt dimensions suitable for sustaining fish of many local species but not conducive for maintaining the shallow environments with ample seagrasses that allow sea snails to thrive.

D. Sediment layers excavated from Calusa watercourt sites contain heterogeneous mixtures of scales from multiple species of fish and fragments of shells from various types of sea snails, but conch shells do not constitute the majority of the mixture in most of those layers.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在现在的佛罗里达州南部，卡卢萨人（公元1000-1600年）通过水利工程而非陆地农业方法来满足相对较大人口的饮食需求。他们用贝壳和沉积物建造了水域（有围栏的沿海围场），以便在潮汐和季节性海平面变化时捕捉各种鱼类；水域池塘随后保存这些鱼，以便后续消费。考古学家特蕾莎·肖伯提出了这些围场的另一种用途，认为它们旨在培养海螺。她将这一假设与海螺对卡卢萨人的高价值联系在一起，认为海螺在营养和建筑材料方面都具有重要意义（海螺壳非常耐用）。
中文解析：
如果雷达扫描显示watercourt的尺寸适合养多种鱼类，但不适合维持海螺（conch）所需的浅水海草环境，则直接削弱了Schober的假设，就是用于培育海螺的说法

The mating environment hypothesis predicts that populations of flowering plants compensate for reduced mating opportunities due to dichogamy (a plant’s expression of male and female functions at separate times to prevent self-pollination) by adjusting the bias of floral sex allocation during the flowering period, increasing the probability of successful cross-plant pollination. Researchers tested the hypothesis by examining a population of broadleaf arrowhead, a plant for which bloom onset generally takes longer for male flowers than for female flowers, during the flowering season. They concluded that the mating environment hypothesis is not well supported by their observational data.

Which choice best describes data from the table that support the researchers’ conclusion?
selections: A. Whereas the total number of open flowers per growth unit peaked on day15, the proportion of male flowers experienced a peak earlier in the flowering season, on day 10.
B. Despite the sharp reduction in the total number of open flowers per growth unit from day 15 to 20, there was no decline in the estimated reproductive success rate of male flowers in that interval.
C. Sex allocations were largely evenly distributed on days 10 and 15 but were female biased on days 5 and 20.
D. Although sex allocations became overwhelmingly female biased by day 20, male flowers’ estimated reproductive success rate did not vary from day 5 to 20.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
配对环境假说预测，开花植物的种群会通过调整开花期间花的性别分配偏向，以补偿由于异熟（植物在不同时间表达雄性和雌性功能以防止自花授粉）导致的交配机会减少，从而增加成功异花授粉的概率。研究人员通过观察一种广叶箭头植物的种群来检验这一假说，该植物在开花季节雄花的开花时间通常比雌花要长。他们得出的结论是，配对环境假说并未得到他们观测数据的有力支持。
中文解析：
交配环境假说预测植物会通过调整花期内的雌雄分配偏差；根据图表第20天时，性别分配极度雌性偏斜（即雄性花比例很低），但雄性花的繁殖成功率在整个花期（第5天到第20天）保持稳定（未下降）。这直接削弱假说，因为如果假说成立，当性别分配雌性偏斜（雄性花减少）时，授粉机会应减少，但植物应通过调整（如增加雄性投资）来补偿，以维持雄性繁殖成功率。然而，数据表明雄性花成功率始终不变，说明植物并未进行有效补偿（性别分配变化未影响成功率）

question:
Studying menus from nineteenth-century restaurants, old coupons clipped out of newspapers, and posters promoting concerts by long-forgotten musicians may seem like a frivolous pursuit, but ephemeral objects like these are useful as evidence of cultural change: they can ________ shifts in norms, values, and concerns that traditional objects of historical inquiry may not.

question:
The Heege Manuscript (HM) is a collection of booklets of once-unbound paper sheets on which Richard Heege copied various texts at his fifteenth-century home between Derbyshire and Nottinghamshire in England. Most other contemporaneous personal manuscripts like the Findern Anthology (FA) consist primarily of pieces by celebrated medieval authors like Hoccleve and other readings favored by elites, whereas the HM has a distinctive emphasis on the popular, including entertainments like crude comedies, and the practical, with advice about manners.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. To suggest that the FA is a poor point of comparison for a collection like the HM
B. To emphasize the ubiquity of hand-copied collections like the FA and the HM in medieval England
C. To provide context for the text’s suggestion that the HM is an outlier among collections of its time
D. To illustrate how the discussion of the HM earlier in the text can improve historians’ understanding of the FA
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《希吉手稿》（Heege Manuscript, 简称HM）是一组书册，由曾经未装订的纸张组成。这些纸张上的各种文本是由理查德·希吉（Richard Heege）在15世纪时抄录的，他的住所位于英格兰德比郡和诺丁汉郡之间。与其他同时代的个人手稿（例如《芬登诗选》（Findern Anthology, 简称FA））主要收录霍克里夫（Hoccleve）等著名中世纪作家作品以及备受精英阶层青睐的其他读物不同，HM则独具特色地强调大众文化内容，其中包括粗俗喜剧等娱乐性作品，以及关于礼仪的实用性建议。
中文解析：
划线部分指“Most other contemporaneous personal manuscripts like the Findern Anthology (FA)...”的功能是为文本主张HM是其同时代收藏中的异类提供背景，即通过对比FA等主流手稿的内容特点，突出HM的独特性

question:
As observed in a 2011 study by Emilio García-Robledo and Alfonso Corzo, macroalgal proliferation may have a suppressive effect on the abundance of cyanobacteria and other microphytobenthos (MPB) — chlorophyll-producing microbes inhabiting marine sediment — in part by reducing the amount of sunlight available to MPB. Examining benthic chlorophyll concentrations (a widely used proxy for MPB biomass) in mudflats in Curlew Bay and other coastal sites in Virginia, Alice F. Besterman and Michael L. Pace found that those concentrations did not negatively correlate with macroalgal proliferation. However, they noted that MPB may respond to low-light conditions by producing higher-than-normal concentrations of chlorophyll, and they thus concluded that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. researchers ought to account for the possibility that because MPB have the capacity to compensate for reduced sunlight availability, benthic chlorophyll concentrations may not always be a reliable indicator of MPB biomass.

B. although their finding was inconsistent with that of García-Robledo and Corzo, this discrepancy was not attributable to the ability of MPB to accelerate chlorophyll production to mitigate the negative impact of macroalgal accumulations.

C. although elevated levels of macroalgae do not always correspond to increased levels of benthic chlorophyll, there is likely a larger trend in MPB biomass that is related to macroalgal presence but unrelated to light conditions.

D. the effect of macroalgal concentrations on MPB abundance that García-Robledo and Corzo reported was not observed in Curlew Bay and other Virginia sites because low-light conditions likely are not generalizable across the sites in the studies.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
根据Emilio García-Robledo和Alfonso Corzo在2011年进行的一项研究，宏藻的繁殖可能会对蓝藻和其他微 phytobenthos（MPB）——即栖息在海洋沉积物中的叶绿素产生微生物——的丰度产生抑制作用，部分原因是减少了MPB可获取的阳光。Alice F. Besterman和Michael L. Pace在研究弗吉尼亚州Curlew Bay和其他沿海地区的泥滩中的底栖叶绿素浓度（一个广泛使用的MPB生物量代理指标）时发现，这些浓度与宏藻繁殖并没有负相关。然而，他们指出，MPB可能会通过产生高于正常水平的叶绿素浓度来响应低光条件，因此他们得出的结论是______。
中文解析：
研究人员应考虑到，大型藻类本该通过遮光抑制MPB生长，但实际监测叶绿素时却没看到减少。原来MPB会“自救”——在缺光时多产叶绿素，所以叶绿素指标可能“骗人”，不能直接代表生物量。研究者因此提醒：用叶绿素浓度推断MPB生物量时要小心！

question:
The following text is adapted from William Shakespeare’s 1597 play The Tragedy of King Richard III. Richard is reflecting on the recent arrest of his brother; the Duke of Clarence, on suspicion of treason against King Edward IV. Derby, Hastings, Buckingham, Rivers, Dorset, and Grey are also members of the English nobility.
RICHARD: I do the wrong, and first begin to brawl.
The secret mischiefs that I set [flowing]
I lay unto the grievous charge of others.
Clarence, whom I indeed have cast in darkness,
I do beweep to many simple [gullible people],
Namely, to Derby, Hastings, Buckingham;
And tell them ‘tis the Queen and her allies
That stir the King against the Duke my brother.
Now they believe it, and withal whet me
To be revenged on Rivers, Dorset, Grey.

Which choice best describes what happens in the text?
selections: A. Richard attributes Clarence’s troubles to both his own secret plotting and the distrust of Clarence that the queen and her allies Derby, Hastings, and Buckingham have planted in the king’s mind.

B. Richard describes having wept as he informed Derby, Hastings, and Buckingham that the queen and her allies convinced the king to act against Clarence, and says that the earnestness of his grief caused them to accept his version of events.

C. Richard acknowledges that his mischievous nature has spurred him to commit misdeeds in the past, including instigating enmity between the king and Clarence, but he reports that he has hitherto not lost the trust of the queen and her allies.

D. Richard indicates that he has pretended to be aggrieved about Clarence’s situation and has proclaimed it to be the fault of the queen and her allies, but in reality, he has caused the hostility the king feels toward Clarence.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本改编自威廉·莎士比亚1597年的戏剧《理查三世的悲剧》。理查正在反思最近因涉嫌叛国而被捕的兄长克拉伦斯公爵的处境。德比、黑斯廷斯、白金汉、里弗斯、多塞特和格雷也是英国贵族的成员。
理查：
是我作恶，却先挑起争端。
我暗中行的不义之事，
却推卸给他人，让他们背负沉重的罪责。
克拉伦斯——实际上是我将他置于黑暗之中——
我却在许多头脑简单的人面前为他流泪，
比如德比、黑斯廷斯、白金汉；
还告诉他们，是王后和她的同党
在挑唆国王反对我的兄长公爵。
如今他们信以为真，甚至鼓励我
去向里弗斯、多塞特、格雷复仇。
中文解析：
理查德自白，自己作恶（I do the wrong），秘密策划（secret mischiefs that I set flowing），嫁祸他人（lay unto the charge of others），假装哭泣（beweep）向Derby等人撒谎，称王后阵营挑拨；理查德承认自己假装为克拉伦斯的处境悲痛，并公开宣称这是王后及其盟友的过错，但实际上正是他本人挑起了国王对克拉伦斯的敌意。

question:
Text 1 is T. L. Hulme’s 1912 poem “ Above the Dock.” Text 2 is from Amy Lowell’s 1912 poem “ The Crescent Moon.”
Text 1
Above the quiet dock in mid night,
Tangled in the tall mast’s corded height,
Hangs the moon. What seemed so far away
Is but a child’s balloon, forgotten after play.
Text 2
Slipping softly through the sky
Little horned, happy moon,
Can you hear me up so high?
Will you come down soon?

Which choice best describes a notable difference in how the speaker of Text 1 and the speaker of Text 2 portray the moon?
selections: A. While both speakers characterize the moon as an entrapped figure, only the speaker of Text 2 describes the moon as being content with this fate.
B. While both speakers present the moon as a tangible object, only the speaker of Text 1 addresses the moon’s beauty.
C. While the speaker of Text 1 presents the moon as an object of play, the speaker of Text 2 presents the moon as an object of serious study.
D. While the speaker of Text 1 presents the moon as seeming to be very close, the speaker of Text 2 emphasizes the moon’s distance from the speaker.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
文本1是T. L. Hulme于1912年创作的诗《码头上方》。文本2是艾米·洛威尔于1912年创作的诗《新月》。
文本1
在宁静的码头上空，
缠绕在高耸的桅杆上，
月亮悬挂着。曾看似遥不可及的
只是一只孩子的气球，玩耍后被遗忘。
文本2
轻柔地滑过天空，
小角的、快乐的月亮，
你能听到我在这么高的地方吗？
你会很快下来吗？
中文解析：
文本1的说话者将月亮描绘成看似很近，像被遗忘的气球，触手可及，而文本2的说话者则强调月亮距离遥远，高悬天空，需呼唤它“下来”

question:
Although Grant Tavinor concludes that computer games are art by virtue of their forming a subcategory of fiction, and Berys Gaut similarly places them within the realm of cinema, neither approach adequately captures a central aspect of playing these games: when the player no longer attends to the narrative and is instead simply absorbed in the instrumentalities of gameplay. This is among the reasons philosopher C. Thi Nguyen contends that the work of computer-game designers is in what he calls the medium of player agency, which the designer prescribes through rules and goals, and which elicits positive aesthetic experiences in the player who agrees to adopt it. Therefore, Nguyen’s position is that Tavinor’s and Gaut’s frameworks ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. are helpful starting points for studying computer games as art, even though these frameworks are overly simplistic.
B. are useful for analyzing the narrative aspects of computer games, even if neither attempts to address player agency.
C. overstate the influence of fiction and cinema on the narrative elements of computer games.
D. subsume computer games under other categories of media that do not address a feature of games that is integral to player enjoyment.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管格兰特·塔维诺（Grant Tavinor）认为计算机游戏因其形成了虚构的一种子类别而被视为艺术，贝里斯·高特（Berys Gaut）同样将其置于电影的领域，但这种观点并没有充分捕捉到玩这些游戏的一个核心方面：当玩家不再关注叙事，而是仅仅沉浸于游戏玩法的工具性时。这也是哲学家C. Thi Nguyen认为计算机游戏设计师的工作在于他所称的玩家代理媒介的原因，设计师通过规则和目标来规定这一媒介，并在同意采用这一媒介的玩家中引发积极的美学体验。因此，阮的观点是塔维诺和高特的框架______。
中文解析：
Tavinor和Gut的理论因归类错误而忽略了游戏的核心即player agency，“subsume computer games under other categories of media”（将游戏归入其他媒体类别）对应Tavinor（小说）和Gaut（电影）。“do not address a feature of games that is integral to player enjoyment”未涉及玩家体验不可或缺的特征，即直接指向玩家代理（player agency）

question:
Neuroscientist Artin Arshamian and his team sought to determine what affects a person’s perception of an odor as pleasant: is it culture, personal taste, or aspects of human anatomy? The team assessed odor preferences in ten groups of people with different modes of living (urban, agricultural, and hunter-gatherer) including the Maniq people from a small community in Thailand and the Seri people from a small community in Mexico. The team observed that across cultures, people generally rated odors about the same: ethyl butyrate, which smells like peaches, was typically rated more pleasant than diethyl disulfide, which smells like garlic. The team’s study thus undermined the idea that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. a person who perceives certain odors as pleasant will likely perceive the odors as roughly equal in pleasantness.
B. culture significantly influences whether a person perceives an odor as pleasant or unpleasant.
C. personal taste has little influence on whether odors are perceived as pleasant or unpleasant.
D. people agree in their perception of odors as pleasant or unpleasant regardless of where they live.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
神经科学家阿尔丁·阿尔沙米安（Artin Arshamian）及其团队试图确定哪些因素影响一个人对气味的愉悦感：是文化、个人口味，还是人类解剖学的某些方面？该团队评估了十组生活方式不同的人（城市、农业和狩猎采集）对于气味的偏好，包括来自泰国一个小社区的马尼克人（Maniq people）和来自墨西哥一个小社区的塞里人（Seri people）。研究团队观察到，在不同文化中，人们通常对气味的评价相似：乙酸乙酯（ethyl butyrate），一种闻起来像桃子的气味，通常被评为比二乙基二硫化物（diethyl disulfide），一种闻起来像大蒜的气味，更加愉悦。因此，团队的研究削弱了这样一种观点：______。
中文解析：
最后一句说明不同文化其实气味选择是一致的，说明数据表明文化差异并未导致气味偏好差异，因为文本削弱了B选项。

question:
Run by researchers in Europe, the Survey of Health, Ageing, and Retirement in Europe (SHARE) is an examination of aging that has attempted to track approximately 120,000 people for several years. Long-running studies like this need a lot of participants not merely for statistical robustness but also because of ________: over such a length of time, a substantial number of participants will withdraw or fall out of contact with the researchers.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
由欧洲研究人员主办的欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查（SHARE）是一项对老龄化进行的研究，试图跟踪大约12万人多年。像这样的长期研究需要大量参与者，这不仅是为了统计的可靠性，还因为______：在如此长的时间内，很多参与者会退出或与研究人员失去联系。
中文解析：
attrition表示损耗，文本中长期研究需要大量参与者，主要是因为人员损耗：随着时间的推移，许多参与者会退出或失去联系。circumspection谨慎；impartiality公正性；replicability可重复性

question:
Mauricio Drelichman and Hans-Joachim Voth’s research into the debt defaults of Philip II (who ruled an empire including Spain and much of Belgium from 1556 to 1598) relates to other work on European early modern state finance, including Hoffman and Norberg’s research on the relationship between state finance and political development. But Drelichman and Voth’s unique contribution to the field is their reconstruction of the earliest extant set of annual fiscal records for any sovereign state, demonstrating in turn that Philip’s defaults were caused by short-term cash shortages, not long-term unsustainable debts.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Analysis of the earliest available records of a sovereign state’s finances can be found not in the work of Hoffman and Norberg but in that of Drelichman and Voth.
B. Drelichman and Voth advanced the field of research on European early modern state finance by assembling a novel collection of evidence that gave them insight into Philip II’s debt defaults.
C. The research by Drelichman and Voth suggests that the logistics of ruling both Spain and much of Belgium led to short-term problems with cash that forced Philip II to default on his debts.
D. Drelichman and Voth’s research on Philip II’s debt defaults builds on earlier work by Hoffman and Norberg, adding nuance to the earlier work’s findings.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
毛里西奥·德雷利赫曼和汉斯-约阿希姆·沃斯对菲利普二世（1556年至1598年统治包括西班牙和比利时大部分地区的帝国）的债务违约的研究与关于欧洲早期现代国家财政的其他研究相关，包括霍夫曼和诺贝格关于国家财政与政治发展关系的研究。然而，德雷利赫曼和沃斯在该领域的独特贡献在于他们重建了任何主权国家现存的最早一组年度财政记录，从而证明菲利普的违约是由于短期现金短缺，而不是长期不可持续的债务。
中文解析：
Drelichman和Voth的独特贡献（unique contribution） 是重建了最早年度财政记录（novel evidence），并由此得出新结论，即短期现金短缺导致违约，推动了领域发展

question:
Some ethicists challenge the concept of personal character, claiming that if it were meaningful, situational factors could not, as they clearly can, induce behavior contrary to that character.As Rachana Kamtekar observes, this argument is difficult to reconcile with our lay conception of character: we expect a person of helpful character to be frequently helpful, not ________ helpful.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一些伦理学家对个人品格的概念提出质疑，他们认为如果品格是有意义的，那么情境因素不可能像现在这样，诱导出与该品格相悖的行为。正如拉查娜·卡姆特卡所观察到的，这一论点很难与我们对品格的日常理解相协调：我们期望一个乐于助人的人经常表现出乐于助人的行为，而不是________乐于助人。
中文解析：
我们期望乐于助人的人经常表现帮助别人，而非要求他们每一次都毫无例外地帮助也，就是允许情境因素影响。这正好反驳了第一句伦理学家的论点，他们用“偶尔违反性格”来否定性格概念，但大众并不要求完美一致性。unfailingly始终如一地，完美从不失败，不要选sporadically，我们期望频繁帮助，而不是偶尔帮助，这不符合伦理学家质疑的逻辑，反而变成了支持！

question:
The Reckoning and Resilience (2022) exhibition at Duke University’s Nasher Museum of Art in Durham, North Carolina, was curated to feature the work of thirty North Carolina artists. The included artists represent a wide variety of artistic disciplines, from painters such as Juan Logan to the sculptor Stephen Hayes. In its inclusion of many borrowed works, the exhibition is atypical for the Nasher Museum, which tends to curate its exhibitions around the permanent collection of contemporary art that it owns.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It explains how an art exhibition differs from many other exhibitions, then analyzes the significance of that difference.
B. It presents the unusual goals curators had for an art exhibition, then evaluates whether the curators achieved those goals.
C. It provides an overview of an art exhibition, then explains what makes the exhibition unusual for the institution that organized it.
D. It discusses the wide range of disciplines represented in an art exhibition, then explains why curators included works in those disciplines.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《清算与韧性》（2022）展览在北卡罗来纳州达勒姆的杜克大学纳舍艺术博物馆举办，策展的目的是展现三十位北卡罗来纳州艺术家的作品。参展艺术家涵盖了多种艺术领域，从画家胡安·洛根到雕塑家斯蒂芬·海斯。该展览包括许多借来的作品，这在纳舍博物馆的展览中并不常见，因为该博物馆通常围绕其所拥有的当代艺术永久收藏策划展览。
中文解析：
文本首先概述了一个艺术展览的基本信息（展览名称、地点、参展艺术家及多样性），随后指出该展览因包含大量借展作品而对主办机构来说很不寻常，因为该机构通常围绕自有馆藏策展。

question:
The terms included in Barry Lopez and Debra Gwartney’s Home Ground: A Guide to the American ________ such as “karst, ” which refers to limestone terrain riddled with caves or sinkholes— illustrate the rich vocabulary used to describe the landforms of North America.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 双破折号之前是例子解释破折号前的名词

question:
Many studies have found a positive association between levels of dissolved organic carbon and mercury in bodies of fresh water undisturbed by human activity. But Stéphane Guédron, Delphine Tisserand, and colleagues did not find this correlation in an examination of freshwater bodies impacted by wastewater, leading some scientists to hypothesize that the association could be particular to undisturbed waters. However, Ida Tjerngren and colleagues carried out a study on freshwater bodies disturbed by urban development that showed similar results to the studies on undisturbed waters, suggesting that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. levels of dissolved organic carbon and mercury are both much higher in bodies of fresh water impacted by wastewater than they are in bodies of fresh water disturbed by urban development.
B. Guédron, Tisserand, and colleagues’ study used different methods to measure the concentration of mercury in fresh water than Tjerngren and colleagues’ study did.
C. the effects of wastewater on the association between levels of dissolved organic carbon and mercury should not be taken as indicative of the effects of every type of human disturbance.
D. disturbances linked to wastewater affect significantly more bodies of fresh water than disturbances linked to urban development do.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
许多研究发现，在未受到人类活动干扰的淡水体中，溶解有机碳与汞的水平之间存在正相关关系。然而，Stéphane Guédron、Delphine Tisserand及其同事在对受废水影响的淡水体进行研究时，并没有发现这种相关性，这导致一些科学家假设这种关联可能特定于未受干扰的水域。然而，Ida Tjerngren及其同事对受到城市开发干扰的淡水体进行的研究显示出与未受干扰水域研究相似的结果，这表明______。
中文解析：
废水污染是一种特殊干扰，其破坏positive association between levels of dissolved organic carbon and mercury的效果并不适用于其他人类活动，如城市开发，好得分之前预测的原题

question:
For her film I Am Somebody (1970), a documentary about a successful months-long strike held by Black female hospital workers in Charleston, South Carolina, director MadelineAnderson chose a narrator who had participated in the ________ by allowing the narrative to be shaped by one of their own, amplified the agency and power the workers possessed.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: a decision做前面protest的同位语，需要逗号隔开不是句子间关系，不用句号或分号，于是B和C错误，于是选择D

question:
• Snow hydrologist Julie Koeberle helps maintain automated snow measurement stations.
• They are called SNOTEL sites.
• There are around 90 stations throughout Wyoming.
• One is at Bear Trap Meadow.
• The data collected can help researchers make downstream water supply predictions.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to provide an example of a SNOTEL site?
selections: A. The data collected by SNOTEL sites can help researchers predict downstream water supplies.
B. The SNOTEL site at Bear Trap Meadow is one of around 90 automated snow measurement stations in Wyoming.
C. Snow hydrologist Julie Koeberle helps maintain automated snow monitoring stations known as SNOTEL sites.
D. Located throughout Wyoming, SNOTEL sites monitor snow conditions.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
• 雪水文专家朱莉·科伯尔（Julie Koeberle）负责维护自动雪测量站。
• 这些测量站被称为SNOTEL站。
• 怀俄明州大约有90个这样的站点。
• 其中一个位于熊圈草地（Bear Trap Meadow）。
• 收集的数据可以帮助研究人员预测下游的水资源供应。
中文解析：
题目要求给一个site的具体例子，B选项提到Bear Trap Meadow符合要求

question:
Branching in Jurisprudential Schools is one of the hundreds of thousands of manuscripts that have survived from roughly the sixteenth century to the present ________ being passed down through private libraries in the city of Timbuktu, Mali.Many of these manuscripts can be found at the Al-Wangari Manuscript Library.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: by之后不是完整的句子，不可以用句号和分号，于是B和C不可以，SAT师生说有符号讲解文章，介词by和后面的being passed…不能分割，于是A正确

question:
At a time when many women writers used male pseudonyms to gain greater freedom of self-expression by evading gender conventions, Katherine Bradley and Edith Cooper adapted the practice by publishing poetry, prose, and drama for four decades under the shared name Michael Field. ________ the duo was able to express the joint creative vision that sustained their long personal and professional partnership.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在许多女性作家为了获得更大的自我表达自由而使用男性笔名以规避性别规范的时代，凯瑟琳·布拉德利和伊迪丝·库珀通过以共同的名字迈克尔·菲尔德（Michael Field）出版诗歌、散文和戏剧，适应了这一做法，持续了四十年。________ 这个二人组合能够表达出支撑他们长期个人与职业伙伴关系的共同创造愿景。
中文解析：
in this way表示“用这种方式”, 前面讲述女性共用一个男性的pseudonym,后面是讲这种方式让题目更好的联合表达

question:
In a 2005 study by Mellado et al., the researchers’ aim was to analyze the diet composition of cattle in Coahuila, Mexico. ________ they aimed to analyze the ratio of three different plant subtypes within these animals’ diet: graminoids, forbs, and browse.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在2005年，Mellado等人的研究中，研究者的目的是分析墨西哥科阿韦拉州牛的饮食成分。________他们旨在分析这类动物饮食中三种不同植物亚型的比例：禾草、阔叶草和灌木。
中文解析：
前面是研究饮食组成，后面是研究组成的具体比例，于是选择specifically

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
· Kale is a vegetable that contains ascorbic acid, an essential nutrient for humans.
· Apricots are fruits that contain ascorbic acid.
· There is 120 milligrams(mg) of ascorbic acid per every 100 grams(g) of kale.
· There is 10 mg of ascorbic acid per every 100g of apricot.
· Humans cannot make ascorbic acid in their bodies, so they must get it from foods, including fruits and vegetables.
· Ascorbic acid is also known as vitamin C.

The student wants to refute a claim that apricots are a better source of vitamin C than kale is. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Kale contains vitamin C (also known as ascorbic acid); in fact, there is 120 mg of vitamin C in every 100g of kale.
B. Kale contains ascorbic acid (also known as vitamin C), and apricots do too.
C. Humans cannot make ascorbic acid in their bodies, but they can get it from kale and apricots.
D. With 120 mg of vitamin C per every 100g, kale is actually a better source of vitamin C than apricots, which contain only 10 mg per every 100g.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
· 羽衣甘蓝是一种蔬菜，含有抗坏血酸，这是一种对人类至关重要的营养素。
· 杏子是一种水果，含有抗坏血酸。
· 每100克羽衣甘蓝中含有120毫克（mg）抗坏血酸。
· 每100克杏子中含有10毫克抗坏血酸。
· 人类无法在体内合成抗坏血酸，因此必须通过食物摄取，包括水果和蔬菜。
· 抗坏血酸也被称为维生素C。
中文解析：
题目要求反驳apricots are better sources than kale，那么根据notes，apricots的VC含量不如kale，D满足要求

question:
As part of his I GOT UP series, Japanese conceptual artist On Kawara spent over a decade—with near daily consistency — mailing postcards to friends declaring what time he got up each day, resulting in pieces such as I Got Up at 7.19 A. M., Jun 6 1977. Such meticulous documentation of mundane ________ artworks that “resonate with existential, psychological and scientific implications about the time-space continuum, ” according to the New York Times, became Kawara’s life’s work.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: became是句子的谓语，于是不能再有其它谓语，选择generating

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
· The nautical mile (6,076 feet) is the measure of distance used in seafaring navigation.
· A nautical mile directly correlates to one minute (1/60th of a degree) of latitude.
· The curvature of Earth affects the accurate measurement of long distances when using flat maps.
· Measuring distances with latitude and longitude coordinates takes into account Earth’s curvature.
· Mariners use nautical charts marked with latitude and longitude to quickly calculate distances and positions.

The student wants to explain why nautical miles are used to measure distances in seafaring navigation. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Nautical miles are a measure of distance equal to one minute of latitude, which is a feature nautical charts use to calculate distances and positions.

B. Nautical charts use latitude and longitude to measure long distances; these charts are more accurate than flat maps for measuring distances in seafaring navigation because they account for Earth’s curvature.
C. Since they directly correlate to the coordinates on nautical charts, which take into account Earth’s curvature, nautical miles are an efficient way to calculate distances at sea.
D. Using nautical miles for navigation at sea takes Earth’s curvature into account, whereas measuring distances with latitude and longitude coordinates does not.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
· 海里（6,076英尺）是海上航行中使用的距离单位。
· 一海里与一分钟（1/60度）的纬度直接相关。
· 地球的曲率会影响使用平面地图时长距离的准确测量。
· 使用纬度和经度坐标测量距离时考虑了地球的曲率。
· 航海者使用标有纬度和经度的海图来快速计算距离和位置。
中文解析：
因为Nautical miles直接对应地球纬度且与考虑Earth's curvature，这样跟航海图坐标挂钩，能高效精准计算海上距离。

question:
Following the formation of the European Union (EU) that same year, the organizers of the1992 Tour de France wanted the bike race to reflect the cross-national flow of people and trade that the EU had made possible. The resulting course was 2,500 miles long ________ seven separate borders of neighboring countries, modeled a vision of the EU’s unifying aims.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子本来是the resulting course was 2,500 miles long and modeled a …，于是crossing seven…是插入语，前后都好隔开，SAT师生说文章有篇是逗号的20种用法

question:
John Quincy Adams employed the pseudonym “Marcellus” — a reference to a leader of an ancient Roman army — in political essays he wrote in 1793, a choice that accomplished far more than simply concealing his authorship. ________ it wasn’t an arbitrary pen name but rather a complex rhetorical strategy through which Adams aligned his political views with the venerated republican ideals of the ancient world, thereby bolstering the authority of his writing.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
约翰·昆西·亚当斯在1793年撰写的政治论文中使用了笔名“马塞勒斯”——这是对古罗马军队一位领导者的提及——这个选择不仅仅是为了隐藏他的身份。_______ 这并不是一个随意的笔名，而是一种复杂的修辞策略，通过这种策略，亚当斯将自己的政治观点与古代世界受到尊崇的共和理想对齐，从而增强了他写作的权威性。
中文解析：
前面说Marcellus这个笔名实现的不只是隐藏作者身份，后面是更多的描述笔名选择的原因与作用（bolstering authority），于是选择indeed连接，表示事实上更细致的强调前文

question: Rectangles ABCD and EFGH are similar. The length of each side of EFGH is 6 times the length of the corresponding side of ABCD. The area of ABCD is 90 square units. What is the area, in square units, of EFGH?
explanations: 一维比例为6：1，二维面积比例为36：1，故为90*36=3240，选D

question: A line intersects two parallel lines, forming four acute angles and four obtuse angles. The measure of one of the acute angles is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>410</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>∘</mo> </mrow> </msup></math>. The sum of the measures of one of the acute angles and three of the obtuse angles is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>14</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>w</mi> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>∘</mo> </mrow> </msup></math>. What is the value of w?
explanations: 直线相交产生4个角，相邻角之和180°，对顶角相等，其中一个锐角为(7x-410)°，相邻钝角为180-(7x-410)=(-7x+590)°,一个锐角+3个钝角（1锐角+1钝角为180）为180+2*（-7x+590）=1360-14x，所以w为1360

question:
A team of archaeologists examined 150 spherically shaped limestone rocks called spheroids that date back about 1.4 million years, concluding that early hominins intentionally chipped away at rocks to form these spheroids over time. The fact that their attempt to make the stones as round as possible was __________ suggests that early hominins may have been more cognitively sophisticated than previously thought.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析：
我们需要修饰早期人类制作球形石器的行为，同时按照好得分的单词线索，参考early hominins intentionally chipped...选项应体现“有意识、有目的”的行为，deliberate符合要求
题目文本翻译：
一组考古学家检查了150个被称为球状石灰岩的球体，这些岩石的年代大约为140万年。他们得出结论，早期的人类故意雕刻岩石，经过一段时间形成了这些球体。事实上，他们试图让石头尽可能圆的这一事实 __________，这表明早期人类可能比之前认为的更具认知能力。

question:
Portable video game consoles and other small electronic devices tend to __________ batteries that can’t be easily taken out and swapped for new ones. Environmental policy researcher Carl Dalhammar warns that when these internal batteries stop working, the devices are usually thrown away, becoming harmful waste.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析：
好得分老师告诉大家这里需要选择一个动词呼应internal batteries，描述这些设备包含/装有电池，最符合逻辑的是contain表示包含，装有。
题目文本翻译：
便携式视频游戏机和其他小型电子设备往往采用__________的电池，这种电池不容易被取出并更换。环境政策研究员卡尔·达尔哈默警告说，当这些内置电池停止工作时，这些设备通常会被丢弃，成为有害废物。

question:
Allison Q. Byrne and colleagues relied on historical DNA (hDNA) — genomic data incidentally preserved in specimens housed in collections such as those at the Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History — to investigate the evolutionary origins of a pathogen affecting amphibians. Although this approach can yield many insights about the biological past, it remains a relatively underutilized resource in part because hDNA is often to some extent degraded, a situation not easily remediable under current methodological paradigms and with extant DNA extraction and analysis technologies.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It presents a scientific study that relied on a particular approach, then describes a barrier to the widespread adoption of that approach.
B. It evaluates a research methodology used in a particular study, then explains how scientists may overcome difficulties inherent to that methodology.
C. It summarizes the findings of a scientific study, then discusses the possibility of other researchers replicating those findings in future studies.
D. It exemplifies a common method of genomic data analysis, then details the difficulties in adapting that method to new circumstances.
explanations:
中文解析：
第一部分是研究案例（hDNA的应用），第二部分是该方法面临的障碍（underutilized resource...degraded）,全段结构是从研究案例到探讨方法局限性，重点是hDNA的潜力和它未被充分利用的原因，而非具体研究发现或解决方案。A选项符合要求。
题目文本翻译：
艾莉森·Q·伯恩及其同事们依靠历史DNA（hDNA）——即在史密森国家自然历史博物馆等收藏中偶然保存的基因组数据——来研究影响两栖动物的病原体的进化起源。尽管这种方法可以提供许多关于生物过去的见解，但由于hDNA往往在某种程度上受到降解，这使得它在现有的方法论范式以及现存的DNA提取和分析技术下，仍然是相对较少被利用的资源。

question:
Saturn is the first planet in our solar system to be discovered to have more than 100 moons orbiting around it. A team of astronomers using the Canada-France-Hawaii Telescope (CFHT) in Hawaii detected 62 undiscovered moons that were previously too small or too dim to see. Saturn now outranks Jupiter as the planet in our solar system with the most observed moons.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To note a new finding about the number of Saturn’s moons
B. To explain how the CFHT works
C. To describe the atmospheric conditions of Jupiter
D. To discuss the history of Hawaii
explanations:
中文解析：
全文围绕土星卫星数量的新纪录展开，核心是新发现（new finding），其他信息（如望远镜、木星对比）均为支持细节。
题目文本翻译：
土星是我们太阳系中首个被发现拥有超过100颗卫星的行星。一个由天文学家组成的团队使用位于夏威夷的加拿大-法国-夏威夷望远镜（CFHT）探测到了62颗之前由于体积太小或亮度太暗而未被发现的卫星。土星现在超越了木星，成为我们太阳系中观察到的卫星最多的行星。

question:
Spanning the 1920s to the 1980s, Mexican architect Luis Barragán’s prolific career evolved through distinct phases. After traveling to the United States and Europe in the early 1930s and immersing himself in an international architectural discourse, Barragán began incorporating principles derived from functionalism and modernism in his work, as seen in the Chávez Peón de Ochoa House, whose unadorned geometric forms contrast with the historically inspired architecture found in the Aguilar House, one of Barragán’s early projects in Guadalajara.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Barragán’s designs of the Chávez Peón de Ochoa House and the Aguilar House are considered paragons of a functionalist and modernist aesthetic.
B. A notable shift in Barragán’s design aesthetic reflects the influence of his time abroad.
C. Barragán’s early work shows an initial dedication to a modernist aesthetic that he later abandoned.
D. Barragán’s design of the Aguilar House is considered more experimental than his design for the Chávez Peón de Ochoa House.
explanations:
中文解析：
文本强调他因海外经历而转向功能主义/现代主义（Chávez Peón de Ochoa House），与早期作品（Aguilar House）形成对比，B选项满足，基本意义是Barragán 的设计美学发生了显著转变，反映了他海外经历的影响，这个题目是旧题变型，更多考法在www.hdfedu.com
题目文本翻译：
从1920年代到1980年代，墨西哥建筑师路易斯·巴拉甘（Luis Barragán）的丰硕职业生涯经历了不同的阶段。1930年代早期，他前往美国和欧洲，深入参与国际建筑话语，之后开始在作品中融入功能主义和现代主义的原则。以查韦斯·佩翁·德·奥乔亚住宅（Chávez Peón de Ochoa House）为例，其简洁的几何形态与巴拉甘在瓜达拉哈拉早期项目之一的阿吉拉尔住宅（Aguilar House）中所体现的历史灵感建筑形成鲜明对比。

question:
Text 1
Yale University and the investment bank JPMorgan Chase are two of the many institutions offering training programs in entrepreneurship. But what results do such programs produce? In a study of college students in Sweden, researcher Ove Hansemark addressed this question and found that participants showed strong belief in their entrepreneurial capabilities after receiving entrepreneurial training.
Text 2
While studies of entrepreneurial training typically report positive results, a close look at these studies reveals widespread methodological shortcomings. For instance, a 1998 study by Ove Hansemark found benefits of entrepreneurial education for Swedish college students, but the study used a very small sample of only 19 students, making it difficult to say whether the training actually had an effect.

Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely answer the underlined question in Text 1?
selections: A. Although the programs may seem to produce positive results, close analysis of studies of the programs shows that they produce negative results just as frequently.
B. It is unknown what results the programs produce because studies of them are often designed in ways that do not allow for definitive conclusions.
C. Most of the programs do not actually produce positive results even though program participants tend to regard them as beneficial.
D. The programs tend to produce inconsistent results because they vary substantially in their methods and aims.
explanations:
中文解析：
Text 2指出研究方法缺陷（very small sample），从而导致结论不可靠，选择B选项，大意是：无法确定项目产生什么结果，因为研究设计通常无法得出明确结论，好得分的阅读术语专项资料有这个题目不同考法全部讲解
题目文本翻译：
文本1
耶鲁大学和投资银行摩根大通是众多提供创业培训项目的机构之一。但这些项目产生了什么样的成果呢？瑞典研究员奥维·汉斯马克（Ove Hansemark）在一项针对大学生的研究中探讨了这个问题，发现参与者在接受创业培训后对自己的创业能力表现出强烈的信心。
文本2
尽管对创业培训的研究通常报告积极的结果，但仔细审视这些研究会发现广泛的方法论缺陷。例如，奥维·汉斯马克在1998年进行的一项研究发现瑞典大学生的创业教育有益，但该研究仅使用了19名学生的非常小的样本，难以判断培训是否真的产生了效果。

question:
The following text is adapted from George Bernard Shaw’s 1905 play Major Barbara.
LADY BRITOMART: You must learn to face life seriously, Stephen. I really cannot bear the whole burden of our family affairs any longer. You must advise me: you must assume the responsibility.
STEPHEN: I!
LADY BRITOMART: Yes, you, of course. You were 24 last June.

As used in the text, what does the word “assume” most nearly mean?
explanations:
中文解析：
原文中 “assume the responsibility” 搭配，意为“承担责任”，且前文提到 “You must learn to face life/ advise me”都是祈使句指出了你的责任， C. Undertake the responsibility表示承担责任（关注SAT师生说公众号）
题目文本翻译：
以下文本改编自乔治·萧伯纳1905年的戏剧《大亨芭芭拉》。
布里托玛特夫人：你必须学会认真面对生活，斯蒂芬。我实在无法再独自承担我们家庭事务的全部重担了。你必须给我建议：你必须承担责任。
斯蒂芬：我！
布里托玛特夫人：是的，当然是你。你去年六月才24岁。

question:
The 2020 novel The Only Good Indians confirmed that Stephen Graham Jones is one of the most talented writers of horror fiction today. By featuring main characters who are Blackfeet, like Jones himself, the novel also helped to ensure that Indigenous people have a place within the horror genre. But Jones is hardly the only Indigenous voice in horror, Métis author Cherie Dimaline has also written in the genre. Her acclaimed 2019 novel Empire of Wild is set in a Métis community in southern Canada.

According to the text, Stephen Graham Jones and Cherie Dimaline are similar in what way?
selections: A. Both have published fictional works featuring main characters who are Blackfeet.
B. Both are citizens of the Blackfeet Nation.
C. Both are Indigenous authors who have written horror fiction.
D. Both have said that they don't like reading horror fiction even though they write it.
explanations:
中文解析：
两人都是 Indigenous authors，并且都写过恐怖小说（参考Jones is hardly the only Indigenous voice in horror）。
题目文本翻译：
2020年的小说《唯一的好印第安人》证实了斯蒂芬·格雷厄姆·琼斯是当今最有才华的恐怖小说作家之一。通过展现以琼斯本人为代表的黑脚印第安人为主角，这部小说也帮助确保了土著人在恐怖类型中有一席之地。然而，琼斯并不是恐怖文学中唯一的土著声音。梅蒂斯作家谢丽·迪马林也在该类型中创作。她备受赞誉的2019年小说《荒野帝国》设定在加拿大南部的梅蒂斯社区。

question:
When a company has a new product, it has to decide when to tell people about it. Companies usually announce a new product before it is released and available for purchase. Those announcements can increase consumer excitement, which can mean that more people will buy the product. But the effect fades quickly, so companies need to be careful in timing the announcement and the release of a new product.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the underlined claim?
selections: A. Consumers tend to prefer new products over older products.
B. Consumers are more likely to buy a new product when they already use products from the company making the new product.
C. Consumer surveys show low excitement for new products that were announced a long time before they were released.
D. The kind of information a company provides about a new product helps determine how likely consumers are to buy the product.
explanations:
中文解析：
C 选项直接证明了过早宣布但延迟上市会降低消费者兴趣，与划线句子的逻辑一致。其他选项均未涉及“时间安排”或“兴奋感消退”的问题。
题目文本翻译：
当一家公司有新产品时，它必须决定何时向公众透露这一消息。公司通常在新产品发布并可供购买之前就会进行公告。这些公告可以增加消费者的期待，这意味着会有更多的人购买该产品。然而，这种效果很快会减退，因此公司在安排新产品的公告和发布时需要谨慎把握时机。

question:
The following text is from George Eliot’s 1857 short story “The Sad Fortunes of the Rev. Amos Barton.” In the text, the narrator addresses the reader directly and alludes to a discussion among Rev. Amos Barton’s neighbors.
It was happy for the Rev. Amos Barton that he did not, like us, overhear the conversation recorded in the last chapter. Indeed, what mortal is there of us, who would find his satisfaction enhanced by an opportunity of comparing the picture he presents to himself of his own doings, with the picture they make on the mental retina of his neighbours? We are poor plants buoyed up by the air-vessels of our own conceit: alas for us, if we get a few pinches that empty us of that windy self-subsistence! The very capacity for good would go out of us.

Which choice best states the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. The narrator expresses relief that a disagreement was resolved more expediently than expected and then indicates how the situation might have gone differently.
B. The narrator comments on the fact that a character remains unaware of how he is viewed by others and then generalizes about the problem of learning others’ opinions of one’s own actions.
C. The narrator summarizes an earlier event involving a specific character and then anticipates the later significance it will have for that character.
D. The narrator implies that a character is not well liked by his neighbors and then uses an extended comparison to demonstrate why their negative opinion of him is largely justified.
explanations:
中文解析：
先以Rev. Amos Barton为例，再推广到普遍人性。结构是具体例子到普遍性讨论，注意核心并非Rev. Amos Barton本身，而是通过他引出人类心理的共性，B符合要求，SAT师生说公众号有这本小说全部选段对应的SAT题目
题目文本翻译：
以下文本摘自乔治·艾略特1857年的短篇小说《阿莫斯·巴顿牧师的悲惨命运》。在文本中，叙述者直接与读者对话，并提到阿莫斯·巴顿牧师邻居之间的讨论。
阿莫斯·巴顿牧师的幸运在于，他并没有像我们一样，偷听到上一章中记录的谈话。事实上，我们当中有哪个凡人，会因为有机会将自己心中对自己行为的印象，与邻居们心中对他的印象进行比较而感到更加满意呢？我们就像被自己虚荣心的气泡支撑起的可怜植物：如果我们遭遇几次让我们失去这种空洞自足的打击，那可真是悲哀！我们内心中善良的能力也会随之消失。
