question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
· The Incarnations (2015) is an epistolary novel by English author Susan Barker.
· Epistolary novels are novels written primarily as a series of fictional documents.
· These documents can be letters, journal entries, newspaper clippings, and more.
· The Incarnations consists primarily of letters.
· The letters are sent between a taxi driver named Wang Jun and a mysterious woman.

The student wants to define the term “epistolary novel.” Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Consisting primarily of letters sent between a taxi driver named Wang Jun and a mysterious woman, Susan Barker’s The Incarnations is an epistolary novel.
B. Susan Barker’s novel The Incarnations was published in 2015 and consists primarily of letters sent between a taxi driver named Wang Jun and a mysterious woman.
C. An epistolary novel is a novel written primarily as a series of fictional documents, such as letters, journal entries, or newspaper clippings.
D. Published in 2015, The Incarnations is an epistolary novel by English author Susan Barker.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
· 《化身》（2015）是英国作家苏珊·巴克所著的一部书信体小说。
· 书信体小说主要以一系列虚构的文档形式写成。
· 这些文档可以是信件、日记条目、报纸剪辑等。
· 《化身》主要由信件组成。
· 这些信件是由一名名叫王俊的出租车司机和一位神秘女性之间互寄的。
中文解析：
题目要求定义“书信体小说（epistolary novel）”，根据笔记Epistolary novel的定义以一系列虚构文件（fictional documents）为主要形式的小说，这些文件可以是：信件（letters）、日记（journal entries）、剪报（newspaper clippings）等，选项C符合要求。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
· Jane is the nickname of a dinosaur fossil specimen housed at the Burpee Museum of Natural History.
· The Burpee Museum of Natural History is located in Rockford, Illinois.
· Jane is a member of the genus Tyrannosaurus.
· Big Mike is the nickname of a dinosaur fossil specimen housed at the Museum of the Rockies.
· The Museum of the Rockies is located in Bozeman, Montana.
· Big Mike is a member of the genus Tyrannosaurus.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two specimens. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. While Jane is housed at the Burpee Museum of Natural History, Big Mike is housed at the Museum of the Rockies.
B. The dinosaur fossil specimens Jane and Big Mike are both members of the genus Tyrannosaurus.
C. Big Mike is the nickname of a Tyrannosaurus fossil specimen housed at the Museum of the Rockies in Bozeman, Montana.
D. The Burpee Museum of Natural History, where Jane is housed, is located in Rockford, Illinois.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
• 简（Jane）是一个恐龙化石标本的昵称，该标本存放在伯皮自然历史博物馆（Burpee Museum of Natural History）。
• 伯皮自然历史博物馆位于伊利诺伊州的洛克福德（Rockford）。
• 简是暴龙属（Tyrannosaurus）的成员。
• 大迈克（Big Mike）是一个恐龙化石标本的昵称，该标本存放在落基山博物馆（Museum of the Rockies）。
• 落基山博物馆位于蒙大拿州的博兹曼（Bozeman）。
• 大迈克也是暴龙属（Tyrannosaurus）的成员。
中文解析：
题目要求强调两个恐龙标本的相似性（similarity），因此需要选择一个选项，指出 Jane 和 Big Mike 的共同点。B选项指出both members of the genus Tyrannosaurus，符合题目要求

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Urban natural areas are city spaces that feature elements of nature.
• Facade-bound green walls are urban natural areas defined as exterior walls that have plants growing on them.
• They can benefit cities by enhancing air quality.
• Urban grasslands are urban natural areas defined as areas of pastures or meadows in cities.
• They can benefit cities by increasing diversity among bird species.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between facade-bound green walls and urban grasslands. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Urban grasslands, which are areas of pastures or meadows in cities, benefit cities by increasing diversity among bird species.
B. Facade-bound green walls enhance air quality, whereas urban grasslands increase diversity among bird species.
C. Facade-bound green walls and urban grasslands can both be considered urban natural areas.
D. By enhancing air quality, facade-bound green walls benefit cities.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
- 城市自然区域是包含自然元素的城市空间。
- 立面绿墙是被定义为在外墙上生长植物的城市自然区域。
- 它们可以通过改善空气质量来惠及城市。
- 城市草地是被定义为城市中的牧场或草地的城市自然区域。
- 它们可以通过增加鸟类物种的多样性来惠及城市。
中文解析：
选项C明确指出立面绿化墙和城市草原都属于城市自然区域（urban natural areas），这是两者最根本的相似之处，完全符合题目要求。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• When the electrons of a chemical element change energy states, certain wavelengths of light are released.
• This unique collection of wavelengths is known as the emission spectrum of the element.
• Magnesium’s emission spectrum includes the 517.2 nanometer (nm) wavelength.
• Helium’s emission spectrum includes the 587.5 nm wavelength.
• The green portion of the visible spectrum is made up of light with wavelengths of 500-570 nm.

The student wants to identify an emission spectrum that includes a wavelength in the green portion of the visible spectrum. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Containing the 517.2 nm and 587.5 nm wavelengths, respectively, both magnesium’s and helium’s emission spectra include wavelengths in the green portion of the visible spectrum.
B. Magnesium’s emission spectrum includes the 517.2 nm wavelength, which is in the green portion of the visible spectrum.
C. The 587.5 nm wavelength, which is in the green portion of the visible spectrum, is one wavelength in the emission spectrum of helium.
D. Since the 517.2 nm wavelength of light is within the 500-570 nm range, it is part of the green portion of the visible spectrum.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
- 当化学元素的电子能级发生变化时，会释放出特定波长的光。
- 这种独特的波长集合被称为该元素的发射光谱。
- 镁的发射光谱包括517.2纳米（nm）的波长。
- 氦的发射光谱包括587.5 nm的波长。
- 可见光谱的绿色部分由波长在500-570 nm之间的光组成。
中文解析：
题目要求 找出一个包含绿色可见光波长（500-570 nm）的发射光谱（emission spectrum）。根据笔记，绿色可见光范围：500-570 nm，镁（Magnesium）的发射光谱：包含 517.2 nm（属于绿色范围），于是选项B符合要求。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
· The Future of Nostalgia is a scholarly book by literary theorist Svetlana Boym.
· The book provides a multifaceted exploration of the concept of nostalgia.
· Chapter 8 explores nostalgia and Europe’s largest shopping mall.
· Chapter 17 discusses various skeptics’ takes on the concept of nostalgia.
· In chapter 17, Boym writes, “The poethics of nostalgia combines estrangement and human solidarity, affect and reflection.”

The student wants to provide a quotation from chapter 17. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. After exploring nostalgia and Europe’s largest shopping mall, Svetlana Boym goes on to discuss various skeptics’ takes on the concept of nostalgia.
B. Svetlana Boym’s The Future of Nostalgia provides a multifaceted exploration of nostalgia.
C. Svetlana Boym explores nostalgia and Europe’s largest shopping mall in chapter 8 of her book.
D. In an exploration of various skeptics’ takes on the concept of nostalgia, Svetlana Boym writes, “The poethics of nostalgia combines estrangement and human solidarity, affect and reflection.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
· 《怀旧的未来》是文学理论家斯韦特兰娜·博伊姆撰写的一本学术书籍。
· 该书对怀旧的概念进行了多方面的探讨。
· 第8章探讨了怀旧与欧洲最大的购物中心。
· 第17章讨论了各种怀疑论者对怀旧概念的看法。
· 在第17章中，博伊姆写道：“怀旧的诗伦理结合了异化与人类团结、情感与反思。”
中文解析：
选项 D 直接引用了第17章的关键句子，并提供了上下文（skeptics’ takes on nostalgia），最符合题目要求。

question:
The 2023 anthology The Big Book of Cyberpunk contains 108 stories, including Fritz Leiber’s “Coming Attraction” (1950) and Erica Satifka’s “Act of Providence” (2021). With its chronological scope, it is more comprehensive than the much shorter 1986 cyberpunk anthology Mirrorshades, but Mirrorshades’s careful selection of stories makes that anthology more _______.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
2023年出版的选集《赛博朋克大书》包含108个故事，其中包括弗里茨·来伯的《即将来临》（1950年）和埃里卡·萨提夫卡的《天意》（2021年）。从时间范围来看，它比1986年那本较短的赛博朋克选集《镜面阴影》更加全面，但《镜面阴影》对故事的精心挑选使得该选集更加______。
中文解析：
最合理选择是 D.discerning（有眼光的），因为句子想表达“《Mirrorshades》虽然短，但选篇更精、更有品味”，but前后形成对比。

question:
Anthropogenic noise (sounds from human sources like traffic or mining) can affect animals, as Soledad Lucía Uran and colleagues found in a 2012 study of brown rats. A meta-analysis of more than 100 such studies examining various species found that, for every study, relevant traits or behaviors of the animals were observably different between the exposed group and the otherwise similar but unexposed group, regardless of whether that difference was beneficial or detrimental for the exposed group. So while a study of birds might show a difference that benefits the exposed group, and a study of mammals might show a difference that’s harmful to the exposed group, both differences are substantial. Therefore, the results of the meta-analysis suggest that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. exposure to anthropogenic noise will likely have noticeable effects both on mammals such as brown rats and on birds such as reed buntings, but the nature of that effect could be very different for the two species.

B. the studies of the birds likely found significantly larger effects of exposure to anthropogenic noise than most studies of mammals except the study of brown rats by Soledad Lucía Uran and colleagues.
C. the studies in the meta-analysis that examined mammals were more likely than those about birds to specify whether the observed effects were detrimental.
D. the study conducted by Soledad Lucía Uran and colleagues found substantial differences, but studies included in the meta-analysis of mammals other than brown rats likely did not.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
人类噪声（如交通或采矿等来源的声音）会影响动物，正如索莱达·露西亚·乌兰及其同事在2012年对褐鼠的研究中发现的那样。一项对100多项研究进行的荟萃分析发现，在这些研究中，动物的相关特征或行为在暴露组与其他相似但未暴露的组之间显著不同，无论这种差异对暴露组是有利还是有害。因此，尽管对鸟类的研究可能显示出对暴露组有利的差异，而对哺乳动物的研究可能显示出对暴露组有害的差异，但这两种差异都是显著的。因此，这项荟萃分析的结果表明，______。
中文解析：
文本举例说明，鸟类研究中暴露组可能受益，而哺乳动物研究中暴露组可能受到有害影响，这表明不同物种的影响性质可能不同。因此，选项A最准确地总结了元分析的结果，即人为噪音对不同物种都会产生明显影响，但影响的性质可能不同。

question:
In New Zealand, France, and other countries with strong democratic institutions, the state tends to exert relatively little direct control over economic performance. Though this may seem to _______the state’s ability to curb inflation, Raj Desai et al. have shown that strongly democratic states can and do deploy effective counter inflationary policies.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在新西兰、法国及其他拥有强大民主制度的国家，国家对经济表现的直接控制往往相对较少。尽管这可能看起来______国家抑制通货膨胀的能力，Raj Desai等人已证明，强大的民主国家能够并且确实采取有效的反通货膨胀政策。
中文解析：
最合理的选择是 A.hamper，因为句子想表达“政府干预少，看似会削弱控通胀能力”（但实际并非如此）。

question:
Nautilids are marine mollusks that begin growing their shells before emerging from their eggs and continue to add shell segments throughout their lifetimes. The walls between their shells’ chambers are called septa, and the deeper the water in which a septum forms, the greater the concentration of the isotope oxygen-18 the septum will contain. Since temperature falls as depth increases, if the area of ocean a nautilid inhabits is known, this isotopic signature can reveal the temperature at which its septa formed. Paleontologist Amane Tajika and colleagues examined each of the septa in two nautilid shells and concluded that septum sample M20 formed at a temperature of 15.2℃ whereas sample F04 formed at 22.5℃.

Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the researchers’ conclusion?
selections: A. At a depth of 355 meters in the nautilids’ habitat, the water is 15.2°C and the concentration of oxygen-18 is equal to that in sample M20.
B. The concentration of oxygen-18 in F04 is lower than that in M20.
C. The concentration of oxygen-18 in F04 is higher than that in M20.
D. At a depth of 90 meters in the nautilids’ habitat, the water is 22.5℃ and the concentration of oxygen-18 is equal to that in sample F04.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
鹦鹉螺是海洋软体动物，它们在孵化出卵之前就开始生长壳，并在整个生命周期中不断添加壳段。壳室之间的墙壁称为隔板，隔板形成的水越深，氧同位素-18的浓度就越高。由于温度随着深度的增加而降低，如果知道鹦鹉螺栖息的海洋区域，这种同位素特征可以揭示其隔板形成时的温度。古生物学家田近天和他的同事们检查了两只鹦鹉螺壳中的每一个隔板，得出结论，样本M20的形成温度为15.2℃，而样本F04的形成温度为22.5℃。
中文解析：
题目要求削弱文本结论，文本表达氧18浓度与水深（温度）正相关：水越深（温度越低），隔板中的氧气18浓度越高。C选项表明高温样本的氧18浓度更高，直接挑战“浓度与水深正相关”的理论基础，从而削弱研究结论。

question:
Although the clustering of cutlery manufacturing firms in Sheffield, UK, is often cited as typical of industrial agglomeration, Giulia Faggio et al. use UK data to show that the mix of factors driving the phenomenon is ________across industries: while access to specialized suppliers can prompt agglomeration, collocation among refined petroleum product manufacturers occurs for different reasons.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管英国谢菲尔德的餐具制造企业聚集常被视为工业集聚的典型例子，Giulia Faggio等人利用英国的数据表明，推动这一现象的因素在不同行业之间是______的：虽然接触专业供应商可以促使集聚，但精炼石油产品制造商之间的共址则是由于不同的原因。
中文解析：
根据冒号后的具体例子，最合理选择是 C.heterogeneous（多样的），因为句子想表达“不同行业的集聚原因各不相同”。

question:
Studying wrappers from discontinued candies, cover images from out-of-print magazines, and posters promoting concerts by long-forgotten musicians may seem like a frivolous pursuit, but ephemeral objects like these are useful as ________  cultural change, revealing shifts in norms, values, and concerns that traditional objects of historical inquiry may not.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
研究停产糖果的包装、绝版杂志的封面图像以及宣传已经被遗忘的音乐人的音乐会的海报似乎是一种轻浮的追求，但像这些短暂的物品在_______文化变迁中是有用的，揭示了传统历史研究对象可能无法显示的规范、价值观和关注点的变化。
中文解析：
最合理选择是 C.manifestations of（体现），因为句子想表达“这些物品是文化变迁的具体表现”。

question:
Argyroxiphium caliginis is among the twenty-eight species of silversword plants found only on the Hawaiian archipelago that collectively illustrate the process of adaptive radiation, or the rapid diversification of an ancestral species into different, related species. Each silversword species is physically distinct, with mature plant forms ranging from trees and shrubs to vines. However, they all descended from a common tarweed plant species, with their unique physical characteristics emerging as they adapted to the archipelago’s many specific habitats over time.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Most plants that grow on the Hawaiian archipelago are descendants of a single founder species.
B. All silverswords that grow on the Hawaiian archipelago have similar physical characteristics.
C. The Hawaiian archipelago exhibits many distinct habitats and species.
D. Silverswords are good examples of adaptive radiation on the Hawaiian archipelago.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Argyroxiphium caliginis 是二十八种仅在夏威夷群岛发现的银剑植物之一，这些植物共同展示了适应辐射的过程，即祖先物种快速多样化为不同的相关物种。每种银剑植物在形态上都有所不同，成熟的植物形态包括树木、灌木和藤本植物。然而，它们都源自一种共同的油菜植物物种，随着时间的推移，它们的独特物理特征在适应群岛上多样特定栖息地的过程中逐渐形成。
中文解析：
文本主要介绍银剑植物（silverswords）是夏威夷群岛上适应辐射（adaptive radiation）的典型案例。因适应不同栖息地，演化出多样形态；体现“快速从单一祖先分化为多个相关物种”的过程。因此银剑植物是夏威夷群岛上适应辐射的代表实例。

question:
The Truelove, first published in 1992, is a novel in Patrick O’Brian’s Aubrey/ Maturin series, which includes twenty books plus an unfinished fragment of a twenty-first. Some critics have found fault with the abrupt endings of The Truelove and other books in the series, saying that they do not finish conclusively but arbitrarily stop. But other critics argue that the books should not be thought of as discrete texts with traditional beginnings and endings but as a single incredibly long work, similar to other multivolume stories, such as Anthony Powell’s A Dance to the Music of Time.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It explains why many critics find the Aubrey/ Maturin novels to be entertaining despite flaws in the novels’ structures.
B. It argues that the unusual structure that O’Brian uses for The Truelove makes it one of his least entertaining books.
C. It presents a reason most critics think the Aubrey/ Maturin series should not have the literary renown of similar works like A Dance to the Music of Time.
D. It describes a characteristic of the Aubrey/ Maturin novels and summarizes a negative assessment of it.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《真爱》是帕特里克·奥布赖恩的奥布里/马图林系列小说中的一本，首次出版于1992年。该系列包括二十本书以及一部未完成的二十一部的片段。一些评论家对《真爱》和系列中其他书籍的突然结束表示不满，认为它们没有明确的结尾，而是随意停止。然而，另一些评论家则认为，这些书籍不应被视为具有传统开头和结尾的独立文本，而应被视为一部极为庞大的单一作品，类似于其他多卷故事，比如安东尼·鲍威尔的《时间的舞蹈》。
中文解析：
划线部分的作用是指出系列小说的一个特点（abrupt ending），并总结批评家对此的负面评价，因此选D。

question:
The following text is from William Carlos Williams’s 1925 creative nonfiction book In the American Grain. Williams is discussing how works by nineteenth-century US poet and fiction writer Edgar Allan Poe were received by American readers.
Poe must suffer by his originality. Invent that which is new, even if it be made of pine from your own yard, and there’s none to know what you have done. It is because there’s no name. This is the cause of Poe’s lack of recognition. He was American. He was the astounding, inconceivable growth of his locality.

As used in the text, what does the underlined figurative phrase most nearly mean?
selections: A. Personal experiences that are hard for others to comprehend
B. Ideas you have never previously expressed
C. Elements of the culture in which you live
D. Inspiration you received while reading independently
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本出自威廉·卡洛斯·威廉姆斯1925年的创意非虚构作品《在美洲的粮食》中。威廉姆斯讨论了十九世纪美国诗人和小说家埃德加·爱伦·坡的作品是如何被美国读者接受的。
坡必须因其独创性而受苦。创造出新的东西，即使它是用你自己院子里的松木制成的，也没有人知道你做了什么。这是因为没有名字。这就是坡缺乏认可的原因。他是美国人。他是他所处地方令人震惊、不可思议的成长。
中文解析：
威廉斯用"用自家后院的松木打造"（pine from your own yard）这个比喻来讨论爱伦·坡（Edgar Allan Poe）的作品为何不被认可。"自家后院的松木"代表你身边熟悉的文化或环境元素（比如美国本土的、日常的东西）。即使你用这些材料创造出新东西（如坡的作品），但因为它们太本地化、太普通（"没有名气"），人们反而认不出它的价值。

question:
The bird species Piculus flavigula (the yellow-throated woodpecker), which forages in relatively dense vegetation, and Willisonis poecilinotus (the common scale-backed antbird), which forages in open areas or low density vegetation, share territory in French Guiana with Thamnomanes caesius (the cinereous antshrike), which emits a loud alarm call when it detects predators. Biologist Ari Martínez and colleagues, who studied the ecological community the species share, hypothesized that there is an inverse relationship between birds’ field of vision while foraging and their sensitivity to alarm calls from neighboring species.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support Martínez and colleagues’ hypothesis?
selections: A. W. poecilinotus displayed no reaction when Martínez and colleagues played T. caesius alarm calls, whereas P. flavigula displayed predator-avoidance behavior in response to the calls.

B. Many local bird species with similar foraging habits to those of P. flavigula displayed no reaction when Martínez and colleagues played T. caesius alarm calls, whereas P. flavigula displayed predator-avoidance behavior.

C. Some individuals of W. poecilinotus displayed predator-avoidance behavior when Martínez and colleagues played T. caesius alarm calls, whereas nearly all did when P. flavigula alarm calls were played.
D. When Martínez and colleagues played T. caesius alarm calls, P. flavigula and W. poecilinotus displayed no reaction, whereas T. caesius displayed predator-avoidance behavior.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
鸟类物种黄色喉啄木鸟（Piculus flavigula）在相对密集的植被中觅食，而普通鳞背蚁鸟（Willisonis poecilinotus）则在开阔地带或低密度植被中觅食。这两种鸟类在法属圭亚那与灰色蚁啄（Thamnomanes caesius）共享领地，后者在发现捕食者时会发出响亮的警报声。生物学家阿里·马丁内斯（Ari Martínez）及其同事研究了这几个物种共享的生态群落，提出了一种假设，即鸟类在觅食时的视野范围与对邻近物种警报声的敏感性之间存在一种反向关系。
中文解析：
Martínez 团队提出，鸟类在觅食时的视野范围（field of vision）与对邻居物种警报声的敏感度呈负相关（inverse relationship）。视野越受限（如密植被中觅食），越依赖警报声；视野越开阔（如稀疏植被中觅食），越不依赖警报声。密植被觅食的 P. flavigula 对警报声有反应；开阔地带觅食的 W. poecilinotus 对警报声无反应。

Konno et al. suggest that differences in iris color led participants to view some dogs as more vulnerable and in need of protection than others and that this phenomenon could help explain the association the researchers observed between iris color and participants’ inclinations to interact with or keep dogs, as illustrated by the finding that ________

B. dogs that participants rated as friendlier were also dogs that participants indicated a stronger willingness to interact with or keep.

question:
Founded in 1996, the Museum of Latin American Art showcases modern and contemporary art by Latin American artists and Latino artists in the United States. It is located in Long Beach, California, and has more than1,300 objects in its collection. Since 2000, a number of other institutions devoted to Latino cultures have opened in the United States. A notable example is LA Plaza de Culturay Artes in Los Angeles. It focuses on Mexican American art and culture.

Which choice best states the main topic of the text?
selections: A. The history of Los Angeles
B. The decline in the number of people attending museums
C. Latino cultural institutions in the United States
D. The geography of Latin America
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
成立于1996年的拉丁美洲艺术博物馆展示了拉丁美洲艺术家和美国拉丁裔艺术家的现代和当代艺术。博物馆位于加利福尼亚州的长滩，馆藏超过1300件艺术品。自2000年以来，美国开设了许多其他致力于拉丁裔文化的机构。其中一个显著的例子是位于洛杉矶的LA Plaza de Cultura y Artes，专注于墨西哥裔美国人的艺术和文化。
中文解析：
全文围绕美国的拉丁文化机构展开，包括其发展、代表案例及特点，C正确

question:
In Tunica, an Indigenous language from the lower Mississippi Valley in what is now the United States, mili means “red,” whereas milimilita is used to refer to several red things. This phenomenon, in which an element of a root word is repeated, sometimes with modification, within another word that is related to the root word, is called reduplication. In this case, the entire word mili gets repeated in milimilita. There are many examples of this type of reduplication in Tunica.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It presents some specific words in Tunica, describes the general linguistic phenomenon exemplified by those words, and then states that this phenomenon occurs frequently in Tunica.

B. It identifies the most frequently occurring words in Tunica, explains why it is difficult to translate those words into English, and then provides examples of languages other than English into which those words can be translated.
C. It explains the phenomenon of reduplication, discusses why reduplication has been controversial among scholars, and then argues that an analysis of Tunica could help resolve that controversy.
D. It describes the relationship between Tunica and several other languages, raises a question about the nature of that relationship, and then answers that question.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在图尼卡语中，这是一种来自美国现在的下密西西比河谷的土著语言，"mili" 意思是“红色”，而 "milimilita" 则用来指代几样红色的东西。这种现象被称为“重叠”，即在与根词相关的另一个词中重复根词的某个元素，有时会有所修改。在这个例子中，整个单词 "mili" 在 "milimilita" 中被重复。图尼卡语中有许多这种类型的重叠例子。
中文解析：
先给出举例 Tunica 语中的具体单词（如 mili “红色” 和 milimilita “多个红色东西”）。再定义现象，解释这些单词体现的“重叠构词法”（reduplication）（即重复词根或部分词根）。最后总结规律指出这种现象在 Tunica 语中很常见。

question:
Text 1
In separate studies, Marine Fernandez and colleagues and Xinhua He and colleagues examined whether plants transfer nutrients to one another using a common mycorrhizal network (CMN) — a lattice of fungal strands in the soil. Fernandez and colleagues excluded all pathways other than the CMN by using barriers to keep the plants’ root systems separate while allowing mycorrhizal strands through — a crucial step He and colleagues’ study did not take.
Text 2
Fernandez and colleagues took the necessary precaution of separating the plants’ root systems (thereby excluding root-to-root transmission). However, any barrier used must allow the thread-like hyphae of a CMN to pass through, and this permeability would also allow liquids through. Thus, the researchers’ experimental design cannot ensure that any nutrient transfer observed can be attributed to a CMN and not to some other pathway.

Based on the texts, which choice best describes a similarity in the points of view presented in Text 1 and Text 2?
selections: A. Each text attempts to dispel a common misunderstanding about the likelihood of plant-to-plant nutrient transfer.
B. Each text assumes that most nutrient transfer between plants is via a CMN.
C. Each text analyzes methods for studying CMN nutrient transfer in order to propose an alternative method of study.
D. Each text critiques the methodology of a study about nutrient transfer via a CMN.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
文本1
在几项独立研究中，Marine Fernandez及其同事以及Xinhua He及其同事研究了植物是否通过共同的菌根网络（CMN）相互转移营养——这是一种土壤中的真菌丝网。Fernandez及其同事通过使用障碍物将植物的根系隔离，同时允许菌根丝通过，从而排除了除CMN以外的所有转移途径，这是He及其同事的研究所未采取的一个关键步骤。
文本2
Fernandez及其同事采取了必要的预防措施，将植物的根系分开（从而排除了根对根的传输）。然而，使用的任何障碍物必须允许CMN的线状菌丝通过，这种通透性也会允许液体通过。因此，研究人员的实验设计无法确保观察到的任何营养转移可以归因于CMN，而不是其他途径。
中文解析：
两段文本的共同点，均围绕研究方法（methodology）展开讨论，并对其提出批评（critique），Text 1 批评 He 的研究未排除其他途径；Text 2 批评 Fernandez 的屏障设计不彻底。

question:
To prevent excessive microbial growth in the closed habitat of the International Space Station, relative humidity is carefully maintained. Nonetheless, Veillonella parvula and other bacteria, which have the potential to damage spacecraft materials, can _______ when routine crew-member activities (e.g., handwashing) produce localized humidity conditions that exceed the specified maximum for the station overall.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
为了防止国际空间站封闭环境中微生物的过度生长，相对湿度被精心控制。然而，Veillonella parvula 和其他细菌在常规的船员活动（如洗手）产生的局部湿度条件超过空间站的总体最大值时，可能会 _______。
中文解析：
最合理选择是 C.proliferate增殖，因为句子想表达“局部湿度过高时，细菌会快速繁殖”。

question:
To measure changes in parasite abundance over time, Chelsea Wood and colleagues counted parasite individuals preserved on specimens of striped sea perch, surf smelt, and six other fish species collected from Puget Sound between 1880 and 2019. Using statistical models to estimate historical populations, the researchers determined that for every 1°C increase in annual average sea surface temperature, the abundance of complex life cycle parasites like Lecithaster sp. that require at least three unique host species throughout their life cycle decreased by 38%. However, the abundance of Bomolochus bellones and other directly transmitted parasites, which require only one host species, was essentially unchanged. These findings suggest that _________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. Lecithaster sp. abundance decreased by 38% over the period studied, whereas B. bellones abundance did not.
B. parasites that rely exclusively on either striped sea perch or surf smelt are more sensitive to rising temperatures than are parasites that can infect both species throughout their life cycles.
C. dependency on only a single host species may confer on parasites some resilience to rising sea surface temperatures.
D. as the number of hosts that complex life cycle parasites require increases, the parasites’ tolerance for rising sea surface temperatures decreases proportionally.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
为了测量寄生虫丰度随时间的变化，切尔西·伍德及其同事对1880年至2019年间从普吉特湾收集的条纹海鲈、冲浪沙丁鱼和其他六种鱼类标本上保存的寄生虫个体进行了计数。研究人员使用统计模型估算历史种群，确定每当年平均海面温度增加1°C时，像Lecithaster sp.这类在其生命周期中需要至少三种独特宿主物种的复杂生命周期寄生虫的丰度下降了38%。然而，Bomolochus bellones等只需一种宿主物种的直接传播寄生虫的丰度基本保持不变。这些发现表明_________。
中文解析：
根据文本的研究结果复杂生命周期寄生虫（如 Lecithaster sp.，需要至少3种宿主）：海表温度每上升1°C，其abundance减少38%。直接传播寄生虫（如 Bomolochus bellones，仅需1种宿主）：Abundance基本不变。于是单宿主寄生虫因依赖关系简单，可能更适应温度变化，而多宿主寄生虫因生命周期复杂更易受干扰。师生说公众号有这个题目其它版本的解析

question:
The moon Dia orbits Jupiter in the same direction that the planet rotates. ________ Dia’s orbit is described as prograde. Erinome, another of Jupiter’s moons, orbits in the opposite direction, so its orbit is described with the opposite term: retrograde.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
月球Dia以与木星自转相同的方向绕行木星。因此，Dia的轨道被描述为顺行轨道。另一个木星的卫星Erinome则以相反的方向绕行，因此它的轨道被描述为逆行轨道。
中文解析：
第一句说明Dia的轨道方向与木星自转方向相同。第二句直接给出结论：这种轨道被称为顺行（prograde）。两句话之间是因果关系，因为方向相同，所以是顺行，选择thus

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
· Waiting is a 1987 black-and-white linocut print by Kuwaiti artist Thuraya Al-Baqsami.
· It depicts a tranquil, everyday scene (a woman in a headscarf gazing out a window).
· iSera toda nuestra! (“It will all be ours!”) is a 1977 color linocut print by Mexican American artist Carlos Cortéz.
· It features a scene with an explicitly political point of view (a group of laborers preparing to go on strike).
· Lino cutting is an inexpensive printmaking technique in which an image is carved onto linoleum tile, covered in ink or paint, and stamped onto paper.

The student wants to make a generalization about linocut prints. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Linocuts can depict a range of scenes, from the explicitly political to the tranquil and everyday.
B. Cortéz’s linocut features a group of laborers preparing to go on strike, while Al-Baqsami’s depicts a woman in a headscarf gazing out a window.
C. Cortéz made iSera toda nuestra! (“It will all be ours!”) in 1977, while Al-Baqsami made Waiting later, in 1987.
D. Lino cutting is a printmaking technique in which linoleum tile is used to create works with an explicitly political point of view.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
• 《等待》是科威特艺术家图拉雅·阿尔-巴克萨米于1987年创作的黑白亚麻版画。
• 它描绘了一个宁静的日常场景（一个戴着头巾的女人凝视着窗外）。
• 《iSera toda nuestra!》（“这将是我们的！”）是墨西哥裔美国艺术家卡洛斯·科尔特斯于1977年创作的彩色亚麻版画。
• 它呈现了一个具有明确政治观点的场景（一群工人准备罢工）。
• 亚麻切割是一种廉价的版画技术，通过在亚麻瓷砖上雕刻图像，然后涂上油墨或颜料，再将其印刷到纸上。
中文解析：
题目的具体要求是a generalization about linocut prints，两幅版画主题差异（日常抑或是政治），说明这种艺术形式题材广泛。A选项a range of scenes符合generalization要求。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·  Katrin Heer, Larissa Albrecht, and Elisabeth K. V. Kalko published a study in 2010.
· In it, the researchers found that ingestion by bats had a neutral effect on the germination of Ficus nymphaeifolia plant seeds.
· Mikaela Marques Pulzatto and M. S. Dainez Filho published a study in 2017.
· In it, the researchers found that ingestion by bats had a negative effect on the germination of Ficus luschnathiana plant seeds.
· Reinaldo Chaves Teixeira, C. Corrêa, and E. Fischer published a study in 2009.
· In it, the researchers found that ingestion by bats had a positive effect on the germination of Ficus pertusa plant seeds.

The student wants to make a generalization about the germination of seeds ingested by bats. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Bat ingestion has consistently been found to have a positive effect on seed germination.
B. As was found in the 2010 study, ingestion by bats has a positive effect on the germination of plant seeds.
C. Over the years, researchers have studied the effect that seed germination has had on ingestion by bats.
D. Seed ingestion by bats can have varying effects on seed germination.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，学生做了以下笔记：
• Katrin Heer、Larissa Albrecht 和 Elisabeth K. V. Kalko 于2010年发表了一项研究。
• 研究发现，蝙蝠对 Ficus nymphaeifolia 植物种子的摄食对其发芽没有影响。
• Mikaela Marques Pulzatto 和 M. S. Dainez Filho 于2017年发表了一项研究。
• 研究发现，蝙蝠对 Ficus luschnathiana 植物种子的摄食对其发芽有负面影响。
• Reinaldo Chaves Teixeira、C. Corrêa 和 E. Fischer 于2009年发表了一项研究。
• 研究发现，蝙蝠对 Ficus pertusa 植物种子的摄食对其发芽有积极影响。
中文解析：
题目要求a generalization about the germination of seeds ingested by bats，根据notes中有积极、中立和消极各种影响，于是概括为D选项的varying effects。Generalization notes题目的在SAT师生说公众号有专项讲解

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
· Between the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, the city of Timbuktu was part of the Songhai Empire.
· Timbuktu was a center of trade and scholarship in the Sahara desert.
· The city was known for its hundreds of thousands of written manuscripts on both secular and religious subjects.
· The manuscripts survive today in dozens of private libraries across the city.
· The Pearls Leading to Accepted Guidance is one of these manuscripts.

The student wants to introduce The Pearls Leading to Accepted Guidance to an audience unfamiliar with the Timbuktu manuscripts’ history. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Between the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, the city of Timbuktu was home to The Pearls Leading to Accepted Guidance, a manuscript that discusses trade centers across the Sahara desert.
B. In the city of Timbuktu, dozens of private libraries house manuscripts, such as The Pearls Leading to Accepted Guidance, that discuss both secular and religious subjects.
C. The Pearls Leading to Accepted Guidance is a manuscript housed in a private library in Timbuktu.
D. Among Timbuktu’s vast collection of secular and religious manuscripts dating back to the Songhai Empire is The Pearls Leading to Accepted Guidance.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，学生做了以下笔记：
• 在十五世纪和十六世纪之间，廷巴克图是宋海帝国的一部分。
• 廷巴克图是撒哈拉沙漠中的一个贸易和学术中心。
• 这座城市以其数十万份关于世俗和宗教主题的书面手稿而闻名。
• 这些手稿至今仍保存在城市内的数十个私人图书馆中。
• 《通往被接受的引导的珍珠》是其中一份手稿。
中文解析：
根据题目要求向不熟悉Timbuktu manuscripts’ history的读者介绍The Pearls Leading to Accepted Guidance ，那么就需要结合背景的历史信息，D选项完整涵盖三大背景：数量庞大（vast collection），主题多样（secular and religious）及历史渊源（Songhai Empire）

question:
Scientists studying asteroid deflection have focused on secondary objects such as S/2015 (190208), a moonlet orbiting the near-Earth asteroid 2006 AQ. In 2022 NASA intentionally crashed a probe into just such an object, successfully altering its orbit. Scientists have yet to demonstrate, ________ that 2006 AQ and other primary objects would be similarly affected.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
科学家们研究小行星偏转时，关注了次要天体，例如S/2015 (190208)，这是一个围绕近地小行星2006 AQ运行的月球状小体。2022年，NASA故意将探测器撞击了这样一个天体，成功改变了它的轨道。然而，科学家们尚未证明，_______ 这个空白，2006 AQ和其他主要天体会受到类似的影响。

科学家已通过实验证明，撞击卫星（S/2015）能改变其轨道。但尚未证明主天体（2006 AQ等）是否也会受到类似影响。两句话之间存在让步关系，承认一个事实，但指出局限性，admittedly符合要求

question:
Many paintings of the trompe l’ oeil genre attain their illusory verisimilitude by depicting quotidian things, such as a fly or an empty bird cage, as if they are placed directly on top of the painted canvas. Nicola van Houbraken’s 1700 trompe I’oeil Portrait of François Rivière, _______ startles the viewer with the extraordinary sight of a man appearing to poke his head out from within the picture frame.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
许多 trompe l’oeil 风格的画作通过描绘日常物品，例如苍蝇或空鸟笼，来达到其幻觉般的逼真效果，仿佛这些物品直接放置在画布上。尼古拉·范·霍布拉肯（Nicola van Houbraken）于1700年创作的 trompe l’oeil 《弗朗索瓦·里维埃肖像》________的空白部分让观众惊讶，因为画中的男人似乎正从画框中探出头来。
中文解析：
大多数“错视画”（trompe l'oeil）通过画日常小物件（如苍蝇、空鸟笼）来制造“它们好像真的贴在画布上”的错觉。van Houbraken 的这幅画却画了一个人从画框里探出头，效果更夸张、更不寻常。逻辑关系是对比，后文是与前文形成对比（普通小物件 vs. 惊人的人头效果），所以选 B.by contrast（相比之下）。

question:
Given that healthy genetic diversity supports honey bee population robustness—a matter of public interest given the bees’ crucial role as pollinators of many crops, such as watermelon—a study revealing a _______ of diversity among US honey bees raised concern, though it also noted the potential to enhance the number of bees carrying several newly discovered genetic variants(e.g., A2-829-4-USA).

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:

鉴于健康的遗传多样性有助于维持蜜蜂种群的强健性——考虑到蜜蜂作为西瓜等多种作物关键传粉者的重要角色，这已成为一项公共利益问题——一项揭示美国蜜蜂多样性_______的研究引发了担忧，不过该研究同时指出，通过推广携带若干新发现遗传变体（如A2-829-4-USA型）的蜂群数量，存在提升种群质量的潜力。

question:
In a large community science effort, biologist Grace Herzel and colleagues collaborated with hundreds of students and other amateur science enthusiasts for more than three years to study how butterfly color and weather conditions relate to butterfly behavior. They found that butterfly color might influence behavior more than butterfly size does, and that butterflies tended to prefer orange and red flowers on cloudy days and multicolor flowers on partly cloudy days.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Collaboration between professional scientists and members of the public is especially useful when studying the behavior of butterflies and other flying insects.
B. A recent study suggested that butterflies’ coloring seems to be less relevant to their behavior than weather conditions.
C. Weather conditions and butterfly color seem to have less influence on butterfly behavior than the location where the butterflies are studied does.
D. A large study suggested that butterfly color and weather conditions might influence the behavior of certain butterflies.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在一项规模宏大的公民科学行动中，生物学家格蕾丝·赫泽尔（Grace Herzel）与数百名学生及业余科学爱好者历时三年多展开合作，研究蝴蝶颜色及天气条件如何影响其行为。研究发现：相较于体型因素，蝴蝶颜色对行为的影响更为显著；阴天时蝴蝶更青睐橙红色花朵，而多云天气则偏好杂色花卉。
中文解析：
根据文本中的研究，蝴蝶颜色对行为的影响比体型更大，天气与花朵颜色的偏好有关系，于是D选项符合要求，颜色和天气都影响蝴蝶的行为

question:
The invertebrates Haywardozoon pacificum and Trophomera manganI have recently been discovered inhabiting the Clarion-Clipperton Zone (CCZ), an area of abyssal plain between Hawaii and Mexico where mining is permitted. The number of other invertebrates that may inhabit the CCZ is currently ________, as the area’s biota is poorly sampled and the few samples that have been taken cannot be presumed to be representative.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
无脊椎动物"太平洋海沃德虫"（Haywardozoon pacificum）和"锰营养体虫"（Trophomera mangan）最近被发现栖息在克拉里昂-克利珀顿区（CCZ）——这是夏威夷和墨西哥之间允许采矿的一片深海平原。由于该区域生物群采样严重不足，且现有少量样本难以代表整体情况，可能栖息在CCZ的其他无脊椎动物数量目前________。
中文解析：
前文指出CCZ区域生物采样不足（poorly sampled），现有样本缺乏代表性（cannot be presumed representative）需要填入一个描述"其他无脊椎动物数量"的形容词，D.inestimable（难以估量的），反映因数据不足无法统计

question:
Movies that are part of larger franchises are often criticized for being predictable. Take, for instance, Spider Man: Far From Home (2019), which is part of the Marvel Cinematic Universe franchise. It’s true that this movie resembles earlier Marvel movies. But just because a movie has familiar elements doesn’t mean it can’t also be worth watching. Critics generally agree that Spider Man: Far From Home isn’t the most exciting franchise movie, but franchise movies are rarely as stale as some people claim. And some franchise movies, like Logan (2017), are wonderfully original.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. The text summarizes the plot of a franchise movie, then explains how the plot is continued in a later movie in that franchise.
B. The text explains why some people enjoyed a particular franchise movie, then considers why other people disliked it.
C. The text describes audiences’ reactions to a movie that is part of a larger franchise, then presents some critics reactions to that movie.
D. The text discusses a common criticism of franchise movies, then argues that the criticism is mostly undeserved.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
作为大型系列电影的一部分，漫威宇宙的《蜘蛛侠：英雄远征》（2019年）常被批评剧情套路化——确实，这部作品延续了漫威电影的一贯风格。但具有熟悉元素并不意味着不值得观看。影评人普遍认为，虽然《英雄远征》并非最令人振奋的系列电影，但这类作品很少如某些观点所言那般陈腐乏味。更有如《金刚狼3：殊死一战》（2017年）这样的系列电影，依然能呈现惊人的原创性。
中文解析：
开头指出系列电影常被批评为 predictable也就是可预测的，剧情老套的，并以Spider Man: Far From Home（2019）为例说明其与早期漫威电影相似，但是也很好，不像人们说的那样乏味，甚至有些非常原创，所以criticism is undeserved。

question:
Sandra Cisneros’s English-language short story “Eyes of Zapata” occasionally includes words and phrases from the Mexican dialect of Spanish. While the story doesn’t translate the Spanish text into English, the meaning can be inferred from the surrounding English text. Ana Castillo adopts a comparable approach to Spanish in her English language novel So Far from God. Both works thus remain accessible to all readers of English, not just those who can also read Spanish.

What is the main topic of the text?
selections: A. The difficulty of translating Sandra Cisneros’s works into languages other than English
B. The commercial success of English-language literature around the world
C. The enduring popularity of Ana Castillo’s works in Mexico
D. The use of non-English vocabulary in two English-language literary works
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
桑德拉·希斯内罗斯的英文短篇小说《萨帕塔之眼》中，偶尔夹杂着墨西哥西班牙语方言的词汇与短语。虽然故事并未将这些西班牙语文本翻译成英文，但读者仍能通过上下文的英文推断其含义。安娜·卡斯蒂略在其英文小说《远离上帝》中也采用了类似的西班牙语处理方式。因此，这两部作品对所有英语读者——而不仅是懂西班牙语的读者——都保持了可读性。
中文解析：
提到两位作家（Sandra Cisneros和Ana Castillo）在英语作品中夹杂西班牙语词汇，强调这些外语内容不翻译成英语，但通过上下文仍能让英语读者理解，明确指出这种写法不影响作品，于是主要内容就是讨论non-English vocabulary在英语文学作品中的使用

question:
Anne Bronte’s 1847 novel Agnes Grey contains elements drawn from Bronte’s own life: there are many parallels between the experiences of the novel’s tide character and those of Bronte, and as a result Agnes Grey is regularly described as an autobiographical novel. This characterization can be useful, but it also presents drawbacks in terms of how the work is perceived, as it may lead readers to believe that Bronte merely fictionalized true events, which, in an artistic field where creativity and inventiveness are prized, can suggest that ___________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. Agnes Grey is less of an imaginative achievement than it actually is.
B. the real-world counterparts of other characters in Agnes Grey are hard to identify.
C. Bronte should not have claimed that Agnes Grey is based on real events.
D. critics disagree about whether Agnes Grey shows greater originality than works without autobiographical elements.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
安妮·勃朗特于1847年创作的小说《阿格尼丝·格雷》中包含了从勃朗特自己的生活中汲取的元素：小说中主角的经历与勃朗特的经历之间存在许多相似之处，因此《阿格尼丝·格雷》经常被描述为一部自传体小说。这种描述可能有用，但在作品被理解方面也存在缺点，因为它可能会让读者认为勃朗特仅仅是将真实事件虚构化了，而在一个重视创造力和独创性的艺术领域中，这可能暗示着____________。
中文解析：
A) Agnes Grey is less of an imaginative achievement than it actually is.
这个选项最合乎逻辑地补全了文本。在一个重视创造力和独创性的艺术领域，如果读者认为勃朗特只是虚构了真实事件，那么可能会导致读者认为《艾格尼丝·格雷》不是一个想象力的成就。

question:
The following text is from Julia Alvarez’s 2000 novel In the Name of Salomé. Salomé, a poet, is hosting guests in the front parlor of her family home, and Ramona is her sister: A salon is a social gathering for the exploration of intellectual ideas.

The front parlor had always been her special province, as she used it for her little school. Which choice best describes the function of the reference to the parlor as Tia Ana’s “special province”?
selections: A. It reveals that Tia Ana feels as if Salomé has betrayed her trust by allowing guests into space she considers her own.
B. It indicates the joy that Tía Ana feels when she uses her classroom for varying purposes.
C. It characterizes the room as a place where Tía Ana can go to escape social pressures.

question:
Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives (2010) and other films by Thai director Apichatpong Weerasethakul are contributions to slow cinema, an art house genre whose contemplative pacing and deprivileging of narrative are further exemplified by films such as Andrei Tarkovsky’s Solaris (1972). Apichatpong describes his films as sleep inducing, which might suggest that they bore their audiences, but boredom does not necessarily cause sleep: in the absence of a goal to which one attaches attention and interest, the tension of boredom can be anxiety inducing rather than soporific. Thus, Apichatpong’s description of his films is not self-deprecation; rather, his work invites sleep and thereby strips the description of its negative connotation.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Audiences will fail to enjoy both Solaris and Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives if they confuse sleepiness with boredom.
B. Slow-cinema films can relieve anxiety for those who embrace their languid pace, but the films increase anxiety for those experiencing boredom as a result of the lack of a cohesive narrative.

C. Solaris and many other slow cinema films often induce anxiety in their audiences due to their measured pace, but films by Aplchartpong do not, despite possessing other traits characteristic of the genre.
D. It would be a misunderstanding to interpret Apichatpong’s reflection on his work as a confession of its failure, because the effects his films produce on audiences are intentional.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《能召回前世的布米叔叔》（2010年）与泰国导演阿彼察邦·韦拉斯哈古的其他作品，皆是对"慢电影"这一艺术流派的贡献。该流派以沉思性的节奏和弱化叙事为特征，安德烈·塔可夫斯基《飞向太空》（1972年）等影片亦属此列。阿彼察邦自称其作品具有"催眠"效果——这或许暗示着影片令观众感到无聊，但无聊未必导致睡意：当缺乏能凝聚注意力与兴趣的目标时，无聊产生的紧张感反而可能引发焦虑而非昏睡。因此，导演对作品的描述并非自谦；相反，他的创作确实在召唤睡眠，由此剥离了"催眠"一词的负面内涵。
中文解析：
Apichatpong作品属于"慢电影"类型，具有沉思节奏和弱化叙事的特点，自称其电影"催眠"，但这并非自嘲，催眠不是无聊（boredom可能引发焦虑而非睡意），导演刻意通过电影营造睡眠邀请，剥离了"催眠"的负面含义（好得分网站有其变体题目），D选项符合要求，大意是如果你认为Apichatpong’s reflection是忏悔，就想错了，因为这是刻意营造的电影效果。

question:
British professional soccer team Manchester United Football Club, whose home uniform color is mainly red, won more than half its home matches between 1947 and 2003. This is a higher proportion of home matches than Hull city Association Football Club, whose home uniform color is not red, won during the same period. According to a study by Martin J. Attrill and colleagues, the color red can cause people to respond with fear and hesitation, which the researchers think helps explain Manchester United’s success. Nadav Goldschmied and colleagues reanalyzed the published data from this study, however, and found no evidence that red uniformed teams are more likely than other teams to win, suggesting that Manchester United’s performance at its home stadium _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. would probably have remained roughly the same if its players had not been wearing red uniforms.
B. was likely influenced by its opponents associations with the color red.
C. was directly tied to its players’ general satisfaction with their unform color
D. may have influenced other teams to change their uniform colors.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
英国职业足球队曼彻斯特联足球俱乐部（主场队服以红色为主）在1947至2003年间赢得了过半的主场比赛。这一主场胜率高于同期主场队服非红色的赫尔城足球俱乐部。马丁·J·阿特里尔团队的研究指出，红色会引发人们的恐惧与迟疑反应，研究者认为这解释了曼联的成功。然而，纳达夫·戈德施密德团队重新分析该研究数据后，发现并无证据表明身着红色队服的球队胜率更高，这意味着曼联在老特拉福德球场的战绩_______。
中文解析：
重新分析数据后，发现没有证据支持红色球衣与胜率存在关联，既然新研究否定了红色球衣的影响，也就是说即使不穿红色球衣，曼联的表现也可能基本不变，和A选项一致

question:
Maryam Hosseini and her team used aerial images of well-mapped areas of Boston to train a computer program to identify sidewalks. When it was tested on images of Brooklyn, it ________ identified sidewalks in the vast majority of cases and even whether sidewalks were concrete or brick. Hosseini believes the program will improve on this already-strong performance as it gets used more.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
玛丽亚姆·霍塞尼（Maryam Hosseini）与研究团队利用波士顿已测绘区域的航拍图像训练计算机程序识别人行道。当该程序在布鲁克林的图像上进行测试时，________在绝大多数情况下准确识别出人行道，甚至能区分混凝土与砖砌材质。霍塞尼认为，随着使用次数增加，这个已经表现优异的程序还将持续优化。
中文解析：
根据最后的积极表达improve on already-strong performance，于是选择积极的选项，说明该computer program是可靠的,reliably符合要求。

question:
Text 1
Despite how the Indian dish madras differs from Mauritius’s gato pima, both dishes are described as a “curry.” The word’s history, however, is fraught. It’s a term created by British and Portuguese colonizers to refer to the myriad spiced sauces with ties to the Indian subcontinent. In 1973, chef Madhur Jaffrey dismissed the term “curry” as inaccurate, and in 2021 blogger Nisha Vedi Pawar suggested that people abandon the term both for its colonial origin and for its failure to grasp the intricacies of India’s cuisines.
Text 2
Growing up in India, chef Chintan Pandya didn’t encounter the term “curry” often: his family didn’t cook curries, but some of his neighbors did. Although the blanket use of the term is rooted in colonialism, Pandya calls some of his dishes curries. Having traveled throughout India as part of his training, he came to appreciate the country’s diverse cuisines and the diverse uses of the term “curry.”

Text 1 and Text 2 present points of view about which topic?
selections: A. The history about the peoples on the Indian subcontinent
B. The use of the term “curry”
C. The difference between madras and gato pima
D. The best method for studying a region’s culsine
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
文本一
尽管印度马德拉斯咖喱与毛里求斯嘎多皮玛风味迥异，两者却都被笼统称为"咖喱"。然而这个词的历史充满争议——这个由英国和葡萄牙殖民者创造的术语，被用来指代所有与印度次大陆相关的香料酱汁。1973年，名厨玛德胡·贾弗里驳斥"咖喱"一词不够准确；2021年博主妮莎·维迪·帕瓦尔更提议弃用该词，既因其殖民渊源，也因它无法体现印度饮食文化的精妙之处。
文本二
主厨钦坦·潘迪亚在印度成长期间鲜少听闻"咖喱"一词：他的家庭不烹制所谓咖喱，但有些邻居会。尽管这个统称植根于殖民历史，潘迪亚仍将自己部分菜肴称为咖喱。在厨艺修行期间走遍印度的经历，让他既领略到祖国饮食文化的多样性，也认识到"咖喱"一词本身的多义性。
中文解析：
两篇文本的核心都是关于curry这个表述

question:
The Polynesian languages, a group of related languages originating on islands in the Pacific, typically have ________ array of consonant sounds. For example, the Tokelauan language of the South Pacific has eleven consonants, and ‘Olelo Hawairi’, the language of the Native Hawaiian people, has eight. Globally, however, the median number of consonants per language is over twenty-two.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
波利尼西亚语族（一组起源于太平洋岛屿的关联语言）通常具有________的辅音系统。例如，南太平洋托克劳语（Tokelauan）仅有11个辅音，而夏威夷原住民语言‘Ōlelo Hawai’i’则只有8个。但就全球而言，每种语言的辅音数量中位数超过22个。
中文解析：
波利尼西亚语言的辅音数量较少（例如夏威夷语有8个，托克劳语有11个），而全球语言辅音数量的中位数超过22个。这表明这些语言的辅音系统较为精简，modest可以表示数量适中，不多

question:
Enacted in 1944, Iceland’s constitution, according to legal _______ contains one of the six constitutional features that enhance judicial independence. Explicit provisions for judicial Independence. Melton and Ginsburg’s research explains, are more likely to be found in constitutions enacted after 1985.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. researchers James Melton and Tom Ginsburg
B. researchers, James Melton and Tom Ginsburg
C. researchers James Melton and T om Ginsburg,
D. Researchers,James Melton and Tom Ginsburg,
explanations: researchers限定修饰后面的两个人名中间不加标点，according to...属于整个句子的插入语，前后有逗号，所以对应C

question:
Amruta Yelamanchili has worked at NASA’s famed Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL), one of the world’s leading facilities for robotic space exploration. _______ Yelamanchili worked as a data scientist on the JPL’s Mars 2020 Perseverance rover team, which improved upon the 2011 Curiosity rover design by adding a coring drill to the robot that could collect rock samples for later analysis.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
阿姆鲁塔·耶拉曼奇利（Amruta Yelamanchili）曾任职于美国宇航局著名的喷气推进实验室（JPL）——这个全球顶尖的机器人太空探索机构。作为JPL"火星2020"毅力号探测车团队的数据科学家，她在2011年好奇号探测车设计基础上进行升级，为机器人增配了岩芯钻探装置，用于采集岩石样本以供后续分析。
中文解析：
Amruta Yelamanchili 在 NASA 著名的喷气推进实验室（JPL）工作,Yelamanchili 在 JPL 的 Mars 2020 Perseverance 火星车团队中担任数据科学家，该火星车在 2011 年 Curiosity 火星车设计的基础上进行了改进，需要选择一个过渡词，将这两句话或后半部分的内容更自然地连接起来。从笼统到具体需要specifically，类型的题目参考好得分的逻辑词

question:
Drummer Dennis Chambers’s distinguished career includes many memorable achievements, such as working on the Brecker Brothers’ album Return of the Brecker Brothers. However, as house drummer at Sugar Hill Records, a record label that was a pioneer of early hip hop ______ Chambers joined too late to play drums on the label’s classic song “Rapper’s Delight.”

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: Chambers joined...是完整句子，前面a record label属于修饰 Sugar Hill Records的同位语（也是插入语），后面跟着一个that引导的定语从句，所以music后面应该用逗号。

question:
Though Middle English was widely spoken in fourteenth-century England, the language was rarely employed in literature until poet Geoffrey Chaucer helped pioneer its literary use. __________ his manuscripts contain the first documented uses of over 2,000 English words—like the word “exaltation” in his 1386 poem “The Squire’s Tale”—which led a contemporary to dub him “the first finder of our fair language.”

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管中古英语在14世纪的英格兰被广泛使用，但直到诗人杰弗里·乔叟帮助开创了文学用途，这种语言在文学作品中很少被采用。他的手稿中包含了超过2,000个英语单词的首次记录使用，比如他在1386年的诗歌《The Squire's Tale》中使用的单词"exaltation"，这使得当时有人封他为"我们美丽语言的第一个发现者"。
中文解析：
选项D) "Indeed," 是最合适的选择来完成文本并提供最具逻辑性的过渡。在这个句子中，前半部分提到了中英语在14世纪广泛使用但在文学作品中很少被采用，然后提到乔叟帮助开创了中英语文学运用的先河。选项D中的“Indeed”可以用来引出一个事实或观点，加强前文提到的内容。在这种情况下，使用“Indeed”引出了关于乔叟在手稿中使用大量英语单词的事实，突出了他对当时英语文学的重要贡献。其他选项可能无法提供这种逻辑性的过渡，因此选项D是最合适的选择。

question:
London-based Nigerian sculptor Sokari Douglas Camp creates art by cutting, bending, and welding recycled metal materials into new and thought-provoking shapes. Her work—which has been featured in galleries around the world, such as the Potters Field Commission for Southwark Council in London and Skidmore College’s Tang Teaching Museum and Art Gallery in New York— often references at least one of several ________ the environment, and Kalabari culture.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 列出三个并列主题，movement, the environment, Kalabari culture列举多项内容时，常用冒号引出具体项目

question:
Two siblings from the same biological parents can inherit different physical traits. For instance, one sibling might inherit thin lips; the other sibling, _______ might inherit full lips.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
同父同母的兄弟姐妹可能遗传不同的外貌特征。例如，一个可能遗传薄唇，而另一个则可能遗传丰唇。
中文解析：
第一句,来自同一对亲生父母的两个兄弟姐妹可以继承不同的身体特征。第二句,例如，一个兄弟姐妹可能继承薄嘴唇；另一个兄弟姐妹，可能继承厚嘴唇。两者间对比关系需要by contrast

question:
Blaise Pascal’s Pascaline device — conceived, like William Oughtred’s earlier Circular Slide Rule, amid the seventeenth century push to replace manual calculations with faster and more accurate machine-based methods — _______ among the first reproducible calculating machines.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: Blaise Pascal’s Pascaline device是单数主语，对应谓语was

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·The Carnegie Prize is an international art competition administered by the Carnegie Museum of Art in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
·Painter Anselm Kiefer of Germany won a Carnegie Prize gold medal in 1985.
·Kiefer’s winning artwork was a painting entitled Midgard
·Sculptor Jean Arp of Germany won a Carnegie Prize gold medal in 1964.
·Arp’s winning artwork was a sculpture entitled Sculpture Classique.

The student wants to contrast the two artworks. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Kiefer’s Midgard is a painting, while Arp’s Sculpture Classique is a sculpture.
B. Kiefer won a Carnegie Prize gold medal in 1985 for the painting Magard
C. Carnegie Prize gold medals have been awarded to both painters and sculptors.
D. Both Midgard and Sculpture Classique are Carnegie Prize gold medal-winning artworks.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下是某学生在研究某一主题时整理的笔记要点：
·卡内基奖是由宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市卡内基艺术博物馆举办的国际艺术竞赛
·德国画家安塞姆·基弗于1985年获得卡内基奖金奖
·基弗的获奖作品为油画《米德加德》
·德国雕塑家让·阿尔普于1964年获得卡内基奖金奖
·阿尔普的获奖作品为雕塑《古典雕塑》
中文解析：
学生想要对比这两件艺术作品，两件作品最明显的区别：一个是绘画，一个是雕塑，A选项满足要求

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
•Merle Oberon (1911-1979) was an actress born in Mumbai (then known as Bombay), India.
•She was of Indian, Maori, and Irish heritage.
•She was the first Indian-born actress to be nominated for an Academy Award.
•Early in her career, she played many nameless, uncredited roles, such as her role in Aren’t We All? (1932).
•Later, she played many named, credited roles, such as Sue Mayberry in Affectionately Yours (1941).

The student wants to begin a narrative about Merle Oberon’s life.
selections: A. Merle Oberon’s story begins in Mumbai (then known as Bombay), India, in 1911.
B. Merle Oberon appeared in many films, including Aren’t We All? (1932) and Affectionately Yours (1941), and was the first Indian-born actress to be nominated for an Academy ward.
C. In 1941, Merle Obero played the role of Sue Mayberry in the film Affectionately Yours.
D. Though she would go on to receive many films, Merle Oberon also played nameless, uncredited roles in many films such as the movie Aren’t we all ? (1932).
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一位学生记下了以下内容：
- Merle Oberon（1911-1979）是一位出生在印度孟买（当时称为孟买）的女演员。
- 她有印度、毛利和爱尔兰血统。
- 她是第一位获得奥斯卡奖提名的印度出生女演员。
- 在她的职业生涯初期，她出演了许多无名、未署名的角色，比如她在《我们都不是？》（1932）中的角色。
- 后来，她出演了许多有名字、署名的角色，比如在《深情地致您》（1941）中扮演的Sue Mayberry。
中文解析：
这个选择最有效地利用了笔记中的相关信息来开始关于Merle Oberon生平的叙述。首先，它提到了Merle Oberon的出生地点和出生时间，这直接涉及到了她的背景和起源。这种叙述方式帮助引入主题并为读者提供了关于Merle Oberon的基本信息，为后续叙述她的一生打下了基础。

question:
When a soil is classified using the International Union of Soil Sciences’ system, its similarity to each of the 32 soil reference groups — defined by several criteria— _______ evaluated, one group at a time, until a match is found. The comparisons are made in a specific order: thus, the criteria for lixisols (soils with clay-rich subsoil) are only applied if the soil doesn’t match the criteria for ferralsols.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: similarity是单数主语，对应谓语需要是复数，根据上下文时态是一般现在时，选择is

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
•Blackberries are fruits that contain ascorbic acid, an essential nutrient for humans.
•Every 100 grams (g) of blackberries contains 21 milligrams (mg) of ascorbic acid.
•Many animals can make ascorbic acid in their bodies, but humans cannot.
•Human must get ascorbic acid from foods, including fruits and vegetables.
•Ascorbic acid is also known as Vitamin C.

The student wants to specify how much vitamin C is in blackberries. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Many animals can make ascorbic acid, which is also known as vitamin C, in their bodies, but humans cannot.
B. There is 21 mg of vitamin C in every 100 g of blackberries.
C. Since humans cannot make vitamin C in their bodies, they must get this essential nutrient from foods like blackberries.
D. Blackberries contain vitamin C, which humans must get from food.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一位学生记下了以下内容：
- 黑莓是含有抗坏血酸的水果，这是人类的一种必需营养素。
- 每100克黑莓含有21毫克抗坏血酸。
- 许多动物可以在体内合成抗坏血酸，但人类不能。
- 人类必须从食物中获取抗坏血酸，包括水果和蔬菜。
- 抗坏血酸也被称为维生素C。
中文解析：
选项B) "There is 21 mg of vitamin C in every 100 g of blackberries." 最有效地使用了笔记中的相关信息来指定黑莓中的维生素C含量。这个选项直接提到了每100克黑莓中含有21毫克维生素C，清晰明了地回答了学生关于黑莓中维生素C含量的问题。其他选项虽然也提到了维生素C和黑莓的关系，但没有提供具体的数量信息，因此不如选项B直接有效地回答了学生的问题。因此，选项B是最有效的选择。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
· E.M. Forster was an acclaimed writer
· He is best known for his novels.
· Forster’s most famous novels include A Room with a View (1908) and Howards End (1910).
· His first published work of fiction was a short story called “Albergo Empedocle.”
· It was published in Temple Bar in 1903.

The student wants to provide a specific example of one of E.M. Forster’s most famous works. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. E.M. Forster was an acclaimed writer known for his novels
B. “Albergo Empedocle” was published before some of E. M. Forster’s most famous novels.
C. The 1908 novel A Room with a View is one of E. M. Forster’s most famous works.
D. E. M. Forster’s first published work of fiction was a 1903 short story called “Albergo Empedocle.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下是学生在研究某一主题时整理的笔记要点：
· E·M·福斯特是备受赞誉的作家
· 他以小说创作最为闻名
· 其最著名的小说包括《看得见风景的房间》（1908年）与《霍华德庄园》（1910年）
· 他首部公开发表的虚构作品是短篇小说《阿尔贝戈·恩培多克勒》
· 该作品于1903年刊载于《庙堂》杂志
中文解析：
需要提供一个"最著名作品"的具体例子，A Room with a View (1908)是最著名作品之完全符合"提供最著名作品具体例子"的要求，C符合要求。

question:
For most of its length, the Pungue River has sufficiently high flow velocity to suspend sedimentary particles; but when the river reaches the calmer waters of the Indian Ocean, its channel widens and divides, reducing flow velocity and thereby ________ sedimentary particle suspension. Particles are thus deposited, eventually forming deltaic lobes.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析：
由于流速降低，悬浮能力减弱，颗粒会停止悬浮并沉积。因此，空缺处应填入一个表示“中断、阻止”悬浮的词，interrupting符合要求。
题目文本翻译：
彭圭河在绝大部分流域保持着足以悬浮沉积颗粒的流速；但当河流注入风平浪静的印度洋时，河道逐渐展宽分汊，流速减缓，从而________沉积颗粒的悬浮能力。这些颗粒因此沉降堆积，最终形成三角洲朵状体。

question:
Annual Number of Forest Patches for Three Land Use Capability Classes in the Chorotega Region, Costa Rica
To understand the extent of deforestation in the Chorotega region of Costa Rica, Juan Pablo Arroyo Mora and colleagues used historical aerial photography and remote sensing data to track changes in the total number of forest patches in areas of different land use capability classes (categories that indicate possible uses of forest land). Due to the Chorotega region’s accessibility, various types of forested areas were converted to cattle pasture as rising international meat prices drove a cattle ranching boom in the 1960s and 1970s: this conversion is evident in the _________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the assertion?
selections: A. high number of patches in class VII and class VIII in 1986.
B. difference between the number of patches in Class VII and in Cass VI in 2000.
C. increase in the number of patches for all classes from 1979 to 2000.
D. decrease in the number of patches for all classes from 1960 to 1979.
explanations:
中文解析：
1960-1979年所有等级的柱状图量减少，与“大规模森林砍伐”时期吻合
题目文本翻译：
为了了解哥斯达黎加乔罗特加地区的森林砍伐程度，胡安·巴布罗·阿罗约·莫拉及其同事使用历史航拍照片和遥感数据来追踪不同土地利用能力类别（指示森林土地可能用途的类别）区域内森林斑块总数的变化。由于乔罗特加地区的可达性，各种类型的森林区域在1960年代和1970年代国际肉类价格上涨推动的牛肉养殖热潮中被转变为牛牧场：这种转变在______中显而易见。

question:
The Virgin Group’s introduction of the Virgin Atlantic airline in 1984 is an instance of brand extension—the company leveraged its brand recognition as a music retailer to enter a new product category. To investigate how market share affects consumers’ likelihood of purchasing brand extensions, Alicia Grasby et al identified 30 extended brand pairs (e.g., the same brand of vacuum cleaner and microwave) in household purchasing data; for each pair, Grasby et al. calculated the branded products’ market share and calculated the increase in probability of a brand in one category being purchased if the same brand was purchased in the other category. A broad inverse relationship between the two values emerged, which can most reasonably be attributed to the fact that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the purchase probability of a brand is affected by the purchase probability of the particular product category to which it belongs, and thus brands in categories that are rarely purchased tend to have low purchase probabilities regardless of market share.

B. as a brand’s market share increases, the number of competing brands in the same product category tends to decrease, and thus the rate of increase in market share tends to accelerate as a brand’s market share grows.

C. brands with high market share have high purchase probability regardless of whether the other product in the pair is purchased and thus have less potential to increase in purchase probability than brands with low market share do.

D. consumers tend to be less familiar with brands with low market share than brands with high market share and thus may purchase both products in a pair with low market share without recognizing that the products are the same brand.
explanations:
中文解析：
这个题目是关于brand extension，之前师生说公众号分析过类似的文章，用的索尼和Google举例，首先要明确market share和probability之间是负相关，即inverse relation，be attributed to the fact，指归因于，于是需要一个原因来解释这个负相关的关系，C选项符合要求，因为高市场份额品牌，购买概率已经很高
品牌延伸带来的概率增加量很小，符合“inverse relation”。
题目文本翻译：
维珍集团（Virgin Group）1984年创立维珍大西洋航空（Virgin Atlantic）是典型的品牌延伸案例——该公司利用其作为音乐零售商的品牌知名度，成功跨足航空业这一全新领域。为研究市场份额如何影响消费者购买延伸品牌产品的意愿，艾丽西亚·格拉斯比（Alicia Grasby）团队从家庭采购数据中筛选出30组延伸品牌组合（例如同一品牌的吸尘器与微波炉）。针对每组产品，研究人员分别计算了品牌产品的市场份额，以及当消费者已购买某品牌一类产品时，购买该品牌另一类产品的概率增幅。数据显示两者呈现显著的负相关关系，这一现象最合理的解释是：________

question:
The following text is from George Eliot’s 1857 short story “The Sad Fortunes of the Rev. Amos Barton.” The Countess Czerlaski is a newcomer to the town of Milby.
It is true, the Countess was a little vain, a little ambitious, a little selfish, a little shallow and frivolous, a little given to white lies. — But who considers such slight blemishes, such moral pimples as these, disqualifications for entering into the most respectable society! Indeed, the severest ladies in Milby would have been perfectly aware that these characteristics would have created no wide distinction between the Countess Czeriaski and themselves; and since it was clear there was a wide distinction — why it must lie in the possession of some vices from which they were undeniably free.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. The residents of Milby had initially viewed the Countess Czeriaski with suspicion, but they have gradually come to see her as mostly harmless.
B. Although the countess Czeriaski actively cultivates a sense of mystery about her, her background is less Interesting than what many residents of Milby have been led to believe.
C. Although the residents of Milby are generally thought to be hospitable, the Countess Czeriaski has committed many social blunders that have caused her to be widely disliked.
D. Some residents of Milby are determined to disapprove of the Countess Czeriaskt, even though the reasons for their dislike are largely groundless.
explanations:
中文解析：
开头承认Czerlaski伯爵夫人有一些小缺点，但指出这些在米尔比镇（Milby）的上流社会中并不罕见。然而，当地的女士们仍武断地认定这种区别一定来自伯爵夫人有某些她们没有的恶习，于是D选项准确抓住了“居民无端否定伯爵夫人”与文中must lie in...的武断语气一致。
题目文本翻译：
这段文字选自乔治·艾略特1857年短篇小说《阿莫斯·巴顿牧师的悲惨命运》。切拉斯基伯爵夫人是米尔比镇的新来者。
诚然，伯爵夫人确实有些虚荣、有些野心、有些自私、有些浅薄轻浮，还偶尔会说些无伤大雅的小谎。——但谁会把这类无足轻重的瑕疵、这些道德上的小疙瘩，当作跻身上流社会的障碍呢！事实上，就连米尔比镇上最严苛的女士们都心知肚明：这些特质根本不足以将切拉斯基伯爵夫人与她们区分开来；而既然两者间确实存在天壤之别——那必定是伯爵夫人拥有某些她们绝对没有的恶习。

question:
Some researchers posit that species on the South Pacific island of Grande Terre are the surviving members of clades that inhabited other islands in the region before the complete emergence of Grande Terre 37 million years ago. In a 2012 study, however, Hervé Sauquet et al, found that the crown age (the age of the most recent common ancestor of all living and extinct species in the clade) of the clade of southern beeches on Grande Terre is 16.4 million years; Sauquet et al, further found that the crown age of the clade of southern beeches in the South Pacific generally is also approximately 16.4 million years.

As presented in the text, the findings of Sauquet et al. best support which statement?
selections: A. The southern beeches found on Grande terre are members of a clade that likely originated outside the South Pacific.
B. The most recent common ancestor of the southern beeches found on Grande Terre lived at least 37 million years ago
C. The southern beeches found on Grande Terre are not members of a clade that existed before the island completely emerged.
D. The ancestors of most species found on Grande Terre arrived on the island earlier than did the most recent common ancestor of the island’s southern beeches.
explanations:
中文解析：
若southern beeches是更古老演化支的幸存成员，其冠群年龄应早于3700万年前（岛屿完全形成前），但实际冠群年龄（1640万年）远晚于3700万年，说明这些beeches并非岛屿形成前就存在的演化支后代，而是后来演化形成的。
题目文本翻译：
部分研究者认为，南太平洋大岛（Grande Terre）上的物种是该地区其他岛屿生物支系的幸存后裔——这些岛屿在3700万年前大岛完全浮出海面前就已存在。然而，埃尔韦·索凯团队2012年的研究发现：大岛南部山毛榉支系的冠群年龄（即该支系现存与灭绝物种最近共同祖先的年代）仅为1640万年；研究还进一步揭示，整个南太平洋地区南部山毛榉支系的冠群年龄同样约为1640万年。

question:
Postcranial skeletal pneumaticity (PSP) refers to the presence of extensions of an animal’s lungs and air sacs inside its bones. Though such structures do not typically fossilize, they are believed to have been present in Tyrannosaurus, Anhanguera, and other Cretaceous theropods and pterosaurs. To ________ PSP from fossils, researchers look for indicators such as large foramina (holes in bones).

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析：
PSP是软组织结构，无法直接化石保存，研究者通过间接证据holes in bones来推测其存在。
题目文本翻译：
颅后骨骼气腔化（Postcranial Skeletal Pneumaticity，简称PSP）是指动物肺部及气囊在骨骼内部的延伸结构。虽然这类软组织通常难以形成化石，但科学家认为暴龙、安杭翼龙等白垩纪兽脚类恐龙与翼龙目生物均具有此特征。为从化石中________PSP现象，研究者主要通过寻找大型骨孔（骨骼表面的孔洞）等特征作为判别依据。

question:
Periods of subfreezing temperatures in Alaska have been growing shorter as a result of climate changes, potentially enabling increased carbon dioxide (CO₂) absorption through greater productivity of sidebells wintergreen (Orthilia secunda) plants and other vegetation, but also potentially enabling increased CO₂output through greater heterotrophic respiration (CO₂generated by the activity of soil microorganisms). Hydrologist Yonghong Yi and her colleagues developed a model incorporating numerous inputs — years of soil moisture and snow cover data among them — to evaluate the effects of climate changes on the CO₂ balance in Alaska, concluding that net CO₂ is likely to increase if seasonal snow cover arrives earlier relative to the onset of soil surface freezing.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers’ conclusion?
selections: A. Relatively early snow cover reduces the amount of soil moisture available for the growth of plant species such as O. secunda and lowers the rate of heterotrophic respiration.
B. The sol insulation provided by snow cover enables heterotrophic respiration to continue during a period in which plant species such as O. secunda are typically not growing.
C. The effect of soil moisture on the growth of vegetation and on the rate of heterotrophic respiration is stronger during the period of seasonal snow cover than during the period without snow cover.

D. Seasonal snow cover tends to persist longer in areas of relatively low vegetation growth and high heterotrophic respiration than in areas of relatively high vegetation growth and low heterotrophic respiration
explanations:
中文解析：
根据结论需证明CO₂增加，于是即微生物呼吸作用增强，CO₂排放增加，至少要超过CO₂吸收，即植物生长受限，积雪隔热作用使微生物呼吸在植物不生长的时期持续，直接导致CO₂净排放增加，B选项符合要求。
题目文本翻译：
由于气候变化，阿拉斯加州低于冰点的低温期正逐渐缩短——这既可能通过单侧花鹿蹄草（Orthilia secunda）等植被的增产提升二氧化碳吸收量，也可能因土壤微生物活动增强导致的异养呼吸作用（微生物活动产生的二氧化碳）而增加碳排放。水文学家易永红及其同事建立的模型综合了多年土壤湿度、积雪覆盖等多项数据，用以评估气候变化对阿拉斯加二氧化碳平衡的影响，其结论表明：若季节性积雪相对于地表冻结期提前到来，该地区二氧化碳净排放量很可能增加。

question:
Though longitudinal studies like the Northern Ireland Longitudinal Study (NILS), which has surveyed approximately 500,000 participants in Northern Ireland to find trends in public health, are expensive because they are conducted over many years, by spanning these time frames, they can reveal causal patterns. But studies for which cause and effect is not at issue, like a public opinion study that merely seeks to determine the proportion of a city’s population that supports a particular tax proposal, can succeed without longitudinal methods, which means that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the public opinion study could likely be completed at a considerably lower cost than NILS.
B. longitudinal methods would likely be less suitable for studies in public opinion than for studies in public health.
C. longitudinal methods would likely be less expensive for studies in public opinion than for studies in public health.
D. the results from NILS would likely be more reliable than those from the public opinion study.
explanations:
中文解析：
前文提到longitudinal study昂贵，民意研究不需要纵向方法。因此，民意研究的成本更低是合理的推论，A符合要求
题目文本翻译：
尽管像北爱尔兰纵向研究（NILS）这样的长期追踪研究成本高昂——该研究持续多年，调查了北爱尔兰约50万参与者以发现公共卫生趋势——但正是由于跨越了较长的时间跨度，这类研究能够揭示因果关系。然而，对于那些并不涉及因果关系的研究（例如仅旨在了解某城市人口中支持某项税收提案比例的民意调查），无需采用纵向研究方法也能取得成功，这意味着______

question:
In Bhutan, use of solid fuel (e.g., coal wood) as a share of total household fuel use fell by approximately two thirds between 2000 and 2019; such shifts are often explained by appeal to the energy ladder, a model holding that fuel choice is mediated mainly by household income (specifically, high technology fuels displace solid fuels as incomes rise). Rasmus Heltberg’s study of fuel use in Nepal shows this model to be reductive, however; household fuel use was heterogeneous, flexible, and influenced by several factors, including the stability of the local electrical grid.

Which choice best describes the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To challenge a common explanation for households fuel choices
B. To contrast patterns in household fuel use in two countries
C. To account for the effect of fuel use on household income
D. To critique a frequently used model of changes In household fuel prices
explanations:
中文解析：
研究证明这个理论太简单化，实际影响因素更多，挑战了常见的energy ladder理论，于是A选项符合要求，这个题目在好得分的真题材料出现多次。
题目文本翻译：
题目文本翻译：
不丹的固体燃料（如煤炭、木材）占家庭燃料总使用量的比例在2000至2019年间下降了约三分之二；此类转变通常用"能源阶梯"理论来解释——该模型认为燃料选择主要受家庭收入调节（具体表现为随收入增长，高科技燃料逐步取代固体燃料）。然而拉斯穆斯·海尔特伯格对尼泊尔燃料使用的研究表明，此模型过于简化：当地家庭燃料使用呈现多元化、灵活化特征，且受电网稳定性等多重因素影响。

question:
A student is writing a research paper on the history of irrigation in the southwestern United States, situating the development of Lake Sabrina (a man-made body of water created in Inyo County. California, in 1908) in a larger historical context. The student claims that some modern-day irrigation methods used in southwestern states, such as California, Arizona, and New Mexico, have a lineage that long predates the completion of Lake Sabrina.

Which quotation from a historian best supports the student’s claim?
selections: A. “Sprinkler irrigation systems, which were developed in the late 20th century, are a convenient technique of irrigating that makes use of machinery in order to spray water in all directions. Many areas of the Southwestern United States are currently irrigated by this method.”
B. “In the decades following the Second world War, irrigation of arid areas for agriculture increased to such a degree that it now accounts for roughly 70% of the world’s water usage.”

C. “The irrigation system developed by the Hiohokam people in what is now central Arizona in the 7th century CE was simple but made use of hydraulic engineering design principles that are still utilized by today’s engineers.”
D. “The importance of the development of irrigation infrastructure in the American Southwest today cannot be overstated, since it is the most common means of conveying water for food production.”
explanations:
中文解析：
需要找到证明"西南部灌溉技术有古老起源"的历史学家论述。直接提到7世纪霍霍坎人(Hohokam)的灌溉系统，并指出其设计原理至今仍被使用，完全匹配"lineage that long predates"的要求。
题目文本翻译：
一名学生正在撰写关于美国西南部灌溉历史的论文，将萨布里娜湖（1908年在加利福尼亚州因约县建成的人工水体）的发展置于更广阔的历史背景中。该学生声称，如今在加利福尼亚、亚利桑那和新墨西哥等西南部州份使用的某些现代灌溉方法，其渊源可远溯至萨布里娜湖建成之前。

question:
Some features, such as the mihrab (or niche), are present in nearly every mosque. But mosques often reflect multiple architectural styles, resulting in a unique __________ of those influence, as in the case of the Sheikh Zayed Mosque, which combines elements from the Persian, Mughal, and Moorish styles.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一些特征，比如米哈拉（或壁龛），几乎出现在每座清真寺中。但清真寺常常反映多种建筑风格，导致一种独特的融合那些影响的风格，就像谢赫扎耶德清真寺的情况一样，该清真寺结合了波斯、莫卧尔和摩尔式风格的元素。
中文解析：
在这种情况下，"融合"这个词是最合逻辑和准确的选择，因为句子描述了清真寺经常融合不同的建筑风格，导致了这些影响的独特结合。"融合"准确地捕捉了不同元素相互结合创造出新的独特事物的概念。在这个语境中，"融合"是最能够准确表达句子意思的词语。

question:
Founded in Denver in 1991, the Museo de Las Americas is one of the best-known US based institutions showcasing Latino cultures. Since its founding, it has acquired more than 4,800 objects for its permanent collection. Since 2000, the number of Latino cultural institutions in the US has expanded considerably, LA Plaza de Cultura y Artes, which opened in Los Angeles in 2011 and focuses on Mexican American art and culture, is among the most prominent.

Which choice best states the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It contrasts the focus of the Latino cultural institution discussed earlier in the text with the focus of the institution discussed later in the text.
B. It identifies a historical trend of which the Latino cultural institution discussed later in the text is a part.
C. It analyzes how two institutions’ approach to exhibiting artworks reflects the approach taken by most Latino cultural institutions.
D. It describes a historical development that encouraged the founding of the two Latino cultural institutions discussed in the text.
explanations:
中文解析：
画线句是一个宏观的历史趋势描述，后文提到 LA Plaza de Cultura y Artes，2011 年成立是其中最突出的机构之一，说明它是这一趋势中的一部分，于是B符合要求。
题目文本翻译：
1991年创立于丹佛的美洲博物馆（Museo de Las Americas）是美国最负盛名的拉丁文化展示机构之一。建馆以来，其永久馆藏已逾4800件。值得注意的是，自2000年起，美国拉丁文化机构数量显著增长——2011年在洛杉矶揭幕的"拉丁文化与艺术广场"（LA Plaza de Cultura y Artes）便是其中翘楚，该机构专注于墨西哥裔美国人的艺术与文化呈现。

question:
The subscription model in which consumers who do not deliberately cancel their subscriptions automatically pay recurring fees for access to products and services benefits retailers when consumer _______ is high. Many of the 8.5 percent of subscribers who canceled their food and beverage subscriptions in January 2022 had stopped valuing their subscriptions long before then, but sellers profited from those customers’ passivity in the interim.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析：
inertia 最精确地描述了消费者因惰性而持续付费的行为，与后文 passivity 形成直接对应。
题目文本翻译：
当消费者_______较高时，这种"用户不主动取消即自动续费"的订阅模式能使零售商获益。2022年1月取消食品饮料订阅的8.5%用户中，多数人早已不再认可订阅价值，但商家仍在此期间利用用户的消极态度获利。

question:
Writer Lydia Davis observed that while _______ literary forms, such as the short story, are recognizable as such even as they evolve, there are rarer “intergeneric” forms that might, for example, use elements of both fiction and essays to create something unclassifiable. The very short publications of Diane Williams arguably fit in this category, since they straddle the line between prose and poetry.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析：
句子前半部分提到“某些文学形式即使演变也能被识别”，而后半部分提到“罕见的“intergeneric” 形式无法归类。两者形成对比，因此空缺处需要填入一个与“罕见”相反的词，即“常见的、正统的”文学形式orthodox符合要求。
题目文本翻译：
作家莉迪亚·戴维斯（Lydia Davis）指出，虽然_______短篇小说等文学体裁在演变过程中仍可被明确辨识，但还存在更罕见的"跨体裁"形式——例如融合小说与散文元素，创造出难以归类的作品。黛安·威廉姆斯（Diane Williams）那些极短小的出版物可谓此类典范，因其游走在散文与诗歌的边界线上。

Issuing a one-dollar coin yields positive seigniorage — profit generated when the face value of a coin exceeds the unit cost of producing it — for Singapore’s government, which can be used to fund such services as education. Issuing coins can also result in negative seigniorage, however, and this phenomenon led Australia to stop producing certain coins. A student argues that it is in the financial interest of the United States to follow the example of Australia with regard to each of the four coins shown in the table.

Which choice best describes data from the table that weaken the student’s argument?
selections: A. Seigniorage per dollar issued was slightly greater for quarter-dollar coins than for ten cent coins, but seigniorage in millions of dollars was much greater for quarter dollar coins than for ten-cent coins.

B. Although issuing one cent and five cent coins resulted in negative seigniorage in millions of dollars, issuing ten-cent and quarter-dollar coins resulted in positive seigniorage in millions of dollars.

C. Issuing one-cent and five-cent coins created negative seigniorage in millions of dollars, but for each of those coins, the gross cost of issuing the coin was lower than the gross cost of issuing ten-cent or quarter-dollar coins was.
D. Although issuing five-cent coins created the greatest negative seigniorage in millions of dollars, issuing one-cent coins created the greatest negative seigniorage per dollar issued
explanations:
中文解析：
