题目文本翻译：
发行1美元硬币能为新加坡政府带来铸币税收益（即当硬币面值超过其单位生产成本时产生的利润），这部分收入可用于资助教育等公共服务。然而，发行硬币也可能导致负铸币税，澳大利亚正是因此停止了某些硬币的铸造。一名学生提出，根据表格中四种硬币的数据，美国若效仿澳大利亚的做法将符合其财政利益。

question:
A 2016 study by researchers Andreas Keller and Leslie Vosshall evaluating how participants described the odors of various chemical compounds revealed some similarities between the odor of sample 15 (linoleic acid) and that of sample 18 (propionic acid). The _____ primary descriptors both included “sour”; however , the next most common word used for sample 15 was “decayed,” while that for sample 18 was “musky.”

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 这个题目两次使用所有格，samples是两个，先加s，在加’，odors也是一样，先加s再加’，于是D符合要求

question:
The Orionid meteor shower’s brightness typically surpasses that of the Daytime Arietid meteor shower due to the interplay of three main factors—namely the size and composition of the ______ velocity upon entering Earth’s mesosphere, with higher velocity meteoroids releasing more energy; and atmospheric fluctuations, such as changes in sky conditions.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 破折号后解释three main factors，分别是size and composition, velocity, atmospheric fluctuations, 三个并列事物内部用了逗号，所以三者的复合并列用分号

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·Lou Scheper-Berkenkamp was a painter and author born in Wesel, Germany.
·She began attending the Bauhaus in 1920.
·The Bauhaus was an influential German art and design school.
·The school famously espoused the design principle of “form follows function.”
·“Form follows function” means that an object’s shape should be determined primarily by its intended purpose.

The student wants to explain the principle espoused by the Bauhaus. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. According to the Bauhaus, an object’s intended purpose (function) should primarily determine its shape (form).
B. Lou Scheper-Berkenkamp was a painter and author who attended the Bauhaus, famous for espousing the principle of “form follows function.”
C. Famous for its principle of “form follows function,” the Bauhaus was an influential German art and design school.
D. An object’s intended purpose and its shape are two elements of the design principle “form follows function.”
explanations:
中文解析：
题目要求explain the principle espoused by the Bauhaus，根据notes，form follows function是其主要的原则，即物体的形状应主要由其预定用途决定，A选项描述function determine form, 和题目要求一致
题目文本翻译：
在研究某个课题时，一名学生记录了以下要点：
·卢·舍佩尔-贝肯坎普是出生于德国韦瑟尔的画家兼作家
·她于1920年进入包豪斯学院学习
·包豪斯是一所极具影响力的德国艺术设计学院
·该学院以倡导"形式追随功能"的设计理念而闻名
·"形式追随功能"意指物品的外形应主要由其使用目的决定

question:

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·According to researcher Muhammad Rayyan Fazal, “geothermal electric energy... [is] capable of producing more energy per megawatt per year as compared to similar capacity solar and wind power systems.”
·Geothermal power plants typically employ dry steam systems, flash steam systems, or binary cycle systems to produce electricity from high-temperature geothermal fluid.
·The Platanares geothermal power plant in Honduras uses a binary cycle system.
·Fazal says that binary cycle systems “pump 100% geothermal fluid back to the injection well, hence offering the least environmental impact with little or no emissions.”

The student wants to use a quotation from Fazal to explain an advantage of the geothermal system at the Platanares plant. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Compared with dry steam systems and flash steam systems, the binary cycle system used at the Platanares plant is “capable of producing more energy per megawatt per year,” Fazal notes.

B. According to Fazal, because it uses high-temperature geothermal fluid to produce electricity, the system used at the Platanares plant results in “little or no emissions,” making it environmentally friendly.
C. Since they return all geothermal fluid to the injection well, binary cycle systems—such as the one at the Platanares plant—produce “the least environmental impact,” according to Fazal.
D. The Platanares plant uses a binary cycle system to produce electricity; in this type of geothermal system, fluid is pumped “back to the injection well,” Fazal explains.
explanations:
中文解析：
题目要求：引用Fazal的话来说明Platanares地热电站系统的优势。根据notes，Fazal指出二元循环系统"将100%地热流体泵回注入井"，该系统的优势是"环境影响最小，几乎零排放"，C选项满足，完整引用Fazal原话"the least environmental impact"
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了如下笔记：
·根据研究者穆罕默德·拉扬·法扎尔的说法，“地热电能……能够每年每兆瓦产生比类似容量的太阳能和风能系统更多的能量。”
·地热发电厂通常采用干蒸汽系统、闪蒸系统或双循环系统来利用高温地热流体发电。
·洪都拉斯的普拉塔纳雷斯地热发电厂使用的是双循环系统。
·法扎尔表示，双循环系统“将100%的地热流体泵回注入井，因此对环境影响最小，几乎没有或没有排放。”

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·Hina Hanta is an online archive curated by the Choctaw Nation of Oklahoma.
·It features images of many cultural artifacts relevant to the history of the Choctaw people.
·It features basketry, including a trunk basket (tapushik pothoma in Choctaw) made from cane.
·The trunk basket was made in 2019.
·The archive features household items, including a stamp (isht inchunwa) made from rubber.
·The stamp was made in the 1800s.

The student wants to support the claim that the online archive features both older and newer artifacts. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The rubber stamp (isht inchunwa) was made in the 1800s.
B. Hina Hanta, an online archive, features both basketry and household items.
C. Not all artifacts in the Hina Hanta archive are from the 1800s.
D. The Hina Hanta online archive features cultural artifacts both old and new, including a rubber stamp from the 1800s and a cane trunk basket from 2019.
explanations:
中文解析：
题目要求 online archive features both older and newer artifacts，选项D符合，因为1800s和2019分别对应了both old and new
题目文本翻译：
学生在研究某一课题时，整理了以下笔记：
·"Hina Hanta"是俄克拉荷马州乔克托族管理的线上数字档案库。
·该档案收录了大量与乔克托族历史相关的文化手工艺品图像。
·其中包括编织工艺品，如一个用藤条制成的储物篮（乔克托语称"tapushik pothoma"）。
·该储物篮制作于2019年。
·档案还收录了家居用品，如一个橡胶制成的印章（乔克托语称"isht inchunwa"）。
·这枚印章制作于19世纪。

question:

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·The Peloncillo-Pan Duro Mountains are located in northwestern Mexico.
·They cover an area of 1,360 square miles (mi²).
·The Big Hatchet Mountains are located in the southwestern United States.
·They cover an area of 65 mi².
·These mountain ranges are two of the dozens of “sky islands” in the southwestern US and northwestern Mexico.
·A sky island is an isolated mountain range whose environment differs drastically from that of the surrounding lowlands.

The student wants to compare the sizes of the two mountain ranges. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. There are dozens of isolated mountain ranges located in the southwestern US and northwestern Mexico.
B. In terms of area, the Peloncillo-Pan Duro Mountains (which cover 1,360 mi²) are larger than the Big Hatchet Mountains (65 mi²).
C. Sky islands in northwestern Mexico and the southwestern US can vary in size.
D. The Peloncillo-Pan Duro Mountains and the Big Hatchet Mountains are both isolated mountain ranges whose environments differ drastically from that of the surrounding lowlands.

需要选择最能比较两座山脉大小的选项。根据笔记Peloncillo-Pan Duro山脉：1,360平方英里，Sierrita山脉：63平方英里，于是B选项符合要求

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·Bengali is a language in the Indo-Aryan language family.
·In Bengali, a noun takes a different form when that noun functions as a location in a sentence.
·The Bengali noun bari (house) is combined with the locative suffix-te to become the locative noun barite (in the house).
·Danish is a language in the Germanic language family.
·In Danish, nouns do not change form to indicate location.
·In Danish, nouns used as a location must be indicated by prepositions such as i (in) or pá (on).

The student wants to emphasize a difference between Bengali and Danish nouns. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. To indicate location in Bengali, a suffix is appended to a noun, but in Danish, the noun is unchanged and a preposition is used.
B. Bengali and Danish belong to two distinct language families; the former is in the Indo-Aryan family, while the latter is a Germanic language.
C. Though nouns in Bengali change form to indicate location, this Indo-Aryan language belongs to a different language family than Danish does.
D. In Bengali, nouns take a different form when they function as a location, as the language belongs to the Indo-Aryan family: Danish, however, belongs to the Germanic family.
explanations:
中文解析：
题目要求emphasize a difference between Bengali and Danish nouns，A选项用but连接，直接对比两种语言表示方位的方式（孟加拉语用后缀，丹麦语用介词且名词不变），符合题目要求。
题目文本翻译：
在研究某一课题时，某学生整理了以下笔记：
·孟加拉语属于印度-雅利安语系。
·在孟加拉语中，当名词在句子中表示地点时，需要采用不同的词形变化。
·孟加拉语名词"bari"（房子）加上方位格后缀"-te"后，变为方位格名词"barite"（在房子里）。
·丹麦语属于日耳曼语系。
·在丹麦语中，名词无需通过词形变化来表示地点。
·丹麦语需借助介词如"i"（在...里）或"pá"（在...上）来标明名词的地点意义。

question:
The Gleaners, painted in the realist style by Jean-François Millet, depicts peasants picking stray wheat from a field after the harvest. The realists’ emphasis on accurately portraying the experiences of average working people was largely a rejection of the romantic style evident in many paintings by Paul Delaroche, which instead _______ their subjects’ beauty or heroism while hiding all imperfection.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:

which指代的是Paul Delaroche的浪漫主义，跟现实主义相反，他们夸大人物的美和英雄主义，掩盖缺点。

question:
Sheep and macaque monkeys can see in three dimensions (3D), which helps them perceive distance and depth. Octopuses and squid are thought to lack 3D vision. Many researchers once thought the same about cuttlefish, but Trevor Wardill and his team wanted to test whether this assumption was true. The team studied how cuttlefish wearing 3D glasses reacted to 3D images of shrimp (a favorite prey) projected on a tank wall. Cuttlefish changed their striking position to match the 3D images, suggesting that their vision is more like that of sheep and macaque monkeys than that of octopuses or squid.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Cuttlefish eyes are much more complex than those of either sheep or macaque monkeys.
B. Before completing their study, Wardill’s team showed that sheep have 3D vision, but macaque monkeys may not.
C. Wardill’s team designed 3D glasses for cuttlefish.
D. The findings of Wardill’s team’s study suggest that like sheep and macaque monkeys, cuttlefish may also have 3D vision.
explanations:
中文解析：
前面铺垫对于cuttlefish的探索，最后一句话表明乌贼的视觉机制更接近绵羊和猕猴，也就是拥有3D视觉，所以对应D.
题目文本翻译：
绵羊和猕猴拥有三维立体视觉，能感知距离与深度，而章鱼和鱿鱼则被认为不具备这种能力。许多研究者曾对乌贼持有相同观点，但特雷弗·沃迪尔团队通过实验验证这一认知：他们为乌贼佩戴3D眼镜，观察其对水箱壁投影的立体虾影（最喜爱的猎物）的反应。结果显示乌贼会调整攻击位置精准对应立体图像，这表明其视觉机制更接近绵羊和猕猴，而非章鱼或鱿鱼。

question:
Text 1
In the past, music albums were created to be played back on physical formats like records. A typical record holds only about twenty-five minutes of music on each of its shiny black sides. This forced artists and producers to think carefully about what music to include on an album and what to leave out. Today’s artists don’t have to worry as much about fitting their music on physical formats. For this reason, many of today’s artists are making albums that are much longer than albums from decades past.
Text 2
In today’s digital age, most music is created to be streamed from online services. These services remove the limitations of physical formats like records and CDs. This may be why many new albums are longer and have more songs than albums crafted for physical formats. Unfortunately, many of these longer albums suffer from a lack of focus.

Based on the texts, the author of Text 1 and the author of Text 2 would most likely agree with which statement about many new albums?
selections: A. Many new albums include more artwork than albums generally once included.
B. Many new albums sell more copies than albums generally once sold.
C. Many new albums are longer than albums generally once were.
D. Many new albums are quieter than albums generally once were.
explanations:
中文解析：
Text 1 提到，过去实体唱片（如黑胶）的容量限制（每面约25分钟）迫使艺术家精心选择内容，而如今数字时代无需担心这种限制，因此新专辑变得更长。Text 2 也指出，数字流媒体服务消除了实体格式的限制，导致许多新专辑比过去更长（但可能缺乏重点）。两篇文章都认为新专辑比之前制作的专辑更长。所以选择C。Haodefen（好得分）的老师提示A是迷惑选项，注意artwork不等同于songs。
题目文本翻译：
文本一
过去，音乐专辑需适配黑胶唱片等实体载体——每面光亮的黑胶仅能容纳约25分钟音乐。这迫使艺术家和制作人必须精挑细选收录曲目。如今创作者不再受实体载体容量限制，因此当代专辑时长普遍远超数十年前的作品。
文本二
数字时代的大多数音乐为流媒体平台创作。在线服务摆脱了黑胶、CD等实体载体的限制，这或许解释了为何新专辑往往曲目更多、时长更长。但遗憾的是，许多加长版专辑因缺乏焦点而品质参差。

question:
Researchers examining data from the New Horizons space probe, which passed Pluto in 2015, were puzzled by a 27-mile-long crater on Pluto’s icy surface. Although Pluto is mostly covered in frozen methane and nitrogen, the surface near the crater seemed to show the presence of water ice and ammonia— both of which are associated with eruptions from ice volcanoes. Additionally, the shape and appearance of the crater did not suggest that it was formed by impact. Based on this evidence, scientist Dale Cruikshank and his team hypothesized that the crater was likely once a massive ice volcano.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It introduces previous findings that suggested a research method for Cruikshank and his team.
B. It implies that the research team eliminated an alternative explanation for the crater based on available evidence.
C. It emphasizes the importance of the New Horizons space probe to researchers.
D. It identifies a misconception that the researchers had about the crater when they were first studying the data.
explanations:
中文解析：
研究人员通过坑洞的形状和外观，排除了“陨石撞击形成”这一可能性，从而支持了“冰火山喷发”的假设。划线部分通过否定另一种解释（陨石撞击），间接强化了冰火山的结论，因此选 B。
题目文本翻译：
2015年飞掠冥王星的"新视野号"探测器传回的数据显示，这颗星球冰面上有一座43公里长的陨石坑令研究人员困惑不已。尽管冥王星表面主要覆盖着冻结的甲烷和氮气，但陨石坑附近区域却检测到水冰和氨冰——这两种物质通常与冰火山喷发有关。此外，该坑洞的形态特征不符合撞击坑的形成规律。基于这些证据，科学家戴尔·克鲁克尚克团队推测，这个坑洞很可能曾是一座巨型冰火山喷发口。

question:
The following text is from Anthony Trollope’s 1855 novel The Warden. Tom Towers is a writer for the newspaper The Jupiter.
It is true that in far-off provinces men did not talk daily of Tom Towers but they read The Jupiter, and acknowledged that without The Jupiter life was not worth having. This kind of hidden but still conscious glory suited the nature of the man. He loved to sit silent in a corner of his club and listen to the loud chattering of politicians, and to think how they all were in his power; — how he could smite the loudest of them, were it worth his while to raise his pen for such a purpose.

What does the text most strongly suggest about Tom Towers?
selections: A. He has received much praise but tends to place too much value on his own importance.
B. He takes private satisfaction in his capacity to influence public opinion.
C. He aims mainly to win the regard of readers who reside in other provinces.
D. He flatters himself that his readers take a greater interest in him than in politicians.
explanations:
中文解析：
文中提到，虽然偏远地区的人不常谈论Tom Towers，但他们读他的报纸 《The Jupiter》，并认为这份报纸至关重要。Tom Towers喜欢坐在俱乐部角落，默默听着政客们高谈阔论，并暗自想着他们都在他的掌控之中——只要他动笔，就能打击最嚣张的政客。SAT师生说公众号提示大家，以上说明他享受这种隐秘的权力感，即他能通过写作影响舆论甚至政客的命运，但并不张扬，而是暗自得意。
题目文本翻译：
（以下文字节选自安东尼·特罗洛普1855年小说《养老院院长》。汤姆·托尔斯是《朱庇特报》的撰稿人。）
诚然，在偏远行省人们不会每日谈论汤姆·托尔斯，但他们阅读《朱庇特报》，并公认若没有这份报纸，生活便失去价值。这种隐秘而自知的光辉正符合此人的本性——他最爱静坐于俱乐部角落，听着政客们高谈阔论，暗自思量这些人都攥在自己手心：只要他愿意提笔，就能让最聒噪的家伙尝尝厉害。

question:

question:
The minor planet 1061 Paeonia was named after the plant genus that includes peonies. But most minor planets are given only an identification number, largely due to there being over 500, 000 such bodies known at present. So while the task of finding a unique name for each minor planet was _______ when few had been discovered, so many minor planets have since been discovered that the task has become nearly impossible.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:

while形成了主从句的对比，后面说minor planets变多了，命名任务变得impossible，那么之前少的时候应该是possible的，对应的是feasible。
题目文本翻译：
小行星1061号以芍药属植物命名，该属包含牡丹等花卉。但由于目前已发现的小行星超过50万颗，大多数仅以编号标识。因此，尽管在发现数量较少时，为每颗小行星_______独特名称尚属可行，但随着后续发现激增，这项任务已变得几乎不可能完成。

question:
In the decades after Mexico won its independence from Spain, literature became a medium through which the new nation _______ its autonomous identity, with authors like Manuel Payno and Justo Sierra Méndez helping to shape what would become a distinctly Mexican literary tradition.

explanations:

题目文本翻译：
墨西哥脱离西班牙独立后的数十年间，文学成为这个新生国家_______其独立身份的重要载体，曼努埃尔·帕伊诺、胡斯托·塞拉·门德斯等作家共同塑造了独具特色的墨西哥文学传统。

question:
Mariana Lopes Barata and Pedro Simões Coelho collected data from 324 music-streaming service users to identify factors that influence users to opt for paid (premium) versions of music streaming services, like Apple Music. They hypothesized that hedonic motivation (the enjoyment that a consumer perceives to be associated with using a service) would be positively correlated with users’ intentions to adopt premium versions. The researchers asked participants to rate statements such as “Using paid music streaming services is pleasant.” They found that, indeed, hedonic motivation positively influences the intention to adopt premium streaming service versions, which suggests that _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. it may be advantageous for music streaming companies to try to influence the extent to which potential users perceive the premium version as pleasant to use.
B. participants who strongly agreed with the statement “ Using paid music streaming services is pleasant ” were more likely to express loyalty to Apple Music than to other streaming services.
C. the statement “ Using paid music streaming services is pleasant ” is not a reliable measure of hedonic motivation.
D. users' intentions to pay for premium streaming services are probably unaffected by factors other than hedonic motivation.
explanations:
中文解析：
研究人员发现，“享乐动机”（即用户觉得付费音乐服务“用起来很愉悦”） 会 正面影响 用户升级付费版的意愿。因此，合理推断出公司如果强化用户对“愉悦感”的认知（比如优化体验、广告宣传），可能促进付费转化。对应A。
题目文本翻译：
玛丽安娜·洛佩斯·巴拉塔与佩德罗·西芒·科埃略通过324名音乐流媒体用户的调研数据，探究用户选择付费订阅（如Apple Music会员）的影响因素。研究假设享乐动机（消费者感知到的使用愉悦感）与付费意愿呈正相关。参与者需对"使用付费音乐流媒体服务令人愉悦"等陈述进行评分。结果证实享乐动机确实能促进付费订阅意愿，这表明_______

question:
Assessing the role of forests as sinks for airborne microplastics that would otherwise continue to disperse in the atmosphere, Akane Miyazaki and her team measured concentrations of plastic particulates on leaves from konara oak trees in Japan. The team used three separate extraction methods: an ultrapure water rinse, a rinse combined with ultrasonic waves, and an alkaline solution treatment that removes epicuticular wax (a surface coating on most land plants to which particles can adhere). The concentrations of particulates recovered were 7.6 percent for water extraction, 38.4 percent for ultrasonic extraction, and 53.8 percent for alkaline extraction, leading the team to conclude that previous assessments have likely underestimated forest canopies’ capacity as sinks.

Which detail, if true, would most directly support the team's conclusion?
selections: A. Most studies of microplastic accumulation on leaves have utilized extraction methods that do not have a substantial effect on epicuticular wax.
B. Most studies of microplastic accumulation on leaves have focused on forests with diverse tree species that exhibit varying levels of epicuticular wax.
C. Most studies of microplastic accumulation on leaves have found particulate concentrations that greatly exceeded 53.8 percent.
D. Most studies of microplastic accumulation on leaves have involved the application of alkaline treatments before water and ultrasonic treatments rather than after them.
explanations:
中文解析：
研究团队发现用不同方法从树叶上提取的微塑料浓度不同：纯水冲洗：7.6%；超声波冲洗：38.4%；碱性溶液处理（去除植物表皮蜡质）：53.8%。他们的结论：过去的研究可能低估了森林树冠吸附微塑料的能力（因为传统方法可能没彻底提取附着在蜡质上的微塑料）。A. 大多数关于树叶微塑料积累的研究使用的提取方法对表皮蜡质影响不大。这个选项直接支持团队的结论：因为团队发现蜡质上附着大量微塑料（碱性提取法最高），而过去方法对蜡质无效，导致低估。如果大多数研究没用能去除蜡质的方法，正好说明他们测得的微塑料量偏低，支持“低估”的结论。好得分的老师认为这是一道难度高的题目，后面sat师生说的公众号会出详细推文。
题目文本翻译：
为评估森林对空气中微塑料颗粒的截留作用（否则这些颗粒将持续在大气中扩散），赤岭茜团队测量了日本小楢树叶面塑料微粒的浓度。研究采用三种提取方法：超纯水冲洗法、超声波辅助冲洗法以及能去除表皮蜡质层的碱性溶液处理法（绝大多数陆地植物表面这层蜡质会吸附微粒）。三种方法提取出的微粒浓度分别为：水洗法7.6%、超声法38.4%、碱解法53.8%。这表明此前研究很可能低估了森林冠层对微塑料的截留能力。

question:
The term “agglomeration economies” refers to the economic benefits enjoyed by firms in the same industry that ________ in a region. For example, in the computer manufacturing industry in the United Kingdom, firms that locate near one another can more readily take advantage of increased potential for information sharing among firms that fosters greater technological innovation.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析：
这里好得分的老师提示：第一句话的作用是解释“agglomeration economies”，如果同学们知道agglomeration表示聚合的意思，那么就可以轻松选出concentrate这个同义词。如果不认识就通过for example中locate near one another推断聚合的意思。
题目文本翻译：
"集聚经济"指的是同一行业的企业因_______某区域而获得的经济效益。例如，英国计算机制造业中，邻近布局的企业能更便捷地利用信息共享机会，这种集群效应促进了更强劲的技术创新。

question:
It has long been thought that the original author of the US Pledge of Allegiance was Francis Bellamy, who said that he wrote the pledge one evening in August of 1892. But a historian recently discovered a newspaper article that was published several months before August 1892. The article describes students reciting the same pledge that Bellamy claims he first wrote in August. This means that Bellamy may not have created the pledge after all.

Based on the text, what piece of knowledge about the Pledge of Allegiance has recently become uncertain?
selections: A. How many changes were made to the pledge in the 1900s
B. Which part of the pledge students liked best in 1892
C. The name of the newspaper that first published the pledge
D. The identity of the person who first wrote the pledge
explanations:
中文解析：
最后一句话提到Bellamy may not have created the pledge after all可能根本不是创作《美国效忠誓词》的人，所以对应D。
题目文本翻译：
传统观点认为《美国效忠誓词》的原作者是弗朗西斯·贝拉米，他自称于1892年8月某晚创作了该誓词。但历史学家最新发现，在1892年8月前的数月，已有报纸记载学生诵读与贝拉米所述完全相同的誓词。这表明贝拉米可能并非誓词的真正创作者。

question:

question:

Instead后面增加新信息，让大家更加了解飞行器超过一定高度是如何维持飞行的。

question:
Many works of the Roman scholar Varro (1st century BCE), including his history of Rome, De gente populi Romani, have been lost to time. Scholars wishing to read a work written by the Roman scholar needn’t _______ they can still procure a copy of Varro’s Rerum rusticarum libra tres, a treatise on agriculture.

question:

question:

question:

question:

question:
Soil thawing in Alaska has been accelerating as a result of climate changes, potentially enabling increased carbon dioxide (CO₂) absorption through greater productivity of artic bramble (Rubus arcticus) plants and other vegetation, but also potentially enabling increased CO₂output through greater heterotrophic respiration (CO₂ generated by the activity of soil microorganisms). Hydrologist Yonghong Yi and her colleagues developed a model incorporating numerous inputs—— years of soil temperature and snow cover data among them — to evaluate the effects of climate changes on the CO₂ balance in Alaska, concluding that net CO₂ is likely to increase if seasonal snow cover arrives earlier relative to the onset of soil surface freezing.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers’ conclusion?
selections: A. The effect of soil temperature on the growth of vegetation and on the rate of heterotrophic respiration is stronger during the period of seasonal snow cover than during the period without snow cover.
B. Relatively early snow cover reduces the amount of soil moisture available for the growth of plant species such as R. arcticus and lowers the rate of heterotrophic respiration.

C. Seasonal snow cover tends to persist longer in areas of relatively low vegetation growth and high heterotrophic respiration than in areas of relatively high vegetation growth and low heterotrophic respiration.
D. The soil insulation provided by snow cover enables heterotrophic respiration to continue during a period in which plant species such as R. arcticus are typically not growing.
explanations:
中文解析：
结论是二氧化碳的净含量增加，所以snow cover带来更多的是heterotrophic respiration而不是 greater productivity of plants，从而释放更多二氧化碳。所以对应D积雪对土壤的保温作用使得在北极悬钩子等植物通常不生长的时期，heterotrophic 呼吸作用仍能持续进行。好得分老师提示这是一道旧题。
题目文本翻译：
阿拉斯加土壤解冻因气候变化加速，一方面可能通过北极悬钩子等植被增产增强二氧化碳吸收，另一方面也可能因土壤微生物活动加剧（异养呼吸作用）增加二氧化碳排放。水文学家易永宏团队建立的综合模型纳入多年土壤温度与积雪覆盖等数据，评估气候变化对当地二氧化碳平衡的影响，结论显示：若季节性积雪相对于地表冻结期提前到来，二氧化碳净排放量很可能增加。

question:
Established knowledge of prehistoric societies primarily stems from analysis of durable historical artifacts, including stone tools, but Mercedes Murillo-Barroso and team have contributed new insights with a unique analysis of plant-based items. Plant-based artifacts, including straw baskets, are seldom studied due to their perishable nature. This relative scarcity  made it all the more exciting when the team examined remains of well-preserved organic artifacts discovered in a cave in Spain and determined that they dated even further back than previously thought.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It suggests that the researchers did not fully achieve a goal outlined earlier in the text.
B. It describes the uncertain nature of a discovery by the researchers mentioned earlier in the text.
C. It distinguishes between the two types of historical artifacts discussed earlier in the text.
D. It refers to a challenging situation presented earlier in the text.
explanations:
中文解析：
“This relative scarcity”（这种相对稀缺性）指代的是前文提到的内容：植物制品因其易腐性而很少被研究。因此它凸显了研究难度，为后文的突破性发现铺垫。所以对应D。
题目文本翻译：
关于史前社会的既定认知主要源于对石器等耐久性历史文物的分析，而梅赛德斯·穆里略-巴罗索团队通过对植物制品的独特研究提供了新视角。由于易腐特性，草编篮筐等植物制品鲜少被研究。当团队检测西班牙某洞穴发现的保存完好的有机文物并确定其年代比此前认为的更久远时，这一发现显得尤为珍贵。

question:
Over 600 languages are spoken in New York City in addition to English — one can find Bambara spoken in the neighborhood of Kingsbridge, or Ghale in Jackson Heights. Most speakers of Chinese languages reside in the neighborhood of Flushing (part of New York City’s borough of Queens), where the dominant Chinese language is Mandarin, and in Chinatown, in the borough of Manhattan, where the dominant Chinese languages are Cantonese and Fuzhounese. Mandarin is widely spoken in north China, while Cantonese and Fuzhounese are widely spoken in south China. It can therefore be inferred that _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. Chinese immigrants who emigrated to New York City many years ago are more likely to speak several Chinese languages than are more recent Chinese immigrants.
B. people who emigrate from north China tend to settle in Queens, while people who emigrate from south China tend to settle in Manhattan.
C. taken together, there are more Cantonese and Fuzhounese speakers among Chinese immigrants in New York City than there are Mandarin speakers.
D. Chinese immigrants regularly change their residences between Queens and Manhattan after they emigrate, rather than staying in one borough.
explanations:
中文解析：
Queens说普通话的多，Manhattan说广东话的多，中国北方人说普通话多，南方人说广东话的多，所以推断出来Queens的北方移民多，Manhattan南方移民多。
题目文本翻译：
纽约市除英语外还流通着600多种语言——国王桥社区能听到班巴拉语，杰克逊高地则通行加莱语。华语使用者主要聚居在皇后区法拉盛（当地以普通话为主）和曼哈顿唐人街（以粤语和福州话为主）。鉴于普通话在中国北方通用，而粤语与福州话盛行于南方，由此可推断_______

question:
In 2023 Nobel Prize-winning physicist Giorgio Parisi published In a Flight of Starlings, a collection of essays on scientific subjects. Acclaimed author Sam Kean, who uses the form of nonfiction narrative to explore scientific discoveries, is interested in the collection less for its aesthetic merit than for its focus on “the false starts... and mistakes that beset real scientific research every day.” Kean argues that all too often, scientists omit this “human stuff” from written accounts of their research and thus ultimately “fail to explain how science really gets done.”

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. It explores a subtle difference between Kean’s and Parisi’s respective objections to scientific research methods.
B. It outlines an area of agreement between Parisi and Kean in how they think about the work of science.
C. It describes Kean’s view that nonfiction narrative is an effective way for Parisi to share his accomplishments.
D. It presents Kean’s claim that Parisi is too modest about his own achievements as a scientist.
explanations:
中文解析：
Parisi的书中提到了科学研究中的“false starts and mistakes”（错误开端和失误）。Kean认为科学家通常忽略这些“human stuff”（人性化内容），导致无法真实展现科学如何运作。好得分的老师提示大家，这里代表两人的关注点一致：科学研究的真实过程（包括失误）比美化后的成果更重要。
题目文本翻译：
2023年诺贝尔物理学奖得主乔治·帕里西出版的科学随笔集《椋鸟飞行时》中，纪实文学作家山姆·基恩对这本著作的关注点并非其文学价值，而在于它聚焦"真实科研中无处不在的失败开端与错误"。基恩指出，科学家在论文中往往刻意省略这些"人性化细节"，导致"最终未能阐明科学发现的真实过程"。

question:
Lisa Linn Kanae is a celebrated contemporary Hawaiian author whose work is ________ by a rich literary history. From the traditional stories of the Kanaka Maoli, or Native Hawaiian people, to the works of writers such as David Malo, the literary heritage of Hawai’i is distinctive and vibrant.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析：
文本表达了Lisa Linn Kanae是当代著名的作家。同时第二句话说到了夏威夷的heritage是独具特色的。两者都是用了积极词汇描述，那么Lisa Linn Kanae是heritage的一部分。所以句子想表达的是：Lisa Linn Kanae的作品受到夏威夷丰富文学传统的影响，preceded在这里表示她的创作是建立在夏威夷悠久文学历史的基础上，符合语境。好得分老师认为这是一道难题，关注SAT师生说查看更多详细解析。
题目文本翻译：
丽莎·林·卡纳埃是当代著名的夏威夷作家，其作品由深厚的文学传统________。从卡纳卡·毛利人（即夏威夷原住民）的古老传说，到大卫·马洛等作家的作品，夏威夷的文学传承独具特色且充满活力。

question:
Archaeologists have identified a plethora of beads fashioned from Tritia gibbosula shells in many Middle Stone Age (MSA) sites across western North Africa, including El Mnasra Cave, Morocco. In a 2021 paper, El Mehdi Sehasseh et al. attribute these artifacts’ ________ to the evolution and propagation of symbolic behavior (e.g., use of personal ornaments) in humans and the availability of T. gibbosula during the MSA.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析：
plethora表示很多，across表示跨越整个西部非洲。所以选择C无处不在。expediency有用，可取。fecundity新颖，多产。ubiquity无处不在。heterogeneity多种多样。可以找到sat_6688领取sat真题词汇1600和难词200，攻克词汇难题。
题目文本翻译：
考古学家在北非西部多个中石器时代遗址（包括摩洛哥的El Mnasra洞穴）中发现了大量由Tritia gibbosula贝壳制成的珠子。El Mehdi Sehasseh等学者在2021年的论文中指出，这些工艺品的________与人类象征性行为（如个人装饰品的使用）的演化传播，以及中石器时代T. gibbosula贝类的可获得性密切相关。

question:
The Apalachicola River delta in Florida is where the river flows into the Gulf of Mexico. As the river reaches the gulf, it forms smaller channels where sediments carried by the river are deposited and form many deltaic lobes, or wetland formations. The shape and size of the delta are _______ by the gulf’s tides, which shift sediments along the coast and reshape the deltaic lobes over time.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析：
原文讲的是墨西哥湾的潮汐如何改变河流沉积物的分布，从而塑造三角洲的形状和大小。所以选择C
题目文本翻译：
佛罗里达州的阿巴拉契科拉河三角洲是河流汇入墨西哥湾的入海口。当河流抵达海湾时，会形成多条小型水道，河水携带的沉积物在此堆积，形成许多三角洲裂瓣（即湿地构造）。三角洲的形态与规模_______墨西哥湾潮汐的影响——潮汐会推动沿岸沉积物移动，并逐渐重塑这些三角洲裂瓣。

question:
David Mitchell’s 2006 novel Black Swan Green contains elements drawn from Mitchell’s own life — there are many parallels between the experiences of the novel’s protagonist, Jason Taylor, and those of Mitchell — and as a result Black Swan Green is regularly described as an autobiographical novel. This characterization can be useful, but it also presents drawbacks in terms of how the work is perceived, given the high value placed on creativity and imagination in artistic endeavors. Readers who take this characterization to mean that Mitchell merely fictionalized actual events may conclude that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. Black Swan Green is not as worthy of praise as it might have been if it had no basis in fact.
B. critics disagree about whether Black Swan Green shows greater originality than works without autobiographical elements.
C. the real-world counterparts of other characters in Black Swan Green are hard to identify.
D. Mitchell should not have claimed that Black Swan Green is based on real events.
explanations:
中文解析：
文章中提到了作品中其实有很大的创作性和想象力，但是读者可能忽视，那么产生的结果就是他们会觉得这个作品抛开事实依据就没那么好。对应的是A。好得分网站上www.hdfedu.com 有这道旧题。
题目文本翻译：
大卫·米切尔2006年小说《黑天鹅绿》融入了作者自身经历——主人公杰森·泰勒与米切尔的遭遇存在诸多相似——因而常被归为自传体小说。这种界定虽有参考价值，却因艺术创作崇尚独创性与想象力而产生认知偏差。若读者据此认为米切尔仅对真实事件进行小说化处理，便可能推断_______

question:
In an international collaboration, Elaine Ostrander, Alan K. Outram, and other researchers probed the evolutionary history of size variation in modern dogs. Scientific consensus held that early dogs had large body mass and that a genetic driver of smaller size in some breeds (e.g., bulldogs) developed only within the last 20,000 years as a result of selective breeding for characteristics favored by humans. Ostrander et al. assert that this explanation is flawed, having discovered that a mutation responsible for variants of IGF1, a gene found in many mammals that regulates production of insulin-like growth factor 1, is ubiquitous in domestic dog breeds.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers' assertion?
selections: A. IGFI has been isolated in genetic material from fossils more than 20,000 years old of the red wolf (Canis rufus) and certain other species related to dogs.
B. An additional mutation related to IGFI affects the development of characteristics other than body size in smaller dog breeds like bulldogs.
C. The mutation related to IGFI influences body size is found in 53,000-year-old genetic material from fossils of Siberian wolves (Canis lupus campestris), an ancestor of dogs.
D. One variant of IGFI is found only in smaller dog breeds like bulldogs and appears to have emerged no more than 20,000 years ago.
explanations:
中文解析：
传统观点认为，小型犬的基因突变是近2万年人类选育的结果。但Ostrander团队认为这一解释有误，因为他们发现IGF1基因突变在家犬中普遍存在（即可能更早出现）。需要证明IGF1突变在更早的犬科祖先中就已存在（直接反驳“近2万年才出现”的传统观点）。C选项提到：该突变影响体型（直接关联研究主题）。在5.3万年前的西伯利亚狼（犬科祖先）化石中发现（证明突变远早于2万年）。
题目文本翻译：
在一项国际合作研究中，伊莱恩·奥斯特兰德、艾伦·K·奥特拉姆等学者探究了现代犬类体型差异的演化史。传统科学观点认为早期犬类体型庞大，而某些品种（如斗牛犬）的小型化基因特征仅在过去两万年间因人类偏好性选育才出现。研究团队发现调控胰岛素样生长因子1的IGF1基因突变普遍存在于家犬品种中，由此指出现有理论存在缺陷。

Esther Sanyé-Mengual, Kathrin Specht, and their team surveyed three groups of people in Bologna, Italy — leaders of urban agriculture projects, stakeholders in urban agriculture (e.g., food researchers and urban farming associations), and the general public — to compare their views about the extent to which urban agriculture contributes to 25 social or ecological services that the team identified. The researchers used these ratings to rank the services for each group, with a ranking of 1 indicating that a group perceives that urban agriculture benefits that service the most. Using only the rankings shown in the table, a city planner in Bologna who is promoting a new urban agriculture project concludes that advertisements aimed at stakeholders should emphasize the project’s benefit to the enhancement of pollination.

Which choice best describes data in the table that support the city planner’s conclusion?
selections: A. The enhancement of pollination was ranked higher for stakeholders than were the other four services.
B. The prevention of soil erosion was ranked lower for stakeholders than it was for project leaders.
C. The enhancement of pollination was ranked higher for the general public than it was for stakeholders.
D. The enhancement of carbon sequestration was ranked higher for stakeholders than was the enhancement of pollination.
explanations:
中文解析：
结论是面向利益相关方的宣传应重点强调项目对提升授粉服务的效益。图表中授粉服务的评分是几项服务中评分最高的，所以符合结论。
题目文本翻译：
埃斯特·桑耶-蒙瓜尔与凯瑟琳·施佩希特团队在意大利博洛尼亚调研了三类人群——都市农业项目负责人、相关利益方（如食品研究员与都市农协）及普通市民——对比他们对25项社会生态服务的贡献度认知。研究人员根据评分对各群体进行服务排序，排名第1表示该群体认为都市农业对该项服务贡献最大。仅依据表格排名数据，一位推广新都市农业项目的城市规划者得出结论：面向利益相关方的宣传应重点强调项目对提升授粉服务的效益。

question:
Callie W. Babbitt, Hema Madaka, and colleagues assembled a database of materials used in consumer electronics by studying products in the lab and by gathering data from similar product studies. The team gave each of these studies a rating for level of detail (with a higher rating for reported data with more detail) and for level of traceability (with a higher rating for clearer descriptions of procedures). Based on these ratings, a second research team concluded that a study by Greg L. Kozak and Gregory A. Keoleian provided more specificity in its data than a study by Oguchi Masahiro and colleagues did.

Which finding, if true, would most directly challenge the second research team’s conclusion?
selections: A. The study by Kozak and Keoleian had a lower detail rating than the study by Oguchi and colleagues did.
B. The study by Kozak and Keoleian had a lower traceability rating than the study by Oguchi and colleagues did.
C. The study by Kozak and Keoleian had a high detail rating and a high traceability rating.
D. The study by Oguchi and colleagues had a low detail rating and a low traceability rating.
explanations:
中文解析：
好得分的SAT师生说的公众号曾写过这个题目，specificity详细程度对应detail rating，这道题的关键在此。评分越高Kozak团队的detail rating（数据细节）低于Oguchi团队，直接反驳“数据更具体”的结论。
题目文本翻译：
卡莉·W·巴比特与赫玛·马达卡团队通过实验室产品检测及同类研究数据整合，建立了消费电子产品材料数据库。研究团队为每项数据来源设定了详细程度评级（数据越详尽评分越高）和可追溯性评级（实验流程描述越清晰评分越高）。基于该评级体系，另一研究团队判定格雷格·L·科扎克与格雷戈里·A·基奥莱安的研究数据比小口正弘团队的研究具有更高精确度。

question:
Since the nineteenth century, Egyptologists have commonly divided ancient Egyptian history into three primary ________ Old Kingdom (2700-2200 BCE), the Middle Kingdom (2050-1800 BCE), and the New Kingdom (1550-1100 BCE). Some historians, however, criticize the names of these periods for revealing more about the culture of the mainly European Egyptologists than that of ancient Egypt itself.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 三个国王时期属于平行并列，对于前面的periods进行解释，所以用冒号连接。

question:
Svante Pääbo and other researchers studying the history of organisms have long utilized ancient DNA—DNA recovered from ancient organic material that has been preserved under natural conditions. However, Reyjane P. Oliveira and colleagues’2017 study of the evolutionary trajectory of the Malagasy grass genus Chasechloa instead relied on historical DNA — genomic data incidentally preserved in specimens that are house d in natural history collections — thus capitalizing on the research potential offered by a vast but hitherto relatively underutilized source of insight into the biological past.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It specifies potential applications of the approach that Oliveira and colleagues used in their study.
B. It offers commentary on the significance of the approach that Oliveira and colleagues used for their study.
C. It emphasizes the importance of Oliveira and colleagues’ findings about the DNA of flora.
D. It explains why the research methodology selected by Oliveira and colleagues is not widely used.
explanations:
中文解析：
划线部分的核心内容是：“利用自然历史馆藏标本中偶然保存的基因组数据，从而开发了一个庞大但此前未被充分利用的研究资源”。这是在评价该研究方法的独特价值（“capitalizing on... underutilized source”），而非单纯描述应用（A）、强调植物DNA发现（C）或解释方法为何不常用（D）。
题目文本翻译：
斯万特·帕博等研究生物历史的学者长期利用古代DNA——即在自然条件下保存的古代有机材料中提取的遗传物质。而雷雅内·P·奥利维拉团队2017年关于马达加斯加禾本科植物Chasechloa属进化轨迹的研究，则采用了历史DNA——自然历史博物馆标本中偶然保存的基因组数据——从而开发了这个庞大却长期未被充分运用的生物历史研究资源。

question:
The following text is from Narcíso Tondreau’s 1898 poem “Yesterday and To-Day” (translated by Agnes Blake Poor in 1918). The poem is about an old statue of the Greek goddess Venus, which now lies on the ground in a state of disrepair.
How long ago, by summer breezes fanned,
Here stood the newborn Venus, fresh and fair;
All palpitating from the master’s hand,
The last touch of his chisel lingering there.
“And surely this shall last!” he proudly thought;
“Fixed in immortal marble is my fame!”
Just here, where human hand has surely wrought,
Some crumbling letters may have spelled his name.

In the text, what does the speaker say that the artist believed about his sculpture?
selections: A. It would be praised for its intricate details that he carefully chiseled.
B. It would be carefully repaired when it inevitably begins to deteriorate.
C. It would bring him enduring fame by withstanding time.
D. Its beauty would be recognized as surpassing that of other images of Venus.
explanations:
中文解析：
艺术家想这个作品将永存（“And surely this shall last!”）和我的名字将永存在玉石上（“Fixed in immortal marble is my fame!”）都代表了他觉得自己的作品将永世流传。
题目文本翻译：
以下文字选自纳西索·通德罗1898年诗作《昨日与今朝》（艾格尼丝·布莱克·普尔1918年英译）。诗歌描绘一尊破损的希腊维纳斯女神像如今倾颓于地的景象。
曾几何时，夏风轻拂的此处
屹立着初诞的维纳斯，鲜妍明媚
大理石犹震颤着大师的余温
雕凿的最后一凿尚留痕
"此作必当永存！"匠人傲然思忖
"不朽的汉白玉将镌刻吾名！"
而今在这人工雕琢之处
唯有剥落的字母或许曾拼写他的姓名

question:
The following text is from William Shakespeare’s circa 1611 play The Winter’s Tale. Camillo has been away from his home in Sicily and serves in the court of Polixenes, the king of Bohemia. He has asked Polixenes for permission to return to Sicily.
POLIXENES: I pray thee, good Camillo, be no more
importunate. Tis a sickness denying thee anything,
a death to grant this.
CAMILLO: It is fifteen years since I saw my country.
Though I have for the most part been aired abroad,
I desire to lay my bones there. Besides, the penitent
king, my master, hath sent for me, to whose feeling
sorrows I might be some allay— or I o’erween [presume] to
think so— which is another spur to my departure.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It bolsters the idea that Camillo’s primary motivation to return home is his concern for the king of Sicily’s well-being in his absence.
B. It suggests that Camillo feels compelled to persuade Polixenes that Camillo’s decision to leave the court is justified.
C. It establishes Camillo’s hope that Polixenes will be comforted knowing that Camillo is’t departing at his own discretion.
D. It conveys Camillo’s recognition that one benefit his presence may afford the king of Sicily is merely speculative.
explanations:
中文解析：
先梳理这个诗歌中的核心人物关系：Polixenes：波西米亚国王（当前雇主，Camillo请求离开的对象）。西西里国王：Camillo的故主（my master）召唤他回国。Camillo要离开说了两个原因：主要动机：思乡（15年未归，想落叶归根）。附加理由：西西里国王召唤他，且他或许（might）能缓解国王的悲伤——但立刻谦虚地表示"可能高估了自己"（o’erween）。所以对应D选项。好得分的老师认为这就像离职或者分手时为了不伤害对方说的一些“官方理由”。这道题很难。
题目文本翻译：
以下文字选自威廉·莎士比亚约1611年剧作《冬天的故事》。卡米洛远离西西里故乡，在波希米亚国王波力克希尼斯宫廷任职。他正向国王请求返回西西里。
波力克希尼斯：
善良的卡米洛，请别再纠缠不休。
拒绝你令我痛苦不堪，
应允此事更如要人性命。
卡米洛：
阔别故国已十五寒暑。
虽常年漂泊异域，
仍盼叶落归根。况且
我那忏悔的主人——国王陛下
已传召我归去，或许
我能稍解他沉痛哀思
（若此念不算僭越），
这更催我启程。

question:

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·Linguistic typologists classify and compare languages according to their structural features.
·One such structure is word order, or the way subjects (S), verbs (V), and objects (O) are typically arranged in a sentence.
·English employs an SVO word order (e. g. , Cows eat grass).
·Bengali employs an SOV word order (e. g. , Cows grass eat).
·Filipino employs a VSO word order (e. g. , Eat cows grass).
·87% of the world’s languages are classified as either SVO or SOV.

The student wants to make a generalization about how word order is employed across languages. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Word order is one of the structural features by which linguistic typologists classify and compare the world’s languages.
B. Linguistic typologists analyze and compare how word order is employed across languages.
C. The way in which subjects, verbs, and objects are typically arranged in a sentence is also called word order.
D. The majority of languages place the subject of a sentence before the verb and object.
explanations:
中文解析：
题干要求概括下文字顺序是如何安排的。D选项说大多数语言的主语放在谓语和宾语前面，符合题目要求。
题目文本翻译：
学生在研究某一课题时整理了以下笔记：
·语言类型学家根据结构特征对语言进行分类比较
·基本语序是重要特征之一，即主语(S)、动词(V)、宾语(O)在句中的常规排列方式
·英语采用SVO语序（例：奶牛吃草）
·孟加拉语采用SOV语序（例：奶牛草吃）
·菲律宾语采用VSO语序（例：吃奶牛草）
·全球87%的语言属于SVO或SOV语序类型

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·Producing the nutrient-rich cyanobacterium L. maxima at industrial scale requires high-quality samples of L. maxima DNA.
·Yirlis Yadeth Pineda-Rodriguez and a team of researchers at the University of Córdoba, Colombia, evaluated the quantity and purity of L. maxima DNA extracted using three different DNA extraction kits.
·CTAB 2X (kit 1) had a DNA yield of 2, 134 nanograms per microliter (ng/μL) and a purity ratio of 2. 2.
·Pbact (kit 2) had a DNA yield of 157 ng/μL and a purity ratio of 1.6.
·Pplant (kit 3) had a DNA yield of 12. 5 ng/μL and a purity ratio of 1.5.
·According to the researchers, Pbact was the most effective because it was the only one with both a sufficiently high yield and a purity rate close to the ideal of 1.8.

The student wants to emphasize the significance of a similarity between two of the kits.Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. CTAB 2X and Pplant both had a DNA yield above 10 and a purity ratio above 1.4.
B. Due to their insufficient yield or purity, CTAB 2X and Pplant were deemed by the researchers to be less effective than Pbact.
C. With the ideal purity ratio being 1.8, CTAB 2X and Pbact were equal in purity, according to the researchers.
D. Compared to CTAB 2X, which had a DNA yield of 2,134 ng/ut, both Pbact and Pplant had insufficient yields; Pplant, in particular, was ineffective due to its low yield.
explanations:
中文解析：
因为题目问的是significance而不是similarity。根据笔记信息：CTAB 2X 和Pplant 要么yield不行，要么purity不行，所以它俩这个共同点体现了它俩不如Pbat有效，less effective就是significance。
题目文本翻译：
学生在研究某一课题时整理了以下笔记：
·工业化生产富含营养的蓝藻L.maxima需要高质量DNA样本
·哥伦比亚科尔多瓦大学伊尔利斯·亚德思·皮内达-罗德里格斯团队评估了三种DNA提取试剂盒的效果
·CTAB 2X（试剂盒1）DNA产量2134纳克/微升，纯度比值2.2
·Pbact（试剂盒2）DNA产量157纳克/微升，纯度比值1.6
·Pplant（试剂盒3）DNA产量12.5纳克/微升，纯度比值1.5
·研究显示Pbact效果最佳，因其在产量达标的同时纯度最接近理想值1.8

道路地图的方法not very accurate，对比计算机程序more accurately，因此，程序的表现比道路地图更好，选择superior。
题目文本翻译：
一些城市使用道路地图来估算人行道的位置，这种方法并不十分准确。Maryam Hosseini及其团队训练了一个计算机程序，通过曼哈顿的航空图像识别人行道，并将其应用于布鲁克林的图像。该程序的表现_________道路地图方法：它能更精确地识别出人行道，甚至可区分鹅卵石路面与砖砌路面。

question:
Memoirs of Elleanor Eldridge is an 1838 historical account by Elleanor Eldridge and Frances Harriet Whipple Green. In the book, the authors assert that all people naturally have an emotional attachment to where they live, writing, ________

Which quotation from Memoirs of Elleanor Eldridge most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “This little book is published for the express purpose of giving a helping hand to suffering and persecuted merit.”

B. “To give some idea of the high esteem in which the subject of the following narrative is held, and the strong interest her misfortunes have excited, a few, from the great number of recommendations in her possession, are selected.”
C. “Blessed are the slumbers of the innocent! They are kindlier than balm, and they refresh and gladden the spirit of childhood, like ministerings from a better world.”
D. “Home is home, to the lowly as well as the great: and no rank, or color, destroys its sacred character, its power over the mind, and the affections.”
explanations:
中文解析：
D选项大意“家就是家，对卑微者和伟人皆是如此：无论身份或肤色，都无法削弱它的神圣性，以及对心灵和情感的支配力。”直接呼应“ an emotional attachment to where they live”
题目文本翻译：
《埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇回忆录》是埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇与弗朗西丝·哈里特·惠普尔·格林于1838年合作完成的历史传记。书中，作者们主张人类天生会对所居之地产生情感依恋，并写道：________

question:

Mr. French, the senior partner, who sat opposite Kirby, was an older man—a safe guess would have placed him somewhere in the debatable ground between forty and fifty; of a good height, as could be seen even from the seated figure, the upper part of which was held erect with the unconscious ease which one associates with military training.

good height描述的是弗伦奇先生的身高，后文提到他即使坐着也能看出上半身挺直，说明他身材较高，considerable height指相当高的，符合语境。
题目文本翻译：
以下文本出自查尔斯·切斯纳特1905年的小说《上校的梦》。弗伦奇先生与柯比先生是工作伙伴。
年长的合伙人弗伦奇先生坐在柯比对面——若作保守推测，他应身处四十岁到五十岁之间的模糊地带；其身材高挑，即使坐着也能看出端倪，上半身笔挺的姿态带着一种人们会联想到军事训练的无意识从容。

question:
Chemists M. H. Gamble, P. Rice, and J. D. Selman studied the mass and heat transfer processes that occur when foods, such as the Indian snacks malapua and puri bhaji, are oil fried. During frying, water in the crust evaporates, leaving voids that oil (a pure fat) can fill. As the process continues, water from the food’s center moves to the crust as long as the crust remains permeable. Therefore, it is likely that, all other things being equal, sections of a food that lose less moisture during the frying process ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. will develop a thicker crust during the frying process than sections that lose more moisture.
B. will have a lower fat content after frying is completed than sections that lose more moisture.
C. will have a crust that loses its permeability less quickly during the frying process than sections that lose more moisture.
D. will have a higher temperature after frying is completed than sections that lose more moisture.
explanations:
中文解析：
根据文本逻辑，水分流失少，油脂填充少，脂肪含量低，于是B符合要求，脂肪含量更低 直接对应“水分流失少 ，油脂填充少”的逻辑。
题目文本翻译：
化学家 M. H. Gamble、P. Rice 和 J. D. Selman 研究了印度小吃马拉普阿（malapua）和普里巴吉（puri bhaji）等食物在油炸过程中发生的传质与传热过程。油炸时，外壳中的水分蒸发后会留下空隙，油（一种纯脂肪）便能渗入这些空隙。只要食物外壳保持渗透性，随着油炸持续进行，食物中心的水分会不断向外壳迁移。因此可以推断，在其他条件相同的情况下，在油炸过程中失去较少水分的食物部位 ________

question:
In Hoocąk, an Indigenous language from the Midwest region of what is now the United States, zi means “yellow,” whereas zizi means “yellow in spots.” This phenomenon, in which an element of a root word is repeated, sometimes with modification, within another word that is related to the root word, is called reduplication. In this case, the entire word zi gets repeated in zizi. There are many examples of this type of reduplication in Hoocąk.

The text makes which point about Hoocąk?
selections: A. It is one of the only languages in the world that makes use of reduplication.
B. It is closely related to another language from the Midwest region of what is now the United States that also makes use of reduplication.
C. It contains many instances of the type of reduplication seen in the words zi and zizi.
D. It has a wide variety of reduplicated words and phrases that mean “yellow.”
explanations:
中文解析：
zi 表示“黄色”，zizi 表示“斑驳的黄色”，这种现象称为“重叠”（reduplication），即通过重复词根，来构成新词，文中提到，Hoocąk语言中有许多这样的重叠例子。
题目文本翻译：
在霍昌卡语（Hoocąk）——一种源自现今美国中西部地区的原住民语言中，"zi"表示"黄色"，而"zizi"则意为"斑点状的黄色"。这种现象被称为"重叠构词法"，即词根中的某个元素在相关词汇中被重复使用（有时伴随形态变化）。此案例中，整个单词"zi"在"zizi"中被完整重复。霍昌卡语中存在大量此类重叠构词法的范例。

question:
Often, the Nobel Prize in Chemistry is given to a single person, such as George de Hevesy in 1943. But recognition isn’t restricted to _________ individuals. Instead, success in fields like chemistry is usually achieved through collaboration with other experts, as was the case for Max Ferdinand Perutz, who was among those awarded for “their studies of the structures of globular proteins.”

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析：
前文说诺奖通常给一个人，但后文强调成功需要合作collaboration。空白处应表达不限于单独获奖者的意思。solitary（单独的） 与collaboration（合作）形成对比，逻辑通顺。
题目文本翻译：
通常，诺贝尔化学奖会授予单独一人，例如1943年的乔治·德海韦西。但认可并不局限于_________个人。相反，在化学等领域取得成就通常需要与其他专家合作，正如马克斯·费迪南德·佩鲁茨的情况——他因"对球状蛋白质结构的研究"而成为获奖者之一。

question:
The Apollo Moon landings (1969–1972) brought atmospheric sensors and soil sensors to the Moon and produced large amounts of data, much of which was stored on outdated technologies. A data-transfer project is making the data available again, thereby ________ the Apollo data’s usefulness, as the data are used to study the geology of the Moon.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析：
数据原本因技术过时而无法使用，现在通过项目重新可用（made available again），这些数据现在被用于研究月球地质，说明其价值被重新激活，renewing符合要求。
题目文本翻译：
阿波罗探月计划（1969–1972）向月球输送了大气传感器与土壤传感器并产生了大量数据，其中大部分存储在过时的技术设备上。某个数据传输项目正在重新启用这些数据，由此________阿波罗数据的使用价值——这些数据正被用于研究月球地质。

question:
Text 1
In 2019 Belo Horizonte, Brazil, was named a City of Gastronomy by UNESCO in recognition of the city’s unique food culture. The honor is well known among residents of the city as well as tourists who visit. It’s obvious that the selection of Belo Horizonte by UNESCO has brought awareness to local recipes, cooking practices, and chefs and has provided a boost to the city’s tourism industry.
Text 2
Many people in Belo Horizonte’s restaurant industry hoped that food tourism would increase after the city was chosen as a City of Gastronomy in 2019. However, as researcher Eerang Park and colleagues argue, cities must still create effective marketing strategies to benefit fully from being named a City of Gastronomy. Without an intentional effort to promote the city’s food scene, many current and potential visitors to Belo Horizonte may not even be aware that it’s home to uniquely delicious food.

Based on the texts, what would the author of Text 2 most likely say in response to the underlined claim in Text 1?
selections: A. Many people worked together to help Belo Horizonte be recognized by UNESCO, but chefs deserve the most credit for Belo Horizonte’s selection as a City of Gastronomy.
B. Belo Horizonte may have benefited from being selected by UNESCO, but tourism can likely be further increased by making more potential visitors aware of the city’s status as a City of Gastronomy.
C. The naming of Belo Horizonte as a City of Gastronomy was long overdue, given the city’s unique and delicious food.
D. The benefits of being named a City of Gastronomy extend well beyond tourism.
explanations:
中文解析：
Text 2 的作者会认为，虽然评选带来了一定好处（如 Text 1 所述），但若不主动宣传，旅游业增长潜力尚未完全释放。B选项Belo Horizonte可能从评选中受益，但通过让更多潜在游客了解其“美食之都”的地位，旅游业可能会进一步增长。完全符合 Text 2 的观点，就是当前受益有限，需主动营销才能充分提升旅游业。
题目文本翻译：
文本1
2019年巴西贝洛奥里藏特被联合国教科文组织命名为"美食之都"，以表彰该市独特的饮食文化。这一荣誉在当地市民和到访游客中广为人知。显然，联合国教科文组织的评选提高了人们对当地食谱、烹饪方法和厨师的认识，并为该市旅游业提供了发展助力。
文本2
贝洛奥里藏特餐饮业的许多从业者曾希望，自2019年该市获评"美食之都"后美食旅游能有所增长。但正如研究人员Eerang Park及其同事所言，城市仍需制定有效的营销策略才能充分受益于"美食之都"称号。若没有有意识地努力推广城市美食景观，许多现有和潜在游客可能根本不知道贝洛奥里藏特拥有独特美味的美食。

explanations:

后文提到 Manuel Cuevas 因终身贡献而获奖，说明该奖项是为了表彰杰出艺术家，honor符合要求。

国家遗产奖旨在_________美国杰出的民间和传统艺术家。墨西哥裔美国牛仔服装师曼努埃尔·奎瓦斯因对艺术的终身贡献而获此殊荣。

question:
Ants and aphids are known to be mutualistic: ants feed on the honeydew produced by aphids, while aphids benefit from ants’ protection against predators. If aphid colonies—which generally require relatively stable surfaces, such as trees or other woody plants, to thrive— are too small to produce significant volumes of honeydew, however, ants will prey on aphids. Researcher Tae-Sung Kwon examined ant and aphid abundance in two habitats in South Korea, one on the mainland and one on Jeju Island. Though the habitats differed in some important respects, both were predominantly grassland, which could help explain why Kwon observed ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. different ant and aphid species on the mainland compared to those on the island.
B. a positive correlation between aphid diversity and abundance on both the mainland and the island.
C. a negative correlation between ant and aphid abundance on both the mainland and the island.
D. diminished ant and aphid abundance on the mainland compared to that on the island.
explanations:
中文解析：
根据公众号SAT师生的推断类题目分析，关键点是草地和树木地要区分开，在草地环境下aphids难以大量繁衍，群体较小 ，蚂蚁可能捕食蚜虫aphids，因此蚂蚁和蚜虫的数量可能呈现负相关（蚂蚁多时蚜虫少）。
题目文本翻译：
蚂蚁和蚜虫被认为存在互利共生关系：蚂蚁以蚜虫分泌的蜜露为食，而蚜虫受益于蚂蚁对捕食者的抵御。然而，若蚜虫群体（通常需要树木或其他木本植物等相对稳定的表面才能繁盛）规模过小导致蜜露产量不足时，蚂蚁则会捕食蚜虫。研究员Tae-Sung Kwon考察了韩国两地（一处大陆区域与一处济州岛区域）的蚂蚁与蚜虫数量。尽管两地栖息地在某些重要方面存在差异，但均以草地环境为主，这可能有助于解释为何Kwon观察到________

question:
The Federalist Papers are a collection of 85 essays written by Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison. Their publication (under a single pen name) was divided among the Daily Advertiser and other New York newspapers in 1787-88. The essays argue that New Yorkers should vote to ratify the proposed United States Constitution. Though the authorship of most of the individual essays is certain, that of a few is in question: for instance, while No. 6, “Concerning Dangers from Dissensions between the States,” was surely penned by Hamilton, No. 62, “The Senate,” may have been written by either Hamilton or Madison.

Based on the text, what do the essays “Concerning Dangers from Dissensions between the States” and “The Senate” have in common?
selections: A. They were both written by one of the three authors of the Federalist Papers, but which of the authors wrote either is not entirely clear.
B. They were both published sometime during 1787 or 1788.
C. They were both collaborative efforts between Alexander Hamilton and James Madison.
D. They were both published in the Daily Advertiser.
explanations:
中文解析：
在SAT师生说（公众号）推文里也讲过这个题目是个旧题改编，这次题目问第6篇和第62篇有什么共同点？B选项正确，文中提到所有文章都在1787-88年发表，这一点适用于这两篇。第6篇作者明确是汉密尔顿，只有第62篇不确定，于是A错了。第6篇明确是汉密尔顿单独写的，于是C也错了，文中只说文章发表在《每日广告报》和其他报纸，未指定这两篇的具体发表处，D也错了。
题目文本翻译：
《联邦党人文集》是由亚历山大·汉密尔顿、约翰·杰伊和詹姆斯·麦迪逊共同撰写的85篇文集。这些文章（以共同笔名发表）于1787至1788年间分散刊登于《每日广告报》及其他纽约报刊。该系列文章旨在呼吁纽约民众投票批准拟议的《美利坚合众国宪法》。尽管大部分单篇文章的作者身份明确，但仍有少数存在争议：例如第六篇《论各州间纷争之隐患》确为汉密尔顿执笔，而第六十二篇《论参议院》则可能出自汉密尔顿或麦迪逊之手。

一名学生正在使用该图表进行关于两个欧洲国家农业、狩猎和林业部门历史就业趋势的课堂展示。该学生指出，从1995年到2007年 ________

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·The human tongue contains taste receptors for a rich, savory flavor called umami.
·Umami is triggered by the compounds in a variety of foods, including tuna and blue cheese.
·Participants in a study tasted a sample of sea palm, a type of brown seaweed.
·They rated its umami intensity as moderate.
·The participants tasted a sample of bull kelp, another type of brown seaweed.
·They rated its umami intensity as high.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two seaweeds. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Some types of brown seaweed, like sea palm and bull kelp, trigger umami flavor in human taste buds.
B. Sea palm is a type of brown seaweed, but so is bull kelp.
C. While sea palm and bull kelp contain umami flavor, umami can also be found in tuna and blue cheese.

在研究某一课题时，某学生记录了以下信息：

· 鲜味由多种食物所含化合物激发，包括金枪鱼和蓝纹奶酪；
· 研究参与者品尝了褐藻类植物海棕榈的样本；
· 他们评定其鲜味强度为中等；
· 参与者随后品尝了同为褐藻的牛昆布样本；
· 他们评定其鲜味强度为高等。

question:
Analyses of Rembrandt’s seventeenth-century painting The Night Watch, citing its richly saturated colors and stark contrasts between light and shadow, often characterize the work as an exemplar of the Baroque-era style. Many art historians, however, challenge the very notion of a distinct Baroque era. They claim that the so-called Baroque aesthetic was, ________ just an extension of the stylings of the Renaissance era.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
中文解析：
in reality表示事实上，前面说质疑so-called Baroque aesthetic，后文说just an extension of the stylings of the Renaissance era，前后意义一直，in reality起到了补充强调作用，需要更多练习请选用好得分SAT逻辑词 70难题合集
题目文本翻译：
对十七世纪伦勃朗画作《夜巡》的分析，援引其浓烈的色彩和明暗之间的鲜明对比，常将该作品描述为巴洛克时期风格的典范。然而，许多艺术史学家质疑所谓独特的巴洛克时期这一概念本身。他们声称，所谓的巴洛克美学不过是文艺复兴时期风格的延伸。

question:
Physicist Walter Massey led numerous scientific organizations over his long career. His most prominent appointment came in 1990, when Massey was named director of the National Science Foundation. ________ Massey had served as the first president of the National Society of Black Physicists.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
中文解析：
主句讲1990年Massey担任NSF主任（较晚事件）,后句讲他更早的职位（首任黑人物理学家协会主席）,需体现时间先后（先担任协会主席，后成为NSF主任）,previously符合要求
题目文本翻译：
物理学家沃尔特·马西在其漫长职业生涯中领导过众多科学组织。他最重要的任命出现在1990年，当时马西被任命为美国国家科学基金会主任。________ 马西此前曾担任美国黑人物理学家协会首任主席。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·The Polytechnic in Gdansk, Poland, is home to a Foucault pendulum.
·The pendulum consists of a weighted ball that swings at the end of a roughly 26-meter-long cable.
·Like all Foucault pendulums, it dangles from a fixed point that ensures the swing path of the pendulum doesn’t change.
·To an observer, the swing path of a Foucault pendulum appears to change over time because Earth rotates beneath it.
·Foucault pendulums are used as a simple way to provide evidence of Earth’s rotation.

The student wants to specify the parts of a Foucault pendulum. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Foucault pendulum at the Polytechnic in Gdansk, Poland, includes a cable that is roughly 26 meters long.
B. With a swing path that appears to change over time, a Foucault pendulum provides evidence of Earth’s rotation.
C. Dangling from a fixed point, the Foucault pendulum at the Polytechnic consists of a cable with a weighted ball at the end.
D. The swing path of the Foucault pendulum at the Polytechnic appears to change over time.
explanations:
中文解析：
题目要求specify the parts，C选项买哦书挂于固定点，由缆绳和末端的配重球组成。完整列出三部分：固定点、缆绳、配重球。
题目文本翻译：
在开展课题研究时，某学生记录了以下信息：
· 波兰格但斯克理工大学设有一座傅科摆装置。
· 该摆锤由末端悬挂重球的约26米长缆索构成。
· 与所有傅科摆相同，该装置悬挂于固定支点，确保摆锤运动轨迹恒定。
· 观测者视角中，傅科摆运动轨迹随时间变化的现象源自地球在其下方的自转运动。
· 傅科摆是验证地球自转现象的直观实证装置。

question:
The Grootbos florilegium in South Africa contains a collection of botanical paintings, with each painting depicting a local plant species in exquisite detail. The florilegium includes a vignette painting by contributing artist Sibonelo Chiliza. Unlike most paintings in the florilegium, ________

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. Chiliza contextualizes a plant within an ecosystem in his vignette.
B. the contextualization of a plant within an ecosystem occurs in Chiliza’s vignette.
C. a plant’s ecosystem is contextualized in Chiliza’s vignette.
D. Chiliza’s vignette contextualizes a plant within an ecosystem.
explanations: 根据most paintings...，需要画来充当句子的主语，于是D符合

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·Soap forms as the result of a chemical reaction between fats and either sodium or potassium hydroxide.
·One end of a soap molecule is hydrophobic (water repelling), and one end is hydrophilic (water attracting).
·The hydrophobic ends of soap molecules adhere to hydrophobic surface contaminants, such as dirt and oils.
·The soap molecules form circular structures (micelles) around contaminants.
·The hydrophilic ends of the molecules encase the micelles in water, lifting the micelles and contaminants off surfaces.

The student wants to explain how soap removes a surface contaminant. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Surface contaminants like dirt and oils are hydrophobic, not hydrophilic— meaning they repel water rather than attract it.
B. Micelles are circular structures created when soap molecules attach themselves to dirt or oils.

C. To remove dirt from a surface, soap molecules form a circular structure, or micelle, around the contaminant; next, the molecules encase the micelle in water, lifting it —and the dirt — off the surface.

D. Dirt, an example of a hydrophobic surface contaminant, can be removed from a surface by soap, which forms as the result of a chemical reaction between fats and either sodium or potassium hydroxide.
explanations:
中文解析：
题目要求explain how soap removes a surface contaminant，C选项满足，肥皂分子先围绕污垢形成胶束，再用水包裹胶束，从而将污垢从表面剥离，完整还原去污流程：形成胶束（疏水端吸附污垢），亲水端包裹胶束（使污垢溶于水），最终剥离
题目文本翻译：
在研究某一主题时，某学生记录了以下要点：
· 肥皂是脂肪与氢氧化钠或氢氧化钾发生化学反应生成的产物。
· 肥皂分子一端具有疏水性（排斥水），另一端具有亲水性（吸引水）。
· 肥皂分子的疏水端会附着于疏水性表面污染物（如灰尘和油脂）。
· 肥皂分子围绕污染物形成环状结构（胶束）。
· 分子的亲水端将胶束包裹在水中，使胶束与污染物从物体表面脱离。

question:
A student is writing a research paper on the history of irrigation in the southwestern United States, situating the development of Searsville Lake (a man-made body of water created in San Mateo County, California, in 1890) in a larger historical context. The student claims that some modern-day irrigation methods used in southwestern states, such as California, Arizona, and New Mexico, have a lineage that long predates the completion of Searsville Lake.

Which quotation from a historian best supports the student’s claim?
selections: A. “The irrigation system developed by the Hohokam people in what is now central Arizona in the 7th century CE was simple but made use of hydraulic engineering design principles that are still utilized by today’s engineers.”
B. “The importance of the development of irrigation infrastructure in the American Southwest today cannot be overstated, since it is the most common means of conveying water for food production.”
C. “In the decades following the Second World War, irrigation of arid areas for agriculture increased to such a degree that it now accounts for roughly 70% of the world’s water usage.”

D. “Sprinkler irrigation systems, which were developed in the late 20th century, are a convenient technique of irrigating that makes use of machinery in order to spray water in all directions. Many areas of the Southwestern United States are currently irrigated by this method.”
explanations:
中文解析：
需要找到证明"西南部灌溉技术有古老起源"的历史学家论述。直接提到7世纪霍霍坎人(Hohokam)的灌溉系统，并指出其设计原理至今仍被使用，完全匹配"lineage that long predates"的要求。
题目文本翻译：
一名学生正在撰写一篇关于美国西南部灌溉历史的研究论文，将塞尔斯维尔湖（一个于1890年在加利福尼亚州圣马特奥县创建的人造水体）的发展置于更大的历史背景中。该学生声称，现代西南各州（如加利福尼亚州、亚利桑那州和新墨西哥州）使用的一些灌溉方法，其渊源早于塞尔斯维尔湖的完工。

question:
Chorioactis geaster, a species of mushroom that makes a distinctive hissing sound when it releases its spores, is an elusive fungus that has been observed only in Texas and Oklahoma in the US and in the Miyazaki and Nara Prefectures in Japan. Scientists aren’t entirely sure why C. geaster is distributed in this way (genetic analysis reveals that the US and Japanese strains diverged 19 million years ago), but the mushroom appears to be very selective: it is typically found on the decaying stumps and roots of only a few tree species that are abundant in these areas.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It provides an explanation for the relationship between C. geaster and its habitats.
B. It highlights the negative impact C. geaster has on the trees on which it’s found.
C. It emphasizes the uncertainty about C. geaster alluded to earlier in the text.
D. It elaborates on a characterization of C. geaster presented earlier in the text.
explanations:
中文解析：
冒号后解释冒号前selective这个特质。前文提到这种蘑菇仅分布在特定地区，而这句话说明它只生长在少数树种上，且这些树种恰好在这些地区丰富。因此，它间接解释了为什么C. geaster的分布如此局限，因为它的宿主树木只在这些地方常见。
题目文本翻译：
地星裂杯菌（Chorioactis geaster）是一种在释放孢子时会发出独特嘶嘶声的真菌。这种稀有真菌目前仅分布于美国得克萨斯州、俄克拉荷马州，以及日本宫崎县和奈良县。科学家尚未完全明确其特殊分布格局的成因（基因分析显示，美国和日本的地星裂杯菌种群在1900万年前便已分化），但该真菌对生长环境表现出高度选择性——通常只生长于这些地区常见的少数几种树木的腐烂树桩和根部。

question:
Many contemporary Indigenous painters practice a specifically Indigenous mode of abstraction; for example, Starr Hardridge often assembles compositions out of motifs common in the traditional beadwork and graphic art of his tribe. In contrast, the prominent Indigenous practitioners of abstract painting during the mid-twentieth century, such as the Southern Cheyenne artist Dick West, typically aligned their compositional strategies with Abstract Expressionism—a school of painting dominated by European American artists— instead of with traditionally nonrepresentational forms of Indigenous art. Thus, in the case of West’s generation, the identification of an abstract painting as Indigenous art tends to _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. deny the extent to which cultural identity influences an artist’s work.
B. depend not on stylistic details but instead on an awareness of the artist’s identity.
C. obscure the Indigenous origins of certain motifs associated with Abstract Expressionism.
D. place a greater emphasis on the artist’s biography than on the aesthetic merit of the painting.
explanations:
中文解析：
当代原住民画家Starr Hardridge采用本民族传统抽象风格，20世纪中叶原住民抽象画家Dick West则倾向于欧美主导的抽象表现主义风格，West一代的作品在风格上与欧美抽象表现主义一致，但因其原住民身份，这些画仍被归类为"原住民艺术"，既然West风格特征与欧美艺术一致，那么归类依据只能是艺术家身份，对应B选项
题目文本翻译：
许多当代原住民画家践行着一种原住民特有的抽象风格：例如斯塔尔·哈德里奇（Starr Hardridge）常从其部落传统珠饰艺术和平面艺术中提取元素进行创作组合。相比之下，二十世纪中叶重要的原住民抽象绘画实践者——如南夏延族艺术家迪克·韦斯特（Dick West）——通常将其构图策略与抽象表现主义（一个由欧洲裔美国艺术家主导的画派）相统一，而非与传统原住民艺术中的非具象形式保持一致。因此，在韦斯特一代的案例中，将抽象绘画视为原住民艺术的认定往往倾向于_______

question:
Some robots such as Saika (developed in 1996) and Poppy (developed in 2013) are designed to resemble humans so that people will find it easier to interact with them. To that end, certain features such as bipedal locomotion can help to _________ the effect of the more unnatural aspects of a robot’s appearance, but a robot that looks too human can fall into the “uncanny valley,” meaning that its appearance unintentionally unsettles those who encounter it.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析：
通过人类特征减轻机器人外观的不自然感，但是过度像人反而会引发恐怖谷效应。help to... the effect of unnatural aspects，需填入缓解负面影响的动词ameliorate 意为改善、减轻，符合语境
题目文本翻译：
有些机器人如Saika（1996年开发）和Poppy（2013年开发）被设计成模仿人类，以便人们能更轻松地与它们互动。为此，双足运动等特定特征有助于_________机器人外观中非自然元素带来的影响，但过于类人的机器人可能陷入"恐怖谷"效应，即其外观会无意中令接触者感到不安。

question:
Demosthenes, a prominent fourth-century BCE Athenian orator, is said to have been _______ of parrhesia, or speaking freely and openly to ensure productive civic deliberation. He is noted for characterizing parrhesia in several public addresses as the foundation of democracy in classical Athens rather than, more simply, as a facilitator of the political system.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析：
Parrhesia（直言自由）是德摩斯梯尼积极倡导的民主核心价值。他将其定义为民主基石，说明他是理念的支持者/倡导者。characterizing... as the foundation 体现主动推广的立场。 a proponent 表示支持者/倡导者，契合他推广Parrhesia的行为。
题目文本翻译：
据说，公元前 4 世纪雅典著名的演说家德摩斯梯尼，一直_______ “直言”，即自由、坦诚地发表意见，以确保公民审议富有成效。他在几次公开演讲中指出，“直言”是古典时期雅典民主的基础，而不仅仅是政治体制的促进因素。

question:
The Clouds is a 423 BCE play by Aristophanes, originally written in ancient Greek. At the time, professional intellectuals called sophists taught customers rhetorical techniques to use in public speaking, along with providing instruction in other subjects. In the play, Aristophanes satirizes sophists as having an exaggerated sense of their own wisdom, as seen when the character _______

Which choice most effectively uses a quotation from a translation of The Clouds to illustrate the claim?
selections: A. Socrates, a sophist, says to a customer, “You talk nonsense. Begone; I can’t teach you any longer.”

B. Strepsiades says of a sophist business, “There dwell men who in speaking of the heavens persuade people that it is an oven, and that it encompasses us, and that we are the embers. These men teach, if one give them money, to conquer in speaking, right or wrong.”
C. Strepsiades encourages his son to learn to be a sophist, saying, “Go, I entreat you. dearest of men, go and be taught.”
D. Socrates, a sophist, says to a new customer, “Come, then, take care that, whenever I propound any clever dogma about abstruse matters, you [seize] immediately.”
explanations:
中文解析：
Exaggerated sense of their own wisdom 可以理解为"对自身智慧的自负夸大认知"，也就是自负，对应了D选项，苏格拉底（一位诡辩家）对新顾客说："那么来吧，注意了，每当我提出关于深奥问题的精妙教条时，你要立即掌握。自己觉得自己提出的都是clever dogma，还让别人立即学习，体现了了自负。
题目文本翻译：
《云》是阿里斯托芬创作于公元前 423 年的一部古希腊语戏剧。当时，被称为智者学派（sophists）的职业知识分子向顾客传授公共演讲的修辞技巧，同时还教授其他学科。剧中，阿里斯托芬讽刺这些智者们过分夸大自己的智慧，正如剧中人物_______时表现的那样

question:
Roy McLendon’s Moonlit St. Lucie, a riverscape featuring the silhouette of a single palm tree against the backdrop of shimmering water and a brilliant moonlit sky, is typical of paintings by the Florida Highwaymen, loosely affiliated landscape artists mainly active in Fort Pierce, Florida, during the 1950s and ‘60s. Some art historians suggest that Highwaymen paintings played a role in shaping popular perceptions of the state that persist today: the natural iconography that McLendon and colleagues constantly revisited— placid inland rivers, windswept palm trees— is now seen as classically Floridian.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To describe the historical circumstances in which paintings by the Florida Highwaymen experienced a resurgence in popularity
B. To explain that a particular painting by Roy McLendon has had greater influence on the broader culture of the state of Florida than is generally acknowledged
C. To contrast the public’s reaction during the 1950s and ‘60s to a particular painting by Roy McLendon with more recent reactions to it
D. To present the argument that paintings by the Florida Highwaymen likely helped to create a particular widespread impression of Florida
explanations:
中文解析：
公路画家的画作可能塑造了人们对佛罗里达的特定印象。文本核心是探讨画作意象与佛罗里达形象之间的关联，D选项精准捕捉这一论点，指出画作中的自然意象（河流、棕榈树）成为佛罗里达的经典符号，引用艺术史学家的观点，说明画作对公众认知的潜在影响。
题目文本翻译：
罗伊·麦克伦登的《圣露西月夜》是一幅河景画，画面中一棵棕榈树的轮廓映衬在波光粼粼的水面和明亮的月光下。这幅画是佛罗里达州“公路画家”们的典型作品。这些画家是松散结盟的风景画家，主要活跃于 20 世纪 50 年代和 60 年代的佛罗里达州皮尔斯堡。一些艺术史学家认为，“公路画家”的作品在塑造如今人们对佛罗里达州的普遍认知方面发挥了作用：麦克伦登及其同事反复描绘的自然意象——宁静的内陆河流、被风吹拂的棕榈树——如今被视为典型的佛罗里达州景象。
