question:
In Egypt, use of solid fuel (e.g., coal, wood) as a share of total household fuel use fell by more than 90 percent between 2000 and 2015; such shifts are often explained by appeal to the energy ladder, a model holding that fuel choice is mediated mainly by household income (specifically, high-technology fuels displace solid fuels as incomes rise). Alemu Mekonne n and Gunnar Köhlin’s study of fuel use in Ethiopia shows this model to be reductive, however: household fuel use was heterogeneous, flexible, and influenced by several factors, including the local availability of different fuel sources.

Which choice best describes the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To contrast patterns in household fuel use in two countries
B. To account for the effect of fuel use on household income
C. To critique a frequently used model of changes in household fuel prices
D. To challenge a common explanation for households’ fuel choices
explanations:
中文解析：
文章先介绍埃及固体燃料使用减少的现象，并提到常用解释是能源阶梯，，认为收入增加会导致燃料升级。however转折，通过埃塞俄比亚的研究证明这个理论太简单化，实际影响因素更多，挑战了常见的energy ladder理论，D符合要求。
题目文本翻译：
在埃及，2000 年至 2015 年间，固体燃料（如煤、木柴）在家庭燃料使用总量中的占比下降了 90% 以上；这种转变通常被解释为能源阶梯模型的作用，该模型认为燃料选择主要受家庭收入的影响（具体而言，随着收入的增加，高科技燃料会取代固体燃料）。然而，阿莱穆·梅孔内和贡纳尔·科林对埃塞俄比亚燃料使用情况的研究表明，这种模型过于简化：家庭燃料使用情况是多样化的、灵活的，并受到多种因素的影响，包括当地不同燃料来源的可获得性。

question:
The following text is adapted from Fanny Burney’s 1778 novel Evelina. The text is an excerpt from a letter by Lady Howard to Evelina’s guardian, Reverend Villars, in which Lady Howard discusses an upcoming trip to London planned by her daughter Mrs. Mirvan’s family.
It is very earnestly [the Mirvans’] wish to enlarge and enliven their party by the addition of your amiable ward, who would share, equally with her own daughter, the care and attention of Mrs. Mirvan. Do not start at this proposal; it is time that [Evelina] should see something of the world. When young people are too rigidly sequestered from it, their lively and romantic imaginations paint it to them as a paradise of which they have been beguiled; but when they are shown it properly, and in due time, they see it such as it really is, equally shared by pain and pleasure, hope and disappointment.

Based on the text, Lady Howard would most likely agree with which statement about Reverend Villars?
selections: A. Although the manner in which he has raised Evelina is in many ways exemplary, he has been misguided in shielding her from the influence of other young people.
B. Although his desire to guard Evelina from unscrupulous people is commendable, his general mistrust has led him to be unduly wary of the Mirvans.
C. He is overly protective of Evelina, who would likely benefit from a greater variety of experiences than she has had thus far
D. He has imparted to Evelina his own idealistic view of the world, which results in her being unprepared to face inevitable disappointments.
explanations:
中文解析：
Lady Howard 的核心观点是牧师过度保护导致Evelina缺乏现实认知，而伦敦之行能提供必要的生活体验，于是批评了牧师的过度保护，希望Evelina更多接触世界，和C选项的表述一致。
题目文本翻译：
以下文本改编自范妮·伯尼（Fanny Burney）1778年的小说《埃夫琳娜》（Evelina）。该文本摘自霍华德夫人（Lady Howard）写给埃夫琳娜监护人维拉尔牧师（Reverend Villars）的一封信，霍华德夫人在信中讨论了她的女儿米尔凡夫人（Mrs. Mirvan）一家计划前往伦敦的旅行。
米尔凡一家非常诚挚地希望通过增添您温柔的监护人，使他们的聚会更加丰富多彩。她将与自己的女儿平等地分享米尔凡夫人的关心和照顾。不要对这个提议感到惊讶；是时候让埃夫琳娜见识一下这个世界了。当年轻人被过于严格地隔离时，他们活泼而浪漫的想象力会将世界描绘成一个被欺骗的乐园；但当他们在适当的时机被正确地展示出来时，他们会看到世界的真实面貌——痛苦与快乐、希望与失望并存。

question:
Omar Asensio and colleagues used machine-learning algorithms to examine consumer reviews of 12, 720 electric-vehicle (EV) charging stations in the US. They found that privately owned or managed charging stations at or near restaurants and convenience stores had relatively low proportions of negative reviews, while stations at or near car rental companies had significantly higher proportions of negative reviews. Additionally, stations at or near car rental companies tend to require consumers to pay full price to use them, while stations elsewhere often offer subsidized or even complimentary charging. Assuming that stations at different sites provide roughly equivalent levels of service, these results suggest that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. EV owners are usually unaware of the fees for using charging stations.
B. EV drivers are more likely to visit areas with many restaurants and convenience stores than they are to visit areas with fewer such businesses.
C. charging stations located near car rental companies are more frequently visited than charging stations located near restaurants and convenience stores.
D. users who are offered a discount have lower expectations of the quality of charging stations than users who are not offered a discount do.
explanations:
中文解析：
餐馆/便利店附近的私人充电站差评较少，且常提供补贴或免费充电租车公司附近的充电站差评较多，且需全额付费，结合最后一句假设不同地点的充电站服务质量大致相同，说明差评差异与服务质量无关，于是推断付费用户（租车公司附近）因支付全价，对服务有更高期待，更容易因未达预期给差评
题目文本翻译：
奥马尔·阿森西奥（Omar Asensio）及其同事使用机器学习算法分析了美国12,720个电动汽车（EV）充电站的消费者评论。他们发现，位于或靠近餐馆和便利店的私人拥有或管理的充电站负面评价比例相对较低，而位于或靠近汽车租赁公司的充电站负面评价比例显著更高。此外，汽车租赁公司附近的充电站往往要求消费者支付全价使用，而其他地点的充电站通常提供补贴甚至免费充电服务。假设不同地点的充电站提供的服务水平大致相当，这些结果表明______

question:
Many music streaming services also function as social media platforms: by giving users the option to follow friends and share curated playlists or information about their listening history, these platforms allow people to convey their music preferences and listening activities directly to their social networks. In a 2023 study, researcher Michael James Walsh interviewed frequent users of a popular music streaming platform to investigate how its social media dimensions shape their listening habits. Walsh found that these dimensions tended to make study participants feel more mindful of how their listening activities may be perceived, which in turn influenced how they managed those activities.

Which quotation from a music streaming platform user would best illustrate Walsh’s finding?
selections: A. “Listening to music through a streaming platform feels a lot more passive, since I don’t need to make any deliberate choices about what music I’m going to consume, like I do when buying digital downloads or records and CDs.”

B. “When I create playlists or choose songs to listen to, I often pick songs that I think the friends who are following me might be interested in listening to, rather than what I might actually prefer listening to in that moment.”
C. “Because the predictions the platform makes about what new songs I might like depend on my past listening habits, at times its recommendations can feel overly repetitive and unvarying.”
D. “The social aspects of music streaming make it really easy to create a sense of a shared listening experience with my friends, even if we aren’t in the same room.”
explanations:
中文解析：
Walsh的研究表明，用户会因为社交功能的存在而更在意自己的听歌行为如何被他人看待feel more mindful of how their listening activities may be perceived（HDF），进而影响他们的听歌选择。B选项直接体现用户因关注朋友的看法而选择歌曲因为pick songs that friends might like，就是在意别人的看法
题目文本翻译：
许多音乐流媒体服务也作为社交媒体平台运作：通过让用户可以关注朋友并分享精心策划的播放列表或他们的听歌历史信息，这些平台使人们能够直接向他们的社交网络传达自己的音乐偏好和听歌活动。在一项2023年的研究中，研究员迈克尔·詹姆斯·沃尔什采访了一个流行音乐流媒体平台的频繁用户，以调查其社交媒体维度如何影响他们的听歌习惯。沃尔什发现，这些维度往往使研究参与者更加关注他们的听歌活动可能会被如何看待，这反过来又影响了他们如何管理这些活动。

question:
In 2017, Belgium, which has strong democratic institutions, experienced an inflation rate of 2. 12%, much higher than the 0. 74% rate seen in Equatorial Guinea, which has relatively weak democratic institutions. Such a result is ________, however: Raj Desai et al. have shown that democratic institution strength tends to restrain inflationary pressures.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析：
研究结论说民主制度强，通胀压力低；实际数据显示民主强的比利时通胀更高与理论相反，需填入一个词描述 “与预期结论矛盾” 的现象。D. anomalous 意为“反常的”，符合要求，这是一个旧题改编，具体参考好得分的SAT真题。
题目文本翻译：
2017 年，民主制度强大的比利时经历了 2. 12% 的通货膨胀率，远高于民主制度相对薄弱的赤道几内亚 0. 74% 的比率。这样的结果却________：然而 Raj Desai 等人已证明民主制度的力量往往会抑制通胀压力。

question:
Postcranial skeletal pneumaticity (PSP) refers to the presence of extensions of an animal’s lungs and air sacs inside its bones. Though such structures do not typically fossilize, they are believed to have been present in Tyrannosaurus, Euhelopus, and other Cretaceous theropods and sauropods. To _______ PSP from fossils, researchers look for indicators such as large foramina (holes in bones).

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析：
PSP是软组织结构，无法直接化石保存，研究者通过间接证据holes in bones,来推测其存在。
题目文本翻译：
颅后骨骼气腔性（Postcranial skeletal pneumaticity，PSP）指动物肺部与气囊在骨骼内部的延伸结构。尽管此类结构通常不会形成化石，但研究者认为霸王龙（Tyrannosaurus）、盘足龙（Euhelopus）及其他白垩纪兽脚类与蜥脚类恐龙具备该特征。为从化石中_______颅后骨骼气腔性，研究者会寻找大型骨孔（骨骼表面的孔洞）等标志性证据。

question:
Whereas Joan Lockard’s 1984 study of captive gorillas reported more right-handedness than left-handedness, Jane Goodall’s1963 study of wild chimpanzees did not. According to a meta-analysis of studies of nonhuman primates, captive populations are more likely to be described as right-handed than wild populations are. Statistical analysis indicates a handedness study would need a minimum of 176 individuals to show a representative result; however, the study by Lockard included a total population of 8, and the study by Goodall included a total population of 8. This suggests that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the study by Lockard reliably represents handedness in captive primates but not in wild primates.
B. Goodall likely underestimated the prevalence of right-handedness among the wild chimpanzees in the study.
C. neither the study by Lockard nor the study by Goodall provides sufficient evidence to make a meaningful comparison about handedness in primates.
D. the study by Lockard reliably represents handedness in captive primates, but the study by Goodall likely does not reliably represent handedness in wild primates.
explanations:
中文解析：
统计分析指出，利手性研究至少需要176个个体才能得出代表性结果
Lockard和Goodall的研究各自仅包含8个个体，两个研究的样本量（8个）远低于最低标准（176个），因此两个研究都缺乏统计学效力，无法得出可靠结论，与C选项一致
题目文本翻译：
而琼·洛克哈德（Joan Lockard）1984年对圈养大猩猩的研究报告显示右利手多于左利手，简·古多尔（Jane Goodall）1963年对野生黑猩猩的研究则没有发现这种现象。根据对非人灵长类动物研究的元分析，圈养群体比野生群体更可能被描述为右利手。统计分析表明，一项利手倾向研究至少需要176个个体才能得出代表性结果；然而，洛克哈德的研究仅包含8个个体，古多尔的研究也只包含8个个体。这表明_________

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·The Peloncillo-Pan Duro Mountains are located in northwestern Mexico.
·They cover an area of 1, 360 square miles (mi²).
·The Sierrita Mountains are located in the southwestern United States.
·They cover an area of 63 mi².
·These mountain ranges are two of the dozens of “sky islands” in the southwestern US and northwestern Mexico.
·A sky island is an isolated mountain range whose environment differs drastically from that of the surrounding lowlands.

The student wants to compare the sizes of the two mountain ranges. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. There are dozens of isolated mountain ranges located in the southwestern US and northwestern Mexico.
B. In terms of area, the Peloncillo-Pan Duro Mountains (which cover 1,360 mi²) are larger than the Sierrita Mountains (63 mi²).
C. Sky islands in northwestern Mexico and the southwestern US can vary in size.
D. The Peloncillo-Pan Duro Mountains and the Sierrita Mountains are both isolated mountain ranges whose environments differ drastically from that of the surrounding lowlands.
explanations:
中文解析：
需要选择最能比较两座山脉大小的选项。根据笔记Peloncillo-Pan Duro山脉：1,360平方英里，Sierrita山脉：63平方英里，于是B选项符合要求
题目文本翻译：
·佩隆西洛-潘杜罗山脉位于墨西哥西北部。
·其覆盖面积为1,360平方英里（mi²）。
·塞里塔山脉位于美国西南部。
·其覆盖面积为63平方英里（mi²）。
·这些山脉是美国西南部和墨西哥西北部数十个"天空群岛"中的两个。
·"天空群岛"是指与周围低地环境差异巨大的孤立山脉群。

question:
George Saunders concludes his essay “What Writers Really Do When They Write” by comparing the work of fiction writing to the act of juggling. The author-as-juggler performs a _______ gathering of central themes and tensions, the tossing of these elements into a dynamic narrative, and the catching of the resolutions that emerge.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

question:

In 2022, a team of researchers _______ to find connections between the physical location in which a social media post was created and the content of that post analyzed geotagged social media posts from various sites in Columbus. The team found that posts from the city’s parks contained more words associated with happiness than did the other posts.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·"Organ²/ASLSP (As Slow as Possible) " is a musical piece by avant-garde composer John Cage.
·A specially designed automated organ in St. Burchardi Church in Halberstadt, Germany, began playing the piece in 2001.
·It is scheduled to stop playing the piece in 2640.
·The performance will last 639 years.
·It will be the longest continuous musical performance in history.

The student wants to indicate how long John Cage’s musical piece will last. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Lasting 639 years, John Cage’s musical piece will be the longest continuous musical performance in history.
B. “Organ²/ASLSP (As Slow as Possible)” is a musical piece currently being played in St. Burchardi Church in Halberstadt, Germany
C. An organ in St. Burchardi Church in Halberstadt, Germany, began playing a musical piece by avant-garde composer John Cage.
D. John Cage is the composer of the musical piece “Organ²/ASLSP (As Slow as Possible).”
explanations:
中文解析：
需要选择最能体现how long John Cage’s musical piece will last即音乐作品持续时间，根据notes作品将持续639年，于是A满足要求
题目文本翻译：
在研究中，一名学生记录了以下信息：
· 先锋派作曲家约翰·凯奇（John Cage）创作了音乐作品《Organ²/ASLSP（尽可能慢）》。
· 德国哈尔伯施塔特圣布尔夏迪教堂内的一台专门设计的自动管风琴于2001年开始演奏此曲。
· 该演奏计划于2640年结束。
· 整场演出将持续639年。
· 这将成为历史上最长的连续音乐演奏。

question:
If an animal can recognize itself in a reflective surface (“the mirror test”), it is considered to have self-awareness. In a recent study, scientists _______ for evidence of self-awareness in snakes, species that rely primarily on olfactory rather than visual processing, adapted the test to foreground smell, modifying the scent trails of North American eastern garter snakes and African ball pythons.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: adapted是全句的谓语，于是searching分词做后置定语修饰scientists，句子中不可以再又其它谓语

question:
A team of ornithologists documented patterns of conspecific brood parasitism among wood ducks (Aix sponsa) in California. The researchers observed several female wood ducks visiting dozens of nesting sites and laying eggs to be incubated by other nesting A. sponsa. Subject 7F64B, _______ visited a select few nesting sites before laying and incubating her eggs herself.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
中文解析：
这段文字描述的是一种行为模式，其中一些雌性木鸭（Aix sponsa）会把自己的卵产在其他雌性木鸭的巢里，由其他鸟类来孵化。然而，7F64B这个个体与这种行为不同，她只访问了一些巢穴，并自己孵化了卵。这里选择“alternatively”是因为它表示7F64B采取了一种不同的方式，和其他个体的行为形成对比。因此，最合适的翻译是“相反地”或“替代地”。这样可以清楚地传达出7F64B的行为与其他木鸭的行为不同。
题目文本翻译：
一队鸟类学家记录了加州木鸭（Aix sponsa）种内巢寄生的模式。研究人员观察到多只雌性木鸭造访数十个巢穴__并将产下的蛋交由其他筑巢的A. sponsa个体孵化。研究对象7F64B_______在亲自产卵并孵化自己的蛋前__只选择了少数几个巢穴造访。

question:
·Curtis Martin and Jim Brown had historic careers as running backs in the National Football League (NFL).
·The running back position entails running, or rushing, down the field with the football to gain yards for the team.
·Curtis Martin gained a total of 14,101 rushing yards in his career.
·He played for the New England Patriots and the New York Jets.
·Jim Brown gained a total of 12, 312 rushing yards in his career.
·He played for the Cleveland Browns.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to begin a narrative about one of the athletes?
selections: A. Martin began his career with the New England Patriots; Brown started with Cleveland Browns.
B. When Martin put on his New England Patriots uniform for his first NFL game, he began what would become a legendary professional career.
C. While Martin finished his career with more rushing yards, both Martin and Brown reached the career milestone of rushing for over 10,000 yards total.
D. Martin’s blend of speed, power, and agility helped him accrue 14,101 rushing yards by the end of his career; etching his name into the NFL’s record books.
explanations:
中文解析：
题目要求begin a narrative about one of the athletes，B选项符合要求，只以Martin一个人首次参赛为切入点，开启个人传奇故事，其它选项都讲述了两个人
题目文本翻译：
·柯蒂斯·马丁（Curtis Martin）和吉姆·布朗（Jim Brown）在美国国家橄榄球联盟（NFL）的跑卫位置上成就了历史级职业生涯。
·跑卫的主要职责是持球在地面推进（即冲球跑动），为球队争取推进码数。
·柯蒂斯·马丁职业生涯累计冲球推进码数达14,101码。
·他曾效力于新英格兰爱国者队和纽约喷气机队。
·吉姆·布朗职业生涯累计冲球推进码数达12,312码。
·他整个职业生涯都在克利夫兰布朗队效力。

question:
Many studies have found a positive association between levels of dissolved organic carbon and mercury in bodies of fresh water in North America. But Enelton Fagnani, José Roberto Guimară, and Pedro Sérgio Fadini did not find this correlation in a study conducted in Brazil, leading some scientists to hypothesize that the pattern is particular to North America. However, Kerstin Leopold, Anja Zierhut, and Jessica Huber reported dissolved organic carbon and mercury rising or falling together in a study conducted in Germany, and several other studies from outside North America have yielded similar results, suggesting that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. bodies of fresh water outside North America are more likely to show a negative association between dissolved organic carbon and mercury levels than a positive association.

B. there may be circumstances specific to the bodies of water examined in Fagnani, Guimară, and Fadini’s study that disrupted a general positive association between dissolved organic carbon and mercury levels.
C. environmental characteristics unique to Brazil likely result in dissolved organic carbon and mercury levels in bodies of fresh water both being significantly higher there than elsewhere.

D. the bodies of water examined in Fagnani, Guimară, and Fadini’s study may be more similar to the bodies of water examined in studies conducted in North America than to those examined in Leopold, Zierhut, and Huber’s study.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
许多研究发现北美淡水体中溶解有机碳与汞水平之间存在正相关关系。然而，Enelton Fagnani、José Roberto Guimarães 和 Pedro Sérgio Fadini 在巴西进行的一项研究中并未发现这种相关性，这让一些科学家假设这种模式可能特属于北美。然而，Kerstin Leopold、Anja Zierhut 和 Jessica Huber 在德国进行的一项研究中报告称，溶解有机碳和汞水平一起上升或下降，来自北美以外的几项其他研究也得出了类似的结果，这表明 ________.
中文解析：
毕竟其它地方基本都是正相关，巴西的研究结果与其他地区的研究结果不同，可能是由某些特定因素导致的，于是选择B选项

question:
In a 2024 study, researchers investigating the biodiversity of trees in Amsterdam counted and classified the city’s trees. They found notable variation in the percentage of native trees in different areas of the city. ________ more than half of the trees in administrative unit GE05 (54%) were native species, but only 12% of the trees in administrative unit GE04 were native species.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:

question:
The bird species Malacoptila fusca (the white-chested puffbird) practices a foraging strategy known as sallying (catching insects in flight and returning to a perch to eat them), enabling it to scan for prey and predators simultaneously. Conversely, Myrmotherula guttata (the rufous-bellied antwren), with which M. fusca shares territory in French Guiana, practices foliage gleaning (picking insects off leaves), substantially limiting the bird’s field of vision while foraging. Biologist Ari Martínez and colleagues hypothesized that the greater vulnerability inherent in the latter strategy is reflected in greater sensitivity to predator warning signals from neighboring species.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support Martínez and colleagues’ hypothesis?
selections: A. When Martinez and colleagues played control sounds of random noise, only M. guttata displayed predator-avoidance behavior, whereas both M. guttata and M. fusc a displayed such behavior when alarm calls from another local bird species were played.

B. When Martinez and colleagues played alarm calls from a species that does not share territory with M. fusca and M. guttata, M. fusca displayed predator-avoidance behavior, whereas M. guttata did not display any behavioral change.
C. When Martinez and colleagues played alarm calls from another local bird species, M. guttata displayed predator-avoidance behavior, whereas M. fusca did not display any behavioral change.

D. When Martinez and colleagues played M. fusca alarm calls, only M. fusca displayed predator-avoidance behavior, whereas both M. fusca and M. guttata displayed such behavior when M. guttata alarm calls were played.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
鸟类物种马拉科普提拉·富斯卡（Malacoptila fusca，白胸泡鸟）采用一种称为“飞扑”的觅食策略（在飞行中捕捉昆虫并返回栖息处进食），使其能够同时扫描猎物和捕食者。相反，与 M. fusca 在法属圭亚那共享领土的红腹蚁鹦鹉（Myrmotherula guttata）则采用树叶采集（从树叶上摘取昆虫），这大大限制了其在觅食时的视野。生物学家阿里·马丁内斯（Ari Martínez）及其同事假设，后者策略固有的较大脆弱性体现在对邻近物种捕食者警告信号的更高敏感性上。
中文解析：
Myrmotherula guttata的视野受限，于是vulnerability and sensitivity要高，那么听到alarm，Myrmotherula guttata会有反应，但是M. fusca不会，那么就是C选项符合要求，用好得分田老师的具象化分析很容易解决这类题目

question:
In medieval England, singers and minstrels made livings as traveling performers, but the pieces they performed have been a mystery, thought to be lost or never committed to paper at all. Recently, however, James Wade has argued that a manuscript collection compiled in the fifteenth century by Richard Heege contains three pieces likely copied from a repertoire book belonging to a minstrel working in the area around Heege’s home. Wade cites features of the texts indicative of live performance, such as chastising the audience, extensive use of simple structures (allowing for easy memorization), and requests for tips (payment) from listeners.

Which statement, if true, would most strongly support Wade’s argument?
selections: A. Heege’s collection contains the earliest examples of the three pieces in question, but each of those pieces occurs in other manuscript collections compiled after Heege’s.
B. The three pieces in question contain references that presume that the audience is familiar with Brackonwet and other small villages near where Heege lived.
C. Features like simple structures also occur in other texts from the period that were widely read but are not known to have been performed for live audiences.
D. Traveling minstrels are thought to have performed mainly for elite audiences, and other parts of Heege’s collection reflect his interest in works with popular appeal.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在中世纪的英格兰，歌手和游吟诗人以旅行表演为生，但他们所演唱的作品一直是个谜，被认为已经失传或根本没有记录在纸上。然而，最近，詹姆斯·韦德（James Wade）提出了一个论点，认为十五世纪由理查德·希格（Richard Heege）编纂的一本手稿收藏中包含了三首可能是从一位在希格家乡附近工作的游吟诗人的曲目书中抄录的作品。韦德引用了文本中一些表明现场表演特征的细节，例如对观众的训斥、大量使用简单结构（便于记忆）以及向听众请求小费（报酬）。
中文解析：
题目要求找出哪个选项最能支持Wade的论点，即Heege的手稿集中的三首作品可能是从一个在该地区工作的吟游诗人的曲目书中抄录的。B选项符合要求，这三首作品包含了一些暗示，表明观众熟悉Brackonwet和Heege家附近的其他小村庄。这个选项直接支持了Wade的论点，因为它表明这些作品可能是为当地的观众创作的，这与吟游诗人在该地区工作的可能性相符。

question:
Spoken in Northern California, Karuk is an isolate, or a language that has no demonstrated relationship to other documented languages. The Haida language in Alaska is an isolate as well. However, most Native languages belong to language families, or groups of languages whose similarities can be attributed to shared descent from a single language spoken thousands of years ago. Curiously, isolates are more prevalent in regions where numerous nonisolates are also spoken. Thus, the geographical circumstances that favor the development of isolates may also drive diversification within language families.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It provides examples of isolates, distinguishes isolates from most other Native languages, then discusses a point of correspondence between isolates and nonisolates.
B. It compares two isolates, sketches the process by which nonisolates evolve from isolates, then discusses how geography affects the development of isolates and nonisolates alike.
C. It defines the concepts of isolate languages and nonisolate languages, distinguishes between the regions where isolates and nonisolates are found, then accounts for this geographical distribution.

D. It names several isolates and nonisolates, proposes a similarity between the two categories of languages, then identifies the respective regions where languages belonging to each category are likely to be found.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在北加州使用的卡鲁克语是一种孤立语言，即没有与其他已记录语言有明确关系的语言。阿拉斯加的海达语也是一种孤立语言。然而，大多数土著语言属于语言家族，即语言组，其相似性可以归因于数千年前共同使用的单一语言的传承。有趣的是，孤立语言在许多非孤立语言也被使用的地区更为普遍。因此，有利于孤立语言发展的地理环境也可能推动语言家族内部的多样化。
中文解析：
先举例孤立语言，再区分孤立语言与语系，最后讨论有相关点correspondence（地理环境的影响），因为A选项满足要求

question:
Researchers who study olfaction—the sense of smell—define valence as a person’s perception of how pleasant an odor is. Conventional wisdom holds that valence is culturally mediated. A team of scientists led by Artin Arshamian evaluated this view by testing how people from ten different places—including the Semelai people from a small community in the Malay Peninsula and the Chachi people from a small community in Ecuador—ranked ten odors from most pleasant to least pleasant. In general, respondents ranked scents similarly regardless of where they lived, overwhelmingly choosing the odorant eugenol as more pleasant than caprylic acid. These results show that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. valence may affect cultural traditions more strongly than researchers had previously predicted.
B. the respondents agreed more often on unpleasant odors than they did on pleasant ones.
C. the conventional belief that odor pleasantness can be objectively measured is questionable.
D. the standard view of culture’s role in olfactory valence may be unsound.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
研究嗅觉的研究人员将“价”（valence）定义为一个人对气味愉悦程度的感知。传统观点认为，价受到文化的影响。由阿尔廷·阿尔沙米安（Artin Arshamian）领导的一组科学家通过测试来自十个不同地方的人们——包括来自马来半岛一个小社区的塞梅莱族（Semelai）和来自厄瓜多尔一个小社区的查奇族（Chachi）——对十种气味的愉悦程度进行排名，从最愉悦到最不愉悦。总体而言，受访者无论居住在哪里，对气味的排名都相似，绝大多数选择香草醛（eugenol）比辛酸（caprylic acid）更愉悦。这些结果表明 ________。
中文解析：
按照好得分hdf田老师讲的逻辑模式，这个段落是先讲conventional wisdom即气味的愉悦度是由文化影响的；然后讲实际的发现，挑战了先前的想法，研究结果挑战了传统观点，因为来自不同文化背景的受访者对气味的排名高度一致，这表明文化对气味愉悦度的影响可能没有传统观点认为的那么强。D符合要求

question:
Text 1
In a seminal 1979 study, Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky presented students and college faculty from Israel, Sweden, and the United States with hypothetical questions involving financial decisions. Finding that participants’ responses indicated that losses have a greater psychological impact than equivalent gains do, the researchers formulated the concept of loss aversion, which has since informed research in fields ranging from marketing to law.
Text 2
Dana Zeif and Eldad Yechiam conducted an experiment in which study participants from five countries were exposed to financial choices that involved potential losses of either relatively minor sums of money, such as 20 US dollars (low-stakes contexts), or more substantial sums, such as 100 US dollars (high-stakes contexts). The researchers concluded that only the latter contexts were associated with loss aversion.

Based on the texts, how would Zeif and Yechiam (Text 2) most likely respond to Kahneman and Tversky’s finding (Text 1)?
selections: A. By contending that the attitude toward financial losses that Kahneman and Tversky observed is contingent on the magnitude of outcomes
B. By agreeing that experimental results support the idea that some people tend to be more cognizant of financial losses than of gains
C. By observing that researchers’ ability to assess feelings about financial decisions is contingent on gathering adequate data about gains and losses
D. By disputing Kahneman and Tversky’s claim that a tendency to place excessive emphasis on financial losses accounts for the loss aversion observed in fields such as marketing and law
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
文本 1
在1979年的一项开创性研究中，丹尼尔·卡尼曼和阿莫斯·特沃斯基向来自以色列、瑞典和美国的学生和大学教职员工提出了涉及财务决策的假设性问题。研究发现，参与者的反应表明，损失对心理的影响大于等量收益的影响，因此研究人员提出了损失厌恶的概念，该概念自此以来对从市场营销到法律等多个领域的研究产生了影响。
文本 2
达娜·泽夫和埃尔达德·耶希亚姆进行了一项实验，实验参与者来自五个国家，他们面临涉及潜在损失的财务选择，这些损失可能是相对较小的金额，例如20美元（低风险情境），或者更大金额，例如100美元（高风险情境）。研究人员得出结论，只有后者的情境与损失厌恶相关。
中文解析：
根据text 2，loss aversion的出现取决于损失的规模大小，于是A选项满足，HDF给大家翻译一下A选项的大意：认为卡尼曼和特沃斯基观察到的对财务损失的态度取决于结果的规模。

question:

question:
A student is writing a research paper on the history of irrigation in the United States, situating the development of the Bear River Reservoir (created in Amador County, California, in 1900) in a larger historical context. The student claims that innovation in irrigation practices throughout the United States has led to designs with increased efficiency.

Which quotation from a study of irrigation best supports the student’s claim?
selections: A. “While the low humidity of Southern California’s desert areas makes irrigation a requirement if agriculture is to be a success there, the relatively high humidity in the northern parts of the state makes such practices less necessary.”

B. “The importance of irrigation infrastructure in the United States today cannot be overstated, since it is the most widely utilized means of conveying water for food production. Accordingly, any increase in the efficiency of irrigation, however small, would be of significant economic and social value.”
C. “The irrigation system developed by the Hohokam people in the 7th century CE in what is now Arizona was simple but applied hydraulic engineering design features that are still in use today.”

D. “Competition for water as a scarce economic resource inspired the development of sprinkler irrigation systems, which have contributed to the reduction of water used for irrigation in the United States to 45% of the total water usage of its population. Comparatively,70% of the world’s water usage is dedicated to irrigation.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一名学生正在撰写一篇关于美国灌溉历史的研究论文，将贝尔河水库（于1900年在加利福尼亚州阿马多尔县建立）的发展置于更大的历史背景中。该学生声称，美国各地灌溉实践的创新导致了更高效的设计。
中文解析：
需要支持claim，美国灌溉实践的创新导致了效率更高的设计，于是D选项符合要求，“对水资源的竞争激发了喷灌系统的发展，这使美国灌溉用水减少到总用水量的45%”。这直接说明了创新（喷灌系统）如何提高了灌溉效率，并提供了具体数据支持，因此最能支持学生的观点

question:

• Some NWRs were established specifically to protect endangered species.
• The Bear Valley NWR is a 4,200-acre area in Oregon.
• It was established to protect the endangered bald eagle.
• The Ellicott Slough NWR is a 139-ac re area in California.
• It was established to protect the endangered Santa Cruz long-toed salamander.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two NWRs. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The US has designated more than 500 areas NWRs, including the Bear Valley NWR in Oregon.
B. While the Bear Valley NWR extends across a 4,200-acre area, the Ellicott Slough NWR encompasses only 139 acres.
C. Some NWRs, such as California’s Ellicott Slough, were established specifically to protect endangered species.
D. Both the Bear Valley NWR and the Ellicott Slough NWR were established to protect endangered species.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
• 美国已指定超过500个地区为国家野生动物保护区（NWRs）。
• 一些NWRs是专门为了保护濒危物种而设立的。
• 熊谷国家野生动物保护区是一个位于俄勒冈州的4200英亩的区域。
• 它是为了保护濒危的秃头鹰而设立的。
• 埃利科特沼泽国家野生动物保护区是加利福尼亚州一个139英亩的区域。
• 它是为了保护濒危的圣克鲁斯长趾蝾螈而设立的。
中文解析：
题目要求two NWRs的相似点，按照notes题目都是保护濒危动物的，于是D符合要求。
