今天的剧院舞台上常常布满道具和布景，以让观众沉浸在剧作的世界中。由于观众已经习惯了精心设计的场景，视觉元素较少的剧作会让观众感到惊讶。但在很久以前，简单、朴素的舞台可能_____观众：高度装饰和细致的布景直到16世纪才变得普遍。
中文解析：
简单未经装饰的舞台对于过去的观众是意料中之的，选择expected by

question:
Michelle Pereira et al. hypothesized that introducing health improvements into workplaces would increase productivity by reducing absenteeism (sick employees not working) and presenteeism (sick workers working less productively due to illness). Pereira’s team enrolled groups of Australian workers in two programs: one that gave employees exercise training (EET) and one that enrolled employees in health promotion seminars (EHP). They then calculated the productivity loss of those groups at 12 weeks and 12 months after the programs began (based on the 28 days preceding each point). They concluded that exercise training was more effective at restraining productivity loss than health promotion seminars were, though this result took time to become apparent.

Which choice best descrlbes data from the table that most effectively strengthen Perelra andcolleagues' conclusion?
selections: A. Productivity loss was largely due to absenteeisin for the EHP group at 12 months after the program began, while productivity loss was largely due to presenteeism for the EET group at 12 months after the prograin began.

B. Productivity loss for the EET group barely decreased between 12 weeks and 12 months after the program began, while productivity loss for the EHP group signifcantly increased during the same time period.

C. Productivity loss was consistently higher for the EHP group than for the FET group over the twelve months that it was measured, though the size of the difference between the two decreased over that time.

D. Productivity loss was fairly similar for the EET and EHP groups 12 weeks after each program began, but at 12 months afterward it had signifcantly increased for the EHP group and significantly decreased for the EET group.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
米歇尔·佩雷拉等人假设，通过在工作场所引入健康改善措施，可以通过减少缺勤（生病员工未工作）和在岗缺勤（生病员工由于生病而工作效率低下）来提高生产力。佩雷拉的团队将一组澳大利亚工人分成两组：一组参加了运动训练项目（EET），另一组则参加了健康促进研讨会（EHP）。随后，他们计算了这两个组在项目开始后的12周和12个月内的生产力损失（基于每个时间点前28天的数据）。他们得出结论，运动训练在限制生产力损失方面比健康促进研讨会更有效，尽管这一结果需要时间才能显现。
中文解析：
文本的结论是EET方式在遏制生产力损耗（restraining productivity loss）更加有效，但是需要时间才能看到明显结果（the result took time to become apparent）,12 weeks时，我们看到两项productivity loss数据相似268和282，但是12 months时，EET的数据171明显比EHP的数据436要低很多，说明时间长才能看到效果。（这是一个旧题重现）

question:
For years, Christopher Clavius's 1593 work Astrolabhem had the earliest knowm evidence of a decimal point, which was in a sine table's interpolation column. However, math historian Glen Van Brummelen posited that Venetian merchant Giovanni Bianchini, who worked as an astrological consultant, used the mathematical symbol approximately 150 years before Clavius did. Van Brummelen asserts that in his role as a consultant, Bianchini used trigonometry to calculate the coordinates of the planets, and these calculations contain the earliest example of the decimal point.

Which fnding, if true, would most directly support the underlined claim?
selections: A. Several dots appear in both Clavius’s Astrolabtum and Bianchini’s Flores Almagesti, but the dot was commonly used in manuscripts in the 1400s and 1500s as a means to separate letters or whole numbers from each other.
B. In Clavius’s Astrolabium, he gives several examples of both interpolation and inverse interpolation using decimal numbers and justifies the metod to his readers by equating 45.7 with “457 tenths.”
C. In a table in Bianchini’s astronomical Latin manuscript from the 1440s, Tabulaeprimi mobilis B, a dot appears between two numbers in a context that suggests the value is not a whole number.
D. As recorded in his manuscripts, some of Bianchini’s calculations for the coordinates of the planets are inaccurate due to the use of whole numbers rather than non-whole-nunber decimals.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
多年来，克里斯托弗·克拉维乌斯（Christopher Clavius）在1593年所著的《天文仪》（Astrolabhem）中被认为是最早出现小数点的证据，这一证据出现在正弦表的插值列中。然而，数学历史学家格伦·范·布鲁梅伦（Glen Van Brummelen）提出，威尼斯商人乔瓦尼·比安基尼（Giovanni Bianchini）在克拉维乌斯之前大约150年就使用了这一数学符号。范·布鲁梅伦声称，作为顾问的比安基尼利用三角学计算行星的坐标，而这些计算中包含了小数点的最早例证。
中文解析：
划线句大意是Bianchini是最早用到小数点的例子，于是选线对应Bianchini在1440s就用到了不是整数，也就是暗示用到了小数点

question:
The soil on Mars can make missions to explore the planet challenging, as the sand and dust are known to clog filters and lock moving parts on robotic rovers and other exploration devices. Using simulants, which are materials designed to simulate different planetary surfaces, scientists are able to study the characteristics of Mars’s surface, simulants like the Mars Mojave simulant—which was developed using lava deposits from California’s MojaveDesert—help scientists evaluate how well their devices will handle the surface when operated on Mars.

Based on the text, what is one reason why simulants are valuable for scientsts?
selections: A. Simulants allow scientists to test the ability of research equipment to withstand some of the conditions it will encounter during a mission.
B. Scientists use simulants to track how the chemical properties of planetary soils have changed over time.
C. Simulants can be mixed with soil from Earth to explore how research equipiment will handle extreme terrains on Earth.
D. Scientists use stimulants to compare the physical properties of Mars’s surface to those of Earth’s surface.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
火星的土壤使得探测该行星的任务变得具有挑战性，因为沙子和尘埃可能会堵塞过滤器并锁住机器人探测器和其他探索设备的活动部件。科学家们使用模拟物，这些材料旨在模拟不同的行星表面，从而研究火星表面的特性。例如，火星莫哈维模拟物是利用加利福尼亚莫哈维沙漠的熔岩沉积物开发的，帮助科学家评估他们的设备在火星表面操作时的表现。
中文解析：
题目考察用simulants的原因，最后一句讲述device value是重要的参考句子，能帮助科学家测试机器设备在火星表面的运作情况。

question:
In 2013 Bridie J.M.Allan and colleagues published a study concluding that ocean acidifcation has a strong effect on the behavior of Pomacentrus amboinensis, a species of fish. However, Allan and colleagues’ study relied on a mean sample size of only about 18 fish. In a 2022 review of various scientists' conclusions about the impacts of ocean acidification on fish behavior. Timothy D. Clark and colleagues caution that relying on such a relatively small sample size can increase the potential for biased analysis. Such analysis, in turn, can contribute to reports of exaggerated effects.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text?
selections: A. It presents a critcism of the results reported by Allan and colleagues in their 2013 study
B. It lists several traits of Pomacentrus amboinensis discovered by Allan and colleagues while conducting their 2013 study
C. It emphasizes a detail about where Allan and colleagues conducted their 2013 study.
D. It states the conclusion reached by Allan and colleagues in their 2013 study.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在2013年，Bridie J.M. Allan及其同事发表了一项研究，得出结论认为海洋酸化对一种鱼类——阿莫尔雀鲷（Pomacentrus amboinensis）的行为有很强的影响。然而，Allan及其同事的研究仅依赖于大约18条鱼的平均样本量。在2022年对多位科学家关于海洋酸化对鱼类行为影响结论的综述中，Timothy D. Clark及其同事警告说，依赖如此相对较小的样本量可能会增加偏见分析的潜在风险。这种分析反过来可能导致对影响的夸大报告。
中文解析：
划线句是2013年的结论（旧题变体考察）

question:
Humans are overwhelmingly right-hand dominant (85-90%) and can thus be said to exhibit strong population level right handedness (PLRH). Among studies of nonhuman primates, Margaret E. Redshaw’s 1993 study of captive gorillas purported to show PLRH while Jane Goodall’s 1963 study of wild chimpanzees did not. Overall, the studies claiming PLRH in nonhuman primates find much lower incidences of right-handedness than humans exhibit, but it’s worth noting that studies of captive primates tend to show significantly greater incidences of right-handedness than studies of wild primates do, therefore raising the possibility that_____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the number of individuals in the study of wild chimpanzees is insufficient to preclude the claim that nonhuman primates exhibit PLRH.
B. the number of individuals in the study of captive gorillas is sufficient for a robust claim regarding evidence of PLRH.
C. the greater exposure to humans among the captive gorillas induced them to acquire more right-handed behaviors.
D. the apparent discrepancy between the studies’ results may be partly attributable to the 1963 study using different criteria when assessing hand dominance than were used in the 1993 study.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
人类在很大程度上是右撇子（85-90%），因此可以说展现出强烈的人群水平右撇性（PLRH）。在非人类灵长类动物的研究中，Margaret E. Redshaw于1993年对圈养大猩猩的研究声称显示了右撇性，而Jane Goodall于1963年对野生黑猩猩的研究则没有。总体来看，声称在非人类灵长类动物中存在PLRH的研究发现，右撇性的发生率远低于人类，但值得注意的是，圈养灵长类动物的研究显示出显著更高的右撇性发生率，而野生灵长类动物的研究则相对较低。因此，这引发了这样一种可能性：_____
中文解析：
从文本最后来看captive animals和人类的接触多，于是正是因为这个原因，right-handedness也更加明显，于是C正确，接触人类导致captive animals right-handed behavior增多

question:
The small white heron and the small dark heron are long-legged birds that live in wetlands, like the Everglades in Florida, Laura D'Acunto and colleagues wanted to know how these birds choose an area in which to live. They looked at features of the birds' habitats, such as the geographic location of the area and how deep the water is during breeding season, They found that although only small white herons prefer areas with deep water during breeding season, both small white herons and small dark herons prefer areas that have standing water for more than 60 days per year The researchers therefore concluded that neither species is very drawn to areas where______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. there is standing water for far fewer than 60 days per year
B. species with breeding seasons longer than 60 days are likely to be present.
C. there are any features that attract the other species.
D. there is relatively deep water during the breeding season.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
小白鹭和小黑鹭是生活在湿地中的长腿鸟类，例如佛罗里达的埃弗格雷德斯。劳拉·达昆托及其同事想了解这些鸟类如何选择栖息地。他们研究了鸟类栖息地的特征，例如该地区的地理位置以及繁殖季节水深。研究发现，尽管只有小白鹭在繁殖季节偏好水深的区域，但无论是小白鹭还是小黑鹭都更喜欢每年有静水超过60天的区域。因此，研究人员得出结论说，这两种鸟类都不太倾向于选择______的区域。
中文解析：
最后说两类鸟都喜欢standing water 超出60天，那么就是少于60不会吸引到任何一种（neither white herons and dark herons ）

question:
Having trouble getting rid of weeds? One surprising solution may be to start eating them. Curly dock and broadleaf plantain are two edible plants that are usually considered weeds in North America. These and other plants like them are sometimes more flavorful than are some plants that people grow as food.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To suggest an unexpected solution to a problem
B. To discuss the best way to garden
C. To describe how good some plants taste
D. To identify a new cooking trend
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
难以清除杂草吗？一个令人惊讶的解决办法可能是开始吃它们。卷叶蓼和大叶车前草是两种在北美通常被视为杂草的可食用植物。与这些植物类似的其他植物，有时比一些人们种植的食物植物更具风味。
中文解析：
用吃掉的方式来解决杂草问题，算作unexpected solution

question:
The Apollo Moon landings (1969-1972) brought radiation detectors and equipment too heavy for liftoff to the Moon and produced large amounts of data. Researcher Philip Metzger, who is investigating the long-term effects of being on the Moon, continues to use Apollo’s data, demonstrating that the missions’ value to science is______.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
阿波罗登月任务（1969-1972）带来了辐射探测器和太重以至于无法发射到月球的设备，并产生了大量数据。正在研究在月球上长期停留影响的研究员菲利普·梅茨格继续使用阿波罗的数据，证明这些任务对科学的价值是______。
中文解析：
根据文本要表达Apollo持续的价值，尤其是参考同意表达continues to，于是选择ongoing

question:
It is hard for publishers and printers to create very long books that balance the requirements of readability, durability, and cost. Among some exceptionally long novels published in English, Haruki Murakami’s IQ84 (translated from Japanese) was published in a 1,157-page edition and runs to an estimated 407,000 words, while John Sayles’s A Moment in the Sun (written originally in English) was published in a 1,100-page edition and runs to an estimated 625,000 words. This indicates that______

Which choice most loglcally completes the text?
selections: A. the editon of A Momtent in the Sun has more words per page than the edion of 1Q84.
B. translating a text from Japanese to English is likely to increase the word count.
C. page count is likely to be a more reliable indicator of how long it takes to read a book than word count.
D. the edition of 1Q84 is printed on thinner paper than the edition of A Moment in the Sun.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
对于出版社和印刷商来说，创作非常长的书籍，平衡可读性、耐用性和成本的要求是很困难的。在一些用英语出版的特别长的小说中，村上春树的《1Q84》（从日语翻译而来）出版了一个1,157页的版本，估计字数达407,000字，而约翰·塞尔斯的《阳光下的一瞬》（最初用英语写作）出版了一个1,100页的版本，估计字数达625,000字。这表明______。
中文解析：
对比两本数的字数和页数，发现字数多的反而页数少，于是可以推断字数多的作品A Moment in the Sun的每页纸张的字多。

question:
The Historical Dictionary of Science Fiction is a crowd sourced project started in 2001 by lexicographer Jesse Sheidlower to record terms that originated in science fiction. Volunteers share digitized excerpts from personal collections of sci-fi magazines not typically preserved in libraries——______that allow the earliest uses of phrases such as “warp speed” (1952) to be identified and added to the dictionary.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《科幻历史词典》是一个众包项目，由词典编纂者杰西·谢德洛威于2001年启动，旨在记录起源于科幻作品的术语。志愿者们分享来自私人收藏的科幻杂志的数字化摘录，这些杂志通常未在图书馆中保存——______这使得能够识别并将“超光速”(1952)等短语的最早用法添加到词典中。
中文解析：
图书馆里没有的私人收藏（personal collection）对于科幻词汇手机的作用贡献选择contributions

question:
Researchers investigated how enjoyment of a story is affected when it has been spoiled (when the reader has foreknowledge of an important plot development). As part of the study, participants rated their enjoyment of one story that was spoiled before they read it and one story that was unspoiled. For each story, participants who had been given a spoiler reported greater enjoyment than did those who hadn’t received a spoiler. But the degree of this difference varied across the stories, as is best illustrated by the enjoyment ratings for_____

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement?
selections: B. “Owl Creek Bridge” and “A Chess Problem”.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
研究人员调查了当故事被剧透（即读者对重要情节发展有预先了解）时，故事的享受程度会受到怎样的影响。作为研究的一部分，参与者在阅读之前对一个被剧透的故事和一个未被剧透的故事的享受程度进行了评分。对于每个故事，收到剧透的参与者报告的享受程度高于那些没有收到剧透的参与者。然而，这种差异的程度在不同的故事中有所不同，最能说明这一点的是对_____的享受评分。
中文解析：
文本最后要求表述degree of difference varied,于是看柱状图差异最小的，和差异较大的就能符合要求，“Owl Creek Bridge” and “A Chess Problem”符合要求，前者差异小，后者差异大，证明了varied

question:
Ceremony, the 1977 novel by Laguna Pueblo author Leslie Marmon Silko, is typical of Native fiction written during the 1960s and 1970s. During that period, Silko and her peers wrote realistic and deeply serious portrayals of life in tribal communities. Recently, however, younger Native writers have embraced popular genres knowm for being entertaining and suspenseful, such as fantasy and horror. Anishinaabe author NathanAdler is a figure in this movement. Their 2016 novel Wrist is a work of horror ficton.

which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It discusses fiction by earlier Native writers, then describes how fiction by more recent Native writers differs from the earlier fiction.
B. It praises one Native fiction writer, then criticizes a different Native fiction writer.
C. It provides an overview of Native fiction, then compares it to fction by non-Natve writers.
D. It describes one Native author’s early works, then describes her more recent works.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《仪式》（Ceremony）是1977年由拉古纳普韦布洛族作家莱斯莉·马尔蒙·西尔科（Leslie Marmon Silko）创作的小说，典型地代表了1960年代和1970年代的土著小说。在那个时期，西尔科和她的同行们创作了对部落社区生活的现实且深刻的描绘。然而，最近年轻的土著作家们开始接受那些以娱乐性和悬念著称的流行类型，如奇幻和恐怖。阿尼希纳贝作家内森·阿德勒（Nathan Adler）是这一运动中的一个重要人物。他们在2016年发表的小说《手腕》（Wrist）是一部恐怖小说。
中文解析：
按照句子顺序概括，突出recently，however带来的时间和内容对比，先描述早期的本土作家，后面描述近期作家与之前的不同

question:
Portratt of Marquess Massimiltano Stantpa is one of dozens of remaining works by the Italian Renaissance artist Sofonisba Anguissola. ______in 1557, her painting can now be found at the Walters Art Museum in Baltimore.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子的谓语是be found，于是不能再选动词形式，需要选B，过去分词状语，逻辑主语是her painting，是被动关系

question:
Synthesized calcium phosphate nanoparticles (CaPNPs) can be used to improve the healing and regeneration of broken bones; this function, well suited for multiple medical applications,______from the biocompatible properties of these particles.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventons of Standard English?
explanations: 主语是this function，需要谓语动词，选择stems，其它都是非谓语

question:
For the past 20 million years, Earth’s magnetic poles in the far north and far south have remained roughly where they are today. This has not always been the_____ throughout geologic history, Earth’s magnetic poles have swapped places several times through a process called polar wandering.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: though作为副词，构成所在句子和前一句之间的转折关系，分号用来分割完整句子，本段话是第一句和第二句之间的转折关系，though放在第二句内，表达当前南北极不变的情况并非是地质时期一成不变的情况。

question:
Nineteenth-century Modernista architects championed nature in their designs. Granted, the dramatic archways and botanical glass work of Palau Mornau, a Modernista private home designed by Manuel Raspall, couldn’t exactly grow in a forest.______one sees natural influences in Raspall’s penchant for curves (rather than right angles) and plant-and animal-inspired flourishes.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transiton?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
十九世纪的现代主义建筑师在他们的设计中倡导自然。诚然，曼努埃尔·拉斯帕尔设计的现代主义私人住宅帕劳·莫尔瑙的戏剧性拱门和植物玻璃工艺无法在森林中生长。然而，人们在拉斯帕尔对曲线（而非直角）的偏爱以及受到植物和动物启发的装饰中，可以看到自然的影响。
中文解析：
private home并不可能真正在森林中生长。然而，人们可以从拉斯帕尔对曲线的偏爱以及受动植物启发的装饰中，看到自然的影响。前后形成对比关系，选择still

question:
The Austroneslan language family comprises some 1,200 languages — including the_____Madurese and Bikol, which are spoken by 14 million and 4,6 million speakers, respectively — and accounts for one-fifth of the world’s languages, making it of keen interest to linguists like Diane Massam.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: Languages普遍的名词修饰具体两类语言，属于限定性修饰不用符号分割

question:
In Panama, citizens must be at least 18 years old to vote in their country’s elections._____ citizens in the lsle of Man need only be 16 years old to cast their vote.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 两个国家不同的选举年龄相比，选择by comparison

question:
Russian-born visual artist Helga stentzel turns household items into strange and Russian-born visual artist Helga stentzel turns household items into strange and surprising works of art. In her prints, tan sweatpants take on the form of a camel as they dangle from a_____the red handles of a pair of pliers become the thongs of flip flops — flip flops made of nails. This “household surrealism,” Stentzel says, “is about finding magic in the mundane.”

Which cholce completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 两个完整句子连接用分号。大意是作品中，挂在晾衣绳上的棕色运动裤呈现出骆驼的形状；一把钳子的红色手柄则变成了人字拖的带子——用钉子制成的人字拖。

question:
Generally, sleek vehicles are more aerodynamic than bulkier ones. For example, the streamlined nose of the Airbus A320 jet helps it glide through wind with relative ease.______a boxy semitruck encounters more wind resistance, making it less aerodynamic.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一般来说，流线型车辆比笨重的车辆更具空气动力学。例如，空客A320喷气式飞机流线型的机头使其能够相对轻松地穿越风阻。而一辆方形的半挂货车则会遇到更多的风阻，从而使其空气动力学性能较差。
中文解析：
两个不同例子的对比，前者是streamlined nose with relative ease, 后者是boxy semitruck with more resistance, 选择on the other hand （旧题变体）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Epazoyucan is a municipality in the state of Hidalgo, Mexico.
●Municipalities are governmental regions responsible for providing many public services to their residents.
●One service they provide is traffic control.
●Epazoyucan covers an area of roughly 140km2.
● Hidalgo is divided into 84 municipalities.

The student wants to emphasize the size of Epazoyucan, which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The municipality of Epazoyucan in Hidalgo, Mexico, covers an area of roughly 140km2.
B. Epazoyucan—a governmental region in the state of Hidalgo, Mexico—provides many public services to its residents.
C. Epazoyucan is one of 84 governmental regions, known as municipalities, across Hidalgo.
D. Providing traffic control is just one example of the public services that municipalities provide.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，学生记录了以下笔记：
● 埃帕索尤坎是墨西哥伊达尔戈州的一个市。
●市是负责向居民提供许多公共服务的政府区域。
● 他们提供的一项服务是交通管理。
● 埃帕索尤坎的面积大约为140平方公里。
●伊达尔戈州分为84个市。
中文解析：
题目要求强调size大小，于是只有A选项的140km2.满足要求

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● The United States has designated more than 500 areas National Wildlife Refuges (NWRS).
● Some NWRs were established specifically to protect endangered species.
● The Crocodile Lake NWR is a 6,686-acre area in Florida.
● It was established to protect the endangered American crocodile.
● The Pearl Harbor NWR is a 61-acre area in Hawaii.
● It was established to protect the endangered Hawaiian stilt.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two NWRs. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Both the Crocodile Lake NWR and the Pearl Harbor NWR were established to protect endangered species.
B. Some NWRs, such as Hawaii’s Pearl Harbor, were established specifically to protect endangered species.
C. While the Crocodile lake NWR extends across a 6,686-acre area, the Pearl Harbor NWR encompasses only 61 acres,
D. The US has designated more than 500 areas NwRs, including the Crocodile Lake NWR in Florida.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
● 美国指定了超过500个国家野生动物保护区（NWR）。
● 一些NWR是专门为了保护濒危物种而建立的。
● 鳄鱼湖国家野生动物保护区位于佛罗里达州，面积为6,686英亩。
● 它的建立是为了保护濒危的美洲鳄。
●珍珠港国家野生动物保护区位于夏威夷，面积为61英亩。
● 它的建立是为了保护濒危的夏威夷鹤。
中文解析：
题目要求对比连个NWR的相似性，根据第四条和第六条notes，他们都是用来保护濒危物种的，于是A正确

question:
As a federalist, New York physician and writer Charles McKnight favored the US Constitution’s provisions for a strong centralized government and supported the document’s rectification; _______essays he published in the New-York journal in December1787 under the pseudonym “Examiner” disparaged the arguments of the anti-federalists, who opposed the Constitution's adoption.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
作为一名联邦主义者，纽约的医生和作家查尔斯·麦克奈特支持美国宪法对强大中央政府的规定，并支持该文件的修正；他于1787年12月以“审查员”（Examiner）的笔名在《纽约期刊》上发表的______文章贬低了反联邦主义者反对宪法通过的论点。
中文解析：
前后句子意义相近，后面给出更加具体的内容，用fittingly。本段话中联邦主义者Charles McKnight支持美国宪法，并拥护该文件的批准；1787年12月，他以Examiner为笔名在《纽约杂志》（New-York Journal）上发表的文章，驳斥了反对宪法的论点。所以federalist，和后面驳斥anti-federalist观点，其实本质是一样的

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Felipe Posada (pseudonym The Invisible Realm) is a New York City-based artist who specializes in the form of art known as surrealist collage.
● Manifestation of the unconscious mind is a central aspect of surrealist collage.
● Irrational juxtaposition of disparate elements is a central aspect of surrealist collage.
● Posada’s Synchronicity irrationally juxtaposes images of a well dressed man, a clouded mountain range, and a doorway to the stars.
● Posada: “My art is a journey through the invisible realm a space where intuition, memories, visions, and dreams are free to take visual form.”

The student wants to provide a specific example of irrational juxtaposition in surrealist collage, Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Images of a well-dressed man, a clouded mountain range, and a doorway to the stars are juxtaposed irrationally in the surrealist collage piece Synchronicicy by artist Felipe Posada.
B. The irrational juxtaposition of disparate elements in Fellpe Posada’s art invokes a space where intuition, memories, visions, and dreams are free to take visual form.
C. Synchronicity by artist Felipe Posada is an example of surrealist collage, a form in which irrational juxtaposition is a central aspect.
D. Surrealist collage, such as Felipe Posada’s Synchonicity, manifests the unconscious mind and irrationally juxtaposes disparate elements.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
● 菲利佩·波萨达（化名“隐形领域”）是一位驻扎在纽约市的艺术家，专注于一种被称为超现实主义拼贴的艺术形式。
● 潜意识的表现是超现实主义拼贴的一个核心方面。
● 不同元素之间的非理性并置是超现实主义拼贴的一个核心方面。
● 波萨达的《同步性》非理性地将一位衣着考究的男子、云雾缭绕的山脉和通向星空的门结合在一起。
● 波萨达：“我的艺术是一段穿越隐形领域的旅程，这是一个直觉、记忆、幻想和梦境自由呈现视觉形态的空间。”
中文解析：
题目要求irrational juxtaposition具体的例子，于是第四条note a well-dressed man, a clouded mountain range, and a doorway to the stars符合irrational juxtaposition的具体要求

question:
Mexican architect Luis Barragán’s prolific career, which spanned the 1920s to the 1980s, evolved through distinct phases. After traveling to the United States and Europe in the early 1930s and immersing himself in a broader architectural discourse , Barragan began incorporating prlnciples derived from functionalism and modernism in his work, as seen in the apartment building at 14 Parque Melchor Ocampo, whose unadorned geometric forms contrast with his earlier projects in Guadalajara, such as the Carmen Orozco House, which evince the aesthelics of traditional Mediterranean and Mexican styles.

Information in the text best supports which statement about the design of the Carmen Orozco House?
selections: A. It represents a transitional moment between the early and late phases of Baragán’s development.
B. It displays the effects of Barragán’s exposure to international architectural trends in the 1930s.
C. It is characteristic of the Guadalejaran architecture that influenced Barragán throughout his career.
D. It reflects an approach to ornamentation and shape that Barragán later stopped using.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
墨西哥建筑师路易斯·巴拉甘（Luis Barragán）在1920年代至1980年代的丰富职业生涯经历了不同的阶段。在1930年代初，他前往美国和欧洲，深入参与更广泛的建筑讨论，将功能主义和现代主义的原则融入他的作品中。以位于14号梅尔乔尔·奥坎波公园的公寓楼为例，其简洁的几何形状与他在瓜达拉哈拉早期的项目形成对比，例如卡门·奥罗斯科住宅，这些早期作品体现了传统地中海和墨西哥风格的美学。
中文解析：
Carmen Orozco House是具体的例子，前面的观点是his earlier projects in Guadalajara，于是和D选项描述的later stopped using是一致的。（这是一个旧题重现）

question:
Edinburgh, Scotland, has installed engineered structures along 89% of its shoreline to protect infrastructure from wave erosion and other hazards, a practice known as shoreline hardening. To evaluate the responses of waterbirds to two types of hardening slructures—riprap and bulkheads— Diann Prosser et al. surveyed waterbird communities consisting of the osprey, the common tern, and 62 other species at different sites in the Chesapeake Bay on the US East Coast. Utilizing the Index of Waterbird Community Integrity (IWCI), on which a high score corresponds to high community integrity, the researchers found that bulkheads are more strongly negatively correlated with waterbird community integrity than is riprap.

Which finding, if true, would most directly illustrate the researchers’ finding?
selections: A. Waterbird communities at curus, a site with a high percentage of shoreline consisting of bulkheads and riprap, had lower average IWCI scores than did waterbird communides at Onancock, a site with a low percentage of shoreline consisting of bulkheads and riprap.

B. Waterbird comununites at Old Road, a site with a relatively high percentage of shoreline consisting of bulkheads, had lower average IWCI scores than did waterbird communities at Miles, a site with a relatively high percentage of shoreline consisting of riprap.

C. Waterbird comununities at Curtis, a site with equal percentages of shoreline consisting of bulkheads and riprap, had higher average IWCI scores than did waterbird communities at Miles, a site with diferent percentages of shoreline consisting of bulkheads and riprap.

D. The difference in average IWCI scores for waterbird cominunities at Stony and Old Road, two sites with a higher percentage of shoreline consisting of bulkheads than of riprap, was stalistically insignificant.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
苏格兰爱丁堡在其海岸线的89%区域安装了工程结构，以保护基础设施免受波浪侵蚀和其他危害，这种做法被称为海岸加固。为评估水鸟对两种类型加固结构（碎石和挡墙）的反应，Diann Prosser等人对美国东海岸切萨皮克湾不同地点的水鸟群落进行了调查，群落包括鱼鹰、普通燕鸥和其他62个物种。利用水鸟群落完整性指数（IWCI），该指数的高分对应于较高的群落完整性，研究人员发现，挡墙与水鸟群落完整性之间的负相关关系比碎石更强。
中文解析：
根据最后一句bulkheads比riprap更容易受到影响，同时IWCI的分值与community integrity相关，于是higher bulkheads有lower IWCI scores，比起higher riprap。

question:
Text 1 is adapted from E,M, Forster's 1910 novel Howards End. Text 2 discusses Howards End. King’s Cross and St. Pancras are adjacent railway terminals in London from which trains travel to the countryside.
Text 1
To Margaret the station of King’s Cross had always suggested Infinity. Its very situation—withdrawn a little behind the facile splendors of St. Pancras—implied a comment on the materialism of life. Those two great arches, colourless, indifferent, shouldering between them an unlovely clock, were fit portals for some eternal adventure, whose issue might be prosperous, but would certainly not be expressed in the ordinary language of prosperity.
Text 2
The interplay between opposing ideological positions in Howards End is broadly articulated in the novel’s organization of geographic space, On the one hand, the modern metropolis of London represents capitalism’s emphasis on pragmatism and the accumulation of material wealth; on the other, the English countryside, accessible via King’s Cross, fosters an idealism that values tradition, authentic personal connection, and the aesthetic- what the novel calls “the infinite”.

Based on the texts, the author of Text 2 would most likely agree with which statement about King’s Cross, as it is depicted in Text 1?
selections: A. Because it is situated at the beginning of Margaret’s journey from the city to the country, King’s Cross emblematize the intrusion of the forces of materialism and modernity into the rural spaces that the novel associates with idealism and tradition.

B. The austerity conveyed by King’s Cross’s appearance mirrors Margaret’s disillusionment with the prospect of having authentic connections with other people in a world that chiefly values more conventional forms of prosperity.

C. As a point of connection between London and the countryside, King’s Cross suggests to Margaret the possibility of acquiring the intangible abundance promised by the kinds of authentic engagements that the novel’s rural spaces seem to offer.

D. King’s Cross has a relatively unassuming appearance whose sharp contrast with the more aesthetically pleasing appearance of St. Pancras suggests to Margaret the ascendancy of the pragmatic capitalistic outlook among London’s inhabitants.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
文本1改编自E.M.福斯特1910年的小说《霍华德庄园》，文本2讨论了《霍华德庄园》。国王十字车站和圣潘克拉斯车站是伦敦相邻的铁路终点站，从这里出发的火车可以到达乡村。
文本1
对玛格丽特来说，国王十字车站总是让人联想到无限。它的位置——略微远离圣潘克拉斯的华丽——暗示了对物质生活的评论。那两座巨大的拱门，无色、无动于衷，肩负着一个不讨人喜欢的钟表，是通往某种永恒冒险的合适门户，其结果可能是繁荣的，但肯定不会用普通的繁荣语言来表达。
文本2
《霍华德庄园》中对立意识形态之间的相互作用在小说的地理空间组织中得到了广泛体现：一方面，现代都市伦敦代表了资本主义对实用主义和物质财富积累的强调；另一方面，通过国王十字车站可达的英格兰乡村则培养了一种理想主义，重视传统、真实的人际联系以及小说所称的“无限”的美学。
中文解析：
第二篇尤其是末尾句回应了第一篇开头句；Margaret 认为 King’s Cross 车站象征着“无限”（Infinity），第二篇提到通过 King’s Cross 可以到达的英国乡村则代表理想主义，重视传统、真实的个人联系和美学即“无限” （infinity）。
C选项的基本意义是作为伦敦与乡村的连接点，King’s Cross 向 Margaret 暗示了获得乡村空间所承诺的无形丰富性的可能性。符合 Text 1 和 Text 2，King’s Cross 象征从物质主义到理想主义的过渡，与乡村的“无限”相联系。

question:
For its 2022 exhibition Guarding the Art, the Baltimore Museum of Art cast the security personnel typically responsible for safeguarding the institution’s collections as the curators, whose individual selections from the museum’s holdings culminated in a show amplifying a distinct perspective not typically given a formal platform.

Which quote from one of the personnel who curated the exhibition would best support the underlined claim?
selections: A. “The most enjoyable part of curating this show has been seeing the outcome of our efforts: a unique show that spans genres, mediums, cultures, and eras. We hope visitors will sense our genuine affinity for the pieces we are charged with protecting.”

B. “My selections for the show were motivated by an interest in bringing publicity to lesser-known artifacts in the museum’s collection, many of which tend to be overlooked or even dismissed as uninteresting by most visitors to the museum.”

C. “The piece I chose is accompanied by a statement of the personal interpretation I’ve developed over countless hours overseeing the work and interacting with its visitors—an interpretation that I’ve previously shared only in small impromptu conversations with those visitors who are interested in discussing their reflections on the piece with me.”

D. “Throughout the exhibition’s development, my colleagues and I partnered closely with other museum staff whose areas of expertise lie in curator and conservation, and whose insights enriched our understandings of the pieces we selected for the exhibition.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在2022年的展览《守护艺术》中，巴尔的摩艺术博物馆将通常负责保护机构藏品的安保人员塑造成策展人，他们从博物馆的藏品中各自挑选作品，最终形成了一场展览，放大了一个通常没有正式平台的独特视角。
中文解析：
curator是策展人，划线部分（a distinct perspective not typically given a formal platform）意思是：这次展览为安保人员提供了一个通常没有正式平台的机会，让他们展示独特的视角，于是对应了C引用内容提到选择展品时附上了个人解读，这些解读是基于长时间观察展品和与游客互动得出的，且之前只在小范围的非正式对话中分享过。这直接支持了“distinct perspective”和“not typical platform”的说法。

question:
The National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) requires US federal agencies to assess environmental effects of potential actions, such as building highways. While many NEPA reviews require public comment, categorical exclusions (CEs) allow quick reviews with nonpublic comment for actions that will minimally affect the environment. In 2020 the rule governing CEs was revised: before, CEs could be granted for actions that “do not individually or cumulatively have a significant effect on the human environment,” but the revised rule allowed CEs if actions “normally do not have a significant effect on the human environment.” Environmentalists found this revision to be potentially detrimental because___

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the increasing need to build new highways and rehabilitate older highways in the US incentives agencies to grant CEs after 2020 for reasons that would not have been considered valid prior to 2020.
B. the 2020 relaxation of the rule regarding CEs would permit more exclusions, resulting in more reviews of actions by federal agencies and a paradoxically slower review process.

C. the rule that governed CEs before 2020 allowed expedited reviews of actions that might have significant effects on the environment if those effects were believed to be rare, while the 2020 revision of the rule subjected such actions to slower reviews.

D. the 2020 revision of the rule governing CEs would allow expedited reviews of actions that had a minimal environmental effect when considered on their own but a significant effect when considered together
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《国家环境政策法案》（NEPA）要求美国联邦机构评估潜在行动的环境影响，例如建设高速公路。尽管许多NEPA审查需要公众评论，但类别排除（CEs）允许对那些对环境影响极小的行动进行快速审查，而无需公众评论。2020年，关于类别排除的规则进行了修订：之前，类别排除可以授予那些“对人类环境没有单独或累计显著影响”的行动，但修订后的规则允许在“通常对人类环境没有显著影响”的情况下授予类别排除。环保人士认为这一修订可能会产生不利影响，因为...
中文解析：
修订后的规则放宽了CEs的适用条件，删掉了之前的individually and cumulatively,换成了normally，可能导致更多action被快速审查，即使这些行动单独来看影响较小，但累积起来可能对环境产生显著影响。直接解释环保主义者的担忧，即修订可能导致更多累积性（cumulatively）环境影响的行动被快速审查。A选项是迷惑选项，但是把the increasing need to build new highways and rehabilitate older highways 当作原因是不合理的

question:
During the 2007-2010 financial crisis, the United Sates furnished billlons of dollars to selected countries’ central banks via mechanisms called swap lines. Aditi Sahasrabuddhe found that countries’ policy environments seem to have been ______ swap-line decisions: the probabllity that banks would be granted swap lines was 0.20 in countries open to foreign-capital inflows and 0.03 in countries with policies restricting such inflows.

Which choice completes the rext with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在2007-2010年的金融危机期间，美国通过被称为掉期额度的机制向某些国家的中央银行提供了数十亿美元。Aditi Sahasrabuddhe发现，国家的政策环境似乎对掉期额度的决策有______：在对外资流入持开放态度的国家，银行获得掉期额度的概率为0.20，而在限制此类流入的国家，概率为0.03。
中文解析：
较少人知晓material可以做形容词，表示对...至关重要， 词组be material to在描述policy environment 对于swap line（货币互换额度）产生重要的影响，前面是原因，后面是结果；如果用A或B选项大意表示基于...依赖，会导致因果颠倒，C选项decouple表示分割，断开

question:
The following text is from Mick Herron’s 2023 novel The Secret Hours. The narrator is describing members of a government committee.
Finally, and adding much needed gravitas, was Sir Winston Day, whose features seemed molded to adorn a bust, or possibly a stamp, and whose forehead was so evidently bulging with gray matter that it would have been impertinent to inquire too closely into the actual achievements his half century of public service had produced. His recently published memoirs possibly cast light on this enigma, but given that such details were not provided until after the thirty-page mark, they might as well have remained state secrets.
@2023 by Mick Herron

Based on the text, which choice best describes Sir Winston Day?
selections: A. He has the appearance of a distinguished figure, but it is uncertain whether he has accomplished anything to earn distinction.
B. He has maintained a modest profile even though he has served the public capably for many years.
C. He looks like a person worthy of respect, but his memoirs reveal that some of his actions were dishonorable.
D. He would be a celebrated public figure if his achievements did not have to be kept secret.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本摘自米克·赫伦（Mick Herron）2023年的小说《秘密时光》（The Secret Hours）。叙述者正在描述一个政府委员会的成员。
最后，增添了急需的庄重感的是温斯顿·戴爵士（Sir Winston Day），他的面容似乎被塑造成了一个半身像，或者可能是一枚邮票，而他的额头显然隆起，似乎充满了灰质，以至于过于详细地询问他半个世纪公共服务所取得的实际成就显得有些无礼。他新近出版的回忆录可能揭示了这个谜团，但鉴于这样的细节直到三十页之后才提供，这些信息不如保持为国家机密更为妥当。
©2023 米克·赫伦
中文解析：
这段文字使用讽刺的语言来评价温斯顿·戴爵士，暗示尽管他的外表令人印象深刻且有着悠久的公共服务经历，但他成就的实际内涵却不好说是不是和他的外形一样突出。最后一句说30页还没有看到他的任何功绩。（这是一个旧题重现）

question:
Noting the correspondence of Leonardo da Vinci’s Mona Lisa to his self-portrait in redchalk, artist lillian Schwartz argued that the former is a self portrait, too—that by mapping his own features onto those of its ostensible subject, Lisa del Giocondo, Leonardo depicted himself as a woman. Indeed, by subjecting both works to digital analysis, Schwartz _____ the two faces’ structural resemblance.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
注意到达芬奇的《蒙娜丽莎》与他的红炭素描自画像之间的对应关系，艺术家莉莲·施瓦茨认为前者也是一幅自画像——通过将自己的特征映射到表面对象丽莎·吉奥孔多的特征上，达芬奇将自己描绘成了一位女性。确实，施瓦茨通过对这两件作品进行数字分析，_____了这两个面孔的结构相似性。
中文解析：
文本提到艺术家 Lillian Schwartz 通过数字分析，发现达·芬奇的《蒙娜丽莎》和他的红色粉笔自画像在面部结构上非常相似。她认为《蒙娜丽莎》实际上是达·芬奇将自己女性化的自画像。Schwartz 通过数字分析“证实”或“支持”了两幅画面部结构的相似性。Corroborate表示支持，符合题目要求；（corroborate之前24年6月考过）
A. corroborated证实、支持
B. amalgamated合并、混合
C. promulgated公布、传播
D. consolidated巩固、合并

question:
As with other river deltas, the Kolyma River delta is______: it is a constantly evolving network of channels and strips of land that change in size and shape as the river deposits new sedimentary particles where the river meets the waters of the East Siberian Sea.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
与其他河流三角洲一样，科利马河三角洲是______：它是一个不断演变的水道和陆地条带网络，随着河流在科利马河与快速西伯利亚海水域相遇时沉积新的沉积颗粒，三角洲的大小和形状也在不断变化。

question:
A student is writing an essay on the subject of cultured meat, which is grown in a laboratory and is intended to help reduce the number of livestock harvested for food. The student wants to make the case that cultured meat production may be useful in responding to an expected widespread change in the public’s behavior.

Which quotation from a publication by a researcher would most effectively support the student’s claim?
selections: A. “ Consumers tend to believe that using less packaging when selling meat production stores would have a significant effect on the environment.”
B. “ The flavor of meat from livestock differs across species (from pig to chicken to cow), and is also influenced by farming conditions and the breeds and genders of animals.”
C. “A growing population that is including significantly more meat in its diet will contribute to an increasing demand for meat products in the 2lst century.”
D. “Researchers who advocate for the development of lab-grown meat claim that it’s better for the environment than conventional meat because it requires less water consumption.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一名学生正在撰写一篇关于培养肉的论文，这种肉类在实验室中生长，旨在帮助减少为食物而屠宰的牲畜数量。学生想论证，培养肉的生产可能有助于应对公众行为预计将发生的广泛变化。
中文解析：
根据文本最后的claim，公众行为变化an expected widespread change in the public's behavior以及实验室培养肉类的潜在作用。C选项符合，因为它直接说明了公众行为变化是肉类消费增加，以及实验室培养肉类可能起到帮助环节作用。

question:
The following text is adapted from George Eliot’s 1857 short story “The Sad Fortunes of the Rev. Amos Barton.” Mr. Ely is a clergyman in the town of Milby.
By the laity of Milby and its neighbourhood [Mr. Ely] was regarded as a man of quite remarkable powers and learning, who must make a considerable sensation in London pulpits and drawing-rooms on his occasional visit to the metropolis; and by his brother clergy he was regarded as a discreet and agreeable fellow. Mr Ely never got into a warm discussion; he suggested what might be thought, but rarely said what he thought himself; he never let either men or women see that he was laughing at them, and he never gave any one an opportunity of laughing at him.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It implies that Mr. Ely’s neighbors are more naive in their estimation of him than people in London are and then explains why his neighbors have been so easily misled.
B. It highlights the disparity between Mr. Ely’s public and private behavior and then conveys why he labors to obscure his true self from other people.
C. It presents the favorable opinion of Mr. Ely that other people hold and then describes the behaviors of Mr. Ely that enable him to maintain that favorable opinion.
D. It shows that Mr, Ely had originally been held in high regard by his friends and then details the events that caused their regard for him to subside.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本改编自乔治·艾略特1857年的短篇小说《阿莫斯·巴顿牧师的悲惨命运》。艾利牧师是米尔比镇的一位牧师。
在米尔比及其周边地区的信徒们眼中，艾利牧师被视为一个颇具才华和学识的人物，偶尔到伦敦时必定会在那里的讲坛和社交场合引起相当大的轰动；而在他的神职同僚眼中，他则被认为是一个稳重且令人愉快的人。艾利牧师从不参与激烈的争论；他会提出一些可能的看法，但很少表达自己的真实想法；他从不让男性或女性看到他在嘲笑他们，也从不让任何人有机会嘲笑他。
中文解析：
文本前半部描述不同人对Mr Ely的好印象，后半部分描述Mr Ely自己的做法让人们能这样看待自己。（这是一个旧题重现）

question:
Microbial fuel cells (MFCs) capitalize on the ability of some species of bacterial to metabolize metal, liberating electrons. The bacteria form a dense biofilm on the surface of an electron-collecting anode, but moving the electrons from the bacterial cytoplasm to an external electrode requires that the electrons pass through a series of inefficient oxidation reduction (redox) reactions. Accordingly, MFC power output rarely exceeds a density of 0.30 milliwatts per square centimeter (mW/cm2). In an experiment, researchers added silver nanoparticles to carbon paper covering the anode in an MFC. The resulting power density was 0.66 mW/cm2, since metals such as silver exhibit high electrical conductivity, the researchers hypothesized that

Which choice most loglcally completes the text?
selections: A. silver nanoparticles may increase the metabolic processes of the bacteria, thereby increasing the number of free electrons available to transfer to the electrode.
B. as the density of the biofilm increases, the series of redox reactions may accelerate independent of the presence of the silver nanoparticles.
C. electrons may be conducted directly to the electrode before the silver nanoparticles catalyze the redox reactions.
D. silver nanoparticles may allow electrons to bypass the series of redox reactions and transfer directly to the electrode.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
微生物燃料电池（MFCs）利用某些细菌种类代谢金属的能力，从中释放电子。这些细菌在电子收集阳极的表面形成致密的生物膜，但将电子从细菌的细胞质转移到外部电极需要电子通过一系列效率较低的氧化还原反应。因此，微生物燃料电池的功率输出很少超过每平方厘米0.30毫瓦（mW/cm²）。在一项实验中，研究人员在一个微生物燃料电池的阳极覆盖的碳纸上添加了银纳米颗粒。由此产生的功率密度为0.66 mW/cm²，因为银等金属表现出高电导率。研究人员假设______
中文解析：
根据文本需要解释银纳米颗粒如何提高MFC的功率输出。银的高导电性可能使电子绕过低效的氧化还原反应，直接传递到电极。银纳米颗粒可能使电子绕过氧化还原反应，直接传递到电极。于是D正确

question:
Born in Chile in 1917, artist and ethnomusicologist Violeta Parra was a pioneer in the nueva canción chilena (Chilean New Song) movement that emerged in the late 1950s and then spread throughout Latin America, Portugal, and Spain as nueva canción. Parra traveled all over Chile compiling extensive records of authentic folk music as well as recipes, proverbs, and other facets of cultural history. These records formed the foundation for the early movement’s revival of traditional Chilean folk forms in new songs that represented modern realities of the working class and strongly advocated for social change. As the movement spread beyond Chile, the breadth of musical traditions incorporated into its foundation also expanded.

Which detail about songs associated with nueva canción, if true, would best illustrate the underlined claim?
selections: A. Many feature political commentary addressing contemporary issues that stemmed from shared experiences of European colonization in Latin American countries.
B. Many demonstrate the stylistic influence of corrido, a genre of narrative songs from Mexico that had come to be characterized by political themes in the early 1800s.
C. Many were written with parts meant to be played on the quena, a traditional flute used across Andean counties, including Chile.
D. Many were produced by Argentinian artists in the late 1950s, with others by artists in additional Latin American countries first emerging soon after.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
维奥莱塔·帕拉（Violeta Parra）于1917年出生于智利，是一位艺术家和民族音乐学家，她是20世纪50年代末出现的智利新歌运动（nueva canción chilena）的先锋，该运动随后在拉丁美洲、葡萄牙和西班牙传播开来，统称为 nueva canción。帕拉在智利各地旅行，收集了大量真实民间音乐的记录，以及食谱、谚语和其他文化历史的方面。这些记录为早期运动复兴传统智利民间形式的新歌曲奠定了基础，这些歌曲代表了工人阶级的现代现实，并强烈倡导社会变革。随着运动超越智利传播，融入其基础的音乐传统的广度也得到了扩展。
中文解析：
划线部分的意思是，随着新歌运动（nueva canción）传播到智利以外，其音乐传统的基础也变得更加广泛，B符合要求提到许多歌曲展示了墨西哥叙事歌曲“corrido”的风格影响，这种歌曲在19世纪初就以政治主题为特征。直接说明新歌运动融入了墨西哥的元素，支持了音乐传统基础扩展的说法。

question:
While modern composers may often get inspiration from past greats like Ludwig van Beethoven, the extent of their influences is broad. The music of Eresto Lecuona, for example, can be said to _____ elements of both the classical European tradition and the social, political, and cultural landscape of his native Cuba.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
虽然现代作曲家常常从像路德维希·范·贝多芬这样的过去伟大人物那里获得灵感，但他们的影响范围很广。例如，埃雷斯托·莱库纳的音乐可以说融合了古典欧洲传统以及他故乡古巴的社会、政治和文化背景的元素。
中文解析：
文本提到现代作曲家可能会从过去的伟大作曲家（如贝多芬）那里获得灵感，但他们的影响范围很广。以 Ernesto Lecuona 的音乐为例，他的作品既包含欧洲古典传统，又反映了他祖国古巴的社会、政治和文化背景。Lecuona 的音乐“展现”了欧洲古典传统和古巴的社会、政治、文化元素。Exhibit符合要求
A. defy违抗、挑战
B. neglect忽视、忽略
C. foretell预言、预示
D. exhibit展现、显示

question:
Though John Crowley, author of Four Freedoms, is perhaps not as well known as the most widely read American writers of the past fifty years, influential figures have championed his work, including the poet James Merrill and the literary critic Harold Bloom. In his afterword to Crowley’s book Little, Big, Bloom praises the novel’s adroit blend of what playwright Friedrich Schiller termed the naive and sentimental modes — while Schiller thought works could be classified as either naive (seeking to describe reality) or sentimental (seeking to develop ideas), Little, Big demonstrates that a work can be both.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To present a reason why a literary critic is impressed by a certain novel
B. To explain what inspired an author to write a particular work
C. To compare the work of a writer with the work of a poet who admired him
D. To argue that all writing must be classified as belonging to one of two categories
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管《四个自由》的作者约翰·克劳利（John Crowley）可能没有过去五十年中最广为阅读的美国作家那么知名，但一些有影响力的人物对他的作品给予了支持，包括诗人詹姆斯·梅里尔（James Merrill）和文学批评家哈罗德·布loom（Harold Bloom）。在布loom对克劳利的书《小，大》（Little, Big）的后记中，他赞扬了这部小说巧妙地融合了剧作家弗里德里希·席勒（Friedrich Schiller）所称的天真与感伤两种模式——虽然席勒认为作品可以被分类为天真的（旨在描述现实）或感伤的（旨在发展思想），但《小，大》展示了一部作品可以同时具备这两者。
中文解析：
文章目的主要参考末尾句描述了该作品Little，big兼备了naive and sentimental，于是让Bloom称赞，那么A符合要求（这是一个旧题重现）

question:

question:
In an ekphrastic poem, a poet explores a work of visual art, such as a drawing, sculprure, or painting. Robert Hayden’s 1994 poem “Monet's Waterlilies,” for example, meditates on Claude Monet’s 1899 painting Water Lilies; Saad Ali’s 2020 poem “This Town,”______takes a painting as its subject: Ivan Alvazovsky’s 1859 work Lunar Night on the Black Sen.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical tansiton?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在一首描写视觉艺术的诗中，诗人探讨一件视觉艺术作品，例如绘画、雕塑或素描。例如，罗伯特·海登（Robert Hayden）在1994年的诗作《莫奈的睡莲》中沉思克劳德·莫奈（Claude Monet）1899年的画作《睡莲》；萨阿德·阿里（Saad Ali）在2020年的诗作《这个城镇》中，则以伊万·艾瓦佐夫斯基（Ivan Alvazovsky）1859年的作品《黑海上的黎明》为题材。
中文解析：
两个相近类型的例子之间用likewise，文中是一首诗歌分别思考了一副画作，又一首诗歌思考了一副画作（旧题变体）

question:
In his 2011 book, historian Sebouh David Aslanlan quantifies the reading patterns of early modern Armenian merchants from New Julfa. Aslanian’s macroanalysis _______nearly 1,000 book titles published between 1512 and 1800 shows not only the steady popularity of religious texts but also a broadening interest in secular books, especlally those on history and geography.

explanations: 文本中shows是真正的谓语，于是需要非谓语examining来充当后置定语修饰前面的名词人物

question:
Scientists studying asteroid deflection have focused on secondary objects such as S/2020 (2013 PY6), a moonlet orbiting the near Earth asteroid 2013 PY6. In 2022 NASA intentionally crashed a probe into just such an object, the moonlet Dimorphos._______Dimorphos’s orbital period around the near-Earth asteroid Didymos was permanently altered.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
研究小行星偏转的科学家们关注了诸如S/2020（2013 PY6）这样的次级天体，这是一颗绕近地小行星2013 PY6运行的卫星。在2022年，NASA故意将一探测器撞向了这样一个天体，即卫星迪莫佛斯（Dimorphos）。_______迪莫佛斯绕近地小行星迪达摩斯（Didymos）的轨道周期被永久改变。

question:
Although 60558 Echeclus and 2014 YX49 are both classified as centaur objects—outer solar system bodies in unstable orbits — they exhibit striking differences in______object 60558 Echeclus is considered an active centaur, showing sporadic comet-like activity (such as clouds of dust and gas on its surface), 2014 YX49, showing no such acclivity, is considered dominant.

explanations: 冒号后解释冒号前，冒号后可以是完整句子，对着这段文字，冒号后while从句和主句对比了两个星体的差异，用来解释前面的differences

question:
● The South Sudan Workers Trade Union Federation (SSWTUF) is a national union federation for the African nation of South Sudan.
● It helps improve conditions for workers in that nation.
● ITUC-Africa is a regional union federation that represents national union federations across Africa.
● It represents the SSWTUF.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to explain the purpose of national union federations?
selections: A. The SSWTUF is a national union federation in Africa.
B. National union federations, such as the SSWTUF, work to improve condition for workers in their member nations.
C. The SSWTUF is one of the national union federations represented by ITUC-Africa.
D. Regional union federations like ITUC-Africa represent the national union federations in a specific area.
explanations:

●它帮助改善该国工人的工作条件。

question:
According to the free electron model, metals, such as copper and silver, do not maintain bonds by sharing and exchanging electrons._______metals are held together by a system of valence electrons that travel freely, interacting with neither ions nor each other. This framework for understanding the subatomic relatlonships within metals can be used to help explain heat and electrical conductivity.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transidon?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
根据自由电子模型，金属（如铜和银）并不是通过共享和交换电子来维持键合的。_______金属是通过一套自由移动的价电子系统被结合在一起，既不与离子相互作用，也不相互作用。这个理解金属内部亚原子关系的框架可以用来帮助解释热和电的导电性。

question:
Firefly luciferase (Fluc) is a distinctly evolved enzyme that can oxidize a substrate called D-luciferin to induce bioluminescence and can act as a fatty acyl CoA synthetase (ACS) enzyme, a class of enzyme present in all insects.______Fluc is a bifunctional enzyme whose presence indicates an insect is capable of emitting light; in contrast, the presence of ACS alone would be insufficient for determining bioluminescence.

Which choice completes the rext with the most logical tansition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
萤火虫荧光素酶（Fluc）是一种独特进化的酶，能够氧化一种称为D-荧光素的底物以诱发生物发光，并且可以作为脂肪酰辅酶A合成酶（ACS）发挥作用，这是一类存在于所有昆虫中的酶。Fluc是一种双功能酶，其存在表明昆虫能够发出光；相比之下，仅有ACS的存在不足以确定生物发光的能力。
中文解析：
前后是一个同义转述的关系，所以选 that is

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Generally, an object will heat up when twisted.
●The twisting of an object is known as torsion.
●A 2019 study led by Zunfeng Liu and Ray Baughman tested the torsional heating of various fibers.
●When a sample of styrene ethyiene-butyiene styrene (SEBS) rubber fiber was twisted, its average surface temperature increased by 3.5°C.
●When a sample of single-ply nickel-titanium (NiTi) wire was twisted, its average surface temperature increased by 21.3°C.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between SEBS rubber and single-ply NiTi wire fibers, Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In 2019, tvo research teais observed the effects of torsional heating on various fbers, including SEBS rubber and single-ply NiTi wire.
B. Both SEBS rubber and single-ply NiTi wire fibers heat up when twisted, according to a 2019 study.
C. Researchers determined that when the fibers were twisted, the average surface temperature of single ply NiTi wire increased more than that of SEBS rubber.
D. Twisting an object will generally cause its temperature to increase, a process known as torsional heating.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
●一般来说，当一个物体被扭转时，它会变热。
●物体的扭转称为扭转。
●一项由Zunfeng Liu和Ray Baughman于2019年进行的研究测试了各种纤维的扭转加热。
●当一段聚苯乙烯-乙烯-丁烯-苯乙烯（SEBS）橡胶纤维被扭转时，其平均表面温度上升了3.5°C。
●当一段单层镍钛合金（NITl）线被扭转时，其平均表面温度上升了21.3°C。
中文解析：
题目问两种SEBS rubber and single-ply NiTi wire fibers的相似点，根据notes最后两条，扭曲时他们的温度会升高。

question:

However, if polls and past voting data suggest that the outcome in a given state is a foregone conclusion, a campaign will not invest its resources there. Ultimately, a state's voting record and polling data, not its population size,______its importance to campaigns.

question:

question: A real estate company offers a series of three webinars. 1,250 people attended the first webinar: 46% of the people who attended the first webinar attended the second webinar, and 32% of the people who attended the first and second webinars attended the third webinar. How many people attended all three webinars?

If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>6</mn></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>162</mn></math>, what is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> ?

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>7</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>13</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>u</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>
In the given equation, u is a positive constant. The sum of the solutions to the equation is 13. What is the value of u ?

A square map has a side length of 45 inches, and 1 inch on the map represents an actual distance of 13 miles. A smaller version of the same map is printed as a square with the side length 70% shorter than the side length of the previous map. On the smaller map, which of the following is closest to the actual distance, in miles, represented by 1 inch?
explanations: 1inch表示13mile，之后相同地图比例缩小70%，意味着0.3inch就表示13mile，所以每inch表示13/0.3=43.33mile，选D（利用常识辅助理解：小地图每单位长度肯定代表长的距离）

question: Right rectangular prism X is similar to right rectangular prism Y. The surface area of right rectangular prism X is 59 square centimeters <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <msup> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow></math>, and the surface area of right rectangular prism Y is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>1</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>475</mn> <msup> <mrow> <mtext> </mtext> <mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>. The volume of right rectangular prism Y is 1,500 cubic centimeters <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <msup> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi> </mrow> <mn>3</mn> </msup> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow></math>. What is the sum of the volumes, in <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi> </mrow> <mn>3</mn> </msup></math>, of right rectangular prism X and right rectangular prism Y?
explanations: 相似图形比例问题，面积比例是长度比例平方，体积比例是长度比例的立方，此题面积比是59/1475=1/25，故长度比例1：5，体积比例1：125，故X体积为1500/125=12，注意问题问的是体积和为12+1500=1512（题目类似与24-5三套m2-20）

question:
A student is studying how woma pythons, eastern brown snakes, and rough-scaled death adders react to sound. The student knew that many snakes display movement of more than 20cm in response to sound traveling through the ground, but assumed that snakes do not detect sound traveling through the air until reading a study by Christina Zdenek, Timothy Staples, and their team.

Which finding from Christina Zdenek, Timothy Staples, and their team’s study, if true, would most directly challenge the underlined assumption?
selections: A. Neither eastern brown snakes nor rough-scaled death adders display movement of more than 20cm in response to airborne sound.
B. Woma pythons have better overall hearing than do rough-scaled death adders.
C. Both woma pythons and eastern brown snakes react only to sounds traveling through the ground.
D. Woma pythons, eastern brown snakes, and rough-scaled death adders display movement of more than 20cm in response to both ground and airborne sound waves.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一名学生正在研究雌性蟒蛇、东部棕蛇和粗鳞死亡Adder对声音的反应。学生了解到，许多蛇在感知通过地面传播的声音时会移动超过20厘米，但在阅读了Christina Zdenek、Timothy Staples及其团队的一项研究后，他假设蛇在空气中传播的声音不会被察觉。
中文解析：
划线句说蛇不能检测空气传来的声音，可是D选项指出ground and ariborne sound waves都会让蛇表现出movement，于是反驳了文本最后的结论
exam_name: 2024年12月第8套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
Text 1
In 2015 Rasht, Iran, was named a City of Gastronomy by UNESCO in recognition of the city’s unique food culture. The honor is well known among residents of the city as well as tourists who visit. It’s obvious that the selection of Rasht by UNESCO has brought awareness to local recipes, cooking practices, and chefs and has provided a boost to the city’s tourism industry.
Text 2
Many people in Rasht’s restaurant industry hoped that food tourism would increase after the city was chosen as a City of Gastronomy in 2015. However, as researcher Eerang Park and colleagues argue, cities must still create effective marketing strategies to benefit fully from being named a City of Gastronomy. Without an intentional effort to promote the city’s food scene, many current and potential visitors to Rasht may not even be aware that it’s home to uniquely delicious food.

Based on the texts, both authors would most likely agree with which statement?
selections: A. The benefits of Rasht having been named a City of Gastronomy extend well beyond increased tourism.
B. Increased tourism isn’t guaranteed after a city has been named a City of Gastronomy.
C. A city’s food scene can benefit from the city being named a City of Gastronomy.
D. A significant number of visitors to Rasht may not know that it was named a City of Gastronomy.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
文本 1
2015年，伊朗的拉什特被联合国教科文组织命名为美食之都，以表彰该市独特的饮食文化。这个荣誉在城市居民和游客中都广为人知。显然，联合国教科文组织选择拉什特的决定提高了人们对当地食谱、烹饪习惯和厨师的认识，并为该市的旅游业带来了积极影响。
文本 2
拉什特的餐饮行业许多人希望在2015年被选为美食之都后，食品旅游会有所增加。然而，正如研究者Eerang Park及其同事所指出的，城市仍然必须制定有效的营销策略，以充分受益于被命名为美食之都的声誉。如果不主动努力推广该市的美食文化，许多当前和潜在的拉什特游客可能甚至不知道这里有独特美味的食物。
中文解析：
题目问两篇文章作者都同意，那么就是food scene会得益于City of Gastronomy这样的荣誉，其它选项并能覆盖两篇的共同点，比如B主要是text2观点
exam_name: 2024年12月第8套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
The following text is from Sara Teasdale’s 1922 poem “Two Songs for Solitude.”
My heart has grown rich with the passing of years,
I have less need now than when I was young
To share myself with every comer,
Or shape my thoughts into words with my tongue.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It explains the speaker’s views about proper conduct toward new acquaintances.
B. It provides examples of behaviors the speaker is less inclined toward than she once was.
C. It presents an episode from the speaker’s youth that she remembers fondly.
D. It emphasizes the social habits the speaker has developed over her lifetime.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本来自莎拉·蒂斯代尔1922年的诗《孤独的两首歌》。
我的心随着岁月的流逝变得富有，
我现在比年轻时更少需要
与每一个过客分享自己，
或用舌头将我的思想化为语言。
中文解析：
最后两句需要结合前两句，基本结构是I have less need to share ... or shape...于是表达比起年轻时，自己less inclined toward these behaviors
exam_name: 2024年12月第8套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
Data are approximate.
A 2022 US Department of Agriculture report by Kayode Ajewole et al. calculated average annual growth rates of agricultural exports from countries over the five years before and the five years following the creation of a free trade agreement (FTA with the US). The table shows data for five countries in the study (Post-FTA calculations included some anticipatory effects preceding the agreements’ official start. ) Ajewole et al. note that an increase in the rate of exports to the US in the post-FTA period does not necessarily indicate that a country produced more goods for export as a result of the FTA. Rather, FTAs sometimes incentivize countries to redirect existing trade from nonmember countries to FTA partners, as is most likely the case with ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
selections: A. Jordan, because the post-FTA period coincided with increasing rates of both its agricultural exports to the US and its total agricultural exports to countries not participating in the FTA.
B. Australia, because its rate of agricultural exports to the US and its rate of total agricultural exports both decreased in the post-FTA period relative to the pre-FTA period.

C. Morocco, because its rate of agricultural exports to the US increased in the post-FTA period relative to the pre-FTA period, while its rate of total agricultural exports decreased during the same period.
D. Panama, because the post-FTA period saw a decrease in its rate of agricultural exports to the US but not in its rate of total agricultural exports.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
2022年美国农业部的一份报告由Kayode Ajewole等人撰写，计算了在自由贸易协定（FTA）与美国签署前五年和签署后的五年中，几个国家农业出口的平均年增长率。表格显示了研究中五个国家的数据。（在FTA后期的计算中包括了一些在协定正式开始前的预期效应。）Ajewole等人指出，FTA后期对美国出口增长的增加并不一定表明该国为出口而生产的商品增加了。相反，自由贸易协定有时会激励国家将现有的贸易从非成员国重新导向FTA伙伴国，这种情况在________中最为可能。
中文解析：
根据文本最后rather前后，大意是有些国家出口美国在FTA后确实增加了，但是未必是生产总量增加，很可能是贸易从之前的别的国家转到了FTA伙伴国（如美国），那么C选项满足，因为摩洛哥对美增加，但是总量减少，和文本最后两句一致
exam_name: 2024年12月第8套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
“A Pair of Silk Stockings” is an 1897 short story written by Kate Chopin. In the story, Mrs. Sommers becomes engrossed in the decision of how she should spend a recently obtained sum of money: ________

Which quotation from “A Pair of Silk Stockings” most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “The question of investment was one that occupied her greatly. For a day or two she walked about apparently in a dreamy state, but really absorbed in speculation and calculation.”
B. “She had learned to clutch a piece of goods and hold it and stick to it with persistence and determination till her turn came to be served, no matter when it came.”

C. “A young girl who stood behind the counter asked her if she wished to examine their line of silk hosiery. She smiled, just as if she had been asked to inspect a tiara of diamonds with the ultimate view of purchasing it.”

D. “It seemed to her a very large amount of money, and the way in which it stuffed and bulged her worn old porte-monnaie [small purse] gave her a feeling of importance such as she had not enjoyed for years.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《一双丝绸长袜》是凯特·肖邦于1897年创作的短篇小说。在故事中，萨默斯夫人沉迷于如何花费一笔新获得的钱的决定：______
中文解析：
文本的观点是Mrs. Sommers思考如何花一笔钱，于是A是正确答案，大意为：投资的问题让她十分关注。她在周围徘徊了一两天，表面上看似恍惚，但实际上却沉浸在思考和计算之中。Engross表示专注做某事
exam_name: 2024年12月第8套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
The following text is adapted from Yone Noguchi’s 1914 memoir The Story of Yone Noguchi. Noguchi is returning home after eleven years abroad.
I reached Tsushima, my native town, at evening.
I frightened my old father at the station, who was actually trying to find me among some other people. There is no wonder that he could not recognise me; I must have changed a great deal.

As used in the text, what does the word “find” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字改编自野口米次的1914年回忆录《野口米次的故事》。野口在国外生活了十一年后回到家乡。
我在傍晚抵达了我出生的城市对马。
在车站，我吓到了我的老父亲，他实际上正试图在人群中寻找我。难怪他认不出我来；我一定变化很大。
中文解析：
根据后面recognize，find表示认出，找到，于是locate是同义词
exam_name: 2024年12月第8套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
In 2004, Andrew Rogers created Ancient Language. In this work, Rogers created an 80-meter-long geoglyph out of rocks in the Atacama Desert. Rogers’s work is part of the land art movement, in which artists reject the confinement and commercialization of art galleries. These artists usually install large-scale pieces outdoors, often in surprising locations.

Based on the text, what can be inferred about Ancient Language?
selections: A. Its location may be considered surprising.
B. It marked a shift in the popularity of the land art movement.
C. It may have had more commercial success in a different outdoor location.
D. It was created early in Rogers’s career.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在2004年，安德鲁·罗杰斯创作了《古代语言》。在这件作品中，罗杰斯在阿塔卡马沙漠中用岩石创造了一个长达80米的地形图案。罗杰斯的作品是土地艺术运动的一部分，该运动中的艺术家拒绝艺术画廊的限制和商业化。这些艺术家通常在户外安装大型作品，常常选择意想不到的地点。
中文解析：
根据最后这个大型艺术品的产出地often in surprising locations，于是和A一致
exam_name: 2024年12月第8套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
Mexican textile artist Victoria Villasana weaves stories of triumph, using her unique method of applying colorful yarn to photographs of people. In some works, Villasana focuses on celebrating cultural icons who are people of color, as she does in her depiction of musician and composer Prince. However, in other works, Villasana honors ordinary people, as she does in her captivating portrayal of a young girl sitting on a sidewalk. Villasana sees both of these approaches as ways of depicting the power and interconnectedness of all people.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It introduces Villasana’s cultural background, describes how this background influences her art, and then outlines some of her ideas for future projects.
B. It compares Villasana to other contemporary artists, indicates how two of her works are similar, and then emphasizes Villasana’s enthusiasm for artistic collaboration.
C. It explains how yarn has historically been used in art, details how Villasana uses yarn in her artworks, and then comments on the popularity of her work.
D. It provides details about Villasana’s artworks, discusses specific examples of her work, and relates them to one of her artistic goals.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
墨西哥纺织艺术家维多利亚·维拉萨纳（Victoria Villasana）通过她独特的方法，将色彩斑斓的纱线应用于人物照片，编织出胜利的故事。在一些作品中，维拉萨纳专注于庆祝作为有色人种的文化偶像，例如她对音乐家和作曲家普林斯（Prince）的描绘。然而，在其他作品中，维拉萨纳则致敬普通人，比如她对坐在人行道上的小女孩的引人注目的刻画。维拉萨纳将这两种方法视为描绘所有人之间力量和相互联系的方式。
中文解析：
文本开端是介绍艺术手法，然后是两类例子，最后是艺术目标，和D选项一致
exam_name: 2024年12月第8套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
Lessons from previous declines in biodiversity can help shape policy recommendations aimed at preserving species at risk. The factors that contributed to the extinction of the shrub-ox around 9500 BCE may also be________ endangered species today.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
从以往生物多样性下降中获得的教训可以帮助形成旨在保护濒危物种的政策建议。大约公元前9500年导致灌木牛的灭绝的因素也可能________今天的濒危物种。
中文解析：
根据第一句先前物种减少的研究help shape policy...可以推断一些因素对现如今依旧是适用的，选择applicable to
exam_name: 2024年12月第8套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
Studies conducted in individual Western societies have demonstrated associations between personality traits and five musical factors (mellowness, unpretentiousness, sophistication, intensity, and contemporariness) underlying individual preferences for styles of Western music. To investigate these associations across cultures, David M. Greenberg et al. collected music-preference assessments for Western genres and self-reported personality traits from participants in fifty-three countries across six continents. The study confirmed that the five-factor framework accurately captured participants’ tastes in Western music, and, moreover, the study found similar correlations between patterns of these factors and of personality traits, suggesting that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the five-factor framework can likely be used to predict preferences for non-Western music styles based on personality traits even if the characteristics of those styles substantially differ from characteristics of Western music styles.
B. the strength of the relationship between personality traits and musical preferences varies less across cultures than researchers had previously assumed.

C. people with a relatively high degree of familiarity with Western music styles are likely to express stronger preferences for those styles than people with a relatively low degree of familiarity with those styles are.
D. across cultural contexts, people who share similar profiles of personality traits tend to prefer listening to similar types of music styles.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在个别西方社会进行的研究表明，人格特征与五种音乐因素（温和性、朴实性、复杂性、强烈性和现代性）之间存在关联，这些因素在个体对西方音乐风格的偏好中起着基础作用。为了跨文化地研究这些关联，David M. Greenberg等人在六大洲的五十三个国家收集了对西方音乐流派的音乐偏好评估和参与者自我报告的人格特征。研究确认了五因素框架准确捕捉了参与者对西方音乐的品味。此外，研究还发现这些因素与人格特征模式之间存在相似的相关性，这表明________。
中文解析：
根据文本personalities和preference for music相关，同时样本支撑范围涉及participants in fifty-three countries across six continents，于是说明across cultural context，相似的personality traits倾向于相似的音乐
exam_name: 2024年12月第8套阅读语法（只录M1，M2和第6套重复）

question:
Like many other bird species that live only on the Hawaiian archipelago, the ‘akeke‘e has adapted to life in a well-defined habitat, resulting in highly specialized physical and behavioral characteristics that aid the species in survival. However, because the ‘akeke‘e is highly specialized, it is especially vulnerable to environmental changes that can disrupt the delicately balanced ecosystem in which it lives.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Hawaiian birds display a unique range of physical and behavioral characteristics and as a result can only live in habitats unique to the Hawaiian archipelago.
B. The ‘akeke‘e is an example of a species unique to the Hawaiian archipelago that is highly specialized and therefore particularly susceptible to habitat disturbances.
C. The ‘akeke‘e is a species of bird that is related to many other Hawaiian birds but does not share a habitat with any of them.
D. The ‘akeke‘e is an example of a highly specialized bird species found only on the Hawaiian archipelago and is related to several other highly specialized bird species found there.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
与许多只生活在夏威夷群岛的鸟类一样，‘akeke‘e（夏威夷小鹀）已适应于特定的栖息环境，这导致了其高度专业化的身体和行为特征，从而帮助该物种生存。然而，由于‘akeke‘e的高度专业化，它特别容易受到环境变化的影响，这些变化可能会破坏其所栖息的微妙平衡的生态系统。
中文解析：

question:
The oceanic whitetip shark and the Pacific halibut are ectothermic (cold-blooded) fish, whereas the shortfin mako shark and the yellowfin tuna are regional endotherms—they retain metabolic heat resulting in body temperatures above the ambient water temperature. Modeling the effect of falling ambient temperatures on ectotherms indicated to researchers Haley R. Dolton and colleagues that ectotherms’ body temperatures inexorably decrease toward the ambient temperature. Data from wild basking sharks show that even though their body temperature consistently remains 1.0 to 1.5℃ above ambient, it also declines as the ambient temperature falls. This suggests that the body temperatures of the ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. yellowfin tuna and the shortfin mako shark are likely to be more variable than the body temperature of the basking shark.
B. Pacific halibut and the basking shark are at least partly determined by the ambient water temperature.

C. basking shark and the shortfin mako shark remain fixed even as ambient water temperature changes, while the body temperature of the Pacific halibut changes with variations in the ambient water temperature.

D. basking shark and the yellowfin tuna remain fixed even if the ambient water temperature changes, while the body temperature of the oceanic whitetip shark varies even if the ambient temperature is stable.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
海洋白鳍鲨和太平洋比目鱼是变温动物（冷血动物），而短鳍马科鲨和黄鳍金枪鱼则是区域内温动物——它们能够保持代谢产生的热量，从而使体温高于周围水温。关于环境温度下降对变温动物的影响的模型研究表明，变温动物的体温不可避免地向环境温度下降。来自野生晒鲨的数据表明，尽管它们的体温始终保持在比环境温度高1.0到1.5℃，但随着环境温度的下降，它们的体温也会下降。这表明______的体温。
中文解析：
根据文本对于鱼类冷血还是恒温的划分标准（比如高于周围水温，受水温升降影响等），basking shark满足比周围水温略高，那么他们属于冷血动物的缘由就一定是收到周围水温的影响，选择B选项。

question:
In 1879, in an effort to determine the longevity of certain seeds left in soil, botanist William Beal buried 20 glass bottles filled with sand and seeds from a variety of plants, including Verbascum, Lepidium virginicum, and Stellaria media. Since then, some of the bottles have been retrieved in the periodic checks of seed viability researchers are conducting. After 60 years had elapsed, most of the seeds in those bottles stopped germinating, but Verbascum seeds have remained viable, including those from a bottle dug up in 2021 by Margaret Fleming, Lars Brudvig, and colleagues.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To discuss an ongoing experiment
B. To explain how to get rid of certain plants
C. To compare two experiments addressing the same questions
D. To describe difficulties associated with preserving seeds
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在1879年，植物学家威廉·比尔（William Beal）为了确定某些种子在土壤中的存活时间，埋藏了20个装满沙子和多种植物种子的玻璃瓶，其中包括毛蕊花（Verbascum）、维吉尼亚紫菜（Lepidium virginicum）和星星草（Stellaria media）。此后，在种子活力研究者定期进行的检查中，一些瓶子被取出。经过60年，大多数瓶子里的种子停止了发芽，但毛蕊花的种子仍然保持活力，包括2021年由玛格丽特·弗莱明（Margaret Fleming）、拉尔斯·布鲁德维希（Lars Brudvig）和同事们挖掘出的一个瓶子中的种子。
中文解析：
文本描述了一个测试种子的实验，并且覆盖了较长的时间ongoing experiment

question:

• In the second alteration, the tunic had no pattern.
• Participants were asked to identify the correct version.
• 86.9% of participants selected the unaltered image, and 13.1% selected an altered version.

The student wants to emphasize how many participants selected an altered version of Fred Flintstone. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. When participants were asked to identify the correct version of Fred Flintstone, 86.9% selected the unaltered image.
B. A 2021 study showed participants an unaltered image of Fred Flintstone, who is a cartoon man in a spotted tunic, alongside two altered versions.
C. Participants were asked to identify the correct version of Fred Flintstone, who is a cartoon man in a spotted tunic.
D. When shown three versions of Fred Flintstone and asked to select the correct one, 13.1% of participants chose an altered version.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，学生做了以下笔记：

• 弗雷德·弗林斯通是一个穿着斑点外衣的卡通男人。
• 在第一次修改中，外衣的图案是条纹状的。
• 在第二次修改中，外衣没有任何图案。

• 86.9%的参与者选择了未修改的图像，13.1%的参与者选择了一个修改过的版本。

题目问多少人选择了altered version，根据notes最后一条，13.1%选择了，对应了D选项

question:

• Umami is triggered by the compounds in a variety of foods, including tuna and garlic.
• Participants in a study tasted a sample of North Pacific konbu, a type of brown seaweed.
• They rated its umami intensity as moderate.
• The participants tasted a sample of arame, another type of brown seaweed.
• They rated its umami intensity as high.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two seaweeds. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Although North Pacific konbu and arame are types of brown seaweed, the latter’s umami flavor is more intense.
B. Some types of brown seaweed, like North Pacific konbu and arame, trigger umami flavor in human taste buds.
C. While North Pacific konbu and arame contain umami flavor, umamic an also be found in tuna and garlic.
D. North Pacific konbu is a type of brown seaweed, but so is arame.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一位学生做了以下笔记：
• 人类的舌头含有感知一种丰富、鲜美味道的味觉受体，这种味道被称为“鲜味”（umami）。
• 鲜味是由多种食物中的化合物触发的，包括金枪鱼和大蒜。
• 一项研究中的参与者品尝了北太平洋昆布（konbu）的样本，这是一种褐色海藻。
• 他们将其鲜味强度评为中等。
• 参与者还品尝了另一种褐色海藻——阿拉梅（arame）的样本。
• 他们将其鲜味强度评为高。
中文解析：
题目要求emphasize a difference，只有A选项比较了两种brown seaweed flavor，用umani衡量了arame比konbu更加intense。

• It was believed to be extinct until a living specimen was identified in New Zealand in 2004.
• Catagonus wagneri is a mammal species.
• It was believed to be extinct until a living specimen was identified in Argentina in 1974.
• They are considered Lazarus species.
• “Lazarus species” is a term for living species of organisms that were once believed to be extinct.

The student wants to specify where Hadramphus tuberculatus was identified. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In 1974, a living specimen of Catagonus wagneri was found in Argentina.
B. A living specimen of Hadramphus tuberculatus, once believed to be extinct, was identified in 2004.
C. Previously believed to be extinct, a living specimen of Hadramphus tuberculatus was identified in New Zealand.
D. Examples of Lazarus species can be found in Hadramphus tuberculatus as well as Catagonus wagneri.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
•Hadramphus tuberculatus 是一种昆虫物种。
•它曾被认为已经灭绝，直到2004年在新西兰发现了一只活体标本。
•Catagonus wagneri 是一种哺乳动物物种。
•它曾被认为已经灭绝，直到1974年在阿根廷发现了一只活体标本。
•它们被视为“拉撒路物种”。
•“拉撒路物种”是指曾被认为灭绝的生物种类，但实际上仍然存在的生物物种。
中文解析：
题目要求specify 地点，根据notes第二条，本以为Hadramphus tuberculatus灭绝了，知道一个发现在新西兰

question: A right rectangular prism has a base area of 16t square centimeters <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <msup> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi data-mjx-auto-op="false">cm</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow></math>.The length of the base of the rectangular prism is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>8</mn> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac></math> cm, and the height of the rectangular prism is 9 cm. question:

question:

In art class, his favorite hour of the week, he carves his name with paper clips into the bottoms of clay cups and bowls. He pastes uncooked pasta to cardboard, and leaves his signature in fat brush strokes below paintings.
