question:
Some ethicists challenge the concept of personal character, claiming that if it were meaningful, situational factors could not, as they clearly can, induce behavior contrary to that character. As Rachana Kamtekar observes, this argument is difficult to reconcile with our lay conception of character: we expect a person of helpful character to be frequently helpful, not ________ helpful.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本解析：
一些伦理学家质疑个人品格的概念，声称如果品格有意义，那么情境因素就不可能像现在这样，促使行为与该品格相悖。正如拉查娜·卡姆泰卡（Rachana Kamtekar）所观察到的，这一论点难以与我们对品格的普通理解相调和：我们期望一个有帮助品格的人经常表现出帮助行为，而不是______帮助。
中文解析：
我们期望乐于助人的人经常表现帮助别人，而非要求他们每一次都毫无例外地帮助也，就是允许情境因素影响。这正好反驳了第一句伦理学家的论点，他们用“偶尔违反性格”来否定性格概念，但大众并不要求完美一致性。unfailingly始终如一地，完美从不失败，不要选sporadically，我们期望频繁帮助，而不是偶尔帮助，这不符合伦理学家质疑的逻辑，反而变成了支持！
exam_name: 2024年11月第6套阅读语法（只保留M1，M2和第5套重复）

question:
The following text is from Julia Alvarez’s 2000 novel In the Name of Salomé. Salomé, a poet, is hosting guests in the front parlor of her family home, and Ramona is her sister. A salon is a social gathering for the exploration of intellectual ideas.
It was evening when the two men got up to leave. Tía Ana had already come into the room several times to see if these guests had departed yet. The front parlor had always been her special province, as she used it for her little school. Now, every evening, it turned into Salomé’s salon, as Ramona called it, and it was never in order for its transformation back to a classroom the following morning.
©2000 by Julia Alvarez

Which choice best describes the function of the reference to the parlor as Tía Ana’s “special province”?
selections: A. It conveys that Tía Ana feels honored that her classroom is used for important events.
B. It characterizes the room as a place where Tía Ana can go to escape social pressures.
C. It reveals that Tía Ana feels as if Salomé has betrayed her trust by allowing guests into a space she considers her own.
D. It introduces an idea that helps explain Tía Ana’s apparent eagerness for Salomé’s guests to leave the space.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字摘自朱莉娅·阿尔瓦雷斯（Julia Alvarez）2000年出版的小说《以撒洛梅之名》（In the Name of Salomé）。萨洛梅是一位诗人，她正在家中的前客厅招待客人，而拉莫娜是她的妹妹。沙龙是一个供人探索智识思想的社交聚会。
到了晚上，那两个男客人起身准备离开。阿娜姨已经好几次进来看看客人是否已经离开。前客厅一直是她的“专属领域”，因为她用它来教她的小学。现在，每个晚上，这里变成了萨洛梅的沙龙，正如拉莫娜所称的那样，而它总是杂乱无章，无法为第二天早晨的教室转变做好准备。
中文解析：
Ana几次去看客人们是否走了，因为这个地方是她的private province，于是凸显了急迫的期待这群客人离开
exam_name: 2024年11月第6套阅读语法（只保留M1，M2和第5套重复）

question:
Known for the albums E.S.P. and ’Round About Midnight, jazz trumpeter Miles Davis collaborated several times with pianist Gil Evans. Their 1958 adaptation of George Gershwin’s opera Porgy and Bess bears little resemblance to the 1935 original. Davis and Evans felt no desire to please listeners expecting an exact duplication of the opera. They omitted parts, such as the aria “I Got Plenty of Nuthin,” and sometimes made only brief gestures toward Gershwin’s melodies. But Davis and Evans’s willingness to recompose Gershwin’s work led to one of the most enduring albums in Davis’s catalog.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To summarize the history of a long collaboration between two artists
B. To describe how two artists transformed another artist’s work
C. To explain why works of art most likely to be praised by critics are those that defy tradition
D. To present reasons why one work of art should be considered superior to another
explanations:
题目中文翻译：
以专辑《E.S.P.》和《’Round About Midnight》闻名的爵士小号手迈尔斯·戴维斯（Miles Davis）曾多次与钢琴家吉尔·埃文斯（Gil Evans）合作。他们1958年改编的乔治·格什温（George Gershwin）歌剧《波基与贝丝》（Porgy and Bess）与1935年的原版几乎没有相似之处。戴维斯和埃文斯并不希望取悦那些期待歌剧精确复制的听众。他们删减了一些部分，比如咏叹调《I Got Plenty of Nuthin》，并且有时仅仅是短暂地触及格什温的旋律。然而，戴维斯和埃文斯愿意重新编排格什温的作品，最终造就了戴维斯音乐目录中最具持久影响力的专辑之一。
中文解析：
文本描述了jazz trumpeter Miles Davis collaborated with pianist Gil Evans，一起改版了George Gershwin’s opera Porgy and Bess，效果很好，于是讲艺术家的名字高度概括后和B选项保持一致
exam_name: 2024年11月第6套阅读语法（只保留M1，M2和第5套重复）

One antipredator defense that the grey-headed lapwing uses to protect its nest and young chicks is called “broken-wing display”; this form of deceptive defense involves an adult bird pretending to be injured and unable to fly in order to distract an approaching predator. Broken-wing display has been documented in 285 bird species from 13 different avian orders. A student predicts that bird species with mean body masses greater than 150 grams do not use deceptive defenses because larger birds tend to be more effective than smaller birds at using aggressive defenses to protect nests from predators, making deceptive defenses unnecessary.

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table that weaken the student’s prediction?
selections: A. The common ringed plover uses broken-wing display, but the pied-billed grebe does not.
B. The pied-billed grebe has a mean body mass of 409 grams and is known to perform broken-wing display.
C. The common snipe uses broken-wing display even though it is larger than the common ringed plover.
D. The common snipe and the common ringed plover both have a mean body mass under 150 grams and use broken-wing display.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
灰头鴴（grey-headed lapwing）用来保护巢穴和幼鸟的一种抗捕食者防御方式叫做“假伤翅展示”（broken-wing display）；这种欺骗性防御方式涉及成年鸟类假装受伤，无法飞行，以此来分散接近的捕食者的注意力。假伤翅展示已经在来自13个不同鸟类目中的285个鸟类物种中有所记录。一名学生预测，体重大于150克的鸟类物种不会使用欺骗性防御，因为较大的鸟类通常比较小的鸟类更擅长使用攻击性防御来保护巢穴免受捕食者的侵害，因此不需要使用欺骗性防御。
中文解析：
题目最后的prediction是体重超出150克就不会用deceptive dense，但是根据图表pied-billed grebe的体重达到409g，依旧有Broken-Wing Display由此可以反驳文本最后一句的结论。
exam_name: 2024年11月第6套阅读语法（只保留M1，M2和第5套重复）

question:
The Age of Innocence is a 1920 novel by Edith Wharton set in 1870s New York City. In the novel, Newland Archer attends an opera. The narrator describes Newland’s tendency to follow the social conventions dictated by other men of New York City society who are in the audience:________

Which quotation from The Age of Innocence best illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “Singly [the men around Newland] betrayed their inferiority; but grouped together they represented ‘New York,’ and the habit of masculine solidarity made him accept their doctrine on all the issues called moral.”
B. “Newland Archer, leaning against the wall at the back of the club box [where his seat was], turned his eyes from the stage and scanned the opposite side of the house.”

C. “Newland Archer felt himself distinctly the superior of these chosen specimens of old New York gentility; he had probably read more, thought more, and even seen a good deal more of the world, than any other man of the number.”
D. “No expense had been spared on the setting, which was acknowledged to be very beautiful even by people who shared her feelings about the undesirability of having anything to do with the house.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《天真时代》是艾迪丝·沃顿（Edith Wharton）于1920年发表的一部小说，故事发生在1870年代的纽约市。在小说中，纽兰·阿彻（Newland Archer）参加了一场歌剧。叙述者描述了纽兰有倾向遵循纽约市社会中其他男性所规定的社交惯例，具体如下______
中文解析：
文本最后说Newland’s tendency to follow the social conventions dictated by other men of New York City society，于是A中的masculine solidarity made him accept their doctrine就是对应了文本的内容，只是表达方式略有差异。
exam_name: 2024年11月第6套阅读语法（只保留M1，M2和第5套重复）

question:
When people think of dinosaurs with feathers, they typically think of winged dinosaurs, such as the four-winged Microraptor. However, many dinosaurs that didn’t have wings also had feathers on their bodies. For instance, research indicates that the wingless, speedy Ornithomimus likely had feathers.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It explains the scientific debate about the finding discussed in the previous sentence.
B. It points out several weaknesses in the theory presented in the previous sentence.
C. It identifies the researchers who made the discovery mentioned in the previous sentence.
D. It provides a specific example of the dinosaurs described in the previous sentence.
explanations:

question:
Optimal foraging theory (OFT) holds that animals’ foraging behaviors reflect cost-benefit trade-offs that vary by species and with dynamic ecological circumstances. One such circumstance is lunar intensity, which Rodrigo A. Vásquez found to be negatively associated with foraging by olive grass mice but Deborah J. Curtis and colleagues found to be positively associated with foraging by mongoose lemurs. This discrepancy is explicable in terms of OFT: the lemurs’ greater reliance on vision means that higher lunar intensity benefits them more than it benefits the mice.

Information in the text best supports which statement about OFT?
selections: A. It tends to allow for a better understanding of the benefits of ecological circumstances than the costs of those circumstances.
B. It can account for observations of different species responding differently to similar ecological circumstances.
C. It can explain why some species act in accordance with cost-benefit trade-offs and others do not.
D. It may be weakened by the finding that the costs and benefits associated with a particular ecological circumstance vary by species.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
最佳觅食理论（OFT）认为，动物的觅食行为反映了成本-效益的权衡，这种权衡因物种和动态生态环境的不同而有所变化。其中一个环境因素是月光强度，罗德里戈·A·瓦斯克斯（Rodrigo A. Vásquez）发现，月光强度与橄榄草鼠的觅食呈负相关，而黛博拉·J·柯蒂斯（Deborah J. Curtis）及其同事则发现，月光强度与狐猴的觅食呈正相关。这个差异可以用最佳觅食理论来解释：狐猴更依赖视力，因此较强的月光对它们的益处大于对草鼠的益处。
中文解析：
最后依据指出OFT其实能够解释为啥同样是lunar intensity（similar ecologic circumstance），不同的动物表现不一样，和B选项一致

● It was established to protect the endangered dusky seaside sparrow.
● The Bitter Creek NWR is a 14,054-acre area in California, on the Pacific coast.
● It was established to protect the endangered California condor.

The student wants to contrast the two NWRs. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Some NWRs were established specifically to protect endangered species such as the California condor.
B. Both the St. Johns NWR and the Bitter Creek NWR were established to protect endangered species.
C. While the St. Johns NWR is in Florida, on the Atlantic coast, the Bitter Creek NWR is in California, on the Pacific coast.
D. The US has designated more than 500 areas NWRs, including the St. Johns NWR in Florida.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
● 美国已指定超过500个地区为国家野生动物保护区（NWRs）。
● 一些NWR是专门为了保护濒危物种而设立的。

● 该保护区的设立是为了保护濒危的昏暗海滨雀。
● 苦溪国家野生动物保护区（Bitter Creek NWR）位于加利福尼亚州，位于太平洋沿岸，占地14,054英亩。
● 该保护区的设立是为了保护濒危的加利福尼亚秃鹰。

题目要求对比two NWRs，根据notes，两个NWRs大小和位置不同，于是C有效的对比了位置

explanations:

selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>8</mn> <mn>13</mn> </mfrac> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>90</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>

explanations: Radian弧度和角度degree比例为π/180，故<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>8</mn> <mn>13</mn> </mfrac> <mo>∗</mo> <mn>180</mn> <mo>∗</mo> <mn>3</mn></math> 选B

The given equation, where t is a positive constant, defines a circle in the xy-plane. The radius of this circle is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><mn>41</mn></msqrt></math> . What is the value of t?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>t</mi><mi>z</mi></mfrac><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>39</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> ，根据半径<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><mn>41</mn></msqrt></math> 整理成圆标准形式为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>t</mi><mn>4</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>t</mi><mn>4</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>41</mn></math> ，此式展开得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>t</mi><mi>z</mi></mfrac><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mn>16</mn></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mn>41</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> ，故<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mn>16</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></math> ，t=±4，取正数4

question: Line k is shown in the xy-plane. question: A polygonal chain is a connected series of line segments whose length is defined as the sum of the lengths of the line segments it is made of. A polygonal chain with a length of 33 centimeters (cm) is extended by adding line segments that each have a length of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>8</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mi>r</mi></math> cm. Which function f represents the total length, in cm, of the extended polygonal chain after x line segments are added?
selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>33</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>8</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mi>r</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>+</mo> <mi>x</mi></math>

D. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>41</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mi>r</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mi>x</mi></math>
explanations: 根据题意，每增加一个segment，多出长度为（8-r），斜率8-r。初始值33， f (x) = (8－r) x+33，整理得到f (x) = 8x－rx + 33，选B

question: For a study, a group of chipmunks will be selected from a habitat consisting of 220 chipmunks, and a group of prairie dogs will be selected from a habitat consisting of 190 prairie dogs. Some of the chipmunks and prairie dogs will be in a treatment group, and some of the chipmunks and prairie dogs will be in a control group. Which of the following is necessary for this study to attempt to establish a cause-and-effect relationship between two variables?
selections: A. The number of chipmunks in the treatment group is equal to the number of prairie dogs in the treatment group, and the number of chipmunks in the control group is equal to the number of prairie dogs in the control group.
B. The chipmunks and the prairie dogs are randomly assigned to the treatment and control groups.
C. The chipmunks and the prairie dogs are randomly selected from their respective habitats.

D. The average age of the chipmunks in the treatment group is equal to the average age of the prairie dogs in the treatment group, and the average age of the chipmunks in the control group is equal to the average age of the prairie dogs in the control group.
explanations: 科学实验的基本原则之一是对被实验对象进行随机的分配，该题中需要随机将不同的实验对象分配到对照组control group和实验组treatment group中，故选B

question: A certain investment account offers a special interest rate for the first 4 months the account is open followed by a lower interest rate for the remainder of the time the account is open. Akeyla opened one of these accounts with an original account balance of $700.00 and did not make any other deposits or withdrawals. 4 months after Akeyla opened the account, the balance had increased by 0.6% of the original balance. 6 months after Akeyla opened the account, the balance had increased by an additional 0.1% of the balance at the end of the first 4 months. Every 2 months after the first 6 months, the balance had increased by an additional 0.1% of the balance 2 months before. Which of the following equations could represent the account balance <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>B</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, in dollars, x months after the account was opened, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>≥</mo> <mn>4</mn></math>?
selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>B</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>704.20</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1.001</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>4</mn> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> </mrow> </msup></math>

B. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>B</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>700.00</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1.001</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>4</mn> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> </mrow> </msup></math>

C. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>B</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>704.20</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1.001</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> </mrow> </msup></math>

D. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>B</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>700.00</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1.001</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> </mrow> </msup></math>
explanations: 根据题意，初始值700，之后的四个月每月增加0.6%得初始值（注意这里不是指数变化），四个月后数据为700=704.2,4个月后，每2个月（周期为2）增加率为0.1%，故选A

question: For the linear function g, the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> in the xy-plane has a slope of 5 and passes through the point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>47</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> . Which equation defines g?
explanations: 斜率5过（2，47）代入点到斜率为5的选项验证可得D

question: Exactly how many x-intercepts does the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>10</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>11</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>3</mn> </msup></math> have in the xy-plane, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>?
explanations: 根据因式判断x=0，10，11时函数值为0，故x-intercepte有3个值，选D

question: In triangle RST, the measure of angle R is 29 degrees. Which statement provides sufficient information to prove that triangle RST is isosceles?
selections: A. The measure of angle S is 151 degrees.
B. The measure of angle S is 61 degrees.
C. The measure of angle S is 58 degrees.
D. The measure of angle S is 29 degrees.
explanations: 等腰三角形两个角相等，D可以支持（（180-29）/2也可以，但不在选项中），选D

question: A chemist combines 30 grams of compound A, 45 grams of compound B, and x grams of compound C. The resulting mixture has a mass of 135 grams. What is the value of x?
explanations: 根据题意，A为30，B为45，C为x，总计135，故30+45+x=135，x=60，选D

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>15</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>15</mn></math>
What is the least value of x that is a solution to the given equation?
explanations: 两侧平方后等式两侧相等（但平方得前提是两侧数值都是非负数，故x≥-15），故x的最小值取-15，选B

question: As the size of a firework’s shell increases, the height above the ground when the firework bursts increases. For a firework to burst 1,075 feet above the ground, a firework’s shell in the shape of a sphere with a volume of 542.68 cubic inches could be used. To the nearest whole number, what is the volume of this firework’s shell in cubic centimeters? (1 inch = 2.54 centimeters)
explanations: 本题考察的其实是单位换算，将体积单位的cubic inches转换成cubic centimeters，注意是三维立体形状，用立方计算， <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>542.68</mn> <mtext> cubic inches </mtext> <mo>∗</mo> <mfrac> <msup> <mn>2.54</mn> <mn>3</mn> </msup> <msup> <mn>1</mn> <mn>3</mn> </msup> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mn>8892.9</mn></math> ，四舍五入取整取8893

question: The mass of object A is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>498</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> of the mass of object B, and the mass of object A is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>0.830</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> of the mass of object C. If the mass of object C is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>p</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math> of the mass of object B, what is the value of p?
explanations: 通过文字表述可得等式：A=4.98B，且A=0.0083C，代入运算得C=600B=60000%B,故p=60000

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnalign="right left right left right left right left right left right left" columnspacing="0em 2em 0em 2em 0em 2em 0em 2em 0em 2em 0em" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="3pt"><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd><mfrac><mn>4</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mn>6</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>g</mi></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd><mfrac><mn>8</mn><mn>13</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>h</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>k</mi></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>
In the given system of equations, g, h, and k are constants. The system has infinitely many solutions. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>g</mi><mi>k</mi></mfrac></math> ?
explanations: 方程组无限解，意味着两个一次方程完全相同，系数和常数都对应成比例，所以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>/</mo></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>4</mn><mrow><mo>/</mo></mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>8</mn><mrow><mo>/</mo></mrow><mn>13</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>13</mn><mrow><mo>/</mo></mrow><mn>10</mn></math>

question: The function f is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mi>a</mi> <mi>x</mi> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mi>b</mi></math>, where a and b are constants. In the xy-plane, the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> passes through the points <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mo>,</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>c</mi> <mo>,</mo> <mn>117</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, where c is a constant. Which of the following could be the value of b?
explanations: 将点 (c,7) 和(2c,117)代入函数中得到两个方程，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>a</mi> <mi>c</mi> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mi>b</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>7</mn></math> 和<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>a</mi> <mrow> <mn>2</mn> <mi>c</mi> </mrow> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mi>b</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>117</mn></math>，消去变量b得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>a</mi> <mi>c</mi> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mi>a</mi> <mrow> <mn>2</mn> <mi>c</mi> </mrow> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mn>117</mn></math> ，设<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi> </mrow> </mrow> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi> </mrow></math> 化简得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>t</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi> </mrow> <mo>−</mo> <mn>110</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>0</mn></math>，解得t=11 or -10，因此计算得到b=4 or -17，选A

question: A right rectangular prism has a base area of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>16</mn> <mi>t</mi></math> square centimeters (<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>). The length of the base of the rectangular prism is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>8</mn> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac></math> cm, and the height of the rectangular prism is 9 cm. Which expression represents the surface area, in <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>, of the right rectangular prism?
explanations: 正方体底面积16t，其中一个底边为8/3，另一个底边为6t，高为9，侧面积一共6个面组成，其中两个为16t，有两个面积为9*8/3=24，还有两个面积为9*6t，总的侧面积为2*16t+2*24+2*54t=140t+48，选B

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>34</mn><msup><mi>z</mi><mrow><mn>18</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><msup><mi>z</mi><mn>9</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>30</mn></math>
In the given expression, b is a positive integer. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>q</mi><msup><mi>z</mi><mn>9</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>r</mi></math> is a factor of the expression, where q and r are positive integers, what is the greatest possible value of b?
explanations: 因式中的q、r，都是整数，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>z</mi><mn>9</mn></msup></math> 设成x变成标准二次函数形式<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>34</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>30</mn></math>，设两个因式分别是qx+r和px+t，则b=pr+qt，b的最大值一定出现在p、r（或者q、t）取最大值的时候，即p=34，r=30，因式为（34x+1）和（x+30）时，所以b最大值为34*30+1*1=1021

question:
When minor planets are discovered, each is given a unique identification number, and some may be given a unique name, as in the case of 1083 Salvia, which was named after the plant genus that includes sages. Under current astronomical conventions, it is ________ for the discoverers to name their discoveries, but they are not required to do so; whether to assign a minor planet a name is entirely the choice of whoever discovers it.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
当小行星被发现时，每个小行星都会被赋予一个独特的识别编号，某些小行星可能会被赋予一个独特的名称，例如1083号小行星“Salvia”，它是以包含鼠尾草的植物属命名的。根据当前的天文学惯例，发现者给他们的发现命名是________，但并不是强制要求；是否为小行星赋予一个名称完全取决于发现者的选择。
中文解析：
最后一句中but前后对比，but前表示为自己发的星星命名是允许的，but后表示不强制，于是permissible和not required对应

question:
Lascaux Cave paintings—detailed paintings of animals found in what is now France and dating from around 17,000 years ago—are sometimes said to be emotionally powerful despite their age, but in fact the paintings are _____________ precisely because of their age. It is the link of shared humanity with the artists across so many centuries that gives the Lascaux Cave paintings such resonance.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译：
Lascaux洞穴壁画——发现于今法国，约在17,000年前的动物详细壁画——有时被认为在年代久远的情况下仍然具有情感力量，但事实上，正是因为它们的年代久远，这些壁画才显得___________。正是跨越如此多个世纪与艺术家们分享人类共同性的联系赋予了Lascaux洞穴壁画如此深远的共鸣。
中文解析：
在这个句子中，前文提到Lascaux Cave paintings是细致描绘动物的绘画作品，距今约17,000年，有时被认为尽管年代久远，但它们仍具有情感力量。后面句子指出，实际上这些绘画之所以具有共鸣正是因为它们的年代久远。使用"affecting"这个词恰当表达了这一点，指出这些绘画之所以有共鸣是因为它们依旧能够打动人。

question:
The following text is from Georgia Douglas Johnson’s 1918 poem “Peace.”
I rest me deep within the wood,
Drawn by its silent call,
Far from the throbbing crowd of men,
On nature’s breast I fall.

As used in the text, what does the word “drawn” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本来自乔治亚·道格拉斯·约翰逊于1918年创作的诗《和平》。
我在林中深深休憩，
被它宁静的召唤吸引，
远离人群的喧嚣，
我在大自然的怀抱中沉醉。
中文解析：
我在树林中，drawn by silent call, 这里的drawn是被吸引的意思，于是entice引诱符合要求

question:
Mexican textile artist Victoria Villasana weaves stories of triumph, using her unique method of applying colorful yarn to photographs of people. In some works, Villasana focuses on celebrating cultural icons who are people of color, as she does in her depiction of artist Frida Kahlo. However, in other works, Villasana honors ordinary people, as she does in her captivating portrayal of a young girl sitting on a sidewalk. Villasana sees both of these approaches as ways of depicting the power and interconnectedness of all people.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Villasana began her artistic career by painting portraits of famous people and then transitioned to depicting everyday people instead.
B. Villasana’s portrayal of a young girl sitting on a sidewalk focuses more on human connection than it does on human resilience.
C. Villasana’s works focus on recognizing both famous and everyday examples of human strength and connection.
D. Villasana’s depiction of Frida Kahlo receives more attention from scholars than her depiction of a young girl sitting on a sidewalk does.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
墨西哥纺织艺术家维多利亚·维拉萨纳通过独特的手法，将色彩缤纷的纱线应用于人物照片，编织出胜利的故事。在一些作品中，维拉萨纳专注于庆祝那些有色人种的文化偶像，比如她对艺术家弗里达·卡洛的描绘。然而，在其他作品中，维拉萨纳则向普通人致敬，例如她对坐在 sidewalk 上的小女孩的引人入胜的刻画。维拉萨纳认为这两种方法都是展现所有人之间力量与相互联系的方式。
中文解析：
段落however前后分别描述了不同作品里有关注icons，有关注ordinary people，于是符合C选项both famous and everyday examples.

question:
Some robots such as Surena (developed in 2008) and COMAN (developed in 2012) feature humanoid characteristics like bipedal locomotion so that people will find it easier to interact with them. While these features can help to __________ feelings of comfort in people, a robot that looks too like human can fall into the “uncanny valley,” meaning that its appearance unintentionally unsettles those who encounter it.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译：
一些机器人，比如2008年开发的Surena和2012年开发的COMAN，具有类似人类的特征，比如双足行走，以便人们更容易与它们互动。虽然这些特征可以帮助__________人们对舒适感的情感，但一个外貌过于类似人类的机器人可能会掉入“怪异山谷”，意味着它的外貌会无意中使那些遇到它的人感到不安。
中文解析：
在这个句子中，前文提到一些机器人具有类似人类的特征，比如双足行走，以便人们更容易与它们进行互动。然后，句子指出，虽然这些特征可以帮助在人们中引起舒适感，但如果一个机器人看起来太像人类，就会落入“诡异山谷”的概念，即其外貌会让那些遇到它的人感到不安。使用"engender"这个词恰当描述了这些特征引起的感觉，表明它们可以在人们中产生一种舒适感。

question:
Master and Commander, first published in 1969, is a novel in Patrick O’Brian’s Aubrey/Maturin series, which includes twenty books plus an unfinished fragment of a twenty-first. Like the rest of the books in the series, Master and Commander has a rather abrupt ending, but the following book, Post Captain, picks up neatly where Master and Commander leaves off. Thus, the sudden ending is only an issue if one considers the books as independent texts—the Aubrey/Maturin series is best thought of as a single incredibly long work, similar to other multivolume stories, such as John Galsworthy’s The Forsyte Saga.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It demonstrates that those readers who most enjoy reading Post Captain will be those who have just finished reading Master and Commander.
B. It argues that the Aubrey/Maturin series deserves the critical renown of works like The Forsyte Saga.
C. It offers a detail that helps explain why it is not necessarily the case that a certain characteristic of Master and Commander should be considered a flaw.
D. It presents a reason Master and Commander and Post Captain are considered to be two of O’Brian’s most engaging novels.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《舰长与指挥官》是帕特里克·奥布莱恩的奥布里/马图林系列小说中的第一部，首次出版于1969年。该系列包括二十本书以及一部未完成的二十一部作品的片段。和系列中的其他书籍一样，《舰长与指挥官》的结尾相当突然，但随后的书《副舰长》恰好接续了《舰长与指挥官》的情节。因此，这个突然的结局只有在将这些书视为独立文本时才会成为一个问题——奥布里/马图林系列最好被视为一部极其庞大的作品，类似于其他多卷故事，如约翰·高尔斯华绥的《福赛特家族》。
中文解析：
划线句具体给出了两部书前者仓促结尾，后者从前者结束处开启，这个细节可以告诉我们这并不是著作的缺点，我们应该把题目理解为连贯在一起的书籍，而不是单独来对待。

question:
In their meta-analysis of research on advergames (video games developed to promote products or services), Zeph M.C. van Berlo et al. confirm that such games, though they can elicit player interest, may not facilitate subsequent recall of product and brand information. This phenomenon can be explained by the finite nature of cognitive capacity as it is articulated in Annie Lang’s limited capacity model of motivated mediated message processing. In this case, players’ cognitive resources are directed foremost toward the advergame’s mechanics, leaving little or no capacity for encoding and storing the information the advertiser intends to be salient.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. The limited capacity model of motivated mediated message processing developed by Lang provides a means of explaining the finding by van Berlo et al. that players may not readily recollect the brand and product information embedded in advergames.
B. The meta-analysis by van Berlo et al. reveals that higher engagement in advergame mechanics is linked to lower effectiveness in persuading players to purchase particular brands and products.

C. Although the limited capacity model of motivated mediated message processing developed by Lang suggests otherwise, advergames can succeed as marketing tools, provided that they achieve a balance between game mechanics and the promotion of a brand or product.

D. Research by van Berlo et al. corroborates Lang’s conclusion that because people predominantly focus on game mechanics when playing video games, it is difficult for advergames to communicate brand and product information in ways that are highly memorable.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在对广告游戏（为推广产品或服务而开发的视频游戏）研究的元分析中，Zeph M.C. van Berlo 等人确认，这些游戏虽然能够激发玩家的兴趣，但可能并不促进对产品和品牌信息的后续记忆。这一现象可以通过安妮·朗的有限能力模型（limited capacity model of motivated mediated message processing）来解释，该模型阐述了认知能力的有限性。在这种情况下，玩家的认知资源主要集中在广告游戏的机制上，几乎没有或根本没有能力去编码和存储广告商希望突出的信息。
中文解析：
Annie Lang的limited capacity model可以用来解释Berlo的发现，也就是这类广告游戏的不足，就是玩家不太能留下对于产品的信息印象，因为人们的认知在advergame mechanics，没有能力去存储广告信息。和A选项是一致的。

question:
The following text is from José Rizal’s 1891 novel The Reign of Greed (translated by Charles Derbyshire in 1912).
A lady accompanied by her husband entered at that moment and took her place in one of the two vacant boxes. She had the air of a queen and gazed disdainfully at the whole house, as if to say,  “I’ve come later than all of you, you crowd of upstarts and provincials, I’ve come later than you!” There are persons who go to the theater like the contestants in a mule-race: the last one in, wins, and we know very sensible men who would ascend the scaffold rather than enter a theater before the first act.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It conveys the urgency some theater patrons feel to be the first ones to arrive at a performance.
B. It emphasizes a character’s desire to be an actor.
C. It helps explain why some people dislike attending theatrical performances.
D. It illustrates the lady’s contemptuous attitude toward the other people in the theater.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字摘自何塞·黎剎于1891年发表的小说《贪婪的统治》（由查尔斯·德比郡于1912年翻译）。
这时，一位女士和她的丈夫走了进来，坐在两个空包厢中的一个。她的气质如同女王，轻蔑地扫视着全场，仿佛在说：“我比你们这些小商贩和乡下人晚到了，你们都比我早！” 有些人去剧院就像参加骡子赛跑：最后到达的赢，而我们知道有些非常理智的人宁愿上绞刑架，也不愿在第一幕之前进入剧院。
中文解释：
这位姗姗来迟的女士，仿佛在骄傲的表达自己比别人来的晚，自己很重要，透露了他傲慢的态度，contemptuous表示轻蔑，蔑视

question:
Why do black-footed cats purr but leopards roar? Researchers hypothesize that this difference between the two feline species may be partly due to a U-shaped bone in their throats called the hyoid. Black-footed cats, which are much smaller than leopards, have a rigid hyoid that rumbles when the cat’s larynx vibrates, resulting in a purr. By contrast, leopards have a somewhat flexible hyoid, and the bone is attached to the skull with a stretchy ligament that black-footed cats lack. These traits allow leopards and most other species of big cats to produce powerful roars. The same traits may also prevent most big cats from purring.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Both black-footed cats and leopards have U-shaped hyoid bones, but black-footed cats’ hyoids are rigid whereas leopards’ hyoids are flexible.
B. Leopards and most other species of big cats can roar because they have flexible hyoid bones that are attached by stretchy ligaments to their skulls.
C. Researchers are uncertain why relatively small cats, such as black-footed cats, purr but relatively large cats, such as leopards, roar.
D. Differences related to the hyoid bone in black-footed cats and leopards may help explain why one species purrs and the other roars.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
为什么黑脚猫会咕噜咕噜叫，而豹子却会咆哮？研究人员假设，这两种猫科动物之间的差异可能部分是由于它们喉咙中的一个U形骨头，称为舌骨。黑脚猫体型远小于豹子，其舌骨是刚性的，当猫的喉头振动时，舌骨会发出隆隆声，从而产生咕噜声。相比之下，豹子的舌骨则稍微灵活，并且这个骨头通过一种黑脚猫所没有的弹性韧带与颅骨相连。这些特征使得豹子和其他大多数大型猫科动物能够发出强有力的咆哮。同样的特征也可能阻止大多数大型猫科动物发出咕噜声。
中文解析：
开头的问题和后面的解答说明了hyoid bone是两类动物不同叫声的关系原因。

question:

Which quotation from The Age of Innocence best illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “To come to the Opera in a [carriage for hire] was almost as honourable a way of arriving as in one’s own carriage.”
B. “[T]hinking over a pleasure to come often gave [Newland] a subtler satisfaction than its realisation.”

C. “When Newland Archer opened the door at the back of the club box the curtain had just gone up on the garden scene. There was no reason why the young man should not have come earlier, for he had dined at seven, alone with his mother and sister.”
D. “No expense had been spared on the setting, which was acknowledged to be very beautiful even by people who shared [Newland’s] acquaintance with the Opera houses of Paris and Vienna.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《天真的时代》是爱迪丝·华顿于1920年出版的一部小说，背景设定在1870年代的纽约市。在小说中，纽兰·阿彻迟到了歌剧演出，叙述者将这一点归因于纽兰对期待的享受：________
中文解析：
要去支持enjoyment of anticipation，于是选项需要有积极的态度和期待的对应表达，那么B符合要求，表达了满怀期待

question:
Mexican architect Luis Barragán’s prolific career, which spanned the 1920s to the 1980s, evolved through distinct phases. As epitomized by the Aguilar House in Guadalajara, many of Barragán’s first projects integrated traditional Mexican building techniques into Mediterranean designs. Extensive travels abroad later sparked an engagement with modernist and functionalist aesthetics—styles whose emphasis on utility and whose repudiation of traditional architecture’s more ornamental elements are readily apparent in Barragán’s house in Calle Guadiana.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It presents biographical information that accounts for the transition in Barragán’s career that is discussed in the text.
B. It notes why the two architectural projects described in the text constitute major departures from Barragán’s typical style.
C. It lends support to an argument about the Mediterranean design aesthetic that is made in the previous sentence.
D. It explains why the architectural project discussed later in the sentence was highly regarded by Barragán’s contemporaries.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
墨西哥建筑师路易斯·巴拉干（Luis Barragán）的一生创作丰硕，跨越了1920年代至1980年代，经历了不同的阶段。以位于瓜达拉哈拉的阿吉拉尔之家（Aguilar House）为例，巴拉干的许多早期项目将传统墨西哥建筑技艺融入地中海风格中。后来，他的广泛海外旅行引发了他对现代主义和功能主义美学的关注——这些风格强调实用性，否定传统建筑中较为华丽的元素，这一点在巴拉干位于瓜迪亚纳街（Calle Guadiana）的住宅中表现得尤为明显。
中文解析：
划线句子说明了巴拉甘的广泛旅行如何促使他开始接触现代主义和功能主义的美学风格，破折号后面说到了这一经历在他的Barragán’s house in Calle Guadiana表现的很明显，所以选A

question:
All stainless steel contains varying amounts of iron, carbon, and corrosion-inhibiting chromium. However, ferritic stainless steel, often used for cooking utensils, contains a higher percentage of chromium (at least 10.5%) than does austenitic stainless steel and a higher concentration of iron, which is responsible for its magnetic properties. Unlike ferritic stainless steel, austenitic stainless steel has a face-centered cubic crystalline structure resulting from the addition of nickel to the alloy. Austenitic stainless steel has two subtypes: the 200 series, often used for washing machines, and the 300 series, which has more nickel than the 200 series and is often used for mining and chemical equipment or compensators. Thus, stainless steel used to manufacture ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. cooking utensils will have greater magnetic properties than stainless steel used to manufacture mining and chemical equipment will.
B. mining and chemical equipment will have a concentration of chromium lower than 10.5%, while stainless steel used for washing machines will not.
C. cooking utensils will have a face-centered cubic crystalline structure.
D. compensators will likely have a similar crystalline structure to stainless steel used to manufacture cooking utensils.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
所有不锈钢都包含不同数量的铁、碳和防腐铬。然而，铁素体不锈钢（通常用于烹饪器具）含有比奥氏体不锈钢更高比例的铬（至少10.5%），并且含有更高浓度的铁，这使其具备磁性。与铁素体不锈钢不同，奥氏体不锈钢具有面心立方晶体结构，这是由于合金中添加了镍。奥氏体不锈钢有两个子类型：200系列，通常用于洗衣机，以及300系列，其镍含量比200系列更高，通常用于矿业和化工设备或补偿器。因此，用于制造______的不锈钢。
中文解析：
ferritic stainless steel用来做cooking utensils，is responsible for its magnetic properties，于是magnetic properties比例更高，mining and chemical equipment属于ferritic stainless steel， magnetic properties比例低。和A选项一致

question:
Cardiff, Wales, has installed engineered structures—mainly breakwalls—along 87% of its shoreline to protect infrastructure from storm surges and other hazards, a practice known as shoreline hardening. Investigating the impact of such structures on waterbird communities at various sites in the Chesapeake Bay on the US East Coast, Diann Prosser et al. hypothesized that shoreline hardening more negatively affects waterbirds than does land development for uses such as housing or agriculture. To evaluate the responses of local waterbird species, including the osprey, to landscape alterations, the researchers utilized the Index of Waterbird Community Integrity (IWCI), on which a low score corresponds to low community integrity.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers’ hypothesis?
selections: A. Waterbird communities at Back River, a site with a relatively high percentage of developed land and a relatively low percentage of hardened shoreline, had higher average IWCI scores than did waterbird communities at Margothy, a site with a lower percentage of developed land but a higher percentage of hardened shoreline.

B. Waterbird communities at Langford, a site with a relatively high percentage of developed land and a relatively low percentage of hardened shoreline, had lower average IWCI scores than did waterbird communities at Mill, a site with a lower percentage of developed land but a higher percentage of hardened shoreline.

C. Waterbird communities at Stony and Curtis, two sites with relatively high percentages of developed land and hardened shoreline, had similar IWCI scores, whereas waterbird communities at Ware and Honga, two sites with relatively low percentages of developed land and hardened shoreline, had widely differing IWCI scores.

D. Waterbird communities at Old Road, a site with a relatively high percentage of developed land and hardened shoreline, had lower average IWCI scores than did waterbird communities at Onancock,a site with a relatively low percentage of developed land and hardened shoreline.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
卡迪夫，威尔士，在其87%的海岸线上安装了工程结构——主要是防波堤，以保护基础设施免受风暴潮和其他危害，这种做法被称为海岸线硬化。Diann Prosser等人研究了这些结构对美国东海岸切萨皮克湾不同地点水鸟群落的影响，假设海岸线硬化对水鸟的负面影响大于土地开发（如住房或农业）。为了评估当地水鸟物种（包括鱼鹰）对景观变化的反应，研究人员使用了水鸟群落完整性指数（IWCI），该指数的低分数对应着较低的群落完整性。
中文解析：
根据这句重要的比较关系shoreline hardening more negatively affects waterbirds than does land development for uses such as housing or agriculture，以及后面IWCI和community integrity score的正比关系，我们可以得出如何developed land比例高，那么IWCI分数高，如果hardened shoreline比例高，那么IWCI分数低，那么就是A选项。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● The Carnegie Prize is an international art competition administered by the Carnegie Museum of Art in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
● Painter John Lavery of Ireland won a Carnegie Prize gold medal in 1896.
● Lavery’s winning artwork was a painting entitled Lady in Brown.
● Sculptor Alexander Calder of the US won a Carnegie Prize gold medal in 1958.
● Calder’s winning artwork was a sculpture entitled Mobile: Pittsburgh.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two artworks. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Both Lady in Brown and Mobile: Pittsburgh are Carnegie Prize gold medal-winning artworks.
B. Lavery, a painter, won a Carnegie Prize gold medal in 1896 for Lady in Brown.
C. The Carnegie Art Museum in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, has awarded Carnegie Prize gold medals to both painters and sculptors.
D. In contrast to Lady in Brown, a painting, Mobile: Pittsburgh is a sculpture.
explanations:
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
● 卡内基奖是由宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡的卡内基美术馆主办的国际艺术比赛。
● 爱尔兰画家约翰·拉弗里在1896年获得了卡内基奖金奖。
● 拉弗里的获奖作品是一幅名为《棕衣女士》的画作。
● 美国雕塑家亚历山大·卡尔德在1958年获得了卡内基奖金奖。
● 卡尔德的获奖作品是一件名为《移动：匹兹堡》的雕塑。
中文解析：
题目要求两部作品的共同点，那么根据notes两部作品都获得了Carnegie Prize的金奖。

question:

question:

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Freezers and other cooling technologies use chemical compounds called refrigerants to absorb heat and release cold air.
● When a refrigerant absorbs heat, it undergoes vaporization, changing from a liquid to a gas.
● When it cools, it undergoes condensation, changing from a gas to a liquid.
● The refrigerant fluoromethane is a hydrofluorocarbon (HFC).
● HFCs are composed of the elements hydrogen, fluorine, and carbon.

The student wants to describe the role of refrigerants in freezers. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Freezers can absorb heat and release cold air through vaporization and condensation.
B. The refrigerant fluoromethane, used in freezers, is made up of hydrogen, fluorine, and carbon.
C. Used in freezers, refrigerants such as fluoromethane can change from a gas to a liquid and back.
D. Freezers use refrigerants like fluoromethane to absorb heat and release cold air.

● 冰箱和其他冷却技术使用称为制冷剂的化学化合物来吸收热量并释放冷空气。
● 当制冷剂吸收热量时，它会经历汽化，从液体变为气体。
● 当它冷却时，会经历冷凝，从气体变为液体。
● 制冷剂氟甲烷是一种氢氟碳化合物（HFC）。
● HFC由氢、氟和碳三种元素组成。
中文解析：
题目要求描述role of refrigerants in freezers in freezers, 主要根据notes前两条，可以看出D符合要求，absorb and release cold air是其具体的功能。

question:
The star Wezen is unvaryingly bright, consistently ranking as one of the brightest stars in the sky (Wezen ranked 36th on a recent list). By contrast, the brightness of the red giant Betelgeuse varies considerably. Indeed, between April and June 2023, Betelgeuse became an astonishing 40% brighter; ________ its ranking rose from 10th to 7th.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
明星韦赞的亮度始终如一， consistently ranking as one of the brightest stars in the sky（韦赞在最近的一份名单中排名第36）。相比之下，红巨星贝塔星（Betelgeuse）的亮度变化很大。实际上，在2023年4月至6月之间，贝塔星的亮度惊人地增加了40%；_______ 它的排名从第10位上升到了第7位。
中文解析：
因为亮度增加了40%，所以排位也从第十长到了第七，前后属于应该关系，in turn前后可以连接因果，所以选B

question:
As disparate as their works may seem, commonalities exist between Antonello da Messina, Italian Renaissance painter of the Venetian ________ Flemish mannerist painter of the Antwerp School; and Jose Guerrero, American abstract painter of the New York School.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 并列事物内有逗号，需要higher level的并列用分号隔开，三个人物和所属的school内部用逗号，彼此间并列用分号

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Balcony House in southwestern Colorado is a former Ancestral Puebloan settlement.
● It was built underunderneath a rock overhang on the side of a cliff and inhabited from approximately 727-1016 CE.
● Pueblo Bonito in northwestern New Mexico is another former Ancestral Puebloan settlement.
● It was constructed on a relatively flat plain and inhabited from approximately 828-1126 CE.
● The Ancestral Puebloan civilization was the precursor of modern Pueblo tribal nations.

The student wants to contrast Balcony House and Pueblo Bonito. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Balcony House was built underneath a rock overhang on the side of a cliff, whereas Pueblo Bonito was built on a relatively flat plain.
B. In contrast to Balcony House, Pueblo Bonito was built underneath a rock overhang on the side of a cliff.
C. Although they were once occupied by the Ancestral Puebloan civilization, Balcony House and Pueblo Bonito are no longer inhabited.
D. Unlike Balcony House, Pueblo Bonito was constructed by the Ancestral Puebloan civilization, the precursor of modern Pueblo tribal nations.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
● 科罗拉多州西南部的阳台屋是一个前印第安人普韦布洛人的定居点，位于悬崖的边缘。
● 新墨西哥州西北部的普韦布洛博尼托是另一个前印第安人普韦布洛人的定居点。
● 它建造在一个相对平坦的平原上，居住时间大约从公元828年到1126年。
● 印第安人普韦布洛文明是现代普韦布洛部落国家的前身。
中文解析：
根据题目要求contrast，于是参考notes前两条可以得出结论Balcony House和Pueblo Bonito的地点是有差异，A选项描述了两者差别

question:
Although Hawaiian literature is highly heterogeneous in many ways, it is also characterized by considerable thematic ________: scholars have drawn connections linking works by writers such as Mary Kawena Pukui and Gary Pak to the traditional stories of the Kanaka Maoli, the Native Hawaiian people.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管夏威夷文学在许多方面具有高度的异质性，但它也以相当明显的主题______为特征：学者们将玛丽·卡维娜·普库伊和加里·帕克等作家的作品与本土夏威夷人民（Kanaka Maoli）的传统故事联系起来。
中文解析：
和前文的heterogeneous对比，同时和后面的connection linking表达相似的意义，冒号是提示线索，于是选continuity。

question:
When discussing literary movements in Spain, scholars regularly characterize the works of Miguel de Unamuno as especially representative of the Generation of ’98. The reasons for this characterization may seem ________, but linking Unamuno with the Generation of ’98 risks disregarding the subtleties in his style that do not neatly conform to the conventions of this literary movement.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在讨论西班牙的文学运动时，学者们常常将米格尔·德·乌纳穆诺的作品视为“98一代”的特别代表。对这种特征的描述可能显得_______，但将乌纳穆诺与“98一代”联系起来，可能会忽视他在风格上的细微差别，这些差别并不完全符合这一文学运动的惯例。
中文解析：
but前后形成转折，前面表达分类原因非常明显，无可争议，irrefutable，后面则表达这样的分类会护士风格中的微差异。

question:
Text 1
One challenge faced by researchers studying global urbanization is that countries may define urban settlements differently. Many countries define urban settlements based on the number of people living in them. However, countries do not all use the same number; for example, Greenland uses a minimum population of 200, while the Netherlands uses 20,000. Other countries use a combination of population and other factors. This variation makes it difficult for researchers to compare aspects of urbanization in different countries.
Text 2
Recently, a group of six international organizations developed global definitions of common types of settlements. The group developed a new measure called the “degree of urbanization.” This new measure establishes global criteria used to define three types of settlements (cities, towns, and rural areas) and allows researchers to better understand global urbanization rates.

Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the problem presented in Text 1?
selections: A. By suggesting that researchers focus on topics besides urbanization
B. By noting that a possible solution to the problem is available
C. By recommending that a specific institution should further investigate the problem
D. By supplying additional ways in which urbanization research is difficult
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
文本 1
研究全球城市化的学者面临的一个挑战是，各国对城市定居点的定义可能不同。许多国家根据居住人口的数量来定义城市定居点。然而，各国使用的人口基准并不相同；例如，格林兰的最低人口要求为200，而荷兰则为20,000。其他国家则结合人口和其他因素来进行定义。这种差异使得研究人员在比较不同国家的城市化各个方面时变得困难。
文本 2
最近，一个由六个国际组织组成的团体制定了常见类型定居点的全球定义。该团体开发了一种新的衡量标准，称为“城市化程度”。这一新标准建立了用于定义三种类型定居点（城市、镇和农村）的全球标准，帮助研究人员更好地理解全球城市化率。
中文解析：
text 1表达不同国家评价城市化时的标准不一样，text 2则说有一种新的方式“degree of urbanization”可以让人们更好的理解全球城市化进程，等于给了解决方案。

question:
Correlation between Model-Predicted
and Participant-Reported Enjoyment
Ratings, by Painting Style
Neuroscientist Kiyohito ligaya and colleagues developed a computational model to predict how much a person will enjoy a particular work of art on a scale from 1 (not at all) to 4 (very much). They then recruited participants to use the same scale to rate several sets of paintings in various styles and calculated the correlation between the ratings predicted by the model and those reported by the participants. Assuming participant P6 gave equal ratings to the abstract and cubist paintings, the data in the graph indicate the model predicted that ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the example?
selections: A. P6’s ratings for abstract and cubist paintings would differ from one another.
B. P6 would derive less aesthetic pleasure from abstract paintings than from cubist paintings.
C. P6’s rating for abstract and cubist paintings would equal one another.
D. P6 would derive more aesthetic pleasure from abstract paintings than from cubist paintings.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
神经科学家木之内和他的同事们开发了一种计算模型，用于预测一个人对特定艺术作品的享受程度，评分范围从1（完全不喜欢）到4（非常喜欢）。他们随后招募参与者，使用相同的评分标准对不同风格的几组绘画进行评分，并计算模型预测的评分与参与者报告的评分之间的相关性。假设参与者P6对抽象画和立体派画给予了相同的评分，图中的数据表明模型预测________。
中文解析：
participant P6给出的值一样，但是表上的correlation柱状图不一样，于是可以看出model预测值不一样

question:
To understand consumer loyalty to specific online retailers, Marina Žižakov and colleagues conducted a survey using 58 statements as proxy indicators of customer experience with receiving online purchases. The statements were categorized by topic—e.g., statement 13, “I am eagerly awaiting the delivery of the ordered items,” was categorized as joyful anticipation—and respondents, all of whom were from Serbia (which is characterized as having a developing economy), rated the importance of each statement to their experience. Researchers found that participants placed low importance on package aesthetics and high importance on speedy delivery and package tracking, but the researchers cautioned against applying the findings to customers generally, suggesting that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. additional research is needed with participants from countries of varying levels of economic development to determine whether delivery time and tracking are more important than package design to customers broadly.
B. customers in countries with higher levels of economic development than that of Serbia are likely to regard package design as relatively more important than delivery time and transparency.

C. online retailers that operate in a variety of countries are more likely to increase customer loyalty if they make their deliveries in less time and allow customers to track those deliveries than if they improve their packaging.
D. the greater importance assigned to delivery time and tracking than to package design may not be observed if the survey were to be given to a larger group of Serbian participants.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
为了理解消费者对特定在线零售商的忠诚度，Marina Žižakov及其同事进行了调查，使用58条陈述作为客户体验的代理指标，以了解他们在收到在线购买时的感受。这些陈述按主题分类——例如，第13条陈述：“我迫切期待所订购物品的送达”被归类为愉快的期待——所有受访者均来自塞尔维亚（该国被认为是一个发展中经济体），他们对每条陈述在其体验中的重要性进行了评分。研究人员发现，参与者对包裹外观的重视程度较低，而对快速送达和包裹追踪的重视程度较高，但研究人员警告不要将这些发现普遍应用于所有顾客，建议________。
中文解析：
最后转折后caution against general application，就是表达这个结果可能未必广泛适用与所有地方，于是可以推断需要更多额外的研究才能知道是否人们比起包装，更关注配送时间与追踪。

question:
Prolonged exposure to anthropogenic noise (sounds from human sources like traffic or mining) can affect animals, as Debra M. Shier and colleagues found in a 2012 study of Stephens kangaroo rats. Researchers conducted a meta-analysis of studies of how such noise affects animals and found that, for every study, relevant traits or behaviors of the animals were observably different between the exposed group and the otherwise similar but unexposed group. Although, on average, studies of mammals showed larger differences than studies of amphibians did, for every class of animals examined, there were individual studies showing differences well above the average for mammals. Therefore, the results of the meta-analysis suggest that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. some studies of amphibians found larger effects of exposure to anthropogenic noise than some studies of mammals did.
B. the studies in the meta-analysis that examined mammals were more likely than those that examined amphibians to specify whether the observed effects were detrimental.
C. the differences that studies attribute to exposure to anthropogenic noise are likely to be more pronounced for amphibians than they are for mammals.
D. the difference found in the study conducted by Debra M. Shier and colleagues was likely larger than the average difference for studies of Stephens kangaroo rats included in the meta-analysis.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
人类活动造成的噪音（如交通或采矿等人源声音）长期暴露会影响动物，正如Debra M. Shier及其同事在2012年对史蒂芬袋鼠鼠的研究中发现的那样。研究人员对关于这种噪音如何影响动物的研究进行了荟萃分析，发现每项研究中，暴露组和其他条件相似但未暴露的组在相关特征或行为上都有明显差异。尽管总体而言，哺乳动物的研究显示出比两栖动物更大的差异，但在每一种动物类别中，都有个别研究显示出远高于哺乳动物平均水平的差异。因此，这项荟萃分析的结果表明________。
中文解析：
最后的结论指出有些个体individuals表现出的差异高于mammals的平均数，那么就说明A正确，也就是amphibians有些比mammals的个体还要更多的影响。

question:
The sloping tile roofs and pictures que façade of Mission San José in Fremont, California, exemplify the Spanish contribution to Californian architecture, an influence that is ________ throughout the state—architectural tourists visiting the Santa Fe Depot in San Diego, for example, can easily recognize how its style draws inspiration from the Spanish missions.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
加利福尼亚州弗里蒙特的圣何塞教堂的倾斜瓦屋顶和别致的外观，体现了西班牙对加利福尼亚建筑的贡献，这种影响在全州范围内 ________ ——例如，前来参观圣地亚哥圣菲车站的建筑旅游者可以轻易辨认出其风格受到西班牙传教士建筑的启发。
中文解析：
palpable表示容易识别，明显的，和后面的easily recognize一致

question:
Mauricio Drelichman and Hans-Joachim Voth’s research on the fiscal vulnerability of Philip II (who ruled not only Spain but other regions including Milan from 1556 to 1598) builds on other studies of European early modern state finance, including Hoffman and Norberg’s work on the relationship between state finance and political development. But Drelichman and Voth’s unique contribution is their reconstruction of the earliest extant set of annual fiscal records for any sovereign state, which demonstrate that Philip's defaults were caused by short-term liquidity crises, not long-term unsustainable debts.

What does the text most strongly suggest about the value of Drelichman and Voth’s research to their discipline?
selections: A. Drelichman and Voth’s research uses newly compiled evidence to eliminate one possible reason Philip II defaulted on his debts and to affirm another.
B. Drelichman and Voth’s research revealed the role of Philip II’s debt defaults in exacerbating short-term liquidity crises.
C. Drelichman and Voth’s research builds on earlier work about a particular aspect of European early modern state finance by Hoffman and Norberg and corrects errors in that earlier work.
D. Drelichman and Voth’s research presented a novel body of evidence supporting Hoffman and Norberg’s hypothesis regarding why Philip II defaulted on several loans.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
毛里西奥·德雷利赫曼和汉斯-约阿希姆·沃特关于菲利普二世财政脆弱性的研究（菲利普二世在1556年至1598年间统治西班牙及包括米兰在内的其他地区）建立在对早期现代欧洲国家财政的其他研究基础上，包括霍夫曼和诺伯格关于国家财政与政治发展的关系的工作。然而，德雷利赫曼和沃特的独特贡献在于他们重建了任何主权国家现存的最早一套年度财政记录，这些记录表明菲利普的违约是由于短期流动性危机造成的，而非长期不可持续的债务。
中文解析：
研究的意思主要在最后一句，说明当初不是因为长期的债务，而是因为短期的资金危机，等于排除了一种可能性，确认了另一种可能性

question:
Veronica L. Bura, Akito Y. Kawahara, and Jayne E. Yack investigated the evolution and function of sound production in silk moth and hawk moth caterpillars. They found that during harmless simulated attacks on caterpillars, 33% of the tested species produced sound, which ranged from clicks in Antheraea pernyi to whistles in Phyllosphingia dissimilis. A second research team has claimed that caterpillars use these sounds primarily to communicate with other members of their species.

Which finding, if true, would most directly challenge the second team’s claim?
selections: A. Among the caterpillar species that produced sound in response to simulated attacks, no individuals produced sound in the minute before the attacks, but the vast majority of individuals produced sound once the simulated attacks began.
B. Most of the caterpillar species that were found to not produce sound in response to simulated attacks have been observed producing sound during encounters with other members of their species.
C. Caterpillars that were found to produce sounds in response to simulated attacks are typically solitary and were tested in isolation.

D. The sounds caterpillars produced in response to the simulated attacks lacked acoustic characteristics that would make them audible to bats, lizards, or birds, some of the most frequent predators of caterpillars.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Veronica L. Bura、Akito Y. Kawahara 和 Jayne E. Yack 研究了丝蛾和鹰蛾幼虫声音产生的演化和功能。他们发现，在对幼虫进行无害的模拟攻击时，33% 的受测物种会发出声音，这些声音从安特雷阿丝绸蛾（Antheraea pernyi）的点击声到菲洛斯芬吉亚蛾（Phyllosphingia dissimilis）的口哨声不等。第二个研究团队声称，幼虫主要使用这些声音与同种的其他成员进行沟通。
中文解析：
C选项：“发现会在模拟攻击时发出声音的毛虫通常是独居的，并且是在单独测试的情况下发出声音。” 也就是，发出声音的毛虫通常是独自生活的，在实验中也没有与其他毛虫接触。因此挑战了第二个团队的观点

question:
The following text is from a 1955 translation of Samuel Beckett’s 1951 novel Molloy (translated by the author and Patrick Bowles). In the text, Molloy has arrived at the town ramparts, an elevated walkway atop the city walls.
And having cleared the ramparts I had to confess the sky was clearing, prior to its winding in the other shroud, night. Yes, the great cloud was ravelling, discovering here and there a pale and dying sky, and the sun, already down, was manifest in the livid tongues of fire darting towards the zenith, falling and darting again, ever more pale and languid, and doomed no sooner lit to be extinguished.
©1955 by Grove Press, Inc.

As used in the text, what does the word “manifest” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字摘自塞缪尔·贝克特1951年小说《莫洛伊》的1955年译本（由作者和帕特里克·博尔斯翻译）。在文本中，莫洛伊到达了城市的城墙，那里是一个高架步道。
“当我走出城墙时，不得不承认天空正在放晴，为夜晚的另一层遮蔽做准备。是的，那片巨大的云彩正在散开，时不时露出一片苍白而垂死的天空，已经沉没的太阳在向天顶猛冲的苍白火焰中显现，时而坠落又时而冲出，愈加苍白和无力，注定在被点燃后不久便要熄灭。”
中文解析：
在这段文字中，“manifest”最接近的意思是"可察觉的"或"显现的"。这里贝克特描述了夕阳的景象，太阳已经下山，但依然通过“燃烧的火焰”显现出来。也就是说，太阳的存在仍然是“可见的”或“显现的”，而不是“已经实现”或“正在衰退”，

question:
Chelsea Wood et al. tracked temperature-driven changes in the abundance of Opechona sp. (a complex life cycle parasite, or CLP, that requires three host species throughout its life cycle), Anthocotyle merlucci (a directly transmitted parasite, which requires only one host species), and 83 other parasite taxa found on eight fish species. CLPs are transmitted when an infected host is ingested by an individual of another species, typically shielding CLPs from the external environment, whereas directly transmitted parasites are exposed to external conditions during transmission. However, Wood et al. found that three-host CLP abundance decreased as sea temperatures rose, whereas directly transmitted parasite abundance was largely stable, suggesting that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. CLPs primarily transmitted by ingestion were less dependent on host species adversely affected by warming temperatures than were CLPs that use other transmission strategies.
B. as the number of host species involved in a parasite’s transmission increases, the parasite is better protected against rising temperatures.
C. directly transmitted parasites identified in the study were more likely to use transmission strategies that shield them from warming temperatures than were three-host CLPs.
D. any advantages that the transmission strategy used by three-host CLPs may have conferred did not completely offset the negative effects of other temperature-driven factors on CLP abundance.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
切尔西·伍德等人追踪了温度变化对Opechona sp.（一种复杂生命周期寄生虫，或称CLP，在其生命周期中需要三种宿主物种）、Anthocotyle merlucci（直接传播的寄生虫，仅需一种宿主物种）以及在八种鱼类中发现的其他83个寄生虫类群的丰度变化。CLP在感染的宿主被另一种物种的个体摄入时传播，这通常会使CLP免受外部环境的影响，而直接传播的寄生虫在传播过程中则暴露于外部条件下。然而，伍德等人发现，随着海洋温度的上升，三宿主CLP的丰度减少，而直接传播寄生虫的丰度大体保持稳定，这表明 ________。
中文解析：
根据文本Opechona sp（CLP）需要依赖三种寄生虫，但是Anthocotyle merlucci只需要依赖一种寄生虫，CLP在寄主感染后会发生转移，能起到保护作用，但是另一种是directly transmitted则是直接暴露在外部环境下，但是结果确实前者易受到温度影响，后者反而保持稳定数量，因此可以得出结论CLPs获得的优势不足以抵消温度对其产生的负面影响。

question:
In 2015 Filipa Faleiro and colleagues published a study concluding that ocean acidification has a strong effect on the behavior of Hippocampus guttulatus, a species of fish. However, Faleiro and colleagues’ study relied on a mean sample size of only 6 fish. In a 2022 review of various scientists’ conclusions about the impacts of ocean acidification on fish behavior, Jeff C. Clements and colleagues caution that relying on such a relatively small sample size can increase the potential for biased analysis. Such analysis, in turn, can contribute to reports of exaggerated effects.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It summarizes a shift in scientists’ understanding of how Hippocampus guttulatus has responded to ocean acidification.
B. It elaborates on a potential consequence of Faleiro and colleagues’ reliance on a relatively small sample size.
C. It emphasizes the magnitude of the effect reported by Faleiro and colleagues of ocean acidification on Hippocampus guttulatus.
D. It counters the objection of Clements and colleagues to studies that rely on relatively small sample sizes.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在2015年，Filipa Faleiro及其同事发表了一项研究，得出结论认为海洋酸化对一种鱼类——斑点海马（Hippocampus guttulatus）的行为有很强的影响。然而，Faleiro及其同事的研究仅依赖于平均6条鱼的样本量。2022年，Jeff C. Clements及其同事对多位科学家关于海洋酸化对鱼类行为影响的结论进行了回顾，警告说依赖如此相对较小的样本量可能会增加分析偏倚的潜在风险。这种分析反过来可能导致对影响的夸大报告。
中文解析：
最后这句划线句表达样本比较小导致的结果被夸大，对应了B选项

question:
Google’s introduction of the Chrome web browser in 2008 is a quintessential instance of brand extension—the company leveraged its brand recognition as an internet search provider to enter a product category where it had not previously competed. An outstanding question is whether perceived category similarity predicts consumers’ likelihood of purchasing brand extensions. To answer this question, Alicia Grasby et al. identified 30 extended-brand pairs (e.g., the same brand of shoes and gloves) in 52 weeks of purchases by approximately 60,000 households and, for each pair, calculated the change in probability of a brand in one category being purchased if the same brand was purchased in the other category.

Based on the text, which potential study design would be most likely to produce evidence that would enable Grasby et al. to answer their research question?
selections: A. Have a representative sample of the households rate the similarity of the product categories in each extended-brand pair, then determine how, if at all, those ratings correlate with the change in probability that the team calculated for each pair.

B. Poll a representative sample of the households to determine the degree of brand recognition of each brand in the extended-brand pairs, then determine how, if at all, the degree of brand recognition correlates with the average cost of each product in the pairs.

C. Have a representative sample of the households rate the similarity of one product in each extended-brand pair to other products in the same category, then determine how, if at all, those ratings correlate with the change in probability that the team calculated for each pair.

D. Poll a representative sample of the households to determine the degree of brand recognition for each brand in the extended-brand pairs, then determine how, if at all, the degree of brand recognition correlates with the frequency with which a different group of households purchased at least one product of that brand.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
谷歌在2008年推出Chrome浏览器是品牌延伸的典型实例——该公司利用其作为互联网搜索提供商的品牌认知度进入了一个之前未曾竞争的产品类别。一个突出的问题是，感知的类别相似性是否能够预测消费者购买品牌延伸的可能性。为了回答这个问题，Alicia Grasby等人识别了30对扩展品牌（例如，同一品牌的鞋子和手套），并在约60,000个家庭的52周购买中计算了每对品牌在一个类别中被购买的概率变化，如果在另一个类别中购买了同一品牌。
中文解析：
依据An outstanding question is whether perceived category similarity predicts consumers’ likelihood of purchasing brand extensions.这个研究针对同一品牌下的不同商品研究，如果想要研究购买同一品牌的另一种商品概率，只需要进行样本研究，去看人们对成对商品的相似性给出评分rating，然后看这个值和购买可能性值之间的关系。

question:
Argyroxiphium sandwicense is a species in a family of plants known collectively as the silversword alliance, all of which grow only on the Hawaiian Islands. Members of this alliance exhibit an extraordinary range of phenotypes, with some species maturing into vines and others into shrubs and trees. All species in the alliance descended from a single ancestral tarweed plant that arrived on the islands around 5 million years ago. The tarweed’s descendants diversified into distinct species as they adapted to live in the wide variety of habitats found on the Hawaiian Islands.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To advance the claim that all plants on the Hawaiian Islands are part of the silversword alliance and list possible ancestors of the plants that make up the alliance
B. To indicate the specific tarweed ancestor of all plants that grow on the Hawaiian Islands and explain why the plants have such varied physical characteristics
C. To describe the silversword alliance and explain how the plant family became so varied
D. To describe the specific habitat where Argyroxiphium sandwicense are found and identify other plants that share a common ancestor with them
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
阿尔吉罗西菲姆·桑德维森（Argyroxiphium sandwicense）是一种植物，属于被统称为银剑联盟的一个植物科，这些植物仅生长在夏威夷群岛。该联盟的成员展现出非凡的表型多样性，有些物种发育成藤本植物，而其他则发展成灌木或树木。这个联盟的所有物种都源于大约500万年前到达这些岛屿的单一祖先植物——tarweed（塔草）。塔草的后代在适应夏威夷群岛上各种栖息地的过程中，演化出不同的物种。
中文解析：
文本第一句描述了silversword alliance, 随后描述了alliance中所有植物有着共同的ancestor，之后适应不同环境而产生了不同的种类。

question:
The following text is from a 1911 translation of Guy de Maupassant’s 1881 short story “A Family Affair.” The narrator is describing Monsieur Alfred Caravan, a bureaucrat in the French government.
For the last thirty years he had invariably gone the same way to his office every morning, and had met the same men going to business at the same time, and nearly on the same spot. Every morning, after buying his penny paper at the corner of the Faubourg Saint Honore, he bought two rolls, and then went to his office, like a culprit who is giving himself up to justice, and got to his desk as quickly as possible, always feeling uneasy, as though he were expecting a rebuke for some neglect of duty of which he might have been guilty.

Taken together, the three underlined portions most clearly serve which function in the text as a whole?
selections: A. They illustrate an unexplained nervous tension that Caravan experiences as he begins each workday.
B. They suggest Caravan’s dismay about being trapped in a job that has become exceedingly monotonous.
C. They reveal that Caravan is unwaveringly precise in his daily routine because of the unreasonable expectations of his employers.
D. They convey Caravan’s growing apprehensiveness about having failed to complete an important work task for the first time in his long career.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本摘自1911年翻译的居伊·德·莫泊桑1881年短篇小说《家庭事务》：叙述者描述了阿尔弗雷德·卡拉万先生，他是法国政府的一名官僚。
在过去的三十年里，他每天早晨总是以同样的方式前往办公室，并在几乎同样的地点遇到同样的商人。每天早晨，在圣奥诺雷街角买了便士报后，他会买两个小面包，然后像一个投案自首的罪犯一样前往办公室，尽可能快地到达自己的桌子，总是感到不安，仿佛他在期待因为某种他可能犯下的失职而受到责备。
中文解析：
文本划线处用比喻和夸张的手法表达处主人公每天上班时的紧张感，culprit表示罪犯，uneasy对应了A选项的nervous

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Louis Ballard was a classical composer and citizen of the Quapaw Tribe.
● His compositions synthesize Western classical music with elements of various Native musical traditions.
● Ballard’s classical piece Live On, Heart of My Nation features a Choctaw hymn.
● Ballard’s classical piece Cacéga Ayuwípi incorporates a Haida gourd rattle, a traditional Native instrument.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two compositions. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. While both compositions integrate various Native musical traditions, Live On, Heart of My Nation does so by featuring a Choctaw hymn and Cacéga Ayuwípi does so by incorporating a Haida go urd rattle.
B. Live On, Heart of My Nation and Cacéga Ayuwípi are two compositions written by Ballard, a classical music composer.

C. In his two compositions Live On, Heart of My Nation and Cacéga Ayuwípi, Ballard blends elements of various Native musical traditions, such as Indigenous hymns or instruments, with Western classical music.
D. allard has different approaches to blending Western classical music with elements of various Native musical traditions, such as using Indigenous hymns and instruments in his compositions
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
● 路易斯·巴拉德是一位古典作曲家，也是夸帕族的公民。

● 巴拉德的古典作品《活下去，我的民族之心》包含了一首乔克托族的圣歌。
● 巴拉德的古典作品《卡切加·阿尤维皮》融合了海达族的葫芦响器，这是一种传统的土著乐器。
中文解析：
题目要求对比two compositions的差异，于是A选项满足要求，一个是hymn，另一个包含Haida gourd rattle

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Uranus has twenty-seven moons, including Oberon and Miranda.
● Oberon completes an orbit of Uranus in 13.46 Earth days on average.
● Miranda completes an orbit of Uranus in 1.41 Earth days on average.
● German mathematician and astronomer Johannes Kepler (1571-1630) described the orbits of planets as elliptical in shape rather than circular.
● Kepler published three laws of planetary motion to describe the orbits of planets around the Sun.
● Kepler’s laws also apply to the elliptical orbits of natural satellites (e.g., moons).

The student wants to contrast the orbits of the two moons. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Miranda completes its orbit of Uranus many times faster than Oberon does.
B. Kepler’s three laws of planetary motion describe the orbits of planets and natural satellites, including those of Oberon and Miranda.
C. Oberon’s orbit of Uranus is elliptical in shape and takes, on average, 13.46 Earth days, while Miranda’s orbit of Uranus is circular in shape and takes, on average,1.41 Earth days.
D. Uranus’s moons, specifically Oberon and Miranda, orbit their planet in the same way the planets orbit the Sun.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一位学生做了以下笔记：
● 天王星有二十七颗卫星，包括奥伯龙和米兰达。
● 奥伯龙平均绕天王星完成一圈的时间为13.46个地球日。
● 米兰达平均绕天王星完成一圈的时间为1.41个地球日。
● 德国数学家和天文学家约翰尼斯·开普勒（1571-1630年）描述了行星的轨道是椭圆形而非圆形。
● 开普勒发表了三条行星运动定律，以描述行星绕太阳的轨道。
● 开普勒的定律同样适用于自然卫星（如卫星）的椭圆轨道。
中文解析：
题目要求对比orbits of the two moons，于是最大的差异就是时间不一样，Miranda时间短，Oberon时间长，也就是说明速度有差异，A选项符合要求

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● A U-shaped curve in a river channel is called a meander.
● A meander forms when water erodes sediment from one side of the riverbank and redeposits that sediment on the opposite side.
● Meanders will gradually change shape and migrate downstream over time.
● A river with high sinuosity has many meanders, and a river with low sinuosity has few.
● The Willapa River in the United States has high sinuosity.

The student wants to define the term “high-sinuosity river.” Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. A high-sinuosity river is one that has many meanders, or U-shaped curves.
B. A high-sinuosity river has U-shaped curves called meanders that will gradually change shape and shift downstream.
C. High sinuosity is caused by the erosion and redepositing of sediment in a riverbank over time.
D. Over time, the many meanders in the high-sinuosity Willapa River will change shape and migrate downstream.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
● 河道中的U型曲线称为曲流（meander）。
● 曲流形成于水流侵蚀河岸一侧的沉积物，并将这些沉积物重新沉积到对侧。
● 曲流会随着时间的推移逐渐改变形状并向下游迁移。
● 一条具有高曲率（sinuosity）的河流有许多曲流，而一条低曲率的河流则曲流较少。
● 美国的威拉帕河（Willapa River）具有高曲率。
中文解析：
high-sinuosity river的定义，根据notes：A river with high sinuosity has many meanders，那么A符合要求

question:
In Hoocąk, an Indigenous language from the Midwest region of what is now the United States, zi means “yellow,” whereas zizi means “yellow in spots.” This phenomenon, in which an element of a root word is repeated, sometimes with modification, within another word that is related to the root word, is called reduplication. In this case, the entire word zi gets repeated in zizi. There are many examples of this type of reduplication in Hoocạk.

The text makes which point about Hoocąk?
selections: A. It has a wide variety of reduplicated words and phrases that mean “yellow.”
B. It is closely related to another language from the Midwest region of what is now the United States that also makes use of reduplication.
C. It contains many instances of the type of reduplication seen in the words zi and zizi.
D. It is one of the only languages in the world that makes use of reduplication.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在霍卡克语（Hoocąk），一种来自现在美国中西部地区的土著语言中，"zi" 意思是“黄色”，而 "zizi" 意思是“斑点状的黄色”。这种现象称为重叠（reduplication），即一个词根中的某个元素在与该词根相关的另一个词中重复，有时还会进行修改。在这个例子中，整个词 "zi" 在 "zizi" 中被重复。霍卡克语中有许多这种类型的重叠的例子。
中文解析：
根据文本Hoocak语言中经常用到语言的重复的方式，正如文本zizi这种情况，对应了选项C

question:
The following text is from Jerome K. Jerome’s 1889 novel Three Men in a Boat (To Say Nothing of the Dog). The narrator and two friends are taking a boat down the River Thames in England.
In a boat, I have always noticed that it is the fixed idea of each member of the crew that he is doing everything. Harris’s notion was, that it was he alone who had been working, and that both George and I had been imposing upon him. George, on the other hand, ridiculed the idea of Harris’s having done anything more than eat and sleep, and had a cast-iron opinion that it was he—George himself—who had done all the labour worth speaking of.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It suggests that Harris is concentrating on helping the group overcome an obstacle.
B. It offers Harris’s belief as a specific example of a trend the narrator has observed while boating.
C. It establishes Harris’s feelings about the narrator’s idea of how boat trips usually proceed.
D. It demonstrates that Harris finds his experiences on the boat to be confusing.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字摘自杰罗姆·K·杰罗姆1889年的小说《三人在船上（不提狗）》。叙述者和两个朋友正在英格兰的泰晤士河上划船。
在船上，我总是注意到每个船员都有一个固定的想法，那就是他自己在做所有的事情。哈里斯认为，只有他一个人在工作，而我和乔治则在对他施加压力。另一方面，乔治嘲笑哈里斯做过任何事情的想法，认为他不过是在吃和睡，并坚信是他——乔治本人——做了所有值得一提的劳作。
中文解析：
段落结构是总分式，于是第一句表明narrator观察到crew member总觉得自己做了所有的活儿，划线句子具体用Harris的想法作为具体例子来进行了前面支持自己的观点，和B选项一致。
