question: The expression <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>6</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>17</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn></math> can be rewritten as<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>a</mi><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow></math>, where a and b are positive integers, or as <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>d</mi><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow></math>, where c and d are positive nonintegers. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></math>?
explanations: 二次函数因式分解的运用，相当于两个因式常数未知（设分别是e和f），可得2e+3f=17，ef=7，该方程组转化成二次函数解得e=7或者e=1.5，根据题意7和1.5分别是就是a和c的取值。a+c=8.5

question: A right square pyramid has a total surface area of 28,160 square inches, and the combined surface area of the four lateral faces of this pyramid is 16,060square inches. What is the height, in inches, of this pyramid?
explanations: 四角锥底是一个正方形，面积为28160-16060=12100，所以底面正方形边长为110，每个侧面三角形面积为16060/4=4015，结合底边110可得slant height为73，四角锥的高、底边一半55和slant height组成直角三角形，根据勾股定理<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msqrt> <msup> <mn>73</mn> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <msup> <mn>55</mn> <mn>2</mn> </msup> </msqrt> <mo>=</mo> <mn>48</mn></math>,选A

question:
Domesticated thousands of years ago in South America, the tomato deviates structurally from the wild plant it is descended from. Maize (corn), another domesticated crop from the Americas, doesn’t closely resemble any wild plant, and genetic research only recently ________ its ancestor to be teosinte grass.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
几千年前在南美洲驯化的番茄在结构上与其祖先的野生植物有所不同。玉米（玉米）是另一种来自美洲的驯化作物，它与任何野生植物的相似性都不大，遗传研究最近才______其祖先确定为稻草草（teosinte）。
中文解析：
在这个句子中，提到了基因研究最近才揭示了夏季南瓜的祖先是野生的Johnny gourd。因此，最合适的词是“revealed”，表示揭示或揭露。其他选项在这个语境中不合适： "encouraged" 鼓励或支持，"expanded" 扩张，"petitioned" 请愿或请求。

question:
The following text is adapted from George Eliot’s 1857 short story “The Sad Fortunes of the Rev. Amos Barton.” Mr. Ely is a clergyman in the town of Milby.
By the laity of Milby and its neighbourhood [Mr. Ely] was regarded as a man of quite remarkable powers and learning, who must make a considerable sensation in London pulpits and drawing-rooms on his occasional visit to the metropolis; and by his brother clergy he was regarded as a discreet and agreeable fellow. Mr Ely never got into a warm discussion; he suggested what might be thought, but rarely said what he thought himself; he never let either men or women see that he was laughing at them, and he never gave any one an opportunity of laughing at him.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It implies that Mr. Ely’s neighbors are more naive in their estimation of him than people in London are and then explains why his neighbors have been so easily misled.
B. It highlights the disparity between Mr. Ely’s public and private behavior and then conveys why he labors to obscure his true self from other people.
C. It presents the favorable opinion of Mr. Ely that other people hold and then describes the behaviors of Mr. Ely that enable him to maintain that favorable opinion.
D. It indicates that Mr Ely was once universally admired by his friends and then relates the circumstances that led to a change in their views.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字改编自乔治·艾略特（George Eliot）1857年的短篇小说《亚莫斯·巴顿牧师的悲惨命运》。艾利先生（Mr. Ely）是米尔比镇的一位牧师。
在米尔比及其周边地区，艾利先生被认为是一位颇具非凡才华和学识的人，他偶尔访问大都市时，必定会在伦敦的讲坛和会客室引起相当大的轰动；而他的兄弟牧师们则认为他是一个谨慎而和蔼可亲的人。艾利先生从不参与激烈的讨论；他会提出人们可能会想到的观点，但很少表达自己的真实想法；他从不让男女见到他在嘲笑他们的样子，也从不让任何人有机会嘲笑他。
中文解析：
文本前半部描述不同人对Mr Ely的好印象，后半部分描述Mr Ely自己的做法让人们能这样看待自己。

question:
Even among fast animals, top speeds can vary significantly. For example, the quarter horse can run up to 89 kilometers per hour (km/hr), whereas the white-throated needletail swift is much faster, flying up to 169 km/hr. This difference is largely because the features that are ________ for running on land restrict top speeds more than the features needed for flying through the air.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
即使在快速动物中，最高速度也可能有显著差异。例如，夸特马的奔跑速度可达每小时89公里，而白喉针尾雨燕则快得多，飞行速度可达每小时169公里。这种差异主要是因为在陆地上奔跑所需的特征会比在空中飞行所需的特征更大程度地限制最高速度。
中文解析：
这两种速度之间的差异在于陆地奔跑时最必要的特征往往比在空中飞行时能达到的最大速度更具限制性，essential符合要求。

question:
In response to concerns that some recent financial crises were exacerbated by consumers misunderstanding risks associated with credit cards, loans, and other financial products, policymakers in many countries have instituted risk-disclosure requirements on sellers of those products. Enrique Seira et al. investigated a variety of risk-disclosure messages sent to thousands of credit card customers and found that the messages had only small and short-lived effects on behavior. Seira et al. asserted that such effects may nevertheless be worth pursuing, given the negligible cost of messaging.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It acknowledges a type of risk-disclosure messaging that Seira et al. may not have fully accounted for in their study.
B. It points out a circumstance that Seira et al. conceded may make risk-disclosure messaging more effective than their study suggests.
C. It notes a factor that led Seira et al. to not dismiss risk-disclosure messaging altogether despite their evidence of its limited utility.
D. It describes a consideration that explains why Seira et al. recommended risk-disclosure messaging even though its effects may be small relative to its costs.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
针对一些最近的金融危机由于消费者对信用卡、贷款和其他金融产品相关风险的误解而加剧的担忧，许多国家的政策制定者已对这些产品的销售者实施了风险披露要求。恩里克·塞拉（Enrique Seira）等人调查了发送给数千名信用卡客户的多种风险披露信息，发现这些信息对行为的影响仅小且短暂。塞拉等人认为，考虑到信息传递的成本微乎其微，这种影响仍然值得追求。
中文解析：
最后画线句是一个考虑点，也就是成本低，就说明这个方法虽然效果短暂，但是刻意继续，毕竟代价也很小，和C一致。

question:
Conservationists worldwide are working to protect ecosystems from habitat destruction and biodiversity loss, and in many cases, initiatives that rely on natural features or processes can help address such challenges. In response to a rapidly dwindling population of blueback salmon, the Quinault Indian Nation (a tribe in Washington State) partnered with the conservation organization Wild Salmon Center to restore naturally occurring logjams in the Quinault River. The logjams create shady pools where the blueback salmon can rest and spawn, thus promoting blueback population recovery.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. As indicated by a recent project, logjams help the blueback salmon thrive and reproduce.
B. A partnership between the Quinault Indian Nation and Wild Salmon Center shows the importance of collaborative approaches to preserving biodiversity.
C. Scientists now realize that nature-based conservation methods offer better long-term solutions to environmental issues than methods that are not nature-based do.
D. Nature-based approaches can be effective ways to achieve conservation goals.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
全球的环保人士正努力保护生态系统，以防止栖息地破坏和生物多样性丧失。在许多情况下，依赖自然特征或过程的倡议可以帮助应对这些挑战。面对蓝背鲑鱼种群急剧减少的情况，奎纳尔特印第安民族（华盛顿州的一个部落）与环保组织野生鲑鱼中心合作，恢复奎纳尔特河中自然形成的树木堆积。树木堆积形成阴凉的水潭，让蓝背鲑鱼可以在其中休息和产卵，从而促进蓝背鲑鱼种群的恢复。
中文解析：
D选项nature-based approaches概括了文章的核心内容，和文章最后讲到的有效保护一致。

question:
Janet Echelman is a sculptor and fiber artist. She has installed giant sculptures all over the world. Echelman uses bright and flowing materials, which mimic the wind.
However, while her sculptures appear as delicate as a breeze, they are actually very durable.

Which quotation from an article about Echelman’s sculptures, if true, would most effectively illustrate the underlined claim?
selections: A. “The materials that Echelman uses to build her sculptures are both flexible and strong.”
B. “The first part of planning a new sculpture is done using paper and pencil, and then a digital program is used to finalize the design.”
C. “Echelman uses a special program that makes a 3D model of the sculpture.”
D. “Each sculpture is designed to reflect local landmarks from the area in which it is eventually installed.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
珍妮特·埃切尔曼（Janet Echelman）是一位雕塑家和纤维艺术家。她在全球范围内安装了巨型雕塑。埃切尔曼使用明亮而流动的材料，模仿风的形态。然而，尽管她的雕塑看起来如微风般轻盈，实际上却非常耐用。
中文解析：
划线句delicate and durable和A选项flexible and strong对应，是合适的illustration。

question:
Humans aren’t the only ones who use tools. Other animals also find tools helpful. Boxer crabs use stinging anemones to defend against attack. And despite sometimes being thought of as simple, many birds make clever use of tools as well. Egyptian vultures have been observed using pebbles to break open ostrich egg shells.

Which choice best states the main topic of the text?
selections: B. How to observe animals in the wild
C. A study of Egyptian vultures
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
人类并不是唯一使用工具的生物。其他动物也发现工具很有帮助。拳击蟹利用刺胞水母来防御攻击。尽管有时被认为是简单的，许多鸟类也巧妙地使用工具。科学家观察到，埃及秃鹫会使用小石子来敲开鸵鸟蛋壳。
中文解析：
段落主要关于出人类外，动物的工具使用

question:
To measure whether countries in free trade agreements (FTAs)—agreements among nations to reduce tariffs, duties, and other trade barriers—experience changes in total agricultural exports, economist Kayode Ajewole and colleagues calculated average export growth rates for several countries over the five years before and the five years after entering an FTA with the United States. The graph shows the results for three countries in the study. Consulting the graph, a student claims that joining an FTA increases the rate of growth of a country’s total agricultural exports.

Which choice best describes data from the graph that weaken the student’s claim?
selections: A. Although agricultural exports from Morocco grew over the five years after Morocco joined MAFTA, their growth rate was even higher in the five years before MAFTA.

B. Over the five years after El Salvador joined CAFTA-DR, agricultural exports from El Salvador grew at a rate of about 21.8 percent, which is higher than the rate over the five years before El Salvador joined the agreement.
C. All the countries shown had positive growth in agricultural exports over the five years after joining their respective FTAs, but their rates of export growth varied.
D. Although agricultural exports from Jordan decreased over the five years before JOFTA, a reversal in this trend was observed over the five years after Jordan joined JOFTA.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
为了测量自由贸易协定（FTA）——各国之间减少关税、税收和其他贸易壁垒的协议——是否会影响国家的农业总出口，经济学家卡约德·阿杰沃尔（Kayode Ajewole）及其同事计算了与美国签署FTA前后五年内多个国家的平均出口增长率。该图表显示了研究中三国的结果。一名学生查看图表后声称，加入FTA会提高一个国家农业总出口的增长率。
中文解析：
文本的最后一句结论时说加入FTA会增加growth rate，但是Morocco加入前的增长率更高，于是可以反驳这个结论，选择A选项。

question:
The Underdogs is a 1915 novel by Mariano Azuela, originally written in Spanish. In the novel, Azuela depicts a traveling group of soldiers as having a renewed sense of agency and authority as they set off on a new stage of their journey: ________

Which quotation from a translation of The Underdogs most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “The men threw out their chests as if to breathe the widening horizon, the immensity of the sky, the blue from the mountains and the fresh air, redolent with the various odors of the sierra. They spurred their horses to a gallop as if in that mad race they laid claims of possession to the earth.”
B. “Some women, traveling with the soldiers, occupy two or three seats with baggage, dogs, cats, parrots.”
C. “Amid the stark rocks and dry branches, roses bloomed like a white offering to the sun as smoothly, suavely, it unraveled its golden threads, one by one, from rock to rock.”

D. “All day long (the soldiers) rode through the canyon, up and down the steep, round hills, dirty and bald as a man’s head, hill after hill in endless succession. At last, late in the afternoon, they descried several stone church towers in the heart of a bluish ridge, and, beyond, the white road with its curling spirals of dust and its gray telegraph poles.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《弱者》（The Underdogs）是马里亚诺·阿苏埃拉（Mariano Azuela）于1915年创作的小说，最初用西班牙语写成。在这部小说中，阿苏埃拉描绘了一支流动的士兵队伍，他们在踏上旅程的新阶段时，重新获得了一种自主权和权威感：________
中文解析：
题目要求illustrate a renewed sense,态度积极，于是对应了A选项，这段引用有效地传达了士兵们对他们的旅程和所经过土地的掌控感和归属感。形象地描绘他们“挺胸向前”和驱马疾驰的场景，暗示了自信、活力以及与周围环境的紧密联系，反映了他们焕发出的主动性和权威感。

question:
Agglomeration economies arise when multiple firms in related industries ________ an area, as with leather production firms and footwear manufacturers in Glasgow, UK. Economists have assumed that companies cluster for the same reasons, but Giulia Faggio et al. found that factors driving agglomeration in some cases are only weakly correlated with agglomeration in others.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
当多个相关行业的公司______一个地区时，就会出现聚集经济，就像英国格拉斯哥的皮革生产公司和鞋类制造商一样。经济学家一直假设公司聚集是出于相同的原因，但Giulia Faggio等人的研究发现，在某些情况下，推动聚集的因素与其他情况下的聚集仅弱相关。
中文解析：
agglomeration economies指的产业聚集，于是amass in表示聚集符合要求。appeal to - 向…呼吁 / 向…请求。amass in - 积累于 / 聚集在。concur with - 同意 / 一致于。intercede in - 介入 / 调解。

question:
When minor planets are discovered, each is given a unique identification number, and some may be given à unique name, as in the case of 1083 Salvia, which was named after the plant genus that includes sages. But naming a minor planet is not ________; whether to assign it a name is entirely the choice of whoever discovers it.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
当小行星被发现时，每颗小行星都会被赋予一个唯一的识别编号，有些小行星可能会被赋予一个独特的名称，例如1083 Salvia，它是以包括鼠尾草的植物属命名的。但给小行星命名并不是______，是否给它命名完全取决于发现者的选择。
中文解析：
根据最后一句，是否命名完全由发现者来定，表达了not mandatory，即命名不是强制性的. mandatory - 强制的；必须的。 feasible - 可行的；可实现的。permissible - 允许的；可准许的。selective - 选择性的；有选择的。

Many films in a language other than English grow to be financially successful over the course of their time in movie theaters in the United States, but some become immediate successes in their opening weekends. A journalist claims that a film’s reception can greatly influence its long-term success. Indications that the film is of high quality, such as an Oscar nomination, can dramatically boost public interest in the film and thus its overall earnings, even with a relatively modest opening weekend performance: for example, ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the example?
selections: A. the opening weekend earnings for Instructions Not Included were $7,846,426 and $904,998 for The Girl Who Played with Fire.
B. All About My Mother was recognized by the Oscars, but Instructions Not Included, which was not recognized, had higher lifetime earnings.
C. The Girl Who Played with Fire earned more money in its opening weekend than Amélie earned, but Amélie had higher lifetime earnings.
D. both Amélie and All About My Mother were recognized by the Oscars, but Amélie had higher lifetime earnings.
explanations:
许多非英语语言的电影在美国电影院上映期间取得了财务上的成功，但有些电影在首个周末就成为了即时的成功。一位记者声称，一部电影的反响可以极大地影响其长期成功。电影质量的指示，如奥斯卡提名，可以显著提高公众对电影的兴趣，从而提升其整体收入，即使在首个周末的表现相对平平。例如，______。
中文解析：
Girl Who Played with Fire第一周的收入比Amélie高，但是lifetime收入没有Amélie高，恰好说明了奥斯卡提名的重要意义。

question:
Mexican architect Luis Barragán’s prolific career, which spanned the 1920s to the 1980s, evolved through distinct phases. After traveling to the United States and Europe in the early 1930s and immersing himself in a broader architectural discourse, Barragán shifted his style to incorporate principles of modernism, as seen in the Ortega House. The project’s unadorned geometric forms, typical of the modernist aesthetic, contrasted with the historically inspired architecture seen in his earlier projects in Guadalajara, such as the house for Emiliano Robles León.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It provides a general statement about the career of a particular architect, highlights a transition in that career, and then expounds on the ways that transition is evident in the architect’s work.
B. It explains the design aesthetic of a particular architect, acknowledges the sources of those design choices, and then contrasts that aesthetic with the designs of earlier architects.
C. It summarizes the career of a particular architect, states how a journey influenced that architect’s career, and then emphasizes how influential that architect’s career has been.
D. It presents a general claim about a particular architect’s career, describes the early stages of the architect’s career, and then explains a later shift in that career.
explanations:
题目文本翻译；
墨西哥建筑师路易斯·巴拉甘（Luis Barragán）在1920年代至1980年代的多产职业生涯经历了不同的阶段。在1930年代初，他前往美国和欧洲，深入参与更广泛的建筑讨论后，巴拉甘开始转变自己的风格，融入现代主义的原则，这在他的奥尔特加住宅（Ortega House）中得到了体现。该项目简洁的几何形态，典型的现代主义美学，与他早期在瓜达拉哈拉的项目中体现的历史灵感建筑形成了鲜明对比，例如为埃米利亚诺·罗布莱斯·莱昂（Emiliano Robles León）所建的住宅。
中文解析：
文章第一句整体描述Luis的事业时间段，第二局描述30s去欧美对他产生的风格转变，最后描述风格转变的具体表现。

question:
With the ongoing expansion of e-commerce, consumers are expecting faster and faster delivery of goods, but delivery companies continue to struggle with last-mile logistics (the final step in delivery to consumers) due to challenges such as complex and inefficient delivery routes. Innovations to mitigate these challenges have been emerging—the use of autonomous delivery robots, for example—but these innovations tend to engender their own complications (e.g., robots travel relatively slowly since they must navigate many ground-level obstacles), leading researchers to conclude that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. there may not be sufficient incentive for delivery companies to attempt to solve the problems associated with last-mile logistics.
B. consumers’ expectations for reduced delivery times may be outstripping what is viable for delivery companies to provide.
C. a better understanding of consumers’ expectations for delivery is needed so that companies can better plan for fluctuations in delivery volume.
D. rapid delivery is a leading factor in consumer satisfaction, and therefore delivery companies would benefit from investing resources in reducing delivery times.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
随着电子商务的不断扩展，消费者对商品的配送速度期待越来越快，但配送公司在“最后一公里”物流（即向消费者交付的最后一步）方面仍面临挑战，如复杂和低效的配送路线。为解决这些挑战，创新措施不断涌现，例如使用自动化配送机器人，但这些创新往往会引发自身的复杂问题（例如，由于必须绕过许多地面障碍，机器人行驶相对缓慢），这使研究人员得出结论______。
中文解析：
消费者期待物流速度快，但是最后一段送达，物流公司还有很多的困难，一些如robots的创意也无法解决，于是无法满足消费者的期待，和B选型一致，outstrip表示超过。

question:
Trustworthy machine learning is an approach that computer scientists like Meredith Ringel Morris use to engineer artificial intelligence technologies. It involves training computer algorithms to be accurate, safe, and fair. Unsupervised machine learning is another approach. ________ involves training computer algorithms to organize unlabeled data sets.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 根据involves的谓语第三人称单数形式，主语应该是it，指代learning

question:
In 1965, a group of student activists traveled by bus across the state of New South Wales to protest racial discrimination against Aboriginal Australians. The activists drove to Wellington, where they interviewed locals; to Walgett, where they picketed a segregated ________ where they staged a protest at a segregated public pool.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 三者的复合并列考察，并列里有逗号，所以三个并列之间用分号

question:
When a picture of Robert Fulton was printed on $2 banknotes in ________ inventor of the steamboat became just one of many nonpresidents to appear on US currency.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: when引导状语从句前置，和主句间逗号隔开

question:
Despite its great distance from Earth—it is 570 light-years away—the star Shaula is one of the brightest stars in the sky, ranking 23rd. Although not as bright as Shaula, the star Alhena also ranks among the 50 brightest stars (43rd, to be exact). ________ Alhena’s brightness is likely due to the star’s relative proximity: Alhena is only 100 light-years from Earth.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管距离地球很远——它位于570光年之外——但沙乌拉（Shaula）是天空中最亮的星星之一，排名第23位。虽然没有沙乌拉那么亮，阿尔赫那（Alhena）也跻身于50颗最亮星星之列（确切地说是第43位）。______ 阿尔赫那的亮度可能与这颗星相对接近有关：阿尔赫那距离地球仅有100光年。
中文解析：
前面讲不如Shaula亮但是也是前50名，后面指出亮的具体原因其实是因为离地球近，indeed引出新信息，用于强调和对比。

question:
Museo Francisco Pancho Coimbre, a sports museum in Ponce, Puerto Rico, is one of more than eighty museums in the US territory. Puerto Rico’s museums ________ visitors about everything from the territory’s sports to its architecture to its coffee.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子需要动词，inform是动词，其它都是非谓语

question:
The near-Earth asteroid 1991 VH is orbited by the moonlet S/1997 (35107). In 2022 scientists studying asteroid deflection intentionally crashed a probe into a similar moonlet, Dimorphos, shortening its orbital period by 32 minutes. ________ it used to take Dimorphos 11 hours, 55 minutes to orbit the near-Earth asteroid Didymos; now it takes 11 hours, 23minutes.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
近地小行星 1991 VH 的周围有一颗小卫星 S/1997 (35107) 环绕。2022年，科学家们研究小行星偏转时，故意将一枚探测器撞击了一颗类似的小卫星 Dimorphos，使其轨道周期缩短了32分钟。______ 之前，Dimorphos 绕近地小行星 Didymos 的周期为11小时55分钟；现在只需11小时23分钟。
中文解析：
第二句末尾shortening its orbital period by 32 minutes，最后一句中11 hours, 55 minutes缩短为11 hours, 23 minutes，是时间的具体缩短的描述，两句间应该用to be exact链接。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● The Carnegie Prize is an international art competition.
● It is administered by the Carnegie Museum of Art in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
● One Carnegie Prize gold medal winner is Glyn Warren Philpot of England.
● Philpot’s painting The Marble Worker was honored in 1913.

The student wants to emphasize the year in which Philpot won a Carnegie Prize gold medal. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Philpot won a Carnegie Prize gold medal in the year 1913.
B. The Carnegie Museum of Art awarded an artist from England a gold medal for the painting The Marble Worker.
C. The painting The Marble Worker earned Philpot a Carnegie Prize gold medal.
D. The Carnegie Prize is an international art competition administered by the Carnegie Museum of Art in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
● 卡内基奖是一个国际艺术比赛。
● 该奖项由位于宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡的卡内基艺术博物馆管理。
● 一位卡内基奖金奖获得者是来自英格兰的格林·沃伦·菲尔波特（Glyn Warren Philpot）。
● 菲尔波特的画作《大理石工人》在1913年获奖。
中文解析：
题目要求emphasize a year，于是A选项1913年满足要求。

question:
As volcanologists like Tamsin Mather are apt to make clear, not all volcanoes are the same. Tendürek in Turkey, for example, is a shield volcano, a type of volcano named for its low profile, resembling a warrior’s shield lying on the ground. Opala in Russia, ________ is a caldera, a large cauldron-like hollow that forms shortly after the emptying of a magma chamber in a volcanic eruption.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
正如火山学家塔姆辛·马瑟（Tamsin Mather）所强调的，并非所有火山都是相同的。例如，位于土耳其的 Tendürek 是一座盾形火山，这种火山因其低矮的轮廓而得名，形似躺在地上的战士盾牌。而位于俄罗斯的 Opala，______ 是一座火山口，形成于火山喷发后岩浆 chamber 为空时的大型锅状凹陷。
中文解析：
前后对比两类火山，用in contrast

question:
The Austronesian language family comprises some 1,200 languages—including the ________ Cebuano and Malagasy, which are spoken by 30 million and 17 million speakers, respectively—and accounts for one-fifth of the world’s languages, making it of keen interest to linguists like Isidore Dyen.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: languages修饰具体的两门语言Cebuano and Malagasy，不用符号分割

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● A supercontinent is a single landmass made up of most or all of Earth’s continents.
● Over time, continents merge together to form supercontinents, which then break apart.
● This process is believed to take hundreds of millions of years and is known as the supercontinent cycle.
● Ur was a supercontinent that formed about 3.1 billion years ago.
● Pangaea was a supercontinent that formed about 300 million years ago.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two supercontinents. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Ur formed about 3.1 billion years ago but eventually broke apart.
B. Forming and breaking apart over hundreds of millions of years, supercontinents are made up of most or all of Earth’s continents.
C. Ur and Pangaea were both supercontinents, single landmasses made up of most or all of Earth’s continents.
D. Pangaea formed about 300 million years ago, but Ur formed much earlier—about 3.1 billion years ago.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
● 超大陆是由地球大部分或全部大陆组成的单一陆地块。
● 随着时间的推移，大陆会合并在一起形成超大陆，然后再分裂。
● 这个过程被认为需要数亿年的时间，称为超大陆循环。
● 乌尔（Ur）是约在31亿年前形成的超大陆。
● 泛大陆（Pangaea）是约在3亿年前形成的超大陆。
中文解析：
题目要求强调两个supercontinents的差异，D满足要求，因为指出形成时间的差异。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Most of the plant and bird species in Oahu, Hawaii, are non-native.
● In a 2019 study, researchers wanted to know what role non-native birds play in dispersing plant seeds in Oahu.
● Researchers catalogued plant seeds found in fecal samples from non-native birds.
● Pipturus albidus, a flowering shrub, was one of fifteen native species catalogued.
● Paederia foetida, a woody vine, was one of twenty-nine non-native species catalogued.
● Researchers concluded that non-native birds play a vital role in dispersing the seeds of native and non-native plants.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two plants. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Most plant species found in Oahu, Hawaii, like Paederia foetida, are non-native.
B. A 2019 study catalogued plant seeds found in bird fecal samples in Oahu. Hawaii, to determine what role non-native birds play in seed dispersal.
C. Seeds from Pipturus albidus and Poederia foetida plants were found in the fecal samples of non-native Hawaiian birds, according to a 2019 study.
D. Though Pipturus albidus and Puederia foetida can both be found in Oahu, Hawaii, only the former plant is native.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
● 夏威夷瓦胡岛的大多数植物和鸟类物种都是外来物种。
● 在2019年的一项研究中，研究人员想了解外来鸟类在瓦胡岛传播植物种子方面的作用。
● 研究人员对外来鸟类粪便样本中发现的植物种子进行了分类。
● Pipturus albidus（一种开花灌木）是被分类的十五种本土植物之一。
● Paederia foetida（一种木质藤本植物）是被分类的二十九种外来植物之一。
● 研究人员得出结论，外来鸟类在传播本土和外来植物的种子方面发挥着重要作用。
中文解析：
题目要求强调two plants的差异，于是D满足要求， Pipturus albidus是native，Puederia foetida是non-native

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Tibetan mastiffs are large dogs native to the Himalayas
● A mutation in their EPAS1 gene prevents excess hemoglobin production.
● A mutation in their HBB gene boosts hemoglobin’s oxygen-carrying ability.
● These mutations enable the dogs to withstand hypoxic (low-oxygen) conditions at high altitudes.
● In a 2016 study, Zhen Wang and colleagues noted that Tibetan wolves’ DNA has the same EPAS1 and HBB mutations.
● Wang and colleagues determined that the dogs first acquired these mutations by interbreeding with Tibetan wolves around 24,000 years ago.

The student wants to present the conclusion of Zhen Wang and colleagues’ 2016 study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. By interbreeding with Tibetan wolves around 24,000 years ago, Tibetan mastiffs acquired the genetic mutations that enable them to withstand hypoxic conditions.
B. Both Tibetan mastiffs and Tibetan wolves have mutations in their EPSA1 and HBB genes, which prevent excess hemoglobin production and boost hemoglobin’s oxygen-carrying ability, respectively.
C. Like Tibetan mastiffs, Tibetan wolves can withstand hypoxic conditions at high altitudes.
D. In addition to preventing excess hemoglobin production, a mutation in Tibetan mastiffs’ HBB gene boosts hemoglobin’s oxygen-carrying ability.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
● 藏獒是原产于喜马拉雅山脉的大型犬。
● 它们的 EPAS1 基因突变阻止了过量的血红蛋白产生。
● 它们的 HBB 基因突变增强了血红蛋白的携氧能力。
● 这些突变使犬类能够在高海拔的缺氧（低氧）环境中生存。
● 在2016年的一项研究中，郑旺（Zhen Wang）及其同事注意到藏狼的 DNA 也有相同的 EPAS1 和 HBB 突变。
● 王和同事们确定，藏獒大约在24000年前通过与藏狼的杂交首次获得了这些突变。
中文解析：
题目要求强调2016 study的结论，那就是最后一条note，于是强调了dogs and wolves interbreeding，那么就是A选项的interbreeding。

question:
Mexican architect Luis Barragán’s prolific career, which spanned the 1920s to the 1980s, evolved through distinct phases. After traveling to the United States and Europe in the early 1930s and immersing himself in a broader architectural discourse, Barragán began incorporating principles derived from functionalism and modernism in his work, as seen in the houses in Avenida Parque Mexico, whose unadorned geometric forms contrast with his earlier projects in Guadalajara, such as the house in Calle Liceo, which evince the aesthetics of traditional Mediterranean and Mexican styles.

Information in the text best supports which statement about the design of the house in Calle Liceo?
selections: A. It represents a transitional moment between the early and late phases of Barragán’s development.
B. It is characteristic of the Guadalajaran architecture that influenced Barragán throughout his career.
C. It reflects an approach to ornamentation and shape that Barragán later stopped using.
D. It displays the effects of Barragán’s exposure to international architectural trends in the 1930s.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
墨西哥建筑师路易斯·巴拉甘（Luis Barragán）的丰硕职业生涯跨越了1920年代至1980年代，经历了不同的阶段。在1930年代初期，他游历美国和欧洲，深入参与更广泛的建筑讨论后，巴拉甘开始在他的作品中融入来源于功能主义和现代主义的原则。这一点在墨西哥公园大道（Avenida Parque Mexico）上的住宅中表现得尤为明显，这些住宅的简洁几何形式与他在瓜达拉哈拉的早期项目形成鲜明对比，例如位于利塞奥街（Calle Liceo）的房子，后者展现了传统地中海和墨西哥风格的美学。
文本解析：
design of the house in Calle Liceo是具体的例子，前面的观点是his earlier projects in Guadalajara，于是和C选项描述的later stopped using是一致的。

question:
The following text is from Anthony Trollope’s 1855 novel The Warden. Charles James is the son of a high-ranking clergy member.
Charles James was an exact and careful boy; he never committed himself; he well knew how much was expected from the eldest son of the Archdeacon of Barchester, and was therefore mindful not to mix too freely with other boys. He had not the great talents of his younger brothers, but he exceeded them in judgment and propriety of demeanour; his fault, if he had one, was an over-attention to words instead of things; there was a thought too much finesse about him, and, as even his father sometimes told him, he was too fond of a compromise.

Which choice best states the function of the phrase “if he had one” in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It concedes that Charles James’s attempts to gain the approval of those who know him are sometimes to little avail.
B. It signals a shift in focus from describing Charles James’s fine traits to criticizing his tendency to excessively fear being the source of conflict.
C. It acknowledges that the qualities in Charles James the narrator goes on to describe may not actually be undesirable characteristics.
D. It anticipates readers’ objections to the narrator’s criticism of Charles James’s faults.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本摘自安东尼·特罗洛普1855年的小说《监护人》。查尔斯·詹姆斯是巴彻斯特大教堂一位高级神职人员的儿子。
查尔斯·詹姆斯是一个严谨而细心的男孩；他从不轻易表态；他清楚作为巴彻斯特大主教长子所寄予的期望，因此他谨慎地避免与其他男孩过于亲密的交往。他没有弟弟们那样的天赋，但在判断力和举止得体方面胜过他们；如果他有缺点，那就是过于关注语言而非事物本身；他身上有些过于细致入微，正如他父亲有时对他说的，他太喜欢妥协了。
中文解析：
if he had one表述假如他有缺点的话，潜台词就是说这个或许也算不得是什么缺点，或者他还是没有什么明显的缺点，也就是和C一致。

question:
Advancements like the emergence of ceramics manufacturing in central Europe circa 28,000 BCE are overemphasized in innovation studies, contributing to the idea that technological change always brings greater complexity. Research by Nathaniel Erb-Satullo reveals an important exception: gold metallurgy flourished in the Caucasus in the Bronze Age, but a steep drop during that time (circa 1500 BCE) in objects featuring gold filigree (in which fine threads of gold are arranged in intricate patterns) and other sophisticated goldsmithing techniques suggests that simpler processes supplanted advanced methods.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It explains that a particular interpretation of technological development has been perpetuated in an academic field and then provides a counterexample demonstrating that the interpretation isn’t always accurate.
B. It summarizes the findings of several studies into the origins of a particular invention and then presents additional evidence from a more recent study that contradicts those findings.

C. It advances a claim made by researchers in one academic field about the nature of technological change and then critiques a contrasting claim presented by a researcher from a related academic field.

D. It details the near-consensus among researchers in a particular field of study regarding how technology evolves and then indicates the controversial nature of a study challenging that broadly accepted view.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在创新研究中，像公元前28000年左右中欧陶瓷制造的出现这样的进展被过分强调，导致人们认为技术变革总是带来更大的复杂性。Nathaniel Erb-Satullo的研究揭示了一个重要的例外：青铜时代时，金属冶炼在高加索地区蓬勃发展，但在那个时期（约公元前1500年），具有金丝镶嵌（将细金丝排列成复杂图案）和其他复杂金工技艺的物品数量急剧下降，这表明更简单的工艺取代了先进的方法。
中文解析：
文本第一句讲ceramics的出现总是被过分强调，总以为技术的变化会带来复杂科技，然后第二句给了一个例外exception，最后表明goldsmith就是简单的方式取代了之前复杂的方式，所以和A选项一致。

question:
Saeed M.Z.A. Tarabieh conducted a study of consumer attitudes toward Jordanian food and beverage companies and found that for consumers who value environmental conservation, their likelihood of purchasing a product decreased when their perception of the product’s risk of causing environmental harm increased. Subsequently, other researchers conducted a study of various demographic groups in Chile, investigating participants’ intentions to purchase a new mobile phone, and found that, on average, college students had the lowest perception among all the demographic groups in the study of the environmental risks of the mobile phone. Assuming that the results of Tarabieh’s study are broadly applicable, this finding suggests that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. college students might be more likely than participants in the other demographic groups to purchase the mobile phone.
B. college students likely prioritize other factors over a product’s environmental sustainability when making purchasing decisions.
C. there is not a meaningful difference in the average likelihood of purchasing environmentally friendly products among the demographic groups included in the study.
D. the new mobile phone is less appealing to college students than other similar products on the market are.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
萨伊德·M.Z.A.·塔拉比赫（Saeed M.Z.A. Tarabieh）对消费者对约旦食品和饮料公司的态度进行了研究，发现对于重视环境保护的消费者来说，当他们对产品可能造成环境危害的风险感知增加时，购买该产品的可能性会降低。随后，其他研究人员对智利的不同人口群体进行了研究，调查参与者购买新手机的意图，发现平均而言，大学生在所有研究的人口群体中对手机的环境风险感知最低。假设塔拉比赫研究的结果具有广泛适用性，这一发现表明________。
中文解析：
根据文本likelihood of purchasing a product decreased when their perception of the product’s risk of causing environmental harm increased，那么college students has the lowest perception,自然购买mobile phones的可能性就是最高的。

question:
Most Native languages belong to language families, or groups of languages whose similarities in vocabulary and grammar suggest shared descent from a single language spoken long ago. In contrast, the language spoken by the Chimariko people in a mountainous area of Northern California was an isolate, or a language with no demonstrated relationship to other languages. Isolates are more prevalent in mountainous regions, likely because challenging terrain inhibits the geographical expansion of language families. Yet factors other than geographical barriers also influenced the distribution of Indigenous languages in California and elsewhere in the present-day United States.

Which statement, if true, would most directly support the claim in the underlined sentence?
selections: A. In mountainous regions of the western US, isolate-speaking peoples historically relied on foraging, hunting, and fishing, while peoples who speak languages in the Uto-Aztecan family historically practiced intensive farming.
B. Several nonisolate languages in the US Southeast, such as Miccosukee, are also associated with challenging terrain, albeit with swamps and coastal wetlands rather than mountain chains.

C. Northern Paiute, a language in the Uto-Aztecan family, was originally spoken in a vast expanse of Idaho, Nevada, and Oregon—a region whose mountainousness rivals that of the homeland of the Chimariko people.

D. The isolates spoken in California and the surrounding region, such as Chimariko, possess similarities to neighboring nonisolate languages at the level of vocabulary, suggesting that isolates can easily acquire words from unrelated languages through cultural exchange.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
大多数本土语言属于语言家族，即一些语言在词汇和语法上具有相似性，表明它们可能源自很久以前讲的单一语言。相比之下，加利福尼亚北部山区的奇马里科人所讲的语言是一种孤立语言，或称没有与其他语言证明有关系的语言。孤立语言在山区更为常见，这可能是因为复杂的地形抑制了语言家族的地理扩展。然而，除了地理障碍之外，其他因素也影响了加利福尼亚及现代美国其他地方的土著语言分布。
中文解析：
C选项中Northern Paiute和Chimariko people的地形一样，都属于土著人民所居住的地方，但是Northern Paiute属于Uto-Aztecan family，而Chimariko people的语言属于isolate语言，说明同为Indigenous地形，但是语言体系不一样，那么，就是影响语言体系的不是geographical barriers。

question:
Though John Crowley, author of The Translator, is not as well known as the most widely read American writers of the past fifty years, his work has had several influential champions, including the poet James Merrill and the literary critic Harold Bloom. In his afterword to Crowley’s book Little, Big, Bloom argues that the novel adroitly blends what playwright Friedrich Schiller termed the naive and sentimental modes—while Schiller thought works could be classified as either naive (seeking to describe reality) or sentimental (seeking to develop ideas), Little, Big fuses both modes of writing.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It accounts for a writer’s lack of popular appeal, cites a literary figure who appreciates that writer, and summarizes the qualities that make the writer’s work unique.

B. It identifies a writer whose work is regarded as difficult to read, brings up two admirers of that writer’s work, and gives information that may make the writer’s work more accessible to new readers.
C. It mentions a writer whose work is not widely known, presents two people who hold a positive opinion of that writer, and gives a reason why one of those people holds that opinion.
D. It describes a writer’s successful career, presents two literary figures who were supporters of that writer’s career, and explains why the writer was able to achieve what he did.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
虽然《翻译者》的作者约翰·克劳利（John Crowley）并不像过去五十年中最广泛阅读的美国作家那样知名，但他的作品得到了几位有影响力的支持者的推崇，包括诗人詹姆斯·梅里尔（James Merrill）和文学评论家哈罗德·布鲁姆（Harold Bloom）。在布鲁姆对克劳利的小说《小，大》（Little, Big）的后记中，他认为这部小说巧妙地融合了剧作家弗里德里希·席勒（Friedrich Schiller）所称的天真与感伤两种模式——席勒认为作品可以被分类为天真（旨在描述现实）或感伤（旨在发展思想），而《小，大》则将这两种写作模式融为一体。
中文解析：
第一句介绍了一个不太出名的作家，之后有两个人认可他的作品，最后是作品的特征，也是收到赞誉的原因，C选项符合要求

Onesmus Kitonyo and colleagues conducted a study in Kenya to investigate whether tilling—the practice of turning soil with hoes, plows, or other machines before planting crops—increases or decreases the yield of maize. Citing the results of the study by Kitonyo and colleagues, a student claims that tilling will help farmers increase crop yields generally.

Which choice best describes data from the table that weaken the student’s claim?
selections: A. There are some studies, such as the study by R.K. Jat and colleagues, that have found crop yields to be lower with tilling than without it.
B. The finding that tilling is associated with an increase in crop yield has not been replicated outside of Kenya.
C. Waqas Ahmed and colleagues reported a crop yield of 7,225 kilograms per hectare when no tilling was used but a yield of only 6,749 kilograms per hectare when tilling was used.
D. The study by Kitonyo and colleagues actually found that tilling was associated with a decrease in crop yield rather than an increase.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：

中文解析：

question:
Neurobiologists Laura Cuaya, Raul Hernández-Pérez, and colleagues investigated the language detection abilities of eighteen dogs raised in similar settings. The researchers monitored the brain activity of Pán (an Australia shepherd), Alma (a mixed breed), and other dogs while the animals listened to three recordings: one of The Little Prince being read in Spanish, the second in Hungarian, and a third made up of short, randomly selected fragments of the first two, scrambled so that they didn’t resemble human speech. Each dog was familiar with either Spanish or Hungarian, but not both. The team concluded that the amount of previous language exposure a dog has received may influence its ability to distinguish familiar languages from unfamiliar ones.

Which finding from the study, if true, would most directly support the team’s conclusion?
selections: A. The similarity between the pattern of brain activity a dog showed in response to hearing the scrambled recording and the pattern of brain activity it showed in response to hearing the language it was not accustomed to was greatest among older dogs.

B. Although the dogs’ general hearing sensitivity declined with age, dogs of all ages showed more brain activity in response to hearing the language they were accustomed to than in response to hearing the other language.

C. The difference between the pattern of brain activity a dog showed when hearing the language it was accustomed to and the pattern of brain activity it showed when hearing the language it was not accustomed to was greatest among older dogs.

D. Dogs showed a different pattern of brain activity when hearing the language they were accustomed to than when hearing the scrambled recording, and the difference in brain activity increased with the age of the dog scanned.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
神经生物学家劳拉·库阿亚、劳尔·埃尔南德斯-佩雷斯及其同事研究了在类似环境中饲养的十八只狗的语言识别能力。研究人员监测了澳大利亚牧羊犬潘（Pán）、混种犬阿尔玛（Alma）及其他狗的脑活动，同时这些动物聆听了三段录音：第一段是《小王子》的西班牙语朗读，第二段是匈牙利语朗读，第三段则由前两段的短小随机片段组成，经过打乱，使其不再像人类语言。每只狗都熟悉西班牙语或匈牙利语，但不同时熟悉两种语言。研究小组得出结论，狗之前的语言接触量可能会影响它们区分熟悉语言与不熟悉语言的能力。
中文解析：
当狗听到它熟悉的语言时，与听到不熟悉的语言相比，脑活动模式之间的差异在年长的狗中最为显著。这表明，随着年龄的增长，狗对熟悉语言的识别能力可能会增强从而呼应了最后结论中的 the amount oflanguage expoure 对于能力的影响。

question:
Anna Linderholm and other researchers probed the evolutionary history of size variation in canids (wolves, foxes, dogs, and their close relatives). The researchers found that small domestic dogs (e.g., Pomeranians) as well as small wild canids (e.g., foxes) tend to have a particular variant, known as the C allele, of the gene IGF1, a growth-related gene found in all mammals. Large canids (e.g., grey wolves, German shepherds), however, tend to have a different variant, known as the T allele, of IGF1. The researchers concluded that the T allele is the more recent of the two alleles to emerge.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers’ conclusion?
selections: A. The T allele is more common among wild canids native to cold regions, whereas the C allele is more common among wild canids native to warm regions.
B. Many domestic dogs and wild canids are heterozygous with regard to IGF1, meaning that they carry both the C and T alleles
C. The C allele but not the T allele is found in both bears and ferrets, which share a relatively recent common ancestor with canids.
D. Domestic dogs are descended from populations of wild canids in which the C allele was more prevalent than the T allele.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
安娜·林德霍尔姆和其他研究人员探讨了犬科动物（狼、狐狸、狗及其近亲）大小变异的进化历史。研究人员发现，小型家犬（如博美犬）以及小型野生犬科动物（如狐狸）往往具有一种被称为C等位基因的IGF1基因变异，这是一种在所有哺乳动物中发现的与生长相关的基因。然而，大型犬科动物（如灰狼、德国牧羊犬）则倾向于拥有IGF1的另一种变异，即T等位基因。研究人员得出结论，T等位基因是这两种等位基因中较新的变异。
中文解析：
文本最后结论是T allele 比 C allele更晚出现（more recent），C选项描述只有C allele（没有T alleles）存在于bears and ferrets，关键点是ferrets share a recent common ancestors with canids, 那就是说C allele出现在它们分化为两类动物之前，但是T Allele就没有存在，就说明那时它还没有产生，于是支持了先后顺序。

question:
Though most hoaxes perpetrated as jokes by mischievous users of Wikipedia, an online encyclopedia that almost anyone can freely edit, have quickly been detected and removed, a few fictitious entries, such as those for the American new wave band Transformatix and the Civil War general George K. Broomhall, persisted on the site for many years before they were finally recognized as ________ and deleted.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管大多数恶作剧是由恶作剧的维基百科用户所 perpetrated 的笑话，这是一部几乎任何人都可以自由编辑的在线百科全书，但一些虚构的条目，如美国新潮乐队 Transformatix 和南北战争将军 George K. Broomhall 的条目，在网站上存在了很多年，直到最终被认定为 ________ 并被删除。
中文解析：
在这个句子中，描述了尽管维基百科是一个几乎任何人都可以自由编辑的在线百科全书，大多数被恶作剧的用户制造的骗局很快就被发现并删除了，但是一些虚构的条目，在网站上存在了多年之后才最终被认为是虚构的，并被删除。Prank虚构，恶作剧适合。enhancements - 增强； pranks - 恶作剧； revelations - 揭示；analyses - 分析

question:
Text 1
The University of Pennsylvania and the investment bank Barclays are two of the many institutions offering training programs in entrepreneurship. But what results do such programs produce? In a study of business students and graduates in Scotland, researchers Laura Galloway and Wendy Brown addressed this question and reported that participants who received entrepreneurial training showed strong intentions to become entrepreneurs.
Text 2
While studies of entrepreneurial training typically report positive results, a close look at these studies reveals widespread methodological shortcomings. This research literature is plagued by unclear hypotheses, insufficient sample sizes, a lack of control groups, and failures to establish pretraining baselines for the measured attributes of participants.

Based on the texts, the author of Text 2 would most like to know the answer to which question about Galloway and Brown’s study that is not addressed in Text 1?
selections: A. Did the participants that Galloway and Brown included in the study share any characteristics or life circumstances?
B. How many Scottish business students and graduates did Galloway and Brown include in the study?
C. Did Galloway and Brown measure any attributes of the participants in the study after they had received the training?
D. Did Galloway and Brown compare Scottish business students and graduates who received the training with a group of successful entrepreneurs who did not receive the training?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
文本 1
宾夕法尼亚大学和投资银行巴克莱是提供创业培训项目的众多机构之一。但这些项目究竟产生了什么样的结果呢？在对苏格兰的商科学生和毕业生的研究中，研究者劳拉·加洛韦和温迪·布朗探讨了这个问题，并报告称，接受创业培训的参与者表现出强烈的创业意向。
文本 2
虽然关于创业培训的研究通常报告积极的结果，但仔细分析这些研究会发现普遍存在的方法论缺陷。该研究文献存在假设不清晰、样本量不足、缺乏对照组，以及未能建立参与者测量属性的培训前基线等问题。
中文解析：
根据text two说到的四个unclear hypotheses, insufficient sample sizes, a lack of control groups, and failures to establish pretraining baselines，于是B符合sample sizes的考虑。

question:
Agglomeration economies arise when multiple firms in related industries ________ an area, as with iron and steel production firms and cutlery and hardware manufacturers in Wolverhampton, UK. Economists have assumed that companies cluster for the same reasons, but Giulia Faggio et al. found that factors driving agglomeration in some cases are only weakly correlated with agglomeration in others.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:

question:
Studying menus from nineteenth-century restaurants, advertisements for defunct amusement parks, and posters promoting long-forgotten plays may seem like a frivolous pursuit, but ephemeral objects like these are useful as markers of cultural change: they can ________ shifts in norms, values, and concerns that traditional objects of historical inquiry may not.

研究十九世纪餐馆的菜单、已关闭游乐园的广告以及宣传早已被遗忘的戏剧的海报，似乎是一种轻浮的追求，但像这些短暂的物品在文化变迁中具有重要作用：它们可以______传统历史研究对象可能无法揭示的规范、价值观和关切的变化。
中文解析：
句子中描述了研究被停产的糖果包装、十九世纪餐馆菜单和宣传长期被遗忘的体育赛事的传单似乎是一种轻浮的追求，但是这些短暂的物品可以作为文化变迁的标记，它们可以记录传统历史研究对象可能无法记录到的规范、价值观和关注点的转变。Evince表示表明显示符合要求。induce - 引诱；导致。vindicate - 为……辩护；证明。evince - 表明；显示。preclude - 排除；阻止选项

question:
Growing seasons in Alaska have been extending further into the year as a result of climate changes, potentially enabling increased carbon dioxide (CO2) absorption through greater productivity of marsh cinquefoil (Comarum palustre) plants and other vegetation, but also potentially enabling increased CO2 output through greater heterotrophic respiration (CO2) generated by the activity of soil microorganisms). Hydrologist Yonghong Yi and her colleagues developed a model incorporating numerous inputs—years of solar radiation and snow cover data among them—to evaluate the effects of climate changes on the Co balance in Alaska, concluding that net CO2 is likely to increase if seasonal snow cover arrives earlier relative to the onset of soil surface freezing.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers’ conclusion?
selections: A. Relatively early snow cover reduces the amount of soil moisture available for the growth of plant species such as C. palustre and lowers the rate of heterotrophic respiration.

B. Seasonal snow cover tends to persist longer in areas of relatively low vegetation growth and high heterotrophic respiration than in areas of relatively high vegetation growth and low heterotrophic respiration.
C. The soil insulation provided by snow cover enables heterotrophic respiration to continue during a period in which plant species such as C. palustre are typically not growing.

D. The effect of solar radiation on the growth of vegetation and on the rate of heterotrophic respiration is stronger during the period of seasonal snow cover than during the period without snow cover.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
阿拉斯加的生长季节因气候变化而进一步延长，这可能通过沼泽五叶草（Comarum palustre）等植物和其他植被的生产力提高，促进二氧化碳（CO2）吸收，但也可能通过异养呼吸（由土壤微生物活动产生的CO2）增加CO2排放。水文学家易永洪及其同事开发了一种模型，结合了多个输入数据，包括多年的太阳辐射和雪覆盖数据，以评估气候变化对阿拉斯加碳平衡的影响。他们得出结论，如果季节性雪覆盖相对于土壤表面冻结的开始时间提前，净CO2可能会增加。
中文解析：
根据最后结论net CO2上升，那么就是seasonal snow cover限制了植被，但是促进了微生物异养呼吸，于是和C选项描述一致。

question:
Kore, one of the eighty known moons of Jupiter, is designated as Jupiter XLIX (“XLIX” means “49”). Roman numerals typically indicate the order in which the moons were named rather than the order of their proximity to Jupiter. It is incorrect to assume, ________ that Kore is the forty-ninth moon from Jupiter in terms of proximity.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
Kore是已知的木星八十颗卫星之一，被指定为木星XLIX（“XLIX”表示“49”）。罗马数字通常表示卫星命名的顺序，而不是它们与木星的距离顺序。________，假设 Kore是离木星第四十九近的卫星是错误的。
中文解析：
科瑞（Kore）是木星已知的八十颗卫星之一，编号为木星XLIX（“XLIX”表示“49”）。罗马数字通常表示卫星命名的顺序，而不是它们与木星距离的顺序。科瑞是从木星距离上算起的第四十九颗卫星这样的假设就错了，前后是一致的顺承关系，于是选择then，注意then有表示“因此，那么”的意思

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Need Money for Cars is a 2023 sculpture by American artist Beau Dunn.
● It consists of a white neon sign that spells out the title phrase
● Pyramid (Yellow) is a 2011 sculpture by Mexican-Swiss artist Ana Roldán.
● It consists of a yellow neon sign that forms an abstract triangle shape.
● Neon signs became popular with advertisers in the 1920s and began to decline in popularity in the 1960s.
● Neon signs became popular with artists in the 1960s and continue to be popular today.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two sculptures. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. While the sculptures share a common material, one spells out a phrase while the other is decidedly more abstract.

B. Molded into an evocative phrase in Need Money for Cars (2023), an abstract form in Pyramid (Yellow) (2011), and an advertising tool in decades past, neon lighting has a number of different applications.
C. Roldán’s sculpture was made in 2011 and Dunn’s in 2023, both well after the advertising heyday of neon signs had passed.
D. American artist Beau Dunn’s and Mexican-Swiss artist Ana Roldán’s sculptures have employed neon signs in different ways, demonstrating the versatility of the popular material.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一位学生做了以下笔记：
● 《需要钱买车》是美国艺术家博·邓（Beau Dunn）于2023年创作的雕塑。
● 该作品由一个白色霓虹灯标志组成，上面写着标题短语。
● 《金字塔（黄色）》是墨西哥-瑞士艺术家安娜·罗尔丹（Ana Roldán）于2011年创作的雕塑。
● 该作品由一个黄色霓虹灯标志组成，形成一个抽象的三角形。
● 霓虹灯标志在1920年代受到广告商的欢迎，到了1960年代开始逐渐失去人气。
● 霓虹灯标志在1960年代受到艺术家的青睐，并至今仍然受欢迎。
中文解析：
题目要求emphasize a difference between the two sculptures，A选项满足，因为一个spell out a phrase, 另一个form an abstract triangle shape.

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Mikaela Marques Pulzatto and M. S. Dainez Filho published a study in 2017.
● In it, the researchers found that ingestion by bats had a positive effect on the germination of Cecropia pachystachya plant seeds.
● Jorge E. López and C. Vaughan published a study in 2004.
● In it, the researchers found that ingestion by bats had a neutral effect on the germination of Senna fruticosa plant seeds.
● Katrin Heer, Larissa Albrecht, and Elisabeth K.V. Kalko published a study in 2010.
● In it, the researchers found that ingestion by bats had a negative effect on the germination of Ficus obtusifolia plant seeds.

The student wants to make a generalization about the germination of seeds ingested by bats. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Seed ingestion by bats can have varying effects on seed germination.
B. As was found in the 2017 study, ingestion by bats has a negative effect on the germination of plant seeds.
C. Over the years, researchers have studied the effect that seed germination has had on ingestion by bats.
D. Bat ingestion has consistently been found to have a positive effect on seed germination.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究某一主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
● Mikaela Marques Pulzatto 和 M. S. Dainez Filho 于2017年发表了一项研究。
● 研究发现，蝙蝠的摄食对Cecropia pachystachya植物种子的发芽有积极影响。
● Jorge E. López 和 C. Vaughan 于2004年发表了一项研究。
● 研究发现，蝙蝠的摄食对Senna fruticosa植物种子的发芽有中性影响。
● Katrin Heer、Larissa Albrecht 和 Elisabeth K.V. Kalko 于2010年发表了一项研究。
● 研究发现，蝙蝠的摄食对Ficus obtusifolia植物种子的发芽有负面影响。
中文解析：
题目要求a generalization about the germination of seeds ingested by bats，根据notes中有积极、中立和消极各种影响，于是概括为A选项的varying effects。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Rooftops is a 1935 black-and-white linocut by Japanese American artist Isami Doi.
●It depicts an everyday scene (a woman hanging laundry up to dry).
●Field is a 1968 black-and-white linocut by Black American artist Samella Lewis.
●It features a scene with an explicitly political point of view (a laborer raising his fist in a symbol of liberation).
●Lino cutting is an inexpensive printmaking technique in which an image is carved onto linoleum tile, which is then painted and stamped onto paper.
●Artist Paul Flight called lino cutting “an art of the people” for its ease of use.

The student wants to make and support a generalization about linocuts. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Linocuts can highlight everyday scenes, like a woman hanging laundry up to dry, or explicitly political ones, like a laborer raising his fist in a symbol of liberation.
B. Artist Paul Flight called lino cutting “an art of the people”; indeed, it is a technique in which an image is carved onto linoleum tile that is then painted and stamped onto paper.
C. Doi made Rooftops in 1935, while Lewis made Field later, in 1968.
D. Rather than reflecting an explicitly political point of view, the linocut Rooftops depicts a tranquil, everyday scene of a woman hanging laundry up to dry.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
- 《屋顶》是由日裔美国艺术家井上勇（Isami Doi）创作于1935年的黑白亚光版画。
- 它描绘了一个日常场景（一个女人晾衣服）。
- 《田野》是由非裔美国艺术家萨梅拉·刘易斯（Samella Lewis）创作于1968年的黑白亚光版画。
- 它展现了一个具有明确政治视角的场景（一个工人举起拳头，象征解放）。
- 亚光版画是一种经济实惠的版画技法，通过在油毡砖上雕刻图像，然后涂上油漆并印刷到纸上。
- 艺术家保罗·弗莱特（Paul Flight）称亚光版画为“人民的艺术”，因为它易于使用。
中文解析：
题目要求make and support a generalization about linocuts，于是需要有观点和具体例子，A选项符合，因为即描述了everyday scenes，又描述了具体两个例子。

question: In triangle DEF, the measure of angle D is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mn>49</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>∘</mo> </mrow> </msup></math> and the measure of angle E is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mn>107</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>∘</mo> </mrow> </msup></math>. question: The cost of renting a power washer is $84 for the first day and $42 for each additional day. Which of the following functions’ gives the cost C(d), in dollars, of renting the power washer for d days, where d is a positive integer?
explanations: 一次函数应用题，根据题意，42为斜率，注意注意语言表述 $84 for the first day ，即为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>84</mn></math> ,所以只有A正确

question: In a set of four consecutive odd integers, where the integers are ordered from least to greatest, the first integer is represented by x. The product of 24 and the third odd integer in the set is at most the value of 86 less than the sum of the first and fourth odd integers in the set. What is the greatest possible value of x?
explanations: 24*(x+4)≤x+(x+6)-86，解得x≤-8，由于x为奇数odd，故最大值为-9

question:

explanations: 经典的二次函数方程组system of equations，将y消去得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>10</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>c</mi></math> 整理得标准形式，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>47</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>288</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> ，system two distinct real solutions意味着<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></math> ,整理结果为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>c</mi><mo>></mo><mfrac><mn>119</mn><mn>12</mn></mfrac></math> 故只有D（技巧解：若时间不够，计算来不及，观察二次函数开口向下，若想有两个交点，一次函数图像也要尽量靠下，也就是c越大越靠下，因为是-c，只有一个答案正确只能是C最大的15）

question: For the function f, for each increase in the value of x by c, where c is a positive constant, the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> increases by a factor of 27. Which of the following equivalent forms of the function f displays <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>c</mi></mfrac></math>  as a coefficient of x?
explanations: 根据题意，for each increase in the value of x by c，increases by a factor of 27，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>27</mn><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>3</mn><mn>3</mn></msup></math> ，对于四个选项来说，可以发现每个选项都是x=6时变化率为27（举例A：<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>3</mn><mrow><mfrac><mn>6</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>27</mn></math> ，其它选项都是）所以c=6，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>c</mi></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>6</mn></mfrac></math> 只有B选项<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>6</mn></mfrac></math>

explanations: 式子化简成<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>9</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，即<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>9</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，两个解为-b 或（2a+1）/9，因为b为正数所以不是-b=42，故（2a+1）/9=42解得a=377/2

explanations: 注意表述的名称，composition分成了muscle、bone、fat，设总composition为x，以及muscle占比67.7%可得67.7%x=139.2，解得x=205.6，除去muscle后bone含量为51.4%，所以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>205.6</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mn>139.2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>∗</mo> <mn>51.4</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi> <mo>≈</mo> <mn>34.1</mn></math>（nearest tenth）

question:
Known for the albums Someday My Prince Will Come and Milestones, jazz trumpeter Miles Davis collaborated several times with pianist Gil Evans. Their 1958 adaptation of George Gershwin’s opera Porgy and Bess bears little resemblance to the 1935 original. Davis and Evans felt no desire to please listeners expecting an exact duplication of the opera. They omitted parts, such as the aria “I Got Plenty of Nuthin,” and sometimes made only brief gestures toward Gershwin’s melodies. But Davis and Evans’s willingness to recompose Gershwin’s work led to one of the most enduring albums in Davis’s catalog.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It presents examples to support a claim made earlier in the text.
B. It shows how two artists benefited from ignoring certain conventions.
C. It proposes a reason why one work of art is widely thought to be more successful than another.
D. It undermines an assertion made later in the text.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
迈尔斯·戴维斯（Miles Davis）因专辑《总有一天我的王子会来》（Someday My Prince Will Come）和《里程碑》（Milestones）而闻名，他与钢琴家吉尔·埃文斯（Gil Evans）多次合作。他们在1958年改编的乔治·格什温（George Gershwin）歌剧《波吉与贝丝》（Porgy and Bess）与1935年的原版几乎没有相似之处。戴维斯和埃文斯并不想迎合那些期待歌剧精确复制的听众。他们省略了一些部分，比如咏叹调《我有很多什么都没有》（I Got Plenty of Nuthin’），而且有时只是对格什温的旋律做出简短的回应。但戴维斯和埃文斯愿意重新编排格什温的作品，最终导致了戴维斯唱片目录中最持久的专辑之一的诞生。
中文解析：
划线句子是对表述（戴维斯和埃文斯并不想迎合那些期待歌剧精确复制的听众）的支持。

question:
Superlubricity, the state of virtually no friction between materials, has desirable applications in many industries. For example, it can make aircraft engines more efficient. To produce a coating that achieves superlubricity, Chanaka Kumara and colleagues broke down carbon nanotubes into fragments of graphene to fully cover two surfaces that would rub together. Friction between pieces of graphene is generally extremely low, and when the researchers added a drop of oil as lubrication, that friction nearly vanished. This new coating may drastically lower friction-related energy costs.

According to the text, what happened when the researchers added oil to the surfaces covered in graphene fragments?
selections: A. All the pieces of graphene collected on just one of the two surfaces.
B. The low amount of friction between the surfaces became even lower.
C. Carbon nanotubes on the surfaces fractured into smaller pieces.
D. Friction between the surfaces did not noticeably change right away.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
超润滑性是指材料之间几乎没有摩擦的状态，这在许多行业中具有理想的应用。例如，它可以提高飞机发动机的效率。为了生产一种实现超润滑性的涂层，Chanaka Kumara及其同事将碳纳米管分解成石墨烯片段，以完全覆盖两个将相互摩擦的表面。石墨烯片段之间的摩擦通常极低，当研究人员添加一滴油作为润滑时，摩擦几乎消失。这种新涂层可能会大幅降低与摩擦相关的能源成本。
中文解析：
文章说加了oil后， friction nearly vanished，于是和B选项一致，表示表面摩擦更低了。

question:
Originating in the traditional stories of the Kanaka Maoli, the Native Hawaiian people, the literature of Hawaii has a rich history that was later brought to international prominence by writers such as Mary Katwena Pukui. Now, by producing acclaimed works, Gary Pak has _______ his place in that literary tradition.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
源于夏威夷土著人民卡纳卡·毛利（Kanaka Maoli）的传统故事，夏威夷文学拥有丰富的历史，后来由玛丽·卡特维纳·普库伊等作家使其在国际上声名显赫。如今，盖瑞·帕克通过创作备受赞誉的作品，______了他在这一文学传统中的地位。
中文解析：
通过好的作品，巩固了自己的文学地位，选择solidify。A. contemplated - 深思，考虑；B. subverted - 颠覆，破坏；C. solidified - 使巩固，使固定；D. extricated - 使摆脱，解脱。

question:
The following text is from George Eliot’s 1857 short story “The Sad Fortunes of the Rev. Amos Barton.” In the text, the narrator addresses the reader directly and alludes to a discussion among Rev. Amos Barton’s neighbors.
It was happy for the Rev. Amos Barton that he did not, like us, overhear the conversation recorded in the last chapter. Indeed, what mortal is there of us, who would find his satisfaction enhanced by an opportunity of comparing the picture he presents to himself of his own doings, with the picture they make on the mental retina of his neighbours? We are poor plants buoyed up by the air-vessels of our own conceit: alas for us, if we get a few pinches that empty us of that windy self-subsistence! The very capacity for good would go out of us.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Although people grasp the importance of honesty, they typically resist confronting others about their flaws.
B. Although people wish to be seen as considerate, the slightest setbacks will often discourage them from being so.
C. People tend to fixate more often than they should on whether their acquaintances think highly of them.
D. People are better off not knowing about the discrepancy between their own self-image and what others think of them.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字节选自乔治·艾略特1857年发表的短篇小说《阿莫斯·巴顿牧师的悲惨命运》。在这段文字中,叙述者直接对读者说话,并提到阿莫斯·巴顿牧师的邻居们之间的一段对话。
幸运的是,阿莫斯·巴顿牧师没有像我们一样,偷听到上一章记录的那段对话。事实上,我们这些凡人中,谁会因为有机会比较自己对自己行为的看法与邻居们心目中的印象而感到更满足呢?我们就像被自负这种"气囊"支撑着的可怜植物:如果这些气囊被戳破了几下,排空了我们虚浮的自我满足,那我们就太可悲了!我们行善的能力也会随之消失。
中文解析：
段落是总分结构，于是第一句说没有overhear conversation是件好事，indeed之后具体描述邻居们对我们的评价，和我们自己对自己的感觉不一样，从而给我们带来很多伤害，和D选项一样。

question:
A road was recently built in a Maryland woodland that is home to the house finch. Some finches’ nests were situated close to the new road and others were deeper in the woodland. Common ravens, which eat finch eggs, can spot nests near the open spaces of roads more easily than they can spot nests surrounded by woodland. Accordingly, researchers in Maryland trying to predict the impact of the new road on finches have suggested that _________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. finch eggs will make up about the same percentage of common ravens’ diet as they did before the road was built.
B. the number of finches building nests near the road will gradually increase as the finches adapt to the presence of the common ravens.
C. finches nesting near the road will lose eggs to common ravens at a higher rate than will finches nesting far from the road.
D. finches nesting far from the road will lay fewer eggs per nest than will finches nesting near the road.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
最近在马里兰州的一片林地中修建了一条新道路，这里是屋顶雀的栖息地。一些雀巢靠近新道路，而另一些则位于林地更深处。普通渡鸦以雀蛋为食，它们更容易发现靠近开放道路的雀巢，而不是那些被林地包围的巢穴。因此，试图预测新道路对雀鸟影响的马里兰研究人员建议______。
中文解析：
根据文本common ravens更容易发现路边开阔地方的finch eggs，于是未来挨着路边的finches损失蛋的比例更高。

question:
Scholarly interest in literary juvenilia — writings by children and teenagers — tends to focus on unpublished works by authors who became famous as adults, such as W.H. Auden’s poem “Autumn,” which he wrote around age 15, because they offer insights into their authors’ artistic development. But some scholars also argue that recovering juvenilia by lesser-known writers is essential to understanding literary history: Daisy Ashford’s novels, which she published as a child, were widely read by contemporaries and are therefore deserving of closer attention.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To describe the challenges famous writers encountered when seeking to publish works written in their childhood
B. To argue that Ashford’s novels have more literary merit than Auden’s juvenilia do
C. To compare the accomplishments of young writers with those of their adult contemporaries
D. To present reasons why literary scholars consider juvenilia to be valuable resources
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
学术界对文学青少年作品（即儿童和青少年的创作）的关注，通常集中在那些成年后成名的作者未发表的作品上，比如W.H. 奥登在15岁时写的诗《秋天》，因为这些作品能够提供关于作者艺术发展的深刻见解。但一些学者也认为，发掘那些不太知名作家的青少年作品对于理解文学历史至关重要：戴西·阿什福德（Daisy Ashford）作为儿童发表的小说在当时受到广泛阅读，因此值得我们给予更多关注。
中文解析：
全文分两个方面说明了青年文学作品作为有价值资源的重要性。but前是第一个方面，but后是第二个方面。

Neighboring species
Target species

In a study of interactions between plants, researchers Carolina Laura Morales and Anna gathered data about flowering plants growing alongside each other in various locations. In each case, the researchers identified one plant as a “target species” and a plant as a “neighboring species.” An example of a neighboring species is the musk which grows alongside the Peruvian lily in ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the example?
explanations:

植物之间相互作用的研究，研究人员卡罗琳娜·劳拉·莫拉莱斯和安娜收集了关于不同地点生长的开花植物的数据。在每个案例中，研究人员确定了一种植物作为“目标物种”，而另一种植物作为“邻近物种”。邻近物种的一个例子是麝香植物，它与秘鲁百合一起生长于______。

question:
Researchers Cesar A. Hidalgo, Elisa Castaner, and Andres Sevtsuk created a computer model to predict the mix of businesses and places of interest found in a given neighborhood. The team used data from the Google Places API service to help identify florists, beauty salons, and other businesses and map their locations. This approach has some limits — data from Places API tend to be restricted to places that are customer facing — but the data set nonetheless provides an extremely reliable source to study colocation patterns of neighborhood amenities.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It describes the imprecise and subjective nature of neighborhood boundaries.
B. It introduces a model that a research team built to evaluate the mix of amenities in urban neighborhoods.
C. It emphasizes the potential utility of the team’s model.
D. It identifies a specific flaw in using a data set about amenities in cities.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
研究人员Cesar A. Hidalgo、Elisa Castaner和Andres Sevtsuk创建了一个计算机模型，以预测特定社区中商业和兴趣地点的组合。该团队使用了Google Places API服务的数据，以帮助识别花店、美容院和其他商家，并绘制它们的位置图。尽管这种方法存在一些局限性——Places API的数据往往仅限于面向顾客的场所——但该数据集仍然提供了一个极为可靠的来源，以研究社区便利设施的共存模式。
中文解析：
破折号间表达了这类数据的局限性，也就是D选项说的flaw

question:
Roy McLendon’s Moonlit St. Lucie, a riverscape featuring the silhouette of a single palm tree against the backdrop of shimmering water and a brilliant moonlit sky, is typical of paintings by the Florida Highwaymen, an informal collective of landscape artists mainly active in the 1950s and ‘60s. Remarkable for anticipating and amplifying cultural perceptions of Florida that became pervasive in the public consciousness, paintings by the Highwaymen are readily identifiable by the natural iconography — placid inland rivers, windswept palm trees — that MeLendon and colleagues perpetually revisited.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Although similar in its subject matter to many paintings by the Florida Highwaymen, Moonlit St. Lucie is now more highly regarded than other Florida Highwaymen paintings are.
B. Representative images found across many paintings by McLendon and other Florida Highwaymen came to be widely associated with Florida in part due to the Florida Highwaymen’s influence.
C. Although paintings by the Florida Highwaymen were once celebrated for their depictions of Florida’s natural environments, the popularity of these paintings waned after the 1960s.

D. The placid inland rivers and windswept palm trees that are typical of McLendon’s works, which are otherwise indistinguishable from other Florida Highwaymen paintings, help to differentiate McLendon’s paintings from those of his colleagues.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
罗伊·麦克伦登的《圣卢西河畔月光》描绘了一幅河流风景画，画面中一棵棕榈树的轮廓在闪烁水面和明亮月光下的夜空背景下显得格外突出。这幅作品是佛罗里达州“高速公路艺术家”集体风格的一个典型例子。“高速公路艺术家”是一群活跃于20世纪50年代至60年代的非正式景观画家团体，他们的画作以自然景象为特色——宁静的内陆河流、被风吹拂的棕榈树等。这些作品通过不断重复描绘类似的自然元素，成功地预示并强化了公众对佛罗里达州的文化认知。这样的艺术创作不仅展现了艺术家们对于家乡美景的独特视角和深厚情感，也反映了那个时代人们对于佛罗里达州的美好想象与向往。
中文解析：
highwaymen的公路画作品能够呈现典型的Florida意象，随后放大了公众对这些意象的感知（public perception），MeLendon and colleagues的作品容易识别也是因为这些经典意象。

question:
Biologists Rebecca M. Calisi-Rodriguez and George E. Bentley examined research on species such as dark-eyed juncos and tucos, which have both been studied under laboratory conditions as well as in the wild, to see whether there were significant differences between findings in the wild and in the lab. And, for example, they found for tucos that daytime is the most active period for wild individuals but not for captive individuals. Calisi-Rodriguez and Bentley therefore concluded that the laboratory setting was likely ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. more suitable than wild settings for studying tucos’ patterns of rest and activity.
B. affecting the results for both tucos and dark-eyed juncos.
C. more suitable for studying dark-eyed juncos than for studying tucos.
D. interfering with tucos’ patterns of rest and activity.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
生物学家丽贝卡·M·卡利西-罗德里格斯和乔治·E·本特利研究了黑眼朱雀和图科等物种的研究，这些物种在实验室条件下和野外都进行了研究，以观察野外与实验室的发现是否存在显著差异。例如，他们发现图科在野外的白天是最活跃的时段，但在圈养个体中则不是。因此，卡利西-罗德里格斯和本特利得出结论，实验室环境可能是______。
中文解析：
tucos白天野外活跃，但是实验室不活跃，说明lab环境影响了tucos的作息。

question:
In a 2018 article about films depicting the experiences of Black Americans, critics for the New York Times praise Madeline Anderson’s 1970 film I Am Somebody as “galvanizing” and Reginald Hudlin’s 1990 film House Party as “exuberant.” Fans of the two films hope that such ______ will attract new audiences to these works.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在2018年一篇关于描绘美国黑人经历的电影的文章中，《纽约时报》的评论家称马德琳·安德森于1970年拍摄的电影《我就是某人》为“激励人心”，而雷金纳德·哈德林于1990年拍摄的电影《派对之家》则被称为“充满活力”。这两部电影的粉丝希望这样的______能够吸引新的观众来欣赏这些作品。
中文解析：
前面铺垫两部作品收到赞誉（praise），于是such acclaim是同意表达，acclaim表示称赞

question:
All stainless steel contains varying amounts of iron, carbon, and corrosion-inhibiting chromium. However, ferritic stainless steel often used for induction cookers contains a higher percentage of chromium (at least 10.5%) than does austenitic stainless steel as well as a higher concentration of iron. Unlike ferritic stainless steel, austenitic stainless steel has a face-centered cubic crystalline structure held stable by the presence of nickel and nitrogen. Austenitic stainless steel has two subtypes: the 200 series, often used for washing machines, and the 300 series, which has more nickel than the 200 series and is often used for storage containers or furnaces. Thus, stainless steel used to manufacture ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. furnaces and stainless steel used to manufacture washing machines will both have a chromium content of less than 10.5%.
B. washing machines will have a higher concentration of nickel in its composition than stainless steel used to manufacture furnaces will.
C. induction cookers will have a face-centered cubic crystalline structure, but stainless steel used to manufacture storage containers will not.
D. storage containers and stainless steel used to manufacture induction cookers will have a similar concentration of nitrogen in their compositions.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
所有不锈钢都含有不同数量的铁、碳和防腐铬。然而，铁素体不锈钢（通常用于电磁炉）含有比奥氏体不锈钢更高比例的铬（至少10.5%）以及更高浓度的铁。与铁素体不锈钢不同，奥氏体不锈钢具有面心立方晶体结构，这种结构由镍和氮的存在保持稳定。奥氏体不锈钢有两个亚类型：200系列，通常用于洗衣机，以及300系列，含有比200系列更多的镍，通常用于储存容器或炉子。因此，用于制造______的不锈钢。
中文解析：
ferritic 和生产washing machines的都属与Austenitic stainless steel的chromium ，对比ferritic stainless steel （chromium高于10.5）

question:
As a member of Indigenous Photograph, artist Tshepiso Mabula ka Ndogngeni (Xhosa) can _______ her work more broadly than she could without the organization’s reach. Photography editors around the world can search for Indigenous photographer members on the organization’s website to find images that document and reflect the lives of Indigenous communities.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
作为土著摄影组织的成员，艺术家Tshepiso Mabula ka Ndogngeni（科萨族）能够比没有该组织的影响力时更广泛地展示她的作品。全球的摄影编辑可以在该组织的网站上搜索土著摄影师成员，以寻找记录和反映土著社区生活的影像。
中文解析：
借助平台网站（organization websites）可以更好的推广自己的作品，选择promote her work。

question:
The following text is adapted from John Matheus’s 1925 short story “Fog.” A train has stopped at a station, where heavy fog has set in.
The little conductor stood on tiptoe in an effort to keep one hand on the signal rope, craning his neck in a vain and dissatisfied endeavor to pierce the miasma of the fog. The motorman chafed in his box, thinking of the drudging lot of the laboring man. He registered discontent.

As used in the text, what does the word “registered” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本改编自约翰·马修斯1925年的短篇小说《雾》。一列火车停在一个车站，浓厚的雾气笼罩着四周。
小列车长踮起脚尖，努力用一只手抓住信号绳，脖子伸得很长，徒劳而不满地想要看穿浓雾的迷雾。驾驶员在他的驾驶室里焦躁不安，思考着劳动者的辛苦生活。他感到不满。
中文解析：
在这个上下文中，“registered discontent”指的是驾驶员表达了不满情绪。他通过他的行为或态度显示出他对工作的不满。在这里，“registered”表示表达或展示，而不是指其他选项中的“enrolled”（注册）、“valued”（重视）或“disregarded”（忽视）。因此，在这个句子中，“registered”最接近的意思是“displayed”。
