Interested in how differences in the color of dogs’ irises affect human responses to dogs, Akitsugu Konno et al. showed close-up images of dogs’ faces to human participants and asked them to rate the dogs’ traits and their own attitudes toward the dogs. Konno et al. suggest that differences in iris color led participants to view some dogs as more vulnerable and in need of protection than others and that this phenomenon could help explain the association the researchers observed between iris color and participants’ inclinations to interact with or keep dogs, as illustrated by the finding that_______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
selections: A. the more mature a dog was perceived to be, the more likely participants were to rate it as having light irises.
B. participants favored the dogs in images 2 and 11, which they rated as less mature than the dogs in images 20 and 16.
C. participants rated the dog in image 2 as less mature than the dog in image 11 and rated the dog in image 16 as less mature than the dog in image 20.
D. dogs that participants rated as friendlier were also dogs that participants indicated a stronger willingness to interact with or keep.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
对狗狗虹膜颜色差异如何影响人类对狗的反应感兴趣的Akitsugu Konno等人向人类参与者展示了狗脸的特写图像，并要求他们评估狗的特征以及他们自己对这些狗的态度。Konno等人认为，虹膜颜色的差异使参与者将某些狗视为更脆弱、更需要保护，这一现象可以帮助解释研究者观察到的虹膜颜色与参与者与狗互动或饲养倾向之间的关联，正如以下发现所示_______。
中文解析
题目文本中提到differences in color会让参与人员认为狗是更vulnerable和需要保护的，影响人们对它们的态度，注意图表中的immature---mature这一栏和题目更相关因为成熟和vulnerable有一定关系，所以我们看irises、mature、以及keep/interact这四列，那么就会对应选择B，编号2和11的狗（颜色深）比编号20和16的狗（颜色浅）更受欢迎，因为他们更不成熟。

question:
The utilization of deceptive antipredator displays is well documented in the spotted sandpiper (Actitis macularius) and other species of the avian order Charadriiformes. An extensive literature review conducted by Léna de Framond et al. revealed that this trait has evolved across a surprisingly large phylogenetic distribution of 13 Aves orders, including Galliformes and Apodiformes. Subsequent investigation of potential selection mechanisms prompted the researchers to conclude that independent of avian order, the prevalence of the trait is mediated by environmental variations associated with the absolute latitude of brooding sites

Which finding, if true, would most strongly support the researchers’ conclusion?
selections: A. The use of deceptive antipredator displays is widespread among Charadriiformes species independent of the absolute latitude of their breeding sites, but its prevalence in other avian orders is limited to species with brooding sites located in absolute latitudes of 0°-30°.

B. Deceptive antipredator displays are documented in Charadriiformes species across the entire range of absolute latitudes of brooding sites within that order, but in species from other orders, deceptive antipredator displays are documented only when brooding sites are at absolute latitudes 10°-20° higher than what is typical for those species.

C. Across the orders in the study, deceptive antipredator displays are observed in approximately 34% of species with brooding ranges of 0°-30° absolute latitude and approximately 60% of species with brooding ranges of 50° 80° absolute latitude.

D. Across the orders in the study, approximately 54% of the bird species brood in ranges from 50° to 80° absolute latitude, but most of the birds that are known to use deceptive antipredator displays brood between 0 and 30° absolute latitude.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在斑点沙鸡（Actitis macularius）以及其他鹤形目（Charadriiformes）鸟类中，利用欺骗性抗捕食展示的现象已有充分的文献记录。Léna de Framond 等人进行的一项广泛文献综述显示，这一特征在13个鸟纲（Aves）目中进化，涉及范围之广令人惊讶，包括鸡形目（Galliformes）和雨燕目（Apodiformes）。后续对潜在选择机制的调查促使研究人员得出结论：无论鸟类的分类如何，该特征的普遍存在受到与繁殖地点绝对纬度相关的环境变化的影响。
中文解析
文本最后表达和order无关（independent of avian order），和absolute latitude of brooding sites相关，across orders可以表达与orders无关，于是从C和D中选择，C表达了具体对应的数据大小和具体维度，满足题目的要求，D的重点在brood，没有讨论 latitude带来的trait的变化，所以不对。

question:
As exemplified by Yi songs about the natural environment and Tlingit songs about wildlife encounters, ecological information can be transmitted in Indigenous songs, and in some instances is maintained only in this way. Kwaxsistalla Wathl’ thla, a song keeper for the Kwakwaka’wakw people in Canada, collaborated with ethnobiologist Dana Lepofsky et al. sharing songs referencing terraced intertidal clam gardens the people implemented in the past to foster healthy development of a dietary staple. Drawing on archaeological evidence as well, Lepofsky et al. determined that the prevalence of the practice described in the songs corresponded with growth in clam size and abundance despite increased harvesting pressure—a finding that demonstrates that _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. representation of practical applications of ecological knowledge is the defining characteristic of the music of certain Indigenous peoples.
B. the Kwakwaka’wakw people likely would not have detailed their creation of clam gardens in songs if their efforts had not produced significantly larger clams.
C. the clams harvested from intertidal terraces by Kwakwaka’wakw people in the past likely were a different species than the clams found in those areas today.
D. effective methods for the cultivation of sources of sustenance are among the ecological knowledge preserved in Indigenous songs.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以关于自然环境的易曲和关于野生动物遭遇的特林吉特歌曲为例，生态信息可以通过土著歌曲进行传递，在某些情况下，只有通过这种方式才能得以保存。加拿大 Kwakwaka’wakw 族的歌曲保管者 Kwaxsistalla Wathl’ thla 与民族生物学家 Dana Lepofsky 等人合作，分享了提及该民族过去实施的梯田潮间带蛤蜊园的歌曲，以促进这种饮食主食的健康发展。Lepofsky 等人还借助考古证据确定，歌曲中描述的这一做法的普遍性与蛤蜊的大小和丰度增长相对应，尽管收获压力增加——这一发现证明了 _______
中文解析
文本描述了Kwakwaka'wakw歌曲里的养殖clams描述，对于clams有重要的意义，archaeological evidence可以看出祖先使用了这个有效的方法保持了clam数量的稳定与增产，和D选项一致。

question:
J. Mason Heberling and David J. Burke relied on historical DNA (hDNA) — genomic data incidentally preserved in specimens housed in natural history collections — to investigate the evolutionary trajectory of arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi. Although this approach offers unique benefits, such as access to genomic data from extirpated populations, it remains relatively underutilized because archival specimens are sometimes stored in ways that compromise DNA quality, a situation not easily remediable under current methodological paradigms and with extant DNA extraction and analysis technologies.

What does the text most strongly suggest about specimens from natural history collections?
selections: A. While they were used in a study that made an important scientific discovery, they are generally of marginal value as sources of genomic data.
B. Because of their often-deteriorated condition, they tend to yield genomic data that are time-consuming to extract and interpret.
C. While they may contain valuable genomic data, not all of them can yield usable hDNA.
D. They are primarily used as sources of genomic data by scientists studying organisms that have undergone major evolutionary change.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
J. Mason Heberling 和 David J. Burke 依靠历史DNA（hDNA）——即在自然历史收藏中偶然保存的基因组数据——来研究丛枝菌根真菌的进化轨迹。尽管这种方法提供了独特的优势，例如可以获取已灭绝种群的基因组数据，但由于档案标本有时以损害DNA质量的方式保存，这种方法仍然相对未被充分利用，而在当前的方法论范式以及现有的DNA提取和分析技术下，这种情况并不容易得到改善。
中文解析
根据文章最后一句的although从句和主句对比，能看到hDNA虽然有优点，但是过去生物保存时会损害DNA质量，当前的技术很难解决，于是C选项正确：虽然过去的specimens或许包含有价值的基因数据，但是并非都能产生可用的hDNA。

question:
Cybersecurity experts often encourage users to create passwords that are fairly complicated and therefore difficult to guess. Nonetheless, research has shown that the more _______ approach to password selection seems to favor convenience over security: for example, the second most commonly used password in 2016 was the easily remembered “password.”

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
网络安全专家通常鼓励用户创建相对复杂的密码，因此难以猜测。然而，研究表明，_______的密码选择方法似乎更倾向于便利性而非安全性：例如，2016年第二常用的密码是容易记住的“password”。
中文解析
根据文本组后second most commonly usely可以推断需要的描述是关于common/ popular，说明人们其实常用的密码是方便记的而不是安全的。

question:
Sony’s introduction of the PlayStation console in 1994 is an instance of brand extension—the company leveraged its brand recognition as a television and radio manufacturer to enter a product category where it had not previously competed. To determine if perceived category similarity predicts consumers’ likelihood of purchasing brand extensions, Alicia Grasby et al. identified 30 extended-brand pairs (e.g., the same brand of hiking shoes and sleeping bag) in 52 weeks of purchases by approximately 60,000 households; for each pair, Grasby et al. had consumers rate the similarity of the product categories and calculated the change in probability of a brand in one category being purchased if the same brand was purchased in the other category.

Which finding, if true, would provide evidence that the possibility Grasby et al. investigated does occur?
selections: A. Consumers tended to purchase more products in categories in which extended- brand pairs are found than in categories in which extended-brand pairs are not found.
B. Consumers’ ratings and the changes in probability calculated by the researchers were both affected by level of brand recognition.
C. There was a strong positive correlation between consumers’ ratings and the changes in probability calculated by the researchers.
D. Consumers’ ratings varied substantially by category pair, whereas the changes in probability calculated by the researchers were broadly similar for each pair.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
索尼在1994年推出PlayStation游戏机是品牌扩展的一个例子——该公司利用其作为电视和收音机制造商的品牌认知度，进入了一个之前未曾竞争的产品类别。为了确定感知的类别相似性是否能预测消费者购买品牌扩展的可能性，Alicia Grasby等人识别了30对扩展品牌（例如，登山鞋和睡袋均为同一品牌）在大约60,000个家庭的52周购买数据中；对于每一对，Grasby等人让消费者对产品类别的相似性进行评分，并计算了在购买了一个类别的品牌后，购买同一品牌在另一个类别的概率变化。
中文解析
要支持文本最后一句，就要表达出higher similarity ratings 和 increased likelihood of purchasing一致，即越是认为categories相似， 越是有可能购买同品牌的产品，就可以支持原文得结论。于是选择C

question:
Neuroscientist Kiyohito ligaya and colleagues developed a computational model to predict how much a person will enjoy a particular work of art on a scale from 1 (not at all) to 4 (very much). They then recruited participants to use the same scale to rate several sets of paintings in various styles and calculated the correlation between the ratings predicted by the model and those reported by the participants. Assuming participant P1 gave equal ratings to the impressionist and color-field paintings, the data in the graph suggest that the model predicted that _______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement?
selections: A. P1 would derive more aesthetic pleasure from impressionist paintings than from color-field paintings.
B. P1’s ratings for impressionist and color-field paintings would differ from one another.
C. P1 would derive less aesthetic pleasure from impressionist paintings than from color-field paintings.
D. P1’s ratings for impressionist and color-field paintings would equal one another.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
神经科学家Kiyohito Ligaya及其同事开发了一个计算模型，用于预测一个人对特定艺术作品的欣赏程度，评分范围为1（完全不喜欢）到4（非常喜欢）。然后，他们招募参与者使用相同的评分标准来评估几组不同风格的画作，并计算模型预测的评分与参与者报告的评分之间的相关性。假设参与者P1对印象派画作和色域画作给出了相同的评分，图表中的数据表明该模型预测________。
中文解析
correlation与model预测给出的值和participants给出的值相关，现在P1给出的数据一样，但是柱状图correlation不一样，于是models predicts给出的值不一样。

During the 1924 New York ticker-tape parade for US Olympic champions, the ribbonlike swirls descending on the scene were paper spools from “tickers,” telegraph machines used to transmit stock prices. Of course, the original ticker tape had long since been retired by the 2019 parade for the US women’s national soccer team. _______ shredded standard paper enriched the celebration.

explanations:

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Generally, an object will heat up when twisted.
●The twisting of an object is known as torsion.
●A 2019 study led by Zunfeng Liu and Ray Baughman tested the torsional heating of various fibers.
●When a 3-millimeter-thick sample of thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) fiber was twisted, its average surface temperature increased by 6℃.
●When a 4-millimeter-thick sample of styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene(SEBS) rubber fiber was twisted, its average surface temperature increased by 3.5℃.

The student wants to contrast the two samples. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Twisting an object will generally cause its temperature to increase, a process known as torsional heating.
B. In 2019, researchers studied the effect of torsional heating on various fibers, including samples of SEBS rubber and TPU.
C. When the fibers were twisted as part of the 2019 study, the surface temperature of both samples increased.
D. The SEBS rubber sample used in the 2019 study was thicker than the TPU sample.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
●一般来说，物体在扭曲时会升温。
●物体的扭曲被称为扭转。
●2019年，Zunfeng Liu 和 Ray Baughman 领导的一项研究测试了各种纤维的扭转加热。
●当一块厚度为3毫米的热塑性聚氨酯（TPU）纤维样本被扭转时，其平均表面温度上升了6℃。
●当一块厚度为4毫米的苯乙烯-乙烯-丁烯-苯乙烯（SEBS）橡胶纤维样本被扭转时，其平均表面温度上升了3.5℃。
中文解析
题目要求对比两个samples，根据notes，SEBS是4-millimeter-thick sample，TPU是3-millimeter-thick sample，于是D符合要求，SEBS比TPU thicker.

question:
In 2015, geologist Peter Rogerson calculated that the geographic center of Kansas was a point 2.1 miles southeast of the municipality of Bushton Bend. Rogerson’s calculation was more accurate than the one from 1920 by the US Geological Survey. _______ this earlier calculation was made using far more rudimentary equipment—only cardboard and string.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在2015年，地质学家彼得·罗杰森计算出堪萨斯州的地理中心位于巴什顿弯市东南2.1英里的一个点。罗杰森的计算比美国地质调查局1920年的计算更为准确。______ 之前的计算仅使用了更为简单的设备——仅仅是纸板和绳子。
中文解析：
"Of course"（当然）后面接解释，在一定程度上有让步解释的意思。说明1920年的计算之所以不够准确，是因为当时使用的设备非常简陋。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Merle Oberon (1911-1979) was an actress born in Mumbai (then known as Bombay) India.
●She was of Indian, Maori, and Irish heritage.
●She was the first Indian-born actress to be nominated for an Academy Award.
●Early in her career, she played many nameless, uncredited roles, such as her role in Service for Ladies (1932).
●Later, she played many named, credited roles, such as Katherine Beckmann in Of Love and Desire (1963).

The student wants to emphasize the order in which the two films were released. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Service for Ladies (1932) was released early in Merle Oberon’s career, whereas Of Love and Desire (1963) came out years later.
B. In Service for Ladies (1932), actress Merle Oberon played a nameless, uncredited role; however, in Of Love and Desire (1963), she played a credited role—that of Katherine Beckmann.
C. Merle Oberon was famous for her roles in films like Service for Ladies (1932) and Of Love and Desire (1963).
D. Early in her career, Merle Oberon wasn’t listed in some film credits, such as the credits for the film Service for Ladies, where she played a nameless, uncredited role.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下是关于梅尔·奥贝伦（Merle Oberon）的研究笔记概要：
●梅尔·奥贝伦（1911-1979）是一位出生于印度孟买（当时称为波姆拜）的女演员。
●她具有印度、毛利和爱尔兰的混合血统。
●她是第一位获得奥斯卡提名的印度出生女演员。
●在她职业生涯的早期，她扮演了许多没有名字和无记名的角色，例如她在《为女士服务》（Service for Ladies, 1932）中的角色。
●后来，她参与了许多有名字和有记名的角色，例如在《爱与欲望》（Of Love and Desire, 1963）中饰演凯瑟琳·贝克曼（Katherine Beckmann）。
这些笔记总结了梅尔·奥贝伦的生平、职业发展及其在电影界的成就。
中文解析
题目要求emphasize 电影发行的顺序（the order），A选项指出俩电影的时间和先后顺序。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●A river’s stream length is the length of a line that follows along the river path.
●A river’s valley length is the length of a straight line drawn from the beginning of the river to the end.
●The river’s curviness, or sinuosity, is the ratio of the river’s stream length to its valley length.
●Low-sinuosity rivers have a stream length 1-1.5 times longer than their valley length, and high-sinuosity rivers have a stream length 1.5 or more times longer than their valley length.
●The Embarras River in Canada has high sinuosity.
●The Luni River in India has low sinuosity.

The student wants to compare the curviness of the two rivers. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The high-sinuosity Luni River in India is curvier than the low-sinuosity Embarras River in Canada.
B. In both the Embarras and the Luni rivers, curviness is determined by comparing stream length to valley length.
C. By comparing the stream lengths of the Embarras and Luni rivers to their valley lengths, one can calculate their curviness, or sinuosity.
D. The Embarras River’s ratio of stream length to valley length, also known as sinuosity, is greater than that of the Luni River.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
● 河流的流线长度是沿着河流路径的线段长度。
● 河流的谷长是从河流起点到终点的直线长度。
● 河流的曲折度或弯曲度是河流流线长度与谷长的比率。
● 低弯曲度的河流流线长度是谷长的1到1.5倍，而高弯曲度的河流流线长度是谷长的1.5倍或更多。
● 加拿大的恩巴拉斯河具有高弯曲度。
● 印度的卢尼河具有低弯曲度。
中文解析
题目要求比较两条河的curviness，Low-sinuosity river Luni River比起 high sinuosity river Embarras River，curviness可以通过stream length比valley length的ratio来确定，于是D选项符合要求。

question:
While researching a topic. a student has taken the following notes:
●Grimanesa Amoros is a Peruvian American artist well known for her LED light sculptures.
●Her sculpture Watch Your Step is made of smooth multicolored LED domes.
●It occupies 335 cubic feet of space.
●Her sculpture Golden Connection is made of entangled blue and white LED tubes.

B. At 100,000 cubic feet in size. Grimanesa Amoros’s Golden Connection cuts a larger figure than the 335-cubic-foot Watch Your Step.
C. Watch Your Step is an LED light sculpture made by Grimanesa Amoros, as is Golden connection.
D. The smooth LED domes of Grimanesa Amoros’s Watch Your Step stand in contrast to the tangled LED tubes of Golden Connection.
explanations:

●她的雕塑《小心脚下》由光滑的多彩LED圆顶构成。
●它占据了335立方英尺的空间。
●她的雕塑《金色连接》由缠绕的蓝色和白色LED管道构成。
●它占据了100,000立方英尺的空间。
中文解析
题目要求强调两者间的相似，于是C满足要求，两者都是LED light sculptures.

question: The perimeter of an isosceles right triangle is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>52</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mn>52</mn> <msqrt> <mn>2</mn> </msqrt></math> inches. What is the length, in inches, of the hypotenuse of this triangle?

question: The table shows three values of x and their corresponding values of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfrac></math> and f is a linear function. What is the y-intercept of the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> in the xy-plane?

question: A set designer is hammering nails along the top edge of a wall with a length of 3x feet, where x is an integer, that will be used to hang garland. The designer hammers the first nail at the left edge of the wall. The designer then hammers an additional nail every <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>3</mn> <mn>8</mn> </mfrac></math> feet along the entire length of the wall, starting from the first nail and with the last nail being hammered at the right edge of the wall. Which equation best represents this situation, where y is the number of nails the designer hammers along the entire length of the wall?
explanations: 根据题意，长度为3x，每3/8feet有一个nail，第一个nail在墙边上，所以总的nail数量y为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>1</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>3</mn> <mi>x</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mn>3</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <mn>8</mn> </mrow> </mfrac></math>，整理等式得到y=1+8x故选D

question:

question:
Water flowing around an obstruction creates vortices (patterns of swirls) of varying size; by detecting the vortices, fish can determine the size and position of the obstruction. Testing by Yuzo R. Yanagisuru, Otar Akanyeti, and James C. Liao using models of three head shapes—narrow(low ratio of width to length), intermediate, and wide (high ratio of width to length)—showed that for medium-sized vortices, fish with wide heads would be least able to distinguish between vortices and general turbulence in the water. A second research team has therefore hypothesized that in low-visibility conditions, wider-headed fish will be less likely than narrower-headed fish to detect obstructions.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the second research team’s hypothesis?
selections: A. A study using obstructions that created medium-sized vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the bristlemouth (Chaetostom a yurubiense), which has a relatively wide head, bumped into more than half of the obstructions.

B. A study using obstructions that created medium-sized vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the wider-headed bristlemouth (Chaetostom a yurubiense) bumped into obstructions more often than the narrower-headed dusky smooth-hound (Mustelus canis) did.

C. A study using obstructions that created medium-sized vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the narrower-headed dusky smooth-hound (Mustelus canis) bumped into the obstructions just as often as the wider-headed bristlemouth (Chaetostoma yurubiense) did.

D. A study using obstructions that created medium-sized vortices in low-visibility conditions found that some specimens of dusky smooth- hound (Mustelus canis), which has a relatively narrow head, bumped into the obstructions more often than other specimens of the same fish did.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
水流绕过障碍物时会形成不同大小的涡旋（旋转模式）；通过检测这些涡旋，鱼类能够判断障碍物的大小和位置。由矢名须留裕（Yuzo R. Yanagisuru）、阿卡尼提（Otar Akanyeti）和廖杰姆斯（James C. Liao）进行的实验使用了三种头部形状的模型——窄头（宽度与长度比率低）、中等头和宽头（宽度与长度比率高）——结果显示，对于中等大小的涡旋，宽头鱼在区分涡旋和水中一般湍流方面的能力最差。因此，第二个研究团队提出假设，在能见度低的情况下，宽头鱼比窄头鱼更不容易发现障碍物。
中文解析：
宽头鱼比窄头鱼更不容易发现障碍物，那么宽头鱼比窄头鱼就更容易撞到障碍物，对应B

question:
The following text is adapted from Mary Seacole’s 1857 autobiography Wonderful Adventures of Mrs. Seacole in Many Lands.
That journey across the Isthmus [of Panama], insignificant in distance as it was, was by no means an easy one. It seemed as if nature had determined to throw every conceivable obstacle in the way of those who should seek to join the two great oceans of the world.

As used in the text, what does the word “conceivable” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本改编自玛丽·西科尔1857年的自传《西科尔女士在多国的奇妙冒险》。
那段穿越巴拿马地峡的旅程，尽管距离微不足道，却绝非易事。似乎大自然决心在那些试图连接世界两大洋的旅者面前设置各种障碍。
中文解析：
这里描述一条举例虽然不长，但是却困难重重的巴拿马海峡连接之路，every conceivable obstacle形容所有困难，于是选择imaginable，所有想象得到的困难。

question:
The lion can run very fast—up to 81 kilometers per hour(km/ hr)—but it is significantly slower than the white-throated needletail swift, which can fly at speeds up to 169 km/ hr. The difference between these speeds is largely ________ of the fact that the features that make flight possible do less to limit top speeds than the features suitable for running on land.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
狮子可以跑得非常快——最高可达每小时81公里——但它的速度显著低于白喉针尾雨燕，该鸟的飞行速度可达每小时169公里。这些速度之间的差异在很大程度上是______因为使飞行成为可能的特征对最高速度的限制较小，而适合在陆地上奔跑的特征则对最高速度限制较大。
中文解析：
两种动物的速度差异的原因，指出是因为能够飞行的特征对限制最高速度的作用要小于适合在水中游泳的特征。需要描述这是一种结果，后面接原因。

question:
Often, the Nobel Prize in Chemistry is given to a single person, such as Frederick Sanger in 1958. But sometimes the Nobel Committee wants to reward work attributed to two or three individuals, in which case, the award is given ________. For instance, in 2008, Roger Y. Tsien was among those awarded for “the discovery and development of the green fluorescent protein, GFP.”

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
诺贝尔化学奖通常授予单个个人，例如1958年的弗雷德里克·桑格。但有时诺贝尔委员会希望奖励归功于两到三个人的工作，在这种情况下，奖项会______。例如，在2008年，罗杰·Y·钱因“绿色荧光蛋白（GFP）的发现和开发”而获得奖项。
中文解析：
根据two or three individuals可以推断是把奖项联合授予，一起获得，jointly符合

question:
Though John Crowley, author of Flint and Mirror, is perhaps not as well known as the most commercially successful American writers of the past fifty years, influential figures have championed his work, including the poet John Hollander and the literary critic Harold Bloom. In his afterword to Crowley’s book Little, Big, Bloom praises the novel’s adroit blend of what playwright Friedrich Schiller termed the naive and sentimental modes—while Schiller thought works could be classified as either naive (seeking to describe reality) or sentimental (seeking to develop ideas), Little, Big demonstrates that a work can be both.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To compare the work of a writer with the work of a poet who admired him
B. To present a reason why a literary critic is impressed by a certain novel
C. To argue that all writing must be classified as belonging to one of two categories
D. To explain what inspired an author to write a particular work
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管《燧石与镜子》(Flint and Mirror)的作者约翰·克劳利(John Crowley)也许不像过去五十年中最成功的美国作家那样广为人知，但他的作品得到了重要人物的推崇，其中包括诗人约翰·霍兰德(John Hollander)和文学评论家哈罗德·布鲁姆(Harold Bloom)。在克劳利的书《小，大》(Little, Big)的跋文中，布鲁姆称赞了这部小说巧妙地融合了剧作家弗里德里希·席勒(Friedrich Schiller)所称的自然模式和感伤模式——席勒认为作品可以分为自然（旨在描述现实）或感伤（旨在发展思想），而《小，大》展示了一部作品可以兼具这两种模式。
中文解析：
约翰·克劳利的小说《小，大》，文学评论家哈罗德·布鲁姆赞扬该书独特地融合了native与sentimental两种风格。重点在于布鲁姆的欣赏及其背后的原因,因此，选项B最能准确捕捉到文本的主要目的。

question:
Any effort to raise the toll that drivers must pay to use the Ogdensburg-Prescott Bridge, which spans the Saint Lawrence River to connect New York State and Ontario, Canada, should explain why a higher toll is necessary; no amount of justification, however, is likely to persuade some drivers who believe the current toll is ________.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
任何提高驾驶者使用奥根斯堡-普雷斯科特大桥通行费的努力——这座桥跨越圣劳伦斯河，连接纽约州和加拿大安大略省——都应解释为什么提高通行费是必要的；然而，任何理由都不太可能说服一些认为当前通行费是________的驾驶者。
中文解析：
文本大意是提高过桥费很难说服一些drivers，他们觉得当前的费用已经很高了，exorbitant表示过高的。A. contentious - 有争议的，存在争议的；B. equivocal - 模棱两可的，含糊不清的；C. exorbitant - 过高的，过分的；D. warranted - 正当的，合理的

question:
The following text is adapted from Jerome K. Jerome’s 1889 novel Three Men in a Boat (To Say Nothing of the Dog).
We [ people] are creatures of the sun. We love light and life. That is why we crowd into the towns and cities, and the country grows more and more deserted every year. In the sunlight—in the daytime, when Nature is alive and busy all around us, we like the open hill- sides and the deep woods well enough: but in the night, when our Mother Earth has gone to sleep, and left us waking, oh! the world seems so lonesome, and we get frightened, like children in a silent house. Then we sit and sob, and long for the gas-lit streets, and the sound of human voices, and the answering throb of human life.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To address common traits that motivate many people to choose to live in urban environments
B. To indicate that people sometimes experience feelings of isolation in crowded areas
C. To illustrate the idea that most people tend to prefer hillsides in the country to certain aspects of towns and cities
D. To caution people not to be so quick to dismiss the natural beauty that can be found in rural areas
explanations:
难度：hard
题目文本翻译：
以下文本摘自杰罗姆·K·杰罗姆1889年的小说《三人在一条船上（不提狗）》。
我们（人类）是阳光的生物。我们热爱光明和生命。这就是为什么我们涌入城镇和城市，而乡村每年变得越来越荒凉。在阳光下——在白天，当大自然在我们周围活跃而忙碌时，我们喜欢开阔的山坡和深邃的森林；但在夜晚，当我们的母亲大地沉沉入睡，留下我们独自醒着时，哦！这个世界似乎是如此孤独，我们感到害怕，就像沉默的房子里的孩子一样。然后我们坐着抽泣，渴望燃气照明的街道、人声的回响，以及人类生命的脉动。
中文解析：
这个文本主要讨论了人们喜欢居住在城市的原因。它指出人们是喜欢阳光和生命的，因此他们倾向于聚集在城市和城镇中。文中提到了在夜晚人们会感到孤独和害怕，渴望城市中的照明灯光、人声和繁忙的生活节奏，这进一步强调了人们对城市生活的偏爱。因此，主要目的在于探讨人们选择居住在城市环境的共同特征和动机，而不是警告人们不要轻易忽视农村地区所拥有的自然美景或者表明大多数人更喜欢乡村的山坡而不喜欢城镇的某些方面。

question:
Cane is a 1923 novel by Jean Toomer. In one portion of the novel, Toomer establishes a contrast between the narrator’s attitude toward life and the attitude of the narrator’s love interest, Avey, writing, ________

Which quotation from Cane most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “[Avey would] smile appreciation, but it was an impersonal smile, never for me.”
B. “As time went on, [Avey’s] indifference to things began to pique me; I was ambitious. I left [our small hometown] earlier than she did.”
C. “I like to feel that something deep in me responded to the trees, the young trees that whinnied like colts impatient to be let free.”
D. “Avey was as silent as those great trees whose tops we looked down upon. She has always been like that. At least, to me.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《甘蔗》是让·图默（Jean Toomer）于1923年出版的一部小说。在小说的一个部分中，图默对叙述者的生活态度与叙述者的爱慕对象艾维（Avey）的态度进行了对比，写道，______。
中文解析：
题目要求对比narrator和恋人的态度，B选项的大意为：随着时间的推移，Avey对事物的漠不关心开始激怒我；我有雄心壮志。我比她更早离开了我们的小镇。

question:
Community science, which involves professional scientists collaborating with amateur science enthusiasts to study a topic, is often an effective and engaging way to conduct research. It can allow people to assist with conservation efforts, build youth confidence in the sciences, and increase the amount of data researchers can collect. This approach was essential to the success of a study by biologist Abbigail Merrill and colleagues of how butterfly color relates to flower choice, which included findings from hundreds of students and community members in northwestern Arkansas.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It describes the development of a type of scientific collaboration, shows how that type of collaboration has been used in a particular field of study, and then suggests future collaborative projects.
B. It identifies a particular approach to research, lists some benefits of that approach, and then mentions a study in which that approach was used.
C. It introduces the topic of a scientific study, describes the study's importance, and then presents the study's results.
D. It argues for a new approach to scientific research, comments on the public's opinion about the approach, and then describes how that approach was applied in a certain study.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
社区科学是指专业科学家与业余科学爱好者合作研究某一主题，这通常是一种有效且引人入胜的研究方式。它可以让人们参与保护工作，增强青少年对科学的信心，并增加研究人员能够收集的数据量。这种方法对生物学家阿比盖尔·梅里尔及其同事关于蝴蝶颜色与花朵选择关系的研究的成功至关重要，该研究包括来自阿肯色州西北部数百名学生和社区成员的发现。
中文解析：
文本开始Introduction of Community Science，然后是benefits of Community Science （aiding conservation efforts, engaging youth in science, and enhancing data collection for researchers.然后是具体例子Specific Example，Overall, the text introduces a concept, discusses its benefits, and illustrates its application with a concrete example.和选项B一致

question:
Honeybee hives consist mainly of hexagonal (six-sided) units called cells, in which queens lay eggs. Hexagonal cells for eggs that develop into nonreproductive workers are smaller than those for eggs that develop into reproductive drones, though the size difference varies by species. Difference in cell size results in a construction problem—it’s hard to neatly connect sections of small cells to sections of large cells—that worsens as the difference increases. To fill in gaps between the sections when building a hive, bees rely on cells that have more or fewer than six sides. A student studying beehive structure consults data on three species, concluding that ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the student’s conclusion?
selections: A. cells for worker eggs are probably closer in size to cells for drone eggs in the hives of the western honeybee than in the hives of the dwarf honeybee and the black dwarf honeybee.
B. both the western honeybee and the black dwarf honeybee probably reserve eight-sided cells for drone eggs, while the dwarf honeybee likely deposits drone eggs in seven-sided cells.
C. the western honeybee probably relies on many more geometrical shapes when constructing cells than either the dwarf honeybee or the black dwarf honeybee does.
D. the percentage of hexagonal cells is probably slightly lower in the hives of the western honeybee than in the hives of the dwarf honeybee and the black dwarf honeybee.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
蜜蜂蜂巢主要由称为“蜂房”的六边形（六面）单元组成，女王在其中产卵。用于发展为非繁殖工蜂的卵的蜂房比用于发展为繁殖雄蜂的卵的蜂房要小，尽管这种大小差异因物种而异。蜂房大小的差异导致了一个建造问题——小蜂房与大蜂房的部分难以整齐连接，且随着差异的增大，这个问题会加剧。为了在建造蜂巢时填补部分之间的缝隙，蜜蜂依靠具有多于或少于六个面的蜂房。一名研究蜂巢结构的学生查阅了三种物种的数据，得出结论_______。
中文解析：
因为western honeybee在图表里需要的非六边形是数量最少的，所以能够说明hive cells的尺寸接近，不需要用到这些其它尺寸的cells，和A选项一致.

question:
Pigments give paints and dyes their color. Ocher is a mineral-based pigment used to make several colors, including red. Red ocher gets its color from iron oxide. Pigments can also be plant-based; plant-based pigments contain a high level of carbon. In a 2023 study, archaeologists tested the red pigment on decorated beads made by members of the Natufian culture approximately 15,000 years ago. The test showed that the pigment found on several beads contained no iron but had a high level of carbon. This finding led the researchers to conclude that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the Natufian beadmakers used plant-based pigments rather than ocher to decorate some of the beads examined in the study.
B. the Natufian beadmakers preferred to use plant-based pigments because they are much brighter than mineral-based pigments are.
C. the pigments used by the Natufian beadmakers likely came from plants because ocher was difficult to find.
D. the Natufian beads examined in the study are the oldest surviving examples of the use of plant-based pigments for decorating beads.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
颜料赋予油漆和染料颜色。赭石是一种矿物基颜料，用于制造多种颜色，包括红色。红赭石的颜色来自氧化铁。颜料也可以是植物基的；植物基颜料含有较高水平的碳。在2023年的一项研究中，考古学家对大约15000年前纳图夫文化成员制作的装饰珠子上的红色颜料进行了测试。测试显示，在几颗珠子上发现的颜料不含铁，但碳含量很高。这个发现使研究人员得出结论_______。
中文解析：
从前面铺垫包含iron是金属染色，包含碳是植物染色，于是可以根据最后，研究者的发现表明，纳图凡文化的珠子上使用的红色颜料含有高水平的碳且不含铁，这意味着他们使用的是基于植物的颜料，而不是矿物基的红土。对应A选项。

question:
In a study by Mika R. Moran, Daniel A. Rodriguez, and colleagues, residents of Quito, Ecuador, and Lima, Peru, were surveyed about parks in their cities. Of the 618 respondents from Quito, 82.9% indicated that they use the city's parks, and of the 663 respondents from Lima, 72.7% indicated using city parks. Given that the percentage of Quito respondents who reported having access to other desired amenities near parks was much lower than that reported by Lima respondents, the difference in park use can't be explained by Quito residents having more access to desired nonpark amenities near parks.

Which choice best describes the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Even though the study found that parks in Lima are more likely to be close to other amenities than parks in Quito are, Quito has more amenities overall than Lima does.
B. The study's findings suggest that an increase in the number of amenities near city parks would likely increase park use in Quito but not in Lima.
C. The study's finding that a greater proportion of residents use parks in Quite than in Lima is partly due to the greater prevalence of parks in Quito.
D. Although the study found that a greater proportion of residents use parks in Quito than in Lima, that difference isn't due to greater access to amenities near parks in Quito.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在米卡·R·莫兰、丹尼尔·A·罗德里格斯及其同事的一项研究中，对厄瓜多尔基多和秘鲁利马的居民进行了有关城市公园的调查。在基多的618名受访者中，82.9%表示他们使用城市的公园；而在利马的663名受访者中，72.7%表示使用城市公园。考虑到基多受访者报告在公园附近拥有其他期望设施的比例远低于利马受访者，因此基多居民的公园使用率差异无法用他们在公园附近获得更多非公园设施的机会来解释。
中文解析:
文本体现了Quito人去parks比例大，但是数据可以看出access to other desired amenities near parks比例却低，于是原因不会是greater access to amenities near parks 和D选项一致。

question:
Whether the reign of a French monarch such as Louis XII or Louis IV was historically consequential or relatively uneventful, its trajectory was shaped by questions of legitimacy and therefore cannot be understood without a corollary understanding of the factors that allowed the monarch to ________ his right to hold the throne successfully.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
无论法国君主如路易十二或路易十四的统治在历史上是具有重要意义还是相对平淡，其发展轨迹都受到合法性问题的影响，因此无法理解而不考虑使该君主成功地________其统治权的相关因素。
中文解析：
描述法无论哪位国国王统治是历史上具有重大影响或相对不太有事件的，而其轨迹是由合法性问题塑造的，一定要理解一个和往事权力相关的因素，assert right，表达claim right。

question:
“Cocoa” is an example of a loanword—that is, a word that originated in one language and was later adopted by another. The word came to English indirectly from cacao, the Spanish word for the plant that chocolate is made from. Spanish had borrowed it from Nahuatl, an Indigenous language of Central Mexico, in which the word’s original form is cacahuatl. “Maize” is also Indigenous in origin and entered English through Spanish. But in this case, the original source was Taíno, a language of the Caribbean islands, in which the word for the corn plant is mahís.

The author makes which point about the Spanish language?
selections: A. It adopted Nahuatl and Taíno words in approximately equal numbers.
B. It has served as a medium through which Indigenous languages have influenced English.
C. Its contribution to English vocabulary roughly equals the collective contribution by Indigenous languages.
D. It has borrowed words from Indigenous languages and contributed words to them.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
“可可”是外来词的一个例子——即起源于一种语言并随后被另一种语言采用的词汇。这个词间接地来自“cacao”，这是西班牙语中表示巧克力来源植物的词。西班牙语是从中美洲土著语言纳瓦特尔语中借来的，而在纳瓦特尔语中，这个词的原始形式是“cacahuatl”。“玉米”也是源于土著语言，通过西班牙语进入英语。但在这种情况下，原始来源是加勒比群岛的一种语言——泰诺语，其中玉米植物的词为“mahís”。
中文解析：
根据文本，作者主要强调西班牙语从土著语言中借用词汇，并将它们引入英语。充当了中间的媒介功能。

In an extensive review of existing literature, Léna de Framond and team cataloged the prevalence of broken-wing display—a defensive behavior observed in Charadrius semipalmatus (semipalmated plover) and many other species—throughout the Aves class. Documentation of the display in 285 species across 52 families suggests the behavior likely evolved independently multiple times, prompting the team to consider ecological and life-history characteristics with hypothesized associations to the behavior’s emergence, including traits related to reproduction investment and future reproduction potential.

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the conclusion?
selections: A. incubation duration and capacity for multiple broods are more strongly associated with the use of broken-wing display than the number of parental incubators is.
B. among species with more than one parental incubator, the use of broken-wing display is associated with greater incubation duration.
C. capacity for multiple broods, number of parental incubators, and incubation duration are equally associated with the use of broken-wing display.
D. broken-wing display is most often observed in species with less opportunity to reproduce in a year due to longer incubation periods.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在对现有文献的广泛审查中，莱娜·德·弗拉蒙德及其团队对断翅展示——一种在半掌沙鸻（Charadrius semipalmatus）及许多其他物种中观察到的防御行为——在鸟类（Aves）分类中的普遍性进行了分类。对来自52个科的285个物种中该行为的记录表明，这种行为可能独立演化了多次，因此团队考虑了与该行为出现相关的生态和生活史特征，包括与繁殖投资和未来繁殖潜力相关的特征。
中文解析：
use of broken-wing display对应yes的两种生物，incubation duration要更短 capacity for multiple broods要更多，the number of parental incubators is没有明显的差别，因此前两个因素more strongly associated。

question:
The Akhundov National Library in Baku houses many historical newspapers, but it isn’t necessary to travel to Baku to access them. Because these rare items are digitized, people around the world can access ________ regardless of where they live.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 指代items，需要复数代词的宾格形式them

question:
As a leader of the National Woman Suffrage Association in the late 1800s, Olympia Brown of ________ an important role in the campaign to secure voting rights for US women.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主语和谓语间不用符号分割

question:
The Globe Theatre in London is a reconstruction of the famed venue where many of Shakespeare’s plays were first performed. In 1613, a prop cannon ________ during a performance and ignited the Globe’s thatched roof. No one was hurt, but in two hours the original Globe was gone.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 根据前后文需要过去时，选择malfunctioned

question:
Many Farms Chapter, which covers 168,000 acres, is one of the 110 chapters of the Navajo ________ Diné bizaad (the Navajo language), the chapter is called Dá’ák’eh Haláni.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 前后完整的句子需要用句号

question:
Famous for its four-degree tilt, the leaning Garisenda Tower is a popular attraction in Bologna’s city center. However, measurements taken in 2023 showed that the tower was rotating in a concerning way. ________ city officials closed the area around the tower so experts could explore solutions to stabilize the historical twelfth-century structure.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以其四度倾斜而闻名的加里森达塔（Garisenda Tower）是博洛尼亚市中心的一个热门景点。然而，2023年进行的测量显示，这座塔以一种令人担忧的方式旋转。_______市政府关闭了塔周围的区域，以便专家可以探索稳定这座历史悠久的十二世纪建筑的解决方案。
中文解析：
了加里森达塔（Garisenda Tower）在2023年的测量显示出令人担忧的旋转情况，因此城市官员关闭了该塔周围的区域，以便专家能够探索稳定这个历史悠久的结构的解决方案。最合适的过渡词是 C. As a result,，因为它表明了由于塔的旋转情况，城市官员采取了关闭该区域的措施。

question:
When languages are no longer spoken, they are considered extinct. ________ the Umbrian language went extinct around the first century BCE, though it was once widely spoken in parts of central Italy.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
当一种语言不再被使用时，它被认为是灭绝的。_______翁布里亚语在公元前一世纪左右灭绝，尽管它曾在意大利中部的部分地区广泛使用。
中文解析：
后面的Umbrian是前面观点的具体例子

question:
Scientists studying asteroid deflection have focused on secondary objects such as S/2018 (2018 EB), a moonlet orbiting the near-Earth asteroid 2018 EB. In 2022 NASA intentionally crashed a probe into just such an object, the moonlet Dimorphos. ________ Dimorphos’s orbital period around the near-Earth asteroid Didymos was permanently altered.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
研究小行星偏转的科学家们关注了诸如S/2018（2018 EB）这样的次级天体，它是一个环绕近地小行星2018 EB运行的小卫星。2022年，NASA故意将一颗探测器撞向这样的天体——小卫星迪莫福斯（Dimorphos）。_______迪莫福斯绕近地小行星迪迪摩斯（Didymos）的轨道周期被永久改变。
中文解析：
前面crash a probe into an object, 后面描述其轨道被改变，于是因果关系用consequently

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Lighthouses send out crucial light signals to help ships and other watercraft navigate at night.
● Before automation, lighthouses were run by lighthouse keepers.
● Elizabeth Riley was the lighthouse keeper at North Point Light in Maryland.
● She held this position from 1834 to 1857.
● Laura J. Hecox was the lighthouse keeper at Santa Cruz Light in California.
● She held this position from 1883 to 1917.

The student wants to emphasize the order in which the two lighthouse keepers began their careers. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Before automation, lighthouse keepers like Elizabeth Riley and Laura J. Hecox were crucial to ensuring safe navigation for watercraft.
B. Laura J. Hecox began her career as a lighthouse keeper years after Elizabeth Riley did.
C. Elizabeth Riley’s career as a lighthouse keeper ended in 1857, whereas Laura J. Hecox’s ended in 1917.
D. From 1834 to 1857, the nighttime waters of Maryland were more navigable thanks to lighthouse keepers Laura J. Hecox and Elizabeth Riley.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
这位学生的研究笔记提供了关于灯塔及其守卫者的有趣历史信息。以下是翻译：
•灯塔发出重要的灯光信号，帮助船只和其他水上交通工具在夜间导航。
•在自动化之前，灯塔是由灯塔看守人管理的。
•艾丽斯·蕾利是马里兰州北点灯塔的灯塔看守人。
•她从1834年到1857年担任这一职务。
•劳拉·J.赫科克斯是加利福尼亚州圣克鲁兹灯塔的灯塔看守人。
•她从1883年到1917年担任此职。
这些信息展示了女性在历史上为公共安全和航海导航做出的重要贡献。
中文解析：
题目要求强调事业开始顺序（the order in which the two lighthouse keepers began their careers），B描述began career，同时用after指出顺序的先后。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● The A. M. Turing Award is a prestigious award given for “major contributions of lasting importance to computing.”
● Judea Pearl won the award in 2011 for developing a calculus for probabilistic reasoning.
● Butler W. Lampson won the award in 1992 for contributions to the development of personal computing environments

The student wants to emphasize the order in which Judea Pearl and Butler W. Lampson won the A. M. Turing Award. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Butler W. Lampson won the A. M. Turing Award in 1992; Judea Pearl won it later, in 2011.
B. It was in 1992 that Butler W. Lampson won the A. M. Turing Award.
C. Judea Pearl and Butler W. Lampson both won the A. M. Turing Award, which is given for “major contributions of lasting importance to computing.”
D. In 2011, Judea Pearl won the A. M. Turing Award for developing a calculus for probabilistic reasoning.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
● A. M. 图灵奖是一项享有盛誉的奖项，颁发给对计算机科学“具有持久重要性的重大贡献”。
● 朱迪亚·珀尔（Judea Pearl）因发展概率推理的微积分而于2011年获得该奖。
● 巴特勒·W·兰普森（Butler W. Lampson）因对个人计算环境发展的贡献而于1992年获得该奖。
中文解析：
题目要求强调顺序，emphasis the order于是A符合要求，1992，2011年前后顺序。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Dinosaur fossil specimens can be found at science museums all over the world.
● Many dinosaur fossil specimens are given nicknames.
● The Royal Saskatchewan Museum in Saskatchewan, Canada, houses a dinosaur fossil specimen nicknamed Scotty.
● Scotty lived in the Late Cretaceous period, which ended more than 65 million years ago.
● It is a member of the genus Tyrannosaurus.

The student wants to provide an example of a dinosaur fossil specimen’s nickname. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. A Tyrannosaurus fossil specimen from the Late Cretaceous period, which ended more than 65 million years ago, is housed at the Royal Saskatchewan Museum.
B. Nicknames are given to many dinosaur fossil specimens, including one housed at a museum in Saskatchewan, Canada.
C. Scotty is the nickname of a Tyrannosaurus fossil specimen housed at the Royal Saskatchewan Museum in Saskatchewan, Canada.
D. Dinosaur fossil specimens can be found at museums all over the world, and many of these specimens are given nicknames.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
● 世界各地的科学博物馆都可以找到恐龙化石标本。
● 许多恐龙化石标本都有昵称。
● 加拿大萨斯喀彻温省的皇家萨斯喀彻温博物馆收藏了一件昵称为斯科蒂（Scotty）的恐龙化石标本。
● 斯科蒂生活在晚白垩纪，距今超过6500万年。
● 它属于霸王龙属（Tyrannosaurus）。
中文解析：
题目需要恐龙nickname具体例子，C选项的Scotty符合要求

question:
Topographical prominence is a measure of a mountain’s independence from other mountains. Having 11,486 feet of prominence, ________

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. geographers have ranked Mount Hayes, a peak in the United States, as the world’s 51st most prominent mountain.
B. Mount Hayes, a peak located in the United States, is ranked by geographers as the world’s 51st most prominent mountain.
C. the list of mountains geographers rank as the world’s most prominent includes Mount Hayes, a peak located in the United States, at number 51.
D. the ranking given by geographers to Mount Hayes, a peak located in the United States, is 51st most prominent mountain in the world.
explanations: having ... 分词作状语，主句的主语是动作having 11,486 feet的发出者，于是需要山来充当主语Mount Hayes

question:
Trade was vital to the Akkadian Empire, which reigned in Mesopotamia from around 2334 BCE to 2154 BCE. Its people ________ wool, grain, and clay to sell to neighboring societies. In exchange, they received valuable items, such as wood, stone, and copper.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 根据前后文需要过去时，选择produced

question:
Diadromous fish migrate between freshwater and marine biomes during their life cycle. The migration’s obligate nature is why diadromous fish can be ________ those that are merely euryhaline (able to tolerate high salinity): the euryhaline blackchin tilapia can survive high salinity, but its life cycle does not involve relocation to a different biome, as does that of the diadromous wild salmon.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
洄游鱼类在其生命周期中会在淡水和海洋生境之间迁徙。这种迁徙的必然性是洄游鱼类能够与仅仅是耐盐性的鱼类（能够耐受高盐度的鱼类）区分开来的原因：耐盐的黑鳃非洲慈鲷可以在高盐度环境中生存，但它的生命周期并不涉及迁移到不同的生境，而洄游的野生鲑鱼则是如此。
中文解析：
两类鱼的差异描述，一类需要在淡水与咸水间来回，一类不需要，A符合要求，demarcate描述差异区分；A. demarcated from - 与...区分开；B. reconstituted as - 重新构成为；C. derived from - 来源于；D. conflated with - 与...混淆

question:
In 2016, Gabriela Gonzalez and team announced that a chirping sound captured by Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory antennas was direct evidence of gravitational waves, which skeptics had argued would be too faint for detection. Detailed statistical analysis helped preclude claims of the event’s ________, confirming the signal at a confidence level of over 99%.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
2016年，Gabriela Gonzalez及其团队宣布，激光干涉引力波天文台天线捕捉到的鸣叫声是引力波的直接证据，而怀疑者曾认为这信号会太微弱而无法被探测。详细的统计分析帮助排除了对该事件________的说法，确认该信号的置信水平超过99%。
中文解析:
根据最后的确定性（confirming the signal at a confidence level,） 推断前面是排除了不确定性，preclude ambiguity排除不确定性；A. discretion - 谨慎，裁量权；B. ambiguity - 模糊，不明确；C. probability - 概率；D. inconspicuousness - 不显眼，隐蔽性

question:
The following text is from George Eliot’s 1857 short story “The Sad Fortunes of the Rev. Amos Barton.” In the text, the narrator addresses the reader directly and alludes to a discussion among Rev. Amos Barton’s neighbors.
It was happy for the Rev. Amos Barton that he did not, like us, overhear the conversation recorded in the last chapter. Indeed, what mortal is there of us, who would find his satisfaction enhanced by an opportunity of comparing the picture he presents to himself of his own doings, with the picture they make on the mental retina of his neighbours? We are poor plants buoyed up by the air-vessels of our own conceit: alas for us, if we get a few pinches that empty us of that windy self-subsistence! The very capacity for good would go out of us.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Although people seek to be viewed as virtuous, the most insignificant setbacks will often inhibit them from being so.
B. People tend to fixate more often than they should on whether their acquaintances think highly of them.
C. People are better off not knowing about the discrepancy between their own self-image and what others think of them.
D. Although people appreciate the value of being truthful, they are generally unwilling to point out others’ failings.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本摘自乔治·艾略特1857年的短篇小说《牧师阿莫斯·巴顿的不幸》。在文本中，叙述者直接与读者对话，并提到牧师阿莫斯·巴顿邻居之间的讨论。
对阿莫斯·巴顿牧师来说，幸好他没有像我们一样，偷听到上一章记录的谈话。事实上，我们之中有哪个凡人会因为有机会将自己心中对自己所做事的形象，与邻居们在心中所形成的形象进行比较而感到满足呢？我们是依靠自我幻想的气囊支撑的可怜植物：如果我们遭受几次冲击，失去那种自我维持的虚幻自信，那可真是可悲啊！善的能力都会离我们而去。
中文解析：
段落是总分结构，于是第一句说没有overhear conversation是件好事，indeed之后具体描述邻居们对我们的评价，和我们自己对自己的感觉不一样，从而给我们带来很多伤害，和C选项一样。

question:
Lisbon has high pedestrian traffic, but simply replicating a feature of Lisbon associated with walkability—e.g., its high number of relatively short blocks—may be insufficient to induce increased walking in other cities. As urbanist Mariela Alfonzo argues, our understanding of individuals’ decision-making about whether to walk is insufficiently robust: some studies emphasize the role of neighborhood type, others the role of individual physical fitness, and so on, but walking decisions are made in complex contexts in which multiple conditions and needs inform individuals’ choices.

Which choice best describes the function of the references to “neighborhood type” and “individual physical fitness” in the text as a whole?
selections: A. They are examples of factors that studies suggest are important in people’s decision-making about walking but that the text claims most people rarely consider when making walking decisions.

B. They represent factors that have been identified as important influences on walking decisions but that the text suggests are merely some of the many factors that may contribute to people’s decision-making about walking.
C. They illustrate factors that researchers believe people consider when making walking decisions in most contexts but that the text argues are unique to walking decisions made by people in Lisbon.
D. They identify factors that Alfonzo argues have been overemphasized in studies of decision-making about walking but that the text asserts are relevant to most people’s walking decisions.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
里斯本的人行交通量很高，但仅仅复制与里斯本步行友好性相关的特征——例如，其相对较短的街区数量——可能不足以在其他城市促进步行。正如城市规划师马里埃拉·阿尔丰索所指出，我们对个体是否选择步行的决策过程的理解并不够扎实：一些研究强调了邻里类型的作用，另一些则强调个体身体素质的影响，等等，但步行决策是在多种条件和需求相互影响的复杂背景下做出的。
中文解析：
冒号后是人们强调的各类因素，但只是众多因素中的一些而已，不是全部要素，和B选项一致。

question:
Vancouver, Canada, has installed engineered structures along 75% of its shoreline to protect infrastructure from storm surges and other hazards, a practice known as shoreline hardening. To evaluate the responses of waterbirds to two types of hardening structures—riprap and bulkheads—Diann Prosser et al. surveyed waterbird communities consisting of the mallard, the common loon, and 62 other species at different sites in the Chesapeake Bay on the US East Coast. Utilizing the Index of Waterbird Community Integrity (IWCI), on which a high score corresponds to high community integrity, the researchers found that bulkheads are more strongly negatively correlated with waterbird community integrity than is riprap.

Which finding, if true, would most directly illustrate the researchers’ finding?
selections: A. Waterbird communities at Curtis, a site with a high percentage of shoreline consisting of bulkheads and riprap, had lower average IWCI scores than did waterbird communities at Onancock, a site with a low percentage of shoreline consisting of bulkheads and riprap.

B. The difference in average IWCI scores for waterbird communities at Stony and Old Road, two sites with a higher percentage of shoreline consisting of bulkheads than of riprap, was statistically insignificant.

C. Waterbird communities at Old Road, a site with a relatively high percentage of shoreline consisting of bulkheads, had lower average IWCI scores than did waterbird communities at Miles, a site with a relatively high percentage of shoreline consisting of riprap.

D. Waterbird communities at Curtis, a site with equal percentages of shoreline consisting of bulkheads and riprap, had higher average IWCI scores than did waterbird communities at Miles, a site with different percentages of shoreline consisting of bulkheads and riprap.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
加拿大温哥华在其75%的海岸线安装了工程结构，以保护基础设施免受风暴潮和其他危害，这种做法被称为海岸加固。为了评估水鸟对两种类型加固结构——石笼（riprap）和防波堤（bulkheads）的反应，迪安·普罗瑟等人在美国东海岸切萨皮克湾的不同地点对包括野鸭、普通潜鸟和其他62个物种在内的水鸟群落进行了调查。研究者利用水鸟群落完整性指数（IWCI），该指数的高分对应于高群落完整性，发现防波堤与水鸟群落完整性的负相关性比石笼更强。
中文解析：
根据最后一句bulkheads比riprap更容易受到影响，同时IWCI的分值与community integrity相关，于是bulkheads有lower IWCI scores，riprap有higher score。

question:
Though John Crowley, author of Endless Things, is not as well known as the most widely read American writers of the past fifty years, his work has had several influential champions, including the poet James Merrill and the literary critic Harold Bloom. In his afterword to Crowley’s book Little, Big, Bloom argues that the novel adroitly blends what playwright Friedrich Schiller termed the naive and sentimental modes—while Schiller thought works could be classified as either naive (seeking to describe reality) or sentimental (seeking to develop ideas), Little, Big fuses both modes of writing.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It accounts for a writer’s lack of popular appeal, cites a literary figure who appreciates that writer, and summarizes the qualities that make the writer’s work unique.
B. It describes a writer’s successful career, presents two literary figures who were supporters of that writer’s career, and explains why the writer was able to achieve what he did.
C. It mentions a writer whose work is not widely known, presents two people who hold a positive opinion of that writer, and gives a reason why one of those people holds that opinion.

D. It identifies a writer whose work is regarded as difficult to read, brings up two admirers of that writer’s work, and gives information that may make the writer’s work more accessible to new readers.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管《无尽的事物》的作者约翰·克劳利并不像过去五十年中最广为阅读的美国作家那样知名，但他的作品却有几位有影响力的支持者，包括诗人詹姆斯·梅里尔和文学评论家哈罗德·布鲁姆。在布鲁姆为克劳利的书《小，大》的后记中，他认为这部小说巧妙地融合了戏剧家弗里德里希·席勒所称的天真和感伤两种模式——席勒认为作品可以被归类为天真（试图描述现实）或感伤（试图发展思想），而《小，大》则将这两种写作模式融合在一起。
中文解析：
第一句介绍了一个不太出名的作家，之后有两个人认可他的作品，最后是作品的特征，也是收到赞誉的原因，C选项符合要求

question:
As computer engineer Sanaz Bahargam can explain, deep learning (DL) and trustworthy machine learning (TML) take divergent approaches in the development of Al technologies. DL pertains to the training of computers to process data in the same way a human brain would, and TML ________ to the training of computer algorithms to be accurate, safe, and fair.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: TML是单数，需要pertains

question:
The morphological novelty of echinoderms—marine invertebrates with radial symmetry usually starlike, around a central point—impedes comparisons with most other animals, in which bilateral symmetry on an anterior-posterior (head to tail) axis through a trunk is typical. Particularly puzzling are sea stars, thought to have evolved a headless layout from a known bilateral origin. Applying genomic knowledge of Saccoglossus kowalevskii acorn worms (close relatives of sea stars, and thus expected to have similar markers for corresponding anatomical regions) to the body patterning genes of Patiria miniata sea stars, Laurent Formery et al. observed activity only in anterior genes across P. miniata’s entire body and some posterior genes limited to the edges, suggesting that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. despite the greater prevalence of anterior genes in sea stars’ genetic makeup, posterior genes active at the body’s perimeter are primarily responsible for the starlike layout that distinguishes sea stars’ radial symmetry from that of other echinoderms.

B. although the two species are closely related, there is only minimal correspondence in the genetic markers for head, tail, and trunk region development in P miniata sea stars and S. kowalevskii acorn worms.

C. rather than undergoing changes resulting in the eventual elimination of a head region in their radial body plan, as previously assumed, sea stars’ morphology evolved to completely lack a trunk and consist primarily of a head region.

D. contrary to the belief that they evolved from early ancestors with the bilateral form typical of many other animals, sea stars instead originated with an atypical body layout that was neither bilaterally nor radially symmetrical.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
海洋无脊椎动物棘皮动物（echinoderms）具有特殊的形态特征，通常呈星形，围绕一个中心点，这使得与大多数其他动物的比较变得困难，后者通常在躯干上具有前后（头到尾）的双侧对称性。尤其令人困惑的是海星，据信它们是从已知的双侧起源进化而来的无头布局。洛朗·福梅里等人将关于海星近亲的橡实虫（Saccoglossus kowalevskii）的基因组知识应用于海星（Patiria miniata）的体型模式基因，观察到P. miniata整个身体中仅在前部基因上有活动，而一些后部基因的活动则仅限于边缘，这表明________。
中文解析：
第一句话是背景信息，重点如下：
A.海星类的echinoderms是radial symmetry，围绕一个中心点展开
B.其他大部分动物是bilateral symmetry，有头部、尾部和躯干
C.他们两个很难比较。
第二句话是对于echinoderms形态进化的假设，重点如下：
D.他们是从bilateral origin进化成headless layout。
第三句话是实验过程（对比近亲和海星）和结果，重点看下结论：
E.P. miniata海星中整个身体，只有anterior genes（前部基因-对应头部）有活动
F. posterior genes（尾部基因-对应尾部）仅限于身体边缘活动
综上，最合理的解释是海星本身就没有躯干，没有bilateral origin进化成headless layout，本身主要由头部区域组成，因为基因主要是anterior genes活动。

question:
Text corpora such as the British National Corpus are large collections of electronically stored texts that can be used to determine the frequency of ________ words. (Words used mainly in specialized or academic publications, on the other hand, tend to be poorly represented. ) A corpus could reveal, for example, that the word “world” is the eighth most commonly used noun in standard English.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
文本语料库，如英国国家语料库，是大量电子存储文本的集合，可用于确定________词的频率。（另一方面，主要用于专业或学术出版物的词汇往往表现得较差。）例如，一个语料库可以揭示，“world”这个词是标准英语中第八个最常用的名词。
中文解析：
根据括号中说通常不涉及学术单词，专有名词，于是应该是普通的单词，选择conventional

question:
Designed by Young Projects, Six Square House demonstrates the increasing focus among architects on developing eco-conscious and sustainable buildings. One way to accomplish this goal is through biophilic design, which incorporates elements that establish a coherent physical and emotional relationship among nature, human biology, and the building. Architects dedicated to this approach carefully contemplate every aspect of their projects from location characteristics and initial materials selection to ultimate interior design choices and building installation. Thus, ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. biophilic design considerations are exercised during both the conception and execution of a new project.
B. architecture firms like Young Projects typically work with large crews in order to expedite the time it takes to build a new project.
C. architecture firms like Young Projects aim to use unique building materials for each project that they design.
D. biophilic design prioritizes the emotional effects on inhabitants rather than the physical state of the natural surroundings.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
由Young Projects设计的六方屋（Six Square House）展示了建筑师们日益关注开发生态意识和可持续建筑的趋势。实现这一目标的一个方法是通过生物亲和设计（biophilic design），该设计融合了自然、人类生物学和建筑之间建立一致的物理和情感关系的元素。 致力于这一方法的建筑师们仔细考虑项目的每一个方面，从选址特点和初始材料选择到最终的室内设计选择和建筑安装。因此，________。
中文解析：
根据文本biophilic design是要融合各类因素，建造eco-conscious and sustainable buildings,于是，A选项和文本意义一致，符合推断结果，大意强调了生物亲和设计在建筑项目的各个阶段都被考虑到

question:
Poetry in Classical Nahuatl, the language of the Aztec Empire, relies on difrasismo, or a parallel noun construction that conventionally operates as a single metaphor. For example, the common difrasismo in cuauhtli in ocelotl (literally, “the eagle, the jaguar”) signifies “warrior.” The device’s function is both formal—providing structure to lines of verse—and ritual: semantic relations among the two nouns and the concept they signify can be tenuous, as in the previous example, such that difrasismos are often only intelligible according to the conceptual associations observed in Aztec ceremonial culture.

Which statement about the difrasismo in cuauhtli in ocelotl is most strongly supported by the text?
selections: A. Its frequency in Classical Nahuatl poetry confirms its intelligibility to the Aztec audience.
B. Its unintelligibility may cause its formal function within a line of verse to go unnoticed by present-day readers.
C. Its apparent obscurity can be resolved when considered in the proper cultural context.
D. Its metaphorical significance derives from the semantic equivalence of the two nouns constituting the difrasismo.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
古典纳瓦特尔语，作为阿兹特克帝国的语言，其诗歌依赖于双名法（difrasismo），这是一种平行名词结构，通常作为单一隐喻运作。例如，常见的双名法“cuauhtli in ocelotl”（字面意思是“鹰， jaguar”）表示“战士”。这种修辞手法的功能既是形式上的——为诗行提供结构——也是仪式性的：两个名词之间的语义关系及其所代表的概念可能是微妙的，如前面的例子所示，因此双名法往往只能根据阿兹特克仪式文化中的概念联想来理解。
中文解析：
根据最后一句only intelligible...可以看出结合恰当的文化背景可以理解其意义。

question:
Text 1
Isaac Asimov, author of The Naked Sun and The Gods Themselves, is highly regarded despite his mediocre writing style. His prose is workmanlike; his characters are flat and discuss ideas rather than emotions. That his work is enjoyable despite this is a testament to his prodigious imagination—even if people read his books only for the ideas, they will have plenty to consider.
Text 2
Asimov is critiqued for his style, but it is wrong to fault a writer for failing to do what he never intended to do. For example, although most of his novel Foundation consists of people discussing science and politics and we find out little about his characters’ lives, Asimov wanted to convey the vast sweep of human history over centuries, and one of his points is that at such a timescale, individuals don’t matter. Thus, his lack of characterization is central to his thematic aims.

Based on the texts, the author of Text 1 would most likely agree with the author of Text 2 on which point?
selections: A. The Naked Sun is more representative of Asimov’s writing style than Foundation is.
B. Asimov’s writing style is often unfairly criticized.
C. Asimov’s characters can be concerned mainly with intellectual matters rather than emotions.
D. Asimov was correct to suggest that individual humans have little influence over the course of human history.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
**文本 1**
艾萨克·阿西莫夫，《裸日》和《诸神自证》的作者，尽管他的写作风格平庸，但仍备受推崇。他的散文风格实用，人物形象平面化，讨论的是思想而非情感。尽管如此，他的作品依然令人愉悦，这证明了他惊人的想象力——即使人们只为思想而阅读他的书，也会有很多值得思考的内容。
**文本 2**
阿西莫夫的风格受到批评，但指责一位作家未能做到他从未打算做的事情是错误的。例如，尽管他的小说《基地》大部分内容是人们讨论科学和政治，且我们对角色的生活知之甚少，但阿西莫夫想要传达的是数百年来人类历史的广阔视野，他的一个观点是，在如此大的时间尺度上，个体并不重要。因此，他缺乏人物刻画的特征正是他主题目标的核心。
中文解析：
答案C之所以正确，是因为两个文本都提到Asimov的角色主要讨论思想而不是情感。
文本1说Asimov的角色是“讨论思想而不是情感”。文本2解释说Asimov的这种写作方式是有意的，目的是表现人类历史的宏大背景。

question:
Some researchers have characterized the flora and fauna of the South Pacific island of Grande Terre as members of clades that inhabited nearby islands before Grande Terre completely emerged 37 million years ago. Thomas R. Buckley et al. found that the crown age (the age of the most recent common ancestor of all living and extinct species in the clade) of the clade of stick insects on Grande Terre is approximately 41.1 million years, while Jesús Gómez-Zurita et al. found that the crown age of the clade of flea beetles on Grande Terre is approximately 12.8 million years.

Which statement about the view put forward by “some researchers” is best supported by information in the text?
selections: A. The view could be true of Grande Terre’s stick insects but is not true of the island’s flea beetles.
B. The view has some empirical support but is weakened by the findings of Buckley et al.
C. The view suggests that Grande Terre may have emerged as early as 41.1 million years ago.
D. The view depends on inaccurate assumptions about the crown ages of the clades of stick insects and flea beetles on Grande Terre.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一些研究人员将南太平洋岛屿大特尔（Grande Terre）的植物和动物特征描述为在大特尔岛完全浮出水面之前，曾栖息于附近岛屿的类群成员，该岛在大约3700万年前形成。托马斯·R·巴克利等人发现，大特尔岛上蜻蜓类昆虫的冠年龄（即该类群中所有现存和灭绝物种的最近共同祖先的年龄）约为4110万年，而赫苏斯·戈麦斯-苏里塔等人则发现，大特尔岛上跳虫类昆虫的冠年龄约为1280万年。
中文解析：
第一句描述Grande Terre出现的时间是37 million years ago，stick insects的crown age  41.1 millions years符合第一句的时间，但是flea beetles的12.8 million years则有明显的出入，于是A符合要求

question:
In a study of urban physical expansion, Richa Mahtta et al. conducted a meta-analysis of more than 300 cities worldwide to determine whether urban land expansion (ULE) was more strongly influenced by urban population growth or by growth in gross domestic product (GDP) per capita, a measure of economic activity. Because efficient national government is necessary to provide urban services and infrastructure that attract economic investment, Mahtta et al. propose that absent other factors, the importance of GDP per capita growth to ULE would likely increase relative to the importance of population growth as governments become more efficient. If true, this suggests the possibility that ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement?
selections: A. countries in Region 1 experienced a slower rate of economic growth in the period from 2000 to 2014 than countries in Region 2 did, despite increasing national government efficiency in Region 1.
B. national governments of countries in Region 1 experienced declines in efficiency in the period from 2000 to 2014, relative to the period from 1970 to 2000.

C. national governments of countries in Region 1 and in Region 2 generally became more efficient in the period from 2000 to 2014 than they had been in the period from 1970 to 2000, but at different rates.

D. national governments of most countries in Region 2 became more efficient in the period from 2000 to 2014 than they had been in the period from 1970 to 2000, but those of several countries in this region did not.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在对城市物理扩张的研究中，Richa Mahtta等人对全球300多个城市进行了元分析，以确定城市土地扩张（ULE）是受到城市人口增长的影响更大，还是受到人均国内生产总值（GDP）增长的影响，这一指标反映了经济活动。由于有效的国家政府对于提供吸引经济投资的城市服务和基础设施是必要的，Mahtta等人提出，在没有其他因素的情况下，随着政府效率的提高，人均GDP增长对城市土地扩张的重要性可能会相对于人口增长的重要性增加。如果这一观点成立，这就暗示了________。
中文解析：
根据文本最后一句，政府有效性（government efficiency）和经济投资相关，而GDP本身是衡量经济活动，根据图表region 1GDP的attribution2000-2014是下降的，于是对应了B选项，对应时间段region 1的government efficiency下降。

question:

question:
Though he’s performed on many respected albums, including While the Gate Is Open by Gary Thomas, drummer Dennis Chambers may be best known for his time as house drummer for the hip-hop label Sugar Hill Records. He did not play drums on the label’s classic song “Rapper’s Delight,” ______joined the label after the song’s release.

question:
The Proto-Uralic language, common ancestor of thirty-seven Eurasian languages with similar linguistic properties, ________ like all protolanguages, hypothetical: there’s no direct evidence these ancestral languages actually existed.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

question:
With the development of new technologies that use natural resources more efficiently, the overall consumption of those resources might be expected to decrease. Economists have observed that improvements in efficiency often correlate negatively with resource ________ efficiency gains, lowering the cost of use, may increase demand to the extent that resource consumption ultimately rises.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

question:
The Madison is a type of line dance that involves neat rows of dancers performing a repeated sequence of steps in unison. ________ many other dances are also defined by order, repetition, and synchronicity, but the Madison is distinguished by its extreme uniformity: when an auditorium full of dancers performs the Madison, one almost gets the impression of a military march.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《麦迪逊舞》是一种排舞，涉及整齐的舞者排成行，齐心协力地重复一系列舞步。______ 许多其他舞蹈也以有序、重复和同步为特征，但《麦迪逊舞》因其极端的统一性而与众不同：当一个满是舞者的礼堂表演《麦迪逊舞》时，几乎给人一种军事行进的印象。
中文解析：
Madison排舞yourepeated sequence of steps in unison，很多别的舞蹈也以order，repetition...等定义，但是还是呈现了不同，选择of course能够表达出承认相似，但要突出后边的不同。

question:

explanations:

两个发电厂对比，所以选择by comparison

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Generally, an object will heat up when twisted.
● The twisting of an object is known as torsion.
● A 2019 study led by Zunfeng Liu and Ray Baughman tested the torsional heating of various fibers.
● When a sample of ethylene propylene diene monomer (EPDM) rubber fiber was twisted, its average surface temperature increased by 12°C.
● When a sample of single-ply nickel-titanium (NiTi) wire was twisted, its average surface temperature increased by 21.3°C.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between EPDM rubber and single-ply NiTi wire fibers. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Both EPDM rubber and single-ply NiTi wire fibers heat up when twisted, according to a 2019 study.
B. Researchers determined that when the fibers were twisted, the average surface temperature of single-ply NiTi wire increased more than that of EPDM rubber.
C. In 2019, two research teams observed the effects of torsional heating on various fibers, including EPDM rubber and single-ply NiTi wire.
D. Twisting an object will generally cause its temperature to increase, a process known as torsional heating.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记下了以下笔记：
●通常，一个物体在扭转时会升温。
●物体的扭转被称为扭转（torsion）。
●2019年，由尊锋·刘（Zunfeng Liu）和雷·博曼（Ray Baughman）领导的一项研究测试了各种纤维的扭转加热。
●当一段乙烯丙烯二烯单体（EPDM）橡胶纤维被扭转时，其平均表面温度上升了12°C。
●当一段单层镍钛（NiTi）丝被扭转时，其平均表面温度上升了21.3°C。
中文解析：
题目要求强调similarity，于是A选项both fibers heat up when twisted满足要求

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Merle Oberon (1911-1979) was an actress born in Mumbai (then known as Bombay), India.
● She was of Indian, Maori, and Irish heritage.
● She was the first Indian-born actress to be nominated for an Academy Award.
● Early in her career, she played many nameless, uncredited roles, such as her role in Strange Evidence (1933).
● Later, she played many named, credited roles, such as Jessica Warren in The Price of Fear (1956).

The student wants to emphasize the order in which the two films were released. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Merle Oberon was famous for her roles in films like Strange Evidence (1933) and The Price of Fear (1956).
B. Strange Evidence (1933) was released early in Merle Oberon’s career, whereas The Price of Fear (1956) came out years later.
C. In Strange Evidence (1933), actress Merle Oberon played a nameless, uncredited role; however, in The Price of Fear (1956), she played a credited role—that of Jessica Warren.
D. Early in her career, Merle Oberon wasn’t listed in some film credits, such as the credits for the film Strange Evidence, where she played a nameless, uncredited role.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记下了以下笔记：
●默尔·奥伯伦（Merle Oberon，1911-1979）是一位出生于孟买（当时称为“ Bombay”）的女演员。
●她具有印度、毛利和爱尔兰的血统。
●她是第一位获得奥斯卡提名的出生于印度的女演员。
●在她职业生涯早期，她饰演了许多无名的、未标注的角色，例如在《奇异证据》（Strange Evidence，1933）中的角色。
●此后，她饰演了许多有名的、被标注的角色，例如在《恐惧的代价》（The Price of Fear，1956）中饰演杰西卡·沃伦（Jessica Warren）。
中文解析：
题目要求强调两部电影的发行顺序，B满足要求，指出了两部电影具体名称与发行的前后时间

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Sheepshead Bay is a 1935 color relief print by Japanese American artist Isami Doi.
● It features boats approaching a dock.
● Intaglio and relief are printmaking techniques in which an image is carved onto a printing block, covered in ink, and stamped onto paper.
● In intaglio printing, ink is applied to the grooved, carved portions of the block.
● In relief printing, ink is applied to the raised, uncarved portions of the block.

The student wants to contrast intaglio and relief printing. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Relief printing is intaglio’s reverse: the ink is applied not to the carved grooves of the printing block but to its raised, uncarved portions.
B. Relief printing, rather than intaglio, is the technique Doi used to depict boats approaching a dock in the 1935 work Sheepshead Bay.
C. In contrast to relief printing, in which ink is applied to the uncarved portions of the block, intaglio printing uses the printing block to stamp the image onto paper.
D. In both relief printing and intaglio, an image is carved onto a printing block, leaving grooves onto which ink is applied.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记下了以下笔记：
●《羊头湾》（Sheepshead Bay）是日本裔美国艺术家土井勇（Isami Doi）于1935年创作的彩色浮雕版画。
●作品描绘了接近码头的船只。
●凹版印刷和浮雕版印刷是版画技术，其中图像被雕刻到印刷块上，涂上油墨，然后印在纸上。
●在凹版印刷中，油墨涂在印刷块的凹槽和雕刻部分。
●在浮雕版印刷中，油墨涂在印刷块的凸起和未雕刻部分。
中文解析：
题目要求intaglio and relief printing，根据notes的最后两条可以选择A，relief printing用在凸出，intaglio printing用来凹陷

中文解析：
of course翻译成当然了，表示承认前文，前面说1920的的不够准确，后面具体指出当时的设备很原始基础。

question: The equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">h</mi> </mrow> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>v</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>273.15</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> </mrow> <mn>5</mn> </mfrac> <mo>+</mo> <mn>32</mn></math> gives the corresponding temperature h, in degrees Fahrenheit, of any substance that has a temperature of v kelvins, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>v</mi> <mo>></mo> <mn>0</mn></math>. question: Parallelogram ABCD is similar to parallelogram PQRS. The length of each side of parallelogram PQRS is 2 times the length of its corresponding side of parallelogram ABCD. question: In the triangle shown, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>R</mi><mi>S</mi><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mn>167</mn></msqrt></math>. question:

One solution to the given equation can be written as <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><msqrt><mi>k</mi></msqrt></math>, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?

explanations: 根据题意，y比2x多49，故选A

question: A hemisphere is half of a sphere. If a hemisphere has a radius of 70 inches, which of the following is closest to the volume, in cubic inches, of this hemisphere?

question:

question: To purchase a used car at a total price of 14,000 dollars, a onetime down payment is required, and then fixed monthly payments are made for the remaining amount owed for the car. question: A park rents beach umbrellas to visitors. The park earns revenue of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mtext> $16 </mtext></math> for each beach umbrella they rent for the day. question: A model predicts that the population of a certain town was 3,000 in 2007. C. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>p</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>000</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0.92</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi> </mrow> </mrow> </msup></math>

question: For a certain type of rope, the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>900</mn> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>, where a is a constant, gives the estimated breaking strength y, in pounds, of a rope with a circumference of x inches. question: For the positive quantities h, j, and k, 27% of h is equivalent to 24% of j, and j is equivalent to 45% of k. What percentage of k is h? (Disregard the % sign when entering your answer. For example, if your answer is 39%, enter 39)

question: For the function f, for every increase of 2 in the value of  x, the value of f (x) increases by a factor of c, where c is a constant. Which of the following equivalent forms of function f displays the value of c as the base or the coefficient?
selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>26</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup></math>

question: In the figure shown, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mn>89</mn></msqrt></math> units, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mi>C</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn></math> units, and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi><mi>E</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>24</mn></math> units.
