question: The graph of line g is shown in the xy-plane. Line k is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>165</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>p</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>w</mi></math>, where p and w are constants. If line k is graphed in this xy-plane, resulting in the graph of a system of two linear equations, the system of two linear equations will have infinitely many solutions. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>p</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>w</mi></math>?
explanations: infinitely many solutions表示两个式子完全相同，跟据图像两个黑点计算斜率<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mn>12</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>10</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>11</mn><mn>10</mn></mfrac></math>，y-intercept为1，函数为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>11</mn><mn>10</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></math>，与165x+py=w相同，165x+py=w整理成<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>165</mn><mi>p</mi></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>w</mi><mi>p</mi></mfrac></math>，所以p=150，w=150，p+w=300

question: The function f is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mi>b</mi> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>c</mi></math>, where a, b, and c are constants. The graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> in the xy-plane passes through the points<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>10</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. If a is an integer greater than 1, which of the following could be the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>a</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>b</mi></math>?
explanations: 二次函数问题，根据两个解(10，0） (-5,0)可得到vertex的x坐标为2.5，即<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mo>−</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi> </mrow> </mrow> <mrow> <mn>2</mn> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi> </mrow> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mn>2.5</mn></math>，得到b=-5a，所以a+b=-4a,而a是大于1的整数，-4a在选项中只能是-8 选A

question: Each of the following frequency tables represents a data set. Which of these frequency tables represents the data set with the smallest standard deviation?
explanations: 统计考点中standard deviation标准差表示的是数据的分散程度，对比4个选项可发现两侧数据分布最多的D具有最大标准差，而最集中分布的A具有最小的标准差，选A

question:
The following text is adapted from Mary seacole's 1857 autobiography Wonderful Adventures of Mrs.Seacole in Many Lands.
That journey across the Isthmus [of Panama], insignificant in distance as it was,was by no means an easy one. It seemed as if nature had determined to throw every conceivable obstacle in the way of those who should seek to join the two great oceans of the world.

As used in the text, what does the word "conceivable" most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字改编自玛丽·西科尔（Mary Seacole）1857年的自传《西科尔夫人的奇妙冒险》（Wonderful Adventures of Mrs. Seacole in Many Lands）。
那段穿越巴拿马地峡的旅程，尽管距离微不足道，却绝非易事。仿佛大自然决心要在寻求连接世界两大洋的旅人面前设置所有可能的障碍。
中文解析：
这里描述一条举例虽然不长，但是却困难重重的巴拿马海峡连接之路，every conceivable obstacle形容所有困难，于是选择imaginable，不一定是可以看得见的（visible）的困难，不一定常规或公开的困难，而是所有能想象到的困境（every imaginable obstacle）

question:
The following text is adapted from the 1895 poem “Ojistoh” by Emily Pauline Johnson, a Kanienkahagen (Mohawk) writer also known as Tekahionwake.
I am Ojistoh, I am she, the wife
Of him whose name breathes bravery and life
And courage to the tribe who calls him chief.
I am Ojistoh, his white star, and he
Is land, and lake, and sky—and soul to me

As used in the text, what does the word “breathes” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字改编自1895年艾米丽·保利娜·约翰逊（Emily Pauline Johnson）所作的诗《Ojistoh》，她是一位来自卡尼恩卡哈根（Mohawk）部落的作家，亦被称为Tekahionwake。
我就是Ojistoh，我是她，那个
以勇气与生命的名号为部落所称颂的首领的妻子。
我就是Ojistoh，他的白色星星，而他
是土地、湖泊、天空——也是我的灵魂。
中文解析：
名字传达或体现了勇气和生命等品质，传达、传递、赋予选择impart

question:
In an extensive review of existing literature, Lena de Framond and team cataloged the prevalence of broken-wing display—a defensive behavior observed in Haematopus longirostris (pied oystercatcher) and many other species—throughout the Aves class. Documentation of the display in 285 species across 52 families suggests the behavior likely evolved independently multiple times, prompting the team to consider ecological and life history characteristics with hypothesized associations to the behavior's emergence, including traits related to reproduction investment and future reproduction potential. Based on their review of those traits, the team concluded that_________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the conclusion?
selections: A. capacity for multiple broods, number of parental incubators, and incubation duration are equally associated with the use of broken-wing display.
B. incubation duration and capacity for multiple broods are more strongly associated with the use of broken-wing display than the number of parental incubators is.
C. broken-wing display is most often observed in species with less opportunity to reproduce in a year due to longer incubation periods.
D. among species with more than one parental incubator, the use of broken-wing display is associated with greater incubation duration.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在对现有文献的广泛回顾中，莱娜·德·弗拉蒙德及其团队对破翼展示这种防御行为进行了分类，该行为在长嘴黑鹬（Haematopus longirostris）及许多其他物种中被观察到。对来自52个科的285个物种中该行为的记录表明，这种行为可能多次独立进化，这促使团队考虑与该行为出现相关的生态和生活史特征，包括与繁殖投资和未来繁殖潜力相关的特征。根据对这些特征的回顾，团队得出结论_________。
中文解析：
use of broken-wing display对应yes的两种生物，incubation duration要更短 capacity for multiple broods要更多，the number of parental incubators is没有明显的差别，因此前两个因素more strongly associated。

question:
Honeybee hives consist mainly of hexagonal (six-sided) units called cells, in which queens lay eggs. Hexagonal cells for eggs that develop into nonreproductive workers are smaller than those for eggs that develop into reproductive drones, though the size difference varies by species. Difference in cell size results in a construction problem—it’s hard to neatly connect sections of small cells to sections of large cells—that worsens as the difference increases. To fill in gaps between the sections when building a hive, bees rely on cells that have more or fewer than six sides. A student studying beehive structure consults data on three species, concluding that ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the student’s conclusion?
selections: A. cells for worker eggs are probably closer in size to cells for drone eggs in the hives of the western honeybee than in the hives of the dwarf honeybee and the black dwarf honeybee.
B. both the western honeybee and the black dwarf honeybee probably reserve eight-sided cells for drone eggs, while the dwarf honeybee likely deposits drone eggs in seven-sided cells.
C. the western honeybee probably relies on many more geometrical shapes when constructing cells than either the dwarf honeybee or the black dwarf honeybee does.
D. the percentage of hexagonal cells is probably slightly lower in the hives of the western honeybee than in the hives of the dwarf honeybee and the black dwarf honeybee.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
蜜蜂蜂巢主要由称为“蜂房”的六边形（六面）单元组成，女王在其中产卵。用于发展为非繁殖工蜂的卵的蜂房比用于发展为繁殖雄蜂的卵的蜂房要小，尽管这种大小差异因物种而异。蜂房大小的差异导致了一个建造问题——小蜂房与大蜂房的部分难以整齐连接，且随着差异的增大，这个问题会加剧。为了在建造蜂巢时填补部分之间的缝隙，蜜蜂依靠具有多于或少于六个面的蜂房。一名研究蜂巢结构的学生查阅了三种物种的数据，得出结论_______。
中文解析：
因为western honeybee在图表里需要的非六边形是数量最少的，所以能够说明hive cells的尺寸接近，不需要用到这些其它尺寸的cells，和A选项一致.

question:
The following text is adapted from Jerome K Jerome's 1889 novel Three Men in a Boat (To Say Nothing of the Dog).
We [people] are creatures of the sun. We love light and life. That is why we crowd into the towns and cities, and the country grows more and more deserted every year. In the sunlight-in the daytime, when Nature is alive and busy all around us, we like the open hill-sides and the deep woods well enough: but in the night, when our Mother Earth has gone to sleep, and left us waking, oh! the world seems so lonesome, and we get frightened, like children in a silent house. Then we sit and sob, and long for the gas-lit streets, and the sound of human voices, and the answering throb of human life.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To convey that crowded areas can cause people to experience feelings of sadness
B. To caution people not to be so quick to dismiss the natural beauty that can be found in rural areas
C. To illustrate the idea that most people tend to prefer hillsides in the country to certain aspects of towns and cities
D. To address common traits that motivate many people to choose to live in urban environments
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文字改编自杰罗姆·K·杰罗姆于1889年出版的小说《三人在船上（谈狗的事）》。
我们（人类）是阳光的生物。我们热爱光明与生命。这就是我们挤进城镇和城市的原因，而乡村每年变得愈发荒凉。在阳光下——在白天，当大自然在我们周围生机勃勃时，我们很喜欢开阔的山坡和幽深的树林；但在夜晚，当我们的母亲大地进入梦乡，而我们却醒着时，哦！这个世界似乎是如此孤独，我们感到害怕，就像在寂静的房子里孩子们那样。然后我们坐着哭泣，渴望煤气灯照亮的街道，渴望人声的回响，以及人类生命的脉动回应。
中文解析：
这个文本主要讨论了人们喜欢居住在城市的原因。它指出人们是喜欢阳光和生命的，因此他们倾向于聚集在城市和城镇中。文中提到了在夜晚人们会感到孤独和害怕，渴望城市中的照明灯光、人声和繁忙的生活节奏，这进一步强调了人们对城市生活的偏爱。因此，主要目的在于探讨人们选择居住在城市环境的共同特征和动机，而不是警告人们不要轻易忽视农村地区所拥有的自然美景或者表明大多数人更喜欢乡村的山坡而不喜欢城镇的某些方面。

question:
In a study by Mika R. Moran, Daniel A. Rodriguez, and colleagues, residents of Panama City, Panama, and Fortaleza, Brazil, were surveyed about parks in their cities. Of the 318 respondents from Panama City, 53.5% indicated that they use the city's parks, and of the 938 respondents from Fortaleza, 35.7% indicated using city parks. Given that the percentage of Panama city respondents who reported having access to other desired amenities near parks was much lower than that reported by Fortaleza respondents, the difference in park use can't be explained by Panama City residents having more access to desired nonpark amenities near parks.

Which choice best describes the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Even though the study found that parks in Fortaleza are more likely to be close to other amenities than parks in Panama city are, Panama city has more amenities overall than Fortaleza does.
B. The study's findings suggest that an increase in the number of amenities near city parks would likely increase park use in Panama city but not in Fortaleza.
C. The study's finding that a greater proportion of residents use parks in Panama city than in Fortaleza is partly due to the greater prevalence of parks in Panama City.
D. Although the study found that a greater proportion of residents use parks in Panama City than in Fortaleza, that difference isn't due to greater access to amenities near parks in Panama city.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在米卡·R·莫兰、丹尼尔·A·罗德里格斯及其同事的研究中，巴拿马城（巴拿马）和福塔雷萨（巴西）的居民被调查了他们对所在城市公园的看法。在318名来自巴拿马城的受访者中，53.5%表示他们使用城市公园，而在938名来自福塔雷萨的受访者中，35.7%表示使用城市公园。鉴于报告在公园附近有其他期望设施可供使用的巴拿马城受访者的比例远低于福塔雷萨受访者的比例，因此，巴拿马城居民使用公园的差异无法用其在公园附近获得更多期望非公园设施的情况来解释。
中文解析:
文本体现了Panama City人去parks比例大，但是数据可以看出access to other desired amenities near parks比例却低，于是原因不会是greater access to
amenities near parks in Panama city，和D选项一致。

question:
Though John Crowley, author of Engine Summer, is perhaps not as well known as the most commercially successful American writers of the past fifty years, influential figures have championed his work, including the poet James Merrill and the literary critic Harold Bloom. In his afterword to Crowley's book Little, Big, Bloom praises the novel's adroit blend of what playwright Friedrich Schiller termed the naive and sentimental modes—while Schiller thought works could be classified as either naive (seeking to describe reality) or sentimental (seeking to develop ideas), Little, Big demonstrates that a work can be both.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To argue that all writing must be classified as belonging to one of two categories
B. To compare the work of a writer with the work of a poet who admired him
C. To explain what inspired an author to write a particular work
D. To present a reason why a literary critic is impressed by a certain novel
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管《引擎夏季》的作者约翰·克劳利（John Crowley）或许没有过去五十年中最成功的美国作家那么知名，但一些有影响力的人物如诗人詹姆斯·梅里尔和文学评论家哈罗德·布卢姆都对他的作品给予了支持。在布卢姆对克劳利的小说《小，大》（Little, Big）的后记中，他赞扬了这部小说巧妙融合了剧作家弗里德里希·席勒所称的天真和感伤两种风格——席勒认为作品可以被归类为天真（旨在描述现实）或感伤（旨在发展思想），而《小，大》则展示了一部作品可以同时具备这两者。
中文解析：
约翰·克劳利的小说《小，大》，文学评论家哈罗德·布鲁姆赞扬该书独特地融合了native与sentimental两种风格。重点在于布鲁姆的欣赏及其背后的原因,因此，选项D最能准确捕捉到文本的主要目的。

question:
Cane is a 1923 novel by Jean Toomer. In one portion of the novel, Toomer establishes a contrast between the narrator's attitude toward life and the attitude of the narrator's love interest, Avey, writing, _____

Which quotation from Cane most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “Avey was as silent as those great trees whose tops we looked down upon. She has always been like that. At least, to me.”
B. "A band in one of the buildings a fair distance off was playing a march. I wished they would stop. Their playing was like a tin spoon in one's mouth."
C. "[Avey would] smile appreciation, but it was an impersonal smile, never for me.”
D. "As time went on, [Avey'sl indifference to things began to pique me; I was ambitious. I left [our small hometown] earlier than she did."
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《手杖》是让·图默于1923年出版的小说。在小说的一个部分，图默对叙述者对生活的态度与叙述者的爱慕对象阿维（Avey）的态度进行了对比，写道，_____
中文解析：
题目要求对比narrator和恋人的态度，D选项符合，D选项的大意为：随着时间的推移，Avey对事物的漠不关心开始激怒我；我有雄心壮志。我比她更早离开了我们的小镇。

question:
“Tomato” is an example of a loanword—that is, a word that originated in one language and was later adopted by another. The word came to English indirectly from tomate, the Spanish word for the widely cultivated plant. Spanish had borrowed it from Nahuatl, an Indigenous language of central Mexico, in which the word's original form is tomatl. “Maize” is also Indigenous in origin and entered English through Spanish. But in this case, the original source was Taino, a language of the Caribbean  islands, in which the word for the corn plant is mahis.

The author makes which point about the Spanish language?
selections: A. It has borrowed words from Indigenous languages and contributed words to them.
B. Its contribution to English vocabulary roughly equals the collective contribution by Indigenous languages.
C. It has served as a medium through which Indigenous languages have influenced English.
D. It adopted Nahuatl and Taino words in approximately equal numbers.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
“番茄”是一个借用词的例子——即源自一种语言并被另一种语言采纳的词汇。这个词是间接通过西班牙语“tomate”传入英语的，西班牙语中的“tomate”指的是这种广泛栽培的植物。西班牙语是从纳瓦特尔语（Nahuatl）借来的，纳瓦特尔语是墨西哥中部的土著语言，该词的原始形式是“tomatl”。“玉米”也源于土著语言，并通过西班牙语进入英语。但在这种情况下，原始来源是加勒比海岛屿的泰诺语（Taino），在这种语言中，玉米植物的词是“mahis”。
中文解析：
根据文本，作者主要强调西班牙语从土著语言中借用词汇，并将它们引入英语。充当了中间的媒介功能。

question:
The swordfish can swim very fast—up to 97 kilometers per hour (km/hr)—but it is significantly slower than the golden eagle, which can fly at speeds up to 320 km/hr The difference between these speeds is largely _____of the fact that the features that make fight possible do less to limit top speeds than the features suitable for swimming through water.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
剑鱼游得非常快——最高可达每小时97公里（km/hr）——但它的速度明显慢于金雕，后者的飞行速度可以达到每小时320公里。这些速度之间的差异在很大程度上_____于使飞行成为可能的特征对最高速度的限制要小于适合在水中游泳的特征。
中文解析：
sword fish和golden eagle速度差异的原因是能够飞行的特征对限制最高速度的作用要小于适合在水中游泳的特征。需要描述这是一种结果，后面接原因。

question:
Community science, which involves professional scientists collaborating with amateur science enthusiasts to study a topic, is often an effective and engaging way to conduct research. It can allow people to assist with conservation efforts, spark youth interest in science, and increase the amount of data researchers can collect. This approach was essential to the success of a study by biologist Abbigail Merrill and colleagues of how butterfly color relates to flower choice, which included findings from hundreds of students and community members in northwestern Arkansas.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It introduces the topic of a scientific study, describes the study's importance, and then presents the study's results.

B. It argues for a new approach to scientific research, comments on the public’s opinion about the approach, and then describes how that approach was applied
in a certain study.
C. It identifies a particular approach to research, lists some benefits of that approach, and then mentions a study in which that approach was used.

D. It describes the development of a type of scientific collaboration, shows how that type of collaboration has been used in a particular field of study, and then suggests future collaborative projects.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
社区科学是指专业科学家与业余科学爱好者合作研究某一主题，这通常是一种有效且引人入胜的研究方式。它可以让人们参与保护工作，激发年轻人对科学的兴趣，并增加研究人员可以收集的数据量。这种方法对于生物学家阿比盖尔·梅里尔及其同事关于蝴蝶颜色与花朵选择之间关系的研究至关重要，该研究包括来自阿肯色州西北部数百名学生和社区成员的发现。
中文解析：
文本开始Introduction of Community Science，然后是benefits of Community Science （aiding conservation efforts, engaging youth in science, and enhancing data collection for researchers)，然后是具体例子Specific Example。Overall, the text introduces a concept, discusses its benefits, and illustrates its application with a concrete example和选项C一致

question:
Pigments give paints and dyes their color. Ocher is a mineral-based pigment used to make several colors, including red. Red ocher gets its color from iron oxide. Pigments can also be plant-based; plant-based pigments contain a high level of carbon. In a 2023 study, archaeologists tested the red pigment on decorated beads made by members of the Natufan culture approximately 15,000 years ago. The test showed that the pigment found on severalbeads contained no iron but had a high levelof carbon.This finding led the researchers to conclude that________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the Natufian beadmakers used plant-based pigments rather than ocher to decorate some of the beads examined in the study.
B. the pigments used by the Natufian beadmakers likely came from plants because ocher was difficult to find.
C. the Natufian beadmakers preferred to use plant-based pigments because they are much brighter than mineral-based pigments are.
D. the Natufian beads examined in the study are the oldest surviving examples of the use of plant-based pigments for decorating beads.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
颜料赋予油漆和染料颜色。赭石是一种矿物基颜料，可用于制作多种颜色，包括红色。红赭石的颜色来自氧化铁。颜料也可以是植物基的；植物基颜料含有较高水平的碳。在2023年的一项研究中，考古学家对大约15000年前纳图凡文化成员制作的装饰珠子上的红色颜料进行了测试。测试显示，几颗珠子上的颜料不含铁，但碳含量很高。这一发现使研究人员得出结论________。
中文解析：
从前面铺垫包含iron是金属染色，包含碳是植物染色，于是可以根据最后，研究者的发现表明，纳图凡文化的珠子上使用的红色颜料含有高水平的碳且不含铁，这意味着他们使用的是基于植物的颜料，而不是矿物基的红土。对应A选项。

question:
Often, the Nobel Prize in chemistry is given to a single person, such as Theodore William Richards in 1914. But sometimes the Nobel Committee wants to reward work attributed to two or three individuals, in which case, the award is given_____.For instance,in 2020,Jennifer Doudna was among those awarded for "the development of a method for genome editing."

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
诺贝尔化学奖通常颁发给单个个人，例如1914年的西奥多·威廉·理查兹。但有时诺贝尔委员会希望奖励归因于两到三个人的工作，在这种情况下，奖项会授予_____詹妮弗·杜德纳因“开发基因组编辑方法”而获奖。
中文解析：
根据诺贝尔奖会归功于两个或三个人的描述，可以选择jointly，联合一起的意思。

question:
Whether the reign of a French monarch such as Louis XII or Louis IV was historically consequential or relatively uneventful, its trajectory was shaped by questions of legitimacy and therefore cannot be understood without a corollary understanding of the factors that allowed the monarch to ________ his right to hold the throne successfully.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：

question:
Water flowing around an obstruction creates vortices (patterns of swirls) of varying size; by detecting the vortices, fish can determine the size and position of the obstruction. Testing by Yuzo R.Yanagisuru, otar Akanyeti, and James C. Liao using models of three head shapes—narrow (low ratio of width to length), intermediate, and wide (high ratio of width to length)—showed that for medium-sized vortices, fish with wide heads would be least able to distinguish between vortices and general turbulence in the water. A second research team has therefore hypothesized that in low-visibility conditions, wider-headed fish will be less likely than narrower-headed fish to detect obstructions.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the second research team's hypothesis?
selections:
A. A study using obstructions that created medium-sized vortices in low-visibility conditions found that some specimens of dusky smooth-hound (Mustelus canis)，which has a relatively narrow head, bumped into the obstructions more often
than otherspecimens of the same fish did

B. A study using obstructions that created medium-sized vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the wider-headed bristlemouth (Chaetostoma yurubiense) bumped into obstructions more often than the narrower-headed dusky smooth-hound (Mustelus canis) did.

C. A study using obstructions that created medium-sized vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the narrower-headed dusky smooth-hound (Mustelus
canis) bumped into the obstructions just as often as the wider-headed bristlemouth (Chaetostoma yurubiense) did.

D. A study using obstructions that created medium-sized vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the bristlemouth (Chaetostoma yurubiense), which has a
relatively wide head, bumped into more than half of the obstructions.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
水流过障碍物时会产生不同大小的涡旋（漩涡模式）；通过检测涡旋，鱼类可以判断障碍物的大小和位置。由八名横和杰姆斯·C·廖进行的测试使用了三种头部形状的模型——窄头（宽度与长度比率低）、中头和宽头（宽度与长度比率高）——结果显示，对于中等大小的涡旋，宽头鱼对涡旋和水中一般湍流的区分能力最差。因此，第二个研究团队假设，在能见度低的情况下，宽头鱼比窄头鱼更不容易探测到障碍物。
中文解析：
宽头鱼比窄头鱼更不容易发现障碍物，那么宽头鱼比窄头鱼就更容易撞到障碍物，对应B

question:

中文解析:
Namascenda 融合了hip-hop在hyperpop sound里，incorporate表明他增加了新的元素，但是没有摈弃之前的东西

question:
Text1
In parts of the Northwest Territories, Canada, the rough-legged hawk is a major predator of the collared lemming. Researcher Alice Kenney and colleagues found that when this predation pressure on collared lemmings was temporarily reduced, their numbers significantly increased. This finding illustrates a foundational ecological principle: predators control prey population numbers.
Text2
Robert D. Hayes and colleagues found that excluding wolves from a site in Yukon, Canada, where they typically prey on Dall sheep had no significant effect on Dall sheep abundance. Many other predation relief studies show an increase in prey abundance, but those studies often focus on small, rapidly reproducing prey, like birds, lemmings, and rabbits, rather than large, slowly reproducing prey, like Dall sheep, which could account for the difference between those results and Hayes and colleagues' results.

Based on the texts, the author of Text 2 would most likely agree with which statement about the “principle” mentioned in Text 1?
selections: A. It has some evidential support, but it should not be regarded as universally applicable.
B. It has been challenged by some studies, but the findings of those studies have not been widely accepted.
C. It may be true for some predators but only because those predators share certain physical characteristics.
D. It is plausible, but many of the studies that support it have methodological flaws.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
**文本1**
在加拿大西北地区的部分地区，粗腿鹰是领圈旅鼠的主要捕食者。研究人员爱丽丝·肯尼及其同事发现，当对领圈旅鼠的捕食压力暂时降低时，它们的数量显著增加。这个发现说明了一个基础的生态原则：捕食者控制猎物的种群数量。
**文本2**
罗伯特·D·海耶斯及其同事发现，排除通常在加拿大育空地区捕食达尔羊的狼，对达尔羊的丰度没有显著影响。许多其他捕食缓解研究显示猎物丰度增加，但那些研究通常集中于像鸟类、旅鼠和兔子这样的小型、繁殖迅速的猎物，而不是像达尔羊这样的大型、繁殖缓慢的猎物，这可能解释了这些结果与海耶斯及其同事结果之间的差异。
中文解析:
第一篇的principle,根据冒号后的解释是说捕食者控制prey numbers，但是第二篇文章最后一句的转折but后说明这个原则只适用于小动物，不适用于大的缓慢繁衍的动物，于是符合A选项，这个principle有证据支撑，但是不是普遍适用的。

question:
Early Earth is thought to have been characterized by a stagnant lid tectonic regime, in which the upper lithosphere (the outer rocky layer) was essentially immobile and there was no interaction between the lithosphere and the underlying mantle. Researchers investigated the timing of the transition from a stagnant lid regime to a tectonic plate regime, in which the lithosphere is fractured into dynamic plates that in turn allow lithospheric and mantle material to mix. Examining chemical data from lithospheric and mantle-derived rocks ranging from 285 million to 3.8 billion years old, the researchers dated the transition to 3.2 billion years ago.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers' conclusion?
selections: A. There is a positive correlation between the age of lithospheric rocks and their chemical similarity to mantle-derived rocks, and that correlation increases significantly in strength at around 3.2 billion years old.
B. Mantle-derived rocks younger than 3.2 billion years contain some material that is not found in older mantle-derived rocks but is found in older and contemporaneous lithospheric rocks.
C. Mantle-derived rocks older than 3.2 billion years show significantly more compositional diversity than lithospheric rocks older than 3.2 billion years do.
D. Among rocks known to be older than 3.2 billion years, significantly more are mantle derived than lithospheric, but the opposite is true for the rocks younger than 3.2 billion years.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
早期地球被认为具有停滞盖构造模式，在这种模式下，上部岩石圈（外部岩层）基本上是静止不动的，岩石圈与下方的地幔之间没有相互作用。研究人员调查了从停滞盖模式向构造板块模式转变的时间，在构造板块模式中，岩石圈被分裂成动态板块，从而允许岩石圈和地幔材料混合。通过研究来自2.85亿年至38亿年前的岩石的化学数据，研究人员将这一转变的时间定为大约32亿年前。
中文解析:
题目的表达在3.2 billion时间点，mantle rocks and lithospheric rocks融合，因此B选项符合，mantle-derived rocks新的岩石里包含之前没有的成分，也就是来自lithospheric rock是的成分。

question:
For its 1974 work Instant Mural, the chicano art collective Asco taped members Patssi Valdez and Humberto Sandoval to an outdoor wall in East Los Angeles. The work is manifestly a commentary on constraint, but many critics focus on Valdez and the social constraints women faced at the time, which is understandable but leaves the presence of Valdez's male collaborator Sandoval unexplained. We should instead consider that in 1974, the art establishment's recognition of Chicano artists was (and had long been) restricted to sociohistorical muralists, leaving nonmuralist Chicano artists—like Asco's members—struggling to even exhibit their work; attending to this context opens an interpretation that accounts for all the evidence, allowing us to conclude that_____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. while Valdez's presence in Instant Mural represents the social constraints placed on women at the time, Sandoval's presence represents chicano muralists' frustration at their lack of recognition by the art establishment.
B. Instant Mural is best understood not as a critique of the social constraints placed on women but rather as a critique of sociohistorical muralists' depictions of Chicano culture.
C. the main subject of Instant Mural is female Chicano artists' experience of being doubly constrained by gender-role expectations and the marginalization of certain types of art.
D. Instant Mural is a reflection on the constraining aesthetic expectations placed on Chicano artists in general rather than on the social constraints placed on women specifically.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
在其1974年的作品《瞬间壁画》中，奇卡诺艺术集体Asco将成员帕茜·瓦尔德斯（Patssi Valdez）和洪贝尔托·桑多瓦尔（Humberto Sandoval）固定在洛杉矶东部的户外墙壁上。这件作品显然是对约束的评论，但许多评论家关注瓦尔德斯以及当时女性所面临的社会约束，这虽然可以理解，但未能解释瓦尔德斯的男性合作者桑多瓦尔的存在。我们应该考虑的是，在1974年，艺术界对奇卡诺艺术家的认可（并且长期以来一直如此）仅限于社会历史壁画家，使得非壁画奇卡诺艺术家（如Asco的成员）甚至难以展出他们的作品；关注这一背景为我们提供了一种解释，能够考虑到所有证据，使我们得出结论：_____。
中文解析：
D选项与文章的更广泛论点相一致，文章将重点从constraint on women转向艺术界对奇卡诺艺术家施加的限制。通过认识到非壁画奇卡诺艺术家所面临的挣扎，这一解读考虑了瓦尔德斯和桑多瓦尔的存在（both male and female），表明该作品批评的是对奇卡诺艺术施加的创作限制（aesthetic expression），而不是仅仅关注性别社会约束。A那个muralist要换成nonmuralist，B 没有结合context描述male，C中的a critique of sociohistorical muralists' depictions of Chicano culture不对。

question:
Political blogs with conspicuous ideological alignments became an integral component of US media in the early 2000s. While some commentators lauded this development, asserting that such blogs had a welcome transparency missing from traditional news, less_____ observers countered that such blogs tended to ideological extremes that exacerbated political polarization to problematic levels.

which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
具有明显意识形态倾向的政治博客在2000年代初成为美国媒体的一个重要组成部分。虽然一些评论员赞扬了这一发展，认为这些博客具有传统新闻所缺乏的透明度，但较少 _____ 的观察者反驳说，这些博客往往倾向于意识形态的极端，导致政治两极化加剧到问题严重的程度。
中文解析:
根据最后一句的消极描述（ideological extremes, political polarization, problematic levels等表达）可以推断是是一些不够积极乐观的观察者评论，sanguine 表示乐观，less sanguine符合文本不乐观的评论人群。

question:
During Rome's republican period, which ended in the first century BCE, libraries were predominantly owned by wealthy individuals who tightly controlled access to their book collections.The first public library became available in Rome in 28 BCE and was soon followed by one commissioned by Emperor Augustus. As modern scholar Fabio Fernandes notes, however, these two traditions aren't as distinct as they seem, as both the emperor and the private library owners viewed their libraries as extensions of their personal patronage, just on vastly differing scales.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To give a brief overview of public access to libraries throughout Rome's republican period
B. To contend that early imperial leaders in Rome wielded too much influence over libraries
C. To assert that private and early public libraries in ancient Rome had an essential similarity
D. To call into question the notion that private Roman libraries disappeared during the first century BCE
explanations:
题目文本翻译：在罗马的共和时期，这一时期于公元前一世纪结束，图书馆主要由富裕个人拥有，他们严格控制对自己书籍藏品的访问权。公元前28年，罗马建立了第一座公共图书馆，随后不久又有一座由皇帝奥古斯都委托兴建的图书馆。然而，现代学者法比奥·费尔南德斯指出，这两种传统并不像它们看起来那么不同，因为皇帝和私人图书馆的拥有者都将自己的图书馆视为个人庇护的延伸，只是在规模上有着巨大的差异。
中文解析:最后一句是文本的主要目的，表达其实这两类图书馆没有那么大差异，只不过是范围大小不一样而已。于是选择C essential similarity符合题意。

question:
Scholars are increasingly exploring the communication and preservation of ecological knowledge through Indigenous songs (e.g, Kazakh songs about water and foraging quality and those of the o'odham people about desert plants). In one study, ethnobiologist Dana Lepofsky et al.received insight from Kwaxsistalla Wathl'thla, a song keeper for the Kwakwaka'wakw people in Canada, into songs referencing the people's use of terraced gardens in intertidal zones along the Pacific Northwest coast for the cultivation of clams for consumption. Archaeological evidence of significant increases in clam size and abundance in that area concurrent with the documented past implementation of the method described in the songs supports the conclusion that_____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. non-Indigenous people around the Pacific Northwest coast adopted the practice developed by the Kwakwaka'wakw people after observing its efficacy.
B. the practice used by ancestors of modern Kwakwaka'wakw people not only effectively maintained a food source but also promoted its robustness.
C. there is greater corroboration in the archaeological record of ecological practices described in Kwakwaka'wakw songs than of those described in Kazakh and O'odham songs.
D. although contemporary Kwakwaka'wakw people have a deep understanding of and appreciation for the fishing and farming practices used by their ancestors, they no longer implement those methods.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
学者们越来越多地探讨通过土著歌曲（例如，关于水和觅食质量的哈萨克歌曲，以及关于沙漠植物的奥奥德哈姆人歌曲）来传递和保存生态知识。在一项研究中，民族生物学家达娜·莱波夫斯基（Dana Lepofsky）等人从加拿大夸夸卡瓦克人民的歌曲保管者Kwaxsistalla Wathl'thla那里获得了关于歌曲的见解，这些歌曲提到了该民族在太平洋西北沿海潮间带使用梯田花园种植可供食用的蛤蜊。考古证据表明，在这一地区蛤蜊的大小和数量显著增加，与歌曲中描述的方法的历史实施相一致，这支持了以下结论：_____。
中文解析：
文本描述了Kwakwaka'wakw歌曲里的养殖clams描述，对于clams有重要的意义，archaeological evidence可以看出祖先使用了这个有效的方法保持了clam数量的稳定与增产，和B选项一致。

question:
Memoirs of Eleanor Eldridge is an 1838 historical account by Elleanor Eldridge and Frances Harriet Whipple Green. In the book, the authors describe how restorative sleep can be for young people, writing, _____

Which quotation from Memoirs of Elleanor Eldridge most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. "Let us, dear reader, remember the punishment of idle curiosity, as taught in the true and affecting history [named] ‘Blue Beard;’ and, striving to be content with the facts in the case,seek  not to lift the veil, which the sensibility of true love, and feminine delicacy, have alike conspired to draw."
B. “Then let no one turn with too much [fussiness] from the simple story of the humble Elleanor, though it may contain few, or none, of the thrilling charms of poetry and passion.”
C. “Blessed are the slumbers of the innocent! They are kindlier than balm, and they refresh and gladden the spirit of childhood, like ministerings from a better world.”
D. “Home is home, to the lowly as well as the great; and no rank, or color, destroys its sacred character, its power over the mind, and the affections."
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
《埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇回忆录》是埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇和弗朗西丝·哈丽特·惠普尔·格林于1838年撰写的历史著作。在书中，作者描述了恢复性睡眠对年轻人的益处，写道：_____
中文解析:
restorative sleep,和C选项的slumber一致，表示睡眠，kindlier，refresh，gladden等积极词汇表达谁的restorative。

question:
Despite stated claims of global relevance, much major research on income inequality performed in the 2010s suffered from a myopic focus on a few countries in North America and Western Europe, partly due to limited data availability. Researchers would later _____ this shortcoming after gaining new access to banking records located in nations in Asia, such as China, and Eastern Europe,such as Hungary.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
尽管声称具有全球相关性，但2010年代关于收入不平等的许多主要研究由于数据可用性有限，过于关注北美和西欧的少数国家，受到了一定程度的短视影响。研究人员随后会 _____ 这一不足，因为他们获得了对位于亚洲（如中国）和东欧（如匈牙利）国家的银行记录的新访问权限。
中文解析:
前半句表达了数据有限（limited data availability）,后面说在获得了access to administrative records后减弱这项不足，mitigate表示减轻符合题目。

question:
Neuroscientist Kiyohito ligaya and colleagues developed a computational model to predict how much a person will enjoy a particular work of art on a scale from 1 (not at all) to 4 (very much). They then recruited participants to use the same scale to rate several sets of paintings in various styles and calculated the correlation between the ratings predicted by the model and those reported by the participants. Assuming participant P6 gave equal ratings to the abstract and cubist paintings, the data in the graph indicate the model predicted that_____

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the example?
selections: A. P6's rating for abstract and cubist paintings would equal one another
B. P6's ratings for abstract and cubist paintings would differ from one another
C. P6 would derive less aesthetic pleasure from abstract paintings than from cubist paintings.
D. P6 would derive more aesthetic pleasure from abstract paintings than from cubist paintings.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
神经科学家木义人·利嘉亚（Kiyohito Ligaya）及其同事开发了一个计算模型，以预测一个人对特定艺术作品的欣赏程度，评分范围从1（一点也不）到4（非常喜欢）。随后，他们招募参与者使用相同的评分标准对几组不同风格的画作进行评分，并计算模型预测的评分与参与者实际报告的评分之间的相关性。假设参与者P6对抽象画和立体派画作给予了相同的评分，图中的数据表明模型预测_____。
中文解析：
首先，注意correlation只代表P6的真实给分和model的预测分数是否一致，通过图表可以看出Abstract更高，Cubist低，两者不一样，但是P6评分一样，所以model预测的P6对于两者的评分有所不同，导致了correlation（相关度）的不同

question:
Eighteenth-century economist Adam Smith is famed for his metaphor of the invisible hand, which he putatively used to illustrate a robust model of how individuals produce aggregate benefits by pursuing their own economic interests. Note “putatively”: as Gavin Kennedy has shown, Smith deploys this metaphor only once in his economic writings—to make a narrow point about the then-dominant economic theory of mercantilism—and it was largely ignored until some twentieth-century economists eager to secure an intellectual pedigree for their views elevated it to a fully-fledged paradigm.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Some twentieth-century economists gave Smith's metaphor of the invisible hand a significance it does not have in Smith's work, but it is nevertheless a useful model of how individuals produce aggregate benefits by pursuing their own economic interests.

B. Smith's metaphor of the invisible hand has been interpreted as a model of how individuals acting in their own interest produce aggregate benefits, but it was intended as a subtle critique of the economic theory of mercantilism.

C. The reputation of Smith's metaphor of the invisible hand is not due to the importance of the metaphor in Smith's work but rather to the promotion of the metaphor by some later economists for their own ends.

D. Although Smith is famed for his metaphor of the invisible hand, the metaphor was largely ignored until economists in the twentieth century came to realize that the metaphor was a robust model that anticipated their own views.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
十八世纪的经济学家亚当·斯密以其“无形之手”的隐喻而闻名，他假定用这个隐喻来说明个人如何通过追求自身经济利益产生整体利益的强大模型。请注意“假定”：正如加文·肯尼迪所示，斯密在他的经济著作中仅使用过一次这个隐喻——以对当时占主导地位的重商主义经济理论提出一个狭隘的观点——而且在很大程度上被忽视，直到一些渴望为自己观点获得知识谱系的二十世纪经济学家将其提升为一个完全成熟的范式。
中文解析:
invisible hand其实Smith只在写作里用了一次，但是随后的经济学家为了推行自己的观点，才推行亚当斯密的观点当成一个范式

question:
The following text is from George Marion McClellan's 1895 poem “Eternity.”
My spirit swoons, and all my senses cry
For ocean's breast and covering of the sky.
Rock me to sleep, ye waves, and outward bound,
Just let me drift far out from toil and care,
Where lapping of the waves shall be the sound,
Which mingled with the winds that gently bear
Me on between a peaceful sea and sky,
To make my soothing slumberous lullaby.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To convey the speaker's longing for the ocean to impart a sense of inner tranquility
B. To contrast the demands of the speaker's everyday life with the serenity of being rocked to sleep by the ocean
C. To illustrate the increasing intensity of the speaker's desire to escape ongoing hardship by gliding on the ocean
D. To justify the speaker's qualms about being transported by the ocean to a quiet Destination
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
以下文本出自乔治·马里昂·麦克莱伦1895年的诗作《永恒》：
我的灵魂昏沉，所有感官呼喊
渴望海洋的怀抱与天空的覆盖。
波浪啊，摇我入睡，向外航行，
让我远离劳作与烦恼漂流，
波浪拍打的声音将是乐曲，
与轻柔的风交融，轻轻送我
在宁静的海洋与天空之间，
为我编织安抚的昏睡摇篮曲。
中文解析:
根据swoon（痴迷），cry for（需要）可以看出narrator对于大海的渴望，根据gently, peaceful, soothing可以看到平静，对应了A选项 longing for tranquility。

question:
Despite the fact that what is now known as the Cassegrain reflector was first constructed by Bonaventura Cavalieri, the telescope is named after the seventeenth-century French astronomer Laurent Cassegrain. One might assume cases like this, where a discovery or concept is not named after the first person who discovered it, to be_____they are counted among a litany of examples of Stigler's law.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of standard English?
explanations: 完整句子连接需要分号分割，同时最后两个句子间的对比关系，于是on the contrary副词词组放在最后一句里，和前一句形成对比关系。

question:
In the list “Splendid Things” from Sei shonagon's Pillow Book, the author delights in grape colored fabric, wisteria vines around a tree, and a snow-covered garden. So shrewd an observer is Shonagon, a lady-in-waiting to Empress Teishi, that her book's musings on tenth-century Japanese courtly life_____ readers a thousand years later.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of standard English?
explanations: fascinate的主语是musings，复数，其它选项需要主语是单数

question:
The present-day city of Dushanbe, Tajikistan, was the capital of the Tajik Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic, one of many nominally autonomous republics within the Soviet Union. Each of these republics_____established along ethnolinguistic lines: most residents of the Tajik Republic spoke Persian, for example.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of standard English?
explanations: each of做主语，是单数，对应was

question:
●Minor planets are astronomical objects that orbit the Sun but are neither planets nor comets.
●Astronomer Jane Luu has discovered many minor planets in her career
●Alongside colleagues David C.Jewitt and chadwick Trujillo, she discovered the  minor planet (19308)1996 TO66 on October 12, 1996.
●Alongside colleagues David C.Jewitt, Chadwick Trujillo, and David J.Tholen, she discovered the minor planet (24978)1998 HJ151 on April 28, 1998.
Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize the discovery of (19308)1996 TO66 to an audience already familiar with Jane Luu?

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize the discovery of (19308)1996 TO66 to an audience already familiar with Jane Luu?
selections: A. First there was the discovery of (19308)1996 TO66 on October 12,1996, and then on April 28,1998, Jane Luu discovered yet another minor planet with the help of her colleagues David C.Jewit, Chadwick Trujillo, and David J.Tholen.
B. Astronomer Jane Luu helped discover not only the minor planet(19308)1996 TO66 on October12, 1996, but also (24978)1998 HJ151on April28, 1998.
C. Jane Luu is an astronomer famous for her discovery of many minor planets in our solar system, including(19308)1996 TO66.
D. On October12, 1996, Jane Luu and her colleagues David C.Jewitt and Chadwick Trujillo made the exciting discovery of the minor planet(19308)1996 TO66.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
●小行星是绕太阳运行的天体，但既不是行星也不是彗星。
●天文学家简·卢（Jane Luu）在她的职业生涯中发现了许多小行星。
●她与同事大卫·C·朱伊特（David C. Jewitt）和查德威克·特鲁希略（Chadwick Trujillo）于1996年10月12日发现了小行星(19308)1996 TO66。
●她与同事大卫·C·朱伊特、查德威克·特鲁希略和大卫·J·托伦（David J. Tholen）于1998年4月28日发现了小行星(24978)1998 HJ151。
中文解析：
题目要求emphasize the discovery of (19308)1996 TO66 to an audience already familiar with Jane Luu,于是无需像C介绍人物，也不能像A/B重点不再TO66,选择D。

question:
Recent analysis of 2010 BL4—an outer solar system object orbiting the Sun between Jupiter and Neptune—has determined its color to be gray, suggesting an icy composition. Such interpretations are ultimately_____the object's gray coloration may be an incidental effect of radiation, solar wind, or collisions with other objects rather than evidence of its physical makeup.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of standard English?
explanations: 完整句子需要分号连接，而且是第一句和第二句之间的对比关系，though需要放在第二句中。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●A supercontinent is a single landmass made up of most or all of Earth's continents.
●Over time, continents merge together to form supercontinents, which then break apart.
●This process is believed to take hundreds of millions of years and is known as the supercontinent cycle.
●Ur was a supercontinent that formed about 3.1 billion years ago
●Columbia was a supercontinent that formed about 1.8 billion years ago.

The student wants to emphasize the order in which the supercontinents were formed.
Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The supercontinent Columbia formed long after the supercontinent Ur.
B. Ur formed about 3.1 billion years ago but eventually broke apart.
C. Forming and breaking apart over hundreds of millions of years, supercontinents are made up of most or all of Earth's continents.

D. Ur and Columbia were both supercontinents, single landmasses made up of
most or all of Earth's continents.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
● 超大陆是由地球大部分或全部大陆组成的单一陆块。
● 随着时间的推移，大陆会合并在一起形成超大陆，然后再分裂。
● 这一过程被认为需要数亿年，并被称为超大陆循环。
● 乌尔（Ur）是一个约在31亿年前形成的超大陆。
● 哥伦比亚（Columbia）是一个约在18亿年前形成的超大陆。
中文解析：
题目要求对比排序 emphasize the order in which the supercontinents were formed，A选项符合要求，Columbia在Ur之后。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes：
●Pattern analysis and contextual analysis are two approaches to art criticism.
●Pattern analysis examines the repetition of visual elements in an artwork.
●Such an analysis of Andy Warhol's Campbells Soup Cans might consider how the
painting's repetition of images of soup cans emphasizes the excesses of consumer culture.
●Contextual analysis considers the historical and cultural contexts of an artwork's time
●Such an analysis of Pablo Picasso's Les Demoiselles d”Avignon might consider how the painting's portrayal of fragmented human figures challenged conventions of beauty during a time of cultural upheaval (early twentieth century).

The student wants to present contextual analysis to an audience unfamiliar with the
concept. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to
accomplish this goal?
selections: A. A pattern analysis of Campbell's Soup Cans might consider how the painting's repetition of images of soup cans emphasizes the excesses of consumer culture.
B. Les Demoiselles d”Avignon's portrayal of fragmented human figures challenged conventions of beauty during a time of cultural upheaval (early twentieth
C. An approach to art criticism, contextual analysis considers the historical and cultural contexts of an artwork's time.
D. Pattern analysis differs from contextual analysis in that pattern analysis examines the repetition of visual elements in an artwork.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
●模式分析和语境分析是两种艺术批评的方法。
●模式分析考察艺术作品中视觉元素的重复。
●对安迪·沃霍尔（Andy Warhol）的《康宝浓汤罐》（Campbell's Soup Cans）的分析可能会考虑到画作中汤罐图像的重复如何强调消费文化的过度。
●语境分析考虑艺术作品创作时期的历史和文化背景。
对巴勃罗·毕加索（Pablo Picasso）的《阿维尼翁的少女》（Les Demoiselles d’Avignon）的分析可能会考虑到画作中碎片化的人物形象如何挑战了文化动荡时期（20世纪初）对美的传统观念。
中文解析：
题目要求present biographical analysis to an audience
unfamiliar with the concept.需要解释biographic analysis，于是C符合要求。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●A river's stream length is the length of a line that follows along the river path.
●A river's valley length is the length of a straight line drawn from the beginning of
the river to the end.
●The river's curviness, or sinuosity, is the ratio of the river's stream length to its
valley length.
●Low-sinuosity rivers have a stream length 1-1.5 times longer than their valley
length, and high-sinuosity rivers have a stream length 1.5 or more times longer than their valley length.
●The Embarras River in Canada has high sinuosity.
●The Luni River in India has low sinuosity.

The student wants to compare the curviness of the two rivers. Which choice most
effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The high-sinuosity Luni River in India is curvier than the low-sinuosity Embarras River in Canada.
B. The Embarras River's ratio of stream length to valley length,also known as sinuosity, is greater than that of the Luni River
C. By comparing the stream lengths of the Embarras and Luni rivers to their valley lengths, one can calculate their curviness,or sinuosity.
D. In both the Embarras and the Luni rivers, curviness is determined by comparing stream length to valley length.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
●河流的流长是沿着河流路径的线的长度。
●河流的谷长是从河流起点到终点绘制的直线的长度。
●河流的曲度或波浪度是河流流长与谷长的比率。
●低波浪度河流的流长比谷长长1到1.5倍，而高波浪度河流的流长比谷长长1.5倍或更多。
●加拿大的恩巴拉斯河（Embarras River）具有高波浪度。
印度的卢尼河（Luni River）具有低波浪度。
中文解析：
题目要求对比curviness，A描述的情况和原文相反，于是B选项虽然没有提到curvy相关词汇，但是说到了curvy的概念，并比较了两者所以选B。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Catharsis, Conversion,Traumata is a 1986 sculpture by American artist Joseph Kosuth.
●It consists of a blue neon sign that spells out the title phrase.
●Harvest Moon is a 2013 sculpture by British/Pakistani artist Shezad Dawood
●It consists of a yellow neon sign that forms an abstract moon shape.
●Neon signs became popular with advertisers in the 1920s and began to decline in popularity in the 1960s.
●Neon signs became popular with artists in the 1960s and continue to be popular today.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two sculptures. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Molded into an evocative phrase in Catharsis, Conversion, Traumata (1986), an abstract form in Harvest Moon (2013), and an advertising tool in decades past, neon lighting has a number of different applications.
B. While the sculptures share a common material, one spells out a phrase while the other is decidedly more abstract.
C. Kosuth's sculpture was made in 1986 and Dawood's in 2013, both well after the advertising heyday of neon signs had passed.
D. American artist Joseph Kosuth's and British/Pakistani artist Shezad Dawood's sculptures have employed neon signs in different ways, demonstrating the versatility of the popular material.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
●《情感宣泄、转变、创伤》（Catharsis, Conversion, Traumata）是美国艺术家约瑟夫·科苏斯（Joseph Kosuth）于1986年创作的雕塑。
●该作品由一个蓝色霓虹灯标志组成，上面拼写着标题短语。
●《丰收月》（Harvest Moon）是英国/巴基斯坦艺术家谢扎德·达伍德（Shezad Dawood）于2013年创作的雕塑。
●该作品由一个黄色霓虹灯标志组成，形成一个抽象的月亮形状。
霓虹灯标志在1920年代受到广告商的欢迎，但在1960年代开始下降。
●霓虹灯标志在1960年代受到艺术家的欢迎，并继续在今天保持流行。
中文解析：
题目要求对比sculptures，于是B选项while引导从句和主句形成对比，表达了两个雕塑的不同。

question:
When, in 2017, Cambridge University students Lucy Moss and Toby Marlow decided they wanted to develop a musical together, one of their goals was for their female actor friends to have good parts to play._____they created the show six, a retelling of the history of king Henry Ⅷ's wives in which each of the six queens has a starring role.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
2017年，剑桥大学的学生露西·莫斯（Lucy Moss）和托比·马洛（Toby Marlow）决定一起创作一部音乐剧，他们的目标之一是让女性演员朋友们拥有出色的角色。_____他们创作了音乐剧《六位女王》，讲述亨利八世的妻子的历史，每位六位女王都有一个主角的角色。
中文解析：
前后因果关系，为了达到前面的目的（female actor friends to have parts to play）,有了后面的show，达到目的选to that end。

question:

explanations:

中文解析：

question:
The prime meridian, the global indicator of zero degrees longitude established in 1884, was originally determined using astronomically derived coordinates._____as decades passed, new calculations would reveal increasingly precise coordinates, yet the prime meridian remained unchanged; it wasn't until the 1980s that, spurred by improved geodetic data, the prime meridian was officially moved—roughly one hundred meters east.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
本初子午线是1884年确立的全球零度经度的标志，最初是通过天文学推导的坐标来确定的。_____随着几十年的推移，新计算揭示了越来越精确的坐标，但本初子午线保持不变；直到1980年代，在更好的大地测量数据的推动下，本初子午线才正式向东移动了大约一百米。
中文解析：
一次又一次地，表示在几十年的过程中，有了越来越精确的坐标，但是原来的计算没有变化

question: To purchase a used car at a total price of 11, 000 dollars, a onetime down payment is required, and then fixed monthly payments are made for the remaining amount owed for the car. The equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>11</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>000</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>200</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>200</mn><mi>t</mi></math> represents this situation, where t is the number of fixed monthly payments that are made. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 200 in this context?
selections: A. The amount, in dollars, of the down payment
B. The amount, in dollars, of each fixed monthly payment
C. The total amount, in dollars, paid for the car after t fixed monthly payments
D. The total number of fixed monthly payments
explanations: 根据题意，t 为fixed monthly payments的数量，200为每个对应的费用，故选B

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>r</mi><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mn>9</mn><mi>w</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn></msqrt></math>
The given equation relates the real numbers r and w, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>w</mi><mo>></mo><mfrac><mn>5</mn><mn>9</mn></mfrac></math>. Which equation correctly expresses w in terms of r?
explanations: in terms of问题，转换各个符号在等式位置即可得C（注意两侧平方得到正号)

question: A model predicts that the population of a certain town was 5,000 in 2008. The model also predicts that each year for the next 5 years, the population p increased by 4% of the previous year’s population. Which equation best represents this model, where x is the number of years after 2008, for <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>5</mn></math>?
explanations: 初始值500，变化率为增长4%，故选D

question: For the positive quantities h, j, and k, 35% of h is equivalent to 49% of j, and j is equivalent to 45% of k. What percentage of k is h? (Disregard the % sign when entering your answer For example, if your answer is 39%, enter 39)
explanations: 根据文字表述<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>35</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi> <mi>h</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>49</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi> <mi>j</mi></math>，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>j</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>45</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi> <mi>k</mi></math>，合并两个式子得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>0.35</mn> <mrow> <mtext></mtext> <mi mathvariant="normal">h</mi> </mrow> <mo>=</mo> <mn>0.2205</mn> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi> </mrow></math>，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mtext> h=0.2205k/0.35=0.63k </mtext></math>，也就是63%

question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>≥</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn></math> represents all solutions to the inequality <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>a</mi> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>18</mn> <mo>≤</mo> <mn>14</mn></math>, where a is a constant, what is the greatest possible value of a?
explanations: 整理不等式可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>a</mi> <mi>x</mi> <mo>≤</mo> <mn>32</mn></math>，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>≤</mo> <mn>32</mn> <mrow> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <mi>a</mi></math>，代入<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>≥</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>8</mn></math>，得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>a</mi> <mo>≤</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>4</mn></math>，取最大值-4

question: For a certain type of rope, the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>900</mn> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>, where a is a constant, gives the estimated breaking strength y, in pounds, of a rope with a circumference of x inches. Based on this equation, if a rope of this type has a circumference of 0.75inches, it has an estimated breaking strength of 708.75 pounds. What is the estimated breaking strength, in pounds, of a rope of this type that has a circumference of 4.50 inches?
explanations: 根据题意，周长<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>与正比关系，设问题答案z可得，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>708.75</mn> <mrow> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <msup> <mn>0.75</mn> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mi>z</mi> <mrow> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <msup> <mn>4.50</mn> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>，计算得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>z</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>25515</mn></math>（不必计算出a得值也可完成该题目）

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>19</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>32</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>r</mi></math>
In the given equation, r is a constant. The equation has exactly one real solution. What is the value of r?
explanations: 二次函数方程组system of equations<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>32</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>19</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，exactly one point意味着<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>,结果为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>r</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>45</mn></math>

question: How many solutions does the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>x</mi></math> have?
explanations: 式子相当于<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，无解，选A

question: A hemisphere is half of a sphere. If a hemisphere has a radius of 83 inches, which of the following is closest to the volume, in cubic inches, of this hemisphere?
explanations: 球的体积公式可查得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mrow><mo>/</mo></mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>π</mi><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>3</mn></msup></math>，半球hemisphere 体积<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mrow><mo>/</mo></mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>π</mi><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>3</mn></msup></math>，代入<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>83</mn></math>计算得到答案D

question: Line k is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></math>. Line j is parallel to line k in the xy-plane and passes through the point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. Which equation defines line j?
explanations: 平行，斜率相同，过（0，1）点，故选B

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>16</mn></math>
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>16</mn></math>
The solution to the given system of equations is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>.What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>y?</mi></math>
explanations: 两式子相加得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>8</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>32</mn></math>，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>8</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></math>，两式子相减得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，故答案为4，选C

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>80</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>
In the <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi><mtext>-plane&#xA0;</mtext></math>, the graph of the given equation is a circle. If this circle is inscribed in a square, what is the perimeter of the square?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>80</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>整理成圆的标准形式：<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>16</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>80</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>16</mn></math><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>100</mn></math>，圆心在（2，4），半径为10，圆内切在一个正方形中，所以正方形的边长就是圆的直径<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mo>∗</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>20</mn></math>，正方形周长即为80，选C

question: An object’s speed is increasing at a rate of 2.7 meters per second squared. What is this rate, in miles per minute squared, rounded to the nearest tenth? <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mtext>Use</mtext><mn>1</mn><mtext>mile</mtext><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>609</mn><mtext>meters.</mtext><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
explanations: 注意数字、单位及数字关系（square 在单位转换时需要用平方，1分钟=60秒），<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2.7</mn><mrow><mtext></mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>/</mo></mrow><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>2.7</mn><mrow><mtext></mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>/</mo></mrow><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>∗</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>60</mn><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn><mover><mo data-mjx-texclass="OP" movablelimits="true">min</mo><mn>2</mn></mover></mrow></mfrac><mo>∗</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi></mrow></mrow><mrow><mn>1609</mn><mrow><mtext></mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi></mrow></mrow></mfrac></math>=6miles per minute squared

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>7</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></math>
The given equation is one equation in a system of two linear equations. If the system of equations has at least one solution, which of the following equations could be the other equation in the system?
