explanations: 一次函数方程组至少一个解，要么斜率不同（式子2），要么两线重合（式子1），故选C

question: In the figure shown, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mn>61</mn></msqrt></math>units, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mi>C</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn></math> units, and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi><mi>E</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>18</mn></math> units. What is the area, in square units, of triangle ADE?
explanations: 直角三角形ABC，利用勾股定理计算出<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn></math>，ABC与ADE相似，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mi>E</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>18</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>24</mn></math>，故<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>D</mi><mi>E</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>20</mn></math>，面积<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>24</mn><mo>∗</mo><mn>20</mn><mrow><mo>/</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>240</mn></math>

question: The function f is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></math>, where a, b, and c are constants. The graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>in the<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi><mtext>-plane&#xA0;</mtext></math> passes through the points <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. If a is an integer greater than 1, which of the following could be the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi></math>?
explanations: 二次函数问题，根据两个解(8，0）<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>可得到vertex的x坐标为3，即<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>a</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></math>，得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>b</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>a</mi></math>，所以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>a</mi></math>,而a是大于1的整数，-5a在选项中只能是-10 选A

question: The graph of line g is shown in the xy-plane. Line k is defined by<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn> 165</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>p</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>w</mi></math>, where p and w are constants. If line k is graphed in this xy-plane, resulting in the graph of a system of two linear equations, the system of two linear equations will have infinitely many solutions. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>p</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>w</mi></math>?
explanations: infinitely many solutions表示两个式子完全相同，跟据图像两个黑点计算斜率<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mn>12</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>10</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>11</mn><mn>10</mn></mfrac></math>，y-intercept为1，函数为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>11</mn><mn>10</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></math>，与<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>165</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>p</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>w</mi></math>相同，165x+py=w整理成<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>165</mn><mi>p</mi></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>w</mi><mi>p</mi></mfrac></math>，所以p=150，w=150，p+w=300

question: Each of the following frequency tables represents a data set. Which of these frequency tables represents the data set with the smallest standard deviation?
explanations: 统计考点中standard deviation标准差表示的是数据的分散程度，对比4个选项可发现两侧数据分布最多的D具有最大标准差，而最集中分布的A具有最小的标准差，选A

question:
Can field mustard plants grow on Mars? can pea plants? You might think the answer to these questions is obviously no, but researchers in the Netherlands recently showed that the seeds of many common plant species can germinate in soil designed to simulate Martian conditions, as long as water is supplied. In fact, some species actually did better Martian soil than in Earth soil: 30 percent of field mustard seeds sprouted when planted in simulated Martian soil, compared with 4 percent that did when planted in soil from their home planet.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To answer long-standing questions about how Martian soil conditions can be simulated on Earth
B. To present a surprising finding about plants grown in soil intended to be similar to Martian soil
C. To discuss an unexpected result about the role of water in plants grown in simulated Martian soil
D. To explain an important study of differences in the composition of Martian soil and the composition of Earth soil
explanations:
题目文本翻译
场芥菜植物能在火星上生长吗？豌豆植物呢？你可能会认为这些问题的答案显然是否定的，但荷兰的研究人员最近展示了许多常见植物种子的种子可以在模拟火星条件的土壤中发芽，只要提供水分。事实上，某些物种在模拟火星土壤中的表现比在地球土壤中更好：30%的场芥菜种子在模拟火星土壤中发芽，而在其家园土壤中仅有4%发芽。
中文解析
文本目的是研究员们发现很多种子在模拟火星状态下能够发芽，且发芽率更高，这符合B选项所说的surprising finding，同时plants grown in soil才是文本的核心重点。

question:
The following text is adapted from Adib Khorram's 2018 novel Darius the Great Is Not Okay. The narrator, Darius, is a teenager visiting family in Iran. He and his friend Sohrab are at the entrance of the ruins of the ancient city of Persepolis.
“ The Gate of All Nations,” Sohrab said. He gestured to the lamassus[ sculptures] and pillars surrounding us.“ That's the name in English.” It wasn't much of a gate anymore, since anyone of any nation could have easily stepped around it instead of walking through. But it was still amazing.
Behind the lamassu, more columns sprouted from the ground like ancient trees in a petrified forest, forty feet tall, spindly but still miraculously upright. Giant stone slabs formed the remains of what must once have been a breathtaking structure.
©2018 by Adib Khorram

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion of the text?
selections: A. It presents an image to illustrate what one part of the ruins looks   like.
B. It emphasizes that the narrator already knows a lot about the   city.
C. It suggests that the narrator had expected to visit a forest.
D. It indicates the specific time in the past when the buildings  became ruins.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下是 Adib Khorram 2018 年小说《达里乌斯并不太好》的改编文本中文翻译：
“万国之门，”索赫拉布说。他指着周围的拉马苏（lamassu）雕塑和柱子。“这就是英文名字。” 这座门现在并不算真正的门，因为任何国家的人都可以轻松地绕它，而不是走进去。但它依然令人惊叹。在拉马苏的背后，更多的柱子像古老的树木一样从地面上生长出来，四十英尺高，细长但依然奇迹般地挺立着。巨大的石板构成了曾经应该是令人叹为观止的建筑的残骸。
中文解析
columns的外形比喻为ancient trees in a petrified forest(石化森林)，是生动的意象（image）形容the ruins of this ancient city. 和A选项一致。

question:
Both sharks and crayfish can detect electrical fields around them, but the_____of their sensitivities differs substantially. Whereas crayfish can detect fields emitted by household electronics, those are many times stronger than  the fields created by water moving through Earth's magnetic field, which sharks are sensitive enough to detect.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
鲨鱼和小龙虾都能感知周围的电场，但它们的灵敏度差异显著。小龙虾能够探测到家庭电子设备发出的电场，而这些电场的强度要比鲨鱼能够感知的水流经过地球磁场所产生的电场强得多。
中文解析
形容两类生物感知的差异程度，用magnitude（程度，尺寸，大小等）

question:
Puerto Rico is an island in the Caribbean Sea. Indigenous people there started raising guinea pigs about 1,700 years ago. Guinea pigs had originally been domesticated much earlier in both Colombia and Peru. So were guinea pigs brought to Puerto Rico from Colombia or from Peru? Ancient Caribbean trade routes connected Puerto Rico with Colombia but not with Peru. Therefore, guinea pigs in Puerto Rico probably came from Colombia and descended from Colombian guinea pigs.

Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the underlined claim?
selections: A. Guinea pigs are common in ancient Puerto Rican art, especially in pottery.
B. Ancient guinea pigs in Puerto Rico were genetically less similar to ancient guinea pigs in Colombia than to ancient guinea pigs in Peru.
C. The guinea pig population of ancient Colombia was much larger than the guinea pig population of ancient Peru.
D. Modern breeds of guinea pigs don't look like images of guinea pigs in ancient art from Puerto Rico, Colombia, and Peru.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
波多黎各是加勒比海上的一个岛屿。那里土著人大约在1700年前开始饲养天竺鼠。天竺鼠最早在哥伦比亚和秘鲁就已经被驯化。那么，天竺鼠是从哥伦比亚还是秘鲁被带到波多黎各的呢？古代加勒比海的贸易路线将波多黎各与哥伦比亚连接起来，但并未与秘鲁相连。因此，波多黎各的天竺鼠很可能来自哥伦比亚，并且是哥伦比亚天竺鼠的后裔。
中文解析
题目结论是guinea pigs从Colombia传入Puerto Rico，如果要weaken this claim，那么可以说古代Puerto Rico的guinea  pigs不像Colobia的，更像Peru的，从种类外形不像来反驳，于是选择B。

question:
“Tomato” is an example of a loanword — that is, a word that originated in one language and was later adopted by another. The word came to English indirectly from tomate, the Spanish word for the widely cultivated plant. Spanish had borrowed it from Nahuatl, an Indigenous language of Central Mexico, in which the word’s original form is tomatl. “Maize” is also Indigenous in origin and entered English through Spanish. But in this case, the original source was Taino, a language of the Caribbean islands, in which the word for the corn plant is mahis.

The author makes which point about the Spanish language?
selections: A. It has borrowed words from Indigenous languages and contributed words to them.
B. Its contribution to English vocabulary roughly equals the collective contribution by Indigenous languages.
C. It adopted Nahuatl and Taino words in approximately equal numbers.
D. It has served as a medium through which Indigenous languages have influenced English.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
“番茄”是一个借词的例子——即一个起源于一种语言并被另一种语言采纳的词汇。这个词间接来自西班牙语“tomate”，表示这种广泛种植的植物。西班牙语是从纳瓦特尔语（Nahuatl）借来的，这是一种中美洲的土著语言，词语的原始形式是“tomatl”。“玉米”也源于土著语言，并通过西班牙语进入英语。但在这种情况下，原始来源是塔伊诺语（Taino），这是加勒比海岛屿的一种语言，其中玉米植物的词是“mahis”。
中文解析：
根据文本，作者主要强调西班牙语从土著语言中借用词汇，并将它们引入英语。充当了中间的媒介功能。

question:
The following text is adapted from Jerome K. Jerome's 1889 novel Three Men in a Boat( To Say Nothing of the Dog).
We [ people] are creatures of the sun. We love light and life. That is why we crowd into the towns and cities, and the country grows more and more deserted every year. In the sunlight—in the daytime, when Nature is alive and busy all around us, we like the open hill-sides and the deep woods well enough: but in the night, when our Mother Earth has gone to sleep, and left us waking, oh! the world seems so lonesome, and we get frightened, like children in a silent house. Then we sit and sob, and long for the gas-lit streets, and the sound of human voices, and the answering throb of human life.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To address common traits that motivate many people to choose to live in urban  environments
B. To indicate that people sometimes experience feelings of isolation in crowded areas
C. To illustrate the idea that most people tend to prefer hillsides in the country to certain aspects of towns and cities
D. To caution people not to be so quick to dismiss the natural beauty that can be found in rural areas
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文字改编自杰罗姆·K·杰罗姆1889年的小说《三人划船（不谈狗的事）》：
我们是阳光的生物。我们热爱光明和生命。这就是为什么我们纷纷涌向城镇和城市，而乡村每年都变得愈加荒凉。在阳光明媚的白天，当大自然在我们周围生机勃勃时，我们喜欢开阔的山坡和深邃的森林；但在夜晚，当我们的母亲大地进入沉睡，留下我们孤独觉醒时，哦！这个世界似乎是如此孤寂，我们感到害怕，像在寂静的房子里的孩子。于是我们坐着哭泣，渴望着煤气灯照亮的街道，渴望着人声的回响，以及人类生命的脉动。
中文解析
这个文本主要讨论了人们喜欢居住在城市的原因。它指出人们是喜欢阳光和生命的，因此他们倾向于聚集在城市和城镇中。文中提到了在夜晚人们会感到孤独和害怕，渴望城市中的照明灯光、人声和繁忙的生活节奏，这进一步强调了人们对城市生活的偏爱。因此，主要目的在于探讨人们选择居住在城市环境的共同特征和动机，而不是警告人们不要轻易忽视农村地区所拥有的自然美景或者表明大多数人更喜欢乡村的山坡而不喜欢城镇的某些方面。

question:
As exemplifed by Temiar songs about landforms and landmarks and Lakota songs about gathering mouse beans, ecological information can be transmitted in Indigenous songs, and in some instances is maintained only in this way. Kwaxsistalla Wathl'thla, a song keeper for the Kwakwaka'wakw people in Canada, collaborated with ethnobiologist Dana Lepofsky et al, sharing songs referencing terraced intertidal clam gardens the people implemented in the past to foster healthy development of a dietary staple. Drawing on archaeological evidence as well, Lepofsky et al.determined that the prevalence of the practice described in the songs corresponded with growth in clam size and abundance despite increased harvesting pressure—a finding that demonstrates that _____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. representation of practical applications of ecological knowledge is the defining characteristic of the music of certain Indigenous peoples.
B. the Kwakwaka'wakw people likely would not have detailed their creation of clam gardens in songs if their efforts hahot produced significantly larger clams.
C. the clams harvested from intertidal terraces by Kwakwaka'wakw people in the past likely were a different species than the clams found in those areas today.
D. effective methods for the cultivation of sources of sustenance are among the ecological knowledge preserved in Indigenous songs.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以Temiar关于地形和地标的歌曲以及Lakota关于采集鼠豆的歌曲为例，生态信息可以通过土著歌曲进行传递，在某些情况下，仅通过这种方式得以保留。加拿大Kwakwaka'wakw人民的歌曲保留者Kwaxsistalla Wathl'thla与民族生物学家Dana Lepofsky等人合作，分享了提到他们过去实施的梯田潮间带蛤蜊园的歌曲，以促进这一饮食主食的健康发展。Lepofsky等人还参考了考古证据，确定这些歌曲中描述的做法的普遍性与蛤蜊大小和丰度的增长相对应，尽管采集压力增加——这一发现表明_____。
中文解析
根据文本 Kwakwaka wakw 歌曲中描述的方法，表明它们有效地维持了蛤蜊的数量（size and abundance）和D选线一致。

question:
Almost all works of fiction contain references to the progression of time, including the time of day when events in a story take place. In a 2020 study, Allen Kim, Charuta Pethe, and Steven Skiena claim that an observable pattern in such references reflects a shift in human behavior prompted by the spread of electric lighting in the late nineteenth century. The researchers drew this conclusion from an analysis of more than 50,000 novels spanning many centuries and cultures, using software to recognize and tally both specific time references—that is, clock phrases, such as 7 a. m. or 2:30 p. m.— and implied ones, such as mentions of meals typically associated with a particular time of day.

Which finding from the study, if true, would most directly support the researchers' conclusion?
selections: A. Novels published after the year 1800 include the clock phrase 10  a. m. less often than novels published efore the year 1800 do.
B. Among novels published in the nineteenth century, implied time references become steadily more common than clock phrases as publication dates approach 1900.
C. The time references of noon(12 p. m.) and midnight (12 a. m.) are used with roughly the same frequency in the novels.
D. Novels published after 1880 contain significantly more references to activities occurring after 10 p. m. than do novels from earlier periods.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
几乎所有的小说作品都包含对时间流逝的描述，包括故事中事件发生的时间。在一项2020年的研究中，艾伦·金、查鲁塔·佩特和史蒂文·斯基纳声称，这些时间参考中的可观察模式反映了19世纪末电灯普及所引发的人类行为变化。研究人员通过分析超过50,000部跨越多个世纪和文化的小说得出这一结论，使用软件识别并统计了具体的时间参考——即时钟短语，例如早上7点或下午2点30分——以及隐含的时间参考，例如提到与特定时间相关的用餐。
中文解析
文本中表达19世纪，电灯的使用使得人们的行为有所改变，并且通过小说能够展现，于是1800s之后的小说更多的提及了晚上10点后，说明人们的睡眠推后了，D选项可以支持原文的结论。

question:
The Vizcaya is just one of approximately three million known historical shipwrecks spread throughout the world’s oceans, and their impact on sea life and underwater ecosystems is of great interest to researchers. Rachel Mugge and colleagues were particularly curious about the effects of wooden shipwrecks on seafloor microbial communities. The researchers studied two wooden shipwrecks in the Gulf of Mexico by placing pieces of pine and oak between zero and 200 meters away from each shipwreck to collect samples of three kinds of microbes: bacteria, archaea, and fungi. They found that across the three microbial communities, peak diversity and richness was observed on pine and oak samples placed approximately 125 meters from the shipwrecks.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It states the number of known shipwrecks, describes the historical significance of one of those shipwrecks, and then comments on the various microbes found at the shipwreck site.

B. It introduces a study of microbial communities near shipwrecks that has received significant scholarly attention, summarizes the results of that study, and then describes a research team’s reaction to the study.
C. It names a famous historical shipwreck, describes the type of wood used to build that ship, and then explains how that wood type influences underwater microbial communities.
D. It notes a general scientific interest in shipwrecks’ ecological effects, describes a specific study related to that interest, and then states one of the study’s findings.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
维斯卡亚号只是全球大约三百万个已知历史沉船中的一艘，这些沉船对海洋生物和水下生态系统的影响引起了研究人员的极大兴趣。瑞秋·穆格（Rachel Mugge）及其同事特别关注木质沉船对海底微生物群落的影响。研究人员在墨西哥湾研究了两艘木质沉船，通过在距离每艘沉船零到200米的范围内放置松木和橡木的样本，来收集三种微生物的样本：细菌、古菌和真菌。他们发现，在这三个微生物群落中，约在距离沉船125米的位置，松木和橡木样本的多样性和丰富度达到了峰值。
中文解析：
文章一开始介绍impact of shipwrecks on marine life, 然后给一个研究，最后是研究的发现，和D选项一致。

question:
To assist with the development of new water-repellant materials for aviation and other applications, a team including both engineers and entomologists conducted a study of the water- repellant properties of cicada wings. The team explained that the_____experts in these two disciplines resulted in a more comprehensive approach than independent efforts by experts in either discipline could have achieved.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
为了帮助开发用于航空和其他应用的新型防水材料，一个包括工程师和昆虫学家的团队研究了蝉翅的防水特性。团队解释说，这两个学科的专家合作，提供了一种更全面的方法，而独立的专家努力无法达到这样的效果。
中文解析
根据including both engineers and entomologists推断是两个领域专家的合作，于是选D collaboration between

question:
While doing research for a paper about metal exports, a student finds information about copper mining in different countries in 1995 and 2020. The student notes that Peru produced 0.38 million metric tons of copper in1995 and_____.

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
selections: A. 1.20 million metric tons of copper in 2020.
B. 0.39 million metric tons of copper in 2020.
C. 2.15 million metric tons of copper in 2020.
D. 0.73 million metric tons of copper in 2020.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
这位学生在进行关于金属出口的论文研究时发现了1995年和2020年不同国家的铜矿生产信息。学生注意到，1995年秘鲁生产了0.38百万公吨的铜，而_____。
中文解析
2020年Peru对应的数值是2.15

question:
New and interesting research conducted by Suleiman A. Al- Sweedan and Moath Alhaj is inspired by their observation that though studies of the effect of high altitude on blood chemistry are_____, the effect on blood chemistry of living in locations below sea level, such as the California towns of Niland and Heber, has received comparatively little notice.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
苏莱曼·阿尔-斯维丹（Suleiman A. Al-Sweedan）和穆阿特·阿尔哈吉（Moath Alhaj）进行的新颖有趣的研究受到了他们的观察的启发：尽管关于高海拔对血液化学影响的研究____，但生活在海平面以下的地方（例如加利福尼亚的尼兰德和希伯尔小镇）对血液化学的影响却得到了相对较少的关注。
中文解析
根据后文海平面下（below sea level）受到的关注少（receive little notice），推断高海拔地区研究blood chemistry at high altitude 收到了足够研究，于是选择abundant。

question:
The following text is adapted from John Matheus's 1926 short story,“ Mr. Bradford Teaches Sunday School.” Mr. Bradford is driving through the countryside in Florida.
The moss in the towering water oaks had be come enlivened with a verdant sheen of silver and hung like festoons of carnival or like funeral decorations for the mourning of the dead. The pine green was resplendent. The bald cypresses spread themselves along the water courses while the willows wept as they always did.
Mr. Bradford was conscious of this gorgeous display of nature.

As used in the text, what does the word“ display” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文本改编自约翰·马修斯1926年的短篇小说《布拉德福德先生教主日学校》。布拉德福德先生正在佛罗里达的乡村行驶。
高耸的水橡树上的苔藓闪烁着银色的生机，像狂欢节的装饰物一样悬挂着，或者像为死者哀悼而设的丧葬装饰。松树的绿色光彩夺目。秃头柏沿着水道延展开来，而柳树则像往常一样低垂着，似乎在哭泣。布拉德福德先生意识到了这幅自然的华丽景象。
中文解析
文本中的display是大自然风景呈现，于是对应exhibition展现，reproduction 繁殖，再生；concealment隐藏；pretentiousness自命不凡，装腔作势

question:
A group of primate conservationists recently began a long-term study of the effects of different conservation strategies on the white-headed langur (Trachypithecus poliocephalus).The species population is currently estimated to be around1,000. It is challenging to accurately count these primates, however, which makes it difficult to tell whether the population is increasing, decreasing, or staying stable. The study may thus_____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. risk making inaccurate conclusions about the effectiveness of different conservation strategies.
B. cause other conservationists to adopt a new methodology for counting populations.
C. benefit from including species beyond the white-headed langur
D. fail to consider less-well-known conservation approaches for the white-headed langur
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一组灵长类动物保护主义者最近开始了一项长期研究，研究不同保护策略对白头叶猴（Trachypithecus poliocephalus）影响的效果。该物种的种群数量目前估计约为1000只。然而，准确计算这些灵长类动物的数量是具有挑战性的，这使得很难判断种群是增加、减少还是保持稳定。因此，该研究可能_____。
中文解析
因为无法精准计算数量，使用不能知道到底是增长还是下降还是稳定，于是针对不同的保护方式无法准确得出结论，和A一致。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●A supercontinent is a single landmass made up of most or all of Earth's continents.
●Over time, continents merge together to form supercontinents, which then break apart.
●This process is believed to take hundreds of millions of years and is known as the supercontinent cycle.
●Ur and columbia were supercontinents.
●Ur formed about 3.1 billion years ago.
●Columbia formed about 1.8 billion years ago.

The student wants to specify when Ur formed. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Ur was a supercontinent, a single landmass made up of most or all of Earth's continents.
B. The supercontinent Ur formed about 3.1 billion years ago.
C. Long ago, the Earth was home to supercontinents like Ur and Columbia.
D. Over hundreds of millions of years, the supercontinent cycle results in supercontinents forming and breaking apart.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
●超大陆是由地球大部分或全部大陆组成的单一陆块。
●随着时间的推移，大陆会合并在一起形成超大陆，然后又会分裂开来。

question:
Soil polluted with cadmium(a heavy metal) is harmful to many plants and animals, but the plant species Elodea canadensis, or Canadian waterweed, not only thrives in such conditions but also helps remediate them. As a metal hyperaccumulator, Elodea canadensis absorbs a large amount of cadmium and stores it safely in its roots and shoots; ____cadmium concentrations in the soil decrease.

which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
受镉（重金属）污染的土壤对许多植物和动物有害，但水草（Elodea canadensis）不仅能够在这种环境中生长良好，还能帮助修复这些污染。作为一种金属超富集植物，水草能够吸收大量镉，并将其安全储存于根部和茎部；____土壤中的镉浓度下降。
中文解析
Elodea canadensis吸收大量的cadmium并将其安全地存储在根和茎中。因此，最合适的过渡词是“accordingly”（对应地），土壤中的cadmium浓度会减少。

question:

There, wildlife biologist Dr. Purnima Devi Barman is on the front lines of conservation efforts that—through community involvement and scientific_____aim to bring adjutants back from near extinction.

question:
The unconventional literary philosophy with which Fernando Pessoa approached his writing is manifested in the Portuguese poet's “heteronyms,” his term for the dozens of fictional personas in whose voices he authored many of his_____among these personas was Ricardo Reis, author of classical odes in a Horatian style.

question:
William Shakespeare likely arrived in London as early as 1585, at the age of 21, to pursue a career in the theater. Little is known of his early years there, but by 1593 he was becoming known for plays such as Richard III._____in 1599, he would delight audiences with Much Ado About Nothing, considered by some to be one of his greatest works.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Ixmiquilpan is a municipality in the state of Hidalgo, Mexico.
●Municipalities are governmental regions responsible for providing many public services to their residents.
●One service they provide is water treatment.
●Ixmiquilpan's population was 98,654in 2020.
●Hidalgo is divided into 84 municipalities.

The student wants to provide an example of a public service that Ixmiquilpan is responsible for. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Ixmiquilpan is one of 84 municipalities in Hidalgo providing public services to their communities.
B. Ixmiquilpan—a governmental region in the state of Hidalgo, Mexico—provides public services to its residents.
C. As a municipality, Ixmiquilpan is responsible for providing water treatment to its residents.
D. In 2020, the municipality of Ixmiquilpan had a population of 98,654.

在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
●Ixmiquilpan是墨西哥伊达尔戈州的一个市。
●市是负责向居民提供许多公共服务的政府区域。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Oak Tree House is an Ancestral Puebloan dwelling site located in southwestern Colorado.
●It was built under a rock overhang and inhabited from approximately 1180-1210 CE.
●The overhanging rock ledges offered protection from heavy rain and snow.
●Yucca House is an Ancestral Puebloan dwelling site located in southwestern Colorado.
●It was built on relatively flat terrain and inhabited from approximately 1080-1275 CE.
●This level surface allowed for the construction of large terraced buildings.

The student wants to explain an advantage of the Oak Tree House dwelling site. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The location of Oak Tree House,an Ancestral Puebloan dwelling site in southwestern colorado, provided an advantage to its inhabitants.
B. Located in southwestern Colorado, Oak Tree House is an Ancestral Puebloan dwelling site that was inhabited from approximately 1180-1210 CE.
C. The relatively flat terrain on which Oak Tree House was built allowed for the construction of large terraced buildings.
D. Since it was built under a rock overhang, Oak Tree House was naturally protected from heavy rain and snow.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
●橡树屋是位于科罗拉多州西南部的一个祖先普韦布洛人居住遗址。
●它建在一个岩石悬崖下，居住时间大约为公元1180年至1210年。
●悬挂的岩石台地为居民提供了抵御大雨和雪的保护。
●俞卡屋是位于科罗拉多州西南部的一个祖先普韦布洛人居住遗址。
●它建在相对平坦的地形上，居住时间大约为公元1080年至1275年。
●这种平坦的地面允许建造大型的阶梯式建筑。

题目要求oak tree house dwelling site的具体优点，于是根据notes，D符合（protected from heavey rain and snow）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●In a 2010 study, researchers Katrin Heer, Larissa Albrecht, and Elisabeth Kv. Kalko wanted to explore the effects of ingestion by bats on the germination of Ficus obtusifolia seeds in Panama.
●The team of researchers tested 120 Ficus obtusifolia seeds that had been ingested by Jamaican fruit bats.
●Of these, 111 seeds(93%)germinated.
●As a control, K.Heer et al. tested 120 Ficus obtusifolia seeds that had not been ingested by Jamaican fruit bats.
●Of these, 116 seeds(97%)germinated.

The student wants to describe the study's research methodology. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In the study, a lower percentage of Ficus obtusifolia seeds ingested by bats germinated than those that had not been ingested by bats
B. The team of researchers tested the germination of 120 Ficus obtusifolia seeds that had been ingested by Jamaican fruit bats and 120 Ficus obtusifolia seeds that had not been ingested.
C. K. Heer et al. wanted to explore the effects of Jamaican fruit bats' ingestion on Ficus obtusifolia seed germination.
D. Research by K. Heer et al.revealed that 111 of 120—that is, 93%—of the Ficus obtusifolia seeds that had been ingested by Jamaican fruit bats.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，学生做了以下笔记：
●在2010年的一项研究中，研究人员Katrin Heer、Larissa Albrecht和Elisabeth Kv. Kalko想要探讨果蝠摄食对巴拿马榕树(Ficus obtusifolia)种子发芽的影响。
●研究团队测试了120颗被牙买加果蝠摄食的榕树种子。
●其中，有111颗种子（93%）发芽。
●作为对照，K. Heer等人测试了120颗未被牙买加果蝠摄食的榕树种子。
●其中，有116颗种子（97%）发芽。
中文解析
题目要求methodology方法论，于是控制变量对比研究符合要求，选择B选项，都是120 seeds gemination，分别研究ingested by Jamaican fruit bats 和not ingensted by Jamaican fruit bats，符合methodology comparison and control group.

question:
Despite stated claims of global relevance, much major research on income inequality performed in the 2010s suffered from a myopic focus on a few countries in North America and Western Europe, partly due to limited data Availability. Researchers would later_____this shortcoming after gaining new access to administrative records located in nations in South America, such as Brazil, and Eastern Europe, such as Russia.

which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
尽管声称具有全球相关性，2010年代关于收入不平等的主要研究却受到了一些北美和西欧国家的短视关注的影响，这在一定程度上是由于数据可获得性有限。研究人员后来会_____这种不足，因为他们获得了位于南美国家（如巴西）和东欧国家（如俄罗斯）的行政记录的新访问权限。
中文解析
前半句表达了数据有限（limited data availability）,后面说在获得了access to administrative records后减弱这项不足，mitigate表示减轻符合题目。

question:
Text1
In parts of New Zealand, the stoat is a major predator of the house mouse. Researcher G.L.Blackwell and colleagues found that when this predation pressure on house mice was temporarily reduced, their numbers significantly increased. This finding illustrates a foundational ecological principle: predators control prey population numbers.
Text2
William D.Gulsby and colleagues found that excluding coyotes from a site in the state of Georgia where they typically prey on white-tailed deer had no significant effect on white-tailed deer abundance. Many other predation relief studies show an increase in prey abundance, but those studies often focus on small, rapidly reproducing prey, like birds, mice, and frogs, rather than large, slowly reproducing prey, like white-tailed deer, which could account for the difference between those results and Gulsby and colleagues' results.

Based on the texts, the author of Text 2 would most likely agree with which statement about the "principle" mentioned in Text 1?
selections: A. It is plausible, but many of the studies that support it have methodological flaws.
B. It has been challenged by some studies,but the findings of those studies have not been widely accepted.
C. It may be true for some predators but only because those predators share certain physical characteristics.
D. It has some evidential support,but it should not be regarded as universally applicable.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
文本1
在新西兰的某些地区，黄鼠狼是家鼠的主要捕食者。研究人员G.L. Blackwell及其同事发现，当对家鼠的捕食压力暂时减小时，它们的数量显著增加。这个发现说明了一个基础的生态原则：捕食者控制猎物的种群数量。
文本2
William D. Gulsby及其同事发现，在乔治亚州某个通常由郊狼捕食的地方，排除郊狼对白尾鹿的数量没有显著影响。许多其他捕食缓解研究显示猎物数量增加，但这些研究往往集中在小型、繁殖迅速的猎物上，比如鸟类、老鼠和青蛙，而不是如白尾鹿这样大型、繁殖缓慢的猎物，这可能解释了这些研究结果与Gulsby及其同事结果之间的差异。
中文解析
第一篇的principle,根据冒号后的解释是说捕食者控制prey numbers，但是第二篇文章最后一句的转折but后说明这个原则只适用于小动物，不适用于大的缓慢繁衍的动物，于是符合D选项，这个principle有证据支撑，但是不是普遍适用的。

question:
Political blogs with conspicuous ideological alignments became an integral component of US media in the early 2000s. While some commentators lauded this development, asserting that such blogs had a welcome transparency missing from traditional news, less____observers countered that such blogs tended to ideological extremes that exacerbated political polarization to problematic levels.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
政治博客在2000年代初期成为美国媒体的重要组成部分，这些博客显著表现出意识形态的倾向。虽然一些评论员对此表示赞赏，认为这些博客具有传统新闻所缺乏的透明度，但较不____的观察者则反驳说，这些博客倾向于极端意识形态，加剧了政治极化，达到了令人担忧的程度。
中文解析
根据最后一句的消极描述（ideological extremes, political polarization, problematic levels等表达）可以推断是是一些不够积极乐观的观察者评论，sanguine 表示乐观，less sanguine符合文本不乐观的评论人群。

question:
Vertical gene transfer involves the transmission of genetic material from a parent to offspring; horizontal gene transfer, on the other hand, involves the exchange of genetic material between organisms not in a parent-offspring relationship. While horizontal gene transfer is common among Prokaryotes---single-celled organisms, such as the bacteria Brevundimonas diminuta and Massilia timonae---it has rarely been observed among eukaryotes (multicellular organisms). However new studies suggest that horizontal gene transfer is more common in eukaryotes than originally thought.

Which choice best states the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It contrasts the frequency with which a biological phenomenon has been detected in two categories of organisms.
B. It argues that two biological phenomena are more similar than they may initially appear to be.
C. It explains why a common perception of a biological process is flawed.
D. It indicates a distinction between the mechanics of two kinds of biological processes.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
垂直基因转移是指遗传物质从亲代传递给子代；而水平基因转移则是指在非亲子关系的生物体之间进行的遗传物质交换。虽然水平基因转移在原核生物中很常见——如单细胞生物，像缩小短杆菌（Brevundimonas diminuta）和蒂莫纳氏菌（Massilia timonae）——但在真核生物（多细胞生物）中却很少被观察到。然而，新的研究表明，水平基因转移在真核生物中比最初认为的更为普遍。
中文解析
while引导的从句和主句形成对比，common 和rarely代表了在单细胞和多细胞生物体内出现频率的不一样。

question:
Biologist Grace Herzel and colleagues conducted a study of how butterfly color and weather conditions relate to butterfly behavior, which wouldn't have been possible without data gathered by students and other amateur science enthusiasts in the community. Considering over three years' worth of data, the researchers found that white butterflies were observed on green flowers more often than any other butterflies were, and that butterflies were observed to feed more often on cloudy days than on other days.

According to the text, which factors seemed to be linked to the behavior of butterflies in Grace Herzel and colleagues' study?
selections: A. Weather conditions but not butterfly color
B. Butterfly color but not weather conditions
C. Both butterfly color and weather conditions
D. Neither butterfly color nor weather conditions
explanations:
题目文本翻译
生物学家格蕾丝·赫尔泽尔及其同事开展了一项研究，探讨蝴蝶的颜色和天气条件与蝴蝶行为之间的关系，而这一研究得以进行，离不开社区中学生和其他业余科学爱好者收集的数据。经过三年多的数据分析，研究人员发现白色蝴蝶在绿色花朵上的出现频率高于其他颜色的蝴蝶，并且蝴蝶在阴天的取食频率高于其他天气条件下。
中文解析
观察结果蝴蝶更多在green flowers，说明color是相关因素，更多feed on cloudy days说明weather是相关因素，于是C符合。

question:
Scholars are increasingly exploring the communication and preservation of ecological knowledge through Indigenous songs (e.g, Temiar songs about landforms and landmarks and those of the Tlingit people about wildlife encounters). In one study, ethnobiologist DanaLepofsky et al. Received insight from Kwaxsistalla Wathl'thla, a song keeper for the Kwakwaka'wakw people in Canada, into songs referencing the people's use of terraced gardens in intertidal zones along the Pacific Northwest coast for the cultivation of clams for consumption. Archaeological evidence of significant increases in clam size and abundance in that area concurrent with the documented past implementation of the method described in the songs supports the conclusion that____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. there is greater corroboration in the archaeological record of ecological practices described in Kwakwaka'wakw songs than of those described in Temiar and Tlingit songs.
B. non-Indigenous people around the Pacific Northwest coast adopted the practice developed by the Kwakwaka'wakw people after observing its efficacy.
C. although contemporary Kwakwaka'wakw people have a deep understanding of and appreciation for the fishing and farming practices used by their ancestors, they no longer implement those methods
D. the practice used by ancestors of modern Kwakwaka'wakw people not only effectively maintained a food source but also promoted its robustness.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
学者们越来越多地探索通过土著歌曲传达和保护生态知识（例如，Temiar人关于地形和地标的歌曲，以及Tlingit人民关于野生动物遭遇的歌曲）。在一项研究中，民族生物学家Dana Lepofsky等人从加拿大Kwakwaka'wakw人民的歌曲守护者Kwaxsistalla Wathl'thla那里获得了启示，该歌曲提及了该民族在太平洋西北沿海潮间带使用梯田花园种植供食用的蛤蜊。考古证据表明，该地区蛤蜊的大小和丰度显著增加，与歌曲中描述的方法的过去实施记录相一致，这支持了以下结论：____
中文解析
文本描述了Kwakwaka'wakw歌曲里的养殖clams描述，对于clams有重要的意义，archaeological evidence可以看出祖先使用了这个有效的方法保持了clam数量的稳定与增产，和D选项一致。

question:
Neuroscientist Kiyohito ligaya and colleagues developed a computational model to predict how much a person will enjoy a particular work of art on a scale from 1(not at all) to 4(very much).They then recruited participants to use the same scale to rate several sets of paintings in various styles and calculated the correlation between the ratings predicted by the model and those reported by the participants. Assuming participant P6 gave equal ratings to the abstract and cubist paintings, the data in the graph indicate the model predicted that____

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the example?
selections: A. P6 would derive more aesthetic pleasure from abstract paintings than from cubist paintings.
B. P6's rating for abstract and cubist paintings would equal one another
C. P6 would derive less aesthetic pleasure from abstract paintings than from cubist paintings.
D. P6's ratings for abstract and cubist paintings would differ from one another
explanations:
题目文本翻译
神经科学家Kiyohito Ligaya及其同事开发了一个计算模型，以预测一个人对特定艺术作品的享受程度，评分范围从1（一点也不）到4（非常喜欢）。他们随后招募参与者使用相同的评分标准对多组不同风格的画作进行评分，并计算模型预测的评分与参与者实际报告的评分之间的相关性。假设参与者P6对抽象画和立体派画作给出了相同的评分，图表中的数据表明该模型预测____。
中文解析
首先，注意correlation只代表P6的真实给分和model的预测分数是否一致，通过图表可以看出Abstract更高，Cubist低，两者不一样，但是P6评分一样，所以model预测的P6对于两者的评分有所不同，导致了correlation（相关度）的不同

question:
One popular theory of the origin of the Moon, the “big whack,” posits that a protoplanet called Theia collided with Earth, flinging debris into orbit that eventually coalesced into the Moon. Until recently, Theia was_____, but researcher Qian Yuan and colleagues now claim to have identified pieces of the protoplanet in the lowermost section of Earth's mantle.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一个流行的月球起源理论“巨大撞击”认为，一个名为特亚（Theia）的原行星与地球碰撞，抛出的碎片进入轨道，最终聚集成月球。直到最近，特亚一直被认为是_____，但研究人员钱远及其同事现在声称已经在地球最底层的地幔中识别出了这个原行星的碎片。
中文解析
根据posits能够得知Theia是假说推断的，于是选择notional，跟后面转折后找到一些证据呈现对比。

question:
Early Earth is thought to have been characterized by a stagnant lid tectonic regime, in which the upper lithosphere (the outer rocky layer) was essentially immobile and there was no interaction between the lithosphere and the underlying mantle. Researchers investigated the timing of the transition from a stagnant lid regime to a tectonic plate regime, in which the lithosphere is fractured into dynamic plates that in turn allow lithospheric and mantle material to mix. Examining chemical data from lithospheric and mantle-derived rocks ranging from 285 milion to 3.8 billion years old, the researchers dated the transition to 3.2 bilion years ago.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers' conclusion?
selections: A. Mantle-derived rocks older than 3.2 billion years show significantly more compositional diversity than lithospheric rocks older than 3.2 billion years do.

B. There is a positive correlation between the age of lithospheric rocks and their chemical similarity to mantle-derived rocks, and that correlation increases significantly in strength at around 3.2 billion years old.
C. Mantle-derived rocks younger than 3.2 billion years contain some material that is not found in older mantle-derived rocks but is found in older and contemporaneous lithospheric rocks.
D. Among rocks known to be older than 3.2 billion years, significantly more are mantle derived than lithospheric, but the opposite is true for the rocks younger than 3.2 billion years.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
早期地球被认为特征为一种静止盖构造模式，期间上层岩石圈（外层岩石层）基本上是静止的，岩石圈与下方的地幔之间没有相互作用。研究人员调查了从静止盖模式转变为构造板块模式的时机，在这种模式下，岩石圈被划分为动态板块，从而允许岩石圈和地幔物质混合。通过研究从2.85亿年到38亿年不等的岩石圈和地幔来源岩石的化学数据，研究人员将这一转变的时间确定为32亿年前。
中文解析
题目的表达在3.2billion时间点，mantle rocks and lithospheric rocks融合，因此C选项符合，mantle-derived rocks新的岩石里包含之前没有的成分，也就是来自lithospheric rock是的成分。

question:
Eighteenth-century economist Adam Smith is famed for his metaphor of the invisible hand, which he putatively used to illustrate a robust model of how individuals produce aggregate benefits by pursuing their own economic interests. Note "putatively": as Gavin Kennedy has shown, Smith deploys this metaphor only once in his economic writings—to make a narrow point about the then-dominant economic theory of mercantilism—and it was largely ignored until some twentieth-century economists eager to secure an intellectual pedigree for their views elevated it to a fully-fledged paradigm.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. The reputation of Smith's metaphor of the invisible hand is not due to the importance of the metaphor in Smith's work but rather to the promotion of the metaphor by some later economists for their own ends.

B. Smith's metaphor of the invisible hand has been interpreted as a model of how individuals acting in their own interest produce aggregate benefits, but it was intended as a subtle critique of the economic theory of mercantilism.

C. Some twentieth-century economists gave Smith's metaphor of the invisible hand a significance it does not have in Smith's work, but it is nevertheless a useful model of how individuals produce aggregate benefits by pursuing their own economic interests.

D. Although Smith is famed for his metaphor of the invisible hand, the metaphor was largely ignored until economists in the twentieth century came to realize that the metaphor was a robust model that anticipated their own views.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
十八世纪的经济学家亚当·斯密以其“看不见的手”隐喻而闻名，他假设使用这个隐喻来说明个人如何通过追求自己的经济利益来产生整体利益的强大模型。请注意“假设”：正如加文·肯尼迪所展示的，斯密在他的经济著作中仅使用过一次这个隐喻——以强调当时占主导地位的重商主义经济理论的一个狭隘观点——而且在很大程度上被忽视，直到一些二十世纪的经济学家渴望为他们的观点获取知识谱系，将其提升为一个成熟的范式。
中文解析
invisible hand其实Smith只在写作里用了一次，但是随后的经济学家为了推行自己的观点，才推行亚当斯密的观点当成一个范式，和A选项一致。

question:
Many artists associated with hyperpop, a movement in electronic music that emerged in the 2010s, conform to the model perfected by the American duo 100 gecs: bold synthesizer arrangements, propulsive beats, and electronically manipulated vocals. Yet the movement is hardly uniform: Swedish recording artist Namasenda incorporates hip-hop rhythms into the hyperpop sound, for example. Such stylistic diversity is encouraged in part by the music-streaming app spotify, whose curated playlist of hyperpop songs balances cohesion with variety.

Which statement about Namasenda is best supported by the text?
selections: A. While some of her recordings conform to the model perfected by 100 gecs, others reject it outright.
B. Her music diverges from the typical hyperpop sound but doesn't abandon it.
C. She developed her unique sound without being influenced by other artists on Spotify's hyperpop playlist.
D. Her inclusion on Spotify's hyperpop playlist inspired established artists to embrace stylistic experimentation.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
许多与超流行（hyperpop）相关的艺术家遵循了由美国二人组合100 gecs完善的模式：大胆的合成器编曲、强劲的节拍和电子处理的声乐。然而，这一运动并不完全统一。例如，瑞典录音艺术家Namasenda将嘻哈节奏融入超流行的声音中。这种风格的多样性在一定程度上得益于音乐流媒体应用Spotify，其策划的超流行歌曲播放列表在连贯性和多样性之间取得了平衡。
中文解析
Namascenda 融合了hip-hop在hyperpop sound里，incorporate表明他增加了新的元素，但是没有摈弃之前的东西，于是B选项符合。

question:
For its 1974 work Instant Mural, the Chicano art collective Asco taped members Patssi Valdez and Humberto Sandoval to an outdoor wall in East Los Angeles.The work is manifestly a commentary on constraint, but many critics focus on Valdez and the social constraints women faced at the time, which is understandable but leaves the presence of Valdez's male collaborator Sandoval unexplained. We should instead consider that in 1974, the art establishment's recognition of Chicano artists was (and had long been) restricted to sociohistorical muralists, leaving nonmuralist Chicano artists—like Asco's members—struggling to even exhibit their work; attending to this context opens an interpretation that accounts for all the evidence, allowing us to conclude that ____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. while Valdez's presence in Instant Mural represents the social constraints placed on women at the time, Sandoval's presence represents Chicano muralists' frustration at their lack of recognition by the art establishment.
B. the main subject of Instant Muralis is female chicano artists' experience of being doubly constrained by gender-role expectations and the marginalization of certain types of art.
C. Instant Muralis is best understood not as a critique of the social constraints placed on women but rather as a critique of sociohistorical muralists' depictions of Chicano culture.
D. Instant Muralis is a reflection on the constraining aesthetic expectations placed on Chicano artists in general rather than on the social constraints placed on women specifically.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
对于1974年的作品《瞬间壁画》，奇卡诺艺术集体Asco将成员Patssi Valdez和Humberto Sandoval贴在洛杉矶东区的一面户外墙上。这件作品显然是对约束的评论，但许多评论者专注于Valdez以及女性在当时所面临的社会约束，这种关注可以理解，但却未能解释Valdez的男性合作者Sandoval的存在。我们应当考虑到，1974年，艺术界对奇卡诺艺术家的认可（以及长期以来的认可）仅限于社会历史壁画艺术家，这使得像Asco成员这样的非壁画奇卡诺艺术家甚至难以展示他们的作品；关注这一背景为我们提供了一种解释，使我们能够考虑到所有的证据，从而得出结论：____。
中文解析
D选项与文章的更广泛论点相一致，文章将重点从constraint on women转向艺术界对奇卡诺艺术家施加的限制。通过认识到非壁画奇卡诺艺术家所面临的挣扎，这一解读考虑了瓦尔德斯和桑多瓦尔的存在（both male and female），表明该作品批评的是对奇卡诺艺术施加的创作限制（aesthetic expression），而不是仅仅关注性别社会约束。A那个muralist要换成nonmuralist，B 没有结合context描述male，C中的a critique of sociohistorical muralists' depictions of Chicano culture不对。

question:
The following text is from George Marion Mcclellan's 1895 poem “Eternity.”
My spirit swoons, and all my senses cry
For Ocean's breast and covering of the sky.
Rock me to sleep, ye waves, and outward bound,
Just let me drift far out from toil and care,
Where lapping of the waves shall be the sound,
Which mingled with the winds that gently bear
Me on between a peaceful sea and sky,
To make my soothing slumberous lullaby.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To justify the speaker's qualms about being transported by the ocean to a quiet destination
B. To contrast the demands of the speaker's everyday life with the serenity of being rocked to sleep by the ocean
C. To illustrate the increasing intensity of the speaker's desire to escape ongoing hardship by gliding on the ocean
D. To convey the speaker's longing for the ocean to impart a sense of inner tranquility
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文本摘自乔治·马里昂·麦克莱伦1895年的诗《永恒》。
我的灵魂眩晕，所有的感官呼喊
渴望大海的怀抱和天空的覆盖。
波浪啊，摇我入眠，向外航行，
让我远离劳作与忧虑漂流，
波浪轻拍的声音将成为乐曲，
与温柔的风交融，轻轻承载
我在宁静的海洋与天空之间，
为我编织安抚的催眠曲。
中文解析
根据swoon（痴迷），cry for（需要）可以看出narrator对于大海的渴望，根据gently, peaceful, soothing可以看到平静，对应了D选项 longing for tranquility。

question:
During Rome's republican period,which ended in the first century BCE, libraries were predominantly owned by wealthy individuals who tightly controlled access to their book collections. The first public library became available in Rome in 28 BCE and was soon followed by one commissioned by Emperor Augustus. As modern scholar Fabio Fernandes notes, however, these two traditions aren't as distinct as they seem, as both the emperor and the private library owners viewed their libraries as extensions of their personal patronage, just on vastly differing scales.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To call into question the notion that private Roman libraries disappeared during the first century BCE
B. To contend that early imperial leaders in Rome wielded too much influence over libraries
C. To give a brief overview of public access to libraries throughout Rome's republican period
D. To assert that private and early public libraries in ancient Rome had an essential similarity
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在罗马共和国时期（公元前一世纪结束），图书馆主要由富裕个人拥有，他们严格控制对其藏书的访问。公元前28年，罗马建立了第一座公共图书馆，随后不久，奥古斯都皇帝也委托建造了一座图书馆。然而，现代学者法比奥·费尔南德斯指出，这两种传统并不像表面上看起来那么不同，因为皇帝和私人图书馆的拥有者都将他们的图书馆视为个人赞助的延伸，只是在规模上有着巨大的差异。
中文解析
最后一句是文本的主要目的，表达其实这两类图书馆没有那么大差异，只不过是范围大小不一样而已。于是选择D essential similarity符合题意。

question:
Memoirs of Elleanor Eldridge is an 1838 historical account by Elleanor Eldridge and Frances Harriet Whipple Green.In the book, the authors describe how restorative sleep can be for young people,writing,____

Which quotation from Memoirs of Elleanor Eldridge most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. "Then let no one turn with too much [fussiness] from the simple story of the humble Elleanor though it may contain few, or none, of the thrilling charms of poetry and passion.”
B. “Home is home, to the lowly as well as the great; and no rank, or color, destroys its sacred character, its power over the mind, and the affections.”
C. “Blessed are the slumbers of the innocent! They are kindlier than balm, and they refresh and gladden the spirit of childhood, like ministerings from a better world."
D. “And now, dear reader, a word with you.What is done cannot be undone. We cannot unravel this web of iniquity, and extract justice from this mass of cruel wrongs.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译
《埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇回忆录》是由埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇和弗朗西斯·哈丽特·惠普尔·格林于1838年撰写的一部历史记载。在书中，作者描述了恢复性睡眠对年轻人的益处，写道：____
中文解析
restorative sleep,和C选项的slumber一致，表示睡眠，kindlier，refresh，gladden等积极词汇表达谁的restorative。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Use the Future is a 1992 sculpture by Italian artist Maurizio Nannucci.
●It consists of a yellow neon sign that spells out the title phrase.
●Gingeris a 2023 sculpture by Japanese artist Rikako Kawauchi.
●It consists of a pink neon sign that forms an abstract squiggle shape.
●Neon'signs became popular with advertisers in the 1920s and began to decline in popularity in the 1960s.
●Neon signs became popular with artists in the 1960s and continue to be popular today.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two sculptures. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. While the sculptures share a common material, one spells out a phrase while the other is decidedly more abstract.
B. Molded into an evocative phrase in Use the Future(1992), an abstract form in Ginger(2023), and an advertising tool in decades past, neon lighting has a number of different applications.
C. Italian artist Maurizio Nannucci's and Japanese artist Rikako Kawauchi's sculptures have employed neon signs in different ways, demonstrating the versatility of the popular material.
D. Nannucci's sculpture was made in 1992 and Kawauchi's in 2023, both well after the advertising heyday neon signs had
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究某个主题时，一位学生做了以下笔记：
●《未来》（The Future）是意大利艺术家毛里齐奥·南努奇（Maurizio Nannucci）于1992年创作的雕塑。
●它由一个黄色霓虹灯标志组成，上面拼写着标题短语。
●《姜》（Ginger）是日本艺术家川内理香子（Rikako Kawauchi）于2023年创作的雕塑。
●它由一个粉色霓虹灯标志组成，形成一个抽象的波浪形状。
●霓虹灯标志在1920年代开始受到广告商的欢迎，并在1960年代开始逐渐失去人气。
●霓虹灯标志在1960年代开始受到艺术家的欢迎，并至今仍然受欢迎。
中文解析
题目要求对比sculptures，于是A选项while引导从句和主句形成对比，表达了两个雕塑的不同。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Francis Halzen is a Belgian particle physicist.
●Particle physicists study subatomic particles.
●Neutrinos are some of the least understood subatomic particles.
●Neutrinos were first discovered in the mid-twentieth century.
●Halzen is known for his discovery of high-energy astrophysicalneutrinos.

The student wants to provide an example of a particle physicist whose research focuses on neutrinos.Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The research done on high-energy astrophysical neutrinos exemplifies the work particle physicists do to advance our understanding of subatomic particles.
B. By studying high-energy astrophysical neutrinos—to name just one example—particle physicists can learn more about neutrinos.
C. Particle physicist Francis Halzen is known for his discovery of high-energy astrophysical neutrinos.
D. Neutrinos are a type of subatomic particle that particle physicists are still trying to understand.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
●法朗西斯·哈尔岑是一位比利时粒子物理学家。
●粒子物理学家研究亚原子粒子。
●中微子是一些最不为人所理解的亚原子粒子。
●中微子在二十世纪中期首次被发现。
●哈尔岑因发现高能天体物理中微子而闻名。
中文解析
题目要求提供一个具体得人物例子，于是Francis Halzen符合要求。

question:

question:
Included in Reclamation! Pan-African Works from the Beth Rudin DeWoody Collection,a 2018 group exhibition at the Taubman Museum of Art in Roanoke, Virginia, was the work of artist Lorna Simpson, who is best known for her multimedia artworks that juxtapose images of African American women with text fragments. which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of standard English?

question:
Recent analysis of 2010 BL4—an outer solar system object orbiting the Sun between Jupiter and Neptune—has determined its color to be gray, suggesting an icy composition. Such interpretations are ultimately____ the object's gray coloration may be an incidental effect of radiation, solar wind, or collisions with other objects rather than evidence of its physical makeup.

which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 完整句子需要分号连接，而且是第一句和第二句之间的对比关系，though需要放在第二句中。

question:
When, in 2017, Cambridge University students Lucy Moss and Toby Marlow decided they wanted to develop a musical together, one of their goals was for their female actor friends to have good parts to play. ___they created the show Six, a retelling of the history of King Henry Ⅷ's wives in which each of the six queens has a starring role.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在2017年，剑桥大学的学生露西·莫斯和托比·马洛决定一起创作一部音乐剧，他们的目标之一是让她们的女性演员朋友们有好的角色可以演出。于是她们创作了音乐剧《六位皇后》（Six），重新讲述了亨利八世的六位妻子的历史，每位皇后都拥有主角的角色。
中文解析
前后因果关系，为了达到前面的目的（female actor friends to have parts to play）,有了后面的show，达到目的选to that end。

question:
In the list “Things That Arouse a Fond Memory of the Past” from Sei Shonagon's Pillow Book, the author delights in pressed silk, a moonlit night, and dried hollyhock. So shrewd an observer is Shonagon, a lady-in-waiting to Empress Teishi, that her book's musings on tenth-century Japanese courtly life____ readers a thousand years later.

explanations: fascinate的主语是musings，复数，其它选项需要主语是单数

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Stylistic analysis and biographical analysis are two approaches to art criticism.
●Stylistic analysis examines how an artwork's visual features contribute to its overall style.
●Such an analysis of Claude Monet's WaterLilies might consider how the painting's loose brushwork represents an impressionist style.
●Biographical analysis considers the personal experiences of the artist.
●Such an analysis of Claude Monet's Women in the Garden might consider how the painting's portrayal of a figure holding red and white roses alludes to Monet's romantic difficulties.

The student wants to present biographical analysis to an audience unfamiliar with the concept. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. An approach to art criticism, biographical analysis considers the personal experiences of the artist.
B. A stylistic analysis of Water Lilies might consider how the painting's loose brushwork represents an impressionist style.
C. Stylistic analysis differs from biographical analysis in that stylistic analysis examines how an artwork's visual features contribute to its overall style.
D. Women in the Garden's portrayal of a figure holding red and white roses alludes to Monet's romantic difficulties.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
●风格分析和传记分析是艺术批评的两种方法。
●风格分析考察一件艺术作品的视觉特征如何影响其整体风格。
●对克劳德·莫奈的《睡莲》的这种分析可能会考虑这幅画的松散笔触如何体现印象派风格。
●传记分析则考虑艺术家的个人经历。
●对克劳德·莫奈的《花园中的女性》的这种分析可能会考虑这幅画中描绘一个手持红白玫瑰的形象如何暗示莫奈的浪漫困扰。
中文解析
题目要求present biographical analysis to an audience unfamiliar with the concept.需要解释biographic analysis，于是A符合要求。

question:
The prime meridian, the global indicator of zero degrees longitude established in 1884, was originally determined using astronomically derived coordinates.___as decades passed, new calculations would reveal increasingly precise coordinates, yet the prime meridian remained unchanged; it wasn't until the 1980s that, spurred by improved geodetic data, the prime meridian was officially moved-roughly one hundred meters east.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
本初子午线是1884年确立的全球零度经度的标志，最初是通过天文学推导的坐标确定的。随着几十年的推移，新计算显示出越来越精确的坐标，但本初子午线保持不变；直到1980年代，由于改进的测地数据推动，本初子午线才正式向东移动了大约一百米。
中文解析
一次又一次地，表示这几十年的过程中，新的计算显示了新的坐标，但是当初的子午线没有变动。

question:
Nadifa Mohamed is a novelist from Hargeisa, Somalia, who has earned international acclaim in recent years. Writers of other literary forms, such as poetry and drama, are less likely to be recognized beyond their nations' borders, but many are still well____Koulsy Lamko, for example, is a celebrated playwright from Chad.

question:
Despite the fact that what is now known as the Carmichael number was first posited by Vaclav simerka, the number is named after the twentieth-century American mathematician Robert carmichael. One might assume cases like this, where a discovery or concept is not named after the first person who discovered it,to be____they are counted among a litany of examples of Stigler's law.

which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●A river's stream length is the length of a line that follows along the river path.
●A river's valley length is the length of a straight line drawn from the beginning of the river to the end.
●The river's curviness,or sinuosity, is the ratio of the river's stream length to its valleylength
●Low-sinuosity rivers have a stream length 1-1.5 times longer than their valley length, and high-sinuosity rivers have a stream length 1.5 or more times longer than their valley length.
●The Embarras River in Canada has high sinuosity.
●The Luni River in India has low sinuosity.

The student wants to compare the curviness of the two rivers. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The high-sinuosity Luni River in India is curvier than the low-sinuosity Embarras River in Canada.
B. The Embarras River's ratio of stream length to valley length, also known as sinuosity, is greater than that of the Luni River
C. In both the Embarras and the Luni rivers, curviness is determined by comparing stream length to valley length.
D. By comparing the stream lengths of the Embarras and Luni rivers to their valley lengths, one can calculate their curviness, or sinuosity.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
●河流的流长是沿着河流路径的线段长度。
●河流的谷长是从河流起始点到终点的直线长度。
●河流的曲率或曲折度是河流流长与谷长的比率。
●低曲折度的河流，其流长比谷长长1到1.5倍；而高曲折度的河流，其流长比谷长长1.5倍或更长。
●加拿大的恩巴拉斯河具有高曲折度。
●印度的卢尼河具有低曲折度。
中文解析
题目要求对比curviness，A描述的情况和原文相反，于是B选项虽然没有提到curvy相关词汇，但是说到了curvy的概念，并比较了两者所以选B。

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0.25</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>6.5</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>64.25</mn></math>
The equation gives the estimated stock price y, in dollars, for a certain company x days after the company went public, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>≤</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>20</mn></math>. Which statement is the best interpretation of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>58</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> in this context?
selections: A. 1 day after the company went public, the company’s estimated stock price is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">$</mi><mn>58</mn></math>.

question:

In the given equation, s and r are constants, and s > 0. If the equation has infinitely many solutions, what is the value of s?
explanations: 方程组无限个解，说明两侧一次函数斜率和截距都相等，12/4=r，得到r=3，7-s/13=3（-8），解得s=403

question: The cost of renting a piece of construction equipment for up to 5 days is $270 for the first day and $135 for each additional day. Which of the following equations gives the cost y, in dollars, of renting the equipment for x days, where x is a positive integer and x ≤ 5?
explanations: 一次函数应用题，根据题意，135为斜率，注意注意语言表述 $270 for the first day ，即为f(1)=270,所以只有A正确

question: A right triangular pyramid has exactly six edges. Each of these edges is 96 centimeters long. If the surface area of the pyramid is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi> </mrow> <msqrt> <mn>3</mn> </msqrt></math> square centimeters, what is the value of k?

question: A line intersects two parallel lines, forming four acute angles and four obtuse angles. The measure of one of these eight angles is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>250</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"> <mo>∘</mo> </mrow> </msup></math>. The sum of the measures of four of the eight angles is k°. Which of the following could NOT be equivalent to k, for all values of x?
explanations: 根据题意，直线相交产生4个角，相邻角之和180°，对顶角相等，其中一个角为(7x-250)°，相邻角为180-(7x-250)=(-7x+430)°,任选4个角一个(7x-250)°和三个(-7x+430)°的和为-14x+1040，与A不一致，选A

question:
Although our knowledge of the Pleistocene epoch and the lives of hominids during this time was once ________, recent analyses of fossils like that of the individual known as Petralona 1, discovered in Greece in 1960, have sharpened our picture of what a day ind the life of Petralona 1 may have looked like.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
尽管我们对更新世时期及这一时期人类的生活了解曾经是______，但最近对1960年在希腊发现的名为Petralona 1的化石的分析，已经使我们对Petralona 1日常生活的情景有了更清晰的认识。
中文解析
nebulous表示模糊的，文本大意是虽然我们之前对于hominids的生活不清楚，但是化石研究让我们更加清晰了（sharpen the picture）

question:
The discoverers of the minor planet 1227 Geranium named it after the plant genus that includes cranesbills. Most of the recently discovered minor planets, however, are given only an identification number, largely due to there being over 500,001 such bodies known at present, which makes the already challenging task of finding a unique name for each nearly ________.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
小行星1227 Geranium的发现者将其命名为包含 cranesbills 的植物属名。然而，大多数最近发现的小行星仅被赋予一个识别号码，这主要是因为目前已知有超过50万个这样的天体，这使得为每个天体找到一个独特名称的任务几乎变得______。
中文解析
Insurmountable的意思是无法逾越的，不可克服的，文本告知现在发现的星体数量很大，加上challenging task这些重要的线索词，于是可以推断给每个星体找个一个独特的命名是及其苦难的（insurmountable）

question:
The food industry has long used thermal technologies to preserve food in large batches. Recent advancements in radiofrequency heating were made through research in Mexico on the preservation of wheat flour. Radiofrequency heating is generally considered to be an improvement over more conventional thermal preservation methods: whereas conventional methods transfer energy from the surface of a food to its interior, radiofrequency heating uses precisely controlled radio waves to generate heat within the food itself, thus reducing industrial cooking times.

Based on the text, what is one disadvantage of some conventional thermal preservation methods?
selections: A. They require more energy than other methods do.
B. Their cooking times are longer than those of other methods.
C. They are only effective in heating foods that are lightweight and small in size.
D. They are especially vulnerable to technological breakdowns.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
食品行业长期以来一直使用热技术来大批量保存食品。最近，在墨西哥关于小麦面粉保存的研究中，取得了射频加热的最新进展。射频加热通常被认为是对更传统热保存方法的改进：传统方法是将能量从食品表面传递到内部，而射频加热则利用精确控制的无线电波在食品内部产生热量，从而减少工业烹饪时间。
中文解析
根据文本最后说radiofrequency heating可以减少cooking time，于是thermal preservation methods的一个缺点就是时间长，对应B

question:
Yingguang Frank Chan and colleagues have explored how convergent evolution-a phenomenon that occurs when the same trait evolves independently in two reproductively separate lineages—can result from a genetic mechanism shared by both lineages. Meanwhile, Patricia J. Wittkopp and colleagues have investigated how convergence occurs through different genetic mechanisms. However, the relative prevalence of convergence through shared and different genetic processes is still poorly understood. This motivated biologists Delbert A. Green II and Cassandra G. Extavour to evaluate both types of convergence in a single study for their 2012 paper.

Which choice best states the main topic of the text?
selections: A. Whether studies of convergent evolution should focus on lineages that share the same underlying genetic mechanism
B. How a particular study of convergent evolution relates to some other studies in the field
C. What kinds of traits are most likely to arise convergently in several lineages
D. Why convergent evolution is particularly difficult for biologists to study
explanations:
题目文本翻译
Yingguang Frank Chan 和同事们探讨了趋同进化这一现象——即当相同特征在两个生殖隔离的谱系中独立演化时——如何可能源于这两个谱系共享的遗传机制。同时，Patricia J. Wittkopp 和同事们研究了趋同是如何通过不同的遗传机制发生的。然而，通过共享和不同遗传过程的趋同相对普遍性仍然了解不足。这促使生物学家 Delbert A. Green II 和 Cassandra G. Extavour 在他们2012年的论文中评估了这两种类型的趋同。
中文解析
Yingguang Frank Chan及其同事、Patricia J. Wittkopp及其同事的研究与Delbert A. Green II和Cassandra G. Extavour研究背后的动机之间的关系，最后一组人结合了之前两组研究

question:
The Last Report on the Miracles at Little No Horse is a 2001 novel by Ojibwe writer Louise Erdrich. It explores how historical events affect families on a reservation in rural North Dakota. The Last Report on the Miracles at Little No Horse is typical of Erdrich’s work. Her writing usually focuses on portrayals of everyday life in Ojibwe communities. Yet some of her novels have fantastical plots and take place outside Ojibwe communities. For example, her 1991 novel The Crown of Columbus is essentially adventure fiction, and the thrilling events in its plot are set largely on a Caribbean island.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It recommends that readers avoid a particular novel by Erdrich.
B. It lists the many similarities between two novels by Erdrich.
C. It offers an example of a novel that differs from most of Erdrich’s work.
D. It discusses what inspired Erdrich to write one of her novels.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
《小无马镇的最后报告》是2001年由奥吉布瓦（Ojibwe）作家路易丝·厄尔德里奇（Louise Erdrich）创作的小说。该书探讨了历史事件如何影响北达科他州乡村保留地上的家庭。《小无马镇的最后报告》是厄尔德里奇作品的典型代表。她的写作通常专注于对奥吉布瓦社区日常生活的描绘。然而，她的一些小说则有着奇幻的情节，并发生在奥吉布瓦社区之外。例如，她1991年的小说《哥伦布的皇冠》本质上是一部冒险小说，其激动人心的情节主要发生在一个加勒比岛屿上。
中文解析
划线句是前面具体的具体例子，和前一句之间是例证关系，他的大部分作品描述 everyday life in Ojibwe communities. 但是个别作品 take place outside Ojibwe communities.划线句就是这个少数作品的例子。对应了C选项

question:
“Tomato” is an example of a loanword—that is, a word that originated in one language and was later adopted by another. The word came to English indirectly from tomate, the Spanish word for the widely cultivated plant. Spanish had borrowed it from Nahuatl, an Indigenous language of Central Mexico, in which the word’s original form is tomatl. “Maize” also has an Indigenous origin and entered English through Spanish. But in this case, the original source was Taino, a language of the Caribbean islands, in which the word for the corn plant is mahis.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Many Spanish words with Indigenous origins first passed through English before entering Spanish.
B. When borrowing from Indigenous languages, Spanish adopted roughly as many words from Nahuatl as from Taino.  a CMN.
C. When non-Indigenous languages borrowed from Indigenous languages, the words often underwent a significant change in meaning.
D. The English words “tomato” and “maize” are both examples of loanwords from Indigenous languages.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
“Tomato” 是一个外来词的例子——即起源于一种语言并被另一种语言采纳的词汇。这个词间接来自西班牙语的 tomate，它指的是广泛种植的植物。西班牙语是从中美洲的土著语言纳瓦特尔语借来的，在纳瓦特尔语中，这个词的原始形式是 tomatl。“Maize” 也有土著起源，并通过西班牙语进入英语。但在这种情况下，原始来源是加勒比海岛屿的塔伊诺语，在塔伊诺语中，玉米植物的词是 mahis。
中文解析
这个之前题目的变体，从文本来看tomato, maize等单词都是从indigenous language而来的loanwords, 西班牙语充当了中间的媒介作用。

question:
Text corpora such as the American National Corpus are enormous collections of electronically stored texts that can be used for empirical testing of hypotheses regarding how ________ a word is in spoken and written English. For instance, one might have a guess about the incidence of the word “long,” but only an analysis of a corpus can prove that “long” is the fifth most commonly used adjective.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
文本语料库，如美国国家语料库，是大量电子存储文本的集合，可以用于对关于一个词在口语和书面英语中使用频率的假设进行实证测试。例如，人们可能会对“long”这个词的使用频率有一个猜测，但只有对语料库的分析才能证明“long”是第五常用的形容词。
中文解析
研究单词使用的广泛性或者说是常用性，选择pervasive（广泛性）

question:
Text 1
In separate studies, Stephen Meding and Robert J. Zasoski and Xinhua He and colleagues examined whether plants transfer nutrients to one another using a common mycorrhizal network (CMN) —a lattice of fungal strands in the soil. Meding and Zasoski excluded all pathways other than the CMN by using barriers to keep the plants’ root systems separate while allowing mycorrhizal strands through—a crucial step He and colleagues’ study did not take.
Text 2
Meding and Zasoski took the necessary precaution of separating the plants’ root systems (thereby excluding root-to-root transmission). However, any barrier used must allow the thread-like hyphae of a CMN to pass through, and this permeability would also allow liquids through. Thus, the researchers’ experimental design cannot ensure that any nutrient transfer observed can be attributed to a CMN and not to some other pathway.

Based on the texts, which choice best describes a point on which the author of Text 1and the author of Text 2 would most likely agree?
selections: A. Meding and Zasoski’s study effectively excluded any explanation for nutrient transfer other than via a CMN.
B. Excluding root-to-root transfer of nutrients between plants is sufficient to ensure that any observed nutrient transfer must involve a CMN.
C. He and colleagues’ study was not designed in a way that would allow it to produce compelling evidence that nutrient transfer occurred via a CMN.
D. A barrier that is impervious to both roots and fungal strands is necessary to evaluate nutrient transfer via a CMN.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
文本1
在不同的研究中，Stephen Meding 和 Robert J. Zasoski 以及 Xinhua He 和同事们考察了植物是否通过一种共同的菌根网络（CMN）相互传递养分——这是一种存在于土壤中的真菌丝状结构。Meding 和 Zasoski 通过使用屏障将植物根系分开，同时允许菌根丝通过，从而排除了除了 CMN 以外的所有传导途径——这是 He 和同事研究未采取的关键步骤。
文本2
Meding 和 Zasoski 采取了必要的预防措施，将植物的根系分开（从而排除了根与根之间的传递）。然而，所使用的任何屏障都必须允许 CMN 的丝状菌丝通过，而这种通透性也会允许液体通过。因此，研究者的实验设计无法确保观察到的任何养分转移可以归因于 CMN，而不是其他某种途径。
中文解析
这个题目之前多次考过，本次是变体，但是本质逻辑与正确选项的思路都没有变化。Text1末尾句中说He团队连根部分离都没有采取措施。Text2则说明根部分离措施也无法保证营养传送通过CMN菌丝，于是两篇文章的共同点观点是He团队设计方式无法为营养的CMN传输提供有力证据。（虽是变体，但是答案的逻辑一样）

question:
Zooarchaeologist Ophélie Lebrasseur and her team examined a fox skeleton discovered in 1991 at an archaeological site alongside artifacts of human habitation (like spear points) in central Argentina. Lebrasseur et al. determined that the fox was Dusicyon avus, an extinct species resembling a jackal, and radiocarbon dating placed the fox at the site at the same time as human inhabitants. (Indeed, the inhabitants may have deliberately buried the fox. ) In addition, while wild foxes have a diet entirely made of meat, isotopic signatures of the skeleton’s teeth indicated that the fox’s diet, like that of the humans, was partly composed of plant material. Lebrasseur et al. therefore concluded that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the humans who were alive at the same time as the fox most likely ate more meat than the fox did.
B. the fox had a diet more similar to that of jackals than to that of wild foxes.
C. the humans who were alive at the same time as the fox hunted using the spears whose points were also found at the site.
D. the fox may have been a companion animal of the humans who inhabited the site at the same time.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
Zooarchaeologist Ophélie Lebrasseur及其团队研究了1991年在阿根廷中部一个考古遗址发现的狐狸骨骼，该遗址还出土了人类居住的文物（如矛头）。Lebrasseur等人确定这只狐狸是已灭绝的Dusicyon avus，外形类似于狼，放射性碳定年法显示这只狐狸与人类居民同时存在于该遗址。（实际上，这些居民可能是故意埋葬了这只狐狸。）此外，虽然野生狐狸的饮食完全由肉类组成，但骨骼牙齿的同位素特征表明，这只狐狸的饮食与人类相似，部分包含植物材料。因此，Lebrasseur等人得出的结论是______。
中文解析
从fox的饮食和人类相近和埋葬有可能是人为埋葬，推断该狐狸可能是人类当时的伙伴。

The survey asked participants what kinds of resolutions they made and separated them into several categories. The table presents percentages of people who make particular kinds of New Year’s resolutions among those who choose to make them, indexed by age bracket.

Which choice best presents a conclusion about the habits of New Year’s resolution makers that is best supported by information in the text and the table?
selections: A. The majority of US adults who make resolutions related to health and exercise also make resolutions in multiple additional categories.
B. Among all US adults, people become less likely to make New Year’s resolutions as they age, regardless of the type of resolution.

C. Resolution makers between the ages of 50 and 64 are more likely to make resolutions related to personal relationships and less likely to make resolutions related to finances than resolution makers between the ages of 30 and 49 are.

Drosophila (fruit flies) have generation times of 10-12 days, so seasonal changes in humidity and other environmental conditions can drive seasonal fluctuations in chromosome rearrangements in species such as D. persimilis and D. subobscura. Drosophila body size (for which wing centroid size serves as a proxy measure) correlates with reproductive fitness. Banu Sebnem Onder and Cansu Fidan Aksoy measured the wing sizes of members of a D. melanogaster population in Yesiloz, Turkey, that were collected monthly between May and October over three years. Their research suggests that Drosophila collected in relatively warmer months should tend to have greater reproductive fitness, as is illustrated by the finding that ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the assertion?
selections: A. the average male wing centroid size was 1.98 mm in September but was 2.31 mm in July.
B. the average female wing centroid size was consistently larger than the male wing centroid size in all four months in the table.
C. the average monthly low temperature was higher in September than in May.
D. the average female wing centroid size was larger in July than in May.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
果蝇（Drosophila）的世代时间为10-12天，因此季节性湿度和其他环境条件的变化可能会导致如D. persimilis和D. subobscura等物种染色体重排的季节性波动。果蝇的体型（以翅膀重心大小作为代理测量）与繁殖适应性相关。Banu Sebnem Onder和Cansu Fidan Aksoy测量了在土耳其Yesiloz地区收集的D. melanogaster种群的翅膀大小，这些样本是在三年间每月收集的，时间从5月到10月。他们的研究表明，在相对温暖的月份收集的果蝇应该倾向于具有更高的繁殖适应性，这一点通过以下发现得到了说明：______。
中文解析
Reproductive fitness和wing centroid size相关，于是按照图表数据，7月的male and female wing centroid size都是更大，于是D正确，A数据错误，B比较male and female和话题无关，应该比较温度，C只看了最低温。

question:
Authors like Laura Esquivel contributed to the outpouring of Mexican literature in the years following the Mexican Revolution, which lasted from 1910-1920. Works from this period make up an ________ proportion of what is considered the canon of Mexican literature, but nineteenth-century writers like Justo Sierra O’Reilly should be considered just as integral to the Mexican literary canon.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
像劳拉·埃斯基维尔（Laura Esquivel）这样的作者为墨西哥革命后（1910-1920年）墨西哥文学的涌现做出了贡献。这一时期的作品构成了被认为是墨西哥文学经典的______比例，然而，像胡斯托·西埃拉·奥雷利（Justo Sierra O'Reilly）这样的十九世纪作家也应被视为墨西哥文学经典中同样不可或缺的一部分。
中文解析
But前后是对比意义，于是前面的作品在墨西哥文学中占据了大比例，but后则是说Justo等人的作品也该是重要组成部分，前面表达比例高，比例大，用outsized proportion。

question:
Prolonged exposure to anthropogenic noise (sounds from human sources like traffic or mining) can affect animals, as Graeme Shannon and colleagues found in a 2014 study of black-tailed prairie dogs. Researchers conducted a meta-analysis of studies of how such noise affects animals and found that, for every study, relevant traits or behaviors of the animals were observably different between the exposed group and the otherwise similar but unexposed group. Although, on average, studies of mammals showed larger differences than studies of fish did, for every class of animals examined, there were individual studies showing differences well above the average for mammals. Therefore, the results of the meta-analysis suggest that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. some studies of fish found larger effects of exposure to anthropogenic noise than some studies of mammals did.
B. the differences that studies attribute to exposure to anthropogenic noise are likely to be more pronounced for fish than they are for mammals.
C. the difference found in the study conducted by Graeme Shannon and colleagues was likely larger than the average difference for studies of black-tailed prairie dogs included in the meta-analysis.
D. the studies in the meta-analysis that examined mammals were more likely than those that examined fish to specify whether the observed effects were detrimental.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
长期暴露于人造噪音（如交通或采矿等人类源发出的声音）会影响动物，Graeme Shannon及其同事在2014年对黑尾草原犬鼠的研究中发现了这一点。研究人员对关于这种噪音如何影响动物的研究进行了元分析，发现每一项研究中，暴露组和其他相似但未暴露组的动物在相关特征或行为上都表现出明显的差异。尽管总体而言，哺乳动物的研究显示出的差异大于鱼类的研究，但在每个动物类别的研究中，都有个别研究显示出超过哺乳动物平均水平的差异。因此，元分析的结果表明______。
中文解析
最后一句although从句和主句之间是对比关系，对比说虽然平均值来看，哺乳动物要比鱼类受噪音的影响大，但是有些individual studies表现出了高于平均值的情况，A选项符合要求。

question:
Male orangutans typically disperse from the territory in which they were born when they reach maturity, whereas females typically do not. Beatrice Ehmann and her colleagues showed that this difference in life trajectory is reflected in the diets of immature orangutans, with females’ diets overlapping more with their mothers’ diets than males’ diets do. For example, on average, individual 9’s mother shared approximately ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the example?
selections: A. 16% of its diet with individual 9’s diet, whereas individual 12’s mother shared approximately 72% of its diet with individual 12’s diet.
B. 81% of its diet with individual 9’s diet, whereas individual 12’s mother shared approximately 72% of its diet with individual 12’s diet.
C. 81% of its diet with individual 9’s diet, whereas individual 12’s mother shared approximately 20% of its diet with individual 12’s diet.
D. 16% of its diet with individual 9’s diet, whereas individual 12’s mother shared approximately 20% of its diet with individual 12’s diet.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
雄性猩猩通常在成熟时会离开出生地的领土，而雌性猩猩通常不会。比阿特丽斯·艾赫曼和她的同事们展示了这种生活轨迹的差异反映在未成熟猩猩的饮食上，雌性猩猩的饮食与母亲的饮食重叠程度高于雄性猩猩的饮食。例如，平均而言，个体9的母亲共享了大约______。
中文解析
文本最后观察diets overlapping with mothers，于是看柱状图的左侧，图表中individual 9，于是黑色代表female individual 9 对应数值81%，male individual 12对应数值72%，能够证明文本最后的结论。

question:
After finding information about Benjamin Sterling Turner, who represented Alabama in the United States House of Representatives, the student discovered biographical sketches of two other Black Americans who served in ________ Robert Brown Elliott of South Carolina and Ronald V. Dellums of California.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: Two Black Americans等同于后面的两个具体人物的名字，前后间冒号连接。

question:
