Study participants from 21 societies, including those in Japan and South Africa, listened to randomized recordings of 18spontaneous laughs taken from natural conversations between pairs of women and 18 volitional laughs produced separately by 18 different women in response to an experimenter’s instruction to laugh. Analysis of the participants’ evaluations of the laughs prompted the team to conclude that the ability to distinguish between spontaneous and volitional laughter appears to be universal across cultures.

Which quotation from a psychologist not involved in the team’s study would most directly weaken the team’s conclusion?
selections: A. “When an individual chooses to produce volitional laughter in a natural social context, the laughter often shares certain acoustic qualities, such as pitch and fluctuation of intensity, with spontaneous laughter.”

B. “Although the team considered the average size of communities in each society in the study, that demographic factor was found to have no effect on listeners’ identifications of laughter as spontaneous or volitional.”
C. “Recent studies in communications have shown that certain acoustic features of spontaneous laughter, such as pitch and intensity, are consistent both within and across societies.”
D. “Judgments of spontaneous laughter are often associated with acoustic features such as greater intensity variability and higher pitch.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译
心理学家格雷戈里·布莱恩特（Gregory Bryant）、多尔萨·阿米尔（Dorsa Amir）及其同事研究了跨文化对自发（真实）笑声和故意（虚假或强迫）笑声的感知。来自21个社会的研究参与者，包括日本和南非的参与者，听取了随机录音，这些录音包括18个自发的笑声，这些笑声来自两名女性之间的自然对话，以及18个由18名不同女性在实验者指示下故意发出的笑声。对参与者对笑声评估的分析促使研究团队得出结论：区分自发笑声和故意笑声的能力在各文化中似乎是普遍存在的。
中文解析
文中的结论the ability to distinguish between spontaneous and volitional laughter appears to be universal across cultures。有两个重点，一是文本默认了人们有区分真笑和假笑的能力（the ability to distinguish）；二是文本认为能力在文化间都普遍存在 universal across cultures。所以，我们反驳的时候可以从以下方式反驳：
反驳方式1：人们没有能力区分自发的笑和假装的笑（diss the ability）
反驳方式2：区分自发的笑和假装的笑并不是普遍存在于文化中的，有些文化中有，有些文化中没有（diss universal across cultures）
A选项表示当个体产生刻意的笑（volitional laughter）会和自发的笑（spontaneous laughter）有很多共通特征，说明人们不能够区分真笑假笑，所以是正确答案。

question:
A report from an international organization that monitors the numbers of women serving as judges or magistrates on various nations’ highest courts, such as the Supreme Court in Sweden and the Supreme Court of Justice in Uruguay, indicates that among the countries that had a different number of women on these courts in 2013 than they had in 2009, the number increased in some countries but decreased in others. For instance, the number of women judges and magistrates on high courts in ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the example?
selections: A. Sri Lanka was greater in 2013 than in 2009, whereas the number in Sweden was the same in 2013 as in 2009.
B. Uruguay was lower in 2013 than in 2009, whereas the number in Sweden was the same in 2013 as in 2009.
C. Sri Lanka was greater in 2013 than in 2009, whereas the number in Uruguay was lower in 2013 than in 2009.
D. Sweden was the same in 2013 as in 2009, but it had more women on its high courts than either Sri Lanka or Uruguay did in 2013.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一份来自一个国际组织的报告监测了各国最高法院（如瑞典的最高法院和乌拉圭的最高司法法院）担任法官或裁判的女性人数。该报告指出，在2013年与2009年相比，某些国家在这些法院上女性法官的数量有所不同，其中一些国家的数量增加，而另一些国家则减少。例如，______高法院的女性法官和裁判人数增加。
中文解析
Sri Lanka是人数增加了，而Uruguay是人数下降了，于是C选项正确

question:
Exclusively inhabiting tropical countries such as Sierra Leone, wild chimpanzees lack adaptations to seasonal variations in ultraviolet B (UVB) irradiance from sunlight; since UVB exposure enables vertebrates to synthesize vitamin D, this raises questions about how chimpanzees in mid-latitude zoos are affected by the lower and more variable UVB irradiance in those locations. In a study of zoo chimpanzees in Sweden and other mid-latitude countries, Sophie Moittié and colleagues found not only that chimpanzees’ vitamin D levels correlate with UVB irradiance but also that vitamin D levels show no evidence of plateauing as UVB irradiance reaches its highest local levels, suggesting that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. averaged across seasons, vitamin D levels in zoo chimpanzees in mid-latitude countries such as Sweden tend to be comparable to those in wild chimpanzees in tropical countries such as Sierra Leone.
B. adaptations to seasonal variations in UVB irradiance may be emerging in zoo chimpanzees in Sweden and other mid-latitude countries.
C. providing supplemental vitamin D to chimpanzees in zoos in Sweden and other mid-latitude countries would likely not be beneficial.
D. zoo chimpanzees in Sweden and other mid-latitude countries tend to synthesize less vitamin D than they are inherently capable of synthesizing.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
野生黑猩猩仅生活在像塞拉利昂这样的热带国家，缺乏适应紫外线B（UVB）辐射季节性变化的能力；由于UVB暴露使脊椎动物能够合成维生素D，这引发了关于在中纬度动物园中生活的黑猩猩如何受到那些地区较低且变化更大的UVB辐射影响的疑问。在对瑞典及其他中纬度国家动物园黑猩猩的研究中，索菲·莫伊蒂（Sophie Moittié）及其同事发现，黑猩猩的维生素D水平不仅与UVB辐射相关，而且维生素D水平在UVB辐射达到当地最高水平时并没有显示出平台效应，这表明______。
中文解析
选项大意为中纬度地带大猩猩合成的VD量低于比他们本身能够合成的能力，也就是他们本身还能够继续合成higher levels of Vitamin D，但是在中纬度地带即便阳光UVB达到当地最高值，也没有达到他们VD合成最高值，没有达到他们的能力所及；这是正确答案，和原文的第一句的两项发现一致，尤其是两项发现的第二项（chimpanzees’ Vitamin D levels shows no evidence of plateauing）是一致的。

question:
A speaker at a recent children’s book publishing conference noted that, while many illustrators do excellent work, in her mind, no one has ever ________ Amos Ferguson’s work as the illustrator of Under the Sunday Tree: there is no better example of the form, according to the speaker.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在最近的一次儿童书籍出版会议上，一位发言者指出，虽然许多插画家都做得很好，但在她看来，没有人能像阿莫斯·弗格森那样______《在星期天的树下》的插图：根据这位发言者的说法，没有比这更好的例子了。
中文解析
很多illustrators很优秀，但是谁都不会超越Amos Ferguson的作品，eclipse表示使逊色，超越，比过。

question:
Like many other genera of wild bees, bumblebees have in recent decades experienced population collapse caused by, among other factors, habitat destruction and climate variation. Bumblebees are also one of the most researched bee genera, second only to honeybees. As a result, ecologists have gained much of their insight about wild-bee declines from bumblebees. In a 2021 paper, zoologist Guillaume Ghisbain notes that bumblebees are among the relatively few wild-bee genera that display social behaviors and dietary generalism (ability to obtain nectar and pollend from a diversity of plant species), two traits that are associated with increased resilience to some specific environmental changes. Ghisbain therefore contends that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. although bumblebees have been more extensively studied than most wild bees, researchers should not use bumblebees to draw conclusions about the decline of other wild bees, even ones with feeding patterns and levels of sociability that are similar to those of bumblebees.

B. because bumblebees and other bees with generalist diets are less negatively affected by environmental stress than bees with specialized diets are, they are less likely to experience major population changes in the future than bees with specialized diets are.

C. because the responses of bumblebees and other wild bees to environmental threats are not always comparable, researchers need to exercise caution when extrapolating information about wild-bee population declines from bumblebees.

D. although bumblebees and many other wild bees have experienced similar population declines in the past, compared with bumblebees, other wild bees may decline much more quickly due to their specialized diet in the future.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
由于栖息地破坏和气候变化等多种因素，蜜蜂的数量正在崩溃。大黄蜂也是研究最为广泛的蜜蜂属，仅次于蜜蜂。因此，生态学家从大黄蜂身上获得了关于野生蜜蜂数量下降的重要见解。在2021年的一篇论文中，动物学家吉约姆·吉斯班（Guillaume Ghisbain）指出，大黄蜂是相对少数表现出社会行为和饮食广泛性（能够从多种植物种类中获取花蜜和花粉）的野生蜜蜂属之一，这两种特征与对某些特定环境变化的增强适应力有关。因此，吉斯班认为______
中文解析
这段文字讨论了大黄蜂在研究野生蜜蜂种群下降中的重要性，强调了它们的社会行为和多样化饮食使其在环境变化中更具韧性。选项C的意思是，由于大黄蜂和其他野生蜜蜂对环境威胁的反应可能不同，因此在将关于大黄蜂的研究结果推广到其他野生蜜蜂时，研究人员需要谨慎。这个选项与段落的主要论点相符。

question:
Writer Silvia Moreno-Garcia’s love of short fiction began when she read a collection of Edgar Allan Poe stories as a child, and she would develop into a prolific short story writer herself, publishing pieces like “The Axolotl” (2013) and “Maquech” (2008). Yet she’s best known as a novelist, in part due to her ________ Gothic (2020) earning a spot on the New York Times Best Sellers list.

question:
Within Earth’s biomes, there are four main types of desert: arid, semiarid, coastal, and cold. The Ferlo Desert in western Africa is an arid ________ it is one of the largest such deserts in the world, with a total area of about70,000 km2.

question:
The Southern Delta Aquariid meteor shower has a zenithal hourly rate (ZHR) of 25, meaning that at the shower’s peak, 25 meteors per hour could potentially be seen by a hypothetical observer. A calculation that assumes ideal viewing conditions, ________

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. an actual viewer’s observed number of meteors in an hour and the ZHR may differ considerably.
B. the number of meteors an actual viewer observes in an hour may differ considerably from the ZHR.
C. there may be a considerable difference between the number of meteors an actual viewer observes in an hour and the ZHR.
D. the ZHR may differ considerably from the number of meteors an actual viewer observes in an hour.
explanations: 这是dangling structure（垂悬结构）的考察，主语the ZHR需要和A calculation保持一致，于是选择D

question:
With one in Canada and another in Antarctica, the observatory sites that form the Super Dual Auroral Radar ________ or SuperDARN, as space physicists like Pavlo Ponomarenko call it---number nearly five dozen. Located across the globe, the radars track geomagnetic storms and other geospace phenomena.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 考察双破折号的使用，主句的主语是observatory sites谓语动词是number，双破折号间起解释说明的作用。

question:
The Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) tracks comparative price list data for its thirty-eight member countries. For instance, in July 2021, a hypothetical basket of goods priced at 100 Us dollars (USD) in the United States would have cost 54 USD and 112 USD in fellow OECD ________ and Ireland, respectively.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: Fellow OECD修饰后面两个国家，是修饰关系，不是等同关系，不用符号分割，选择D选项

question:
Though he’s performed on many respected albums, including From The Street by Tom Coster, drummer Dennis Chambers may be best known for his time as house drummer for the hip-hop label Sugar Hill Records. He did not play drums on the label’s classic song “Rapper’s Delight,” ________ joined the label after the song’s release.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 完整的句子间需要句号连接，其它选项都是句子内容连接方式，however所在的第二句和第一句之间是转折对比关系。

question:
With their distinctive cone shapes and steeply sloping sides, the volcanoes Kuchinoshima (Japan) and Tantalus (Hawaii) may look similar from afar. Gari Mayberry and other volcanologists, ________ can tell by how each was formed that Kuchinoshima is a composite volcano, while Tantalus is a cinder cone volcano.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
由于其独特的圆锥形状和陡峭的坡度，日本的口之岛（Kuchinoshima）和夏威夷的坦塔鲁斯（Tantalus）从远处看可能相似。加里·梅伯里（Gari Mayberry）和其他火山学家，______可以通过它们的形成方式判断出口之岛是一个复合火山，而坦塔鲁斯是一个火山渣锥火山。
中文解析
第一句说从远处看两个火山相近，第二句说Gari等人能够区分出其差异，前后对比转折关系，用副词though

question:
In a 2022 analysis, researchers investigated how negative adjectives like “ashamed” evolve. ________ the researchers applied a statistical model to a set of words to infer the rate of cognate replacement—the rate at which a word will be replaced over time with a noncognate form-in Indo-European languages.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在2022年的一项分析中，研究人员调查了“羞愧”等负面形容词是如何演变的。______研究人员对一组词汇应用了统计模型，以推断印欧语言中同源词替换的速率——即一个词在时间推移中被非同源形式替代的速率。
中文解析
第一句整体描述研究负面类形容词如何衍变（how negative adjectives evolve）,这里不要受到like举例的影响；第二句则是研究员们具体的数据模型和具体研究，应该用specifically表述，具体来说

question:
The title of “Of the Inequality amongst Us,” an essay by French philosopher Michel de Montaigne, suggests a straightforward topic. However, Montaigne’s expansive, curious mind meant that he never limited himself to one subject. ________ the essay is not just a discussion of inequality but a broad exploration of Montaigne’s entire worldview.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
“我们之间的不平等”（Of the Inequality amongst Us）是法国哲学家米歇尔·德·蒙田（Michel de Montaigne）的一篇随笔，标题暗示了一个直接的主题。然而，蒙田那广阔而好奇的心智使他从未将自己局限于一个主题。**因此**，这篇随笔不仅仅是对不平等的讨论，更是对蒙田整个世界观的广泛探索。
中文解析
前一句铺垫蒙田的思路不拘泥一个主题，后一句描述essay讨论了inequality及整个世界观，所以用predictably表示可以预料，lastly是时间先后关系，that said表示话虽如此，additionally表示可以并列递进

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● There are more than 500 National Wildlife Refuges (NWRs) across the United States.
● The Mason Neck NWR is a 2,276-acre area in Virginia, on the Atlantic coast.
● It was established to protect the endangered bald eagle.
● The Nestucca Bay NWR is a 457-acre area in Oregon, on the Pacific coast.
● It was established to protect the endangered Aleutian Canada goose.

The student wants to provide an overview of the NWR program. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Both the Mason Neck NWR and the Nestucca Bay NWR were established to protect endangered species.
B. Oregon’s Nestucca Bay NWR was established to protect the endangered Aleutian Canada goose.
C. One of more than 500 NWRs in the US, the Mason Neck NWR encompasses 2,276 acres in Virginia.
D. The US’s more than 500 NWRs protect endangered species from coast to coast.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
● 美国有超过500个国家野生动物保护区（NWRs）。
● 梅森颈国家野生动物保护区（Mason Neck NWR）位于弗吉尼亚州，面积为2,276英亩，位于大西洋沿岸。
● 该保护区成立的目的是保护濒危的白头鹰。
● 内斯图卡湾国家野生动物保护区（Nestucca Bay NWR）位于俄勒冈州，面积为457英亩，位于太平洋沿岸。
● 该保护区成立的目的是保护濒危的阿留申加拿大鹅。
中文解析
题目要求an overview of the NWR program,于是D选项满足，既描述了总体数量超500多家，又描述了其作用是保护濒危物种。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Tlaxcoapan is a municipality in the state of Hidalgo, Mexico.
● Municipalities are governmental regions responsible for providing many public services to their residents.
● One service they provide is street lighting.
● Tlaxcoapan covers an area of roughly 42 km2.
● Hidalgo is divided into 84 municipalities.

The student wants to emphasize the size of Tlaxcoapan. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Providing street lighting is just one example of the public services that municipalities provide.
B. The municipality of Tlaxcoapan in Hidalgo, Mexico, covers an area of roughly 42 km2.
C. Tlaxcoapan is one of 84 governmental regions, known as municipalities, across Hidalgo.
D. Tlaxcoapan—a governmental region in the state of Hidalgo, Mexico—provides many public services to its residents.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
● Tlaxcoapan是墨西哥伊达尔戈州的一个市。
● 市是负责向居民提供多种公共服务的政府区域。
● 他们提供的服务之一是街道照明。
● Tlaxcoapan的面积大约为42平方公里。
● 伊达尔戈州分为84个市。
中文解析
题目邀请emphasize the size, 于是B选项符合要求，告知42平方公里。

question:
● Vexillology is the study of flags.
● The flags of many countries include symbols like animals, plants, or landforms.
● These symbols often represent an aspect of the region’s history. culture, or landscape.
● The flag of San Marino includes a laurel branch.
● The flag of Croatia includes leopards.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to make and support a generalization about symbols on flags?
selections: A. The flags of some countries include symbols of plants; San Marino’s, for example, includes a laurel branch.
B. San Marino’s flag includes a laurel branch, a symbol that is important to that country’s national identity.
C. Vexillology is the study of flags; accordingly, vexillologists are interested in flags from around the world.
D. Many countries feature symbols on their flags, and the study of these designs is known as vexillology.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
● 旗帜学（Vexillology）是对旗帜的研究。
● 许多国家的旗帜上包含动物、植物或地貌等符号。
● 这些符号通常代表该地区历史、文化或自然景观的某个方面。
● 圣马力诺的国旗上有一根月桂枝。
● 克罗地亚的国旗上有豹子图案。
中文解析
题目要求make and support a generalization,于是选项需要先make a generalization，然后用具体的evidence support，因此选择A选项，分号前是generalization of flags’ symbols,分号后是具体一个国家的例子充当supporting作用。

question: A district school board in a certain state is proposing a change to the time school starts for all high schools in the district. One way that young orangutans acquire foraging skills is through a behavior scientists call peering—closely watching older orangutans as they engage in an activity that the young have not yet mastered. Since male orangutans typically leave the area of their birth upon maturity and females do not, Beatrice Ehmann and her colleagues hypothesized that it is more advantageous for immature males than females to devote attention to orangutans who are immigrants to the home region of the immature individual, and this should be reflected in sex-specific differences in peering behavior.

Which choice best describes data from the table that support Ehmann and colleagues’ hypothesis?
selections: A. The proportion of peering events directed at immigrants to immature orangutans’ home regions ranged from a low of 0.00 to a high of 1.00.
B. Individual 5 and individual 6 directed a lower proportion of peering events at immigrants to their home regions than did individual 8 and individual 10.

C. Individual 8 directed a higher proportion of peering events at immigrants to its home region than did individual 10, and individual 6 directed a higher proportion of peering events at immigrants to its home region than did individual 5.
D. Individual 10 had the highest total number of peering events observed at 33.
explanations:
A.中文解析
文本最后的结论是体现性别差异，也就是male比female在peering行为中更加得益的结果，于是图表中individual 5 and 6 are females，individual 8 and 10 are males，对比时需要male 和female之间对比，且体现出female peering proportion更低，那就是B选项的对应描述。
B.题目文本翻译
年轻猩猩获得觅食技能的一种方式是通过一种被科学家称为“凝视”的行为，即密切观察年长猩猩从事尚未掌握的活动。由于雄性猩猩通常在成熟后离开出生地区而雌性不会，贝阿特丽斯·埃曼（Beatrice Ehmann）及其同事假设，相对于雌性，对于未成熟的雄性来说，将注意力集中在移民到未成熟个体家乡地区的猩猩身上更有利，并且这应该在凝视行为中反映出性别特定的差异。

question:
Average Monetized Productivity Loss at Two Points After Programs Began, in Australian Dollars
Type of training

Michelle Pereira et al. hypothesized that introducing health improvements into workplaces would increase productivity by reducing absenteeism (sick employees not working) and presenteeism (sick workers working less productively due to illness). Pereira’s team enrolled groups of Australian workers in two programs: one that gave employees exercise training (EET) and one that enrolled employees in health promotion seminars (EHP). They then calculated the productivity loss of those groups at 12 weeks and 12 months after the programs began (based on the 28 days preceding each point). They concluded that exercise training was more effective at restraining productivity loss than health promotion seminars were, though this result took time to become apparent.

Which choice best describes data from the table that most effectively strengthen Pereira and colleagues’ conclusion?
selections: A. Productivity loss for the EET group barely decreased between 12 weeks and 12 months after the program began, while productivity loss for the EHP group significantly increased during the same time period.

B. Productivity loss was consistently higher for the EHP group than for the EET group over the twelve months that it was measured, though the size of the difference between the two decreased over that time.

C. Productivity loss was fairly similar for the EET and EHP groups 12 weeks after each program began, but at 12 months afterward it had significantly increased for the EHP group and significantly decreased for the EET group.

D. Productivity loss was largely due to absenteeism for the EHP group at 12 months after the program began, while productivity loss was largely due to presenteeism for the EET group at 12 months after the program began.
explanations:
A.中文解析
文本的结论是EET方式在遏制生产力损耗（restraining productivity loss）更加有效，但是需要时间才能看到明显结果（the result took time to become apparent）,12 weeks时，我们看到两项productivity loss数据相似268和282，但是12 months时，EET的数据171明显比EHP的数据436要低很多，说明时间长才能看到效果。于是正确答案C。
B.题目文本翻译
Michelle Pereira等人假设，将健康改进引入工作场所将通过减少旷工（生病的员工不工作）和在岗工作能力下降（因疾病导致工作效率降低的员工）来提高生产力。 Pereira的团队将一组澳大利亚工人分别纳入两个项目：一个提供员工运动训练（EET），另一个让员工参加健康促进研讨会（EHP）。然后他们在这两个项目开始后的12周和12个月（基于每个时间点前28天的数据）计算了这些群体的生产力损失。他们得出结论，相比健康促进研讨会，运动训练在抑制生产力损失方面更有效，尽管这个结果需要一定时间才能显现。

question:
Memoirs of Elleanor Eldridge is an 1838 historical account by Elleanor Eldridge and Frances Harriet Whipple Green. In the book, the authors assert that people don’t need to be famous to be worthy of memoirs, writing, ________

Which quotation from Memoirs of Elleanor Eldridge most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “Then let no one turn with too much [fussiness] from the simple story of the humble Elleanor, though it may contain few, or none, of the thrilling charms of poetry and passion.”

B. “There is often a kind of [deceptive] light, playing around such [famous] names, calculated to dazzle and mislead, by their false lustre, until the eye can no longer receive the pure light of Truth, or the mind appreciate real excellence, or intrinsic worth.”
C. “It should not be considered essential to the interest and value of biography, that its subject be of exalted rank, or illustrious name.”

D. “How careful ought we to be to speak nothing but the truth, even in regard to the most trifling circumstances; and not only so, but to be well assured that what we suppose to be true, is truth, before we receive it as such.”
explanations:
A.中文解析
文本assertion说people don't need to be famous to be worthy of memoirs, 大意就是无需非得是名人才值得有传记，C选项中subject of exalted rank, or illustrious name 指的是名人，It should not be considered essential to the interest and value of biography, 表明这不是传记的必要符合原文末尾的assertion。
B.题目文本翻译
《埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇的回忆录》是埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇和弗朗西斯·哈丽特·惠普尔·格林于1838年撰写的历史记录。在这本书中，作者们断言人们无需成为名人才配得上有回忆录，写道：________”

question:
Forest Area for Three Land Use Capability Classes in the Chorotega Region, Costa Rica
To understand the extent of deforestation in the Chorotega region of Costa Rica, Juan Pablo Arroyo Mora and colleagues used historical aerial photography and remote sensing data to track changes in the forest cover area across different land use capability classes (categories that indicate possible uses of forest land). Due to the Chorotega region’s accessibility, various types of forested areas were converted to cattle pasture as rising international meat prices drove a cattle ranching boom in the 1960s and 1970s. By the mid 1980s, however, increased public awareness and environmental reforms, along with a decline in meat prices, triggered a natural regrowth process, as evident by the ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the assertion?
selections: A. decrease in the forest cover area for all classes from 1960 to 1979.
B. difference between the forest cover area in Class I-IV and in Class VI in 2000.
C. increase in the forest cover area for all classes from 1979 to 2000.
D. similarity in forest cover area in Class I-IV and Class VIII in 1986.
explanations:
A.中文解析
题目文本最后说natural regrowth process of forests, 于是只有C选项能够支持，支持了1979年后整体的增长趋势，尤其是86之后更加明显的上涨。
B.题目文本翻译
为了了解哥斯达黎加乔罗特加地区的森林砍伐程度，胡安·帕布罗·阿罗约·莫拉（Juan Pablo Arroyo Mora）和同事使用历史航空摄影和遥感数据跟踪了不同土地利用能力类别（指示森林土地可能用途的类别）的森林覆盖面积变化。由于乔罗特加地区的可及性，各种类型的森林区域在上世纪60年代和70年代由于国际肉类价格上涨推动了牛肉养殖业的繁荣而转变为牧场。然而，到了1980年代中期，随着公众意识的增强和环境改革，以及肉类价格的下降，触发了一种自然再生过程，正如________所显示的那样。

question:
Can field mustard plants grow on Mars? Can pea plants? You might think the answer to these questions is obviously no, but researchers in the Netherlands recently showed that the seeds of many common plant species can germinate in soil designed to simulate Martian conditions, as long as water is supplied. In fact, some species actually did better in Martian soil than in Earth soil: 30 percent of field mustard seeds sprouted when planted in simulated Martian soil, compared with 4 percent that did when planted in soil from their home planet.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To explain an important study of differences in the composition of Martian soil and the composition of Earth soil
B. To present a surprising finding about plants grown in soil intended to be similar to Martian soil
C. To answer long-standing questions about how Martian soil conditions can be simulated on Earth
D. To discuss an unexpected result about the role of water in plants grown in simulated Martian soil
explanations:
A.中文解析
文本目的是研究员们发现很多种子在模拟火星状态下能够发芽，且发芽率更高，这符合B选项所说的surprising finding，同时plants grown in soil才是文本的核心重点。
B.题目文本翻译
田野芥菜能在火星上生长吗？豌豆能吗？你可能认为这些问题的答案显然是否定的，但荷兰的研究人员最近展示了许多常见植物种子在设计模拟火星条件的土壤中可以发芽，只要提供水源。事实上，一些植物种类在火星土壤中的表现实际上比在地球土壤中更好：在模拟火星土壤中种植的田野芥菜种子中，有30％发芽，而在其原生土壤中种植的则只有4％发芽。

question:
Louise Arner Boyd, who led several scientific expeditions off the coast of Greenland in the 1930s, undoubtedly accomplished much, but to gain a lasting place in our historical memory, there is little that can ________ being the first to do something. For example, people will always remember that Enid Gordon-Gallien led the expedition that first mapped the area around Kalambo Falls between Zambia and Tanzania.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
这个文本在SAT中多次变体出现，大意是虽然Louise很有成就，但是想在历史上拥有地位，什么都比不过“the first to do something”,于是选择prevail over表示战胜，超过。
B.题目文本翻译
路易丝·阿纳·博伊德（Louise Arner Boyd）在上世纪30年代领导了几次科学考察格陵兰岛海岸的远征，无疑取得了很多成就，但要在我们的历史记忆中留下持久的地位，几乎没有什么能够________比率先做某事。例如，人们将永远记得伊妮德·戈登-加利恩（Enid Gordon-Gallien）领导的考察队率先绘制了赞比亚和坦桑尼亚之间卡兰博瀑布周围地区的地图。

question:
The following text is adapted from Adib Khorram’s 2018 novel Darius the Great Is Not Okay. The narrator, Darius, is a teenager visiting family in Iran. He and his friend Sohrab are at the entrance of the ruins of the ancient city of Persepolis.
“The Gate of All Nations,” Sohrab said. He gestured to the lamassus [sculptures] and pillars surrounding us. “That’s the name in English.”
It wasn’t much of a gate anymore, since anyone of any nation could have easily stepped around it instead of walking through. But it was still amazing.
Behind the lamassu, more columns sprouted from the ground like ancient trees in a petrified forest, forty feet tall, spindly but still miraculously upright. Giant stone slabs formed the remains of what must once have been a breathtaking structure.
©2018 by Adib Khorram

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Darius has seen the columns before.
B. Darius is surprised that Sohrab knows so much about the ruins.
C. Darius wants to learn about the people who built Persepolis.
D. Darius is impressed by the overall sight of the ruins.
explanations:
A.中文解析
题目背景告知是Darius和朋友在entrance of the ruins of ancient city of Persepolis, 主体部分是描述了所见场景，态度积极，miraculously，breathtaking等词都是态度可以参考的词，于是D选项描述Darius is impressed by the overall sight最符合文本主要内容。
B.题目文本翻译
以下文字改编自阿迪布·科拉姆（Adib Khorram）2018年的小说《大流士不太好》。叙述者达里乌斯是一名青少年，正在伊朗探亲。他和朋友索赫拉布站在波斯波利斯古城遗址的入口处。
“所有国家之门，”索赫拉布说道。他指着围绕我们的兰玛斯（雕塑）和柱子。“这是英文名字。”
那不再是一个真正的门了，因为任何国家的人都可以轻易绕过它而不是从中穿过。但它依然令人惊叹。
在兰玛斯的后面，更多的柱子从地面上长出，像一片石化森林中的古老树木，高四十英尺，细长但仍然奇迹般地直立。巨大的石板构成了曾经必定是一个令人惊叹的结构的遗迹。
©2018年 阿迪布·科拉姆

question:
British professional soccer team Arsenal Football Club, whose home uniform color is mainly red, won more than half its home matches between 1947 and 2003. This is a higher proportion than the proportion of home matches won by Watford Football Club, whose home uniform color is not red, during the same period. According to a study by Martin J. Attrill and colleagues, the color red can cause people to respond with fear and hesitation, which the researchers think helps explain Arsenal’s success. Nadav Goldschmied and colleagues reanalyzed the published data from this study, however, and found no evidence that red-uniformed teams are more likely than other teams to win, suggesting that Watford’s home-match win percentage ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. would likely have remained roughly the same if its players had been wearing red uniforms.
B. may have influenced other teams to change their uniform colors.
C. was directly tied to its players’ general satisfaction with their uniform color.
D. was likely influenced by its players’ associations with the color red.
explanations:
A.中文解析
从文本最后描述来看，红色的队服与获胜之间并无关系，因此可以得出即便换了衣服颜色，也不会影响输赢的概率，所以选择A选项。
B.题目文本翻译
英国职业足球队阿森纳足球俱乐部的主场队服主要是红色，该俱乐部在1947年至2003年之间赢得了超过一半的主场比赛。这一比例高于瓦特福德足球俱乐部在同一时期内主场比赛获胜的比例。根据马丁·J·阿特里尔（Martin J. Attrill）及其同事的一项研究，红色可以导致人们产生恐惧和犹豫，研究人员认为这有助于解释阿森纳的成功。然而，纳达夫·戈尔德施密德（Nadav Goldschmied）及其同事重新分析了这项研究中的已发表数据，发现没有证据表明穿红色队服的球队比其他球队更有可能获胜，这表明瓦特福德的主场比赛获胜率________”

question:
The Last of England, painted in the realist style by Ford Madox Brown, depicts a working-class family immigrating to Australia to start a new life. The realists’ emphasis on accurately portraying the experiences of average working people was largely a rejection of the romantic style evident in many paintings by Leon Belly, which instead ________ their subjects’ beauty or heroism while hiding all imperfection.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
文本对比了现实主义手法与浪漫主义手法的不同点，浪漫主义通常会夸大主人公的beauty or heroism，选择exaggerate。
B.题目文本翻译
《英格兰的最后一位》，由福特·马多克斯·布朗（Ford Madox Brown）以现实主义风格绘制，描绘了一个工人阶级家庭移民到澳大利亚开始新生活的故事。现实主义画家强调准确描绘普通工人的经历，这在很大程度上是对勒昂·贝利（Leon Belly）许多画作中所呈现的浪漫主义风格的一种拒绝，后者反而___隐藏所有瑕疵，而强调主题的美丽或英雄主义。

question:
The following text is adapted from Mary Seacole’s 1857 autobiography Wonderful Adventures of Mrs. Seacole in Many Dands.
That journey across the Isthmus [of Panama], insignificant in distance as it was, was by no means an easy one. It seemed as if nature had determined to throw every conceivable obstacle in the way of those who should seek to join the two great oceans of the world.

As used in the text, what does the word “conceivable” most nearly mean?
explanations:
A.中文解析
这里描述一条举例虽然不长，但是却困难重重的巴拿马海峡连接之路，every conceivable obstacle形容所有困难，于是选择possible，不一定是可以看得见的（visible）的困难，不一定常规或公开的困哪，而是所有的困境（every possible obstacle）
B.题目文本翻译
以下文本改编自玛丽·西科尔（Mary Seacole）于1857年所著的自传《Mrs. Seacole 的精彩冒险在众多Dands中》。
那次穿越巴拿马地峡的旅程，尽管在距离上微不足道，却丝毫不容易。看起来仿佛大自然决定要在那些寻求连接世界两大洋的人的路上摆上所有可能的障碍。

question:
Many believe that lullabies, characterized by their slow tempos, contain some acoustic features that are universally calming to infants. In a study, Constance M. Bainbridge and colleagues played both a lullaby sung in the Luk Saami language and a non-lullaby sung in the Tundra Nenets language to a group of infants. The researchers also measured the infants’ heart rates, as a reduced heart rate is considered a measure of relaxation. They claim that the lullaby did indeed relax the infants.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support Bainbridge and colleagues’ claim?
selections: A. The heart rates of infants in the study were more irregular during the lullabies than during non-lullabies.
B. Infants’ heart rates were substantially lower during the lullaby than during the non-lullaby.
C. Parents of infants in the study chose the lullaby over the non-lullaby when asked which song they would use to calm their child.
D. Both the song in Luk Saami and the song in Tundra Nenets were sung by a female singer.
explanations:
A.中文解析
文章末尾的结论是lullaby能够是婴儿放松，那么就需要证明lullabies能够让心跳速率降低，所以选B。
B.题目文本翻译
许多人认为，摇篮曲以其缓慢的节奏为特征，包含一些声学特征，对婴儿普遍具有镇静作用。在一项研究中，康斯坦斯·M·贝恩布里奇（Constance M. Bainbridge）及其同事向一组婴儿播放了一首用卢克萨米语演唱的摇篮曲和一首用图德拉涅涅茨语演唱的非摇篮曲。研究人员还测量了婴儿的心率，因为心率降低被认为是放松的一个指标。他们声称，摇篮曲确实让婴儿放松下来。

question:
In a 2018 article celebrating films depicting the Black experience, critics for the New York Times ________ William Greaves’s1968 film Symbiopsychotaxiplasm, Take One and Spike Lee’s 1992 film Malcolm X, praising the former as “a vital artifact of its time” and the latter as “electrifying.”

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
根据文本celebrating，praising等词汇，包括句子整体意义描述，critics评论员态度积极，于是选择commend，表示赞扬的意义。
B.题目文本翻译
在一篇2018年的文章中，庆祝描绘黑人经历的电影，纽约时报的评论家________了威廉·格里夫斯（William Greaves）1968年的电影《Symbiopsychotaxiplasm, Take One》和斯派克·李（Spike Lee）1992年的电影《马尔科姆X》，称前者为“其时代的重要文物”，后者为“令人激动的”。

question:
Researchers César A. Hidalgo, Elisa Castañer, and Andres Sevtsuk created a computer model to predict the mix of gyms, beauty salons, and other businesses found in a given neighborhood. How we define a neighborhood and its boundaries is subjective, so the team used a clustering algorithm to locate dense groupings of amenities that represent human-identified neighborhoods like Boston’s Central Square. The predictive model, which incorporates this algorithm, is sure to be invaluable in determining the optimal mix of a city’s amenities.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It describes how an algorithm can predict the success of certain businesses, discusses an example of a use of that algorithm, and suggests potential uses of the algorithm in other fields.
B. It introduces a research team’s study of urban neighborhoods, describes an aspect of the study’s methodology, and suggests a potential application of the team’s research.
C. It summarizes trends in recent urban development, describes a potential problem for urban planners, and suggests a computational tool that can be used to solve that problem.
D. It explains why urban planners are interested in understanding the locations of certain businesses, details a study that has addressed this question, and identifies one key finding.
explanations:
A.中文解析
Structure需要按照顺序全面概括，这段话第一句介绍了一个predictive model，后面则是应用algorithm来衡量optimal mix of a city’s amenities.B选项恰好是先引出research team’study, 后面才是potential application，对应了原文最后的的表达（is sure to be invaluable）.
B.题目文本翻译
研究人员塞萨尔·A·伊达尔戈（César A. Hidalgo）、埃莉莎·卡斯塔涅尔（Elisa Castañer）和安德烈斯·塞夫楚克（Andres Sevtsuk）创建了一个计算机模型，用于预测在特定社区中发现的健身房、美容沙龙和其他业务的组合。我们如何定义一个社区及其边界是主观的，因此该团队使用了聚类算法来定位代表人类确定的类似波士顿中央广场的社区的密集设施群。这个预测模型，结合了这一算法，肯定对确定城市设施的最佳组合非常有价值。

question:
When people think of dinosaurs with feathers, they typically think of winged dinosaurs, such as the bat like Yi qi. However, many dinosaurs that didn’t have wings also had feathers on their bodies. For instance, research indicates that the wingless, predatory Juravenator likely had feathers.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To argue that only one species of dinosaur had feathers
B. To explain why feathered dinosaurs went extinct
C. To point out the differences between dinosaur feathers and bird feathers
D. To discuss the presence of feathers on certain types of dinosaurs
explanations:
A.中文解析
文本的目的是说没有翅膀的恐龙也可能会有羽毛，也就是D选项presence of features on certain types of dinosaurs。
B.题目文本翻译
当人们想到长有羽毛的恐龙时，通常会想到有翅膀的恐龙，比如蝙蝠状的"夜齿"。然而，许多没有翅膀的恐龙身上也长有羽毛。例如，研究表明，无翅、食肉的侏罗纪猎手可能也长有羽毛。

question:
Studies have shown that when we listen to high-tempo music (songs with a high number of beats per minute, or bpm) during endurance exercise, we perceive our effort as lower than it actually is, which leads to an increased pace and a higher heart rate. Researchers recently designed a follow-up study in which participants jogged outdoors for 30 minutes while listening to Aerosmith’s “Livin’ on the Edge” (169 bpm) continuously. The next day participants performed the same activity while listening to Beyonce’s “Irreplaceable” (88 bpm). As expected, listening to that song resulted in participants ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. perceiving their effort as higher while jogging than they had the previous day.
B. jogging a longer distance in the 30 minutes than they had the previous day.
C. varying their jogging pace more than they had the previous day.
D. exhibiting a higher average heart rate while jogging than they had the previous day.
explanations:
A.中文解析
根据文章high-tempo music让人们perceive our efforts as lower，反推lower tempo music相对会perceive our efforts as higher，那么第一天169bpm，第二天88 bpm，于是第二天会觉得比前一天付出的effort要higher，和A选项一致。
B.题目文本翻译
研究表明，当我们在进行耐力运动时听高节奏音乐（每分钟拍数高的歌曲）时，我们会认为自己的努力比实际要小，这会导致步伐加快和心率增加。研究人员最近设计了一项后续研究，参与者在户外慢跑30分钟，同时持续听Aerosmith的“Livin’ on the Edge”（169 bpm）。第二天，参与者进行相同活动时听Beyonce的“Irreplaceable”（88 bpm）。如预期，听这首歌导致参与者________”

question:
In the 1960s and the 1970s, a loose-knit group of writers including Sonia Sanchez, Gwendolyn Brooks, and James Baldwin ________ monumental works of poetry and fiction exploring the Black American experience and together came to be known as the Black Arts movement.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 并列谓语动词published and came都是过去时，同时时间1960s and 1970s也是描述过去。

question:
In the Silurian hypothesis, astrophysicist Adam Frank and climatologist Gavin Schmidt suggest the geological record may contain evidence of prehuman advanced civilizations. This sensational hypothesis obscures the scientists’ practical ________ Frank and Schmidt don’t believe such a civilization existed, and their “hypothesis” is a thought experiment exploring the traces our own civilization will leave on the geological record.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: However作为副词，所在句和前一句形成转折关系，第一句和第二句间存在转折关系，需要however在第二句内，第二句和第三句完整句连接需要分号，不可以用逗号。于是选B选项。

question:
At 1,666 years old, RCR 1, a foxtail pine (Pinus balfouriana) located in the United States, is one of the oldest known trees in the world. With almost two millennia of climate data in its tree rings, a single tree like ________ claims dendrochronologist Valerie Trouet, can tell the history of the world.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主语后有逗号，谓语前有逗号，中间部分是间接引用做插入语，于是需要在this后加逗号，因为谓语can tell前已经有逗号。

question:
An upcoming exhibition will showcase Vincent van Gogh’s drawing Building in Eindhoven, which Van Gogh ________ in the city of Nuenen nearly 150 years ago.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 150年前表示过去，需要动词过去式，completed

question:
A 2012 study led by ________ studied the impact of fertilizers containing nitrogen on grassland arthropod populations. Another study, led by Kimberly J. La Pierre in 2015, looked at fertilizers containing nitrogen and two other macronutrients: phosphorus and potassium.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: Researcher修饰人物的名字不可以用符号分割，主语和谓语（studied）之间不可以分割，于是选择C

question:
Included among a particular group of mid-twentieth-century artists known as the New York School, French abstract ________ was known for using energetic brushstrakes and for capturing the energy and chaos of modern life.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: Abstract painter修饰人物名词，不用符号分割，主语和谓语was known for之间不分割，于是选择A选项。

question:
Scientists were able to isolate a relatively pure sample of cadmium in 1817, the same year they first discovered the element’s existence. ________ the isolation process took longer for niobium, which was isolated in its pure form 63 years after scientists first discovered it.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
A.中文解析
前后对比了cadmium 与niobium的分离提取时间，前者发现后就提取了，后者却用来很久的时间，对比关系选择by contrast。
B.题目文本翻译
科学家在1817年成功分离出了相对纯净的镉样品，与他们首次发现该元素的存在的同一年。而对于铌来说，分离过程花费的时间更长，科学家在首次发现该元素后63年才成功将其分离成纯净形式。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• For centuries in Japan, it was common practice for farmers to cultivate terraced rice fields (tanada in Japanese).
• Tanada were built by carving the steep hillsides into a series of large, flat steps.
• This agricultural method allowed farmers to increase arable land and prevent landslides.
• The Sawajiri tanada in Miyagi Prefecture, Japan, was developed during the Sengoku period.
• The Sengoku period (1467 CE-1615 CE) was characterized by social upheaval and civil war.

The student wants to explain the design of the Sawajiri tanada. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Sawajiri terraced rice field, or tanada, was built by carving the steephillside into a series of large, flat steps, making the land more arable and less prone to landslides.
B. Developed in the Sengoku period, the Sawajiri tanada was built during a time of Japanese history characterized by social upheaval and civil war.
C. The agricultural method of carving hillsides into terraced rice fields was common practice in Japan for centuries.
D. During the Sengoku period, a farming method was used that involved carving large, flat steps out of the steep hillsides.
explanations:
A.中文解析
题目关键词explain the design of tranada于是我们不仅要描述design还要解释原因，A选项做到了描述外形与其优点阐释。
B.题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下内容：
• 在日本的几个世纪里，种植梯田（日本称为“田园田”）是一种普遍的做法。
• 田园田是通过将陡峭的山坡雕刻成一系列大型平坦的台阶而建造的。
• 这种农业方法使农民能够增加可耕地，并防止山体滑坡。
• 日本宫城县的沢尻梯田是在战国时代发展起来的。
• 战国时代（公元1467年至1615年）以社会动荡和内战为特征。

question:
• Antonio Stradivari (1644-1737) made about 1,000 violins in his lifetime.
• Musicians prize his Stradivarius violins for their famed sound quality.
• Many of the 500 or so that exist today are named for a previous owner.
• The ex-Berglund Stradivarius is named for Paavo Berglund, a Finnish violinist.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to explain how the ex-Berglund Stradivarius got its name?
selections: A. The ex-Berglund Stradivarius is named after its former owner, Paavo Berglund.
B. Of the 1,000 or so violins Antonio Stradivari made, only about 500 exist today.
C. Designed by Antonio Stradivari, Stradivarius violins like the ex-Berglund are renowned for their quality.
D. Paavo Berglund was a Finnish violinist.
explanations:
A.中文解析
题目要求解释如何获得name，A选项说明了is named after its former own.
B.题目文本翻译
- 安东尼奥·斯特拉迪瓦里（1644-1737）一生制作了约1000把小提琴。
- 音乐家们珍视他的斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴，因其声音质量而闻名。
- 如今大约有500把斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴仍在存在，其中许多是以之前的所有者命名的。
- “前柏格伦德斯特拉迪瓦里”是以芬兰小提琴家帕沃·柏格伦德的名字命名的。

question:
When ordering the branches of the Colville River system by Hack’s method, one begins with the riverway’s lowest point, the Colville River. ________ when using Strahler’s method, one begins at the top of the river system, with the Okokmilaga River and other tributaries fed by the riverway’s source, Alaska’s De Long Mountains.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
A.中文解析
这里有两种method，一个是Hack’s method及具体内容，另一个是Strahler’s method及具体内容描述，两者间的关系是一种方法与另一种方法间的关系，选择alternatively。
B.题目文本翻译
在使用Hack方法对科尔维尔河系统的支流进行排序时，首先从河流的最低点科尔维尔河开始。而在使用Strahler方法时，则是从河系统的顶部开始，即阿拉斯加的德朗山脉的水源，包括Okokmilaga河和其他由河流源头供水的支流。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Buland Darwaza is a historic gateway.
• It is located in the city of Agra, India.
• It is one of the many remaining structures built by the Mughal Empire.
• The Mughal Empire was a South Asian empire.
• It lasted from the early sixteenth century to the mid-nineteenth century.

The student wants to specify the location of Buland Darwaza. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Buland Darwaza is a historic gateway built by the Mughal Empire.
B. Buland Darwaza was built by the Mughal Empire, a South Asian empire that started in the early sixteenth century.
C. The Mughal Empire, which built Buland Darwaza, lasted from the early sixteenth century to the mid-nineteenth century.
D. Buland Darwaza can be found in Agra, a city in the country of India.
explanations:
A.中文解析
题目要求specify location，于是D选项Agra，India满足具体地点。
B.题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
• Buland Darwaza是一个历史门户。
• 它位于印度阿格拉市。
• 这是莫卧儿帝国留存下来的许多建筑之一。
• 莫卧儿帝国是一个南亚帝国。
• 它延续了从16世纪初到19世纪中叶的时间段。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Eizabeth Catlett (1915-2012) was a celebrated African American artist
• She is best known for creating sculptures and prints that explore the Black experience.
• Face is a 1973 sculpture by Catlett.
• It is made of marble.

The student wants to describe a sculpture by Elizabeth Catlett. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Made of marble, Face is a 1973 sculpture by Elizabeth Catlett.
B. Artist Elizabeth Catlett is best known for creating sculptures and prints that explore the Black experience.
C. Elizabeth Catlett was a celebrated artist whose work includes sculptures.
D. Elizabeth Catlett, a celebrated artist, was born in 1915.
explanations:
A.中文解析
题目要求描述a sculpture,于是需要具体到一个雕塑，只有A选项满足。
B.题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下内容：
• 伊丽莎白·卡特莱特（1915-2012）是一位备受赞誉的非裔美国艺术家。
• 她以创作探索黑人经历的雕塑和版画而闻名。
• 《面孔》是卡特莱特于1973年创作的雕塑作品。
• 它是由大理石制成的。

question:
Some robots such as Justin (developed in 2008) and TALOS (developed in 2017) feature humanoid characteristics like the ability to respond to voice commands so that people will find it easier to interact with them. While these features can help to ________ feelings of comfort in people, a robot that looks too human can fall into the “uncanny valley,” meaning that its appearance unintentionally unsettles those who encounter it.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
While引导从句前后语义是对比关系，while...engender comfort in people（虽然产生舒适安抚感），主句unsettles those who encounter it （让接触者感到不安）
B.题目文本翻译
一些机器人，如2008年研发的Justin和2017年研发的TALOS，具有类似人类的特征，比如能够响应语音命令，这样人们会更容易与它们互动。虽然这些特点可以帮助________人们的舒适感，但一个看起来太像人类的机器人可能会陷入“怪异谷”，意味着其外表会让那些遇到它的人感到不安。

question:
In 2015 Filipa Faleiro and colleagues published a study concluding that ocean acidification has a strong effect on the behavior of Hippocampus guttulauts, a species of fish. However, Faleiro and colleagues’study relied on a mean sample size of only 6 fish. In a 2022 review of various scientists’ conclusions about the impacts of ocean acidification on fish behavior, Timothy D. Clark and colleagues caution that relying on such a relatively small sample size can increase the potential for biased analysis. Such analysis, in turn, can contribute to reports of exaggerated effects.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It summarizes a problem that scientists are investigating, then provides a possible solution to that problem.
B. It describes a characteristic of a fish species, then explains why that characteristic is noteworthy.
C. It presents the result of a study, then raises a potential concern related to that result.
D. It states a similarity between two scientific studies, then notes a difference between them.
explanations:
A.中文解析
文本首先展现出研究结果即acidification对鱼类造成的影响，然后提出一个可能的影响结果的事情（a concern about the sample size）
B.题目文本翻译
2015年，Filipa Faleiro及其同事发表了一项研究，得出结论称海洋酸化对斑点海马(Hippocampus guttulauts)的行为有很大影响。然而，Faleiro及其同事的研究仅依赖于平均样本量为6条鱼。在2022年对各种科学家关于海洋酸化对鱼类行为影响的结论进行的回顾中，Timothy D. Clark及其同事警告称，依赖如此相对较小的样本量可能增加偏见分析的潜在可能性。这样的分析反过来可能会导致夸大效果的报告。

question:
Writer Silvia Moreno-Garcia’s love of short fiction began when she read a collection of Edgar Allan Poe stories as a child, and she would develop into a prolific short story writer herself, publishing pieces like “In the Details” (2015) and “Shade of the Ceiba Tree” (2011). Yet she’s best known as a novelist, in part due to her ________ Gothic (2020) earning a spot on the New York Times Best Sellers list.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: Novel修饰Mexican Gothic的具体名字，不用符号分割

question:
Optimal foraging theory (OFT) holds that animals’ foraging behaviors reflect cost-benefit trade-offs that vary by species and with dynamic ecological circumstances. One such circumstance is lunar intensity, which Alexander Lang and colleagues found to be negatively associated with foraging by white-throated round-eared bats but Patricia C. Wright found to be positively associated with foraging by three-striped night monkeys. This discrepancy is explicable in terms of OFT: the monkeys’ greater reliance on vision means that higher lunar intensity benefits them more than it benefits the bats.

According to the text, the difference between Lang and colleagues’ findings and Wright’s findings can be attributed to which difference between white-throated round-eared bats and three-striped night monkeys?
selections: A. The bats are less reliant on vision than the monkeys are.
B. The bats decrease their foraging activity as lunar intensity increases, whereas the monkeys increase their foraging activity.
C. The bats are more vulnerable to predators than the monkeys are.
D. The bats encounter different levels of lunar intensity than the monkeys do.
explanations:
A.中文解析
文本最后一句说明是否依赖视线捕食（reliance on vision）是产生两种差异的主要原因，即依赖vision，那么月光强带来的捕食益处大，也就是A选项的基本含义
B.题目文本翻译
最佳觅食理论（OFT）认为，动物的觅食行为反映了因物种和动态生态环境而异的成本效益权衡。一个这样的情况是月光强度，Alexander Lang及其同事发现，白喉圆耳蝙蝠的觅食与月光强度呈负相关，而Patricia C. Wright发现，三条纹夜猴的觅食与月光强度呈正相关。这种差异可用OFT来解释：猴子更依赖视觉，这意味着较高的月光强度对它们的好处比对蝙蝠的好处更大。

question:
Text 1
According to a study by a conservation group representing 11 tribal nations in the Great Lakes region, the firefly (waawaatesi in the Ojibwe language) will have significantly worse outcomes over the next 50 years if temperatures increase as much as some models suggest. By contrast, the white-tailed deer (waawaashkeshi in Ojibwe) should be able to withstand the highest predicted warming without much harm and so likely won’t require the conservation efforts that the firefly will.
Text2
US government agencies involved in conservation are unfortunately not able to address every possible threat to natural resources. They must use the best information available to decide which species are most threatened and therefore most in need of conservation efforts.

Based on the texts, both authors would most likely agree with which statement?
selections: A. A collaborative approach is necessary to keep temperatures in the Great Lakes region from increasing to the highest predicted levels.
B. Agencies involved in natural-resource management in the Great Lakes region should focus their conservation efforts more on the firefly than on the white tailed deer.
C. Conservation efforts focused on the firefly are more likely to be successful if they incorporate state and federal agency resources with the knowledge of tribal groups in those efforts.
D. State, federal, and tribal groups involved in natural-resource management in the Great Lakes region should immediately begin conservation programs for both the firefly and white-tailed deer.
explanations:
A.中文解析
Text 1对比了两种动物的情况，firefly的处境更加岌岌可危，text 2表达用有限的资源用在最濒危的物种上，于是两篇文章的共同观点是把保护力量更多的用在处境更差的firefly上，和B选项一致。
B.题目文本翻译
文本1
根据代表五大湖地区11个部落的一个保护团体的研究，如果温度增加到一些模型所暗示的程度，萤火虫（Ojibwe语中称为waawaatesi）在未来50年将面临显著更糟的后果。相比之下，白尾鹿（Ojibwe语中称为waawaashkeshi）应该能够承受最高预测的升温而不会受到太大伤害，因此可能不需要像萤火虫那样的保护工作。
文本2
参与保护工作的美国政府机构不幸不能解决所有可能对自然资源构成威胁的问题。他们必须利用现有的最佳信息来决定哪些物种受到最大威胁，因此最需要保护工作。

question:
Women Judges and Magistrates on High Courts, 2009-2013
A report from an international organization that monitors the numbers of women serving as judges or magistrates on various nations’ highest courts, such as the Supreme Court in Sweden and the Supreme Court in Honduras, indicates that among the countries that had a different number of women on these courts in 2013 than they had in 2009, the number increased in some countries but decreased in others. For instance, the number of women judges and magistrates on high courts in ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the example?
selections: A. Honduras was lower in 2013 than in 2009, whereas the number in Sweden was the same in 2013 as in 2009.
B. Kenya was greater in 2013 than in 2009, whereas the number in Honduras was lower in 2013 than in 2009.
C. Kenya was greater in 2013 than in 2009, whereas the number in Sweden was the same in 2013 as in 2009.
D. Sweden was the same in 2013 as in 2009, but it had more women on its high courts than either Kenya or Honduras did in 2013.
explanations:
A.中文解析
文本最后表述the number increased in some countries but decreased in others, 我们要对应图表中Kenya是属于increase，Honduras属于decrease，Sweden不需要考虑，因为2009，2013的数据一样，正确答案B。
B.题目文本翻译
一份来自国际组织的报告监测了各国最高法院，如瑞典最高法院和洪都拉斯最高法院中担任法官或法官的女性人数。报告显示，在那些2013年与2009年女性在这些法院任职人数有所变化的国家中，一些国家的女性人数增加了，而另一些国家则减少了。例如，在______高等法院的女性法官和法官人数增加了。

question:
A speaker at a recent children’s book publishing conference noted that, while many illustrators do excellent work, in her mind, no one has ever ________ Amos Ferguson’s work as the illustrator of Under the Sunday Tree: there is no better example of the form, according to the speaker.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
While引导从句和主句间形成意义的对比，表达虽然many illustrators（插画师）do exellent work，但是，没有人能比得过Amos Ferguson’s work...选项B正确，eclipse可以表达比得过，使逊色等意义；选项中Convene召集，召开；eclipse遮盖，使黯然失色；cite引用；augment增大，强化；
B.题目文本翻译
最近一次儿童图书出版会议上的一位发言者指出，尽管许多插画家做得很出色，但在她看来，没有人能够________阿莫斯·弗格森作为《在周日树下》的插画家的作品：根据这位发言者的观点，这是这种形式的最佳范例。

question:
According to historical documents, Marietta Strozzi—a young woman who was prominent in fifteenth century Florentine culture—inspired several artworks, including a portrait bust sculpted by Desiderio da Settignano. Multiple sculptures dating to the period have been alleged to be the reported bust, but none have been authenticated as Desiderio’s depiction of Strozzi. Given the historical importance of both Strozzi and Desiderio’s sculpture of her, positively identifying the bust would be a notable accomplishment for art historians.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Although there is documentation that Desiderio was commissioned to sculpt the portrait bust of Strozzi, numerous instances of false identification have made art historians skeptical that the sculpture will be uncovered.
B. Although successfully finding and authenticating Desiderio’s portrait bust of Strozzi remains a challenge, the historical importance of the work justifies the continued pursuit of this goal.

C. Although numerous fifteenth-century Florentine portrait busts have been recovered over time, evidence has led art historians to conclude that Desiderio’s bust of Strozzi is likely no longer extant.
D. Although historians strongly suspect that a particular sculpture is Desiderio’s portrait bust of Strozzi, they do not currently have a method for conclusively verifying the artist or subject.
explanations:
A.中文解析
文本第二句转折词but后强调none have been authenticated as Desiderios’ depiction of Strozzi, 说明还无法确定，但是最后一句说positively identifying the bust（半身像）would be a notable accomplishment. 这与B选项意义是一致的，无法确实说明remain a challenge, notable accomplishment说明了historical importance。
B.题目文本翻译
根据历史文件，Marietta Strozzi是15世纪佛罗伦萨文化中备受瞩目的年轻女性，她激发了几件艺术作品，包括Desiderio da Settignano雕刻的肖像胸像。据称，有多个雕塑被认为是那个肖像胸像，但尚未有任何一个被确认为Desiderio对Strozzi的描绘。鉴于Strozzi和Desiderio雕塑的历史重要性，积极确认这个胸像对艺术史学家来说将是一项显著的成就。

question:
Water flowing around an obstruction creates vortices (patterns of swirls) of varying size; by detecting the vortices, fish can determine the size and position of the obstruction. Testing by Yuzo R. Yanagisuru, Otar Akanyeti, and James C. Liao using models of three head shapes—narrow (low ratio of width to length), intermediate, and wide (high ratio of width to length)—showed that for large vortices, fish with intermediate heads would be better able than narrow-headed fish to distinguish between vortices and general turbulence in the water. A second research team has therefore hypothesized that in low-visibility conditions, intermediate-headed fish will be more likely than narrow-headed fish to detect obstructions that create large vortices.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the second research team’s hypothesis?
selections: A. A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that some specimens of the intermediate-headed black sea bass (Centropristis striates) bumped into the obstructions more often than other specimens of the same fish did.

B. A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the narrow-headed flat needlefish (Ablennes hians) bumped into obstructions more often than the intermediate-headed black sea bass (Centropristis striates) did.

C. A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the intermediate-headed black sea bass (Centropristis striates) bumped into the obstructions just as often as the narrow-headed flat needlefish (Ablennes hians) did.

D. A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the flat needlefish (Ablennes hians), which has a relatively narrow head, bumped into more than half of the obstructions.
explanations:
A.中文解析
根据文章最后一句，intermediate-headed fish更能察觉到障碍物，于是更不容易撞到障碍物，也就是说narrow-headed fish更容易 bumped into obstructions.
B.题目文本翻译
水流经障碍物会形成各种大小的涡旋（旋涡图案）；鱼类通过侦测这些涡旋可以确定障碍物的大小和位置。由Yuzo R. Yanagisuru、Otar Akanyeti和James C. Liao进行的实验，使用了三种头部形状模型——窄头（宽度与长度比例低）、中间型和宽头（宽度与长度比例高）——显示，对于大涡旋，具有中间头部的鱼类相较于窄头鱼更能够区分水中的涡旋和一般的湍流。因此，第二个研究团队提出假设，在能见度较低的情况下，中间头部的鱼类比窄头鱼更有可能检测到形成大涡旋的障碍物。

question:
The following text is adapted from Guy de Maupassant’s 1884 short story “A Recollection,” from the collection Guy de Maupassant Short Stories (translated by Albert M.C. MeMaster et al. in 1903). The narrator is taking a boat down the Seine river from Paris, France, to the surrounding countryside.
I took up a position in the bows [front of the boat], standing up and looking at the quays, the trees, the houses and the bridges disappearing behind us. And suddenly I perceived the great viaduct of Point du Jour which blocked the river. It was the end of Paris, the beginning of the country, and behind the double row of arches the Seine, suddenly spreading out as though it had regained space and liberty, became all at once the peaceful river which flows through the plains, alongside the wooded hills, amid the meadows, along the edge of the forests.

Based on the text, which choice best expresses the narrator’s characterization of the Seine?
selections: A. The journey along the Seine is mostly peaceful, but the current intensifies briefly under the Point du Jour.
B. The waters of the Seine are more confined and rough in Paris than they are in the countryside.
C. The Seine is similar to Paris in that it is beautiful and slow to change.
D. As the journey progressed from Paris to the countryside, the waters of the Seine gradually cleared.
explanations:
A.中文解析
Characterization of Seine主要是看文章的前面对于水流描述的对比，the end of Paris，the beginning of the country，水流因为空间开阔变得spreading out， 变得peaceful，这些可以让我们得出在巴黎段更加的confined and rough（狭窄湍急），在乡村段更加平缓开阔。
B.题目文本翻译
以下文字摘自加缪潘的1884年短篇小说《回忆录》，收录于1903年阿尔伯特M.C.麦克马斯特等人翻译的《加缪潘短篇小说集》中。故事中的叙述者正乘船沿塞纳河从法国巴黎前往周边乡村。
我站在船头位置，仰望着码头、树木、房屋和消失在我们身后的桥梁。突然，我看到挡住河道的朱尔角大高架桥。那是巴黎的尽头，乡村的开始，双排拱道后，塞纳河突然扩展开来，仿佛重新获得了空间和自由，瞬间变成了穿过平原、沿着林木覆盖的山丘、在草地中、沿着森林边缘流淌的宁静河流。

question:
Exclusively inhabiting tropical countries such as Tanzania, wild chimpanzees lack adaptations to seasonal variations in ultraviolet B (UVB) irradiance from sunlight, since UVB exposure enables vertebrates to synthesize vitamin D, this raises questions about how chimpanzees in mid-latitude zoos are affected by the lower and more variable UVB irradiance in those locations. In a study of zoo chimpanzees in France and other mid-latitude countries, Sophie Moittie and colleagues found not only that chimpanzees’ vitamin D levels correlate with UVB irradiance but also that vitamin D levels show no evidence of plateauing as UVB irradiance reaches its highest local levels, suggesting that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. adaptations to seasonal variations in UVB irradiance may be emerging in zoo chimpanzees in France and other mid-latitude countries.
B. averaged across seasons, vitamin D levels in zoo chimpanzees in mid-latitude countries such as France tend to be comparable to those in wild chimpanzees in tropical countries such as Tanzania.
C. providing supplemental vitamin D to chimpanzees in zoos in France and other mid-latitude countries would likely not be beneficial.
D. zoo chimpanzees in France and other mid-latitude countries tend to synthesize less vitamin D than they are inherently capable of synthesizing.
explanations:
A.中文解析
文章的前提是chimpanzees 缺乏对UVB变化的适应性，而UVB会和vitamin D levels相关，文本最后一句指出VD levels和UVB相关，同时当UVB达到当地顶峰值，vitamin D level没有达到plateauing（即没有稳定在高峰值），这就说明UVB当前值还没有到大猩猩合成能力的顶峰值，chimpanzees此时还有能力继续合成vitamin D，和D选项一致。
B.题目文本翻译
独自栖息在坦桑尼亚等热带国家的野生黑猩猩缺乏适应日照中紫外B辐射季节变化的适应性，因为紫外B照射使脊椎动物能够合成维生素D，这引发了关于中纬度动物园内的黑猩猩如何受到这些地点更低且更不稳定的紫外B辐射的影响的问题。在一项针对法国和其他中纬度国家动物园黑猩猩的研究中，Sophie Moittie和同事发现黑猩猩的维生素D水平与紫外B辐射强度相关，而且维生素D水平在紫外B辐射强度达到当地最高水平时并没有出现平台化的证据，这表明________

question:
Though most hoaxes perpetrated as jokes by mischievous users of Wikipedia, an online encyclopedia that almost anyone can freely edit, have quickly been detected and removed, a few entries that knowledgeable readers should have realized were ________, such as those for the country singer-songwriter Joseph G. Williams and the television miniseries Sheer Perfection, persisted on the site for many years before they were finally recognized as falsehoods and deleted.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
Though引导从句和主句间形成对比意义，前面讲到一些错误的词很快被删除了，后面则是一些虚假错误的东西多年后才被识别和删除，选项A正确，Spurious谬误，虚假，scrupulous正直，一丝不苟，palpable明显的，compulsory强制的
B.题目文本翻译
虽然大多数由调皮的维基百科用户恶作剧而制造的骗局很快被发现并删除，但一些条目却在网站上持续存在多年，直到最终被承认为虚假并删除，而明智的读者应该意识到这些条目是________，比如乡村歌手约瑟夫·G·威廉斯和电视迷你剧《完美无瑕》的条目。

question:
Psychologists Gregory Bryant, Dorsa Amir, and colleagues investigated cross-cultural perceptions of spontaneous (real) laughter and volitional (fake or forced) laughter. Study participants from 21 societies, including those in Austria and Turkey, listened to randomized recordings of 18 spontaneous laughs taken from natural conversations between pairs of women and 18 volitional laughs produced separately by 18 different women in response to an experimenter’s instruction to laugh. Analysis of the participants’ evaluations of the laughs prompted the team to conclude that the ability to distinguish between spontaneous and volitional laughter appears to be universal across cultures.

Which quotation from a psychologist not involved in the team’s study would most directly weaken the team’s conclusion?
selections: A. “When an individual chooses to produce volitional laughter in a natural social context, the laughter often shares certain acoustic qualities, such as pitch and fluctuation of intensity, with spontaneous laughter.”

B. “Although the team considered the average size of communities in each society in the study, that demographic factor was found to have no effect on listeners’ identifications of laughter as spontaneous or volitional.”
C. “Judgments of spontaneous laughter are often associated with acoustic features such as greater intensity variability and higher pitch.”
D. “Recent studies in communications have shown that certain acoustic features of spontaneous laughter, such as pitch and intensity, are consistent both within and across societies.”
explanations:
A.中文解析
文中的结论the ability to distinguish between spontaneous and volitional laughter appears to be universal across cultures。有两个重点，一是文本默认了人们有区分真笑和假笑的能力（the ability to distinguish）；二是文本认为能力在文化间都普遍存在 universal across cultures。所以，我们反驳的时候可以从以下方式反驳：
反驳方式1：人们没有能力区分自发的笑和假装的笑（diss the ability）
反驳方式2：区分自发的笑和假装的笑并不是普遍存在于文化中的，有些文化中有，有些文化中没有（diss universal across cultures）
A选项表示当个体产生刻意的笑（volitional laughter）会和自发的笑（spontaneous laughter）有很多共通特征，说明人们不能够区分真笑假笑，所以是正确答案。
B.题目文本翻译
心理学家Gregory Bryant、Dorsa Amir和他们的同事调查了跨文化对于自发（真实）笑声和蓄意（虚假或迫使）笑声的认知。来自21个社会的研究参与者，包括奥地利和土耳其，听取了18段自然对话中女性之间的自发笑声和18段由18位不同女性根据实验者的指示单独制作的蓄意笑声的随机录音。对参与者对笑声的评价进行分析后，团队得出结论：跨文化中，区分自发笑声和蓄意笑声的能力似乎是普遍存在的。

question:
Arthurian legends (tales related to the character of King Arthur) derive from many sources, such as Annales Cambriae, composed around 970, and Perceval, the Story of the Grail from around 1181. One of the most significant sources, Geoffrey of Monmouth’s History of the Kings of Britain, was written in Latin in the 1130s; some material from it was later adapted by the Norman poet Wace into the Roman de Brut in 1155. But while no source before 1155 includes references to the famous Round Table at which Arthur’s knights assembled, both the Roman de Brut and Sir Thomas Malory’s 15th-century compilation of Arthurian legends, Le Morte d’Arthur, do. It can therefore be inferred that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. Geoffrey of Monmouth was unaware of stories of the Round Table when composing his History, though historians know that works containing such stories were available to him.
B. Le Morte d’Arthur is more historically accurate than History, because Perceval, the Story of the Grail had not been written when Geoffrey of Monmouth was writing his work.
C. Malory did not use Annales Cambriae as a source for information he presented about the Round Table.

D. Geoffrey of Monmouth’s accounts of Arthurian legends in his History are more similar overall in content to the accounts in Perceval, the Story of the Grail than they are to the accounts in Roman de Brut.
explanations:
A.中文解析
Annales Cambriae 创作于970年，早于1155年，于是不会有reference to the Round Table，因此15世纪Malory创作中呈现Round Table不可能用Annales Cambriae 作为自己的source。选择C选项。
B.题目文本翻译
亚瑟王传奇（与亚瑟王角色相关的故事）源自许多来源，如大约970年编写的《威尔士年鉴》和大约1181年的《珀西瓦尔，圣杯传说》。最重要的来源之一是杰弗里·蒙茅斯的拉丁文著作《不列颠诸王史》，写于1130年代；其中的一些材料后来被诺曼诗人瓦斯在1155年改编成《不鲁特传》。然而，在1155年之前的任何来源中都没有提到亚瑟的骑士们聚集在著名的圆桌前，但《不鲁特传》和托马斯·马洛里在15世纪编撰的亚瑟王传奇集《亚瑟王之死》中有。因此可以推断出________

question:
Writer Lydia Davis observed that while traditional literary forms, such as the novel, are recognizable as such even as they evolve, there are more ________ forms that might, for example, borrow elements from both fables and realist narratives to make something unconventional. The late-period pieces of James Tate arguably fit in this category, since they straddle the line between prose and poetry.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
While引导的从句和主句之间形成对比关系，traditional literary forms are recognizable, 反过来，unconventional forms are more amorphous，也就是有些非传统的形式难以识别，借鉴不同的文体。没有固定的形态选择amorphous。Dispersed散布的customary习俗的 Amorphous无定型的，无组织 neutral 中立的
B.题目文本翻译
作家Lydia Davis观察到，尽管传统文学形式，如小说，在演变过程中仍然是可识别的，但也存在更为________的形式，例如可以从寓言和现实主义叙事中借鉴元素来创作出与众不同的作品。詹姆斯·泰特的晚期作品可以说属于这一类别，因为它们跨越了散文和诗歌之间的界限。

question:
With one in Finland and another in Japan, the observatory sites that form the Super Dual Auroral Radar ________ or SuperDARN, as space physicists like Tadahiko Ogawa call it—number nearly five dozen. Located across the globe, the radars track gravity waves and other geospace phenomena.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 双破折号连用的情景

question:
With their distinctive cone shapes and steeply sloping sides, the volcanoes Maungarei (New Zealand) and Fisher (Alaska) may look similar from afar. Pranabendu Moitra and other volcanologists, ________ can tell by how each was formed that Maungarei is a cinder cone volcano, while Fisher is a composite volcano.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
A.中文解析
第一句是两种火山的相近之处，第二句则是能够分清其不同的类比，是对比关系。选择though
B.题目文本翻译
凭借其独特的锥形和陡峭的斜坡，从远处看，新西兰的 Maungarei 火山和阿拉斯加的 Fisher 火山可能看起来相似。普拉纳本杜·莫伊特拉和其他火山学家，通过每座火山的形成方式可以判断，Maungarei 是一座烟丘火山，而 Fisher 是一座复合火山。

question:
The Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) tracks comparative price list data for its thirty-eight member countries. For instance, in July 2021, a hypothetical basket of goods priced at 100 US dollars (USD) in the United States would have cost 39 USD and 130 USD in fellow OECD ________ and Iceland, respectively.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: OECD nations修饰Colombia and Iceland不用符号分割

question:
The Quadrantid meteor shower has a zenithal hourly rate (ZHR) of 110, meaning that at the shower’s peak 110 meteors per hour could potentially be seen by a hypothetical observer. A calculation that assumes ideal viewing conditions, ________

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. the number of meteors an actual viewer observes in an hour may differ considerably from the ZHR.
B. there may be a considerable difference between the number of meteors an actual viewer observes in an hour and the ZHR.
C. an actual viewer’s observed number of meteors in an hour and the ZHR may differ considerably.
D. the ZHR may differ considerably from the number of meteors an actual viewer observes in an hour.
explanations: 这是一个dangling structure, 我们需要让主句的主语和前面的a calculation that assumes ideal viewing conditions 保持一致,那么主语就是前文铺垫的ZHR，于是选择D

question:
The title of “Of Moderation,” an essay by French philosopher Michel de Montaigne, suggests a straightforward topic. However, Montaigne’s expansive, curious mind meant that he never limited himself to one subject. ________ the essay is not just a discussion of moderation but a broad exploration of Montaigne’s entire worldview.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
A.中文解析
文本第二句说not limited to one subject, 第三句说的是not just...but 呼应了前面的not limited to one subject,所以选择predictably。
B.题目文本翻译
法国哲学家米歇尔·德·蒙田的散文《论节制》的标题暗示了一个直接的主题。然而，蒙田那种广泛而好奇的心灵意味着他从未局限于一个主题。因此，这篇散文不仅仅是关于节制的讨论，而是对蒙田整个世界观的广泛探索。

question:
Within Earth’s biomes, there are four main types of desert: arid, semiarid, coastal, and cold. The Australian Desert in Australasia is an arid ________ it is one of the largest such deserts in the world, with a total area of about 2,700,000 km2.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 分号用于分割完整句子，第二句和第一句间是例证关系，于是However需要放在第二句内。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Modularity of mind is the notion that the mind is at least partly composed of innate neural structures (modules) that perform fast, necessary tasks.
• 1983: cognitive scientist Jerry A. Fodor hypothesized that low-level cognitive systems (e.g., perception, language) are modular.
• In Fodorian modularity, high-level systems (e.g., reasoning) are not modular
• 2003: cognitive scientist Peter Carruthers proposed the massive modularity hypothesis (MMH).
• MMH expands modularity to include all cognitive systems.

The student wants to compare Fodor’s hypothesis with Carruthers’s. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In considering some but not all cognitive systems modular, Fodorian modularity is not as expansive in its definition of modularity as MMH is.
B. The hypotheses of Fodor and Carruthers differ in whether they consider low level cognitive systems, such as perception and language, modular.
C. In 2003, Carruthers proposed the massive modularity hypothesis, disagreeing with Fodor’s earlier hypothesis that the mind is composed of innate neural structures.
D. Following Fodor’s 1983 hypothesis, Carruthers proposed that modularity of mind includes all cognitive systems.
explanations:
A.中文解析
Fodorian modularity 猜想只包含了low-level cognitive systems, 但是Peter Carruthers的MMH猜想则包括了all cognitive systems, 正如A选项所讲Fodorian modularity is not as expansive as definition of MMH (Carruther’s)
B.题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一个学生已经做了以下笔记：
- 头脑的模块化是一个概念，即头脑至少部分由执行快速、必要任务的先天神经结构（模块）组成。
- 1983年：认知科学家杰瑞·A·福多尔提出低层认知系统（例如，感知、语言）是模块化的假设。
- 在福多尔的模块化理论中，高层系统（例如，推理）不是模块化的。
- 2003年：认知科学家彼得·卡鲁瑟斯提出了大规模模块化假设（MMH）。
- MMH将模块化扩展到所有认知系统。

question:
Though he’s performed on many respected albums, including DBIII: Live at the Cotton Club Tokyo by Dean Brown, drummer Dennis Chambers may be best known for his time as house drummer for the hip-hop label Sugar Hill Records. He did not play drums on the label’s classic song “Rapper’s Delight,” ________ joined the label after the song’s release.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: However作为副词，表示所在句和前一句间的转折关系。本段话第二句和第一句间是转折关系，于是句号需要用在however后面，才能表达一二句间的转折关系。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• There are more than 500 National Wildlife Refuges (NWRs) across the United States.
• The Mason Neck NWR is a 2,276-acre area in Virginia, on the Atlantic coast.
• It was established to protect the endangered bald eagle.
• The Coachella Valley NWR is a 3,592-acre area in California, on the Pacific coast.
• It was established to protect the endangered Coachella Valley fringe-toed lizard.

The student wants to provide an overview of the NWR program. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Both the Mason Neck NWR and the Coachella Valley NWR were established to protect endangered species.
B. One of more than 500 NWRs in the US, the Mason Neck NWR encompasses 2,276 acres in Virginia.
C. The US’s more than 500 NWRs protect endangered species from coast to coast.
D. California’s Coachella Valley NWR was established to protect the endangered Coachella Valley fringe-toed lizard.
explanations:
A.中文解析
题目要求an overview of the NWR program，C选项描述了整体数量，功能与地理位置，符合要求。
B.题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一个学生已经做了以下笔记：
- 美国有500多个国家野生动物保护区（NWRs）。
- 梅森颈国家野生动物保护区是位于弗吉尼亚州大西洋海岸的一个占地2,276英亩的区域。
- 它建立的目的是保护濒临灭绝的白头海雕。
- 科切拉谷国家野生动物保护区是位于加利福尼亚州太平洋海岸的一个占地3,592英亩的区域。
- 它建立的目的是保护濒临灭绝的科切拉谷边缘蜥蜴。

question:
• Vexillology is the study of flags.
• The flags of many countries include symbols like animals, plants, or landforms.
• These symbols often represent an aspect of the region’s history, culture, or landscape.
• The flag of Cyprus includes an olive branch.
• The flag of Andorra includes a cow.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to make and support a generalization about symbols on flags?
selections: A. Many countries feature symbols on their flags, and the study of these designs is known as vexillology.
B. Cyprus’s flag includes an olive branch, a symbol that is important to that country’s national identity.
C. The flags of some countries include symbols of plants; Cyprus’s, for example, includes an olive branch.
D. Vexillology is the study of flags; accordingly, vexillologists are interested in flags from around the world.
explanations:
A.中文解析
题目要求是make and support a generalization, 于是需要先generalization，再给出supporting evidence，C符合要求，因为显示是generalization普遍描述，后面是具体的example，即supporting。
B.题目文本翻译
- 旗帜学是研究旗帜的学科。
- 许多国家的旗帜包括动物、植物或地貌等象征。
- 这些象征通常代表着该地区的历史、文化或景观的一部分。
- 塞浦路斯的国旗上包括一个橄榄枝。
- 安道尔的国旗上包括一头牛。

question:
In a 2022 analysis, researchers investigated how negative adjectives like “unhappy” evolve. ________ the researchers applied a statistical model to a set of words to infer the rate of cognate replacement—the rate at which a word will be replaced over time with a noncognate form—in Indo-European languages.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
A.中文解析
前后两句是一致的内容，后一句相较前一句更加的细致，于是选择specifically
B.题目文本翻译
在一项2022年的分析中，研究人员调查了诸如“unhappy”这样的负面形容词是如何演变的。研究人员应用了统计模型对一组单词进行分析，以推断印欧语系语言中同源替换的速率——即一个词随着时间被非同源形式替代的速率。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Singuilucan is a municipality in the state of Hidalgo, Mexico.
• Municipalities are governmental regions responsible for providing many public services to their residents.
• One service they provide is water treatment.
• Singuilucan covers an area of roughly 420 km2.

explanations:

在研究一个主题时，一个学生已经做了以下笔记：
- Singuilucan是墨西哥伊达尔戈州的一个市镇。

- 伊达尔戈州分为84个市镇。

question: A district school board in a certain state is proposing a change to the length of lunch periods for all high schools in the district. A sample of 365 high school students was selected at random from all high school students in the district. The selected students were asked whether they approved of the proposed change, and 211 students responded that they did not approve. Which of the following is the largest population to which the results of the survey can begeneralized?
selections: A. All high school students in the district
B. The 365 students who were surveyed
C. All high school students in the state
D. The 211 students who responded that they did not approve of the proposed change

question: A biologist is designing a study to observe the behavior of male and female amethyst-throated hummingbirds. According to the study’s design, at least 91 hummingbirds will be observed, and the positive difference between the number of males, x, and the number females, y, will not exceed 8. Which of the following systems of inequalities represents this situation?
selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnalign="right left right left right left right left right left right left" columnspacing="0em 2em 0em 2em 0em 2em 0em 2em 0em 2em 0em" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="3pt"><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>⩾</mo><mn>91</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd><mi></mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>y</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>⩽</mo><mn>8</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>

B. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnalign="right left right left right left right left right left right left" columnspacing="0em 2em 0em 2em 0em 2em 0em 2em 0em 2em 0em" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="3pt"><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>⩾</mo><mn>91</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>⩽</mo><mn>8</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>

C. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnalign="right left right left right left right left right left right left" columnspacing="0em 2em 0em 2em 0em 2em 0em 2em 0em 2em 0em" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="3pt"><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>⩽</mo><mn>91</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>⩽</mo><mn>8</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>

D. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtable columnalign="right left right left right left right left right left right left" columnspacing="0em 2em 0em 2em 0em 2em 0em 2em 0em 2em 0em" displaystyle="true" rowspacing="3pt"><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>⩽</mo><mn>91</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd></mtd><mtd><mi></mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>y</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>⩽</mo><mn>8</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>
explanations: 根据题意，公母蜂鸟之和至少91，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>91</mn></math>，数量差不大于8，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>y</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mn>8</mn></math>，故选A

question: Ari examined a set of 85 plants.The lightest plant had a mass of 2.8 kilograms kg and the heaviest plant had a mass of 6.2 kg.
