question: For the polynomial function v, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>v</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>3</mn></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>v</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>13</mn></math>. The graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>v</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> in the <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi> </mrow> <mo>−</mo> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi> </mrow></math>passes through the points (-2, 7) and (6, 0). Which of the following must be true?
selections: A. When <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>v</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> is divided by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>13</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, the remainder is 0

B. When <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>v</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> is divided by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, the remainder is -2.

C. When <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>v</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>is divided by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, the remainder is 3.

D. When <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>v</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>is divided by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, the remainder is 0.
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>v</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>3</mn></math>,可知函数除以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>余数为3，根据（-2，7）可知函数除以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>余数为7，根据（6，0）可以得到函数有一个因式是<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>，故选D

question:
Though many ________ studies of the effect of altitude on blood chemistry focus on people who live above sea level, researchers Suleiman A. Al-Sweedan and Moath Alhaj recently chose the novel path of focusing on people who live below sea level, in locations such as the California towns of Bombay Beach and Imperial.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
尽管许多_____关于海拔对血液化学影响的研究集中在生活在海平面以上的人群，但研究人员阿尔-斯威丹和穆阿特·阿尔哈吉最近选择了一条新颖的路径，专注于生活在海平面以下的人群，例如加利福尼亚的博姆拜海滩和帝国镇。
中文解析
虽然传统研究关注高海波地带对blood chemistry产生的影响，但是研究者选了一个新的关注点，那就是低于海平面的地带，traditional 和novel path形成了反义词对比

question:
In 2023 literary scholar Jeremy Douglass cautioned technology investors and enthusiasts who predict conventional books’ ultimate displacement by newer forms of media. Douglass observed that the concept of an “interactive” text is much older than technologists assume, extending back to the first time readers scratched notes into a text’s margins. In addition, newer media, such as video games, haven’t replaced older forms of entertainment, such as comic books, but rather exist alongside them. Douglass believes that rather than supplanting books, technology is simply making new forms of expression possible.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It explains the basis for the claim made by the technologists mentioned in the text.
B. It suggests that academics are better suited than investors to see the potential uses of contemporary interactive texts.
C. It challenges the stance of the investors and enthusiasts who are mentioned earlier in the text.
D. It provides a historical anecdote about the technological challenges involved in reading the earliest interactive texts.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在2023年，文学学者杰里米·道格拉斯警告那些预测传统书籍最终会被新媒体形式取代的技术投资者和爱好者。道格拉斯观察到，“互动”文本的概念比技术专家假设的要古老得多，早在读者第一次在文本边缘划上笔记的时候就已经存在。此外，视频游戏等新媒体并没有取代漫画书等旧娱乐形式，而是与它们并存。道格拉斯认为，技术并不是在取代书籍，而是让新的表达形式成为可能。
中文解析
第一句说传统书籍会被替代，但是划线句则指出传统书籍的有点“interactive”特质远比大家想到的时间更早，那么就是在证明传统书籍的有点特质，反驳第一句，于是对应了C选项

question:
The following text is from Jerome K. Jerome’s 1889 novel Three Men in a Boat (To Say Nothing of the Dog). The narrator and two friends are taking a boat down the River Thames in England.
In a boat, I have always noticed that it is the fixed idea of each member of the crew that he is doing everything. Harris’s notion was, that it was he alone who had been working, and that both George and I had been imposing upon him. George, on the other hand, ridiculed the idea of Harris’s having done anything more than eat and sleep, and had a cast-iron opinion that it was he—George himself—who had done all the labour worth speaking of.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. The narrator recognizes that Harris’s and George’s attitudes are typical of how crew members view their own contributions on boats.
B. The narrator has recognized that Harris spends most of his time eating and sleeping.
C. Everyone in the group has been given tasks to do, but the narrator hasn’t been willing to complete his.
D. The amount of work that needs to be done on the boat is likely more than the narrator, George, and Harris can handle.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文本摘自杰罗姆·K·杰罗姆1889年的小说《三个人在船上（不谈狗）》。叙述者和两个朋友正在英国的泰晤士河上划船。
在船上，我总是注意到每个船员都有一个固定的想法，那就是他自己在做所有的事情。哈里斯认为，只有他一个人在工作，而乔治和我则在占他的便宜。另一方面，乔治嘲笑哈里斯除了吃和睡以外做过任何事情的想法，并坚信是他——乔治自己——做了所有值得一提的劳动。
中文解析
段落结构是总分式，于是第一句表明narrator观察到crew member总觉得自己做了所有的活儿，此后句子具体用Harris and George来进行了支持自己的观点，对应了A选项。

question:
Women like Grace Murray Hopper made important early contributions to the history of US cryptology, a field concerned with secure data communication and storage. Hopper was a US naval admiral and computer scientist who coined the term “debugging” and invented the first compiler program for translating computer code. In this way, Hopper and others like her helped make it possible for more women—such as Anna Lysyanskaya, who currently works in and teaches digital cryptography—to enter the field of cryptology.

According to the text, what is one similarity between Hopper and Lysyanskaya?
selections: A. They both founded organizations that encourage women to pursue careers in cryptology.
B. They both have contributed to the field of cryptology.
C. They both have worked in the field of history.
D. They both have argued that more US schools should teach the history of cryptology.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
像格蕾丝·穆里·霍普（Grace Murray Hopper）这样的女性在美国密码学的历史上做出了重要的早期贡献，密码学是一个与安全数据通信和存储有关的领域。霍普是一位美国海军上将和计算机科学家，她创造了“调试”（debugging）这个术语，并发明了第一个用于翻译计算机代码的编译程序。通过这种方式，霍普和她的同类为更多女性进入密码学领域铺平了道路，比如安娜·利西亚斯卡娅（Anna Lysyanskaya），她目前在数字密码学方面工作并教授相关课程。
中文解析
文本对两个人物态度积极，共同特点是各自对于cryptology（加密学）作出了重要贡献。

question:
Businesses selling clothing and other fashion items face obstacles in trying to forecast how much product to order: tastes and styles change quickly, while manufacturing clothing takes a significant amount of time. Researchers Youran Fu and Marshall Fisher have found that combining sellers’ own data with information gathered from social media can dramatically improve the accuracy of such forecasts—by 24 to 57 percent in the cases they directly studied. Better predictions mean demand is easier to meet without retailers becoming overstocked.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Becoming overstocked is the main preoccupation of sellers trying to forecast demand for fashion items.
B. Social media is revolutionizing how both sellers and researchers view the fashion industry.
C. Using multiple data sources can enhance the ability of sellers in the fashion industry to anticipate demand.
D. Retailers can use their own data to accurately predict how tastes and styles are evolving.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
销售服装和其他时尚商品的企业在预测订单数量时面临诸多障碍：消费者的品味和风格变化迅速，而制造服装需要相当长的时间。研究人员傅有然和马歇尔·费舍尔发现，将卖家的自身数据与社交媒体上收集的信息相结合，可以显著提高预测的准确性——在他们直接研究的案例中，准确性提高了24%到57%。更好的预测意味着零售商更容易满足需求，而不会出现库存过剩的情况。
中文解析
本段话中强调了结合sellers的数据和social media数据，于是对应C选项的multiple data sources，最后一句better predictions meet need，对应了C选项的anticipate demand。

question:
At the turn of the twentieth century, Black residents of Richmond, Virginia, had few formal options for banking and other financial services. To ________ this situation, Maggie Lena Walker chartered the St. Luke Penny Savings Bank in 1903. The bank went on to provide home loans and savings opportunities to thousands of Black families over the following decades.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在20世纪初，弗吉尼亚州里士满的黑人居民在银行和其他金融服务方面几乎没有正式选择。为了解决这一情况，玛吉·莉娜·沃克于1903年创办了圣卢克便士储蓄银行。该银行在接下来的几十年里为成千上万的黑人家庭提供了住房贷款和储蓄机会。
中文解析
“rectify”意为纠正或修复一种情况。句子表明，Maggie的目标是通过创办圣卢克便士储蓄银行来改善当时在弗吉尼亚州里士满的黑人居民所能获得的有限银行服务选项。

question:
“A Pair of Silk Stockings” is an 1897 short story written by Kate Chopin. In describing the character of Mrs. Sommers, Chopin emphasizes the uniqueness of Mrs. Sommers’s perspective: ________

Which quotation from “A Pair of Silk Stockings” most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “For a day or two she walked about apparently in a dreamy state, but really absorbed in speculation and calculation.”
B. “She had no time—no second of time to devote to the past. The needs of the present absorbed her every faculty.”

C. “It is safe to say there was no one present who bore quite the attitude which Mrs. Sommers did to her surroundings. She gathered in the whole—stage and players and people in one wide impression, and absorbed it and enjoyed it.”
D. “She wanted an excellent and stylish fit, she told the young fellow who served her, and she did not mind the difference of a dollar or two more in the price so long as she got what she desired.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译
《一双丝绸长袜》是凯特·肖邦于1897年创作的短篇小说。在描写萨默斯夫人的性格时，肖邦强调了萨默斯夫人视角的独特性：________
中文解析
文本要求强调Mrs. Sommer观点uniqueness，于是C符合，C选项指出no one bear attitude like her,证明了其观点独一无二。

question:
The following text is from Maria Amparo Ruiz de Burton’s 1885 novel The Squatter and the Don. In the novel, Clarence and Mercedes develop a romantic relationship.
Mercedes, being not quite seventeen, her grief at parting from Clarence was wild, vehement and all-absorbing. But she had been trained to obedience, and her battles with the spirit always took place after she carefully locked her bedroom door. Then Clarence was wildly apostrophized, and a torrent of tears relieved the overcharged, aching heart.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. It emphasizes Mercedes’s extreme insecurity.
B. It suggests that the magnitude of Mercedes’s feelings are unusual for her age.
C. It provides background explaining why Clarence has left Mercedes.
D. It conveys how Mercedes handles her intense feelings about being separated from Clarence.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文本摘自玛丽亚·安帕罗·鲁伊斯·德·伯顿1885年的小说《佃农与唐人》。在这部小说中，克拉伦斯和梅赛德斯发展了一段浪漫关系。
梅赛德斯年仅十七岁，因与克拉伦斯的离别而感到极度悲痛，情绪激烈，无法自持。但她已被训练成顺从，所有的内心斗争总是在她小心锁上卧室的门后进行。此时，她会疯狂地呼唤克拉伦斯，泪水如潮水般涌出，缓解了那颗承受着过多痛苦的心。
中文解析
核心人物Mercedes和自己的恋人分开后，充满悲伤（grief），转折词but之后是她关上门后的情感行为描述，对应了D选项handles her intense feeling

question:
Tarawa, with a population of roughly 30,000 people, ________ home to an impressive 29 percent of Kiribati’s  total population.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主语Tarawa是单数，对应选is

question:
The Gleaners, painted in the realist style by Jean-François Millet, depicts peasants picking stray wheat from a field after the harvest. The realists emphasis on accurately portraying the experiences of average working people was largely a rejection of the romantic style evident in many paintings by Horace Vernet, which instead ________ their subjects’ beauty or heroism while hiding all imperfection.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
《拾穗者》是让-弗朗索瓦·米勒以现实主义风格创作的，描绘了农民在收获后从田野中捡拾遗落的小麦的场景。现实主义者强调准确描绘普通劳动人民的经历，这在很大程度上是对霍拉斯·维尔奈许多画作中可见的浪漫主义风格的拒绝，后者则_______其主题的美丽或英雄主义，同时掩盖所有的不完美。
中文解析
文本进行了现实主义和浪漫主义绘画的对比，两者各自强调的内容不一样，emphasis on的同意表达accentuate。

question:
Whatever the general attitude toward Spike Lee’s 1992 film Malcolm X and Carl Franklin’s 1995 film Devil in a Blue Dress when they were initially released, both films now tend to be regarded quite ________. In 2018, for example, critics for the New York Times praised the former as “electrifying” and the latter as “picture-perfect. ”

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
无论人们在最初观看斯派克·李1992年的电影《马尔科姆·X》和卡尔·富兰克林1995年的电影《蓝衣女魔头》时持有什么样的态度，如今这两部电影往往被认为相当______。例如，在2018年，《纽约时报》的评论家称前者为“令人振奋的”，后者为“完美无瑕的”。
中文解析
文本态度积极，favorably在段落中线索词有同意表达praise

question:

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:

增加道路容量可能看起来是解决交通拥堵的显而易见的方案，但众多研究对这种方法的______提出了质疑。额外的道路容量不仅往往无法缓解拥堵，还可能通过鼓励更多人开车而使交通情况变得更糟。
中文解析
Efficacy表示有效性，增加道路容量看似是解决方案，但是很容研究质疑该方式的有效性。

question:
Sociologist Todd Gitlin co-opted the term “recombinant,” normally used in reference to genetic engineering, to describe serialized television shows of the 1980s. Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 第一个句子：Gitlin’s use是的主语，referenced是谓语，第二个句子：shows是主语，attracted是谓语，两个句之间用分号连接

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: Its代指前面的museum’s

question:
Australia ratified the Outer Space Treaty, an international agreement with over 100 signing nations that acts as the foundation for the laws of space, on January 27, 1967. Colombia signed the treaty; ________ it has yet to officially ratify it.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:

澳大利亚于1967年1月27日批准了《外层空间条约》，这是一个超过100个签署国的国际协议，构成了太空法律的基础。哥伦比亚签署了该条约；然而，它尚未正式批准。
中文解析
Colombia签署了合约，但是还没有官方正式批准（ratify），前后是对比转折关系。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● The Museu de les Ciències Principe Felipe is in Valencia, Spain.
● It is home to a Foucault pendulum
● Vasile Alecsandri National College is in Galati, Romania.
● It is home to a Foucault pendulum.
● A Foucault pendulum dangles from a fixed point that ensures the swing path of the pendulum doesn’t change.
● To an observer, the swing path of a Foucault pendulum appears to change over time because Earth rotates beneath it.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two locations. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Because Earth rotates beneath it, the swing path of the Foucault pendulum at the Museu de les Ciències Príncipe Felipe appears to change over time.
B. The Museu de les Ciències Principe Felipe, which is home to a Foucault pendulum, is in Spain, not Romania.
C. The Museu de les Ciències Principe Felipe in Valencia, Spain, and Vasile Alecsandri National College in Galati, Romania, both house Foucault pendulums.
D. One Foucault pendulum is in Spain, and the other is in Romania.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
● 菲利普王子科学博物馆位于西班牙瓦伦西亚。
● 这里有一个傅科摆。
● 瓦西勒·阿列克桑德里国家学院位于罗马尼亚加拉兹。
● 这里也有一个傅科摆。
● 傅科摆悬挂在一个固定点上，确保摆的摆动路径不会改变。
● 对观察者来说，傅科摆的摆动路径随着时间的推移似乎在变化，因为地球在其下方旋转。
中文解析
题目要求强调两个地点的相似，于是C符合要求，both house ...指明了两个地点的相似处

question:
In her 2012 analysis of tree rings from Japan’s Yaku Island, cosmic ray physicist Fusa Miyake noted an anomalous carbon-14 spike dating to 774-775 CE, indicating that a massive burst of radiation reached Earth during that time. ________ this unprecedented radiocarbon surge was dubbed a “Miyake event” in honor of its discoverer.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在她对日本屋久岛的树木年轮进行的2012年分析中，宇宙射线物理学家宫崎扶佐注意到一个异常的碳-14峰值，追溯到公元774-775年，这表明在那个时期一场大规模的辐射爆发到达了地球。________ 这个前所未有的放射碳激增事件被称为“宫崎事件”，以纪念其发现者。
中文解析
前文和后文描述的是同一件事，没有转折对比，后门给前文的发现一个合适的命名，选择fittingly表示合适地，恰当地

question:
● Minor planets are astronomical objects that orbit the Sun but are neither planets nor comets.
● Astronomer Jane Luu has discovered many minor planets in her career.
● Alongside colleague David C. Jewitt, she discovered the minor planet (15836) 1995 DA2 on February 24,1995.
● Alongside colleagues David C. Jewitt, Chadwick Trujillo, and K. Berney, she discovered the minor planet (24952) 1997 QJ4 on August 28, 1997.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize the discovery of (15836) 1995 DA2 to an audience already familiar with Jane Luu?
selections: A. First there was the discovery of (15836) 1995 DA2 on February 24, 1995, and then on August 28, 1997, Jane Luu discovered yet another minor planet with the help of her colleagues David C. Jewitt, Chadwick Trujillo, and K. Berney.
B. Astronomer Jane Luu helped discover not only the minor planet (15836) 1995 DA2 on February 24,1995, but also (24952) 1997 QJ4 on August 28, 1997.
C. Jane Luu is an astronomer famous for her discovery of many minor planets in our solar system, including (15836) 1995 DA2.
D. On February 24,1995, Jane Luu and her colleague David C. Jewitt made the exciting discovery of the minor planet (15836) 1995 DA2.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
● 小行星是绕太阳 orbit 的天体，但既不是行星也不是彗星。
● 天文学家简·卢（Jane Luu）在她的职业生涯中发现了许多小行星。
● 她与同事大卫·C·朱伊特（David C. Jewitt）于1995年2月24日发现了小行星（15836）1995 DA2。
● 她与同事大卫·C·朱伊特、查德威克·特鲁希略（Chadwick Trujillo）和K·伯尼（K. Berney）于1997年8月28日发现了小行星（24952）1997 QJ4。
中文解析
题目要求emphasize the discovery of (15836) 1995 DA2 to an audience already familiar with Jane Luu，于是选项无需介绍Jane Luu，其次选项要强调(15836) 1995 DA2，D符合要求，尤其是exciting discovery起到了强调作用，其它选项要么没有强调(15836) 1995 DA2，要么过多介绍了Jane Luu。

question:
● Soo-Bong Kim is a South Korean particle physicist.
● Particle physicists study subatomic particles.
● Neutrinos are some of the least understood subatomic particles.
● Kim is known for his research on neutrino oscillations.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to specify what type of neutrino research Kim is known for?
selections: A. Neutrinos are a type of subatomic particle that particle physicists are still trying to understand.
B. Soo-Bong Kim, whose research involves particle physics, is from South Korea.
C. In the ongoing pursuit to better understand these subatomic particles, particle physicist Soo-Bong Kim is known for his research on neutrino oscillations.
D. One scientist who has worked to advance our understanding of neutrinos is the South Korean particle physicist Soo-Bong Kim.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
● 金秀璋（Soo-Bong Kim）是一位韩国粒子物理学家。
● 粒子物理学家研究亚原子粒子。
● 中微子是一些最不被理解的亚原子粒子。
● 金秀璋因其在中微子振荡方面的研究而闻名。
中文解析
题目要求specify the type Kim is known for, C选项符合要求，因为C选项明确说明Kim is known for his research on neutrino oscillations

question:
● The Music by Black Composers (MBC) project aims to inspire aspiring music students by archiving and sharing information about the music of Black classical composers.
● William Benjamin Cooper is a Black classical music composer included in MBC’s Historic Composers Directory.
● He was born in 1920 and died in 1993.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to set up a discussion of Cooper’s career for an audience already familiar with the MBC project?
selections: A. While William Benjamin Cooper is considered a great composer, there are many more such composers included in the MBC Historic Composers Directory.

B. The MBC project’s Historic Composers Directory highlights Black classical composers of the past, such as William Benjamin Cooper (1920-1993), in order to inspire music students to become the classical composers of the future.
C. Among the many talented figures included in the MBC project is classical music composer William Benjamin Cooper.
D. Born in 1920, William Benjamin Cooper passed away in 1993, according to the MBC project.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
● “黑色作曲家音乐”（MBC）项目旨在通过归档和分享关于黑人古典作曲家音乐的信息来激励有志的音乐学生。
● 威廉·本杰明·库珀是一位被纳入MBC历史作曲家名录的黑人古典音乐作曲家。
● 他于1920年出生，1993年去世。
中文解析
C选项最有效地利用了给定句子中的信息，为已熟悉MBC项目的受众引入对赖特事业的讨论。先是直接提到了在MBC项目中包含的众多才华横溢的人物之一是Benjamin Cooper，为下文对赖特事业的讨论提供了一个合适的开端。

question:
Featuring jagged peaks of black ink surrounded by hazy swirls of blue and green paint, Zhang Daqian’s 1983 painting Punoruma of Mount Lu is inspired by the tradition of qinglü shanshui, a type of Chinese landscape painting ________ by the use of blue and green hues to depict ethereal, otherworldly landscapes.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

question:

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

question:
The Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind project is anticipated to generate 2.6 gigawatts of energy, enough to power almost one million homes. As its name indicates, the project—currently in development—consists of wind turbines located off the Virginia coast. ________ the project plan calls for 176 large turbines to be placed at a site 27 miles east of Virginia Beach.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
“海岸维吉尼亚离岸风电项目预计将产生2.6吉瓦的能源，足够为近百万个家庭供电。正如其名称所示，该项目目前正在开发中，由位于维吉尼亚海岸的风力涡轮机组成。______ 项目计划在离维吉尼亚海滩27英里处的地点安装176个大型涡轮机。”

question:

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

1974年在坦桑尼亚发现的被称为LH 4的个体化石遗骸，不仅能帮助古人类学家识别人科的进化步骤，还能 ________ 普里斯托新世的整体情况，揭示LH 4生活的时代的重要细节。

句子结构not only identify ... but also illuminate...表达了fossil remains的重要意义

question:
The following text is from Sarojini Naidu’s 1896 poem “Alabaster.”
Like this alabaster box whose art.
Is frail as a cassia-flower, is my heart,
Carven with delicate dreams and wrought With many a subtle and exquisite thought.

Which choice best describes the function of the two underlined portions in the text as a whole?
selections: A. They indicate potential reactions, one hoped for and one feared, to a decision the speaker considers throughout the text.
B. They provide examples, one literal and one figurative, of a change that the speaker describes throughout the text.
C. They describe the subjects, one physical and one abstract, of a comparison that extends throughout the text.
D. They symbolize two viewpoints, one cautious and one impulsive, that are contrasted throughout the text.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文本出自萨罗吉尼·奈杜1896年的诗《石膏盒》。
我的心就像这个石膏盒，
其艺术如香樟花般脆弱，
雕刻着细腻的梦，
蕴含着许多微妙而精致的思绪。

这是修辞中比喻的考察，a comparison between alabaster box and my heart,前者physical，后者abstract，这个比喻贯穿整首诗歌。

question:
The work of Tobias Gerstenberg et al. on tracking eye movements supports a theory that people engage in ________ thinking when making causal judgments: when subjects were asked to look at two colliding billiard balls and judge whether one caused or prevented the other’s movement through a gate, their eyes looked at where the target ball would have gone if the ball that altered its path did not exist.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
托比亚斯·格斯滕伯格等人的研究表明，人们在做因果判断时会进行______思维：当受试者被要求观察两个相撞的台球并判断其中一个是否导致或阻止了另一个通过一个门的运动时，他们的视线集中在如果改变其路径的球不存在时目标球会去往的位置。
中文解析
Tracking eye movement 在后面台球相撞的例子中，人们的眼睛会看向球本来应该的走向，这里的虚拟语气可以看出，本来球已经改变了方向，但是我们会看向事实上不存在的方向，于是选择counterfactual 的英文意义是what did not happen or what does not exist, 和文本需要的意义一致counterfactual thinking。

question:
Rafael Núñez and colleagues studied how members of the Yupno, an Indigenous group in Papua New Guinea, conceptualize time. The researchers recorded Yupno speakers explaining certain temporal words and phrases, such as kalip si ngan, a past-oriented expression that translates to “a long time ago,” and coded each speaker’s manual gestures. Previous research has found a tendency in many cultures to make temporal distinctions using spatial concepts and gestures, particularly along egocentric axes (i.e., relative to the orientation of the speaker): for instance, English speakers often refer to the front/back axis to describe events in time. In an anthropology paper, a student claims that the tendency toward ego-based conceptualizations of time is universal.

Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the student’s claim?
selections: A. Some Yupno grammatical structures used when talking about time are also used in English.
B. When Yupno speakers who are outdoors use gestures to refer to the future, they point uphill from their current location regardless of which way they are facing
C. A Yupno speaker points in opposite directions when indicating a past event versus a future event.
D. Although Yupno speakers and English speakers both use gestures to indicate orientation in time, Yupno speakers tend to use fewer gestures overall when speaking than English speakers do.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
拉斐尔·努涅斯及其同事研究了巴布亚新几内亚的原住民群体尤普诺（Yupno）成员如何概念化时间。研究人员记录了尤普诺语者解释某些时间词汇和短语的过程，例如 kalip si ngan 这个过去时的表达，意为“很久以前”，并对每位说话者的手势进行了编码。以往的研究发现，许多文化在使用空间概念和手势进行时间区分时，往往呈现出一种倾向，特别是在自我中心的轴线上（即相对于说话者的方位）：例如，英语使用者常常通过前/后轴来描述时间事件。在一篇人类学论文中，一位学生声称，基于自我中心的时间概念化倾向是普遍存在的。
中文解析
Weaken the claim,就是否定最后一句内容，最后一句的关键词是ego-based conceptualization of time is universal,那么B选项中Yupno speakers point uphill 则是based on outside factor不是ego-based，于是可以削弱文章的claim。

question:
Before the Mariner 2 mission completed a successful flyby of Venus in 1962, astronomers’ ideas about the planet were little more than ________. Venus’s atmosphere is so thick that Earth-based observations had yielded very little information about the planet.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在1962年海洋者2号任务成功飞掠金星之前，天文学家对这颗行星的想法仅仅是______。金星的大气层非常厚重，以至于地球上的观测几乎没有提供关于这颗行星的信息。
中文解析
Before...讲述之前的认知仅仅是猜想而已，little more than表示不过是，仅仅是，第二句话具体解释大气层后，没有太多的信息了解，所以前面的猜想选择conjecture。

question:
Over 600 languages are spoken in New York City in addition to English—one can find Acehnese spoken in the neighborhood of Astoria, for example, or Hindi in Gramercy Park. English is the most common, with 65% of New Yorkers speaking it at home; Spanish is second, at 20%. A linguist hypothesizes that a Spanish dialect—a variation differing from the parent language in some of its vocabulary, pronunciation, and grammar—has developed in New York City, partly due to its linguistic interaction with English. Previous research shows that younger speakers of nonmajority languages are more likely to borrow words from the majority language of a region than are older speakers. If the linguist’s hypothesis is correct, it is therefore likely to be the case that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. younger speakers of Spanish in New York City would be more likely to use a dialect specific to New York City than older speakers living in the same neighborhood would be.

B. the proportion of younger speakers who use a Spanish dialect specific to New York City is higher in neighborhoods where many languages are spoken than in neighborhoods where Spanish and English predominate.
C. both the number of languages spoken in New York City and the number of dialects of each of those languages will increase over time.
D. Spanish used by younger speakers in New York City tends to have more words borrowed from other nonmajority languages than borrowed from English.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在纽约市，除了英语之外，有超过600种语言被使用。例如，在阿斯托里亚社区可以听到阿切尼语，在格拉默西公园则可以听到印地语。英语是最常用的语言，65%的纽约人在家中使用英语；西班牙语位居第二，占20%。一位语言学家假设，在纽约市发展出了一种西班牙语方言——这种方言在某些词汇、发音和语法上与母语有所不同，部分原因是与英语的语言互动。先前的研究表明，年轻的非主流语言使用者比老年使用者更可能从该地区的主流语言中借用词汇。如果这位语言学家的假设是正确的，那么很可能会出现以下情况：______
中文解析
文本最后是猜想的重点依据，也就是non-majority languages人群中，年轻人比老一辈更有可能borrow words from majority language，具体可以理解为西班牙语的年轻一代比老一代更可能从英文中借来词汇使用，这和A选项的表意一致，注意dialect specific to New York City根据文本定义就是因为borrow words而和老一辈不同的Spanish dialect。

question:
Water flowing around an obstruction creates vortices (patterns of swirls) of varying size; by detecting the vortices, fish can determine the size and position of the obstruction. Testing by Yuzo R. Yanagisuru, Otar Akanyeti, and James C. Liao using models of three head shapes—narrow (low ratio of width to length), intermediate, and wide (high ratio of width to length)—showed that for large vortices, fish with intermediate heads would be better able than wide-headed fish to distinguish between vortices and general turbulence in the water. A second research team has therefore hypothesized that in low-visibility conditions, intermediate-headed fish will be more likely than wide-headed fish to detect obstructions that create large vortices.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the second research team’s hypothesis?
selections: A. A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the intermediate-headed black sea bass (Centropristis striates) bumped into the obstructions just as often as the wide-headed Synodontis macropunctata did.

B. A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the wide-headed Synodontis macropunctata bumped into obstructions more often than the intermediate-headed black sea bass (Centropristis striates) did.

C. A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that some specimens of the intermediate-headed black sea bass (Centropristis striates) bumped into the obstructions more often than other specimens of the same fish did.

D. A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the Synodontis macropunctata, which has a relatively wide head, bumped into more than half of the obstructions.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
水流绕过障碍物会形成不同大小的涡旋（旋转模式）；通过检测这些涡旋，鱼可以判断障碍物的大小和位置。由Yuzo R. Yanagisuru、Otar Akanyeti和James C. Liao进行的测试使用了三种头部形状模型——窄型（宽度与长度比低）、中型和宽型（宽度与长度比高）。结果显示，对于大型涡旋来说，中型头部的鱼比宽头部的鱼更能区分涡旋与水中的一般湍流。因此，第二个研究团队假设在能见度低的情况下，中型头部的鱼比宽头部的鱼更有可能检测到产生大型涡旋的障碍物。
中文解析
题目要求支持最后一句话second research team’s hypothesis, 也就是支持intermediate-headed fish 比wide-headed fish 更容易detect obstructions，换句话说就是wide-headed fish更容易撞到障碍物。

question:
Arthurian legends (tales related to the character of King Arthur) derive from many sources, such as Preiddeu Annwfn, composed around 900, and Erec and Enide from around 1170. One of the most significant sources, Geoffrey of Monmouth’s History of the Kings of Britain, was written in Latin in the 1130s; some material from it was later adapted by the Norman poet Wace into the Roman de Brut in 1155. But while no source before 1155 includes references to the famous Round Table at which Arthur’s knights assembled, both the Roman de Brut and Sir Thomas Malory’s 15th-century compilation of Arthurian legends, Le Morte d’Arthur, do. It can therefore be inferred that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. Malory did not use Preiddeu Annwfn as a source for information he presented about the Round Table.
B. Geoffrey of Monmouth was unaware of stories of the Round Table when composing his History, though historians know that works containing such stories were available to him.
C. Le Morte d’Arthur is more historically accurate than History, because Erec and Enide had not been written when Geoffrey of Monmouth was writing his work.
D. Geoffrey of Monmouth’s accounts of Arthurian legends in his History are more similar overall in content to the accounts in Erec and Enide than they are to the accounts in Roman de Brut.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
亚瑟王传说（与亚瑟王角色相关的故事）来源于许多不同的资料，如大约900年创作的《Preiddeu Annwfn》和大约1170年的《Erec和Enide》。其中一个最重要的来源是杰弗里·蒙默斯的《不列颠诸王史》，该书在1130年代用拉丁语写成；其中的一些材料后来被诺曼诗人瓦斯改编为1155年的《布鲁特之书》。但是，在1155年之前，没有任何资料提到亚瑟的骑士们聚集的著名圆桌，而《布鲁特之书》和托马斯·马洛里的15世纪的亚瑟王传奇汇编《亚瑟之死》都提到了它。因此可以推断出，______。
中文解析
Preiddeu Annwfn 创作于900年，早于1155年，于是不会有reference to the Round Table，因此15世纪Malory创作中呈现Round Table不可能用Preiddeu Annwfn 作为自己的source。选择A选项。

question:
Text 1
A conservation group representing 11 tribal nations in the Great Lakes region reported to various state and federal natural resources agencies operating in the region that the firefly (waawaatesi in the Ojibwe language) will likely fare significantly worse than the black bear (makwa in Ojibwe) due to rising temperatures over the next 50 years. This collaborative approach has helped build trust between government and tribal groups, which will likely improve the quality of any joint conservation projects.
Text 2
State and federal natural resources agencies are increasingly incorporating traditional ecological knowledge from tribal groups in the agencies’ plans to address threats to natural resources due to increasing temperatures. This approach has helped build positive relationships between tribal groups and these agencies and furthermore tends to lead to better conservation outcomes.

Based on the texts, both authors would most likely agree with which statement?
selections: A. Natural resources conservation projects are likely to benefit from collaboration between tribal and government groups.
B. A collaborative approach to conservation is likely to help reduce the predicted temperature increases in the Great Lakes region.
C. In the Great Lakes region, it is more important to focus conservation efforts on the firefly than it is to focus on the black bear.
D. In the Great Lakes region, conservation efforts focused on the firefly are likely to be more effective than the focused on the black bear.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
文本1
一个代表大湖区11个部落国家的保护组织向该地区的各种州和联邦自然资源机构报告，萤火虫（在奥吉布瓦语中称为waawaatesi）在未来50年内由于气温上升，可能会比黑熊（在奥吉布瓦语中称为makwa）遭受更严重的影响。这种合作方式有助于在政府和部落团体之间建立信任，从而可能提高任何联合保护项目的质量。
文本2
州和联邦自然资源机构越来越多地在其应对气温上升对自然资源威胁的计划中纳入部落团体的传统生态知识。这种方法有助于在部落团体和这些机构之间建立积极的关系，并且往往会导致更好的保护成果。
中文解析
题目要求答两篇文章的共同特征，那么text 1 and 2的共同点是认可tribal and government groups之间的合作会带来好处，本题有很多变体，不要思维定式。

question:
The following text is adapted from Guy de Maupassant’s 1884 short story “A Recollection,” from the collection Guy de Maupassant Short Stories (translated by Albert M.C. McMaster et al. in 1903). The narrator is taking a boat down the Seine river from Paris, France, to the surrounding countryside.
I took up a position in the bows [front of the boat), standing up and looking at the quays, the trees, the houses and the bridges disappearing behind us. And suddenly I perceived the great viaduct of Point du Jour which blocked the river. It was the end of Paris, the beginning of the country, and behind the double row of arches the Seine, suddenly spreading out as though it had regained space and liberty, became all at once the peaceful river which flows through the plains, alongside the wooded hills, amid the meadows, along the edge of the forests.

Based on the text, which choice best expresses the narrator’s characterization of the Seine?
selections: A. As the journey progressed from Paris to the countryside, the waters of the Seine gradually cleared.
B. The Seine is similar to Paris in that it is beautiful and slow to change.
C. The waters of the Seine are more confined and rough in Paris than they are in the countryside.
D. The current under the arches of the Point du Jour contrasts starkly with the otherwise calm flow of the Seine throughout the journey.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文字改编自居伊·德·莫泊桑1884年的短篇小说《回忆》，该小说收录于《居伊·德·莫泊桑短篇小说集》（由阿尔伯特·M.C.·麦克马斯特等人于1903年翻译）。叙述者乘船沿着法国巴黎的塞纳河驶向周边的乡村。
我站在船头，俯视着消失在身后的码头、树木、房屋和桥梁。突然，我看到了阻挡河流的庞大高架桥——普瓦特·朱尔高架桥。那是巴黎的尽头，也是乡村的开始。在那排双重拱门的后面，塞纳河突然宽广开来，仿佛重新获得了空间和自由，顿时变成了一条流淌在平原上、穿过林木山丘、草地和森林边缘的宁静河流。
中文解析
Characterization of Seine主要是看文章的前面对于水流描述的对比，the end of Paris，the beginning of the country，水流因为空间开阔变得spreading out， 变得peaceful，这些可以让我们得出在巴黎段更加的confined and rough（狭窄湍急），在乡村段更加平缓开阔。

question:
The following text is adapted from Virginia Woolf’s 1919 novel Night and Day. Katharine is the granddaughter of a celebrated poet.
[Katharine’s] descent from [a celebrated poet] was no surprise to her, but matter for satisfaction, until, as the years wore on, certain drawbacks made themselves very manifest. Perhaps it is a little depressing to inherit not lands but an example of intellectual virtue; perhaps the conclusiveness of a great ancestor is a little discouraging to those who run the risk of comparison with him.

As used in the text, what does the word “manifest” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文本改编自弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫1919年的小说《夜与日》。凯瑟琳是一个著名诗人的 granddaughter。
凯瑟琳出身于一位著名诗人，这对她来说并不意外，而是让她感到满意，直到随着岁月的流逝，某些缺陷显露无疑。或许继承的不是土地，而是知识的典范，这有些令人沮丧；或许伟大祖先的决定性成就对那些面临与之比较风险的人来说有些令人气馁。
中文解析
大意是表达随着时间的推移，缺点越发明显，manifest在这里是明显的，evident是合适的选择。

question:
A film studies student is researching early 20th-century film serials, which consisted of individual episodes of a single long story that were shown weekly in theaters. Clancy of the Mounted is a 1933 serial that, over its 12 episodes, kept its audience interested with the suspense and drama that are typical of the northern adventure genre. The student, however, claims that ultimately audiences of the time preferred resolution and closure over ongoing tension.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the student’s claim?
selections: A. The 12th episode of Clancy of the Mounted was the most expensive episode of the series to produce.
B. The 12th episode of Clancy of the Mounted was viewed by more people than was any previous episode in the series.
C. Modern critics generally regard the first episode as the best installment of Clancy of the Mounted.
D. Audiences of the time considered Clancy of the Mounted to belong to a genre other than the northern adventure genre.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一名电影研究专业的学生正在研究20世纪早期的电影连载，这些连载由单个长故事的各个剧集组成，每周在电影院放映。《骑警克兰西》是一部1933年的连载作品，在其12集的过程中，通过悬念和戏剧性吸引了观众，这些特征典型地属于北方冒险类型。然而，这位学生声称，当时的观众最终更喜欢解决和结局，而不是持续的紧张感。
中文解析
文本最后claim说audiences倾向于resolution and closure over ongoing tension，那就是最后一个episode会更受到观众的喜爱，比起中间持续的episodes（on going tension），即B选项。第12个episode观众会更多。

question:
The Reckoning and Resilience (2022) exhibition at Duke University’s Nasher Museum of Art in Durham, North Carolina, is dedicated to the work of thirty North Carolina artists, including Juan Logan, Cornell Watson, and Stephen Hayes. Although the Nasher Museum has focused exhibitions entirely on North Carolina artists before, as it did previously in the photography exhibition Across County Lines, the breadth of disciplines in Reckoning and Resilience sets it apart.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the underlined claim?
selections: A. Reckoning and Resilience and Across County Lines were curated to emphasize works that are not owned by the Nasher Museum.
B. The Nasher Museum has a world-class collection of contemporary art that includes many paintings and sculptures from artists both inside and outside North Carolina.
C. Logan is a painter, Watson is a photographer, and Hayes is a sculptor
D. Watson is a North Carolina photographer, as were all of the artists featured in Across County Lines.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
《清算与韧性》（2022）展览在北卡罗来纳州达勒姆的杜克大学纳舍艺术博物馆举办，专注于三十位北卡罗来纳艺术家的作品，包括胡安·洛根、康奈尔·沃特森和斯蒂芬·海耶斯。尽管纳舍博物馆之前也曾专门举办全北卡罗来纳艺术家的展览，例如在摄影展《跨县界》中的展示，但《清算与韧性》在学科广度上使其独具特色。
中文解析
划线句子是让步状语从句部分指出了Nasher Museum共同点就是关注North Carolina artists，主句则指出了本次展览Reckoning and Resilience的特色，即the breadth of disciplines ,也就是学科范围之广度。C选项painter，photographer，sculptor能够支持。

question:
Like all species of baleen whales, the humpback whale feeds on tiny creatures known as krill by filtering water through bristlelike keratin structures called baleen plates. In this way, baleen whales can eat up to 30 percent of their total mass per day. And while no one would call the humpback whale small—it can have a mass as high as 30,000 kg—it is one of the smaller baleen whales and is much smaller than the northern right whale, which can weigh a whopping 80,000 kg and consume as much as 24,000 kg of krill per day.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It describes a characteristic shared by all baleen whales and then illustrates a difference between the humpback whale and the northern right whale that is relevant to that characteristic.
B. It discusses a unique feature of the humpback whale and how the lack of that feature in the northern right whale explains differences in the two species’ behavior.
C. It draws a distinction between the sizes of the humpback whale and the northern right whale and then presents a feature that they have in common.
D. It details a relationship between humpback and northern right whales and krill and then discusses an unexpected consequence of a change in baleen whale populations.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
像所有的须鲸物种一样，座头鲸通过过滤水中的小生物——称为虾夷扇贝——来进食，这些生物通过叫做须板的角质结构进行过滤。通过这种方式，须鲸每天可以摄入其体重的30%。虽然没人会称座头鲸为小型鲸鱼——其体重可高达30,000千克——但它属于较小的须鲸，远小于北方右鲸，后者的体重可达到惊人的80,000千克，并且每天可摄入多达24,000千克的虾夷扇贝。
中文解析
文本第一句like...是所有baleen whales的共同特点，然后是两种whale的大小差异，及与之相关的吃掉食物的具体数量描述。

question:
In what is now Washington state, the Tulalip Tribes operate the Hibulb Cultural Center. Relying on traditional knowledge to guide the design of exhibits, this institution presents Tulalip history and culture to the tribes’ citizens. The Choctaw Nation, a tribe in Oklahoma, employs a similar strategy in its own cultural center Both centers contrast with museums that aren’t Indigenous-led; when displaying Indigenous artifacts, such museums tend to anticipate mainly non-Indigenous audiences and rely on Euro-centric strategies for designing exhibits.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It elaborates on a claim made earlier in the sentence.
B. It addresses a potential criticism of a claim made earlier in the sentence.
C. It defines a term used earlier in the sentence.
D. It acknowledges an exception to the general principle proposed earlier in the sentence.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在现在的华盛顿州，图拉利普部落运营着希布尔布文化中心。该机构依靠传统知识指导展览的设计，向部落的公民展示图拉利普的历史和文化。位于俄克拉荷马州的乔克托部落在其文化中心也采用类似的策略。这两个中心与非原住民主导的博物馆形成对比；在展示原住民文物时，这些博物馆往往主要面向非原住民观众，并依赖以欧洲中心主义为基础的展览设计策略。
中文解析
最后一句划线句解释了non-indigenous-led museums针对的audience群体与依赖的策略，是对前文museums that aren’t Indigenous-led的解释。

question:
Today, the Michelin Guide is widely known as the arbiter of fine dining, but when it was created in 1900, it was little more than a marketing gimmick; d brothers Andre and Edouard Michelin sought to increase profits for their tire company by encouraging their customers to drive across France, visiting the guide’s recommended hotels and restaurants along the way. Nevertheless, the guide soon grew in scope and ________ its modest French eateries were replaced with some of the most estgemed restaurants from around the world, including Makimura in Tokyo and DiverXO in Madrid.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 两个完整句子连接逗号+and是可以的，其它选项都不可以连接完整句。

question:
Jeffery Renard Allen’s short essay on “backwall,” a word referring to the cliff at the head of a glacier-carved valley, is included in the collection Home Ground: A Guide to the American Landscape. The book wasn’t written solely by ________ other authors, such as Carolyn Servid and Barry Lopez, also contributed essays.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: However作为副词，所在句和前一句形成转折关系，第一句和第二句间存在转折关系，需要however在第二句内，第二句和第三句完整句连接需要分号，不可以用逗号。于是选B选项。

question:
Integrating insights from economics and psychology, researchers in the field of behavioral economics explore a variety of topics. Olga Shurchkov of Wellesley College studies worker ________ other researchers investigate areas such as market behavior and consumer behavior.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 副词词组for instance所在的句子和前一句间形成例证关系。第一句和第二句间构成例证关系，for instance需要放在第二句内，第二三句间是完整句子，需要分号连接。

question:
Mountain climbing routes that incorporate metal rungs and cables are known as via ferratas, from the Italian phrase for “iron path.” As climbing these routes has shifted from a mode of travel to a sporting activity, modern via ferratas are rarely designed to simply reach a summit. ________ new routes favor recreation over utility, aiming to provide a challenging climb or showcase dramatic scenery.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
结合金属和钢缆的登山路线被称为“via ferrata”，源自意大利语中的“铁道”一词。随着攀登这些路线的方式从一种旅行模式转变为一种体育活动，现代的via ferrata很少仅仅是为了到达山顶。______新的路线更侧重于休闲而非实用，旨在提供具有挑战性的攀登体验或展示壮观的风景。
中文解析
逻辑词前一句的内容是...are rarely designed to simply reach a summit, 后一句是类似的意义，但是更加细致的描述了路线的设计，于是选择递进关系more often。

question:
● At London and New York Fashion Weeks, fashion designers debut new clothing collections.
● Color consultants create trend reports on the popular colors at a given Fashion Week.
● A report on 2018 London Fashion Week noted the popularity of a light green-yellow shade that was cool in tone and soft in intensity.
● A report on 2019 New York Fashion Week noted the popularity of a deep brown shade that was warm in tone and rich in intensity.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to describe a color that was popular at 2019 New York Fashion Week?
selections: A. Shades of light green-yellow and deep brown have both been featured in Fashion Week reports prepared by color consultants.
B. The shade favored by designers at 2019 New York Fashion Week was a departure from the cool, soft shade of light green-yellow that had proved popular at 2018 London Fashion Week.
C. Each Fashion Week, color consultants compile reports on the colors that have been popular among designers.
D. At 2019 New York Fashion Week, many designer collections featured a warm, rich shade of deep brown.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
● 在伦敦和纽约时装周，时装设计师推出新的服装系列。
● 色彩顾问会制作关于某一时装周流行颜色的趋势报告。
● 一份关于2018年伦敦时装周的报告指出了一种清淡的绿黄色调的流行，这种颜色冷调且柔和。
● 一份关于2019年纽约时装周的报告则指出了一种深棕色调的流行，这种颜色暖调且饱和。
中文解析
题目要求描述2019年New York Week 的popular color，于是D选项满足，deep brown shade.

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● The fifth Solvay Conference on Physics was held in 1927.
● It brought together twenty-nine of the era’s preeminent scientists to discuss the emerging field of quantum theory.
● The conference famously featured a debate between physicists Albert Einstein and Niels Bohr.
● Bohr proposed that subatomic entities like electrons had only probable realities until they were observed.
● Einstein argued that subatomic entities like electrons had a reality independent of observation.
● Bohr’s position, later called the Copenhagen interpretation, remains the most widely accepted theory of quantum mechanics.

The student wants to place Einstein’s argument within its historical context. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. During the dawn of quantum theory, Einstein maintained the independent reality of some subatomic entities, although Bohr’s opposing interpretation would become the widely accepted view.
B. In 1927, Einstein and Bohr engaged in a famous debate; Bohr’s argument, later called the Copenhagen interpretation, would remain popular decades after.
C. The attendees of the 1927 Solvay Conference were among the preeminent scientists of their era, including Einstein, who opposed Bohr’s proposal.
D. At the 1927 Solvay Conference on Physics, Einstein disagreed with Bohr’s argument that subatomic entities like electrons had a reality independent of observation.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
● 第五届索尔维会议于1927年举行。
● 会议聚集了二十九位当时杰出的科学家，讨论新兴的量子理论领域。
● 会议中著名地出现了物理学家阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦与尼尔斯·玻尔之间的辩论。
● 玻尔提出，像电子这样的亚原子实体在被观察之前只有概率现实。
● 爱因斯坦则认为，像电子这样的亚原子实体具有独立于观察的现实。
● 玻尔的观点后来被称为哥本哈根解释，至今仍是量子力学中最广泛接受的理论。
中文解析
题目要求Einstein’ argument, A选项 Einstein maintained ... 就是爱因斯坦的argument，后半句although Bohr’s interpenetration would have become the widely accepted view,就是题目要求的historical context。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● Chromosomes are cellular structures that contain genes.
● Genes carry critical instructions for determining an organism’s physical traits.
● Members of the same species typically have the same number of chromosomes.
● The bat-eared fox (Otocyon megalotis) and the Bengal fox (Vulpes bengalensis) are species of foxes.
● The bat-eared fox has seventy-two chromosomes.
● The Bengal fox has sixty chromosomes.

The student wants to specify how many chromosomes the bat-eared fox has. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The bat-eared fox (Otocyon megalotis) and the Bengal fox (Vulpes bengalensis) both have chromosomes, but the bat-eared fox has more than the Bengal fox does.
B. The Bengal fox, a species of fox, has sixty structures called chromosomes.
C. The bat-eared fox’s chromosomes contain genes, which are critical to determining an organism’s physical traits.
D. The bat-eared fox (Otocyon megalotis) has seventy-two chromosomes.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生做了以下笔记：
● 染色体是包含基因的细胞结构。
● 基因携带决定生物体物理特征的重要指令。
● 同一物种的成员通常具有相同数量的染色体。
● 耳蝠狐狸（Otocyon megalotis）和孟加拉狐狸（Vulpes bengalensis）是狐狸的两个物种。
● 耳蝠狐狸有七十二条染色体。
● 孟加拉狐狸有六十条染色体。
中文解析
题目要求回答fennec fox具体有多少条chromosomes，D选项回答seventy-two。

question:
With his room-sized installation Unicorn/My Private Sky, Norwegian artist Borre Sæthre succeeds in creating a whimsical yet perplexing experience. ________ when visitors set foot inside the fantastically blue room and encounter the life-sized stuffed unicorn preening at the far end of it, they are both dazzled and confused—as if stepping into a strange and enchanting new world.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
挪威艺术家博尔雷·萨特雷（Borre Sæthre）通过他的房间级装置作品《独角兽/我的私人天空》，成功地创造了一种奇幻而又令人困惑的体验。当访客走进这个梦幻般的蓝色房间，看到远处那只正在整理毛发的真人大小的毛绒独角兽时，他们既感到目眩神迷，又感到困惑——仿佛踏入了一个奇异而迷人的新世界。
中文解析
第一句和第二句的意义是相近的，都是表达进入这样的房间以及具体的感受，于是选择indeed来表达强调。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
● The Mohs scale of mineral hardness is a ten-point scale that orders minerals by hardness based on their ability to scratch other minerals.
● Minerals with larger numbers are harder than minerals with smaller numbers and can leave visible scratches on them.
● Minerals with smaller numbers are softer than minerals with larger numbers and cannot leave visible scratches on them.
● The mineral calcite has a Mohs scale number of 3.
● The mineral apatite has a Mohs scale number of 5.
● The mineral corundum has a Mohs scale number of 9.

The student wants to make a generalization about minerals. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Based on their Mohs scale numbers, corundum (9) is harder than apatite (5), and apatite is harder than calcite (3).
B. Corundum can leave visible scratches on calcite, which is why corundum has a higher number than calcite on the Mohs scale of mineral hardness.
C. Any mineral with a Mohs number of 9, like corundum, can scratch a mineral with a Mohs number of 5, like apatite.
D. The Mohs scale can be used to order calcite, corundum, and apatite by their ability to scratch other minerals.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，学生做了以下笔记：
● 莫氏硬度等级是一个十分制的等级，用于根据矿物划伤其他矿物的能力来排序矿物的硬度。
● 硬度数值较大的矿物比数值较小的矿物更硬，并且能够在其上留下可见的划痕。
● 硬度数值较小的矿物比数值较大的矿物更软，无法在其上留下可见的划痕。
● 矿物方解石的莫氏硬度数值为3。
● 矿物磷灰石的莫氏硬度数值为5。
● 矿物刚玉的莫氏硬度数值为9。
中文解析
题目要求make a generalization about minerals, 只有c选项符合generalization of minerals，这个题目有若干变体，每次答案要依据题目变化。虽然A有效地比较了特定矿物的硬度，但它并未涵盖mohs硬度等级作为根据矿物划分刮擦能力的工具的整体原则。D是关于Mohs的概括，重点没有在mineral上面，所以也不对。

This hypothesis ________ that certain trees, such as P sylvestris, survived without interruption or human intervention throughout the Holocene cannot stand, researchers Michael O’Connell and Karen Molloy counter, unless other explanations can first be ruled out.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: Suggesting现在分词做后置定语，修饰前面的名词hypothesis，hypothesis 是句子的主语，cannnot stand是句子的谓语

question:
Interest in mechanotransduction, the mechanism by which cells sense and convert mechanical stimuli into biochemical signals, is expanding because of innovative work by biomedical scientists—many of whom, like neuroscience and biophysics expert Elba Serrano, ________ this mechanism to better understand how the body’s neurological and biomechanical systems interact.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 判断从句的主语many of whom是复数，于是对应的谓语动词study，其它都是对应主语为单数。

question:
An analysis by Alain Elayi and colleagues of coins minted in Sidon in the fifth and fourth centuries BCE reveals a change in their composition over time: while a coin from circa 450 BCE contains about 98% silver and 1% copper, a coin from 367 BCE (the end of Ba’alsillem II’s reign) contains 74.2% silver and 24.7% copper, giving it a relatively yellowish appearance that traders would have noticed. Because coins with a silver content below 80% were widely considered unsuitable for trade, Elayi et al. speculate that a crisis in confidence in the currency occurred in Sidon around 367 BCE, which was likely relieved—despite Sidon’s persistent oppressive financial obligations—as a result of Ba’alsillem Il’s successor Abd’astart I’s decision to ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. keep the amount of silver in Sidonian coins consistent with that in coins minted in 367 BCE but decrease their weight.
B. proclaim that the percentage of silver in coins suitable for trade would be raised to a threshold higher than 80%.
C. fund the mining of some copper deposits that were not available to Ba’alsillem II.
D. begin minting heavier coins with a proportion of silver to copper similar to that in coins minted in 367 BCE.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
艾兰·埃拉伊及其同事对公元前五世纪和四世纪西顿铸造的硬币进行的分析显示，这些硬币的成分随着时间的推移发生了变化：公元前450年左右的一枚硬币含有约98%的银和1%的铜，而公元前367年（巴阿尔西勒姆二世统治末期）的一枚硬币含有74.2%的银和24.7%的铜，使其外观相对偏黄，商人们会注意到这一点。由于银含量低于80%的硬币通常被广泛认为不适合交易，埃拉伊等人推测，在公元前367年，西顿的货币信心发生了危机，尽管西顿仍面临持续的压迫性财政义务，这种危机很可能是由于巴阿尔西勒姆二世的继任者阿卜杜阿斯塔特一世决定______。
中文解析
根据文本silver content占比低于80%不适合交易，从而产生货币的信任危机，缓解的方式（relieve）就是保持银占比达到80%以上，那么A选项保持银含量不变，减轻硬币的总重量，从而提高银占比的方式是可行的。

question: What is the slope of the graph of<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi> y</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>11</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>16</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi></math> in the xy-plane?

question: A machine launches a baseball from ground level. The baseball reaches a maximum height of 92.16 meters above the ground at 2.4 seconds and hits the ground at 4.8 seconds. Which equation represents the height above ground h, in meters, of the baseball t seconds after it is launched?

explanations: 式子展开得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>6</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>33</mn></math>故<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>6</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>24</mn></math>

question: In triangle FGH and triangle KLM, the measures of angles G and L are each 60°. The lengths of<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi> G</mi><mi>H</mi></mrow><mo accent="false">¯</mo></mover></math> and<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi> L</mi><mi>M </mi></mrow><mo accent="false">¯</mo></mover></math>are each 34 centimeters, and<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mi>G</mi><mi>H</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>G</mi><mi>F</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>L</mi><mi>M</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>L</mi><mi>K</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>.Which additional piece of information would be necessary to prove that triangle FGH is congruent to triangle KLM?
selections:
A. The lengths of FG¯and 
KM are each 17 centimeters.
B. The measures of angles H and M are each 30°.
C. The measures of angles F and K are each 90°.
D. No additional information is necessary.
explanations: 两个三角形，对应的一组角相等，一组角的临边<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover accent="true" accentunder="false"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">G</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mo accent="false">¯</mo></mover></math>和<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover accent="true" accentunder="false"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi></mrow><mo accent="false">¯</mo></mover></math>也相等，同时根据<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">G</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">G</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>，得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover accent="true" accentunder="false"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">G</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></mrow><mo accent="false">¯</mo></mover></math>和<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover accent="true" accentunder="false"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></mrow><mo accent="false">¯</mo></mover></math>也相等，这一组边也是角G，L临边，属于全等三角形中SAS条件，故选D

question: The water depth in a certain river is 78.7 feet <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi> </mrow> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. question: The graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></math> is shown. Which equation defines the function f?

question: The result of increasing the quantity x by 600% is 126. What is the value of x?

question: The perimeter of an equilateral triangle is 642 centimeters. The three vertices of the triangle lie on a circle. The radius of the circle is<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi> w</mi><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt></math>  centimeters. What is the value of w?

question:
The following text is from William Shakespeare’s play The Tempest, first performed in 1611. Miranda has lived on an island with her father, Prospero, since she was three years old. Prospero has stated that Miranda likely does not remember anything other than her life on the island.
MIRANDA: ’Tis far off,
And rather like a dream than an assurance
That my remembrance warrants. Had I not
Four or five women once that tended me?
PROSPERO: Thou hadst, and more, Miranda. But how is it
That this lives in thy mind? What seest thou else
In the dark backward and abysm of time?
If thou remember’st ought ere thou camest here,
How thou camest here thou mayst.

In the text, which point does Prospero most directly make about Miranda and her memories?
selections: A. Miranda’s impression of a scene is vague because she is remembering a scenario she had daydreamed about as a child rather than a scenario that had occurred in reality.

B. Miranda’s doubts about the accuracy of one recollection of a place other than the island are clouding her judgment and seem to be making her reluctant to explore her recollection of traveling to the island.
C. Miranda’s reminiscences about her early childhood have a melancholy quality that betrays her discontented view of her current circumstances.
D. Miranda’s ability to summon details of an experience she had before arriving on the island suggests that she may also be able to summon details of her arrival on the island.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
这是威廉·莎士比亚的《暴风雨》中的一段对话，主要是在探讨米兰达对她过去生活的记忆。米兰达在这里表达了对她在岛上生活的回忆，以及对她过去生活的模糊印象。普洛斯佩罗则引导她回忆更多的细节，询问她是否记得在来到这个岛之前的经历。
MIRANDA: 这好像是很久以前的事了，更像是梦境而非我确切记忆的事。我不是有过四五个曾经侍奉过我的女仆吗？
PROSPERO: 你是有的，而且不止这些，Miranda。但这是如何在你的脑海中存留的？在时间的黑暗深渊之中，你还看到了什么？
如果你在来到这里之前记得任何事情，那你来到这里的方式也许你可以回忆起来。
中文解析
主旨细节题的背景不能忽略，背景中Prospero 曾说女儿Miranda 很可能不记得岛上的任何事情，但是文本中Miranda能够回忆起four or five women once tended me, 说明她有一些印象，她自己觉得更像梦境一般（注意这其实真实发生过），Prospero的话语最后两句大意是：If you remember things before, you probably remember how you came here.这和D选项一致。
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:
Pteropods are small swimming snails with thin, delicate calcium carbonate shells. These animals are thought to be especially vulnerable to ocean acidification due to calcium carbonate’s susceptibility to dissolution at lower pH values. Victoria L. Peck and colleagues recently found that the periostracum (a protective coating on pteropods’ outer shells) prevents this dissolution when intact. Moreover, the team was surprised to discover that even when the periostracum is breached, pteropods can still mitigate damage by rebuilding the inner shell wall.

Which choice best describes the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To call for additional research on biological mechanisms that improve pteropod survival rates
B. To address some of the ways ocean acidification has altered pteropod behavior over time
C. To discuss a conclusion drawn in a study of calcium carbonate’s role in protecting the periostracum of pteropods
D. To present findings that suggest that a concern about the effects of ocean acidification on pteropod shells may be unwarranted
explanations:
题目文本翻译
浮游软体动物是一种小型的游泳蜗牛，具有薄而精致的碳酸钙外壳。这些动物被认为对海洋酸化特别脆弱，因为碳酸钙在较低pH值下容易溶解。Victoria L. Peck及其同事最近发现，当外壳的保护涂层（称为外壳层）完好时，可以防止这种溶解。此外，研究团队惊讶地发现，即使外壳层受到破损，浮游软体动物仍然能够通过重建内壳壁来减轻损害。
中文解析
最后两句是文本的重点，也就是两个发现，一是periostracum可以防御溶解，二是当其受损，pteropods可以重建内壳来减少损害，这两个发现可以说明ocean acidification 不会对生物Pteropods造成特别大的影响，这和D选项的描述是一致的，也就是a concern(担忧) may be unwarranted(没有根据的)
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:
Past research suggests that pollination by honeybees is responsible for up to 10 percent of total onion crop production. Now researchers are trying to determine how dependent cucumber crop production is on honeybees. The first phase of their study involved shielding some cucumber plants to prevent insects from pollinating them, resulting in those plants having 40 to 90 percent lower crop production than plants that were pollinated normally. However, the researchers claim that the first-phase experiment alone didn’t tell them how much of that difference in crop production is due specifically to excluding honeybees.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers’ claim?
selections: A. Other insects like solitary bees also pollinate onion plants, and some studies have allowed them to pollinate normally while excluding honeybees.
B. Other insects like squash bees also pollinate cucumber plants, and the shielding in the first phase of the study blocked them as well.
C. Honeybees are more commonly used to pollinate cucumber plants than onion plants.
D. The shielding used in the first phase of the study did not affect the amount of sunlight the cucumber plants received.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
过去的研究表明，蜜蜂授粉对洋葱作物的总产量贡献高达10%。现在，研究人员正在尝试确定黄瓜作物的产量对蜜蜂的依赖程度。研究的第一阶段涉及对一些黄瓜植物进行屏蔽，以防止昆虫对它们进行授粉，结果显示，这些植物的作物产量比正常授粉的植物低40%到90%。然而，研究人员声称，仅仅依靠第一阶段的实验并不能告诉他们，作物产量差异中具体有多少是由于排除了蜜蜂的授粉。
中文解析
第一阶段中prevent insects from pollinating，但是insects本身还包含了honeybees和别的insects，所以数据就不能全部归因在honeybees上，这和B选项是一致的，比如squash bees在这个阶段也被block了，这样就能支持文章最后一句的claim。
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:

In a college course on urban affairs, a student asserts that increased traffic congestion in the United States in the 1990s was present both in very large cities such as New York City, New York, and smaller areas such as Albany-Schenectady-Troy, New York, and Beaumont, Texas; though those smaller areas may have been less affected by traffic congestion than very large cities, this congestion also worsened in them over time.

Which choice best describes data from the graph that support the student’s claim?
selections: A. In at least one of the three urban areas shown, the amount of traffic delay was less than 20 hours per commuter per year at one point between 1990 and 2000.
B. In 1992, the amount of traffic delay in the New York City, New York, area was less than 30 hours per commuter per year.

C. While the annual number of hours of traffic delay per commuter was always lower in the Albany-Schenectady-Troy, New York, area than in the New York City, New York, area for each year between 1990 and 2000, the amount of traffic delay rose in both areas during this period.

D. Even though the amount of traffic delay per commuter per year was greater in the Albany-Schenectady-Troy, New York, area than in the New York City, New York, area throughout the period from 1990 to 2000, the amounts were nearly identical in 1996.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在一门关于城市事务的大学课程中，一名学生声称，美国在1990年代的交通拥堵现象不仅存在于纽约市这样的特大城市，也出现在阿尔巴尼-斯科哈里-特洛伊（Albany-Schenectady-Troy, New York）和德克萨斯州的博蒙特（Beaumont）等较小地区。尽管这些较小地区受到交通拥堵的影响可能不如特大城市严重，但随着时间的推移，这些地区的拥堵情况也有所加剧。
中文解析
文本最后一句之处虽然smaller areas were less affected，但是congestion also worsened over time，于是选项需要对应小地方没有大地方受影响，但是大小地方都是在恶化，C选项符合题意。

That journey across the Isthmus [of Panama], insignificant in distance as it was, was by no means an easy one. It seemed as if nature had determined to throw every conceivable obstacle in the way of those who should seek to join the two great oceans of the world.

As used in the text, what does the word"conceivable"most nearly mean?

question:
