As urbanist Mariela Alfonzo argues, our understanding of individuals’ decision-making about whether to walk is insufficiently robust: some studies emphasize the role of personal preference, others the role of perceived safety, and so on, but walking decisions are made in complex contexts in which multiple conditions and needs inform individuals’ choices.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To describe the effect of high population density on any given city’s walkability
B. To present a claim about how individuals’ decision-making about walking can be improved
C. To discuss the difficulty of identifying a reliable way to increase walking in any given city
D. To explain why it is challenging to compare the amount of pedestrian traffic in different cities
explanations:
题目文本翻译
东京的人流量很大，但仅仅复制与步行友好性相关的东京特征（例如高人口密度）可能不足以在其他城市中促进步行。城市规划师玛丽埃拉·阿方索（Mariela Alfonzo）指出，我们对个体步行决策的理解仍然不足：一些研究强调个人偏好的作用，另一些则关注感知安全性等因素，但步行决策是在复杂的背景下做出的，其中多种条件和需求共同影响个体的选择。
中文解析
文本指出replicating a feature of Tokyo很难，因为walking这件事受到很多因素的共同影响，是复杂环境下多种状况的共同结果，于是和C选项一致，identifying a reliable way 是很难的。
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:
• Jean-Michel Basquiat was an American artist who produced more than two thousand drawings and paintings.
• His work Untitled (Prophet I) was completed in 1982 and sold at auction in 2011.
• Untitled (Prophet I) is composed of acrylic, oil stick, and paper collage on canvas and measures 5,655 square inches in area.
• His work Catharsis was completed in 1983 and sold at auction in 2008.
• Catharsis is composed of acrylic and oil stick on canvas and measures 6,750 square inches in area.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize how the two works are similar?
selections: A. Composed by artist Jean-Michel Basquiat in 1982 and 1983, respectively, both Untitled (Prophet I) and Catharsis use acrylic paint as a Medium题目.
B. Artist Jean-Michel Basquiat completed Untitled (Prophet I) in 1982, and Catharsis followed in 1983.
C. Artist Jean-Michel Basquiat’s work Untitled (Prophet I) is composed of acrylic, oil stick, and paper collage, while Catharsis is composed of acrylic and oil stick.
D. Between artist Jean-Michel Basquiat’s works Catharsis and Untitled (Prophet I), the former is the larger of the two.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
 让-米歇尔·巴斯奎特（Jean-Michel Basquiat）是一位美国艺术家，他创作了超过两千幅素描和绘画作品。
 他的作品《无题（先知 I）》（Untitled (Prophet I)）完成于1982年，并于2011年在拍卖会上出售。
 这幅作品采用丙烯、油棒和纸拼贴在画布上创作，面积达到5,655平方英寸。
 他的另一件作品《净化》（Catharsis）完成于1983年，并于2008年在拍卖会上出售。
 《净化》使用丙烯和油棒在画布上创作，面积为6,750平方英寸。
中文解析
题目要求强调共同特征，只有A选项满足，因为Both指出两个作品都用acrylic paint作为媒介。
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Onomatopoeias are words that imitate the sounds they represent.
• Words that represent the same sound are often written and pronounced very differently from language to language.
• This variation is due in part to differences in how the languages are structured.
• “Khrok fi” is a Thai onomatopoeia that represents the sound of snoring.
• “Bhnosh” is a Bengali onomatopoeia that represents the sound of snoring.

The student wants to contrast two words that represent the same sound. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The Thai word “khrok fi” and the Bengali word “bhnosh” are onomatopoeias that represent the sound of snoring.
B. Though they both represent the sound of snoring, the onomatopoeias “khrok fi” (Thai) and “bhnosh” (Bengali) are written and pronounced very differently.
C. Onomatopoeias, words that imitate the sounds they represent, are often written and pronounced very differently from language to language.
D. The Thai word “khrok fi,” which represents the sound of snoring, is an onomatopoeia.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
这位学生的笔记关于拟声词的研究内容可以总结如下：
- 拟声词是模仿它们所代表声音的词。
- 不同语言中表示相同声音的词往往书写和发音差异很大。
- 这种差异部分是由于语言结构的不同。
- “Khrok fi”是泰语中的一个拟声词，表示打鼾的声音。
- “Bhnosh”是孟加拉语中的一个拟声词，也表示打鼾的声音。
中文解析
题目要求contrast，于是要对比两个词（代表意义一样的俩词），B选项though从句和主句间是对比关系，但是他们写法和发音不一样，强调了对比差异。
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:
A film studies student is researching early 20th-century film serials, which consisted of individual episodes of a single long story that were shown weekly in theaters. Clancy of the Mounted is a 1933 serial that, over its 12 episodes, kept its audience interested with the suspense and drama that are typical of the northern adventure genre. The student, however, claims that ultimately audiences of the time preferred resolution and closure over ongoing tension.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the student’s claim?
selections: A. The 12th episode of Clancy of the Mounted was the most expensive episode of the series to produce.
B. The 12th episode of Clancy of the Mounted was viewed by more people than was any previous episode in the series.
C. Modern critics generally regard the first episode as the best installment of Clancy of the Mounted.
D. Audiences of the time considered Clancy of the Mounted to belong to a genre other than the northern adventure genre.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
这位电影研究生正在研究20世纪初的电影系列剧，这些系列剧由一系列单独的剧集组成，每周在电影院放映，以讲述一个长篇故事。《克兰西的骑警》（Clancy of the Mounted）是一部1933年的系列剧，通过12集的剧情，利用北方冒险类型的悬念和戏剧性吸引了观众。然而，这位学生声称，当时的观众最终更偏好故事的解决和结局，而不是持续的紧张感。
中文解析
文本最后claim说audiences倾向于resolution and closure over ongoing tension，那就是最后一个episode会更受到观众的喜爱，比起中间持续的episodes（on going tension），即B选项。第12个episode观众会更多。
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:
Whatever the general attitude toward Madeline Anderson’s 1970 film I Am Somebody and Reginald Hudlin’s 1990 film House Party when they were initially released, both films now tend to be regarded quite ________. In 2018, for example, critics for the New York Times praised the former as “galvanizing” and the latter as “exuberant.”

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
无论在最初上映时对马德琳·安德森1970年电影《我是一名重要人物》和雷金纳德·哈德林1990年电影《聚会》持有什么样的总体态度，这两部电影现在往往被认为相当积极。2018年，例如，《纽约时报》的评论家称前者为“激励人心”，后者为“充满活力”。
中文解析
从文本后面的例子可以看到积极的态度，比如praise等词汇的提示，于是需要选择积极的单词favorably
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:
Narwhals are shy whales that live in the remote Arctic Ocean. Some of them have a long tusk, like a unicorn horn, with sensitive nerves. Narwhals are known for this tusk, but many actually don’t have one and its purpose is unknown. One group of scientists came up with a possible purpose in 2014. The scientists suggested that the tusk may help narwhals determine when water around them is likely to start freezing and become dangerous for them. Marine biologist Kristin Laidre disagrees with that idea, though. She reasons that if the narwhal’s tusk serves such an important purpose, then it’s most likely that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. some narwhals would seek a new habitat.
B. more narwhals would have a tusk.
C. fewer marine animals would also have tusks.
D. narwhals would become less shy over time.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
独角鲸是生活在偏远北极海域的害羞鲸类。它们中的一些拥有一根像独角兽角一样的长牙，里面有敏感的神经。独角鲸因这根牙而闻名，但实际上许多独角鲸并没有这根牙，其用途仍然不明。2014年，科学家们提出了一个可能的用途。科学家们建议，这根牙可能帮助独角鲸判断周围的水何时可能开始结冰，从而变得对它们危险。然而，海洋生物学家克里斯汀·莱德尔对此观点表示不同意。她认为，如果独角鲸的牙具有如此重要的用途，那么最有可能的情况是 ________。
中文解析
Tusk的功能对于Narwhals有利，所以可以推断出更多的narwhals会进化出这个tusk，那么B是正确答
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:
To evaluate their ideas about environmental conditions in the Pliocene epoch, paleontologists must turn to ________ evidence. Only material objects—such as the fossil remains of the individual known as AL 200-1, discovered in Ethiopia in 1975—can show whether a particular idea about the Pliocene is defensible.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
要评估他们对上新世环境条件的想法，古生物学家必须依赖于______证据。只有物质对象——例如1975年在埃塞俄比亚发现的被称为AL 200-1的个体的化石遗骸——才能显示关于上新世的特定观点是否是合理的。
中文解析
在这个句子中的空白处，需要填入“实物”或“化石”这样的词，来强调物质证据的重要性。Material objects对应的就是physical evidence
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:
Treasure Island is an 1883 novel by Robert Louis Stevenson.When the narrator was a child, his father ran a hotel. A mysterious sailor came to stay at the hotel. The narrator was frightened of the sailor, as can be seen when the narrator says, ________

Which quotation from Treasure Island most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “How [the sailor] haunted my dreams, I need scarcely tell you. On stormy nights, when the wind shook the four corners of the house and the surf roared along the cove and up the cliffs, I would see him in a thousand forms, and with a thousand diabolical expressions.”
B. “I remember [the sailor] as if it were yesterday, as he came plodding to the inn door, his sea-chest following behind him in a hand-barrow.”
C. “[The sailor] was a very silent man by custom. All day he hung round the cove or upon the cliffs with a brass telescope.”

D. “All the time he lived with us [the sailor] made no change whatever in his dress but to buy some stockings from a hawker. One of the [corners] of his hat having fallen down, he let it hang from that day forth, though it was a great annoyance when it blew.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在罗伯特·路易斯·史蒂文森的小说《金银岛》中，叙述者小时候的父亲经营着一家酒店。一位神秘的水手来到酒店住宿，叙述者对这位水手感到害怕。这种恐惧可以通过叙述者的描述体现出来，比如他可能会说：“那个水手身上散发着一种令人不安的气息，他的眼神中闪烁着不寻常的光芒，让我不由自主感到战栗。”这种对水手的恐惧感为故事奠定了紧张的基调。
中文解析
Was frightened of表示感到担忧或害怕，于是A选项中的stormy night，wind shook等场景描述能够支持
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:
Students in a biology class investigated why individual house mice (Mus musculus) can differ from one another in their susceptibility to cataracts in old age. The students compared wild-type mice and knockout mice, which are mice with specific genes deactivated, when mice of each type were raised in similar naturalistic environments and periodically tested for cataracts. Finding that knockout mice with the gene Aasdh deactivated tended to develop cataracts more frequently than did wild-type mice, the students concluded that differences in cataract frequency among house mice in nature are solely attributable to variations in the level of expression of Aasdh.

Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the students’ conclusion?
selections: A. Some wild-type mice were very similar to the knockout mice with regard to cataract frequency but showed a wide variety of levels of expression of Aasdh.
B. The level of expression of Aasdh does not appear to affect the functioning of any other genes in house mice.
C. A sampling of house mice captured in natural settings shows that individual mice can differ from one another in the level of expression of Aasdh.
D. The mice with Aasdh deactivated were identical to the wild-type mice except with regard to cataract frequency.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
生物课的学生们研究了为什么个体家鼠（Mus musculus）在老年时对白内障的易感性会有所不同。学生们比较了野生型小鼠和基因敲除小鼠，这些基因敲除小鼠的特定基因被灭活。当这两种小鼠在相似的自然环境中饲养并定期检测白内障时，发现基因Aasdh被灭活的基因敲除小鼠比野生型小鼠更频繁地出现白内障。学生们因此得出结论，家鼠在自然界中白内障发生频率的差异完全可以归因于Aasdh基因表达水平的差异。
中文解析
文本学生的结论是cataract frequency只和Aasdh的水平相关，但是如果wild-type mice和knockout mice的cataract frequency一样，但是Aasdh levels差异很大，这就说明学生的结论错了，因为还有别的因素在影响。
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:
Joseph A. Walker’s award-winning play The River Niger was produced in 1972 by the groundbreaking Negro Ensemble Company (NEC). NEC cofounder Douglas Turner Ward, who worked as an actor, director, and playwright, had met actor and producer Robert Hooks while they were performing in a 1960 touring production of Lorraine Hansberry’s play A Raisin in the Sun. Together, they envisioned a theater company that would nurture and showcase the work of Black theater professionals. Since NEC’s founding in 1967, its workshops and performances have given Black playwrights, including Walker, a forum for their compelling stories.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It illustrates the importance of an organization mentioned in the text.
B. It compares the achievements of two people discussed later in the text.
C. It argues against the claim made earlier in the text.
D. It provides additional information about a person discussed in the text.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
约瑟夫·A·沃克（Joseph A. Walker）获奖的剧作《尼日尔河》（The River Niger）于1972年由开创性的黑人合奏公司（Negro Ensemble Company, NEC）制作。NEC的联合创始人道格拉斯·特纳·沃德（Douglas Turner Ward）是一位演员、导演和剧作家，他在1960年与演员和制片人罗伯特·胡克斯（Robert Hooks）一起演出洛林·汉斯伯里的剧作《阳光下的葡萄干》（A Raisin in the Sun）时相识。两人共同构想了一个剧团，旨在培养和展示黑人戏剧专业人士的作品。自1967年NEC成立以来，其工作坊和演出为包括沃克在内的黑人剧作家提供了一个展示自己引人入胜故事的平台。
中文解析
划线句是Douglas Turner Ward的后置定语，给出了关于Douglas的具体描述，和D选项保持一致
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:
Smartphones and other small electronic devices tend to use batteries that can’t be easily taken out and swapped for new ones. Environmental policy researcher Jean-Pierre Schweitzer warns that when these internal batteries stop working, the devices are usually thrown away, becoming harmful ________.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
环境政策研究员让-皮埃尔·施韦策（Jean-Pierre Schweitzer）警告说，当这些内部电池停止工作时，设备通常会被丢弃，成为有害的电子废物。
中文解析
当电池被丢弃，变成了有害废品 harmful waste
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:
Animals use many objects as tools to achieve goals more easily. Such goals include grooming, finding food, and protecting themselves. For a long time, people thought tool use was unique to primates. Sea otters and other animals, though, have busted the myth that tool use is limited to certain primates. Inventively, sea otters use stationary anvil stones to break open mollusk shells. Woodpecker finches also get creative. They use cactus spines to pry insects from hiding places.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Animals find it difficult to use objects as tools.
B. Unlike primates, sea otters are exceptionally skillful at using different tools.
C. Contrary to long-held beliefs, primates aren’t the only animals to use tools.
D. There are many myths about tool use that researchers are starting to challenge.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
动物们使用许多物体作为工具，以更轻松地实现目标。这些目标包括梳理毛发、寻找食物和保护自己。长期以来，人们认为工具使用是灵长类动物所独有的。然而，海獺和其他动物打破了这一神话，证明工具使用并不仅限于某些灵长类动物。海獺巧妙地利用固定的砧石来敲开软体动物的外壳。啄木鸟雀也展现了创造力，它们使用仙人掌刺来撬出藏匿的昆虫。
中文解析
文本前三句表达长期以来人们觉得只有灵长类能使用工具，后半段则说sea otters等动物也能使用工具，与C选项一致。
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:
Over 600 languages are spoken in New York City in addition to English––one can find Bartangi spoken in the neighborhood of Yorkville, or Ghale in Jackson Heights. Most speakers of Chinese languages reside in the neighborhood of Flushing (part of New York City’s borough of Queens) and in Chinatown, in the borough of Manhattan. New immigrants from north China, where Mandarin is the primary first language, tend to settle in Queens, while new immigrants from south China, where many people speak Cantonese or Fuzhounese as a first language, tend to settle in Manhattan. It can therefore be inferred that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. languages tend to change more rapidly in areas where many languages are spoken than in areas where few languages are spoken.
B. correlations in a country between languages and regions where they are spoken can replicate themselves in a new country to which the original country’s citizens emigrate.
C. languages spoken by immigrant peoples can differ significantly in vocabulary and pronunciation from those same languages in their country of origin.
D. there is a positive correlation between the physical size of a country and the number of languages spoken in that country.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在纽约市，除了英语外，还有超过600种语言在使用——在Yorkville社区可以听到巴尔坦吉语，在Jackson Heights可以听到嘎勒语。大多数讲中文的人居住在法拉盛（属于纽约市的皇后区）和曼哈顿的唐人街。来自北中国的新移民，普通话是他们的主要母语，往往倾向于定居在皇后区；而来自南中国的新移民，许多人以粤语或福州话为母语，则倾向于定居在曼哈顿。因此，可以推断出______。
中文解析
根据文本铺垫中国不同地带人到达纽约后，聚居地依旧也呈现出不同方言，于是说明了语言和地区关系再新的地方得以复制。
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:
The following text is adapted from Kenneth Grahame’s 1908 novel The Wind in the Willows. The Mole has been found by a friend after getting lost in the woods. It is beginning to snow.
The Mole saw the wood that had been so dreadful to him in quite a changed aspect. Holes, hollows, pools, pitfalls, and other menaces to the wayfarer were vanishing fast, and a gleaming carpet was springing up everywhere, that looked too delicate to be trodden upon by rough feet.

As used in the text, what does the word "delicate" most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
这段文字改编自肯尼斯·格雷厄姆1908年的小说《溪边的伙伴》。鼹鼠在树林中迷路后，终于被朋友找到。雪开始飘落。
鼹鼠看到那片曾让他感到恐惧的树林，变得截然不同。那些可怕的洞穴、凹陷、水池、陷阱以及其他对旅人的威胁正迅速消失，四处都在冒出一层闪亮的地毯，显得如此细腻，似乎不适合粗糙的脚步踩踏。
中文解析
文本背景是下雪时，文本最后a gleaming carpet是雪地的比喻，太delicate而不能被踏足（to be trodden upon by rough feet）,于是delicate表达fragile，脆弱容易被破坏的意思
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:
Jean Batten, who was the first person to fly between England and New Zealand solo, and Ynes Mexia, who was the first to discover the botanical genus Mexianthus, are ensured lasting places in our historical memory. No matter what others may do in the future, nobody can ever ________ the standing of these women as the first to accomplish these feats.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
珍·巴滕是第一位单人飞行往返于英格兰和新西兰的人，而伊内斯·梅西亚是第一位发现植物属墨西安图斯的人，她们在历史记忆中占据着持久的位置。无论未来他人如何作为，没人能 ever ________ 这两位女性作为第一位完成这些壮举的地位。
中文解析
文本铺垫“first person”在历史上的地位，于是后世无论人们做了什么，都无法削弱（undermine）第一名们的功绩
exam_name: 2024年8月第2&7套阅读语法（只有44道题）

question:
Burt Kotler and colleagues showed that high moonlight intensity inhibits the activity of the greater Egyptian gerbil (Gerbillus pyramidum), a finding explicable in terms of benefits and costs: greater lunar intensity may not enable the gerbils to increase foraging success enough to offset the higher chance of detection by predatory foxes or owls. Though many other nocturnal mammals respond to lunar intensity variations similarly to greater Egyptian gerbils, Mohol bushbabies (Galago moholi) display the opposite pattern, as their heavy reliance on visual foraging results in a different balance of reward and risk.

Which choice best describes the function of the reference to "heavy reliance on visual foraging" in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It emphasizes an attribute of Mohol bushbabies that enables them to respond to lunar intensity variations more rapidly than greater Egyptian gerbils and many other nocturnal mammals do.
B. It identifies a characteristic of Mohol bushbabies that explains why they do not reduce their activity under high lunar intensity like greater Egyptian gerbils and many other nocturnal mammals do.
C. It describes a behavioral pattern displayed by Mohol bushbabies that is inconsistent with how they would be expected to respond to high lunar intensity based on benefits and costs.

D. It presents a trait of Mohol bushbabies that serves as evidence for the assertion that greater Egyptian gerbils are not the only nocturnal mammals whose activity is inhibited by high lunar intensity.

题目文本翻译
Burt Kotler及其同事的研究表明，高月光强度会抑制埃及大沙鼠（Gerbillus pyramidum）的活动，这一发现可以通过收益与成本的平衡来解释：较强的月光可能不足以使沙鼠增加觅食成功率，以弥补被捕食者（如狐狸或猫头鹰）发现的更高风险。虽然许多其他夜行性哺乳动物对月光强度变化的反应与埃及大沙鼠相似，莫霍尔树猴（Galago moholi）却表现出相反的模式，因为它们对视觉觅食的高度依赖导致了收益与风险之间不同的平衡。
中文解析
Heavy reliance on visual foraging是Mohol Bushbabies在月光很亮时依旧出来活动的原因，也是和Egyptian gerbil表现不一致的原因，于是选择B选项

question:
Text 1
Isaac Asimov, author of The Caves of Steel and The Stars, Like Dust, is highly regarded despite his mediocre writing style. His prose is workmanlike; his characters are flat and discuss ideas rather than emotions. That his work is enjoyable despite this is a testament to his prodigious imagination-even if people read his books only for the ideas, they will have plenty to consider.
Text 2
Asimov is critiqued for his style, but it is wrong to fault a writer for failing to do what he never intended to do. For example, although most of his novel Foundation consists of people discussing science and politics and we find out little about his characters’ lives Asimov wanted to convey the vast sweep of human history over centuries, and one of his points is that at such a timescale, individuals don’t matter. Thus his lack of characterization is central to his thematic aims.

Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the description of Asimov’s characters in the underlined portion of Text 1？
selections: A. Asimov’s characterizations would have been richer if he had possessed a deeper understanding of history.
B. The flatness of Asimov’s characters is a feature of The Caves of Steel and The Stars, Like Dust but not of Foundation.
C. The flatness of Asimov’s characters should not necessarily be considered a flaw in his writing.
D. Asimov’s characterizations would have been more believable if his writing had discussed fewer ideas.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
文本1
艾萨克·阿西莫夫是《钢铁洞穴》和《星辰如尘》等作品的作者，尽管他的写作风格平庸，但备受推崇。他的文风勤奋务实；他的人物平面，更多讨论思想而非情感。尽管如此，他的作品仍然令人愉悦，这证明了他非凡的想象力——即使人们只是因为他的观点而阅读他的书，他们也会有很多东西值得思考。
文本2
阿西莫夫因其风格而受到批评，但责备一个作家未能做他从未打算做的事情是不公平的。例如，虽然他的小说《基地》大部分内容都是人们讨论科学和政治，我们对他的人物生活了解甚少，但阿西莫夫想要传达的是人类历史在数个世纪内的广阔篇章，他的其中一个观点是在这种时间尺度上，个体并不重要。因此，他的缺乏人物塑造是与他的主题目标密切相关的。
中文解析
Text 2第一句表达了Asimov的风格问题（his characters are flat）是作者故意的，最后再次说明是为了主题才这样做，于是我们可以得出结论，text2会认为flatness of characters不见得是写作的瑕疵不足。

question: The area of a triangle is equal to <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math> quare centimeters. The length of the base of the triangle is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>12.5</mn></math> centimeters,and the height of the triangle is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>5</mn></math> centimeters.What is the value of x?
explanations: 根据题目表述：三角形面积<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>,长是2x+12.5，宽是x-5 ，得到面积=<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi> </mrow> <mo>+</mo> <mn>12.5</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi> </mrow> <mo>−</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>,整理式子得到2.5x-62.5=0，x=25

question: For the linear function p,<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>p</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6</mn></math>,where c is a constant,<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>p</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>26</mn></math>,and the slope of the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>p</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> in the xy-plane is 8. For the linear function t,<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7</mn></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>38</mn></math>.What is the slope of the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> in the xy-plane?
explanations: p过点（c，-6）和（3，26），斜率为8，可得c=-1，再通过点（-1，-7）和（4，38）算出t的斜率为9

question: Rectangles ABCD and EFGH are similar. The length of each side of EFGH is 10 times the length of the corresponding side of ABCD. The area of ABCD is 100 square units. What is the area, in square units, of EFGH?
explanations: 长度比为10，面积比为100，所以EFGH面积为100*100=10000

question: The difference between the measure of angle A and the measure of angle B is  <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>4</mn></mfrac><mi>π</mi></math>  radians. question: Triangle QRS is similar to triangle FGH such that Q, R, and S correspond to F, G and H, respectively. Each side of triangle FGH has the  1 4  length of its corresponding side in triangle QRS. In triangle FGH, the measure of angle F is 35°, the measure of angle G is 8°, and FG=a. In triangle QRS, the measure of angle Q is b° and  Q R = 20. What is the value of a+b?
explanations: 相似三角形对应角相等，b=Q=F=35，对应边成比例（本题1/4）a=FG=20*(1/4)=5，a+b=40

question: In March, an account manager completed 15 more than 3 times the number of sales the account manager completed in April. In March and April, the account manager completed 327 sales. How many sales did the account manager complete in April?

question: Which expression is a factor of<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn> 2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>30</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn></math>?

question:

question: A scientist makes batches of bricks using different sand-to-cement ratios to test how the sand-to-cement ratio affects the strength of the brick. For one batch of bricks, the scientist uses 4,880 cubic centimeters (<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mn>3</mn></msup></math>) of sand and cement, where the ratio of the volume of sand to the volume of cement is 7 to 3. If s represents the volume, in <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mn>3</mn></msup></math>, of sand and c represents the volume, in<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mn>3</mn></msup></math>, of cement that the scientist uses for this batch of bricks, which system of equations represents this situation?
explanations: 根据题意<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>4880</mn><mtext>,</mtext></math>，s/c=7/3（7c=3s），故选D

question: The function p is defined by<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi> p</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>c</mi><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow></math>, where a, b, and c are constants. In the xy-plane, the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> passes through the points<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>24</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>and (0, 899).what is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>12</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>?
explanations: 对数字敏感的话，可以看出函数中x=-6为对称轴（根据平方符号），所以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>24</mn><mo>,</mo><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>12</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>899</mn></math>,答案为24+899=923

question: If the perimeter of an equilateral triangle with a height of 46 units is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>a</mi> <msqrt> <mn>3</mn> </msqrt></math> units, what is the value of a?
explanations: 根据reference中特殊三角形得知，等边三角形的高是边长的<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <msqrt> <mn>3</mn> </msqrt> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac></math>倍，边长为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>46</mn> <mo>∗</mo> <mfrac> <mn>2</mn> <msqrt> <mn>3</mn> </msqrt> </mfrac></math>，根据题目可以建立等式<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>3</mn> <mo>∗</mo> <mn>46</mn> <mo>∗</mo> <mfrac> <mn>2</mn> <msqrt> <mn>3</mn> </msqrt> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msqrt> <mn>3</mn> </msqrt> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi></math>得到a=92

question: A square map has a side length of 35 inches, and 1 inch on the map represents an actual distance of 17 miles. A smaller version of the same map is printed as a square with the side length 55% shorter than the side length of the previous map. On the smaller map, which of the following is closest to the actual distance, in miles, represented by 1 inch?
explanations: 1inch表示17mile，之后相同地图比例缩小55%，意味着0.45inch就表示17mile，所以每inch表示17/0.45=37.78mile，选D（利用常识辅助理解：小地图每单位长度肯定代表更大得距离）

question:

Which of the following equations displays, as a constant or coefficient, the maximum value of the function it defines, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>0</mn></math>?
Ⅰ.<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>16</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1.24</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>x</mi></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>43</mn></math>

question:
Since the Hubble Space Telescope was launched into space in 1990, astronauts have needed to complete regular missions to repair the telescope and keep it working smoothly. Researchers hope that robots will soon be able to make these repairs. Employing robots instead of humans to make repairs will be helpful, as _______ astronauts to maintain the telescope can be expensive.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
句子中大意表达希望robots能够替代人去做修理工作，因为依赖人力去做造价太高，于是选择relying on
B.题目文本翻译
自1990年哈勃太空望远镜被送入太空以来，宇航员们一直需要完成定期的任务来修复望远镜并确保其正常运行。研究人员希望机器人很快能够完成这些修复任务。使用机器人而不是人类进行修理将是有益的，因为维护望远镜所需的宇航员可能会很昂贵。

question:
In 1776, the United States sent Benjamin Franklin to France to try to win the country’s support in the United States’ fight for independence from Great Britain. Franklin was very popular in France. This _______ surely helped him to convince France to assist the United States.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
第一句中描述Franklin was popular, 于是第二句需要类似的意义，那就是受欢迎，受崇敬，选esteem
B.题目文本翻译
1776年，美国派遣本杰明·富兰克林前往法国，试图赢得法国对美国脱离大不列颠独立的支持。富兰克林在法国非常受欢迎。这无疑帮助他说服法国协助美国。

question:
Becoming a member of the organization on Indigenous Photograph has helped Sara Aliaga Ticona (Aymara) to ________ her work with an audience beyond Bolivia, where she’s from. The organization’s database of members is used by photography editors and others in the media industry around the world.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
根据第二句 is used by photography editors and others around the world, 使用人群遍及世界，于是可以和第一句audience beyond Bolivia一致，是描述作品共享范围之广，选share。
B.题目文本翻译
成为土著摄影组织的成员帮助了来自玻利维亚的莎拉·阿利亚加·蒂科纳（Aymara）将她的作品展示给更广泛的国际观众。该组织的成员数据库被全球的摄影编辑和其他媒体行业人士使用。

question:
“Coyote” is an example of a loanword— that is, a word that originated in one language and was later adopted by another. The word came to English indirectly from coyote, the Spanish word for the wild canine species. Spanish had borrowed it from Nahuatl, an Indigenous language of Central Mexico, in which the word’s original form is coyotl. “Condor” also has an Indigenous origin and entered English through Spanish. But in this case, the original source was Quechua, a language of South America, in which the word for the large vulture species is kuntur.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. The English words “coyote” and “condor” are both examples of loanwords from Indigenous languages.
B. When borrowing from Indigenous languages, Spanish adopted roughly as many words from Quehua.
C. Many Spanish words with Indigenous origins first passed through English before entering Spanish.
D. When non-Indigenous languages borrowed from Indigenous languages, the words often underwent a significant change in meaning.
explanations:
A.中文解析
A选项指出英文中的两个单词是外来语loanwords，来自于indigenous language，是文章的基本大意，B选项as many as数量一样没有依据，C选项说反了语言流动的顺序，D选项单词经历了外形变化，但是没有说经历了意义的重大变化，没有依据。这个题目多次变体，不要受之前答案的思维定式影响。
B.题目文本翻译
“Coyote”是一个借词的例子，即一种起源于一种语言并后来被另一种语言采用的词汇。这个词最初是从西班牙语的coyote（指一种野生的犬科动物）间接传入英语的。西班牙语是从纳瓦特尔语中借用这个词的，纳瓦特尔语是中部墨西哥的一个土著语言，其原始形式是coyotl。“Condor”也具有土著起源，是通过西班牙语进入英语的。但在这种情况下，原始来源是南美的克丘亚语，克丘亚语中大型秃鹰物种的名称是kuntur。

question:
Memoirs of Elleanor Eldridge is an 1838 historical account by Elleanor Eldridge and Frances Harriet Whipple Green. In the book, the authors assert that people don’t need to be famous to be worthy of memoirs, writing, ________

Which quotation from Memoirs of Elleanor Eldridge most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “Then let no one turn with too much [fussiness] from the simple story of the humble Elleanor, though it may contain few, or none, of the thrilling charms of poetry and passion.”

B. “There is often a kind of [deceptive] light, playing around such [famous] names, calculated to dazzle and mislead, by their false lustre, until the eye can no longer receive the pure light of Truth, or the mind appreciate real excellence, or intrinsic worth.”
C. “It should not be considered essential to the interest and value of biography, that its subject be of exalted rank, or illustrious name.”

D. “How careful ought we to be to speak nothing but the truth, even in regard to the most trifling circumstances; and not only so, but to be well assured that what we suppose to be true, is truth, before we receive it as such.”
explanations:
A.中文解析
文本assertion说people don't need to be famous to be worthy of memoirs, 大意就是无需非得是名人才值得有传记，C选项中subject of exalted rank, or illustrious name 指的是名人，It should not be considered essential to the interest and value of biography, 表明这不是传记的必要符合原文末尾的assertion。
B.题目文本翻译
《埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇的回忆录》是埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇和弗朗西斯·哈丽特·惠普尔·格林于1838年撰写的历史记录。在这本书中，作者们断言人们无需成为名人才配得上有回忆录，写道：________”

question:
The following text is from Yung Wing’s 1909 memoir My Life in China and America. Yung Wing was the first American college graduate of Chinese heritage; Phoebe Brown was the first prominent female hymn writer in the United States.
I look back upon my acquaintance with Mrs. Phoebe H. Brown with a mingled feeling of respect and admiration. She certainly was a remarkable New England woman — a woman of surpassing strength of moral and religious character. Those who have had the rare privilege of reading her stirring biography, will, I am sure, bear me out in this statement. She went through the crucible of unprecedented adversities and trials of life and came out one of the rare shining lights that beautify the New England sky.

Which choice best describes the function of the reference to Brown’s biography in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It emphasizes that Brown’s life has been a popular subject for writers because it was so remarkable.
B. It suggests that other people who are familiar with Brown’s life would share the author’s view of her.
C. It explains why Brown was unique amongst her peers.
D. It describes the nature of the relationship between Yung and Brown.
explanations:
A.中文解析
Bear out表示支持，划线句大意是但凡读过Phoebe传记的人都会支持我的观点，和B选选项一致，熟悉她的人会和作者观点一样。
B.题目文本翻译
以下文字摘自容闳1909年的回忆录《我的中国和美国生活》。容闳是美国第一位中国裔本科毕业生；菲比·布朗是美国第一位著名的女诗歌作家。
回忆起我与菲比·H·布朗夫人的相识，我心中涌现出一种融合了尊重和钦佩的复杂感情。她无疑是一位非凡的新英格兰女性——一个拥有非凡道德和宗教品格力量的女性。那些有幸阅读过她感人传记的人，我相信，会支持我所说。她经历了前所未有的逆境和生活的考验，成为了一位照亮新英格兰天空的稀有闪亮之光之一。

question:
The following text is from Mary Shelley’s 1818 novel Frankenstein. Victor Frankenstein, who is narrating this portion of text, describes the state of scientific knowledge as he began his own study of the natural world.
The untaught peasant beheld the elements around him and was acquainted with their practical uses. The most learned philosopher knew little more. He had partially unveiled the face of Nature, but her immortal lineaments were still a wonder and a mystery. He might dissect, anatomise, and give names; but, not to speak of a final cause, causes in their secondary and tertiary grades were utterly unknown to him. I had gazed upon the fortifications and impediments that seemed to keep human beings from entering the citadel of nature, and rashly and ignorantly I had repined.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It explains what can be gained from a scientific approach to understanding natural phenomena.
B. It describes an intensely debated scientific controversy that Victor dedicated his life to resolving.
C. It undermines the idea that a practical approach to understanding natural phenomena is inferior to a scientific approach.
D. It suggests that Victor did not discover what he wanted to know from the scientific research available to him.
explanations:
A.中文解析
划线句整体态度消极，表达主人公无法通过scientific knowledge（标题的背景需要重视）来探究终极原因（final cause），和D选项描述Victor无法发现通过scientific research发现自己想知道的事情是一致的表述。
B.题目文本翻译
以下文字摘自玛丽·雪莱1818年的小说《弗兰肯斯坦》。维克多·弗兰肯斯坦正在叙述这段文字，描述了他开始研究自然界时科学知识的状态。
未受教育的农民看到身边的元素，了解它们的实际用途。最博学的哲学家也知之甚少。他已经部分揭开了自然的面纱，但她永恒的线条仍然是一个奇迹和谜团。他可能会解剖、解剖学，给事物命名；但是，更不用说最终原因，次生和三级原因对他来说完全是未知的。我曾凝视着那些似乎让人类无法进入自然堡垒的防御工事和障碍物，轻率而无知地我曾怨恨。

question:
In the 1940s, Evelyn Cunningham worked for the Pittsburgh Courier, focusing on coverage of the early civil rights movement. Cunningham’s accomplishment is just one example of the rich history of Black journalism in the United States. That history is preserved by the National Association of Black Journalists, which was founded in Washington, DC, in 1975 to support Black media professionals and honor people like Cunningham.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. The National Association of Black Journalists was founded in Washington, DC, in the 1900s.
B. Black journalist has an interesting history both inside and outside the United States.
C. Cunningham’s achievements are often overlooked in countries other than the United States.
D. Black journalism in the United States has an important history that the National Association of Black Journalists helps to honor.
explanations:
A.中文解析
本段的末尾句是概括主旨的重中之重，态度是积极地，概括起来是National Association of Black Journalists 用来支持敬仰black journalism，例如Cunningham这类人，和D选项是一致的。A和B没有抓住重点，C的态度是消极的。
B.题目文本翻译
在1940年代，伊芙琳·坎宁安在匹兹堡信使报工作，专注于早期民权运动的报道。坎宁安的成就只是美国黑人新闻业丰富历史的一个例子。这一历史由美国黑人记者协会保留，该协会成立于1975年在华盛顿特区，旨在支持黑人媒体专业人士，并纪念像坎宁安这样的人物。

question:
There are over 150 species of the cactus genus Mammillaria throughout the Americas, but their survival can be threatened by high precipitation and dense vegetation that blocks sunlight. Researchers have located species from the genus in almost every state in Mexico, with several of them, like M. knippeliana, restricted to only one state. The fact that this genus has not been observed in eastern and western Coahuila has been attributed to a lack of appropriate habitat, but much of the landscape in this area is notoriously inaccessible, which suggests that _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. M. knippeliana may have been overlooked in eastern and western Coahuila because of its similarity to another species.
B. the current methods of collecting and tracking Mammillaria species throughout Mexico may cause an overestimation of the number of species in this genus.
C. the perceived absence of Mammillaria in eastern and western Coahuila may be due to insufficient exploration of the region.
D. the dense vegetation and high annual precipitation levels in eastern and western Coahuila impede the ability of Mammillaria species to survive.
explanations:
A.中文解析
文本的重点是最后两句，M.knippeliana restricted to only one state只在一个地方有，much of the landscape in eastern and western Coahuila is inaccessible说明我们没有发现，很可能是这个地方我们没有办法进去，没有办法深入考察，于是才以为当地没有，这和C选项的insufficient exploration是一致的。
B.题目文本翻译
仙人掌属植物种类 Mammillaria 在整个美洲有150多种，但它们的生存可能会受到高降水量和密集植被遮挡阳光的威胁。研究人员在墨西哥几乎每个州都发现了这个属的物种，其中一些，如 M. knippeliana，仅限于一个州。这个属植物在科阿韦拉州的东部和西部尚未被观察到的事实被归因于缺乏适宜的栖息地，但该地区的许多地貌因难以接近而臭名昭著，这表明 _______。

question:
Why do ocelots purr but jaguars roar? Researchers hypothesize that this difference between the two feline species may be partly due to a U-shaped bone in their throats called the hyoid. Ocelots, which are much smaller than jaguars, have a rigid hyoid that rumbles when the cat’s larynx vibrates, resulting in a purr. By contrast, jaguars have a somewhat flexible hyoid, and the bone is attached to the skull with a stretchy ligament that ocelots lack. These traits allow jaguars and most other species of big cats to produce powerful roars. The same traits may also prevent most big cats from purring.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Both ocelots and jaguars have U-shaped hyoid bones, but ocelots’ hyoids are rigid whereas jaguars’ hyoids are flexible.
B. Researchers are uncertain why relatively small cats, such as ocelots, purr but relatively large cats, such as jaguars, roar.
C. Jaguars and most other species of big cats can roar because they have flexible hyoid bones that are attached by stretchy ligaments to their skulls.
D. Differences related to the hyoid bone in ocelots and jaguars may help explain why one species purrs and the other roars.
explanations:
A.中文解析
文章是问答式的，问题提出ocelots purr but jaguars roar,回答则具体解释了原因是因为hyoid bone的差异造成，这和D选项的表述是一致的。
B.题目文本翻译
为什么豹猫会发出呜咽声而美洲豹会咆哮？研究人员假设这两种猫科动物之间的这种差异可能部分原因于它们喉部的一个U形骨骼，称为舌骨。豹猫比美洲豹要小得多，它们有一个僵硬的舌骨，当猫的喉结振动时会发出低吟声，结果就是呜咽声。相比之下，美洲豹有一个有些灵活的舌骨，这根骨骼通过一个弹性韧带连接到头骨，而豹猫缺少这种结构。这些特征使得美洲豹和大多数其他大型猫科动物能够发出强劲的咆哮声。同样的特征可能也阻止了大多数大型猫科动物发出呜咽声。

question:
To understand the extent of deforestation in the Chorotega region of Costa Rica, Juan Pablo Arroyo-Mora and colleagues used historical aerial photography and remote sensing data to track changes in the forest cover area across different land use capability classes (categories that indicate possible uses of forest land). Due to the Chorotega region’s climate, various types of forested areas were converted to cattle pasture as rising international meat prices drove a cattle ranching boom in the 1960s and 1970s. By the mid-1980s, however, increased public awareness and environmental reforms, along with a decline in meat prices, triggered a natural regrowth process, as evident by the ______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the assertion?
selections: A. increase in the forest cover area for all classes from 1979 to 2000.
B. similarity in forest cover area in Class I-IV and Class VII in 1986.
C. difference between the forest cover area in Class I-IV and in Class VI in 2000.
D. decrease in the forest cover area for all classes from 1960 to 1979.
explanations:
A.中文解析
题目文本最后说natural regrowth process of forests, 于是只有A选项能够支持，之处了1979年后整体的增长趋势。
B.题目文本翻译
为了了解哥斯达黎加乔罗特加地区的森林砍伐程度，胡安·巴勃罗·阿罗约-莫拉和同事们利用历史航空摄影和遥感数据跟踪不同土地利用能力类别（指示森林用地可能用途的类别）的森林覆盖面积变化。由于乔罗特加地区的气候，1960年代和1970年代国际肉类价格上涨推动了牛肉养殖业的繁荣，导致各种类型的森林地区被转换为牛场。然而，到了1980年代中期，随着公众意识的增强和环境改革，以及肉类价格下降，触发了自然再生过程，这表现在 ______。

question:
The creation of Lotte Reiniger’s 1926 animated film The Adventures of Prince Achmed was ________ process. Over the course of three years, Reiniger and her collaborators painstakingly made more than 250,000 individual images of hand-cut paper silhouettes and repeatedly had to invent entirely new methods and tools to create the special effects Reiniger envisioned.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
根据后面描述耗时3年，painstakingly表示艰苦卓绝地，于是前面应该选arduous（艰苦的）来和后面的具体艰苦描述表述一致。
B.题目文本翻译
洛特·赖尼格尔的1926年动画电影《阿赫梅德王子的冒险》的创作过程是一个费时的过程。在三年的时间里，赖尼格尔和她的合作者们费力地制作了超过25万个手工剪纸剪影，并不断发明全新的方法和工具来实现赖尼格尔设想的特效。

question:
The 1958 poem “The Ghost’s Leavetaking” by American author Sylvia Plath _______ the first use of the word “dreamscape.”

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子没有谓语，A,B,C都是非谓语形式，于是选D contains。
