question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●The French Republican calendar was used in France from 1793 to 1805.
●Each calendar week had ten days, two of which were called quintidi and decadi.
●Each quintidi was given a unique name in honor of an animal.
●Each decadi was given a unique name in honor of an agricultural tool.
●Bélier, a quintidi in the month of Thermidor, was named after the ram.
●Crible, a decadi in the month of Nivose, was named after the sieve.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between quintidi and decadi. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. One quintidi during the month of Thermidor was named after an animal, the ram.
B. Each quintidi in the calendar honored an animal, such as the ram, whereas each decadi honored an agricultural tool, such as the sieve.
C. There were ten days in each week of the French Republican calendar, and two of these days were called quintidi and decadi.
D. Each decadi was named after an agricultural tool; for example, a decadi during the month of Nivose was named after the sieve.
explanations: 这个选择清楚地强调了quintidi和decadi之间的区别，quintidi表示像公羊这样的动物，而decadi表示像筛子这样的农业工具。它有效地利用了关于法国共和日历中这两个日子的独特名称和荣誉的注释信息，来说明这两个日子的区别。

question:
A painting by 19th-century artist Katsushika Hokusai, _______

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. deeper thematic meaning is conveyed to viewers of The Great Wave off Kanagawa through visual allegory.
B. The Great Wave off Kanagawa’s deeper thematic meaning is conveyed to viewers through visual allegory.
C. visual allegory allows The Great Wave off Kanagawa to convey its deeper thematic meaning to viewers.
D. The Great Wave off Kanagawa employs visual allegory to convey its deeper thematic meaning to viewers.
explanations: 这个题需要主语和A painting保持一致，于是只有D符合。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Kepler’s first law of planetary motion states that the orbit of a planet around the Sun is an ellipse.
●The law also states that, in an elliptical orbit, the object being orbited is one of the ellipse’s foci.
●Kepler’s laws of planetary motion also apply to natural satellites (e.g., moons).
●Umbriel is a moon of Uranus that orbits the planet in 4.14 Earth days on average.
●Umbriel’s orbit is elliptical.

The student wants to provide an explanation and example of Kepler’s first law of planetary motion. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Umbriel’s orbit of Uranus is elliptical, demonstrating Kepler’s first law of planetary motion, which describes the elliptical orbits of planets but applies to moons as well.
B. Kepler’s first law of planetary motion states that the orbit of a planet around the Sun is an ellipse; for example, planetary satellites orbit their planets in an elliptical fashion.
C. Kepler’s first law of planetary motion, which describes the orbits of Uranus and other planets in the solar system, states that the object being orbited is one of the ellipse’s foci.
D. Uranus’s moon Umbriel completes an orbit in 4.14 Earth days on average, a clear example of Kepler’s first law of planetary motion, which describes the elliptical orbit of planets.
explanations: A选项明确指出 Umbriel 的轨道是椭圆形的，直接展示了开普勒第一定律的应用。它不仅描述了行星的椭圆轨道，还提到这一定律适用于卫星，完整地使用了笔记中的信息。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●The black-footed ferret is a mammal species.
●Up until 1981, it was believed to be extinct.
●That year, a live black-footed ferret was identified in the wild in the United States.
●The black-footed ferret is considered a Lazarus species.
●“Lazarus species” is a term for living species of organisms that were once believed to be extinct.

The student wants to define the term “Lazarus species” and provide an example of one. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish these goals?
selections: A. The term “Lazarus species” describes a living species of organism, such as the black-footed ferret, that was once believed to be extinct.
B. Sometimes, a species once believed to be extinct is later found living in the wild.
C. The black-footed ferret, a species of mammal, was identified in the wild in 1981.
D. One example of a Lazarus species is the black-footed ferret, a mammal species that was identified in the wild in the United States in 1981.
explanations: 题目要求define “Lazarus species”并提供例子，于是A选项前半句是定语，such as之后是example满足条件。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Louis Ballard was a classical composer and citizen of the Quapaw Tribe.
●He is one of the first composers to synthesize Western classical music with elements from various Native musical traditions.
●Ballard’s Pan Indian Rhythms(1970) for percussion is written in a classical form.
●It incorporates Ute notched sticks, a traditional Native instrument.

The student wants to provide an example of the way in which Ballard’s compositions blend Western classical music with elements of Native musical traditions. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Ballard, who wrote Pan Indian Rhythms for percussion, is recognized as one of the first composers to blend elements of various Native American musical traditions with Western classical music.
B. Blending elements of various Native musical traditions and Western classical music, Ballard composed Pan Indian Rhythms for percussion in 1970.
C. Ballard blended elements of various Native musical traditions with Western classical music in many of his works, including Pan Indian Rhythms (1970).
D. Ballard’s composition Pan Indian Rhythms is written in a classical form and incorporates Ute notched sticks.
explanations: 选项 D 更为详细和具体地描述了作品的特点，包括使用的具体乐器，因此更有效地使用了笔记中的相关信息来解释 Ballard 的作品如何融合两种音乐传统。

question:
Scientists studying asteroid deflection have focused on secondary objects such as S/2018 (15745), a moonlet orbiting the near-Earth asteroid Yuliya. In 2022 NASA intentionally crashed a probe into just such an object, successfully altering its orbit. _______ these results are no guarantee that Yuliya and other primary objects would be similarly affected.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 它承认小卫星轨道的成功改变是一个事实，但随后又提出了警告，即像尤利娅这样的主要物体的结果可能不一样。这种转变有效地建立了特定成功与其他对象的不确定性之间的对比。Granted表示诚然，的确

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●A merchant ship is any ship hired to carry cargo or passengers.
●A ship’s carrying capacity is also known as its deadweight tonnage (DWT).
●In 2021, there were a total of 392 merchant ships registered in Saudi Arabia.
●The combined DWT of these ships was 13.7 million tons.

The student wants to specify the number of merchant ships in Saudi Arabia in 2021. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In total, Saudi Arabia’s merchant ships had a carrying capacity, or deadweight tonnage, of 13.7 million tons in 2021.
B. Combined, Saudi Arabia’s merchant ships had a deadweight tonnage of 13.7 million tons in 2021.
C. The carrying capacity of a merchant ship is also known as deadweight tonnage.
D. There were a total of 392 merchant ships-ships hired to carry cargo or passengers—registered in Saudi Arabia in 2021.
explanations: 这个选项直接提供了学生笔记中提到的2021年沙特阿拉伯商船的具体数量。它包括有关船舶类型及其用途的相关信息，提供了一个关于该国商船数量的清晰而简洁的陈述。

question:
Text 1
Isaac Asimov, author of Robots and Empire and I, Robot, is highly regarded despite his mediocre writing style. His prose is workmanlike; his characters are flat and discuss ideas rather than emotions. That his work is enjoyable despite this is a testament to his prodigious imagination—even if people read his books only for the ideas, they will have plenty to consider.
Text 2
Asimov is critiqued for his style, but it is wrong to fault a writer for failing to do what he never intended to do. For example, although most of his novel Foundation consists of people discussing science and politics and we find out little about his characters’ lives, Asimov wanted to convey the vast sweep of human history over centuries, and one of his points is that at such a timescale, individuals don’t matter. Thus his lack of characterization is central to his thematic aims.

Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the description of Asimov’s characters in the underlined portion of Text 1?
selections: A. The flatness of Asimov’s characters is a feature of Robots and Empire and I, Robot but not of Foundation.
B. Asimov’s characterizations would have been more believable if his writing had discussed fewer ideas.
C. Asimov’s characterizations would have been richer if he had possessed a deeper understanding of history.
D. The flatness of Asimov’s characters should not necessarily be considered a flaw in his writing.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
文本1
艾萨克·阿西莫夫是《机器人与帝国》和《我，机器人》的作者，尽管他的写作风格平庸，但他受到了很高的评价。他的文笔娴熟;他笔下的人物平淡无奇，讨论的是思想而不是情感。尽管如此，他的作品还是令人愉悦的，这证明了他惊人的想象力——即使人们读他的书只是为了思想，他们也会有很多需要考虑的地方。
文本2
人们批评阿西莫夫的写作风格，但指责一位作家没有完成他从未想过要做的事情是错误的。例如，尽管他的小说《基础》大部分内容都是关于人们讨论科学和政治的，我们对他笔下人物的生活知之甚少，但阿西莫夫想要传达的是几个世纪以来人类历史的广阔脉络，他的观点之一是，在这样一个时间尺度上，个人并不重要。因此，他缺乏人物塑造是他的主题目标的核心。
中文解析
文本2的作者在给定的段落中认为，指责作家没有做他从未打算做的事情是错误的。就阿西莫夫而言，他的人物缺乏深度是由于他的主题目标，而不是他的写作缺陷。他的作品中关注思想而不是情感，缺乏人物塑造，这是一个深思熟虑的选择。因此，阿西莫夫笔下人物的平面化并不一定是一种缺陷。

question:
Some cities track pedestrian activity to map their sidewalks, but this method often _______ sidewalks few pedestrians use, resulting in incomplete maps. Maryam Hosseini and her team found that a computer program trained to identify sidewalks in aerial images of Boston could also accurately identify sidewalks in aerial images of Philadelphia and even distinguished between concrete and granite.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一些城市通过跟踪行人活动来绘制人行道地图，但这种方法往往忽略了行人很少使用的人行道，导致地图不完整。Maryam Hosseini和她的团队发现，经过训练可以识别波士顿航拍图像中人行道的计算机程序也可以准确识别费城航拍图像中的人行道，甚至可以区分混凝土和花岗岩
中文解析
如果城市通过跟踪行人活动来绘制人行道地图，但忽略了行人最少的人行道，这确实可能导致地图不完整。这个词的选择突出了在绘制过程中对这些人迹罕至的人行道的疏忽或缺乏关注。于是neglect忽视符合题目。

question:
With a shell that measured 1.7 meters, the extinct mollusk Parapuzosia seppenradensis is the largest ammonite in the fossil record. Ever since fossilized Lmains of this species were discovered in 1895, scientists have been perplexed by its size. After examining 154 ammonite fossils including some of P. seppenradensis from Montana and Parapuzosia leptophylla (a smaller ammonite species) from England, paleontologist Christina Ifrim, Andrew S. Gale, and colleagues concluded that P. seppenradensis may have evolved from P. leptophylla and gradually increased in size as larger ammonites were better able to escape being preyed on by mosasaurs.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It states a long-standing scientific assumption and then shows how recent research has overturned that assumption.
B. It describes a scientific mystery and then discusses a research team’s attempt to solve that mystery.
C. It compares fossils found in Montana and England and then points out which of those fossils provides more information.
D. It notes the discovery of a new ammonite species and then remarks on the importance of that discovery.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
已经灭绝的软体动物Parapuzosia seppenradensis的壳长1.7米，是化石记录中最大的鹦鹉螺。自从这个物种的化石在1895年被发现以来，科学家们一直对它的大小感到困惑。古生物学家克里斯蒂娜·伊夫里姆、安德鲁·s·盖尔和同事们研究了154块mosasaurs化石，其中包括来自蒙大拿的P. seppenradensis和来自英国的Parapuzosia leptophyla(一种较小的物种)，他们得出结论，P. seppenradensis可能是从P. leptophytla进化而来的，随着体型较大的菊石能够更好地逃脱mosasaurs的捕食，它们的体型逐渐增大。
中文解析
这是因为该书首先介绍了自1895年被发现以来一直困扰科学家们的“Parapuzosia seppenradensis”的巨大体型之谜。然后，它继续讨论古生物学家克里斯蒂娜·伊夫里姆、安德鲁·s·盖尔和同事们最近进行的研究，以了解这个物种的进化，以及它是如何逐渐增大体型以避免被恐龙龙捕食的。文章的重点是谜题和解决谜题的尝试，因此选项B是最合适的选择。

question:
In the 2010s, the price of vintage She-Ra action figures rose dramatically, which had the counterintuitive effect of _____ demand: buyers who hadn’t previously wanted to purchase old action figures thronged the market, believing prices would continue to rise and the toys could be resold later at a profit.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在2010年代，老式She-Ra玩偶的价格大幅上涨，这产生了产生需求的反直觉效果:以前不想购买旧玩偶的买家涌入市场，他们认为价格会继续上涨，这些玩具以后可以转售获利。
中文解析
原文传达了价格的上涨产生或带来了对动作公仔需求的增加，engender demand表示产生需求。

question:
A student is researching the trends in the topics submitted to a national science fair for high school students. The graph shows the number of submissions by topic that were made each year. Based on the data in the graph, the student claims that there were more medicine and health research topics submitted in 2019 than in any other year.

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to support the underlined claim?
selections: A. In 2016, the number of cellular and molecular biology topic submissions was the same as the number of animal science topic submissions.
B. In 2019, there were more physics and space science topic submissions than there were medicine and health topic submissions.
C. The lowest number of animal science topic submissions in a year was approximately 95 in 2016.
D. The highest number of medicine and health topic submissions during the period shown is approximately 285 in 2019.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
一名学生正在研究参加全国中学生科学博览会的题目的趋势。该图显示了每年按主题提交的作品数量。根据图表中的数据，该学生声称，2019年提交的医学和健康研究课题比其他任何一年都多。
中文解析
D选项在所示期间提交的医学和健康主题最多的是2019年的285个。恰好说明了题目最后一句2019年提交的医学和健康研究课题比其他任何一年都多。

question:
The tendency to group authors together into distinct literary movements often encourages literary scholars to _________ subtleties in an author’s style. Those studying the works of William Ellery Channing, for instance, may inadvertently overlook nuances in his work by focusing only on the most obvious ways in which his style corresponds to transcendentalism.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
将作家归类为不同的文学运动的倾向往往会使文学学者忽视作家风格的微妙之处。例如，那些研究威廉·埃勒里·钱宁作品的人，可能会因为只关注他的风格与先验主义相对应的最明显的方式而无意中忽略了他作品中的细微差别。
哪个选项用最有逻辑和精确的单词或短语来完成文章?
中文解析
这种选择有效地传达了一种观点，即学者们在仅仅关注作者与某一特定文学运动的一致性时，可能没有充分考虑或承认作者风格的细微差别，Discount可以表示不够重视。

question:
As complex life cycle parasites, Lecithaster sp. and Capillaria parophrysi require multiple host species throughout their development. Extrapolating from parasite counts on Pacific herring and seven other fish species collected from Puget Sound from 1880 to 2019, Chelsea Wood et al. found that the abundance of three-host parasites, such as Lecithaster sp., negatively correlated with rising average annual sea temperatures; the abundance of two-host parasites, such as C. parophrysi, was largely stable. Noting that fish and other marine vertebrates are especially vulnerable to climate change, Wood et al. observed that all three-host parasites in the study depend on at least two vertebrate species, while all two-host parasites depend on only one, suggesting that _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. although Lecithaster sp. and C. parophrysi both require Pacific herring as a host, C. parophrysi was more adversely affected by warming-driven changes in the Pacific herring population than Lecithaster sp. was.
B. population size and density of the eight fish species examined in the study were likely largely unaffected by rising sea temperatures.

C. warming-induced population changes among Puget Sound vertebrates may have suppressed some parasite populations, but there were no changes among the eight studied host species that affected two-host parasite abundance.
D. a parasite’s sensitivity to warming temperatures is negatively correlated with the number of unique vertebrate species it depends on throughout its life cycle.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
作为复杂的生命周期寄生虫，毛细线虫和细毛线虫在其发育过程中需要多种寄主。Chelsea Wood等人从1880年至2019年在普吉特湾(Puget Sound)收集的太平洋鲱鱼和其他七种鱼类的寄生虫数量推断，发现三宿主寄生虫(如Lecithaster sp.)的丰度与年平均海水温度上升呈负相关;双宿主寄生虫(如parophrysi)的丰度基本稳定。注意到鱼类和其他海洋脊椎动物特别容易受到气候变化的影响，Wood等人观察到研究中的所有三宿主寄生虫都依赖于至少两种脊椎动物物种，而所有两宿主寄生虫只依赖于一种脊椎动物物种，这表明
中文解析
文本中A 说反了，D也说反了，研究指出，三宿主寄生虫依赖至少两种脊椎动物宿主，而双宿主寄生虫只依赖一种脊椎动物宿主。在这个背景下，最合理的结论应当是C温度升高，减少了寄生虫，因为寄生虫的生命周期中所依赖的宿主种类数量会受到海水温度变化的消极影响。也就是说，依赖更多宿主种类的寄生虫更容易受到这些宿主种群变化的影响，而 two-host parasite abundance相对保持稳定，说明其宿主的数量没有明显变化。B选项unaffected和原文矛盾。

question:
All stainless steel contains varying amounts of iron, carbon, and corrosion-inhibiting chromium. However, ferritic stainless steel, often used for induction cookers, contains a higher percentage of chromium (at least 10.5%) than does austenitic stainless steel and a higher concentration of iron, which is responsible for its magnetic properties. Unlike ferritic stainless steel, austenitic stainless steel has a face-centered cubic crystalline structure resulting from the addition of nickel to the alloy. Austenitic stainless steel has two subtypes: the 300 series, often used for storage containers, and the 200 series, which has less nickel and more manganese than the 300 series and is used for indoor architecture. Thus, stainless steel used to manufacture storage containers will have ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. similar magnetic properties to stainless steel used to manufacture induction cookers.
B. a concentration of manganese greater than 10.5%, while stainless steel used to manufacture indoor architecture will not.
C. a face-centered cubic crystalline structure, while stainless steel used to manufacture induction cookers will not.
D. a lower percentage of nickel in its composition than stainless steel used to manufacture induction cookers will.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
所有的不锈钢都含有不同数量的铁、碳和抗腐蚀的铬。然而，通常用于电磁炉的铁素体不锈钢含有比奥氏体不锈钢更高比例的铬(至少10.5%)和更高浓度的铁，这是其磁性的原因。与铁素体不锈钢不同，奥氏体不锈钢由于在合金中加入镍而具有面心立方晶体结构。奥氏体不锈钢有两种类型:300系列，通常用于存储容器;200系列，比300系列含镍少，锰多，用于室内建筑。因此，用于制造储存容器的不锈钢将具有______
中文解析
文中指出，由于在合金中添加了镍，奥氏体不锈钢具有面心立方晶体结构，用于制造存储容器的不锈钢将具有面心立方晶体结构，而用于制造电磁炉的不锈钢则不会。

question:
Joel Brown and colleagues showed that high moonlight intensity inhibits the activity of the Arizona pocket mouse (Perognathus amplus), a finding explicable in terms of benefits and costs: greater lunar intensity may not enable the mice to increase foraging success enough to offset the higher chance of detection by predatory owls or hawks. Though many other nocturnal mammals respond to lunar intensity variations similarly to Arizona pocket mice, Azara’s night monkeys (Aotus azarae) display the opposite pattern, as their heavy reliance on visual foraging results in a different balance of reward and risk.

Based on the text, why do Azara’s night monkeys respond to high lunar intensity differently than Arizona pocket mice do?
selections: A. In such conditions, the chance of detection by predators declines for Azara’s night monkeys but rises for Arizona pocket mice.
B. Although the risks of activity in such conditions are greater for Azara’s night monkeys than they are for Arizona pocket mice, the rewards are also greater for Azara’s night monkeys.
C. In such conditions, the costs of activity are lower relative to the benefits of activity for Azara’s night monkeys than they are for Arizona pocket mice.

D. Due to their heavy reliance on visual foraging, Azara’s night monkeys experience a reduction in their foraging success in such conditions, whereas Arizona pocket mice experience no change in their foraging success.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
乔尔·布朗和他的同事们发现，高强度的月光抑制了亚利桑那口袋鼠(Perognathus amplus)的活动，这一发现可以从收益和成本的角度来解释:更高的月光强度可能无法使老鼠提高觅食成功率，不足以抵消被掠食性猫头鹰或鹰发现的更高几率。尽管许多其他夜行哺乳动物对月亮强度变化的反应与亚利桑那口袋鼠相似，但Azara的夜猴(Aotus azarae)表现出相反的模式，因为它们严重依赖视觉觅食，导致了不同的回报和风险平衡。
中文解析
这是因为Azara night monkeys严重依赖视觉觅食，与Arizona pocket mice相比，这导致了它们对回报和风险的不同平衡。这表明活动的成本(比如被捕食者发现)相对于活动的好处更低,利大于弊，选项C是最准确的选择

question:
Neurobiologists Laura Cuaya, Raúl Hernández-Pérez, and colleagues investigated the language detection abilities of eighteen dogs. The researchers monitored the brain activity of Grog (a border collie), Alma (a mixed breed), and other dogs while the animals listened to three recordings: one of The Little Prince being read in Spanish, the second in Hungarian, and a third made up of short, randomly selected fragments of the first two, scrambled so that they didn’t resemble human speech. Each dog was familiar with either Spanish or Hungarian, but not both. The team concluded that differences in dogs’ anatomical features may affect their ability to distinguish speech from nonspeech.

Which finding from the study, if true, would most directly support the team’s conclusion?
selections: A. The pattern of brain activity that long-headed dogs showed when hearing the scrambled recording was different from the pattern of brain activity that short-headed dogs showed when hearing the language they were accustomed to.
B. Compared with shorter-headed dogs, longer-headed dogs showed a greater difference in brain activity when hearing either Spanish or Hungarian than when hearing the scrambled recording.
C. Compared with shorter-headed dogs, longer-headed dogs showed a greater difference in brain activity when hearing the language they were accustomed to than when hearing the other language.
D. Long-headed dogs accustomed to hearing Spanish tended to show more brain activity when hearing Spanish than long-headed dogs accustomed to hearing Hungarian showed when hearing Hungarian.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
神经生物学家Laura Cuaya (Raúl Hernández-Pérez)和同事们调查了18只狗的语言探测能力。研究人员监测了格洛格(边境牧羊犬)、阿尔玛(混血儿)和其他狗的大脑活动，同时让它们听三段录音:一段是用西班牙语朗读的《小王子》，第二段是匈牙利语，第三段是由前两段随机挑选的简短片段组成的，这些片段被打乱了，不像人类的语言。每只狗都熟悉西班牙语或匈牙利语，但不是两种都熟悉。研究小组得出结论，狗解剖特征的差异可能会影响它们区分语言和非语言的能力。
中文解析
这个题目的关键是文本最后一句话，speech and nonspeech，不是accustomed or not，也不是语言种类的问题。 B选项正确因为它直接比较了长头狗在接触实际语言(西班牙语或匈牙利语)和非语言(乱码录音)时的大脑活动。这与研究小组关于狗区分语言和非语言能力的结论更加吻合。

question:
When Belgium joined Interpol—the International Criminal Police _______ in 1923, the Belgian Federal Police gained access to the combined resources of law enforcement agencies from around the globe.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 双破折内信息表示解释说明的作用，成对使用。

question:
Scholars cite Mr: President, the 1946 novel by Guatemalan author Miguel Ángel Asturias, as a foundational text of magical realism, the Latin American style of fiction in which antirealistic plot devices—often borrowed from the folkloric traditions of Indigenous and colonial societies in the Americas—are deployed in an otherwise realistic mode of representation typical of the modern novel. This style has exerted a decisive influence on authors around the world, including Olga Tokarczuk, whose 1996 novel Primeval and Other Times resembles classic magical realist novels in its juxtaposition of literary realism with folklore- namely, that of Poland.

Which quotation from a literary scholar would most directly support the claim in the underlined portion of the text?
selections: A. “The logic of the realistic plot of Primeval and Other Times is repeatedly and productively disrupted by the presence of imagery and situations drawn from Polish folklore.”

B. “Although Polish folklore clearly informs the style and occasionally antirealistic plot of Primeval and Other Times, the novel also shows the inarguable influence of the magical realist tradition of Latin America.”
C. “Like many works in the Latin American magical realist tradition, Primeval and Other Times is indebted to antirealistic elements in the folkloric tradition of Poland.”

D. “While Primeval and Other Times alternates between realistic and antirealistic modes of representation, details suggesting the influence of Polish folklore nevertheless occur throughout the novel.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译
学者们引用危地马拉作家米格尔Ángel阿斯图里亚斯1946年的小说《总统先生》作为魔幻现实主义的基础文本。魔幻现实主义是一种拉丁美洲的小说风格，其中反现实主义的情节设计——通常借鉴于美洲土著和殖民社会的民间传说传统——被运用在现代小说典型的现实主义表现模式中。这种风格对世界各地的作家都产生了决定性的影响，包括奥尔加·托卡丘克，她1996年的小说《原始和其他时代》类似于经典的魔幻现实主义小说，因为它将文学现实主义与民间传说(即波兰的民间传说)并放在一起。
中文解析
最后一个句子中resemble classic magical realist，和C选项like many works一致，juxtaposition of realism with folklore 和C选项 is indebted to antirealistic elements in folkloric tradition一致。这个题目关键是划线句juxtaposition表示并置并列，但是有些选项错误的用了对比逻辑，比如B选项的although，D选项的while，A选项的disrupted这些都是不理想的表述。

Some climate models for the western United States predict that while total annual precipitation may remain unchanged from the present level, precipitation will become concentrated into fewer but more intense rain and snow events. University of Texas climate scientist Geeta Persad and her colleagues simulated how the amount of water entering aquifers and the amount being used for irrigation purposes would change if this were to occur Persad and her colleagues concluded that concentration of precipitation into fewer events would result in a higher number of dry days, triggering more irrigation, but that this change in irrigation output is highly sensitive to the baseline concentration of precipitation that currently exists in an area.

Which choice best describes data from the table that support Persad and her colleagues’ conclusion?
selections: A. If baseline precipitation is somewhat concentrated, the amount of water being used for irrigation will increase 0.4% for surface water and 0.9% for groundwater, whereas the amount of water entering aquifers will increase 11.0% if baseline precipitation is evenly distributed.

B. If baseline precipitation is somewhat concentrated, water use for irrigation will increase only slightly, whereas it will increase 9.0% for surface water and 7.9% for groundwater if baseline precipitation is evenly distributed.

C. If baseline precipitation is somewhat concentrated, the amount of water entering aquifers will increase 4.9%, while the amount being used for irrigation will increase 0.4% for surface water and 0.9% for groundwater.

D. If baseline precipitation is somewhat concentrated, water use for irrigation will decline by a small amount, whereas it will increase 11.0% for surface water and 9.0% for groundwater if baseline precipitation is evenly distributed.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
美国西部的一些气候模式预测，虽然年总降水量可能与目前的水平保持不变，但降水将集中为更少但更强烈的雨雪事件。德克萨斯大学的气候科学家Geeta Persad和她的同事们模拟了进入含水层的水量和用于灌溉的水量在这种情况下会发生怎样的变化。Persad和她的同事们得出结论，如果降水集中在更少的事件上，将导致更多的干旱天数，从而引发更多的灌溉。但是，灌溉产量的这种变化对一个地区目前存在的基线降水浓度高度敏感。
中文解析
根据原文的最后的结论和图表，如果基线降水较为集中，灌溉用水量只会略有增加，而如果基线降水分布均匀，地表水和地下水的用水量将分别增加9.0%和7.9%。

question:
In Egypt, use of solid fuel (e.g., coal, wood) as a share of total household fuel use fell by more than 90 percent between 2000 and 2015; such shifts are typically explained by appeal to the energy ladder, a model holding that fuel choice is mediated mainly by household income (specifically, high-technology fuels displace solid fuels as incomes rise). Alemu Mekonnen and Gunnar Köhlin’s study of fuel use in Ethiopia shows how reductive this model is, however: although income of course constrained fuel choice, several circumstances, including the local availability of different fuel sources, influenced decisions.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It anticipates a potential objection to the description of a model that the text provides.
B. It admits the superficial plausibility of an assumption that the text presents as lacking any empirical support.
C. It acknowledges the role played by a factor whose importance the text suggests has been overstated.
D. It concedes that a finding may not appear to support the main view that the text advances.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在埃及，2000年至2015年间，固体燃料(如煤、木材)的使用量占家庭燃料总使用量的比例下降了90%以上;这种转变通常是通过能源阶梯来解释的，该模型认为燃料选择主要受家庭收入的影响(具体来说，随着收入的增加，高科技燃料取代了固体燃料)。Alemu Mekonnen和Gunnar Köhlin对埃塞俄比亚燃料使用的研究表明，这个模型是多么的简化:尽管收入当然限制了燃料的选择，但一些情况，包括当地不同燃料来源的可用性，影响了决策。
中文解析
在这方面，下划线部分指出了能源阶梯模型的局限性，承认虽然家庭收入确实在燃料选择方面发挥作用，但其他因素，如当地不同燃料来源的可得性，也对决定产生重大影响。文中指出该模型是简化的，并指出影响燃料使用的其他情况，这表明家庭收入在决定燃料选择方面的重要性可能被夸大了。因此，选项C最好地描述了文本中划线部分的功能。

question:
Released in 1996, the AMD K5 microchip contained a single CPU, or core, to execute commands. The invention of the dual-core chip in the early 2000s led to a seismic shift in processing power. Since then, the average processing power of microchips—whose cores can number in the dozens, hundreds, or even thousands—________drastically.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主语the average processing power是单数，需要匹配谓语动词has improved

question:
In his 2016 poem “Orphan,” Blas Falconer explores Teresita Fernandez’s sculpture Nocturnal (Horizon Line), a work that features horizontal bands of granite. ________ Falconer participates in a tradition dating back to Homer’s Iliad: that of ekphrasis, poetry that engages with visual art.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 在2016年的诗歌《孤儿》(Orphan)中，布拉斯·法尔科纳(Blas Falconer)探索了特雷西塔·费尔南德斯(Teresita Fernandez)的雕塑《夜间》(地平线)，这是一件以花岗岩水平带为特色的作品。这样的探索（in doing so），法尔科纳参与了一个可以追溯到荷马的《伊利亚特》的传统:ekphrasis，与视觉艺术相结合的诗歌。

question:
Should Italy cut taxes? As of 2017, Italy’s top tax rate (55%) was lower than the highest point on the country’s Laffer curve, placing Italy below the threshold for a tax cut. A theoretical relationship between tax rates and revenues, _________ in 1974.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. Arthur Laffer, an economist, famously made a sketch of the curve on a napkin
B. economist Arthur Laffer famously sketched the curve on a napkin
C. the curve was famously sketched on a napkin by economist Arthur Laffer
D. a napkin was famously used by economist Arthur Laffer to sketch the curve on
explanations: 最后一个句子的a theoretical relationship between tax rates and revenues，和主语的the curve应该保持一致，是同一个事物。

question:
The mycorrhizal association between alder trees and Paxillus panuoides, a fungus commonly referred to as oyster roll-rim, is well _________ sharing nutrients via fungal hyphae and the host tree’s roots, the organisms form a kind of social system more commonly associated with animals than plants: a community.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 最后一个句子中form是动词，于是这是两个完整句子间的连接，可以用分号或者冒号，但是第二句话后面有1个冒号，冒号套冒号的用法不常出现；分号也可以表示递进解释，所以选C。

question:
In 2018, Slovak photographer Maria Svarbová exhibited her work for audiences across the ________ vivid pastel colors, overexposed tones, and mirrorlike symmetry to evoke a Socialist-era aesthetic, her photos captivated viewers from South Korea to Portugal.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 这是两个完整句子间的链接，应该用句号，选D

question:
The World Cup of men’s soccer, one of the biggest sporting events on the planet, brought 32 national teams from six continents to the host country, Brazil, in 2014. The event, which is held every four years, has expanded greatly since it was played in Italy in 1934. _______ the World Cup included only 16 teams, most from Europe and the Americas.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 文本提到1934年的世界杯，追溯到当时只有16支队伍，于是用时间逻辑词then

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●The Zim Smith Mid-County Trail is located in New York.
●It is one of more than 2,000 disused railroad corridors in the US that have been converted into public trails since the 1960s.
●Such trails are known as rail trails.
●The Union Pacific Railroad Trail in Nevada is parallel to an active railway, the Union Pacific Railroad.
●It is one of approximately 400 trails in the US that share a right-of-way with an active rail line.
●Such trails are known as rails-with-trails.

The student wants to make a generalization about rails-with-trails. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In the US, trails have been constructed from disused railroad corridors as well as on property parallel to active rail lines.
B. In the US, trails that share a right-of-way with an active rail line are less common than some other types of railway trails.
C. The Union Pacific Railroad Trail in Nevada is one of approximately 400 US trails that share a right-of-way with an active rail line.
D. Since the 1960s, thousands of public trails in the US have been created from disused railroad corridors.
explanations: 题目要求generalization，于是不能选C或D这些相对细节的选项，B突出了 rails-with-trails的特点share a right-of-way with an active rail line，同时总结了比 rail trails少的情况。

question:
Most solar eclipses from long ago have been forgotten, but not all. ________ scholars still discuss an eclipse that occurred on May 17, 2231 BCE. That’s because it was the fifth-longest total eclipse before the Dark Ages—7 minutes, 21 seconds long.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 第二句具体描述了一个solar eclipses，是第一句的具体例子，选择for example

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Sue is the nickname of a dinosaur fossil specimen housed at the Field Museum of Natural History.
●The Field Museum of Natural History is located in Chicago, Illinois.
●Sue is a member of the genus Tyrannosaurus.
●Thomas is the nickname of a dinosaur fossil specimen housed at the Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County.
●The Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County is located in Los Angeles, California.
●Thomas is a member of the genus Tyrannosaurus.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two specimens. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The dinosaur fossil specimens Sue and Thomas are both members of the genus Tyrannosaurus.
B. While Sue is housed at the Field Museum of Natural History, Thomas is housed at the Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County.
C. The Field Museum of Natural History, where Sue is housed, is located in Chicago, Illinois.
D. Thomas is the nickname of a Tyrannosaurus fossil specimen housed at the Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County in Los Angeles, California.
explanations: 题目要求两个样本的共同点，于是A选项满足，这个选择有效地强调了两个标本之间的相似性，强调了它们都是同一属的成员，暴龙。这是基于一个共同的特征直接比较和对比两种化石，这是强调它们相似性的最有效方式。

question:
●Jean-Michel Basquiat was an American artist who produced more than two thousand drawings and paintings.
●Most of his works were completed in New York City in the 1980s.
●His work Untitled (Pollo Frito) was completed in 1982.
●The work is composed of acrylic, oil, and enamel on canvas and measures 60 inches by 120.5 inches.
●Untitled (Pollo Frito) was purchased by a private collection for $25.7 million in a 2018 auction.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize the scope of Basquiat’s work?
selections: A. Untitled (Pollo Frito) is just one of more than two thousand drawings and paintings completed by American artist Jean-Michel Basquiat.
B. Though artist Jean-Michel Basquiat completed most of his two thousand-plus drawings in the 1980s, his work Untitled (Pollo Frito) is composed of acrylic, oil, and enamel on canvas.
C. Decades after artist Jean-Michel Basquiat completed his 1982 work Untitled (Pollo Frito), a private collection purchased it for $25.7 million.
D. At a 2018 auction, artist Jean-Michel Basquiat’s Untitled (Pollo Frito), composed of acrylic, oil, and enamel on canvas, sold for S25.7 million.
explanations: 为了强调 Jean-Michel Basquiat 作品的范围，最有效地使用所给句子中的信息的选择应该既提到他的作品数量，又提到具体的作品作为例子，所以应该选A

question:
Proto-Indo-European—a protolanguage, or ancestral language of a family of descendant(daughter) languages—is said to be the common ancestor of all Indo-European languages. This is a hypothetical __________ Proto-Indo-European is only postulated, its characteristics being inferred from the linguistic properties of its 448 daughters.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: However是副词用在单独的句子中，不能用于连接完整的句子，所以A错误。However引导所在的句子和前一句之间的关系，原文第一句和第二句之间是转折关系，于是however要放在第二个句子内。原始印欧语——一种原始语言，或后代语言家族的祖先语言——据说是所有印欧语言的共同祖先，但是这是一个假设的名称。第三句解释第二句。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●In a 2010 study, Clark and Tilman found that the presence of plant litter had a negative effect on seedling emergence.
●The study was conducted in a grassland setting in the United States.
●In a 2002 study, Stammel et al. found that the presence of plant litter had a negative effect on seedling emergence.
●The study was conducted in a grassland setting in Germany.
●Seedling emergence is when a seedling sprouts above ground and begins photosynthesis.

The student wants to make a generalization about research on plant litter. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Studies have found that the presence of plant litter can have a negative effect on seedling emergence.
B. Clark and Tilman found that plant litter in a grassland setting in the United States had a negative effect on seedling emergence.
C. In studies by both Clark and Tilman (2010) and Stammel et al. (2002), a negative effect was found.
D. Seedling emergence, which is when a seedling sprouts above ground and begins photosynthesis, has been the focus of past research.
explanations: 这一选择有效地利用了笔记中的相关信息，对plant litter对seedling emergence有负面影响的研究进行了概括。它总结了笔记中提到的两项研究的结果，并将其作为一般结论提出。其它选项或是没有概括，或者没有答出文章的主要内容。

question:

question: The town of Fillmore is planning its annual fireworks show. question: The dot plot shows the distribution of capacity for a set of capacitors, set A, which a researcher used for a certain experiment. Which of the following is true about the capacities of the capacitors in set B?
selections: A. The mean capacity is 8μF, and the range of capacities is 12μF.
B. The mean capacity is 8μF, and the range of capacities is 29μF.
C. The mean capacity is 25μF, and the range of capacities is 12μF.
D. The mean capacity is 25μF, and the range of capacities is 29μF.
explanations: 观察数据可发现，横坐标为等差数列，分布对称，所以mean为8，setB每个数字加17，所以mean变为17，range为最大值减最小值所以是12uF不变，故选C

question: The positive number a is 2,800% of the number c, and c is 25% of the number b. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>a</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mi>b</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>w</mi> <mi>c</mi></math>, where w is a constant, what is the value of w?

question: Line j is defined by <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>4</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>55</mn></math>. Line k is parallel to line j in the xy-plane. An equation of line k is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>24</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>r</mi> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>15</mn></math>, where r is a constant. If line k passes through the point (0, b), what is the value of b?
explanations: 线j与k平行，故斜率相等，j、k的斜率为-4/5，且k函数为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>24</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mi>r</mi> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>15</mn></math>，即<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mn>24</mn> <mi>r</mi> </mfrac> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mfrac> <mn>15</mn> <mi>r</mi> </mfrac></math>，故<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mn>24</mn> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mrow> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <mn>5</mn></math>，所以r=30，再代入（0, b）到k函数中，得到b=1/2

question: The product of a positive number x and the number that is 15 less than x is equal to 286. What is the value of x?

question: In triangle FGH and triangle KLM, the measures of angles G and L are each 30°. The lengths of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>G</mi> <mi>H</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="false">¯</mo> </mover></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>L</mi> <mi>M</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="false">¯</mo> </mover></math> are each 34 centimeters, and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>G</mi> <mi>H</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mi>G</mi> <mi>F</mi> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>L</mi> <mi>M</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mi>L</mi> <mi>K</mi> </mrow> </mfrac></math>. Which additional piece of information would be necessary to prove that triangle FGH is congruent to triangle KLM?
selections: A. The lengths of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>F</mi> <mi>G</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="false">¯</mo> </mover></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>K</mi> <mi>M</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="false">¯</mo> </mover></math> are each 17 centimeters.
B. The measures of angles H and M are each 60°.
C. The measures of angles F and K are each 90°.
D. No additional information is necessary.
explanations: 两个三角形，对应的一组角相等，一组角的临边<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>G</mi> <mi>H</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="false">¯</mo> </mover></math>和<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>L</mi> <mi>M</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="false">¯</mo> </mover></math>也相等，同时根据<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>G</mi> <mi>H</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mi>G</mi> <mi>F</mi> </mrow> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>L</mi> <mi>M</mi> </mrow> <mrow> <mi>L</mi> <mi>K</mi> </mrow> </mfrac></math>，得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>G</mi> <mi>F</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="false">¯</mo> </mover></math>和<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>L</mi> <mi>K</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="false">¯</mo> </mover></math>也相等，这一组边也是角G，L临边，属于全等三角形中SAS条件，故选D

question:
The following text is from Armando Palacio Valdés’s short story “The Love of Clotilde,” originally published in Spanish in 1884. In the story, Don Jerónimo is a financial supporter of artists in the theater.
Any youth from the provinces who arrived in Madrid with a drama in his pocket could take no surer road to seeing it produced than that which led to the home of Don Jerónimo. One and all, he received them with open arms, the good and the bad alike. There is no denying that, since he was rather brusque in his ways, he never spared the young authors who asked his advice and read him their productions, but criticized vigorously, even to the verge of insult.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It conveys Don Jerónimo’s lack of interest in continuing to support playwrights.
B. It explains Don Jerónimo’s view of the quality of theatrical works of the time.
C. It creates a contrast between the talent of a young playwright and that of Don Jerónimo.
D. It emphasizes the degree to which Don Jerónimo’s support is consequential for inexperienced playwrights.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文字摘自阿曼多·帕拉西奥·瓦尔德萨姆斯的短篇小说《克洛蒂尔德的爱》，最初于1884年以西班牙语出版。在这个故事中，Don Jerónimo是剧院艺术家的经济支持者。
任何一个从外省来的年轻人，只要口袋里装着一出戏，来到马德里，想让自己的剧被演出来，没有比找Jerónimo更确定的途径了。他张开双臂欢迎所有的人，不管是好人还是坏人。不可否认的是，由于他的方式相当粗鲁，他从不放过那些向他征求意见并向他读作品的年轻作家，而是激烈地批评，甚至到了侮辱的边缘。
中文解析
Don Jerónimo的身份是financial supporter of artists in the theater.文中No surer road 是一种比喻的手法，形容再没有比找Don Jerónimo是年轻作家produce their dramas的必经之路 了，于是和选项D保持一致：它强调了唐Jerónimo的支持对没有经验的剧作家的影响程度。
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
The SCAD Museum of Art in Savannah, Georgia, has around 4,500 works of art. Digital images of hundreds of those works have been put online through the museum’s website and the Google Arts & Culture project. One of the images is of The Card Game, a painting by Jacob Lawrence. In a paper, a student claims that putting a work from the museum online increases the number of people who experience that work.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the underlined claim?
selections: A. Many people who have been to Savannah say that the SCAD Museum of Art is worth visiting.
B. Each year, more people access the online image of The Card Game than visit the SCAD Museum of Art in person.
C. The SCAD Museum of Art has several works by Jacob Lawrence.
D. The Card Game has been praised by some art critics.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
位于乔治亚州萨凡纳的SCAD艺术博物馆拥有大约4500件艺术品。数百件作品的数字图像已经通过博物馆的网站和谷歌艺术与文化项目发布到网上。其中一幅是雅各布·劳伦斯的画作《纸牌游戏》。在一篇论文中，一名学生声称，将博物馆的作品放到网上可以增加体验该作品的人数。
中文解析
把博物馆的作品放到网上会增加体验该作品的人数。如果访问《纸牌游戏》在线图片的人比亲自参观博物馆的人多，这表明艺术品的在线存在正在接触到更多的观众，并有可能增加艺术品的整体曝光率。
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
A contraction of “you all,” the pronoun “y’all” has long been used as a plural version of “you” in the South and in Black communities around the US. In recent decades, most other English-speaking communities in the US have begun to use “y’all.” What explains its rise in popularity? Many varieties of English have no pronoun that specifically addresses more than one person and instead must use “you” to address both one person and more than one. But “y’all” always refers to two or more people. As a result, it conveys the speaker’s meaning more precisely than “you” can.

Which question does the text most directly attempt to answer?
selections: A. How many other plural versions of the pronoun “you” are there in English, besides “y’all”?
B. When was the first recorded use of the pronoun “y’all” in the English language?
C. Is “y’all” commonly used in English-speaking regions of the world besides the US?
D. Why has the pronoun “y’all” become more widely used in the US?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
代词“y 'all”是“you all”的缩写形式，在美国南部和黑人社区长期以来一直被用作“you”的复数形式。近几十年来，美国大多数其他英语社区都开始使用“y 'all”。如何解释其受欢迎程度的上升?许多英语变体都没有专门指代多人的代词，而是必须用“你”来指代一人或多人。但是“y’all”总是指两个或两个以上的人。因此，它比“你”更准确地传达了说话人的意思。
中文解析
文本最后一句传递“y’all”传递了说话人更准确的意思，能够对应回答D选项。

question:
Navajo artist Sally Black’s mastery of traditional weaving techniques is apparent in her expertly crafted baskets, which typically are woven from sumac (a textured and flexible material) and ______ bold colors.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 根据文章其它动词，需要现在时feature
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
Stars form in cloudlike swirls of gas and dust that cannot be touched, but astrophysicist Nia Imara believes these formations need not remain completely _______to researchers: she uses simulation data and sophisticated 3D printers to produce interactive models of these stellar nurseries.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
恒星在云状的气体和尘埃漩涡中形成，无法触摸，但天体物理学家Nia Imara认为，这些结构不需要完全保留_______对研究人员来说:她使用模拟数据和复杂的3D打印机来制作这些恒星托儿所的互动模型。
中文解析
Cannot be touched和转折后need not  remain intangible表达的相似的意思，就是触摸不到，无形的，冒号后解释可以通过数据模拟与3D打印来解决。  A一个令人遗憾的B可以解释的C无形D可重复的
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
The following text is from Jose Rizal’s 1891 novel The Reign of Greed (translated by Charles Derbyshire in 1912).
A lady accompanied by her husband entered at that moment and took her place in one of the two vacant boxes. She had the air of a queen and gazed disdainfully at the whole house, as if to say, “I’ve come later than all of you, you crowd of upstarts and provincials, I’ve come later than you!” There are persons who go to the theater like the contestants in a mule-race: the last one in, wins, and we know very sensible men who would ascend the scaffold rather than enter a theater before the first act.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It illustrates the lady’s contemptuous attitude toward the other people in the theater.
B. It helps explain why some people are especially perceptive of the social dynamics at theaters.
C. It emphasizes a character’s dedication to her career.
D. It conveys the urgency some theater patrons feel to be the first ones to arrive at a performance.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文字摘自何塞·黎刹1891年的小说《贪婪的统治》(1912年由查尔斯·德比希尔翻译)。
这时，一位女士在她丈夫的陪同下走了进来，在两个空包厢中的一个上了座。她有一种女王的神气，轻蔑地望着整个屋子，好像在说:“我比你们都来得晚，你们这群暴发户和乡巴佬，我比你们来得晚!”有些人上戏院去，就像参加骡子赛跑的选手一样:谁最后进去，谁就赢;我们也知道一些非常明智的人，他们宁愿登上断头台，也不愿在第一幕开始前进戏院。
中文解析
划线句子“我比你们都来得晚，你们这群暴发户和乡巴佬，我比你们来得晚!”表达了这位女士傲慢的态度，与选项A contemptuous保持一致。
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
Many people use the trademark “Kleenex” to refer generally to facial tissue rather than specifically to products made by Kimberly-Clark, the company that owns the trademark. As legal experts note, this may pose a problem for Kimberly-Clark. In the US, courts can cancel a trademark if they decide that its meaning is no longer specific to the trademark owner’s products. If “Kleenex” were judged to have become a generic term, as “cellophane” was, other companies would be free to use it to promote similar products, making it harder for Kimberly-Clark to stand out from competitors.

What does the text suggest about the term “cellophane”?
selections: A. It is the subject of great debate among legal experts.
B. It once referred to a specific product made by a particular company.
C. It has recently become surprisingly popular for unknown reasons.
D. It was never intended by its creator to be used as a trademark.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
许多人使用“Kleenex”商标泛指面巾纸，而不是专门指拥有该商标的金佰利公司(Kimberly-Clark)生产的产品。正如法律专家指出的那样，这可能会给金佰利公司带来一个问题。在美国，如果法院认定商标的含义不再特定于商标所有者的产品，就可以取消商标。如果“Kleenex”像“cellophane”一样被判定为通用术语，那么其他公司就可以随意使用它来推广类似的产品，这将使金佰利公司更难从竞争对手中脱颖而出。
中文解析
这段文字暗示“玻璃纸”（cellophance）曾经是一家特定公司生产的一种特定产品，类似于“Kleenex”是金佰利公司生产的一种特定产品。随着时间的推移，“玻璃纸”(cellophane)一词变成了一个通用术语，就像“舒洁”(Kleenex)一样，导致该术语可能失去商标保护。
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
It is common for freshwater lakes near or above a latitude of 45° north of the equator, like Opeongo Lake in Canada, to accumulate surface ice in winter. The amount and duration of ice depends on many factors, including local weather conditions as well as the  lake’s depth, volume, and surface area, but a climate researcher claims that some lakes in these latitudes have seen a decline in the duration of ice between the early 1980s and the mid-2000s. She cites as a typical example _______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the researcher’s example?
selections: A. both Lake Neusiedl and Oulujärvi, which had fewer than 195 days of ice in the winter of 1980-81.
B. Oulujärvi, which had fewer days of ice in the winter of 2005-06 than it did in the winter of 1980-81.
C. Lake Neusiedl, which had more days of ice in the winter of 2005-06 than it did in the winter of 1980-81.
D. both Lake Neusiedl and Oulujärvi, which had more than 100 days of ice in the winter of 2005-06.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在赤道以北45°附近或以上的淡水湖，如加拿大的奥佩昂戈湖，在冬季表面结冰是很常见的。冰的数量和持续时间取决于许多因素，包括当地的天气条件以及湖泊的深度、体积和表面积，但一位气候研究人员声称，这些纬度的一些湖泊在20世纪80年代初至21世纪头十年中期之间，冰的持续时间有所减少。她举了一个典型的例子_______
中文解析
根据原文最后的结论，对应图表最浅颜色，Oulujärvi，它在2005- 2006年冬天的结冰天数比1980- 1981年冬天的要少。
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
The first documented use of the English word “humiliation” is attributed to poet Geoffrey Chaucer’s 1386 work “The Parson’s Tale.” However, Chaucer didn’t write in Modern English; ______ he wrote in what we now call Middle English, which was commonly used during the period.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 然而，乔叟没有用现代英语写作;instead，他用我们现在所说的中古英语写作，这种英语在那个时期很常用。两个句子用相反的描述方式描述同一件事，选择instead表示取而代之，相反。
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
●Trans-Siberian Orchestra (TSO) is a band from the United States that was created in 1996.
●The band’s sound combines the genres of hard rock and classical music, with an epic assembly of nearly fifty musicians that includes over a dozen singers.
●Musicians are regularly invited to perform with TSO on tour.
●Electric violinist Mark Wood toured with TSO from 1999 to 2008.
●Guitarist Bill Hudson toured with TSO in 2015.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize the role Mark Wood played when performing with TSO?
selections: A. Musicians Mark Wood and Bill Hudson both toured with the genre-bending band TSO.
B. It was from 1999 to 2008 that electric violinist Mark Wood performed with TSO.
C. From electric violinist Mark Wood to guitarist Bill Hudson, musicians of all backgrounds have taken the opportunity to perform with TSO.
D. From 1999 to 2008, Mark Wood performed with TSO as a touring electric violinist.
explanations: D选项符合题目要求；D选项大意：从1999年到2008年，马克·伍德作为巡回电小提琴手与TSO一起演出。这个选择有效地强调了Mark Wood在与TSO一起演出时所扮演的特定角色，提到了他与乐队和他的乐器一起巡演的年份。
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
Courses on African American history can be found at colleges and universities across the US. For example, historian Jeanne Theoharis teaches courses at Brooklyn College about the Civil Rights and Black Power movements. ________ at Virginia Tech University, historian Paula Marie Seniors teaches courses about Africana studies.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 不同人物在不同学校讲授African American history，用elsewhere连链接不同的地点描述。
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
Within Earth’s biomes, there are four main types of desert: arid, semiarid, coastal, and cold. The Kyzylkum Desert in central Asia is a semiarid desert, for _______ a total area of about 300, 000 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>k</mi> <msup> <mi>m</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>, it is also one of the largest deserts of any type.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: For example在第二句的末尾，和第一句间是例证关系，和第三句间用句号隔开。
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●In a 2021 study, researchers showed participants an unaltered image of a popular character or logo alongside two slightly altered versions.
●The Bic logo contains a cartoon man holding a pen.
●In the first alteration, the man was holding a pencil.
●In the second alteration, the man was holding nothing.
●Participants were asked to identify the correct version.
●65.3% of participants selected the unaltered image.

The student wants to present a finding from the study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. When participants were asked to identify the correct version of the Bic logo, 65.3% selected the unaltered image.
B. Participants were asked to identify the correct version of the Bic logo, which contains a cartoon man holding a pen.
C. The Bic logo contains a cartoon man holding a pen, but in one of the altered versions, the man was holding a pencil.
D. In a 2021 study, researchers asked participants to identify the correct version of the Bic logo.
explanations: 题目要求present a finding，A选项说通过提到参与者被要求做的特定任务(识别Bic标志的正确版本)和选择未改变图像的参与者的百分比65.3%，有效地展示了研究的发现。
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
The Coastal Futures Conservatory in Virginia is known for creating aural representations of ecological data. One such effort combines underwater audio recorded in seagrass beds with data that track rising carbon levels in the seagrass. As carbon levels increase, the audio is correspondingly distorted; ________ listeners can “hear” the changes in the carbon levels.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 文中大意为其中一项工作是将在海草床上录制的水下音频与跟踪海草中碳含量上升的数据结合起来。随着碳含量的增加，音频也相应失真;________听众可以“听到”碳含量的变化。是因果关系，于是选择thus
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
Immanuel Wallerstein and other historians of capitalism rarely discuss domestic capitalism in Africa before the period of European colonization, implicitly presenting capitalism as external to and imposed on Africa. Crislayne Alfagali and other Africanist scholars have shown, however, that in parts of Africa, wage labor competition, the manufacture of surplus goods for monetized sale, and other features of capitalism predated colonization. One reason for this discrepancy is that historians of capitalism tend to focus on longitudinal economic data drawn from archival records, which do not exist for much of precolonial Africa.

Which statement about Alfagali and other Africanist scholars is best supported by information in the text?
selections: A. They likely differ from historians of capitalism in the methods they use to derive longitudinal economic data from archival records.
B. They likely make use of different types of evidence than historians of capitalism typically rely on.
C. They likely view capitalism as having been more beneficial for Africa than historians of capitalism do.
D. They likely have a different view about which activities should be considered capitalist in nature than historians of capitalism do.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
伊曼纽尔·沃勒斯坦(Immanuel Wallerstein)等资本主义历史学家很少讨论欧洲殖民时期之前非洲的国内资本主义，含蓄地将资本主义呈现为外部和强加于非洲的资本主义。然而，Crislayne Alfagali和其他非洲学者已经表明，在非洲的部分地区，雇佣劳动力竞争、生产剩余商品用于货币化销售，以及资本主义的其他特征早在殖民之前就存在了。造成这种差异的一个原因是，资本主义历史学家倾向于关注从档案记录中提取的纵向经济数据，而这些数据在殖民前的非洲并不存在。
中文解析
最后一句表明非洲学者如何利用档案记录中的纵向经济数据以外的证据来表明，在欧洲殖民之前，非洲部分地区就存在资本主义的特征。这表明他们的证据类型不同于资本主义历史学家。
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
In the late 2010s, the price of vintage cards from the game Magic: The Gathering rose dramatically, which had the counterintuitive effect of ________ demand: buyers who hadn’t previously wanted to purchase Magic: The Gathering cards suddenly thronged the market, believing prices would continue to rise and the cards could be resold later at a profit.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在2010年代末，《万智牌》游戏中的古董卡牌价格大幅上涨，这产生了________需求的反直觉效应:之前不想购买《万智牌》卡牌的买家突然涌向市场，他们认为价格会继续上涨，这些卡牌随后可以转售获利。
中文解析
从冒号后的解释可以看到buyers suddenly thronged the market,于是前面应该需求激增，于是选择precipitating，表示加速，促使快速发生。
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
The following text is from Charles Chesnutt’s 1905 novel The Colonel’s Dream. Mr. French and Mr. Kirby work together.
Mr. French, the senior partner, who sat opposite Kirby, was an older man—a safe guess would have placed him somewhere in the debatable ground between forty and fifty; of a good height, as could be seen even from the seated figure, the upper part of which was held erect with the unconscious ease which one associates with military training.

As used in the text, what does the word “placed” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文字选自查尔斯·切斯纳特1905年的小说《上校的梦》。弗兰奇先生和柯比先生一起工作。
坐在柯比对面的资深合伙人弗兰奇先生年纪比较大——保守地说，他的年龄应该在40到50岁之间;甚至从那坐着的人身上也可以看出，他的上半身是挺直的，不知不觉就像在接受军事训练一样轻松。
中文解析：
基于文本中的guess和后面between forty and fifty，可以看出place表示推测，估计estimate
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
Historians have argued that a crucial component of the Civil Rights Movement’s success in the 1960s was the Southern Christian Leadership Conference’s Citizen Education Program (CEP), which invited promising activists from across the South to its one-week training sessions in Dorchester, Georgia. Led by experienced organizers such as Dorothy Cotton and Septima Clark, CEP attendees—more than 7, 000 in all—participated in workshops on topics ranging from public speaking to legal doctrine before returning home and using their newly acquired knowledge to spearhead local civil rights initiatives.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It establishes that criticism of the CEP was limited to a few individuals in the Southern Christian Leadership Conference.
B. It suggests that CEP attendees held a diverse array of opinions about the Southern Christian Leadership Conference’s political philosophy.
C. It underscores the extent of the CEP’s impact on the Civil Rights Movement of the 1960s.
D. It illustrates the CEP organizers’ efforts to educate participants on a wide variety of topics.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
历史学家认为，民权运动在20世纪60年代取得成功的一个关键因素是南方基督教领袖会议的公民教育计划(CEP)，该计划邀请南方各地有前途的活动家参加在佐治亚州多尔切斯特举行的为期一周的培训课程。在多萝西·科顿(Dorothy Cotton)和塞普蒂玛·克拉克(Septima Clark)等经验丰富的组织者的带领下，共有7000多名CEP与会者参加了从公开演讲到法律原则等主题的讲习班，然后回国，并利用他们新获得的知识带头开展当地的民权倡议。
中文解析
因为划线句式7000多人的数据，突出了公民教育计划(CEP)在20世纪60年代对民权运动的重大影响和范围。所提供的信息强调了项目的规模和成效，详细介绍了参加人员的人数、他们接受的培训以及他们如何利用所学知识在当地社区推动民权倡议。
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
Asteroid 6478 Gault has experienced intermittent mass loss since at least 2013, but in contrast to some other asteroids with repeated mass-loss episodes, 6478 Gault has not lost mass at its perihelion (the closest point of its orbit to the Sun), and thus the loss is not attributable to solar energy-driven ice vaporization. And as Jane X. Luu et al. point out, the singular nature of impact ejection makes it untenable as an account of multiple loss episodes of similar duration over several years. Instead, Luu et al. are likely correct that 6478 Gault is shedding mass due to rotational instability.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It describes an astronomical finding, discusses competing theories about that finding that the author regards as flawed, and then describes new evidence that supports an alternative theory.
B. It presents a scientific observation, describes a contrast between that observation and other observations, and then explains why those other observations should not be considered credible.
C. It introduces a natural phenomenon, refutes two potential explanations for that phenomenon, and then presents a third explanation for that phenomenon that the author regards as plausible.
D. It discusses a physical process, evaluates possible causes of that process, and then states that a persuasive account of the process has yet to be put forward.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
至少从2013年开始，小行星6478 Gault就经历了间歇性的质量损失，但与其他一些反复发生质量损失的小行星不同，6478 Gault在近日点(其轨道上离太阳最近的点)并没有失去质量，因此这种损失不能归因于太阳能驱动的冰蒸发。正如Jane X. Luu等人所指出的那样，撞击喷射的单一性质使得它不能作为多年来持续时间相似的多次损失事件的解释。相反，Luu等人认为6478 Gault由于旋转不稳定而脱落质量可能是正确的。
中文解析
solar energy-driven ice vaporization和nature of impact ejection这两个potential explanations都被反驳了，最后一句中rotational instability是plausible的第三个解释。
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
The results of randomized clinical trials testing the efficacy of common medical interventions sometimes fail to _______ conclusions that practitioners reach based on their real-world observations of patients. While there are several possible reasons for this, one is that practitioners may overlook confounding variables that account for the results they attribute to the interventions in question.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
测试普通医疗干预效果的随机临床试验的结果有时无法证实从业人员根据对患者的实际观察得出的结论。虽然有几个可能的原因，其中一个是从业者可能忽略了混淆变量，这些变量解释了他们归因于相关干预措施的结果。
中文解析
Corroborate表示证实，根据文本前后文意义，其中有原因是practitioners overlook foundling variables, 于是可以逆推前面应该是fail to corroborate conclusions.
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
In 2013 Trevor James Hamilton and colleagues published a study concluding that ocean acidification has a strong effect on the behavior of Sebastes diploproa, a species of fish. However, Hamilton and colleagues’ study relied on a mean sample size of only about 11 fish. In a 2022 review of various scientists’ conclusions about the impacts of ocean acidification on fish behavior, Timothy D. Clark and colleagues caution that relying on such a relatively small sample size can increase the potential for biased analysis. Such analysis, in turn, can contribute to reports of exaggerated effects.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To present a debate between two research teams about a cause of ocean acidification
B. To explain how the behavior of a fish species has changed over time
C. To note a potential concern about the findings of a scientific study
D. To discuss an aspect of ocean acidification that is frequently overlooked
explanations:
题目文本翻译
2013年，特雷弗·詹姆斯·汉密尔顿(Trevor James Hamilton)和他的同事发表了一项研究，得出的结论是，海洋酸化对双proa(一种鱼类)的行为有很强的影响。然而，汉密尔顿及其同事的研究依赖于平均只有11条鱼的样本大小。2022年，蒂莫西·d·克拉克(Timothy D. Clark)和他的同事在一篇综述中，回顾了各种科学家关于海洋酸化对鱼类行为影响的结论，他们警告说，依赖这样一个相对较小的样本量，可能会增加偏见分析的可能性。这样的分析反过来又可能导致夸大效应的报告。
中文解析
文章的末尾之处a small size会导致exaggerated effects，于是符合C选项所讲的potential concern。
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
Indigenous songs are an important resource for ecological information. Songs of the O’odham people in the southwestern United States provide a deep understanding of Sonoran Desert plant ecology, and the songs of the Karen (hta) Hin Lad Nai people in Thailand offer detailed information about bees. There have been efforts made to preserve Indigenous languages over the years—e.g., the United Nations’ International Decade of Indigenous Languages (2022-2032). However, such attempts have typically focused on spoken language despite the fact that some expressions in these languages appear only in songs. Therefore, if those involved in such efforts want to ensure that a comprehensive range of information is secured, they must _________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. acknowledge that Indigenous songs are largely but not entirely composed using phrases taken from spoken language.
B. recognize that Indigenous languages likely have more unique expressions that represent ecological knowledge than represent other types of information.
C. analyze musical similarities in the songs of the O’odham and Karen (hta) Hin Lad Nai people.
D. incorporate the preservation of songs into their broader efforts to protect Indigenous languages.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
土著歌曲是重要的生态信息资源。美国西南部O 'odham人的歌曲提供了对索诺兰沙漠植物生态的深刻理解，泰国Karen (hta) Hin Lad Nai人的歌曲提供了关于蜜蜂的详细信息。多年来，人们一直在努力保护土著语言。联合国土著语言国际十年(2022-2032)。然而，这些尝试通常集中在口语上，尽管这些语言中的一些表达只出现在歌曲中。因此，如果参与此类努力的人员想要确保信息的全面获取，他们必须_________
中文解析
D选项表明为了确保全面的信息全面获取，那些参与保护土著语言的人也应该把重点放在保护包含独特表达和宝贵生态知识的歌曲上。这与歌曲是重要资源的观点是一致的

question:
As complex life cycle parasites, Anisakis sp. and Capillaria parophrysi require multiple host species throughout their development. Extrapolating from parasite counts on walleye pollock and seven other fish species collected from Puget Sound from 1880 to 2019, Chelsea Wood et al. found that the abundance of three-host parasites, such as Anisakis sp., negatively correlated with rising average annual sea temperatures; the abundance of two- host parasites, such as C. parophrysi, was largely stable. Noting that fish and other marine vertebrates are especially vulnerable to climate change, Wood et al. observed that all three-host parasites in the study depend on at least two vertebrate species, while all two-host parasites depend on only one, suggesting that _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. population size and density of the eight fish species examined in the study wered likely largely unaffected by rising sea temperatures.

B. although Anisakis sp. and C. parophrysi both require walleye pollock as a host, C. parophrysi was more adversely affected by warming-driven changes in the walleye pollock population than Anisakis sp. was.
C. a parasite’s sensitivity to warming temperatures is negatively correlated with the number of unique vertebrate species it depends on throughout its life cycle.

D. warming-induced population changes among Puget Sound vertebrates may have suppressed some parasite populations, but there were no changes among the eight studied host species that affected two-host parasite abundance.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
作为复杂的生命周期寄生虫，异尖线虫和细毛线虫在其发育过程中需要多种寄主。Chelsea Wood等人从1880年至2019年在普吉特海湾收集的白眼鳕鱼和其他七种鱼类的寄生虫数量推断，发现三宿主寄生虫(如Anisakis sp.)的丰度与年平均海水温度上升呈负相关;双宿主寄生虫，如parophrysi的丰度基本稳定。注意到鱼类和其他海洋脊椎动物特别容易受到气候变化的影响，Wood等人观察到研究中的所有三宿主寄生虫都依赖于至少两种脊椎动物物种，而所有双宿主寄生虫只依赖于一种，这表明_______
中文解析
在这个背景下，最合理的结论应当是D温度升高，减少了寄生虫，因为寄生虫的生命周期中所依赖的宿主种类数量会受到海水温度变化的消极影响。也就是说，依赖更多宿主种类的寄生虫更容易受到这些宿主种群变化的影响，而 two-host parasite abundance相对保持稳定，说明其宿主的数量没有明显变化。

question:
A report from an international organization that monitors the numbers of women serving as judges or magistrates on various nations’ highest courts, such as the Supreme Court of Justice and the Constitutional Court in Belgium and the Supreme Court in Honduras, indicates that, other than the countries that had more women on these courts in 2013 than in 2009, for some the number in 2013 was less than that in 2009, and for others it was the same in both years. For instance, the number of women judges and magistrates on high courts in _________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the example?
selections: A. Honduras was lower in 2013 than in 2009, whereas the number in Belgium was the same in 2013 as in 2009.
B. Armenia was greater in 2013 than in 2009, whereas the number in Honduras was lower in 2013 than in 2009.
C. Armenia was greater in 2013 than in 2009, whereas the number in Belgium was the same in 2013 as in 2009.
D. Belgium was the same in 2013 as in 2009, but it had more women on its high courts than either Armenia or Honduras did in 2013.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一个国际组织的一份报告,监控女性担任法官或法官的数量在不同国家的最高法院,如比利时最高法院和宪法法院和最高法院在洪都拉斯,表明,比其他国家有更多的女性在这些法院2013年比2009年多,对于一些数量2013年比2009年少,或者两年是相同。例如，高等法院女法官和地方法官的人数_________
中文解析
文本最后要求2013年比2009年少，或者相同，那么A选项洪都拉斯2013年的数字低于2009年，而比利时2013年的数字与2009年相同。

question:
Text 1
In western Arkansas, many buildings and other structures rest on soil that is expansive, meaning that it swells or shrinks as its moisture level changes. Civil engineer Jay X. Wang has noted that the effects of expansive soil appear slowly in the form of gradually growing cracks in foundations, walls, and pavements. Because these effects are incremental and can generally be repaired (though at some cost), structures in western Arkansas are typically not built to resist them.
Text 2
In a 2021 study, Rubayet Bin Mostafiz and colleagues calculated that in the state of Louisiana alone, the annual cost of damage caused by expansive soils reaches nearly $90 million. But they note that this damage can be mitigated: building vapor barriers between structural foundations and the soil can significantly reduce the effects of soil swelling and shrinking.

Based on the texts, how would Rubayet Bin Mostafiz and colleagues (Text 2) most likely respond to the information presented in Text 1?
selections: A. They would encourage engineers in western Arkansas to insert vapor barriers between new structures’ foundations and the surrounding soil.
B. They would recommend that engineers in western Arkansas measure the moisture level in the soil beneath proposed structures before beginning construction.
C. They would argue that engineers in western Arkansas have misjudged the effectiveness of the techniques they use to reduce the effects of expansive soil.
D. They would suggest that engineers in western Arkansas consider the cost of reinforcing the vapor barriers between existing structural foundations and the soil.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
文本1
在阿肯色州西部，许多建筑物和其他结构都建在膨胀的土壤上，这意味着它会随着湿度的变化而膨胀或收缩。土木工程师Jay X. Wang注意到膨胀土的影响以地基、墙壁和路面逐渐扩大的裂缝的形式缓慢显现。由于这些影响是渐进的，通常可以修复(尽管需要一些成本)，阿肯色州西部的建筑通常不能抵御它们。
文本2
在2021年的一项研究中，Rubayet Bin Mostafiz和他的同事计算出，仅在路易斯安那州，膨胀土造成的破坏每年造成的损失就接近9000万美元。但他们指出，这种损害是可以减轻的:在结构基础和土壤之间建立蒸汽屏障可以显著减少土壤膨胀和收缩的影响。
基于文本，Rubayet Bin Mostafiz和他的同事(文本2)最有可能对文本1中的信息做出什么反应?
中文解析
第二篇文章认为damage的花费接近90million美元，并且认为建立蒸汽屏障可以显著减少膨胀土引起的土壤膨胀和收缩的影响，所以Rubayet Bin Mostafiz及其同事会建议text 1也去使用这种方法。
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
Geneticist Elaine Ostrander led an international collaboration in which Mietje Germonpré and other researchers investigated the evolutionary history of size variation in modern dogs. The researchers identified multiple versions of the gene regulating the production of IGF-1 (insulin-like growth factor 1) in dogs and found that dogs of the same breed consistently share the same version of the gene. In a discussion of the study, a student hypothesizes that small breeds of dogs (for example, chihuahuas) must share a version that represses IGF-1 production that would otherwise confer larger body size.

Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the student’s claim?
selections: A. The degree of size variation among dogs is greater than that of any other land- based mammal.
B. The majority of the most prevalent dog breeds have limited activity in the gene that regulates IGF-1 production.
C. Some breeds with small body sizes and Low IGF-1 concentrations have a different version of the gene regulating IGES production than do chihuahuas.
D. The gene that regulates IGF-1 production is not the only gene that influences body size in dogs but is the only such gene that shows within-breed version consistency.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
遗传学家伊莱恩·奥斯特兰德(Elaine Ostrander)领导了一个国际合作项目，诺伯特·贝内克(Norbert Benecke)和其他研究人员调查了现代狗体型变化的进化史。研究人员在狗身上发现了调节IGF-1(胰岛素样生长因子1)产生的基因的多个版本，并发现同一品种的狗始终具有相同的基因版本。在研究的讨论中，一名学生假设，小型品种的狗(例如，Havaneses)必须共享一个抑制IGF-1产生的版本，否则会导致更大的体型。
中文解析
要weaken文本的最后的结论，small breeds of dogs (for example, Havaneses) must share a version that represses IGF-1 production，于是C选项提到a different version正好可以反驳原文的结论
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

question:
Scholars cite Men of Maize, the 1949 novel by Guatemalan author Miguel Ángel Asturias, as a foundational text of magical realism, the Latin American style of fiction in which antirealistic plot devices—often borrowed from the folkloric traditions of Indigenous and colonial societies in the Americas—are deployed in an otherwise realistic mode of representation typical of the modern novel. This style has exerted a decisive influence on authors around the world, including José Saramago, whose 1982 novel Baltasar and Blimunda resembles classic magical realist novels in its juxtaposition of literary realism with folklore—namely, that of Portugal.

Which quotation from a literary scholar would most directly support the claim in the underlined portion of the text?
selections: A. “Although Portuguese folklore clearly informs the style and occasionally antirealistic plot of Baltasar and Blimunda, the novel also shows the inarguable influence of the magical realist tradition of Latin America.”
B. “Like many works in the Latin American magical realist tradition, Baltasar and Blimunda is indebted to antirealistic elements in the folkloric tradition of Portugal.”
C. “The logic of the realistic plot of Baltasar and Blimunda is repeatedly and productively disrupted by the presence of imagery and situations drawn from Portuguese folklore.”

D. “While Baltasar and Blimunda alternates between realistic and antirealistic modes of representation, details suggesting the influence of Portuguese folklore nevertheless occur throughout the novel.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译
学者们引用危地马拉作家米格尔Ángel阿斯图里亚斯1949年的小说《玉米人》作为魔幻现实主义的基础文本。魔幻现实主义是一种拉丁美洲的小说风格，其中反现实主义的情节设计——通常借鉴于美洲土著和殖民社会的民间传说传统——被运用在现代小说典型的现实主义表现模式中。这种风格对世界各地的作家都产生了决定性的影响，其中包括约瑟夫·萨拉马戈，他1982年的小说《巴尔塔萨和布里蒙达》(Baltasar and Blimunda)类似于经典的魔幻现实主义小说，因为它将文学现实主义与民间传说——也就是葡萄牙的民间传说——并放在一起。
中文解析
最后一个句子中resemble classic magical realist，和like many works一致，juxtaposition of realism with folklore 和 is indebted to antirealistic elements in folkloric tradition一致。
exam_name: 2024年6月第4套阅读语法（M1-21 questions; M2-18 questions）

Entomologists Yash Sondhi and Samuel Fabian have tried to explain why moths fly erratically around light sources at night. Knowing that flying insects keep their backs pointed toward sunlight during the day, _________

B. moths mistake nighttime lights for the Sun and continually try to reorient their bodies while flying near such lights, the researchers theorize.

question: Square P has a side length of x inches. Square Q has a perimeter that is 32 inches greater than the perimeter of square P. The function f gives the area of square Q, in square inches. Which of the following defines f?
selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>8</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>

B. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>32</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>

C. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>32</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>8</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>

D. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>32</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>32</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>
explanations: 正方形周长多32，即边长多8，所以Q的边长为x+8，面积为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>8</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>，选A

question: A circle in the xy-plane has a diameter with endpoints (a, 11) and (a, d), where a and d are constants. An equation of this circle is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>y</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>17</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mi>r</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>, where r is a positive constant. What is the value of d?
explanations: 根据圆方程式可知圆心在点（a, 17），点(a, 11) 和  (a, d)连线是直径，所以两点中点为（a, 17），故（11+d）/2=17，d=23，选D

question: Circle A has a radius of 2x and circle B has a radius of 94x. The area of circle B is how many times the area of circle A?
explanations: 圆的面积比是半径的平方，两个圆半径比为47，所以面积比为47的平方为2209

question: The function <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>80</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>000</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow> <mfrac> <mi>t</mi> <mn>790</mn> </mfrac> </mrow> </msup></math> gives the number of bacteria in a population t minutes after an initial observation. How much time, in minutes, does it take for the number of bacteria in the population to double?
explanations: 题目问的是指数函数的周期，取t/790中的790作为答案，选B
