question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mroot><msup><mi>p</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mn>5</mn></mroot><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>t</mi><mrow><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>4</mn></mfrac></mrow></msup></math>
In the given equation, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>p</mi><mo>></mo><mn>1</mn></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>t</mi><mo>></mo><mn>1</mn></math>. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>p</mi><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>, where n is a constant, what is the value of n?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mroot><msup><mi>p</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mn>5</mn></mroot><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>t</mi><mrow><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>4</mn></mfrac></mrow></msup></math>整理得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mrow><mfrac><mn>2</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>t</mi><mrow><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>4</mn></mfrac></mrow></msup></math>，两侧取4/3次方得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mrow><mfrac><mn>2</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mo>∗</mo><mfrac><mn>4</mn><mn>3</mn></mfrac></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mrow><mfrac><mn>8</mn><mn>15</mn></mfrac></mrow></msup></math>，结合题干中<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>p</mi><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>，得到2n-1=8/15，得到n=23/30

question:
For triangle PQR and triangle STU, angles P and S each measure 30°, QR=16 and TU=12. Which additional piece(s) of information is (are) sufficient to prove that triangle PQR is similar to triangle STU?
I. The length of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>P</mi> <mi>Q</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="false">¯</mo> </mover></math> is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>4</mn> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac></math> the length of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>S</mi> <mi>T</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="false">¯</mo> </mover></math>
II. The length of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>P</mi> <mi>R</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="false">¯</mo> </mover></math> is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>4</mn> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac></math> the length of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>S</mi> <mi>U</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="false">¯</mo> </mover></math>
selections: A. I is sufficient, but II is not.
B. II is sufficient, but I is not.
C. I is sufficient, and II is sufficient.
D. Neither I nor II is sufficient.
explanations: 题目给出两个三角形，∠P=∠S，同时P、S对边比值为4/3，I和II两个条件都是SSA，都无法证明两个三角形相似（除非是SAS，两个边成比例及其夹角相等），故选D

question:
Argentina, Brazil, and the United States are among the world’s leading producers of maize (corn), and each country exports a certain percentage of maize each marketing year, which runs from March to February in Argentina and Brazil and from September to August in the United States. A student is researching those percentages and finds that for the marketing year 2012/2013, the percentage of maize exported by ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the text?
selections: A. Brazil exceeded the percentage exported by Argentina for the first time.
B. Brazil increased from the previous marketing year but remained lower than the percentage exported by the United States.
C. the United States reached its highest point during the five marketing years.
D. Argentina decreased from the previous marketing year but remained the highest among the three countries.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
阿根廷、巴西和美国是世界上谷物(玉米)的主要生产国，每个国家每个销售年出口一定比例的玉米，阿根廷和巴西的销售年从3月到2月，美国的销售年从9月到8月。一名学生正在研究这些百分比，发现在2012/2013销售年度，阿根廷较前一个销售年度有所下降，但仍是三个国家中最高的。
中文解析
2012/2013对应图表，从percent来看分别对应Argentina, Brazil, and U.S 分别对应70，30，10，同时2011/2012 percent 对应的是80，因此D选项描述Argentina decreased from the previous marketing year but remained the highest.

question:
President Richard Nixon is most famous for his participation in the 1970s Watergate political scandal, a convoluted tale of criminality and eroded ethics involving a constellation of associates such as political operative Jeb Stuart Magruder and Nixon’s secretary Rose Mary Woods. But Nixon’s legacy is complex: he has been praised for his role in affirming the sovereignty of tribal nations, and he once made an attempt at reforming United States health care policy that is arguably a precursor to the Affordable Care Act, which became law during the Barack Obama administration.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Richard Nixon’s reputation is primarily due to the actions of his associates.
B. Some of Richard Nixon’s policies influenced the policies of later presidential administrations.
C. Jeb Stuart Magruder and Rose Mary Woods were significant figures in the presidency of Richard Nixon.
D. Richard Nixon is commonly linked with an infamous historical event, but this overshadows some of his notable achievements.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
理查德·尼克松总统因卷入20世纪70年代的水门事件而闻名，这是一个涉及犯罪和道德败坏的复杂故事，涉及政治特工杰布·斯图尔特·马格鲁德和尼克松的秘书罗斯·玛丽·伍兹等一群同伙。但尼克松留下的遗产是复杂的:他因在肯定部落国家主权方面的作用而受到称赞，他曾试图改革美国的医疗保健政策，可以说是《合理医疗费用法案》(Affordable care Act)的先驱，后者在巴拉克·奥巴马(Barack Obama)执政期间成为法律。
中文解析
段落第二句的转折反差，But前表达尼克松水门事件丑闻大家都知晓，但是文本强调的重点是水门事件掩盖了他在其它方面的政策与作用。

question:
There is no doubt that Irving Langmuir must have proved himself to be extraordinarily ________ understanding some of the most advanced concepts in the field of chemistry—in 1932 his remarkable talent and hard work was recognized when he was awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for “his discoveries and investigations in surface chemistry.”

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
毫无疑问，Irving Langmuir肯定已经证明了自己在理解化学领域一些最先进的概念方面非常熟练——1932年，他因“在表面化学方面的发现和研究”而被授予诺贝尔化学奖，这是对他非凡天赋和辛勤工作的认可。
中文解析
文本是对Irving的认可，需要积极的词汇，表达其在前沿化学概念中的理解，选择adept at熟练；Modest谦逊；dispassionate不带感情，平心静气；lighthearted心情愉快。

question:
All stainless steel contains varying amounts of iron, carbon, and corrosion-inhibiting chromium. However, ferritic stainless steel, often used for induction cookers, contains a higher percentage of chromium (at least 10.5%) than does austenitic stainless steel and a higher concentration of iron, which is responsible for its magnetic properties. Unlike ferritic stainless steel, austenitic stainless steel has a face-centered cubic crystalline structure resulting from the addition of nickel to the alloy. Austenitic stainless steel has two subtypes: the 300 series, often used for aerospace tubing, and the 200 series, which has less nickel and more manganese than the 300 series and is used for dishwashers. Thus, stainless steel used to manufacture ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. aerospace tubing will have similar magnetic properties to stainless steel used to manufacture induction cookers.

B. both aerospace tubing and dishwashers will have a face-centered cubic crystalline structure, but stainless steel used to manufacture aerospace tubing will have less nickel than stainless steel used to manufacture dishwashers will.
C. aerospace tubing will have a concentration of manganese greater than 10. 5%, while stainless steel used to manufacture dishwashers will not.
D. aerospace tubing will have less manganese in its composition than stainless steel used to manufacture dishwashers will.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
所有的不锈钢都含有不同数量的铁、碳和抗腐蚀的铬。然而，通常用于电磁炉的铁素体不锈钢含有比奥氏体不锈钢更高比例的铬(至少10.5%)和更高浓度的铁，这是其磁性的原因。与铁素体不锈钢不同，奥氏体不锈钢由于在合金中加入镍而具有面心立方晶体结构。奥氏体不锈钢有两种类型:300系列，通常用于航空航天管道;200系列，比300系列含有更少的镍和更多的锰，用于洗碗机。因此，用于制造航空航天管的不锈钢在其成分中的锰含量将低于用于制造洗碗机的不锈钢。
中文解析
主要关注文末末尾处的比较关系，...200 series, which has less nickel and more manganese than the 300 series。200series用来造aerospace tubing，300 series用来制造dishwashers，所以aerospace tubing will have less manganese。

question:
The following text is adapted from Adib Khorram’s 2018 novel Darius the Great Is Not Okay. Darius, a teenager from the United States, is visiting his grandparents, Babou and Mamou, in Iran. They are preparing for a holiday celebration.
I felt like a tourist.
But Babou fussed with my cap a little more, even though Mamou had already gotten it settled. He looked me in the eye from time to time, like he was looking for something, and thought maybe—just maybe—I had it in me after all.
Babou hummed to himself as he smoothed out my shoulder seams and rested his hands on them.
“I am glad you are here to see this, Darioush-jan.”
Maybe I wasn’t such a tourist.
@2018 by Adib Khorram

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To demonstrate that Babou and Darius aren’t very interested in going to new places
B. To emphasize that Darius has been looking forward to an event
C. To suggest that Babou is planning to visit Darius in the United States soon
D. To show that Babou affects the way Darius thinks of himself
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文字改编自阿迪布·霍拉姆2018年的小说《大流士大帝不好》。达利斯，一个来自美国的少年，正在参观他的
祖父母，爷爷和奶奶，在伊朗。他们正在为节日庆典做准备。
我觉得自己像个游客。
但是爷爷又把我的帽子弄得乱七八糟，尽管马穆已经把它弄好了。他时不时地看着我的眼睛，好像在寻找什么东西，他想，也许——只是也许——我还是有那个东西的。
爷爷一边哼着歌，一边抚平我肩膀上的接缝，双手放在上面。
“我很高兴你在这里看到这一切，亲爱的达里乌什。”
也许我不是个游客。
中文解析
Darius从美国去伊朗，感觉自己是个tourist，但是爷爷的动作行为与话语，让他最后感觉自己或许不是游客，于是改变了他对自己的身份定位。

question:
Studies of the Effects of Tilling vs. No Tilling on Crop Yields
Danijel Jug and colleagues found that tilling—the practice of turning soil with hoes, plows, or other machines before planting crops—was associated with an increased yield of winter wheat. But some studies of other crops have found the opposite effect, raising the question of whether the increase in yield found by Jug and colleagues is specific to their study crop. However, this doesn’t seem to be the case: _______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the assertion?
selections: A. crop yields with tilling have ranged from 2, 693 kilograms per hectare for winter barley to 4, 860 kilograms per hectare for winter wheat.
B. Gevan Behnke and colleagues found a similar association in a study using soybeans.
C. a study using winter wheat yielded 4, 860 kilograms per hectare with tilling and only 3,910 kilograms per hectare without tilling.
D. R. K. Jat and colleagues reported an even larger positive effect of tilling on the yield of maize.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
Danijel Jug和他的同事发现，耕作——在种植作物之前用锄头、犁或其他机器翻耕土壤的做法——与冬小麦产量的增加有关。但对其他作物的一些研究发现了相反的效果，这就提出了一个问题:Jug和同事们发现的产量增加是否只适用于他们研究的作物?然而，事实似乎并非如此
中文解析
Soybean的数据（对应Gevan Behnke and colleagues的研究）tilling之后是明显比no tilling要产量高，于是说明winter wheat的情况不是实验的个例，符合文本末尾的支撑需要。

question:
J. G. Ballard’s 1984 novel Empire of the Sun contains elements drawn from Ballard’s own life—there are many parallels between the experiences of the novel’s protagonist, Jim Graham, and those of Ballard—and as a result Empire of the Sun is regularly described as an autobiographical novel. This characterization can be useful, but it also presents drawbacks in terms of how the work is perceived, as it may lead readers to believe that Ballard merely fictionalized true events, which, in an artistic field where creativity and inventiveness are prized, can suggest that _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. Ballard should not have claimed that Empire of the Sun is based on real events.
B. the real-world counterparts of other characters in Empire of the Sun are hard to identify.
C. Empire of the Sun is less of an imaginative achievement than it actually is.
D. critics disagree about whether Empire of the Sun shows greater originality than works without autobiographical elements.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
J.G巴拉德1984年的小说《太阳帝国》包含了巴拉德自己生活中的一些元素——小说主人公吉姆·格雷厄姆的经历和巴拉德的经历有很多相似之处——因此，《太阳帝国》通常被描述为自传体小说。这种描述可能是有用的，但它也在如何理解这部作品方面呈现出缺点，因为它可能会让读者相信巴拉德只是虚构了真实的事件，在一个重视创造力和发明创造的艺术领域，这可能表明，《太阳帝国》没有那么富有想象力。
中文解析
文本末尾句非常重要的指出 presents drawbacks in terms of how the work is perceived，于是我们的选项需要是对作品消极理解，再结合in an artistic field where creativity and inventiveness are prized，由此选择C，人们会觉得这部作品基于真实事件，所有不太具有想象力。

question:
The food industry has long used thermal technologies to preserve food in large batches. Recent advancements in infrared heating were made through research in Mexico on the preservation of bean flour. Infrared heating is generally considered to be an improvement over more conventional thermal preservation methods: whereas conventional methods transfer energy from the surface of a food to its interior, infrared heating uses high-intensity infrared light to generate heat within the food itself, thus reducing industrial cooking times.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It emphasizes the simplicity of infrared heating technologies.
B. It explains why conventional heating methods are popular in commercial applications and proposes a shift away from these methods.
C. It suggests that there are possible flaws in infrared heating technologies that have not yet been well researched.
D. It identifies an advantage that infrared heating has over conventional thermal preservation methods.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
食品工业长期以来一直使用热技术来大批量保存食品。通过在墨西哥对豆粉保鲜的研究，取得了红外加热的最新进展。红外线加热通常被认为是对传统保温方法的改进:传统方法将能量从食物表面转移到食物内部，而红外线加热利用高强度红外光在食物内部产生热量，从而减少工业烹饪时间。
中文解析
划线句子whereas表示对比，对比conventional thermal preservation与infrared heating加热方式的差异，突显infrared heating的优势。

question:
Auxins are a class of hormones that influence plant growth, including leaf orientation (the tendency of leaves to be larger on one side of their long central axis than the other). University of California, Berkeley biologist Ciera Martinez and colleagues noted that in certain plants in which leaves grow in pairs, auxins will typically be concentrated in opposite sides of each leaf in the pair (e. g. , on the left side of one leaf in the pair and the right side of the other). Accordingly, they hypothesized that paired leaves should tend to show opposite-side orientation, and they tested their hypothesis by examining paired leaves from several species of grapevines.

Which choice best describes data from the graph that support Martinez and colleagues’ hypothesis?
selections: A. In the maple-leaf grape, frost grape, and July grape, all the leaf pairs show opposite-side orientation.
B. Although the number of leaf pairs showing same-side orientation is fairly high in the July grape, it is much lower in both the maple-leaf grape and frost grape.
C. Although the exact ratio varies by species, the maple-leaf grape, frost grape, and July grape all show more leaf pairs with opposite-side orientations than with same-side orientations.
D. The number of leaf pairs showing opposite-side orientation is fairly high in the maple-leaf grape, but not as high as it is in the July grape.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
生长素是一类影响植物生长的激素，包括叶片的方向(叶片在长中轴的一边比另一边大的趋势)。加州大学伯克利分校的生物学家Ciera Martinez和他的同事注意到，在某些叶子成对生长的植物中，生长素通常集中在每对叶子的相对一侧(例如，在一对中的一片叶子的左侧和另一片叶子的右侧)。因此，他们假设成对的叶子应该倾向于显示相反的方向，他们通过检查几种葡萄藤的成对叶子来验证他们的假设。
中文解析
选项C最好地描述了图表中支持Martinez及其同事假设的数据。这个选项提到，尽管确切的比例因物种而异，但所有三种葡萄(枫叶葡萄、霜冻葡萄和七月葡萄)的叶片对都是opposite-orientation side更多。这与生长素集中在每对叶片的相对侧的假设一致。

question:
Economists have long observed that firms in related industries tend to cluster in the same area, as is the case in Leeds, UK, where many thread and yarn spinning firms as well as textile weaving firms are located. The factors causing such clustering are ______: what drives firms in certain industries to cluster may not be especially relevant among other industries.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
经济学家长期以来观察到，相关行业的公司倾向于聚集在同一地区，就像英国利兹的情况一样，那里有许多线和纱线纺纱公司以及纺织公司。造成这种集群的因素是可变的:促使某些行业的企业集群的因素可能与其他行业并不特别相关。
中文解析
文本最后冒号后的解释内容中提到not be especially relevant among other industries, 说明驱动的要素是变化的，一个行业的驱动要素未必是其它行业的驱动要素。

question:
In her large-scale sculpture Casa-Isla, artist Edra Soto included references to her childhood in Puerto Rico. For example, the sculpture’s steel panels have a crisscrossing pattern inspired by the iron gates ________

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. Soto would see in her neighborhood?
B. would Soto see in her neighborhood?
C. would Soto see in her neighborhood.
D. Soto would see in her neighborhood.
explanations: 这个题目本质上是标点符号与句子语序的规则考察，后面的句子应该是一个从句修饰iron gates, 从句中用陈述句语序与句号，于是选择D。

question:
In a large community science effort, biologist Abbigail Merrill and colleagues collaborated with hundreds of students and other amateur science enthusiasts for more than three years to study how butterfly color and time of day relate to butterfly behavior. They found that butterfly color might influence behavior more than butterfly size does, and that butterflies were observed to feed more often in the morning than at any other time of day.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Time of day and butterfly color seem to have less influence on butterfly behavior than the location where the butterflies are studied does.
B. A recent study suggested that butterflies’ coloring seems to be less relevant to their behavior than time of day.
C. Collaboration between professional scientists and members of the public is especially useful when studying the behavior of butterflies and other flying insects.
D. A large study suggested that butterfly color and time of day might influence the behavior of certain butterflies.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在一项大型社区科学研究中，生物学家阿比盖尔·梅里尔及其同事与数百名学生和其他业余科学爱好者合作了三年多的时间，研究蝴蝶的颜色和一天中的时间与蝴蝶的行为之间的关系。他们发现蝴蝶的颜色可能比蝴蝶的大小更能影响蝴蝶的行为，并且观察到蝴蝶在早上进食的频率比一天中的任何其他时间都要高。
中文解析
文本最后一句话的结论是重点，整体可以理解color, size, time of the day都会影响到butterflies behaviors，including feeding behavior.

question:
The following text is adapted from Kenneth Grahame’s 1908 novel The Wind in the Willows. The Mole is dazed after briefly meeting a stranger while traveling with a friend.
[The] Mole stood still a moment, held in thought. As one wakened suddenly from a beautiful dream, who struggles to recall it, and can re-capture nothing but a dim sense of the beauty of it, the beauty! Till that, too, fades away in its turn.

As used in the text, what does the word “recall” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文字改编自肯尼斯·格雷厄姆1908年的小说《柳林风声》。鼹鼠在和朋友一起旅行时遇到了一个陌生人，他感到一阵眩晕。
鼹鼠静静地站了一会儿，陷入了沉思。就像一个人突然从一个美丽的梦中醒来，他挣扎着回忆它，但什么也不能重新捕捉到，只有一种朦胧的美，美!直到它也随之消逝。
中文解析
场景中As one wakened suddenly from a beautiful dream 美梦惊醒, recall（dream），回忆梦境

question:
Portable video game consoles and wireless speakers tend to contain batteries that can’t be easily _________. Environmental policy researcher Jean-Pierre Schweitzer warns that because new batteries can’t be put in once the old ones no longer work, the gadgets stop functioning and are usually disposed of as trash.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
环境政策研究员让-皮埃尔·施韦策警告说，便携式视频游戏机和无线扬声器往往含有不易更换的电池，因为一旦旧电池不再工作，新电池就无法插入，这些小玩意停止工作，通常被当作垃圾处理掉。
中文解析：
重点关注因果关系中的原因because new batteries can’t be put in once the old ones no longer work, the gadgets stop functioning and are usually disposed of as trash. Old ones no longer work 说明前面要填入replace（batteries）,电池的替换。

question:
A student is writing a research paper on the history of irrigation in the United States, situating the development of Hume Lake (created in Fresno County, California, in 1908) in a larger historical context. The student claims that California’s climate renders irrigation an essential component of agriculture in some parts of the state but not in others.

Which quotation from a study of California agriculture best supports the student’s claim?
selections: A. “The usefulness of irrigation infrastructure in California today cannot be overstated, since it is the most common means of conveying water for agricultural purposes.”

B. “Natural humidity, which renders irrigation unnecessary or reduces its importance in the northern reaches of California, gradually decreases toward the sun-scorched but nonetheless fertile valleys of the southern part of the state.”

C. “Sprinkler irrigation systems are a contemporary way of irrigating that requires machinery to spray water in all directions. These are currently used throughout the United States and are especially prevalent in California.”

D. “The irrigation system developed by the Hohokam people in the 7th century CE in what is now Arizona was simple, but this system applied hydraulic engineering design features that are in use today throughout California.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一个学生正在写一篇关于美国灌溉历史的研究论文，将休谟湖(1908年在加利福尼亚州弗雷斯诺县创建)的发展置于更大的历史背景中。这名学生声称，加州的气候使得灌溉在该州的某些地区成为农业的重要组成部分，而在其他地区则不然。
中文解析
在加州北部，自然湿度使得灌溉变得不必要，或者降低了灌溉的重要性，而在加州南部被太阳炙烤但仍然肥沃的山谷，自然湿度逐渐减少,使得灌溉又变得重要。于是正支持了文本中最后学生的结论，加州的气候使得irrigation在加州一些地方重要，一些地方不重要。

question:
Many of the cities and _______ are known by nicknames that correspond to one of their notable features, like landscape, climate, famous residents, or chief exports. For example, the Puerto Rican municipality of Hatillo has also been called “the Blue Coast of Puerto Rico,” a nickname that alludes to what the area is well known for: the pristine blue ocean that surrounds it.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. towns, that dot the island of Puerto Rico,
B. towns that dot the island of Puerto Rico
C. towns that dot the island of Puerto Rico,
D. towns, that dot the island of Puerto Rico
explanations: That定语从句修饰前面的cities and towns不能用符号分开，主语和谓语之间，也就是are known不能用符号分开，于是选择B

question:
As a behavioral economist, Francesca Gino of Harvard Business School examines human economic behavior through a lens that, _______ elements of psychology and economics, illuminates how and why (and to what effect) people make particular choices.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 从句中已经有动词illuminates，于是不可以再出现其它的谓语动词，所以选分词combining。其它选项都是动词形式。

question:
As an object-oriented computer programming language, Perl is used by coders like Black Girls Code founder Kimberly Bryant ________ programs by manipulating “objects” (that is, specifically defined variables or combinations of variables) into interacting with each other. Conversely, Pascal, used in software development and educational instruction, is not an object-oriented language.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 动词的固定搭配考察，be used to do , 具体在文本中Perl is used by coders to create programs

question:
Anthony van Dyck, a Flemish mannerist painter whose works are distinctive for their precise yet exaggerated details, ___________ frequently included in the seventeenth-century art movement the Antwerp School, whose members were known for depicting rural life in the Low Countries.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 动词保持主谓一致的原则，主语Anthony van Dyck是单数，选择is

question:
By analyzing the level of radioactive decay within a fossil specimen, scientists can establish the age of that fossil with a high degree of precision. When radioactive elements aren’t present, scientists turn to _______ analysis of Earth’s sediment layers (strata)—to estimate how old a fossil is based on the age of the strata in which the fossil is found.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 双破折起解释说明作用，成对使用等于是括号或者是双逗号，相当于插入语。

question:
The World Cup of men’s soccer, one of the biggest sporting events on the planet, brought 32 national teams from six continents to the host country, Brazil, in 2014. The event, which is held every four years, has expanded greatly since it was played in Italy in 1934. ________ the World Cup included only 16 teams, most from Europe and the Americas.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: 文本提到1934年的世界杯，追溯到当时只有16支队伍，于是用时间逻辑词then

question:
Recognized as a National Heritage Area by the United States Congress in 1996, the Rivers of Steel National Heritage Area _______ a region of Pennsylvania that has long been known for its unique natural, cultural, and historical attributes.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 本题是动词时态考察，从后面的has long been是现在完成时，于是时间是现在，同时the Rivers of Steel National Heritage Area是单数主语，于是选择D选项is

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●In 1897, twenty Black US Army infantrymen rode bicycles from Montana to Missouri.
●The 1, 900-mile journey took forty-one days.
●The goal was to test the idea of forming a military bicycle corps.
●In 2022, Erick Cedeno, a Black long-distance cyclist, reenacted the journey.
●Cedeno wanted to honor the infantrymen on the journey’s 125th anniversary.

The student wants to emphasize how far the infantrymen traveled. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The 125th anniversary of the infantrymen’s journey was in 2022.
B. The US infantrymen rode their bicycles from Montana to Missouri—traveling a total of 1,900 miles.
C. The goal of the 1897 journey was to test the idea of forming a military bicycle corps.
D. Over a century later, Erick Cedeño honored the infantrymen by reenacting their 1897 journey.
explanations: 题目中需要强调how far，选项B a total of 1,900 miles能够回答路途长度

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Mary Kang is a Korean American portrait photographer.
●She is based in New York City and in Austin, Texas.
●One of Kang’s photographs features artist Dominique Fung.
●In the portrait, Fung is seated on the floor.
●Five of Fung’s paintings are resting against the wall behind her.

The student wants to describe where Fung is in the photograph to an audience already familiar with Kang and Fung. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Dominique Fung is in a photograph by Mary Kang, a portrait photographer based in New York City and Austin, Texas.
B. Mary Kang is a photographer based in both New York City and Austin, Texas.
C. In Kang’s portrait of her, Fung is seated on the floor, with five of her paintings resting against the wall behind her.
D. Five paintings by artist Dominique Fung can be seen in the background of Mary Kang’s photograph.
explanations: 题目要求回答where Fung is，于是C选项 Fung is seated on the floor说明了位置，同时题目给出an audience already familiar with Kang and Fung，所以不必想其它选项那样描述Kang and Fung

question:
In his essay “Of Smells,” French philosopher Michel de Montaigne explores a relatively light subject, but he addresses heavier fare in “Of the Punishment of Cowardice.” Regardless of subject matter, Montaigne works to question his own perspective throughout his essays. _______ his personal motto was “What do I know?”

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: Fittingly表示恰当地，Montaigne works to question his own perspective throughout his essays.蒙田质疑自己的观点，他的personal motto was “what do I know”,逻辑词前后是一致的关系，于是不可以用still，conversely都是表示转折时使用。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●The Future of Nostalgia is a scholarly book by literary theorist Svetlana Boym.
●The book explores the concept of nostalgia from various angles.
●Chapter 3 explores nostalgia in the 1993 sci-fi action movie Jurassic Park.
●Chapter 16 discusses the nostalgic home décor of Russian émigrés.
●In chapter 16, Boym writes, “Their rooms filled with diasporic souvenirs are not altars to their unhappiness, but rather places for communication.”

The student wants to explain what Svetlana Boym writes about in chapter 3. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. After exploring nostalgia in the 1993 sci-fi action movie Jurassic Park, Svetlana Boym goes on to discuss the nostalgic home décor of Russian émigrés.
B. Literary theorist Svetlana Boym explores nostalgia in the 1993 sci-fi action movie Jurassic Park in chapter 3 of her book.
C. As Svetlana Boym writes in the sixteenth chapter of her book, “Their rooms filled with diasporic souvenirs are not altars to their unhappiness, but rather places for communication.”
D. Svetlana Boym’s The Future of Nostalgia explores the concept of nostalgia from various angles.
explanations: 题目要求讲述chapter 3中内容，于是B选项内容恰好是满足的

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Somalia is a country in East Africa.
●A high percentage of Somalia’s population (46. 4 percent) is under fifteen years old.
●It has the sixth—largest under-fifteen population in the world.
●Roughly 40 percent of Africa’s population is under fifteen years old-the highest of any continent.
●According to the United Nations (UN), Africa’s “high number of young people is an opportunity for the continent’s growth—but only if these new generations are fully empowered to realise their best potential.”

The student wants to emphasize the global rank of Somalia’s youth population. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Africa’s high population of young people is due in part to the high percentage of young people in Somalia.
B. With 46.4 percent of its population under fifteen years of age, Somalia has the sixth-largest population for that age range in the world.
C. Making up roughly 40 percent of the continent’s total population, Africa’s under-fifteen population offers “an opportunity for the continent’s growth,” according to the UN.
D. “Only if these new generations are fully empowered to realise their best potential,” says the UN, will Africa’s high percentage of young people lead to the continent’s growth.
explanations: 题目需要强调global rank of Somalia’s youth population，B选型的46.4 percent 是youth population，sixth-largest说明了全球的排名

question:
Historians have argued that a crucial component of the Civil Rights Movement’s success in the 1960s was the Southern Christian Leadership Conference’s Citizen Education Program (CEP), which invited promising activists from across the South to its one-week training sessions in Dorchester, Georgia. Led by experienced organizers such as Dorothy Cotton and Septima Clark, CEP attendees—more than 7,000 in all—participated in workshops on topics ranging from public speaking to legal doctrine before returning home and using their newly acquired knowledge to spearhead local civil rights initiatives.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It establishes that criticism of the CEP was limited to a few individuals in the Southern Christian Leadership Conference.
B. It underscores the extent of the CEP’s impact on the Civil Rights Movement of the 1960s.
C. It illustrates the CEP organizers’ efforts to educate participants on a wide variety of topics.
D. It suggests that CEP attendees held a diverse array of opinions about the Southern Christian Leadership Conference’s political philosophy
explanations:
题目文本翻译
历史学家认为，民权运动在20世纪60年代取得成功的一个关键因素是南方基督教领袖会议的公民教育计划(CEP)，该计划邀请南方各地有前途的活动家参加在佐治亚州多尔切斯特举行的为期一周的培训课程。在多萝西·科顿(Dorothy Cotton)和塞普蒂玛·克拉克(Septima Clark)等经验丰富的组织者的带领下，共有7000多名CEP与会者参加了从公开演讲到法律原则等主题的讲习班，然后回国，并利用他们新获得的知识带头开展当地的民权倡议。
中文解析
因为划线句式7000多人的数据，突出了公民教育计划(CEP)在20世纪60年代对民权运动的重大影响和范围。所提供的信息强调了项目的规模和成效，详细介绍了参加人员的人数、他们接受的培训以及他们如何利用所学知识在当地社区推动民权倡议。

question:
Indigenous songs are an important resource for ecological information. Songs of the Warlpiri people in Yuendumu, Australia, convey information about wild edible seeds, and the songs of the Sakha people in Siberia, Russia, address the effects of climate change on local ecosystems. There have been efforts made to preserve Indigenous languages over the years—e.g., the United Nations’ International Decade of Indigenous Languages (2022-2032). However, such attempts have typically focused on spoken language despite the fact that some expressions in these languages appear only in songs. Therefore, if those involved in such efforts want to ensure that a comprehensive range of information is secured, they must __________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. recognize that Indigenous languages likely have more unique expressions that represent ecological knowledge than represent other types of information.
B. acknowledge that Indigenous songs are largely but not entirely composed using phrases taken from spoken language.
C. incorporate the preservation of songs into their broader efforts to protect Indigenous languages.
D. analyze musical similarities in the songs of the Warlpiri and Sakha people.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
土著歌曲是重要的生态信息资源。澳大利亚Yuendumu的Warlpiri人的歌曲传达了有关野生可食用种子的信息，俄罗斯西伯利亚的萨哈人的歌曲则讲述了气候变化对当地生态系统的影响。多年来，人们一直在努力保护土著语言。联合国土著语言国际十年(2022-2032)。然而，这些尝试通常集中在口语上，尽管这些语言中的一些表达只出现在歌曲中。因此，如果参与此类努力的人员想要确保信息的全面安全，他们必须将歌曲的保存纳入保护土著语言的更广泛努力中。
中文解析
文本的意义是不能只关注spoken language，因为some expressions in these languages appear only in songs，于是ensure that a comprehensive range of information is secured，就需要preservation of songs，对应C选项。

question:
Dervla Murphy, who cycled solo through Europe, Iran, Afghanistan, Pakistan, and India, undoubtedly accomplished much, but her place in our historical memory is perhaps more _______ than that of a noteworthy “first” such as Ynes Mexia, who was the first to discover the botanical genus Mexianthus, a deed for which she will always be remembered.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
Dervla Murphy独自骑自行车穿越了欧洲、伊朗、阿富汗、巴基斯坦和印度，毫无疑问，她取得了很多成就，但她在我们历史记忆中的地位可能比一个值得注意的“第一人”更不确定，比如Ynes Mexia，她是第一个发现墨西哥属植物的人，她将永远被铭记。
中文解析
原文对比noteworthy “first”、always be remembered的相反面，应该是uncertain，其它选项都是积极的形容词不能选。

question:
Fernand Braudel and other historians of capitalism rarely discuss domestic capitalism in Africa before the period of European colonization, implicitly presenting capitalism as external to and imposed on Africa. John Iliffe and other Africanist scholars have shown, however, that in parts of Africa, institutionally protected private land ownership, the existence of salaried labor, and other features of capitalism predated colonization. One reason for this discrepancy is that historians of capitalism tend to focus on longitudinal economic data drawn from archival records, which do not exist for much of precolonial Africa.

Which statement about Iliffe and other Africanist scholars is best supported by information in the text?
selections: A. They likely make use of different types of evidence than historians of capitalism typically rely on.
B. They likely have a different view about which activities should be considered capitalist in nature than historians of capitalism do.
C. They likely differ from historians of capitalism in the methods they use to derive longitudinal economic data from archival records.
D. They likely view capitalism as having been more beneficial for Africa than historians of capitalism do.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
布罗代尔和其他资本主义历史学家很少讨论欧洲殖民时期之前非洲的国内资本主义，含蓄地将资本主义呈现为外部和强加于非洲的资本主义。然而，约翰·伊利夫和其他非洲学者已经证明，在非洲的部分地区，受制度保护的私有土地所有权、受薪劳动力的存在以及资本主义的其他特征早在殖民统治之前就存在了。造成这种差异的一个原因是，资本主义历史学家倾向于关注从档案记录中提取的纵向经济数据，而这些数据在殖民前的非洲并不存在。
中文解析
它突出了像John Iliffe这样的非洲学者如何利用档案记录中的纵向经济数据以外的证据来表明，在欧洲殖民之前，非洲部分地区就存在资本主义的特征。这表明他们的研究方法和证据类型不同于资本主义历史学家。

question:
In the 2010s, the price of vintage My Little Pony figures rose dramatically, which had the counterintuitive effect of _______ demand: buyers who hadn’t previously wanted to purchase old toys suddenly thronged the market, believing prices would continue to rise and the toys could be resold later at a profit.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在2010年代，小马的古董玩具价格大幅上涨，这产生了一种违背直觉的需求加速需求效应:之前不想购买旧玩具的买家突然涌入市场，他们认为价格会继续上涨，这些玩具以后可以转售获利。
中文解析
从冒号后的解释可以看到buyers suddenly thronged the market,于是前面应该需求激增，于是选择precipitating，表示加速，促使快速发生。

question:
Text 1
Toni Morrison’s 1973 novel Sula, a tale of two women’s lives set in small-town Ohio from the 1910s to the 1960s, has been described as historical fiction. While it’s inarguable that Morrison’s book takes place in the past rather than in her own time, Sula is much richer and more complicated than the mere re-creation of the past suggested by the term “historical fiction.”
Text 2
Some literary critics dismiss historical fiction as a shallow genre in which writers show off their knowledge of period details rather than tell meaningful stories. But historical fiction can be used to explore profound themes and complex characters—in fact, many writers find that writing about the past gives them a creative freedom they’d lack if they wrote about the present.

Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the claim about Sula advanced by the author of Text 1?
selections: A. By arguing that Morrison displays a thorough knowledge of historical details in Sula.
B. By asserting that dissatisfaction with describing Sula as historical fiction reflects a misunderstanding of the genre.
C. By conceding that the genre of historical fiction contains many works that are less sophisticated than Sula is.
D. By claiming that the author of Text 1 has underestimated the richness and complexity of Sula.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
文本1
托尼·莫里森1973年的小说《苏拉》被称为历史小说，讲述了两个女人从20世纪10年代到60年代在俄亥俄州小镇上的生活。无可争辩的是，莫里森的书发生在过去，而不是她自己的时代，苏拉比“历史小说”所暗示的仅仅是对过去的再创造要丰富和复杂得多。
文本2
一些文学评论家认为历史小说是一种肤浅的体裁，作者在其中展示他们对时代细节的了解，而不是讲述有意义的故事。但历史小说可以用来探索深刻的主题和复杂的人物——事实上，许多作家发现，写过去给了他们创作自由，这是他们写现在所缺乏的。
根据文本，文本2的作者最有可能如何回应文本1的作者提出的关于苏拉的主张?
中文解析
Author in text 1 认为sula这部作品比 “historical fiction”那种mere recreation of the past要优秀，但是text 2指出其实historical fiction很好，比如explore profound themes and complex characters，所以文本2会觉得如果文本1不满意Sula被归类成historical fiction, 其实是对该题材有误解。

question:
In a 2014 study that took place in Laos, Stéphane Guédron, Delphine Tisserand, and colleagues found a negative association between levels of dissolved organic carbon and mercury in bodies of fresh water. It may seem reasonable to be skeptical of this finding, since most other studies, such as research conducted in 2015 in Canada by Stéphanie Hamelin and colleagues, have found that dissolved organic carbon and mercury levels rise together. Like the latter study, however, most studies of the topic have been conducted in North America, and many of those study sites have similar characteristics to one another, suggesting that ___________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. few of the studies conducted in North America have been able to measure dissolved organic carbon and mercury levels with the same level of precision as in Guédron, Tisserand, and colleagues’ study.

B. the mercury levels reported in Guédron, Tisserand, and colleagues’ study were much higher than those reported in the study by Hamelin and colleagues even though the dissolved organic carbon levels reported in the two studies were approximately the same.
C. Guédron, Tisserand, and colleagues’ study may have inadvertently measured a different characteristic of bodies of fresh water than their levels of dissolved organic carbon and mercury.

D. Guédron, Tisserand, and colleagues’ finding may differ from the findings of other studies due to a difference in environmental circumstances that affects the relationship between dissolved organic carbon and mercury in fresh water.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
2014年，在老挝进行的一项研究中，古萨德伦、戴尔芬·蒂瑟兰及其同事发现，淡水水体中溶解有机碳和汞的含量呈负相关。对这一发现持怀疑态度似乎是合理的，因为大多数其他研究，比如2015年加拿大的斯特姆萨尼·哈梅林及其同事进行的研究，都发现溶解的有机碳和汞含量会同时上升。然而，与后一项研究一样，该主题的大多数研究都是在北美进行的，其中许多研究地点彼此具有相似的特征，这表明gusamdron, Tisserand和同事的发现可能与其他研究的结果不同，因为环境环境的差异影响了淡水中溶解有机碳和汞之间的关系。
中文解析
这一选择表明，不同地区不同的环境条件可能导致淡水中溶解有机碳和汞含量之间的不同关系，这可能解释了老挝研究结果与在北美进行的研究结果之间的差异。

question:
The results of randomized clinical trials testing the efficacy of common medical interventions sometimes fail to ________ conclusions that practitioners reach based on their real-world observations of patients. While there are several possible reasons for this, one is that practitioners may overlook confounding variables that account for the results they attribute to the interventions in question.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
测试普通医疗干预效果的随机临床试验的结果有时无法证实从业人员根据对患者的实际观察得出的结论。虽然有几个可能的原因，其中一个是从业者可能忽略了混淆变量，这些变量解释了他们归因于相关干预措施的结果。
中文解析
Corroborate表示证实，根据文本前后文意义，其中有原因是practitioners overlook foundling variables, 于是可以逆推前面应该是fail to corroborate conclusions.

question:
As complex life cycle parasites, Opechona sp. and Cucullanellus kanabus require multiple host species throughout their development. Extrapolating from parasite counts on Pacific herring and seven other fish species collected from Puget Sound from 1880 to 2019, Chelsea Wood et al. found that the abundance of three-host parasites, such as Opechona sp., negatively correlated with rising average annual sea temperatures; the abundance of two-host parasites, such as C. kanabus, was largely stable. Noting that fish and other marine vertebrates are especially vulnerable to climate change, Wood et al. observed that all three-host parasites in the study depend on at least two vertebrate species, while all two-host parasites depend on only one, suggesting that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. although Opechona sp. and C. kanabus both require Pacific herring as a host, C. kanabus was more adversely affected by warming-driven changes in the Pacific herring population than Opechona sp. was.
B. a parasite’s sensitivity to warming temperatures is negatively correlated with the number of unique vertebrate species it depends on throughout its life cycle.

C. warming-induced population changes among Puget Sound vertebrates may have suppressed some parasite populations, but there were no changes among the eight studied host species that affected two-host parasite abundance.
D. population size and density of the eight fish species examined in the study were likely largely unaffected by rising sea temperatures.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
Opechona sp.和Cucullanellus kanabus作为复杂的生命周期寄生虫，在其发育过程中需要多种寄主。Chelsea Wood等人从1880年至2019年在普吉特海湾收集的太平洋鲱鱼和其他七种鱼类的寄生虫数量推断，发现三宿主寄生虫(如Opechona sp.)的丰富度与年平均海水温度上升呈负相关;双宿主寄生虫(如卡纳布氏弧菌)的丰度基本稳定。注意到鱼类和其他海洋脊椎动物特别容易受到气候变化的影响，Wood等人观察到，研究中的所有三宿主寄生虫都依赖于至少两种脊椎动物物种，而所有两宿主寄生虫只依赖于一种脊椎动物物种，这表明寄生虫对变暖温度的敏感性与其在整个生命周期中所依赖的独特脊椎动物物种的数量呈负相关。
中文解析
文本中A 说反了，B也说反了，应该是positive relation正相关关系，研究指出，三宿主寄生虫依赖至少两种脊椎动物宿主，而双宿主寄生虫只依赖一种脊椎动物宿主。在这个背景下，最合理的结论应当是C温度升高，减少了寄生虫，因为寄生虫的生命周期中所依赖的宿主种类数量会受到海水温度变化的消极影响。也就是说，依赖更多宿主种类的寄生虫更容易受到这些宿主种群变化的影响，而 two-host parasite abundance相对保持稳定，说明其宿主的数量没有明显变化。

question:
In 2011 Brynn M. Devine and colleagues published a study concluding that ocean acidification has a strong effect on the behavior of Cheilodipterus quinquelineatus, a species of fish. However, Devine and colleagues’ study relied on a mean sample size of only about 25 fish. In a 2022 review of various scientists’ conclusions about the impacts of ocean acidification on fish behavior, Timothy D. Clark and colleagues caution that relying on such a relatively small sample size can increase the potential for biased analysis. Such analysis, in turn, can contribute to reports of exaggerated effects.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To note a potential concern about the findings of a scientific study
B. To discuss an aspect of ocean acidification that is frequently overlooked
C. To present a debate between two research teams about a cause of ocean acidification
D. To explain how the behavior of a fish species has changed over time
explanations:
题目文本翻译
2011年，布林·m·迪瓦恩(Brynn M. Devine)及其同事发表了一项研究，得出的结论是，海洋酸化对一种名为quinquelineatus的鱼类的行为有很大影响。然而，迪瓦恩和同事的研究依赖于平均只有25条鱼的样本大小。2022年，蒂莫西·d·克拉克(Timothy D. Clark)和他的同事们在一篇综述中，对各种科学家关于海洋酸化对鱼类行为影响的结论进行了回顾，他们警告说，依赖这样一个相对较小的样本量，可能会增加分析有偏见的可能性。这样的分析反过来又可能导致夸大效应的报告。
中文解析
文章的末尾之处a small size会导致exaggerated effects，于是符合A选项所讲的potential concern。

question:
Text 1
In southern and central Georgia, many buildings and other structures rest on soil that is expansive, meaning that it swells or shrinks as its moisture level changes. Civil engineer Jay X. Wang has noted that the effects of expansive soil appear slowly in the form of gradually growing cracks in foundations, walls, and pavements. Because these effects are incremental and can generally be repaired (though at some cost), structures in southern and central Georgia are typically not built to resist them.
Text 2
In a 2021 study, Rubayet Bin Mostafiz and colleagues calculated that in the state of Louisiana alone, the annual cost of damage caused by expansive soils reaches nearly $90 million. But they note that this damage can be mitigated: building vapor barriers between structural foundations and the soil can significantly reduce the effects of soil swelling and shrinking.

Based on the texts, how would Rubayet Bin Mostafiz and colleagues (Text 2) most likely respond to the information presented in Text 1?
selections: A. They would encourage engineers in southern and central Georgia to insert vapor barriers between new structures’ foundations and the surrounding soil.
B. They would argue that engineers in southern and central Georgia have misjudged the effectiveness of the techniques they use to reduce the effects of expansive soil.
C. They would suggest that engineers in southern and central Georgia consider the cost of reinforcing the vapor barriers between existing structural foundations and the soil.
D. They would recommend that engineers in southern and central Georgia measure the moisture level in the soil beneath proposed structures before beginning construction.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
文本1
在佐治亚州的南部和中部，许多建筑物和其他结构都建在膨胀的土壤上，这意味着它会随着湿度的变化而膨胀或收缩。土木工程师Jay X. Wang注意到膨胀土的影响以地基、墙壁和路面逐渐扩大的裂缝的形式缓慢显现。由于这些影响是渐进的，通常可以修复(尽管需要一些费用)，乔治亚州南部和中部的建筑通常无法抵御它们。
文本2
在2021年的一项研究中，Rubayet Bin Mostafiz和他的同事计算出，仅在路易斯安那州，膨胀土造成的破坏每年造成的损失就接近9000万美元。但他们指出，这种损害是可以减轻的:在结构基础和土壤之间建立蒸汽屏障可以显著减少土壤膨胀和收缩的影响。
基于文本，Rubayet Bin Mostafiz和他的同事(文本2)最有可能对文本1中的信息做出什么反应?
中文解析
建立蒸汽屏障可以显著减少膨胀土引起的土壤膨胀和收缩的影响。Rubayet Bin Mostafiz及其同事建议在佐治亚州南部和中部的新建筑中使用蒸汽屏障，这可能是在倡导一种积极主动的方法，以减轻该地区膨胀土壤造成的破坏。

question:
Geneticist Elaine Ostrander led an international collaboration in which Norbert Benecke and other researchers investigated the evolutionary history of size variation in modern dogs. The researchers identified multiple versions of the gene regulating the production of IGF-1 (insulin-like growth factor 1) in dogs and found that dogs of the same breed consistently share the same version of the gene. In a discussion of the study, a student hypothesizes that small breeds of dogs (for example, Havaneses) must share a version that represses IGF-1 production that would otherwise confer larger body size.

Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the student’s claim?
selections: A. The majority of the most prevalent dog breeds have limited activity in the gene that regulates IGF-1 production.
B. The degree of size variation among dogs is greater than that of any other land-based mammal.
C. Some breeds with small body sizes and low IGF-1 concentrations have a different version of the gene regulating IGF-1 production than do Havaneses.
D. The gene that regulates IGF-1 production is not the only gene that influences body size in dogs but is the only such gene that shows within-breed version consistency.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
遗传学家伊莱恩·奥斯特兰德(Elaine Ostrander)领导了一个国际合作项目，诺伯特·贝内克(Norbert Benecke)和其他研究人员调查了现代狗体型变化的进化史。研究人员在狗身上发现了调节IGF-1(胰岛素样生长因子1)产生的基因的多个版本，并发现同一品种的狗始终具有相同的基因版本。在研究的讨论中，一名学生假设，小型品种的狗(例如，Havaneses)必须共享一个抑制IGF-1产生的版本，否则会导致更大的体型。
中文解析
要weaken文本的最后的结论，small breeds of dogs (for example, Havaneses) must share a version that represses IGF-1 production，于是C选项提到a different version正好可以反驳原文的结论

question:
Asteroid 6478 Gault has experienced intermittent mass loss since at least 2013, but in contrast to some other asteroids with repeated mass-loss episodes, 6478 Gault has not lost mass at its perihelion (the closest point of its orbit to the Sun), and thus the loss is not attributable to solar energy-driven ice vaporization. And as Jane X. Luu et al. point out, the singular nature of impact ejection makes it untenable as an account of multiple loss episodes of similar duration over several years. Instead, Luu et al. are likely correct that 6478 Gault is shedding mass due to rotational instability.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It presents a scientific observation, describes a contrast between that observation and other observations, and then explains why those other observations should not be considered credible.
B. It describes an astronomical finding, discusses competing theories about that finding that the author regards as flawed, and then describes new evidence that supports an alternative theory.
C. It discusses a physical process, evaluates possible causes of that process, and then states that a persuasive account of the process has yet to be put forward.
D. It introduces a natural phenomenon, refutes two potential explanations for that phenomenon, and then presents a third explanation for that phenomenon that the author regards as plausible.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
至少从2013年开始，小行星6478 Gault就经历了间歇性的质量损失，但与其他一些反复发生质量损失的小行星不同，6478 Gault在近日点(其轨道上离太阳最近的点)并没有失去质量，因此这种损失不能归因于太阳能驱动的冰蒸发。正如Jane X. Luu等人所指出的那样，撞击喷射的单一性质使得它不能作为多年来持续时间相似的多次损失事件的解释。相反，Luu等人认为6478 Gault由于旋转不稳定而脱落质量可能是正确的。
中文解析：
solar energy-driven ice vaporization和nature of impact ejection这两个potential explanations都被反驳了，最后一句中rotational instability是plausible的第三个解释。

question:
The following text is from Charles Chesnutt’s 1905 novel The Colonel’s Dream. Mr. French and Mr. Kirby work together.
Mr. French, the senior partner, who sat opposite Kirby, was an older man—a safe guess would have placed him somewhere in the debatable ground between forty and fifty; of a good height, as could be seen even from the seated figure, the upper part of which was held erect with the unconscious ease which one associates with military training.

As used in the text, what does the word “placed” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文字选自查尔斯·切斯纳特1905年的小说《上校的梦》。弗兰奇先生和柯比先生一起工作。
坐在柯比对面的资深合伙人弗兰奇先生年纪比较大——保守地说，他的年龄应该在40到50岁之间;甚至从那坐着的人身上也可以看出，他的上半身是挺直的，不知不觉就像在接受军事训练一样轻松。
中文解析：
基于文本中的guess和后面between forty and fifty，可以看出place表示推测，估计estimate

question:
Scholars cite Pedro Paramo, the 1955 novel by Mexican author Juan Rulfo, as a foundational text of magical realism, the Latin American style of fiction in which antirealistic plot devices—often borrowed from the folkloric traditions of Indigenous and colonial societies in the Americas—are deployed in an otherwise realistic mode of representation typical of the modern novel. This style has exerted a decisive influence on authors around the world, including Orhan Pamuk, whose 2001 novel My Name Is Red resembles classic magical realist novels in its juxtaposition of literary realism with folklore—namely, that of Turkey.

Which quotation from a literary scholar would most directly support the claim in the underlined portion of the text?
selections: A. “The logic of the realistic plot of My Name Is Red is repeatedly and productively disrupted by the presence of imagery and situations drawn from Turkish folklore.”
B. “While My Name Is Red alternates between realistic and antirealistic modes of representation, details suggesting the influence of Turkish folklore nevertheless occur throughout the novel.”

C. “Although Turkish folklore clearly informs the style and occasionally antirealistic plot of My Name Is Red, the novel also shows the inarguable influence of the magical realist tradition of Latin America.”
D. “Like many works in the Latin American magical realist tradition, My Name Is Red is indebted to antirealistic elements in the folkloric tradition of Turkey.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译
学者们引用墨西哥作家胡安·鲁尔福1955年的小说《佩德罗·帕拉莫》作为魔幻现实主义的基础文本。魔幻现实主义是一种拉丁美洲的小说风格，其反现实主义的情节设计——通常借鉴于美洲土著和殖民地社会的民间传说传统——被运用在现代小说典型的现实主义表现模式中。这种风格对世界各地的作家都产生了决定性的影响，包括奥尔罕·帕慕克，他2001年的小说《我的名字叫红》(My Name Is Red)类似于经典的魔幻现实主义小说，将文学现实主义与民间传说——也就是土耳其的民间传说——并置于一起。
中文解析
最后一个句子中resemble classic magical realist，和D选项like many works一致，juxtaposition of realism with folklore 和D选项 is indebted to antirealistic elements in folkloric tradition一致。

question:
●Richard Serra is an American artist.
●He is known for his large metal sculptures.
●His sculpture Gutter Corner Splash: Night Shift is roughly 2 feet wide and 9 feet tall.
●It is made from lead.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize the size of the sculpture?
selections: A. Richard Serra is an American artist known for his large metal sculptures.
B. Richard Serra’s Gutter Corner Splash: Night Shift is made of lead.
C. Gutter Corner Splash: Night Shift—a large metal sculpture by artist Richard Serra—stretches roughly 2 feet wide and 9 feet tall.
D. American artist Richard Serra creates large sculptures from metals such as lead.
explanations: 题目要求emphasize the size of the sculpture，只有C选项的roughly 2 feet wide and 9 feet tall是具体的size

question:
Modernista architects championed nature in their designs. _________ the dramatic archways and botanical glasswork of Palau Mornau, a Modernista private home designed by Manuel Raspall, couldn’t exactly grow in a forest. Still, one sees natural influences in Raspall’s penchant for curves (rather than right angles) and plant-and animal-inspired flourishes.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: Granted表示诚然，的确，第一句表达现代主义建筑师在设计中崇尚自然。第二句表达其建筑设计中其引人注目的拱门和植物玻璃工艺品无法在森林中生长，两句间需要granted进行转折连接。同时，这种转折为接下来still之后的说明提供了一个合理的铺垫。其它选项表达递进，因此或相近是错误的。

question:
Entomologists Yash Sondhi and Samuel Fabian have tried to explain why moths fly erratically around light sources at night. Knowing that flying insects keep their backs pointed toward sunlight during the day, _________

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. the researchers theorize that moths, mistaking nighttime lights for the Sun, continually try to reorient their bodies while flying near such lights.
B. the researchers’ theory is that moths mistake nighttime lights for the Sun, continually trying to reorient their bodies while flying near such lights.
C. moths continually try to reorient their bodies while flying near nighttime lights, the researchers theorize, mistaking such lights for the Sun.
D. moths mistake nighttime lights for the Sun and continually try to reorient their bodies while flying near such lights, the researchers theorize.
explanations: 最后一个句子knowing分词作状语，逻辑上，主句的主语是knowing动作的发出者，四个选项里只有researchers满足，因此选择A。

question:
In a 2005 study by Mellado et al., the researchers determined the ratio of three different plant subtypes within the diet of sheep: graminoids, forbs, and browse. ________ the researchers determined the relative quantities of the plants the animal consumed.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations: "That is," 第二句话，具体引出了对研究者如何确定动物消费的植物相对数量的解释，所以用「也就是说」去引导。

question:
Butterfly is a 1988 painting by the Japanese artist Ay-O. Like many of Ay-O’s paintings, Butterfly, which portrays a swimmer performing the butterfly stroke, attempts to make use of the entire visual light _______ sporting rainbow-striped goggles, the rainbow-hued swimmer splashes through a wavy rainbow of water.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 冒号前是完整的句子，表达这幅画试图用整个可视的光谱去刻画一个正在蝶泳的人。冒号后是具体的解释内容，表达的意思为：戴着彩虹条纹护目镜，这位彩虹色的游泳者在彩虹般的波浪中飞溅。

question:
Albania, Hungary, and the other member nations of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization, or NATO, share a commitment to the principle of collective defense, each NATO member ________ to defend the others if necessary.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 虽然从选项看起来是考察动词的形式，但是本质上这是一个独立主格的考点，逗号不能连接完整的句子，这也是ABC选项错误的原因，我们需要选pledging这个非谓语的形式。最后半句each NATO member pledging to defend the others if necessary,就是一个典型的独立主格现象，附属在一个主句里。

question:
The Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) tracks comparative price list data for its thirty-eight member countries. For instance, in July 2021, a hypothetical basket of goods priced at 100 US dollars (USD) in the United States would have cost 54 USD and 110 USD in fellow OECD ________ and Luxembourg, respectively.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: OECO nations修饰Hungary,不能用符号分开

question:

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 第一句到groups解释用句号收尾。第二句established to...过去分词做状语，动作的发出者后面主句的主语 both the Orden Hijos de América (1921)and the Partido Nacional de La Raza Unida (1970)

question:
In Antarctica, the Syowa East observatory site monitors activity in the upper atmosphere of the southern _________ in Finland, another observatory site, Hankasalmi, monitors the sky of the northern hemisphere. Together, they are part of the Super Dual Auroral Radar Network—or SuperDARN, as space physicists like Mark Lester call it.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 第一句和第二句的谓语都是monitors，完整句子之间需要句号，分号或者，and来衔接，于是选择B，其它选项都是用于句子内部的符号。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Artist Pablo Picasso of Spain won a Carnegie Prize gold medal in 1930.
●The Carnegie Prize is an international art competition.
●It is administered by the Carnegie Museum of Art in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
●Picasso’s winning artwork was a painting entitled Portrait of Mme. Picasso.

The student wants to identify the painting for which Picasso won a Carnegie Prize gold medal. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Picasso won a Carnegie Prize gold medal for the painting Portrait of Mme. Picasso.
B. The Carnegie Museum of Art awarded Picasso a gold medal in 1930.
C. The Carnegie Prize is an international art competition administered by the Carnegie Museum of Art in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
D. In 1930, an artist from Spain won a Carnegie Prize gold medal for a painting.
explanations: 题目要求是painting for which Picasso won a Carnegie Prize gold medal，根据notes里最后一条获奖绘画的名字，于是可以选择A

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Onomatopoeias are words that imitate the sounds they represent.
●Onomatopoeias used to represent the same sound often vary from language to language.
●This variation is due in part to differences in how languages are structured.
●“Ba-dumm” is a German onomatopoeia that represents the sound of a heartbeat.
●“Doki doki” is a Japanese onomatopoeia that represents the sound of a heartbeat.
●The term “onomatopoeia” combines the Greek words for “name” (onoma) and “to make” (poiein).

The student wants to provide a specific example of onomatopoeia. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Differences in how languages are structured can cause variations in the words used in different languages to represent the same sound.
B. The Japanese word “doki doki” both imitates and represents the sound of a heartbeat.
C. The languages of German and Japanese use different words to represent the sound of a heartbeat.
D. The term “onomatopoeia,” which refers to words that imitate the sound they represent, combines the Greek words for “name” and “to make.”
explanations: 题目需要specific example of onomatopoeia(拟声)，于是只有B选项“doki doki”是具体的拟声例子

question:
●Vexillology is the study of flags.
●The flags of many countries include symbols like animals, plants, or landforms.
●These symbols often represent an aspect of the region’s history, culture, or landscape.
●The flag of Papua New Guinea includes a raggiana bird-of-paradise.
●The flag of El Salvador includes a palm branch.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to make and support a generalization about symbols on flags?
selections: A. Papua New Guinea’s flag includes a raggiana bird-of-paradise, a symbol that is important to that country’s national identity.
B. The flags of some countries include symbols of animals; Papua New Guinea’s, for example, includes a raggiana bird-of-paradise.
C. Many countries feature symbols on their flags, and the study of these designs is known as vexillology.
D. Vexillology is the study of flags; accordingly, vexillologists are interested in flags from around the world.
explanations: 题目要求make and support a generalization about symbols on flags, B选项前半句是对于国旗的概括描述，后半句是具体的例子支持。

question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>4</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>6</mn></math>, what is the value of 12x?

question: A chemist combines water and isopropanol to make a mixture with a volume of 52 milliliters (mL). The volume of isopropanol in the mixture is 10 mL. explanations: 根据题意，混合物总体积52，其中isopropanol 占10，所以水体积为52-10=42

question: A company has a customer loyalty program. In January 2018, there were 900 customers enrolled in the loyalty program. explanations: 根据题意，初始值为900，增长率为2%（变化率为1+2%=1.02），故为B

question: The function <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>10</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>000</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow> <mfrac> <mi>t</mi> <mn>330</mn> </mfrac> </mrow> </msup></math> gives the number of bacteria in a population t minutes after an initial observation. explanations: 根据题意，初始值为10000，变化率为2，周期为330min，所以是每330分钟变为原来的得2倍，答案330

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>12</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>36</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>
In the xy-plane, the graph of the given equation is a circle. If this circle is inscribed in a square, what is the perimeter of the square?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>12</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>36</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>整理成圆的标准形式：<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>12</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>36</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>36</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>9</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>36</mn></math>，得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>81</mn></math>，圆心在（3, 6），半径为9，圆内切在一个正方形中，所以正方形的边长就是圆的直径9*2=18，正方形周长即为72

question:
Callie W. Babbitt, Hema Madaka, and colleagues assembled a database of materials used in consumer electronics by studying products in the lab and by gathering data from similar product studies. The team gave each of these studies a rating for level of detail (with a higher rating for reported data with more detail) and for level of traceability (with a higher rating for clearer descriptions of procedures). Based on these ratings, a second research team concluded that the methodology was better explained in a study by Oguchi Masahiro and colleagues than it was in a study by Timothy G. Townsend and colleagues.

Which finding, if true, would most directly challenge the second research team’s conclusion?
selections: A. The study by Oguchi and colleagues had a low detail rating and a low traceability rating.
B. The study by Oguchi and colleagues had a lower detail rating than the study by Townsend and colleagues did.
C. The study by Townsend and colleagues had a low detail rating and a low traceability rating.
D. The study by Oguchi and colleagues had a lower traceability rating than the study by Townsend and colleagues did.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
Callie W. Babbitt, Hema Madaka和同事们通过在实验室研究产品和收集类似产品研究的数据，建立了一个用于消费电子产品的材料数据库。该团队对每一个研究都给出了详细程度(报告的数据越详细，评分越高)和可追溯性水平(对过程的描述越清晰，评分越高)的评分。基于这些评分，第二个研究小组得出结论，Oguchi Masahiro及其同事的研究比Timothy G. Townsend及其同事的研究更能解释这种方法。
中文解析
因为如果Oguchi 及其同事 的研究traceability低于Townsend 及其同事的研究，那么第二个研究团队的结论就会受到挑战。他们认为Oguchi 及其同事的研究在方法学解释方面更好，但实际上如果他们的研究评分较低，这可能意味着其研究可能存在一些问题或不够准确，从而使第二个研究团队的结论不太可靠。methodology主要看procedures，因为主要看traceability

question:
Nella Larsen’s 1928 novel Quicksand is regularly described as autobiographical. That characterization is apt—there are many parallels between the experiences of the novel’s protagonist, Helga Crane, and those of Larsen—but it should not be taken to mean that all the people and events depicted in Quicksand are based on actual people and events. The novel is largely pure invention, and readers who neglect this fact and instead try to identify more and more real-life analogues thus risk _________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. positing unsupportable connections between Quicksand and Larsen’s life.
B. misrepresenting Quicksand as being more widely read than it actually is.
C. minimizing the fact that Larsen drew on real-world material when writing Quicksand.
D. overemphasizing the extent to which Larsen took inspiration from earlier writers.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
内拉·拉森1928年的小说《流沙》通常被描述为自传。这种描述很贴切——小说主人公海尔加·克兰的经历和拉森的经历有很多相似之处——但这并不意味着《流沙》中描绘的所有人和事都是基于真实的人和事。小说很大程度上是纯粹的虚构，如果读者忽视了这一事实，转而试图找出越来越多的现实生活中的相似之处，就会面临风险
中文解析
文本最后 identify more and more real-life analogues，说明我们把流沙和拉森的生活联系在一起也就是选项A. positing unsupportable connections between Quicksand and Larsen’s life.

question:
Many contemporary Indigenous painters practice a specifically Indigenous mode of abstraction; for example, Linda Lomahaftewa often assembles compositions out of motifs common in the ceramics and other traditional arts of the Hopi Tribe. In contrast, the prominent Indigenous practitioners of abstract painting during the mid-twentieth century, such as the Kiowa artist T. C. Cannon, typically aligned their compositional strategies with Abstract Expressionism—a school of painting dominated by European American artists—instead of with traditionally nonrepresentational forms of Indigenous art. Thus, in the case of Cannon’s generation, the identification of an abstract painting as Indigenous art tends to _________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. depend not on stylistic details but instead on an awareness of the artist’s identity.
B. place a greater emphasis on the artist’s biography than on the aesthetic merit of the painting.
C. obscure the Indigenous origins of certain motifs associated with Abstract Expressionism.
D. deny the extent to which cultural identity influences an artist’s work.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
许多当代土著画家都采用一种特别的土著抽象模式:例如，琳达·洛马哈夫特瓦(Linda Lomahaftewa)经常用霍皮部落陶瓷和其他传统艺术中常见的图案组合作品。相比之下，20世纪中期杰出的土著抽象绘画实践者，如基奥瓦艺术家t·c·坎农，典型地将他们的构图策略与抽象表现主义(一种由欧美艺术家主导的绘画流派)结合起来，而不是传统的土著艺术的非代表性形式。因此，在坎农这一代人的情况下，抽象绘画作为本土艺术的认同倾向于_________
中文解析
以下是文章的逻辑：
首先，文章首先指出，当代的土著画家通常使用传统土著艺术中的图案和元素进行创作。
然后，文章对比了二十世纪中期的土著画家（如T. C. Cannon），他们的创作策略与抽象表现主义对齐。
最后，文章指出在Cannon这一代人中，认定一幅抽象画为土著艺术更多依赖于了解艺术家的身份，而不是绘画的风格细节。
具体的逻辑是：
- 当代土著画家的作品可以通过其使用的传统图案进行识别（即通过风格细节）。
- 二十世纪中期的土著画家与抽象表现主义对齐，他们的作品风格与主流的抽象表现主义相似，因此仅凭风格细节很难将其认定为土著艺术。
- 因此，要认定他们的作品为土著艺术，关键在于了解这些艺术家的身份，即他们是土著艺术家。
所以，可以推断出答案A（depend not on stylistic details but instead on an awareness of the artist’s identity）是最符合文章逻辑的选项。

question:
Like all species of baleen whales, the common minke whale feeds on tiny creatures known as krill by filtering water through bristlelike keratin structures called baleen plates. In this way, baleen whales can eat up to 30 percent of their total mass per day. And while no one would call the common minke whale small—it can have a mass as high as 4,000 kg—it is one of the smaller baleen whales and is much smaller than the blue whale, which can weigh a whopping 150,000 kg and consume as much as 45,000 kg of krill per day.

Based on the text, what can most reasonably be concluded about krill consumption among common minke and blue whales?
selections: A. Most baleen whales include krill in their diets, but the common minke whale is less likely than the blue whale to do so.
B. The quantities of krill consumed by blue whales has made it difficult for common minke whales to find sufficient food.
C. The blue whale is able to eat more krill per day than the common minke whale is.
D. Both the common minke whale and the blue whale can eat as much as 45,000 kg of krill per day.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
像所有种类的须鲸一样，普通的小须鲸以被称为磷虾的微小生物为食，通过被称为须鲸板的刚毛状角蛋白结构过滤水。通过这种方式，须鲸每天可以吃掉它们总重量的30%。虽然没有人会说普通的小须鲸小——它的体重可高达4000公斤——但它是较小的须鲸之一，比蓝鲸小得多，蓝鲸的体重可高达15万公斤，每天消耗多达4.5万公斤的磷虾。
中文解析
蓝鲸体重15万公斤，每天能比普通的小须鲸吃更多的磷虾，约4.5万公斤，于是选C。

question:
The following text is from Anne Spencer’s 1922 poem “Translation.”
We trekked into a far country,
My friend and I.
Our deeper content was never spoken.
But each knew all the other said.
He told me how calm his soul was laid
By the lack of anvil and strife. “The wooing kestrel,” I said, “mutes his mating-note
To please the harmony of this sweet silence.”

Which choice best describes the function of the reference to “anvil and strife” in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It emphasizes an opposition between nature and the relationship of the speaker and her friend.
B. It illustrates how the speaker and her friend can feel a close connection even though they do not talk about their feelings.
C. It represents a strong contrast to the speaker’s friend’s current experience of tranquility.
D. It symbolizes the speaker’s friend’s view that meaningful work and social engagement are core components of a fulfilling life.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文字摘自安妮·斯宾塞1922年的诗歌《翻译》。
我们长途跋涉到一个遥远的国家，
我的朋友和我。
我们更深层次的内容从来没有说过。
但每个人都知道对方说的话。
他告诉我他的灵魂是多么的平静
因为没有铁砧和冲突。
“求爱的红隼，”我说，“发出低沉的求偶声
为了取悦这甜蜜的寂静的和谐。”
中文解析
他告诉我他的灵魂是多么的平静, 因为没有铁砧和冲突（anvil and strife）。于是anvil and strife的作用是反差对比前半句当前灵魂的平静。选择C。

question:
The fungus Porillus atrotomentosus, commonly referred to as velvet roll-rim, is known to establish ectomycorrhizal bonds with certain alder tree species; in many cases, such symbiotic relationships, wherein fungal hyphae make contact with the alder’s root system, _________ extensive networks, which can be used to transport nutrients between trees.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 最后一个句子的主语是such symbiotic relationships，需要谓语动词form，其它选项都是非谓语结构。

question:
The Gorno-Altai Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic, whose residents mainly spoke Altai, was one of many nominally autonomous Soviet __________ by giving these restive republics the right to assert their prerogatives, President Mikhail Gorbachev likely hastened the Soviet Union’s breakup.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. republics; established along ethnolinguistic lines
B. republics established along ethnolinguistic lines,
C. republics. Established, along ethnolinguistic lines,
D. republics established along ethnolinguistic lines;
explanations: 首先，分析句子主谓宾，第一句话的主语The Gorno-Altai Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic，谓语为was ；第二句话主语为President Mikhail Gorbachev，谓语为hastened。两个句子需要用分号或者句号链接，排除B。Established along是介词的搭配，不用符号分割，排除C。剩下established修饰是republics。By giving sth修饰的是President Mikhail Gorbachev，所以答案是D。
