It is common for freshwater lakes near or above a latitude of 45 north of the equator, like Opeongo Lake in Canada, to accumulate surface ice in winter. The amount and duration of ice depends on many factors, including local weather conditions as well as the lake’s depth, volume, and surface area, but a climate researcher claims that the higher a lake’s latitude, the more days per winter it will typically have measurable amounts of surface ice.

Which choice best describes data in the table that support the researcher’s claim?
selections: A. Oulujärvi is at a higher latitude than Mirror Lake and typically had fewer days of ice per winter than Mirror Lake did.
B. Oulujärvi had 194 days of ice in the winter of 1980-81 and 155 days of ice in the winter of 2005-06.
C. Oulujärvi is at a higher latitude than Mirror Lake and typically had more days of ice per winter than Mirror Lake did.
D. Lake Neusiedl had 77 days of ice in the winter of 1980-81 and 104 days of ice in the winter of 2005-06.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在赤道以北45度附近或以上的淡水湖，如加拿大的奥彭戈湖(Opeongo Lake)，在冬季表面结冰是很常见的。冰的数量和持续时间取决于许多因素，包括当地的天气条件以及湖泊的深度、体积和表面积，但一位气候研究人员声称，湖泊的纬度越高，每年冬天表面冰的可测量量通常越多。
中文解析
Oulujärvi的纬度64.3比镜湖43.94要高，数据显示每年冬天结冰的天数通常比镜湖多。于是选择C。

question:
Scholars cite One Hundred Years of Solitude, the 1967 novel by Colombian author Gabriel Garcia Marquez, as a foundational text of magical realism, the Latin American style of fiction in which antirealistic plot devices—often borrowed from the spiritual and narrative traditions of Indigenous and colonial societies in the Americas—are deployed in an otherwise realistic mode of representation typical of the modern novel. This style has exerted a decisive influence on authors around the world, including Keri Hulme, whose 1984 novel The Bone People resembles classic magical realist novels in its juxtaposition of literary realism with cultural traditions—namely, those of the Maori, the Indigenous people of New Zealand.

Which quotation from a literary scholar would most directly support the claim in the underlined portion of the text?
selections: A. “While The Bone People alternates between realistic and antirealistic modes of representation, details suggesting the influence of Maori cultural traditions nevertheless occur throughout the novel.”

B. “Although Maori cultural traditions clearly inform the style and occasionally antirealistic plot of The Bone People, the novel also shows the inarguable influence of the magical realist tradition of Latin America.”
C. “The logic of the realistic plot of The Bone People is repeatedly and productively disrupted by the presence of imagery and situations drawn from Maori cultural traditions.”
D. “Like many works in the Latin American magical realist tradition, The Bone People is indebted to antirealistic elements in the cultural traditions of the Maori, the Indigenous people of New
explanations:
题目文本翻译
学者们引用哥伦比亚作家加夫列尔·加西亚·马尔克斯1967年的小说《百年孤独》作为魔幻现实主义的基础文本。魔幻现实主义是一种拉丁美洲的小说风格，其反现实主义的情节设计——通常借鉴于美洲土著和殖民社会的精神和叙事传统——以一种现代小说典型的现实主义表现方式进行部署。这种风格对世界各地的作家都产生了决定性的影响，包括Keri Hulme，她1984年的小说《骨人》(the Bone People)类似于经典的魔幻现实主义小说，它将文学现实主义与文化传统——也就是新西兰土著毛利人的文化传统——并置于一起。
中文解析
D选项基本含义为：像许多拉丁美洲魔幻现实主义传统的作品一样，《骨人》也受到了新西兰土著毛利人文化传统中反现实主义元素的影响。恰恰支持了原文中划线句子。

question:
Although the literary works of David Malo and Lee Cataluna have universal appeal, they are also ________ the Hawaiian literary tradition in which both authors work and that stretches back to the traditional stories of the Kanaka Maoli, the Native Hawaiian people.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
虽然David Malo和Lee Cataluna的文学作品具有普遍的吸引力，但他们也与夏威夷的文学传统密不可分，这两位作者都是在夏威夷的文学传统中工作的，这可以追溯到夏威夷土著居民Kanaka Maoli的传统故事。
中文解析
在这段文本中，A. inextricable不可分割的; B. subverted颠覆; C.presage 预示；D. incongruous不协调的

question:
In her 2017 poem “The Kiss,”Sasha Pimentel contemplates Gustav Klimt’s painting The Kiss, presenting a nuanced imaginative response to Klimt’s piece that goes beyond mere description. ________ rather than simply presenting the painting’s elements in a straightforward way, Pimentel uses the painting’s depiction of a couple embracing as a vehicle for exploring themes of beauty and love.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
萨沙·皮门特尔(Sasha Pimentel)在2017年的诗歌《吻》(The Kiss)中思考了古斯塔夫·克里姆特(Gustav Klimt)的画作《吻》(The Kiss)，对克里姆特的作品进行了细致入微的想象回应，超越了单纯的描述。________皮门特尔不是简单地以直截了当的方式呈现这幅画的元素，而是用这幅画对一对夫妇拥抱的描绘作为探索美与爱主题的工具。
中文解析
第一句话提出了一个概念，即Pimentel的诗超越了简单描述。第二句话换了中方式解释第一句话，所以选择B选项。

question:
The near-Earth asteroid 2007 LE is orbited by the moonlet S/2012(461852). In 2022 scientists studying asteroid deflection intentionally crashed a probe into a similar moonlet, Dimorphos, shortening its orbital period by 32 minutes. _________ it used to take Dimorphos 11 hours, 55 minutes to orbit the near-Earth asteroid Didymos; now it takes 11 hours, 23 minutes.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
近地小行星2007 LE被小卫星S/2012(461852)环绕。2022年，研究小行星偏转的科学家故意将探测器撞向一颗类似的小卫星Dimorphos，将其轨道周期缩短了32分钟。具体来说，Dimorphos过去绕近地小行星Didymos轨道运行需要11小时55分钟;现在需要11小时23分钟。
中文解析
第二句末尾shortening its orbital period by 32 minutes，最后一句中11 hours, 55 minutes缩短为11 hours, 23 minutes，是时间的具体缩短的描述，两句间应该用specifically链接。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
The Carnegie Prize is an international art competition administered by the Carnegie Museum of Art in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
●Painter Augustus John of Wales won a Carnegie Prize gold medal in 1924.
●John’s winning artwork was a painting entitled Madame Suggia. ●Sculptor Richard Serra of the US won a Carnegie Prize gold medal in 1985.
●Serra’s winning artwork was a sculpture entitled Carnegie.

The student wants to contrast the two artworks. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Both Madame Suggia and Carnegie are Carnegie Prize gold medal-winning artworks.
B. Carnegie Prize gold medals have been awarded to both painters and sculptors.
C. John won a Carnegie Prize gold medal in 1924 for the painting Madame Suggia.
D. John’s Madame Suggia is a painting, while Serra’s Carnegie is a sculpture.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个课题时，一个学生做了以下笔记:
卡内基奖是一项国际艺术竞赛，由宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡的卡内基艺术博物馆管理。
画家奥古斯都·约翰于1924年获得卡内基奖金奖。
约翰的获奖作品是一幅名为《苏吉亚夫人》的画作。
1985年，美国雕塑家理查德·塞拉获得卡内基奖金奖。
塞拉的获奖作品是一件名为《卡内基》的雕塑。
这个学生想对比一下这两件艺术品。哪种选择最有效地利用笔记中的相关信息来实现这个目标?
中文解析
题目强调contrast，于是只有D选项满足while前后对比关系

question:
Pennsylvania politician and writer Samuel Bryan strategically adopted the pen name “Centinel” when voicing disapproval of the ratification of the US Constitution in the Philadelphia Independent Gazetteer. Publishing pseudonymously offered a number of advantages, such as shielding a writer from criticism and controversy. __________ by removing a potential source of bias (the writer’s name), it encouraged readers to focus on an essay’s arguments.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
宾夕法尼亚州政治家兼作家塞缪尔·布莱恩在《费城独立报》上发表反对批准美国宪法的文章时，策略性地使用了笔名“Centinel”。以笔名发表文章有很多好处，比如使作家免受批评和争议。__________通过消除潜在的偏见来源(作者的名字)，它鼓励读者关注文章的论点。
中文解析
用笔名的方式带来a number of benefits，一项是shielding a writer from criticism and controversy，另一项好处是 by removing a potential source of bias (the writer’s name), it encouraged readers to focus on an essay’s arguments. 两句之间是属于递进的关系，于是选择moreover。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●The Future of Nostalgia is a book by Svetlana Boym.
●In it, Boym explores the concept of nostalgia from various angles.
●In Chapter 4, “Restorative Nostalgia,” she defines a form of nostalgia interested in re-creating the past.
●In Chapter 5. “Reflective Nostalgia,” she defines a form of nostalgia interested in meditating on past things.

The student wants to emphasize the order in which the topics appear. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In The Future of Nostalgia, Svetlana Boym offers readers a multifaceted exploration of the concept of nostalgia.
B. After defining a form of nostalgia interested in re-creating the past, Svetlana Boym goes on to define a form of nostalgia interested in meditating on past things.
C. Svetlana Boym defines a form of nostalgia interested in re-creating the past in her chapter titled “Restorative Nostalgia.”
D. In the book, Svetlana Boym not only defines a form of nostalgia interested in meditating on past things but also defines a form of nostalgia interested in re-creating the past.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个课题时，一个学生做了以下笔记:
《怀旧的未来》是Svetlana Boym的一本书。
在书中，Boym从多个角度探讨了怀旧的概念。
在第四章“恢复性怀旧”中，她定义了一种对重现过去感兴趣的怀旧。
在第5章。“反思怀旧”，她定义了一种怀旧的形式，对过去的事情感兴趣。
学生想要强调主题出现的顺序。哪种选择最有效地利用笔记中的相关信息来实现这个目标?
中文解析
题目要求emphasize order of topics，于是B选项after..., go on to define ...能够表达topics的顺序

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Most of the plant and bird species in Oahu, Hawaii, are non-native.
●In a 2019 study, researchers wanted to know what role non-native birds play in dispersing plant seeds in Oahu.
●Researchers catalogued plant seeds found in fecal samples from non-native birds.
●Pipturus albidus, a flowering shrub, was one of fifteen native species catalogued.
●Hedychium gardnerianum, an herbaceous vine, was one of twenty-nine non-native species catalogued.
●Researchers concluded that non-native birds play a vital role in dispersing the seeds of native and non-native plants.

The student wants to present findings from the study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In a 2019 study, researchers found seeds from Pipturus albidus and Hedychium gardnerianum in the feces of non-native birds.
B. Most plant species found in Oahu, Hawaii, like Hedychium gardnerianum, are non-native.
C. To determine the role non-native birds play in plant seed dispersal, a 2019 study examined seeds found in bird fecal samples in Oahu, Hawaii.
D. A 2019 study in Oahu, Hawaii, included the plant Pipturus albidus in its exploration of the role non-native birds play in seed dispersal.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个课题时，一个学生做了以下笔记:
夏威夷瓦胡岛的大多数植物和鸟类都是非本地的。
在2019年的一项研究中，研究人员想知道非本地鸟类在瓦胡岛传播植物种子方面发挥了什么作用。
研究人员对在非本地鸟类粪便样本中发现的植物种子进行了分类。
灰比杜斯(Pipturus albidus)是一种开花灌木，是被编目的15种本地物种之一。
加德纳(Hedychium gardnerianum)是一种草本藤本植物，是被编目的29种非本地物种之一。
研究人员得出结论，非本地鸟类在传播本地和非本地植物的种子方面起着至关重要的作用。
学生想要展示研究的发现。哪种选择最有效地利用笔记中的相关信息来实现这个目标?
中文解析
题目要求呈现研究发现present findings from the study，A选项，In a 2019 study, researchers found... 就是研究员的发现。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Georgia Douglas Johnson (1880-1966) was an African American writer.
●Johnson lived and worked in New York City for many years.
●Johnson’s poem “Calling Dreams” was published in 1920.
●Johnson’s poem “Paradox” was published in 1926.

The student wants to indicate the order in which Johnson’s two poems were published. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Born in 1880, Johnson was an African American writer.
B. Johnson’s poem “Calling Dreams” was published in 1920, and “Paradox” followed in 1926.
C. New York City was where Johnson lived and worked for many years.
D. Johnson, an African American writer, wrote the poem “Calling Dreams.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个课题时，一个学生做了以下笔记:
乔治亚·道格拉斯·约翰逊(1880-1966)是非裔美国作家。
约翰逊在纽约市生活和工作多年。
约翰逊的诗《呼唤梦想》发表于1920年。
约翰逊的诗《悖论》发表于1926年。
这个学生想指出约翰逊的两首诗出版的顺序。哪种选择最有效地利用笔记中的相关信息来实现这个目标?
中文解析
题目强调order in which Johnson’s two poems were published,于是B时间分别1920与1926可以满足要求。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Use the Future is a 1992 sculpture by Italian artist Maurizio Nannucci.
●It consists of a yellow neon sign that spells out the title phrase.
●Ginger is a 2023 sculpture by Japanese artist Rikako Kawauchi.
●It consists of a pink neon sign that forms an abstract squiggle shape.
●Neon signs became popular with advertisers in the 1920s and began to decline in popularity in the 1960s.
●Neon signs became popular with artists in the 1960s and continue to be popular today.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two sculptures. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Molded into an evocative phrase in Use the Future (1992), an abstract form in Ginger (2023), and an advertising tool in decades past, neon lighting has a number of different applications.
B. Italian artist Maurizio Nannucci’s and Japanese artist Rikako Kawauchi’s sculptures have employed neon signs in different ways, demonstrating the versatility of the popular material.
C. Nannucci’s sculpture was made in 1992 and Kawauchi’s in 2023, both well after the advertising heyday of neon signs had passed.
D. While the sculptures share a common material, one spells out a phrase while the other is decidedly more abstract.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个课题时，一个学生做了以下笔记:
使用未来是意大利艺术家Maurizio Nannucci在1992年创作的雕塑。
它由一个黄色的霓虹灯组成，上面拼出了标题短语。
姜是日本艺术家河内理子(Rikako Kawauchi)于2024年创作的雕塑。
它由一个粉红色的霓虹灯组成，形成一个抽象的歪歪扭扭的形状。
霓虹灯在20世纪20年代开始受到广告商的欢迎，并在60年代开始衰落。
霓虹灯招牌在20世纪60年代开始受到艺术家们的欢迎，并一直流行到今天。
这位学生想强调两个雕塑之间的区别。哪个选择最重要?
中文解析
题目要求emphasize difference of two sculptures，于是D选项用while来强调one spell out a phrase , one is more abstract.

selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>16</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>3.8</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>231.04</mn></math>

B. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>16</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>3.8</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>231.04</mn></math>

C. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>16</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>3.8</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>231.04</mn></math>

D. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>16</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>t</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>3.8</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>231.04</mn></math>

question:

The given function f models the balance of a bank account, in dollars, x years after it is opened. C. At the end of every 6-month interval, the balance increases by about 0.3% of the balance at the beginning of the 6-month interval.
D. At the end of every 2-year interval, the balance increases by about 0.3% of the balance at the beginning of the 2-year interval.

question: In the xy-plane, line p has a slope of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>5</mn> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac></math> and an x-intercept of (9, 0). What is the y-coordinate of the y-intercept of line p?

question: A right square pyramid has a surface area of 75,264 square inches, which includes a base area of 36,864 square inches. What is the slant height, in inches, of this pyramid?

The amount of the 1st payment that was applied to the principal balance was $220.93. For each additional payment, the amount that was applied to the principal balance was approximately 0.5% greater than the amount that was applied to the principal balance for the previous payment. question:

(1 inch=2.54 centimeters)
explanations: 本题考察的其实是单位换算，将体积单位的cubic inches转换成cubic centimeters，注意是三维立体形状，用立方计算， 514.23 cubic inches<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo>∗</mo> <mfrac> <msup> <mn>2.54</mn> <mn>3</mn> </msup> <msup> <mn>1</mn> <mn>3</mn> </msup> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mn>8426.7</mn></math>，四舍五入取整取8427

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo>−</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>90</mn></math>
One solution to the given equation can be written as <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>s</mi> <mo>+</mo> <msqrt> <mi>t</mi> </msqrt> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac></math>, where s and t are positive integers. What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mi>s</mi> <mi>t</mi> </mfrac></math>?
explanations: 整理二次函数得：<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo>−</mo> <mn>9</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mn>81</mn> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi> </mrow> <mo>−</mo> <mn>90</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>0</mn></math>，化简得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>10</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>0</mn></math>，用求根公式<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mo>−</mo> <mi>b</mi> <mo>±</mo> <msqrt> <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mi>a</mi> <mi>c</mi> </msqrt> </mrow> <mrow> <mn>2</mn> <mi>a</mi> </mrow> </mfrac></math>得到解为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mrow> <mo>−</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo>±</mo> <msqrt> <mn>41</mn> </msqrt> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mi>s</mi> <mo>+</mo> <msqrt> <mi>t</mi> </msqrt> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </mfrac></math>，故s=9，t=41，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mi>s</mi> <mi>t</mi> </mfrac> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mn>9</mn> <mn>41</mn> </mfrac></math>

question: Right rectangular prism X is similar to right rectangular prism Y. The surface area of right rectangular prism X is 52 square centimeters <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <msup> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow></math>, and the surface area of right rectangular prism Y is 3,328 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>. The volume of right rectangular prism X is 10.5 cubic centimeters <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"> <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo> <msup> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi> </mrow> <mn>3</mn> </msup> <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo> </mrow></math>. What is the volume, in <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi> </mrow> <mn>3</mn> </msup></math>, of right rectangular prism Y?
explanations: 相似图形比例问题，面积比例是长度比例平方，体积比例是长度比例的立方，此题面积比是52/3328=1/64，故长度比例1：8，体积比例<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>1</mn> <mo>:</mo> <msup> <mn>8</mn> <mn>3</mn> </msup> <mo>=</mo> <mn>512</mn></math>，故Y体积为10.5*512=5376

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>38</mn> <msup> <mi>z</mi> <mrow> <mn>18</mn> </mrow> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mi>b</mi> <msup> <mi>z</mi> <mn>9</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mn>30</mn></math>
In the given expression, b is a positive integer. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>q</mi> <msup> <mi>z</mi> <mn>9</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mi>r</mi></math> is a factor of the expression, where q and r are positive integers, what is the greatest possible value of b?
explanations: 因式中的q、r，都是整数，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>z</mi> <mn>9</mn> </msup></math>设成x变成标准二次函数形式<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>38</mn> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mi>b</mi> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>30</mn></math>，设两个因式分别是qx+r和px+t，则b=pr+qt，b的最大值一定出现在p、r（或者q、t）取最大值的时候，即p=38，r=30，因式为（38x+1）和（x+30）时，所以b最大值为38*30+1*1=1141

question:
Horizontal gene transfer involves the exchange of genetic material between organisms not in a parent-offspring relationship. It is common among prokaryotes (single-celled organisms such as the bacteria Brevibacillus borstelensis and Massilia timonae). The process can have the effect of increasing bacterial resistance to antibiotics; as such, an understanding of how to prevent horizontal gene transfer might result in the mitigation of dangerous pathogens (organisms that cause disease).

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. A common perception of horizontal gene transfer is inaccurate.
B. Horizontal gene transfer is more common than was initially thought.
C. The results of new research into horizontal gene transfer cast doubt on earlier findings.
D. The study of horizontal gene transfer may yield findings with useful applications.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
水平基因转移涉及生物体之间非亲代关系的遗传物质交换。它在原核生物(单细胞生物，如细菌短芽孢杆菌和马氏杆菌)中很常见。这一过程可能会增加细菌对抗生素的耐药性;因此，了解如何防止水平基因转移可能会减少危险病原体(导致疾病的生物体)。
中文解析
选择D. The study of horizontal gene transfer may yield findings with useful applications，因为文本主要讨论了水平基因转移的概念以及其在细菌抗生素耐药性方面的影响。最后一句提到了防止水平基因转移可能有助于减轻危险病原体的影响，这表明对水平基因转移的研究可能会产生有用的应用。因此，这个选项最好概括了文章的主要内容。

question:
The great blue heron and the small dark heron are long-legged birds that live in wetlands, like the Everglades in Florida. Laura D’Acunto and colleagues wanted to know how these birds choose an area in which to live. They looked at features of the birds’ habitats, such as the geographic location of the area and how deep the water is during the birds’ breeding season. They found that great blue herons prefer areas with deep water during breeding season, but that was not true for small dark herons. The researchers concluded that water management strategies that increase the depth of water in potential wetland bird habitats during breeding season are therefore less likely to ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. attract small dark herons to the area than they are to attract great blue herons to the area.
B. extend the average lifespan of great blue herons already in the area than they are to attract a greater number of those birds to the area.
C. attract birds that don’t typically live in wetlands to the area than they are to attract great blue herons or small dark herons to the area.
D. decrease the area’s appeal to both great blue herons and small dark herons than they are to increase the appeal to both.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
大蓝鹭和小黑鹭是生活在湿地中的长腿鸟类，比如佛罗里达的埃沃格莱兹。劳拉·达昆托和同事想知道这些鸟类是如何选择生活区域的。他们研究了鸟类栖息地的特征，比如地理位置和鸟类繁殖季节水域的深度。他们发现，大蓝鹭在繁殖季节更喜欢水深的地区，但对小黑鹭来说并非如此。研究人员总结认为，在鸟类繁殖季节增加潜在湿地鸟类栖息地水域深度的水管理策略因此不太可能对小黑鹭产生负面影响。
中文解析
选择A， attract birds that don’t typically live in wetlands to the area than they are to attract great blue herons or small dark herons to the area.是因为前文提到研究发现大蓝鹭更喜欢在繁殖季节深水区域生活，而小黑鹭不是。因此，水管理策略增加潜在湿地鸟类栖息地在繁殖季节的水深度，更不太可能吸引小黑鹭到该地区。

question:

For example, none of the countries in the graph had more than 2 women in these positions in 1980, but ________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the example?

B. the increase in the number of women on the high courts from 1980 to 2010 in Peru was greater than that in either the Philippines or Mexico.
C. neither Peru nor the Philippines saw a reduction in the women on their high courts in any of the years shown on the graph, but Mexico did after 1990.
D. Mexico had 2 women on its high courts in 1980 and 3 in 2010.
explanations:

一个监测各国最高法院(如墨西哥最高法院和菲律宾最高法院)中担任法官或地方法官的女性人数的国际组织的一份报告发现，总体趋势是，2010年在高等法院任职的女性人数比1980年多。例如，图表中没有一个国家在1980年有超过两名妇女担任这些职位，但是________

A选项能够和最后一句转折前的描述（图表中没有一个国家在1980年有超过两名妇女担任这些职位）形成对比反差，从而看到2010年的三个国家人数都超出了3人

question:
Manul cats are small, shy felines. They live mostly alone in out-of-the-way parts of Asia, such as on Mount Everest. These cats have been difficult to research because their habitats are so ________ large populations of humans.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
马努尔猫是小型、胆怯的猫科动物。它们主要独自生活在亚洲偏远的地区，比如在珠穆朗玛峰上。由于它们的栖息地通常与人类的大量聚居地相隔甚远，因此对这些猫进行研究一直都很困难。
中文解析
在这个上下文中，最合适的词语是C. distant from。因为句子前面提到Manul猫生活在亚洲偏僻的地方，如珠穆朗玛峰，这些地方远离人口密集的地区，因此使用"distant from"更贴切地描述了它们的栖息地与人类的远离。

question:
Text corpora such as the Corpus of Contemporary American English are enormous collections of electronically stored texts that can be used for empirical testing of hypotheses regarding how ________ a word is in spoken and written English. For instance, one might have a guess about the incidence of the word “day,” but only an analysis of a corpus can prove that “day” is the fifth most commonly used noun.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
文本语料库，比如现代美国英语语料库，是大量电子化存储的文本集合，可用于实证测试关于某个词在英语口语和书面语中使用频率的假设。例如，有人可能对单词“day”的出现频率有猜测，但只有对语料库的分析才能证明“day”是第五个最常用的名词。
中文解析
在这个上下文中，最合适的词语是C. pervasive。因为句子表明文本语料库，如当代美国英语语料库，是巨大的电子存储文本收集，可以用于对关于某个词在口语和书面英语中使用频率的假设进行实证测试。因此，使用"pervasive"更能准确描述文本语料库对英语单词使用频率的全面性和普遍性进行分析和测试的重要性。

question:
Some paleontologists thought that a sudden shift toward an arid climate on the Australian continent may have brought about the rapid extinction of several species of large kangaroos around 200,000 years ago. However, new evidence that the change in conditions occurred well before those species went extinct is forcing paleontologists to ________ that hypothesis.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一些古生物学家认为，大约在20万年前，澳大利亚大陆气候突然向干旱气候转变，可能导致几种大袋鼠物种快速灭绝。然而，新证据表明，这种环境变化发生在这些物种灭绝之前，这迫使古生物学家重新评估那个假说。
中文解析
在这个上下文中，最合适的词语是A. revise。因为句子表明，新的证据表明那些变化发生在那些物种灭绝之前，这迫使古生物学家重新评估之前的假设。因此，使用"revise"更合适，表示对假设进行修订。

question:
The following text is from Mark Twain’s 1876 novel The Adventures of Tom Sawyer. Tom, a child, has been told by his aunt to paint their house’s fence.
Tom appeared on the sidewalk with a bucket of whitewash and a long-handled brush. He surveyed the fence, and all gladness left him and a deep melancholy settled down upon his spirit. Thirty yards of board fence nine feet high.

As used in the text, what does the word “surveyed” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文本摘自马克·吐温（Mark Twain）1876年的小说《汤姆·索亚历险记》（The Adventures of Tom Sawyer）。汤姆，一个孩子，被他的阿姨告知要给家里的篱笆刷白漆。
汤姆出现在人行道上，手持一桶白漆和一把长柄刷子。他审视着篱笆，所有的快乐都离开了他，一种深深的忧郁笼罩着他的心灵。三十码长的九英尺高的板篱笆。
中文解析
在这个上下文中，"surveyed"这个词最接近的意思是C. Looked at。因为在这段文本中，Tom出现在人行道上，拿着一桶白粉和一把长柄刷子，然后他审视着围墙，这表明他在看着围墙，所以"surveyed"在这里的意思是看，观察。

question:
The invention in 1958 of the integrated circuit (or microchip) radically altered the semiconductor industry. In fact, some historians argue that it fundamentally ________ the industry by enabling it to take advantage of mass production methods for the first time.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
1958年集成电路（或微芯片）的发明彻底改变了半导体行业。事实上，一些历史学家认为，通过首次利用大规模生产方法，它从根本上改变了该行业。
中文解析
在这个上下文中，最合适的词语是B. transformed。因为句子前面提到，集成电路的发明在1958年彻底改变了半导体行业，使其首次能够利用大规模生产方法。因此，使用"transformed"更能准确描述这种根本性的变化和影响。

question:
The Age of Innocence is a 1920 novel by Edith Wharton set in the 1870s in the northeastern United States. In the novel, Newland Archer and May Welland have just been married. They are spending a summer with May’s relatives in Newport, Rhode Island. May is puzzled by Newland’s lack of enthusiasm for Newport:_______

Which quotation from The Age of Innocence best illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “The Newport Archery Club always held its August meeting at the Beauforts’.”
B. “[May] represented peace, stability, comradeship, and the steadying sense of an unescapable duty.”
C. “May herself could not understand [Newland’s] obscure reluctance to fall in with so reasonable and pleasant a way of spending the summer.”
D. “[Newland] had the feeling of unexplained excitement with which, on half-holidays at school, he used to start off into the unknown.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译
《纯真时代》是爱迪丝·华顿于1920年创作的小说，背景设定在19世纪70年代的美国东北部。在小说中，纽兰德·阿切尔和梅·韦兰德刚刚结婚。他们正在罗德岛州纽波特与梅的亲戚共度夏季。梅对纽兰德对纽波特缺乏热情感到困惑：
中文解析
选择C. “May herself could not understand [Newland’s] obscure reluctance to fall in with so reasonable and pleasant a way of spending the summer.”，是因为这句话最好说明了May对Newland缺乏对Newport的热情的困惑。May无法理解Newland为什么对于度过夏天的方式如此合理和愉快的事情有隐晦的犹豫。这句话清晰地表达了May对Newland情感的困惑，符合问题中提到的主张。

question:
In 2020, rap artist and professor A.D. Carson published the first peer-reviewed rap album about his experiences with Black masculinity called “i used to love to dream.” Typically in peer review, experts evaluate scholarly articles prior to publication. For Carson’s album, dubbed a “mixtap/e/ssay,” peer review involved both scholars and rap artists. In combining elements of a mixtape album with scholarly essays that connect Carson’s lyrics to historical and contemporary contexts for listeners both inside and outside academia, Carson’s album helped redefine how scholarship is created and shared.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To compare the relative public impact of scholarly articles and albums
B. To describe how each step of the peer review process unfolds
C. To capture one scholar’s opinion of a new rap album
D. To explain why a certain rap album is particularly innovative
explanations:
题目文本翻译
2020年，说唱艺术家兼教授A.D. Carson出版了第一张同行评议的说唱专辑，讲述了他与黑人男子气概的经历，名为《我曾经爱做梦》。在同行评议中，专家通常会在学术文章发表前对其进行评估。卡森的专辑被称为“mixtap/e/ssay”。同行评议包括学者和说唱艺术家。卡森的专辑将混音带专辑的元素与学术论文结合起来，将卡森的歌词与学术界内外的听众的历史和当代背景联系起来，卡森的专辑帮助重新定义了学术是如何创造和分享的。
中文解析
选项D. To explain why a certain rap album is particularly innovative，最能概括文本的主要目的。文本主要讨论了A.D. Carson的专辑"i used to love to dream"如何创新地结合了学术论文和音乐元素，重新定义了学术研究的创作和分享方式。因此，文本的主要目的是解释为什么这张专辑在创新方面非常独特。

question:
Why do ocelots purr but jaguars roar? Researchers hypothesize that this difference between the two feline species may be partly due to a U-shaped bone in their throats. This bone is called the hyoid. Ocelots, which are much smaller than jaguars, have a rigid hyoid that rumbles when the cat’s larynx vibrates, resulting in a purr. By contrast, jaguars have a somewhat flexible hyoid, and the bone is attached to the skull with a stretchy ligament that ocelots lack. These traits allow jaguars and most other species of big cats to roar. The same traits may also prevent most big cats from purring.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. The sentence explains the unique nature of the researchers’ hypothesis.
B. The sentence identifies the location of a bone in felines.
C. The sentence introduces a term that is used in the discussion that follows.
D. The sentence summarizes the debate presented in the text.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
为什么豹猫会咕噜咕噜地叫，而美洲虎会咆哮呢？研究人员假设这两种猫科动物之间的这种差异可能部分原因是它们喉咙里的一个U形骨头。这个骨头叫做舌骨。豹猫比美洲虎要小得多，其舌骨较硬，当猫的喉头震动时会发出隆隆声，从而产生咕噜声。相比之下，美洲虎的舌骨较为柔韧，而且骨头与头骨连接的是一根有弹性的韧带，而豹猫没有这种结构。这些特征使得美洲虎和大多数其他种类的大猫能够发出咆哮声。同样的特征也可能阻止大多数大猫发出咕噜声。
中文解析
在这个上下文中，最合适的选择是C. The sentence introduces a term that is used in the discussion that follows.这句话介绍了一个术语"hyoid"，并解释了这个术语在接下来的讨论中起到的作用。这个术语在后面的内容中起着重要作用，因为它解释了为什么豹猫会咕噜而美洲虎会咆哮的原因。

question:
The following text is adapted from Lady Gregory’s 1904 play Spreading the News. Jack Smith and Bartley Fallon have encountered each other at the local fair.
JACK: It isn’t to the fair I came myself, but up to the Five Acre Meadow I’m going, where I have a contract for the hay. We’ll get a share of it into tramps [drying stacks] to-day.
BARTLEY: You will not get it into tramps to-day. The rain will be down on it by evening, and on myself too. It’s seldom I ever started on a journey but the rain would come down on me before I’d find any place of shelter.
JACK: If it didn’t itself, Bartley, it is my belief you would carry a leaky pail on your head in place of a hat, that way you’d not be without some cause of complaining.

Based on the text, what does Jack most likely believe about Bartley?
selections: A. Bartley will be able to help Jack with cutting the hay.
B. Bartley is concerned that Jack hasn’t prepared for the weather.
C. Bartley is a poor judge of the weather.
D. Bartley will find fault with any situation.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文本改编自Lady Gregory的1904年剧作《传播消息》。杰克·史密斯和巴特利·法伦在当地的集市上相遇。
杰克：我不是来参加集市的，而是去五英亩草地，那里我有一份收割干草的合同。我们今天会把一部分收割到干草堆里。
巴特利：你今天不可能把它收割到干草堆里。到了晚上，雨水会淋到它上面，也会淋到我头上。我很少开始旅程就不会被雨淋湿，还没找到避雨的地方就会淋湿。
杰克：如果不是这样的话，巴特利，我相信你会把一个漏水的桶戴在头上代替帽子，这样你就不会没有抱怨的理由了。
中文解析
从 Jack 的话中可以看出，即使不下雨，Bartley 也会戴上一个漏水的桶来让自己有抱怨的理由。题目问的是Jack的看法，Jack 很可能认为 Bartley 会在任何情况下都找到抱怨的理由。

A telescope allows us to see very faint objects mostly due to the large size of the opening that light passes through, known as the aperture. Like the pupil in the human eye, the larger the diameter of a telescope’s aperture, the fainter the objects we can detect with it. An amateur astronomer claims that she likely could see most, but not all, of the stars in the table while using a telescope with a 160-millimeter (mm) aperture.

Which choice best describes data from the table that support the amateur astronomer’s claim?
selections: A. Only Sk-69° 249 A can be seen from Earth using a telescope with a 60 mm aperture.
B. Only Sk-69° 249 A has a mass below 145 solar masses.
C. Only HSH95-46 requires a telescope with a minimum aperture greater than 160 mm to be visible from Earth.
D. Only VFTS 482 is further than 163,000 light-years from Earth.
explanations:
题目文本翻译：
望远镜能让我们看到非常微弱的物体，主要是因为光线通过的开口很大，也就是光圈。就像人眼的瞳孔一样，望远镜孔径的直径越大，我们能探测到的物体就越模糊。一位业余天文学家声称，当她使用160毫米口径的望远镜时，她可能能看到表中的大部分恒星，但不是全部。
中文解析：
C选项表述只有HSH95-46需要最小孔径大于160毫米的望远镜才能从地球上看到。业余科学家说讲的能看到绝大多数而不是全部。

question:
Named for the number of hoofed toes they possess, even-toed ungulates, such as the domestic goat (Capra aegagrus hircus), ________ to a vast and diverse order of animals.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: even-toed ungulates是复数主语，需要belong作为谓语动词

question:
Within Earth’s biomes, there are four main types of desert: arid, semiarid, coastal, and cold. The roughly ________ is classified as an arid desert.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 2，330，000修饰Arabian Desert不添加符号，主语谓语之间不添加符号，于是答案选择D

question:
Included in We Wanted a Revolution!, a 2018 group exhibition at the Albright-Knox Art Gallery in Buffalo, New York, was the work of multimedia artist Lorna Simpson. The impact of Simpson’s work is ________ the horizons of conceptual photographic art, challenging conventional notions of race, gender, history, and memory, and shedding light on the experience of African American women in contemporary society.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 冒号前面通常是完整的句子，冒号后面expanding..., challenging..., and shedding ...构成并列的解释信息

question:
Today, the Michelin Guide is widely known as the arbiter of fine dining, but when it was created in 1900, it was little more than a marketing gimmick; brothers Andre and Edouard Michelin sought to increase profits for their tire company by encouraging their customers to drive across France, visiting the guide’s recommended hotels and restaurants along the way. Nevertheless, the guide soon grew in scope and ________ its modest French eateries were replaced with some of the most esteemed restaurants from around the world, including Quintessence in Tokyo and Gaon in Seoul.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 逗号+and前后链接完整的句子

question:
Just as the state of Texas has a designated state flower, tree, and bird, it also has a state soil: Houston Black soil. Houston Black is a fitting choice for state soil, in large part because it can be found in abundance across the state. ________ it plays an important role in Texas’s agricultural industry and is used to grow a variety of crops, like cotton and sorghum.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
正如德克萨斯州有指定的州花、树和鸟一样，它也有一种州土壤：休斯顿黑土。休斯顿黑土是州土的合适选择，很大程度上因为它在整个州内广泛分布。它在德克萨斯州的农业产业中扮演着重要角色，被用于种植各种作物，如棉花和高粱。
中文解析
选择A. Additionally, 是因为这个选项能够提供一个逻辑上的过渡，引入一个新的方面或信息，进一步支持Houston Black土壤作为得克萨斯州州土壤的合适性。前文提到Houston Black土壤在得克萨斯州很常见，而后文提到它在得克萨斯州的农业产业中发挥着重要作用。因此，使用Additionally来引出这个额外的信息是合适的。

question:
In their 2022 study of Indo-Pacific bottlenose dolphins (Tursiops aduncus), ________ found that the dolphins’ tendency to rub their heads against corals with antimicrobial properties may confer health benefits.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. German biologist, Gertrud Morlock, and colleagues,
B. German biologist Gertrud Morlock, and colleagues
C. German biologist, Gertrud Morlock, and colleagues
D. German biologist Gertrud Morlock and colleagues
explanations: German biologist身份修饰人物的名字，不用符号隔开，主语和谓语found之间也不用符号分开。

question:
Legislators in Antigua are elected via a first-past-the-post electoral system. In this winner-take-all voting system, the seat is awarded to the candidate who receives not a majority but a plurality (i.e., greatest number) of votes. ________ if several popular candidates are vying for the same seat, it is possible for a candidate to win an election despite receiving less than 50% of the votes.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在安提瓜，立法者是通过一种多数制选举制度当选的。在这种赢者通吃的投票制度中，席位将授予获得最多选票而非多数选票的候选人。因此，如果有几位知名候选人争夺同一席位，有可能一位候选人在选举中获得不到50%的选票却赢得选举。
中文解析
选择C. accordingly, 进一步说明前文提到的第一过门柱式选举制度的情况，前文提到，这种制度中议席会授予获得最多选票而非绝对多数选票的候选人。因此，这是制度所决定的，但如果有几位热门候选人争夺同一席位，仍然可能出现一个候选人赢得选举但获得的选票不到50%的情况。

question:
Generally, sleek vehicles are more aerodynamic than bulkier ones. The streamlined nose of the T-45 Goshawk jet, ________ helps it glide through wind with relative ease, while a boxy pickup truck encounters more wind resistance, making it less aerodynamic.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一般来说，线条流畅的车辆比臃肿的车辆更具有空气动力学特性。T-45 Goshawk喷气式飞机的流线型机头，有助于使其相对轻松地穿越风，而一个笨重的皮卡则会遇到更多的风阻，使其空气动力学性能较差。
中文解析
选择C. for instance, 是因为这个选项提供了一个具体的例子，进一步说明前文关于车辆外形与空气动力学之间的关系。前文提到了一般情况下，修长的车辆比笨重的车辆更具有空气动力学。因此，使用for instance来引出一个具体的例子，即T-45 Goshawk喷气机的流线型机头，有助于说明这个原则。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Asparagus is a vegetable that contains ascorbic acid, an essential nutrient for humans.
●Every 100 grams (g) of asparagus contains 6 milligrams (mg) of ascorbic acid.
●Many animals can make ascorbic acid in their bodies, but humans cannot.
●Humans must get ascorbic acid from foods, including fruits and vegetables.
●Ascorbic acid is also known as vitamin C.

The student wants to provide an example of a vegetable that contains vitamin C. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Humans cannot make ascorbic acid in their bodies, but they can get it from foods, such as vegetables, for example.
B. Many animals can make ascorbic acid, which is also known as vitamin C, in their bodies, but humans cannot.
C. Vitamin C, also known as ascorbic acid, can be found in asparagus as well as other vegetables.
D. Since humans cannot make vitamin C in their bodies, they must get it from food.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记下了以下笔记：
- 芦笋是一种蔬菜，含有抗坏血酸，这是人类的一种必需营养物质。
- 每100克芦笋含有6毫克抗坏血酸。
- 许多动物可以在体内合成抗坏血酸，但人类无法。
- 人类必须从食物中获取抗坏血酸，包括水果和蔬菜。
- 抗坏血酸也被称为维生素C。
中文解析
选项C最有效地使用了笔记中的相关信息来提供一个包含维生素C的蔬菜的例子。该选项提到了维生素C也被称为抗坏血酸，并指出它可以在芦笋以及其他蔬菜中找到。这样的描述直接与学生的目标一致，即提供一个含有维生素C的蔬菜的例子。其他选项虽然提到了维生素C和蔬菜，但没有像选项C那样明确地将维生素C与芦笋以及其他蔬菜联系起来。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Hina Hanta is an online archive curated by the Choctaw Nation of Oklahoma.
●Hina Hanta means “bright path” in Choctaw.
●It features images of cultural artifacts relevant to the history of the Choctaw people.
●It includes a shawl (anchi in Choctaw) made from cloth.
●It includes a fanner basket (ufko) made from cane.

The student wants to specify the shawl’s name in Choctaw. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The cloth shawl, which is included in the Hina Hanta online archive, is called an anchi in Choctaw.
B. Hina Hanta, which means “bright path” in Choctaw, includes a shawl in its archive.
C. The Hina Hanta archive features cultural artifacts, such as a shawl and a fanner basket, that are relevant to the history of the Choctaw people.
D. The name of the online archive Hina Hanta means “bright path” in Choctaw.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记下了以下笔记：
- Hina Hanta是由俄克拉荷马州恰克托民族策划的在线档案。
- Hina Hanta在恰克托语中意为“光明之路”。
- 它展示了与恰克托人历史相关的文化文物的图像。
- 它包括一条用布料制成的披肩（恰克托语中称为“anchi”）。
- 它包括一个用藤条制成的扇篮（恰克托语中称为“ufko”）。
中文解析
选项A最有效地使用了笔记中的相关信息来指定Choctaw语中shawl的名称。

question:
Researchers Tammy Kernodle and Paul Austerlitz have lent their expertise on Black history and music to an important new project: Carnegie Hall’s Timeline of African American Music, a digital resource that, ________ text and music clips, traces the history of specific musical genres (such as funk and swing).

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 从句中that做主语，traces做谓语，不能再出现其它谓语动词，只能选择integrating

question:
●Since 1931, the New York Times (NYT) Best Sellers list has been a measure of the most successful books in the US.
●Kwame Alexander and Diana Ross are Black authors who have reached the NYT Best Sellers list.
●The Crossover is a children’s book by Kwame Alexander.
●It reached the NYT Best Sellers list on August 27, 2017.
●Secrets of a Sparrow is a memoir by Diana Ross.
●It reached the NYT Best Sellers list on November 21, 1993.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize the different years in which the books reached the NYT Best Sellers list?
selections: A. Kwame Alexander and Diana Ross are both NYT best-selling authors.
B. The Crossover and Secrets of a Sparrow are both books by Black authors that have reached the NYT Best Sellers list.
C. Kwame Alexander’s The Crossover and Diana Ross’s Secrets of a Sparrow are both NYT best sellers, but the former is a children’s book, whereas the latter is a memoir.
D. The memoir Secrets of a Sparrow became an NYT best seller in 1993; The Crossover, a children’s book, joined this list as well, but in 2017.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
自1931年以来，《纽约时报》（NYT）畅销书榜一直是衡量美国最成功的书籍的标准。
Kwame Alexander和Diana Ross是两位黑人作者，他们曾进入过《纽约时报》畅销书榜。
《The Crossover》是Kwame Alexander写的一本儿童书。
它于2017年8月27日进入了《纽约时报》畅销书榜。
《Secrets of a Sparrow》是Diana Ross的一部回忆录。
它于1993年11月21日进入了《纽约时报》畅销书榜。
中文解析
选项D最有效地使用了所给句子中的信息来强调这两本书达到纽约时报畅销书榜的不同年份。选项D明确指出了Secrets of a Sparrow在1993年成为畅销书，而The Crossover则在2017年加入了这个榜单。这样的对比突出了这两本书在不同年份取得成功的情况。选项A提到了这两位作者都是纽约时报畅销书榜上的作者，但没有强调不同的年份。选项B提到了这两本书都是黑人作者的作品，但也没有强调不同的年份。选项C提到了这两本书都是纽约时报畅销书榜上的畅销书，但主要强调了它们的类型，而不是强调不同的年份。因此，选项D最有效地使用了给定句子中的信息来突出这两本书达到纽约时报畅销书榜的不同年份。

question:
Evan MacLean and colleagues evaluated behavioral and genetic data from over 14,000 dogs, representing more than 100 breeds, and found that certain similarities in behavior between breeds correspond to genetic similarities between those breeds, suggesting a genetic basis for breed differences in behavior. This was the case for both dog rivalry and energy but was especially pronounced for chasing, which can be seen when a dog pursues small animals like birds or squirrels. A different study found that the French bulldog and the bullmastiff breeds exhibit similar chasing behavior, suggesting that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. their similarities with respect to that behavior could result from a shared aspect of their genetics.
B. individual French bulldogs likely display higher levels of chasing than individual bullmastiffs.
C. French bulldogs and bullmastiffs show a greater tendency toward chasing than most other dog breeds do.
D. the two breeds will likely become less genetically similar over time.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
埃文·麦克林（Evan MacLean）和他的同事从代表100多个品种的超过14,000只狗的行为和遗传数据中进行了评估，发现某些品种之间的行为相似性与这些品种之间的遗传相似性相对应，暗示了品种间行为差异的遗传基础。这适用于狗之间的竞争和活力，但在追逐方面尤为显著，当一只狗追逐小动物如鸟类或松鼠时就可以看到。另一项研究发现，法国斗牛犬和斗牛獒品种表现出相似的追逐行为，这表明________。
中文解析
选择A. "their similarities with respect to that behavior could result from a shared aspect of their genetics."（他们在行为上的相似之处可能源于他们基因中的共同因素。）最合乎逻辑地完成了这段文字。前文提到，一项研究发现法国斗牛犬和斗牛獒这两个品种表现出类似的追逐行为。因此，这两个品种之间的相似性可能源于它们基因中的共同因素。选项A直接联系了这两个品种之间的行为相似性与基因相似性之间的关系，因此最为合适。

question:
Though it does not guarantee a book’s commercial success,______can play a big role in that success—a well-executed marketing campaign helped to make Richard Bachman’s novel The Regulators the fifth-best-selling novel of 1996.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
尽管它不能保证一本书的商业成功，________一个精心制定的营销活动有助于使理查德·巴赫曼的小说《调节者》成为1996年第五畅销小说。
中文解析
在这个句子中，描述了尽管它不能保证一本书的商业成功，但宣传可以在其中发挥重要作用。这个句子提到了理查德·巴赫曼的小说《The Regulators》因为一个成功的营销活动而在1996年成为第五畅销的小说。因此，最合适的选项是"B. publicity"（宣传），因为它可以正确描述在一本书的成功中宣传的重要性。选项A中的"originality"（独创性）、选项C中的"complexity"（复杂性）和选项D中的"practicality"（实用性）都与句子描述的情况不符。因此，选项B是最适合填入句子的选项。

question:
British painter Peter Edwards has a ________ painting portraits of notable figures from a variety of different fields. These characteristic works include his esteemed portraits of writer Maud Sulter and soccer player Bobby Charlton.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
英国画家彼得·爱德华兹擅长________绘制各领域知名人物的肖像。这些特色作品包括他为作家莫德·萨尔特和足球运动员鲍比·查尔顿创作的备受推崇的肖像。
中文解析
在这个句子中，描述了英国画家Peter Edwards擅长画不同领域知名人物的肖像画。根据句子的语境，应该用一个词来描述Peter Edwards在画这些肖像画方面的名声或声誉。因此，最合适的选项是"D. reputation for"（以......而闻名）。这个短语准确地描述了Peter Edwards在画肖像画方面的专长和声誉。选项A中的"complaint about"（抱怨）和选项B中的"question about"（关于问题）都不合适，因为它们与句子描述的内容不符。选项C中的"requirement for"（要求）也不合适，因为它无法准确描述Peter Edwards在画肖像画方面的特长。因此，选项D是最适合填入句子的选项。

question:
Though most hoaxes perpetrated as jokes by mischievous users of Wikipedia, an online encyclopedia that almost anyone can freely edit, have quickly been detected and removed, a few fictitious entries, such as those for the town of Stone Ridge, Maryland, and the 18th-century forestry magnate Guillermo Garcia, persisted on the site for many years before they were finally recognized as ________ and deleted.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
虽然维基百科是一部几乎任何人都可以自由编辑的在线百科全书，大多数由调皮用户为恶作剧而制造的骗局很快被发现并删除，但有几个虚构的条目，比如关于马里兰州斯通里奇镇和18世纪林业巨头吉列尔莫·加西亚的条目，在被最终确认为______并删除之前在网站上存在了很多年。
中文解析
在这个句子中，描述了尽管维基百科是一个几乎任何人都可以自由编辑的在线百科全书，大多数被恶作剧的用户制造的骗局很快就被发现并删除了，但是一些虚构的条目，比如关于马里兰州斯通里奇镇和18世纪林业大亨Guillermo Garcia的条目，在网站上存在了多年之后才最终被认为是虚构的，并被删除。因此，最合适的选项是"B. fabrications"（虚构物），因为它准确描述了这些条目被识别为虚构并被删除。选项A中的"analyses"（分析）、选项C中的"enhancements"（增强）和选项D中的"revelations"（揭示）都不如选项B精确地描述这种情况。因此，选项B是最适合填入句子的选项。

question:
Life Among the Paiutes is an 1882 autobiographical narrative by Sarah Winnemucca Hopkins. In the work, Winnemucca creates suspense by emphasizing her physical response to an event, writing ________

Which quotation from Life Among the Paiutes most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “Oh, how my heart jumped when I heard a noise close by. It was a horse running towards us. We had to lie down close to the ground. It came close to us and stopped. Oh, how my heart beat! I thought whoever it was would hear my heart beat.”
B. “Oh, how happy everybody was! One could hear laughter everywhere, and songs were sung by happy women and children.”

C. “Late in that fall, there came news that my grandfather was on his way home. Then my father took a great many of his men and went to meet his father, and there came back a runner, saying, that all our people must come together.”

D. “That same fall, after my grandfather came home, he told my father to take charge of his people and hold the tribe, as he was going back to California with as many of his people as he could get to go with him.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译
《Life Among the Paiutes》是萨拉·温内马卡·霍普金斯（Sarah Winnemucca Hopkins）于1882年撰写的自传体故事。在这部作品中，温内马卡通过强调她对事件的生理反应来制造悬念，写道：“Life Among the Paiutes”
中文解析
选择A. “Oh, how my heart jumped when I heard a noise close by. It was a horse running towards us. We had to lie down close to the ground. It came close to us and stopped. Oh, how my heart beat! I thought whoever it was would hear my heart beat.”（哦，当我听到附近有声音时，我的心跳得多厉害。有匹马朝我们跑来。我们只能躺在地上。它靠近我们停下来了。哦，我的心跳得多厉害！我以为任何人都会听到我的心跳。）最有效地展示了作者通过强调自己对事件的生理反应来营造悬念的说法。这段引文描述了作者对附近有声音的反应，以及紧张的情境，强调了她的心跳声。这种情感的描写增加了紧张感和悬念，使读者更加投入故事中。因此，选项A最能够有效地展示这个说法。

question:
Archaeologists have discovered a runestone in Norway that may contain the earliest example of written words in Scandinavia. Carbon dating at the discovery site revealed that the stone was likely carved between 1 and 250 CE. Runologist Kristel Zilmer believes the stone will be helpful in learning more about the use of runic alphabets in early Iron Age Scandinavia.

Which choice best states the main topic of the text?
selections: A. A new method for dating rock samples
B. A runestone found in Norway
C. The research interests of Kristel Zilmer
D. Battles of the Iron Age
explanations:
题目文本翻译
考古学家在挪威发现了一块古代石碑，可能包含了斯堪的纳维亚地区最早的文字书写例子。在发现地点进行的碳定年显示，该石碑可能是在公元1至250年之间雕刻的。文字学家克里斯特尔·齐尔默认为，这块石头将有助于更多地了解早期铁器时代斯堪的纳维亚地区符文字母的使用。
中文解析
选择B. A runestone found in Norway（挪威发现的一块符文石），最能够概括文本的主题。文本描述了在挪威发现的一块符文石，提到了一些有关这块石头的信息，包括可能包含斯堪的纳维亚最早的书面文字的内容，以及碳测年显示这块石头可能是在1至250年间刻上的。文中也提到了符文学家Kristel Zilmer认为这块石头将有助于了解早期铁器时代斯堪的纳维亚地区符文字母的用法。因此，选项B最能够概括文本的主题。

question:
President Richard Nixon is most famous for his participation in the 1970s Watergate political scandal, a convoluted tale of criminality and eroded ethics involving a constellation of associates such as Attorney General Richard Kleindienst and Republican Party official Robert Mardian. But Nixon’s legacy is complex: he has been praised for his role in opening relations between the United States and China, and he once made an attempt at reforming United States health care policy that is arguably a precursor to the Affordable Care Act, which became law during the Barack Obama administration.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It compares the achievements of two historical figures.
B. It offers information suggesting that a particular perception of a historical figure is an oversimplification.
C. It provides evidence supporting a claim about a historical figure and that figure’s associates.
D. It explains why a historical figure’s accomplishments are often disregarded by historians.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
理查德·尼克松总统最著名的是他参与了20世纪70年代的水门事件，这是一个关于犯罪和侵蚀的道德故事，包括司法部长理查德·克莱登斯特和共和党官员罗伯特·马迪安。但尼克松的遗产是复杂的：他一直称赞他的角色在开放美国和中国之间的关系，他曾经试图改革美国医疗政策，可以说是平价医疗法案的前身，成为法律在奥巴马政府。
中文解析
在这个文本中，下划线句子“Nixon’s legacy is complex: he has been praised for his role in opening relations between the United States and China, and he once made an attempt at reforming United States health care policy that is arguably a precursor to the Affordable Care Act, which became law during the Barack Obama administration.”揭示了尼克松的遗产是复杂的，他有过一些积极的成就。这句话暗示了尼克松的形象不能简单化，而是一个复杂的历史人物。因此，最能描述下划线句子在整个文本中的功能的选项是B. It offers information suggesting that a particular perception of a historical figure is an oversimplification.（它提供的信息表明对一个历史人物的特定看法是过于简单化的）。选项A，C和D并不准确描述下划线句子的功能。

According to the table, the number (in thousands) is ________

explanations:
题目文本翻译
美国女童子军是一个青年组织，在2021年拥有超过100万名成员。一个学生正在写一篇关于该组织历史的文章，希望确定1995年14至17岁的女童子军成员的人数。根据表格，数字(以千为单位)是________

question:
Text 1
Attempts to automate classification of music into genres have not been very successful. It is also unclear whether categorizing music by genre is useful, since genre categories are ambiguous, subjective, and simplistic. As Jin Ha Lee and Anh Thu Nguyen argue in their study of the South Korean band BTS, relationships between pieces of music may be best understood with concepts other than genre.
Text 2
Forró is a genre of music originally from Brazil that shares some harmonic and rhythmic similarities with the bolero genre. Automated genre classification systems typically struggle to draw distinctions in situations like this, but Yandre Costa and colleagues solved that problem by converting sound to images and having computers compare features of those images. Their approach could improve genre classification, which could have many benefits for users.

Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 1 most likely respond to the claim about the potential benefits of Costa and colleagues’ research in Text 2?
selections: A. By suggesting that future research may provide substantial advancements in the field of automated genre classification
B. By asserting that genre classifications may not be the most helpful way to think about music
C. By arguing that some genres are more easily recognized by classification systems than others
D. By emphasizing that humans do not necessarily enjoy every recording in a genre they claim to prefer
explanations:
题目文本翻译
Text 1
尝试自动对音乐进行流派分类并不是非常成功。而且是否将音乐按流派分类是否有用也不清楚，因为流派分类是模糊的、主观的和简化的。正如Jin Ha Lee和Anh Thu Nguyen在他们对韩国乐队BTS的研究中所提出的观点，音乐之间的关系可能最好通过与流派不同的概念来理解。
Text 2
Forró是一种源自巴西的音乐流派，它与波莱罗流派在和声和节奏上有一些相似之处。自动流派分类系统通常难以在这种情况下区分，但Yandre Costa及其同事通过将声音转换为图像，让计算机比较这些图像的特征来解决了这个问题。他们的方法可以改善流派分类，这对用户有许多好处。
中文解析
在文本1中，作者提到音乐的类型是模糊的，主观的，和简化的，并认为用除了音乐类型之外的概念可能更好地理解音乐之间的关系。因此，作者可能会对文本2中关于Costa和同事研究的潜在好处的主张做出回应，认为音乐类型分类可能不是思考音乐的最有帮助的方式。因此，最可能的回应是B. By asserting that genre classifications may not be the most helpful way to think about music（声称音乐类型分类可能不是思考音乐的最有帮助的方式）。选项A，C和D与文本1的内容不太相符合。

question:
Humans aren’t the only ones who use tools. Other animals also find tools helpful. Octopuses use two halves of a seashell to provide protection or a place to hide. And despite sometimes being thought of as simple, many birds make clever use of tools as well. Striated herons have been observed using breadcrumbs and other lures to attract fish to the water’s surface, making it easier for the herons to catch them.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence?
selections: A. It explains that humans use tools for many different tasks.
B. It argues that octopuses use tools more often than other animals do.
C. It provides one example of tool use in a nonhuman animal.
D. It emphasizes that octopuses are smarter than birds.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
人类并不是唯一使用工具的动物。其他动物也发现工具很有帮助。章鱼使用两半贝壳来提供保护或藏身之处，尽管有时被认为简单，许多鸟类也巧妙地运用工具。已经观察到斑鹭使用面包屑和其他诱饵来吸引鱼到水面，使得斑鹭更容易捕捉它们。
中文解析
在这个句子中，“Striated herons have been observed using breadcrumbs and other lures to attract fish to the water’s surface, making it easier for the herons to catch them.”提供了一个非人类动物使用工具的例子。这个例子展示了纹鹭使用面包屑和其他诱饵来吸引鱼类到水面，以便更容易捕捉它们。因此，最能描述下划线句子功能的选项是C. It provides one example of tool use in a nonhuman animal.（它提供了一个非人类动物使用工具的例子）。选项A，B和D并没有正确描述下划线句子的功能。

question:
The state of Wisconsin has classified the walnut twig beetle as an invasive species that could harm some of the state’s native species. But researchers Alejandro Camacho and Jason McLachlan have pointed out that “invasive” and “native” are labels that describe temporary circumstances. Changes in Earth’s climate may force animals from their current ranges. Climate changes may also create good habitats in areas where a species couldn’t live previously. In the case of Wisconsin, these observations suggest that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the state was previously home to some walnut twig beetles but they were outcompeted by invading species.
B. it’s useful at present for the state to distinguish between invasive and native species in some instances but not in the case of the walnut twig beetle.
C. even if Earth’s climate doesn’t change in the way scientists predict, the walnut twig beetle will likely establish itself in the state.
D. the state’s designation of the walnut twig beetle as invasive may be appropriate now but not in the future.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
威斯康辛州已将核桃枝甲虫分类为一种可能会危害该州某些本土物种的入侵物种。但研究人员亚历杭德罗·卡马乔（Alejandro Camacho）和贾森·麦克拉克兰（Jason McLachlan）指出，“入侵”和“本土”是描述暂时情况的标签。地球气候的变化可能迫使动物离开它们当前的分布范围。气候变化还可能在以前某些物种无法生存的地区创造良好的栖息地。对于威斯康辛州而言，这些观察表明________。
中文解析
前文提到，威斯康星州将核桃树枝甲虫列为可能危害该州某些本土物种的入侵物种。然而，Alejandro Camacho和Jason McLachlan指出，“入侵”和“本土”是描述暂时情况的标签。地球气候的变化可能会迫使动物离开它们目前的分布范围。气候变化也可能会在以前某些物种无法生存的地区创造适宜的栖息地。因此，暗示着之前该州可能曾是核桃树枝甲虫的栖息地，但它们将来的未必是栖息在这里。

question:
Excavating a pachycephalosaur fossil is a ________ process, since it can take weeks or even months of hard, physically tiring work to clear away the dirt and rock covering the specimen.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
挖掘厚头龙化石是一个______的过程，因为需要花费数周甚至数月的艰苦、体力消耗大的工作来清除覆盖在标本上的泥土和岩石。
中文解析
在这个句子中，描述了挖掘一个pachycephalosaur恐龙化石的过程是一个需要大量辛苦、耗时数周甚至数月的过程。根据句子中描述的情况，最合适的词应该是表示困难和耗时的。因此，选项D中的"difficult"（困难）是最合乎逻辑和精确的词语，因为它准确描述了挖掘过程的性质。选项A中的"cheap"（便宜）和选项B中的"rapid"（快速）都不符合句子中描述的情况。选项C中的"common"（普遍的）也不合适，因为它并没有描述挖掘过程的困难性。因此，选项D是最适合填入句子的选项。

question:
A student is writing an essay on the subject of cultured meat, which is grown in a laboratory and is intended to help reduce the number of livestock harvested for food. The student wishes to make the case that people have mixed feelings about cultured meat that may be a barrier to its worldwide adoption.

Which quotation from a publication by a researcher would most effectively support the student’s claim?
selections: A. “Many consumers who were surveyed believed that cultured meat would be good for the environment if widely available, but few of those same consumers were willing to try eating cultured meat themselves.”
B. “Consumers tend to believe that using less packaging when selling meat products in stores would have a significant effect on the environment.”
C. “Advocates of lab-grown meat claim that it’s safer than conventional meat because the means of its production can be tightly controlled.”
D. “The flavor of meat from livestock differs across species (from pig to chicken to cow), and is also influenced by farming conditions and the breeds and genders of animals.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一名学生正在写一篇关于培养肉的论文，这种肉是在实验室中培养的，旨在帮助减少为食物而养殖的牲畜数量。学生希望阐述人们对培养肉持有复杂的看法，这可能成为其在全球范围内推广的障碍。
中文解析
选择A. “Many consumers who were surveyed believed that cultured meat would be good for the environment if widely available, but few of those same consumers were willing to try eating cultured meat themselves.”（许多被调查的消费者认为，如果培育肉普遍可获得，将对环境有益，但同样的这些消费者中很少有人愿意尝试食用培育肉。）最有效地支持学生的论点。这句引文指出了消费者对培育肉的环境潜力持肯定态度，但却不愿意亲自尝试食用，暗示了人们对培育肉存在矛盾的态度。这种矛盾情绪可能成为培育肉全球普及的障碍。因此，选项A最能够有效地支持学生的论点。

question:
А unique dialect, or regional variety, of Spanish is spoken in Puerto Rico. It contains many words borrowed from the language of the Tainos, the Indigenous people of Puerto Rico. African languages also made important contributions to the Puerto Rican dialect. For example, the way certain vowel sounds are pronounced in it can be ________ to how they are pronounced in Yoruba, a West African language.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
波多黎各有一种独特的西班牙语方言或地区变体。它包含许多从波多黎各土著塔伊诺语言借来的词汇。非洲语言也对波多黎各方言做出了重要贡献。例如，在这种方言中发音的某些元音声音可能与西非语言约鲁巴语中的发音方式相似。
中文解析
在这个句子中，描述了波多黎各的一种独特的西班牙语方言，这种方言包含了很多从波多黎各土著民族——泰诺人的语言中借来的词汇。非洲语言也对波多黎各方言做出了重要贡献。句子中提到，波多黎各方言中某些元音的发音方式可以追溯到尤鲁巴语，一种西非语言。因此，最合适的选项是"A. traced"（追溯），因为它准确描述了某些元音发音方式在波多黎各方言和尤鲁巴语之间的联系。选项B中的"announced"（宣布）、选项C中的"offered"（提供）和选项D中的"surrendered"（投降）都与句子描述的情况不符。因此，选项A是最适合填入句子的选项。

question:
Buried collections of Bronze Age metal items (called hoards) have been found all over Britain. For hoards discovered since the 1960s, such as the 1965 discovery of the Walderslade hoard, advancements like inexpensive metal detectors, ground-penetrating radar, and aerial surveys have made it much easier for searchers to locate hoards before putting the first shovel in the ground. Hoards found before the1960s, however, such as the discovery of the Auchnacree hoard around 1921, were not aided by such technologies and thus were much more likely to ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: B. result from artifacts being unearthed accidentally.
C. include rare items from the 10th century BCE.
D. occur before the ground was disturbed.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
自1960年代以来发现的青铜时代金属物品（称为财宝）已在整个英国发现。对于自1960年代以来发现的财宝，例如1965年发现的沃尔德斯莱德财宝，诸如廉价金属探测器、地下雷达和航空测量等先进技术使搜索者在动用第一铲之前更容易地找到财宝。然而，自1960年代之前发现的财宝，比如大约1921年发现的奥克纳克里财宝，没有受到这些技术的帮助，因此更有可能________。
中文解析
选择B. "result from artifacts being unearthed accidentally."（由于偶然被发掘，这些文物通常会形成。）最合乎逻辑地完成了这段文字。前文提到，自1960年代以来发现的藏品，如1965年发现的Walderslade藏品，受益于诸如廉价金属探测器、地下雷达和航空调查等技术的进步，这些技术使得寻宝者在动土前更容易地找到藏品。而在1960年代之前发现的藏品，如大约在1921年发现的Auchnacree藏品，没有受到这些技术的帮助，因此更有可能是偶然被挖掘出来的。因此，选项B最为合适。

question:
From 2009 to 2019, travelers flew out of major urban airports with increasing ________ Washington Dulles International Airport in Washington, DC, saw a 6.9 percent increase in airline passengers, from 11,122,438 total passengers in 2009 to 11,892,778 in 2019.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 完整句子链接需要用句号或者分号，于是A用逗号是错误的，其次for example作为副词词组，表示所在句子和前一句之间的举例关系。

question:

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: spend...doing固定搭配

question:
Textile artist Amber Joy Greenidge-Sabral wanted to avoid using harsh synthetic dyes that could be damaging to the environment. ________ she began experimenting with more environmentally friendly natural dye methods, using organic materials like prairie parsley and weld herb for their natural red and yellow colors.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
纺织艺术家Amber Joy Greenidge-Sabral想要避免使用可能对环境造成损害的刺激性合成染料。________她开始尝试更环保的天然染料方法，使用类似草原荽和菘草这样的有机材料，以获得它们天然的红色和黄色。
中文解析
选项A最合乎逻辑，因为在空白处之前提到了艺术家Amber Joy Greenidge-Sabral想要避免使用对环境有害的合成染料。因此，选项A中的短语"With this in mind,"可以引出她开始尝试更环保的天然染料方法的原因。这种过渡方式使得文本之间的逻辑联系更加清晰和连贯。

question:
Residents of Brasilia, Brazil, rely on its rapid transit system, the Brasilia Metro, for millions of trips each year. ________ city officials strive to maintain the system’s 25 stations to ensure each of these journeys is as smooth as possible.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
巴西利亚（Brasilia）的居民依靠其快速交通系统——巴西利亚地铁（Brasilia Metro）进行数百万次的出行。 ________ 市政官员努力维护该系统的 25 个车站，以确保每次旅程尽可能顺利。
中文解析
选项B最合乎逻辑。在空白处之前提到了Residents of Brasilia依赖Brasilia Metro进行数百万次旅行，说明了Brasilia Metro对当地居民的重要性。因此，在这种情况下，使用词语"Accordingly,"可以引出下文，指出城市官员为保持地铁系统的25个车站而努力，以确保每次旅行尽可能顺利。这种过渡方式使得文本之间的逻辑联系更加清晰和连贯。

question:
In a 2023 study, researchers documented a fascinating behavior in the aquatic plant Elodea densa. When exposed to low levels of light, the plant’s ________ the cellular organs that generate energy from light—reshuffled to form a tightly packed, glass-like surface ideal for collecting more light.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 双破折号内的信息解释前面的名词

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●The international Slow Food movement was founded in 1989 with the signing of the “Slow Food Manifesto.”
●The movement promotes universal access to healthy, high-quality food.
●It calls for sustainable food production practices that protect local environments, ecosystems, and biodiversity.
●It advocates for fair treatment of and compensation for food production workers.
●The Slow Food USA organization was founded in 2000.

The student wants to introduce the Slow Food movement to a new audience. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The international Slow Food movement, founded in 1989, promotes universal access to healthy, high-quality food that is produced sustainably by workers who are treated and compensated fairly.
B. The Slow Food movement advocates for food production workers.
C. The signing of the “Slow Food Manifesto” in 1989 marked the founding of the international Slow Food movement,while the Slow Food USA organization was founded in 2000.
D. Goals of the movement include universal access to healthy, high-quality food and sustainable food practices.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一位学生在研究一个主题时做了以下笔记：
- 国际慢食运动于 1989 年签署《慢食宣言》而成立。
- 该运动倡导人人都能获得健康、高质量的食物。
- 它呼吁可持续的食品生产实践，以保护当地环境、生态系统和生物多样性。
- 它主张对食品生产工人进行公平对待和补偿。
- 慢食美国组织成立于 2000 年。
中文解析
选项A最有效地利用了笔记中的相关信息来介绍Slow Food运动。根据学生的笔记，Slow Food运动成立于1989年，旨在推广人们普遍获得健康、高质量食品，这些食品是由受到公平对待和补偿的工人生产的。选项A中提到了这些关键信息，简洁明了地介绍了Slow Food运动的宗旨和目标，最有效地向新受众介绍了这一运动。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●The poem “7 haiku (for St. Augustine)” is by African American writer Sonia Sanchez.
●It was published in her 2010 poetry book entitled Morning Haiku.
●The poem is written as a sequence of seven haiku.
●According to the book’s publisher, Penguin Random House (PRH), the book “celebrates the gifts of life and mourns the deaths of revered African American figures.”
●According to Sanchez, she chose to write in the form of haiku because it helps “maintain memory and dignity.”

The student wants to describe the format of “7 haiku (for St. Augustine).” Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Sanchez chose the form used in the poem “7 haiku (for St. Augustine)” because it helps “maintain memory and dignity.”
B. The poem “7 haiku (for St. Augustine)” was published in the 2010 book Morning Haiku, which “celebrates the gifts of life and mourns the deaths of revered African American figures.”
C. The poems in Morning Haiku (2010) are each written as a sequence of haiku.
D. The poem “7 haiku (for St. Augustine)” is written as a sequence of seven haiku.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一位学生做了以下笔记：
- 诗歌《7 俳句（为圣奥古斯丁）》是由非裔美国作家索尼娅·桑切斯（Sonia Sanchez）创作的。
- 它发表在她 2010 年的诗集《晨俳句》中。
- 这首诗是由七首俳句组成的序列。
- 根据该书的出版商企鹅兰登书屋（Penguin Random House，PRH）的说法，这本书“赞美了生命的馈赠，并悼念了备受尊敬的非裔美国人物的逝世”。
- 桑切斯称，她选择以俳句形式写作，是因为这有助于“保持记忆和尊严”。
中文解析
D提到了“7 haiku (for St. Augustine)”的格式。是以七首俳句的形式写成的，所以选D。

question:
In May of 1986, the Philippines liberalized its stock market, meaning that it began allowing foreign individuals and businesses to invest money in Filipino companies. This was part of a wave of stock market liberalizations around the world-Malaysia in 1987, Morocco in 1988, and so on. The standard view among economists at the time was that liberalization would make it easier for companies to raise money from investors. Economist Peter Blair Henry examined the economies of 11 countries that were part of the liberalization wave and found that, on average, companies based in those countries received significant increases in investment in the three years following liberalization, suggesting that ________

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. companies in Malaysia experienced a greater increase in investment following liberalization than did companies in the Philippines.
B. economists who held the standard view of liberalization failed to anticipate some serious negative effects of liberalization.
C. companies did not benefit from liberalization until at least three years after liberalization occurred.
D. empirical evidence was consistent with the scholarly consensus about the consequences of liberalization.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
1986年5月，菲律宾放开了其股票市场，意味着允许外国个人和企业向菲律宾公司投资。这是世界范围内股票市场放宽的浪潮的一部分-马来西亚在1987年，摩洛哥在1988年等等。当时经济学家们的标准观点是，放宽限制将使公司更容易从投资者那里筹集资金。经济学家彼得·布莱尔·亨利（Peter Blair Henry）调查了参与放宽浪潮的11个国家的经济状况，发现在放宽限制后的三年内，这些国家的公司平均获得了显著的投资增加，这表明________。
中文解析
选择D是因为文中提到经济学家Peter Blair Henry对参与自由化浪潮的11个国家进行了研究，并发现平均来说，这些国家的公司在自由化后的三年内获得了大幅增加的投资。这说明实证证据与学术界关于自由化后果的共识是一致的。因此，选项D是最合乎逻辑的选择。

Pomo artist Susan Billy creates elaborate baskets. She typically ________ them from willow and sedge.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 句子中主语She，缺失谓语，需要B选项 weaves

question:
The algaita is a double reed wind instrument from West Africa. The reed of a wind instrument is the mouthpiece ________ A double reed contains two pieces of cane that vibrate and produce sound as air passes between them.

explanations: 当问句放置于从句中，需要用陈述句语序且句号结尾。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●The Great Salt Lake is one of the world’s saltiest bodies of water.
●The lake is located in Utah.
●The northern portion of the lake has a higher concentration of salt than the southern portion.
●Crustaceans called Artemia franciscana live in the southern portion.
●Bacteria called Nodularia live in the southern portion.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between Artemia franciscana and Nodularia. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Crustaceans called Artemia franciscana and bacteria called Nodularia both live in the southern portion of the Great Salt Lake.
B. Bacteria called Nodularia live in the Great Salt Lake, which is located in Utah.
C. The Great Salt Lake in Utah is one of the saltiest bodies of water in the world.
D. Artemia franciscana, a type of crustacean, lives in the Great Salt Lake.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一位学生在研究一个主题时做了以下笔记：
- 大盐湖是世界上盐分最高的水体之一。
- 该湖位于犹他州。
- 湖的北部盐分浓度高于南部。
- 名为 Artemia franciscana 的甲壳动物生活在南部。
- 名为 Nodularia 的细菌生活在南部。
中文解析
选项A最有效地强调了Artemia franciscana和Nodularia之间的相似之处。根据学生的笔记，Artemia franciscana和Nodularia都生活在Great Salt Lake的南部。因此，选项A中指出了这一点，强调了这两种生物在同一地区生活的事实。这种表述方式最有效地突出了Artemia franciscana和Nodularia之间的相似之处。

question:
Within a given ecosystem, energy tends to transfer across what ecologists, such as Michelle Evans-White, call trophic levels. ________ primary producers, like plants, at the first trophic level provide energy (i.e., food) for herbivores, like deer, at the second level; those at the second level provide energy for carnivores and omnivores, like coyotes, at the third; and so on, up the food chain.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在一个给定的生态系统中，能量倾向于在生态学家（如Michelle Evans-White）所称的营养级之间转移。________第一营养级的初级生产者，如植物，为第二级的食草动物，如鹿，提供能量（即食物）；第二级的动物为第三级的食肉动物和杂食动物，如郊狼，提供能量；依此类推，一直延伸至食物链的顶端。
中文解析
选项D最合乎逻辑。在空白处之前提到了生态学家Michelle Evans-White称之为营养级的概念，说明了能量在一个生态系统内如何传递。因此，在这种情况下，使用短语"For example,"可以引出具体的例子来说明这种能量传递的过程，即通过说明不同营养级之间的关系来解释概念。这种过渡方式使得文本之间的逻辑联系更加清晰和连贯。

question: A choir of 48 singers has 12 members who sing bass. If one singer from the choir is selected at random, what is the probability of selecting a singer who sings bass?
explanations: 概率问题，一共48个singers，有12个sing bass，概率计算12/48

question: The graph of the function f in the xy-plane, where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, has x-intercepts of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, (3, 0), and (6, 0). Which of the following must be true?

Note: Figure not drawn to scale.
In the figure shown, line r is parallel to line s, and both lines are intersected by line t. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>w</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>24</mn></math>, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>w</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>29</mn></math>, and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>7</mn><mi>w</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi></math>, where a is a constant, what is the value of a?

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn></math>
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>r</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>48</mn></math>
The functions f and g are given. In function g, r is a constant. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>⋅</mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>192</mn></math>, what is the value of r?
explanations: 关注x或<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math>系数即可，举例x系数为x*48+4*(-rx)=(48-4r)x，则48-4r=0，得到r=12

question: A botanist wants to plant certain types of oak trees and pine trees in a 600-foot-long row. Each of these oak trees requires 40 feet of space to grow, and each of these pine trees requires 30 feet of space to grow. The equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>40</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>30</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>600</mn></math> models the possible number of oak trees, x, and pine trees, y, that the botanist can plant. Which graph represents this relationship?
explanations: 40x+30y=600可得两个intercept分别是（15，0）和（0，20），观察选项中intercept即可得到B

question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>2</mn></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi></math>, what is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>3</mn> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mi>g</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>?

question: For a certain isotope, at the end of every 29-year period, the mass of a sample of the isotope has decayed to half its mass at the beginning of the 29-year period. question:
The following text is from Mark Oshiro’s 2018 novel Anger Is a Gift. In the novel, Moss and his friends are on a subway train in Northern California.
Lights from the outside world then filled the train car as it rose out of the ground and climbed the elevated track. As long as Moss had lived in West Oakland, he’d never tired of this specific view, so he pointed toward the windows. “Check it,” he said, and the Port of Oakland began to pass by them.
@2018 by Mark Oshiro

As used in the text, what does the word “specific” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
这段文字摘自马克·奥希罗（Mark Oshiro）2018年的小说《愤怒是一种礼物》（Anger Is a Gift）。在小说中，莫斯（Moss）和他的朋友们在北加州的一辆地铁列车上。
当列车从地下升起，沿着高架轨道爬升时，外部世界的光线填满了车厢。莫斯在西奥克兰（West Oakland）居住的那么长时间里，他从未厌倦过这个特定的景色，所以他指向窗外说道：“看吧。”港口开始从他们身旁掠过。

在这段文本中，"specific" 这个词最接近的含义是 "particular"，表示特定或具体的意思。因此 D 选项（Particular）是正确的选择。

question:
Horizontal gene transfer involves the exchange of genetic material between organisms not in a parent-offspring relationship. It is common among prokaryotes (single-celled organisms, such as the bacteria Enterococcus cecorum and Moraxella caviae). The process can have the effect of increasing bacterial resistance to antibiotics; as such, an understanding of how to prevent horizontal gene transfer might result in the mitigation of dangerous pathogens (organisms that cause disease).

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It suggests that a commonly held belief regarding an organism is mistaken.
B. It summarizes the history of research into a biological phenomenon.
C. It illustrates why one organism may pose more of a threat than another.
D. It explains a practical benefit of researching a particular biological process.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
水平基因转移涉及在非亲代关系的生物体之间交换遗传物质。这种现象在原核生物（单细胞生物，如细菌艺氏肠球菌和卡维氏棘杆菌）中很常见。这一过程可能导致细菌对抗生素的抗性增加；因此，了解如何预防水平基因转移可能会减轻危险病原体（引起疾病的生物体）的影响。
中文解析
选项D 最好描述了下划线句子在整个文本中的功能。下划线句子解释了研究水平基因转移的一个实际好处，即可以有助于减轻危险病原体（引起疾病的生物）的影响。整个段落讨论了水平基因转移的过程以及其对细菌对抗抗生素的能力和疾病传播的影响。因此，下划线句子解释了研究水平基因转移的实际益处。

question:
Although the government of the Soviet Union attempted to ________ Georgi Vladimov’s novel Faithful Ruslan, copies of the book circulated in secret among readers in several parts of the country.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

题目文本翻译
尽管苏联政府试图``禁止``格奥尔基·弗拉迪莫夫（Georgi Vladimov）的小说《忠诚的鲁斯兰》（Faithful Ruslan），但该书的副本在该国的几个地区秘密传阅给读者。
中文解析
在这个句子中，空白处需要一个词来描述苏联政府试图做的事情，使得后面的内容更有逻辑性。在这种情况下，最适合的词是 "suppress"，意思是镇压或压制。因此，C 选项（suppress）是最合乎逻辑和精确的选择，表示苏联政府试图镇压乔治·弗拉迪莫夫的小说《忠实的鲁斯兰》。

question:
The following text is from Anne Spencer’s 1922 poem “Translation.”
We trekked into a far country.
My friend and I.
Our deeper content was never spoken,
But each knew all the other said.
He told me how calm his soul was laid
By the lack of anvil and strife.
“The wooing kestrel,” I said, “mutes his mating-note
To please the harmony of this sweet silence.”

Which choice best describes the function of the reference to the “wooing kestrel” (a type of bird) in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It emphasizes the speaker’s belief that her friend is not sharing his true feelings with her.
B. It suggests that nature has secrets that humans are fundamentally incapable of discovering.
C. It illustrates the assertion that peace is a subjective state rather than an objective one.
D. It presents the natural world as aligning with the experience of the speaker and her friend.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
这段文字摘自安妮·斯宾塞（Anne Spencer）1922年的诗歌《翻译》（Translation）。
我们跋涉到一个遥远的国家。
我和我的朋友。
我们更深层次的内容从未言说，
但每个人都知道对方所说的一切。
他告诉我说，他的灵魂是如何平静的
因为没有砧和斗争。
“求偶的隼鸟，”我说，“消音了他的求爱音符
为了取悦这甜美寂静的和谐。”
中文解析
在这首诗中，"wooing kestrel" 被用来描述一个鸟类，暗示它停止了求偶的歌声，以迎合周围宁静的环境。这个比喻可以解释为，诗中的“我”和“朋友”也在这种宁静中找到了内心的平静。因此，选项 D 提出的观点，即自然界与说话者和她的朋友的体验是一致的，是正确的。这个比喻展示了自然界和人类体验之间的共鸣和联系。

The fog extended its tentacles over city and river, gradually obliterating traces of familiar landscapes. At five-thirty the old Panhandle bridge, supported by massive sandstone pillars, stalwart, as when erected fifty years before to serve a generation now passed behind the portals of life, had become a spectral outline against the sky.
