explanations: 将<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>t</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>、</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>120</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>代入函数得到两个方程，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>a</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mi>b</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>0</mn></math>和<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>1</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mi>b</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>120</mn></math>，第二个式子直接得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>b</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>121</mn></math>

question: The area of a triangle is equal to <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math> square centimeters. The length of the base of the triangle is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>7</mn></math> centimeters, and the height of the triangle is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>3</mn></math> centimeters. What is the value of x?
explanations: 根据题目表述：三角形面积<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>x</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>，长是2x+7，高是x-3，得到面积<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo>=</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> <mo>=</mo> <msup> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>，整理式子得到x-21=0，x=21

explanations: 一次函数应用题，根据题意，165为斜率，注意注意语言表述 $330 for the first day，即为f(1)=330，所以只有D正确

question:
According to a team of neuroeconomists from the University of Zurich, ease of decision making may be linked to communication between two brain regions, the prefrontal cortex and the parietal cortex. Individuals tend to be more decisive if the information ﬂow between the regions is intensiﬁed, whereas they make choices more slowly when information ﬂow is____

Which choice complete the text with the most logical and precise word and phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
根据苏黎世大学的一组神经经济学家的研究，决策的简易可能与两个脑区之间的交流有关，即前额叶皮质和顶叶皮质。当这两个区域之间的信息流增强时，个体往往更有决断力，而当信息流量减少时，他们做出选择更慢。
题目解析
在给定的文本中，描述了决策便利性与两个大脑区域之间的信息流量之间的关联。根据文中的描述，如果这两个大脑区域之间的信息流更加密集（intensified），个体往往会更果断。因此，当信息流减少时，个体会做出选择得更慢。因此，选项 A. reduced（减少）是最合乎逻辑和精确的选择，因为信息流减少会导致决策相对减慢。

question:
Sheep and falcons can see in three dimensions (3D), which helps them perceive distance and depth. Octopuses and squid are thought to lack 3D vision. Many researchers once thought the same about cuttleﬁsh, but Trevor Wardill and his team wanted to test whether this assumption was true. The team studied how cuttleﬁsh wearing 3D glasses reacted to 3D images of shrimp (a favorite prey) projected on a tank wall. Cuttleﬁsh changed their striking position to match the 3D images, suggesting that their vision is more like that of sheep and falcons than that of octopuses or squid.

Which choice best states the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It explains how 3D vision in sheep and falcons differs from the type of 3D vision discussed in the text.
B. It explains why the animals discussed in the text were once thought to lack 3D vision.
C. It offers a suggestion for future research on the aspect of 3D vision discussed in the text.
D. It presents the results of the study of 3D vision discussed in the text.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
羊和猎鹰可以看到三维（3D）图像，这有助于它们感知距离和深度。 据认为章鱼和鱿鱼缺乏3D视觉。 许多研究人员认为墨鱼也是如此，但Trevor Wardill和他的团队想要测试这个假设是否正确。 团队研究了戴着3D眼镜观看在水槽墙上投影的虾（一种喜爱的猎物）的3D图像的墨鱼的反应。 墨鱼改变了它们的攻击位置来匹配3D图像，表明它们的视觉更像羊和猎鹰，而不像章鱼或鱿鱼。
题目解析
在原文中，第四句提到研究人员Trevor Wardill及其团队对墨鱼（cuttlefish）戴着3D眼镜观看3D图像反应的研究。这些墨鱼改变了它们的攻击位置以匹配3D图像，这表明它们的视觉更像羊和猎鹰，而不像章鱼或乌贼。因此，被划线的句子是在提供这项研究的结果，表明墨鱼的视觉可能与其他具有3D视觉的动物类似。所以选项D是最好的选择。

question:
Mexico City has high pedestrian trafﬁc, but simply replicating a feature of Mexico City associated with walkability—e.g., its high block density—may be insufﬁcient to induce increased walking in other cities. As urbanist Mariela Alfonzo argues, our understanding of individuals’ decision-making about whether to walk is insufﬁciently robust: some studies emphasize the role of sidewalk width, others the role of neighborhood attractiveness, and so on, but walking decisions are made in complex contexts in which multiple conditions and needs inform individuals’ choices.

Which choice best describes the function of the references to “sidewalk width” and “neighborhood attractiveness” in the text as a whole?
selections: A. They represent factors that have been identiﬁed as important inﬂuences on walking decisions but that the text suggests are merely some of the many factors that may contribute to people’s decision-making.

B. They illustrate factors that researchers believe people consider when making walking decisions in most contexts but that the text argues are unique to walking decisions made by people in Mexico City.
C. They identify factors that Alfonzo argues have been overemphasized in studies of decision-making about walking but that the text asserts re relevant to most people’s walking decisions.
D. They are examples of factors that studies suggest are important in people’s decision-making about walking but that the text claims most people rarely consider when making walking decisions.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
墨西哥城的行人交通量很高，但简单地复制与墨西哥城的可步行性相关联的特征（例如，其高的街区密度）可能不足以促使其他城市的步行增加。正如城市规划师玛丽拉·阿方索所认为的那样，我们对个体是否选择步行的决策的理解还不够充分：一些研究强调人行道宽度的作用，另一些研究强调社区吸引力的作用，等等，但步行决策是在复杂的背景下做出的，其中多种条件和需求影响个体的选择。
题目解析
在文中，提到了研究关于步行决策的一些因素，如人行道宽度和社区吸引力。然而，文中指出，对于人们是否选择步行的决策，存在许多复杂的因素和需要。因此，尽管人行道宽度和社区吸引力是重要的因素之一，但并不能仅凭这两个因素就能全面解释人们的步行决策。因此，选择A最好描述了这两个因素在整个文中的作用。其他选项都无法完全反映文中的观点和逻辑。

question:
In June of 1986, India liberalized its stock market, meaning that it began allowing foreign individuals and businesses to invest money in Indian companies. This was part of a wave of stock market liberalizations around the world—Malaysia in1987, Pakistan in 1991, and so on. The standard view among economists at the time was that liberalization would make it easier for companies to raise money from investors. Economist Peter Blair Henry examined the economies of 11 countries that were part of the liberalization wave and found that, on average, companies based in those countries received signiﬁcant increases in investment in the three years following liberalization, suggesting that_____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. companies did not benefit from liberalization until at east three years after liberalization occurred.
B. companies in Malaysia experienced a greater increase in investment following liberalization than did companies in India.
C. economists who held the standard view of liberalization failed to anticipate some serious negative effects of liberalization.
D. empirical evidence was consistent with the scholarly consensus about the consequences of liberalization.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在1986年6月，印度放宽了其股市政策，意味着开始允许外国个人和企业在印度公司中投资。这是一场全球股市放宽的浪潮的一部分--马来西亚在1987年，巴基斯坦在1991年等等。当时经济学家们的标准观点是，放宽政策将使公司更容易从投资者那里筹集资金。经济学家彼得·布莱尔·亨利研究了参与放宽浪潮的11个国家的经济，发现平均来看，这些国家的公司在放宽政策后的三年内获得了显著的投资增加，这表明________。
题目解析
在原文中提到，经济学家彼得·布莱尔·亨利研究了参与放宽浪潮的11个国家的经济，发现平均来看，这些国家的公司在放宽政策后的三年内获得了显著的投资增加。因此，选项D实践与自由主义结果一致。

question:
Buried collections of Bronze Age metal items (called hoards) have been found all over Britain. For hoards discovered since the 1960s, such as the 1965 discovery of the Walderslade hoard, advancements like inexpensive metal detectors, ground-penetrating radar, and aerial surveys have made it much easier for searchers to locate hoards before putting the first shovel in the ground. Hoards found before the 1960s, however, such as the discovery of the Auchnacree hoard around 1921, were not aided by such technologies and thus were much more likely to_____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. include rare items from the 10th century BCE.
C. occur before the ground was disturbed.
D. result from artifacts being unearthed accidentally.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
被发现的青铜时代金属物品的藏品（被称为贮藏品）遍布整个英国。对于自1960年代以来发现的贮藏品，例如1965年发现的瓦德斯莱德贮藏品，像廉价的金属探测器、地下雷达和空中勘测等先进技术使搜索者在动用第一铲之前更容易找到贮藏品。然而，在1960年代以前发现的贮藏品，如约1921年发现的奥克纳克里贮藏品，没有受到这些技术的帮助，因此更有可能_____。
题目解析
在原文中，提到了自1960年代以前发现的贮藏品，由于缺乏像金属探测器、地下雷达和空中勘测等现代技术，因此在动用第一铲之前更难找到贮藏品。因此，最合乎逻辑的选项是被偶然发现的

question:
Ecologist Exequiel Ezcurra and colleagues found that the inhabitants of the Mexica empire used natural landmarks to track time with a high degree of_____. By observing the sun’s position in relation to various points on the mountains surrounding the Basin of Mexico, the Mexica were able to precisely identify the dates when signiﬁcant events such as solstices occurred.

Which choice complete the text with the most logical and precise word and phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
生态学家埃克西基尔·埃斯库拉（Exequiel Ezcurra）和他的同事发现，墨西哥帝国的居民利用自然地标来高度精确地追踪时间。通过观察太阳在墨西哥盆地周围山脉的各个点的位置，墨西哥帝国人能够精确地确定诸如至暑至至点等重要事件发生的日期。
题目解析
在这个语境中，文本描述了墨西加帝国的居民如何利用自然地标来追踪时间，通过观察太阳在周围山脉的位置来确定重要事件发生的日期。在这种背景下，他们能够精确地追踪时间，这显示出他们对时间追踪的高度准确性。因此，使用词汇"exactitude"（准确性）更好地强调了这种精确度和准确性。其他选项（如A. precariousness，C. resilience，D. inconspicuousness）在这个上下文中不太适用，因为它们并不强调追踪时间的准确性。

question:
Contribution of Three Key Industries to Oklahoma Economy in 2017
Industries
Approximate Contribution
Tribal economic activity
$7,312,240,000
Construction

The Choctaw Nation, the Citizen Potawatori Nation, and the more than thirty other tribes in Oklahoma operate numerous businesses and collectively generate billions of dollars in revenue. In fact, when the tribes’ activity is regarded as a single industry,  it is a contribution to the Oklahoma economy in 2017.

Which choice uses data from the table to most effectively complete the comparison?
selections: A. exceeded the contribution made by both construction and health care.
B. was greater than the contribution made by health care but equal to that made by construction.
C. was lower than the contribution made by either construction or health care.
D. surpassed the contribution made by construction but fell short of that made by health care.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在俄克拉荷马州，乔克托族、彭托瓦托米族以及其他三十多个部落经营着众多企业，共同创造数十亿美元的收入。事实上，当这些部落的活动被视为一个单一产业时，在2017年对俄克拉荷马州经济的贡献。
题目解析
根据表格中的数据，部落经济活动对俄克拉荷马州经济的贡献为$7,312,240,000，高于建筑业的$6,797,300,000，但低于卫生保健行业的$13,727,300,000。因此，部落经济活动超过了建筑业的贡献，但没有达到卫生保健行业的水平，所以答案是D. surpassed the contribution made by construction but fell short of that made by health care.

question:
The following text is adapted from Willa Cather’s 1912 novel Alexander’s Bridge.
For the next few days Alexander was very busy. He took a desk in the ofﬁce of a [Scottish] engineering ﬁrm on Henrietta Street, and was at work almost constantly. He avoided the clubs and usually dined alone at his hotel.

As used in the text, what does the word “constantly” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文本是根据威拉·凯瑟（Willa Cather）1912年小说《亚历山大桥》改编的。接下来的几天，亚历山大非常忙碌。他在亨利埃塔街的一个[苏格兰]工程公司的办公室里租了一张书桌，几乎是在工作中不停歇。他避开了俱乐部，通常独自在酒店用餐。
题目解析
在上下文中，描述了亚历山大在亨利埃塔街一个苏格兰工程公司的办公室里工作几乎是持续不断的。由于他非常忙碌，所以他几乎总是在工作。因此，“constantly”在这里的意思是持续不断地，不停地工作。所以，与“nonstop”最为接近。

question:
Steepletop in Austerlitz, New York, is the house where Edna St. Vincent Millay lived for twenty-ﬁve years and wrote many of her poems. Now the house is a museum dedicated to Millay’s life and writings. Visitors travel to this museum to feel more connected to an author they admire. To encourage that sense of connection, the museum’s curators recommend nearby hiking trails and outdoor activities. Such activities help visitors appreciate the natural scenery that inspired Millay.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To compare Steepletop with other museums
B. To explain why readers enjoy Millay’s works
D. To describe a museum focused on Millay’s life and works
explanations:
题目文本翻译
Steepletop在纽约奥斯特里茨，是爱德娜·圣文森·米莱居住了二十五年并创作了许多诗歌的房子。现在这座房子是一个致力于米莱生平和著作的博物馆。游客前往这个博物馆是为了感受与他们钦佩的作者更紧密的联系。为了鼓励这种联系感，博物馆的策展人推荐附近的徒步旅行径和户外活动。这些活动有助于游客欣赏启发米莱创作的自然风景。
题目解析
在原文中，文章的主要内容是描述Steepletop在纽约奥斯特里茨的房子，这是Edna St. Vincent Millay居住并创作许多诗歌的地方。现在这座房子已经成为一个致力于Millay生平和作品的博物馆。文章提到游客前往这个博物馆是为了与他们钦佩的作者建立更紧密的联系。为了鼓励这种联系感，博物馆的馆长推荐附近的徒步旅行径和户外活动。这些活动帮助游客欣赏启发Millay的自然风景。因此，文章的主要目的是描述一个专注于Millay生平和作品的博物馆，而不是比较Steepletop与其他博物馆，解释为什么读者喜欢Millay的作品，或总结Millay的传记。因此，选项D.描述一个专注于Millay生平和作品的博物馆是最合逻辑的答案。

question:
Fish whose DNA has been modiﬁed to include genetic material from other species are known as transgenic. Some transgenic ﬁsh have genes from jellyﬁsh that result in ﬂuorescence (that is, they glow in the dark). Although these ﬁsh were initially engineered for research purposes in the 1990s, they were sold as pets in the 2000s and can now he found in the wild in creeks in Brazil. A student in a biology seminar who is writing a paper on these ﬁsh asserts that their escape from Brazilian ﬁsh farms, into the wild may have signiﬁcant negative iong-term ecological effects.

Which quotation from a researcher would best support the student’s assertion?
selections: A. “In one site in the wild where transgenic fish were observed temales outnumbered males, while in another the numbers of females and tales were equivalent.”
B. “Though some presence of transgenic fish in the wild has been recorded, there are insufficient studies of the impact of those fish on the ecosystems into which they are introduced.”
C. “The ecosystems into which transgenic fish are known to have been introduced may represent a subset of the ecosystems into which the fish have actually been introduced.”
D. “Through interbreeding, transgenic fish might introduce the trait to fluorescence into wild fish populations, making those populations more vulnerable to predators.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译
被修改DNA以包括来自其他物种遗传物质的鱼类被称为转基因鱼。一些转基因鱼具有来源于水母的基因，导致它们能够发出荧光（即在黑暗中发光）。尽管这些鱼最初是在1990年代为了研究目的而基因改造的，但它们在2000年代被作为宠物出售，并且现在可以在巴西的溪流中找到。一位在生物学研讨会上写关于这些鱼的论文的学生声称，它们从巴西的养鱼场逃逸到野外可能会对生态产生重要的长期负面影响。
题目解析
这句话最能支持学生的主张，因为它指出了转基因鱼可能通过交配将荧光特性引入到野生鱼群中，从而使这些鱼群更容易受到捕食者的威胁。这表明转基因鱼的逃逸可能会对生态系统产生负面影响，因为引入的新特性可能会改变野生鱼群的动态和生态平衡。

question:
Tanya Tagagsa is a writer and musician and a member of the Inuit community of Cambridge Bay in northern Canada. Critics and fellow writers have praised her work tor combining traditional Inuit stories with popular genres of literature, such as fantasy ﬁction. But Tagaq is not the only indigenous writer to blend traditional stories with popular literature. In the 2016 novel Wrist, Nathan Adier successfully blended the oral storytelling tradition of their people, the Anishinnabe, with horror ﬁction.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Several famous indigenous writers increased their book sales when they began incorporating traditional stories.
B. The success of Tanya Tagaq has influence non-indigenous authors who write in popular literary genre.
C. Non-indigenous authors should consider the experience of indigenous readers.
D. Recent Indigenous fiction writers are mixing traditional stories with popular literary genres.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
Tanya Tagaq是一位作家和音乐家，也是加拿大北部剑桥湾因纽特社区的成员。评论家和其他作家赞扬她的作品，因为她将传统因纽特故事与流行文学体裁（如幻想小说）相结合。但Tagaq并非唯一一位将传统故事与流行文学相结合的土著作家。在2016年的小说《腕部》，Nathan Adier成功地将他们的人民（安尼什纳贝族）的口头讲故事传统与恐怖小说相结合。
题目解析
选择D最好阐述了文本的主要观点，因为文本中明确提到了Tanya Tagaq和Nathan Adier这两位土著作家成功地将传统故事与流行文学体裁相结合。这表明了最近土著小说作家中出现了这种趋势。因此，这个选项最能概括文本中关于土著作家将传统故事与流行文学体裁相结合的主要论点。其他选项提及了一些相关内容，但没有涵盖文本中关于土著作家创作的具体趋势和特点。

One way that young orangutans acquire foraging skills is through a behavior scientists call peering-closely watching older orangutans as they engage in an activity that the young have not yet mastered. Since male orangutans typically leave the area of their birth upon maturity and females do not, Beatrice Ehmann and her colleagues hypothesized that it is more advantageous for immature males than females to devote attention to orangutans who are immigrants to the home region of the immature individual, and this should be reﬂected in sex-speciﬁc differences in peering behavior.

Which choice best describes data from the table that support Ehmann and colleague’s hypothesis?
selections: A. The proportion of peering events directed at immigrants to immature orangutans' home regions ranged from a low of 0.13 to a high of 1.00.

B. Individual 8 directed a higher proportion of peering events at immigrants to its home region than did individual 16, and individual 1 directed a higher proportion of peering events at immigrants to its home region than did individual 2.
C. Individual 16 had the highest total number of peering events observed at 80.
D. Individual 2 and individual 1 directed a lower proportion or peering events at immigrants to their home regions than did individual 8 and individual 16.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一种年幼的猩猩获得觅食技能的方式是通过一种科学家称之为凝视行为，即密切观察年长猩猩从事一种年幼尚未掌握的活动。由于雄性猩猩通常在成熟后离开出生地区，而雌性猩猩则不会，因此Beatrice Ehmann和她的同事假设，对于尚未成熟的雄性猩猩而言，将注意力集中在移民到其家乡地区的猩猩上更有利，这应该在凝视行为中体现出性别特异的差异。
题目解析
假设的内容是male orangutans比female orangutans注意older orangutans会更有利，选项D提到了表格中个体1和2（代表female）比个体8和16（代表male）盯着older orangutans的比例更低，所以支持了hypothesis。

question:
The following text is Emily Dicknison’s circa 1873 poem “There is no Frigate like a Book”. A Frigate like a Book” A Frigate is a light fast ship; courses are swift horses.
There is no Frigate like a Book
To take us Lands away
Nor any Coursers like a Page
Of prancing Poetry—
This Traverse may the poorest take
Withut oppress of Toll—
How frugal is the Chariot
That bears the Human soul.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Reading gives people a reprieve from the financial focus of modern life.
B. Poetry can forge connections between people from different cultures.
C. People can learn more about distant places by reading books than by traveling to those places.
D. Literature can metaphorically transport people to new places regardless of their means.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文本是艾米莉·狄更生（Emily Dickinson）大约于1873年创作的诗歌《没有什么像书一样的军舰》。一艘军舰就像一艘轻快的快船；航程就像骏马快速。
没有什么像书一样的军舰
能把我们带到遥远的土地
也没有什么像一页
腾跃的诗歌-
这种穿越可能是最贫困者也能拥有
而不会受到压迫-
那携带人类灵魂的马车是多么节俭。
题目解析
这个选项最能概括诗歌的主题，诗歌强调书籍，特别是诗歌，有能力将个体带到新的地方和体验，而无需进行实际旅行。诗歌突出了文学丰富人类灵魂的能力，提供了一种逃避和探索的形式。诗中通过比喻的方式强调文学的力量，将人们带到新的地方，无论他们的经济条件如何。其他选项并未完全捕捉到诗歌中强调文学传达新体验和探索的主题。

question:
Uncle Vanya: Scenes From Country Life in Four Acts is an 1898 play by Anton Chekhov, originally written in Russian. In the play, professor Serabrakoff and his wife Helena have come to stay at their country estate, which Vanya manages with the help of Sonta, the professor’s daughter from a previous marriage. Chekhov portrays the professor as being unable to adjust to living at the country estate, as is evident when_____

Which quotation from a translation of Uncle Vanya most effectively illustrate the claim?
selections: A. Professor Serabrakoff says to Helena.“I am used to my library and the Lecture hall and to the esteem and admiration of my colleagues suddenly find myself plunged into this wilderness [the estate], condemned to see the same stupid people from morning till night and listen to their futile conversations.”
B. Professor Serabrakoff says, “I am a book-worn and a scholar, and am unfamiliar with practical affairs. I cannot, I find,dispense with the help of well-informed people.”
C. Vanya says to himself,“Professor Serabrakoff is absolutely unknown, and his Tame has burst like a soap-bubble.”
D. Professor Serabrakoff says to Helena,“Ever since I have been old, I have been hateful to myself,and lam sure, hateful to you all as well.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译
《维亚尼叔叔：四幕乡村生活场景》是安东·契诃夫于1898年创作的一部戏剧，最初用俄语写成。在剧中，教授塞拉布拉科夫和他的妻子海伦娜来到他们的乡村庄园居住，维亚尼管理着这座庄园，得到了教授与前妻的女儿索娜的帮助。契诃夫描绘了教授无法适应在乡村庄园生活的情况，这一点在_____中显而易见。
题目解析
这句话最能有效地描绘教授Serabrakoff对于在乡村庄园生活的不适应，原因如下：
1. 语言生动：这句话使用了形象生动的语言，如"plunged into this wilderness"、"the same stupid people"、"futile conversations"等，清晰地表达了教授对于庄园生活的厌倦和失望。
2. 对比鲜明：这句话对比了教授在城市中的优越感与在乡村庄园中的孤立感，强调了他无法适应新环境的困境。
3. 表达内心感受：教授在对话中表达了自己的内心感受，包括对于庄园生活的厌倦、对于周围人的不满和对过去荣耀的怀念，这有效地展示了他的心理状态。
因此，这句话最能有效地描绘了教授Serabrakoff对于在乡村庄园生活的不适应。

question:
The National Heritage Fellowship was created to honor exceptional folk and traditional artists in the United States. In 2008, the fellowship was given to quilter Bettye Kimbrell. Kimbrell was______to receive it because of the lifetime contribution to the arts.

Which choice complete the text with the most logical and precise word and phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
National Heritage Fellowship 是为了表彰美国杰出的民俗和传统艺术家而创建的。2008年，这个奖项被授予了拼布艺术家Bettye Kimbrell。Kimbrell因为对艺术的终身贡献而______获得这一奖项。
题目解析
答案是 D. chosen，因为在句子中提到，“Kimbrell was chosen to receive it because of the lifetime contribution to the arts.” 这里的意思是“Kimbrell被选中获得这个奖项，因为她对艺术的终身贡献”，所以“chosen”是最符合逻辑和精确的词语。其他选项"A. confused"（困惑）、"B. ineligible"（不合格的）、"C. reluctant"（不情愿的）在这个语境中不太适合。

question:
In a 2022 analysis of 200 terms, researchers found a broad pattern of valence-dependent mutation in which negative adjectives saw a faster rate of cognate replacement—the rate at which a word will be replaced over time with a noncognate form—than other words.  The researchers found that negative adjectives like "homeless" evolve most rapidly;  ________negative nouns evolve most slowly.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在2022年的一项分析中，研究人员将统计模型应用于一组词汇，推断同源替代率-一个词汇随时间被非同源形式替代的速率-在印欧语言中。研究人员发现，像“无家可归”的负面形容词进化得最快，_____而负面名词进化得最慢。
题目解析
这里最合逻辑的过渡词是“同时”，因为它对比了否定形容词的快速演变和否定名词的缓慢演变，表示这两种现象同时发生，但速度不同。

question:
In the 1880s, inventor Lewis Latimer improved upon Thomas Edison’s design for the electric light bulb._____Latimer made the light bulb more durable by placing cardboard around its carbon ﬁlament. With this innovation, Latimer became the first Black inventor to contribute to the electrification of the world.

explanations:

在1880年代，发明家刘易斯·拉蒂默改进了托马斯·爱迪生的电灯泡设计。_____拉蒂默通过在碳丝灯丝周围放置硬纸板，使电灯泡更加耐用。凭借这一创新，拉蒂默成为了第一位对世界电气化做出贡献的黑人发明家。
题目解析
在这个情境中，"Specifically"（具体地说）这个词引导下文具体描述了刘易斯·拉蒂默改进电灯泡设计的方式，即通过在碳丝灯丝周围放置硬纸板。这个词提供了一个明确的转折，引出了具体的信息。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●  Earthquakes start at a point called a "focus" and spread out from there as seismic waves.
●  The two types of seismic waves that travel beneath Earth’s surface are primary waves (P waves) and secondary waves (S waves).
●  P waves travel more quickly beneath Earth’s surface than do S waves.
●  P waves compress and expand the ground, causing it to move backward and forward.
●  S waves cause the ground to move from side to side.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between P waves and S waves. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. P waves and S waves both travel beneath Earth's surface, causing the ground to move.
B. P waves travel away from an earthquake's starting point at a higher rate of speed than do S waves.
C. Spreading out from the focus of an earthquake, P waves move the ground backward and forward.
D. Although P waves and S waves start at the same point, they are very differently.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一个学生记下了以下笔记：
- 地震从一个被称为“震源”的点开始，然后作为地震波向外传播。
- 在地球表面以下传播的两种地震波分别是初级波（P波）和次级波（S波）。
- P波在地球表面以下的传播速度比S波更快。
- P波使地面压缩和扩张，导致地面向前后移动。
- S波使地面从一侧移动到另一侧。
题目解析
选择A是因为它直接强调了P波和S波之间的相似之处，即它们都在地球表面以下传播，导致地面移动。这与学生想要强调的相似之处一致，并且有效地利用了笔记中提到的相关信息。其他选项虽然也包含了笔记中的信息，但没有直接突出P波和S波在地面移动方面的共同点。

question:
● The Music by Black Composers (MBC) project aims to inspire aspiring music students by archiving and sharing information about the music of Black classical composers.
● Logie Wright is a Black classical music composer included in MBC’s Historic Composers Directory,
● He was born in 1927 and died in 2001.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to set up a discussion of Wright’s career for an audience already familiar with the MBC project?
selections: A. Among the many talented figures included in the MBC project is classical music composer Logie Wright.

B. The MBC project's Historic Composers Directory highlights Black classical composers of the past, such as Logie Wright (1927-2001),in order to inspire music students to become the classical composers of the future.
C. While Logie Wright is considered a great composer, there are many more such composers included in the MBC Historic Composers Directory.
D. Born in 1927, Logie Wright passed away in 2001, according to the MBC project.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
○ 黑人作曲家音乐计划（MBC）的目标是通过归档和分享关于黑人古典作曲家音乐的信息，激励有抱负的音乐学生。
○ 洛吉·赖特（Logie Wright）是MBC历史作曲家目录中包括的一位黑人古典音乐作曲家，
○ 他生于1927年，逝于2001年。
题目解析
选项A最有效地利用了给定句子中的信息，为已熟悉MBC项目的受众引入对赖特事业的讨论。选项A直接提到了在MBC项目中包含的众多才华横溢的人物之一是古典音乐作曲家洛吉·赖特，为下文对赖特事业的讨论提供了一个合适的开端。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●  A currency is a money system.
●  Sometimes, countries adopt a new currency to replace an older one.
●  Mozambique adopted the escudo as its official currency in 1914.
●  The medical replaced the escudo in 1980.
●  The medical remains Mozambique’s official currency.

The student wants to specify how long Mozambique officially used the escudo. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Though Mozambique currently uses the medical, the country's former official currency was introduced in 1914.
B. Countries sometimes adopt new currency systems, as Mozambique did when it replaced the escudo with medical.
C. The escudo was Mozambique's official currency from 1914 to 1980.
D. The medical has been Mozambique's official currency since 1980, when it replaced the escudo
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个主题时，一个学生记下了以下笔记：
- 货币是一种货币体系。
- 有时，国家会采用一种新的货币来取代旧的货币。
- 莫桑比克于1914年采用了埃斯库多作为官方货币。
- 医药品在1980年代取代了埃斯库多。
- 医药品仍然是莫桑比克的官方货币。
题目解析
选择C最有效地传达了学生想要指定的信息，即莫桑比克在1914年至1980年间使用了埃斯库多作为官方货币。这个选项直接从笔记中提取了相关信息，清晰地表明了莫桑比克使用埃斯库多的时间范围。其他选项没有提供关于莫桑比克使用埃斯库多的具体时间段的明确信息。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●  Traditionally, manufacturers have dyed denim jeans blue by dipping them in a solution containing indigo powder
●  Indigo doesn’t dissolve in just water, so manufacturers must mix hazardous chemicals with water to dissolve the powder.
●  Textile researcher Smriti Rai discovered a process for dyeing blue jeans without chemicals.
●  Rai added indigo powder to a hydrogel containing nanocellulose and produced a dye that could be spread directly onto the denim.
●  Nanocellulose is a natural plant-based substance that separates the molecules of indigo powder.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two approaches to dyeing blue jeans. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Though created using a different process, Rai’s dye contains the same ingredient as the dye produced by blue jean manufacturers.
B. Nanocellulose is a natural, plant-based substance that separates the molecules of indigo powder, which doesn't dissolve in water.
C. The traditional approach to dyeing blue jeans is to dip them in a solution containing hazardous chemicals.
D. Rai’s approach substitutes a natural, plant-based substance hazardous chemicals that manufacturers have traditionally tested.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在研究一个话题时，一名学生记录了以下笔记：
○ 传统上，制造商通过将牛仔裤浸泡在含靛蓝粉末的溶液中来将其染成蓝色：
○ 靛蓝不会在纯水中溶解，因此制造商必须将危险化学品与水混合以溶解粉末。
○ 纺织研究员斯米蒂·赖（Smriti Rai）发现了一种无需化学品染色蓝色牛仔裤的方法。
○ 赖将靛蓝粉末添加到含有纳米纤维素的水凝胶中，并制造出一种可直接涂抹在牛仔布上的染料。
○ 纳米纤维素是一种天然的基于植物的物质，可以分离靛蓝粉末的分子。
题目解析
选择D的原因是因为它直接比较了赖的方法与传统方法之间的区别，强调了赖的方法用一种天然、植物基物质替代了传统制造商通常使用的危险化学品。这突出了传统方法中化学品的使用与赖创新方法中使用天然替代品之间的对比。这种直接的对照有助于强调两种方法之间的差异，并突出了赖的方法的环保和可持续性优势。

question:
Soil polluted with chromium (a heavy metal) is harmful to many plants and animals, but the plant species Ludwigina prostruta, or creeping water primrose, can thrive in such conditions. _____as a metal hyperaccumulator, Ludwigia prostrata absorbs a large amount of chromium and sequesters it in its roots and shoots, thereby reducing concentrations of this harmful substance in the soil.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
受到铬（一种重金属）污染的土壤对许多植物和动物有害，但植物种类水莲花（Ludwigina prostruta）可以在这种条件下茁壮成长。_____作为金属超富集植物，水莲花吸收大量铬并将其储存在根部和茎中，从而降低土壤中这种有害物质的浓度。
题目解析
前面提到了Ludwigina prostruta可以在受到污染的环境中茁壮成长，后面说它可以降低土壤中有害物质的浓度。两者之间是不仅，而且的递进关系，所以选D。

question:
In 1891, design artist William Morris cofounded the Kelmscott Press, which printed editions of books using preindustrial methods. Historians argue that Morris’s repudiation of industrialization is_____the Kelmscott editions’ use of handmade materials and intricate ornamentation reminiscent of medieval manuscripts: these meticulously handcrafted elements exemplify the artistry involved.

Which choice complete the text with the most logical and precise word and phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
1891年，设计艺术家威廉·莫里斯共同创办了凯尔姆斯科特印刷厂，该印刷厂使用传统手工方法印刷书籍。历史学家认为，莫里斯对工业化的抵制体现在凯尔姆斯科特版本所使用的手工材料和复杂装饰，这些精心手工制作的元素体现了所涉及的艺术性。
题目解析
选择 B. manifest in 是因为在句子中，“Historians argue that Morris’s repudiation of industrialization is reflected in the Kelmscott editions’ use of handmade materials and intricate ornamentation”可以理解为历史学家认为莫里斯对工业化的抵制在凯尔姆斯科特版本中得到了体现。在这个语境中，使用“manifest in”可以准确地表达这种关系，即某种特征或特点在某事物中清晰可见。其他选项不够符合语境或不够精确。

question:
The Austronesian language family includes Banjarese, Hiligaynon, and some 1,200 other languages throughout the Pacific, making it one of the largest language families in the world and of keen interest to_____of Leiden University.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the convention of Standard English?
explanations: linguist 和人物是修饰关系，不用符号分割符号，介词短语不用符号分割。

question:
A number of recording artists_____distinctions between Indigenous music and other musical styles. For example, Choctaw singer—songwriter Samantha Crain—incorporated elements of Choctaw hymns into folk-pop on her single "When We Remain” and Swinomish Ãnpiaq musician Black Belt Eagle Scout combined powwow-style melodies with rock on her album. At the Party with My Brown Friends.

Which choice complete the text with the most logical and precise word and phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一些录音艺术家在原住民音乐与其他音乐风格之间______差异。例如，Choctaw 女歌手兼词曲作者 Samantha Crain 在她的单曲"When We Remain"中融入了 Choctaw 圣歌元素到民谣流行音乐中，而 Swinomish Ãnpiaq 音乐家 Black Belt Eagle Scout 在她的专辑《At the Party with My Brown Friends》中将 powwow 风格的旋律与摇滚结合在一起。

question:
The organizers specifically indicated that the conference was intended to focus on children’s literature, so despite the education specialist’s_____her expertise on the subject in general, she found that she could speak authoritatively about the works of illustrator Ashley Bryan, particularly Beat the Story Drum, Pum-Pum, which she had used effectively in classroom instruction for many years.

Which choice complete the text with the most logical and precise word and phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
主办方明确表示会议旨在专注于儿童文学，因此尽管这位教育专家在一般主题上有专业知识，她发现自己能够权威地谈论插画家阿什利·布莱恩（Ashley Bryan）的作品，特别是《击打故事鼓，布姆-布姆》（Beat the Story Drum, Pum-Pum），她多年来在课堂教学中有效地使用了这本书。
题目解析
Despite表达的内容和“她发现自己能够权威地谈论”意思相反，所以选择hesitancy about。意思是尽管她对专业知识有犹豫的地方，但是她还是能够权威地讨论其作品。

question:
A number of artists associated with hyperpop, a movement in electronic music that emerged in the 2010s, aggressively manipulate their recorded voice. The musician Arca, for example, sometimes shifts the pitch of her vocals to be much higher than that of her natural range. And even the hyperpop artists who don’t rely on pitch-shifting, such as Namasenda, often distort their vocals using digital tools. By persistently modifying the voice, hyperpop invites the listener to reflect on the extent to which digital technology mediates the human experience today.

Which description of vocal manipulation in hyperpop is best supported by the text?
selections: A. It symbolized the power of contemporary music to influence listeners' sense of self.
B. It represents the continuity of human experience despite social and historical change.
C. It serves as an example of digital technology's negative influence on daily life.
D. It functions as a commentary on contemporary social conditions.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一些与电子音乐中的一种运动“超级流行”相关的艺术家大胆地操纵他们录制的声音。例如，音乐家Arca有时会将她的人声音高调整得比她的自然音域要高得多。即使那些不依赖音高转换的超级流行艺术家，比如Namasenda，也经常使用数字工具来扭曲他们的声音。通过持续地修改声音，超级流行邀请听众反思数字技术在今天如何影响人类的体验。
题目解析
文本最后一句话表达了hyperpop起到的社会作用，也就是和D选项是一致的

question:
Some ethicists hold that the moral goodness of an individual’s actions depends solely on whether the actions themselves are good, irrespective of the context in which they are carried out. Philosopher L. Sebastian Purcell has shown that surviving works of Aztec (Nahua) philosophy express a very different view. Purcell reveals that these works posit an ethical system in which an individual’s actions are judged in light of how well they accord with the individual’s role in society and how well they contribute to the community. To the extent that these works are representative of Aztec thought, Purcell’s analysis suggests that_____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the Aztecs would have disputed the idea that the morality of an individual’s actions can be assessed by appealing to standards of behavior that are independent of the individual’s social circumstances.
B. the Aztecs would not have accepted the notion that the morality of an individual’s actions can be fairly evaluated by people who do not live in the same society as that individual.

C. actions by members of Aztec society who contributed a great deal to their community could be judged as morally good even if those actions were inconsistent with behaviors the Aztecs regarded as good in all contexts.
D. similar actions performed by people in different social roles in Aztec society would have been regarded as morally equivalent actions led to different outcomes for the community.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一些伦理学家认为，一个人的行为的道德善良与否仅取决于这些行为本身是否是好的，而无论其所处的背景如何。哲学家L. Sebastian Purcell指出，幸存下来的阿兹特克（纳瓦）哲学作品表达了一种非常不同的观点。Purcell揭示了这些作品提出的一种伦理体系，其中一个人的行为是根据它们与个人在社会中的角色的协调程度以及它们对社区的贡献程度来评判的。在这些作品代表阿兹特克思想的程度上，Purcell的分析表明______。
题目解析
根据文中提到的Philosopher L. Sebastian Purcell揭示的阿兹特克哲学作品的内容，表明阿兹特克的伦理体系是根据个人在社会中的角色和对社区的贡献来评判一个人的行为，而不是基于独立于个人社会情境的行为标准。因此，选项A最符合文中提到的内容和逻辑。

question:
Like all species of baleen whales, the common minke whale feeds on tiny creatures known as krill by filtering water through bristle like keratin structures called baleen plates. In this way, baleen whales can eat up to 30 percent of their total mass per day. And while no one would call the common minke whale small, it—which can have a mass as high as 4,000 kg—is one of the smaller baleen whales and is much smaller than the ﬁn whale, which can weigh a whopping 80,000kg and consume as much as 24,000 kg of krill per day.

Based on the text, what can most reasonably be concluded about krill consumption among common minke and tin whales?
selections: A. Both the common minke whale and the fin whale can eat as much as 24,000-kg of krill per day.
B. The quantities of krill consumed by fin whales has made it difficult for common minke whales to find sufficient food.
C. The fin whale is able to eat more kill per day than the common minke whale is.
D. Most baleen whales include krill in their diets. but the common minke whale is less likely than the fin whale to do so.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
像所有须鲸一样，普通小须鲸以通过将水通过一种称为须板的角蛋白结构过滤的方式捕食称为磷虾的微小生物。这样，须鲸每天可以摄食其总质量的高达30％。尽管没有人会称普通小须鲸为小型动物，它的质量可能高达4000千克，但它是比较小的须鲸之一，比鲸鲨小得多，鲸鲨的重量可能高达惊人的80000千克，并且每天可以摄食高达24000千克的磷虾。
题目解析
根据文本，作者提到fin whale能够消耗高达24,000千克的磷虾，而普通小须鲸则没有提及能够消耗这么多磷虾。因此，可以合理推断，fin whale每天能够摄食更多的磷虾，因此选项C是最合理的结论。

question:
Mahmoud Reza Hemami and colleagues showed that high moonlight intensity inhibits the activity of the Iranian jerboa (Allactaga firouzu) , a result explicable in terms of benefits and costs; greater lunar intensity may not enable the jerboas to increase foraging success enough to offset the higher chance of detection by predatory jackals or owls. Most other nocturnal mammals respond to lunar intensity variations similarly to Iranian jerboas, but Azara’s night monkeys (Aotus azarae) display the opposite pattern, as their heavy reliance on visual foraging results in a different balance of reward and risk.

Which choice best describe the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It introduces an observation of a behavioral pattern, presents an explanation for the pattern, and then describes an exception to the pattern that casts doubt on that explanation.
B. It discusses two different responses to the same natural phenomenon, explains why one of those responses occurs, and then suggests that the other response still needs to be explained.
C. It presents and explains a study result, indicates that the result is similar to the results of many other studies, and then attributes a conflicting study result to a difference in that study.
D. It describes and accounts for a finding, characterizes the finding as representative of a general pattern, and then describes and accounts for an exception to that pattern.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
马哈茂德·雷扎·赫马米和同事表明，高月光强度抑制了伊朗大耳鼠（Allactaga firouzu）的活动，这一结果可通过成本和收益来解释；更高的月光强度可能使大耳鼠无法通过增加觅食成功率来抵消被掠食的豺狼或猫头鹰发现的风险增加。大多数其他夜间哺乳动物对月亮强度变化的反应与伊朗大耳鼠类似，但阿扎拉夜猴（Aotus azarae）显示出相反的模式。由于它们对视觉觅食的重度依赖，这导致了不同的风险和回报平衡。
题目解析
选项D最好描述了文本的整体结构。首先，文本描述了一个发现，即高月光强度抑制了伊朗大耳鼠的活动。然后，文本将这一发现归纳为一种普遍规律，指出大多数其他夜间哺乳动物对月光强度变化的反应与伊朗大耳鼠类似。并对这一发现进行了解释， 对应a result explicable...最后，文本提到了一个例外情况，即阿扎拉夜猴对月光强度的反应与其他哺乳动物相反，这种例外情况被解释为阿扎拉夜猴重视视觉觅食导致的不同风险和回报平衡。因此，选项D最准确地描述了文本的整体结构。

question:
Many studies have found a positive association between levels of dissolved organic carbon and mercury in bodies of fresh water in North America. But Stephane Guedron, Delphine Tisserand, and colleagues did not find this correlation in a study conducted in Laos, leading some scienists to hypothesize that the association is particular to North America. However, several other studies conducted outside North America, such as on by Ida Tjerngren and colleagues in Sweden, showed similar results to the North American studies, while few have produced results similar to those of Guedron, Tieserand, and colleagues’ study, suggesting that_____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. dissolved organic carbon and mercury levels do typically rise and fall together in fresh water.
B. levels of dissolved organic carbon and mercury in bodies of fresh water are both much higher in Laos than elsewhere.
C. there were circumstances unique to Tjerngren and colleagues’ study that impeded accurate measurements of mercury levels.
D. the hypothesis that the positive association is particular to North America is correct.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
许多研究发现，在北美的淡水体中，溶解有机碳水平与汞含量呈正相关。但Stephane Guedron、Delphine Tisserand和他们的同事在老挝进行的一项研究中并没有发现这种相关性，这导致一些科学家推测这种关联性可能特定于北美。但是，一些在北美以外进行的研究，如瑞典Ida Tjerngren及其同事的研究，展示出与北美研究类似的结果，而很少有研究产生了类似于Guedron、Tisserand和同事研究的结果。这表明_______。
题目解析
选项A提供了一个合理的解释，即typically两者相关是典型的现象。

question:
Studies of the Effects of Tilling vs.No Tilling on Crop Yields
Eduardo Martinez and colleagues found that tilling—the practice of turning soil with hoes, plows, or other machines before planting crops—was associated with an increased yield of winter wheat. But some studies of other crops have found the opposite effect, raising the question of whether the increase in yield found by Martinez and colleagues is specific to their study crop. However, this doesn’t seem to be the case:_____

Which choice most effectively use data from the table to complete the text?
selections: A. Igor Bogunovic and colleagues reported an even larger positive effect of tilling on the yield of maize.
B. a study using winter wheat yielded 4,829 kilograms per hectare with tilling and only 2,894 kilograms per hectare without tilling.
C. Fuseini Issaka and colleagues found a similar association in a study using rice.
D. crop yields with tilling have ranged from 1,676 kilograms per hectare for spring barley to 6,400 kilograms per hectare for rice.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
埃迪瓦多·马丁内斯和同事发现，犁地——在种植庄稼之前用锄头、犁或其他机器翻土的做法——与冬小麦产量的增加有关。但一些关于其他作物的研究却发现了相反的效果，这引发了一个问题：马丁内斯和同事发现的产量增加是否只适用于他们研究的作物。然而，事实似乎并非如此：
题目解析
根据表格中提供的数据，rice（Fuseini Issaka and colleagues的研究）和maize（Igor Bogunovic and colleagues的研究）在犁地的时候产量比不犁地的时候高。所以只有他两的数据支持之前的研究结果。C匹配Fuseini Issaka and colleagues的研究。

question:
Text 1
In 2015 Belem. Brazil, was named a City of Gastronomy by UNESCO in recognition of the city’s unique food culture. The honor is well known among both residents of the city and tourists who visit. Simply by selecting Belem. UNESCO has helped bring awareness to local recipes, cooking practices, and chefs and has provided a significant boost to the city’s tourism industry.
Text 2
Many people in Belem’s restaurant industry hoped that food tourism would increase after the city was chosen as a City of Gastronomy in 2015. However, as researcher Eerang Park and colleagues argue, cities must still create effective marketing strategies to benefit fully from being named a City of Gastronomy. Without the intentional effort that was made to promote the city’s food scene, many current and potential visitors to Belem would not even be aware that it’s home to uniquely delicious food.

Which choice best describe the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. The author of Text 1 assumes that a city’s restaurant owners and chefs are most likely to benefit from a city being named a City of Gastronomy, bur the author of Text 2 states that the honor most affects tour guides and tour operators.
B. The author of Text 1 views Belem’s status as a City of Gastronomy as having been beneficial for the city, but the author of Text2 questions whether there’s been a benefit.
C. The author of Text 1 considers the effects of Belem’s City of Gastronomy status to be less permanent than the author of Text 2 considers them to be.
D. The author of Text 1 states that the benefits are automatic, while the author of Text 2 states that effort is required to fully achieve the benefits.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
2015年，巴西贝伦被联合国教科文组织命名为美食之城，以表彰该城独特的美食文化。这一荣誉在该市居民和游客中广为人知。仅仅通过选择贝伦，联合国教科文组织就帮助提高了对当地食谱、烹饪实践和厨师的认识，并为该市的旅游业提供了显著的推动。
许多贝伦餐饮行业的人士希望，2015年该市被选为美食之城后，美食旅游业会增加。然而，正如研究人员朴意郞和同事所指出的，城市仍须制定有效的营销策略才能充分从被命名为美食之城中受益。如果没有刻意推广该市的美食场景，许多目前和潜在的贝伦游客甚至不会意识到这里拥有独特美味的美食。
题目解析
在第一段中，Text 1的作者提到，联合国教科文组织的荣誉为贝伦的美食文化带来了显著的提升，而在第二段中，Text 2的作者则指出，尽管贝伦被选为美食之城，但城市仍需制定有效的营销策略才能充分受益。这表明Text 1的作者认为获得这一荣誉会自动带来好处，而Text 2的作者则认为需要刻意努力才能实现这些好处。因此，选项D最好描述了文本的整体结构。

question:
It is tempting to treat the clustering of information technology firms in Northern California as representative of industrial agglomeration generally, but Guilia Faggio et al. caution against_____this one example: the potential for knowledge spillovers, a dominant driver of collocation in this industry, was largely absent from the plant manufacturing industry.

Which choice complete the text with the most logical and precise word and phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
诱人的是将北加利福尼亚州信息技术公司的集群视为工业集聚的普遍代表，但朱利亚·法吉奥等人警告不要简单地以此例推广：在这个行业中，地理聚集的主要驱动因素——知识溢出的潜力，在工厂制造业中很大程度上是缺乏的。
题目解析
文章中专家警告不要简单地用一个例子去推理出一个过度的概括的道理，D选项的意思是从特定结论推断出普遍结论，所以适合这个语境。

question:
The phrase omo-ropmo bilak is a past-oriented expression used by members of the Yupno, an Indigenous group in Papua New Guinea, that translates to “a couple of years ago.” Rafael Nunez and colleagues recorded Yupno speakers explaining several of these temporal-related words and phrases and coded each speaker’s manual gestures. Previous research has found evidence of Spanish speakers referring to the front/back axis to describe events in time, and many researchers believe that this tendency to make temporal distinctions along imagined linear axes is universal. However, Nunez and colleagues claim that this tendency is not in fact ubiquitous.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support Nufez and colleagues' claim?
selections: A. Yupno speakers typically use their left hand to make temporal gestures regardless of whether the gestures are past oriented or future oriented.
B. When outdoors and referring to the future, Yupno speakers facing uphill gesture in front of themselves, whereas those facing downhill gesture behind themselves.
C. Yupno speakers were observed making temporal gestures both indoors and outdoors, though with greater frequency when indoors.
D. Some Yupno grammatical structures used when talking about also used in Spanish.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
短语omo-ropmo bilak是巴布亚新几内亚Yupno族人使用的一个表达过去时间的词汇，翻译为“几年前”。拉斐尔·努涅斯和同事记录了Yupno族人解释几个这类与时间相关的词汇和短语，并记录了每位讲话者的手势。先前的研究发现，西班牙语讲者使用前后轴来描述时间事件。许多研究人员认为，这种在想象中沿线性轴进行时间区分的倾向是普遍存在的。然而，努涅斯和同事声称这种倾向实际上并不普遍。
题目解析
B选项借助了外在事物uphill or downhill进行时间描述，于是说明原文倾向imagined linear axes不是普遍的

question:
With many elements, like xenon, scientists were able to isolate a relatively pure sample of the substance shortly after discovering its existence but this wasn’t the case with all elements._____the isolation process took years. The element uranium, for instance, was discovered in 1789 but not isolated until 1841.

explanations:

在发现存在后不久，科学家们就能够分离相对纯净的元素样品，比如氙等元素，但并非所有元素都是如此。_____, 分离过程需要几年时间。例如，铀元素在1789年被发现，但直到1841年才被分离。
题目解析
Sometimes对应前面wasn’t the case with all elements

question:
Where_______Interestingly, it was invented by an author. It first appears in the novel The Sands of Mars by English author Arthur C.Clarke.

selections: C. the word “beep” did come from?

question:
In hindsight, given the ideas about the natural world circulating among British scientists in the 1800s, the theory of natural selection was an obvious next step. It may not have been a coincidence,_____that Charles Darwin and Alfred Wallace arrived at the concept independently. Indeed, contrary to the popular myth of the lone genius, theirs is not the first paradigm-shifting theory to have emerged from multiple scholars working in parallel.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
事后看来，考虑到19世纪英国科学家们对自然界的观念，自然选择理论是一个明显的下一步。查尔斯·达尔文和阿尔弗雷德·华莱士独立提出这一概念可能并非巧合。事实上，与孤独天才的流行神话相反，他们的并不是第一个由多位学者并行工作而提出的颠覆性理论。
题目解析
前因后果和时间先后的关系用then

question:
When_____debuted in April 1983 as part of the exhibit Children’s Art: Identity: New Work from Youth Education Program, the artworks brought vibrant visual texture to the bustling terminals of San Francisco International Airport.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the convention of Standard English?
explanations: they指代后面主语the artworks

question:
A band might choose a name that is as unique and original as possible._____they might name themselves after a recognizable song by a favorite band. This is what the Swedish pop rock band Roxette did when they named themselves after the song “Roxette” by Dr. Feelgood.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一个乐队可能会选择一个尽可能独特和原创的名字。_____ 他们可能会以最喜爱乐队的一首知名歌曲命名自己。这正是瑞典流行摇滚乐队Roxette在将自己命名为Dr. Feelgood乐队的歌曲“Roxette”之后所做的。
题目解析
"Alternatively" 在这个句子中是最合适的选择，因为它用于引出一个替代的想法或选择。在这个上下文中，前一句提到乐队选择一个尽可能独特和原创的名字，接着使用"Alternatively"引出了一个与之相反或替代的情况，即他们也可能选择以最喜爱的乐队的一个广为人知的歌曲命名自己。这种转折的逻辑和关系使得"Alternatively"是最合适的过渡词。其他选项在这个语境中不太适合，无法传达出前后句之间的替代关系。

question:
With over five decades of hit singles, including “Lately” from the album Hotter than July, Stevie Wonder looms over the history of pop music with near peerless talent and longevity._____in 1989, his legacy earned him one of the music industry’s top honors: a spot in the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以超过五十年的热门单曲，包括专辑《Hotter than July》中的“Lately”，斯蒂维·汪达以几乎无与伦比的才华和持久力笼罩着流行音乐的历史。_____在1989年，他的音乐遗产为他赢得了音乐行业最高荣誉之一：摇滚名人堂的名额。
题目解析
在这个语境中，前一句提到了斯蒂维·汪达在流行音乐历史上的杰出成就，然后下一句提到了在1989年他因这些成就而获得了音乐界最高荣誉之一的事实。由于这两个句子之间存在因果关系，因此最合适的逻辑过渡词是"Accordingly"，表示前后之间的逻辑关系。

explanations:

question: For the linear function f, the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> in the xy-plane has a slope of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>3</mn> <mn>4</mn> </mfrac></math> and passes through the point (12, 10). question: Of 400,000 objects in a group, 312,000 are new. What percentage of objects in that grouр are new?

The quadratic function f has a factor of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>7.75</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> and a zero at <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>x</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>c</mi></math>, where c is a positive constant. The graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> in the xy-plane has its vertex at <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>3.75</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mi>d</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, where d is a positive constant. What is the value of c?
explanations: factor of (x+7.75)意味着解为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7.75</mn></math>，a zero at x=c就是解为c，两个解的平均数就是顶点x坐标（二次函数图像对称性决定的），得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7.75</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mi>c</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mrow> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <mn>2</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>3.75</mn></math>解得c=0.25（注意factor和solution可以相互计算及转换）

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn></math>
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>r</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>128</mn></math>
The functions f and g are given. In function g, r is a constant. If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>⋅</mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>512</mn></math>, what is the value of r?
explanations: 计算 f(x)·g(x) 得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mn>8</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>r</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>128</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo>∗</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>32</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>r</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>128</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>r</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>512</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>512</mn></math>，即32-r=0和128-4r=0，r=32

question: A school swim team sold shirts to raise money. The team raised $13 from each short-sleeved shirt sold and raised $15 from each long-sleeved shirt sold. The team raised a total of $474 from the sale of these shirts. The equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>13</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>15</mn> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>474</mn></math> represents this situation. Which of the following is the best interpretation of y in this context?
selections: A. The number of long-sleeved shirts sold
B. The number of short-sleeved shirts sold
C. The price, in dollars, of each long-sleeved shirt
D. The price, in dollars, of each short-sleeved shirt
explanations: 准确提取题目中出现的数字、单位及程度表述，总价$474，x、y分别定义的是数量number，所以式中$13和$15分别是单价。问题问的是y，对应long-sleeved shirt得数量

方法1：二次函数方程组system of equations，将y消去整理得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>9</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>108</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，无论利用转换成因式(x-3)(x-6)=0,还是求根公式<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>±</mo><msqrt><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi></msqrt></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>a</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>都可以得到解x=3 or 6，带入函数得到y=0 or 54，x+y=3 or 60结合选项选D；

question:
Days per Winter That Lakes Have Surface Ice
It is common for freshwater lakes near or above a latitude of 45°north of the equator, like Lake Mjosa in Norway, to accumulate surface ice in winter. The amount and duration of ice depends on many factors, including local weather conditions as well as the lake’s depth, volume, and surface area, but a climate researcher claims that some lakes in these latitudes have seen a decline in the duration of ice between the early 1980s and the mid-2000s.

Which choice best describes data in the table that support the researcher’s claim?
selections: A. Kalmarinjärvi is at a higher latitude than Mirror Lake and typically had more days of ice per winter than Mirror Lake did.
B. Kalmarinjärvi had fewer days of ice in the winter of 2005-06 than it did in the winter of 1980-81.
C. Kalmarinjärvi is at a higher latitude than Mirror Lake and typically had fewer days of ice per winter than Mirror Lake did.
D. Lake Neusiedl had more days of ice in the winter of 2005-06 than it did in the winter of 1980-81.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在赤道以北45°纬度附近的淡水湖泊，如挪威的姆约萨湖，冬季常常积聚地表冰层。冰层的数量和持续时间取决于许多因素，包括当地的天气条件以及湖泊的深度、体积和表面积，但一位气候研究人员声称，在这些纬度的一些湖泊在20世纪80年代初至2000年代中期之间看到了冰层持续时间的下降。
题目解析
在这种情况下，选择B是最佳答案现在的ice days比之前少了

question:
External shopping cues are a type of marketing that uses obvious messaging—a display featuring a new product, for example, or a "buy one, get one free" offer—to entice consumers to make spontaneous purchases. In a study, data scientist Sam K.Hui and colleagues found that this effect can also be achieved with a less obvious cue: rearranging a store’s layout. The researchers explain that trying to find items in new locations causes shoppers to move through more of the store, exposing them to more products and increasing the likelihood that they’ll buy an item they hadn’t planned on purchasing.

Which response from a survey given to shoppers who made a purchase at a retail store best supports the researchers’ explanation?
selections: A. “I needed to buy some cleaning supplies, but they weren’t in their regular place. While I was looking for them, I saw this interesting notebook and decided to buy it, too.”
B. “I didn’t buy everything on my shopping list today. I couldn’t find a couple of the items in the store, even though 1 looked all over for them."
C. “The store sent me a coupon for a new brand of soup, so I came here to find out what kinds of soup that brand offers. I decided to buy a few cans because I had the coupon.”
D. “This store is larger than one that’s closer to where I live, and it carries more products. I came here to buy some things that the other store doesn’t always have.”
explanations:
题目文本翻译
外部购物线索是一种营销类型，利用明显的信息传递，例如展示新产品或“买一送一”优惠，来诱使消费者进行即时购买。在一项研究中，数据科学家Sam K. Hui和其同事发现，这种效果也可以通过不那么明显的线索实现：重新布置商店的布局。研究人员解释说，尝试在新位置找到商品会导致购物者在商店内更多地移动，使他们接触更多产品，从而增加他们购买未计划购买的商品的可能性。
题目解析
这个回答最能支持研究人员的解释，因为它涉及到了购物者在商店内寻找特定商品的过程。购物者在寻找清洁用品时发现它们不在通常的位置，这迫使他们在商店内移动并浏览其他产品。在这个过程中，购物者注意到了一本有趣的笔记本，最终决定购买。这个情景与研究人员的解释一致，即重新布置商店的布局会导致购物者接触更多产品，从而增加他们购买未计划购买商品的可能性。因此，这个回答最能支持研究人员的观点。

question:
The Paul Laurence Dunbar House in Dayton, Ohio, is the house where Paul Laurence Dunbar lived for two years and wrote his later poetry collections. Now the house is a museum dedicated to Dunbar’s life and writings. Visitors travel to this museum to feel more connected to an author they admire. To encourage that sense of connection, the museum’s curators have set up exhibits with furnishings owned by Dunbar. Such exhibits help visitors understand day-to-day life in the house where Dunbar felt inspired.

Which choice best states the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It states the current purpose of a building mentioned in the previous sentence.
B. It summarizes the career of an author mentioned in the previous sentence.
C. It recommends the works of an author mentioned in the previous sentence.
D. It recounts the history of a place mentioned in the previous sentence.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
俄亥俄州代顿市的保罗·劳伦斯·邓巴之家，是保罗·劳伦斯·邓巴居住过两年并创作了他后期诗集的房子。现在这座房子已经成为一个专门致力于邓巴生平和作品的博物馆。游客前往这个博物馆，以感受与他们敬仰的作家更紧密的联系。为了鼓励这种联系感，博物馆的策展人设置了陈列，展示了邓巴拥有的家具。这样的展示帮助游客了解邓巴所受启发的房子中的日常生活。
题目解析
答案A是最佳选择，因为这句话描述了前一句提到的房子目前的用途，即成为一个致力于保罗·劳伦斯·邓巴生平和作品的博物馆。这帮助读者了解这座房子的转变和目前的功能，使得阅读更加连贯和清晰。

question:
On painter William H.Johnson’s return to the United States in 1938 after a decade in Europe, his style underwent an abrupt transformation. Turning away from landscapes painted in an expressionist style—a style that often involves using fluid, distorted shapes and thick, textured brushstrokes to express the artist’s subjective experience of reality—Johnson began painting portraits of Black Americans in a bold new way. Evocative of African sculpture and American and Scandinavian folk art,these portraits feature flat, deliberately oversimplified figures in a vibrant but limited color palette.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It elaborates on the previous sentence’s statement about a transitional moment in Johnson’s artistic career.
B. It provides information about Johnson’s travels in support of a claim about his artistic influences, which is advanced in the following sentence.
C. It recounts a moment in Johnson’s personal life that enabled the success of his subsequent career, which is summarized in the following sentence.
D. It presents evidence that calls into question the previous sentence’s characterization of Johnson’s artistic development.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
1938年在欧洲度过十年后，画家威廉·H·约翰逊返回美国时，他的风格经历了一次突然的转变。他放弃了以表现主义风格绘制的风景画，这种风格通常涉及使用流动的、扭曲的形状和厚实的、有质感的笔触来表达艺术家对现实的主观体验。约翰逊开始以一种全新的大胆方式绘制黑人美国人的肖像，这些肖像唤起了非洲雕塑以及美国和斯堪的纳维亚民间艺术的感觉，这些肖像特点是扁平的、刻意简化的人物形象，采用了生动而有限的色彩调色板。
题目解析
在原文中，前一句提到约翰逊在欧洲度过十年后返回美国，他的风格经历了突然的转变。而下一句详细描述了这种风格转变的具体内容，即他开始以一种全新的方式绘制黑人美国人的肖像。因此，第二句提供了对约翰逊艺术生涯中转折时刻的进一步阐述，扩展了前一句的内容，因此选择A是最合适的。

question:
The National Heritage Fellowship was created to honor exceptional folk and traditional artists in the United States for their_______. The Irish American accordionist Joe Derrane was chosen for the fellowship because he has contributed so much to the arts.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
国家传统遗产奖项被创立是为了表彰美国杰出的民间和传统艺术家，以表彰他们的成就。爱尔兰裔美国手风琴演奏家乔·德兰尼之所以被选为获奖者，是因为他在艺术方面做出了巨大贡献。
题目解析
根据上下文，文中提到"National Heritage Fellowship" 是为了表彰美国特殊的民间和传统艺术家的某种特质。而后文提到爱尔兰裔美国手风琴演奏家乔·德兰尼之所以被选为此奖项，是因为他在艺术方面做出了巨大贡献。因此，最符合语境的选择是"Achievements"（成就）。其他选项"若有所思"（suspicions）、"假设"（assumptions）、"预测"（predictions）与语境不符。

question:
Some pieces of music might have many meanings—the compositions of Albeme Caron-Legris can_______as many different interpretations as there are people to listen to them—and so as long as a listener’s interpretation isn’t willfully absurd or the result of inattention, it is difficult to justify the claim that the listener has misunderstood the piece.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
一些音乐作品可能有许多含义 - Albeme Caron-Legris的作品可以产生多种不同的解释，就像有多少人听到它们就有多少种解释一样。因此，只要听众的解释不是故意荒谬或由于不注意，就很难证明听众误解了这首作品。
题目解析
根据上下文，文中提到Albeme Caron-Legris的音乐可能会有许多意义，可以被赋予多种不同的解释，就像有多少人听到它们就有多少种解释一样。因此，最合乎逻辑的词汇是"yield"（产生、带来），表示音乐作品可以带来多种不同的解释。其他选项"refute"（反驳）、"counteract"（抵消）、"partition"（划分）与句意不符。

question:
The following text is adapted from Adib Khorram’s 2018 novel Darius the Great Is Not Okay. Darius, a teenager from the United States, is visiting his grandparents, Mamou and Babou, and other family members in Iran.
I was too tired to fall all the way asleep, and even though Mamou was soft and warm, leaning up against her wasn’t a terribly comfortable position to sleep in. So I dozed and floated on the clouds of Farsi that blew my way from the front seat of Dayi [Uncle] Jamsheed’s SUV.
It reminded me of when I was little, and Mom chanted to me in Farsi every night before bedtime. It’s hard to describe Farsi chanting: the way Mom drew her voice out like the notes of a cello as she recited poems by Rumi or Hafez. I didn’t know what they meant, but that didn’t matter. It was quiet and soothing.
©2018 by Adib Khorram

Which choice best describes the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To connect a current experience to a memory from the narrator’s past
B. To name some of the narrator’s favorite poets who wrote in Farsi
C. To describe a situation the narrator thinks is boring
D. To reveal that the narrator’s mother is a musician
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文本摘自阿迪布·科拉姆（Adib Khorram）2018年的小说《大流士不太好》。达利乌斯，一位来自美国的十几岁少年，正在伊朗拜访他的祖父母、Mamou和Babou，以及其他家庭成员。
我太累了无法完全入睡，尽管Mamou柔软而温暖，靠在她身上并不是一个非常舒适的睡姿。所以我打着瞌睡，飘浮在Farsi的云层中，这些Farsi是从Dayi [叔叔] Jamsheed的SUV前座飘来的。
这让我想起小时候，妈妈每天晚上在我入睡前用Farsi唱诵给我听。很难描述Farsi的唱诵方式：妈妈像大提琴的琴音一样拉长声音，朗诵鲁米（Rumi）或哈菲兹（Hafez）的诗歌。我不知道它们的意思，但那并不重要。它是安静而舒缓的。
题目解析
答案A是最佳选择，因为文本描述了主人公在现在的经历与他过去在母亲用Farsi为他唱诵的时光之间的联系。这种联系帮助读者更好地理解主人公的情感和回忆。整段文本都围绕着这种情感联系展开，而不是仅仅描述母亲是音乐家这一点。

question:
In a study by Mika R. Moran, Daniel A. Rodriguez, and colleagues, residents of Mexico City, Mexico, and La Paz, Bolivia, were surveyed about parks in their cities. Of the 562 respondents from Mexico City, 77.6% indicated that they use the city's parks, and of the 528 respondents from La Paz, 67.5% indicated using city parks. Given that the percentage of Mexico City respondents who reported living within a 10-minute walk of a park was much lower than that reported by La Paz respondents, greater proximity alone can't explain the difference in park use.

The text makes which point about the difference between the proportions of Mexico City residents and La Paz residents using parks?
selections: A. It could be due to inaccuracies in the survey results.
B. It was calculated using sources that predate the survey.
C. It was much larger than the researchers conducting the study expected.
D. It is caused by something other than the parks’ proximity to city residents.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在Mika R. Moran、Daniel A. Rodriguez及其同事进行的一项研究中，对墨西哥城和玻利维亚拉巴斯的居民进行了关于城市公园的调查。在562名墨西哥城受访者中，有77.6%表示他们使用城市的公园，而在528名拉巴斯受访者中，有67.5%表示使用城市公园。鉴于墨西哥城受访者报告的居住在距离公园10分钟步行路程以内的比例远低于拉巴斯受访者的报告比例，仅仅更近的距离并不能解释公园使用情况的差异。
题目解析
在文本中，提到墨西哥城和拉巴斯的居民对城市公园的使用情况进行了调查。尽管墨西哥城受访者报告居住在距离公园10分钟步行路程以内的比例远低于拉巴斯受访者的报告比例，但两地居民使用公园的比例却没有太大差异。这表明公园的距离不是导致墨西哥城和拉巴斯居民使用公园比例差异的唯一原因。因此，文本指出墨西哥城居民和拉巴斯居民使用公园比例的差异是由于与城市居民的距离之外的其他原因造成的。

question:
Architects looking for inspiration may examine photographs of iconic buildings such as the Leaning Tower in Pisa. A two-dimensional photograph, however, cannot capture how a building interacts with its surroundings, whether by complementing, blending in with, or perhaps even clashing with sights and activities nearby. An image of the Leaning Tower thus_____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. conceals the subtle deterioration of the building’s materials.
B. serves to exaggerate the building’s historical importance.
C. misrepresents how the building is perceived by people who have never visited Pisa.
D. fails to convey the full impact of the building’s design and structure.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
建筑师寻找灵感时可能会查看像比萨斜塔这样的标志性建筑的照片。然而，一幅二维照片无法捕捉建筑物与其周围环境的互动，无论是通过与周围景观和活动相辅相成、融为一体，还是可能与附近景观和活动产生冲突。因此，比萨斜塔的一幅图像可能无法捕捉到建筑物与周围环境的互动。
题目解析
选项D最合乎逻辑是因为前文提到了二维照片的局限性，即无法捕捉建筑物与周围环境的互动。因此，由于二维照片无法完全展示建筑物的设计和结构，也就无法传达建筑物的全面影响。建筑的设计和结构不仅包括外观的立体感和细节，还包括建筑与周围环境的互动方式，如与周围景观和活动的关系。因此，选项D中提到的二维照片无法传达建筑物设计和结构的全部影响是最符合前文内容的。

question:
The following text is from Betty Smith’s 1943 novel A Tree Grows in Brooklyn. Francie, a young girl, visits the library often.
Francie thought that all the books in the world were in that library and she had a plan about reading all the books in the world. She was reading a book a day in alphabetical order and not skipping the dry ones. She remembered that the first author had been Abbott. She had been reading a book a day for a long time now and she was still in the B’s. Already she had read about bees and buffaloes, Bermuda vacations and Byzantine architecture. For all her enthusiasm, she had to admit that some of the B’s had been hard going. But Francie was a reader.
©1947 by Betty Smith

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To illustrate Francie’s enjoyment of an unusual topic
B. To explain why Francie prefers reading over other activities
C. To portray Francie’s determination to meet a goal
D. To describe a book that Francie greatly admires
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文本摘自贝蒂·史密斯于1943年的小说《布鲁克林长大的树》。年幼的弗兰西经常去图书馆。
弗兰西认为世界上所有的书都在那个图书馆里，她有一个计划要读完世界上所有的书。她正在按照字母顺序每天读一本书，而且不会跳过那些枯燥的书。她记得第一个作者是阿伯特。她已经连续很长时间每天读一本书了，但她仍然在B开头的书籍上。她已经读过有关蜜蜂和水牛、百慕大度假和拜占庭建筑的内容。尽管她充满热情，但她不得不承认，有些B开头的书真的很难读。但弗兰西是一个读者。
题目解析
这段文本主要聚焦在弗兰西的阅读计划和她的决心上。她认为图书馆里拥有世界上所有的书，因此她制定了一个雄心勃勃的计划，要读完所有的书。她每天按照字母顺序阅读一本书，即使有些书很难读。她的坚持和热爱阅读的态度展现了她对目标的决心。因此，这段文本最重要的目的是描绘弗兰西的决心和毅力，以实现她阅读所有书籍的目标。

question:
The following text is from Lady Gregory’s 1904 play Spreading the News. Mrs. Tarpey, Bartley, and Mrs. Fallon have been buying and selling goods at the local fair.
MRS.TARPEY: Good morrow, Bartley Fallon; good morrow, Mrs. Fallon. Well, Bartley, you’ll find no cause for complaining to-day; they are all saying it was a good fair.
BARTLEY: (Raising his voice.) It was not a good fair, Mrs.Tarpey. It was a scattered sort of a fair. If we didn’t expect more, we got less. That’s the way with me always; whatever I have to sell goes down and whatever I have to buy goes up. If there’s ever any misfortune coming to this world, it’s on myself it pitches, like a flock of crows on seed potatoes.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It discusses an event that Mrs. Tarpey believes is unlikely to occur.
B. It uses a counterexample to raise questions about a claim that Bartley made.
C. It provides a description of something that happened to Bartley at the fair.
D. It presents a vivid image to emphasize a claim that Bartley makes.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文本摘自Lady Gregory的1904年剧作《传播消息》。塔皮夫人、巴特利和法隆夫人在当地集市上买卖商品。
塔皮夫人：早上好，巴特利·法隆；早上好，法隆夫人。嗯，巴特利，你今天不会找到什么抱怨的理由；大家都说这是一个不错的集市。
巴特利：（提高声音。）这不是一个好的集市，塔皮夫人。这是一个散乱的集市。如果我们没想到更多，我们得到了更少。这总是我的方式；我要卖的东西都跌价，我要买的东西都涨价。如果这个世界上有什么不幸，那就是落在我身上，就像一群乌鸦落在种子土豆上。
题目解析
在这段对话中，巴特利使用了比喻来描述他经常遇到的不幸。他比喻说，不幸总是像一群乌鸦落在种子土豆上一样，即不幸总是围绕着他。这个比喻使用生动的形象来强调巴特利所做的声明，即无论他要卖的东西还是要买的东西，都不如他期望的那样顺利。因此，这个下划线部分在文本中的作用是通过生动的形象来强调巴特利的说法。

question:
Biologist Rosanna Alegado believes that we might learn how multicellular organisms developed from single-celled ones if we understand why the single-celled organism Salpingoeca rosetta, the oldest living relative of animals, sometimes forms colonies of cells. Alegado and colleagues reviewed data from many studies about how S. rosetta responds when exposed to another type of single-celled organism, bacteria, including David C. Edman’s work with Listeria monocytogenes bacteria and Jang-Cheon Cho’s work with Croceibacter atlanticus bacteria. Alegado and colleagues concluded that neither L. monocytogenes nor C. atlanticus are likely to have played a significant role in the development of multicellular organisms.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support Alegado and colleagues’conclusion?
selections: A. S. rosetta did not tend to form colonies when exposed to either L.monocytogenes or C. atlanticus.
B. S. rosetta tended to form colonies when exposed to L. monocytogenes and when exposed to C. atlanticus.
C. S. rosetta tended to form colonies when exposed to L. monocytogenes, but not when exposed to C. atlanticus.
D. S. rosetta tended to form colonies when exposed to C. atlanticus, but not when exposed to L. monocytogenes.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
生物学家Rosanna Alegado认为，如果我们了解为什么单细胞生物Salpingoeca rosetta（动物的最古老活着的亲戚）有时会形成细胞群，我们可能会了解多细胞生物是如何从单细胞生物发展而来的。Alegado和同事们回顾了许多关于S. rosetta暴露于另一种单细胞生物细菌时如何反应的研究数据，包括David C. Edman对李斯特菌和Jang-Cheon Cho对大西洋黄色细菌的研究。Alegado和同事们得出结论，李斯特菌和大西洋黄色细菌都不太可能在多细胞生物的发展中起重要作用。
题目解析
这个答案最直接支持Alegado和同事们的结论，因为如果S. rosetta在暴露于L. monocytogenes或C. atlanticus时都不倾向于形成细胞群，那么这表明这两种细菌对于多细胞生物的发展没有起到重要作用。因此，这个发现会进一步支持他们的结论。

question:
The Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP) seeks to discover long-term trends related to childhood development by compiling and analyzing evidence from approximately 12,000 participants in Germany. As with most longitudinal studies, extensive funding support is needed for SOEP to collect the relevant data over timescales and at intervals that will support robust conclusions. But the quality of a more constrained investigation, such as a transportation study seeking only to yield the average number of people per day who use a city’s public transportation system, is much less dependent on high levels of funding because______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. such studies are not trying to identify trends over time.
B. the transportation study is unlikely to be able to recruit 12,000 participants.
C. expanding the scope of such studies is unlikely to be feasible.
D. such studies are likely to be a lower priority for funding than SOEP.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
社会经济面板（SOEP）旨在通过收集和分析来自德国约12,000名参与者的证据，发现与儿童发展相关的长期趋势。与大多数纵向研究一样，SOEP需要广泛的资金支持，以便在时间范围内收集相关数据，并以支持稳健结论所需的间隔。但是，像一项交通研究这样的更为受限的调查，只寻求得出每天使用某市公共交通系统的人数平均值，其质量更不太依赖于高额资金支持，因为______
题目解析
在原文中，提到了针对儿童发展相关长期趋势的SOEP需要大量资金支持来收集相关数据。相比之下，一项更为受限的调查，如仅仅旨在确定每天使用某城市公共交通系统的人数平均值的研究，不需要像SOEP那样大量的资金支持。这是因为这种调查的范围较小，目标更为明确，不需要像SOEP那样长期收集大量数据。因此，扩大此类研究的范围通常是不可行的，也不需要高额资金支持。因此，选择A最符合原文逻辑。

question:
Impact of Four Key Industries on Oklahoma Economy in 2017
The Cherokee Nation, the Quapaw Tribe, and the more than thirty other tribes in Oklahoma operate numerous businesses and generate billions of dollars in revenue. An economics student is researching the tribes’ collective activity as a single industry. The student wants to compare the average amount that industry contributed per employee to Oklahoma’s economy with the average amount contributed per employee by three other industries. Looking at the table, the student finds that tribal economic activity contributed over $141,000 per employee, on average, ranking it_____

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the comparison?
selections: A. above all three of the other industries listed in the table.
B. above either administration/waste or construction and nearly equal to transportation/warehousing.
C. below all three of the other industries listed in the table.
D. below transportation/warehousing but above both construction and administration/waste.
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在2017年，特拉华国家、夸帕部落以及俄克拉何马州的其他三十多个部落经营了众多企业，并创造了数十亿美元的收入。一位经济学学生正在研究这些部落集体活动作为一个单一行业的情况。学生希望比较该行业每名雇员贡献给俄克拉何马州经济的平均金额与其他三个行业每名雇员的平均贡献金额。查看表格，学生发现部落经济活动平均每名雇员贡献超过141,000美元，排名位于_____。
由于部落经济活动每名雇员的平均贡献超过141,000美元，位列在表中四个关键行业中贡献最高的位置。
题目解析
根据表中提供的数据，部落经济活动平均每名雇员贡献超过141,000美元。与其他三个行业相比，部落经济活动的平均贡献排名如下：
- 部落经济活动 ($141,510)：高于管理/废物处理和建筑业，并接近运输/仓储业。
- 运输/仓储业 ($234,720)：高于部落经济活动。
- 建筑业 ($87,994)：低于部落经济活动。
- 管理/废物处理业 ($60,132)：低于部落经济活动。
因此，选项D最有效地利用了表中的数据来完成比较。

question:
The following text is from Virginia Woolf’s 1919 novel Night and Day. The text describes a gathering of aspiring young artists and intellectuals.
One person after another rose, and, as with an ill-balanced axe, attempted to hew out his conception of art a little more clearly, and sat down with the feeling that, for some reason which he could not grasp, his strokes had gone awry. As they sat down they turned almost invariably to the person sitting next them, and rectified and continued what they had just said in public.

As used in the text, what does the figurative phrase“hew out”most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
以下文字摘自弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫1919年的小说《夜与日》。这段文字描述了一群志向远大的年轻艺术家和知识分子的聚会。一个接一个的人站起来，试图像用一把不平衡的斧头一样更清晰地雕刻出他对艺术的构想，然后坐下时感到，由于他无法理解的某种原因，他的努力已经偏离了轨道。当他们坐下时，他们几乎总是转向坐在他们旁边的人，修正并延续他们刚刚在公开场合说的话。
题目解析
在这段文本中，“hew out”这个短语的意义是指尝试清晰地表达某种观念或概念，就像用斧头雕刻或定义出来一样。在这里，人们站起来试图更清楚地表达他们对艺术的理解或构思，就像雕刻或定义出他们的想法一样。因此，“hew out”在这里更接近于“定义”这个意思。

question:
Anthropologist Livia Barbosa, of the Universidade Federal Fluminense in Brazil,_____ food and sociability in contemporary Brazil—specifically, how foods such as carne-de-sol (a cured meat dish) and pé-de-moleque (a traditional peanut brittle candy) function as central mechanisms in building social relationships, values, and identities.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

question:
On Guadalupe Peak, which_____an elevation of 8,751 feet, one can find the highest point in Texas.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

question:
At 3,020 years old, Patriarca da Floresta, a jequitibá-rosa (Cariniana legalis) located in Brazil, is one of the oldest known trees in the world. With over three millennia of climate data in its tree rings, a single tree like this, claims______Valerie Trouet, can tell the history of the world.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 答案D dendrochronologist修饰Valerie Trouet不用符号分割。整个双逗号间, claims_______Valerie Trouet, 是插入语

question:
After appropriate permissions are granted, a typical archaeological dig begins with a surveyor making a detailed grid of the excavation site. Then, the site is carefully dug, and any artifacts found are recorded and mapped onto the site grid._____the artifacts are removed, cataloged, and analyzed in a laboratory.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本翻译
在获得适当的许可之后，一个典型的考古挖掘通常以测量员对挖掘现场进行详细的网格勘测开始。然后，对现场进行仔细挖掘，发现的任何文物都会被记录并绘制到现场网格上。最后，这些文物会被移除、编目并在实验室中进行分析。
题目解析
根据上下文，文中提到在获得适当的许可后，一个典型的考古挖掘开始于测量员对挖掘现场进行详细的网格勘测。然后，对现场进行仔细挖掘，发现的任何文物都会被记录并绘制到现场网格上。根据这个流程，最合适的过渡词是“Finally”（最后），表示对文物进行处理和分析是整个挖掘过程的最后一步。其他选项“例如”（For instance）、“相反”（On the contrary）、“早些时候”（Earlier）与语境不符。

question:
Scholars have praised Gwendolyn Brooks’s 1945 poem "Ballad of Pearl May Lee" for its nuanced portrayal of life in Brooks’s South Side Chicago neighborhood. The poem shouldn’t be regarded as being simply a product of Brooks’s_____the breadth of the poet’s influences, which range from medieval English ballads to the poetry of Emily Dickinson and Langston Hughes.

question:
Julia Alvarez’s 1994 novel In the Time of the Butterflies, a fictionalized account of the lives of the Mirabal_____can serve as a starting point for those wanting to explore how the rule of dictator Rafael Trujillo has been represented in Dominican American literature.
