In the xy-plane, the graphs of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> intersect at two points, (h, j) and (k, m), where <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>j</mi><mo>></mo><mi>m</mi></math>. When <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo><</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, which of the following must also be true?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>39</mn><mi>x</mi></math>函数图像是开口向下的曲线，和一次函数直线有两个交点，x坐标为h和k，因为f(x)开口向下，所以一定是在（h、k）之间时<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>></mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>，（任意绘制图像可发现）所以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo><</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>时为D

question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>6</mn> <mn>7</mn> </mfrac> <mi>p</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>42</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mn>84</mn></math>, what is the value of 7p?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mfrac> <mn>6</mn> <mn>7</mn> </mfrac> <mi>p</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>42</mn></math>，得p=49，注意问题是7p

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi></mfrac></math>
In the given equation, k is a constant. The solution to the given equation is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>224</mn></mfrac></math>. What is the value of k?
explanations: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi></mfrac></math>，得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mi>k</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>,化简得5kx=x+1，解为1/（5k-1）=1/224，再对k求解为k=45

question: If <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>5</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>+</mo> <mn>58</mn></math>, what is the value of x+4?
explanations: x+4看作整体，直接可得x+4=58

question: A triangular prism has a height of 9 centimeters (cm) and a volume of 234 <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mn>3</mn></msup></math>. What is the area, in <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></math>, of the base of the prism? (The volume of a triangular prism is equal to Bh, where B is the area of the base and h is the height of the prism.)
explanations: triangular 长方体高为9，体积234，体积=底面积*高，所以底面积为234/9=26

question: A circle in the xy-plane has its center at <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> and has a radius of 9. An equation of this circle is <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>a</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>, where a, b, and c are constants. What is the value of c ?
explanations: 圆心在<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>半径为9得圆方程<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>81</mn></math>，将方程展开整理得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>14</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>9</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>23</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，所以c为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>23</mn></math>

question: An area of 56.00 square nautical miles is equivalent to k smmare kilometers. To the nearest tenth, what is the value of k? (1 nautical mile=1.852 kilometers)
explanations: 单位转换，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>56</mn> <mo>∗</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>1.852</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup></math>≈192.1(注意名称是面积要计算平方，答案四位有效数字)

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>c</mi></math>
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></math>
In the given system of equations, c is a constant. The system has two distinct real solutions. Which of the following could be the value of c?
explanations: 两个式子合并得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>48</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>144</mn><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>c</mi></math>，整理得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>47</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>144</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，根据两个解<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></math>解得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi><mo>></mo><mfrac><mn>95</mn><mn>16</mn></mfrac></math>，故选D

question:
In triangle ABC and triangle DEF, sides AB and DE each have a side length of 10 inches, and angles A and D each have an angle measure of 40°. Which of the following additional pieces of information is (are) sufficient to prove whether triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF?
I. The measures of angles B and C are equal.
II. The lengths of sides AC and DF are equal.
III. The lengths of sides BC and EF are equal.
selections: A. I is sufficient, but II and III are not.
B. II is sufficient, but I and III are not.
C. III is sufficient, but I and II are not.
D. II is sufficient and III is sufficient, but I is not.
explanations: 满足全等三角形得条件有角边角（ASA）或边角边（SAS），本题满足的是边角边（SAS）得条件即为B，注意D是边边角（SSA）不一定全等

question:

question:
________ though it seemed to many mathematicians, Nagata’s conjecture, posed in 1972, eventually yielded to the combined efforts of Ualbai U. Umirbaev and Ivan P. Shestakov, who presented a proof of it in 2004.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
尽管许多数学家认为这是不可能的，但纳加塔（Nagata）于1972年提出的猜想最终在乌尔拜·乌乌尔巴耶夫（Ualbai U. Umirbaev）和伊万·谢斯塔科夫（Ivan P. Shestakov）共同努力下于2004年被证明了。
题目解析
在这个句子中，提到了 Nagata’s 猜想在 1972 年提出，经过 Ualbai U. Umirbaev 和 Ivan P. Shestakov 的共同努力，于 2004 年得到证明。因此，应该选择一个描述 Nagata’s 猜想的状态的词语。在这种情况下，“insuperable” 意味着难以克服的或无法逾越的，与 Nagata’s 猜想一开始看起来对许多数学家来说似乎是无法克服的情况相吻合。因此，最合适的选择是 “D. Insuperable”。

question:
Mexican textile artist Victoria Villasana weaves stories of triumph, using her unique method of applying colorful yarn to photographs of people. In some works, Villasana focuses on celebrating cultural icons who are people of color, as she does in her depiction of activist Ryu Gwansun. However, in other works, Villasana honors ordinary people, as she does in her captivating portrayal of a young girl sitting on a sidewalk. Villasana sees both of these approaches as ways of depicting the power and interconnectedness of all people.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. To emphasize that Villasana prefers to focus on famous figures in her work
B. To offer an overview of Villasana’s artistic style
C. To demonstrate that Villasana collaboration frequently with other artists
D. To provide an example of an everyday individual which Villasana has portrayed in her work
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
墨西哥纺织艺术家维多利亚·维拉萨纳（Victoria Villasana）用自己独特的方法，在人物照片上运用丰富多彩的纱线编织充满胜利故事。在一些作品中，维拉萨纳专注于庆祝有色人种的文化偶像，就像她描绘激进分子柳宽顺（Ryu Gwansun）那样。然而，在其他作品中，维拉萨纳尊重普通人，就像她生动描绘一个坐在人行道上的小女孩那样。维拉萨纳认为这两种方式都是描绘所有人的力量和相互联系的方式。
题目解析
这句话提供了一个例子，说明 Villasana 在她的作品中展示了普通人。这有助于强调她的作品不仅关注名人，也关注普通人，呈现了所有人的力量和相互联系。

question:
Béláné Mocsáry, who traveled solo to four continents in the early 1900s, undoubtedly accomplished much, but her place in our historical memory is perhaps more _______ than that of a noteworthy “first” such as Adeline and Augusta Van Buren, who were the first women to ride solo motorcycles across the continental United States, a deed for which they will always be remembered.

Which choice completes the test with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
贝兰娜·莫克沙瑞（Béláné Mocsáry）在20世纪初独自环游了四大洲，无疑取得了许多成就，但她在我们历史记忆中的地位也许比不上像阿德琳和奥古斯塔·范布伦（Adeline and Augusta Van Buren）这样的显赫“第一人”，她们是第一批独自骑摩托车横穿美国大陆的女性，这一壮举将永远被人们铭记。
题目解析
在这个句子中，提到了两位女性：Béláné Mocsáry 和 Adeline 和 Augusta Van Buren。虽然 Béláné Mocsáry 在早期 1900 年代独自环游了四大洲，取得了很大成就，但她在历史记忆中的位置可能不如 Adeline 和 Augusta Van Buren 那样“值得记忆”。因此，她的地位是uncertain的。

question:
A number of recording artists ________ distinctions between Indigenous music and other musical styles. For example, Inuit singer-songwriter Tanya Tagaq incorporated Inuit throat singing into electronic music on her album Tongues, and Swinomish/Iñupiaq musician Black Belt Eagle Scout combined powwow-style melodies with rock on her album At the Party with My Brown Friends.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
一些录音艺术家模糊了原住民音乐与其他音乐风格之间的界限。例如，因纽特人创作歌手塔尼亚·塔加克（Tanya Tagaq）在她的专辑《Tongues》中将因纽特族喉音歌唱融入到电子音乐中，而斯威诺米什/因纽比克音乐家Black Belt Eagle Scout在她的专辑《At the Party with My Brown Friends》中将印第安传统舞蹈风格的旋律与摇滚音乐结合在一起。
题目解析
这个句子讲述了一些音乐艺术家把原住民音乐和其他音乐风格融合的情况。在这种背景下，艺术家是在拒绝不同音乐风格之间的区别。因此，最合适的选择是 “reject”，意为拒绝或排斥。

question:
Wenheng Zhang and colleagues have explored how convergent evolution—a phenomenon that occurs when the same trait evolves independently in two reproductively separate lineages—can result from a genetic mechanism shared by both lineages. Meanwhile, Armin P. Moczek and colleagues have investigated how convergence occurs through different genetic mechanisms, but the relative prevalence of convergence through shared and different genetic processes is still poorly understood. This motivated biologists Delbert A. Green II and Cassandra G. Extavour to evaluate both types of convergence in a single study for their 2012 paper.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Before Green and Extavour’s study, convergent evolution was assumed to require a shared genetic mechanism between two lineages that share the trait.
B. Green and Extavour’s study addresses convergent evolution more comprehensively than the studies by Zhang and colleagues and Moczek and colleagues do.
C. Green and Extavour’s study was conducted using data from the studies by Zhang and colleagues and Moczek and colleagues.
D. Both the study by Zhang and colleague and that by Green and Extavour compare convergence through shared genetic mechanic in convergence through different genetic mechanic.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
张文衡和同事探讨了趋同进化的机制——这是指在两个生殖隔离的谱系中，相同的特征独立进化的现象——可能源自这两个谱系共享的遗传机制。同时，Armin P. Moczek和同事研究了趋同是如何通过不同的遗传机制发生的，但是趋同通过共享和不同的遗传过程之间的相对普遍性仍然知之甚少。这促使生物学家Delbert A. Green II和Cassandra G. Extavour在他们2012年的论文中评估了这两种趋同类型。
题目解析
选择B是因为题干提到了Delbert A. Green II和Cassandra G. Extavour的研究更全面地讨论了收敛进化，相比于Wenheng Zhang和同事以及Armin P. Moczek和同事的研究。根据文本内容，Green和Extavour的研究旨在评估两种不同类型的收敛进化，而Zhang和同事以及Moczek和同事的研究并没有如此全面地考虑这一问题。因此，选择B最准确地概括了文本的主要观点。

question:
Like all species of baleen whales, the sei whale feeds on tiny creatures known as krill by filtering water through bristlelike keratin structures called baleen plates. In this way, baleen whales can eat up to 30 percent of their total mass per day. And while no one would call the sei whale small—it can have a mass as high as 25,000 kg—it is one of the smaller baleen whales and is much smaller than the northern right whale, which can weigh a whopping 80,000 kg and consume as much as 24,000 kg of krill per day.

Based on the text, what can most reasonably be concluded about krill consumption among sei and northern right whales?
selections: A. The northern right whale is able to eat more krill per day than the sei whale is.
B. Both the sei whale and the northern right whale can eat an much as 24,000 kg of krill per day.
C. The quantities of krill consumed by northern right whales has make a difficult for sei whales to find sufficient feed.
D. Most baleen whales include krill in their diets, but the sei whale is   likely than the northern right whale to do so.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
像所有须鲸类物种一样，斑鲸通过通过其称为须板的毛状角质结构过滤水来捕食小型生物——即所谓的磷虾。通过这种方式，须鲸每天可以摄食其总体重的高达30%。尽管没有人会称斑鲸为小型动物——它的重量可能高达25,000公斤——但它是较小的须鲸之一，远比北部露脊鲸要小，后者体重可高达惊人的80,000公斤，每天可消耗高达24,000公斤的磷虾。
题目解析
根据文本，“北极鲸”可以吃掉高达24,000千克的磷虾，而“征鲸”可以吃掉最高达25,000千克的磷虾。因此，可以合理推断北极鲸每天吃更多的磷虾，所以选项A是最合理的结论。

question:
The following text is adapted from John Matheus’s 1926 short story, “Mr. Bradford Teaches Sunday School.” Mr. Bradford is driving through the countryside in Florida.
The moss in the towering water oaks had become enlivened with a verdant sheen of silver and hung like festoons of carnival or like funeral decorations for the mourning of the dead. The pine green was resplendent. The bald cypresses spread themselves along the water courses while the willows wept as they always did.
Mr. Bradford was conscious of this gorgeous display of nature.

As used in the text, what does the word “display” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
以下文本改编自约翰·马修斯（John Matheus）1926年的短篇小说《布拉德福德先生教授主日学》。 布拉德福德先生开车穿过佛罗里达州的乡村。 高大的水橡树上的苔藓闪耀着一层银色，悬挂着像嘉年华的花彩或像为哀悼死者而悬挂的葬礼装饰物。 松树的翠绿色彩辉煌夺目。 光秃的水杉沿着水道展开，而柳树像往常一样哭泣着。
布拉德福德先生意识到了这一绚丽的自然景观。
题目解析
在这个文本中，"display"一词用来描述大自然的景观，指的是壮观的表现或景观。在这里，"display"意味着一种引人注目的、美丽而壮观的景象，与“spectacle”这个选项最为接近。

question:
Text corpora such as the British National Corpus are enormous collections of electronically stored texts that can be used for empirical testing of hypotheses regarding how ________ a word is in spoken and written English. For instance, one might have a guess about the incidence of the word “world,” but only an analysis of a corpus can prove that “world” is the eighth most commonly used noun.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
文本语料库，如英国国家语料库，是巨大的电子存储文本集合，可用于对关于某个词在英语口语和书面语中的使用频率的假设进行经验测试。例如，一个人可能对单词“world”的出现频率有所猜测，但只有通过对语料库的分析才能证明“world”是第八个最常用的名词。
题目解析
在这个上下文中，根据前文提到的，文本语料库是用来对英语口语和书面语中的单词使用频率进行实证测试的，所以应该选择一个与词频相关的词语。在这种情况下，"pervasive" 这个词意味着“普遍存在的，普及的”，与文本中对文本语料库的描述相符。因此，选择“A. pervasive”是最合乎逻辑和准确的选择。

question:
Many pastes contain copper oxide nanoparticles (CuO-NPs), which can leach into waterways and soils via wastewater. In a 2012 study, Superb K. Misra and colleagues found that CuO-NPs can accumulate in the bodies of great pond snails (Lymnaea stagnalis). While bioaccumulation of manufactured nanoparticles may be inherently worrisome, it has been hypothesized that CuO-NP bioaccumulation in invertebrates like L. stagnalis could serve a valuable proxy role, obviating the need for manufacturers to conduct costly and intrusive sampling of vertebrate species—such as African clawed frogs (Xenopus laevis), commonly used in regulatory compliance testing—for nanoparticle bioaccumulation, as environmental protection laws currently require.

Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the hypothesis presented in the text?
selections: A. The rate of CuO-NP uptake in L. stagnalis differs from the rate of CuO-NP uptake in X. laevis in a way that is not yet well understood by researchers.
B. L. stagnalis has been shown to accumulate several other types of manufactured nanoparticles in addition to CuO-NPs, whereas X. laevis has been shown to accumulate only CuO-NPs.
C. When L. stagnalis and X. laevis are exposed to similar levels of CuO-NPs, concentrations of CuO-NPs in animals of both species show little variation from individual to individual.
D. Compared with X. laevis. L. stagnalis can accumulate detectable CuO-NP concentrations with significantly fewer negative effects.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
许多浆糊含有氧化铜纳米粒子（CuO-NPs），这些纳米粒子可以通过废水进入水道和土壤。在2012年的一项研究中，Superb K. Misra及其同事发现CuO-NPs可以在大型池螺（Lymnaea stagnalis）的体内积累。虽然制造纳米颗粒的生物富集可能本质上令人担忧，但有人假设，CuO-NP在像L. stagnalis这样的无脊椎动物中的生物富集可能起到一个宝贵的代理作用，避免了制造商需要进行昂贵和侵入性的脊椎动物物种（如非洲爪蟾（Xenopus laevis），常用于监管合规测试）的纳米颗粒生物富集采样，因为环境保护法律目前要求。
题目解析
选项 A 直接挑战了使用 L. stagnalis 作为 X. laevis 的生物累积代理的假设。如果 L. stagnalis 和 X. laevis 对 CuO-NP 的吸收速率有不同且尚不为研究人员所了解的方式，这表明两个物种在CuO-NP的吸收过程可能存在本质上的差异。因此，这会削弱使用 L. stagnalis 作为 X. laevis CuO-NP 生物累积的有效代理的论点。

question:
Text 1
For decades, ornithologists assumed that if they saw a singing Bell’s vireo—a bird species found in temperate North America—they must be observing a male. That’s because birdsong has long been considered a male trait; researchers have argued that singing enables males to attract mates and claim territory.
Text 2
Recent evidence shows that a female Bell’s vireo is as capable of song as a male is. In fact, Karan J. Odom and colleagues found evidence of female song in 71% of the 323 species they examined. They claim that the historical mischaracterization of birdsong as a male trait is largely the result of bias: much of the research ornithologists have carried out has been near universities in the temperate northern hemisphere, where female birdsong is less common than it is in the tropics.

Based on the texts, how would Odom and colleagues (Text2) most likely respond to the view of birdsong presented in Text 1?
selections: A. They would suggest that it reflects a tendency to study male birds rather than female birds.
B. They would claim that other factors than mate attraction and territorial defense have driven the evolution of singing in male birds.
C. They would underscore that male songbirds in temperate zones are likely using their songs for different purposes than are male songbirds in the tropics.
D. They would argue that it was influenced by the binds of study sites researchers tended to select.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
Text 1
几十年来，鸟类学家一直认为，如果他们看到一只歌唱的贝尔氏维里欧鸟——一种发现于北美温带地区的鸟类——那么他们一定在观察一只雄鸟。这是因为长期以来人们认为鸟鸣是雄性特征；研究人员认为，歌唱使雄性能够吸引配偶并宣示领地。
Text 2
最近的证据表明，雌性贝尔氏维里欧鸟和雄性一样具有歌唱能力。事实上，Karan J. Odom及其同事在调查的323种鸟类中发现了71%的雌性鸟类存在歌唱行为。他们声称，将鸟鸣历史性地误认为是雄性特征主要是由于偏见所致：许多鸟类学家进行的研究大多集中在温带北半球的大学附近，而在热带地区，雌性鸟类的歌唱行为比温带地区更为常见。
题目解析
根据文本2中提到的，研究鸟鸣被错误地认为是雄性特征的历史观点主要是由于偏见造成的，因为很多研究是在温带北半球的大学附近进行的，而在那里，雌性鸟类的鸣叫比在热带地区要少见。因此，研究受到study sites影响。

question:
Days per Winter That Lakes Have Surface Ice
It is common for freshwater lakes near or above a latitude of 45° north of the equator, like Lake Mjosa in Norway, to accumulate surface ice in winter. The amount and duration of ice depends on many factors, including local weather conditions as well as the lake’s depth, volume, and surface area, but a climate researcher claims that some lakes in these latitudes have seen a decline in the duration of ice between the early 1980s and the mid-2000s.

Which choice best describes data in the table that support the researchers claim?
selections: A. Kalmarinjärvi had fewer days of ice in the winter of 2005-06 than it did in the winter of 1980-81.
B. Kalmarinjärvi is at a higher latitude than Mirror Lake and typically had fewer days of ice per winter than Mirror Lake.
C. Kalmarinjärvi is at a higher latitude than Mirror Lake and typically had more days of ice per winter than Mirror Lake did.
D. Lake Neusiedl had more days of ice in the winter of 2005-06 than it had in the winter of 1980-81.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在赤道以北45°以上的纬度附近的淡水湖，如挪威的墨约沙湖（Lake Mjosa），在冬季会普遍积累表面冰层。冰的数量和持续时间取决于许多因素，包括当地的天气条件以及湖泊的深度、体积和表面积，但一位气候研究员声称，这些纬度的一些湖泊在20世纪80年代初到21世纪中期之间看到了冰层持续时间的减少。
题目解析
选项A最能描述支持研究人员观点的数据，原因如下：
1. 选项A提供了具体的比较数据：它指出了Kalmarinjärvi湖在两个不同时间段（1980-81年冬季和2005-06年冬季）的结冰天数情况。这种具体的数据比其他选项提供的一般性描述更有说服力，能够直接支持研究人员的观点。
2. 研究人员声称在纬度较高的地区，一些湖泊的结冰持续时间有所下降。选项A提供的数据恰好支持了这一观点，因为它指出了Kalmarinjärvi湖在近几十年间的结冰情况有所减少，与研究人员的说法一致。
3. 其他选项虽然也提到了不同湖泊的特征和数据，但并没有提供直接支持研究人员观点的信息。例如，选项B和C提到了Kalmarinjärvi和Mirror Lake之间的比较，但并没有与研究人员的观点联系起来。选项D提供了Lake Neusiedl湖在不同时间段的结冰情况，但与研究人员观点相悖。
因此，选项A提供了直接支持研究人员观点的具体数据，是最能描述支持研究人员观点的选项。

question:
In June of 1987, South Korea liberalized its stock market, meaning that it began allowing foreign individuals and businesses to invest money in South Korean companies. This was part of a wave of stock market liberalizations from the mid-1980s through the mid-1990s—Brazil in 1988, Venezuela in 1990, and so on. In an analysis of economic data from 1976 to 1993, Ross Levine and Sara Zervos found that liberalization did not lead to enduring increases in investment in companies based in countries that liberalized. Peter Blair Henry, however, found that, on average, investment in companies in liberalized countries increased significantly in the three years following liberalization. Taken together, these results suggest that ___________.

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. investment growth is likely to be more consistent in countries that liberalize than in countries that do not.
B. it typically takes at least three years for companies to benefit from government policies allowing foreign investment, but governments rarely maintain such policies for that long.
C. economists’ expectations about the effect of liberalization an investment were largely correct.
D. companies based in countries that begin allowing foreign investment will probably see short-term increases in investment, but that these gains are unlikely to last.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在1987年6月，韩国放开了其股票市场，意味着开始允许外国个人和企业投资于韩国公司。这是从20世纪80年代中期到20世纪90年代中期一波股票市场放开的浪潮的一部分——巴西在1988年，委内瑞拉在1990年，等等。在对1976年至1993年的经济数据进行分析时，罗斯·莱文（Ross Levine）和萨拉·泽夫斯（Sara Zervos）发现，放开并没有导致投资于放开国家公司的持续增加。然而，彼得·布莱尔·亨利（Peter Blair Henry）发现，平均而言，放开国家公司的投资在放开后的三年内显著增加。综合这些结果表明 ________。
题目解析
选项D最能合理地完成文本，是因为它在两位研究者的研究结果基础上提出了总结性的观点，能够综合解释他们的研究发现。根据Ross Levine和Sara Zervos的研究，自由化并没有导致对自由化国家公司投资的持续增加，这表明自由化并不一定会带来长期的投资增长。而Peter Blair Henry的研究结果显示，一般而言，自由化国家公司的投资在自由化后的三年内显著增加，这暗示着自由化可能会在短期内带来投资增长。因此，选项D提出的结论更能综合解释这些研究结果，指出自由化国家公司可能会看到短期投资增长，但这些增长不太可能持续下去。

question:
Callie W. Babbitt, Hema Madaka, and colleagues assembled a database of materials used in consumer electronics by studying products in the lab and by gathering data from similar product studies. The team gave each of these studies a rating for level of traceability (with a higher rating for clearer descriptions of procedures) and for category consistency (with a higher rating for using materials categories more closely aligned with the categories in the team’s database). Based on these ratings, a second research team concluded that the methodology was better explained in a study by Lutz Stobbe than it was in a study by Martin Streicher-Porte and colleagues.

Which finding, if true, would most directly challenge the second research team’s conclusion?
selections: A. The study Stobbe has a lower traceability rating that the study by Streicher-Porte and colleagues did.
B. The study by Stobbe had a high consistency rating and a high traceability rating.
C. The Study by Stobbe had a lower consistency rating than the study by Streicher-Porte and colleagues did.
D. The study by Streicher-Porte and colleagues had a medium consistency rating and a medium traceability rating.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
Callie W. Babbitt、Hema Madaka和同事们通过研究实验室中的产品并收集类似产品研究的数据，建立了一个关于消费电子产品中使用材料的数据库。团队对这些研究进行了追溯性等级评分（对程序描述更清晰的评分较高）和类别一致性评分（对使用的材料类别与团队数据库中的类别更加匹配的评分较高）。基于这些评分，第二个研究团队得出结论，认为Lutz Stobbe的研究中的方法论解释比Martin Streicher-Porte和同事的研究更好。
题目解析
因为如果Stobbe的研究traceability低于Streicher-Porte及其同事的研究，那么第二个研究团队的结论就会受到挑战。他们认为Stobbe的研究在方法学解释方面更好，但实际上如果Stobbe的研究评分较低，这可能意味着其研究可能存在一些问题或不够准确，从而使第二个研究团队的结论不太可靠。methodology主要看procedures，因为主要看traceability

question:
US Hydroelectric Power Plants, 2019
A run of river hydroelectric power plant, as the name suggests, uses the natural flow of a water source to generate electricity but is unable to start or stop that flow through its generators. In contrast, a peaking hydroelectric power plant (used when demand for electricity peaks) controls the flow of water through its generators: starting flow when demand is high enough, stopping it when demand is too low, and otherwise regulating it to keep pace with changing electricity need. question:
Arthurian legends (tales related to the character of King Arthur) derive from many often contradictory sources, such as Preiddeu Annwfn, composed around 900, and Perceval, the Story of the Grail from around 1181. Sir Thomas Malory’s 15th-century text Le Morte d’Arthur was an attempt to compile these stories into a coherent narrative. Many of Malory’s sources derive from Geoffrey of Monmouth’s History of the Kings of Britain, written in the 1130s. While neither History nor any works that predate it mention Arthur’s famous Round Table at which his knights assembled, Le Morte d’Arthur does, suggesting that ___________.

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. Geoffrey of Monmouth’s accounts of Arthurian legends in History are more similar overall in content to the accounts in Perceval, the Story of the Grail than they are to the accounts in Le Morte d’Arthur.
B. Malory encountered the Round Table in a source that Geoffrey of Monmouth was not familiar with when writing his History.
C. Le Morte d’Arthur is more historically accurate than History, because Perceval, the Story of the Grail had not been written when Geoffrey of Monmouth was writing his work.
D. when a version of an Arthurian legend contradicted the version in History, Malory preferred to include Geoffrey of Monmouth’s  version  in Le Morte d’Arthur.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
亚瑟王传奇（与亚瑟王角色相关的故事）源自许多经常矛盾的来源，如约公元900年创作的《Preiddeu Annwfn》和约公元1181年的《Perceval, the Story of the Grail》。托马斯·马洛里爵士（Sir Thomas Malory）于15世纪创作的作品《亚瑟王之死》试图将这些故事编纂成一个连贯的叙事。马洛里的许多来源都源自杰弗里·蒙茅斯（Geoffrey of Monmouth）在1130年代写的《不列颠诸王史》。尽管《不列颠诸王史》及其前任作品没有提及亚瑟王著名的圆桌，亚瑟王的骑士们在这里集会，但《亚瑟王之死》提到了这一点，这表明 ________。
题目解析
选项B最逻辑地完成了文本，原因如下：
1. 原文提到，Le Morte d’Arthur 包含了关于亚瑟王的圆桌，而Geoffrey of Monmouth 的作品中并没有提到。这暗示着Malory 在写作 Le Morte d’Arthur 时，可能接触到了Geoffrey of Monmouth 不熟悉的关于圆桌的资料。
2. 选项B指出了这一点，即 Malory 在写作 Le Morte d’Arthur 时，可能接触到了 Geoffrey of Monmouth 不熟悉的关于圆桌的资料，这解释了为什么 Le Morte d’Arthur 中包含了关于圆桌的内容。因此，选项B最为合适，最逻辑地完成了文本，衔接了前后文的内容。

question:

explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在考虑要上演哪些话剧和音乐剧时，旧金山的剧院通常更倾向于让观众满意，而不是冒险尝试。因此，尽管他们可能急于上演像《阿玛迪乌斯》（Amadeus）这样的经典作品，但大多数人会对上演相对未知剧作家的作品持保留态度。

question:

explanations:

题目解析

question:

question:
In a college course on urban affairs, a student asserts that traffic congestion in the United States increased between 1990 and 2000 mostly in and around very large cities such as Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The student claims that not only were smaller areas such as Albany-Schenectady-Troy, New York, and Boise, Idaho, less affected, but the amount of congestion in those areas remained constant throughout the same period. A second student claims that this is an unsupported assertion based on incorrect assumptions about traffic patterns in urban areas of different sizes.

Which choice best describes data from the graph that support the second student's claim?
selections: A. In all three urban areas shown, the amount of traffic delay per commuter per year was greater in 2000 than in 1990.

B. Throughout the period between 1990 and 2000, the amount of traffic delay per commuter per year was greater in the Albany-Schenectady-Troy, New York, area than in the Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, area.
C. In at least one of the three urban areas shown, the amount of traffic delay was less than 20 hours per commuter per year at one point between 1990 and 2000.
D. In 1992, the amount of traffic delay in the Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, area was less than 30 hours per commuter per year.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在一门关于城市事务的大学课程中，一名学生断言美国在1990年至2000年间的交通拥堵主要发生在费城等非常大的城市及其周边地区。该学生声称像纽约州的奥尔巴尼-斯克内克塔迪-特洛伊和爱达荷州的博伊西等较小地区受影响较小，而这些地区在同一时期的拥堵程度保持不变。第二名学生声称这是一个没有依据的断言，基于对不同规模城市交通模式的错误假设。
题目解析
选项A支持第二个学生的观点，因为它提供了数据显示在1990年到2000年期间，所有三个城市地区中每名通勤者每年的交通延误时间都增加了。这表明交通拥堵问题在不同大小的城市地区都有所增加，与第一名学生的断言相悖，即较小地区如Albany-Schenectady-Troy, New York和Boise, Idaho没有受到影响。因此，选项A支持第二个学生的观点，即第一名学生基于错误假设。

question:
In Costa Rica, use of solid fuel (e.g, coal, wood) as a share of total household fuel use fell by approximately 60 percent between 2000 and 2019; such shifts are typically explained by appeal to the energy ladder, a model holding that fuel choice is mediated mainly by household income (specifically, high-technology fuels displace solid fuels as incomes rise). Rasmus Heltberg's study of fuel use in Guatemala shows how reductive this model is, however: household fuel use was heterogeneous, flexible, and influenced by several factors, including local price of different sources.

Based on the text, which choice best explains why the author characterizes the energy ladder as “reductive”?
selections: A. The energy ladder asserts that households only consider one aspect of fuel when making fuel choices, but Heltberg's study showed that households ignore that characteristic of fuel and evaluate several other factors instead.

B. The energy ladder holds that the adoption of one type of fuel means that another type of fuel must be displaced, but Helthberg's study showed that several different fuel types are typically used in equal proportion.

C. The energy ladder assumes that the same factor influences household fuel choice in all locations, but Heltberg's study showed that fuel choice in Guatemala is influenced by different factors than is fuel choice in Costa Rica.
D. The energy ladder attributes household fuel choice primarily to a single characteristic of households, but Heltberg's study showed that multiple circumstances can affect household fuel choice.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在哥斯达黎加，2000年至2019年间，固体燃料（如煤炭、木材）在家庭燃料使用总量中的份额下降了约60％；这种转变通常可以通过能源阶梯模型来解释，该模型认为燃料选择主要受家庭收入的影响（具体而言，随着收入增加，高技术燃料会取代固体燃料）。然而，拉斯姆斯·赫尔特伯格对危地马拉燃料使用的研究显示，这个模型是多么简化了：家庭燃料使用是异质的、灵活的，并受到多种因素的影响，包括不同来源的本地价格。
题目解析
根据文本，“Rasmus Heltberg's study of fuel use in Guatemala shows how reductive this model is, however: household fuel use was heterogeneous, flexible, and influenced by several factors, including local price of different sources.” 这段文字表明，Heltberg的研究显示，家庭燃料使用是多元化的，灵活的，并受到多种因素的影响，包括不同来源的当地价格。因此，选项D）“能源阶梯模型主要将家庭燃料选择归因于家庭的单一特征，但Heltberg的研究表明，多种情况可以影响家庭燃料选择。”最能解释作者将能源阶梯模型描述为“简化的”原因。

question:
Water flowing around an obstruction creates vortices (patterns of swirls) of varying size; by detecting the vortices, fish can determine the size and position of the obstruction. Testing by Yuzo R. Yanagisuru, Otar Akanyeti, and James C. Liao using models of three head shapes—narrow (low ratio of width to length), intermediate, and wide (high ratio of width to length)—showed that for large vortices, fish with intermediate heads would be better able than narrow-headed fish to distinguish between vortices and general turbulence in the water. A second research team has therefore hypothesized that in low-visibility conditions, intermediate-headed fish will be more likely than narrow-headed fish to detect obstructions that create large vortices.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the second research team's hypothesis?
selections: A. A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the intermediate-headed Lobocheilos rhabdoura bumped into the obstructions just as often as the narrow-headed lookdown (Selene vomer) did.

B. A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the lookdown (Selene vomter), which has a relatively narrow head, bumped into more than half of the obstructions.

C. A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that the narrow-headed lookdown (Selene vomer)bumped into obstructions more often than the intermediate-headed Lobocheilos rhabdoura did.

D. A study using obstructions that created large vortices in low-visibility conditions found that some specimens of the intermediate-headed Lobocheilos rhabdoura bumped into the obstructions more often than other specimens of the same fish did.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
水流经过障碍物时会产生不同大小的涡旋（漩涡形态）；通过检测涡旋，鱼类可以确定障碍物的大小和位置。Yuzo R. Yanagisuru、Otar Akanyeti和James C. Liao进行的实验使用三种头部形状的模型——窄头（宽度与长度比低）、中间头和宽头（宽度与长度比高）——显示，对于大涡旋，具有中等头部的鱼类比窄头鱼更能够区分涡旋和水中的一般湍流。因此，第二个研究团队假设在能见度低的情况下，具有中等头部的鱼类比窄头鱼更有可能检测到产生大涡旋的障碍物。
题目解析
第二个研究团队的假设是，在低能见度条件下，中等头宽的鱼比窄头的鱼更有可能检测到会产生大涡流的障碍物。为了支持这一假设，最直接的证据应该显示出在低能见度条件下，中等头宽的鱼比窄头的鱼更少撞上障碍物，这表明中等头宽的鱼更擅长检测到这些障碍物。
选项 C 直接支持了这一假设，因为它显示，在低能见度条件下，窄头的 Selene vomer（看倒鱼）比中等头宽的 Lobocheilos rhabdoura 更频繁地撞上障碍物，这意味着中等头宽的鱼更好地检测到了这些障碍物，从而支持了研究团队的假设。

question:
The ancient writing system used in the Maya kingdoms of southern Mexico and Central America had a symbol for the number zero. The earliest known example of the symbol dates to more than 2,000 years ago. At that time, almost none of the writing systems elsewhere in the world possessed a zero symbol. And the use of zero in Mexico and Central America may be even more ancient. Some historians suggest that Maya mathematicians inherited it from the Olmec civilization, which flourished in the region 2,400-3,600 years ago.

According to the text, what do some historians suggest about Maya civilization?
selections: A. Maya civilization acquired the use of zero from the Olmec civilization.
B. Maya civilization respected its historians more than it respected its mathematicians.
C. Maya civilization was highly secretive about its intellectual achievements.
D. Maya civilization tried to introduce its writing system to other civilizations.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在墨西哥南部和中美洲的玛雅王国使用的古代书写系统中有一个代表数字零的符号。已知的最早零符号的例子可追溯到2000多年前。那个时候，世界其他地方几乎没有任何书写系统拥有零符号。而在墨西哥和中美洲使用零的历史可能更加古老。一些历史学家认为，玛雅数学家可能是从鼎盛于该地区2400-3600年前的奥尔梅克文明那里继承了零的概念。
题目解析
根据文本，“一些历史学家认为，玛雅文明的数学家继承了这个符号，这个符号在墨西哥和中美洲的使用可能更古老。一些历史学家认为，玛雅数学家继承了它，而不是创造了它。”这段文字表明，一些历史学家认为玛雅文明从奥尔梅克文明继承了使用零的概念，而不是自己创造了这个符号。因此，选项A）“玛雅文明从奥尔梅克文明获得了使用零的概念”是符合文本内容的最佳选择。

question:
Minimum and Maximum Depths of Stony Coral Species in Caribbean and Indo-Pacific Waters
Some scientists have suggested that as ocean temperatures rise, many fish and corals found in the shallow zone (less than 30 meters below the surface) could take refuge in the cooler, darker mesophotic zone (30 to 150 meters below the surface). However, it isn't clear that all such species will be able to tolerate mesophotic conditions. In 2018, Luiz Rocha and colleagues studied stony corals in the two zones in Caribbean and Indo-Pacific waters. Based on the depths at which those corals are now found, the species that seems least suited to a full migration to the mesophotic zone is ____

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
selections: A. Acropora striata, because its maximum depth of 25 meters is close to but doesn't reach the mesophotic zone.
B. Porites nodifera, because its maximum depth of 15 meters is furthest from the mesophotic zone.
C. Agaricia grahamae, because its minimum depth of 20 meters is in the shallow zone.
D. Pocillopora meandrina, because its minimum depth of 1 meter is the shallowest of those listed.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
一些科学家已经提出，随着海洋温度上升，许多生活在浅层区域（水面以下30米以内）的鱼类和珊瑚可能会在较凉爽、较暗的中光区域（水面以下30至150米）寻找庇护。然而，并不清楚所有这些物种是否能够适应中光区的条件。2018年，Luiz Rocha及其同事研究了加勒比海和印度-太平洋水域中两个区域内的石珊瑚。根据这些珊瑚现在所发现的深度，似乎最不适合完全迁移到中光区的物种是___
题目解析
在问题中，我们需要确定哪种珊瑚物种似乎最不适合完全迁移到深中光带。根据提供的信息和表格中的数据，我们可以看到Porites nodifera的最大深度为15米，这是所列物种中距离深中光带最远的。这表明Porites nodifera目前生长的深度最接近深中光带，迁移到更深的区域可能会对它们的生存造成挑战。因此，选项B是使用表中数据有效地完成陈述的最佳选择。

question:
The following text is adapted from Jerome K. Jerome's 1889 novel Three Men in a Boat (To Say Nothing of the Dog).
We [people] are creatures of the sun. We love light and life. That is why we crowd into the towns and cities, and the country grows more and more deserted every year. In the sunlight—in the daytime, when Nature is alive and busy all around us, we like the open hill-sides and the deep woods well enough: but in the night, when our Mother Earth has gone to sleep, and left us waking, oh! the world seems so lonesome, and we get frightened, like children in a silent house. Then we sit and sob, and long for the gas-lit streets, and the sound of human voices, and the answering throb of human life.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To indicate that people sometimes experience feelings of isolation in crowded areas
B. To address common traits that motivate many people to choose to live in urban environments
C. To caution people not to be so quick to dismiss the natural beauty that can be found in rural areas
D. To demonstrate that most people tend to prefer being alone in the country to being alone in towns or cities
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
以下文本改编自杰罗姆·K·杰罗姆1889年的小说《三个男人划船去说笑话（兼谈狗）》。
我们[人类]是阳光的生物。我们热爱光明和生活。这就是为什么我们挤进城镇和城市，而乡村每年变得越来越荒凉。在阳光下——在白天，当大自然在我们周围充满生机和繁忙时，我们喜欢开阔的山坡和深邃的树林：但是在夜晚，当我们的母亲大地入睡时，留下我们醒着，哦！世界显得如此寂寞，我们变得害怕，像在一个寂静的房子里的孩子一样。然后我们坐下来哭泣，渴望煤气灯下的街道，人类声音的响起，以及人类生活的跳动。
题目解析
在这段文本中，作者表达了人类对阳光和生活的热爱，以及在夜晚感到孤独和恐惧的情感。作者指出人们之所以喜欢拥挤在城镇和城市中，是因为他们喜欢光明和生活，而在乡村每年都变得更加荒凉。在太阳下，人们喜欢开阔的山坡和深林，但在夜晚，当大地沉睡时，世界变得孤独，人们感到害怕，像是在一个寂静的房子里的孩子一样。作者强调了人类对城市环境的偏好，因为那里有人类活动和灯光，使人们感到安慰和安全。因此，选择B)强调了人们选择居住在城市环境的共同特点，是最能反映这段文本的主要目的的选项。

question:
Dubautia waialealae is a species in a family of plants known collectively as the silversword alliance, all of which grow only on the Hawaiian Islands. Members of this alliance exhibit an extraordinary range of phenotypes, with some species maturing into vines and others into shrubs and trees. All species in the alliance descended from a single ancestral tarweed plant that arrived on the islands around 5 million years ago. The tarweed's descendants diversified into distinct species as they adapted to live in the wide variety of habitats found on the Hawaiian Islands.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined phrase in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It lists species from a family of plants found only on the Hawaiian Islands.
B. It provides the common name for the Dubautia waialealae plant.
C. It explains why Dubautia waialealae is unique among members of the silversword alliance.
D. It supplies the name used to refer to a group of related plant species.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
Dubautia waialealae是银剑联盟植物家族中的一种物种，所有这些植物只生长在夏威夷群岛上。这个联盟中的成员展示了一系列非凡的表型，一些物种成熟后会变成藤蔓，而另一些则成长为灌木和树木。这个联盟中的所有物种都是从大约500万年前来到这些岛屿的单一祖先塔尔草植物演化而来的。随着它们适应夏威夷群岛上各种各样的栖息地，塔尔草的后代逐渐分化成了不同的物种。
题目解析
在这段文本中，句子提到了"the silversword alliance"，这是一个植物家族的名称，包括了Dubautia waialealae这个物种。这个短语的作用是给出了这个植物家族的名称，用来指代一组相关的植物物种。因此，选项D) "It supplies the name used to refer to a group of related plant species" 最能描述这个短语在文本中的功能。

question:
Domesticated thousands of years ago by Indigenous people in South America, the potato deviates structurally from the wild plant it is descended from. Summer squash, another crop domesticated by Indigenous Americans, shows so little resemblance to any wild plant that genetic research was necessary to ____ the wild Johnny ground as its ancestor.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
几千年前被南美洲土著人驯化的土豆，在结构上与其野生祖先有所不同。夏季南瓜是另一种由美洲土著人驯化的作物，它与任何野生植物都几乎没有相似之处，因此需要进行基因研究来确定它的野生祖先是何物。
题目解析
这里选择"A) confirm"是因为在句子中，提到了进行基因研究以确认野生植物与夏季南瓜的亲缘关系，因此在这个语境下，confirm（确认）是最符合逻辑和准确的选择。

question:
Text 1
According to a study by a conservation group representing 11 tribal nations in the Great Lakes region, the northern pike (ginoozhe in the Ojibwe language) will have significantly worse outcomes over the next 50 years if temperatures increase as much as some models suggest. By contrast, the white-tailed deer (waawaashkeshi in Ojibwe) should be able to withstand the highest predicted warming without much harm and so likely won't require the conservation efforts that the northern wild pike will.
Text 2
US government agencies involved in conservation are unfortunately not able to address every possible threat to natural resources. They must use the best information available to decide which species are most threatened and therefore most in need of conservation efforts.

Based on the texts, both authors would most likely agree with which statement?
selections: A. A collaborative approach is necessary to keep temperatures in the Great Lakes region from increasing to the highest predicted levels.
B. Agencies involved in natural-resource management in the Great Lakes region should focus their conservation efforts more on the northern pike than on the white-tailed deer.
C. Conservation efforts focused on the northern pike are more likely to be successful if they incorporate state and federal agency resources with the knowledge of tribal groups in those efforts.
D. State, federal, and tribal groups involved in natural-resource management in the Great Lakes region should immediately begin conservation programs for both the northern pike and white-tailed deer.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
文本1
根据代表五大湖地区11个部落国家的一个保护组织的一项研究，如果温度增加达到某些模型所暗示的程度，北梭鱼（Ojibwe语中的ginoozhe）在未来50年将会遭受明显更糟糕的结果。相比之下，白尾鹿（Ojibwe语中的waawaashkeshi）应该能够承受最高预测变暖而不受太大伤害，因此可能不需要像北方野梭鱼那样的保护努力。
文本2
参与保护工作的美国政府机构很遗憾无法应对自然资源面临的每一种可能威胁。他们必须利用现有的最佳信息来决定哪些物种受到的威胁最大，因此最需要保护工作。
题目解析
根据第一段文本，北方梭子鱼可能会在未来50年面临更严重的后果，如果气温上升的幅度达到某些模型所预测的水平。相比之下，白尾鹿可能能够承受最高预测升温而不受太大伤害，因此很可能不需要像北方梭子鱼那样的保护努力。第二段文本提到，美国政府机构参与的自然资源保护不可能应对所有潜在的威胁，他们必须利用最好的信息来确定哪些物种受到威胁最大，因此最需要保护努力。

question:
When classical pianist Martha Argerich performs, it appears as if the music is coming to her spontaneously. She's highly skilled technically, but because of how freely she plays and her willingness to take risks, she seems relaxed and natural. Her apparent ease, however, is due to a tremendous amount of preparation. Despite Argerich's experience and virtuosity, she never takes for granted that she knows a piece of music. Instead, she approaches the music as if encountering it for the first time and tries to understand it anew.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To provide details about how Argerich identifies which pieces of music she will perform
B. To assert that Argerich's performances look effortless because of how she prepares for them
C. To discuss the kinds of music Argerich feels most comfortable encountering for the first time
D. To describe the unique way that Argerich approaches music she hasn't performed before
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
当古典钢琴家玛莎·阿格丽奇演奏时，似乎音乐是自然而然地流露出来的。她在技术上非常娴熟，但由于她演奏时的自由和愿意冒险的态度，她显得轻松自然。然而，她表现出来的轻松实际上是由于大量的准备工作。尽管阿格丽奇经验丰富，技艺高超，但她从不认为自己对一首乐曲了如指掌。相反，她会像是第一次遇到这首音乐一样对待，试图重新理解它。
题目解析
在这段文本中，主要讨论了马莎·阿尔格里希（Martha Argerich）对音乐的独特处理方式。文中提到了她的演奏看起来是不费力的，但实际上是经过了大量的准备。她会像第一次遇见音乐一样对待音乐，尝试重新理解它。

question:
“The Bet” is an 1889 short story by Anton Chekhov. In the story, a banker is described as being very upset about something: ____

Which quotation from “The Bet” most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “Then the banker cautiously broke the seals off the door and put the key in the keyhole.”
B. “It struck three o'clock, the banker listened; everyone was asleep in the house and nothing could be heard outside but the rustling of the chilled trees.”
C. “The banker, spoilt and frivolous, with millions beyond his reckoning, was delighted at the bet.”
D. “When [the banker] got home he lay on his bed, but his tears and emotion kept him for hours from sleeping."
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
《赌注》是安东·契诃夫于1889年创作的短篇小说。故事中，一个银行家被描述为对某事感到非常不安：___
题目解析
在这个问题中，“The Bet”是安东·契诃夫的一部短篇小说，故事中描述一个银行家因某件事情而感到非常沮丧。要找出最有效地说明这一点的引语，我们需要找到揭示银行家情绪状态的线索。选项D中的引语“当[银行家]回家后，他躺在床上，但他的眼泪和情绪让他几个小时无法入睡。”最直接地描绘了银行家的情感困扰和不安，暗示了他受到了某种严重影响或事件的困扰。因此，选项D是最有效地说明银行家感到非常沮丧的引语。

question:
Mariana Lopes Barata and Pedro Simoes Coelho collected data from 324 music-streaming service users to identify factors that influence users to opt for paid (premium) versions of music streaming services, like Spotify. They hypothesized that performance expectancy (how much the use of a service is perceived to benefit the consumer) would be positively correlated with users' intentions to adopt premium versions. The researchers asked participants to rate statements such as “Overall, a paid music streaming service is advantageous.” They found that, indeed, performance expectancy positively influences the intention to adopt premium streaming service versions, which suggests that ____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. users' intentions to pay for premium streaming services are probably unaffected by factors other than performance expectancy.
B. participants who strongly agreed with the statement “Overall, a paid music streaming service is advantageous” were more likely to express loyalty to Spotify than to other streaming services.
C. the statement “Overall, a paid music streaming service is advantageous” is not a reliable measure of performance expectancy.
D. it may be advantageous for music streaming companies to try to influence the extent to which potential users perceive the use of the premium version to be beneficial.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
Mariana Lopes Barata和Pedro Simoes Coelho收集了324名音乐流媒体服务用户的数据，以确定影响用户选择付费（高级）音乐流媒体服务（如Spotify）的因素。他们假设绩效期望（使用服务被认为对消费者有多大好处）与用户采用高级版本的意图呈正相关。研究人员要求参与者对诸如“总体而言，付费音乐流媒体服务是有利的”等陈述进行评分。他们发现，确实，绩效期望积极影响采用高级流媒体服务版本的意图，这表明___。
题目解析
研究发现，性能期望与用户采用高级版本的意向呈正相关，意味着用户对使用高级版本的益处的感知对他们选择是否采用高级版本是有影响的。因此，音乐流媒体公司可以通过影响潜在用户对使用高级版本的益处的感知来增加他们选择采用高级版本的可能性。这与D选项中提到的内容相符，因此D选项最符合逻辑地完整了文本。

question:

B. As Svetlana Boym writes in the seventeenth chapter of her book, “The poethics of nostalgia combines estrangement and human solidarity, affect and reflection.”
C. After outlines the origins and use of the term nostalgia, Svetlana Boym goes on to discuss various skeptics' takes on the concept of nostalgia.
D. Svetlana Boym's The Future of Nostalgia explores the concept of nostalgia from various angles.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下内容：
- 《怀旧的未来》是文学理论家斯维特兰娜·博伊姆（Svetlana Boym）的一本学术著作。
- 这本书从各个角度探讨了怀旧的概念。

在第17章中，博伊姆写道：“怀旧的诗学结合了疏离和人类团结，感情和反思。”
题目解析
这个选项最有效地利用了提供的信息来回答学生的问题。它提到了Svetlana Boym在她的书的第一章中概述了怀旧这个术语的起源和用法，直接回答了学生对于Boym在第一章中写了什么的问题。其他选项虽然提到了Boym的书和怀旧这个概念，但没有直接回答学生的问题，因此选择A是最有效的选项。

question:
Just as the state of Hawaii has a designated state flower, tree, and bird, it also has a state soil: Hilo soil. Hilo is a fitting choice for state soil, in large part because it can be found in abundance across the state. ____ it plays an important role in Hawaii's agricultural industry and is used to grow a variety of crops, like ginger and taro.

explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
正如夏威夷州有指定的州花、树木和鸟类一样，它也有一种州土壤：希洛土壤。希洛土壤是州土壤的合适选择，很大程度上是因为它在整个州内都能大量找到。它在夏威夷农业产业中扮演重要角色，____被用来种植各种作物，如姜和芋。
题目解析
这是因为原句前一句提到Hilo soil是夏威夷的州土壤，因为在整个州都能找到，接着提到它在夏威夷的农业产业中扮演着重要的角色以及被用来种植各种作物。因此，接下来需要一个逻辑过渡词来表明这是一个额外的信息，这个信息进一步支持了Hilo soil作为夏威夷的州土壤的选择。因此，逻辑最合适的选择是D) Additionally。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●The poem “5 love haiku" is by African American writer Sonia Sanchez
●It was published in her 2010 poetry book entitled Morning Haiku.
●The poem is written as a sequence of five haiku.
●According to the book's publisher, Penguin Random House (PRH), the book “celebrates the gifts of life and mourns the deaths of revered African American figures.”
●According to Sanchez, she chose to write in the form of haiku because it helps “maintain memory and dignity."

The student wants to provide an example of a poem from Morning Haiku. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Included in Sanchez's poetry book Morning Haiku (2010),“5 love haiku” is a poem written as a sequence of five haiku.
B. Sanchez chose to write in the form of the haiku because it helps “maintain memory and dignity.”
C. The 2010 poetry book Morning Haiku “celebrates the gifts of life and mourns the deaths of revered African American figures."
D. The poem by Sanchez is written as a sequence of five haiku.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记下了以下笔记：
- 诗歌《5个爱的俳句》是由非裔美国作家索尼娅·桑切斯（Sonia Sanchez）所作。
- 该诗歌发表在她2010年的诗集《晨曦俳句》中。
- 这首诗以五个俳句的形式编写。
- 根据该书的出版商企鹅兰登书屋（PRH）称，这本书“颂扬生命的馈赠，并悼念备受尊敬的非裔美国人物的逝去。”
据桑切斯称，她选择以俳句的形式写作是因为这有助于“维护记忆和尊严”。
题目解析
这个选项最有效地利用了提供的信息来回答学生的问题。它提到了Sonia Sanchez的诗集《Morning Haiku》中包含了一首名为“5 love haiku”的诗，而且说明了这首诗是由五首俳句组成的。其他选项虽然也提到了Sanchez的诗集《Morning Haiku》或者俳句的形式，但没有提供具体的例子，因此选择A是最有效的选项。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●In the 1930s, the Imperial Sugar Cane Institute in India sought to limit the country's dependence on imported sugarcane.
●The institute enlisted botanist Janaki Ammal to breed a local variety of sugarcane.
●She crossbred the imported sugarcane species Saccharum oficinarum with grasses native to India.
●She succeeded in creating sugarcane hybrids well suited to India's climate.

The student wants to emphasize Janaki Ammal's achievement. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. By crossbreeding the imported sugarcane species Saccharum officinarum with grasses native to India, Ammal succeeded in creating sugarcane hybrids well suited to India's climate.
B. In the 1930s, the Imperial Sugar Cane Institute, which enlisted Ammal, sought to limit dependence on imported sugarcane.

在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下内容：

question:

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two dinosaur fossil specimens. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Both the Tyrannosaurus fossil specimen Jane and the Triceratops fossil specimen Fafnir lived in the Late Cretaceous period.
B. While the Tyrannosaurus fossil specimen Jane is inRockford, Minois, the Triceratops fossil specimen Fafnir is in Saint Paul, Minnesota.

explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下内容：
- 世界各地的科学博物馆都可以找到恐龙化石标本。
- 一个被昵称为简（Jane）的恐龙化石标本被收藏在伊利诺伊州罗克福德的伯皮自然历史与文化博物馆（Burpee Museum of Natural History and Culture）。
- 简是一只暴龙，生活在晚白垩纪时期。
- 一个被昵称为法夫尼尔（Fafnir）的恐龙化石标本被收藏在明尼苏达州圣保罗的明尼苏达科学博物馆（Science Museum of Minnesota）。
- 法夫尼尔是一只三角龙，生活在晚白垩纪时期。
题目解析

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●A river's stream length is the length of a line that follows along the river path.
●A river's valley length is the length of a straight line drawn from the beginning of the river to the end.
●The river's curviness, or sinuosity, is the ratio of the river's stream length to its valley length.
●This ratio is less than or equal to 1.5:1 in low-sinuosity rivers and greater than 1.5:1 in high-sinuosity rivers.
●The Fort Nelson River in Canada has high sinuosity.
●The Wadi Al-Hamd River in Saudi Arabia has low sinuosity.

The student wants to compare the sinuosity of the Fort Nelson and Wadi Al-Hamd rivers. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. While the high-sinuosity Fort Nelson River is located in Canada, the Wadi Al-Hamd River is in Saudi Arabia.
B. In both the Fort Nelson and the Wadi Al-Hamd rivers, sinuosity is determined by comparing stream length to valley length.
C. The ratio of the Fort Nelson River's stream length to its valley length is greater than 1.5:1, exceeding that of the Wadi Al-Hamd River.
D. By comparing the stream lengths of the Fort Nelson and Wadi Al-Hamd rivers to their valley lengths, one can calculate their sinuosity.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记下了以下笔记：
- 河流的河道长度是沿着河流路径延伸的一条线的长度。
- 河流的谷长度是从河流起点到终点画出的直线长度。
- 河流的曲折度，或称为弯曲度，是河流的河道长度与谷长度的比值。
- 这个比值在低曲率河流中小于或等于1.5:1，在高曲率河流中大于1.5:1。
- 加拿大的弗特纳尔逊河具有高曲率。
- 沙特阿拉伯的瓦迪·阿尔哈姆德河曲率较低。
题目解析
这个选项最有效地使用了提供的信息来比较Fort Nelson和Wadi Al-Hamd两条河流的曲率。根据笔记中提到的信息，Fort Nelson River的流程长度与山谷长度的比值大于1.5:1，而Wadi Al-Hamd River的比值小于1.5:1，因此选择C是最有效的选项。

question:
Upper Fruitland Chapter is one of the 110 chapters of the Navajo Nation (Naabeehó Bináhásdzo). The chapter, whose boundaries encompass 83,400 acres, ____ known as Doo Alk’aai in the Navajo language (Diné bizaad).

question:
The groundbreaking Negro Ensemble Company (NEC), founded in 1967, produced Paul Cater Harrison's award-winning play The Great MacDaddy in 1974. The company was cofounded by Robert Hooks, an actor, producer, and activist, and actor and playwright Douglas Turner Ward, who had met while performing in a 1960 touring production of Lorraine Hansberry's play A Raisin in the Sun. They shared a vision of a theater company that would nurture and showcase the work of Black theater professionals. Since its beginning, NEC has provided a forum for the voices of Harrison and other Black playwrights through workshops and performances.

According to the text, how did Hooks and Ward initially meet?
selections: A. Harrison introduced Hooks to Ward at a performance of The Great MacDaddy.
B. Hooks and Ward attended the same performance of The Great MacDaddy.
C. Hooks and Ward participated in the same workshop at NEC.
D. Hooks and Ward were both actors in a production of A Raisin in the Sun.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
1967年成立的开创性的黑人团体剧团（NEC）于1974年制作了保罗·卡特·哈里森的获奖剧《The Great MacDaddy》。该剧团由演员、制片人和活动家罗伯特·胡克斯和演员兼剧作家道格拉斯·特纳·沃德共同创立，他们在1960年的“日萨尼亚之夏”巡回演出中相识。他们共同拥有了一个关于培养和展示黑人戏剧专业人士作品的戏剧团体的愿景。自成立以来，NEC通过研讨会和表演为哈里森和其他黑人剧作家的声音提供了一个平台。
题目解析
根据文本，Hooks和Ward最初是在1960年参与罗琳·汉斯贝里的戏剧《太阳升起的地方》巡回演出时相识的。因此，选项D是正确的。

question:
Research such as the 2010 study of fish by Advin Yim-Hol Chan and colleagues has shown that noise from human activity, like traffic on a busy highway, has significant effects on animals, and many governments require studies of the potential noise effects on wildlife before approving highway construction projects. A report on one such study proposed many more actions to mitigate the effects on birds in the area than it did to mitigate the effects on arthropods in the area. Despite the lack of focus on measures specifically for arthropods, conservationists were satisfied that the proposed mitigations were sufficient to protect all the wildlife in the area because ____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the measures aimed at protecting birds will likely also minimize most of the effects on arthropods.
B. the severity of the effects of noise on different species of birds can differ significantly.
C. the effects of noise on birds have been less extensively documented than the effects on arthropods have.
D. the measures intended to protect birds can sometimes have adverse effects on arthropods.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
根据Advin Yim-Hol Chan和同事在2010年进行的研究，表明人类活动产生的噪音，如繁忙公路上的交通，对动物有显著影响，许多政府在批准公路建设项目之前要求进行潜在噪音影响对野生动物的研究。有一份关于这类研究的报告建议采取更多措施来减轻该地区鸟类的影响，而对减轻该地区节肢动物的影响提出的措施较少。尽管缺乏专门针对节肢动物的措施，但保护主义者认为提出的减轻措施足以保护该地区的所有野生动物，因为 ____
题目解析
选项A提出了一个合乎逻辑的解释，指出保护鸟类的措施很可能也会减少对节肢动物的影响。这是因为鸟类和节肢动物在生态系统中通常有相互关联和相互作用的关系。例如，鸟类可能是节肢动物的食物来源，或者它们在同一生态环境中共享资源。因此，采取措施来保护鸟类可能会间接地保护节肢动物，因为减少对鸟类的影响可能会减少对整个生态系统的影响。因此，选项A提供了一个合理的解释，说明为什么即使没有专门针对节肢动物的措施，保护鸟类的措施也可能足以保护整个生态系统中的野生动物。

question:
The minor planet 1061 Paeonia was named after the plant genus that includes peonies. But most minor planets are given only an identification number, both because there are over 500,000 such bodies known at present and because any name chosen needs to be ____ that body: no two minor planets are allowed to have the same name.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
小行星1061 Paeonia的命名是根据含有牡丹花的植物属而得名。但大多数小行星只被赋予一个识别号码，因为目前已知有超过50万个这样的天体，并且因为选择的任何名称都需要与该天体不同：不允许两个小行星拥有相同的名称。
题目解析
在这个句子中，空格处需要填入一个词或短语，以便表达任何被选择的名称都需要与那个天体独一无二，因为不允许两个小行星有相同的名字。在这种情况下，最合适的选择是"exclusive to"（独有于）。因此，选项A）是最合适的选择。

question:
Why do jungle cats purr but leopards roar? Researchers hypothesize that this difference between the two feline species may be partly due to a U-shaped bone in their throats. This bone is called the hyoid. Jungle cats, which are much smaller than leopards, have a rigid hyoid that rumbles when the cat's larynx vibrates, resulting in a purr. By contrast, leopard have a somewhat flexible hyoid, and the bone is attached to the skull with a stretchy ligament that jungle cats lack. These traits allow leopards and most other species of big cats to roar. The same traits may also prevent most big cats from purring.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. The sentence introduces a term that is used in the discussion that follows.
B. The sentence explains the unique nature of the researchers' hypothesis.
C. The sentence summarizes the debate presented in the text.
D. The sentence identifies the location of a bone in felines.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
为什么丛林猫会咕噜咕噜叫，而豹子却会吼叫？研究人员假设这两种猫科动物之间的这种差异部分原因可能是由于它们喉咙中的一个 U 形骨头。这个骨头被称为舌骨。相比豹子，丛林猫要小得多，它们的舌骨是坚硬的，当猫的喉头振动时，舌骨会发出隆隆声，从而产生咕噜声。相比之下，豹子有一个相对灵活的舌骨，这个骨头与头骨通过一根有弹性的韧带连接，而丛林猫却没有这种特质。这些特征使豹子和大多数其他大型猫科动物能够发出吼叫声。同样的特征也可能会阻止大多数大型猫科动物发出咕噜声。
题目解析
在这段文本中，句子“Researchers hypothesize that this difference between the two feline species may be partly due to a U-shaped bone in their throats. This bone is called the hyoid.”引入了一个术语“hyoid”，并且解释了这个骨骼在丛林猫和豹子之间的声音差异中的作用。在接下来的讨论中，将进一步探讨这个术语的重要性，以解释为什么丛林猫会咕噜而豹子会咆哮。因此，这个句子作为引入关键概念的起点，在全文中起着重要的功能。

question:
The following text is adapted from Jean Webster's 1912 novel Daddy-Long-Legs. The narrator is a young college student writing letters detailing her weekly experiences.
[The college is] organizing the Freshman basket-ball team and there's just a chance that I shall make it. I'm little of course, but terribly quick and wiry and tough. While the others are hopping about in the air, I can dodge under their feet and grab the ball.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To compare basketball with other sports
B. To provide details of how to play basketball
C. To state how players will be chosen for the basketball team
D. To explain why the narrator thinks she might make the basketball team
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
以下文本改编自Jean Webster的1912年小说《长腿叔叔》。叙述者是一名年轻的大学生，写信详细描述她每周的经历。
[学校正在]组织新生篮球队，我有机会入选。我当然个子小，但非常敏捷、精力充沛和坚韧。当其他人在空中跳跃时，我可以躲在他们脚下，抢到球。
题目解析
在这段文本中，叙述者描述了她自己在篮球场上的优势，包括她的小个子、敏捷、健壮和灵活。这些都是她相信自己有可能进入篮球队的原因。因此，这段文本的主要目的是解释叙述者为什么认为自己有可能进入篮球队。

A student is using the table as part of a social studies class presentation on the US auto industry in the early twentieth century. The student notes that, according to the table, from 1910 to 1925 ____

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
selections: A. the number of cars produced increased but the number of companies producing cars decreased.
B. both the number of cars produced and the number of companies producing cars remained unchanged.
C. the number of cars produced decreased but the number of companies producing cars remained unchanged.
D. both the number of cars produced and the number of companies producing cars increased.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
一个学生正在利用这张表格作为社会研究课程关于二十世纪初美国汽车工业的演示的一部分。学生指出，根据表格，从1910年到1925年 ____
题目解析
根据表格的数据，我们可以看到从1910年到1925年，汽车产量从600,000辆增加到了2,500,000辆，这表明汽车产量增加了。另一方面，生产汽车的公司数量从245家减少到了85家，这表明生产汽车的公司数量减少了。因此，选项A最有效地利用了表格中的数据，描述了这两个趋势。

question:
In the early 19th century, ships in the British Royal Navy were ranked based on military strength. The system considered the number of a ship's cannons and decks. "First-rate” was the highest ranking, and “sixth-rate" was the lowest ranking, followed by unranked ships. This ranking determined the size of a ship's crew: first-rate ships had between 850 and 875 crewmen, while lower-ranked ships had fewer. Two of the ships in the British Royal Navy from this period were the Dreadnought (98 cannons and three decks) and the Caledonia (120 cannons and three decks). Of these two, only the Caledonia was ranked a first-rate ship. It can therefore be concluded that ____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. not all ships with three decks were ranked as first-rate ships.
B. all ships with at least 98 cannons were ranked as first-rate ships.
C. the Dreadnought had between 850 and 875 crewmen.
D. the Caledonia needed a crew larger than 875 people in order to operate efficiently.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
根据19世纪初英国皇家海军的舰船排名以及舰船的炮数和甲板数来确定，"一等战舰"是最高排名，“六等战舰”是最低排名，其次是未经排名的舰船。这种排名决定了舰船的船员规模：一等战舰的船员在850到875人之间，而排名较低的舰船的船员数量较少。在这个时期英国皇家海军的两艘舰船是“无畏”号（98门炮和三层甲板）和“卡勒多尼亚”号（120门炮和三层甲板）。在这两艘舰船中，只有“卡勒多尼亚”号被评为一等战舰。因此可以得出结论：____
"卡勒多尼亚"号是一等战舰，而“无畏”号不是。
题目解析
在提供的文本中，给出了两艘船的信息：Dreadnought（98门火炮和三层甲板）和Caledonia（120门火炮和三层甲板）。只有Caledonia被评为一等级船只。因此，根据这些信息，我们可以推断不是所有拥有三层甲板的船只都被评为一等级船只。这意味着船只是否被评为一等级不仅取决于甲板数量，还取决于其他因素，例如火炮数量。因此，选项A是最合逻辑的选择，因为它提供了一个合理的结论，即不是所有拥有三层甲板的船只都被评为一等级船只。

question:
Summer is typically thought of as a sweltering season. However, the city of Ljubljana has rather cool summers. There, the average summer temperature ____  just 66.7 degrees Fahrenheit.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard
English?
explanations: 这个句子是一个陈述句，使用现在时态，因此应该使用"is"来完整句子。其他选项中的分号或冒号在这种情况下不符合标准英语语法。

question:
The Card Game is a painting by Jacob Lawrence, dated 1953. It's part of the full collection of the SCAD Museum of Art in Savannah, Georgia. A digital image of it can also be found in an online collection. In a paper, a student claims that people usually spend more time viewing a work of art in a museum than they do online.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the underlined claim?
selections: A. Most people spend about three minutes viewing The Card Game at the museum and only about one minute viewing it online.
B. The Card Game isn't the only work of art by Jacob Lawrence that has been put online.
C. Most people who go to museums in Savannah are visiting from other places.
D. More than one museum has works of art by Jacob Lawrence in its full collection.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
《纸牌游戏》是雅各布·劳伦斯于1953年创作的一幅画作。它是位于乔治亚州萨凡纳SCAD艺术博物馆的完整收藏之一。它的数字图像也可以在网上的收藏中找到。在一篇论文中，一名学生声称人们通常在博物馆里观看艺术作品的时间比在网上观看时更长。
题目解析
选项A提供了一个直接的比较，指出在博物馆里观看《The Card Game》的时间与在线观看的时间之间的差异。这种时间的差异可以被解释为人们更倾向于在博物馆里花更多的时间来欣赏艺术作品，因为他们可能更专注、更投入地观看作品，或者受到周围环境的影响。因此，这个发现直接支持了学生的观点，即人们在博物馆里通常花费更多的时间来观赏艺术作品。

question:
The following text is from Lilliam Rivera's 2020 novel Never Look Back. The text describes the narrator looking around his father's apartment.
Pops's pride and joy is his wall of towering bookshelves. He once said you can tell a man's worth by the number of books he owns. I guess this means Pops is overflowing with riches because ever since I can remember I was never without a book within reach.
©2020 by Lilliam Rivera

As used in the text, what does the word “tell" most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
波普的骄傲和喜悦来自他那高耸的书架墙。他曾经说过，一个人拥有的书籍数量可以反映他的价值。我猜这意味着波普富足无比，因为在我记忆中，我身边总是有书随手可及。
题目解析
在文本中，“tell"一词的意思最接近"judge”（判断）。在这个句子中，Pops认为一个人拥有的书籍数量可以反映出他的价值，因此可以推断出"tell"在这里的意思是"judge"（判断）。

question:
Austria, which, according to international indices, has relatively strong democratic institutions and low international income inequality, experienced an inflation rate of 2.08% in 2017, whereas Cameroon, which shows the opposite pattern on such indices, had an inflation rate of only 0.64% that year. Such a comparison may seem consistent with the theoretical critique that by diluting control over the economy, democratic institutions inhibit states' ability to counteract inflationary pressures, but when Raj Desai et al. examined democratic strength, intranational inequality, and inflation in more than 100 countries, they found that democratic strength, if associated with low inequality, restrains inflationary pressures, which would suggest that ____

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. factors other than the Austria's political structure contributed to the country's inflation rate exceeding that of Cameroon in 2017.

B. the 2017 difference between Austria's inflation rate and Cameroon's inflation rate is primarily but not exclusively attributable to the different levels of intranational income inequality in the two countries.
C. international indices may have underestimated the strength of the Austria's democratic institutions relative to Cameroon's.
D. inflation in the Austria in 2017 would have been higher if the Austria's government had less control over the economy.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
尽管根据国际指数，奥地利的民主制度相对较强，国内收入不平等水平较低，但2017年通货膨胀率为2.08%，而喀麦隆则在同一年的通货膨胀率仅为0.64%。这种比较似乎与理论上的批评一致，即通过削弱对经济的控制，民主制度抑制了国家对抗通货膨胀压力的能力，但是当Raj Desai等人对100多个国家的民主力量、国内不平等和通货膨胀进行研究时，他们发现，如果民主力量与低不平等相关联，会抑制通货膨胀压力，这表明____
题目解析
在文本末尾中提到，100多国的研究发现，民主制度如果与低不平等相联系，会抑制通货膨胀压力。这意味着奥地利当先的通过膨胀是有其它原文的，并非是政治结构的原因。

question:
On February 1, 2018, Florida-based researchers Martha A.Scholl, Maoya Bassiouni, and Angel J. Torres-Sánchez ____ climate data from several sites in Puerto Rico's Luquillo Mountains. At 8:30 a.m, the air temperature was 16°C at site CC1, the site with the highest elevation, and it had shifted to 16.8°C by 11:00p.m.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 动词和宾语间不用符号分割

question:
The arrival of humans to the Americas is thought to have _______ a sudden decrease in biodiversity throughout the continents. Although the extinction of species like the toxodon was likely the result of a combination of factors, from decreasing food sources to habitat destruction, most of these factors can be directly tied to the presence of humans.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
人类抵达美洲被认为导致了整个大陆生物多样性的突然减少。尽管像巨剑齿兽这样的物种灭绝很可能是多种因素的结果，从食物来源减少到栖息地破坏，但大多数这些因素都可以直接与人类的存在联系起来。
题目解析
在这个题目中，文本提到了人类到达美洲后导致了生物多样性的急剧减少。我们需要选择一个词来填空，以描述人类到达美洲所导致的结果。让我们分析一下每个选项：导致选择caused。

question:
Animals use many objects as tools to achieve goals more easily. Such goals include grooming, finding food, and protecting themselves. For a long time, people thought tool use was unique to primates. Octopuses and other animals, though, have busted the myth that tool use requires hands. Inventively, octopuses use two halves of a seashell to provide protection or a place to hide. Greater vasa parrots also get creative. They use date pits to grind seashells into calcium powder.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Unlike primates, octopuses are exceptionally skillful at using different tools.
B. There are many myths about tool use that researchers are starting to challenge.
C. Animals find it difficult to use objects as tools.
D. Contrary to long-held beliefs, primates aren't the only animals to use tools.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
动物利用许多物体作为工具，以更轻松地实现目标。这些目标包括梳洗、寻找食物和保护自己。长期以来，人们认为使用工具是灵长类动物独有的特征。然而，章鱼和其他动物打破了工具使用需要手的神话。章鱼巧妙地利用两半贝壳来提供保护或藏身之处。大维萨鹦鹉也非常有创造力。它们利用椰枣核将贝壳磨成钙粉。
题目解析
这个文本的主要目的是表明长期以来人们对于只有灵长类动物能够使用工具的观念是错误的。文本提到了章鱼和鹦鹉等其他动物也展示了使用工具的能力，这打破了人们的观念。因此，选项D表达了这个主要观点，即与长期以来的信念相反，灵长类动物并不是唯一会使用工具的动物。

question:
In eastern Mexico, Monument 61 and Monument 1 are the names given to two massive human head statues that were left behind by the ancient Olmec civilization. Both statues are made of stone and are extremely heavy. ____ they each weigh more than 5 tons!

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在墨西哥东部，纪念碑61和纪念碑1是古老奥尔梅克文明遗留下来的两座巨大人头雕像的名称。这两座雕像都是由石头制成，非常沉重。事实上，它们每个重量都超过5吨！
题目解析
选项C) "In fact,"是最合适的过渡词。在这个句子中，前后两个句子之间是一种因果关系，第一句提到这两座雕像是巨大的人头雕像，第二句解释了这种巨大的程度，所以使用"In fact,"作为过渡词是最合适的。其他选项在这个语境中并不适用：
选项A) "In any case,"并不直接引导解释或证明前面提到的内容。
选项B) "Earlier,"指示时间顺序，但在这个句子中并不符合语境。
选项D) "Instead,"则表明对比，而不是解释或证明前面提到的内容。

question:
In 1929, Edwin Herbert Land invented a polarizing filter that was featured in a number of products, from sunglasses to 3D movies. A decade later, Land ____ his technology to invent the world's first instant camera, the Polaroid Land camera.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard
English?
explanations: 在这句子中，我们需要填入一个动词来表明在过去Land使用了他的技术来发明世界上第一台即时相机。因此，正确的选择是"used"，它是过去时的动词形式，符合句子的时态要求。

question:
Included in Every Day: Selections from the Collection, a 2019 group exhibition at the Baltimore Museum of Art in Maryland, was the work of multimedia artist Lorna Simpson. The impact of Simpson's work is ____ the horizons of conceptual photographic art, challenging conventional notions of race, gender, history, and memory, and shedding light on the experience of African American women in contemporary society.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard
English?
explanations: threefold前是完整的句子，threefold后是expanding... challenging ... ,and shedding 的并列语，需要冒号引出

question:
●Ynés Mexía was a Mexican American botanist.
●Between 1917 and1938, she collected over 150,000 botanical samples throughout the Americas.
●She collected a sample of Achyrocline vauthieriana in Minas Gerais, Brazil,on May 3, 1930.
●She collected a sample of Vernonia liatroides in Jalisco, Mexico, on February14, 1927.
●These specimens are members of the Asteraceae family.
●They can now be viewed online at the C.V. Starr Virtual Herbarium.

Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize when she collected both of the samples?
selections: A. Thousands of botanical samples collected by Ynés Mexía can now be found in one place: online at the C.V. Starr Virtual Herbarium.
B. On May 3 in 1930, Ynés Mexía added a new specimen to her growing collection of botanical samples: Achyrocline vauthieriana of the Asteraceae family.
C. While both specimens collected by Ynés Mexía are members of the same family, Achyrocline vauthieriana was found in Minas Gerais and Vernonia liatroides was found in Jalisco.
D. Ynés Mexía collected a sample of Achyrocline vauthieriana in May of 1930, after collecting Vernonia liatroides in February of 1927.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
- Ynés Mexía是一位墨西哥裔美国植物学家。
- 从1917年到1938年，她在整个美洲收集了超过15万个植物样本。
- 她于1930年5月3日在巴西米纳斯吉拉斯州收集了一份Achyrocline vauthieriana样本。
- 她于1927年2月14日在墨西哥哈利斯科州收集了一份Vernonia liatroides样本。
- 这些标本属于菊科植物家族。
- 现在可以在C.V. Starr虚拟标本馆在线查看它们。
题目解析
选项D) 最有效地利用了给定句子中的信息来强调Ynés Mexía采集这两个样本的时间。第一句提到了Ynés Mexía是一个植物学家，第二和第三句提到了她分别在1930年5月和1927年2月采集了两个样本，最后一句提到这两个样本都是菊科植物。因此，选项D)强调了她在1927年2月收集了Vernonia liatroides样本后，在1930年5月收集了Achyrocline vauthieriana样本的时间顺序。
其他选项在这个语境中并不适用：
选项A)提到了Ynés Mexía收集了成千上万的植物样本，但并没有强调她收集这两个特定样本的时间。
选项B)描述了她在1930年5月收集Achyrocline vauthieriana的样本，但没有提到她之前在1927年2月收集了Vernonia liatroides的样本。
选项C)提到了这两个样本属于同一科，但没有强调她收集这两个样本的具体时间。

question:
In his essay “Of Friendship," French philosopher Michel de Montaigne explores a relatively light subject, but he addresses heavier fare in “Of the Uncertainty of Our Judgment." Regardless of subject matter, Montaigne works to question his own perspective throughout his essays. ____ his personal motto was “What do I know?”

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在他的论文《论友谊》中，法国哲学家米歇尔·德·蒙田探讨了一个相对轻松的主题，但在《论我们判断的不确定性》中，他处理了更沉重的内容。无论是哪个主题，蒙田都在他的论文中努力质疑自己的观点。他的个人座右铭是“我知道什么？”
题目解析
选项A) "Fittingly,"是最合适的过渡词。在这个句子中，前后两个句子之间是一种因果关系，第一句提到Montaigne在不同的文章中探讨了轻松的和沉重的主题，但无论主题如何，他都努力质疑自己的观点。因此，使用"Fittingly,"作为过渡词是最合适的，因为它暗示这种质疑态度与Montaigne的个人座右铭相符。其他选项在这个语境中并不适用：
选项B) "Conversely,"用于表达对比，但在这个语境中并不合适。
选项C) "Nowadays,"用于引导当前情况或时代，但在这个句子中并不合适。
选项D) "Still,"用于表达转折或相反的情况，但在这个语境中并不合适。

question:
In forecasting weather events, meteorologists sometimes discuss the role of atmospheric rivers. What are atmospheric rivers, and how ____ Part of the water cycle, atmospheric rivers are narrow channels of moisture moving through the atmosphere. In certain conditions, these “rivers” can release some of their moisture as precipitation.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. do they affect our weather.
B. they do affect our weather.
C. do they affect our weather?
D. they do affect our weather?
explanations: 逗号+and连接两个疑问句。疑问词+助动词是疑问句语序，需要用问号结尾。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Documentary TV programs in the slow TV genre consist of uninterrupted broadcasts of ordinary events in real time.
●All Aboard! The Sleigh Ride (running time: 2 hour) is a British slow TV program that aired in 2015.
●It documented a sleigh ride along an arctic postal route.
●Monsen: Minutt for Minutt (running time: 5 hours) is a Norwegian slow TV program that aired in 2020.
●It documented a hike from Stigstuv to Rauhelleren in Norway.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two TV programs. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. A prime example of the slow TV genre can be seen in All Aboard! The Sleigh Ride， a 2-hour British TV documentary program documenting a sleigh ride along an arctic postal route.
B. While All Aboard! The Sleigh Ride depicts a sleigh ride along an arctic postal route, Monsen: Minutt for Minutt depicts a hike from Stigstuv to Rauhelleren in Norway.
C. Compared to the 5-hour-long Monsen: Minutt for Minutt, the slow TV program All Aboard! The Sleigh Ride is relatively short, at 2 hours.
D. Documenting ordinary events in real time, All Aboard! The Sleigh Ride and Monsen: Minutt for Mintt are both documentary programs in the slow TV genre.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下内容:
- 慢电视类型的纪录片电视节目由连续不断的实时播放普通事件组成。
- 《All Aboard! The Sleigh Ride》（播放时长：2小时）是一部英国慢电视节目，于2015年播出。
- 它记录了一次沿着北极邮路的雪橇之旅。
- 《Monsen: Minutt for Minutt》（播放时长：5小时）是一部挪威慢电视节目，于2020年播出。
- 它记录了一次从Stigstuv到Rauhelleren的挪威徒步旅行。
题目解析
选项D)最有效地突出了这两个电视节目之间的相似之处。它强调了它们都是以实时记录普通事件为特点的慢电视纪录片节目。这个选项利用了给定笔记中提到的关键信息，直接对两个节目进行了比较，突出了它们的共同特点。
其他选项在这个语境中并不适用：
选项A)提供了有关《All Aboard! The Sleigh Ride》的信息，但没有与《Monsen: Minutt for Minutt》进行比较。
选项B)提到了两个节目各自记录的事件，但没有强调它们的共同特点。
选项C)比较了两个节目的长度，但没有直接涉及它们的共同特点。

question:
In 2014, Nestor Gomez won his first-ever storytelling competition, relating a tale about his life as a Guatemalan immigrant living in Chicago. ____ in 2017, Gomez created the show 80 Minutes Around the World as a platform for others to share stories about their immigration experiences.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
2014年，内斯托·戈麦斯赢得了他有生以来的第一个讲故事比赛，讲述了他作为一名居住在芝加哥的危地马拉移民的生活故事。然后在2017年，戈麦斯创作了节目《环游世界80分钟》，作为一个平台，让其他人分享他们的移民经历故事。
题目解析
选项C) "Later,"是最合适的过渡词。在这个句子中，第一句提到2014年Nestor Gomez赢得了他的第一个讲故事比赛，第二句提到了2017年Gomez创建了一个节目，为他人分享他们的移民经历提供平台。因此，使用"Later,"作为过渡词是最合适的，因为它暗示了第一件事情之后发生的事情。其他选项在这个语境中并不适用：
选项A) "Instead,"表明对比，而不是时间顺序。
选项B) "For example,"用于举例，但在这个语境中并不合适。
选项D) "In other words,"用于解释或澄清前面提到的内容，但在这个句子中并不合适。

question:
F. Julius LeMoyne was an outspoken abolitionist whose Pennsylvania home was a stop on the underground railroad (the network of people and places that some enslaved people used to escape to freedom). It was relatively rare for supporters of the railroad to be secretive about their antislavery views. ____ they were vocal abolitionists like LeMoyne.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
F. Julius LeMoyne是一位直言不讳的废奴主义者，其位于宾夕法尼亚州的住所是地下铁路的一个站点（一些被奴役的人利用此网络逃往自由的人和地点）。对于支持地下铁路的人来说，他们对于自己的反奴隶制观点保持保密相对较为罕见。___他们像勒莫因一样是直言不讳的废奴主义者。
题目解析
选项C) "More often,"是最合适的过渡词。在这个句子中，第一句提到LeMoyne是一个坦率的废奴主义者，他的家是地下铁路的一个站点。第二句提到支持地下铁路的人很少对他们的反奴隶制观点保密。使用"More often,"作为过渡词是最合适的，因为它暗示与LeMoyne相反情况经常发生。其他选项在这个语境中并不适用：
选项A) "Fittingly,"适用于在两个相关事实之间建立联系，但在这个语境中并不合适。
选项B) "Granted,"用于表达让步或同意，但在这个句子中并不合适。
选项D) "For example,"用于举例，但在这个语境中并不合适。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●In astronomy, the mass of stars can be described in units called solar masses.
●One solar mass is roughly equal to the mass of the Sun.
●The mass of the star Proxima Centauri is 0.122 solar masses.
●The mass of the star Sirius A is 2.063 solar masses.

The student wants to emphasize the mass of Sirius A. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The mass of stars, like Proxima Centauri, can be described in units called solar masses.
B. In astronomy, the mass of stars can be described in units called solar masses, and one solar mass is roughly equal to the mass of the Sun.
C. The Sun is more massive than Proxima Centauri, which has a mass of 0.122 solar masses.
D. With a mass of 2.063 solar masses, Sirius A is more massive than the Sun.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下内容:
- 在天文学中，星体的质量可以用太阳质量单位来描述。
- 一个太阳质量大约等于太阳的质量。
- Proxima Centauri恒星的质量为0.122太阳质量。
- Sirius A恒星的质量为2.063太阳质量。
题目解析
选项D) 最有效地利用了给定的信息来强调天狼星A的质量。给定的笔记中提到了太阳的质量，以及Proxima Centauri和Sirius A的质量与太阳质量的关系。选项D)直接比较了Sirius A的质量（2.063太阳质量）与太阳的质量，强调了它比太阳更加庞大。
其他选项在这个语境中并不适用：
选项A)提到了Proxima Centauri，但没有直接与Sirius A进行比较。
选项B)提到了太阳的质量，但没有突出Sirius A的质量。
选项C)提到太阳比Proxima Centauri更重，但没有涉及到Sirius A。
