question:
In Tutelo, an Indigenous language from the Mid-Atlantic region of what is now the United States, okayeke means “bad,” whereas ati okayeye’ tesel means “bad houses.” This phenomenon, in which an element of a root word is repeated, sometimes with modification, within another word that is related to the root word, is called reduplication. In this case, the element “ye” in okayeke gets repeated in ati okayeye’ tesel. There are many examples of this type of reduplication in Tutelo.

The text makes which point about the Tutelo word ati okayeye’ tesel?
selections: A. It doesn’t have a clear equivalent in English.
B. It is identical in meaning to several other words in Tutelo.
C. It contains a repetition of the element “ye” in okayeke.
D. It is the only word in Tutelo that uses reduplication.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在图特洛语中（一种源自当前美国中大西洋地区的土著语言），okeke的意思是“坏”，而ati okayeye’ tesel的意思是“坏房屋”。在这种现象中，一个词根中的元素会在与该词根相关的另一个词中重复出现，有时还会做出修改，这种现象被称为重复。在这个例子中，在okeke中的元素“ye”在ati okayeye’ tesel中被重复出现。在图特洛语中有许多这种重复的例子。
题目解析
在文本中，作者提到了Tutelo语中的reduplication现象，即一个词的元素在与该词相关的另一个词中被重复，有时会进行修改。在这个例子中，元素“ye”在okeke中被重复并出现在ati okayeye’ tesel中。因此，正确答案是C，因为ati okayeye’ tesel包含了okeke中的元素“ye”的重复。

question:
Desolation Island, first published in 1978, is a novel in Patrick O’Brian’s Aubrey/Maturin series, which includes twenty completed books. Some critics have found fault with the abrupt ending of Desolation Island and other books in the series, saying that they do not finish conclusively but arbitrarily stop. Other critics, however, argue that the books should not be thought of as discrete texts with traditional beginnings and endings but as a single incredibly long work, similar to other multivolume stories, such as John Galsworthy’s The Forsyte Saga.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Critics have differing views regarding the efficacy of the structures of the novels in the Aubrey/Maturin series.
B. Some critics think the Aubrey/Maturin series should have the literary renown of The Forsyte Saga, while others disagree.
C. The unusual structure that O’Brian uses for Desolation Island makes it one of his most intricate books.
D. Many critics judge the Aubrey/Maturin novels to be remarkably entertaining despite flaws in the novels’ structures.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
《荒凉岛》是帕特里克·奥布莱恩的奥布莱/马图林系列小说中第一次出版于1978年的小说，该系列共有二十本完成的书。一些评论家批评《荒凉岛》和该系列中的其他书的突然结局，称它们并没有得到圆满结束，而是随意中断。然而，其他评论家则认为这些书不应被视为具有传统开头和结尾的独立文本，而是像约翰·高斯华斯的《福尔赛家族》等其他多卷故事一样，被看作是一个极其长的单一作品。
题目解析
在文本中，作者提到了一些评论家对《Desolation Island》和其他奥布莱恩的奥布莱/马图林系列小说的结尾有所批评，认为它们结束得突然而不完整，停顿也较武断。另一方面，还有一些评论家认为这些书不应被视为传统的有着明确开始和结束的独立文本，而应被看作是一部极其长的单一作品，类似于约翰·高尔斯华绥的《弗尔赛特家族》。因此，选项A中提到了评论家对于奥布莱恩的奥布莱/马图林系列小说结构有效性的不同看法，这反映了文本所讨论的核心观点。

question:
Indigenous Photograph is an organization whose mission is to ensure that images of Indigenous peoples in the media are presented from Indigenous perspectives. The organization _______ this commitment by promoting the works of artist Melody Charlie (Ahousat) and other prominent Indigenous photographers who document reflect Indigenous lives and experiences.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
原住民摄影组织是一个旨在确保媒体中的原住民形象从原住民角度呈现的组织。该组织通过推广艺术家梅洛迪·查理（阿胡萨特人）等知名原住民摄影师的作品来体现这一承诺，这些摄影师记录并反映了原住民的生活和经历。
题目解析
在这个句子中，需要一个动词来描述组织如何表现其承诺。在这种情况下，"shows"是最合适的选项，因为它指示组织通过推广Melody Charlie等艺术家的作品来展示其承诺。这个词强调了组织通过实际行动来证明其致力于确保媒体中对土著人的形象是从土著视角呈现。其他选项如"precedes"（在......之前）"concludes"（结束）"explains"（解释）在这个上下文中则不太合适。

question:
President Richard Nixon is most famous for his participation in the 1970s Watergate political scandal, a convoluted tale of criminality and eroded ethics involving a constellation of associates such as Attorney General Richard Kleindienst and Secretary of State Henry Kissinger. But Nixon’s legacy is complex: he has been praised for his role in affirming the sovereignty of tribal nations, and he once made an attempt at reforming United States health care policy that is arguably a precursor to the Affordable Care Act, which became law during the Barack Obama administration.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It compares the achievements of three historical figures to a fourth that is mentioned later in the text.
B. It describes a common perception of a historical figure that is challenged by information presented later in the text.
C. It states a claim about a historical figure that supported by evidence later in the text.
D. It presents an accomplishment of a historical figure whose significance is detailed later in the text.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
尼克松总统最著名的事迹是他参与了上世纪七十年代的水门事件政治丑闻，这是一个涉及到包括司法部长理查德·克莱因代斯特和国务卿亨利·基辛格在内的一系列合伙人的犯罪和道德败坏的复杂故事。但尼克松的遗产是复杂的：他因肯定部落国家的主权而受到赞扬，他曾试图改革美国的医疗政策，这在某种程度上可以看作是奥巴马政府期间通过的《平价医疗法案》的前身。
题目解析
这道题目中，它陈述了关于历史人物理查德·尼克松的复杂遗产，提到了他在肯定部落国家主权方面的作用，以及他曾试图改革美国的医疗保健政策。这句话为和前面的丑闻水门事件相反。

question:
Orientation of Paired Leaves in Grapevines and Related Species
Many plants have leaves that are larger on one side of their long central axis than the other, a phenomenon known as asymmetrical orientation. University of California, Berkeley biologist Ciera Martinez and colleagues examined several species of grapevines and closely related plants, which have leaves that grow in pairs, to see if both leaves in a pair tend to be oriented toward the same side (that is, have more tissue on the same side) or not. They found that opposite-side orientations are more common than same-side orientations, though the ratios can vary by species. This variation can be seen in the table, where ratios range from ___________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the assertion?
selections: A. 2.30 to 1 in Ampelopsis glandulosa to 4.22 to 1 in Vitis vulpina.
B. 1.50 to 1 in Vitis palmata to 4.22 to 1 in Ampelopsis glandulasa.
C. 9 to 1 in Ampelopsis glandulosa to 47 to 1 in Vitis vulpina.
D. 27 to 1 in Vitis palmata to 165 to 1 in Vitis acerifolia.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在加利福尼亚大学伯克利分校的生物学家Ciera Martinez和同事们研究了几种葡萄藤和密切相关的植物物种，这些植物的叶子生长成对，看看一对叶子是否倾向于朝向同一侧（即，在同一侧有更多组织）或不是。他们发现，相反方向的定向比相同方向的定向更常见，尽管各个物种间的比例可能有所不同。这种变化可以在表格中看到，比例范围从___________。
题目解析
这道题目要求选择一个选项，用表中的数据来有效地完成句子。根据题目描述，研究人员观察了几种葡萄藤和密切相关的植物的叶子对是否朝向同一侧的现象，他们发现对立面的朝向比同一侧的朝向更为常见，尽管比例会因物种而异。因此，答案应该提供一些具体的数据，让读者了解不同物种之间的比例变化。
ratios range 要填写数据的范围，根据图表是1.50到4.22，分别对应着Vitis palmata和Ampelopsis glandulasa.两种植物。B选项提供了具体的数据支持，清晰地展示了不同物种之间的比例变化.

question:
“The Monster” is an 1898 story by Stephen Crane. In the story, the character of Jim, a young boy, accidentally damages a peony (a flower) in the yard while his father is tending to the lawn. Crane depicts the dedication and care with which his father typically cares for his lawn, writing, ____________

Which quotation from “The Monster” most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “[Jim’s father] paused, and with the howl of the machine no longer occupying the sense, one could hear the robins in the cherry trees arranging their affairs.”
B. “[Jim] went on to the lawn, very slowly, and kicking wretchedly at the turf. Presently his father came along with the whirring machine, while the sweet, new grass blades spun from the knives.”

C. “[Jim’s father] was shaving this lawn as if it were a priest’s chin. All during the season he had worked at it in the coolness and peace of the evenings after supper. Even in the shadow of the cherry trees the grass was strong and healthy.”
D. “The father reflected. After a time he said, ‘Jimmie, come here.’ With an infinite modesty of demeanor the child came forward.”
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
“《怪物》是斯蒂芬·克雷恩（Stephen Crane）于1898年创作的一则故事。在故事中，一个名叫吉姆的年轻男孩在父亲整理院子时不小心损坏了一株牡丹花。克雷恩描绘了他父亲通常对草坪的细心呵护和关爱，写道，__________”
题目解析
在这个题目中，要找到最有效地展示Crane描述Jim的父亲如何细心呵护草坪的引述。在文本中，提到了Jim的父亲如何像“剃神父的下巴”一样精心修剪草坪，这显示了他对草坪的热爱和专注。因此，选项C“[Jim’s father] was shaving this lawn as if it were a priest’s chin. All during the season he had worked at it in the coolness and peace of the evenings after supper. Even in the shadow of the cherry trees the grass was strong and healthy.”最有效地展示了这一点，符合题目要求。

question:
The following text is adapted from Anton Chekhov’s 1904 play The Cherry Orchard (translated by Julius West in 1916).
TROFMOV: Believe me, Anya, believe me! I’m not thirty yet, I’m young, I’m still a student, but I have undergone a great deal! I’m as hungry as the winter, I’m ill, I’m shaken... and where haven’t I been-fate has tossed me everywhere!

As used in the text, what does the word “undergone” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
TROFMOV：相信我，安妮娅，相信我！我还没有三十岁，我年轻，我还是个学生，但我经历了很多！我饥肠辘辘如同冬天，我病了，我动摇不安……我去过哪里了，命运把我抛到了各个地方！
题目解析
在这个上下文中，"undergone"一词表明主人公已经经历过一些困难或挑战，因此"endured"（忍受、承受）是最接近的意思。在这句话中，主人公正在描述自己所经历的困难和磨难，表明自己曾经历过很多，这与"endured"的含义相符。

question:
Previous research has shown that plant species with a narrow geographical range tend to be more generically homogeneous than plant species with extensive ranges are. Based on these findings, researchers recently ran simulations to predict how the genetic variation of several species of Mammillaria, a genus of cactus found throughout the Anterens, might change in different distribution conditions. One of these species. M. evermanniana, is found only in the state of Baja California Sur. The researchers simulated what would happen if M.evermanniana spread to new habitats outside Baja California Sur, and, consistent with previous findings, the results showed that _______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. Mammillaria species other than M.evermanniana would become more common in Baja California Sur.
B. there was a gradual increase in the genetic homogeneity of Mamunillaria species in states neighboring Baja California Sur.
C. the genetic homogeneity of M. evermanniana decreased over time.
D. several other Mammillaria species could survive in Baja California Sur in the future.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
先前的研究表明，地理分布范围狭窄的植物物种通常比分布范围广泛的植物物种更具有遗传同质性。基于这些发现，研究人员最近进行了模拟实验，以预测穿刺仙人掌属（Mammillaria）中几种物种的遗传变异在不同分布条件下可能会如何变化。其中一种物种M. evermanniana，仅分布于下加利福尼亚州。研究人员模拟了如果M. evermanniana扩展到下加利福尼亚州之外的新栖息地会发生什么情况，并且与先前的发现一致，结果显示_______
题目解析
在这个情境下，研究人员基于之前的研究结果，运用模拟来预测Mammillaria属的几个物种在不同分布条件下的遗传变异情况。由于M. evermanniana是仅在Baja California Sur州发现的物种，而其他物种可能具有更广泛的分布范围，根据之前的研究，这些具有较窄地理分布范围的物种往往具有更高的遗传同质性。因此，当模拟M. evermanniana扩展到Baja California Sur州之外的新栖息地时，根据前提，研究人员预计M. evermanniana的遗传同质性将会降低，因为该物种将与其他物种进行交叉繁殖，导致遗传杂交和变异的增加。
因此，根据研究的设计和之前的相关研究结果，选项C最为合适，因为它描述了M. evermanniana的遗传同质性会随着时间的推移而降低，符合研究的逻辑和背景。

question:
Annual Average Hours of Highway Traffic Delay per Auto Commuter
The college course on urban affairs, a student asserts that increased traffic congestion in the 1990s in the United States was present both in very large cities such as New York City, New York, and smaller areas such as Allentown-Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, and Beaumont Texas; though those smaller areas may have been less affected by traffic congestion than very large cities, this congestion also worsened in them over time.

Which choice best describes data from the graph that support the student’s claim?
selections: A. While the number of hours of traffic delay per commuter per year was always lower in the Allentown Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, area than in the New York City, New York, area for each year between 1990 and 2000, the amount of traffic delay rose in both areas during this period.
B. Throughout the period between 1990 and 2000, the annual amount of traffic delay per commuter was greater in the Allentown-Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, area than in the New York City, New York, area.
C. In 1992, the amount of traffic delay in the New York City, New York, area was less than 30 hours per commuter per year.
D. In at least one of the three urban areas shown, the amount of traffic delay was less than 20 hours per person per year at one point between 1990 and 2000.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
每位汽车通勤者每年的平均高速公路交通延误小时数
在城市事务课程上，一名学生声称在1990年代，美国不仅在大城市如纽约市，纽约州，以及较小地区如宾夕法尼亚州的阿伦敦-伯利恒和得克萨斯州的博蒙特等地出现了交通拥堵问题；尽管这些较小地区可能受到的交通拥堵影响较小于大城市，但随着时间的推移，这种拥堵问题在这些地区也逐渐加剧。
题目解析
在题目中提到，学生声称1990年代美国交通拥堵情况加剧，不仅在大城市如纽约市，也在较小地区如Allentown-Bethlehem, Pennsylvania和Beaumont Texas出现。尽管这些较小地区受交通拥堵影响可能不如大城市那么严重，但随着时间的推移，这种拥堵情况也在这些地区恶化。
选项A指出了在1990年至2000年期间，Allentown-Bethlehem, Pennsylvania地区的交通延误时间总是低于纽约市，但两个地区的交通延误时间都在这段时间内增加。这表明即使在较小的地区，交通拥堵情况也在加剧，与学生的说法相符。因此，选项A是最好描述数据支持学生说法的选项。

question:
The Museum of Modern Art (MOMA) in New York City has an exhibition of video games that includes Pac Man from 1980, which museum visitors can play on site, and The Sirs from 2000, which visitors can see only in a video presentation. MOMA claims the video presentations are only for games that would be impractical to display in a playable form, but video games are an inherently interactive medium, a feature that is grossly absent in a video-only presentation

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It provides a claim about video games as art that both MOMA and the author accept as true.
B. It identifies a feature of many video games that is not shared by some of the games included in MOMA’s exhibition.
C. It describes a misconception about video games that the author believes is evident in MOMA’s choice about which video games to exhibit.
D. It presents a consideration that the author thinks partly undermines MOMA’s approach to exhibiting video games.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
纽约市现代艺术博物馆（MOMA）举办了一个视频游戏展览，其中包括1980年的《吃豆人（Pac Man）》，博物馆参观者可以现场玩，以及2000年的《The Sirs》，观众只能通过视频展示看到。MOMA声称视频展示仅适用于那些以可玩形式展示不切实际的游戏，但视频游戏是一种固有的互动媒介，这一特征在仅有视频展示中严重缺失。
题目解析
选择D是最佳答案，因为划线句子表达了作者对MOMA展示视频游戏的方式的批评。作者认为视频游戏是一种互动媒介，而在仅有视频展示的情况下，这种互动特征是缺失的。因此，作者认为MOMA的选择在某种程度上削弱了展示视频游戏的效果。这种批评性的观点表明划线句子在整个文本中的功能是提出了作者对MOMA展示视频游戏方式的一种考虑。

question:
The emphasis on accurately representing the experiences of average working people that is characteristic of the realist style can be seen in TheThird-Class Carriage, painted by Honord Durnier, which depicts working-class travelers in a third-class railway car. This style can thus be seen as an effort to _______ what were regarded as the excesses of the romantic style evident in many paintings by Eugene Emmanuel Amaury Pineux Duval, which instead exaggerated their subjects’ beauty or heroism while hiding all imperfection.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
强调准确描绘普通劳动人民经历的现实主义风格的特点可以在奥诺雷·杜米埃的作品《三等车厢》中看到，该作品描绘了三等铁路车厢中的工人阶级旅客。因此，这种风格可以被视为一种努力，来________弗朗索瓦·埃曼纽尔·欧仁·阿莫里·皮纳尔·迪瓦尔所创作的许多作品中所体现的浪漫主义风格的过度，后者夸大了他们的主题的美丽或英雄主义，同时隐藏了所有的缺陷。
题目解析
这题应该选择 B. counteract
在这个句子中，描述了现实主义风格强调准确描绘普通工人的经历，而这种风格可以在Honoré Daumier的作品《Third-Class Carriage》中看到，该作品描绘了一个三等车厢中的工人旅客。句子的后半部分提到了浪漫主义风格的夸张，这与现实主义形成了对比。因此，应该选择一个词来表示现实主义风格是对浪漫主义风格的一种抵制或对抗。在这种情况下，"counteract"（抵消）是最合适的选择。其他选项如"understand"（理解）"advance"（推进）"accentuate"（强调）则不符合句子的语境。

question:
Biologist Rosanno Alegado believes that we might learn how multicellular organisms developed from single-celled ones if we understand why the single-celled organism Selpingoeca rosetta, the oldest living relative of animals, sometimes forms colonies of cells. Alegado and colleagues reviewed data from many studies of how S.rosetta responds when exposed to another type of single-celled organism, bacteria, including Tristan Barbeyron’s work with Zobellia galactonovorans bacteria and Jongsik Chun’s work with Algoriphagus mannitolivorans bacteria. Alegado and colleagues concluded that both Z. galactonovorans and A. mannitolivorans might have played a role in the development of multicellular organisms.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support Alegado and colleagues’ conclusion?
selections: A. A. Barbeyron and Chun found that S.rosetta tended to form colonies after bacterial exposure.
B. Barbeyron found that S. rosetta tended to form colonies after bacterial exposure, but Chun did not.
C. Neither Barbeyron nor Chun found that S. rosetta tended to form colonies after bacterial exposure.
D. Chun found that S. rosetta tended to form colonies after bacterial exposure, but Barbeyron did not.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
生物学家罗桑诺·阿莱加多（Rosanno Alegado）认为，如果我们了解为什么单细胞生物Selpingoeca rosetta（动物的最古老的亲属）有时会形成细胞群，我们可能会了解多细胞生物是如何从单细胞生物进化而来的。阿莱加多和同事们回顾了许多关于S.rosetta暴露于另一种单细胞生物——细菌时的反应的研究数据，包括Tristan Barbeyron对Zobellia galactonovorans细菌和Jongsik Chun对Algoriphagus mannitolivorans细菌的研究。阿莱加多和同事们得出结论，Z. galactonovorans和A. mannitolivorans可能在多细胞生物的发展中发挥了作用。
题目解析
选项A最直接支持Alegado和同事的结论，原因如下：
1. 选项A指出Barbeyron和Chun的研究结果表明，S.rosetta在暴露于细菌后倾向于形成细胞群。这与Alegado和同事的结论直接相关，因为他们认为Z. galactonovorans和A. mannitolivorans可能在多细胞生物的发展中发挥了作用。
2. 如果Barbeyron和Chun的研究结果都表明S.rosetta在暴露于细菌后倾向于形成细胞群，这将进一步加强Alegado和同事的结论，支持他们认为这些细菌可能有助于多细胞生物的发展这一观点。
因此，选项A最直接支持Alegado和同事的结论，因为它提供了与他们观点直接相关的研究发现。

question:
Although fewer companies trade their stocks on the Casablanca Stock Exchange in Casablanca Morocco, than on the stock exchanges in London, Mumbai, or Tokyo, the Casablanca Stock Exchange has the advantage of being able to _________relatively small companies in Morocco: by connecting those companies to investors with expertise about the country’s economic conditions, the Casablanca Stock Exchange can help those companies thrive.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
原住民摄影组织是一个旨在确保媒体中的原住民形象从原住民角度呈现的组织。该组织通过推广艺术家梅洛迪·查理（阿胡萨特人）等知名原住民摄影师的作品来体现这一承诺，这些摄影师记录并反映了原住民的生活和经历。
题目解析
在这个句子中，需要一个动词来描述卡萨布兰卡证券交易所如何帮助摩洛哥的相对小型公司。在这种情况下，"nurture" 是最合适的选项。这个词表示支持和促进某物的增长或发展，与句子描述的卡萨布兰卡证券交易所通过将这些公司与了解该国经济状况的投资者连接起来来帮助这些公司茁壮成长的意思相符合。其他选项如"designate"（指定）"preclude"（阻止）"assess"（评估）在这个上下文中则不太合适。

question:
Cane is a 1923 novel by Jean Toomer. In one portion of the novel, Toomer uses figurative language to connect the narrator’s urban environment of Washington, DC, and the rural South of the narrator’s past, writing,  ________

Which quotation from Cane most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “the young trees had not outgrown their [planter] boxes then. V Street [in Washington, DC] was lined with them.”
B. “And when the wind is from the South, soil of my homeland falls like a fertile shower upon the lean streets of [Washington, DC].”
C. “The [train] engines of this valley have a whistle, the echoes of which sound like iterated gasps and sobs. I always think of them as crude music.”
D. “I sang, with a strange quiver in my voice, a promise-song.”
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
《Cane》是让·图默（Jean Toomer）于1923年创作的一部小说。在小说的某一部分，图默使用比喻的语言来连接叙述者所处的城市环境华盛顿特区和叙述者过去的南方乡村，写道，________
题目解析
这句话有效地展示了Toomer在小说《Cane》中通过比喻来连接叙述者所处的城市环境和他过去的乡村南部环境的方式，主要体现在以下几点：
1.比喻的形象性：这句话中使用了比喻，将风从南方吹来的情景比作叙述者祖国的土壤像肥沃的雨一样洒落在华盛顿特区的瘦弱街道上。这种形象生动地表达了叙述者内心对家乡的眷恋之情。
2.对比的效果：通过将叙述者的祖国土壤与华盛顿特区的城市环境进行对比，展示了叙述者内心的矛盾和迷茫感。这种对比营造了一种独特的情感氛围，帮助读者更好地理解叙述者的心理状态。
3.连接城市与乡村：这句话巧妙地将城市环境和乡村家园联系起来，通过自然元素（风和土壤）的比喻，创造了一种联系城市与乡村的意象，突出了叙述者内心深处对家园的思念和对城市环境的异化感。
因此，选项B最有效地展示了Toomer在小说《Cane》中使用比喻来连接叙述者城市环境和乡村南部环境的手法。

question:
In what is now New Mexico, the Pueblo of Pojoaque operates the Poeh Cultural Center. Relying on traditional knowledge to guide the design of exhibits, this institution presents Pojoaque history and culture to the tribe's citizens. The Choctaw Nation, a tribe in Okiahoma, employs a similar strategy in its own cultural center. Both centers contrast with museums that aren't Indigenous-led; when displaying Indigenous artifacts, such museums tend to anticipate mainly non Indigenous audiences and rely on Euro-centric strategies for designing exhibits.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It encourages tribal citizens to attend their local cultural center.
B. It explains how one tribal cultural center differs from other tribal cultural centers.
C. It suggests improvements to a particular tribal cultural center.
D. It provides a basic description of a particular tribal cultural center.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在现在的新墨西哥州，波霍瓦克普韦勒村庄经营着波埃文化中心。凭借传统知识来指导展览设计，这个机构向部落的公民展示波霍瓦克的历史和文化。位于奥克拉荷马州的乔克托民族，在其自己的文化中心采用类似的策略。这两个中心与非土著领导的博物馆形成对比；在展示土著文物时，这些博物馆往往主要预期非土著观众，并依赖于欧洲中心的展览设计策略。
题目解析
这题中，划线句子描述了文化中心在设计展览时使用传统知识的做法，而不是非土著领导的博物馆通常采用的欧洲中心化策略。

question:
Over the years, dozens of architectural and archaeological sites important to Hawaiian history and culture—such as Grove Farm, Kilauea School, and the Pu ‘u ‘opae Bridge—have been added to an important ________ Hawai ‘i Register of Historic Places. New sites are added each year, as decided by a review board of experts including sociologist Alion Okinaka, architect Katie Stephens, and historian Bill Souza.

Brothers Andre and Edound Michshin sought to increase profits for their tire company by encouraging their customers to drive across France, visiting the guide's recommended hotels and ________ as it grew in scope and influence, the guide had its modest French eateries replaced with the best restaurants from around the world, including Ultraviolet in Shanghai and Gaon in Seoul.

question:
The Underdogs is a 1915 novel by Mariano Azuela, originally written in Spanish. In the novel, a group of soldiers travel through a canyon, where their collective mood becomes strongly affected by the strenuous conditions of their journey:______

Which quotation from a translation of The Underdogs most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “The sierra is clad in gala colors. Over its inaccessible peaks the opalescent fog settles like a snowy veal on the forehead of a bride.”
B. “All day long [the soldiers] rode through the canyon, up and down the steep, round hills, dirty and bald as a man's head, hill after hill in endless succession.”
C. “Then, hurriedly, [the soldiers] took the Juchipila canyon northward, without halting to rest until nightfall.”
D. “The sun, beating down upon [the soldiers], dulled their minds and bodies and presently they were silent.”
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
《The Underdogs》是马里亚诺·阿苏埃拉于1915年创作的小说，最初是用西班牙语写成的。在小说中，一群士兵穿越一个峡谷，他们的集体情绪受到旅程艰难条件的强烈影响：________。
题目解析
在题干中，我们需要选择一个能够最有效地展示士兵在峡谷旅行中情绪受到影响的引语。让我们来分析一下选项D为什么是最佳选择：
选项D中的引语“太阳照射在士兵身上，使他们的身心变得迟钝，不久他们就安静下来。”直接描述了太阳对士兵身心的影响，说明了这种影响如何让他们变得沉默。这个引语清晰地表达了旅行条件对士兵情绪的影响，突出了他们在旅行中面临的困难和艰辛，以及这些困难如何影响了他们的情绪状态。因此，选项D最能有效地支持题干中关于士兵情绪受到影响的主张。

question:
Text 1
Attempts to automate classification of music into genres have not been very successful, and we may be at the limit of what is technologically possible. But it's not clear that this is a worthwhile pursuit in any case-as jin Ha Lee and Anh Thu Nguyen argue in their study of the South Korean band BTS, relationships between pieces of music may be best understood with concepts other than genre.
Text 2
Tango is a genre of music originally from Argentina and Uruguay that shares some harmonic and rhythmic similarities with the pagode genre. Automated genre classification systems typically struggle to draw distinctions in situations like this, but Yandre Costa and colleagues solved that problem by converting sound to images and having computers compare features of those images, an approach that demonstrates how much innovation is possible in this field.

Based on the texts, how would the author on Text 2 most likely respond to the claim in the underlined sentence of Text 1?
selections: A. By arguing that people tend to disagree when identifying genre classification for music
B. By suggesting that the concept of genre may become more useful for music listeners
C. By criticizing previous research into automated music genre classification for favoring specific genre categories
D. By asserting that it may be possible to improve automated classification systems
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
文本1
尝试将音乐自动分类为流派并不十分成功，也许我们已经达到了技术上的极限。但无论如何，这是否值得追求并不清楚——正如金哈利（Jin Ha Lee）和阮安清（Anh Thu Nguyen）在对韩国乐队BTS的研究中所争论的那样，音乐之间的关系可能最好用与流派不同的概念来理解。
文本2
探戈是起源于阿根廷和乌拉圭的一种音乐流派，与巴戈德流派有一些和谐和节奏上的相似之处。自动流派分类系统通常在这种情况下难以区分，但亚德雷·科斯塔（Yandre Costa）和同事通过将声音转换为图像，并让计算机比较这些图像的特征来解决了这个问题，这种方法展示了在这个领域中有多少创新是可能的。
题目解析
根据文本2中提到的情况，作者讨论了Yandre Costa和同事采用一种创新方法解决自动音乐类型分类系统难以区分类别的问题。通过将声音转换为图像，并让计算机比较这些图像的特征，他们成功地克服了困难。这表明作者认为在自动音乐类型分类系统方面仍然存在改进的可能性，并且可以通过创新的方法来实现这一点。因此，作者最有可能对文本1中提到的困难问题表示，可能可以通过改进现有系统来解决。因此，选项 D) "By asserting that it may be possible to improve automated classification systems" 更符合文本2中的内容和作者的观点。

question:
The Caves of Gargas paintings—stencils of human hands found in what is now France and dating from around 27,000 years ago—are thought of as art today, but the question of whether the people of the time understood the paintings as something akin to art in our modern sense or in some other way entirely is _____: we will never be able to answer it.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
加尔加斯洞窟的手印绘画，发现于今法国地区，可追溯至约27,000年前。如今被视为艺术作品，但当时的人们是否将这些绘画理解为类似于我们现代意义上的艺术，抑或以完全不同的方式理解，这个问题是无法解决的：我们永远无法回答。
题目解析
在这个句子中，作者提出了一个问题，即关于古代人是否把Gargas洞穴的手印画看作类似于现代的艺术，还是以其他方式理解。然而，作者指出这个问题是"irresolvable"，即不可能解决或回答的。因为这个问题发生在约27,000年前，我们无法直接了解当时人们的想法和观念，因此无法确定他们对这些画的理解。这种情况下，这个问题就会永远无法解决或回答，因此 "irresolvable" 是最符合语境和逻辑的选项。

question:
The 2000 production of the Green Bird Was the first Broadway show for which Constance Hoffman was credited as a costume designer. Hoffman was among the Broadway costumed designers interviewed by Sara jabion-Roberts and Eulanda A. Sanders for their study of historical accuracy in costume design for shows with a historical setting. They found that even designers who value historical accuracy will often include contemporary design elements that don't fit with the historical period. In a research paper about theatrical costume design, a student argues that costume designers for modern productions of Shakespeare’s A Midsummer Night’s Dream (set in ancient Greece) sometimes include such elements unintentionally.

Which quotation from an interview with a costume designer would most effectively support the student's claim?
selections: A. “I tend to pay careful attention to a character’s accessories like gloves, hats, and jackets, These elements help communicate information about how this person would have fit into society at the time.”

B. “I aim to create a clear sense of the character and the world they inhabit, Sometimes this means adhering to the historical period’s style, but frequently, as in stagings of A Midsummer Night’s Dream, some flexibility is required to communicate an idea to the audience.”
C. “Costumes must always reflect the correct historical period. Too often, I’ve seen costumes that borrow from a wide span of periods, resulting in a production with a confusing visual style.”

D. “In the 1980s I was costuming for a production of A Midsummer Night’s Dream. Even though I focused on using the correct materials and techniques for the play’s period in history. When I look back I can clearly see the influence of 1980s fashion in my designs.”
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
《绿鸟》2000年的制作是康斯坦斯·霍夫曼首次被认可为服装设计师的百老汇秀。霍夫曼是百老汇服装设计师中被萨拉·贾比安-罗伯茨和尤兰达·A·桑德斯采访的一员，他们研究了历史背景设定的剧目中服装设计的历史准确性。他们发现，即使重视历史准确性的设计师，也往往会加入与历史时期不符的当代设计元素。在一篇关于戏剧服装设计的研究论文中，一名学生争辩说，为现代版本的莎士比亚《仲夏夜之梦》（设定在古希腊）设计服装的设计师有时会无意中包含这样的元素。
题目解析
文本最后的结论是：即便designer重视historical accuracy，但是也会不小心出现contemporary design element。这样的D选项中恰好说明在A midsummer night中不小心服装带有了80年代的风格，支持原文的观点

question:
With his widely celebrated portraits of poet Seamus Heaney, molecular biologist Struther Arnott, and other prominent figures in different fields, British painter Peter Edwards has ______ substantial prestige as an artist.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
在为诗人西默斯·希尼（Seamus Heaney）、分子生物学家斯特鲁瑟·阿诺特（Struther Arnott）和其他不同领域的知名人物创作的广受赞誉的肖像画中，英国画家彼得·爱德华兹已经________作为一位艺术家的重要声誉。
题目解析
在这个句子中，提到了英国画家彼得爱德华兹通过他的广受赞誉的肖像作品，包括描绘诗人西默斯·希尼、分子生物学家斯特拉瑟·阿诺特等知名人物，赢得了作为艺术家的重要声誉。根据句子的语境，画家彼得爱德华兹通过他的杰出作品获得了显著的声誉。
在这种情况下，"achieved" 是最合适的词语。"Achieved" 表示取得、获得，这里指的是画家彼得爱德华兹通过其杰出的作品赢得了重要的声誉。选项C）"achieved" 最符合句子的语境，描述了彼得爱德华兹作为艺术家所取得的声誉。因此，"achieved" 是最合乎逻辑和语境的选项。

question:
The following text is adapted from William Wordsworth's 1798 poem. “Lines Written a Few Miles above Tintern Abbey.”
Once again
Do behold these steep and lofty cliffs
Which on a wild secluded scene impress
Thoughts of more deep seclusion: and connect
The landscape with the quiet of the sky.

As used in the text, what does the word “deep” most nearly mean?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
以下文本改编自威廉·华兹华斯1798年的诗歌《在滕特恩修道院上方的几英里路上写的一行》。
再次
看这些陡峭而高大的悬崖
在一片荒凉幽静的景色中给人留下深邃孤寂的思绪，并将
风景与宁静的天空联系在一起。
题目解析
在这首诗中，"deep" 这个词用来修饰 "seclusion"，意为"深度的隐居"，指的是一种更深层次的隐居感。诗中描述了高耸险峻的悬崖，给人一种深邃、深远的隐居感觉，这种感觉与天空的宁静相互联系。在这个句子中，"deep" 的意思是指一种深刻、强烈的隐居感，而非其他描述如"tough"（困难的）、"hideous"（丑陋的）、"complicated"（复杂的）。因此，"deep" 在这里最接近的含义应该是"intense"（强烈的、深刻的）。

question:
Eden Robinson is a novelist and a member of the Haisia Nation in western Canada. Critics and fellow writers have praised her work for combining traditional Haisia stories with popular genres of literature, such as fantasy and mystery fiction. But Robinson is not the only Indigenous writer to blend traditional stories with popular literature. In the 2019 novel Empire of Wild, Cherie Dimaline successfully blended the oral storytelling tradition of her people, the Metis, with horror fiction.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To discuss two writers who blend traditional indigenous stories with popular genres
B. To urge younger Indigenous authors to avoid writing in popular genres
C. To argue that traditional Indigenous stories are more memorable than most novels are
D. To explain why one Indigenous author has achieved more success than another has
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
伊丹·罗宾逊（Eden Robinson）是一位小说家，也是加拿大西部海西亚族的成员。评论家和作家们赞扬她的作品，因为她将传统的海西亚故事与流行文学类型，如奇幻小说和悬疑小说相结合。但罗宾逊并不是唯一一位将传统故事与流行文学相融合的土著作家。在2019年的小说《Wild帝国》中，謝里·迪马林（Cherie Dimaline）成功地将她的民族梅蒂斯人的口头讲故事传统与恐怖小说相结合。
题目解析
这题选项 A) "To discuss two writers who blend traditional indigenous stories with popular genres" 是最符合文本的主旨的选择，原因如下：
1. 文本开头明确提到了两位作家 Eden Robinson 和 Cherie Dimaline，并介绍了她们的背景和作品。
2. 文本主要讨论了这两位作家如何将传统的土著故事与流行文学体裁相结合，而非呼吁年轻的土著作者避免使用流行文学体裁、争论传统土著故事是否比大多数小说更令人难忘，或者解释为什么一个土著作者比另一个取得更多成功。
3. 文本的内容主要围绕这两位作者的作品展开讨论，强调了她们如何将传统土著故事和流行文学体裁相结合，而不是对作者之间的成功进行比较或提倡年轻作家避免使用特定体裁。因此，选项 A) 最准确地概括了文本的主旨

question:
US Hydroelectric Power Plants, 2019
A run-of-river hydroelectric power plant, as the name suggests, uses the natural flow of a water source to generate electricity but is unable to start or stop that flow through its generators. In contrast, a peaking hydroelectric power plant (used when demand for electricity peaks) controls the flow of water through its generators: starting flow when demand is high enough, stopping it when demand is too low, and otherwise regulating it to keep pace with changing electricity needs.  Although peaking plants do not typically operate continuously as run-of-river plants do, peaking plants can generate more megawatt-hours of power per year (MWh/yr) than some run-of-river plants. For example, the ______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the example?
selections: A. average power generated annually by the Great Falls plant is higher than that generated by any of the run-of-river plants in the table.
B. Scanlon plant, which is a run-of-river plant, has more generators than any of the other plants in the table.
C. run-of-river plant with the highest average annual power generation in the table generates more electricity than the peaking plant with the highest annual power generation in the table.
D. average power generated annually by the Kansas River plant is higher than that generated by the Scanlon plant.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
根据名称，常规河水发电厂利用水源的自然流动来发电，但无法通过其发电机启动或停止流动。相比之下，峰值水电站（在电力需求达到峰值时使用）通过其发电机控制水流量：当需求足够高时启动流量，当需求过低时停止流量，并通过其他方式调节以跟上不断变化的电力需求。尽管峰值电厂通常不像常规河水发电厂那样连续运行，但峰值电厂每年可以产生比一些常规河水发电厂更多的兆瓦时电能（MWh/yr）。例如，______。
题目解析
选项average power generated annually by the Great Falls plant is higher than that generated by any of the run-of-river plants in the table.是因为它直接比较了表格中年发电量最高的 run-of-river plant 根据文章中提到的信息，尽管 peaking plants 不像 run-of-river plants 那样连续运行，但它们可以产生更多的电力。因此，选项A提供的比较正好支持了这一点。

question:
Horses and barn owls can see in three dimensions (3D), which helps them perceive distance and depth. Octopuses and squid are thought to lack 3D vision. Many researchers once thought the same about cuttlefish, but Trevor Wardill and his team wanted to test whether this assumption was true. The team studied how cuttlefish wearing 3D glasses reacted to 3D images of shrimp (a favorite prey) projected on a tank wall. Cuttlefish changed their striking position to match the 3D images, suggesting that their vision is more like that of horses and barn owls than that of octopuses or squid.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Researchers have long known that horses and barn owls can see in 3D.
B. Cuttlefish are surprisingly similar in structure to octopuses and squid.
C. Contrary lo what many researchers had assumed, cuttlefish may be able to see in 3D.
D. The ability to see in 3D allows many animals to interact with one another.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
马和猫头鹰能够看到三维空间（3D），这有助于它们感知距离和深度。据信，章鱼和乌贼缺乏3D视觉。许多研究人员曾认为乌贼也是如此，但特雷弗·沃迪尔（Trevor Wardill）及其团队想要测试这一假设是否正确。该团队研究了戴着3D眼镜的乌贼对投影在水槽墙上的虾（一种喜爱的猎物）的3D图像做出的反应。乌贼改变了它们的攻击位置以匹配3D图像，表明它们的视觉更像马和猫头鹰，而不是章鱼或乌贼。
题目解析
在文本中，提到了许多研究人员过去认为乌贼可能缺乏3D视觉能力，但Trevor Wardill及其团队想要测试这一假设是否属实。团队对戴着3D眼镜的乌贼对着墙壁上投影的虾的3D图像做出反应进行了研究。结果显示，乌贼改变了自己的攻击位置以匹配3D图像，这表明他们的视觉更像马和仓鸮，而不像章鱼或鱿鱼。因此，文本主要表达了与许多研究人员过去的假设相反，乌贼可能具有3D视觉能力的观点。因此，选项C) Contrary to what many researchers had assumed, cuttlefish may be able to see in 3D. 最好地概括了文本的主要内容。

question:
In a 2012 study in the United States, Michael F. Berndt and Travis K.Bavin found a positive association between levels of dissolved organic carbon and mercury in bodies of fresh water. Many other studies have yielded similar results, suggesting to some scientists that this association is true for all bodies of fresh water. But much of that research has been conducted at broadly similar sites in North America, and when Seam Noh and colleagues examined bodies of fresh water in South Korea, they found a negative association between dissolved organic carbon levels and mercury levels. If similar findings emerge from other locations outside North America, that could suggest that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the mercury levels reported in Noh and colleagues’ study were much higher than those reported in the study by Berndt and Bavin even though the dissolved organic carbon levels reported in the two studies were approximately the same.
B. Berndt and Bavin may have inadvertently measured a different characteristic of bodies of fresh water than their levels of dissolved organic carbon and mercury.

C. the relationship between dissolved organic carbon and mercury reported by Berndt and Bavin reflects conditions that are characteristic of certain kinds of ecosystems in North America rather than universal conditions.
D. most of the studies conducted in North America have measured dissolved organic carbon and mercury levels at a higher level of precision than was the case in Noh and colleagues' study.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
这可能表明在不同地理位置的淡水体系中，溶解有机碳水平与汞水平之间的关联并非普遍存在。这表明先前的研究结果可能受到地理和环境因素的影响，而不是普遍适用于所有淡水体系。这种差异性的研究结果表明了需要更广泛的研究来了解不同地区之间溶解有机碳和汞之间的关系，以更全面地理解这一问题。
题目解析
在文中提到，许多研究表明溶解有机碳水平与淡水体中的汞水平之间存在正相关关系，这些研究结果导致一些科学家认为这种关联对所有淡水体都适用。然而，当Noh和他的同事在韩国的淡水体中进行研究时，他们发现溶解有机碳水平与汞水平之间存在负相关关系。这表明在不同地区可能存在不同的结果，而不是所有淡水体都符合相同的关联。因此，选择C）the relationship between dissolved organic carbon and mercury reported by Berndt and Bavin reflects conditions that are characteristic of certain kinds of ecosystems in North America rather than universal conditions. 提供了一个合理的解释，即Berndt和Bavin所报道的溶解有机碳和汞之间的关系可能只反映了北美某些生态系统的特定条件，而不是普遍条件。这个解释解释了为什么在南韩的研究中发现了与北美研究不同的结果。因此，选择C是最合乎逻辑的。

question:
In order to identify research trends, Shirley Ann Williams et al. reviewed a collection of studies of the social media website Twitter, such as the 2011 paper by Celik et al. titled “Learning Semantic Relationships between Entities in Twitter,” Williams's team searched for the term “Twitter” on the Scopus and Web of Science databases and found that, though most papers returned by the search did in fact focus on the social media platform, a few discussed unrelated subjects such as sounds made by tractor engines. One reasonable explanation for this result is that it occurred because ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. a group of researchers had an extensive discussion on Twitter about the design of tractor engines.
B. most of the papers in the Scopus and Web of Science databases do not discuss automotive engines or social media websites.
C. the word “twitter” may not always refer to a social media website, but to other subjects such as noises made by machines.
D. academics who are active on social networks are likely to announce their recent publications on Twitter.
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
这个结果发生的一个合理解释是因为搜索引擎可能会返回包含与搜索关键词（如“Twitter”）相关的文档，但实际上这些文档可能并不直接涉及到研究社交媒体平台Twitter。这种搜索结果的混淆可能源于搜索引擎算法的限制或数据库中的标签或索引问题。因此，一些看似不相关的主题可能会在搜索结果中出现，尽管并不符合研究团队的实际研究兴趣。
题目解析
选择C）the word “twitter” may not always refer to a social media website, but to other subjects such as noises made by machines. 这个选项最合乎逻辑地完成了文本，因为它提供了一个合理的解释：搜索结果中出现与Twitter无关的论文的原因可能是因为“twitter”一词并非总是指社交媒体网站，而可能指其他主题，比如机器发出的声音。在这种情况下，一些论文可能会讨论与Twitter无关的主题，导致搜索结果中出现了这些不相关的论文。因此，这个选项提供了一个合理的解释，解释了为什么会在搜索结果中出现与Twitter无关的论文，使得它成为最合乎逻辑的选择。

question:
The following text is adapted from Adlb Khorram’s 2018 novel Darius the Great Is Not Okay. Darius, a teenager from the United States, is visiting his family members in Iran.
I dozed and floated on the clouds of Farsi that blew my way from the front seat of Dayi [Uncle] Jamsheed’s SUV.
It remained me of when I was little, and Mom chanted to me in Farsi every night before bedtime. It’s hard to describe Farsi chanting: the way Mom drew her voice out like the notes of a cello as she recited poems by Rumi or Hafez. I didn’t know what they meant, but that didn’t matter. It was quiet and soothing.
© 2018 by Adlb Khorram

Based on the text, what does the narrator mainly remember about the times when his mother chanted to him?
selections: A. That he liked the characters in the stories his mother made up while chanting
B. That his mother had music playing in the background while she chanted
C. That his mother didn't usually chant at night
D. That he found the sound of his mother's chanting to be calming
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
以下文本改编自阿德尔·霍拉姆（Adib Khorram）2018年的小说《大流士不好》。达里乌斯，一个来自美国的十几岁少年，正在伊朗拜访他的家人。
我打盹，漂浮在从贾姆希德大叔的SUV前座吹来的波斯语云雾中。
这让我想起小时候，妈妈每晚在睡前用波斯语向我吟诵。很难描述波斯语的吟诵方式：妈妈像拉奏大提琴的音符一样拉长声音，当她背诵鲁米或哈菲兹的诗歌时。我不知道它们的意思，但那并不重要。它是安静而舒缓的。
题目解析
在文本中，主人公描述了他小时候母亲用波斯语吟诵诗歌的情景，他提到自己并不了解母亲吟诵的诗歌内容，但这并不重要，因为这种吟诵方式让他感到宁静和舒缓。他描述了母亲吟诵的声音如同大提琴音符一样拉长，这种方式让他感到放松。因此，根据文本内容，可以得出结论，主人公主要记得母亲吟诵声音让他感到宁静和舒缓。因此，选项 D) That he found the sound of his mother's chanting to be calming 是最符合文本的描述和主人公的记忆的。

question:
Whether the reign of a French monarch such as Louis Ⅶ or Henry V was historically consequential or relatively uneventful, its trajectory was shaped by questions of legitimacy and therefore cannot be understood without a corollary understanding of the characteristic without which the monarch would have been forced to ______ the throne.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
题目文本中文翻译
无论是法国国王路易七世还是亨利五世的统治在历史上是具有重大影响还是相对平淡，它的轨迹都受到合法性问题的影响，因此如果没有一种特征，君主将不得不________宝座，因此没有办法理解。
题目解析
在这个句子中，作者提到君主的统治轨迹是由合法性问题塑造的，因此，要理解君主的统治，就必须理解一个特征，如果没有这个特征，君主将不得不放弃王位。合法性对于君主的统治至关重要，因为它确保了君主的合法性和权威性。如果一个君主没有合法性，他就无法维持统治，可能会面临反抗和推翻。因此，如果一个君主没有合法性，他可能会被迫放弃王位。
在这种情况下，"abandon"是最合适的词语，因为它指的是主动放弃、放弃权力或地位。如果君主没有合法性，他可能会被迫放弃王位，因为他无法有效地维持统治。因此，"abandon"是最能体现句子逻辑和意义的选项。
