question:
Known for her massive photorealistic paintings of African American figures floating or swimming in pools, Calida Garcia ______ was the logical choice to design the book cover for Ta-Nehisi Coates’s The Water Dancer, a novel about an African American man who can travel great distances through water.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 连贯表达。在主句中，Calida Garcia Rawles是主语，后面紧跟着动词was，主谓之间不需要加标点符号，选项D正确。

question:
The following text is adapted from Jack London’s 1903 novel The Call of the Wild. Buck is a sled dog living with John Thornton in Yukon, Canada.
Thornton alone held [Buck]. The rest of mankind was as nothing. Chance travellers might praise or pet him; but he was cold under it all, and from a too demonstrative man he would get up and walk away. When Thornton’s partners, Hans and Pete, arrived on the long-expected raft, Buck refused to notice them till he learned they were close to Thornton; after that he tolerated them in a passive sort of way, accepting favors from them as though he favored them by accepting.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Buck has become less social since he began living with Thornton.
B. Buck mistrusts humans and does his best to avoid them.
C. Buck has been especially well liked by most of Thornton’s friends.
D. Buck holds Thornton in higher regard than any other person.
explanations:
A.中文解析
D是最佳答案，因为它最准确地陈述了文本的主要观点。文本首先确立了巴克将大多数人视为“无足轻重”的观点，然后解释说，除非其他人对桑顿表现出友好，否则巴克不会承认他们，即使是这样，他也只是勉强接受。因此，文本集中讨论了桑顿在巴克心中具有特殊地位的想法，巴克比其他人更尊重他。
B.题目文本解析
以下文本改编自杰克·伦敦于1903年创作的小说《野性的呼唤》。巴克是一只雪橇狗，与约翰·桑顿一起生活在加拿大育空地区。
桑顿独自拥有[巴克]。其他人类对他来说毫无价值。偶然经过的旅行者可能会赞美或抚摸他；但他内心却是冷漠的，如果一个太过热情的人，他会站起来走开。当桑顿的伙伴汉斯和皮特如期抵达，坐着长期等待的筏子时，巴克拒绝注意他们，直到他得知他们靠近桑顿；之后，他以一种被动的方式容忍他们，接受他们的好意，好像他接受了他们的好意一样。

question:
The Souls of Black Folk is a 1903 book by W.E.B. Du Bois. In the book, Du Bois suggests that upon hearing Black folk songs, he felt an intuitive and sometimes unexpected sense of cultural recognition: ______

Which quotation from The Souls of Black Folk most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “[Black folk music] still remains as the singular spiritual heritage of the nation and the greatest gift of the Negro people.”
B. “Ever since I was a child these songs have stirred me strangely. They came out of the South unknown to me, one by one, and yet at once I knew them as of me and of mine.”

C. “Caricature has sought again to spoil the quaint beauty of the music, and has filled the air with many debased melodies which vulgar ears scarce know from the real. But the true Negro folk-song still lives in the hearts of those who have heard them truly sung and in the hearts of the Negro people.”
D. “The songs are indeed the siftings of centuries; the music is far more ancient than the words, and in it we can trace here and there signs of development.”
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择B是最佳答案，因为《黑人的灵魂》中的引文说明了杜波依斯在听到黑人民歌时感到文化认同的感受。在引文中，杜波依斯解释说，整个人生中，黑人民歌“奇怪地激起了他的情感”。即使这些歌曲起源于他不熟悉的南方地区，他却认为这些歌曲“属于我和我的人们”。也就是说，他与这些歌曲有着强烈的认同感，并将它们与自己的社区联系在一起。因此，杜波依斯在听到黑人民歌时感到一种直观的文化认同感。

question:
The following text is adapted from Karel Čapek’s 1920 play R.U.R. (Rossum’s Universal Robots), translated by Paul Selver and Nigel Playfair in 1923. Fabry and Busman are telling Miss Glory why their company manufactures robots.
FABRY: One Robot can replace two and a half workmen. The human machine, Miss Glory, was terribly imperfect. It had to be removed sooner or later.
BUSMAN: It was too expensive.
FABRY: It was not effective. It no longer answers the requirements of modern engineering. Nature has no idea of keeping pace with modern labor.

As used in the text, what does the word “answers” most nearly mean?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案，因为在文本中，“answers”最接近于“fulfills”的意思。在文本中，法布里（Fabry）和布斯曼（Busman）声称，他们公司制造的机器人比人类工人更有效率，他们将人类工人称为“人类机器”。法布里观察到，人类机器“不再满足现代工程的要求”，也就是说，人类工人无法满足现代工业化工作场所的严格需求。
B.题目文本解析
以下文字改编自卡雷尔·恰佩克（Karel Capek）于1920年创作的戏剧《R.U.R.》（罗瑟姆的通用机器人），由保罗·塞尔弗（Paul Selver）和奈杰尔·普莱费尔（Nigel Playfair）于1923年翻译。法布里和布斯曼正在告诉格洛丽小姐为什么他们公司制造机器人。
法布里：一个机器人可以取代两个半工人。格洛丽小姐，人类机器非常不完善。它迟早会被淘汰。
布斯曼：太昂贵了。
法布里：不够有效。它不再满足现代工程的要求。自然并不考虑跟上现代劳动力的步伐。

question:
Geographer Adebayo Oluwole Eludoyin and his colleagues surveyed small-scale farmers in three locations in Ondo State, Nigeria—which has mountainous terrain in the north, an urbanized center, and coastal terrain in the south—to learn more about their practices, like the types of crops they mainly cultivated. In some regions, female farmers were found to be especially prominent in the cultivation of specific types of crops and even constituted the majority of farmers who cultivated those crops; for instance, ______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the example?
selections: A. most of the farmers who mainly cultivated cereals and most of the farmers who mainly cultivated non–root vegetables in south Ondo were women.
B. more women in central Ondo mainly cultivated root crops than mainly cultivated cereals.
C. most of the farmers who mainly cultivated non–root vegetables in north and south Ondo were women.
D. a relatively equal proportion of women across the three regions of Ondo mainly cultivated cereals.

question:
Some economic historians ______ that late nineteenth- and early twentieth-century households in the United States experienced an economy of scale when it came to food purchases—they assumed that large households spent less on food per person than did small households. Economist Trevon Logan showed, however, that a close look at the available data disproves this supposition.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择A是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地完成了文本对19世纪末至20世纪初家庭食物购买的讨论。在这个背景下，“surmised”意味着在很少证据的情况下形成了一个想法或假设。文本解释说，某些经济历史学家“假定”大家庭和小家庭在每人食物消费上的支出不同，但另一位经济学家根据现有数据的证据发现这个假设是错误的。这个背景表明，经济历史学家未经足够考虑证据就做出了错误的假设。
B.题目文本解析
一些经济历史学家认为，19世纪末至20世纪初的美国家庭在食物购买方面呈现规模经济效应——他们假设大家庭在每人食物支出上比小家庭少。然而，经济学家特雷文·洛根表明，仔细查看现有数据可以证明这个假设是错误的。

question:
In 2010, archaeologist Noel Hidalgo Tan was visiting the twelfth-century temple of Angkor Wat in Cambodia when he noticed markings of red paint on the temple ______ the help of digital imaging techniques, he discovered the markings to be part of an elaborate mural containing over 200 paintings.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 用标点符号连接句子。空格前是完整的一句话，是由when引导的主句跟从句，空格后是另一句完整的话，是由with the help...techniques作为状语开头，谓语是discovered，可以连接两个完整句子的标点符号有句号、分号、冒号、破折号，或者逗号/破折号加并列连词。因此选项D正确。

question:
In West Africa, jalis have traditionally been keepers of information about family histories and records of important events. They have often served as teachers and advisers, too. New technologies may have changed some aspects of the role today, but jalis continue to be valued for knowing and protecting their peoples’ stories.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Even though there have been some changes in their role, jalis continue to preserve their communities’ histories.
B. Although jalis have many roles, many of them like teaching best.
C. Jalis have been entertaining the people within their communities for centuries.
D. Technology can now do some of the things jalis used to be responsible for.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择A是最佳答案，因为它最准确地陈述了文本的主旨。根据文本，贾利斯（jalis）传统的角色是维护关于家庭历史和重要事件的信息。文本继续说，尽管技术变革在一定程度上改变了贾利斯的角色，但人们仍然重视贾利斯保存他们社区历史的价值。
B.题目文本解析
在西非，贾利斯传统上是家族历史信息的守护者，记录重要事件的记载者。他们经常也充当教师和顾问的角色。新技术可能已经改变了贾利斯的一些职责，但他们仍然因了解和保护人们的故事而受到重视。

question:
Scholars have noted that F. Scott Fitzgerald’s writings were likely influenced in part by his marriage to Zelda Fitzgerald, but many don’t recognize Zelda as a writer in her own right. Indeed, Zelda authored several works herself, such as the novel Save Me the Waltz and numerous short stories. Thus, those who primarily view Zelda as an inspiration for F. Scott’s writings ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. overlook the many other factors that motivated F. Scott to write.
B. risk misrepresenting the full range of Zelda’s contributions to literature.
C. may draw inaccurate conclusions about how F. Scott and Zelda viewed each other’s works.
D. tend to read the works of F. Scott and Zelda in an overly autobiographical light.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择 B 是最佳答案，因为它在逻辑上最完整地补充了对 Zelda Fitzgerald 对文学的贡献的讨论。文本开始说，许多学者主要将 Zelda 视为与 F. Scott Fitzgerald 的婚姻相关，并“不将 Zelda 视为一位独立的作家”。文本随后提到了她写的一部小说和“许多短篇小说”，并且这样的学者往往忽略了这些。因此，那些将焦点仅放在 Zelda 作为 F. Scott 作品灵感的学者，可能会误解 Zelda 对文学的全部贡献。
B.题目文本解析
学者们指出，F. Scott Fitzgerald 的作品很可能在某种程度上受到他与 Zelda Fitzgerald 的婚姻的影响，但许多人并不认为 Zelda 本身也是一位作家。事实上，Zelda 本人也创作了几部作品，如小说《Save Me the Waltz》和许多短篇小说。因此，那些主要将 Zelda 视为 F. Scott 作品灵感的人们

question:
Cheng Dang and her colleagues at the University of Washington recently ran simulations to determine the extent to which individual snow ______ affect the amount of light reflecting off a snowy surface.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 所有格。affect是动词,所以properties不需要使用所有格形式,所以排除AC,然后grains表示颗粒是名词，而且后面还有被修饰的名词physical properties,所以需要用所有格形式表示“的”，选择B。

question:
Eli Eisenberg, a genetics expert at Tel Aviv University in Israel, recently discovered that ______ have a special genetic ability called RNA editing that confers evolutionary advantages.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. cephalopods, ocean dwellers that include the squid, the octopus, and the cuttlefish
B. cephalopods—ocean dwellers—that include the squid, the octopus, and the cuttlefish,
C. cephalopods, ocean dwellers that include: the squid, the octopus, and the cuttlefish,
D. cephalopods—ocean dwellers that include the squid, the octopus, and the cuttlefish—
explanations: 状语的标点符号。这一句话的主语是discovered，而ocean dwellers tha...cuttlefisht是对cephalopods的补充说明，因此可以作为插入语放在cephalopods后，可以使用破折号，选项D正确。

question:
The Progressive Era in the United States witnessed the rise of numerous Black women’s clubs, local organizations that advocated for racial and gender equality. Among the clubs’ leaders ______ Josephine St. Pierre Ruffin, founder of the Women’s Era Club of Boston.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主谓一致。这里有一个倒装结构，真正的主语为Josephine St. Pierre Ruffin，为单数形式，因此选项A正确。

question:
A model created by biologist Luis Valente predicts that the rate of speciation—the rate at which new species form—on an isolated island located approximately 5,000 kilometers from the nearest mainland ______ triple the rate of speciation on an island only 500 kilometers from the mainland.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 连贯表达。Predict后跟着宾语从句，从句中的主语为the rate of...mainland，空格处为谓语，选项A、B、C错误，为非谓语，选项D正确。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Samuel Selvon was a Trinidadian author.
●The Lonely Londoners is one of his most celebrated novels.
●Selvon published the novel in 1956.
●It is about a group of men who emigrate from the Caribbean to Great Britain after World War II.
●Some of The Lonely Londoners’ characters also appear in Selvon’s later novel Moses Ascending.

The student wants to introduce Samuel Selvon and his novel The Lonely Londoners to a new audience. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In 1956, Trinidadian author Samuel Selvon published one of his most celebrated novels, The Lonely Londoners, which is about a group of men who emigrate from the Caribbean to Great Britain after World War II.
B. Samuel Selvon wrote the novel Moses Ascending after he wrote The Lonely Londoners.
C. The Lonely Londoners, a celebrated novel that was published in 1956, depicts post–World War II Caribbean migration from the perspective of a Trinidadian author.
D. Some of the characters who appear in Samuel Selvon’s Moses Ascending also appear in The Lonely Londoners.
explanations: 选择 A 是最佳答案。通过指出Selvon是一位特立尼达作家，并指出《The Lonely Londoners》是他于1956年出版的一部小说，讲述了一群男子在二战后从加勒比海移民到英国的故事，这句话有效地向新的观众介绍了Samuel Selvon及他的小说。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Pterosaurs were flying reptiles that existed millions of years ago.
●In a 2021 study, Anusuya Chinsamy-Turan analyzed fragments of pterosaur jawbones located in the Sahara Desert.
●She was initially unsure if the bones belonged to juvenile or adult pterosaurs.
●She used advanced microscope techniques to determine that the bones had few growth lines relative to the bones of fully grown pterosaurs.
●She concluded that the bones belonged to juveniles.

The student wants to present the study and its findings. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. In 2021, Chinsamy-Turan studied pterosaur jawbones and was initially unsure if the bones belonged to juveniles or adults.
B. Pterosaur jawbones located in the Sahara Desert were the focus of a 2021 study.
C. In a 2021 study, Chinsamy-Turan used advanced microscope techniques to analyze the jawbones of pterosaurs, flying reptiles that existed millions of years ago.
D. In a 2021 study, Chinsamy-Turan determined that pterosaur jawbones located in the Sahara Desert had few growth lines relative to the bones of fully grown pterosaurs and thus belonged to juveniles.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案。这句话介绍了研究和其发现，指出了研究的日期和研究者的姓名，同时描述了研究者对下颚骨的研究结果以及她是如何得出这一结论的。
B.题目文本解析
在研究一个主题时，一位学生记下了以下笔记:
• 翼龙是存在于数百万年前的飞行爬行动物。
• 在2021年的一项研究中，Anusuya Chinsamy-Turan分析了位于撒哈拉沙漠中的翼龙下颚骨碎片。
• 最初她不确定这些骨头是属于幼年还是成年翼龙。
• 她使用先进的显微镜技术确定这些骨头相对于完全成年翼龙的骨头具有较少的生长线。
• 她得出结论这些骨头属于幼年翼龙。

question:
Award-winning travel writer Linda Watanabe McFerrin considers the background research she conducts on destinations featured in her travel books to be its own reward. ______ McFerrin admits to finding the research phase of her work just as fascinating and engaging as exploring a location in person.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案。逻辑上，“In fact”表明这个句子中的信息——即麦克费林发现她工作中的研究阶段与旅行一样迷人——强调并详细阐述了前一个句子中提到的麦克费林将背景研究视为一项有益的活动。
B.题目文本解析
屡获殊荣的旅行作家琳达·渡边·麦克费林认为她对旅行书中所涉及目的地进行的背景研究本身就是一种回报。麦克费林承认，她发现工作中的研究阶段与亲自探索一个地点一样令人着迷和吸引。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Bharati Mukherjee was an Indian-born author of novels and short stories.
●She published the novel The Holder of the World in 1993.
●A central character in the novel is a woman living in twentieth-century United States.
●Another central character is a woman living in seventeenth-century India.

The student wants to introduce the novel The Holder of the World to an audience already familiar with Bharati Mukherjee. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Bharati Mukherjee’s settings include both twentieth-century United States and seventeenth-century India.
B. In addition to her novel The Holder of the World, which was published in 1993, Indian-born author Bharati Mukherjee wrote other novels and short stories.
C. Bharati Mukherjee’s novel The Holder of the World centers around two women, one living in twentieth-century United States and the other in seventeenth-century India.
D. The Holder of the World was not the only novel written by Indian-born author Bharati Mukherjee.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择C是最佳答案。这句话有效地向已经熟悉穆克吉的观众介绍了《The Holder of the World》，解释了这部小说围绕两个女性展开，并提到了作者，但没有提供任何其他的识别信息。
B.题目文本解析
在研究一个主题时，一位学生记下了以下笔记:
• 巴哈拉蒂·穆克吉是一位印度出生的小说家和短篇小说作家。
• 她于1993年出版了小说《The Holder of the World》。
• 小说中的一个中心人物是一位生活在20世纪美国的女性。
• 另一个中心人物是一位生活在17世纪印度的女性。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●In 2019, Emily Shepard and colleagues in the UK and Germany studied the effect of wind on auks’ success in landing at cliffside nesting sites.
●They found as wind conditions intensified, the birds needed more attempts in order to make a successful landing.
●When the wind was still, almost 100% of landing attempts were successful.
●In a strong breeze, approximately 40% of attempts were successful.
●In near-gale conditions, only around 20% of attempts were successful.

The student wants to summarize the study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. For a 2019 study, researchers from the UK and Germany collected data on auks’ attempts to land at cliffside nesting sites in different wind conditions.
B. Emily Shepard and her colleagues wanted to know the extent to which wind affected auks’ success in landing at cliffside nesting sites, so they conducted a study.
C. Knowing that auks often need multiple attempts to land at their cliffside nesting sites, Emily Shepard studied the birds’ success rate, which was only around 20% in some conditions.
D. Emily Shepard’s 2019 study of auks’ success in landing at cliffside nesting sites showed that as wind conditions intensified, the birds’ success rate decreased.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案。这句话有效地总结了这项研究，指出了谁进行了研究、研究是何时进行的以及其结果显示：随着风力加强，海鸟的着陆成功率下降。
B.题目文本解析
在研究一个主题时，一位学生记下了以下笔记:
• 2019年，英国和德国的艾米莉·谢波德（Emily Shepard）与同事研究了风对海鸟在悬崖旁筑巢地点着陆成功率的影响。
• 他们发现随着风力加强，鸟类需要更多次尝试才能成功着陆。
• 当风平静时，几乎有100%的着陆尝试成功。
• 在强风中，成功率约为40%。
• 在近狂风条件下，只有约20%的尝试成功。

question:
The Mission 66 initiative, which was approved by Congress in 1956, represented a major investment in the infrastructure of overburdened national ______ it prioritized physical improvements to the parks’ roads, utilities, employee housing, and visitor facilities while also establishing educational programming for the public.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 并列连词连接句子。空格处前后为主谓完整的两个句子，前面句子的谓语为represented，后面句子的谓语为prioritized。可以连接两个完整句子的标点符号有句号、分号、冒号、破折号，或者逗号/破折号加并列连词。故只有选项C正确。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Abdulrazak Gurnah was awarded the 2021 Nobel Prize in Literature.
●Gurnah was born in Zanzibar in East Africa and currently lives in the United Kingdom.
●Many readers have singled out Gurnah’s 1994 book Paradise for praise.
●Paradise is a historical novel about events that occurred in colonial East Africa.

The student wants to introduce Paradise to an audience unfamiliar with the novel and its author. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Abdulrazak Gurnah, who wrote Paradise and later was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature, was born in Zanzibar in East Africa and currently lives in the United Kingdom.
B. Many readers have singled out Abdulrazak Gurnah’s 1994 book Paradise, a historical novel about colonial East Africa, for praise.
C. A much-praised historical novel about colonial East Africa, Paradise (1994) was written by Abdulrazak Gurnah, winner of the 2021 Nobel Prize in Literature.
D. Paradise is a historical novel about events that occurred in colonial East Africa, Abdulrazak Gurnah’s homeland.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择 C 是最佳答案。这句话有效地向不熟悉这本小说及其作者的观众介绍《Paradise》，描述《Paradise》是一部关于殖民地东非的历史小说，作者是获得2021年诺贝尔文学奖的得主。
B.题目文本解析
在研究一个主题时，一个学生记录了以下内容：
• Abdulrazak Gurnah获得了2021年诺贝尔文学奖。
• Gurnah出生在东非的桑给巴尔，目前居住在英国。
• 许多读者特别称赞了Gurnah于1994年出版的书《Paradise》。
• 《Paradise》是一部关于殖民地东非发生事件的历史小说。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Seven species of sea turtle exist today.
●Five sea turtle species can be found in the Atlantic Ocean.
●One of those species is the Kemp’s ridley sea turtle.
●Its scientific name is Lepidochelys kempii.
●Another of those species is the olive ridley sea turtle.
●Its scientific name is Lepidochelys olivacea.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two sea turtle species. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Among the seven species of sea turtle is the olive ridley sea turtle, which can be found in the Atlantic Ocean.
B. The Kemp’s ridley sea turtle is referred to as Lepidochelys kempii, while the olive ridley sea turtle is referred to as Lepidochelys olivacea.
C. Both the Kemp’s ridley sea turtle and the olive ridley sea turtle can be found in the Atlantic Ocean.
D. The Kemp’s ridley sea turtle (Lepidochelys kempii) and the olive ridley sea turtle (Lepidochelys olivacea) are different species.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择 C 是最佳答案。这句话强调了两种海龟物种之间的相似之处：它们都可以在大西洋找到。
B.题目文本解析
在研究一个主题时，一个学生记录了以下内容：
• 今天存在七种海龟物种。
• 大西洋中有五种海龟物种。
• 其中一种是坎普氏龙海龟。
• 它的学名是Lepidochelys kempii。
• 另一种是橄榄龙海龟。
• 它的学名是Lepidochelys olivacea。

question:
A study by a team including finance professor Madhu Veeraraghavan suggests that exposure to sunshine during the workday can lead to overly optimistic behavior. Using data spanning from 1994 to 2010 for a set of US companies, the team compared over 29,000 annual earnings forecasts to the actual earnings later reported by those companies. The team found that the greater the exposure to sunshine at work in the two weeks before a manager submitted an earnings forecast, the more the manager’s forecast exceeded what the company actually earned that year.

Which choice best states the function of the underlined sentence in the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. To summarize the results of the team’s analysis
B. To present a specific example that illustrates the study’s findings
C. To explain part of the methodology used in the team’s study
D. To call out a challenge the team faced in conducting its analysis
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择C是最佳答案，因为它最好地描述了划线句子在整个文本中的作用。第一句介绍了维拉拉加文团队研究的含义：工作时间暴露在阳光下会导致过分乐观的行为。划线句子描述了团队所参考的数据及其使用方式（将关于收入的预测与公司实际收入进行比较），最后一句介绍了团队在对数据进行研究中发现的结果。因此，划线句子主要是用来解释团队研究中使用的方法之一。
B.题目文本解析
一项由包括金融教授马杜·维拉拉加万在内的团队进行的研究表明，在工作日暴露在阳光下可能导致过分乐观的行为。该团队使用了1994年至2010年间一组美国公司的数据，将逾29,000个年度收入预测与后来这些公司报告的实际收入进行了比较。团队发现，在经理提交收入预测前两周的工作中暴露于阳光的程度越大，经理的预测超过公司当年实际收入的程度就越大。

question:
Text 1
Most animals can regenerate some parts of their bodies, such as skin. But when a three-banded panther worm is cut into three pieces, each piece grows into a new worm. Researchers are investigating this feat partly to learn more about humans’ comparatively limited abilities to regenerate, and they’re making exciting progress. An especially promising discovery is that both humans and panther worms have a gene for early growth response (EGR) linked to regeneration.
Text 2
When Mansi Srivastava and her team reported that panther worms, like humans, possess a gene for EGR, it caused excitement. However, as the team pointed out, the gene likely functions very differently in humans than it does in panther worms. Srivastava has likened EGR to a switch that activates other genes involved in regeneration in panther worms, but how this switch operates in humans remains unclear.

Based on the texts, what would the author of Text 2 most likely say about Text 1’s characterization of the discovery involving EGR?
selections: A. It is reasonable given that Srivastava and her team have identified how EGR functions in both humans and panther worms.
B. It is overly optimistic given additional observations from Srivastava and her team.
C. It is unexpected given that Srivastava and her team’s findings were generally met with enthusiasm.
D. It is unfairly dismissive given the progress that Srivastava and her team have reported.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择B是最佳答案，因为它反映了基于提供的信息，文本2的作者最有可能如何回应文本1。文本1讨论了在既能够完全再生的三带豹纹蠕虫和在功能相对有限的人类中发现的与再生有关的基因EGR。文本1将这一发现描述为"特别有前途"，是对人类再生理解中的"令人兴奋的进展"的标志。另一方面，文本2的作者关注的是报告EGR发现的团队指出，虽然EGR在人类中的功能尚不清楚，但很可能与其在豹纹蠕虫中的功能非常不同。因此，文本2的作者很可能会说，鉴于Srivastava团队关于人类EGR的观察，文本1对EGR发现的热情过于乐观。
B.题目文本解析
文本1
大多数动物可以再生身体的一些部分，比如皮肤。但是当一只三带豹纹蠕虫被切成三块时，每一块都会长出一个新的蠕虫。研究人员正在调查这一壮举，部分原因是为了更多地了解人类相对有限的再生能力，他们正在取得令人兴奋的进展。一项特别有前途的发现是，人类和豹纹蠕虫都拥有与再生相关的早期生长反应基因（EGR）。
文本2
当Mansi Srivastava及其团队报告说，豹纹蠕虫和人类一样拥有一个与再生相关的EGR基因时，引起了兴奋。然而，正如团队指出的那样，这个基因在人类中的功能很可能与在豹纹蠕虫中的功能大不相同。Srivastava将EGR比作一种开关，激活了参与豹纹蠕虫再生的其他基因，但这个开关在人类中的作用仍然不清楚。

question:

In fact, so many films and associated records for this era have been lost that counts of those four figures’ output should be taken as bare minimums rather than totals; it’s entirely possible, for example, that ______

selections: A. Dark Cloud acted in significantly fewer films than did Lillian St. Cyr, who is credited with 66 performances.

一些研究美国土著演员和电影制片人的研究人员已经将注意力转向了电影的早期时期，特别是1910年代和1920年代，当时像詹姆斯·杨·迪尔（James Young Deer）、黑云（Dark Cloud）、埃德温·凯瑞（Edwin Carewe）和莉莲·圣西尔（Lillian St. Cyr，艺名Red Wing）这样的人以某种方式参与了许多电影。实际上，对于这个时代的许多电影和相关记录已经丢失，这四位人物的作品数量应该被视为最低限制，而不是总数；例如，完全有可能，

question:
New and interesting research conducted by Suleiman A. Al-Sweedan and Moath Alhaj is inspired by their observation that though there have been many studies of the effect of high altitude on blood chemistry, there is a ______ studies of the effect on blood chemistry of living in locations below sea level, such as the California towns of Salton City and Seeley.

explanations:

question:
Given that stars and planets initially form from the same gas and dust in space, some astronomers have posited that host stars (such as the Sun) and their planets (such as those in our solar system) are composed of the same materials, with the planets containing equal or smaller quantities of the materials that make up the host star. This idea is also supported by evidence that rocky planets in our solar system are composed of some of the same materials as the Sun.

Which finding, if true, would most directly weaken the astronomers’ claim?
selections: A. Most stars are made of hydrogen and helium, but when cooled they are revealed to contain small amounts of iron and silicate.
B. A nearby host star is observed to contain the same proportion of hydrogen and helium as that of the Sun.
C. Evidence emerges that the amount of iron in some rocky planets is considerably higher than the amount in their host star.
D. The method for determining the composition of rocky planets is discovered to be less effective when used to analyze other kinds of planets.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择C是最佳答案，因为它提出了一个发现，如果属实，将削弱天文学家关于恒星和它们的行星组成的主张。文本解释说，由于恒星和行星从相同的气体和尘埃开始形成，天文学家认为行星应该由与它们的母恒星相同的材料组成，但数量应相等或更少。一些岩质行星中铁的含量远高于它们的母恒星的发现将削弱天文学家的主张，因为它将表明一些行星包含与它们的母恒星相同的材料，但数量更多。
B.题目文本解析
鉴于恒星和行星最初形成于太空中相同的气体和尘埃，一些天文学家提出，母恒星（如太阳）和它们的行星（如我们太阳系中的行星）由相同的材料组成，行星中包含的材料与母恒星相比相等或更少。这一想法也得到了支持，因为我们太阳系中的岩石行星由一些与太阳相同的材料组成。

question:
Considering a large sample of companies, economics experts Maria Guadalupe, Julie Wulf, and Raghuram Rajan assessed the number of managers and leaders from different departments who reported directly to a chief executive officer (CEO). According to the researchers, the findings suggest that across the years analyzed, there was a growing interest among CEOs in connecting with more departments in their companies.

Which choice best describes data from the graph that support the researchers’ conclusion?
selections: A. The average numbers of managers and department leaders reporting directly to their CEO didn’t fluctuate from the 1991–1995 period to the 2001–2008 period.
B. The average number of managers reporting directly to their CEO was highest in the 1996–2001 period.
C. The average number of department leaders reporting directly to their CEO was greater than the average number of managers reporting directly to their CEO in each of the three periods studied.
D. The average number of department leaders reporting directly to their CEO rose over the three periods studied.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案，因为它描述了支持研究人员结论的图表数据，即CEO们对与公司更多部门联系感兴趣的趋势正在增长。图表显示了三个不同时间段内直接向CEO汇报的人员平均数量：这些人员被分为经理和部门领导。在1991-1995年期间，直接向CEO汇报的部门领导的平均数量略多于三人；在1996-2001年期间，这个数字为四人；在2001-2008年期间，这个数字几乎达到了七人。因此，在研究的三个时期内，直接向CEO汇报的部门领导的平均数量有所增加，这表明CEO们正在与更多部门联系。
B.题目文本解析
经济学专家Maria Guadalupe、Julie Wulf和Raghuram Rajan在考察了大量公司样本后，评估了不同部门的经理和领导直接向首席执行官（CEO）汇报的数量。研究人员表示，根据他们的研究结果，跨越多年的分析显示，CEO们对与公司更多部门联系感兴趣的趋势在增长。

question:
The following text is from Charlotte Brontë’s 1847 novel Jane Eyre. Jane, the narrator, works as a governess at Thornfield Hall.
I went on with my day’s business tranquilly; but ever and anon vague suggestions kept wandering across my brain of reasons why I should quit Thornfield; and I kept involuntarily framing advertisements and pondering conjectures about new situations: these thoughts I did not think to check; they might germinate and bear fruit if they could.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To convey a contrast between Jane’s outward calmness and internal restlessness
B. To emphasize Jane’s loyalty to the people she works for at Thornfield Hall
C. To demonstrate that Jane finds her situation both challenging and deeply fulfilling
D. To describe Jane’s determination to secure employment outside of Thornfield Hall
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择A是最佳答案，因为它最准确地描述了文本的主要目的，即展示简（Jane）在平静地进行日常任务的同时，内心却感到不安，可能正在考虑寻找一份新工作。文本开头，简说：“我平静地继续着我的日常工作”，表明她外表上是平静的。这种外表上的平静与她内心的强烈不安形成对比，因为简说她一直在考虑离开工作的念头，一直“不由自主地在脑海中构思广告”（意味着她无法停止自己想出潜在的工作广告），并且经常想知道新的“情况”（或工作）会是什么样子。
B.题目文本解析
以下文字摘自夏洛蒂·勃朗特于1847年创作的小说《简·爱》。简，叙述者，作为一个家庭教师在桑菲尔德庄园工作。
我平静地继续着我的日常工作；但时不时地，莫名其妙的建议不断在脑海中游荡，提醒我为何应该离开桑菲尔德；我不由自主地在脑海中构思广告，思考新的工作机会：我并没有想要控制这些想法；如果可能的话，它们可能会生根发芽并结出果实。

question:
One challenge when researching whether holding elected office changes a person’s behavior is the problem of ensuring that the experiment has an appropriate control group. To reveal the effect of holding office, researchers must compare people who hold elected office with people who do not hold office but who are otherwise similar to the office-holders. Since researchers are unable to control which politicians win elections, they therefore ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. struggle to find valid data about the behavior of politicians who do not currently hold office.
B. can only conduct valid studies with people who have previously held office rather than people who presently hold office.
C. should select a control group of people who differ from office holders in several significant ways.
D. will find it difficult to identify a group of people who can function as an appropriate control group for their studies.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案，因为它最符合逻辑地从文本讨论的研究人员在研究担任选举职位对一个人行为的影响时所面临的挑战中得出的结论。文本解释了研究人员很难测试选举职位对人们的影响，因为找到愿意担任对照组的人很困难。文本表明，对照组需要由与被测试组分享特征但不具有被测试变量（在这种情况下为担任选举职位）的人组成。由于研究人员无法影响谁赢得选举，他们也无法确定谁将作为对照组中一个适当相似的成员。因此，逻辑上可以得出结论，研究人员将发现很难确定一个可以作为其研究中适当对照组的人群。
B.题目文本解析
在研究担任选举职位是否会改变一个人的行为时，一个挑战是确保实验具有适当的对照组。为了揭示担任职位的影响，研究人员必须将担任选举职位的人与不担任职位但在其他方面与担任者相似的人进行比较。由于研究人员无法控制哪些政治家赢得选举，因此他们因此无法确定谁会作为一个适当相似的对照组成员。

question:
In studying the use of external stimuli to reduce the itching sensation caused by an allergic histamine response, Louise Ward and colleagues found that while harmless applications of vibration or warming can provide a temporary distraction, such ______ stimuli actually offer less relief than a stimulus that seems less benign, like a mild electric shock.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择B是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地完成了对沃德及其同事的发现的讨论。在这个上下文中，“innocuous”意味着温和或无害。文本描述了沃德及其同事用来缓解瘙痒的振动和加热为“无害的应用”，并继续将这些应用与另一种实际上提供更多缓解的刺激进行对比，尽管这种刺激似乎更强烈且“不那么温和”。这个上下文传达了振动和加热是无害刺激的观念。
B.题目文本解析
在研究外部刺激物来减轻过敏组织胺反应引起的瘙痒感时，路易丝·沃德和同事发现，虽然振动或加热的无害应用可以提供暂时的分散注意力，但这种刺激实际上提供的缓解比看起来不那么温和的刺激要少，比如轻微的电击。

question:
The following text is adapted from Indian Boyhood, a 1902 memoir by Ohiyesa (Charles A. Eastman), a Santee Dakota writer. In the text, Ohiyesa recalls how the women in his tribe harvested maple syrup during his childhood.
Now the women began to test the trees—moving leisurely among them, axe in hand, and striking a single quick blow, to see if the sap would appear. The trees, like people, have their individual characters; some were ready to yield up their life-blood, while others were more reluctant. Now one of the birchen basins was set under each tree, and a hardwood chip driven deep into the cut which the axe had made. From the corners of this chip—at first drop by drop, then more freely—the sap trickled into the little dishes.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It portrays the range of personality traits displayed by the women as they work.
B. It foregrounds the beneficial relationship between humans and maple trees.
C. It demonstrates how human behavior can be influenced by the natural environment.
D. It elaborates on an aspect of the maple trees that the women evaluate.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案，因为它最好描述了文本中带有下划线句子的功能，这句话在整体上描绘了Ohiyesa部落的妇女如何收集枫树汁。文本中提到，妇女们使用斧头敲击枫树，以找出哪些树会产生树液。下划线句子将树木比作人，将树液描述为树木的“生命血液”。有些树已经准备好分泌树液，而另一些则不愿意这样做。通过拟人化，这句话提供了更多关于枫树这一方面的细节——即它们潜在的分泌树液能力，这正是妇女们正在评估的内容。
B.题目文本解析
以下文本摘自1902年Santee Dakota作家Ohiyesa（Charles A. Eastman）的回忆录《印第安男孩》。在文本中，Ohiyesa回忆了他童年时期部落中的妇女们如何收集枫树汁。
现在，妇女们开始测试树木——悠闲地在树木间移动，手持斧头，猛击一下，看看树液是否会出现。树木，就像人一样，有着各自的特点；有些树愿意释放它们的生命血液，而其他一些则更为不情愿。现在，在每棵树下放置一个桦树木碗，将一块硬木片深深地插入斧头切割的伤口。从这块木片的角落——起初是一滴一滴，然后变得更加自由地——树液滴入小碟中。

question:
Whether the reign of a French monarch such as Hugh Capet or Henry I was historically consequential or relatively uneventful, its trajectory was shaped by questions of legitimacy and therefore cannot be understood without a corollary understanding of the factors that allowed the monarch to ______ his right to hold the throne.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择C是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地完成了对于法国国王如休·卡佩和亨利一世统治合法性的讨论。在这个上下文中，“buttress”意味着加强或捍卫。文本指出，无论法国国王的统治是否重要或平静，每位国王都面临关于其继位的合法性的质疑。文本接着说，为了理解一个法国国王的统治道路，了解是什么促使国王能够“坐稳王位”是很重要的。这个上下文表明，休·卡佩和亨利一世等法国国王必须捍卫他们作为国王的权利。
B.题目文本解析
无论是像休·卡佩或亨利一世这样的法国国王的统治在历史上是否有重大意义或相对平静，其轨迹都受到统治合法性的质疑所塑造，因此如果没有对促使这位国王捍卫其坐稳王位的因素有对应的理解，就无法理解其统治。

question:
Mosasaurs were large marine reptiles that lived in the Late Cretaceous period, approximately 100 million to 66 million years ago. Celina Suarez, Alberto Pérez-Huerta, and T. Lynn Harrell Jr. examined oxygen-18 isotopes in mosasaur tooth enamel in order to calculate likely mosasaur body temperatures and determined that mosasaurs were endothermic—that is, they used internal metabolic processes to maintain a stable body temperature in a variety of ambient temperatures. Suarez, Pérez-Huerta, and Harrell claim that endothermy would have enabled mosasaurs to include relatively cold polar waters in their range.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support Suarez, PérezHuerta, and Harrell’s claim?
selections: A. Mosasaurs’ likely body temperatures are easier to determine from tooth enamel oxygen-18 isotope data than the body temperatures of nonendothermic Late Cretaceous marine reptiles are.

B. Fossils of both mosasaurs and nonendothermic marine reptiles have been found in roughly equal numbers in regions known to be near the poles during the Late Cretaceous, though in lower concentrations than elsewhere.

C. Several mosasaur fossils have been found in regions known to be near the poles during the Late Cretaceous, while relatively few fossils of nonendothermic marine reptiles have been found in those locations.
D. During the Late Cretaceous, seawater temperatures were likely higher throughout mosasaurs’ range, including near the poles, than seawater temperatures at those same latitudes are today.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择C是最佳答案，因为它提出了一个发现，如果属实，将最有力地支持Suarez、Perez-Huerta和Harrel的关于莫沙龙的主张。文中提到Suarez、Perez-Huerta和Harrel的研究关于莫沙龙的牙釉质让他们得出结论，莫沙龙是恒温动物，这意味着它们可以生活在许多不同温度的水域中，仍然能保持稳定的体温。研究人员声称恒温使莫沙龙能够生活在相对寒冷的极地水域。如果在莫沙龙存在的时期附近的极地地区发现了几个莫沙龙化石，并且非恒温海洋爬行动物的化石在这些地点很少见，那将支持研究人员的主张：这将显示莫沙龙栖息在极地水域，但非恒温海洋哺乳动物往往不这样做，这表明恒温可能是使莫沙龙能够包括极地水域在其范围内的特征。
B.题目文本解析
莫沙龙是生活在约1亿到6600万年前晚白垩纪时期的大型海洋爬行动物。塞利娜·苏亚雷斯（Celina Suarez）、阿尔贝托·佩雷斯-休埃塔（Alberto Perez-Huerta）和T·林·哈雷尔（T. Lynn Harrell Jr.）检查了莫沙龙牙釉质中的氧-18同位素，以计算可能的莫沙龙体温，并确定莫沙龙是恒温动物，即它们利用内部代谢过程在各种环境温度下保持稳定的体温。苏亚雷斯、佩雷斯-休埃塔和哈雷尔声称恒温使莫沙龙能够将相对寒冷的极地水域包括在其范围内。

question:
Researcher Haesung Jung led a 2020 study showing that individual acts of kindness can ______ prosocial behavior across a larger group. Jung and her team found that bystanders who witness a helpful act become more likely to offer help to someone else, and in doing so, can inspire still others to act.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择C是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地完成了对Jung及其团队研究善举的讨论。在这个背景下，“foster”意味着鼓励或促进发展。文本表明，Jung及其团队发现，看到一种有帮助的（或亲社会的）行为会使旁观者更有可能去帮助其他人，进而激励更多人去帮助他人。也就是说，该团队证明了单个善举可以在群体中促进额外的亲社会行为。
B.题目文本解析
研究者Haesung Jung领导了一项2020年的研究，显示个别善举可以在更大的群体中促进亲社会行为。Jung及其团队发现，目击到一种有帮助的行为的旁观者更有可能向其他人提供帮助，并通过这样做，可以激励其他人采取行动。

question:
Musician Joni Mitchell, who is also a painter, uses images she creates for her album covers to emphasize ideas expressed in her music. For the cover of her album Turbulent Indigo (1994), Mitchell painted a striking self-portrait that closely resembles Vincent van Gogh’s Self-Portrait with Bandaged Ear (1889). The image calls attention to the album’s title song, in which Mitchell sings about the legacy of the postimpressionist painter. In that song, Mitchell also hints that she feels a strong artistic connection to Van Gogh—an idea that is reinforced by her imagery on the cover.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It presents a claim about Mitchell, then gives an example supporting that claim.
B. It discusses Van Gogh’s influence on Mitchell, then considers Mitchell’s influence on other artists.
C. It describes a similarity between two artists, then notes a difference between them.
D. It describes the songs on Turbulent Indigo, then explains how they relate to the album’s cover.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择A是最佳答案，因为它准确描述了文本内部元素的组织。文本开始声称乔尼·米切尔（Joni Mitchell）的专辑封面使用她创作的图像来强调她专辑中蕴含的想法。然后，文本提供了一个例子，说明米切尔在专辑《蓝调印象》（Turbulent Indigo）封面上的自画像类似于梵高的一幅画作，文本指出这样做有助于强调米切尔对梵高的深厚情感连接，这种连接也体现在专辑的主打歌中。
B.题目文本解析
音乐家乔尼·米切尔（Joni Mitchell）是一名画家，她利用为专辑封面创作的图像来强调她音乐中表达的想法。在她的专辑《蓝调印象》（Turbulent Indigo）（1994年）的封面上，米切尔绘制了一幅引人注目的自画像，与文森特·梵高（Vincent van Gogh）的《戴绷带耳的自画像》（1889年）非常相似。这幅图像引人注目专辑的主打歌，米切尔在其中歌唱关于后印象派画家的遗产。在那首歌中，米切尔也暗示她与梵高有着强烈的艺术连接，这个想法在封面的图像中得到了加强。

question:
While attending school in New York City in the 1980s, Okwui Enwezor encountered few works by African artists in exhibitions, despite New York’s reputation as one of the best places to view contemporary art from around the world. According to an arts journalist, later in his career as a renowned curator and art historian, Enwezor sought to remedy this deficiency, not by focusing solely on modern African artists, but by showing how their work fits into the larger context of global modern art and art history.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the journalist’s claim?
selections: A. As curator of the Haus der Kunst in Munich, Germany, Enwezor organized a retrospective of Ghanaian sculptor El Anatsui’s work entitled El Anatsui: Triumphant Scale, one of the largest art exhibitions devoted to a Black artist in Europe’s history.

B. In the exhibition Postwar: Art Between the Pacific and the Atlantic, 1945–1965, Enwezor and cocurator Katy Siegel brought works by African artists such as Malangatana Ngwenya together with pieces by major figures from other countries, like US artist Andy Warhol and Mexico’s David Siqueiros.

C. Enwezor’s work as curator of the 2001 exhibition The Short Century: Independence and Liberation Movements in Africa, 1945–1994 showed how African movements for independence from European colonial powers following the Second World War profoundly influenced work by African artists of the period, such as Kamala Ibrahim Ishaq and Thomas Mukarobgwa.

D. Enwezor organized the exhibition In/sight: African Photographers, 1940 to the Present not to emphasize a particular aesthetic trend but to demonstrate the broad range of ways in which African artists have approached the medium of photography.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择B是最佳答案，因为如果其为真，将最直接支持艺术记者关于恩韦佐夫作为策展人和艺术史学家的论断。文中，艺术记者断言恩韦佐夫希望不仅关注现代非洲艺术家，而且展示“他们的作品如何融入全球现代艺术和艺术史的更大背景”，或者说他们的作品如何与世界其他地方的艺术发展和其他艺术家的作品相关联。《战后：1945-1965年太平洋和大西洋之间的艺术》的描述表明，恩韦佐夫和西格夫的展览将非洲艺术家的作品与其他国家的艺术家的作品汇聚在一起，从而支持艺术记者的论断，即恩韦佐夫试图在全球现代艺术和艺术史的背景下展示非洲艺术家的作品。
B.题目文本解析
在上世纪80年代在纽约市上学期间，奥克维·恩韦佐遇到了在展览中很少看到非洲艺术家的作品，尽管纽约以是世界各地当代艺术的最佳展示地之一而闻名。根据一位艺术记者在他作为著名策展人和艺术史学家的职业生涯中晚期的说法，恩韦佐并非仅仅专注于现代非洲艺术家，而是试图通过展示他们的作品如何融入更广泛的全球现代艺术和艺术史的背景来弥补这一不足。

question:
To humans, it does not appear that the golden orb-weaver spider uses camouflage to capture its ______ the brightly colored arachnid seems to wait conspicuously in the center of its large circular web for insects to approach. Researcher Po Peng of the University of Melbourne has explained that the spider’s distinctive coloration may in fact be part of its appeal.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 用标点符号连接句子。空格前是完整的一句话，谓语动词为does not appear，空格后是另一句完整的话，是由rather作为状语开头，谓语是seems to，可以连接两个完整句子的标点符号有句号、分号、冒号、破折号，或者逗号/破折号加并列连词。因此选项D正确。

question:
When designing costumes for film, American artist Suttirat Larlarb typically custom fits the garments to each actor. ______ for the film Sunshine, in which astronauts must reignite a dying Sun, she designed a golden spacesuit and had a factory reproduce it in a few standard sizes; lacking a tailor-made quality, the final creations reflected the ungainliness of actual spacesuits.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择A是最佳答案。"然而"在逻辑上表明这个句子中提到的Suttirat Larlarb为电影《阳光》设计的宇航服是在工厂生产的标准尺寸，这与前一个句子中描述的Larlarb通常定制服装以适应演员的方式形成了显著的例外。
B.题目文本解析
在为电影设计服装时，美国艺术家苏蒂拉特·拉拉布通常会为每位演员定制服装。但在电影《阳光》中，宇航员必须重新点燃一个正在消亡的太阳，她设计了一件金色宇航服，并让工厂复制了几种标准尺寸；由于缺乏量身定制的特质，最终的作品体现了实际宇航服的笨拙。

question:
Hegra is an archaeological site in present-day Saudi Arabia and was the second largest city of the Nabataean Kingdom (fourth century BCE to first century CE). Archaeologist Laila Nehmé recently traveled to Hegra to study its ancient ______ into the rocky outcrops of a vast desert, these burial chambers seem to blend seamlessly with nature.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

question:

question:
Compiled in the late 1500s largely through the efforts of Indigenous scribes, Cantares Mexicanos is the most important collection of poetry in Classical Nahuatl, the principal language of the Aztec Empire. The poems portray Aztec society before the occupation of the empire by the army of Spain, and marginal notes in Cantares Mexicanos indicate that much of the collection’s content predates the initial invasion. Nonetheless, some of the poems contain inarguable references to beliefs and customs common in Spain during this era. Thus, some scholars have concluded that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. while its content largely predates the invasion, Cantares Mexicanos also contains additions made after the invasion.
B. although those who compiled Cantares Mexicanos were fluent in Nahuatl, they had limited knowledge of the Spanish language.
C. before the invasion by Spain, the poets of the Aztec Empire borrowed from the literary traditions of other societies.
D. the references to beliefs and customs in Spain should be attributed to a coincidental resemblance between the societies of Spain and the Aztec Empire.
explanations:

选择A是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地完成了文本。文本解释了《墨西哥卡恰雷斯》包含了关于西班牙入侵前的阿兹特克帝国的诗歌。此外，它指出收藏中的注释证实了一些诗歌早于西班牙入侵，而一些描绘的习俗可能源自西班牙。这暗示了一些诗歌是在入侵之前创作的，但对西班牙习俗的引用可能是在入侵之后才出现的，因此该收藏包含了入侵前的内容以及入侵后的内容。
B.题目文本解析
在16世纪晚期，主要由土著抄写员的努力编纂而成的《墨西哥卡恰雷斯》是阿兹特克帝国主要语言纳瓦特尔的最重要的诗歌集。这些诗歌描绘了西班牙军队占领帝国之前的阿兹特克社会，而《墨西哥卡恰雷斯》中的边注表明该收藏的很大部分内容早于最初的入侵。然而，一些诗歌中包含了明显与这个时代西班牙普遍信仰和习俗有关的引用。因此，一些学者得出结论认为

question:

explanations: 时态。过去进行时表示某个过去时间点正在进行的动作，本句表示在when she made an interesting discovery发生时，Bonnie Buratti正在做的事情。因此选项D正确。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Astronomers estimate that the number of comets orbiting the Sun is in the billions.
●81P/Wild is one of many comets whose orbit has changed over time.
●81P/Wild’s orbit once lay between the orbits of Uranus and Jupiter.
●The comet’s orbit is now positioned between the orbits of Jupiter and Mars.

The student wants to make and support a generalization about the orbits of comets. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish these goals?
selections: A. Astronomers estimate that the number of comets orbiting the Sun is in the billions; the comets’ orbits may change over time.
B. Like Uranus, Jupiter, and Mars, billions of comets orbit the Sun.
C. One example of a comet is 81P/Wild, whose orbit around the Sun once lay between Uranus’s and Jupiter’s orbits but is now positioned between those of Jupiter and Mars.
D. A comet’s orbit around the Sun may change over time: the orbit of comet 81P/Wild once lay between the orbits of Uranus and Jupiter but is now positioned between those of Jupiter and Mars.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择 D 是最佳答案。这个句子做了一个概括性陈述，即彗星围绕太阳的轨道可能随时间变化，并通过彗星81P/Wild的轨道变化的例子加以支持，该彗星曾位于天王星和木星轨道之间，但现在位于木星和火星轨道之间。
B.题目文本解析
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下内容：
• 天文学家估计围绕太阳运行的彗星数量为数十亿。
• 81P/Wild是众多轨道随时间变化的彗星之一。
• 81P/Wild的轨道曾位于天王星和木星轨道之间。
• 该彗星的轨道现在位于木星和火星轨道之间。

question:

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. species, both native and nonnative,
B. species, both native and nonnative;
C. species; both native and nonnative,
D. species both native and nonnative,
explanations: 平行结构。因为dedicated之后跟了三个并列成分，分别是growing、fostering和educating，又因为educating之前已经用了分号，因此fostering前也需要用分号，因此选项B正确。

question:
In her poetry collection Thomas and Beulah, Rita Dove interweaves the titular characters’ personal stories with broader historical narratives. She places Thomas’s journey from the American South to the Midwest in the early 1900s within the larger context of the Great Migration. _____ Dove sets events from Beulah’s personal life against the backdrop of the US Civil Rights Movement.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案。"同样"在逻辑上表明，本句中提到的信息——即达芙将贝乌拉的生活置于美国民权运动的背景之中——与之前关于托马斯和大迁徙的信息类似。这两句话都支持第一句关于达芙将她的人物描绘在更广泛历史叙事背景中的说法。
B.题目文本解析
在里塔·道夫的诗集《托马斯和比尤拉》中，她将主角们的个人故事与更广泛的历史叙事交织在一起。她将托马斯在20世纪早期从美国南部到中西部的旅程放置在更大背景的大迁徙中。道夫将比尤拉个人生活中的事件设置在美国民权运动的背景之下。

question:
The Babylonian king Hammurabi achieved much during his forty-year reign. He conquered all of Mesopotamia and built Babylon into one of the most powerful cities of the ancient world. Today, ______ he is mainly remembered for a code of laws inscribed on a seven-foot-tall block of stone: the Code of Hammurabi.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择C是最佳答案。逻辑上，“however”表明这个句子中的信息——即哈姆拉比主要因他的一个成就而被记住，即《汉谟拉比法典》——与先前关于哈姆拉比许多成就的信息相反。
B.题目文本解析
巴比伦国王哈姆拉比在他为期四十年的统治期间取得了许多成就。他征服了整个美索不达米亚，并将巴比伦建设成了古代世界最强大的城市之一。然而，如今人们主要因为他刻在七英尺高石块上的法典而记住他：《汉谟拉比法典》。

question:

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 用标点符号连接句子。空格前是完整的一句话，谓语是entered, 空格后是另一句完整的话，是由having...wife作为非谓语来修饰the celebrated ship，主句谓语是set，可以连接两个完整句子的标点符号有句号、分号、冒号、破折号，或者逗号/破折号加并列连词。因此选项B正确。

question:
K.D. Leka and colleagues found that the Sun’s corona provides an advance indication of solar flares—intense eruptions of electromagnetic radiation that emanate from active regions in the Sun’s photosphere and can interfere with telecommunications on Earth. Preceding a flare, the corona temporarily exhibits increased brightness above the region where the flare is ______.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择B是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地完成了关于太阳耀斑先兆的讨论。在这个背景下，"impending"意味着即将发生或接近。文本提到Leka和同事进行的一项研究发现，太阳的日冕提供了太阳耀斑的先兆。文本随后指出为什么这种先兆会有用——太阳耀斑可以干扰地球上的通信，并最后描述了日冕的特征，这是警示太阳耀斑的特征。文本表明，这种特征——日冕特定区域的亮度增加——出现在耀斑出现之前。因此，在上下文中，最佳答案应该表示耀斑即将发生或迫近。
B.题目文本解析
K.D. Leka和同事发现，太阳的日冕提供太阳耀斑的预警——这些耀斑是从太阳光球的活跃区域发出的强烈电磁辐射喷发，可能会干扰地球上的电信通讯。在耀斑发生之前，日冕临时展示出在耀斑发生区域上方亮度增加的特征。

question:
Ecologist Exequiel Ezcurra and colleagues found that the inhabitants of the Mexica empire used natural landmarks to track time with a high degree of ______. By observing the sun’s position in relation to various points on the mountains surrounding the Basin of Mexico, the Mexica were able to precisely identify the dates when significant events such as solstices occurred.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择B是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地完成了文本对墨西哥帝国居民用来追踪时间的方法的讨论。在这个背景下，“exactitude”意味着精确。文本表明墨西哥人利用太阳相对于各种自然地标的位置来追踪时间的流逝，解释说这样的方法使墨西哥人能够准确确定重要事件的日期，如至暑日。这一背景支持了墨西哥人能够以高度精确性或准确度追踪时间的观点。
B.题目文本解析
生态学家埃克塞基尔·埃斯库拉和他的同事发现，墨西哥帝国的居民利用自然地标以高度_________的精确度来追踪时间。通过观察太阳相对于墨西哥盆地周围山脉上的各个点的位置，墨西哥人能够精确地确定重要事件发生的日期，比如至暑日。

question:
The ancient writing system used in the Maya kingdoms of southern Mexico and Central America had a symbol for the number zero. The earliest known example of the symbol dates to more than 2,000 years ago. At that time, almost none of the writing systems elsewhere in the world possessed a zero symbol. And the use of zero in Mexico and Central America may be even more ancient. Some historians suggest that Maya mathematicians inherited it from the Olmec civilization, which flourished in the region 2,400–3,600 years ago.

According to the text, what do some historians suggest about Maya civilization?
selections: A. Maya civilization acquired the use of zero from the Olmec civilization.
B. Maya civilization respected its historians more than it respected its mathematicians.
C. Maya civilization was highly secretive about its intellectual achievements.
D. Maya civilization tried to introduce its writing system to other civilizations.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择A是最佳答案，因为它提供了文本支持的关于玛雅文明的信息。文本指出，玛雅王国使用的书写系统中有一个代表数字零的符号。文本继续说，在零符号最早出现的时候，超过2000年前，世界上几乎没有其他书写系统包含这样的符号。文本还指出，一些历史学家认为玛雅数学家从奥尔梅克文明继承了零的使用，而奥尔梅克文明存在于玛雅文明之前在同一地区。因此，根据文本，一些历史学家认为玛雅文明从奥尔梅克文明获得了使用零的概念。
B.题目文本解析
墨西哥南部和中美洲玛雅王国使用的古代书写系统中有一个代表数字零的符号。已知的最早零的符号可以追溯到2000多年前。当时，世界其他地方的几乎没有书写系统具有零的符号。而在墨西哥和中美洲使用零的可能更古老。一些历史学家认为，玛雅数学家从在该地区兴盛的奥尔梅克文明那里继承了这一概念，而奥尔梅克文明的兴盛时期可以追溯到2400-3600年前。

question:
In editor Lisa Yaszek’s introduction to her anthology The Future Is Female! More Classic Science Fiction Stories by Women, Yaszek identifies an increasing sense of ______ feminist mode of writing in the 1970s, in contrast to many woman-authored science fiction stories of the 1920s to 1960s whose politics were less deliberately signaled.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择B是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地完成了对Yaszek科幻小说选集引言的讨论。在这个背景下，“overtly”意味着公开或没有隐瞒。文本对比了女性作者创作的20世纪20年代至60年代科幻小说中缺乏“明确标志”的政治主题，以及Yaszek对70年代女性作者科幻小说的看法。这种对比暗示了70年代的作品明显反映了女性主义政治主题。换句话说，文本表明，与20世纪20年代至60年代创作科幻小说的女性不同，70年代创作科幻小说的女性表达了公开的女性主义主题。
B.题目文本解析
在编辑Lisa Yaszek撰写的科幻小说选集《未来是女性！更多女性经典科幻故事》的引言中，Yaszek指出与20世纪20年代至60年代许多女性撰写的科幻小说在政治上不太明确的情况形成鲜明对比，她认为在20世纪70年代出现了日益明显的女性主义写作模式。

question:
A subject of much speculation, distinctive sets of parallel ridges mark the icy crust of Europa, Jupiter’s smallest moon. Researchers now claim that the ridges’ formation mechanism mirrors that of a strikingly similar pair on Greenland’s ice sheet. There, surface water seeped through fissures in the sheet and formed a water pocket that subsequently disrupted the overlying ice, forcing fragments of it upward and outward into peaks, as the pocket froze and expanded. Although Europa lacks liquid surface water, the same process could be driven by the moon’s subsurface ocean.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Researchers think that the ridges on Europa and the ridges in Greenland may have been formed by the same process even though Europa, unlike Greenland, doesn’t have liquid water on its surface.
B. The primary difference between the ridges on Europa and the ridges in Greenland is that unlike the Europa ridges, the Greenland ridges are parallel.
C. The pair of ridges found on Greenland’s ice sheet appear to have formed long before the recently discovered sets of ridges on Europa forme
D. Researchers don’t understand why Europa is marked by so many sets of ridges when the moon doesn’t have any liquid water on its surface that could have collected and expanded under the icy crust.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择A是最佳答案，因为它准确陈述了文本的主要观点。文本聚焦于木星的卫星欧罗巴上形成的平行冰脊，据称是由与格陵兰冰盖上形成的平行脊梁相同的机制形成的。文本指出，在格陵兰，地表的水渗透到冰盖的下部，导致隆起形成脊梁，并且文本还指出，尽管欧罗巴的地表缺乏液态水，但相同的过程可能由欧罗巴地表下的海洋驱动。换句话说，文本的主要观点是，欧罗巴和格陵兰冰上的平行脊梁很可能是由类似的过程引起的，尽管在格陵兰，这个过程始于地表上的液态水，而欧罗巴地表缺乏液态水。
B.题目文本解析
被广泛猜测的一个主题是，木星最小的卫星欧罗巴的冰皮上有着独特的平行脊梁。研究人员现在声称，这些脊梁的形成机制与格陵兰冰盖上一对惊人相似的脊梁的机制相似。在那里，地表水通过冰盖中的裂缝渗透，并形成了一个水囊，随后扰乱了上覆冰层，迫使冰层碎片向上和向外推成峰，同时水囊冻结并膨胀。尽管欧罗巴缺乏液态地表水，但相同的过程可能由该卫星的地下海洋驱动。

question:
Researchers have long hypothesized that woolly mammoths were hunted to extinction in North America by humans using spears with grooved tips known as Clovis points. One anthropologist set out to test this hypothesis. Using a mechanical spear-thrower, he launched spears with Clovis points into mounds of clay—substitutes for the animals’ large bodies. The projectiles generally penetrated only a few inches into the clay, an amount insufficient to have harmed most woolly mammoths. This led the anthropologist to conclude that hunters using spears with Clovis points likely weren’t the principal drivers of the extinction.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To argue for the significance of new findings amid an ongoing debate among researchers
B. To discuss the advantages and disadvantages of the method used in an experiment
C. To summarize two competing hypotheses and a major finding associated with each one
D. To describe an experiment whose results cast doubt on an established hypothesis
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案，因为它最准确地陈述了文本的主要目的，即描述一个实验的结果对一个已建立的假设产生了怀疑。文本开始指出，研究人员长期以来认为北美的长毛猛犸象被使用克洛维斯尖矛的人类猎杀致灭绝。文本随后描述了一位人类学家进行的实验来测试这一假设。根据文本，实验结果使人类学家得出结论，使用克洛绂斯尖矛的猎手可能不是灭绝的主要原因。人类学家的研究结果对文本开头提出的长期存在的假设产生了怀疑，并暗示长毛猛犸象可能因为其他原因在北美灭绝。
B.题目文本解析
研究人员长期假设长毛猛犸象在北美被使用克洛维斯尖矛的人类猎杀致灭绝。一位人类学家开始测试这一假设。他使用一种机械投掷矛，将带有克洛维斯尖矛的矛投向泥土堆——这些泥土堆代替了动物的大体型。这些投射物通常只穿透泥土几英寸，这个深度不足以伤害大多数长毛猛犸象。这导致人类学家得出结论，使用克洛维斯尖矛的猎手可能不是导致灭绝的主要原因。

question:
External shopping cues are a type of marketing that uses obvious messaging—a display featuring a new product, for example, or a “buy one, get one free” offer—to entice consumers to make spontaneous purchases. In a study, data scientist Sam K. Hui and colleagues found that this effect can also be achieved with a less obvious cue: rearranging a store’s layout. The researchers explain that trying to find items in new locations causes shoppers to move through more of the store, exposing them to more products and increasing the likelihood that they’ll buy an item they hadn’t planned on purchasing.

Which response from a survey given to shoppers who made a purchase at a retail store best supports the researchers’ explanation?
selections: A. “I needed to buy some cleaning supplies, but they weren’t in their regular place. While I was looking for them, I saw this interesting notebook and decided to buy it, too.”
B. “I didn’t buy everything on my shopping list today. I couldn’t find a couple of the items in the store, even though I looked all over for them.”
C. “The store sent me a coupon for a new brand of soup, so I came here to find out what kinds of soup that brand offers. I decided to buy a few cans because I had the coupon.”
D. “This store is larger than one that’s closer to where I live, and it carries more products. I came here to buy some things that the other store doesn’t always have.”
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择A是最佳答案，因为它最好支持研究人员对重新布置商店布局结果的解释。根据文本，山姆·K·许（Sam K. Hui）和同事发现，重新布置商店的布局可以鼓励顾客做出即兴购买。文本指出，研究人员解释说布局的改变会导致购物者寻找物品的新位置，这会让购物者接触更多的产品，增加他们做出非计划购买的可能性。被调查的购物者的这段引文表明，购物者在寻找不在通常位置的清洁用品时，自发购买了一个笔记本。因此，这段引文支持了研究人员的解释，即重新布置商店的布局会导致购物者做出意外购买。
B.题目文本解析
外部购物线索是一种营销手段，利用明显的信息传递，例如展示一个新产品或提供“买一送一”的优惠，来诱使消费者做出即兴购买。在一项研究中，数据科学家山姆·K·许（Sam K. Hui）和同事发现这种效果也可以通过更不明显的线索实现：重新布置商店的布局。研究人员解释说，尝试在新位置找到物品会导致购物者在商店内更多地移动，使他们接触更多产品，增加他们购买未计划购买的商品的可能性。

question:
According to a team of neuroeconomists from the University of Zurich, ease of decision making may be linked to communication between two brain regions, the prefrontal cortex and the parietal cortex. Individuals tend to be more decisive if the information flow between the regions is intensified, whereas they make choices more slowly when information flow is ______.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择A是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地完成了文本对大脑两个区域之间信息流动如何影响人们决策轻松程度的讨论。在这个背景下，“reduced”意味着减少。文本介绍了一个神经经济学团队的发现，即决策可能与前额叶皮层和顶叶皮层之间的沟通有关。在介绍这一发现时，文本暗示了那些倾向于更果断的人和那些做决定更慢的人之间的对比。根据文本，当两个大脑区域之间的信息流增强或加强时，人们往往更果断。另一方面，在这种背景下，当两个大脑区域之间的信息流减少时，人们做出选择的速度会变慢。
B.题目文本解析
根据苏黎世大学的一组神经经济学家，决策的轻松程度可能与两个大脑区域之间的沟通有关，即前额叶皮层和顶叶皮层。如果区域之间的信息流增强，个体往往更果断，而当信息流______时，他们做选择更慢。

question:
To understand how Paleolithic artists navigated dark caves, archaeologist Mª Ángeles Medina-Alcaide and her team tested different lighting methods in a cave in Spain using replicas of artifacts found in European caves with art. They used three different Paleolithic light sources—torches, animal-fat lamps, and fireplaces—determining that each likely had a specific purpose. For instance, the team learned that the animal-fat lamps were less useful than torches while walking because the lamps didn’t illuminate the cave floor.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Medina-Alcaide and her team’s study demonstrated that fireplaces were essential to the creators of Paleolithic cave art.
B. Medina-Alcaide and her team discovered that Paleolithic cave artists in Spain used animal-fat lamps more often than they used torches.
C. Medina-Alcaide and her team were reluctant to draw many conclusions from their study because of the difficulty they had replicating light sources based on known artifacts.
D. Medina-Alcaide and her team tested Paleolithic light sources and learned some details about how Paleolithic artists traveled within dark caves.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案，因为它最准确地陈述了文本的主要观点。文本指出，考古学家Mª Ángeles Medina-Alcaide和她的团队使用旧石器时代光源的复制品来了解旧石器时代艺术家如何在黑暗洞穴中移动。研究人员发现，例如，火炬比动物脂灯更有助于在洞穴中移动。因此，文本的主要观点是，Medina-Alcaide和她的团队测试了旧石器时代的光源，并了解了一些关于旧石器时代艺术家如何在黑暗洞穴中移动的细节。
B.题目文本解析
为了了解旧石器时代艺术家如何在黑暗洞穴中导航，考古学家Mª Ángeles Medina-Alcaide和她的团队在西班牙的一个洞穴中使用欧洲洞穴艺术中发现的文物的复制品测试了不同的照明方法。他们使用了三种不同的旧石器时代光源——火炬、动物脂灯和火炉——确定每种光源可能有特定的用途。例如，团队发现动物脂灯在行走时比火炬不那么有用，因为灯没有照亮洞穴地面。

question:
Even with the widespread adoption of personal computers, many authors still choose to write and revise their novels by hand and only then transcribe the final version on a computer. It may be tempting to speculate about how a novel written this way would be affected if it had been exclusively typed instead, but each novel is a unique entity resulting from a specific set of circumstances. Therefore, ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. in order to increase their efficiency, authors who currently write their novels largely by hand should instead work only on a computer.
B. authors who do most of their drafting and revising by hand likely have more success than those who work entirely on a computer.
C. novels written by hand take less time to produce, on average, than novels written on a computer do.

explanations:

选择D是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地跟随文本讨论作者撰写和修改小说的手段。在提到尽管计算机现在被广泛使用，许多作者仍选择手写草稿小说时，文本承认了一种猜测，即相反选择——只使用计算机——可能会对这些小说产生影响。然而，文本随后指出，每部小说都是其创作周围特定条件的独特结果的结合。这表明不可能确定任何单一条件（如写作手段）本身对其影响；因此，没有合理的方法来评估如果小说以其他方式写成会有何不同。
