question:
In forecasting weather events, meteorologists sometimes discuss the role of atmospheric rivers. What are atmospheric rivers, and how ______ Part of the water cycle, atmospheric rivers are narrow channels of moisture moving through the atmosphere. In certain conditions, these “rivers” can release some of their moisture as precipitation.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. do they affect our weather.
B. they do affect our weather.
C. do they affect our weather?
D. they do affect our weather?
explanations: 句子语序及句末标点。前文What are atmospheric rivers为疑问语序，以及后文Part of ... atmosphere是一句主谓齐全完整的句子。因此how...weather也应该用疑问语序，选项C正确。

question:
Behavioral ecologists Will Wiggins, Sarah Bounds, and Shawn Wilder recently examined the behavior of field-collected and laboratory-reared bold jumping spiders (Phidippus audax). They found a positive association between experimental high-protein diets and aggressive behavior in field-collected males and a similar association between experimental high-lipid diets and aggressive behavior in lab-reared males; additionally, field-collected spiders showed a preference for flowers manipulated to display ultraviolet fluorescence, whereas lab-reared spiders showed a preference for flowers dyed with red food coloring that was not fluorescent. Wiggins, Bounds, and Wilder therefore concluded that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. rearing conditions likely affect the responses of bold jumping spiders to experimental stimuli.
B. being raised in a laboratory setting reduces aggression among male bold jumping spiders.
C. laboratory settings are more suitable for studying bold jumping spiders’ diets than their flower preferences.
D. experiments involving bold jumping spiders should make use of lab-reared individuals.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择A是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地完成了文本对田野收集和实验室饲养的大胆跳蛛在暴露于某些实验刺激时观察到的行为的讨论。文本表明研究人员将两组雄性大胆跳蛛（野外收集和实验室饲养）暴露于不同的刺激并观察它们随后的行为。文本继续详细描述了研究团队所做的观察：野外收集的蜘蛛在被喂高蛋白饮食时展现出攻击性行为，并偏好经过操纵显示紫外线荧光的花朵，而实验室饲养的蜘蛛在被喂高脂肪饮食时展现出攻击性行为，并偏好被染成红色的非荧光花朵。从文本中可以推断出，蜘蛛的饲养条件（野外与实验室）是实验的自变量。因此，可以推断出蜘蛛被饲养的条件可能会影响它们对不同实验刺激的反应。
B.题目文本解析
行为生态学家威尔·威金斯、莎拉·邦兹和肖恩·怀尔德最近研究了野外采集和实验室饲养的大胆跳蛛（Phidippus audax）的行为。他们发现，在野外采集的雄性蜘蛛中，实验性高蛋白饮食与攻击性行为呈正相关，而在实验室饲养的雄性蜘蛛中，实验性高脂肪饮食与攻击性行为呈类似关联；此外，野外采集的蜘蛛偏好经过操纵显示紫外线荧光的花朵，而实验室饲养的蜘蛛偏好被染成不发光的红色食品色素的花朵。因此，威金斯、邦兹和怀尔德因此得出结论，________。

question:
A student is researching the trends in the topics submitted to a national science fair for high school students. The graph shows the number of submissions by topic that were made each year. Based on the data in the graph, the student claims that there were more medicine and health research topics submitted in 2019 than in any other year.

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to support the underlined claim?
selections: A. In 2016, the number of cellular and molecular biology topic submissions was the same as the number of animal science topic submissions.
B. In 2019, there were more physics and space science topic submissions than there were medicine and health topic submissions.
C. The lowest number of animal science topic submissions in a year was approximately 95 in 2016.
D. The highest number of medicine and health topic submissions during the period shown is approximately 285 in 2019.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案，因为它有效地利用了图表中的数据来支持下划线部分的论断，即2019年提交给全国科学展的医学和卫生主题比所显示的其他任何一年都要多。该选项表明2019年提交的大约285个医学和卫生主题多于图表中显示的其他任何一年的医学和卫生主题提交数量——这一描述得到了图表中的信息的支持，图表显示2016年、2017年和2018年的医学和卫生主题提交数量低于250，但2019年超过250（大约285个提交）。
B.题目文本解析
一个学生正在研究提交给全国高中学生科学展的主题趋势。该图表显示了每年按主题提交的数量。根据图表中的数据，学生声称2019年提交的医学和卫生研究主题比其他任何一年都要多。

question:
The following text is adapted from Jean Webster’s 1912 novel Daddy-Long-Legs. The narrator is a young college student writing letters detailing her weekly experiences.
[The college is] organizing the Freshman basket-ball team and there’s just a chance that I shall make it. I’m little of course, but terribly quick and wiry and tough. While the others are hopping about in the air, I can dodge under their feet and grab the ball.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To compare basketball with other sports
B. To provide details of how to play basketball
C. To state how players will be chosen for the basketball team
D. To explain why the narrator thinks she might make the basketball team
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案，因为它最准确地描述了文本的主要目的。在文本的第一句中，叙述者表示她认为自己有机会成为大学篮球队的一员。她继续解释说自己“敏捷”和“坚强”。基于这些特点，她认为自己有机会加入球队。因此，文本的主要目的是解释为什么叙述者认为自己可能会进入篮球队。
B.题目文本解析
以下文本改编自Jean Webster的1912年小说《长腿叔叔》。叙述者是一名年轻的大学生，写信详细描述她的每周经历。
[学校正在]组织新生篮球队，我有一点可能会进去。我当然个子小，但非常敏捷、精力充沛、坚强。当其他人在空中跳跃时，我可以躲在他们的脚下并抢到球。

question:
“Looking Back on Girlhood” is an 1892 short story by Sarah Orne Jewett. In the story, the narrator explains that she prefers her hometown to other places she has visited: ______

Which quotation from “Looking Back on Girlhood” most effectively illustrates this claim?
selections: A. “There is always something fresh, something to be traced or discovered, something particularly to be remembere”

B. “Two large rivers join just below the village at the head of tide-water, and these, with the great inflow from the sea, make a magnificent stream, bordered by lovely green fields that slope gently to long lines of willows at the water’s edge.”

C. “I have had a good deal of journeying in my life, and taken great delight in it, but I have never taken greater delight than in my rides and drives and tramps and voyages within the borders of my native town.”
D. “There is never-ending pleasure in making one’s self familiar with such a region.”
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择C是最佳答案，因为它最有效地阐明了叙述者更喜欢她的家乡而不是她去过的其他地方的主张。在引文中，叙述者比较了她对她去过的地方和她的家乡的感受。叙述者表示，尽管她一生中所做的许多旅行给她带来了很多快乐，但她最享受的经历是在她家乡的边界内。
B.题目文本解析
《回顾少女时代》是萨拉·奥恩·朱厄特（Sarah Orne Jewett）于1892年创作的短篇小说。在这个故事中，叙述者解释说她更喜欢自己的家乡而不是她去过的其他地方：______

question:
Julia Alvarez’s 1994 novel In the Time of the Butterflies, a fictionalized account of the lives of the Mirabal ______ can serve as a starting point for those wanting to explore how the rule of dictator Rafael Trujillo has been represented in Dominican American literature.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 同位语。因为主句中的主语是Julia Alvarez’s 1994 novel In the Time of the Butterflies，谓语为can，a fictionalized...sisters是作为非限制性同位语来修饰句子主语，需要与主句之间隔开，又因为a fictionalized前已经用来逗号，为了对称，因此选项C正确。

question:
Woven from recycled yarn and hand tufted using a carpet weaving technique passed down by the artist’s Turkish grandmother, ______ so lush and tactilely inviting that you are tempted to reach out and touch them.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. the topological tapestries of Argentine textile artist Alexandra Kehayoglou are
B. the Argentine textile artist Alexandra Kehayoglou creates topological tapestries that are
C. when she creates her topological tapestries, Argentine textile artist Alexandra Kehayoglou makes them
D. Alexandra Kehayoglou is an Argentine textile artist whose topological tapestries are
explanations: 状语的逻辑主语。woven...grandmother，是用来修饰主句中的逻辑主语，因此逻辑主语应该为the topological tapestries，意思是the topological tapestries are woven... 因此选项A正确。

question:
In 1949, Frank Zamboni developed an ice rink resurfacing machine. As Zamboni’s machine moved along the rink’s surface, it first scraped off the top layer of ice. ______ it sprayed water into the deep grooves left behind by customers’ skates. Lastly, it smoothed over the newly formed ice.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择B是最佳答案。"接下来"在逻辑上表明，这个句子中的行动——喷水——是重新铺设过程中的下一步，紧随之前提到的刮冰操作。
B.题目文本解析
在1949年，弗兰克·扎蒙尼发明了一台冰场表面修复机。当扎蒙尼的机器沿着冰面移动时，首先刮掉了冰面的顶层。______然后它会向顾客滑冰留下的深沟喷水。最后，它会将新形成的冰表面平整。

question:
On March 23, 2021, a gust of wind wreaked havoc on global trade. Ever Given, an international shipping container vessel, became lodged in Egypt’s Suez Canal, a major shipping route between Europe and Asia. The vessel took six days to ______ it’s as heavy as two thousand blue whales when fully loaded.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
selections: A. dislodge in part due to its sheer size,
B. dislodge, in part due to its sheer size:
C. dislodge, in part due to its sheer size,
D. dislodge, in part, due to its sheer size
explanations: 用标点符号连接句子。首先空格处前是完整的一句话，谓语动词为took，空格处后也是完整的一句话，谓语为is。可以连接两个完整句子的标点符号有句号、分号、冒号、破折号，或者逗号/破折号加并列连词。因此选项B正确。

question:
In the 1880s, inventor Lewis Latimer improved upon Thomas Edison’s design for the electric light bulb. ______ Latimer made the light bulb more durable by placing cardboard around its carbon filament. With this innovation, Latimer became the first Black inventor to contribute to the electrification of the world.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案。"具体而言"在逻辑上表示，这个句子中的信息——拉蒂默使灯泡更耐用——提供了一个具体细节，对前一句中拉蒂默改进灯泡的更一般性声明进行了详细阐述。
B.题目文本解析
在19世纪80年代，发明家刘易斯·拉蒂默对托马斯·爱迪生的电灯泡设计进行了改进。具体而言，拉蒂默通过在碳丝灯丝周围放置硬纸板使灯泡更耐用。凭借这一创新，拉蒂默成为第一个对世界电气化做出贡献的黑人发明家。

question:
Jamaican British artist Willard Wigan is known for his remarkable ______ so small that they are best viewed through a microscope, Wigan’s sculptures are made from tiny natural materials, such as spiderweb strands.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 用标点符号连接句子。首先空格处前是完整的一句话，谓语动词为is，空格处后也是完整的一句话，是以creations作为名词短语修饰后面主句的主语，谓语为are。可以连接两个完整句子的标点符号有句号、分号、冒号、破折号，或者逗号/破折号加并列连词。因此选项C正确。

question:
Jeffrey Gibson’s sculptural object KNOW YOUR MAGIC, BABY, an Everlast-brand exercise bag embroidered with multicolored beads and a fringe associated with the dances of the Ojibwe people, stitches together—literally and figuratively—recognizable symbols from both Native and non-Native cultures. ______ Gibson’s piece also blurs the distinction between contemporary art and traditional crafts.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择B是最佳答案。"In so doing"在逻辑上表示，关于吉布森的作品——它模糊了当代艺术与传统手工艺之间的区别——是该作品融合特定的本土和非本土文化符号的结果或后果。
B.题目文本解析
在这样做的过程中，吉布森的雕塑作品《了解你的魔力，宝贝》是一只刺绣有多彩珠子和与奥吉布韦人舞蹈相关的流苏的Everlast品牌运动包，从字面和象征意义上连接了来自本土和非本土文化的可识别符号。在吉布森的作品中，也模糊了当代艺术和传统工艺之间的区别。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●In World War I, US soldiers who were members of the Choctaw Nation in Oklahoma participated in the Choctaw Code Talkers program.
●The Choctaw Code Talkers were trained to relay coded military information in their native language.
●In World War II, the US Army recruited Navajo (Diné) soldiers to transmit coded messages in their native language.
●These soldiers were known as the Navajo Code Talkers.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the Choctaw Code Talkers and the Navajo Code Talkers. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. US soldiers who were members of the Choctaw Nation in Oklahoma used their native language to relay coded information.
B. In World War II, one group of Navajo (Diné) soldiers was known as the Navajo Code Talkers.
C. Both the Choctaw Code Talkers and the Navajo Code Talkers transmitted coded military messages in the soldiers’ native languages.
D. The Choctaw Code Talkers, not the Navajo Code Talkers, served in World War I.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择C是最佳答案。这句话强调了Choctaw密码通信员和Navajo密码通信员之间的相似之处，因为它解释了这两个团体都使用他们的母语来传递编码消息给军方。
B.题目文本解析
在研究一个主题时，一名学生记录了以下内容：
- 在第一次世界大战中，来自俄克拉荷马州乔克托族的美国士兵参加了乔克托密码通信员计划。
- 乔克托密码通信员接受训练，用他们的母语传递编码的军事信息。
- 在第二次世界大战中，美国军队招募了纳瓦霍（迪内）士兵，用他们的母语传递编码消息。
- 这些士兵被称为纳瓦霍密码通信员。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●The International Center for the Arts of the Americas (ICAA) is directed by Mari Carmen Ramírez.
●Ramírez oversaw an initiative to create an online archive of historical documents related to the history of Latin American and Latino visual art.
●The ICAA digitized over 10,000 documents, including the writings of Latin American and Latino artists and critics.
●The creation of the archive didn’t require historical documents to be removed from their countries of origin.
●Scholars now have more access to these documents.

The student wants to explain an advantage of the ICAA’s archive being digital. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Over 10,000 documents related to the history of Latin American and Latino visual art are part of the ICAA archive.
B. By offering online versions of historical documents, the ICAA’s archive provides more access to these materials without removing them from their countries of origin.
C. Among the historical documents in the ICAA’s archive are the writings of Latin American and Latino artists and critics.
D. The ICAA’s director, Mari Carmen Ramírez, oversaw the creation of an online archive of historical documents related to Latin American and Latino visual art.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择B是最佳答案。这个句子解释了ICAA档案数字化的一个优势，指出由于历史文件不必从它们的原籍国移除，档案提供了更多历史文件的获取。
B.题目文本解析
在研究一个话题时，一名学生记录了以下内容：
- 美洲国际艺术中心（ICAA）由Mari Carmen Ramírez指导。
- Ramírez监督了一个倡议，创建了一个关于拉丁美洲和拉美裔视觉艺术历史的在线档案。
- ICAA数字化了超过10,000份文件，包括拉丁美洲和拉美裔艺术家和评论家的著作。
- 创建这个档案没有要求历史文件从原籍国移除。
- 学者现在对这些文件有更多的获取权限。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Sister Rosetta Tharpe (1915–1973) was a gospel musician.
●She was known for her passionate vocals and electric guitar performances.
●In 2018, Tharpe was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame for her major impact on the genre.
●According to songwriter Roxie Moore, “[Tharpe] would sing until you cried and then she would sing until you danced for joy.”
●According to guitarist Celisse Henderson, “Tharpe is the unquestioned founding mother of rock ’n’ roll.”

The student wants to use a quotation to support a claim about Tharpe’s contribution to rock ’n’ roll. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Gospel musician Sister Rosetta Tharpe had a major impact on rock ’n’ roll, and she was known for her passionate electric guitar performances.
B. Celisse Henderson believes that Sister Rosetta Tharpe had a major impact on the development of rock ’n’ roll.
C. Sister Rosetta Tharpe had such a major impact on rock ’n’ roll that Celisse Henderson called her “the unquestioned founding mother” of the genre.
D. A gospel musician, Sister Rosetta Tharpe had the ability to “sing until you cried” and also “until you danced for joy,” according to Roxie Moore.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择C是最佳答案。这个句子使用亨德森的引用来支持对萨普对摇滚乐的贡献的论断，指出萨普对这一流派的影响使亨德森称她为“无可争议的摇滚乐创始母亲”。
B.题目文本解析
在研究一个话题时，一名学生记录了以下内容：
- Sister Rosetta Tharpe（1915–1973）是一位福音音乐家。
- 她以她充满激情的歌声和电吉他表演而闻名。
- 2018年，Tharpe因对摇滚乐流派的重大影响被引入了摇滚名人堂。
- 根据词曲作者Roxie Moore的说法，“[Tharpe]会唱到你哭泣，然后会唱到你因喜悦而跳舞。”
- 根据吉他手Celisse Henderson的说法，“Tharpe是无可争议的摇滚乐创始母亲。”

question:
The soundtrack to Mira Nair’s 1991 film Mississippi Masala expressively captures the clashing of cultures that happens when ______ (a young Indian woman from Uganda and a young African American man from Mississippi) meet. Featured throughout the film are songs from Uganda’s Afrigo Band, the Indian composer L. Subramaniam, and the Mississippi blues musician Sam Chatmon.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 所有格。然后protagonist后没有修饰它的名词等成分，只有meet这个动词，因此protagonists后不需要加所有格，因此选项B、C错误。又因为空格处的代词代指的为Mira Nair’s 1991 film Mississippi Masala，需要用it，又因为后面还有two protagonists，因此it需要用形容词性物主代词。选项D正确。

question:
After appropriate permissions are granted, a typical archaeological dig begins with a surveyor making a detailed grid of the excavation site. Then, the site is carefully dug, and any artifacts found are recorded and mapped onto the site grid. ______ the artifacts are removed, cataloged, and analyzed in a laboratory.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案。“最后”在逻辑上表明，这个句子中的行动——移除、分类和分析文物——是一个过程中的下一步和最后步骤，紧随之前的调查、挖掘、记录和绘图等行动。
B.题目文本解析
在获得适当的许可后，典型的考古挖掘开始于一名测量员对挖掘现场进行详细的网格标绘。然后，现场被仔细挖掘，找到的任何文物都会被记录并绘制在现场网格上。______然后文物被移除，分类并在实验室中进行分析。

question:
To demonstrate that the integrity of underground metal pipes can be assessed without unearthing the pipes, engineer Aroba Saleem and colleagues ______ the tendency of some metals’ internal magnetic fields to alter under stress: the team showed that such alterations can be measured from a distance and can reveal concentrations of stress in the pipes.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案，因为它在逻辑上最完整地补充了关于利用磁性来检测埋在地下的金属管道中的应力的讨论。在这个上下文中，“exploited”意味着充分利用。文本表明一些金属的磁场在受应力时会发生变化，萨利姆和同事表明可以从远处测量这些变化，从而展示了可以评估地下金属管道的完整性而不必将其挖掘出来。因此，这个上下文表明萨利姆和同事充分利用了金属磁场的这种倾向。
B.题目文本解析
为了证明可以在不挖掘管道的情况下评估地下金属管道的完整性，工程师Aroba Saleem和同事利用了一些金属内部磁场在受应力时发生变化的倾向：团队表明这种变化可以从远处测量，并且可以显示管道中的应力集中。

question:
Changes to vegetation cover and other human activities influence carbon and nitrogen levels in soil, though how deep these effects extend is unclear. Hypothesizing that differences in land use lead to differences in carbon and nitrogen levels that are not restricted to the topsoil layer (0–30 cm deep), Chukwuebuka Okolo and colleagues sampled soils across multiple land-use types (e.g., grazing land, cropland, forest) within each of several Ethiopian locations. They found, though, that across land-use types, carbon and nitrogen decreased to comparably low levels beyond depths of 30 cm.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It describes a phenomenon that scientists do not fully understand, explains a research team’s hypothesis about that phenomenon, and then describes a finding that led the team to refine the hypothesis.

B. It introduces an unresolved scientific question, presents a research team’s hypothesis pertaining to that question, and then describes an observation made by the team that conflicts with that hypothesis.

C. It discusses a process that scientists are somewhat unclear about, introduces competing hypotheses about that process, and then explains how a research team concluded that one of those hypotheses is likely correct.

D. It explains a hypothesis that has been the subject of scientific debate, discusses how a research team tested that hypothesis, and then presents data the team collected that validate the hypothesis.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择B是最佳答案，因为它最准确地描述了文本的整体结构。文本开始解释人类活动如何影响土壤中的碳和氮水平，但这些影响在土壤中体现得有多深仍然是一个未解决的问题。接下来，文本总结了Okolo及其同事关于这个问题的假设——即不同类型的土地利用对碳和氮水平的不同影响也会在表土层以下观察到——然后简要解释了他们用来测试这个假设的方法。最后，文本指出研究人员发现，在表土层以下的深度，所有土地利用类型的碳和氮含量降至类似低水平，这一发现与文本中前期提出的团队假设相矛盾。因此，文本介绍了一个未解决的科学问题，提出了一个研究团队关于该问题的假设，然后描述了该团队所做的观察与他们的假设相冲突的情况。
B.题目文本解析
植被覆盖的变化和其他人类活动影响土壤中的碳和氮水平，尽管这些影响能延伸多深尚不清楚。推测不同的土地利用导致碳和氮水平的差异不仅仅局限于表土层（深度为0-30厘米），Chukwuebuka Okolo和同事在埃塞俄比亚多个地点的多种土地利用类型（例如牧场、耕地、森林）中对土壤进行了取样。然而，他们发现，在不同土地利用类型中，碳和氮在超过30厘米深度后都降至相对较低的水平。

question:
Text 1
Efforts to automate classification of paintings into different artistic styles have had little success, and we have probably reached the technological limit of this work. Furthermore, it’s not obvious that this is even a useful endeavor—as several critics have argued, differences between artistic styles are inherently subjective and often not the best way to understand relationships between works.
Text 2
Baroque painting utilized a very similar color palette as Renaissance painting did to depict largely the same subjects that Renaissance painting depicted. Automated artistic style classifiers often struggle to draw distinctions between these two styles, but Ravneet Singh Arora and Ahmed Elgammal were able to achieve a high degree of accuracy in Baroque/Renaissance comparisons by running one classification model atop another, an approach that demonstrates how much innovation is possible in this realm.

Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the claim in the underlined sentence of Text 1?
selections: A. By emphasizing that there are still advances being made in automated artistic style classification
B. By criticizing previous research into automated artistic style classification systems for focusing on a narrow group of styles
C. By arguing that most people are not able to correctly identify the style of paintings that they are shown
D. By suggesting that people may eventually develop more uniform and accepted ideas about artistic styles and their boundaries
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择A是最佳答案，因为它反映了《文本2》的作者最有可能如何对待《文本1》中下划线句子中的说法。《文本1》首先断言，努力将绘画自动分类到不同风格的尝试在很大程度上未能成功，并且技术限制可能会阻止取得重大成功。《文本2》承认自动艺术风格分类器发现很难区分巴洛克时期绘画和文艺复兴时期绘画，但接着描述了Ravneet Singh Arora和Ahmed Elgammal的工作，他们通过在一个模型之上运行另一个模型实现了更高的分类准确性。《文本2》最后总结描述了Arora和Elgammal的方法，认为这证明了在这一领域仍然存在创新的可能性。因此，《文本2》的作者不会同意《文本1》中下划线句子的说法，即自动绘画分类模型的技术限制已经达到了极限：相反，《文本2》的作者会强调在自动艺术风格分类方面仍在取得进展。
B.题目文本解析
文本1
尝试自动将绘画分类为不同的艺术风格一直取得很少成功，并且我们可能已经达到了这项工作的技术极限。此外，这甚至不明显是一个有用的努力——正如一些评论家所认为的，艺术风格之间的差异在本质上是主观的，并且通常不是理解作品之间关系的最佳方式。
文本2
巴洛克绘画和文艺复兴绘画在很大程度上使用了非常相似的调色板来描绘文艺复兴绘画描绘的大部分相同主题。自动艺术风格分类器经常难以区分这两种风格，但Ravneet Singh Arora和Ahmed Elgammal通过在一个分类模型之上运行另一个分类模型，成功在巴洛克/文艺复兴风格的比较中实现了高度的准确性，这种方法展示了在这一领域中创新有多么可能。

question:
Though not closely related, the hedgehog tenrecs of Madagascar share basic ______ true hedgehogs, including protective spines, pointed snouts, and small body size—traits the two groups of mammals independently developed in response to equivalent roles in their respective habitats.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案，因为在上下文中，“与...相似”意味着具有某种相似之处。文本在两类哺乳动物之间建立了比较，指出虽然刺猬猬和真刺猬没有密切关系，但它们在栖息地中扮演着类似的角色，这种情况导致了它们独立发展了一些相同的身体特征。这个上下文支持了刺猬猬在某些方面与真刺猬相似或共享基本相似之处的观点。
B.题目文本解析
尽管没有密切关系，马达加斯加的刺猬猬与真刺猬共享基本_____，包括保护性的刺、尖尖的吻部和较小的体型——这些特征是这两类哺乳动物为了应对各自栖息地中的类似角色而独立发展的。

question:
The following text is adapted from Herman Melville’s 1855 novel Israel Potter. Israel is a young man wandering through New England during the late eighteenth century.
He hired himself out for three months; at the end of that time to receive for his wages two hundred acres of land lying in New Hampshire. [...] His employer proving false to the contract in the matter of the land, and there being no law in the country to force him to fulfil it, Israel—who, however brave-hearted, and even much of a dare-devil upon a pinch, seems nevertheless to have evinced, throughout many parts of his career, a singular patience and mildness—was obliged to look round for other means of livelihood than clearing out a farm for himself in the wilderness.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It implies that Israel treasures a particular characteristic of his personality when that characteristic should usually be regarded as a flaw.
B. It suggests that if not for a certain aspect of his character, Israel might not have been as easily thwarted in his ambition to establish a farm.
C. It shows why Israel would not have been able to undertake the enormous amount of labor necessary to run a farm even if he had owned the necessary property.
D. It explains why, when the situation requires it, Israel is able to undertake courageous acts that others would generally avoi
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择B是最佳答案，因为它最好地描述了文中下划线部分在整个文本中的功能。文本描述了以色列·波特（Israel Potter）在十八世纪晚期试图在新英格兰建立农场的失败尝试：根据他的合同，他应该在三个月的工作后获得两百英亩土地，但他的雇主拒绝兑现协议，以色列无法通过法律手段获得应得的土地。因此，以色列被迫另找其他谋生手段。为了解释为什么以色列特别容易受雇主的不诚实行为影响，下划线部分表明，尽管以色列在某些情况下“勇敢，甚至在关键时刻非常大胆”，但他也具有“特殊的耐心和温和”。换句话说，以色列在某些情况下可能会表现出勇气，但通常温顺且不喜争论，由此可以推断出以色列经常受人利用。因此，下划线部分暗示，如果不是由于他性格的某个特定方面，以色列可能就不会在实现建立农场的雄心上那么容易受挫。
B.题目文本解析
以下文本改编自赫尔曼·梅尔维尔（Herman Melville）1855年的小说《以色列·波特》。以色列是一名年轻人，在十八世纪晚期漫游新英格兰地区。
他雇佣自己工作了三个月；在那段时间结束时，作为工资，他将获得位于新罕布什尔州的两百英亩土地。[...] 鉴于雇主在土地方面违约，而该国家没有法律强制他兑现，以色列——尽管他勇敢，甚至在关键时刻非常大胆，但在他的职业生涯中似乎表现出了与众不同的耐心和温和——不得不寻找其他谋生手段，而不是在荒野中开垦一片农场。

question:
The Cretaceous pterosaur Tupandactylus navigans is known for having an anomalously oversized head crest. Until an almost complete fossil skeleton was found in Brazil, paleontologists had been able to study only skull specimens from T. navigans, though it was presumed that, like other pterosaurs, the species’s primary form of locomotion was powered flight. Examining the fuller skeleton in 2016, Victor Beccari and his team determined that T. navigans had long hind legs, short wings, and an unusually long neck—characteristics that, combined with the creature’s large-crested head, would have made sustained flight difficult and walking upright relatively comfortable. Based on these findings the team suggests that T. navigans likely ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. flew for longer distances than did other pterosaur species that had oversized head crests.
B. had longer wings than other pterosaur species considered to have been comfortable walking.
C. had a smaller head than researchers expected based on the earlier T. navigans skull specimens.
D. flew for shorter distances and spent more time walking than researchers previously thought.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案，因为它最符合逻辑地完成了关于白垩纪翼龙图帕达克提鲁斯·纳维根斯（Tupandactylus navigans）的讨论。文本首先描述了古生物学家最初根据观察到的仅有化石头骨而不是完整骨骼而推测的T. navigans的情况，即T. navigans有一个过大的头冠，而且和其他翼龙一样，它的主要运动方式应该是飞行。文本继续描述了研究人员维克多·贝卡里（Victor Beccari）及其团队根据研究到的几乎完整的T. navigans化石骨架得出的结论，这提供了化石头骨单独无法提供的额外信息。贝卡里和同事们确定T. navigans有着长的后腿、短的翅膀和异常长的脖子，除了古生物学家之前观察到的过大头冠。这些特征结合在一起会使持续飞行变得困难，而直立行走则会更为舒适，这将使T. navigans不同于其他主要通过飞行移动的翼龙。因此，贝卡里和同事认为古生物学家先前持有的猜测是不准确的：T. navigans可能并不主要通过动力飞行移动，而是可能飞行的距离更短，而且比研究人员先前认为的更多时间在行走。
B.题目文本解析
白垩纪翼龙图帕达克提鲁斯·纳维根斯以其异常巨大的头饰而闻名。直到在巴西发现了一具几乎完整的化石骨骼之前，古生物学家只能研究T. navigans的头骨标本，尽管人们认为，像其他翼龙一样，这种物种的主要运动方式是动力飞行。2016年，维克多·贝卡里（Victor Beccari）及其团队研究了更完整的骨架，确定了T. navigans具有长的后腿、短的翅膀和异常长的脖子等特征，加上生物体的大头饰，这些特征使持续飞行变得困难，而直立行走相对舒适。基于这些发现，团队建议T. navigans很可能______

question:
Mary Engle Pennington, a chemist who helped advance home refrigeration, undoubtedly made a substantial impact on society, but her place in our historical memory is perhaps more ______ than that of Stephanie Kwolek, who invented the incredibly strong material known as Kevlar, an accomplishment for which she will long be remembered.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择B是最佳答案，因为它在逻辑上最完整地补充了关于Mary Engle Pennington和Stephanie Kwolek的讨论。在这个上下文中，“tentative”意味着不确定或不明确。文本表明在“我们的历史记忆中的位置”方面，Pennington和Kwolek之间存在对比，并指出Kwolek“将长期被记住”因为她发明了凯夫拉材料。这个上下文表明，尽管Pennington对社会产生了影响，但她的记忆可能不如Kwolek那么长久，换句话说，她的可记忆性可能比Kwolek的更不确定。
B.题目文本解析
玛丽·恩格尔·彭宁顿是一位帮助推动家用制冷技术发展的化学家，她无疑对社会产生了巨大影响，但她在我们的历史记忆中的地位可能比起发明了极强材料Kevlar的斯蒂芬妮·科沃克来说，更为________。

question:
While recent scholarship has undermined claims that the works of twelfth-century Islamic philosopher Ibn Rushd were ______ other Muslim philosophers of his time, it is indisputable that his location in the Muslim-ruled area of what is now Spain meant that his works were primarily available thousands of miles west of the era’s center of Islamic thought.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地完成了文本对十二世纪伊斯兰哲学家伊本·鲁什德的讨论。在这个上下文中，“对...不重要”意味着对相关性不大。根据文本，伊本·鲁什德的作品主要在他生活的西班牙可获得，远离穆斯林世界的中心地区，这一事实可能支持这样一个结论：他对当时的穆斯林同行的影响有限。然而，文本暗示最近的学术研究表明，他的作品仍然对他同时代的其他穆斯林哲学家产生了影响。这个上下文支持这样的观点：在这一时期，他的作品对伊斯兰思想并不无关紧要。
B.题目文本解析
尽管最近的学术研究削弱了对十二世纪伊斯兰哲学家伊本·鲁什德作品与他同时代其他穆斯林哲学家相关的说法，但毫无疑问，他生活在如今西班牙的穆斯林统治区的位置意味着他的作品主要在当时伊斯兰思想中心地区以西数千英里处得以获得。

question:
To understand how temperature change affects microorganism-mediated cycling of soil nutrients in alpine ecosystems, Eva Kaštovská et al. collected plant-soil cores in the Tatra Mountains at elevations around 2,100 meters and transplanted them to elevations of 1,700–1,800 meters, where the mean air temperature was warmer by 2°C. Microorganism-mediated nutrient cycling was accelerated in the transplanted cores; crucially, microorganism community composition was unchanged, allowing Kaštovská et al. to attribute the acceleration to temperature-induced increases in microorganism activity.

It can most reasonably be inferred from the text that the finding about the microorganism community composition was important for which reason?
selections: A. It provided preliminary evidence that microorganism-mediated nutrient cycling was accelerated in the transplanted cores.
B. It suggested that temperature-induced changes in microorganism activity may be occurring at increasingly high elevations.
C. It ruled out a potential alternative explanation for the acceleration in microorganism-mediated nutrient cycling.
D. It clarified that microorganism activity levels in the plant-soil cores varied depending on which microorganisms comprised the community.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择C是最佳答案，因为它准确描述了为什么关于微生物群落组成的发现很重要。文本描述了Eva Kaštovská及其团队进行的一项实验，在实验中他们收集了来自一个海拔高度的植物土壤芯，并将其移植到海拔较低、平均空气温度较高的地点。Kaštovská及其团队观察到，在移植的土壤芯中，微生物介导的营养循环加速进行，而且“关键是，微生物群落组成没有改变”，这使得团队能够将加速归因于由温度差异引起的微生物活动变化。这明显意味着团队否则无法作出这种归因，这意味着微生物组成的改变代表了加速的另一个可能解释，必须被排除在外。
B.题目文本解析
为了了解温度变化如何影响高山生态系统中土壤养分的微生物介导循环，Eva Kaštovská等人在塔特拉山脉海拔约2100米处收集了植物土壤芯，并将其移植到海拔1700-1800米处，那里的平均空气温度比较高2°C。在移植的土壤芯中，微生物介导的营养循环加速进行；关键是，微生物群落组成没有改变，这使得Kaštovská等人能够将加速归因于温度诱导的微生物活动增加。

question:
It may seem that the optimal strategy for an animal pursuing prey or escaping predators is to move at maximal speed, but the energy expense of exploiting full speed capacity can disfavor such a strategy even in escape contexts, as evidenced by the fact that ______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the text?
selections: A. most lizard species use about the same percentage of their maximal speed when escaping predation as they do when pursuing prey.
B. multiple lizard species move at an average of less than 90% of their maximal speed while escaping predation.
C. more lizard species use, on average, 90%–100% of their maximal speed while escaping predation than use any other percentage of their maximal spee
D. at least 4 lizard species use, on average, less than 100% of their maximal speed while pursuing prey.
explanations:
A.中文解析
B选项是最佳答案，因为它描述了图表中的数据，完整地说明了文本讨论了蜥蜴物种在逃避捕食者时使用最大速度的情况。根据文本内容，以最大速度（可能的最高速度）移动需要消耗大量能量，因此即使在逃离捕食者时，这并不总是动物们有效的策略。该图表展示了关于蜥蜴物种在逃离捕食者或追捕猎物时使用最大速度的平均百分比的数据。图表根据在逃离和追捕时使用30%-39%、40%-49%、50%-59%、60%-69%、70%-79%、80%-89%和90%-100%最大速度的物种数量对数据进行了分类。在图表中，逃离捕食者时，至少有一种蜥蜴物种在以下每个百分比类别中：50%-59%、60%-69%、70%-79%和80%-89%。因此，图表中的数据显示，多种蜥蜴物种在逃离捕食时的平均速度低于它们的最大速度的90%。
B.题目文本解析
尽管看起来对于追捕猎物或逃避捕食者，动物的最佳策略是以最大速度移动，但是利用全部速度能力所需的能量开支可能不利于这样的策略，甚至在逃离情境中，这一事实的证据是 ______。

question:
“Poetry” is a 1919 poem by Marianne Moore. The poem highlights an ambivalence toward poetry as the speaker acknowledges its merits while also expressing a sense of displeasure, writing ______

Which quotation from “Poetry” most effectively illustrates the claim?
selections: A. “nor is it valid / to discriminate against ‘business documents and / school-books’; all these phenomena are important.”
B. “One must make a distinction / however: when dragged into prominence by half poets, the result is not / poetry”
C. “when [poems] become so derivative as to become unintelligible, the / same thing may be said for all of us—that we / do not admire what / we cannot understan”
D. “Reading [poetry], however, with a perfect contempt for it, one discovers that there is in / it after all, a place for the genuine.”
explanations:
A.中文解析
D选项是最佳答案，因为它最有效地使用了“诗歌”中的引语来阐明诗歌突显对诗歌持矛盾态度或矛盾情感的主张。在引语中，演讲者暗示人们可能“鄙夷”或鄙视诗歌，但即使持有这种负面态度，人们也会发现“一个真诚的位置”。由于该引语表达了对诗歌持矛盾态度，它有效地阐明了演讲者在讨论阅读诗歌的价值和不快时的矛盾情感。
B.题目文本解析
“诗歌”是玛丽安·摩尔（Marianne Moore）于1919年创作的一首诗。这首诗突显了对诗歌的矛盾态度，因为演讲者在承认诗歌的优点的同时也表达了一种不快感，写道 ______。

question:
To investigate potential cognitive benefits of taking leave from work, psychologist Jan Packer and colleagues conducted a six-month study of Australian university staff members who took no leave from work during the study, took 2–4 days of leave, or took 1–5 weeks of leave. Tests of attentiveness were administered to participants three times during the study: at random for the no-leave staff, and for the rest, one week before their leave, one week following their return to work, and one week after the second test administration. After analyzing the results, the researchers concluded that longer leave times might not confer a greater cognitive benefit than shorter leave times do.

Which choice best describes data from the graph that support the researchers’ conclusion?
selections: A. In the second test administration, participants who took 2–4 days of leave had higher average attentiveness scores than did those who took no leave, but in the third test administration, those who took no leave had higher average scores than those who took 1–5 weeks of leave.
B. In the first test administration, participants who took 2–4 days of leave had lower average attentiveness scores than did those who took 1–5 weeks of leave and those who took no leave.
C. In both the second and third test administrations, participants who took 2–4 days of leave had higher average attentiveness scores than did participants who took 1–5 weeks of leave.
D. In the second and third test administrations, participants who took 2–4 days of leave had higher average attentiveness scores than did those who took no leave.
explanations:
A.中文解析
C选项是最佳答案，因为它描述了图表中的数据，支持了Jan Packer及其同事对大学员工休假时间对专注力的影响的结论。根据文本，研究者的研究设计包括一个不休假的员工群体，一个休假2-4天的员工群体和一个休假1-5周的员工群体。休假的参与者在休假前一周（第一次测试）、回到工作岗位后一周（第二次测试）和回到工作岗位后两周（第三次测试）进行了专注力测试。没有休假的参与者随机进行了三次测试。图表显示，在回到工作岗位后一周，只休假2-4天的参与者的平均专注力得分在540至600之间，而休假1-5周的参与者的平均得分在480至540之间。在回到工作岗位后两周，只休假2-4天的参与者的平均得分在480至540之间，而休假1-5周的参与者的平均得分约为480。换句话说，图表显示，在两个休假后测试日期上，休假时间更长的参与者的平均专注力得分低于休假时间较短的参与者。由于专注力是认知功能的一个指标，这些数据证实了Packer及其同事的结论，即长时间休假可能不会比较短时间休假带来更大的认知益处。
B.题目文本解析
为了调查休假对认知功能的潜在益处，心理学家Jan Packer和同事对在研究期间没有休假、休假2-4天或休假1-5周的澳大利亚大学教职员工进行了为期六个月的研究。在研究期间，参与者进行了专注力测试，测试分别在研究期间三次进行：对于没有休假的员工是随机进行的，对于其他员工是在他们休假前一周、回到工作后一周和第二次测试后一周进行的。在分析结果后，研究人员得出结论，长时间的休假可能不会带来比短时间休假更大的认知益处。

question:
Despite the generalizations about human behavior they have produced, many studies of behavioral psychology have used highly unrepresentative subject pools: students at the colleges and universities where the researchers are employed. To ______ this situation, it is necessary to actively recruit subjects from diverse backgrounds and locations.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择B是最佳答案，因为它在逻辑上最完整地补充了关于行为心理学研究的讨论。在这个上下文中，“ameliorate”意味着帮助改善或提高。文本指出，许多行为心理学研究存在缺陷，因为使用的被试群体“非常不具代表性”。然后建议研究人员应该从“不同背景和地点”招募被试，以帮助解决不具代表性被试群体的问题。因此，这个上下文传达了侧重多样性的招募工作将有助于改善文本中概述的问题。
B.题目文本解析
尽管它们产生了关于人类行为的概括，但许多行为心理学研究使用了非常不具代表性的被试群体：研究人员就职的学院和大学的学生。为了改善这种情况，有必要积极从不同背景和地点招募被试。

question:
Some ethicists hold that the moral goodness of an individual’s actions depends solely on whether the actions themselves are good, irrespective of the context in which they are carried out. Philosopher L. Sebastian Purcell has shown that surviving works of Aztec (Nahua) philosophy express a very different view. Purcell reveals that these works posit an ethical system in which an individual’s actions are judged in light of how well they accord with the individual’s role in society and how well they contribute to the community. To the extent that these works are representative of Aztec thought, Purcell’s analysis suggests that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. the Aztecs would have disputed the idea that the morality of an individual’s actions can be assessed by appealing to standards of behavior that are independent of the individual’s social circumstances.
B. the Aztecs would not have accepted the notion that the morality of an individual’s actions can be fairly evaluated by people who do not live in the same society as that individual.

C. actions by members of Aztec society who contributed a great deal to their community could be judged as morally good even if those actions were inconsistent with behaviors the Aztecs regarded as good in all contexts.
D. similar actions performed by people in different social roles in Aztec society would have been regarded as morally equivalent unless those actions led to different outcomes for the community.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择A是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地完成了有关阿兹特克（纳瓦）伦理的讨论。文本表明，根据普赛尔对现有阿兹特克哲学作品的解释，阿兹特克伦理系统将个体的行为视为与该个体在社会角色以及这些行为对社区的影响相关。文本将这种观点与一些伦理学家持有的另一种观点进行了对比，即无论行为发生在何种情境中，行为都是道德上好或坏的。因此，普赛尔的分析表明，阿兹特克人会坚称个体行为的道德性根植于该人在社区中的位置和行为的影响，因此在缺少这种背景的情况下无法确定个体行为的道德性。
B.题目文本解析
一些伦理学家认为，一个人的行为的道德善良程度仅取决于这些行为本身是否是好的，不受行为发生的背景的影响。哲学家L. Sebastian Purcell表明，存世的阿兹特克（纳瓦）哲学作品表达了一种截然不同的观点。Purcell揭示了这些作品提出了一个伦理系统，其中个体的行为将根据其是否与个体在社会中的角色相符以及它们对社区的贡献程度而受到评判。在这些作品代表阿兹特克思想的程度上，Purcell的分析表明______

question:
To test whether a medication is effective, scientists compare outcomes for patients taking it and patients taking a placebo (a medically inactive substance). Patients normally aren’t told they’re receiving a placebo, but a research team conducted a study to see if there might be a medical benefit to telling them. The team used various measures to evaluate participants, with higher ratings indicating greater well-being in each measure. Compared to the mean ratings after 21 days for participants in the control group, the mean ratings for participants who were aware of taking a placebo ______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
selections: A. ranged from 5.0 to 92.00, indicating that well-being varied widely from participant to participant.
B. were lower for two measures, with the rating for only one measure indicating greater well-being for these participants.
C. ranged from 3.9 to 46.00, with no rating indicating greater well-being in any measure for these participants.
D. were higher for all three measures, indicating greater overall well-being for these participants.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案，因为它最有效地利用了表格中的数据来完成关于研究中两组参与者的平均评分的比较陈述。文本解释了一个研究团队使用各种措施评估了研究参与者，以了解告知患者他们正在接受安慰剂可能会有医学益处。表格显示了团队对参与者在21天后三个措施的平均评分：整体改善、症状严重度减轻和生活质量改善。根据表格，对于接受安慰剂的参与者，这三个措施的平均评分都高于对照组的参与者。鉴于较高的评分表示更好的幸福感，正如文本所述，表中的平均评分表明，接受安慰剂的参与者整体幸福感要高于对照组的参与者。
B.题目文本解析
为了测试药物是否有效，科学家比较服用药物的患者和服用安慰剂（一种医学上无效的物质）的患者的结果。通常不会告知患者他们正在接受安慰剂，但一个研究团队进行了一项研究，以查看告知他们可能是否存在医学益处。该团队使用各种措施评估参与者，每项措施的较高评分表示在该措施中具有更好的幸福感。与对照组参与者21天后的平均评分相比，意识到自己正在服用安慰剂的参与者的平均评分______

question:
In a painting titled “The Milkmaid” by Johannes Vermeer, the artist prominently features a bread basket, milk pitcher, and bowl. Such quotidian objects, depicted in exquisite detail by Vermeer, a painter celebrated for his naturalism, ______ the daily minutiae of a seventeenth-century Dutch household.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主谓一致。句子的主语为such quotidian objects，为复数，因此谓语动词应该为reveal，选项D正确。

question:
For thousands of years, humans have used domesticated goats (Capra hircus) to clear land of unwanted vegetation. When it comes to their diets, goats are notoriously ______ they will devour all kinds of shrubs and weeds, leaving virtually no part of any plant unconsumed.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 用标点符号连接句子。首先空格处前是完整的一句话，when的时间状语从句，主句谓语动词为are，空格处后也是完整的一句话，谓语为will。可以连接两个完整句子的标点符号有句号、分号、冒号、破折号，或者逗号/破折号加并列连词。因此选项D正确

question:
In her 1983 book The Managed Heart: Commercialization of Human Feeling, sociologist Arlie Russell Hochschild first explored at length her conception of a “sociology of emotions”—the idea that the various cultural and ideological frameworks a person has internalized (class, gender, political affiliation, etc.) ______ each emotional reaction that person has within a situation.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 主谓一致。The idea后的同位语中句子的主语为frameworks，为复数，因此谓语动词应该为underline，选项C正确。

question:
Latin America is known to have dozens, if not hundreds, of popular dance forms. Only five of these dances are included in international ballroom dance ______ rumba, samba, cha-cha-cha, paso doble, and jive—the last of which is grouped with the other Latin dances despite not having Latin roots.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 用标点符号连接句子。首先根据句意，only...competitions是与上一句意思相反，因此however是要用逗号与only...competitions相连，选项D错误。又因为上文说有Only five of these dances are included，因此后文具体说明了这五种舞蹈，所以需要用冒号。选项A正确。

question:
Physical materials can be classified by how much light passes through them. Clear glass, which is classified as transparent, allows all (or almost all) light to pass ______ wax paper, which is classified as translucent, allows only some light to pass through.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 用标点符号连接句子。首先空格处前是完整的一句话，谓语动词为allows，空格处后也是完整的一句话，谓语为allows。可以连接两个完整句子的标点符号有句号、分号、冒号、破折号，或者逗号/破折号加并列连词。因此选项C正确

question:
In retrospect, one of the lessons of the 2003 Human Genome Project is that a gene is affected by many factors, not the least of which is its interactions with the protein products of other genes. ______ rather than just focusing on the human genome, efforts to better understand gene mutations related to disease have begun to consider the human proteome, the complete set of proteins expressed by human genes.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案。"因此"在逻辑上表明，这个句子陈述了对2003年人类基因组计划的前一信息的结果或后果。考虑到2003年项目的一个重要教训（即基因受其他基因的蛋白产物相互作用的影响），研究已经开始考虑人类蛋白质组而不仅仅是基因组。
B.题目文本解析
因此，回顾2003年人类基因组计划的一个教训是，一个基因受许多因素影响，其中至少之一是它与其他基因的蛋白质产物的相互作用。______因此，努力更好地理解与疾病相关的基因突变已经开始考虑人类蛋白质组，即由人类基因表达的完整蛋白质组。

question:
A turtle shell appears external to the animal, protecting its body like armor. ______ the shell is often incorrectly assumed to be an exoskeleton, a rigid outer casing like that of a crustacean or an insect, when in fact it is an endoskeleton, a part of the turtle’s internal bone structure, more akin to a spine or a pair of ribs.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择D是最佳答案。"因此"在逻辑上表明，关于乌龟壳的这个句子——即人们错误地认为它们是外骨骼——是因为壳看起来是外部的动物的结果。
B.题目文本解析
乌龟壳看起来是外部的动物，像盔甲一样保护着它的身体。______因此，人们常常错误地认为这个壳是外骨骼，类似于甲壳动物或昆虫的硬外壳，实际上它是内骨骼，是乌龟内部骨骼结构的一部分，更类似于脊柱或一对肋骨。

question:
According to Duverger’s law, countries with single-ballot majoritarian elections for single-member districts tend to polarize into two-party systems, wherein dueling political parties consistently dominate the political system. ______ countries with proportional-representation electoral systems tend to support multi-partyism, under which power gets distributed among many political parties.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择B是最佳答案。“相反”在逻辑上表明，这个句子中的信息——即采用比例代表制选举制度的国家往往朝向多党制——与之前提到的采用单一选票多数制选举的国家倾向于拥有两党制度形成对比。
B.题目文本解析
根据杜维日尔法则，采用单一选票多数制度进行单议员选区选举的国家往往会形成两党制，其中两大政党持续主导政治体系。______相反，采用比例代表制选举制度的国家往往支持多党制，权力分布在许多政党之间。

question:
Working together with the Navajo Nation Department of Water Resources, Dr. Lani Tsinnajinnie analyzed data about snowpack levels in the Chuska Mountains. She found that the snowpack (the amount of snow on the ground) was deepest in early March at lower elevations. At higher elevations, ______ the snowpack was deepest in mid-March.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
A.中文解析
“另一方面”在逻辑上表明，该句中的信息——即在三月中旬，恰斯卡山的较高海拔处的积雪最深——与之前提到的低海拔处的积雪在三月初最深的信息形成对比。选择C是最佳答案。
B.题目文本解析
在与纳瓦霍部门的水资源合作中，Lani Tsinnajinnie博士分析了恰斯卡山地区的积雪水平数据。她发现，在低海拔地区，积雪（地面上的积雪量）在三月初最深。在较高海拔处，______积雪在三月中旬最深。

question:
The Boston Saloon was one of the most popular African American–owned establishments in nineteenth-century Nevada. ______ by businessman William A.G. Brown, the saloon was known to offer elegant accommodations and an inclusive environment.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 状语的逻辑主语。因为后文的主语为the saloon，所以逗号前非谓语动词应该修饰the saloon，为过去分词时态比较适合，表示被创造，因此选择A正确。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●The US government classifies sensitive information according to the degree to which disclosure could affect the nation’s security.
●Information that could cause “damage” to national security is classified as Confidential.
●Information that could cause “serious damage” to national security is classified as Secret.
●Most routine diplomatic correspondence, if disclosed, could cause damage but not serious damage to national security.
●Diplomatic correspondence includes communication with both allies and adversaries.

The student wants to indicate which category most routine diplomatic correspondence belongs in, based on how sensitive information is classified. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. According to the US government, which classifies such sensitive information as routine diplomatic correspondence, Confidential information could damage national security if disclose
B. Most routine diplomatic correspondence is classified according to the degree to which disclosure could affect the nation’s security.
C. Having the potential to damage national security if disclosed, most routine diplomatic correspondence is classified as Confidential.
D. If disclosed, communication with both allies and adversaries could affect the nation’s security.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择C是最佳答案。这个句子说明了大部分例行外交信函属于哪个分类类别，解释说这些信函被分类为机密，因为如果泄露可能会危害国家安全。
B.题目文本解析
在研究一个主题时，一位学生做了以下笔记：
- 美国政府根据信息泄露可能对国家安全造成的影响程度对敏感信息进行分类。
- 可能会对国家安全造成“损害”的信息被分类为机密。
- 可能会对国家安全造成“严重损害”的信息被分类为机密。
- 大部分例行外交通信，如果泄露，可能会造成损害，但不会对国家安全造成严重损害。
- 外交通信包括与盟友和对手的交流。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
●Elizabeth Catlett’s sculpture Recognition (1970) shows two African American figures with rounded, indistinct features.
●The figures reach out to each other in a pose that symbolizes a close, supportive relationship.
●Her sculpture Students Aspire (1978) shows two African American figures with sharply defined features.
●The figures hold an equal sign above their heads with one hand and embrace each other with the other hand.
●This pose symbolizes their support for each other in the pursuit of equality.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two sculptures. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Catlett’s Students Aspire depicts two figures supporting each other in the pursuit of equality.
B. Recognition and Students Aspire both show African American figures in poses that symbolize supportive relationships.
C. Catlett completed Recognition in 1970 and Students Aspire in 1978.
D. The figures in Recognition have features that are rounded and indistinct, while the figures in Students Aspire have sharply defined features.
explanations:
A.中文解析
选择B是最佳答案。这个句子强调了雕塑《Recognition》和《Students Aspire》之间的相似性，指出两个雕塑都展示了象征支持关系的非裔美国人形象。
B.题目文本解析
在研究一个主题时，一位学生做了以下笔记：
- 伊丽莎白·卡特莱特的雕塑《认同》（1970年）展示了两个非裔美国人的人物，具有圆润、模糊的特征。
- 这些人物以一种象征密切、支持关系的姿势互相伸出手。
- 她的雕塑《学生向往》（1978年）展示了两个非裔美国人的人物，特征鲜明。
- 这些人物用一只手在头顶上举着一个等号，用另一只手互相拥抱。
- 这个姿势象征着他们在追求平等的过程中相互支持。

In the xy-plane, the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> passes through the point <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>24</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>24</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo><</mo> <mn>0</mn></math>. Which of the following must be true?
explanations: 对于给定坐标或函数中具体点的位置，可以将坐标<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>24</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>带入函数中，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>0</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi> </mrow> <msqrt> <mo>−</mo> <mn>24</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi> </mrow> </msqrt></math>，而根号的值实数范围内为非负，所以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msqrt> <mo>−</mo> <mn>24</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mi>b</mi> </msqrt> <mo>=</mo> <mn>0</mn></math>得到b=24，再代入x=24得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi> </mrow> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>24</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi> </mrow> <msqrt> <mn>24</mn> <mo>+</mo> <mn>24</mn> </msqrt> <mo><</mo> <mn>0</mn></math>，同样根号为非负，a一定小于0，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>f</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>a</mi> <msqrt> <mi>b</mi> </msqrt></math>不是唯一值，而<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi> </mrow> <mo><</mo> <mn>0</mn></math>，b=24，必然<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi> </mrow> <mo><</mo> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi> </mrow></math>

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>19</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>121</mn></math>
The graph of the given equation is a circle in the xy-plane. The point (a, b) lies on the circle. Which of the following is a possible value for a?
explanations: 题目中方程为标准圆方程，圆心在<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>19</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>半径为11（121开根号），问题中讨论的a是坐标（a，b）中x坐标，只需要观察圆心x坐标<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn></math>与选项的关系，选项中只有B的<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>14</mn></math>与<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn></math>的距离小于等于半径11

question: A right rectangular prism has a height of 9 inches. The length of the prism’s base is x inches, which is 7 inches more than the width of the prism’s base. Which function V gives the volume of the prism, in cubic inches, in terms of the length of the prism’s base?
selections: A. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>V</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>

B. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>V</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>

C. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>V</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>

D. <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>V</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>
explanations: 读题可知，长方体高9，长为x，宽为（x-7），根据长方形体积公式可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>V</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>9</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>7</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>。注意通过语言表述的计算规则

question: What is the value of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>tan</mi> <mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>92</mn> <mi>π</mi> </mrow> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac></math>?
explanations: 在标准圆体系下，每2π一个周期，92π/3相当于2π/3，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>tan</mi> <mo data-mjx-texclass="NONE">⁡</mo> <mn>2</mn> <mi>π</mi> <mrow> <mo>/</mo> </mrow> <mn>3</mn> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <msqrt> <mn>3</mn> </msqrt></math>

question: Two customers purchased the same kind of bread and eggs at a store. The first customer paid 12.45 dollars for 1 loaf of bread and 2 dozen eggs. The second customer paid 19.42 dollars for 4 loaves of bread and 1 dozen eggs. What is the cost, in dollars, of 1 dozen eggs?
explanations: 一次函数应用题问题，可以设bread价格为x，egg价格为y，根据文字表述得到组system of equations:x+2y=12.45 and 4x+y=19.42，用最基本的方法消去x，x=12.45-2y代入，4（12.45-2y）+y=19.42，得到7y=4*12.45-19.42借助计算器准确计算得到y= 4.34（题目问的是y，选择消去x更快捷）

question: In the xy-plane, line p has a slope of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mn>5</mn> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac></math> and an x-intercept of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>. What is the y-coordinate of the y-intercept of line p?
explanations: 一次函数slope确定为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mn>5</mn> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac></math>，可得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi> </mrow> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mfrac> <mn>5</mn> <mn>3</mn> </mfrac> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi> </mrow> <mo>+</mo> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi> </mrow></math>形式，代入点<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>6</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>0</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>b</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>10</mn></math>，b的值就是y-intercept

question: For the linear function h, the graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mi>h</mi> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> in the xy-plane passes through the points (7, 21) and (9, 25). Which equation defines h?
explanations: 由函数信息（7, 21）和（9, 25）可以得到，一次函数斜率(25-21)/(9-7)=2，得到y=2x+b，再随意代入一个坐标，如（7, 21）可得到b=7，所以为y=2x+7

question:
23, 27, 27, 32, 35, 36, 52
What is the range of the 7 scores shown?
explanations: 统计考点中的range，range=max-min，题中max为52，min为23，range=52-23=29（注意range在数学中不是范围，是一个数值）

question: Which quadratic equation has no real solutions?
explanations: 利用根数量判定式<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mi>a</mi> <mi>c</mi> <mo><</mo> <mn>0</mn></math>，寻找答案可得只有D的<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>−</mo> <mn>4</mn> <mi>a</mi> <mi>c</mi> <mo><</mo> <mn>0</mn></math>

question: How many solutions does the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>12</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mo>=</mo> <mo>−</mo> <mn>3</mn> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>12</mn> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> have?
explanations: 相当于是一次函数方程组问题，整理左右去掉括号得到12x-36=-3x-36，解得x=0

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn></math>
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>16</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>63</mn></math>
A solution to the given system of equations is (x, y). What is the greatest possible value of x?
explanations: 经典的二次函数方程组system of equations，将y消去得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>16</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>63</mn><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn></math>，整理标准形式<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>15</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>54</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，无论利用转换成因式(x+6)(x+9)=0，还是求根公式<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>±</mo><msqrt><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi></msqrt></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>a</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>都可以得到解<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn><mtext>or</mtext><mo>−</mo><mn>9</mn></math>，题目说是最大的x所以答案为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn></math>

question: A right triangle has legs with lengths of 11 centimeters and 9 centimeters. What is the length of this triangle’s hypotenuse, in centimeters?
explanations: 题目没有提供三角形的图，确认直角边分别为11和9，利用勾股定理计算斜边，斜边<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo>=</mo> <msqrt> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>11</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mn>9</mn> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> </msqrt> <mo>=</mo> <msqrt> <mn>202</mn> </msqrt></math>

question: Kaylani used fabric measuring 5 yards in length to make each suit for a men’s choir. The relationship between the number of suits that Kaylani made, x, and the total length of fabric that she purchased y, in yards, is represented by the equation <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mi>y</mi> <mo>−</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>6</mn></math>. What is the best interpretation of 6 in this context?
selections: B. Kaylani purchased a total of 6 yards of fabric.
C. Kaylani used a total of 6 yards of fabric to make the suits.
D. Kaylani purchased 6 yards more fabric than she used to make the suits.
explanations: 应用题审题：y是总长度total length purchased ，5（5 yards each suit）x是suit数量，5x是suit总长度，y-5x就是purchased 比suit总用料多了6 yards .

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>18</mn></math>
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>18</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>15</mn></math>
If the given equations are graphed in the xy-plane, at how many points do the graphs of the equations intersect?
explanations:
经典的二次函数方程组system of equations，将y消去得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>18</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>15</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>18</mn></math>；
方法1：整理得到标准形式<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>108</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>975</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，利用判别式<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi><mo><</mo><mn>0</mn></math>到0个解；
方法2：<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>18</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>15</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>18</mn></math>转化成<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>18</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>观察可发现<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>18</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>≤</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，且<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo><</mo><mn>0</mn></math>，组合起来一定不等于0，所以无解选D

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1.84</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mrow><mfrac><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></mfrac></mrow></msup></math>
The function f is defined by the given equation. The equation can be rewritten as <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>p</mi><mn>100</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mi>x</mi></msup></math>, where p is a constant. Which of the following is closest to the value of p?
explanations:
方法1：<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1.84</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mrow><mfrac><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></mfrac></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>p</mi><mn>100</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mi>x</mi></msup></math>，解指数函数，两侧同时4次方再开根号x次方，得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1.84</mn><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>p</mi><mn>100</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mn>4</mn></msup></math>，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>p</mi><mn>100</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mroot><mn>1.84</mn><mn>4</mn></mroot></math>，利用计算器<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>p</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>100</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mroot><mn>1.84</mn><mn>4</mn></mroot><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>，利用计算器计算可得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mo>≈</mo><mn>16.47</mn></math>；
方法2：为方便计算可令x=4(不用x=1是为了避免出现计算时有分数)，直接得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1.84</mn><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>p</mi><mn>100</mn></mfrac><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mn>4</mn></msup></math>再代入计算。

question: A truck can haul a maximum weight of 5,630 pounds. During one trip, the truck will be used to haul a 190 -pound piece of equipment as well as several crates. Some of these crates weigh 25 pounds each and the others weigh 62 pounds each. Which inequality represents the possible combinations of the number of 25-pound crates, x, and the number of 62-pound crates, y, the truck can haul during one trip if only the piece of equipment and the crates are being hauled?
explanations: 准确提取文中数字、单位、程度表述词汇获取准确数学关系信息，x个25 pounds each,y个62 pounds each，转化为算式25x+62y，maximum weight of 5,630 pounds表示小于等于5630pounds，同时190-pound单位和5630单位一致，语言表达说该重量已包含在车内，是载货量要排除掉的重量，用减法，所以整个式子是<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>25</mn> <mi>x</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>62</mn> <mi>y</mi> <mo>≤</mo> <mn>5</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mn>630</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mn>190</mn></math>，选A（技巧，若有同学认为是5630+190，观察选项并没有该数字即可排除）

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>6</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn><mi>r</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>p</mi><mi>w</mi></math>
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>7</mn><mi>r</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>w</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>w</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>11</mn></math>
In the given system of equations, p is a constant. If the system has no solution, what is the value of p?
explanations: 一次函数方程组system of equations， no solution意味着两个line具有相同slope和不同的y-intercept，式子1的slope为p/7，式子2的slope为10/7，斜率相等得到p=10（本题不需要验证y-intercept是否相等）

question:
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>9</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>13</mn></math>
<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>y</mi></math>
What is the solution (x, y) to the given system of equations?
explanations: 经典的一次函数方程组system of equations，直接消去y（或x）得到等式，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>26</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>18</mn><mi>x</mi></math>，解得<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></math>，代入任意方程中得到<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn></math>，解的坐标为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>

question: A company that produces socks wants to estimate the percent of the socks produced in a typical week that are defective. A random sample of 310 socks produced in a certain week were inspected. Based on the sample, it is estimated that 12% of all socks produced by the company in this week are defective, with an associated margin of error of 3.62%. Based on the estimate and associated margin of error, which of the following is the most appropriate conclusion about all socks produced by the company during this week?
selections: A. 3.62% of the socks are defective.
B. It is plausible that between 8.38% and 15.62% of the socks are defective.
C. 12% of the socks are defective.
D. It is plausible that more than 15.62% of the socks are defective.
explanations: 准确提取文中数字相关信息：样本310个，预计百分比12%，误差边界margin of error 3.62%，置信区间在<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mn>12</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi> <mo>±</mo> <mn>3.62</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi> <mo>=</mo> <mn>8.38</mn> <mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi></math>至15.62%（注意这个范围并不是数据一定在的范围，常用plausible 来形容，如果选项说数据一定在这个方位内，是错误选项）

question: The graph of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></math> is shown, where b and c are constants. What is the value of bc?
explanations: 通过图可知顶点vertex的x值为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></math>，顶点公式<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi><mrow><mo>/</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>a</mi></math>可得b=4，图中y-intercept直接读取为<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn></math>，所以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn></math>，<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>b</mi><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>24</mn></math>.（将图中三个点坐标带入计算也可，但是计算量大不推荐）

question: The result of increasing the quantity x by 400% is 60. What is the value of x?
explanations: 通过文字表述可得等式：x（1+400%）=60，得到x=12，注意 increasing  by的意思是在原有基础上增加不能丢掉数字1

question: In the xy-plane, a circle has center C with coordinates (h, k). Points A and B lie on the circle. Point A has coordinates <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>h</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo>,</mo> <mi>k</mi> <mo>+</mo> <msqrt> <mn>102</mn> </msqrt> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, and ∠ACB is a right angle. What is the length of <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mover> <mrow> <mi>A</mi> <mi>B</mi> </mrow> <mo accent="false">¯</mo> </mover></math>?
explanations: 计算AC距离可得到半径：<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <msqrt> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>h</mi> <mo>+</mo> <mn>1</mn> <mo>−</mo> <mi>h</mi> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mo>+</mo> <mo stretchy="false">(</mo> <mi>k</mi> <mo>+</mo> <msqrt> <mn>102</mn> </msqrt> <mo>−</mo> <mi>k</mi> <msup> <mo stretchy="false">)</mo> <mn>2</mn> </msup> </msqrt> <mo>=</mo> <msqrt> <mn>103</mn> </msqrt></math>，圆中△ABC是等腰直角三角形，斜边是直角边（直角边是圆半径）的<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mo>=</mo> <msqrt> <mn>2</mn> </msqrt></math>倍，所以<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mrow> <mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi> <mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi> </mrow> <mo>=</mo> <msqrt> <mn>2</mn> </msqrt> <msqrt> <mn>103</mn> </msqrt> <mo>=</mo> <msqrt> <mn>206</mn> </msqrt></math>

question: The graph of the linear function <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>19</mn></math> is shown. If c and d are positive constants, which equation could define f?
explanations: 图中直线是y=f(x)+19的图，所以f(x)的图比原图下降19的单位，f(x)的y-intercept必然小于0，斜率看图可知小于0，所以f(x)=kx+b中的k、b都小于零，只与选项A一致（c and d are positive constants）

question:
Note: Figure not drawn to scale.
In the figure shown, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mn>34</mn></msqrt><mtext>units</mtext></math>, <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mi>C</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mtext>units</mtext></math>, and <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi><mi>E</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>21</mn><mtext>units</mtext></math>.
