question:
Nigerian American author Teju Cole’s ______ his two passions—photography and the written word—culminates in his 2017 book, Blind Spot, which evocatively combines his original photographs from his travels with his poetic prose.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析
选项B是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地补充了文本对科尔的书《盲点》的讨论。在这个语境中，“enthusiasm for”意味着对……的热情。文本解释了《盲点》由原创照片和诗意散文组成——这两个元素对应了文本中提到的科尔对摄影和文字的热情。这个语境暗示科尔对摄影和写作的热情促使他创作了一本成功结合这两种媒介的书。
题目文本解析
尼日利亚裔美国作家特朱·科尔的______他对两种热情——摄影和文字——的结合 culminates in his 2017 book, Blind Spot, which evocatively combines his original photographs from his travels with his poetic prose.

question:
In habitats with limited nutrients, certain fungus species grow on the roots of trees, engaging in mutually beneficial relationships known as ectomycorrhizae: in this symbiotic exchange, the tree provides the fungus with carbon, a nutrient necessary for both species, and the fungus ______ by enhancing the tree’s ability to absorb nitrogen, another key nutrient, from the soil.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析
选项B是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地补充了文本对外生菌根关系的讨论。在这个语境中，“reciprocates”意味着以相同的方式或程度作出回应。文本指出，在某些栖息地中，某些真菌与树木之间的关系是“互惠的”，涉及一种“共生交换”，其中每个生物都帮助对方获取重要的营养物质。换句话说，每个生物提供与其所获得相同类型的利益：树木为真菌提供一种营养物质（碳），而真菌通过帮助树木吸收另一种营养物质（氮）来进行回报。
题目文本解析
在营养有限的栖息地中，某些真菌种类生长在树木的根部，形成互惠的关系，称为外生菌根：在这种共生交换中，树木为真菌提供碳，这是一种对两种物种都必需的营养物质，而真菌______通过增强树木从土壤中吸收氮（另一种关键营养物质）的能力来进行回报。

question:
The following text is from Georgia Douglas Johnson’s 1922 poem “Benediction.”
Go forth, my son,
Winged by my heart’s desire!
Great reaches, yet unknown,
Await
For your possession.
I may not, if I would,
Retrace the way with you,
My pilgrimage is through,
But life is calling you!

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
selections: A. To express hope that a child will have the same accomplishments as his parent did
B. To suggest that raising a child involves many struggles
C. To warn a child that he will face many challenges throughout his life
D. To encourage a child to embrace the experiences life will offer
explanations:
中文解析
选项D是最佳答案，因为它准确地阐述了文本的主要目的。这首诗的开头，讲述者敦促孩子“勇往直前”，并给予他鼓励（“我内心的渴望”）。接着，讲述者暗示，新的体验（“伟大的、尚未知的领域”）在等待着这个儿子，“生活在召唤”他去探索。因此，主要目的是鼓励孩子去拥抱他生活中可获得的各种体验。
题目文本解析
以下文本摘自乔治亚·道格拉斯·约翰逊1922年的诗《祝福》。
去吧，我的儿子，
在我心中渴望的翅膀上飞翔！
伟大的、尚未知的领域，
在等待
你的占有。
如果我愿意，我也无法
与你重走这条路，
我的朝圣之旅已结束，
但生活在召唤你！

question:
Former astronaut Ellen Ochoa says that although she doesn’t have a definite idea of when it might happen, she ______ that humans will someday need to be able to live in other environments than those found on Earth. This conjecture informs her interest in future research missions to the moon.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析
选项B是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地补充了文本对奥乔亚预测人类有一天需要生活在地球以外地方的讨论。在这个语境中，“speculates”意味着提出一个没有确凿证据的想法。文本指出，奥乔亚“没有确切的想法”关于人类何时可能需要生活在其他环境中，并将奥乔亚的预测描述为“推测”，即没有令人信服的证据所提出的结论。这个背景表明，奥乔亚在做出这一预测时是在进行推测。
题目文本解析
前宇航员艾伦·奥乔亚表示，尽管她对这可能何时发生没有确切的想法，但她______人类将来需要能够在地球以外的其他环境中生活。这一推测促使她对未来的月球研究任务产生了兴趣。

question:
Mônica Lopes-Ferreira and others at Brazil’s Butantan Institute are studying the freshwater stingray species Potamotrygon rex to determine whether biological characteristics such as the rays’ age and sex have ______ effect on the toxicity of their venom—that is, to see if differences in these traits are associated with considerable variations in venom potency.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析
选项D是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地补充了文本对洛佩斯-费雷拉及其同事在研究一种名为Potamotrygon rex的黄貂鱼物种的讨论。在这个语境中，“a substantial” effect 意味着一个显著或重要的影响。文本表明，研究人员正在寻求确定黄貂鱼的年龄和性别是否与毒液效力的“显著差异”相关。这一背景暗示研究人员想要了解黄貂鱼的年龄和性别是否对毒液的毒性有显著影响。
题目文本解析
莫妮卡·洛佩斯-费雷拉和巴西布坦坦研究所的其他人正在研究淡水黄貂鱼物种Potamotrygon rex，以确定生物特征，如黄貂鱼的年龄和性别，对其毒液的毒性是否有______影响——也就是说，看看这些特征的差异是否与毒液效力的显著变化相关。

question:
According to historian Vicki L. Ruiz, Mexican American women made crucial contributions to the labor movement during World War II. At the time, food processing companies entered into contracts to supply United States armed forces with canned goods. Increased production quotas conferred greater bargaining power on the companies’ employees, many of whom were Mexican American women: employees insisted on more favorable benefits, and employers, who were anxious to fulfill the contracts, complied. Thus, labor activism became a platform for Mexican American women to assert their agency.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?
selections: A. It elaborates on a claim about labor relations in a particular industry made earlier in the text.
B. It offers an example of a trend in the World War II–era economy discussed earlier in the text.
C. It notes a possible exception to the historical narrative of labor activism sketched earlier in the text.
D. It provides further details about the identities of the workers discussed earlier in the text.
explanations:
中文解析
选项A是最佳答案，因为它最能描述下划线部分在文本整体中的作用。文本指出，第二次世界大战期间食品加工公司的生产配额增加，使员工能够在劳动交换中获得更好的交易。下划线部分提供了这一增强的议价能力的一个例子：员工要求更有利的福利，雇主则因受到履行合同苛刻条款的压力而予以满足。因此，文本中下划线部分对早前提到的特定行业（食品加工）中的劳动关系的主张进行了详细说明。
题目文本解析
根据历史学家维基·L·鲁伊斯的说法，墨西哥裔美国女性在第二次世界大战期间对劳工运动做出了重要贡献。当时，食品加工公司签订合同，为美国武装部队提供罐头食品。生产配额的增加赋予了公司的员工更大的议价权，其中许多人是墨西哥裔美国女性：员工坚持要求更有利的福利，而雇主为了履行合同而感到焦虑，因此予以满足。因此，劳工行动主义成为墨西哥裔美国女性主张自身权利的平台。

question:
At over a thousand pages across two volumes, The Fifty-Year Mission, compiled by Edward Gross and Mark A. Altman, is presented as the “complete, uncensored, unauthorized oral history” as told by the people behind the media franchise Star Trek. The work aspires to be comprehensive by, for example, including accounts from cast and crew members of every Star Trek television series and film to date. But while The Fifty-Year Mission is clearly a unique and valuable resource, it has a shortcoming common among oral histories: it lacks a clear authorial point of view that could otherwise unite the various accounts into a cohesive whole.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
selections: A. Star Trek franchise, but the published work lacks information about many key events in the franchise’s history.
B. The Fifty-Year Mission includes more accounts from people involved with Star Trek television shows than it does from people involved with Star Trek films.
C. The large amount of material compiled into The Fifty-Year Mission is surprising given that many of the people involved in the Star Trek franchise did not participate in the oral history project.
D. The Fifty-Year Mission represents a worthwhile attempt to thoroughly recount the history of the Star Trek franchise, but its approach has an important limitation.
explanations:
中文解析
选项D是最佳答案，因为它最准确地陈述了文本的主要思想。根据文本，Gross和Altman的书被称为“宝贵的资源”，因为它是一部“完整的、未经审查的、未经授权的口述历史”，其中包含了与“每一部《星际迷航》电视系列和电影”相关的人的叙述。然而，文本也指出了该书创作者所采用的口述历史方法的一个固有缺陷：缺乏一种作者声音，无法将众多叙述统一成一个连贯的叙事。因此，文本的主要思想是，尽管这本书试图呈现《星际迷航》系列的全面口述历史是值得肯定的，但创作者所选择的方法存在一个重要的局限性。
题目文本解析
《五十年使命》由Edward Gross和Mark A. Altman编撰，跨越两卷，超过一千页，呈现为媒体特许经营《星际迷航》背后人物所述的“完整、未经审查、未经授权的口述历史”。该作品旨在全面涵盖，例如，包含迄今为止每一部《星际迷航》电视系列和电影的演员和工作人员的叙述。但尽管《五十年使命》显然是一个独特且有价值的资源，它也存在口述历史中常见的一个缺陷：缺乏明确的作者视角，无法将各种叙述统一成一个连贯的整体。

question:
In a study of bottlenose dolphins, biologist Laela S. Sayigh and a team of researchers analyzed recordings of female bottlenose dolphins interacting with their calves.

According to the table, in which year was the dolphin with the ID FB43 recorded with her calf?
explanations:
中文解析
选项D是最佳答案，因为它准确反映了表格中的数据。根据表格，ID为FB43的海豚的记录年份为1992年。
题目文本解析
在对宽吻海豚的一项研究中，生物学家Laela S. Sayigh及其研究团队分析了雌性宽吻海豚与其幼崽互动的录音。

question:
The novelist Toni Morrison was the first Black woman to work as an editor at the publishing company Random House, from 1967 to 1983. A scholar asserts that one of Morrison’s likely aims during her time as an editor was to strengthen the presence of Black writers on the list of Random House’s published authors.

Which finding, if true, would most strongly support the scholar’s claim?
selections: A. The percentage of authors published by Random House who were Black rose in the early 1970s and stabilized throughout the decade.
B. Black authors who were interviewed in the 1980s and 1990s were highly likely to cite Toni Morrison’s novels as a principal influence on their work.
C. The novels written by Toni Morrison that were published after 1983 sold significantly more copies and received wider critical acclaim than the novels she wrote that were published before 1983.
D. Works that were edited by Toni Morrison during her time at Random House displayed stylistic characteristics that distinguished them from works that were not edited by Morrison.
explanations:
中文解析
选项A是最佳答案，因为它提出了一项发现，如果属实，将支持学者关于托尼·莫里森可能旨在增强黑人作家在兰登书屋出版作者名单上存在感的主张。文本解释了莫里森是兰登书屋的第一位黑人女性编辑，并且她在1967年至1983年期间担任该职务。如果说在1970年代——即莫里森在职期间的大部分时间——兰登书屋出版的黑人作者作品的比例高于以往，这将暗示莫里森可能有意加强黑人作者在兰登书屋出版作者名单上的存在，从而支持学者的主张。
题目文本解析
小说家托尼·莫里森是第一位在兰登书屋出版社担任编辑的黑人女性，任职时间为1967年至1983年。一位学者断言，莫里森在担任编辑期间的一个可能目标是增强黑人作家在兰登书屋出版作者名单上的存在感。

question:
Studying tools unearthed at a cave site on the western coast of Italy, archaeologist Paola Villa and colleagues have determined that prehistoric Neanderthal groups fashioned them from shells of clams that they harvested from the seafloor while wading or diving or that washed up on the beach. Clamshells become thin and eroded as they wash up on the beach, while those on the seafloor are smooth and sturdy, so the research team suspects that Neanderthals prized the tools made with seafloor shells. However, the team also concluded that those tools were likely more challenging to obtain, noting that ______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to support the research team’s conclusion?
selections: A. at each depth below the surface in the cave, the difference in the numbers of tools of each type suggests that shells were easier to collect from the beach than to harvest from the seafloor.
B. the highest number of tools were at a depth of 3–4 meters below the surface, which suggests that the Neanderthal population at the site was highest during the related period of time.
C. at each depth below the surface in the cave, the difference in the numbers of tools of each type suggests that Neanderthals preferred to use clamshells from the beach because of their durability.
D. the higher number of tools at depths of 5–6 meters below the surface in the cave than at depths of 4–5 meters below the surface suggests that the size of clam populations changed over time.
explanations:
中文解析
选项A是最佳答案，因为它最有效地利用表格中的数据来支持研究人员关于尼安德特人采集贝壳以用作工具的结论。文本解释了尼安德特人使用贝壳制作工具，而用于此目的的最坚固、因此也是最受欢迎的贝壳是位于海底，而不是海滩上。然而，研究人员还得出结论，来自海底的贝壳制作的工具比来自海滩的工具更为稀少。同时，表格显示在每个深度上，来自海滩的贝壳制作的工具数量超过了来自更受欢迎的海底贝壳制作的工具数量。更受欢迎的贝壳更稀少这一事实表明，从海底采集贝壳显著比从海滩采集贝壳要困难得多。
题目文本解析
研究意大利西海岸一个洞穴遗址出土的工具时，考古学家Paola Villa及其同事们确定，史前尼安德特人群体是用他们在海底收集的贝壳制作这些工具的，这些贝壳可能是在涉水或潜水时采集的，或者是冲上海滩的。冲上海滩的贝壳变得纤薄且侵蚀，而海底的贝壳则光滑而坚固，因此研究团队怀疑尼安德特人更重视用海底贝壳制作的工具。然而，团队还得出结论，获取这些工具可能更具挑战性，指出______。

question:
Public-awareness campaigns about the need to reduce single-use plastics can be successful, says researcher Kim Borg of Monash University in Australia, when these campaigns give consumers a choice: for example, Japan achieved a 40 percent reduction in plastic-bag use after cashiers were instructed to ask customers whether ______ wanted a bag.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 选项A是最佳答案。测试的规则是代词与先行词的一致性。复数代词“they”在数量上与复数先行词“customers”一致。

question:
Text 1
Astronomer Mark Holland and colleagues examined four white dwarfs—small, dense remnants of past stars—in order to determine the composition of exoplanets that used to orbit those stars. Studying wavelengths of light in the white dwarf atmospheres, the team reported that traces of elements such as lithium and sodium support the presence of exoplanets with continental crusts similar to Earth’s.
Text 2
Past studies of white dwarf atmospheres have concluded that certain exoplanets had continental crusts. Geologist Keith Putirka and astronomer Siyi Xu argue that those studies unduly emphasize atmospheric traces of lithium and other individual elements as signifiers of the types of rock found on Earth. The studies don’t adequately account for different minerals made up of various ratios of those elements, and the possibility of rock types not found on Earth that contain those minerals.

Based on the texts, how would Putirka and Xu (Text 2) most likely characterize the conclusion presented in Text 1?
selections: A. As unexpected, because it was widely believed at the time that white dwarf exoplanets lack continental crusts
B. As premature, because researchers have only just begun trying to determine what kinds of crusts white dwarf exoplanets had
C. As questionable, because it rests on an incomplete consideration of potential sources of the elements detected in white dwarf atmospheres
D. As puzzling, because it’s unusual to successfully detect lithium and sodium when analyzing wavelengths of light in white dwarf atmospheres
explanations:
中文解析
选项C是最佳答案，因为它反映了普提尔卡和徐（文本2）可能如何看待文本1中提出的结论。文本1讨论了马克·霍兰德及其同事的一项研究，他们在四颗白矮星的气氛中检测到了锂和钠的痕迹。研究团队声称，这支持了类似地球的大陆地壳的系外行星曾经围绕这些恒星旋转的观点。文本2介绍了普提尔卡和徐，他们指出钠和锂存在于几种不同的矿物中，而这些矿物中的一些可能存在于地球上没有的岩石类型中。因此，普提尔卡和徐可能会将文本1中的结论描述为可疑，因为它没有考虑到锂和钠也存在于与地球大陆地壳不同的岩石中。
题目文本解析
文本1
天文学家马克·霍兰德及其同事研究了四颗白矮星——这些是过去恒星的小而密集的残骸——以确定曾经围绕这些恒星运行的系外行星的组成。通过研究白矮星大气中的光波长，研究团队报告称，锂和钠等元素的痕迹支持存在与地球类似的大陆地壳的系外行星。
文本2
以往对白矮星大气的研究得出结论，某些系外行星具有大陆地壳。地质学家基思·普提尔卡和天文学家徐思怡认为，这些研究过于强调锂和其他单一元素在大气中的痕迹，视其为地球上岩石类型的标志。这些研究没有充分考虑由这些元素不同比例组成的矿物，以及那些包含这些矿物但在地球上不存在的岩石类型的可能性。

question:
In documents called judicial opinions, judges explain the reasoning behind their legal rulings, and in those explanations they sometimes cite and discuss historical and contemporary philosophers. Legal scholar and philosopher Anita L. Allen argues that while judges are naturally inclined to mention philosophers whose views align with their own positions, the strongest judicial opinions consider and rebut potential objections; discussing philosophers whose views conflict with judges’ views could therefore ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. allow judges to craft judicial opinions without needing to consult philosophical works.
B. help judges improve the arguments they put forward in their judicial opinions.
C. make judicial opinions more comprehensible to readers without legal or philosophical training.
D. bring judicial opinions in line with views that are broadly held among philosophers.
explanations:
中文解析
选项B是最佳答案，因为它最合理地补充了文本对安妮塔·艾伦关于法官在司法意见中引用哲学家的论点的讨论。文本指出，法官在撰写司法意见时有时会引用哲学家，并且根据艾伦的说法，法官倾向于引用与他们自己观点一致的哲学家。然而，艾伦声称，最好的司法意见会考虑潜在的反对意见并加以驳斥，这表明法官可以通过包括与自己观点相悖的哲学家的讨论来强化他们的意见。
题目文本解析
在被称为司法意见的文件中，法官解释其法律裁决背后的推理，在这些解释中，他们有时会引用并讨论历史和当代哲学家。法律学者和哲学家安妮塔·L·艾伦认为，虽然法官自然倾向于提及与自己立场一致的哲学家，但最强有力的司法意见会考虑并反驳潜在的反对意见；因此，讨论与法官观点相悖的哲学家可能会 ______。

question:
The following text is from David Barclay Moore’s 2022 novel Holler of the Fireflies. The narrator has just arrived at summer camp, which is far away from his home.
This place was different than I thought it would be. I’d never been somewhere like this before. I did feel scared, but also excited.
©2022 by David Barclay Moore

According to the text, how does the narrator feel about being at summer camp?
selections: C. He feels both scared and excited.
D. He feels both angry and jealous.
explanations:

选项C是最佳答案，因为它最准确地表达了叙述者对在夏令营的感受。文本中，叙述者表示在到达营地后，他发现营地与自己预期的不同，因此感到“害怕，但也很兴奋”。
题目文本解析
以下文本摘自大卫·巴克利·摩尔2022年的小说《萤火虫的呼喊》。叙述者刚刚到达远离家乡的夏令营。
这个地方与我想象的不同。我从未去过这样的地方。我确实感到害怕，但也很兴奋。
©2022 大卫·巴克利·摩尔

question:
In the 1700s and 1800s, European composers experimented with volume in their musical works. They did so by increasing the number of musicians playing in the orchestra. For example, in some of his operas, German composer Richard Wagner added more horns, trombones, and tubas to the orchestra. With more instruments playing at the same time, the orchestra could play extremely loudly at key moments in his operas.

According to the text, how did Richard Wagner achieve moments of extremely high volume in his operas?
selections: A. By moving the performances of his operas from outdoor stages to indoor ones
B. By increasing the number of musicians playing horns, trombones, and tubas in the orchestra
C. By building a concert hall whose shape would cause sounds to echo
D. By insisting that the singers undergo special training to sing for extended periods of time
explanations:
中文解析
选项B是最佳答案，因为它陈述了理查德·瓦格纳在其歌剧中如何实现极高音量的时刻，这一说法得到了文本的支持。文本指出，欧洲作曲家通过增加管弦乐队中的音乐人数来实验音量，并以瓦格纳为例，提到他“在管弦乐队中增加了更多的号、长号和大号”。文本解释说，通过让更多这些乐器同时演奏，瓦格纳的歌剧在关键时刻的整体音量可以显著增加。
题目文本解析
在1700年代和1800年代，欧洲作曲家在他们的音乐作品中尝试音量的变化。他们通过增加管弦乐队中的演奏人数来实现这一点。例如，德国作曲家理查德·瓦格纳在他的某些歌剧中为管弦乐队增加了更多的号、长号和大号。随着更多乐器同时演奏，管弦乐队能够在他的歌剧中的关键时刻发出极大的音量。

question:
To survive when water is scarce, embryos inside African turquoise killifish eggs ______ a dormant state known as diapause. In this state, embryonic development is paused for as long as two years—longer than the life span of an adult killifish.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 选项A是最佳答案。测试的规则是句子中的限定动词和非限定动词形式。主句需要一个限定动词来执行主语（在这个例子中是“embryos”）的动作，而这个选项提供了一个有限的现在时动词“enter”，以表明胚胎是如何进入休眠状态的。

question:

explanations: 选项C是最佳答案。测试的规则是主谓一致。单数动词“has been”在数量上与单数主语“writing”一致。

question:
Atoms in a synchrotron, a type of circular particle accelerator, travel faster and faster until they ______ a desired energy level, at which point they are diverted to collide with a target, smashing the atoms.

explanations: 选项B是最佳答案。所测试的规则是动词在句子中表达时态的使用。在这个选项中，动词“reach”的现在时态与用于描述原子如何通过同步辐射器移动的现在时态动词“travel”和“are diverted”一致。

question:
When Chinese director Chloé Zhao accepted the Oscar in 2021 for her film Nomadland, she made Academy Award history. ______ only one other woman, Kathryn Bigelow of the United States, had been named best director at the Oscars, making Zhao the second woman and the first Asian woman to win the award.

explanations:
中文解析
选项B是最佳答案。“之前”在逻辑上表明本句中描述的事件——比格洛被评选为最佳导演——发生在赵赢得奖项之前。只有另一位女性在此之前赢得过该奖项，这使得赵的胜利更具意义。
题目文本解析
当中国导演赵婷在2021年因其电影《无依之地》获得奥斯卡奖时，她创造了奥斯卡历史。______ 此前只有另一位女性，即美国的凯瑟琳·比格罗（Kathryn Bigelow）曾获得奥斯卡最佳导演奖，这使赵婷成为第二位获奖的女性和第一位获奖的亚洲女性。

question:
Neuroscientist Karen Konkoly wanted to determine whether individuals can understand and respond to questions during REM sleep. She first taught volunteers eye movements they would use to respond to basic math problems while asleep (a single left-right eye movement indicated the number one). ______ she attached electrodes to the volunteers’ faces to record their eye movements during sleep.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
中文解析
选项B是最佳答案。“接下来”在逻辑上表明本句中描述的动作——孔科利记录参与者的眼动——是孔科利实验中的下一步。
题目文本解析
神经科学家卡伦·孔科利（Karen Konkoly）想要确定个体在快速眼动睡眠（REM睡眠）期间是否能够理解并回答问题。她首先教会志愿者在睡眠中用眼部动作来回应基本的数学问题（一次左右眼的移动表示数字一）。______ 然后，她在志愿者的脸上附上电极，以记录他们在睡眠期间的眼动。

question:

B. A Persian philosopher and physician wrote a medical textbook called The Canon of Medicine.
C. The Canon of Medicine was a medical textbook used by Middle Eastern and European universities for centuries.
D. Ibn Sina recorded the most advanced medical knowledge of his time in his book The Canon of Medicine.
explanations:
中文解析
选项A是最佳答案。该句指出了书籍出版的年份。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Gaspar Enriquez is an artist.
• He specializes in portraits of Mexican Americans.
• A portrait is an artistic representation of a person.
• Enriquez completed a painting of the sculptor Luis Jimenez in 2003.
• He completed a drawing of the writer Rudolfo Anaya in 2016.

The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two portraits. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. The portraits, or artistic representations, of Luis Jimenez and Rudolfo Anaya were both completed by Enriquez in the early 2000s.
B. Enriquez has completed portraits of numerous Mexican Americans, including sculptor Luis Jimenez and writer Rudolfo Anaya.
C. While both are by Enriquez, the 2003 portrait of Luis Jimenez is a painting, and the 2016 portrait of Rudolfo Anaya is a drawing.
D. Luis Jimenez was a Mexican American sculptor, and Rudolfo Anaya was a Mexican American writer.
explanations:
中文解析
选项C是最佳答案。该句强调了这两幅肖像之间的区别，指出一幅是画作，另一幅是素描。

question:
Typically, underlines, scribbles, and notes left in the margins by a former owner lower a book’s ______ when the former owner is a famous poet like Walt Whitman, such markings, known as marginalia, can be a gold mine to literary scholars.

explanations: 选项A是最佳答案。测试的规则是句子中独立分句的协调。独立分句是包含主语和动词的短语，可以独立作为一个句子。这一选项使用逗号和协调连词“but”来连接第一个独立分句（“underlines…lower a book’s value”）和第二个独立分句（“such markings…can be a gold mine to scholars”），从而形成一个复合句。

question:
The parasitic dodder plant increases its reproductive success by flowering at the same time as the host plant it has latched onto. In 2020, Jianqiang Wu and his colleagues determined that the tiny dodder achieves this ______ with its host by absorbing and utilizing a protein the host produces when it is about to flower.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析
选项A是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地完成了文本对寄生植物藤黄（dodder）与其宿主植物之间关系的讨论。在这个上下文中，“同步”指的是事物同时发生的行为。文本指出，藤黄和其宿主植物是同步开花的，而这种同步发生是因为藤黄利用了宿主在开花前不久产生的一种蛋白质。
题目文本解析
寄生植物藤黄通过与其依附的宿主植物同时开花来提高其繁殖成功率。在2020年，吴建强及其同事确定，这种微小的藤黄通过吸收和利用宿主在即将开花时产生的一种蛋白质，达成了这种______。

question:
The process of mechanically recycling plastics is often considered ______ because of the environmental impact and the loss of material quality that often occurs. But chemist Takunda Chazovachii has helped develop a cleaner process of chemical recycling that converts superabsorbent polymers from diapers into a desirable reusable adhesive.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析
选项B是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地完成了文本对塑料回收讨论的内容。在这个上下文中，“不充分”的意思是“不令人满意”。文本指出，机械塑料回收过程对环境产生影响，并导致“材料质量的损失”。文本将此与Chazovachii的化学塑料回收过程进行对比，后者更清洁，且产生理想的产品。文本对机械回收负面方面的强调表明，在环境影响和所产生材料质量方面，它是不充分的。
题目文本解析
机械回收塑料的过程常常被认为是______，因为它通常会对环境产生影响，并导致材料质量的损失。然而，化学家塔昆达·查佐瓦奇（Takunda Chazovachii）帮助开发了一种更清洁的化学回收过程，将尿布中的超吸水聚合物转化为一种理想的可重复使用的粘合剂。

question:
The general store was essential to daily life in the rural United States during the 1800s because it provided the supplies that the people living in nearby communities needed. Also, the store was a ______ of information. People socializing at the general store would share news and help spread it throughout their communities.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析
选项A是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地完成了文本对19世纪美国乡村社区中杂货店角色的讨论。在这个上下文中，“来源”指的是某物起源或获取的地方。文本指出，人们在杂货店社交时会分享新闻。这一背景支持了杂货店在乡村社区中作为信息来源的观点。
题目文本解析
在19世纪的美国乡村生活中，杂货店对日常生活至关重要，因为它提供了附近社区居民所需的各种用品。此外，杂货店还是一个______信息的来源。人们在杂货店社交时会分享新闻，并帮助将其传播到整个社区。

question:
According to Potawatomi ecologist Robin Wall Kimmerer, the Indigenous method of harvesting Hierochloe odorata, or sweetgrass, by snapping the plant off at the root actually ______ wild populations: it may seem counterintuitive, she says, but this method of removal allows new sweetgrass plants to repopulate the space, with an overall increase in number and vigor.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanations:
中文解析
选项D是最佳答案，因为它最合乎逻辑地完成了文本对土著人采集香蒲草（Hierochloe odorata）方法的讨论。在这个上下文中，“补充”指的是帮助增加种群或帮助其恢复。文本解释说，尽管从根部折断野生植物看似对野生种群有害，但实际上它有助于香蒲草的生长，增加了它们的“数量和活力”。这一背景传达了这样一个观点：尽管看起来违反直觉，但土著人采集香蒲草的方法实际上是有助于恢复野生种群的。
题目文本解析
根据波塔瓦托米生态学家罗宾·沃尔·基默尔（Robin Wall Kimmerer）的说法，土著人通过从根部折断香蒲草（Hierochloe odorata）或香草的采集方法实际上______野生种群：她说，这可能看起来违反直觉，但这种去除方法允许新的香蒲草植物重新填补这个空间，从而整体上增加了数量和活力。

question:
When construction of a single-family house begins, it is called a housing start. In the first four months of 2022, the highest number of housing starts in the United States was in ______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?
explanations:
中文解析
选项A是最佳答案，因为它有效地利用了表格中的数据来完成该陈述，确定了美国在2022年住房开工数量最高的月份。根据表格，该表显示了2022年1月至4月的美国住房开工数量，最高的住房开工数量为180.3万，发生在4月。
题目文本解析
当一栋单户住宅的建设开始时，这被称为住房开工。在2022年的前四个月，美国的住房开工数量最高是在______。

question:
Archaeologist Petra Vaiglova, anthropologist Xinyi Liu, and their colleagues investigated the domestication of farm animals in China during the Bronze Age (approximately 2000 to 1000 BCE). By analyzing the chemical composition of the bones of sheep, goats, and cattle from this era, the team determined that wild plants made up the bulk of sheep’s and goats’ diets, while the cattle’s diet consisted largely of millet, a crop cultivated by humans. The team concluded that cattle were likely raised closer to human settlements, whereas sheep and goats were allowed to roam farther away.

Which finding, if true, would most strongly support the team’s conclusion?
selections: A. Analysis of the animal bones showed that the cattle’s diet also consisted of wheat, which humans widely cultivated in China during the Bronze Age.
B. Further investigation of sheep and goat bones revealed that their diets consisted of small portions of millet as well.
C. Cattle’s diets generally require larger amounts of food and a greater variety of nutrients than do sheep’s and goats’ diets.
D. The diets of sheep, goats, and cattle were found to vary based on what the farmers in each Bronze Age settlement could grow.
explanations:
中文解析
选项A是最佳答案，因为它提出的发现如果成立，将最有力地支持团队得出的结论，即牛更有可能在靠近人类定居点的地方饲养，而不是羊和山羊。文本解释了Vaiglova、Liu及其同事分析了来自中国青铜时代的羊、山羊和牛骨的化学成分，以调查这些动物的驯化过程，即它们从野生状态适应到与人类密切联系的状态。根据文本，团队的分析显示，该时代的羊和山羊主要以野生植物为食，而牛则以人类种植的作物——小米为食。如果对动物骨骼的分析显示牛的饮食中也包括小麦，这是一种在青铜时代中国由人类种植的作物，那么这一发现将通过提供额外证据支持团队的结论，即该时代的牛以人类种植的作物为食，因此可以推断人类在种植这些作物的定居点附近饲养牛，而让山羊和羊在更远的地方徘徊，生活在未被人类耕作的野生植被区域。
题目文本解析
考古学家佩特拉·瓦伊戈娃（Petra Vaiglova）、人类学家刘心怡（Xinyi Liu）及其同事研究了青铜时代（约公元前2000年至1000年）中国农场动物的驯化情况。通过分析这一时期羊、山羊和牛骨的化学成分，团队确定野生植物占羊和山羊饮食的主要部分，而牛的饮食主要由人类种植的小米构成。团队得出结论，牛更可能在靠近人类定居点的地方饲养，而羊和山羊则被允许在更远的地方徘徊。

question:
Global biomass is the total mass of living material, such as animals and plants, on Earth. A team of scientists estimated the global biomass, by species, of various wild land mammals. The team found that the species with the highest global biomass is the ______

Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the sentence?
explanations:
中文解析
选项D是最佳答案，因为它准确识别了全球生物量最高的物种，即白尾鹿，约为270万吨。图表显示了四种全球生物量最高的野生陆地哺乳动物的全球生物量。图表显示，非洲灌木象的全球生物量约为130万吨，东部灰袋鼠的生物量约为60万吨，而野猪的生物量约为190万吨。这些数值都低于白尾鹿的全球生物量，后者约为270万吨。因此，白尾鹿是全球生物量最高的物种。
题目文本解析
全球生物量是指地球上所有生物材料的总质量，如动物和植物。一个科学团队估算了不同野生陆地哺乳动物的全球生物量，按物种分类。团队发现，全球生物量最高的物种是______。

question:
A group of researchers working in Europe, Asia, and Oceania conducted a study to determine how quickly different Eurasian languages are typically spoken (in syllables per second) and how much information they can effectively convey (in bits per second). They found that, although languages vary widely in the speed at which they are spoken, the amount of information languages can effectively convey tends to vary much less. Thus, they claim that two languages with very different spoken rates can nonetheless convey the same amount of information in a given amount of time.

Which choice best describes data from the table that support the researchers’ claim?
selections: A. Among the five languages in the table, Thai and Hungarian have the lowest rates of speech and the lowest rates of information conveyed.
B. Vietnamese conveys information at approximately the same rate as Spanish despite being spoken at a slower rate.
C. Among the five languages in the table, the language that is spoken the fastest is also the language that conveys information the fastest.
D. Serbian and Spanish are spoken at approximately the same rate, but Serbian conveys information faster than Spanish does.
explanations:
中文解析
选项B是最佳答案，因为它为“即使以不同的语速讲述，两种语言也能传达相似数量的信息”这一说法提供了表格中最直接的支持。表格显示了五种语言的发音速率以及它们传达信息的速率。越南语的发音速率约为每秒5.3个音节，而西班牙语的发音速率约为每秒7.7个音节，但这两种语言传达信息的速率非常相似：越南语约为每秒42.5比特，而西班牙语约为每秒42.0比特。因此，尽管越南语的语速较慢，但其传达信息的速率与西班牙语相近，这一描述支持了文本中的说法，即语言即使以不同的语速讲述，也能传达相同数量的信息。
题目文本解析
一组在欧洲、亚洲和大洋洲工作的研究人员进行了研究，以确定不同的欧亚语言通常以多快的速度（以每秒音节数计）进行交流，以及它们能够有效传达多少信息（以每秒比特数计）。他们发现，尽管语言的发音速度差异很大，但语言能够有效传达的信息量的变化相对较小。因此，他们声称，两种发音速度截然不同的语言在一定时间内仍然能够传达相同数量的信息。

question:
The following text is adapted from Gwendolyn Bennett’s 1926 poem “Street Lamps in Early Spring.”
Night wears a garment
All velvet soft, all violet blue...
And over her face she draws a veil
As shimmering fine as floating dew...
And here and there
In the black of her hair
The subtle hands of Night
Move slowly with their gem-starred light.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
selections: A. It presents alternating descriptions of night in a rural area and in a city.
B. It sketches an image of nightfall, then an image of sunrise.
C. It makes an extended comparison of night to a human being.
D. It portrays how night changes from one season of the year to the next.
explanations:
中文解析
选项C是最佳答案，因为它最准确地描述了文本的整体结构。在整个文本中，叙述者将夜晚描绘得像一个穿着衣服（“一种天鹅绒般柔软”的“紫蓝色”衣物）和面纱“遮住她的脸”的人，并且用“星星般的光芒”缓慢地移动她的手穿过她的黑发。因此，文本的结构是对夜晚与人类的一个延伸比较。
题目文本解析
以下文本改编自关多琳·贝内特（Gwendolyn Bennett）1926年的诗《早春的街灯》（“Street Lamps in Early Spring”）。
夜晚披上一件
全是天鹅绒般柔软、全是紫蓝色的衣服……
她在脸上轻轻拉上一个面纱，
如同漂浮的露珠般闪闪发光……
在她黑发的点滴之间，
夜晚的细腻之手
缓慢地移动着，带着星辰般的光芒。

question:
British scientists James Watson and Francis Crick won the Nobel Prize in part for their 1953 paper announcing the double helix structure of DNA, but it is misleading to say that Watson and Crick discovered the double helix. ______ findings were based on a famous X-ray image of DNA fibers, “Photo 51,” developed by X-ray crystallographer Rosalind Franklin and her graduate student Raymond Gosling.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 选项C是最佳答案。所测试的惯例是物主限定词的使用。复数物主限定词“their”与复数并列名词短语“Watson and Crick”在数上保持一致，因此表明这些发现是属于沃森和克里克的。

question:
The following text is adapted from Pam Muñoz Ryan’s 2020 novel Mañanaland. In the village where Max lives, there is an old fortress called La Reina. Children in the village say that the fortress is haunted.
For as long as he could remember, Max had begged Papá [his father] to take him to see La Reina and the ruins up close. He’d be a hero among his friends if he was the first boy to cross the haunted gates! Just because Papá didn’t believe in ghosts didn’t mean they weren’t there. Maybe this summer Papá would finally take him. He was almost twelve.
©2020 by Pam Muñoz Ryan

Which choice best describes the overall purpose of the text?
selections: A. To portray how proud Max’s father is of Max
B. To explain why Max doesn’t want to grow up yet
C. To criticize Max for disliking summer
D. To show how much Max wants to visit La Reina
explanations:
中文解析
选项D是最佳答案，因为它最准确地描述了文本的整体目的。文本指出，“在他能记得的时间里”，马克斯一直“请求”他的父亲带他去拉雷纳（La Reina）。这一点在文本中得到了进一步强调，表明“这个夏天”他的父亲可能“终于会带”马克斯去参观拉雷纳。因此，整个文本的目的是展示马克斯有多想去拉雷纳。
题目文本解析
以下文本改编自帕姆·穆尼奥斯·瑞安（Pam Muñoz Ryan）2020年的小说《明天的土地》（Mañanaland）。在马克斯生活的村庄里，有一座名为拉雷纳（La Reina）的古老堡垒。村里的孩子们说这座堡垒是闹鬼的。
在他能记得的时间里，马克斯一直恳求爸爸带他去近距离观看拉雷纳和废墟。如果他是第一个穿越那个闹鬼大门的男孩，他将在朋友中成为英雄！仅仅因为爸爸不相信鬼魂，并不意味着鬼魂就不存在。也许这个夏天，爸爸终于会带他去。他快十二岁了。
©2020 by Pam Muñoz Ryan

question:
In the 1960s, Gloria Richardson led a movement to promote racial equality. Her involvement in this effort was inspired by her daughter, Donna Richardson. In 1961, Donna joined protests organized by the Student Nonviolent Coordinating Committee in Cambridge, Maryland. Following her daughter, Gloria joined these protests too. Gloria soon became the cochair of the Cambridge Nonviolent Action Committee. She was also the leader of what became known as the Cambridge movement.

According to the text, what did Gloria Richardson lead?
selections: B. Her daughter Donna’s high school
C. Protests to support environmental protections
D. A new business in Cambridge, Maryland
explanations:
中文解析
选项A是最佳答案，因为它提供了关于格洛丽亚·理查森（Gloria Richardson）的信息，并得到了文本的支持。文本详细描述了格洛丽亚在推动种族平等方面的参与，包括她是后来被称为剑桥运动（Cambridge movement）的领导者。
题目文本解析
在1960年代，格洛丽亚·理查森（Gloria Richardson）领导了一场推动种族平等的运动。她参与这一努力的灵感来自于她的女儿唐娜·理查森（Donna Richardson）。1961年，唐娜加入了在马里兰州剑桥由学生非暴力协调委员会组织的抗议活动。受女儿的影响，格洛丽亚也加入了这些抗议。格洛丽亚很快成为剑桥非暴力行动委员会的共同主席。她还成为了后来被称为剑桥运动的领导者。

question:
The following text is adapted from Sylvia Acevedo’s 2018 memoir Path to the Stars: My Journey from Girl Scout to Rocket Scientist. The narrator is traveling by car with her family to Mexico City. Mario and Laura are her brother and sister.
Mario and I played games to see how many different license plates we could spot, and Laura liked to look for children in the back seats of the cars we passed. We were used to the forty-five-minute drive to El Paso and familiar with the six-hour ride to Chihuahua, but I wondered what the long journey to Mexico City would be like.
©2018 by Sylvia Acevedo

According to the text, what did the narrator and Mario do while riding in the car?
explanations:
中文解析
选项D是最佳答案，因为它最准确地描述了叙述者和马里奥在车上时所做的事情。文本描述了叙述者与家人一起进行的汽车旅行。文本指出，在车程中，叙述者和马里奥“玩游戏”，看看他们能找到多少不同的车牌。
题目文本解析
以下文本改编自西尔维亚·阿塞维多（Sylvia Acevedo）2018年的回忆录《通往星辰的道路：我从女童子军到火箭科学家的旅程》（Path to the Stars: My Journey from Girl Scout to Rocket Scientist）。叙述者正与家人一起乘车前往墨西哥城。马里奥和劳拉是她的兄弟姐妹。
马里奥和我玩游戏，看看能找到多少不同的车牌，而劳拉喜欢在我们经过的汽车后座寻找小孩。我们已经习惯了到埃尔帕索的四十五分钟车程，也对前往奇瓦瓦的六小时旅程很熟悉，但我想知道前往墨西哥城的这段漫长旅程会是什么样子。
©2018 by Sylvia Acevedo

question:
Born in 1891 to a Quechua-speaking family in the Andes Mountains of Peru, Martín Chambi is today considered to be one of the most renowned figures of Latin American photography. In a paper for an art history class, a student claims that Chambi’s photographs have considerable ethnographic value—in his work, Chambi was able to capture diverse elements of Peruvian society, representing his subjects with both dignity and authenticity.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the student’s claim?
selections: A. Chambi took many commissioned portraits of wealthy Peruvians, but he also produced hundreds of images carefully documenting the peoples, sites, and customs of Indigenous communities of the Andes.
B. Chambi’s photographs demonstrate a high level of technical skill, as seen in his strategic use of illumination to create dramatic light and shadow contrasts.
C. During his lifetime, Chambi was known and celebrated both within and outside his native Peru, as his work was published in places like Argentina, Spain, and Mexico.
D. Some of the peoples and places Chambi photographed had long been popular subjects for Peruvian photographers.
explanations:
中文解析
选项A是最佳答案，因为它提出了一个发现，如果成立，将支持关于查姆比（Chambi）照片的说法。文本描述了一位学生提出的观点，即查姆比的照片“具有相当的民族志价值”，这意味着它们作为文化记录是有价值的，并且“以尊重的方式捕捉了秘鲁社会的多样元素”。如果查姆比确实仔细拍摄了来自秘鲁不同社区的人们，以及拍摄了不同社区的习俗和场所，那么这将支持照片作为秘鲁社会多样元素的描绘而具有民族志价值的说法。
题目文本解析
马丁·查姆比（Martín Chambi）于1891年出生在秘鲁安第斯山脉的一个讲克丘亚语的家庭，如今被认为是拉丁美洲摄影界最著名的人物之一。在一篇艺术史课程的论文中，一位学生声称查姆比的照片具有相当的民族志价值——在他的作品中，查姆比能够捕捉秘鲁社会的多样元素，以尊严和真实的方式表现他的拍摄对象。

question:
Although military veterans make up a small proportion of the total population of the United States, they occupy a significantly higher proportion of the jobs in the civilian government. One possible   for this disproportionate representation is that military service familiarizes people with certain organizational structures that are also reflected in the civilian government bureaucracy, and this familiarity thus ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
selections: A. makes civilian government jobs especially appealing to military veterans.
B. alters the typical relationship between military service and subsequent career preferences.
C. encourages nonveterans applying for civilian government jobs to consider military service instead.
D. increases the number of civilian government jobs that require some amount of military experience to perform.
explanations:
中文解析
选项A是最佳答案，因为它提出了从文本关于在美国担任公职的退伍军人的讨论中最合乎逻辑的结论。文本指出，担任公职的退伍军人所占比例远高于整体人口中退伍军人的比例。文本还提到，退伍军人在这些职位中异常高的代表性可能是由于民间政府机构与军队之间共享的组织结构。因此，可以合理推断，正是民间政府结构的熟悉性使得这些工作对退伍军人特别有吸引力。
题目文本解析
尽管退伍军人占美国总人口的比例较小，但他们在民间政府中的职位比例却显著更高。这种不成比例的代表性的一种可能原因是，军事服务使人们熟悉某些组织结构，这些结构在民间政府的官僚体系中也有所体现，因此这种熟悉感 ______。

question:
Food and the sensation of taste are central to Monique Truong’s novels. In The Book of Salt, for example, the exiled character of Bình connects to his native Saigon through the food he prepares, while in Bitter in the Mouth, the character of Linda ______ a form of synesthesia whereby the words she hears evoke tastes.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 选项C是最佳答案。所测试的惯例是使用动词来表达时态。在这个选项中，动词“experiences”的现在时态与其他现在时态的动词（例如，“connects”和“prepares”）一致，这些动词用于描述Truong小说中的事件。此外，在讨论文学作品时，使用现在时态是很常见的。

question:
A member of the Cherokee Nation, Mary Golda Ross is renowned for her contributions to NASA’s Planetary Flight Handbook, which ______ detailed mathematical guidance for missions to Mars and Venus.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 选项A是最佳答案。所测试的惯例是关系从句中有限动词的使用。关系从句，例如以“which”开头的从句，需要一个有限动词，即能够作为从句主要动词的动词。这个选项正确地为从句提供了有限的过去式动词“provided”。

question:
Most conifers (trees belonging to the phylum Coniferophyta) are evergreen. That is, they keep their green leaves or needles year-round. However, not all conifer species are evergreen. Larch trees, ______ lose their needles every fall.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
中文解析
选项A是最佳答案。“例如”在逻辑上表明这一句中的信息——落叶松每年秋天会落针——是对前一句话的支持性例子（即并非所有针叶树种全年保持叶子或针叶）。
题目文本解析
大多数针叶树（属于针叶植物门 Coniferophyta 的树木）是常绿的。也就是说，它们全年保持绿色的叶子或针叶。然而，并非所有针叶树种都是常绿的。落叶松，______每年秋天都会掉落它们的针叶。

question:
Organisms have evolved a number of surprising adaptations to ensure their survival in adverse conditions. Tadpole shrimp (Triops longicaudatus) embryos, ______ can pause development for over ten years during extended periods of drought.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
中文解析
选项B是最佳答案。“例如”在逻辑上表明这一句中的信息——蝌蚪虾胚胎可以在持续干旱期间暂停发育——是对前一句所述生物为了在不利条件下生存而进化出惊人适应性的主张的一个例证。
题目文本解析
生物为了在恶劣条件下确保生存，进化出了许多惊人的适应性。蝌蚪虾（Triops longicaudatus）的胚胎，______ 可以在持续的干旱期间暂停发育超过十年

question:
In February 1919, following the end of the First World War, women from ten countries around the world convened the Inter-Allied Women’s Conference in Paris. The conference’s goals were ______ ensure women’s participation in the proceedings of the Paris Peace Conference, to secure the right of women to serve in the League of Nations, and to advocate for human rights.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 选项A是最佳答案。所测试的惯例是句子内部标点符号的使用。在这个选项中，冒号正确地引入了1919年国际女性会议所提出的目标系列。

question:
Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie’s 2013 novel Americanah chronicles the divergent experiences of Ifemelu and Obinze, a young Nigerian couple, after high school. Ifemelu moves to the United States to attend a prestigious university. ______ Obinze travels to London, hoping to start a career there. However, frustrated with the lack of opportunities, he soon returns to Nigeria.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
中文解析
选项A是最佳答案。“与此同时”在逻辑上表明这一句中描述的动作（Obinze搬到伦敦追求职业）与前一句中描述的动作（Ifemelu搬到美国）是同时发生的。第一句明确指出这些动作发生在大致相同的时间，提到角色在高中后的“不同经历”。
题目文本解析
奇玛曼达·恩戈齐·阿迪奇（Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie）于2013年出版的小说《美国人》（Americanah）讲述了一对年轻尼日利亚情侣伊费梅卢（Ifemelu）和奥宾泽（Obinze）在高中毕业后的不同经历。伊费梅卢搬到美国，进入一所知名大学。_____而奥宾泽则前往伦敦，希望在那里开始他的职业生涯。然而，由于对机会的缺乏感到沮丧，他很快就返回了尼日利亚。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·The Seikan Tunnel is a rail tunnel in Japan.
·It connects the island of Honshu to the island of Hokkaido.
·It is roughly 33 miles long.
·The Channel Tunnel is a rail tunnel in Europe.
·It connects Folkestone, England, to Coquelles, France.
·It is about 31 miles long.

The student wants to compare the lengths of the two rail tunnels. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Some of the world’s rail tunnels, including one tunnel that extends from Folkestone, England, to Coquelles, France, are longer than 30 miles.
B. The Seikan Tunnel is roughly 33 miles long, while the slightly shorter Channel Tunnel is about 31 miles long.
C. The Seikan Tunnel, which is roughly 33 miles long, connects the Japanese islands of Honshu and Hokkaido.
D. Both the Seikan Tunnel, which is located in Japan, and the Channel Tunnel, which is located in Europe, are examples of rail tunnels.
explanations:
中文解析
选项B是最佳答案。这句话比较了两个铁路隧道的长度，指出英吉利海峡隧道（约31英里长）比青函隧道（大约33英里长）稍短。
题目文本解析
在研究一个主题时，学生做了以下笔记：
- 青函隧道是日本的一条铁路隧道。
- 它连接本州岛和北海道岛。
- 它大约长33英里。
- 英吉利海峡隧道是欧洲的一条铁路隧道。
- 它连接英格兰的福克斯通和法国的科凯尔。
- 它大约长31英里。

question:
Etched into Peru’s Nazca Desert are line drawings so large that they can only be fully seen from high above. Archaeologists have known of the lines since the 1920s, when a researcher spotted some from a nearby foothill, and they have been studying the markings ever since. ______ archaeologists’ efforts are aided by drones that capture high-resolution aerial photographs of the lines.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanations:
中文解析
选项A是最佳答案。“目前”在逻辑上表明考古学家使用无人机（这是一项当前技术）拍摄这些线条，是对前一句中描述的持续进行的考古研究的现代延续。
题目文本解析
在秘鲁的纳斯卡沙漠中，刻有如此巨大的线条图案，以至于只有从高空才能完全看到它们。考古学家自20世纪20年代以来就知道这些线条，当时一位研究者在附近的山坡上看到了其中一些，之后他们就一直在研究这些标记。______ 考古学家的工作得到了无人机的帮助，这些无人机能够拍摄高分辨率的航拍照片。

question:
In order to prevent nonnative fish species from moving freely between the Mediterranean and Red Seas, marine biologist Bella Galil has proposed that a saline lock system be installed along the Suez Canal in Egypt’s Great Bitter Lakes. The lock would increase the salinity of the lakes and ______ a natural barrier of water most marine creatures would be unable to cross.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 选项B是最佳答案。所测试的惯例是句子中非限定（无时态）动词形式的使用。情态动词“would”表示从过去的视角来看未来，应该与非限定的基本动词形式搭配使用。在这个选项中，非限定的基本动词“create”与非限定的基本动词“increase”正确地结合在一起，用来描述锁会做什么。

question:
After the United Kingdom began rolling out taxes equivalent to a few cents on single-use plastic grocery bags in 2011, plastic-bag consumption decreased by up to ninety ______ taxes are subject to what economists call the “rebound effect”: as the change became normalized, plastic-bag use started to creep back up.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanations: 选项C是最佳答案。所测试的惯例是句子之间标点符号的使用。在这个选项中，“percent”后的句号正确地标记了一个句子（“After…percent”）与另一个句子（“Such…up”）之间的界限。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·The Gullah are a group of African Americans who have lived in parts of the southeastern United States since the 18th century.
·Gullah culture is influenced by West African and Central African traditions.
·Louise Miller Cohen is a Gullah historian, storyteller, and preservationist.
·She founded the Gullah Museum of Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, in 2003.
·Vermelle Rodrigues is a Gullah historian, artist, and preservationist.
·She founded the Gullah Museum of Georgetown, South Carolina, in 2003.

The student wants to emphasize the duration and purpose of Cohen’s and Rodrigues’s work. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. At the Gullah Museums in Hilton Head Island and Georgetown, South Carolina, visitors can learn more about the Gullah people who have lived in the region for centuries.
B. Louise Miller Cohen and Vermelle Rodrigues have worked to preserve the culture of the Gullah people, who have lived in the United States since the 18th century.
C. Since 2003, Louise Miller Cohen and Vermelle Rodrigues have worked to preserve Gullah culture through their museums.
D. Influenced by the traditions of West and Central Africa, Gullah culture developed in parts of the southeastern United States in the 18th century.
explanations:
中文解析
选项C是最佳答案。这句话通过指出这两位女性自2003年以来一直在努力保护Gullah文化，强调了Cohen和Rodrigues工作的持续时间（时间长度）和目的。
题目文本解析
在研究一个主题时，学生做了以下笔记：
- Gullah是一个自18世纪以来居住在美国东南部部分地区的非裔美国人群体。
- Gullah文化受到西非和中非传统的影响。
- Louise Miller Cohen是一位Gullah历史学家、讲故事的人和文化保护者。
- 她于2003年创立了南卡罗来纳州希尔顿头岛的Gullah博物馆。
- Vermelle Rodrigues是一位Gullah历史学家、艺术家和文化保护者。
- 她于2003年创立了南卡罗来纳州乔治城的Gullah博物馆。

question:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
·Little is known about the life of Wong Fei-hung (1847–1925).
·He was born near Foshan, China, and gained local recognition as a physician and Hung Ga (also known as Hung Gar) Kung Fu master.
·He achieved many incredible martial arts feats—some confirmed and some rumored.
·He has become an internationally known folk hero thanks to his depiction in over a hundred films, television shows, and other media.
·In the 1991 film Once Upon a Time in China, actor Jet Li portrays Wong Fei-hung using superhuman kung fu abilities to save his community.

The student wants to emphasize the effect media had on building Wong Fei-hung’s legacy. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
selections: A. Thanks to his depiction in over a hundred pieces of media, Wong Fei-hung was locally known as a successful physician and Hung Ga Kung Fu master.
B. Though he was known locally during his lifetime, Wong Fei-hung’s later depiction in television, film, and other media has turned him into an internationally known folk hero.
C. Various media have depicted Wong Fei-hung, the successful physician and kung fu master who became an internationally known folk hero.
D. Wong Fei-hung’s abilities as a kung fu master are depicted in many media, including the 1991 film Once Upon a Time in China.
explanations:
中文解析
选项B是最佳答案。这句话强调了媒体在塑造黄飞鸿遗产方面所产生的影响，指出他去世后的媒体描绘将黄飞鸿转变为一个国际知名的民间英雄。
题目文本解析
在研究一个主题时，学生做了以下笔记：
- 关于黄飞鸿（1847–1925）的生活知之甚少。
- 他出生在中国佛山附近，因成为一名医生和洪家（又称洪拳）武术大师而获得当地的认可。
- 他完成了许多令人难以置信的武术壮举——有些是确认的，有些则是传闻。
- 由于在超过一百部电影、电视节目和其他媒体中的描绘，他已经成为一个国际知名的民间英雄。
- 在1991年的电影《黄飞鸿》中，演员李连杰饰演黄飞鸿，凭借超凡的武功能力拯救他的社区。
